1.en: Narrated by Shu'bah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from his father, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: That a woman suffered from istihadah in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and she was commanded. He said: I said to Abd al-Rahman, "Did the Prophet ﷺ command her?" He said, "I will not narrate anything to you about the Prophet ﷺ." He said: "So she was commanded to delay the Zuhr and hasten the Asr, and perform one ghusl for the two of them, and to delay the Maghrib and hasten the Isha, and perform one ghusl for the two of them, and to perform a ghusl for the Subh."
1.hi: Shu'bah ne bataya: Maine Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim se mustahaza aurat ke baare mein poocha, to unhone mujhe apne walid se, Aisha رضي الله عنها se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ke zamane mein ek aurat ko istihadah hua, aur usay hukum diya gaya. Unhone bataya: Maine Abd al-Rahman se poocha, "Kya Nabi ﷺ ne usay hukum diya tha?" Unhone kaha, "Main tumhein Nabi ﷺ ke baare mein kuch bhi bayaan nahi karunga [saaf tor par]." Unhone bataya: "So usay hukum diya gaya ke woh Zuhr der se padhe aur Asr jaldi, aur donon ke liye ek ghusl kare, aur Maghrib der se padhe aur Isha jaldi, aur donon ke liye ek ghusl kare, aur Subh ke liye ek ghusl kare."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : اسْتُحِيضَتْ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتُ جَحْشٍ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ، وَهِيَ تَحْتَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، فَاشْتَكَتْ ذَلِكَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ بِحِيضَةٍ، إِنَّمَا هُوَ عِرْقٌ، فَإِذَا أَقْبَلَتْ الْحَيْضَةُ فَدَعِي الصَّلَاةَ، وَإِذَا أَدْبَرَتْ، فَاغْتَسِلِي وَصَلِّي "، قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ : فَكَانَتْ تَغْتَسِلُ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ، ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي، قَالَتْ : وَكَانَتْ تَقْعُدُ فِي مِرْكَنٍ لِأُخْتِهَا زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ حَتَّى إِنَّ حُمْرَةَ الدَّمِ لَتَعْلُو الْمَاءَ
1.en: Aisha رضي الله عنها narrated: She said: Umm Habibah bint Jahsh suffered from istihadah for seven years, and she was married to Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf, and she complained of that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to her, "It is not menstruation, it is only a vein; so when the menstruation comes, leave the prayer, and when it departs, then perform ghusl and pray." Aisha said: So she used to perform ghusl for every prayer, then pray. She said: And she used to sit in a large basin belonging to her sister Zaynab bint Jahsh, until the redness of the blood would rise over the water.
1.hi: Aisha رضي الله عنها ne bataya: Umm Habibah bint Jahsh ko saat saal tak istihadah rahi, aur woh Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf ke nikaah mein thi, aur unhone iski shikayat Rasulullah ﷺ se ki, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne unse farmaya, "Yeh haiz nahi hai, yeh to bas ek rag hai; so jab haiz aaye to namaz chhod do, aur jab woh guzar jaaye, to ghusl karo aur namaz padho." Aisha ne bataya: So woh har namaz ke liye ghusl karti thin, fir namaz padhti thin. Unhone bataya: Aur woh apni behen Zaynab bint Jahsh ke ek bade tashtari mein baith jaati thin yahan tak ke khoon ki surkhi paani ke upar aa jaati thi.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ أَبِي حُبَيْشٍ ، قَالَتْ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي امْرَأَةٌ أُسْتَحَاضُ، أَفَأَتْرُكُ الصَّلَاةَ؟، قَالَ :" لَا، إِنَّمَا ذَلِكِ عِرْقٌ، وَلَيْسَتْ بِالْحِيضَةِ، فَإِذَا أَقْبَلَتْ الْحَيْضَةُ، فَاتْرُكِي الصَّلَاةَ، فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ قَدْرُهَا، فَاغْسِلِي عَنْكِ الدَّمَ وَتَوَضَّئِي وَصَلِّي "، قَالَ هِشَامٌ : فَكَانَ أَبِي يَقُولُ : تَغْتَسِلُ غُسْلَ الْأَوَّلِ ثُمَّ مَا يَكُونُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ، فَإِنَّهَا تَطَّهَّرُ وَتُصَلِّي
1.en: Aisha رضي الله عنها narrated: That Fatimah bint Abi Hubaysh said, "O Messenger of Allah, indeed I am a woman who has istihadah, shall I leave the prayer?" He said, "No, that is only a vein, and it is not menstruation; so when the menstruation comes, leave the prayer, and when its amount/period has passed, wash the blood off yourself and perform ablution and pray." Hisham said: My father used to say: She performs the first ghusl, then what comes after that, she purifies herself [with wudu] and prays.
1.hi: Aisha رضي الله عنها ne bataya ke Fatimah bint Abi Hubaysh ne kaha, "Ya Rasulullah, main aisi aurat hoon jise istihadah hoti hai, kya main namaz chhod dun?" Aapne farmaya, "Nahi, yeh to bas ek rag hai, aur yeh haiz nahi hai; so jab haiz aaye to namaz chhod do, aur jab uski muddat guzar jaaye, to apne aap se khoon dho lo aur wudu karo aur namaz padho." Hisham kehte hain: Mere walid kaha karte the: Woh pehla ghusl karti hai, fir jo iske baad hota hai, usmein woh sirf wudu karke paak ho jaati hai aur namaz padhti hai.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا  أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ   زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : أَنَّ امْرَأَةً كَانَتْ تُهَرَاقُ الدَّمَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَاسْتَفْتَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ لَهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ K :" لِتَنْظُرْ عَدَدَ اللَّيَالِي وَالْأَيَّامِ الَّتِي كَانَتْ تَحِيضُهُنَّ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَكُونَ بِهَا الَّذِي كَانَ، وَقَدْرَهُنَّ مِنْ الشَّهْرِ، فَتَتْرُكْ الصَّلَاةَ لِذَلِكَ، فَإِذَا خَلَفَتْ ذَلِكَ، وَحَضَرَتْ الصَّلَاةُ، فَلْتَغْتَسِلْ، وَلْتَسْتَثْفِرْ بِثَوْبٍ، ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي "
1.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Yasar, from a man, from Umm Salamah, wife of the Prophet ﷺ: That a woman used to have blood flow excessively in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so Umm Salamah sought a ruling for her from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to her, "Let her look at the number of nights and days in which she used to menstruate before that which befell her happened to her, and their extent of the month, so let her leave the prayer for that; then when she has passed that, and the prayer time comes, let her perform ghusl, and let her bind herself with a cloth, then pray."
1.hi: Sulayman ibn Yasar ne ek aadmi ke zariye Umm Salamah, Nabi ﷺ ki biwi, se bataya: Ek aurat ko Rasulullah ﷺ ke zamane mein bahut khoon aata tha, so Umm Salamah ne uski taraf se Rasulullah ﷺ se fatwa poocha, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne unse farmaya, "Woh un raaton aur dinon ki tadaad dekhe jinmein woh pehle haiz mein hoti thi, us se pehle ke ye [istihadah] hone laga, aur mahine mein unki miqdar, so unhi dinon namaz chhode; fir jab woh guzar jaayein, aur namaz ka waqt aaye, to woh ghusl kare, aur kapde se apne aap ko bandhe, fir namaz padhe."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، غَلَبَنِي الدَّمُ، قَالَ :" اغْتَسِلِي وَصَلِّي "
1.en: Umm Habibah رضي الله عنها narrated: She said, "O Messenger of Allah, the blood has overwhelmed me." He said, "Perform ghusl and pray."
1.hi: Umm Habibah رضي الله عنها ne kaha, "Ya Rasulullah, khoon ne mujhpar ghalba paa liya hai." Aapne farmaya, "Ghusl karo aur namaz padho."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الْهَاشِمِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ  ، أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتْ عَائِشَةَ   زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، تَقُولُ : جَاءَتْ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتُ جَحْشٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَكَانَتْ اسْتُحِيضَتْ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ، فَاشْتَكَتْ ذَلِكَ إِلَيْهِ، وَاسْتَفْتَتْهُ فِيهِ، فَقَالَ لَهَا :" إِنَّ هَذَا لَيْسَ بِالْحِيضَةِ، إِنَّمَا هَذَا عِرْقٌ، فَاغْتَسِلِي، ثُمَّ صَلِّي "، قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ : وَكَانَتْ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ تَغْتَسِلُ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ، وَتُصَلِّي، وَكَانَتْ تَجْلِسُ فِي الْمِرْكَنِ فَتَعْلُو حُمْرَةُ الدَّمِ الْمَاءَ، ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي
1.en: Narrated by Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman, from Aisha رضي الله عنها, wife of the Prophet ﷺ: That Umm Habibah bint Jahsh came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and she had suffered istihadah for seven years, so she complained of that to him, and sought a ruling from him about it, so he said to her, "This is not menstruation, this is only a vein, so perform ghusl, then pray." Aisha said: And Umm Habibah used to perform ghusl for every prayer, and pray, and she used to sit in the basin and the redness of the blood would rise over the water, then she would pray.
1.hi: Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman ne bataya ke unhone Aisha رضي الله عنها, Nabi ﷺ ki biwi, ko yeh kehte suna: Umm Habibah bint Jahsh Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aayin, aur unhein saat saal istihadah rahi tha, so unhone iski shikayat ki, aur iske baare mein fatwa poocha, to aapne unse farmaya, "Yeh haiz nahi hai, yeh to bas ek rag hai, so ghusl karo, fir namaz padho." Aisha ne bataya: Aur Umm Habibah har namaz ke liye ghusl karti thin, aur namaz padhti thin, aur woh tashtari mein baith jaati thin aur khoon ki surkhi paani ke upar aa jaati, fir woh namaz padhti thin.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ،  عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، أَنَّ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتَ جَحْشٍ كَانَتْ اسْتُحِيضَتْ فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَأَمَرَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" بِالْغُسْلِ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ، فَإِنْ كَانَتْ لَتَنْغَمِسُ فِي الْمِرْكَنِ، وَإِنَّهُ لَمَمْلُوءٌ مَاءً، ثُمَّ تَخْرُجُ مِنْهُ، وَإِنَّ الدَّمَ لَغَالِبهِ فَتُصَلِّي "، أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ  : " أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ بَادِيَةَ بِنْتَ غَيْلَانَ الثَّقَفِيَّةَ "، وَعَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَن عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : إِنَّمَا هِيَ سَهْلَةُ بِنْتُ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو اسْتُحِيضَتْ، وَأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ أَمَرَهَا " بِالْغُسْلِ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ "، فَلَمَّا جَهَدَهَا ذَلِكَ، أَمَرَ " أَنْ تَجْمَعَ بَيْنَ الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ فِي غُسْلٍ وَاحِدٍ، وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ فِي غُسْلٍ وَاحِدٍ، وَتَغْتَسِلَ لِلصُّبْحِ "، أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ : " إِنَّمَا جَاءَ اخْتِلَافُهُمْ أَنَّهُنَّ ثَلَاثَتَهُنَّ عِنْدَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ : هِيَ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ ، وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ : هِيَ بَادِيَةُ، وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ : هِيَ سَهْلَةُ بِنْتُ سُهَيْلٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Aisha, with an additional chain via al-Qasim and via Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim; and via Sa'd ibn Ibrahim: That Umm Habibah bint Jahsh had suffered istihadah in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded her "to perform ghusl for every prayer; and she would immerse herself in the basin while it was full of water, then come out of it, and the blood would be predominant over it, and she would pray." [Another chain, via al-Zuhri, from al-Qasim]: "that she was Badiyah bint Ghaylan al-Thaqafiyyah." And from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from his father, from Aisha, she said: "It was only Sahlah bint Suhayl ibn Amr who suffered istihadah, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had commanded her 'to perform ghusl at every prayer,' then when that exhausted her, he commanded 'that she combine between Zuhr and Asr in a single ghusl, and Maghrib and Isha in a single ghusl, and perform ghusl for Subh.'" [Another chain] from Sa'd ibn Ibrahim, who said: "Their disagreement only arose because all three of them were with Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf رضي الله عنه, so some of them said: she is Umm Habibah, and some of them said: she is Badiyah, and some of them said: she is Sahlah bint Suhayl."
1.hi: Aisha رضي الله عنها se, aur ek aur sanad Zuhri ke zariye Qasim se, aur ek aur Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim ke zariye apne walid se, aur ek aur Sa'd ibn Ibrahim se riwayat hai: Umm Habibah bint Jahsh ko Rasulullah ﷺ ke zamane mein istihadah hua, so Rasulullah ﷺ ne unhein hukum diya "ke har namaz ke liye ghusl karein; aur woh tashtari mein doobki lagaatin jabke woh paani se bhara hota, fir usse bahar aatin, aur khoon usmein ghalib hota, phir bhi woh namaz padhtin." [Ek aur sanad Zuhri se, Qasim se]: "ke woh Badiyah bint Ghaylan al-Thaqafiyyah thin." Aur Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim ne apne walid se, Aisha se bataya, unhone kaha: "Woh bas Sahlah bint Suhayl ibn Amr thin jinhein istihadah hua, aur Rasulullah ﷺ ne unhein hukum diya tha 'ke har namaz ke waqt ghusl karein,' fir jab yeh unhein thaka dene laga, to aapne hukum diya 'ke woh Zuhr aur Asr ke darmiyan ek ghusl se jama karein, aur Maghrib aur Isha ke darmiyan ek ghusl se, aur Subh ke liye ghusl karein.'" [Ek aur sanad] Sa'd ibn Ibrahim se, unhone kaha: "Unka ikhtilaaf isliye hua kyunki teenon Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf رضي الله عنه ke nikaah mein thin, so kuch ne kaha: woh Umm Habibah hain, aur kuch ne kaha: woh Badiyah hain, aur kuch ne kaha: woh Sahlah bint Suhayl hain."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى ، أَنَّ الْقَعْقَاعَ بْنَ حَكِيمٍ أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ سَعِيدًا  عَنْ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ، فَقَالَ : يَا ابْنَ أَخِي، مَا بَقِيَ أَحَدٌ أَعْلَمُ بِهَذَا مِنِّي :" إِذَا أَقْبَلَتْ الْحَيْضَةُ، فَلْتَدَعْ الصَّلَاةَ، وَإِذَا أَدْبَرَتْ فَلْتَغْتَسِلْ وَلْتُصَلِّ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Qa'qa' ibn Hakim, who asked Sa'id about the woman with istihadah: He said, "O son of my brother, no one remains more knowledgeable of this than me: 'When the menstruation comes, let her leave the prayer, and when it departs, let her perform ghusl and pray.'"
1.hi: Al-Qa'qa' ibn Hakim ne bataya ke unhone Sa'id se mustahaza aurat ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha, "Ae mere bhai ke bete, mujhse zyada iska ilm rakhne wala koi baaki nahi bacha: 'Jab haiz aaye, to woh namaz chhode, aur jab woh guzar jaaye, to ghusl kare aur namaz padhe.'"

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَمَّارٍ  مَوْلَى بَنِي هَاشِمٍ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ :" تَدَعُ الصَّلَاةَ أَيَّامَ أَقْرَائِهَا، ثُمَّ تَغْتَسِلُ ثُمَّ تَحْتَشِي وَتَسْتَثْفِرُ، ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي "، فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ : وَإِنْ كَانَ يَسِيلُ؟ قَالَ : " وَإِنْ كَانَ يَسِيلُ مِثْلَ هَذَا الْمَثْعَبِ "
1.en: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه narrated, concerning the woman with istihadah: "She leaves the prayer during the days of her cycles, then she performs ghusl, then she stuffs [cloth] and binds herself, then she prays." The man said, "And even if it flows?" He said, "Even if it flows like this gutter."
1.hi: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه ne mustahaza aurat ke baare mein bataya: "Woh apne [aadat ke] dinon mein namaz chhode, fir ghusl kare, fir [ruyi] bhare aur khud ko bandhe, fir namaz padhe." Aadmi ne poocha, "Agar woh bahta rahe [to bhi]?" Unhone kaha, "Agarche yeh is naali ki tarah bahta rahe."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ  ، عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا :" مِنْ أَشَدِّ النَّاسِ قَوْلًا فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ، ثُمَّ رَخَّصَ بَعْدُ : أَتَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ، فَقَالَتْ : أَدْخُلُ الْكَعْبَةَ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ؟، قَالَ : نَعَمْ، وَإِنْ كُنْتِ تَثُجِّينَهُ ثَجًّا، اسْتَدْخِلِي، ثُمَّ اسْتَثْفِرِي، ثُمَّ ادْخُلِي "
1.en: Narrated by Ammar ibn Abi Ammar, about Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: He said: Ibn Abbas was "among the strictest of people in speech concerning the woman with istihadah, then he later gave a concession: a woman came to him, and said, 'Shall I enter the Ka'bah while I am menstruating?' He said, 'Yes, and even if you are gushing it forth in a stream, insert [a cloth], then bind yourself, then enter.'"
1.hi: Ammar ibn Abi Ammar ne bataya: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما "mustahaza aurat ke baare mein logon mein sabse sakht baat karne walon mein se the, fir baad mein rukhsat de di: Ek aurat unke paas aayi, aur kaha, 'Kya main haiz ki haalat mein Ka'bah mein dakhil ho sakti hoon?' Unhone kaha, 'Haan, agarche tum use dhaar ki tarah bahaa rahi ho, [kapda] andar rakho, fir khud ko bandho, fir dakhil ho jao.'"

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ قَمِيرَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : سَأَلْتُهَا عَنْ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ، قَالَتْ :" تَنْتَظِرُ أَقْرَاءَهَا الَّتِي كَانَتْ تَتْرُكُ فِيهَا الصَّلَاةَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ، فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ طُهْرِهَا الَّذِي كَانَتْ تَطْهُرُ فِيهِ، اغْتَسَلَتْ، ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَتْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ وَصَلَّتْ "، أَخْبَرَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ مُعْتَمِرٍ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ  مِنْ حَيِّهِ ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ  ، مِثْلَ مَا قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا
1.en: Narrated by Qamir, from Aisha رضي الله عنها; a similar report also given from a man of the tribe, from Abu Ja'far: She said: I asked her about the woman with istihadah, she said: "She waits for her cycles in which she used to leave the prayer before that; then when the day of her purity comes, in which she used to become pure, she performs ghusl, then she performs ablution at every prayer and prays." [Another chain] from a man of his tribe, from Abu Ja'far, similar to what Aisha رضي الله عنها said.
1.hi: Qamir ne bataya: Maine Aisha رضي الله عنها se mustahaza aurat ke baare mein poocha, unhone bataya: "Woh apne un [aadat ke] dinon ka intezaar kare jinmein woh pehle namaz chhoda karti thi; fir jab uski paaki ka woh din aaye jismein woh pehle paak hoti thi, to woh ghusl kare, fir har namaz ke waqt wudu kare aur namaz padhe." [Ek aur sanad] apni qaum ke ek shakhs se, Abu Ja'far se, jaisa Aisha رضي الله عنها ne kaha.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ قَمِيرَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ :" تَنْتَظِرُ أَيَّامَهَا الَّتِي كَانَتْ تَتْرُكُ الصَّلَاةَ فِيهَا، فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ طُهْرِهَا الَّذِي كَانَتْ تَطْهُرُ فِيهِ، اغْتَسَلَتْ ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَتْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ وَصَلَّتْ "
1.en: Aisha رضي الله عنها narrated, concerning the woman with istihadah: "She waits for her days in which she used to leave the prayer; then when the day of her purity comes, in which she used to become pure, she performs ghusl, then she performs ablution at every prayer and prays."
1.hi: Aisha رضي الله عنها ne mustahaza aurat ke baare mein bataya: "Woh apne un dinon ka intezaar kare jinmein woh namaz chhoda karti thi; fir jab uski paaki ka din aaye jismein woh paak hoti thi, to woh ghusl kare, fir har namaz ke waqt wudu kare aur namaz padhe."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْيَقْظَانِ  ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ تَدَعُ الصَّلَاةَ أَيَّامَ حَيْضِهَا فِي كُلِّ شَهْرٍ، فَإِذَا كَانَ عِنْدَ انْقِضَائِهَا، اغْتَسَلَتْ، وَصَلَّتْ، وَصَامَتْ، وَتَوَضَّأَتْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Adi ibn Thabit, from his father, from his grandfather رضي الله عنه, from the Prophet ﷺ: That he said, "The woman with istihadah leaves the prayer during the days of her menstruation in every month; then when it comes to its ending, she performs ghusl, and prays, and fasts, and performs ablution at every prayer."
1.hi: Adi ibn Thabit ne apne walid se, unhone apne dada رضي الله عنه se, Nabi ﷺ ka farmaan naql kiya: "Mustahaza aurat har mahine apne haiz ke dinon mein namaz chhode; fir jab woh khatam ho jaaye, to woh ghusl kare, aur namaz padhe, aur roza rakhe, aur har namaz ke waqt wudu kare."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ كَثِيرٍ  ، وَحَفْصٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ   فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ الَّتِي تَعْرِفُ أَيَّامَ حَيْضَتِهَا إِذَا طُلِّقَتْ فَيَطُولُ بِهَا الدَّمُ :" فَإِنَّهَا تَعْتَدُّ قَدْرَ أَقْرَائِهَا ثَلَاثَ حِيَضٍ، وَفِي الصَّلَاةِ إِذَا جَاءَ وَقْتُ الْحَيْضِ فِي كُلِّ شَهْرٍ، أَمْسَكَتْ عَنْ الصَّلَاةِ "
1.en: Narrated by Kathir and Hafs, from al-Hasan, concerning the woman with istihadah who knows the days of her menstruation, if she is divorced and the blood continues long with her: "She observes her waiting period by the extent of her cycles, three menstruations; and as for the prayer, when the time of menstruation comes in every month, she withholds from the prayer."
1.hi: Kathir aur Hafs ne al-Hasan se, us mustahaza aurat ke baare mein bataya jo apne haiz ke dinon ko jaanti ho, agar use talaaq de di jaaye aur khoon uspar lamba chalta rahe: "Woh apni iddat apne [aadat ke] chakron ke barabar, teen haiz, guzaare; aur namaz ke maamle mein, jab har mahine haiz ka waqt aaye, to woh namaz se ruk jaaye."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِقَتَادَةَ : " امْرَأَةٌ كَانَ حَيْضُهَا مَعْلُومًا، فَزَادَتْ عَلَيْهِ خَمْسَةَ أَيَّامٍ، أَوْ أَرْبَعَةَ أَيَّامٍ، أَوْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ؟، قَالَ : تُصَلِّي، قُلْتُ : يَوْمَيْنِ؟، قَالَ : ذَاكَ مِنْ حَيْضِهَا "، وَسَأَلْتُ ابْنَ سِيرِينَ ، قَالَ :" النِّسَاءُ أَعْلَمُ بِذَلِكَ "
1.en: Narrated by Mu'tamir, from his father: He said: I said to Qatadah, "A woman whose menstruation was known, and it increased over it by five days, or four days, or three days?" He said, "She prays." I said, "[What about] two days?" He said, "That is from her menstruation." And I asked Ibn Sirin, he said: "Women know that better."
1.hi: Mu'tamir ne apne walid se bataya: Maine Qatadah se poocha, "Ek aurat jiska haiz maloom ho, aur usmein paanch din, ya chaar din, ya teen din ka izafa ho jaaye [to kya hukum hai]?" Unhone kaha, "Woh namaz padhe." Maine poocha, "[Aur agar] do din [ho]?" Unhone kaha, "Woh uske haiz mein se hai." Aur maine Ibn Sirin se poocha, unhone kaha: "Auratein isay behtar jaanti hain."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ   فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَرَى الدَّمَ أَيَّامَ طُهْرِهَا، قَالَ :" أَرَى أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ وَتُصَلِّيَ "
1.en: Narrated by Mu'tamir, from his father, from al-Hasan, concerning the woman who sees blood during the days of her purity: He said: "I hold that she should perform ghusl and pray."
1.hi: Mu'tamir ne apne walid se, al-Hasan se, us aurat ke baare mein bataya jo apni paaki ke dinon mein khoon dekhe: Unhone kaha, "Meri raay hai ke woh ghusl kare aur namaz padhe."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ بَهْرَامَ  ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ  ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ   عَنْ الْمَرْأَةِ تُسْتَحَاضُ؟، قَالَ :" تَنْتَظِرُ قَدْرَ مَا كَانَتْ تَحِيضُ، فَلْتُحَرِّمْ الصَّلَاةَ، ثُمَّ لِتَغْتَسِلْ، وَلْتُصَلِّ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ أَوَانُهَا الَّذِي تَحِيضُ فِيهِ، فَلْتُحَرِّمْ الصَّلَاةَ ثُمَّ لِتَغْتَسِلْ، فَإِنَّمَا ذَاكَ مِنْ الشَّيْطَانِ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُكْفِرَ إِحْدَاهُنَّ "
1.en: Narrated by Shahr ibn Hawshab: He said: Ibn Abbas was asked about the woman who suffers istihadah, so he said: "She waits the extent of what she used to menstruate, then let her forbid the prayer to herself, then let her perform ghusl and pray, until when it is her time in which she [normally] menstruates, then let her forbid the prayer, then let her perform ghusl; for that is only from Shaytan, who wants to make one of them disbelieve."
1.hi: Shahr ibn Hawshab ne bataya: Ibn Abbas se ek aisi aurat ke baare mein poocha gaya jise istihadah ho, to unhone kaha: "Woh utna intezaar kare jitna woh pehle haiz mein rahi thi, fir apne upar namaz haraam kare, fir ghusl kare aur namaz padhe, yahan tak ke jab uska woh waqt aaye jismein woh [aam tor par] haiz mein hoti hai, to woh apne upar namaz haraam kare, fir ghusl kare; kyunki woh [ziyaada khoon] to bas shaytan ki taraf se hai jo chahta hai ke woh kufr mein pad jaaye."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاق ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ :" تَدَعُ الصَّلَاةَ أَيَّامَ أَقْرَائِهَا، ثُمَّ تَغْتَسِلُ وَتَحْتَشِي كُرْسُفًا، وَتَوَضَّأُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali, Abu Ja'far, concerning the woman with istihadah: He said: "She leaves the prayer during the days of her cycles, then she performs ghusl and stuffs cotton, and performs ablution at every prayer."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Ali, Abu Ja'far, ne mustahaza aurat ke baare mein bataya: "Woh apne [aadat ke] dinon mein namaz chhode, fir ghusl kare aur ruyi bhare, aur har namaz ke waqt wudu kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ فِرَاسٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ قَمِيرَ  امْرَأَةِ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ :" الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ تَجْلِسُ أَيَّامَ أَقْرَائِهَا، ثُمَّ تَغْتَسِلُ غُسْلًا وَاحِدًا، وَتَتَوَضَّأُ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Qamir, the wife of Masruq, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: She said: "The woman with istihadah sits during the days of her cycles, then she performs a single ghusl, and performs ablution for every prayer."
1.hi: Qamir, Masruq ki biwi, ne Aisha رضي الله عنها se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Mustahaza aurat apne [aadat ke] dinon mein baithi rahe [namaz na padhe], fir woh ek hi ghusl kare, aur har namaz ke liye wudu kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، قَالَ : اسْتُحِيضَتْ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ آلِ أَنَسٍ فَأَمَرُونِي، فَسَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ  ، فَقَالَ :" أَمَّا مَا رَأَتْ الدَّمَ الْبَحْرَانِيَّ، فَلَا تُصَلِّي، فَإِذَا رَأَتْ الطُّهْرَ وَلَوْ سَاعَةً مِنْ نَهَارٍ، فَلْتَغْتَسِلْ وَلْتُصَلِّ "
1.en: Narrated by Anas ibn Sirin, from Ibn Abbas: He said: A woman from the family of Anas suffered istihadah, so they commanded me [to ask], so I asked Ibn Abbas, and he said: "As for when she sees the dark reddish-black blood, she does not pray; but when she sees purity, even for an hour of the day, let her perform ghusl and pray."
1.hi: Anas ibn Sirin ne bataya: Anas ke gharwalon mein se ek aurat ko istihadah hua, so unhone mujhe hukum diya [ke poochun], so maine Ibn Abbas se poocha, to unhone kaha: "Jab woh gehra surkh-siyaah khoon dekhe, to woh namaz na padhe; lekin jab woh saafi (paaki) dekhe, chahe din ke ek ghante ke liye hi ho, to woh ghusl kare aur namaz padhe."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَتْ أُمُّ وَلَدٍ لِأَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ اسْتُحِيضَتْ،  فَأَمَرُونِي أَنْ أَسْتَفْتِيَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا فَسَأَلْتُهُ، فَقَالَ :" إِذَا رَأَتْ الدَّمَ الْبَحْرَانِيَّ، فَلَا تُصَلِّي، فَإِذَا رَأَتْ الطُّهْرَ، فَلْتَغْتَسِلْ وَلْتُصَلِّ "
1.en: Narrated by Anas ibn Sirin, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: He said: A slave-mother of Anas ibn Malik suffered istihadah, so they commanded me to seek a ruling from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما, so I asked him, and he said: "When she sees the dark reddish-black blood, she does not pray; but when she sees purity, let her perform ghusl and pray."
1.hi: Anas ibn Sirin ne bataya: Anas ibn Malik ki umm-e-walad ko istihadah hua, so unhone mujhe hukum diya ke main Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se fatwa poochun, so maine unse poocha, to unhone kaha: "Jab woh gehra surkh-siyaah khoon dekhe, to woh namaz na padhe; lekin jab woh saafi dekhe, to woh ghusl kare aur namaz padhe."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ نُصَيْرٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ ، عَنْ الضَّحَّاكِ  : أَنَّ امْرَأَةً سَأَلَتْهُ، فَقَالَتْ : إِنِّي امْرَأَةٌ أُسْتَحَاضُ، فَقَالَ :" إِذَا رَأَيْتِ دَمًا عَبِيطًا، فَأَمْسِكِي أَيَّامَ أَقْرَائِكِ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Dahhak: That a woman asked him, and said, "I am a woman who has istihadah." He said, "When you see fresh red blood, then withhold [from prayer] during the days of your cycles."
1.hi: Al-Dahhak se bataya gaya ke ek aurat ne unse poocha, aur kaha, "Main aisi aurat hoon jise istihadah hoti hai." Unhone kaha, "Jab tum taaza surkh khoon dekho, to apne [aadat ke] dinon mein [namaz se] ruk jao."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ تَجْلِسُ أَيَّامَ أَقْرَائِهَا، ثُمَّ تَغْتَسِلُ لِلظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ غُسْلًا وَاحِدًا، وَتُؤَخِّرُ الْمَغْرِبَ وَتُعَجِّلُ الْعِشَاءَ وَذَلِكَ فِي وَقْتِ الْعِشَاءِ، وَلِلْفَجْرِ غُسْلًا وَاحِدًا، وَلَا تَصُومُ، وَلَا يَأْتِيهَا زَوْجُهَا، وَلَا تَمَسُّ الْمُصْحَفَ "
1.en: Narrated by Ibrahim: He said: "The woman with istihadah sits during the days of her cycles, then she performs a single ghusl for Zuhr and Asr, and she delays Maghrib and hastens Isha, that being within the time of Isha, and a single ghusl for Fajr; and she does not fast, and her husband does not come to her, and she does not touch the Mushaf."
1.hi: Ibrahim ne bataya: "Mustahaza aurat apne [aadat ke] dinon mein baithi rahe, fir Zuhr aur Asr ke liye ek hi ghusl kare, aur Maghrib der se aur Isha jaldi padhe, aur yeh Isha ke waqt mein ho, aur Fajr ke liye ek ghusl kare; aur woh roza na rakhe, aur uska shohar uske paas na aaye, aur woh Mushaf ko na chhue."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا يَقُولُ فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ :" تَغْتَسِلُ غُسْلًا وَاحِدًا لِلظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ، وَغُسْلًا لِلْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ "، وَكَانَ يَقُولُ : " تُؤَخِّرُ الظُّهْرَ وَتُعَجِّلُ الْعَصْرَ وَتُؤَخِّرُ الْمَغْرِبَ وَتُعَجِّلُ الْعِشَاءَ "
1.en: Narrated by Ata, about Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: He said: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما used to say concerning the woman with istihadah: "She performs a single ghusl for Zuhr and Asr, and a ghusl for Maghrib and Isha." And he used to say: "She delays Zuhr and hastens Asr, and delays Maghrib and hastens Isha."
1.hi: Ata ne bataya: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما mustahaza aurat ke baare mein kaha karte the: "Woh Zuhr aur Asr ke liye ek ghusl kare, aur Maghrib aur Isha ke liye ek ghusl kare." Aur woh kaha karte the: "Woh Zuhr der se aur Asr jaldi padhe, aur Maghrib der se aur Isha jaldi padhe."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ إِذَا خَلَفَتْ قُرُوءُهَا :" فَإِذَا كَانَ عِنْدَ الْعَصْرِ تَوَضَّأَتْ وُضُوءًا سَابِغًا ثُمَّ لِتَأْخُذْ ثَوْبًا، فَلْتَسْتَثْفِرْ بِهِ، ثُمَّ لِتُصَلِّ الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ جَمِيعًا، ثُمَّ لِتَفْعَلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ لِتُصَلِّ الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ جَمِيعًا، ثُمَّ لِتَفْعَلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي الصُّبْحَ "
1.en: Narrated by Mujahid, concerning the woman with istihadah when her cycles have passed: "When it is time for Asr, she performs a complete ablution, then let her take a cloth and bind herself with it, then let her pray Zuhr and Asr together; then let her do the same, then let her pray Maghrib and Isha together; then let her do the same, then she prays Subh."
1.hi: Mujahid ne, us mustahaza aurat ke baare mein bataya jiske [aadat ke] chakr guzar chuke hon: "Jab Asr ka waqt aaye to woh mukammal wudu kare, fir ek kapda le aur usse khud ko bandhe, fir Zuhr aur Asr ekathay padhe; fir isi tarah kare, fir Maghrib aur Isha ekathay padhe; fir isi tarah kare, fir Subh padhe."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، وَسَعِيدٍ ، وَعِكْرِمَةَ ، قَالُوا : فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ :" تَغْتَسِلُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ لِصَلَاةِ الْأُولَى وَالْعَصْرِ، فَتُصَلِّيهِمَا، وَتَغْتَسِلُ لِلْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ فَتُصَلِّيهِمَا، وَتَغْتَسِلُ لِصَلَاةِ الْغَدَاةِ "
1.en: Narrated by Ata, Sa'id, and Ikrimah, concerning the woman with istihadah: They said: "She performs ghusl every day for the first prayer and Asr, and prays them both, and performs ghusl for Maghrib and Isha and prays them both, and performs ghusl for the morning prayer."
1.hi: Ata, Sa'id, aur Ikrimah ne mustahaza aurat ke baare mein bataya: Unhone kaha, "Woh har din Zuhr aur Asr ke liye ghusl kare aur dono padhe, aur Maghrib aur Isha ke liye ghusl kare aur dono padhe, aur Fajr ke liye ghusl kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُبَيْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنٌ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ ، قَالَ :" الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ تَغْتَسِلُ، ثُمَّ تَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ، فَإِنْ رَأَتْ شَيْئًا اغْتَسَلَتْ وَجَمَعَتْ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ "
1.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Shaddad: He said: "The woman with istihadah performs ghusl, then combines between Zuhr and Asr; then if she sees something [more blood], she performs ghusl and combines between Maghrib and Isha."
1.hi: Abdullah ibn Shaddad ne bataya: "Mustahaza aurat ghusl kare, fir Zuhr aur Asr ko jama kare; fir agar use kuch [aur khoon] nazar aaye, to woh ghusl kare aur Maghrib aur Isha ko jama kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ سُمَيٍّ ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيِّبِ  عَنْ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ، فَقَالَ :" تَجْلِسُ أَيَّامَ أَقْرَائِهَا، وَتَغْتَسِلُ مِنْ الظُّهْرِ إِلَى الظُّهْرِ، وَتَسْتَذْفِرُ بِثَوْبٍ، وَيَأْتِيهَا زَوْجُهَا، وَتَصُومُ "، فَقُلْتُ : عَمَّنْ هَذَا؟ فَأَخَذَ الْحَصَا
1.en: Narrated by Sumayy: He said: I asked Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab about the woman with istihadah, and he said: "She sits during the days of her cycles, and performs ghusl from Zuhr to Zuhr, and binds herself with a cloth, and her husband comes to her, and she fasts." So I said, "From whom is this?" So he took up the pebble [and remained silent].
1.hi: Sumayy ne bataya: Maine Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se mustahaza aurat ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: "Woh apne [aadat ke] dinon mein baithi rahe, aur Zuhr se Zuhr tak ghusl kare, aur kapde se khud ko bandhe, aur uska shohar uske paas aa sakta hai, aur woh roza rakhe." Maine poocha, "Yeh kiski riwayat hai?" To unhone kankari uthaa li [aur khamosh ho gaye].

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ ، قَالَ :" تَغْتَسِلُ مِنْ ظُهْرٍ إِلَى ظُهْرٍ، وَتَتَوَضَّأُ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ، فَإِنْ غَلَبَهَا الدَّمُ اسْتَثْفَرَتْ "، وَكَانَ الْحَسَنُ يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ
1.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab; al-Hasan used to say the same: He said: "She performs ghusl from Zuhr to Zuhr, and performs ablution for every prayer; then if the blood overwhelms her, she binds herself." And al-Hasan used to say that.
1.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab ne bataya: "Woh Zuhr se Zuhr tak ghusl kare, aur har namaz ke liye wudu kare; fir agar khoon uspar ghalib aa jaaye, to woh khud ko bandhe." Aur al-Hasan bhi yehi kehte the.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى ، أَنَّ سُمَيًّا مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّ الْقَعْقَاعَ بْنَ حَكِيمٍ، وَزَيْدَ بْنَ أَسْلَمَ أَرْسَلَاهُ إِلَى سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  يَسْأَلُهُ كَيْفَ تَغْتَسِلُ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ؟، فَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ :" تَغْتَسِلُ مِنْ الظُّهْرِ إِلَى مِثْلِهَا مِنْ الْغَدِ لِصَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ، فَإِنْ غَلَبَهَا الدَّمُ اسْتَثْفَرَتْ، وَتَوَضَّأَتْ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ، وَصَلَّتْ "
1.en: Narrated by Sumayy, freed servant of Abu Bakr ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Harith ibn Hisham, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab: That al-Qa'qa' ibn Hakim and Zayd ibn Aslam sent him to Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab to ask him how the woman with istihadah performs ghusl; Sa'id said: "She performs ghusl from Zuhr to its like the next day for the Zuhr prayer; then if the blood overwhelms her, she binds herself, and performs ablution for every prayer, and prays."
1.hi: Sumayy, Abu Bakr ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Harith ibn Hisham ke azaad kiye hue ghulam, ne bataya ke al-Qa'qa' ibn Hakim aur Zayd ibn Aslam ne unhein Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab ke paas bheja yeh poochne ke mustahaza aurat kaise ghusl kare; Sa'id ne kaha: "Woh Zuhr se agle din Zuhr ki namaz ke waqt tak ghusl kare; fir agar khoon uspar ghalib aa jaaye, to woh khud ko bandhe, aur har namaz ke liye wudu kare, aur namaz padhe."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ ، عَنْ مُعْتَمِرٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ :" تَغْتَسِلُ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ إِلَى صَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ مِنْ الْغَدِ "
1.en: Narrated by Mu'tamir, from his father, from al-Hasan, concerning the woman with istihadah: "She performs ghusl from the Zuhr prayer to the Zuhr prayer of the next day."
1.hi: Mu'tamir ne apne walid se, al-Hasan se, mustahaza aurat ke baare mein bataya: "Woh Zuhr ki namaz se agle din Zuhr ki namaz tak ghusl kare."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ تَدَعُ الصَّلَاةَ أَيَّامَ حَيْضِهَا مِنْ الشَّهْرِ، ثُمَّ تَغْتَسِلُ مِنْ الظُّهْرِ إِلَى الظُّهْرِ، وَتَوَضَّأُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ، وَتَصُومُ وَتُصَلِّي، وَيَأْتِيهَا زَوْجُهَا "، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، وَعَطَاءٍ  مثل ذلك
1.en: Narrated by Humayd, from al-Hasan; a similar report also from Abbad ibn Mansur, from al-Hasan and Ata: He said: "The woman with istihadah leaves the prayer during the days of her menstruation of the month, then she performs ghusl from Zuhr to Zuhr, and performs ablution at every prayer, and fasts and prays, and her husband comes to her." [Another chain] from Abbad ibn Mansur, from al-Hasan and Ata, similarly.
1.hi: Humayd ne al-Hasan se bataya: "Mustahaza aurat mahine mein apne haiz ke dinon namaz chhode, fir woh Zuhr se Zuhr tak ghusl kare, aur har namaz ke waqt wudu kare, aur roza rakhe aur namaz padhe, aur uska shohar uske paas aa sakta hai." [Ek aur sanad] Abbad ibn Mansur se, al-Hasan aur Ata se, isi tarah.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ قَمِيرَ  امْرَأَةِ مَسْرُوقٍ : أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ :" تَغْتَسِلُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ مَرَّةً "
1.en: Narrated by Da'ud, from al-Sha'bi, from Qamir, wife of Masruq, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: That Aisha رضي الله عنها said, concerning the woman with istihadah: "She performs ghusl once every day."
1.hi: Da'ud ne al-Sha'bi se, Qamir, Masruq ki biwi, se bataya: Aisha رضي الله عنها ne mustahaza aurat ke baare mein kaha: "Woh har din ek martaba ghusl kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ  ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ  ، عَنْ مُقَاتِلِ بْنِ حَيَّانَ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ :" تَغْتَسِلُ مِنْ ظُهْرٍ إِلَى ظُهْرٍ "، قَالَ مَرْوَانُ : وَهُوَ قَوْلُ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ
1.en: Narrated by Bukayr ibn Ma'ruf, from Muqatil ibn Hayyan, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه; Marwan noted this was also al-Awza'i's view: That he used to say, concerning the woman with istihadah: "She performs ghusl from Zuhr to Zuhr." Marwan said: And that is the saying of al-Awza'i.
1.hi: Bukayr ibn Ma'ruf ne Muqatil ibn Hayyan se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه se bataya: Woh mustahaza aurat ke baare mein kaha karte the: "Woh Zuhr se Zuhr tak ghusl kare." Marwan kehte hain: Aur yehi al-Awza'i ka bhi qaul hai.

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ ، قَالَ :" الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ تَغْتَسِلُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ عِنْدَ صَلَاةِ الْأُولَى "
1.en: Narrated by Abd al-Karim, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab: He said: "The woman with istihadah performs ghusl every day at the time of the first prayer."
1.hi: Abd al-Karim ne Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se bataya: "Mustahaza aurat har din pehli namaz (Zuhr) ke waqt ghusl kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَتَّابٌ هُوَ ابْنُ بَشِيرٍ الْجَزَرِيُّ  ، عَنْ خُصَيْفٍ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ :" لَمْ يَرَ بَأْسًا أَنْ يَأْتِيَهَا زَوْجُهَا "
1.en: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه narrated, concerning the woman with istihadah: "He did not see any harm in her husband coming to her."
1.hi: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه ne mustahaza aurat ke baare mein bataya: "Unhein uske shohar ke uske paas aane mein koi harj nazar nahi aaya."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ الْأَفْطَسِ ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ  : أَتُجَامَعُ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ؟ ، فَقَالَ :" الصَّلَاةُ أَعْظَمُ مِنْ الْجِمَاعِ "
1.en: Narrated by Salim al-Aftas, about Sa'id ibn Jubayr: He said: Sa'id ibn Jubayr was asked, "Is the woman with istihadah to be had intercourse with?" So he said, "The prayer is greater than intercourse."
1.hi: Salim al-Aftas ne bataya: Sa'id ibn Jubayr se poocha gaya, "Kya mustahaza aurat se jima kiya jaa sakta hai?" To unhone kaha, "Namaz jima se bhi bada [ahamiyat wala] hai [aur woh namaz padhti hai]."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ سُمَيٍّ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ ، قَالَ :" يَأْتِيهَا زَوْجُهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Sumayy, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab: He said, "Her husband comes to her."
1.hi: Sumayy ne Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Uska shohar uske paas aa sakta hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ، قَالَ :" يَغْشَاهَا زَوْجُهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Yunus, from al-Hasan, concerning the woman with istihadah: He said, "Her husband has [marital] relations with her."
1.hi: Yunus ne al-Hasan se, mustahaza aurat ke baare mein bataya: Unhone kaha, "Uska shohar uske saath sohbat kar sakta hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ ، قَالَ فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ :" يَغْشَاهَا زَوْجُهَا وَإِنْ قَطَرَ الدَّمُ عَلَى الْحَصِيرِ "
1.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Muslim, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, concerning the woman with istihadah: He said: "Her husband has relations with her even if the blood drips onto the mat."
1.hi: Abdullah ibn Muslim ne Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, mustahaza aurat ke baare mein bataya: Unhone kaha, "Uska shohar uske saath sohbat kar sakta hai agarche khoon chatai par tapak jaaye."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ ، قَالَ : قِيلَ لِبَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ الْحَجَّاجَ بْنَ يُوسُفَ، يَقُولُ :" إِنَّ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةَ لَا يَغْشَاهَا زَوْجُهَا "، قَالَ بَكْرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِيُّ  : " الصَّلَاةُ أَعْظَمُ حُرْمَةً يَغْشَاهَا زَوْجُهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Humayd, about Bakr ibn Abdullah al-Muzani: He said: It was said to Bakr ibn Abdullah, "Indeed al-Hajjaj ibn Yusuf says, 'The woman with istihadah, her husband does not have relations with her.'" Bakr ibn Abdullah al-Muzani said: "The prayer has greater sanctity; her husband has relations with her."
1.hi: Humayd ne bataya: Bakr ibn Abdullah se kaha gaya, "Hajjaj ibn Yusuf kehta hai, 'Mustahaza aurat se uska shohar sohbat nahi kar sakta.'" Bakr ibn Abdullah al-Muzani ne kaha, "Namaz ki hurmat [ehmiyat] zyada hai [aur uski ijaazat hai], uska shohar uske saath sohbat kar sakta hai."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" يَأْتِيهَا زَوْجُهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Hammad ibn Zayd, from Humayd, from al-Hasan: He said, "Her husband comes to her."
1.hi: Hammad ibn Zayd ne Humayd se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Uska shohar uske paas aa sakta hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ :" يُجَامِعُهَا زَوْجُهَا، تَدَعُ الصَّلَاةَ أَيَّامَ حَيْضِهَا، فَإِذَا حَلَّتْ لَهَا الصَّلَاةُ، فَلْيَطَأْهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Abdullah, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Ata, concerning the woman with istihadah: He said: "Her husband has intercourse with her; she leaves the prayer during the days of her menstruation, then when the prayer becomes lawful for her, let him have intercourse with her."
1.hi: Khalid ibn Abdullah ne Ata ibn al-Sa'ib se, Ata se, mustahaza aurat ke baare mein bataya: Unhone kaha, "Uska shohar uske saath sohbat kar sakta hai; woh apne haiz ke dinon mein namaz chhode, fir jab uske liye namaz halal ho jaaye, to shohar uske saath sohbat kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ زُرْعَةَ الْخَارِفِيُّ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ يُجَامِعُهَا زَوْجُهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Umar ibn Zur'ah al-Kharifi, from Muhammad ibn Salim, from al-Sha'bi, from Ali رضي الله عنه: He said, "The woman with istihadah, her husband has intercourse with her."
1.hi: Umar ibn Zur'ah al-Kharifi ne Muhammad ibn Salim se, al-Sha'bi se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) رضي الله عنه se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Mustahaza aurat se uska shohar sohbat kar sakta hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ ، وَالْحَسَنِ ، وَعَطَاءٍ ، قَالُوا فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ :" تَغْتَسِلُ وَتُصَلِّي، وَتَصُومُ رَمَضَانَ، وَيَغْشَاهَا زَوْجُهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Abu Awanah, from Qatadah, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, al-Hasan, and Ata, concerning the woman with istihadah: They said: "She performs ghusl and prays, and fasts Ramadan, and her husband has relations with her."
1.hi: Abu Awanah ne Qatadah se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, al-Hasan, aur Ata se, mustahaza aurat ke baare mein bataya: Unhone kaha, "Woh ghusl kare aur namaz padhe, aur Ramzan ke roze rakhe, aur uska shohar uske saath sohbat kar sakta hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ حَفْصٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ : كَانَ يَقُولُ : الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ لَا يَغْشَاهَا زَوْجُهَا، قَالَ أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ : قَالَ لِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ :" لَا أَعْلَمُ أَحَدًا قَالَ هَذَا عَنْ الْحَسَنِ "
1.en: Narrated by Hafs, from al-Hasan; Abu al-Nu'man notes Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Qattan's remark: He said: He used to say: "The woman with istihadah, her husband does not have relations with her." Abu al-Nu'man said: Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Qattan said to me: "I do not know of anyone who said this from al-Hasan."
1.hi: Hafs ne al-Hasan se bataya: Woh kaha karte the: "Mustahaza aurat se uska shohar sohbat nahi kar sakta." Abu al-Nu'man kehte hain: Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Qattan ne mujhse kaha: "Mujhe kisi ke bare mein nahi maloom jisne yeh baat al-Hasan se naql ki ho."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ ،  عَنْ خَالِدٍ ، قَالَ :" كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ  يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَغْشَى الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ "
1.en: Narrated by Khalid: He said: "Muhammad [ibn Sirin] used to dislike that a man have relations with his wife while she has istihadah."
1.hi: Khalid ne bataya: "Muhammad (Ibn Sirin) is baat ko na-pasand karte the ke koi aadmi apni biwi se sohbat kare jabke woh mustahaza ho."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ لَا يَأْتِيهَا زَوْجُهَا، وَلَا تَصُومُ ، وَلَا تَمَسُّ الْمُصْحَفَ "
1.en: Narrated by Sufyan, from Mansur, from Ibrahim: He said: "The woman with istihadah, her husband does not come to her, and she does not fast, and she does not touch the Mushaf."
1.hi: Sufyan ne Mansur se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Mustahaza aurat ke paas uska shohar nahi aata, aur woh roza nahi rakhti, aur woh Mushaf ko nahi chhooti."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ الْأَعْوَرُ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ قَمِيرَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ :" الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ لَا يَأْتِيهَا زَوْجُهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Abd al-Malik ibn Maysarah, from al-Sha'bi, from Qamir, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: She said: "The woman with istihadah, her husband does not come to her."
1.hi: Abd al-Malik ibn Maysarah ne al-Sha'bi se, Qamir se, Aisha رضي الله عنها se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Mustahaza aurat ke paas uska shohar nahi aata."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ : كَانَ يُقَالُ :" الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ لَا تُجَامَعُ، وَلَا تَصُومُ، وَلَا تَمَسُّ الْمُصْحَفَ، إِنَّمَا رُخِّصَ لَهَا فِي الصَّلَاةِ "، قَالَ يَزِيدُ : " يُجَامِعُهَا زَوْجُهَا، وَيَحِلُّ لَهَا مَا يَحِلُّ لِلطَّاهِرِ "
1.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn al-Harith, from Mansur, from Ibrahim; with Yazid's addition: He said: It used to be said: "The woman with istihadah is not to be had intercourse with, and she does not fast, and she does not touch the Mushaf; she was only given a concession concerning the prayer." Yazid said: "Her husband has intercourse with her, and what is lawful for the pure [woman] is lawful for her."
1.hi: Ja'far ibn al-Harith ne Mansur se, Ibrahim se bataya: Kaha jaata tha: "Mustahaza aurat se sohbat nahi ki jaati, aur woh roza nahi rakhti, aur woh Mushaf ko nahi chhooti; usay sirf namaz ke maamle mein rukhsat di gayi hai." Yazid kehte hain: "Uska shohar uske saath sohbat kar sakta hai, aur jo paak aurat ke liye halal hai woh uske liye bhi halal hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" تُمْسِكُ الْمَرْأَةُ عَنْ الصَّلَاةِ فِي حَيْضِهَا سَبْعًا، فَإِنْ طَهُرَتْ، فَذَاكَ، وَإِلَّا أَمْسَكَتْ مَا بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ الْعَشْرَةَ، فَإِنْ طَهُرَتْ، فَذَاكَ، وَإِلَّا اغْتَسَلَتْ وَصَلَّتْ، وَهِيَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ "
1.en: Narrated by Yunus, from al-Hasan: He said: "The woman withholds from prayer during her menstruation for seven [days]; then if she becomes pure, that is that, and if not, she withholds what is between it and the tenth [day]; then if she becomes pure, that is that, and if not, she performs ghusl and prays, and she is [now considered] a woman with istihadah."
1.hi: Yunus ne al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Aurat apne haiz mein saat [din] tak namaz se ruki rahe; fir agar woh paak ho jaaye, to theek hai, warna woh us aur das ke darmiyan tak ruki rahe; fir agar woh paak ho jaaye, to theek hai, warna woh ghusl kare aur namaz padhe, aur ab woh mustahaza [shumaar hogi]."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ الرَّبِيعِ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" الْحَيْضُ عَشْرَةٌ، فَمَا زَادَ فَهِيَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ "، وقَالَ عَطَاءٌ : " الْحَيْضُ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Rabi', from al-Hasan; with Ata's view: He said: "Menstruation is ten [days]; whatever exceeds that, she is a woman with istihadah." And Ata said: "Menstruation is fifteen [days]."
1.hi: Al-Rabi' ne al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Haiz das [din tak] hai; jo isse zyada ho, woh mustahaza hai." Aur Ata ne kaha: "Haiz pandrah [din tak] hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ الْجَلْدِ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، قَالَ :" الْحَيْضُ عَشْرَةٌ فَمَا زَادَ فَهِيَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ "
1.en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik: He said: "Menstruation is ten [days]; whatever exceeds that, she is a woman with istihadah."
1.hi: Anas ibn Malik ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Haiz das [din tak] hai; jo isse zyada ho, woh mustahaza hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ ، قَالَ :" الْحَيْضُ إِلَى ثَلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ، فَمَا زَادَ فَهِيَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ "
1.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Jubayr: He said: "Menstruation extends up to thirteen [days]; whatever exceeds that, she is a woman with istihadah."
1.hi: Sa'id ibn Jubayr ne bataya: "Haiz terah [din] tak hai; jo isse zyada ho, woh mustahaza hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ الْجَلْدِ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، قَالَ :" الْحَيْضُ عَشْرَةُ أَيَّامٍ، ثُمَّ هِيَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ "
1.en: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik: He said: "Menstruation is ten days, then she is a woman with istihadah."
1.hi: Anas ibn Malik ne bataya: "Haiz das din hai, fir woh mustahaza ho jaati hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ ، قَالَ :" الْحَيْضُ إِلَى ثَلَاثَةَ عَشَرَ يَوْمًا، فَمَا سِوَى ذَلِكَ فَهِيَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ "
1.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Jubayr: He said: "Menstruation extends up to thirteen days; whatever is beyond that, she is a woman with istihadah."
1.hi: Sa'id ibn Jubayr ne bataya: "Haiz terah din tak hai; jo iske alawa ho, woh mustahaza hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ يُونُسَ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا رَأَتْ الدَّمَ فَإِنَّهَا تُمْسِكُ عَنْ الصَّلَاةِ، تَعُدُّ أَيَّامِ حَيْضِهَا يَوْمًا أَوْ يَوْمَيْنِ، ثُمَّ هِيَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Hasan: He said: "When she sees the blood, she withholds from prayer; she counts the days of her menstruation as a day or two, then after that she is a woman with istihadah."
1.hi: Al-Hasan ne bataya: "Jab woh khoon dekhe, to namaz se ruk jaaye; woh apne haiz ke dinon ko ek ya do din gine, fir uske baad woh mustahaza hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ جَلْدِ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ :" الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ تَنْتَظِرُ ثَلَاثًا، أَرْبَعًا، خَمْسًا، سِتًّا، سَبْعًا، ثَمَانِيًا، تِسْعًا، عَشْرًا "
1.en: Narrated by Anas: He said: "The woman with istihadah waits three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten [days]."
1.hi: Anas ne bataya: "Mustahaza aurat teen, chaar, paanch, chhe, saat, aath, nau, das [din] tak intezaar kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ :" بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةَ تَنْتَظِرُ عَلَى أَقْرَائِهَا بِيَوْمٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Ata: He said: "It reached us that the woman with istihadah waits over her cycles by one day."
1.hi: Ata ne bataya: "Humein khabar pahunchi hai ke mustahaza aurat apne [aadat ke] chakron se ek din zyada intezaar kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ صَبِيحٍ  ، عَنْ مَنْ  ، سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، يَقُولُ :" مَا زَادَ عَلَى الْعَشْرَة، فَهِيَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Rabi' ibn Sabih, from someone who heard Anas ibn Malik رضي الله عنه: He said: "Whatever exceeds the ten, she is a woman with istihadah."
1.hi: Al-Rabi' ibn Sabih ne ek shakhs se bataya jisne Anas ibn Malik رضي الله عنه ko kehte suna: "Jo das se zyada ho, woh mustahaza hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ ، عَنْ مُفَضَّلِ بْنِ مُهَلْهَلٍ ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ :" أَقْصَى الْحَيْضِ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ "
1.en: Narrated by Ata: He said: "The furthest extent of menstruation is fifteen [days]."
1.hi: Ata ne bataya: "Haiz ki zyada se zyada muddat pandrah [din] hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ سُفْيَانُ  : بَلَغَنِي عَنْ أَنَسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" أَدْنَى الْحَيْضِ ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ "، سُئِلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ الدَّارِمِيُّ : تَأْخُذُ بِهَذَا؟، قَالَ : " نَعَمْ، إِذَا كَانَ عَادَتَهَا "، وَسَأَلْتُهُ أَيْضًا عَنْ هَذَا؟، قَالَ : " أَقَلُّ الْحَيْضِ يَوْمٌ وَلَيْلَةٌ، وَأَكْثَرُهُ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ "
1.en: Narrated by Sufyan, that it reached him from Anas رضي الله عنه; with Abdullah al-Darimi's responses: Sufyan said: it reached me from Anas رضي الله عنه that he said: "The minimum of menstruation is three days." Abdullah al-Darimi was asked, "Do you hold to this?" He said, "Yes, if it is her habit." And I asked him also about this, he said: "The minimum of menstruation is a day and a night, and its maximum is fifteen [days]."
1.hi: Sufyan ne bataya: Mujhe Anas رضي الله عنه se khabar pahunchi hai ke unhone kaha, "Haiz ki kam se kam muddat teen din hai." Abdullah al-Darimi se poocha gaya, "Kya aap isi par amal karte hain?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, agar yeh uski aadat ho." Aur maine unse yeh bhi poocha, unhone kaha: "Haiz ki kam se kam muddat ek din aur ek raat hai, aur zyada se zyada pandrah [din]."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي زَكَرِيَّا ، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : هُوَ أَبُو سَعْدٍ الصَّغَّانِيُّ ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ الرَّبِيعِ ،  عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" أَدْنَى الْحَيْضِ ثَلَاثٌ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Hasan: He said: "The minimum of menstruation is three [days]."
1.hi: Al-Hasan ne bataya: "Haiz ki kam se kam muddat teen [din] hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ ، عَنْ مَعْقِلِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ :" أَدْنَى الْحَيْضِ يَوْمٌ "
1.en: Narrated by Ata: He said: "The minimum of menstruation is one day."
1.hi: Ata ne bataya: "Haiz ki kam se kam muddat ek din hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا رَأَتْ الدَّمَ قَبْلَ حَيْضِهَا يَوْمًا أَوْ يَوْمَيْنِ فَهُوَ مِنْ الْحَيْضِ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Hasan: He said: "When she sees the blood a day or two before her [expected] menstruation, it is part of the menstruation."
1.hi: Al-Hasan ne bataya: "Jab woh apne haiz se ek ya do din pehle khoon dekhe, to woh haiz mein se hi shumaar hoga."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، وَقَيْسِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا فِي الْبِكْرِ إِذَا نَفِسَتْ فَاسْتُحِيضَتْ، قَالَا :" تُمْسِكُ عَنْ الصَّلَاةِ مِثْلَ مَا تُمْسِكُ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ نِسَائِهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Qatadah and Qays ibn Sa'd, from Ata: That the two of them said, concerning the young woman when she gives birth and then suffers istihadah, they said: "She withholds from prayer just as the women of her family withhold."
1.hi: Qatadah aur Qays ibn Sa'd ne Ata se bataya: Un dono ne us kunwari aurat ke baare mein kaha jise bachcha hua ho aur fir istihadah ho jaaye: Unhone kaha, "Woh utna namaz se ruke jitna uske ghar ki [doosri] auratein rukti hain."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ : قَالَ سُفْيَانُ  :" إِذَا كَانَتْ الْمَرْأَةُ أَوَّلَ مَا تَحِيضُ تَجْلِسُ فِي الْحَيْضِ مِنْ نَحْوِ نِسَائِهَا "، سُئِلَ عَبْد اللَّهِ عَنْ هَذَا، فَقَالَ : " هُوَ أَشْبَهُ الْأَشْيَاءِ "
1.en: Narrated by Sufyan; Abdullah al-Darimi's response also given: Sufyan said: "When it is the first time the woman menstruates, she sits [abstains] for the period of menstruation similar to the women of her family." Abdullah [al-Darimi] was asked about this, and he said: "It is the closest/most fitting of things."
1.hi: Sufyan ne bataya: "Jab aurat ko pehli baar haiz aaye, to woh apne ghar ki auraton jaisi muddat tak baithi rahe." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) se iske baare mein poocha gaya, unhone kaha: "Yeh sab se zyada munaasib baat hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ   فِي الْكَبِيرَةِ تَرَى الدَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَا نَرَاهُ حَيْضًا "
1.en: Narrated by Ata, concerning the elderly woman who sees blood: He said, "We do not consider it menstruation."
1.hi: Ata ne budhi aurat ke baare mein bataya jo khoon dekhe: Unhone kaha, "Hum use haiz nahi samajhte."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، أَخْبَرَنِيهِ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ   فِي امْرَأَةٍ تَرَكَهَا الْحَيْضُ ثَلَاثِينَ سَنَةً، ثُمَّ رَأَتْ الدَّمَ" فَأَمَرَ فِيهَا بِشَأْنِ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ "
1.en: Narrated by Ata, concerning a woman whom menstruation had left for thirty years, then she saw blood: "He ruled concerning her according to the matter of the woman with istihadah."
1.hi: Ata ne us aurat ke baare mein bataya jiska haiz teen saal se chhoot chuka tha, fir usne khoon dekha: "Unhone uske baare mein mustahaza aurat wala hukum diya."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  فِي الْكَبِيرَةِ تَرَى الدَّمَ، قَالَ :" هِيَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ، تَفْعَلُ كَمَا تَفْعَلُ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ "
1.en: Narrated by Ata, concerning the elderly woman who sees blood: He said, "She is in the position of a woman with istihadah; she does as the woman with istihadah does."
1.hi: Ata ne budhi aurat ke baare mein bataya jo khoon dekhe: Unhone kaha, "Woh mustahaza aurat ke hukum mein hai; woh wahi kare jo mustahaza aurat karti hai."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، وَالْحَكَمِ بْنِ عُتَيْبَةَ ، في التي قعدت من المحيض،" إذا رأت الدم توضأت وصلت ولا تغتسل "، سئل عبد الله عَنْ الْكَبِيرَةِ، قَالَ : " تَوَضَّأُ وَتُصَلِّي، وَإِذَا طُلِّقَتْ تَعْتَدُّ بِالْأَشْهُرِ "
1.en: Narrated by Hajjaj, from Ata and al-Hakam ibn Utaybah; Abdullah al-Darimi's response also given: Concerning the one who has stopped menstruating: "when she sees blood, she performs ablution and prays, and does not perform ghusl." Abdullah was asked about the elderly woman, he said: "She performs ablution and prays, and if she is divorced she observes her waiting period by months."
1.hi: Hajjaj ne Ata aur al-Hakam ibn Utaybah se, us aurat ke baare mein bataya jiska haiz band ho chuka ho: "Jab woh khoon dekhe, to wudu kare aur namaz padhe, aur ghusl na kare." Abdullah se budhi aurat ke baare mein poocha gaya, unhone kaha: "Woh wudu kare aur namaz padhe, aur agar use talaaq ho jaaye to woh mahinon se iddat guzaare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ : قَالَ سُفْيَانُ  :" الطُّهْرُ خَمْسُ عَشْرَةَ "
1.en: Narrated by Sufyan: He said: "The [minimum] period of purity is fifteen [days]."
1.hi: Sufyan ne bataya: "Paaki ki muddat pandrah [din] hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا حَاضَتْ الْمَرْأَةُ فِي شَهْرٍ، أَوْ فِي أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً ثَلَاثَ حِيَضٍ، قَالَ : فَإِذَا شَهِدَ لَهَا الشُّهُودُ الْعُدُولُ مِنْ النِّسَاءِ أَنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَا يُحَرِّمُ عَلَيْهَا الصَّلَاةَ مِنْ طُمُوثِ النِّسَاءِ الَّذِي هُوَ الطَّمْثُ الْمَعْرُوفُ، فَقَدْ خَلَا أَجَلُهَا "، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : سَمِعْت يَزِيدَ بْنَ هَارُونَ، يَقُولُ : " أَسْتَحِبُّ الطُّهْرَ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ "
1.en: Narrated by Ibrahim; Abu Muhammad also notes Yazid ibn Harun's saying: He said: "When a woman menstruates in a month, or in forty nights, three menstruations - he said: then if just witnesses from among the women testify for her that she saw what makes the prayer forbidden to her, of the flow of women which is the well-known menstrual flow, then her waiting period has elapsed." Abu Muhammad said: I heard Yazid ibn Harun say: "I prefer [reckoning] the period of purity as fifteen [days]."
1.hi: Ibrahim ne bataya: "Jab aurat ko ek mahine mein, ya chaalis raaton mein, teen haiz aa jaayein - unhone kaha: fir agar aurat mein se aadil gawah gawaahi dein ke usne woh dekha jo namaz ko haraam karta hai, aurat ke us mashhoor bahav se jo maaruf haiz hai, to uski iddat guzar chuki." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Maine Yazid ibn Harun ko kehte suna: "Main paaki ki muddat pandrah [din] rakhna pasand karta hoon."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ ، قَالَ : جَاءَتْ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى عَلِيٍّ تُخَاصِمُ زَوْجَهَا طَلَّقَهَا، فَقَالَتْ : قَدْ حِضْتُ فِي شَهْرٍ ثَلَاثَ حِيَضٍ، فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ لِشُرَيْحٍ  : اقْضِ بَيْنَهُمَا، قَالَ : يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَأَنْتَ هَا هُنَا؟، قَالَ : اقْضِ بَيْنَهُمَا، فَقَالَ : يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَأَنْتَ هَا هُنَا؟، قَالَ : اقْضِ بَيْنَهُمَا، فَقَالَ :" إِنْ جَاءَتْ مِنْ بِطَانَةِ أَهْلِهَا مِمَّنْ يُرْضَى دِينُهُ وَأَمَانَتُهُ تَزْعُمُ أَنَّهَا حَاضَتْ ثَلَاثَ حِيَضٍ، تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ قُرْءٍ وَتُصَلِّي، جَازَ لَهَا وَإِلَّا فَلَا "، فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ  : قَالُونُ، وَقَالُونُ بِلِسَانِ الرُّومِ : أَحْسَنْتَ
1.en: Narrated by Amir: He said: A woman came to Ali disputing with her husband who had divorced her, and she said, "I have menstruated three menstruations in a month." So Ali said to Shurayh, "Judge between them." He said, "O Commander of the Believers, and you are here?" He said, "Judge between them." He said [again], "O Commander of the Believers, and you are here?" He said, "Judge between them." So he said: "If there come from the inner circle of her family those whose religion and trustworthiness are approved, claiming that she menstruated three menstruations, becoming pure at each cycle and praying, it is permissible for her; otherwise not." Then Ali said, "Qalun" - and 'Qalun' in the Roman tongue means "You have done well."
1.hi: Amir ne bataya: Ek aurat Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke paas aayi, apne shohar se jhagda karte hue jisne use talaaq de di thi, aur usne kaha, "Mujhe ek mahine mein teen haiz aaye hain." So Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Shurayh se kaha, "Un dono ke darmiyan faisla karo." Unhone kaha, "Ae Ameer-ul-Mumineen, aap yahan maujood hain?" Unhone kaha, "Un dono ke darmiyan faisla karo." Unhone [phir] kaha, "Ae Ameer-ul-Mumineen, aap yahan maujood hain?" Unhone kaha, "Un dono ke darmiyan faisla karo." To unhone [Shurayh ne] kaha: "Agar uske ghar ke qareebi logon mein se, jinke deen aur amaanat par bharosa kiya jaaye, koi aayein aur gawahi dein ke usay teen haiz aaye hain, har chakr par woh paak hui aur namaz padhi, to yeh uske liye jaayez hai; warna nahi." Fir Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha, "Qalun" - aur 'Qalun' Rumi zubaan mein iska matlab hai "Tumne achha kaha."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  : # وَلا يَحِلُّ لَهُنَّ أَنْ يَكْتُمْنَ مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ فِي أَرْحَامِهِنَّ سورة البقرة آية 228 #، قَالَ : الْحَيْضُ، قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ : أَتَقُولُ بِهَذَا؟، قَالَ : لَا، وَسُئِلَ عَبْد اللَّهِ عَنْ حَدِيثِ شُرَيْحٍ : تَقُولُ بِهِ، قَالَ :" لَا، وَقَالَ : ثَلَاثُ حِيَضٍ فِي الشَّهْرِ كَيْفَ يَكُونُ؟ "
1.en: Narrated by Ikrimah, concerning Surah al-Baqarah verse 228; with Abu Muhammad's and Abdullah al-Darimi's responses: Concerning "And it is not lawful for them to conceal what Allah has created in their wombs" [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 228]: he said, "[That refers to] menstruation." It was said to Abu Muhammad, "Do you hold this view?" He said, "No." And Abdullah was asked about the hadith of Shurayh, "Do you hold to it?" He said, "No," and he said, "Three menstruations in a month - how could that be?"
1.hi: Ikrimah ne is aayat ke baare mein bataya: "Aur unke liye halal nahi ke jo Allah ne unke rehmon mein paida kiya hai use chhupaayein" [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 228]: unhone kaha, "[Iska matlab] haiz hai." Abu Muhammad se poocha gaya, "Kya aap isi ke qaail hain?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi." Aur Abdullah se Shurayh ki riwayat ke baare mein poocha gaya, "Kya aap isi par amal karte hain?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi," aur kaha, "Ek mahine mein teen haiz kaise ho sakte hain?"

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : " كَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَاتَنْهَى النِّسَاءَ أَنْ يَنْظُرْنَ لَيْلًا فِي الْمَحِيضِ، وَتَقُولُ : إِنَّهُ قَدْ يَكُونُ الصُّفْرَةَ وَالْكُدْرَةَ "
1.en: Narrated by Amrah, about Aisha رضي الله عنها: She said: "Aisha رضي الله عنها used to forbid the women from looking at night concerning menstruation, and she used to say: 'Indeed it may be yellowish discharge or turbid discharge.'"
1.hi: Amrah ne bataya: "Aisha رضي الله عنها auraton ko raat mein haiz ka jaayza lene se mana kiya karti thin, aur kaha karti thin: 'Kyunki [raat ke andhere mein] zard ya gadle rang ko [khoon samajhne ki] ghalti ho sakti hai.'"

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ مَوْلَاةِ  عَمْرَةَ ، قَالَتْ :" كَانَتْ عَمْرَةُ  تَأْمُرُ النِّسَاءَ أَنْ لَا يَغْتَسِلْنَ حَتَّى تَخْرُجَ الْقُطْنَةُ بَيْضَاءَ "
1.en: Narrated by the freed servant-woman of Amrah, about Amrah: She said: "Amrah used to command the women not to perform ghusl until the cotton [test-pad] came out white."
1.hi: Amrah ki azaad ki hui laundi ne bataya: "Amrah auraton ko hukum deti thin ke woh ghusl na karein jab tak ruyi safed na nikal aaye."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ : قَالَ سُفْيَانُ  :" الْكُدْرَةُ وَالصُّفْرَةُ فِي أَيَّامِ الْحَيْضِ حَيْضٌ، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ رَأَتْهُ بَعْدَ أَيَّامِ الْحَيْضِ مِنْ دَمٍ أَوْ كُدْرَةٍ أَوْ صُفْرَةٍ، فَهِيَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ "، سُئِلَ عَبْدُ الله : تَأْخُذُ بِقَوْلِ سُفْيَانَ؟، قَالَ : نَعَمْ
1.en: Narrated by Sufyan; Abdullah al-Darimi's response also given: He said: "The turbid discharge and the yellowish discharge during the days of menstruation are [counted as] menstruation, and everything she sees after the days of menstruation, of blood or turbid discharge or yellowish discharge, she is a woman with istihadah." Abdullah was asked, "Do you hold to Sufyan's saying?" He said, "Yes."
1.hi: Sufyan ne bataya: "Haiz ke dinon mein gadla aur zard rang haiz [mein shumaar] hai, aur haiz ke dinon ke baad woh jo bhi dekhe - khoon ho ya gadlaapan ho ya zardi - woh mustahaza hai." Abdullah se poocha gaya, "Kya aap Sufyan ki baat par amal karte hain?" Unhone kaha, "Haan."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ صَاحِبَتِهِ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، وَكَانَتْ فِي حِجْرِ عَمْرَةَ ، قَالَتْ : أَرْسَلَتْ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ إِلَى عَمْرَةَ   بِكُرْسُفَةِ قُطْنٍ فِيهَا كَالصُّفْرَةِ تَسْأَلُهَا : هَلْ تَرَى إِذَا لَمْ تَرَ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ الْحِيضَةِ إِلَّا هَذَا أَنْ قَدْ طَهُرَتْ؟ فَقَالَتْ :" لَا، حَتَّى تَرَى الْبَيَاضَ خَالِصًا "
1.en: Narrated by Fatimah bint Muhammad, who was raised by Amrah: She said: A woman from Quraysh sent to Amrah a piece of cotton with something like yellowness on it, asking her: does she consider, if a woman sees nothing of menstruation except this, that she has become pure? So she said, "No, not until she sees pure whiteness."
1.hi: Fatimah bint Muhammad, jo Amrah ki godh mein palin, ne bataya: Quraysh ki ek aurat ne Amrah ke paas ruyi ka ek tukda bheja jismein zardi jaisi cheez thi, yeh poochne ke: kya woh samajhti hain ke agar aurat haiz ka sirf itna hi dekhe, to woh paak ho chuki hai? To unhone kaha, "Nahi, jab tak woh khaalis safedi na dekh le."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ زُرَيْعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَتْنِي فَاطِمَةُ  ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ  ، قَالَتْ :" كُنَّا نَكُونُ فِي حِجْرِهَا فَكَانَتْ إِحْدَانَا تَحِيضُ ثُمَّ تَطْهُرُ فَتَغْتَسِلُ وَتُصَلِّي، ثُمَّ تَنْكُسُهَا الصُّفْرَةُ الْيَسِيرَةُ، فَتَأْمُرُنَا أَنْ نَعْتَزِلَ الصَّلَاةَ حَتَّى لَا نَرَى إِلَّا الْبَيَاضَ خَالِصًا "
1.en: Narrated by Asma, via Fatimah: She said: "We used to be in her care, and one of us would menstruate, then become pure and perform ghusl and pray, then a slight yellowness would recur to her, so she would command us to abstain from prayer until we saw nothing but pure whiteness."
1.hi: Asma ne bataya: "Hum unki dekh-bhaal mein hote the, to humein se koi haiz mein hoti, fir paak ho jaati aur ghusl karke namaz padhti, fir usay thodi si zardi lot aati, to woh humein namaz se ruk jaane ka hukum deti jab tak hum khaalis safedi na dekh lein."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ :" الْكُدْرَةُ، وَالصُّفْرَةُ، وَالدَّمُ، فِي أَيَّامِ الْحَيْضِ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْحَيْضِ "
1.en: Narrated by Ata: He said: "Turbid discharge, yellowness, and blood, during the days of menstruation are in the position of menstruation."
1.hi: Ata ne bataya: "Haiz ke dinon mein gadlaapan, zardi, aur khoon - sab haiz ke hukum mein hain."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ :" إِذَا رَأَتْ الدَّمَ، فَلْتُمْسِكْ عَنْ الصَّلَاةِ حَتَّى تَرَى الطُّهْرَ أَبْيَضَ كَالْقَصَّةِ، ثُمَّ تَغْتَسِلْ وَتُصَلِّي "
1.en: Narrated by Aisha: That she said, "When she sees the blood, let her withhold from prayer until she sees the purity, white like the qassah, then let her perform ghusl and pray."
1.hi: Aisha ne bataya: "Jab woh khoon dekhe, to namaz se ruki rahe yahan tak ke woh paaki dekh le, safed 'qassah' ki tarah, fir woh ghusl kare aur namaz padhe."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ الْأَحْوَلِ ، قَالَ :" كَانَ الْحَسَنُ  لَا يَعُدُّ الصُّفْرَةَ وَالْكُدْرَةَ، وَلَا مِثْلَ غُسَالَةِ اللَّحْمِ شَيْئًا "
1.en: Narrated by Amir al-Ahwal, about al-Hasan: He said: "al-Hasan did not count the yellowness and the turbid discharge, nor anything like the washing-water of meat, as anything."
1.hi: Amir al-Ahwal ne bataya: "Al-Hasan zardi aur gadlaapan ko, aur na hi gosht dhone ke paani jaisi cheez ko, kuch shumaar karte the."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ ، قَالَتْ :" كُنَّا لَا نَعُدُّ الصُّفْرَةَ وَالْكُدْرَةَ شَيْئًا "
1.en: Umm Atiyyah narrated: She said: "We did not count the yellowness and the turbid discharge as anything."
1.hi: Umm Atiyyah ne bataya: "Hum zardi aur gadlaapan ko kuch shumaar nahi karte the."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَرَى الدَّمَ فِي أَيَّامِ طُهْرِهَا، قَالَ :" أَرَى أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ وَتُصَلِّيَ "، وقَالَ ابْنُ سِيرِينَ  : " لَمْ يَكُونُوا يَرَوْنَ بِالْكُدْرَةِ وَالصُّفْرَةِ بَأْسًا "
1.en: Narrated by Mu'tamir, from his father, from al-Hasan; with Ibn Sirin's view: Concerning the woman who sees blood during the days of her purity, he said: "I hold that she should perform ghusl and pray." And Ibn Sirin said: "They did not see any harm in the turbid discharge and the yellowness."
1.hi: Mu'tamir ne apne walid se, al-Hasan se, us aurat ke baare mein bataya jo apni paaki ke dinon mein khoon dekhe: Unhone kaha, "Meri raay hai ke woh ghusl kare aur namaz padhe." Aur Ibn Sirin ne kaha: "Woh gadlaapan aur zardi mein koi harj nahi samajhte the."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْأَعْلَى ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ ، فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَرَى الصُّفْرَةَ بَعْدَ الطُّهْرِ، قَالَ :" تِلْكَ التَّرِيَّةُ تَغْسِلُهُ وَتَوَضَّأُ وَتُصَلِّي "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Hanafiyyah, concerning the woman who sees yellowness after purity: He said: "That is [merely] the tariyyah; she washes it, and performs ablution, and prays."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Hanafiyyah ne, us aurat ke baare mein bataya jo paaki ke baad zardi dekhe: Unhone kaha, "Woh sirf tariyyah [halka baqiya asar] hai; woh use dho le, aur wudu kare, aur namaz padhe."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  وَحَجَّاجٌ ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ يُونُسَ ، وَحُمَيْدٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" لَيْسَ فِي التَّرِيَّةِ شَيْءٌ بَعْدَ الْغُسْلِ إِلَّا الطُّهُورُ "، قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : التَّرِيَّةُ الصُّفْرَةُ وَالْكُدْرَةُ
1.en: Narrated by Yunus and Humayd, from al-Hasan; with Abdullah al-Darimi's note: He said: "There is nothing in the tariyyah after ghusl except purity." Abdullah [al-Darimi] said: The tariyyah is the yellowness and the turbid discharge.
1.hi: Yunus aur Humayd ne al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Ghusl ke baad tariyyah mein sirf paaki hai [aur kuch nahi]." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Tariyyah se murad zardi aur gadlaapan hai.

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ  ، وَعَفَّانُ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، عَنْ الْحَجَّاجِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" إِذَا رَأَتْ الْمَرْأَةُ التَّرِيَّةَ بَعْدَ الْغُسْلِ بِيَوْمٍ أَوْ يَوْمَيْنِ، فَإِنَّهَا تَطَهَّرُ وَتُصَلِّي "
1.en: Ali رضي الله عنه narrated: That he said, "When the woman sees the tariyyah a day or two after ghusl, she is [considered] pure and she prays."
1.hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) رضي الله عنه ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab aurat ghusl ke ek ya do din baad tariyyah dekhe, to woh paak shumaar hogi aur namaz padhegi."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ :" لَيْسَ فِي التَّرِيَّةِ بَعْدَ الْغُسْلِ إِلَّا الطُّهُورُ "
1.en: Narrated by Ata: He said: "There is nothing in the tariyyah after ghusl except purity."
1.hi: Ata ne bataya: "Ghusl ke baad tariyyah mein sirf paaki hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ الْهُذَيْلِ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، وَكَانَتْ قَدْ بَايَعَتْ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ :" كُنَّا لَا نَعْتَدُّ بِالْكُدْرَةِ وَالصُّفْرَةِ بَعْدَ الْغُسْلِ شَيْئًا "
1.en: Umm Atiyyah رضي الله عنها narrated - she had given the pledge of allegiance to the Prophet ﷺ: That she said: "We did not count the turbid discharge and the yellowness after ghusl as anything."
1.hi: Umm Atiyyah رضي الله عنها, jinhone Nabi ﷺ se bay'at ki thi, ne bataya: "Hum ghusl ke baad gadlaapan aur zardi ko kuch shumaar nahi karte the."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ يُونُسَ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا رَأَتْ الْحَائِضُ دَمًا عَبِيطًا بَعْدَ الْغُسْلِ بِيَوْمٍ أَوْ يَوْمَيْنِ، فَإِنَّهَا تُمْسِكُ عَنْ الصَّلَاةِ يَوْمًا، ثُمَّ هِيَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Hasan: He said: "When the menstruating woman sees fresh red blood a day or two after ghusl, she withholds from prayer for a day, then after that she is a woman with istihadah."
1.hi: Al-Hasan ne bataya: "Jab haiz wali aurat ghusl ke ek ya do din baad taaza surkh khoon dekhe, to woh ek din namaz se ruki rahe, fir uske baad woh mustahaza [shumaar hogi]."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" إِذَا تَطَهَّرَتْ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ الْمَحِيضِ، ثُمَّ رَأَتْ بَعْدَ الطُّهْرِ مَا يَرِيبُهَا، فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ رَكْضَةٌ مِنْ الشَّيْطَانِ فِي الرَّحِمِ، فَإِذَا رَأَتْ مِثْلَ الرُّعَافِ، أَوْ قَطْرَةِ الدَّمِ، أَوْ غُسَالَةِ اللَّحْمِ، تَوَضَّأَتْ وُضُوءَهَا لِلصَّلَاةِ، ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي فَإِنْ كَانَ دَمًا عَبِيطًا الَّذِي لَا خَفَاءَ بِهِ، فَلْتَدَعْ الصَّلَاةَ "، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : سَمِعْتُ يَزِيدَ بْنَ هَارُونَ، يَقُولُ : " إِذَا كَانَ أَيَّامُ الْمَرْأَةِ سَبْعَةً، فَرَأَتْ الطُّهْرَ بَيَاضًا، فَتَزَوَّجَتْ ثُمَّ رَأَتْ الدَّمَ مَا بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ الْعَشْرِ، فَالنِّكَاحُ جَائِزٌ صَحِيحٌ، فَإِنْ رَأَتْ الطُّهْرَ دُونَ السَّبْعِ، فَتَزَوَّجَتْ ثُمَّ رَأَتْ الدَّمَ، فَلَا يَجُوزُ، وَهُوَ حَيْضٌ " ، وسُئِلَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : تَقُولُ بِهِ؟، قَالَ : نَعَمْ
1.en: Ali رضي الله عنه narrated; Abu Muhammad also notes Yazid ibn Harun's saying: He said: "When the woman becomes pure from menstruation, then sees after purity something that causes her doubt, it is only a kick from Shaytan in the womb; so when she sees something like a nosebleed, or a drop of blood, or the washing-water of meat, she performs ablution as her ablution for prayer, then she prays; but if it is fresh red blood which is unmistakable, let her leave the prayer." Abu Muhammad said: I heard Yazid ibn Harun say: "When a woman's days are seven, and she sees the purity as whiteness, then she marries, then sees blood between it and the tenth [day], the marriage is permissible and valid; but if she sees the purity before the seven, then marries, then sees the blood, it is not permissible, and it is menstruation." And Abdullah was asked, "Do you hold to this?" He said, "Yes."
1.hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) رضي الله عنه ne bataya: "Jab aurat haiz se paak ho jaaye, fir paaki ke baad koi aisi cheez dekhe jisse use shak ho, to woh sirf raham mein shaytan ki ek dhakkar hai; so jab woh nakseer jaisi, ya khoon ka ek qatra, ya gosht dhone ke paani jaisi cheez dekhe, to woh namaz ke wudu ki tarah wudu kare, fir namaz padhe; lekin agar woh taaza surkh khoon ho jismein koi shubha na ho, to woh namaz chhod de."
