Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Maine Yazid ibn Harun ko kehte suna: "Jab aurat ke [haiz ke] din saat hon, aur woh paaki ko safedi ke roop mein dekhe, fir woh nikaah kare, fir us aur das [din] ke darmiyan khoon dekhe, to nikaah jaayez aur sahih hai; lekin agar woh saat se pehle paaki dekhe, fir nikaah kare, fir khoon dekhe, to yeh jaayez nahi, aur yeh haiz hai." Aur Abdullah se poocha gaya, "Kya aap isi par amal karte hain?" Unhone kaha, "Haan."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ" يَكُونُ حَيْضُهَا سِتَّةَ أَيَّامٍ، أَوْ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ، ثُمَّ تَرَى كُدْرَةً أَوْ صُفْرَةً، أَوْ تَرَى الْقَطْرَةَ أَوْ الْقَطْرَتَيْنِ مِنْ الدَّمِ، أَنَّ ذَلِكَ بَاطِلٌ وَلَا يَضُرُّهَا شَيْءٌ "
1.en: Ali رضي الله عنه narrated: Concerning the woman "whose menstruation is six days, or seven days, then she sees turbid discharge or yellowness, or sees a drop or two of blood, that is void and does not harm her at all."
1.hi: Ali (Alayhis Salam) رضي الله عنه ne us aurat ke baare mein bataya "jiska haiz chhe din, ya saat din ho, fir woh gadlaapan ya zardi dekhe, ya khoon ka ek ya do qatra dekhe, to woh baatil [galat / na-mo'tabar] hai aur usay koi nuqsan nahi pahunchaata."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ ، قَالَ :" سَأَلْتُ عَطَاءً  عَنْ الْمَرْأَةِ تَغْتَسِلُ مِنْ الْحَيْضِ، فَتَرَى الصُّفْرَةَ، قَالَ : تَوَضَّأُ وَتَنْضَحُ "
1.en: Narrated by Abd al-Karim: He said: "I asked Ata about the woman who performs ghusl from menstruation, then sees the yellowness," he said: "She performs ablution and sprinkles [water]."
1.hi: Abd al-Karim ne bataya: "Maine Ata se us aurat ke baare mein poocha jo haiz se ghusl kare, fir zardi dekhe," unhone kaha: "Woh wudu kare aur [paani] chidke."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ، قَالَ :" تَدَعُ الصَّلَاةَ فِي قُرُوئِهَا ذَلِكَ يَوْمًا أَوْ يَوْمَيْنِ، ثُمَّ تَغْتَسِلُ، فَإِذَا كَانَ عِنْدَ الْأُولَى نَظَرَتْ، فَإِنْ كَانَتْ تَرِيَّةً، تَوَضَّأَتْ وَصَلَّتْ، وَإِنْ كَانَ دَمًا، أَخَّرَتْ الظُّهْرَ وَعَجَّلَتْ الْعَصْرَ، ثُمَّ صَلَّتْهُمَا بِغُسْلٍ وَاحِدٍ، فَإِذَا غَابَتْ الشَّمْسُ نَظَرَتْ، فَإِنْ كَانَتْ تَرِيَّةً، تَوَضَّأَتْ وَصَلَّتْ، وَإِنْ كَانَ دَمًا، أَخَّرَتْ الْمَغْرِبَ وَعَجَّلَتْ الْعِشَاءَ، ثُمَّ صَلَّتْهُمَا بِغُسْلٍ وَاحِدٍ، فَإِذَا طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ، نَظَرَتْ، فَإِنْ كَانَتْ تَرِيَّةً، تَوَضَّأَتْ وَصَلَّتْ، وَإِنْ كَانَ دَمًا، اغْتَسَلَتْ وَصَلَّتْ الْغَدَاةَ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ "، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : " الْأَقْرَاءُ عِنْدِي : الْحَيْضُ "
1.en: Narrated by Ata, concerning the woman with istihadah: He said: "She leaves the prayer during her cycles for a day or two, then she performs ghusl; then when it is [time for] the first [prayer], she looks - if it is tariyyah, she performs ablution and prays, and if it is blood, she delays Zuhr and hastens Asr, then prays them both with a single ghusl; then when the sun sets she looks - if it is tariyyah, she performs ablution and prays, and if it is blood, she delays Maghrib and hastens Isha, then prays them both with a single ghusl; then when dawn breaks, she looks - if it is tariyyah, she performs ablution and prays, and if it is blood, she performs ghusl and prays the morning [prayer] - in every day and night, three times." Abu Muhammad said: "The [word] 'aqra' in my view means menstruation."
1.hi: Ata ne mustahaza aurat ke baare mein bataya: "Woh apne [aadat ke] chakron mein ek ya do din namaz chhode, fir ghusl kare; fir jab pehli [namaz ka waqt] ho, woh dekhe - agar tariyyah ho, to wudu kare aur namaz padhe, aur agar khoon ho, to Zuhr der se aur Asr jaldi padhe, fir dono ek hi ghusl se padhe; fir jab suraj doobe, woh dekhe - agar tariyyah ho, to wudu kare aur namaz padhe, aur agar khoon ho, to Maghrib der se aur Isha jaldi padhe, fir dono ek hi ghusl se padhe; fir jab fajr ho, woh dekhe - agar tariyyah ho, to wudu kare aur namaz padhe, aur agar khoon ho, to ghusl kare aur subah ki namaz padhe - har din aur raat mein, teen martaba." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: "'Aqra' se meri raay mein murad haiz hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" اعْتَكَفَ، وَاعْتَكَفَ مَعَهُ بَعْضُ نِسَائِهِ وَهِيَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ تَرَى الدَّمَ، فَرُبَّمَا وَضَعَتْ الطَّسْتَ تَحْتَهَا مِنْ الدَّمِ "، وَزَعَمَ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ رَأَتْ مَاءَ الْعُصْفُرِ، فَقَالَتْ : " كَأَنَّ هَذَا شَيْءٌ كَانَتْ فُلَانَةُ تَجِدُهُ "
1.en: Aisha رضي الله عنها narrated: That the Prophet ﷺ "made i'tikaf, and some of his wives made i'tikaf with him while she was a woman with istihadah, seeing the blood, so she would sometimes place the basin beneath her because of the blood." And it was claimed that Aisha saw the water/dye of safflower, and said: "It is as if this is something so-and-so used to experience."
1.hi: Aisha رضي الله عنها ne bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne "i'tikaf kiya, aur aapki kuch biwiyon ne bhi aapke saath i'tikaf kiya jabke woh mustahaza thin, khoon dekh rahi thin, so woh kabhi-kabhi khoon ki wajah se apne neeche tashtari rakh leti thin." Aur bataya jaata hai ke Aisha ne kusum ke phool ke rang jaisa paani dekha, to unhone kaha, "Aisa lagta hai jaise yeh woh cheez hai jo fulaani ko hoti thi."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ ، عَنْ الْحَجَّاجِ ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ عَطَاءً  عَنْ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ مِنْ الْمَحِيضِ، ثُمَّ تَرَى الصُّفْرَةَ، قَالَ :" تَوَضَّأُ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Hajjaj: He said: "I asked Ata about the woman who becomes pure from menstruation, then sees the yellowness," he said: "She performs ablution."
1.hi: Al-Hajjaj ne bataya: "Maine Ata se us aurat ke baare mein poocha jo haiz se paak ho jaaye, fir zardi dekhe," unhone kaha: "Woh wudu kare."

1.ar: قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : قَرَأْتُ عَلَى زَيْدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ هُوَ ابْنُ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ الْمَرْأَةِ كَانَ حَيْضُهَا سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ، فَزَادَتْ حَيْضَتُهَا، قَالَ :" تَسْتَظْهِرُ بِثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ "
1.en: Abu Muhammad [al-Darimi] narrated, having read to Zayd ibn Yahya, from Malik ibn Anas: He said: I asked him about the woman whose menstruation was seven days, and her menstruation increased, he said: "She waits cautiously an extra three days."
1.hi: Abu Muhammad (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Maine Zayd ibn Yahya ke saamne padha, unhone Malik ibn Anas se bataya: Maine unse us aurat ke baare mein poocha jiska haiz saat din ka ho, aur uska haiz badh jaaye, unhone kaha: "Woh ehtiyaatan teen aur din intezaar kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ عَوَّامٍ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا طَهُرَتْ الْمَرْأَةُ فِي وَقْتِ صَلَاةٍ، فَلَمْ تَغْتَسِلْ وَهِيَ قَادِرَةٌ عَلَى أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ، قَضَتْ تِلْكَ الصَّلَاةَ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Hasan: He said: "When the woman becomes pure at the time of a prayer, and does not perform ghusl though she is able to perform ghusl, she makes up that prayer."
1.hi: Al-Hasan ne bataya: "Jab aurat namaz ke waqt paak ho jaaye, aur ghusl na kare jabke woh ghusl karne ki taaqat rakhti ho, to woh us namaz ki qaza karegi."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا صَلَّتْ الْمَرْأَةُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ حَاضَتْ فَلَا تَقْضِي إِذَا طَهُرَتْ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Hasan: He said: "When the woman prays two rak'ahs, then menstruates, she does not make it up when she becomes pure."
1.hi: Al-Hasan ne bataya: "Jab aurat do rakat padh chuki ho, fir usay haiz aa jaaye, to jab woh paak ho to us namaz ki qaza nahi karegi."

1.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمَعْمَرِيُّ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، قَالَ :.
ح حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الظُّهْرِ، فَتُؤَخِّرُ غُسْلَهَا حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ وَقْتُ الْعَصْرِ، قَالَا :" تَقْضِي الظُّهْرَ "
1.en: Narrated by Qatadah, and via a second chain by al-Hajjaj, from Ata, concerning the woman who becomes pure at Zuhr time and delays her ghusl until Asr time: They both said: "She makes up the Zuhr."
1.hi: Qatadah ne, aur ek doosri sanad se al-Hajjaj ne Ata se, us aurat ke baare mein bataya jo Zuhr ke waqt paak ho aur apna ghusl Asr ka waqt aane tak der kare: Dono ne kaha, "Woh Zuhr ki qaza karegi."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، وَمُغِيرَةُ ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ ، وَعُبَيْدَةُ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تُفَرِّطُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ حَتَّى يُدْرِكَهَا الْحَيْضُ، قَالُوا :" تُعِيدُ تِلْكَ الصَّلَاةَ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Hasan, and by Amir [via al-Mughirah], and by Ibrahim [via Ubaydah]: Concerning the woman who is negligent in [performing] the prayer until menstruation overtakes her: they said: "She repeats that prayer."
1.hi: Al-Hasan ne, aur Amir ne [al-Mughirah ke zariye], aur Ibrahim ne [Ubaydah ke zariye], us aurat ke baare mein bataya jo namaz mein kotahi kare yahan tak ke usay haiz aa jaaye: Unhone kaha, "Woh us namaz ko dohraayegi."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ ، وَيُونُسَ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، فِي امْرَأَةٍ حَضَرَتْ الصَّلَاةُ فَفَرَّطَتْ حَتَّى حَاضَتْ، قَالَا :" تَقْضِي تِلْكَ الصَّلَاةَ إِذَا اغْتَسَلَتْ "
1.en: Narrated by Hammad ibn Abi Sulayman and Yunus, from al-Hasan: Concerning a woman for whom the prayer time came and she was negligent until she menstruated: they both said: "She makes up that prayer when she performs ghusl."
1.hi: Hammad ibn Abi Sulayman aur Yunus ne al-Hasan se, us aurat ke baare mein bataya jispar namaz ka waqt aaya aur usne kotahi ki yahan tak ke usay haiz aa gaya: Dono ne kaha, "Woh jab ghusl kare to us namaz ki qaza karegi."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، وَقَتَادَةَ ، قَالَا :" إِذَا ضَيَّعَتْ الْمَرْأَةُ الصَّلَاةَ حَتَّى تَحِيضَ، فَعَلَيْهَا الْقَضَاءُ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Hasan and Qatadah: They said: "When the woman neglects the prayer until she menstruates, then the making-up is due upon her when she becomes pure."
1.hi: Al-Hasan aur Qatadah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab aurat namaz mein kotahi kare yahan tak ke usay haiz aa jaaye, to jab woh paak ho to uspar qaza wajib hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا فَرَّطَتْ ثُمَّ حَاضَتْ، قَضَتْ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Sha'bi: He said: "When she is negligent, then menstruates, she makes it up."
1.hi: Al-Sha'bi ne bataya: "Jab woh kotahi kare, fir usay haiz aa jaaye, to woh qaza karegi."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ : حَدَّثَنَا عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ ، عَنْ أَبِي يُوسُفَ ،  عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا حَاضَتْ الْمَرْأَةُ فِي وَقْتِ الصَّلَاةِ، فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا الْقَضَاءُ "، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : يَعْقُوبُ هُوَ ابْنُ الْقَعْقَاعِ قَاضِي مَرْوٍ ، وَأَبُو يُوسُفَ شَيْخٌ مَكِّيٌّ
1.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Jubayr: He said: "When the woman menstruates during the time of a prayer, then there is no making-up due upon her." Abu Muhammad said: Ya'qub is Ibn al-Qa'qa', the judge of Marw, and Abu Yusuf is a Makkan shaykh.
1.hi: Sa'id ibn Jubayr ne bataya: "Jab aurat namaz ke waqt mein haiz mein aa jaaye, to uspar qaza wajib nahi." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Ya'qub, Ibn al-Qa'qa' hain, Marw ke qazi, aur Abu Yusuf Makki shaykh hain.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ  حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ  ، وَقَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، قَالَ :" إِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ الْمَغْرِبِ، صَلَّتْ الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ، وَإِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ، صَلَّتْ الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ "، أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، مِثْلَهُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَيَّاشٍ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ  ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنهُمَا، مِثْلَهُ
1.en: Narrated by Ata; similar reports also given from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, and from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: He said: "When she becomes pure before Maghrib, she prays Zuhr and Asr, and when she becomes pure before Fajr, she prays Maghrib and Isha." [Similar reports are narrated through other chains, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, and from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما, similarly.]
1.hi: Ata ne bataya: "Jab woh Maghrib se pehle paak ho jaaye, to Zuhr aur Asr padhe, aur jab Fajr se pehle paak ho jaaye, to Maghrib aur Isha padhe." [Isi jaisi riwayat Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se, aur Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se bhi isi tarah aayi hai.]

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  فِي الْحَائِضِ" تُصَلِّي الصَّلَاةَ الَّتِي طَهُرَتْ فِي وَقْتِهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Yunus, from al-Hasan, concerning the menstruating woman: "She prays the prayer in whose time she became pure."
1.hi: Yunus ne al-Hasan se, haiz wali aurat ke baare mein bataya: "Woh us namaz ko padhe jiske waqt mein woh paak hui."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، وَطَاوُسٍ ، وَمُجَاهِدٍ ، قَالُوا :" إِذَا طَهُرَتْ الْحَائِضُ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ، صَلَّتْ الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ، وَإِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ، صَلَّتْ الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ "
1.en: Narrated by Ata, Tawus, and Mujahid: They said: "When the menstruating woman becomes pure before Fajr, she prays Maghrib and Isha, and when she becomes pure before sunset, she prays Zuhr and Asr."
1.hi: Ata, Tawus, aur Mujahid ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab haiz wali aurat Fajr se pehle paak ho jaaye, to Maghrib aur Isha padhe, aur jab suraj doobne se pehle paak ho jaaye, to Zuhr aur Asr padhe."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  فِي الْحَائِضِ" إِذَا رَأَتْ الطُّهْرَ آخِرَ النَّهَارِ، صَلَّتْ الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ، وَإِذَا طَهُرَتْ آخِرَ اللَّيْلِ، صَلَّتْ الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ "، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ ، مِثْلَهُ
1.en: Narrated by al-Hakam, concerning the menstruating woman; a similar report also from Tawus: "When she sees purity at the end of the day, she prays Zuhr and Asr, and when she becomes pure at the end of the night, she prays Maghrib and Isha." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Tawus.]
1.hi: Al-Hakam ne haiz wali aurat ke baare mein bataya: "Jab woh din ke aakhri hisse mein paaki dekhe, to Zuhr aur Asr padhe, aur jab raat ke aakhri hisse mein paak ho, to Maghrib aur Isha padhe." [Isi jaisi riwayat Tawus se bhi aayi hai.]

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو زَيْدٍ سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، قَالَ : كَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ ، يَقُولُ :" إِذَا طَهُرَتْ عِنْدَ الْعَصْرِ، صَلَّتْ الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ "
1.en: Narrated by Mughirah, about Ibrahim: He said: Ibrahim used to say: "When she becomes pure at [the time of] Asr, she prays Zuhr and Asr."
1.hi: Mughirah ne bataya: Ibrahim kaha karte the: "Jab woh Asr ke waqt paak ho jaaye, to woh Zuhr aur Asr padhe."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو زَيْدٍ ، قَالَ : قَالَ شُعْبَةُ : سَأَلْتُ حَمَّادًا ، قَالَ :" إِذَا طَهُرَتْ فِي وَقْتِ صَلَاةٍ صَلَّتْ "
1.en: Narrated by Shu'bah, from Hammad: He said: I asked Hammad, he said: "When she becomes pure during the time of a prayer, she prays."
1.hi: Shu'bah ne bataya: Maine Hammad se poocha, unhone kaha, "Jab woh namaz ke waqt mein paak ho jaaye, to woh namaz padhe."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ  ، وَحُمَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" إِذَا طَهُرَتْ فِي وَقْتِ صَلَاةٍ، صَلَّتْ تِلْكَ الصَّلَاةَ، وَلَا تُصَلِّي غَيْرَهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Yunus and Humayd, from al-Hasan, from Anas رضي الله عنه: He said: "When she becomes pure during the time of a prayer, she prays that prayer, and does not pray other than it."
1.hi: Yunus aur Humayd ne al-Hasan se, Anas رضي الله عنه se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab woh namaz ke waqt mein paak ho jaaye, to woh usi namaz ko padhe, aur uske alawa koi aur na padhe."

1.ar: قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : قَرَأْتُ عَلَى زَيْدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ، قَالَ :" تُصَلِّي الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ "، قُلْتُ : فَإِنْ كَانَ طُهْرُهَا قَرِيبًا مِنْ مَغِيبِ الشَّمْسِ، قَالَ : " تُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ وَلَا تُصَلِّي الظُّهْرَ، وَلَوْ أَنَّهَا لَمْ تَطْهُرْ حَتَّى تَغِيبَ الشَّمْسُ، لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْهَا شَيْءٌ "، سُئِلَ عَبْد اللَّهِ تَأْخُذُ بِهِ؟، قَالَ : لَا
1.en: Abu Muhammad [al-Darimi] narrated, having read to Zayd ibn Yahya, from Malik: He said: I asked him about the woman who becomes pure after Asr, he said: "She prays Zuhr and Asr." I said, "What if her purity is close to sunset?" He said: "She prays Asr and does not pray Zuhr, and had she not become pure until the sun set, nothing would be due upon her." Abdullah was asked, "Do you take that view?" He said, "No."
1.hi: Abu Muhammad (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Maine Zayd ibn Yahya ke saamne padha, Malik se: Maine unse us aurat ke baare mein poocha jo Asr ke baad paak ho, unhone kaha, "Woh Zuhr aur Asr padhegi." Maine poocha, "Agar uski paaki suraj doobne ke qareeb ho [to kya hukum hai]?" Unhone kaha, "Woh Asr padhegi aur Zuhr nahi padhegi, aur agar woh suraj doobne tak paak na hoti, to uspar kuch wajib nahi hota." Abdullah se poocha gaya, "Kya aap isi par amal karte hain?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ الْمُحَارِبِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ : كَتَبَتْ إِلَيْهِ امْرَأَةٌ : إِنِّي قَدْ اسْتُحِضْتُ مُنْذُ كَذَا وَكَذَا، فَبَلَغَنِي أَنَّ عَلِيًّا   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" تَغْتَسِلُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ "، قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ : " مَا نَجِدُ لَهَا غَيْرَ مَا قَالَ عَلِيٌّ "
1.en: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما narrated: He said: A woman wrote to him: "I have had istihadah since such-and-such," and it reached me that Ali رضي الله عنه said: "She performs ghusl at every prayer." Ibn Abbas said: "We do not find for her [ruling] other than what Ali said."
1.hi: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما ne bataya: Ek aurat ne unhein likha: "Mujhe fulaan waqt se istihadah ho raha hai," aur mujhe khabar mili ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) رضي الله عنه ne kaha: "Woh har namaz par ghusl kare." Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Humein uske liye Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke qaul ke siwa aur kuch nahi milta."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ ، أَوْ عِكْرِمَةُ ، قَالَ : كَانَتْ زَيْنَبُ تَعْتَكِفُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهِيَ تُرِيقُ الدَّمَ، فَأَمَرَهَا أَنْ" تَغْتَسِلَ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Abu Salamah or Ikrimah: He said: Zaynab used to make i'tikaf with the Prophet ﷺ while she was shedding blood, so he commanded her "to perform ghusl at every prayer."
1.hi: Abu Salamah ya Ikrimah ne bataya: Zaynab Nabi ﷺ ke saath i'tikaf karti thin jabke unhein khoon aa raha hota tha, so aapne unhein hukum diya "ke woh har namaz par ghusl karein."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، أَنَّ عَلِيًّا  ، وَابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا كَانَا، يَقُولَانِ :" الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ تَغْتَسِلُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, about Ali and Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنهما: That Ali and Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنهما used to say: "The woman with istihadah performs ghusl at every prayer."
1.hi: Yahya ibn Abi Kathir ne bataya ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنهما kaha karte the: "Mustahaza aurat har namaz par ghusl kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَطَاءَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ ، يَقُولُ :" تَغْتَسِلُ بَيْنَ كُلِّ صَلَاتَيْنِ غُسْلًا وَاحِدًا، وَتَغْتَسِلُ لِلْفَجْرِ غُسْلًا وَاحِدًا "، قَالَ الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ : وَكَانَ الزُّهْرِيُّ، وَمَكْحُولٌ، يَقُولَانِ : " تَغْتَسِلُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Awza'i, from Ata ibn Abi Rabah; with al-Zuhri's and Makhul's view: He said: I heard Ata ibn Abi Rabah say: "She performs one ghusl between every two prayers, and she performs one ghusl for Fajr." Al-Awza'i said: And al-Zuhri and Makhul used to say: "She performs ghusl at every prayer."
1.hi: Al-Awza'i ne bataya: Maine Ata ibn Abi Rabah ko kehte suna: "Woh har do namazon ke darmiyan ek ghusl kare, aur Fajr ke liye ek ghusl kare." Al-Awza'i kehte hain: Aur al-Zuhri aur Makhul kaha karte the: "Woh har namaz par ghusl kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، وَوَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  صَاحِبِ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، أَنَّ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ ، قَالَ وَهْبٌ : أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتَ جَحْشٍ كَانَتْ تُهَرَاقُ الدَّمَ، وَإِنَّهَا سَأَلَتْ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ ذَاكَ، فَأَمَرَهَا" أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ وَتُصَلِّيَ "
1.en: Narrated by Abu Salamah, regarding Umm Habibah [bint Jahsh, per Wahb's note]: That Umm Habibah - Wahb said: Umm Habibah bint Jahsh - used to have blood shed continuously, and she asked the Prophet ﷺ about that, so he commanded her "to perform ghusl at every prayer and pray."
1.hi: Abu Salamah ne bataya ke Umm Habibah - Wahb kehte hain: Umm Habibah bint Jahsh - ko lagataar khoon aata rehta tha, aur unhone Nabi ﷺ se iske baare mein poocha, so aapne unhein hukum diya "ke woh har namaz par ghusl karein aur namaz padhein."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ  ، يَقُولُ : كَتَبَتْ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، وَابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ  رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا : إِنِّي أُسْتَحَاضُ فَلَا أَطْهُرُ، وَإِنِّي أُذَكِّرُكُمَا اللَّهَ إِلَّا أَفْتَيْتُمَانِي، وَإِنِّي سَأَلْتُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالُوا  : كَانَ عَلِيٌّ  ، يَقُولُ :" تَغْتَسِلُ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ "، فَقَرَأْتُ، وَكَتَبْتُ الْجَوَابَ بِيَدِي مَا أَجِدُ لَهَا إِلَّا مَا قَالَ عَلِيٌّ، فَقِيلَ : إِنَّ الْكُوفَةَ أَرْضٌ بَارِدَةٌ، فَقَالَ : " لَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَابْتَلَاهَا بِأَشَدَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ "، أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  ، قَالَ : قِيلَ لِابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا : إِنَّ أَرْضَهَا أَرْضٌ بَارِدَةٌ، فَقَالَ : " تُؤَخِّرُ الظُّهْرَ وَتُعَجِّلُ الْعَصْرَ، وَتَغْتَسِلُ غُسْلًا، وَتُؤَخِّرُ الْمَغْرِبَ، وَتُعَجِّلُ الْعِشَاءَ، وَتَغْتَسِلُ غُسْلًا، وَتَغْتَسِلُ لِلْفَجْرِ غُسْلًا "
1.en: Narrated by Abu Bishr, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr; a similar report also via Mujahid, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: He said: I heard Sa'id ibn Jubayr say: A woman wrote to Ibn Abbas and Ibn al-Zubayr رضي الله عنهما: "I have istihadah and I do not become pure, and I remind the two of you of Allah unless you give me a fatwa, and I have asked about that." So they said: Ali used to say: "She performs ghusl for every prayer." So I read [the question], and I wrote the answer with my own hand: I find nothing for her except what Ali said. Then it was said, "Indeed Kufah is a cold land." So he [Ibn Abbas] said: "If Allah had willed, He would have tried her with something more severe than that." [Another chain] Narrated by Mujahid: He said: It was said to Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: "Her land is a cold land." So he said: "She delays Zuhr and hastens Asr, and performs a ghusl, and delays Maghrib and hastens Isha, and performs a ghusl, and performs a ghusl for Fajr."
1.hi: Abu Bishr ne bataya: Maine Sa'id ibn Jubayr ko kehte suna: Ek aurat ne Ibn Abbas aur Ibn al-Zubayr رضي الله عنهما ko likha: "Mujhe istihadah hai aur main paak nahi hoti, aur main tum dono ko Allah ki qasam deti hoon ke mujhe fatwa do, aur maine iske baare mein poocha hai." To unhone kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) kaha karte the: "Woh har namaz par ghusl kare." So maine [sawal] padha, aur apne haath se jawab likha: Mujhe uske liye Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke qaul ke siwa kuch nahi milta. Fir kaha gaya, "Kufah thandi zameen hai [to yeh mushkil hai]." To unhone [Ibn Abbas ne] kaha: "Agar Allah chahta, to isse bhi zyada sakht cheez se uska imtihaan leta." [Ek aur sanad] Mujahid se bataya gaya: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se kaha gaya: "Unki zameen thandi zameen hai." To unhone kaha: "Woh Zuhr der se aur Asr jaldi padhe, aur ek ghusl kare, aur Maghrib der se aur Isha jaldi padhe, aur ek ghusl kare, aur Fajr ke liye ek ghusl kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا : أَنَّ ابْنَةَ جَحْشٍ كَانَتْ تَحْتَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ" وَكَانَتْ تُسْتَحَاضُ، فَكَانَتْ تَخْرُجُ مِنْ مِرْكَنِهَا وَإِنَّهُ لَعَالِيهِ الدَّمُ فَتُصَلِّي "
1.en: Narrated by Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Zaynab bint Umm Salamah رضي الله عنها: That the daughter of Jahsh was married to Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf, "and she used to have istihadah, so she would come out of her basin while the blood was overflowing above it, and she would pray."
1.hi: Hisham ibn Urwah ne apne walid se, Zaynab bint Umm Salamah رضي الله عنها se bataya ke Jahsh ki beti, jo Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf ke nikaah mein thi, "unhein istihadah hota tha, so woh apni tashtari se bahar aatin jabke usmein khoon upar tairta hota, phir bhi woh namaz padhtin."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ ، عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ ، وَيَحْيَى بْنَ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ ، يَقُولَانِ :" تُفْرِدُ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ اغْتِسَالَةً "، قَالَ الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ : وَبَلَغَنِي عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ، مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ
1.en: Narrated by al-Awza'i, from al-Zuhri and Yahya ibn Abi Kathir; with Makhul's note: He said: I heard al-Zuhri and Yahya ibn Abi Kathir say: "She sets aside a separate ghusl for every prayer." Al-Awza'i said: And it reached me from Makhul, the same.
1.hi: Al-Awza'i ne bataya: Maine al-Zuhri aur Yahya ibn Abi Kathir ko kehte suna: "Woh har namaz ke liye alag ghusl kare." Al-Awza'i kehte hain: Aur mujhe Makhul se bhi isi jaisi baat pahunchi hai.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ  ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ كَانَ، يَقُولُ :" لِكُلِّ صَلَاتَيْنِ اغْتِسَالَةٌ، وَتُفْرِدُ لِصَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ اغْتِسَالَةً "
1.en: Narrated by al-Awza'i, informed by Ata, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه: That Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه used to say: "For every two prayers, one ghusl, and she sets aside a separate ghusl for the Subh prayer."
1.hi: Al-Awza'i ne Ata se bataya ke Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه kaha karte the: "Har do namazon ke liye ek ghusl, aur Subh ki namaz ke liye alag ghusl."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ الْكُوفِيِّ ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً سَأَلَتْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، فَقَالَتْ : إِنِّي أُسْتَحَاضُ، فَقَالَ :" عَلَيْكِ بِالْمَاءِ فَانْضَحِيهِ، فَإِنَّهُ يَقْطَعُ الدَّمَ عَنْكِ "
1.en: Narrated by Hammad al-Kufi, about Ibrahim: That a woman asked Ibrahim, and said, "I have istihadah," so he said, "You must use water, so sprinkle it, for indeed it stops the blood from you."
1.hi: Hammad al-Kufi ne bataya ke ek aurat ne Ibrahim se poocha, aur kaha, "Mujhe istihadah hai." To unhone kaha, "Paani istemal karo aur ise chidko, kyunki yeh tumse khoon rok deta hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ دِينَارٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  فِي الْمُطَلَّقَةِ الَّتِي ارْتِيبَ بِهَا" تَرَبَّصُ سَنَةً، فَإِنْ حَاضَتْ وَإِلَّا تَرَبَّصَتْ بَعْدَ انْقِضَاءِ السَّنَةِ ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْهُرٍ، فَإِنْ حَاضَتْ وَإِلَّا فَقَدْ انْقَضَتْ عِدَّتُهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Yunus, from al-Hasan, concerning the divorced woman about whom there is doubt [regarding menstruation]: "She waits a year; if she menstruates [fine], and if not, she waits after the completion of the year three [more] months; if she menstruates [fine], and if not, then her waiting period has ended."
1.hi: Yunus ne al-Hasan se, us talaaq-shuda aurat ke baare mein bataya jiske haiz mein shak ho: "Woh ek saal intezaar kare; agar usay haiz aa jaaye [to theek hai], warna woh saal poora hone ke baad teen [aur] mahine intezaar kare; agar usay haiz aa jaaye [to theek hai], warna uski iddat guzar chuki."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ مَالِكٌ عَنْ عِدَّةِ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ إِذَا طُلِّقَتْ ، فَحَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" عِدَّتُهَا سَنَةٌ "، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : هُوَ قَوْلُ مَالِكٍ
1.en: Narrated by Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab; Abu Muhammad notes this as Malik's view: That he said, concerning the waiting period of the woman with istihadah, if she is divorced: "Her waiting period is a year." Abu Muhammad said: This is the saying of Malik.
1.hi: Malik ne Ibn Shihab se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se bataya: Unhone kaha, mustahaza aurat ki iddat ke baare mein, agar use talaaq ho jaaye: "Uski iddat ek saal hai." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Yeh Malik ka qaul hai.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ جَابِرُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  عَنْ الْمَرْأَةِ تُطَلَّقُ وَهِيَ الشَّابَّةٌ فترتفع حيضتها من غير كبر، قَالَ :" مِنْ غَيْرِ حَيْضٍ تَحَيَّضُ؟ ! "، وَقَالَ طَاوُسٌ  : " ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْهُرٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Dinar, about Jabir ibn Zayd; with Tawus's view: He said: Jabir ibn Zayd was asked about the woman who is divorced while young, and her menstruation ceases without old age [being the cause], he said: "Does she menstruate without menstruation?!" And Tawus said: "Three months."
1.hi: Amr ibn Dinar ne bataya: Jabir ibn Zayd se us jawaan aurat ke baare mein poocha gaya jise talaaq ho jaaye aur uska haiz budhaape ke bina hi ruk jaaye, unhone kaha, "Kya woh bina haiz ke haiz mein aayegi?!" Aur Tawus ne kaha: "Teen mahine [iddat hai]."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْأَعْلَى ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا طَلَّقَ الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ فَحَاضَتْ حَيْضَةً أَوْ حَيْضَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ ارْتَفَعَتْ حَيْضَتُهَا إِنْ كَانَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ كِبَرٍ، اعْتَدَّتْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْهُرٍ، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ شَابَّةً وَارْتَابَتْ، اعْتَدَّتْ سَنَةً بَعْدَ الرِّيبَةِ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Zuhri: He said: "When a man divorces his wife, and she menstruates once or twice, then her menstruation ceases - if that is due to old age, she observes a waiting period of three months, and if she was young and there is doubt [about the cause], she observes a waiting period of a year after the doubt."
1.hi: Al-Zuhri ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab aadmi apni biwi ko talaaq de, aur usay ek ya do haiz aa jaayein, fir uska haiz ruk jaaye - agar yeh budhaape ki wajah se ho, to woh teen mahine ki iddat guzaare, aur agar woh jawaan ho aur [wajah mein] shak ho, to woh shak ke baad ek saal ki iddat guzaare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَلِيفَةُ بْنُ خَيَّاطٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ ، قَالَ :" الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ وَالَّتِي لَا يَسْتَقِيمُ لَهَا حَيْضٌ فَتَحِيضُ فِي شَهْرٍ مَرَّةً وَفِي الشَّهْرِ مَرَّتَيْنِ، عِدَّتُهَا ثَلَاثَةُ أَشْهُرٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Ikrimah: He said: "The woman with istihadah, and she whose menstruation does not run regularly, so she menstruates once in a month and twice in a month - her waiting period is three months."
1.hi: Ikrimah ne bataya: "Mustahaza aurat, aur woh jiska haiz theek se na aata ho, so kabhi mahine mein ek baar aur kabhi do baar - uski iddat teen mahine hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَلِيفَةُ بْنُ خَيَّاطٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ ، قَالَ :" تَعْتَدُّ بِالْأَقْرَاءِ "
1.en: Narrated by Hammad: He said: "She observes her waiting period by [reckoning] the cycles."
1.hi: Hammad ne bataya: "Woh apni iddat 'aqra' [chakron] se guzaare."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ ، قَالَ :" عِدَّةُ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ سَنَةٌ "
1.en: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab narrated: He said: "The waiting period of the woman with istihadah is a year."
1.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab ne bataya: "Mustahaza aurat ki iddat ek saal hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ عِيسَى ، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، عَنْ يُونُسَ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ تَعْتَدُّ بِالْأَقْرَاءِ "
1.en: al-Hasan narrated: He said: "The woman with istihadah observes her waiting period by [reckoning] the cycles."
1.hi: Al-Hasan ne bataya: "Mustahaza aurat apni iddat 'aqra' se guzaare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَلِيفَةُ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْأَعْلَى ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، قَالَ :" بِالْأَقْرَاءِ "، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : أَهْلُ الْحِجَازِ ، يَقُولُونَ : " الْأَقْرَاءُ : الْأَطْهَارُ "، وَقَالَ أَهْلُ الْعِرَاقِ : هُوَ الْحَيْضُ ، قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : وَأَنَا أَقُولُ : " هُوَ الْحَيْضُ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Zuhri; with Abu Muhammad's and Abdullah al-Darimi's remarks: He said: "[Reckoning] by the cycles." Abu Muhammad said: The people of the Hijaz say: "The cycles [mean] the periods of purity." And the people of Iraq said: it is menstruation. Abdullah [al-Darimi] said: And I say: "It is menstruation."
1.hi: Al-Zuhri ne bataya: "'Aqra' se." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Ahl-e-Hijaz kehte hain: "Aqra se murad paaki ke ayyam hain." Aur ahl-e-Iraq kehte hain: yeh haiz hai. Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Aur main kehta hoon: "Yeh haiz hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ تَعْتَدُّ بِالْأَقْرَاءِ "
1.en: al-Hasan narrated: He said: "The woman with istihadah observes her waiting period by [reckoning] the cycles."
1.hi: Al-Hasan ne bataya: "Mustahaza aurat apni iddat 'aqra' se guzaare."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ ، عَنْ الْهِقْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ  عَنْ رَجُلٍ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ شَابَّةٌ تَحِيضُ، فَانْقَطَعَ عَنْهَا الْمَحِيضُ حِينَ طَلَّقَهَا، فَلَمْ تَرَ دَمًا، كَمْ تَعْتَدُّ؟، قَالَ :" ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْهُرٍ "، قَالَ : وَسَأَلْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ عَنْ رَجُلٍ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ فَحَاضَتْ حَيْضَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ ارْتَفَعَتْ حَيْضَتُهَا، كَمْ تَرَبَّصُ؟، قَالَ : " عِدَّتُهَا سَنَةٌ "، قَالَ : وَسَأَلْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ عَنْ رَجُلٍ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ تَحِيضُ، تَمْكُثُ ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْهُرٍ، ثُمَّ تَحِيضُ حَيْضَةً، ثُمَّ يَتَأَخَّرُ عَنْهَا الْحَيْضُ، ثُمَّ تَمْكُثُ السَّبْعَةَ الْأَشْهُرَ وَالثَّمَانِيَةَ، ثُمَّ تَحِيضُ أُخْرَى تَسْتَعْجِلُ إِلَيْهَا مَرَّةً وَتَسْتَأْخِرُ أُخْرَى، كَيْفَ تَعْتَدُّ؟، قَالَ : " إِذَا اخْتَلَفَتْ حِيضَتُهَا عَنْ أَقْرَائِهَا فَعِدَّتُهَا سَنَةٌ "، قُلْتُ : وَكَيْفَ إِنْ كَانَ طَلَّقَ وَهِيَ تَحِيضُ فِي كُلِّ سَنَةٍ مَرَّةً كَمْ تَعْتَدُّ؟، قَالَ : " إِنْ كَانَتْ تَحِيضُ أَقْرَاؤُهَا مَعْلُومَةٌ هِيَ أَقْرَاؤُهَا، فَإِنَّا نُرَى أَنْ تَعْتَدَّ أَقْرَاءَهَا "
1.en: Narrated by al-Awza'i, from al-Zuhri: He said: I asked al-Zuhri about a man who divorced his wife while she was young and menstruating, then her menstruation ceased at the time he divorced her, and she saw no blood - how long does she wait? He said: "Three months." He said: And I asked al-Zuhri about a man who divorced his wife, and she menstruated twice, then her menstruation ceased - how long does she wait? He said: "Her waiting period is a year." He said: And I asked al-Zuhri about a man who divorced his wife while she menstruates - she stays three months, then menstruates once, then her menstruation is delayed from her, then she stays seven months and eight, then she menstruates again, hastening to it once and delaying another time - how does she observe her waiting period? He said: "When her menstruation differs from her cycles, her waiting period is a year." I said, "And how if he divorced her while she menstruates once every year - how long does she wait?" He said: "If her menstrual cycles are known, they are her cycles, so we hold that she observes her waiting period by her cycles."
1.hi: Al-Awza'i ne bataya: Maine al-Zuhri se poocha ek aise aadmi ke baare mein jisne apni biwi ko talaaq di jabke woh jawaan thi aur haiz aata tha, fir jab usne talaaq di to uska haiz ruk gaya, aur usne koi khoon na dekha - woh kitna intezaar kare? Unhone kaha, "Teen mahine." Unhone bataya: Aur maine al-Zuhri se poocha ek aise aadmi ke baare mein jisne apni biwi ko talaaq di, aur usay do haiz aaye, fir uska haiz ruk gaya - woh kitna intezaar kare? Unhone kaha, "Uski iddat ek saal hai." Unhone bataya: Aur maine al-Zuhri se poocha ek aise aadmi ke baare mein jisne apni biwi ko talaaq di jabke usay haiz aata hai - woh teen mahine rahe, fir usay ek haiz aaye, fir uska haiz der se aaye, fir woh saat mahine aur aath [mahine] rahe, fir usay dobara haiz aaye, kabhi jaldi aur kabhi der se - woh iddat kaise guzaare? Unhone kaha, "Jab uska haiz uske [aadat ke] chakron se mukhtalif ho jaaye, to uski iddat ek saal hai." Maine poocha, "Aur agar usne use talaaq di jabke usay saal mein ek baar haiz aata ho - woh kitna intezaar kare?" Unhone kaha, "Agar uske haiz ke chakr maloom hon, to wahi uske chakr hain, so hum yehi maante hain ke woh apne chakron se iddat guzaare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ  عَنْ الرَّجُلِ يَبْتَاعُ الْجَارِيَةَ لَمْ تَبْلُغْ الْمَحِيضَ وَلَا تَحْمِلُ مِثْلُهَا، بِكَمْ يَسْتَبْرِئُهَا؟، قَالَ :" بِثَلَاثَةِ أَشْهُرٍ "، وَقَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  : " بِخَمْسَةٍ وَأَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا "
1.en: Narrated by al-Awza'i, from al-Zuhri; with Yahya ibn Abi Kathir's view: He said: I asked al-Zuhri about a man who purchases a slave-girl who has not reached the age of menstruation and the like of her does not become pregnant - for how long does he perform istibra'? He said: "Three months." And Yahya ibn Abi Kathir said: "Forty-five days."
1.hi: Al-Awza'i ne bataya: Maine al-Zuhri se poocha ek aise aadmi ke baare mein jo aisi laundi khareede jo abhi haiz ki umar tak na pahunchi ho aur uski jaisi laundi haamila nahi hoti - woh kitni muddat tak istibra' (intezaar) kare? Unhone kaha, "Teen mahine." Aur Yahya ibn Abi Kathir ne kaha: "Pachas mein se paanch kam din [45 din]."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ  ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ :" تَغْتَسِلُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ وَتُصَلِّي "، وَقَالَ حَمَّادٌ : " لَوْ أَنَّ مُسْتَحَاضَةً جَهِلَتْ فَتَرَكَتْ الصَّلَاةَ أَشْهُرًا، فَإِنَّهَا تَقْضِي تِلْكَ الصَّلَوَاتِ، قِيلَ لَهُ : وَكَيْفَ تَقْضِيهَا؟، قَالَ : تَقْضِيهَا فِي يَوْمٍ وَاحِدٍ إِنْ اسْتَطَاعَتْ "، قِيلَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ : تَقُولُ بِهِ؟، قَالَ : إِي وَاللَّهِ
1.en: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما narrated; with Hammad's addition and Abdullah al-Darimi's response: That he used to say, concerning the woman with istihadah: "She performs ghusl at every prayer and prays." And Hammad said: "If a woman with istihadah were ignorant and left the prayer for months, then she makes up those prayers." It was said to him, "And how does she make them up?" He said: "She makes them up in a single day if she is able." It was said to Abdullah, "Do you hold this view?" He said, "Yes, by Allah."
1.hi: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما ne bataya ke woh mustahaza aurat ke baare mein kaha karte the: "Woh har namaz par ghusl kare aur namaz padhe." Aur Hammad ne kaha: "Agar mustahaza aurat najaankaari ki wajah se mahinon namaz chhod de, to woh un namazon ki qaza karegi." Unse poocha gaya, "Aur woh unki qaza kaise karegi?" Unhone kaha: "Woh unki qaza ek hi din mein kar le agar woh iski taaqat rakhti ho." Abdullah se poocha gaya, "Kya aap isi ke qaail hain?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, Allah ki qasam."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ   عَنْ الْحَامِلِ تَرَى الدَّمَ، فَقَالَ :" تَدَعُ الصَّلَاةَ "
1.en: Narrated by Malik, from al-Zuhri: He said: I asked al-Zuhri about the pregnant woman who sees blood, so he said: "She leaves the prayer."
1.hi: Malik ne bataya: Maine al-Zuhri se us haamila aurat ke baare mein poocha jo khoon dekhe, to unhone kaha: "Woh namaz chhod de."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ، مُجَاهِدًا  عَنْ امْرَأَتِي رَأَتْ دَمًا، وَأَنَا أُرَاهَا حَامِلًا، قَالَ :" ذَلِكَ غَيْضُ الْأَرْحَامِ # اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَحْمِلُ كُلُّ أُنْثَى وَمَا تَغِيضُ الأَرْحَامُ وَمَا تَزْدَادُ سورة الرعد آية 8 #، فَمَا غَاضَتْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ رَأَتْ مِثْلَهُ فِي الْحَمْلِ "
1.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn al-Aswad, from Mujahid: He said: I asked Mujahid about my wife who saw blood while I consider her pregnant, he said: "That is the ghayd [diminishing] of the wombs [referring to] 'Allah knows what every female carries and what the wombs fall short of and what they increase' [Surah al-Ra'd, verse 8], so whatever it falls short of something, she sees the like of it in the pregnancy."
1.hi: Uthman ibn al-Aswad ne bataya: Maine Mujahid se apni biwi ke baare mein poocha jisne khoon dekha jabke main use haamila samajhta hoon, unhone kaha: "Yeh rahmon ka 'ghayd' [kami] hai [is aayat ki taraf ishara]: 'Allah jaanta hai jo har maada apne pet mein rakhti hai aur jo kuch rahmein kam karti hain aur jo badhaati hain' [Surah Ar-Ra'd, aayat 8], so jo kuch kam ho, uska asar woh hamal mein isi tarah dekhti hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الْأَحْوَلِ ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  فِي هَذِهِ الْآيَةِ : # اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَحْمِلُ كُلُّ أُنْثَى وَمَا تَغِيضُ الأَرْحَامُ وَمَا تَزْدَادُ وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِمِقْدَارٍ سورة الرعد آية 8 #، قَالَ :" ذَلِكَ الْحَيْضُ عَلَى الْحَبَلِ، لَا تَحِيضُ يَوْمًا فِي الْحَبَلِ إِلَّا زَادَتْهُ طَاهِرًا فِي حَبَلِهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Ikrimah, concerning Surah al-Ra'd verse 8: Concerning "Allah knows what every female carries and what the wombs fall short of and what they increase, and everything with Him is by a measure" [Surah al-Ra'd, verse 8]: he said, "That is the menstruation during pregnancy; she does not menstruate a day during pregnancy except that it adds a day of purity to her pregnancy."
1.hi: Ikrimah ne is aayat ke baare mein bataya: "Allah jaanta hai jo har maada apne pet mein rakhti hai aur jo kuch rahmein kam karti hain aur jo badhaati hain, aur har cheez uske paas ek andaaze se hai" [Surah Ar-Ra'd, aayat 8]: unhone kaha, "Yeh hamal ke dauran ka haiz hai; woh hamal mein jis din bhi haiz mein ho, uska ek din uske hamal mein paaki ke roop mein badh jaata hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، قَالَ : أَمْرٌ لَا يُخْتَلَفُ فِيهِ عِنْدَنَا، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا" الْمَرْأَةُ الْحُبْلَى إِذَا رَأَتْ الدَّمَ أَنَّهَا لَا تُصَلِّي حَتَّى تَطْهُرَ "
1.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: He said: A matter about which there is no disagreement among us, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: "The pregnant woman, when she sees blood, does not pray until she becomes pure."
1.hi: Yahya ibn Sa'id ne bataya: Yeh ek aisi baat hai jismein humare yahan koi ikhtilaaf nahi, Aisha رضي الله عنها se: "Haamila aurat, jab woh khoon dekhe, to jab tak paak na ho namaz na padhe."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  : # وَمَا تَغِيضُ الأَرْحَامُ سورة الرعد آية 8 #، قَالَ :" هُوَ الْحَيْضُ عَلَى الْحَبَلِ # وَمَا تَزْدَادُ سورة الرعد آية 8 #، قَالَ : فَلَهَا بِكُلِّ يَوْمٍ حَاضَتْ فِي حَمْلِهَا يَوْمًا تَزْدَادُ فِي طُهْرِهَا حَتَّى تَسْتَكْمِلَ تِسْعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ طَاهِرًا "
1.en: Narrated by Ikrimah, concerning Surah al-Ra'd verse 8: Concerning "and what the wombs fall short of" [Surah al-Ra'd, verse 8]: he said, "That is the menstruation during pregnancy," concerning "and what they increase" [Surah al-Ra'd, verse 8]: he said: "So for every day she menstruated during her pregnancy, she has a day added to her pregnancy in purity, until she completes nine months in purity."
1.hi: Ikrimah ne bataya, is aayat ke baare mein "jo rahmein kam karti hain": unhone kaha, "Yeh hamal ke dauran ka haiz hai," aur "jo woh badhaati hain" ke baare mein: unhone kaha: "So jitne din woh apne hamal mein haiz mein rahi, utne din uske hamal mein paaki ke roop mein badh jaate hain, yahan tak ke woh nau mahine paaki mein poore kar le."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  : # وَمَا تَغِيضُ الأَرْحَامُ سورة الرعد آية 8 #، قَالَ :" إِذَا حَاضَتْ الْمَرْأَةُ وَهِيَ حَامِلٌ، قَالَ : يَكُونُ ذَلِكَ نُقْصَانًا مِنْ الْوَلَدِ، فَإِذَا زَادَتْ عَلَى تِسْعَةِ أَشْهُرٍ، كَانَ تَمَامًا لِمَا نَقَصَ مِنْ وَلَدِهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Mujahid, concerning Surah al-Ra'd verse 8: Concerning "and what the wombs fall short of" [Surah al-Ra'd, verse 8]: he said, "When the woman menstruates while she is pregnant," he said: "that becomes a deficiency in the child, so if it exceeds nine months, it is a completion for what was deficient in her child."
1.hi: Mujahid ne bataya, is aayat ke baare mein "jo rahmein kam karti hain": unhone kaha, "Jab aurat haamila hote hue haiz mein ho," unhone kaha: "Yeh bachche ke liye kami ban jaati hai, so agar [muddat] nau mahine se zyada ho jaaye, to yeh uski poorai hai jo uske bachche mein kami hui thi."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ ،  عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِيِّ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" امْرَأَتِي تَحِيضُ وَهِيَ حُبْلَى "، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : سَمِعْتُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ حَرْبٍ، يَقُولُ : امْرَأَتِي تَحِيضُ وَهِيَ حُبْلَى
1.en: Narrated by Humayd, from Bakr ibn Abdullah al-Muzani; Abu Muhammad also notes Sulayman ibn Harb's remark: That he said, "My wife menstruates while she is pregnant." Abu Muhammad said: I heard Sulayman ibn Harb say: "My wife menstruates while she is pregnant."
1.hi: Humayd ne Bakr ibn Abdullah al-Muzani se bataya ke unhone kaha, "Meri biwi ko hamal mein haiz aata hai." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Maine Sulayman ibn Harb ko kehte suna: "Meri biwi ko hamal mein haiz aata hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ :" إِذَا رَأَتْ الْحُبْلَى الدَّمَ، فَلْتُمْسِكْ عَنْ الصَّلَاةِ فَإِنَّهُ حَيْضٌ "، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ، عَن عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ
1.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Aisha رضي الله عنها; a similar report also given from Malik: That she said, "When the pregnant woman sees blood, let her withhold from the prayer, for it is menstruation." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Malik, that it reached him, from Aisha رضي الله عنها, the same.]
1.hi: Yahya ibn Sa'id ne Aisha رضي الله عنها se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab haamila aurat khoon dekhe, to woh namaz se ruk jaaye, kyunki yeh haiz hai." [Isi jaisi riwayat Malik se bhi, jo unhein Aisha رضي الله عنها se pahunchi, isi tarah aayi hai.]

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  فِي الْحَامِلِ تَرَى الدَّمَ" إِنْ كَانَ الدَّمُ عَبِيطًا، اغْتَسَلَتْ وَصَلَّتْ، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ تَرِيَّةً، تَوَضَّأَتْ وَصَلَّتْ "، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ ، مِثْلَهُ
1.en: Narrated by al-Sha'bi, concerning the pregnant woman who sees blood; a similar report also given from al-Awza'i: "If the blood is fresh/bright red, she performs ghusl and prays, and if it is tariyyah, she performs ablution and prays." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from al-Awza'i.]
1.hi: Al-Sha'bi ne us haamila aurat ke baare mein bataya jo khoon dekhe: "Agar khoon taaza surkh ho, to woh ghusl kare aur namaz padhe, aur agar woh tariyyah ho, to woh wudu kare aur namaz padhe." [Isi jaisi riwayat al-Awza'i se bhi aayi hai.]

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادُ هُوَ ابْنُ الْعَوَّامِ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" إِنْ كَانَتْ تَرَاهُ كَمَا كَانَتْ تَرَاهُ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ فِي أَقْرَائِهَا تَرَكَتْ الصَّلَاةَ، وَإِنْ كَانَ إِنَّمَا هُوَ فِي الْيَوْمِ أَوْ الْيَوْمَيْنِ، لَمْ تَدَعْ الصَّلَاةَ "
1.en: al-Hasan narrated: He said: "If she sees it as she used to see it before that in her cycles, she leaves the prayer, and if it is only for a day or two, she does not leave the prayer."
1.hi: Al-Hasan ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Agar woh use waisi hi dekhe jaisi pehle apne [aadat ke] chakron mein dekhti thi, to woh namaz chhod de, aur agar yeh sirf ek ya do din ke liye ho, to woh namaz na chhode."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ  ، وَعَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ مَطَرٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ،  عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا فِي الْحَامِلِ تَرَى الدَّمَ، قَالَتْ :" لَا يَمْنَعُهَا ذَلِكَ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Ata, from Aisha رضي الله عنها, concerning the pregnant woman who sees blood: She said, "That does not prevent her from prayer."
1.hi: Ata ne Aisha رضي الله عنها se, us haamila aurat ke baare mein bataya jo khoon dekhe: Unhone kaha, "Yeh use namaz se nahi rokta."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، عَنْ مَطَرٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   فِي الْحَامِلِ تَرَى الدَّمَ، قَالَتْ :" تَغْتَسِلُ وَتُصَلِّي "، قَالَ يَزِيدُ : " لَا تَغْتَسِلُ "، قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : أَقُولُ بِقَوْلِ يَزِيدَ
1.en: Narrated by Ata, from Aisha, concerning the pregnant woman who sees blood; with Yazid's and Abdullah al-Darimi's remarks: She said, "She performs ghusl and prays." Yazid said: "She does not perform ghusl." Abdullah [al-Darimi] said: I hold the saying of Yazid.
1.hi: Ata ne Aisha se, us haamila aurat ke baare mein bataya jo khoon dekhe: Unhone kaha, "Woh ghusl kare aur namaz padhe." Yazid ne kaha: "Woh ghusl na kare." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Main Yazid ke qaul par amal karta hoon.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ ، عَنْ يُونُسَ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  فِي الْحَامِلِ تَرَى الدَّمَ، قَالَ :" هِيَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ، غَيْرَ أَنَّهَا لَا تَدَعُ الصَّلَاةَ "
1.en: al-Hasan narrated, concerning the pregnant woman who sees blood: He said, "She is in the position of the woman with istihadah, except that she does not leave the prayer."
1.hi: Al-Hasan ne us haamila aurat ke baare mein bataya jo khoon dekhe: Unhone kaha, "Woh mustahaza aurat ke hukum mein hai, siwaay iske ke woh namaz nahi chhodti."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  فِي الْحَامِلِ تَرَى الدَّمَ، قَالَ :" تَغْسِلُ عَنْهَا الدَّمَ، وَتَتَوَضَّأُ، وَتُصَلِّي "
1.en: Ibrahim narrated, concerning the pregnant woman who sees blood: He said, "She washes off the blood, and performs ablution, and prays."
1.hi: Ibrahim ne us haamila aurat ke baare mein bataya jo khoon dekhe: Unhone kaha, "Woh apne se khoon dho de, aur wudu kare, aur namaz padhe."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ ،  عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، وَالْحَكَمِ ، قَالَا :" إِذَا رَأَتْ الْحَامِلُ الدَّمَ، تَوَضَّأَتْ وَصَلَّتْ "
1.en: Narrated by Ata and al-Hakam: They said, "When the pregnant woman sees blood, she performs ablution and prays."
1.hi: Ata aur al-Hakam ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab haamila aurat khoon dekhe, to woh wudu kare aur namaz padhe."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ جَامِعٍ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي رَاشِدٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  فِي الْحَامِلِ تَرَى الدَّمَ، قَالَ :" تَوَضَّأُ وَتُصَلِّي "
1.en: Ata narrated, concerning the pregnant woman who sees blood: He said, "She performs ablution and prays."
1.hi: Ata ne us haamila aurat ke baare mein bataya jo khoon dekhe: Unhone kaha, "Woh wudu kare aur namaz padhe."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ يُونُسَ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" هِيَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ "
1.en: al-Hasan narrated: He said: "She is in the position of the woman with istihadah."
1.hi: Al-Hasan ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Woh mustahaza aurat ke hukum mein hai."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" لَا يَكُونُ حَيْضٌ عَلَى حَمْلٍ "
1.en: Ibrahim narrated: He said: "There is no menstruation during pregnancy."
1.hi: Ibrahim ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Hamal ke dauran haiz nahi hota."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  فِي الْحَامِلِ تَرَى الدَّمَ، قَالَ :" هِيَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ "
1.en: al-Hasan narrated, concerning the pregnant woman who sees blood: He said: "She is in the position of the woman with istihadah."
1.hi: Al-Hasan ne us haamila aurat ke baare mein bataya jo khoon dekhe: Unhone kaha, "Woh mustahaza aurat ke hukum mein hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ " إِذَا رَأَتْ الْحَامِلُ الدَّمَ لَمْ تَدَعْ الصَّلَاةَ "
1.en: Ibrahim narrated: "When the pregnant woman sees blood, she does not leave the prayer."
1.hi: Ibrahim ne bataya: "Jab haamila aurat khoon dekhe, to woh namaz na chhode."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ الْحَجَّاجِ ،  عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، وَالْحَكَمِ بْنِ عُتَيْبَةَ ، أنهما قَالَا فِي الْحُبْلَى :" وَالَّتِي قَعَدَتْ عَنْ الْمَحِيضِ إِذَا رَأَتْ الدَّمَ، تَوَضَّأَتَا وَصَلَّتَا، وَلَا تَغْتَسِلَانِ "
1.en: Narrated by Ata and al-Hakam ibn Utaybah, concerning the pregnant woman and the one who has stopped menstruating: They said, "when she sees blood, the two of them perform ablution and pray, and the two of them do not perform ghusl."
1.hi: Ata aur al-Hakam ibn Utaybah ne haamila aurat aur us aurat ke baare mein bataya jiska haiz band ho chuka ho: Unhone kaha, "Jab woh khoon dekhein, to dono wudu karein aur namaz padhein, aur dono ghusl na karein."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ ، عَنْ مَطَرٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ :" تَغْتَسِلَانِ وَتُصَلِّيَانِ "
1.en: Ata narrated: He said: "The two of them perform ghusl and pray."
1.hi: Ata ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Dono ghusl karein aur namaz padhein."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الدِّمَشْقِيُّ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ :" إِنَّ الْحُبْلَى لَا تَحِيضُ، فَإِذَا رَأَتْ الدَّمَ، فَلْتَغْتَسِلْ، وَلْتُصَلِّي "
1.en: Aisha رضي الله عنها narrated: She said: "Indeed the pregnant woman does not menstruate, so when she sees blood, let her perform ghusl, and let her pray."
1.hi: Aisha رضي الله عنها ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Haamila aurat ko haiz nahi aata, so jab woh khoon dekhe, to woh ghusl kare, aur namaz padhe."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفُضَيْلِ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  فِي الْمَرْأَةِ إِذَا رَأَتْ الدَّمَ وَهِيَ تَمَخَّضُ، قَالَ :" هُوَ حَيْضٌ تَتْرُكُ الصَّلَاةَ "
1.en: Ibrahim narrated, concerning the woman who sees blood while she is in labor: He said: "It is menstruation; she leaves the prayer."
1.hi: Ibrahim ne us aurat ke baare mein bataya jo dard-e-zeh (labour pain) ke waqt khoon dekhe: Unhone kaha, "Yeh haiz hai; woh namaz chhod de."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَامِلِ" إِذَا ضَرَبَهَا الطَّلْقُ، وَرَأَتْ الدَّمَ عَلَى الْوَلَدِ، فَلْتُمْسِكْ عَنْ الصَّلَاةِ "، وقَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : تُصَلِّي مَا لَمْ تَضَعْ
1.en: al-Hasan narrated, concerning the pregnant woman; with Abdullah al-Darimi's response: "When labor pains strike her, and she sees blood upon the child, let her withhold from the prayer." And Abdullah [al-Darimi] said: She prays as long as she has not given birth.
1.hi: Al-Hasan ne haamila aurat ke baare mein bataya: "Jab use dard-e-zeh shuru ho, aur woh bachche ke saath khoon dekhe, to woh namaz se ruk jaaye." Aur Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Woh namaz padhegi jab tak use bachcha na ho jaaye.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  فِي النُّفَسَاءِ" كَطُهْرِ امْرَأَةٍ مِنْ نِسَائِهَا "
1.en: Qatadah narrated, concerning the woman in postpartum bleeding: "[Her waiting period is] like the purity period of a woman from among her women [family]."
1.hi: Qatadah ne nifas wali aurat ke baare mein bataya: "[Uski muddat] uske ghar ki auraton mein se kisi ek aurat ki paaki ki tarah hai [yaani uske khaandan ki aadat ke mutaabiq]."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  فِي النُّفَسَاءِ" تُمْسِكُ عَنْ الصَّلَاةِ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا، فَإِنْ رَأَتْ الطُّهْرَ فَذَاكَ، وَإِنْ لَمْ تَرَ الطُّهْرَ، أَمْسَكَتْ عَنْ الصَّلَاةِ أَيَّامًا خَمْسًا، سِتًّا، فَإِنْ طَهُرَتْ فَذَاكَ، وَإِلَّا أَمْسَكَتْ عَنْ الصَّلَاةِ مَا بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ الْخَمْسِينَ، فَإِنْ طَهُرَتْ فَذَاكَ، وَإِلَّا فَهِيَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ "
1.en: al-Hasan narrated, concerning the woman in postpartum bleeding: "She withholds from prayer forty days; then if she sees purity, that is that; and if she does not see purity, she withholds from prayer five, six days; then if she becomes pure, that is that; otherwise she withholds from prayer what is between her and fifty; then if she becomes pure, that is that; otherwise she is a woman with istihadah."
1.hi: Al-Hasan ne nifas wali aurat ke baare mein bataya: "Woh chaalis din namaz se ruki rahe; fir agar woh paaki dekh le, to theek hai; aur agar paaki na dekhe, to woh paanch, chhe din aur ruki rahe; fir agar woh paak ho jaaye, to theek hai; warna woh apne aur pachaas [din] ke darmiyan tak ruki rahe; fir agar woh paak ho jaaye, to theek hai; warna woh mustahaza hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَاصِ  أَنَّهُ كَانَ" لَا يَقْرَبُ النُّفَسَاءَ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا "، وقَالَ الْحَسَنُ : " النُّفَسَاءُ خَمْسَةٌ وَأَرْبَعُونَ إِلَى خَمْسِينَ، فَمَا زَادَ فَهِيَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Hasan, about Uthman ibn Abi al-As; with al-Hasan's own view: That he "did not approach the woman in postpartum bleeding for forty days." And al-Hasan said: "The postpartum period is forty-five up to fifty; whatever exceeds that, she is a woman with istihadah."
1.hi: Al-Hasan ne bataya ke Uthman ibn Abi al-As "chaalis din tak nifas wali aurat ke paas nahi jaate the." Aur al-Hasan ne kaha: "Nifas paitalis se pachas din tak hai; jo isse zyada ho, woh mustahaza hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَاصِ ، قَالَ :" وَقْتُ النُّفَسَاءِ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا، فَإِنْ طَهُرَتْ، وَإِلَّا فَلَا تُجَاوِزْهُ حَتَّى تُصَلِّيَ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Hasan, from Uthman ibn Abi al-As: He said: "The time of postpartum bleeding is forty days; if she becomes pure, and if not, she should not exceed it until she prays."
1.hi: Al-Hasan ne Uthman ibn Abi al-As se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Nifas ka waqt chaalis din hai; agar woh paak ho jaaye [to theek hai], aur agar nahi, to usay isse aage nahi badhna chahiye, use namaz padhni chahiye."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ :" إِنْ كَانَ لِلنُّفَسَاءِ عَادَةٌ، وَإِلَّا جَلَسَتْ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً "
1.en: Ata narrated: He said: "If the woman in postpartum bleeding has a habitual pattern [she follows it]; and if not, she sits forty nights."
1.hi: Ata ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Agar nifas wali aurat ki koi aadat (muqarrar muddat) ho [to usi par amal kare]; warna woh chaalis raatein baithi rahe."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ :" النِّفَاسُ حَيْضٌ "
1.en: Ata narrated: He said: "Postpartum bleeding is [reckoned as] menstruation."
1.hi: Ata ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Nifas haiz [ke hukum mein] hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مَاهَكَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ :" تَنْتَظِرُ النُّفَسَاءُ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا أَوْ نَحْوَهَا "
1.en: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما narrated: He said: "The woman in postpartum bleeding waits forty days or thereabouts."
1.hi: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Nifas wali aurat chaalis din ya uske aas-paas intezaar kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْأَعْلَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَهْلٍ الْبَصْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ مُسَّةَ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ :" كَانَتْ النُّفَسَاءُ " تَجْلِسُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا، أَوْ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً، وَكَانَتْ إِحْدَانَا تَطْلِي الْوَرْسَ عَلَى وَجْهِهَا مِنْ الْكَلَفِ "
1.en: Umm Salamah رضي الله عنها narrated: She said: "The women in postpartum bleeding used to sit, in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, forty days, or forty nights, and one of us would apply wars on her face because of the dark facial patches."
1.hi: Umm Salamah رضي الله عنها ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Nifas wali auratein Rasulullah ﷺ ke zamane mein chaalis din, ya chaalis raatein baithi rehti thin, aur humein se koi apne chehre par 'wars' [zard rang ka lep] lagati thi kalaf [chehre par kaale dhabbe] ki wajah se."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ جَلْدٍ ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ : أَنَّ امْرَأَةً لِعَائِذِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  نُفِسَتْ فَجَاءَتْ بَعْدَمَا مَضَتْ عِشْرُونَ لَيْلَةً فَدَخَلَتْ فِي لِحَافِهِ، فَقَالَ : مَنْ هَذِهِ؟، قَالَتْ : أَنَا فُلَانَةُ، إِنِّي قَدْ تَطَهَّرْتُ فَرَكَضَهَا بِرِجْلِهِ، فَقَالَ :" لَا تُغَرِّنِي عَنْ دِينِي حَتَّى تَمْضِيَ أَرْبَعُونَ لَيْلَةً "
1.en: Narrated by Mu'awiyah ibn Qurrah: That a wife of A'idh ibn Amr gave birth, and she came to him after twenty nights had passed, and entered his bedcovers, so he said, "Who is this?" She said, "I am so-and-so, I have purified myself." So he pushed her away with his foot, and said, "Do not deceive me away from my religion until forty nights have passed."
1.hi: Mu'awiyah ibn Qurrah ne bataya ke A'idh ibn Amr ki ek biwi ko bachcha hua, aur woh bees raatein guzarne ke baad unke paas aayi aur unki chaadar mein ghus gayi, to unhone kaha, "Yeh kaun hai?" Usne kaha, "Main fulaani hoon, main paak ho chuki hoon." To unhone use apne paaon se dhakel diya, aur kaha, "Mujhe mere deen se dhoka na do jab tak chaalis raatein na guzar jaayein."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مَاهَكَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ :" النُّفَسَاءُ تَجْلِسُ نَحْوًا مِنْ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا "
1.en: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما narrated: He said: "The woman in postpartum bleeding sits about forty days."
1.hi: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Nifas wali aurat taqreeban chaalis din baithi rahe."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مَاهَكَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ :" النُّفَسَاءُ تَنْتَظِرُ نَحْوًا مِنْ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا "
1.en: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما narrated: He said: "The woman in postpartum bleeding waits about forty days."
1.hi: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Nifas wali aurat taqreeban chaalis din intezaar kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، أَنَّ الْحَسَنَ ، قَالَ فِي النُّفَسَاءِ الَّتِي تَرَى الدَّمَ :" تَرَبَّصُ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً، ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي "، وَقَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ  : " شَهْرَيْنِ ثُمَّ هِيَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ "
1.en: Narrated by Mu'tamir, from his father, from al-Hasan; with al-Sha'bi's view: That al-Hasan said, concerning the woman in postpartum bleeding who sees blood: "She waits forty nights, then she prays." And al-Sha'bi said: "Two months, then she is in the position of the woman with istihadah."
1.hi: Mu'tamir ne apne walid se bataya ke al-Hasan ne, nifas wali aurat ke baare mein jo khoon dekhe, kaha: "Woh chaalis raatein intezaar kare, fir namaz padhe." Aur al-Sha'bi ne kaha: "Do mahine, fir woh mustahaza aurat ke hukum mein hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ شُعَيْبٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ الْأَفْطَسُ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ الْعَلَاءَ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ ، قَالَ :" الْمَرْأَةُ تَنْتَظِرُ مِنْ الْغُلَامِ ثَلَاثِينَ يَوْمًا، وَمِنْ الْجَارِيَةِ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا "، يَعْنِي : النُّفَسَاءَ، قَالَ مَرْوَانُ : هُوَ قَوْلُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، وقَالَ الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ : هُمَا سَوَاءٌ
1.en: Narrated by Ibrahim ibn Sulayman al-Aftas, from al-Ala ibn al-Harith, from Makhul; with Marwan's and al-Awza'i's notes: He said: "The woman waits, for a boy, thirty days, and for a girl, forty days" - meaning, the woman in postpartum bleeding. Marwan said: This is the saying of Sa'id ibn Abd al-Aziz, and al-Awza'i said: The two of them are equal.
1.hi: Ibrahim ibn Sulayman al-Aftas ne al-Ala ibn al-Harith se, Makhul se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Aurat, agar ladka ho to teen martaba das din [30 din], aur agar ladki ho to chaalis din intezaar kare" - yaani, nifas wali aurat. Marwan kehte hain: Yeh Sa'id ibn Abd al-Aziz ka qaul hai, aur al-Awza'i kehte hain: Dono barabar hain.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا رَأَتْ الدَّمَ عِنْدَ الطَّلْقِ يَوْمًا أَوْ يَوْمَيْنِ، فَهُوَ مِنْ النِّفَاسِ "
1.en: al-Hasan narrated: He said: "When she sees blood at the time of labor pains a day or two, it is from postpartum bleeding."
1.hi: Al-Hasan ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab woh dard-e-zeh ke waqt ek ya do din khoon dekhe, to yeh nifas mein se hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  فِي الْحَامِلِ تَرَى الدَّمَ وَهِيَ تَطْلُقُ، قَالَ :" تَصْنَعُ مَا تَصْنَعُ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ "
1.en: Ata narrated, concerning the pregnant woman who sees blood while she is in labor: He said: "She does what the woman with istihadah does."
1.hi: Ata ne us haamila aurat ke baare mein bataya jo dard-e-zeh ke waqt khoon dekhe: Unhone kaha, "Woh wahi kare jo mustahaza aurat karti hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تُجْنِبُ، ثُمَّ تَحِيضُ، قَالَ :" تَغْتَسِلُ "، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، مِثْلَهُ
1.en: Ibrahim narrated, concerning the woman who becomes junub, then menstruates; a similar report also from al-Hasan: He said: "She performs ghusl." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from al-Hasan.]
1.hi: Ibrahim ne us aurat ke baare mein bataya jo janabat mein ho, fir usay haiz aa jaaye: Unhone kaha, "Woh ghusl kare." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se al-Hasan se bhi aayi hai.]

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ :" الْحَيْضُ أَكْبَرُ "
1.en: Ata narrated: He said: "Menstruation is greater [i.e., a more major state of impurity]."
1.hi: Ata ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Haiz [janabat se] bada hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  فِي رَجُلٍ غَشِيَ امْرَأَتَهُ فَحَاضَتْ، فَقَالَ :" تَغْتَسِلُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ "
1.en: Narrated by Mughirah, from Ibrahim, concerning a man who had intercourse with his wife then she menstruated: He said, "That she performs ghusl is more beloved to me."
1.hi: Mughirah ne Ibrahim se, us aadmi ke baare mein bataya jisne apni biwi se sohbat ki fir usay haiz aa gaya: Unhone kaha, "Mujhe zyada pasand hai ke woh ghusl kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، وَالنَّخَعِيِّ ، قَالَا :" لِتَغْتَسِلْ مِنْ الْجَنَابَةِ "، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ الْأَحْوَلِ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ
1.en: Narrated by Hajjaj, from Ata and al-Nakha'i; a similar report also from Amir al-Ahwal, from al-Hasan: They said: "Let her perform ghusl from janabah." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Amir al-Ahwal, from al-Hasan.]
1.hi: Hajjaj ne Ata aur al-Nakha'i se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Woh janabat se ghusl kare." [Isi jaisi riwayat Amir al-Ahwal se, al-Hasan se bhi aayi hai.]

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْعَلَاءُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ عَنْهَا حَمَّادٌ ، فَقَالَ : قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ  :" تَغْتَسِلُ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Ala ibn al-Musayyab, about Hammad and Ibrahim: He said: Hammad was asked about it, so he said: Ibrahim said: "She performs ghusl."
1.hi: Al-Ala ibn al-Musayyab ne bataya: Hammad se iske baare mein poocha gaya, to unhone kaha: Ibrahim ne kaha: "Woh ghusl kare."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى ، عَنْ ابْنِ فُضَيْلٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، قَالَ :" تَغْتَسِلُ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Salim, from al-Sha'bi: He said: "She performs ghusl."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Salim ne al-Sha'bi se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Woh ghusl kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ الْحَكَمَ بْنَ عُتَيْبَةَ ، يَقُولُ :" كَانَ يُعْجِبُهُمْ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ أَنْ تَتَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءَهَا لِلصَّلَاةِ، ثُمَّ تُسَبِّحَ اللَّهَ وَتُكَبِّرَهُ فِي وَقْتِ الصَّلَاةِ "
1.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Ayyub, from al-Hakam ibn Utaybah: He said: I heard al-Hakam ibn Utaybah say: "They used to like, concerning the menstruating woman, that she perform ablution as her ablution for prayer, then glorify Allah and magnify Him at the time of the prayer."
1.hi: Yahya ibn Ayyub ne bataya: Maine al-Hakam ibn Utaybah ko kehte suna: "Unhein yeh baat pasand thi ke haiz wali aurat namaz ke wudu ki tarah wudu kare, fir namaz ke waqt Allah ki tasbih aur takbir kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِأَبِي قِلَابَةَ  :" الْحَائِضُ تَتَوَضَّأُ عِنْدَ وَقْتِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ، وَتَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ؟، فَقَالَ : مَا وَجَدْتُ لِهَذَا أَصْلًا "
1.en: Narrated by Sulayman al-Taymi, from Abu Qilabah: He said: I said to Abu Qilabah, "Does the menstruating woman perform ablution at the time of every prayer, and remember Allah?" He said, "I did not find any basis for this."
1.hi: Sulayman al-Taymi ne bataya: Maine Abu Qilabah se poocha, "Kya haiz wali aurat har namaz ke waqt wudu kare, aur Allah ka zikr kare?" Unhone kaha, "Mujhe iski koi asal nahi mili."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيد  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الصَّدَفِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ" يَأْمُرُ الْمَرْأَةَ الْحَائِضَ عِنْدَ أَوَانِ الصَّلَاةِ أَنْ تَوَضَّأَ، وَتَجْلِسَ بِفِنَاءِ مَسْجِدِهَا، فَتَذْكُرَ اللَّهَ وَتُسَبِّحَ "
1.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Yazid al-Sadafi, from his father, from Uqbah ibn Amir al-Juhani رضي الله عنه: That he "used to command the menstruating woman, at the time of prayer, to perform ablution, and sit in the courtyard of her mosque, and remember Allah and glorify Him."
1.hi: Khalid ibn Yazid al-Sadafi ne apne walid se, Uqbah ibn Amir al-Juhani رضي الله عنه se bataya ke woh "haiz wali aurat ko namaz ke waqt hukum dete the ke woh wudu kare, aur apni masjid ke sehan mein baithe, aur Allah ka zikr kare aur tasbih kare."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ : أَتَقْرَأُ؟، قَالَ :" لَا، إِلَّا طَرَفَ الْآيَةِ وَلَكِنْ تَوَضَّأُ عِنْدَ وَقْتِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ، ثُمَّ تَسْتَقْبِلُ الْقِبْلَةَ وَتُسَبِّحُ وَتُكَبِّرُ وَتَدْعُو اللَّهَ G "
1.en: Narrated by Abd al-Malik, from Ata, concerning the menstruating woman: "Does she recite?" He said, "No, except part of a verse, but she performs ablution at the time of every prayer, then faces the Qiblah and glorifies [Allah], and magnifies [Him], and supplicates to Allah, mighty and majestic is He."
1.hi: Abd al-Malik ne Ata se, haiz wali aurat ke baare mein bataya: "Kya woh [Quran] padhe?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi, sirf aayat ka ek tukda [padh sakti hai], lekin woh har namaz ke waqt wudu kare, fir Qibla ki taraf rukh kare aur tasbih kare aur takbir kare aur Allah 'Azza wa Jall se dua kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ ، حَدَّثَنَا ضَمْرَةُ ، حَدَّثَنَا الشَّيْبَانِيُّ وَهُوَ يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي عَمْرٍو مِنْ أَهْلِ الرَّمْلَةِ ، حَدَّثَنَا مَكْحُولٌ ، قَالَ :" تُؤْمَرُ الْحَائِضُ تَتَوَضَّأُ عِنْدَ مَوَاقِيتِ الصَّلَاةِ، وَتَسْتَقْبِلُ الْقِبْلَةَ وَتَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ تَعَالَي "
1.en: Narrated by al-Shaybani (Yahya ibn Abi Amr, from the people of al-Ramlah), from Makhul: He said: "The menstruating woman is commanded to perform ablution at the times of prayer, and face the Qiblah, and remember Allah the Exalted."
1.hi: Al-Shaybani (Yahya ibn Abi Amr, ahl-e-Ramlah mein se) ne Makhul se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Haiz wali aurat ko hukum diya jaata hai ke woh namaz ke waqton par wudu kare, aur Qibla ki taraf rukh kare, aur Allah Ta'ala ka zikr kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا سَمِعَ الْحَائِضُ وَالْجُنُبُ السَّجْدَةَ، يَغْتَسِلُ الْجُنُبُ وَيَسْجُدُ، وَلَا تَقْضِي الْحَائِضُ، لِأَنَّهَا لَا تُصَلِّي "
1.en: Narrated by Hammad, from Ibrahim: He said: "When the menstruating woman and the one in janabah hear the verse of prostration, the one in janabah performs ghusl and prostrates, and the menstruating woman does not make it up, because she does not pray."
1.hi: Hammad ne Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab haiz wali aurat aur janabat wala aayat-e-sajdah sunein, to janabat wala ghusl kare aur sajda kare, aur haiz wali qaza na kare, kyunki woh namaz nahi padhti."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  فِي الْحَائِضِ تَسْمَعُ السَّجْدَةَ، قَالَ :" لَا تَقْضِي "
1.en: Narrated by Mughirah, from Ibrahim, concerning the menstruating woman who hears the verse of prostration: He said: "She does not make it up."
1.hi: Mughirah ne Ibrahim se, haiz wali aurat ke baare mein bataya jo aayat-e-sajdah sune: Unhone kaha, "Woh qaza na kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ ، وَجَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" لَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا شَيْءٌ "
1.en: Narrated by Sa'id, from Abu Ma'shar, from Ibrahim: He said: "Nothing is due upon her."
1.hi: Sa'id ne Abu Ma'shar se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Uspar kuch wajib nahi."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدَةُ بْنُ مُعَتِّبٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ :" كُنَّا نَحِيضُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَمَا يَأْمُرُ امْرَأَةً مِنَّا بِرَدِّ الصَّلَاةِ "
1.en: Narrated by Ubaydah ibn Mu'attib, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: She said: "We used to menstruate in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he did not command any of us women to make up the prayer."
1.hi: Ubaydah ibn Mu'attib ne Ibrahim se, al-Aswad se, Aisha رضي الله عنها se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke zamane mein haiz mein aati thin, aur aap humein se kisi ko namaz ki qaza karne ka hukum nahi dete the."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ مُعَاذَةَ  : أَنَّ امْرَأَةً سَأَلَتْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا : أَتَقْضِي إِحْدَانَا صَلَاةَ أَيَّامِ حَيْضِهَا؟، فَقَالَتْ :" أَحَرُورِيَّةٌ أَنْتِ؟ قَدْ كَانَتْ إِحْدَانَا تَحِيضُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَلَا تُؤْمَرُ بِقَضَاءٍ "، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ الرِّشْكِ  ، عَنْ مُعَاذَةَ  ، قَالَ أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ : " كَأَنَّ حَمَّادًا فَرِقَ حَدِيثَ أَيُّوبَ، فَجَاءَ بِهَذَا "
1.en: Narrated by Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah, from Mu'adhah; a similar chain also via Yazid al-Rishk, from Mu'adhah: That a woman asked Aisha رضي الله عنها, "Does one of us make up the prayer of the days of her menstruation?" She said, "Are you a Haruriyyah? One of us used to menstruate in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and she was not commanded to make up." [Another chain] from Yazid al-Rishk, from Mu'adhah. Abu al-Nu'man said: "It seems Hammad was uncertain about Ayyub's hadith, so he brought this [version instead]."
1.hi: Ayyub ne Abu Qilabah se, Mu'adhah se bataya ke ek aurat ne Aisha رضي الله عنها se poocha, "Kya humein se koi apne haiz ke dinon ki namaz qaza kare?" Unhone kaha, "Kya tum Haruriyyah [Khariji firqe ki] ho? Humein se koi Rasulullah ﷺ ke zamane mein haiz mein aati thi, aur usay qaza karne ka hukum nahi diya jaata tha." [Ek aur sanad] Yazid al-Rishk se, Mu'adhah se. Abu al-Nu'man kehte hain: "Lagta hai Hammad Ayyub ki riwayat mein shak mein pad gaye, so unhone yeh [doosri riwayat] pesh ki."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا سَمِعَتْ الْحَائِضُ السَّجْدَةَ، فَلَا تَسْجُدْ "
1.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Abdullah, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Amir: He said: "When the menstruating woman hears the verse of prostration, she does not prostrate."
1.hi: Khalid ibn Abdullah ne Ata ibn al-Sa'ib se, Amir se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab haiz wali aurat aayat-e-sajdah sune, to woh sajda na kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ ، قَالَ :" لَا تَسْجُدُ الْمَرْأَةُ الْحَائِضُ إِذَا سَمِعَتْ السَّجْدَةَ "
1.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Abdullah, from Khalid al-Hadhdha, from Abu Qilabah: He said: "The menstruating woman does not prostrate when she hears the verse of prostration."
1.hi: Khalid ibn Abdullah ne Khalid al-Hadhdha se, Abu Qilabah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Haiz wali aurat aayat-e-sajdah sunne par sajda nahi karti."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ" يَكْرَهُ لِلْحَائِضِ أَنْ تَسْجُدَ إِذَا سَمِعَتْ السَّجْدَةَ "
1.en: Narrated by Khalid, from al-Hasan ibn Ubaydullah, from Ibrahim: That he "used to dislike for the menstruating woman to prostrate when she hears the verse of prostration."
1.hi: Khalid ne al-Hasan ibn Ubaydullah se, Ibrahim se bataya ke woh "haiz wali aurat ke aayat-e-sajdah sunne par sajda karne ko na-pasand karte the."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي غَالِبٍ عَجْلَانَ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْ النُّفَسَاءِ وَالْحَائِضِ : هَلْ تَقْضِيَانِ الصَّلَاةَ إِذَا تَطَهَّرْنَ، قَالَ :" هُوَ ذَا، أَزْوَاجُ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَلَوْ فَعَلْنَ ذَلِكَ أَمَرْنَا نِسَاءَنَا بِذَلِكَ "
1.en: Narrated by Abu Ghalib Ajlan, about Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه: He said: I asked Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه about the woman in postpartum bleeding and the menstruating woman: "Do the two of them make up the prayer when they become pure?" He said: "This is indeed the case of the wives of the Prophet ﷺ; had they done that, we would have commanded our women to do the same."
