1.hi: Abu Ghalib Ajlan ne bataya: Maine Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه se nifas wali aur haiz wali aurat ke baare mein poocha: "Kya woh paak hone ke baad namaz ki qaza karein?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh to Nabi ﷺ ki biwiyon ki misaal hai; agar unhone aisa kiya hota, to hum apni auraton ko bhi isi ka hukum dete."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ  ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : أَتَتْ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى عَائِشَةَ  ، فَقَالَتْ : أَقْضِي مَا تَرَكْتُ مِنْ صَلاتِي فِي الْحَيْضِ عِنْدَ الطُّهْرِ؟، فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ :" أَحَرُورِيَّةٌ أَنْتِ؟ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَكَانَتْ إِحْدَانَا تَحِيضُ وَتَطْهُرُ، فَلَا يَأْمُرُنَا بِالْقَضَاءِ "
1.en: Narrated by Layth, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from his father: He said: A woman came to Aisha, and said, "Shall I make up what I left of my prayer during menstruation, when I become pure?" So Aisha said: "Are you a Haruriyyah? We used to be with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and one of us would menstruate and become pure, and he would not command us to make up."
1.hi: Layth ne Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim se, apne walid se bataya: Ek aurat Aisha ke paas aayi, aur kaha, "Kya main haiz ke dauran chhodi hui apni namazon ki, paaki ke waqt, qaza karun?" To Aisha ne kaha: "Kya tum Haruriyyah ho? Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath rehti thin, aur humein se koi haiz mein aati aur paak hoti, aur aap humein qaza karne ka hukum nahi dete the."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ ، عَنْ كَثِيرٍ أَبِي إِسْمَاعِيل ، قَالَ : قُلْت لِفَاطِمَةَ  يَعْنِي بِنْتَ عَلِيٍّ :" أَتَقْضِينَ الصَلَاةَ أَيَّامِ حَيْضِكِ؟، قَالَتْ : لَا "
1.en: Narrated by Kathir Abu Isma'il, about Fatimah bint Ali: He said: I said to Fatimah - meaning the daughter of Ali - "Do you make up the prayer of the days of your menstruation?" She said, "No."
1.hi: Kathir Abu Isma'il ne bataya: Maine Fatimah - yaani Ali (Alayhis Salam) ki beti - se poocha, "Kya aap apne haiz ke dinon ki namaz qaza karti hain?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ الرِّشْكِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ مُعَاذَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا سَأَلَتْهَا امْرَأَةٌ : أَتَقْضِي الْحَائِضُ الصَّلَاةَ؟، قَالَتْ :" أَحَرُورِيَّةٌ أَنْتِ؟ قَدْ حِضْنَ نِسَاءُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَأَمَرَهُنَّ يَجْزِينَ "، قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : مَعْنَاهُ أَنَّهُنَّ لَا يَقْضِينَ
1.en: Narrated by Yazid al-Rishk, from Mu'adhah, from Aisha رضي الله عنها; with Abdullah al-Darimi's note: He said: I heard Mu'adhah, from Aisha رضي الله عنها, that a woman asked her: "Does the menstruating woman make up the prayer?" She said: "Are you a Haruriyyah? The wives of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to menstruate, and he commanded them that it sufficed them." Abdullah said: Its meaning is that they do not make it up.
1.hi: Yazid al-Rishk ne bataya: Maine Mu'adhah ko Aisha رضي الله عنها se yeh naql karte suna ke ek aurat ne unse poocha: "Kya haiz wali aurat namaz ki qaza kare?" Unhone kaha: "Kya tum Haruriyyah ho? Rasulullah ﷺ ki biwiyon ko haiz aata tha, aur aap unhein hukum dete the ke unke liye [bina qaza ke] kaafi hai." Abdullah kehte hain: Iska matlab hai ke woh qaza nahi karti thin.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" الْحَائِضُ وَالْجُنُبُ يَذْكُرَانِ اللَّهَ، وَيُسَمِّيَانِ "
1.en: Narrated by Mughirah, from Ibrahim: He said: "The menstruating woman and the one in janabah remember Allah, and pronounce His name."
1.hi: Mughirah ne Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Haiz wali aurat aur janabat wala Allah ka zikr kar sakte hain, aur uska naam le sakte hain [Bismillah keh sakte hain]."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، قَالَ : بَلَغَنِي عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ ، أنهما قَالَا :" لَا يَقْرَأْ الْجُنُبُ وَالْحَائِضُ آيَةً تَامَّةً، يَقْرَآنِ الْحَرْفَ "
1.en: Narrated by Sufyan, from Ibrahim and Sa'id ibn Jubayr: He said: It reached me from Ibrahim, and Sa'id ibn Jubayr, that the two of them said: "The one in janabah and the menstruating woman should not recite a complete verse; the two of them [may] recite [a single] word."
1.hi: Sufyan ne bataya: Mujhe Ibrahim aur Sa'id ibn Jubayr se khabar pahunchi hai ke un dono ne kaha, "Janabat wala aur haiz wali aurat mukammal aayat na padhein; dono [sirf] lafz [ek shabd] padh sakte hain."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْبَزَّازُ ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ ، عَنْ فِرَاسٍ ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  :" الْجُنُبُ وَالْحَائِضُ لَا يَقْرَآنِ الْقُرْآنَ "
1.en: Narrated by Shuraik, from Firas, from Amir: "The one in janabah and the menstruating woman do not recite the Qur'an."
1.hi: Shuraik ne Firas se, Amir se bataya: "Janabat wala aur haiz wali aurat Quran nahi padhte."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ عُمَرُ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ يَكْرَهُ أَوْ" يَنْهَى أَنْ يَقْرَأَ الْجُنُبُ "، قَالَ شُعْبَةُ : " وَجَدْتُ فِي الْكِتَابِ وَالْحَائِضُ "
1.en: Ibrahim narrated; with Shu'bah's note: He said: "Umar رضي الله عنه used to dislike, or forbid, that the one in janabah recite [Quran]." Shu'bah said: "I found in the book also 'and the menstruating woman.'"
1.hi: Ibrahim ne bataya: "Umar رضي الله عنه janabat wale ke [Quran] padhne ko na-pasand karte the, ya mana karte the." Shu'bah kehte hain: "Maine kitaab mein 'aur haiz wali aurat' bhi paaya."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" أَرْبَعَةٌ لَا يَقْرَءُونَ الْقُرْآنَ : عِنْدَ الْخَلَاءِ، وَفِي الْحَمَّامِ، وَالْجُنُبُ، وَالْحَائِضُ، إِلَّا الْآيَةَ وَنَحْوَهَا لِلْجُنُبِ وَالْحَائِضِ "
1.en: Ibrahim narrated: He said: "Four do not recite the Qur'an: at the place of relieving oneself, and in the bathhouse, and the one in janabah, and the menstruating woman - except a verse and the like of it for the one in janabah and the menstruating woman."
1.hi: Ibrahim ne bataya: "Chaar log Quran nahi padhte: qaza-e-hajat ki jagah par, aur hammam mein, aur janabat wala, aur haiz wali aurat - siwaay ek aayat ya usi jaisi cheez ke, janabat wale aur haiz wali aurat ke liye."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الْأَحْمَرُ ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، وَحَمَّادٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ ، قَالُوا :" الْحَائِضُ وَالْجُنُبُ يَسْتَفْتِحُونَ الْآيَةَ وَلَا يُتِمُّونَ آخِرَهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Ata, and Hammad, from Ibrahim and Sa'id ibn Jubayr: They said: "The menstruating woman and the one in janabah begin the verse but do not complete its end."
1.hi: Ata, aur Hammad ne Ibrahim aur Sa'id ibn Jubayr se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Haiz wali aurat aur janabat wala aayat shuru kar sakte hain lekin uska aakhir mukammal nahi karte."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الْأَحْوَلِ ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ ، فِي الْحَائِضِ، قَالَ :" لَا تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ "
1.en: Narrated by Asim al-Ahwal, from Abu al-Aliyah, concerning the menstruating woman: He said: "She does not recite the Qur'an."
1.hi: Asim al-Ahwal ne Abu al-Aliyah se, haiz wali aurat ke baare mein bataya: Unhone kaha, "Woh Quran na padhe."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، وَأَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، قَالَا : أَخْبَرَنَا السَّائِبُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ  ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا كَانَتْ" تَرْقِي أَسْمَاءَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا وَهِيَ عَارِكٌ "
1.en: Narrated by Ibn Abi Mulaykah, about Aisha رضي الله عنها: That Aisha رضي الله عنها used to "recite ruqyah over Asma رضي الله عنها while she was menstruating."
1.hi: Ibn Abi Mulaykah ne bataya ke Aisha رضي الله عنها "Asma رضي الله عنها par ruqyah (dua padh kar dam) karti thin jabke woh haiz mein hoti thin."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ ، قَالَ :" الْجُنُبُ يَذْكُرُ اسْمَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى "
1.en: Qatadah narrated: He said: "The one in janabah remembers the name of Allah the Exalted."
1.hi: Qatadah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Janabat wala Allah Ta'ala ka naam le sakta hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ سَيَّارٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ ، قَالَ : كَانَ يُقَالُ :" لَا يَقْرَأُ الْجُنُبُ، وَلَا الْحَائِضُ، وَلَا يُقْرَأُ فِي الْحَمَّامِ، وَحَالَانِ لَا يَذْكُرُ الْعَبْدُ فِيهِمَا اللَّهَ : عِنْدَ الْخَلَاءِ، وَعِنْدَ الْجِمَاعِ، إِلَّا أَنَّ الرَّجُلَ إِذَا أَتَى أَهْلَهُ، بَدَأَ فَسَمَّى اللَّهَ "
1.en: Narrated by Abu Wa'il: He said: It used to be said: "The one in janabah does not recite, nor the menstruating woman, and one does not recite in the bathhouse, and there are two states in which the servant does not remember Allah: at the place of relieving himself, and during intercourse, except that the man, when he comes to his wife, begins by pronouncing the name of Allah."
1.hi: Abu Wa'il ne bataya: Kaha jaata tha: "Janabat wala Quran nahi padhta, aur na hi haiz wali aurat, aur hammam mein nahi padha jaata, aur do haalatein aisi hain jinmein banda Allah ka zikr nahi karta: qaza-e-hajat ki jagah, aur jima ke waqt, magar yeh ke jab aadmi apni biwi ke paas jaaye, to pehle Allah ka naam le [Bismillah kahe]."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ : تَقْرَأُ؟، قَالَ :" لَا، إِلَّا طَرَفَ الْآيَةِ "
1.en: Narrated by Abd al-Malik, from Ata, concerning the menstruating woman: "Does she recite?" He said, "No, except the edge/fringe of the verse."
1.hi: Abd al-Malik ne Ata se, haiz wali aurat ke baare mein bataya: "Kya woh padhe?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi, sirf aayat ka ek chhota hissa [padh sakti hai]."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ  ، عَنْ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عَطَّافٍ L275 ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" أَرْبَعٌ لَا يَحْرُمْنَ عَلَى جُنُبٍ وَلَا حَائِضٍ : سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ "، سُئِلَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد عَبْد اللَّهِ : يَقْرَأُ الْجُنُبُ آيَةً آيَةً؟، قَالَ : لَا يُعْجِبُنِي
1.en: Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه narrated; with Abu Muhammad Abdullah's response: He said: "Four are not forbidden to the one in janabah nor the menstruating woman: Subhan Allah, and al-Hamdu lillah, and la ilaha illallah, and Allahu Akbar." Abu Muhammad Abdullah was asked: "Does the one in janabah recite verse by verse?" He said: "I do not like that."
1.hi: Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Chaar cheezein janabat wale aur haiz wali aurat par haraam nahi hain: Subhan Allah, aur Al-hamdu lillah, aur La ilaha illallah, aur Allahu Akbar." Abu Muhammad Abdullah se poocha gaya: "Kya janabat wala aayat-dar-aayat padh sakta hai?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe yeh pasand nahi."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ صُبَيْحٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ الْحَائِضِ تَسْمَعُ السَّجْدَةَ، قَالَ :" لَا تَسْجُدُ لِأَنَّهَا صَلَاةٌ "
1.en: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه narrated: That he was asked about the menstruating woman who hears the verse of prostration, he said: "She does not prostrate, because it is [a form of] prayer."
1.hi: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه se poocha gaya us haiz wali aurat ke baare mein jo aayat-e-sajdah sune, unhone kaha: "Woh sajda na kare, kyunki yeh namaz hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، وأبي الضحي ، قَالَا :" لَا تَسْجُدُ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Hasan ibn Ubaydullah, from Ibrahim and Abu al-Duha: They said: "She does not prostrate."
1.hi: Al-Hasan ibn Ubaydullah ne Ibrahim aur Abu al-Duha se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Woh sajda na kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ ، قَالَا :" لَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا ذَاكَ الصَّلَاةُ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ "
1.en: Narrated by Hajjaj, from Hammad, from Ibrahim and Sa'id ibn Jubayr: They said: "Nothing is due upon her; the prayer is greater than that."
1.hi: Hajjaj ne Hammad se, Ibrahim aur Sa'id ibn Jubayr se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Uspar kuch wajib nahi; namaz isse bhi badi cheez hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ :" مُنِعَتْ خَيْرًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ الصَّلَاةَ الْمَكْتُوبَةَ "
1.en: Narrated by Ibn al-Mubarak, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ata: He said: "She has been forbidden from something better than that: the obligatory prayer."
1.hi: Ibn al-Mubarak ne Ibn Jurayj se, Ata se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Use to us se behtar cheez se roka gaya hai: farz namaz se."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" لَا تَسْجُدُ "
1.en: Narrated by Ghundar, from Ash'ath, from al-Hasan: He said: "She does not prostrate."
1.hi: Ghundar ne Ash'ath se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Woh sajda na kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، عَنْ يُونُسَ ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَرَى الطُّهْرَ فَتَسْمَعُ السَّجْدَةَ، قَالَ :" لَا تَسْجُدُ حَتَّى تَغْتَسِلَ "
1.en: Narrated by Ibn al-Mubarak, from Yunus, from al-Zuhri, concerning the woman who sees purity then hears the verse of prostration: He said: "She does not prostrate until she performs ghusl."
1.hi: Ibn al-Mubarak ne Yunus se, al-Zuhri se, us aurat ke baare mein bataya jo paaki dekhe fir aayat-e-sajdah sune: Unhone kaha, "Woh sajda na kare jab tak ghusl na kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو زَيْدٍ سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ ذَرًّا  ، عَنْ وَائِلِ بْنِ مُهَانَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ لِلنِّسَاءِ :" تَصَدَّقْنَ، فَإِنَّكُنَّ أَكْثَرُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ "، فَقَالَتْ امْرَأَةٌ لَيْسَتْ مِنْ عِلْيَةِ النِّسَاءِ : لِمَ، أَوْ بِمَ، أَوْ فِيمَ؟، قَالَ : " إِنَّكُنَّ تُكْثِرْنَ اللَّعْنَةَ، وَتَكْفُرْنَ الْعَشِيرَ "، قَالَ : وَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ : مَا مِنْ نَاقِصِي الدِّينِ وَالْعَقْلِ أَغْلَبَ لِلرِّجَالِ ذَوِي الْأَمْرِ عَلَى أَمْرِهِمْ مِنْ النِّسَاءِ، قَالَ رَجُلٌ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ : مَا نُقْصَانُ عَقْلِهَا؟، قَالَ : جُعِلَتْ شَهَادَةُ امْرَأَتَيْنِ بِشَهَادَةِ رَجُلٍ، قَالَ سُئِلَ : مَا نُقْصَانُ دِينِهَا؟ قَالَ : تَمْكُثُ كَذَا وَكَذَا مِنْ يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ لَا تُصَلِّي لِلَّهِ صَلَاةً
1.en: Narrated by Abu Zayd Sa'id ibn al-Rabi', from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, from Dharr, from Wa'il ibn Muhanah, from Abdullah رضي الله عنه, from the Prophet ﷺ; with Abdullah's further remarks: That he said to the women: "Give charity, for indeed you are the majority of the inhabitants of the Fire." So a woman who was not among the elite of the women said: "Why, or for what, or in what [respect]?" He said: "Indeed you curse frequently, and are ungrateful to your husband." He said: And Abdullah said: "Nothing is more overpowering to men of authority in their affairs than those deficient in religion and intellect," [meaning] women. A man said to Abdullah, "What is the deficiency of her intellect?" He said, "The testimony of two women has been made [equal] to the testimony of one man." He said: it was asked, "What is the deficiency of her religion?" He said: "She stays such-and-such number of days and nights not praying any prayer to Allah."
1.hi: Abu Zayd Sa'id ibn al-Rabi' ne Shu'bah se, al-Hakam se, Dharr se, Wa'il ibn Muhanah se, Abdullah رضي الله عنه se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya ke aapne auraton se farmaya: "Sadqa do, kyunki tum jahannum ke rehne walon mein aksariyat mein ho." To auraton mein se ek aisi aurat jo unke sardaron mein se nahi thi, ne poocha: "Kyun, ya kis liye, ya kis wajah se?" Aapne farmaya: "Kyunki tum bahut lanat bhejti ho, aur apne shohar ki na-shukri karti ho." Unhone bataya: Aur Abdullah ne kaha: "Aqal aur deen mein naaqis logon mein se koi bhi aise mardon par jinke haath mein ikhtiyaar hai, itna ghalib nahi jitni auratein," - yaani auraton ke baare mein. Ek aadmi ne Abdullah se poocha, "Uski aqal ki kami kya hai?" Unhone kaha, "Do auraton ki gawahi ek mard ki gawahi ke barabar rakhi gayi hai." Unhone bataya: Poocha gaya, "Uske deen ki kami kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Woh itne itne din aur raatein rehti hai, Allah ke liye koi namaz nahi padhti."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ :" إِذَا طَهُرَتْ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ الْحَيْضِ، فَلْتَتَّبِعْ ثَوْبَهَا الَّذِي يَلِي جِلْدَهَا فَلْتَغْسِلْ مَا أَصَابَهُ مِنْ الْأَذَى، ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي فِيهِ "
1.en: Aisha رضي الله عنها narrated: She said: "When the woman becomes pure from menstruation, let her follow with her garment that which is next to her skin, and let her wash off what has afflicted it of the harm, then she prays in it."
1.hi: Aisha رضي الله عنها ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab aurat haiz se paak ho jaaye, to woh apne us kapde ka jaayza le jo uski khaal se laga hota hai, aur usmein jo takleef-dah [khoon ka] asar laga ho use dho de, fir usi mein namaz padhe."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ :" كَانَ يَكُونُ لِإِحْدَانَا الدِّرْعُ فِيهِ تَحِيضُ وَفِيهِ تُجْنِبُ، ثُمَّ تَرَى فِيهِ الْقَطْرَةَ مِنْ دَمِ حَيْضَتِهَا، فَتَقْصَعُهُ بِرِيقِهَا "
1.en: Aisha رضي الله عنها narrated: She said: "One of us used to have a shirt in which she menstruated and in which she was in janabah, then she would see in it a drop of the blood of her menstruation, so she would moisten it with her saliva."
1.hi: Aisha رضي الله عنها ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Humein se kisi ke paas ek kameez hoti thi jismein woh haiz mein bhi hoti aur janabat mein bhi, fir woh usmein apne haiz ke khoon ka ek qatra dekhti, to woh apne thook se use gheela karke [rugad kar] saaf kar deti."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ الْهُذَلِيُّ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ   " إِنَّ إِحْدَاكُنَّ تَسْبِقُهَا الْقَطْرَةُ مِنْ الدَّمِ،فَإِذَا أَصَابَتْ إِحْدَاكُنَّ ذَلِكَ فَلْتَقْصَعْهُ بِرِيقِهَا "
1.en: Narrated by al-Hasan, from his mother, from Umm Salamah: "Indeed a drop of blood may precede one of you, so when that befalls one of you, let her moisten it with her saliva."
1.hi: Al-Hasan ne apni maa se, Umm Salamah se bataya: "Kabhi khoon ka ek qatra tum mein se kisi se pehle nikal jaata hai, so jab yeh tum mein se kisi ko ho jaaye, to woh use apne thook se saaf kar de."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ  ، عَنْ مُعَاذَةَ الْعَدَوِيَّةِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ :" إِذَا غَسَلَتْ الْمَرْأَةُ الدَّمَ فَلَمْ يَذْهَبْ، فَلْتُغَيِّرْهُ بِصُفْرَةِ وَرْسٍ، أَوْ زَعْفَرَانٍ "
1.en: Aisha رضي الله عنها narrated: She said: "When the woman washes the blood, and it does not go away, let her alter it with the yellowness of wars, or saffron."
1.hi: Aisha رضي الله عنها ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab aurat khoon dhoye, aur woh na jaaye, to woh use 'wars' ki zardi se, ya kesar (zaffran) se rang badal de."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ الرِّشْكِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ مُعَاذَةَ الْعَدَوِيَّةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ لَهَا امْرَأَةٌ : الدَّمُ يَكُونُ فِي الثَّوْبِ فَأَغْسِلُهُ، فَلَا يَذْهَبُ، فَأُقَطِّعُهُ؟، قَالَتْ :" الْمَاءُ طَهُورٌ "
1.en: Narrated by Yazid al-Rishk, from Mu'adhah al-Adawiyyah, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: He said: I heard Mu'adhah al-Adawiyyah, from Aisha رضي الله عنها, a woman said to her: "The blood is in the garment, so I wash it, and it does not go away, shall I cut it out?" She said: "Water is the purifier."
1.hi: Yazid al-Rishk ne bataya: Maine Mu'adhah al-Adawiyyah ko Aisha رضي الله عنها se naql karte suna, ek aurat ne unse kaha: "Khoon kapde mein lag jaata hai, main use dhoti hoon, aur woh nahi jaata, kya main use kaat dun?" Unhone kaha: "Paani hi paak karne wala hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي جَابِرُ بْنُ صُبْحٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ خِلَاسَ بْنَ عَمْرٍو  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، تَقُولُ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ :" يَكُونُ مَعِي فِي الشِّعَارِ الْوَاحِدِ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ طَامِثٌ إِنْ أَصَابَهُ مِنِّي شَيْءٌ غَسَلَ مَا أَصَابَهُ، لَمْ يَعْدُهُ إِلَى غَيْرِهِ، وَصَلَّى فِيهِ ثُمَّ يَعُودُ، وَإِنْ أَصَابَهُ مِنِّي شَيْءٌ، فَعَلَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، غَسَلَ مَكَانَهُ لَمْ يَعْدُهُ إِلَى غَيْرِهِ، وَصَلَّى فِيهِ "
1.en: Aisha رضي الله عنها narrated: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Abu al-Qasim, "used to be with me in a single wrap while I was menstruating, flowing with blood; if something of mine affected it, he washed what it affected, and did not go beyond it to other than it, and prayed in it, then returned; and if something of mine affected it [again], he did the like of that, washed its place, did not go beyond it to other than it, and prayed in it."
1.hi: Aisha رضي الله عنها ne bataya: Rasulullah ﷺ, Abu al-Qasim, "mere saath ek hi chaadar mein hote the jabke main haiz mein hoti, khoon beh raha hota; agar mujhse kuch usmein lag jaata, to aap us jagah ko dho lete jahan laga tha, use uske alawa doosri jagah tak nahi phailaate, aur usi mein namaz padhte, fir wapas aa jaate; aur agar mujhse dobara kuch us mein lag jaata, to aisa hi karte, uski jagah dho lete, use aur kahin tak nahi phailaate, aur usi mein namaz padhte."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، فِيمَا تَلْبَسُ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ الثِّيَابِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ" إِنْ أَصَابَهُ دَمٌ، غَسَلَتْهُ، وَإِلَّا فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا غَسْلُهُ وَإِنْ عَرِقَتْ فِيهِ، فَإِنَّهُ يُجْزِئُهَا أَنْ تَنْضَحَهُ "
1.en: Narrated by Hammad, from Ibrahim, concerning what the menstruating woman wears of garments: "If blood affects it, she washes it, and otherwise there is no washing due upon her, and if she sweats in it, it suffices her to sprinkle it."
1.hi: Hammad ne Ibrahim se, us kapde ke baare mein bataya jo haiz wali aurat pehne: "Agar khoon lag jaaye, to woh use dho le, warna uspar dhona wajib nahi, aur agar woh usmein paseena aaye, to uske liye chidak dena kaafi hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ ، قَالَ :" الْمَرْأَةُ الْحَائِضُ تُصَلِّي فِي ثِيَابِهَا الَّتِي تَحِيضُ فِيهَا، إِلَّا أَنْ يُصِيبَ شَيْئًا مِنْهَا دَمٌ، فَتَغْسِلَ مَوْضِعَ الدَّمِ "
1.en: Narrated by Uthman, from Mujahid: He said: "The menstruating woman prays in her garments in which she menstruates, except that if blood affects something of them, she washes the place of the blood."
1.hi: Uthman ne Mujahid se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Haiz wali aurat unhi kapdon mein namaz padhe jinmein woh haiz mein rehti hai, siwaay iske ke agar unmein khoon lag jaaye, to woh khoon ki jagah dho le."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ الْمُنْذِرِ  ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ دَمِ الْحَيْضِ يُصِيبُ الثَّوْبَ، قَالَ :" حُتِّيهِ ثُمَّ رُشِّيهِ بِالْمَاءِ "
1.en: Asma bint Abi Bakr رضي الله عنها narrated: She said: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about the blood of menstruation that afflicts the garment, he said: "Scrape it off, then sprinkle it with water."
1.hi: Asma bint Abi Bakr رضي الله عنها ne bataya: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ se haiz ke us khoon ke baare mein poocha jo kapde mein lag jaaye, aapne farmaya: "Use khurach do, fir usay paani se chidak do."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ طَهْمَانَ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" الْحَائِضُ لَا تَغْسِلُ ثَوْبَهَا إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ دَمٌ "
1.en: Ibrahim narrated: He said: "The menstruating woman does not wash her garment if there is no blood on it."
1.hi: Ibrahim ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Haiz wali aurat apna kapda na dhoye agar usmein khoon na ho."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ هُوَ ابْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَتْنِي فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ الْمُنْذِرِ  ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : سَمِعْتُ امْرَأَةً تَسْأَلُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ ثَوْبِهَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ مِنْ مَحِيضِهَا، كَيْفَ تَصْنَعُ بِهِ؟، قَالَ :" إِنْ رَأَيْتِ فِيهِ دَمًا فَحُكِّيهِ، ثُمَّ اقْرُصِيهِ بِمَاءٍ، ثُمَّ انْضَحِي فِي سَائِرِهِ، فَصَلِّي فِيهِ "
1.en: Narrated by Fatimah bint al-Mundhir, from Asma bint Abi Bakr رضي الله عنها: She said: I heard a woman asking the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about her garment, when she becomes pure from her menstruation, how should she treat it? He said, "If you see blood on it, scrape it off, then rub it with water, then sprinkle the rest of it, then pray in it."
1.hi: Fatimah bint al-Mundhir ne Asma bint Abi Bakr رضي الله عنها se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine ek aurat ko Rasulullah ﷺ se apne kapde ke baare mein poochte suna, jab woh apne haiz se paak ho jaaye, to us kapde ka woh kya kare? Aapne farmaya, "Agar tum usmein khoon dekho, to use khurach do, fir paani se mal do, fir uske baaki hisse par [paani] chidak do, fir usi mein namaz padho."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ سَلَّامٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْحَدَّادِ  ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ دِينَارٍ  مَوْلَى أُمِّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتِ مِحْصَنٍ ، عَنْ أُمِّ قَيْسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ دَمِ الْحِيضَةِ يَكُونُ فِي الثَّوْبِ، فَقَالَ :" اغْسِلِيهِ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ وَحُكِّيهِ بِضِلَعٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Adi ibn Dinar, freed servant of Umm Qays bint Mihsan, from Umm Qays رضي الله عنها: She said: I asked the Prophet ﷺ about the blood of menstruation that is on the garment, so he said: "Wash it with water and lote-leaves and scrape it with a rib."
1.hi: Adi ibn Dinar, Umm Qays bint Mihsan ke azaad kiye hue ghulam, ne Umm Qays رضي الله عنها se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Nabi ﷺ se haiz ke us khoon ke baare mein poocha jo kapde mein lag jaaye, to aapne farmaya: "Use paani aur beri ke pattoan se dho lo, aur ek paseli (haddi ke kinaare) se khurach do."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ كَرِيمَةَ  ، قالَتْ : سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ  ، وَسَأَلْتُهَا امْرَأَةٌ يُصِيبُ ثَوْبَهَا مِنْ دَمِ حِيضَتِهَا، قَالَتْ :" لِتَغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ "، قَالَتْ : فَإِنَّا نَغْسِلُهُ فَيَبْقَى أَثَرُهُ؟، قَالَتْ : " إِنَّ الْمَاءَ طَهُورٌ "
1.en: Narrated by Ali ibn al-Mubarak, from Karimah, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: He said: I heard Karimah say: I heard Aisha, and a woman asked her about blood of her menstruation afflicting her garment, she said: "Let her wash it with water." She said: "But we wash it and its trace remains?" She said: "Indeed water is the purifier."
1.hi: Ali ibn al-Mubarak ne bataya: Maine Karimah ko kehte suna: Maine Aisha ko suna, aur ek aurat ne unse apne haiz ke khoon ke kapde mein lagne ke baare mein poocha, unhone kaha: "Woh use paani se dho le." Usne poocha: "Lekin hum dhote hain to uska nishaan reh jaata hai?" Unhone kaha: "Paani hi paak karne wala hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ :" كَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ  تَرَى الشَّيْءَ مِنْ الْمَحِيضِ فِي ثَوْبِهَا، فَتَحُتُّهُ بِالْحَجَرِ، أَوْ بِالْعُودِ، أَوْ بِالْقَرْنِ، ثُمَّ تَرُشُّهُ "
1.en: Ata narrated: He said: "Aisha used to see something of the menstrual [discharge] on her garment, so she would scrape it off with a stone, or a stick, or a horn, then sprinkle it."
1.hi: Ata ne bataya: "Aisha apne kapde par haiz ka kuch asar dekhti thin, to woh use kisi pathar se, ya lakdi se, ya seeng se khurach detin, fir usay chidak detin."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيِّ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ  عَنْ الْجُنُبِ يَعْرَقُ فِي الثَّوْبِ ثُمَّ يَمْسَحُهُ بِهِ، قَالَ :" لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ "
1.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Uthman ibn Khuthaym, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr: He said: I asked Sa'id ibn Jubayr about the one in janabah who sweats in his garment then wipes himself with it, he said: "There is no harm in it."
1.hi: Abdullah ibn Uthman ibn Khuthaym ne bataya: Maine Sa'id ibn Jubayr se us janabat wale ke baare mein poocha jo apne kapde mein paseena bahaaye fir usi se khud ko poonchhe, unhone kaha: "Ismein koi harj nahi."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  أَنَّهُ كَانَ" لَا يَرَى بِعَرَقِ الْجُنُبِ فِي الثَّوْبِ بَأْسًا "
1.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Uthman ibn Khuthaym, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr: That he "did not see any harm in the sweat of the one in janabah on the garment."
1.hi: Abdullah ibn Uthman ibn Khuthaym ne Sa'id ibn Jubayr se bataya ke woh "janabat wale ke paseene ko kapde mein koi harj nahi samajhte the."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  أَنَّهُ كَانَ" لَا يَرَى بِهِ بَأْسًا "
1.en: Narrated by Hammad, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from al-Sha'bi: That he "did not see any harm in it."
1.hi: Hammad ne Ata ibn al-Sa'ib se, al-Sha'bi se bataya ke woh "ismein koi harj nahi samajhte the."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ : مَا كُلُّ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانُوا يَجِدُونَ ثَوْبَيْنِ، فَقَالَ :" إِذَا اغْتَسَلْتَ أَلَسْتَ تَلْبَسُهُ فَذَاكَ بِذَاكَ "
1.en: Narrated by Hammad, from Humayd, from al-Hasan: He said: Not all the companions of the Prophet ﷺ used to find two garments, so he said: "When you perform ghusl, do you not wear it? That is like that."
1.hi: Hammad ne Humayd se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha: Nabi ﷺ ke sab sahaba ke paas do kapde nahi hote the, to unhone kaha: "Jab tum ghusl karte ho, to kya use pehante nahi ho? To woh bhi waisa hi hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ  : أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا سُئِلَتْ عَنْ الرَّجُلِ يُصِيبُ الْمَرْأَةَ، ثُمَّ يَلْبَسُ الثَّوْبَ فَيَعْرَقُ فِيهِ،" فَلَمْ تَرَ بِهِ بَأْسًا "
1.en: Narrated by Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad: That Aisha رضي الله عنها was asked about a man who has intercourse with a woman, then wears the garment and sweats in it, "and she did not see any harm in it."
1.hi: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se, al-Qasim ibn Muhammad se bataya ke Aisha رضي الله عنها se us aadmi ke baare mein poocha gaya jo apni biwi se sohbat kare, fir kapda pehne aur usmein paseena aaye, "to unhone ismein koi harj nahi samjha."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ :" لَا بَأْسَ أَنْ يَعْرَقَ الْجُنُبُ وَالْحَائِضُ فِي الثَّوْبِ يُصَلَّى فِيهِ "
1.en: Ata narrated: He said: "There is no harm in the one in janabah and the menstruating woman sweating in the garment in which one prays."
1.hi: Ata ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Janabat wale aur haiz wali aurat ke us kapde mein paseena aane mein koi harj nahi jismein namaz padhi jaati hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ ،  عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  فِي الْجُنُبِ يَعْرَقُ فِي ثَوْبِهِ، قَالَ :" لَا يَضُرُّهُ، وَلَا يَنْضَحُهُ بِالْمَاءِ "
1.en: Narrated by Abu al-Ahwas, from Abu Hamzah, from Ibrahim, concerning the one in janabah who sweats in his garment: He said, "It does not harm him, and he does not need to sprinkle it with water."
1.hi: Abu al-Ahwas ne Abu Hamzah se, Ibrahim se, us janabat wale ke baare mein bataya jo apne kapde mein paseena bahaaye: Unhone kaha, "Isse use koi nuqsaan nahi, aur use paani se chidakne ki zaroorat nahi."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  فِي الْحَائِضِ إِذَا عَرِقَتْ فِي ثِيَابِهَا " فَإِنَّهُيُجْزِئُهَا أَنْ تَنْضَحَهُ بِالْمَاءِ "
1.en: Narrated by Hammad, from Ibrahim, concerning the menstruating woman when she sweats in her garments: "It suffices her to sprinkle it with water."
1.hi: Hammad ne Ibrahim se, haiz wali aurat ke baare mein bataya jab usay apne kapdon mein paseena aaye: "Uske liye paani se chidak dena kaafi hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  كَانَ" يَعْرَقُ فِي الثَّوْبِ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ، ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي فِيهِ "
1.en: Narrated by Malik, from Nafi', about Ibn Umar: That he "used to sweat in the garment while he was in janabah, then pray in it."
1.hi: Malik ne Nafi' se bataya ke Ibn Umar "janabat ki haalat mein kapde mein paseena bahaate, fir usi mein namaz padhte."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ هُوَ ابْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّهُ" لَمْ يَكُنْ يَرَى بَأْسًا بِعَرَقِ الْحَائِضِ وَالْجُنُبِ "
1.en: Narrated by Hisham ibn Hassan, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: That he "did not see any harm in the sweat of the menstruating woman and the one in janabah."
1.hi: Hisham ibn Hassan ne Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se bataya ke woh "haiz wali aurat aur janabat wale ke paseene ko koi harj nahi samajhte the."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : مَا يَحِلُّ لِي مِنْ امْرَأَتِي وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ؟، قَالَ :" لِتَشُدَّ عَلَيْهَا إِزَارَهَا ثُمَّ شَأْنَكَ بِأَعْلَاهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Malik ibn Anas, from Zayd ibn Aslam: He said: A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and said: "What is lawful for me from my wife while she is menstruating?" He said: "Let her tie her lower wrap firmly upon herself, then do as you wish above it."
1.hi: Malik ibn Anas ne Zayd ibn Aslam se bataya: Unhone kaha: Ek aadmi ne Rasulullah ﷺ se poocha, "Meri biwi ke haiz ki haalat mein mere liye kya halal hai?" Aapne farmaya: "Woh apni izaar (lower wrap) apne upar mazbooti se baandh le, fir tumhein ikhtiyaar hai uske upar ke hisse mein."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، قَالَ : أَرْسَلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ إِلَى عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا لِيَسْأَلَهَا : هَلْ يُبَاشِرُ الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ؟، فَقَالَتْ :" لِتَشُدَّ إِزَارَهَا عَلَى أَسْفَلِهَا ثُمَّ يُبَاشِرُهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Malik, from Nafi': He said: Abdullah ibn Abdullah ibn Umar sent to Aisha رضي الله عنها to ask her: "Does the man engage in intimate contact with his wife while she is menstruating?" So she said: "Let her tie her wrap firmly over her lower part, then he may engage in intimate contact with her."
1.hi: Malik ne Nafi' se bataya: Abdullah ibn Abdullah ibn Umar ne Aisha رضي الله عنها ke paas [aadmi] bheja yeh poochne ke: "Kya aadmi apni haiz wali biwi se mubaashirat (chhoona-choomna) kar sakta hai?" To unhone kaha: "Woh apni izaar apne neeche ke hisse par mazbooti se baandh le, fir woh uske saath mubaashirat kar sakta hai."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ ، عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" الْحَائِضُ يَأْتِيهَا زَوْجُهَا فِي مَرَاقِّهَا وَبَيْنَ فَخِذَيْهَا، فَإِذَا دَفَقَ، غَسَلَتْ مَا أَصَابَهَا، وَاغْتَسَلَ هُوَ "
1.en: Narrated by Hammad, from Ibrahim: He said: "The menstruating woman - her husband comes to her between her thighs and in her soft parts; then when he ejaculates, she washes what has afflicted her, and he performs ghusl."
1.hi: Hammad ne Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Haiz wali aurat - uska shohar uski raanon ke darmiyan aur uske narm hisson mein [sharamgah ke ilawa] aa sakta hai; fir jab woh inzaal ho jaaye, to woh apne uspar lage hisse ko dho le, aur woh [shohar] ghusl kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ الْكَرِيمِ عَنْ الْحَائِضِ، فَقَالَ : قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ  :" لَقَدْ عَلِمَتْ أُمُّ عِمْرَانَ أَنِّي أَطْعُنُ فِي أَلْيَتِهَا، يَعْنِي : وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ "
1.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Amr, from Abd al-Karim, from Ibrahim: He said: I asked Abd al-Karim about the menstruating woman, so he said: Ibrahim said: "Umm Imran certainly knew that I would thrust between her buttocks" - meaning, while she was menstruating.
1.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Amr ne bataya: Maine Abd al-Karim se haiz wali aurat ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: Ibrahim ne kaha: "Umm Imran ko zaroor pata tha ke main uski shirmgaah ke bahar hi [ran ke darmiyan] jaata hoon" - yaani, jabke woh haiz mein hoti.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ مِغْوَلٍ ، قَالَ : سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ عَطَاءً  عَنْ الْحَائِضِ" فَلَمْ يَرَ بِمَا دُونَ الدَّمِ بَأْسًا "
1.en: Narrated by Malik ibn Mighwal, about Ata: He said: A man asked Ata about the menstruating woman, "and he did not see any harm in what is short of [actual] blood/intercourse."
1.hi: Malik ibn Mighwal ne bataya: Ek aadmi ne Ata se haiz wali aurat ke baare mein poocha, "to unhone khoon [wali jagah] se kam mein koi harj nahi samjha."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ :" كُنْتُ إِذَا حِضْتُ أَمَرَنِي النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَأَتَّزِرُ، وَكَانَ يُبَاشِرُنِي "
1.en: Narrated by Sufyan, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: She said: "When I menstruated, the Prophet ﷺ would command me, so I would wrap myself, and he would engage in intimate contact with me."
1.hi: Sufyan ne Mansur se, Ibrahim se, al-Aswad se, Aisha رضي الله عنها se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab mujhe haiz aata, to Nabi ﷺ mujhe hukum dete, so main izaar baandh leti, aur aap mujhse mubaashirat karte."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي مَيْمُونُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ  ، قَالَ : سُئِلَتْ عَائِشَةُ   مَا يَحِلُّ لِلرَّجُلِ مِنْ امْرَأَتِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ؟، قَالَتْ :" مَا فَوْقَ الْإِزَارِ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Awza'i, from Maymun ibn Mihran: He said: Aisha was asked, "What is lawful for the man from his wife while she is menstruating?" She said: "What is above the wrap."
1.hi: Al-Awza'i ne Maymun ibn Mihran se bataya: Unhone kaha: Aisha se poocha gaya, "Aadmi ke liye apni haiz wali biwi se kya halal hai?" Unhone kaha: "Izaar se upar ka hissa."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُيَيْنَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جَوْشَنٍ  ، عَنْ مَرْوَانَ الْأَصْفَرِ  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِعَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا : مَا يَحِلُّ لِلرَّجُلِ مِنْ امْرَأَتِهِ إِذَا كَانَتْ حَائِضًا؟، قَالَتْ :" كُلُّ شَيْءٍ غَيْرُ الْجِمَاعِ "، قَالَ : قَلْتُ : فَمَا يَحْرُمُ عَلَيْهِ مِنْهَا إِذَا كَانَا مُحْرِمَيْنِ؟، قَالَتْ : " كُلُّ شَيْءٍ غَيْرُ كَلَامِهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Uyaynah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Jawshan, from Marwan al-Asfar, from Masruq: He said: I said to Aisha رضي الله عنها: "What is lawful for the man from his wife when she is menstruating?" She said: "Everything except intercourse." He said: I said, "Then what is forbidden to him from her when the two of them are in ihram?" She said: "Everything except speaking to her."
1.hi: Uyaynah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Jawshan ne Marwan al-Asfar se, Masruq se bataya: Unhone kaha: Maine Aisha رضي الله عنها se poocha: "Aadmi ke liye apni haiz wali biwi se kya halal hai?" Unhone kaha: "Jima ke siwa sab kuch." Unhone bataya: Maine poocha, "Fir jab dono ehraam mein hon to uski taraf se uspar kya haraam hai?" Unhone kaha: "Uski baat karne ke siwa sab kuch [haraam hai]."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ جَلْدِ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ :" لِإِنْسَانٍ اجْتَنِبْ شِعَارَ الدَّمِ "
1.en: Narrated by Jald ibn Ayyub, from a man, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: She said, to a person: "Avoid the place marked by the blood."
1.hi: Jald ibn Ayyub ne ek aadmi se, Aisha رضي الله عنها se bataya: Unhone ek shakhs se kaha, "Khoon wali jagah se bacho."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا كَفَّ الْأَذَى يَعْنِي : الدَّمَ "
1.en: Narrated by Sufyan, from Isma'il, from al-Sha'bi: He said: "When the harm ceases" - meaning, the blood.
1.hi: Sufyan ne Isma'il se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab takleef-dah cheez [khoon] band ho jaaye" - yaani, khoon.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ ، قَالَ :" لَا بَأْسَ أَنْ تُؤْتَى الْحَائِضُ بَيْنَ فَخِذَيْهَا وَفِي سُرَّتِهَا "
1.en: Mujahid narrated: He said: "There is no harm in coming to the menstruating woman between her thighs and in her navel."
1.hi: Mujahid ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Haiz wali aurat ke paas uski raanon ke darmiyan aur uski naabhi mein jaane mein koi harj nahi."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ ، قَالَ :" تُقْبِلُ وَتُدْبِرُ، إِلَّا الدُّبُرَ وَالْمَحِيضَ "
1.en: Mujahid narrated: He said: "He may approach from the front and from behind, except the rear passage and the place of menstruation."
1.hi: Mujahid ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Woh aage se aur peechhe se aa sakta hai, sirf dubur (peechhe wala raasta) aur haiz ki jagah [sharamgah] ke siwa."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ  ، وَيَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : كُنْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي لِحَافٍ، فَوَجَدْتُ مَا تَجِدُ النِّسَاءُ، فَقُمْتُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَا لَكِ، أَنَفِسْتِ؟ "، قُلْتُ : وَجَدْتُ مَا تَجِدُ النِّسَاءُ، قَالَ : " ذَاكَ مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ عَلَى بَنَاتِ آدَمَ "، قَالَتْ : فَقُمْتُ فَأَصْلَحْتُ مِنْ شَأْنِي، ثُمَّ رَجَعْتُ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " ادْخُلِي فِي اللِّحَافِ "، فَدَخَلْتُ
1.en: Umm Salamah رضي الله عنها narrated: She said: I was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ under a wrap, then I felt what women feel, so I got up, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "What is wrong with you, have you begun menstruating?" I said: "I felt what women feel." He said: "That is what Allah has written for the daughters of Adam." She said: So I got up and fixed my affair, then I returned, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Enter into the wrap." So I entered.
1.hi: Umm Salamah رضي الله عنها ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath ek chaadar ke andar thi, fir mujhe woh mehsoos hua jo auratein mehsoos karti hain, so main uth gayi, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Tumhein kya hua, kya tumhein haiz shuru ho gaya?" Maine kaha: "Mujhe woh mehsoos hua jo auratein mehsoos karti hain." Aapne farmaya: "Yeh woh hai jo Allah ne Bani Adam ki betiyon ke liye likh diya hai." Unhone bataya: To main uthi aur apna intezaam theek kiya, fir wapas aayi, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Chaadar mein aa jao." So main andar aa gayi.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : بَيْنَا أَنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مُضْطَجِعَةٌ فِي الْخَمِيلَةِ إِذْ حِضْتُ، فَانْسَلَلْتُ، فَأَخَذْتُ ثِيَابَ حِيضَتِي، فَقَالَ :" أَنَفِسْتِ؟ "، قُلْتُ : نَعَمْ، قَالَتْ : " فَدَعَانِي فَاضْطَجَعْتُ مَعَهُ فِي الْخَمِيلَةِ "، قَالَتْ : وَكَانَتْ هِيَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " يَغْتَسِلَانِ مِنْ الْإِنَاءِ الْوَاحِدِ مِنْ الْجَنَابَةِ، وَكَانَ يُقَبِّلُهَا وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ "
1.en: Umm Salamah رضي الله عنها narrated: She said: While I was lying with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a woolen blanket, I menstruated, so I slipped away, and took my menstruation clothes, so he said: "Have you begun menstruating?" I said: "Yes." She said: "So he called me, and I lay down with him in the blanket again." She said: And she and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "used to bathe from a single vessel from janabah, and he used to kiss her while he was fasting."
1.hi: Umm Salamah رضي الله عنها ne bataya: Jabke main Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath ek ooni chaadar mein leti hui thi, mujhe haiz aa gaya, so main aahista se nikal gayi, aur apne haiz ke kapde le liye, to aapne farmaya: "Kya tumhein haiz shuru ho gaya?" Maine kaha: "Haan." Unhone bataya: "To aapne mujhe bulaya, aur main phir se aapke saath chaadar mein let gayi." Unhone bataya: Aur woh aur Rasulullah ﷺ "janabat se ek hi bartan se ghusl kiya karte the, aur aap unhein bosa dete the jabke roze se hote."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ  ، عَنْ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ  ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يُبَاشِرُ الْمَرْأَةَ مِنْ نِسَائِهِ فَوْقَ الْإِزَارِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ "
1.en: Maymunah رضي الله عنها narrated: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ "used to engage in intimate contact with a woman among his wives, above the wrap, while she was menstruating."
1.hi: Maymunah رضي الله عنها ne bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "apni biwiyon mein se kisi ek se izaar ke upar mubaashirat karte the jabke woh haiz mein hoti."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَيْسَرَةَ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُرَحْبِيلَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يَأْمُرُ إِحْدَانَا إِذَا كَانَتْ حَائِضًا أَنْ تَشُدَّ عَلَيْهَا إِزَارَهَا، ثُمَّ يُبَاشِرُهَا "
1.en: Aisha رضي الله عنها narrated: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ "used to command one of us, when she was menstruating, to tie her wrap firmly upon herself, then he would engage in intimate contact with her."
1.hi: Aisha رضي الله عنها ne bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "humein se kisi ek ko, jab woh haiz mein hoti, hukum dete ke woh apni izaar apne upar mazbooti se baandh le, fir aap uske saath mubaashirat karte."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَيْسَرَةَ  قَالَ : قَالَتْ أُمُّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا :" كُنْتُ أَتَّزِرُ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ، ثُمَّ أَدْخُلُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي لِحَافِهِ "
1.en: Narrated by Abu Maysarah, about the Mother of the Believers رضي الله عنها: He said: The Mother of the Believers رضي الله عنها said: "I used to wrap myself while I was menstruating, then enter with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ into his blanket."
1.hi: Abu Maysarah ne bataya: Ummul-Mumineen رضي الله عنها ne kaha, "Main haiz ki haalat mein izaar baandh leti, fir Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath unki chaadar mein andar chali jaati."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ ابْنُ جُبَيْرٍ  : مَا لِلرَّجُلِ مِنْ امْرَأَتِهِ إِذَا كَانَتْ حَائِضًا؟، قَالَ :" مَا فَوْقَ الْإِزَارِ "
1.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Abi Ziyad, about Ibn Jubayr: He said: Ibn Jubayr was asked: "What is [permitted] for the man from his wife when she is menstruating?" He said: "What is above the wrap."
1.hi: Yazid ibn Abi Ziyad ne bataya: Ibn Jubayr se poocha gaya: "Aadmi ke liye apni haiz wali biwi se kya [halal] hai?" Unhone kaha: "Izaar se upar ka hissa."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ  فِي الْحَائِضِ، قَالَ :" الْفِرَاشُ وَاحِدٌ، وَاللُّحُفُ شَتَّى، فَإِنْ كَانُوا لَا يَجِدُونَ، رَدَّ عَلَيْهَا مِنْ لِحَافِهِ "
1.en: Narrated by Ibn Awn, from Muhammad ibn Sirin, from Ubaydah, concerning the menstruating woman: He said: "The bed is one, but the blankets are separate; if they had none, he would return part of his blanket to her."
1.hi: Ibn Awn ne Muhammad ibn Sirin se, Ubaydah se, haiz wali aurat ke baare mein bataya: Unhone kaha, "Bistar ek hai, lekin chaadar alag-alag; agar unke paas alag na hon, to woh apni chaadar ka kuch hissa uski taraf laut de."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ ،  عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ ، قَالَ لَهُ :" مَا فَوْقَ السَّرَرِ أَوْ السُّرَّةِ "
1.en: Narrated by Ibn Awn, from Muhammad ibn Sirin, from Shurayh: He said to him: "What is above the navel."
1.hi: Ibn Awn ne Muhammad ibn Sirin se, Shurayh se bataya: Unhone usse kaha, "Naabhi se upar ka hissa."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ بَابَنُوسَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يَتَوَشَّحُنِي وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ، وَيُصِيبُ مِنْ رَأْسِي وَبَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ ثَوْبٌ "
1.en: Aisha رضي الله عنها narrated: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ "used to wrap himself around me while I was menstruating, and would touch/reach from my head, and between him and me there was a garment."
1.hi: Aisha رضي الله عنها ne bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "mere gird chaadar lapet lete jabke main haiz mein hoti, aur mere sar se [zulfein sanwaarne ka] kaam karte, aur unke aur mere darmiyan ek kapda hota."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ : أَنَّ الْيَهُودَ كَانُوا إِذَا حَاضَتْ الْمَرْأَةُ فِيهِمْ لَمْ يُؤَاكِلُوهَا، وَلَمْ يُشَارِبُوهَا، وَأَخْرَجُوهَا مِنْ الْبَيْتِ، وَلَمْ تَكُنْ مَعَهُمْ فِي الْبُيُوتِ، فَسُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى # وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى سورة البقرة آية 222 #، فَأَمَرَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" أَنْ يُؤَاكِلُوهُنَّ، وَأَنْ يُشَارِبُوهُنَّ، وَأَنْ يَكُنَّ مَعَهُمْ فِي الْبُيُوتِ، وَأَنْ يَفْعَلُوا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ مَا خَلَا النِّكَاحَ "، فَقَالَتْ الْيَهُودُ : مَا يُرِيدُ هَذَا أَنْ يَدَعَ شَيْئًا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا إِلَّا خَالَفَنَا فِيهِ، فَجَاءَ عَبَّادُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، وَأُسَيْدُ بْنُ حُضَيْرٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَأَخْبَرَاهُ بِذَلِكَ، وَقَالَا : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَفَلَا نَنْكِحُهُنَّ فِي الْمَحِيضِ؟ " فَتَمَعَّرَ وَجْهُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ تَمَعُّرًا شَدِيدًا حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ وَجَدَ عَلَيْهِمَا، فَقَامَا، فَخَرَجَا "، هَدِيَّةُ لَبَنٍ " فَبَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي آثَارِهِمَا فَرَدَّهُمَا فَسَقَاهُمَا "، فَعَلِمْنَا أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَغْضَبْ عَلَيْهِمَا
1.en: Anas رضي الله عنه narrated: That the Jews, when a woman among them menstruated, did not eat with her, nor drink with her, and put her out of the house, and she was not with them in the houses; so the Prophet ﷺ was asked about that, so Allah the Exalted revealed: "And they ask you about menstruation, say: it is harm" [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 222]; so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded them "to eat with them, and to drink with them, and that they be with them in the houses, and that they do everything except intercourse." So the Jews said, "This man does not want to leave anything of our affair except that he opposes us in it." So Abbad ibn Bishr, and Usayd ibn Hudayr رضي الله عنهما came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and informed him of that, and said, "O Messenger of Allah, shall we not have intercourse with them during menstruation?" "So the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ changed color severely, until we thought that he was angry with the two of them, so they got up, and went out," [carrying] "a gift of milk," so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent after their traces and brought them back and gave them to drink, "so we knew that he was not angry with the two of them."
1.hi: Anas رضي الله عنه ne bataya ke Yahoodi log, jab unmein kisi aurat ko haiz aata, to na uske saath khaana khaate, na uske saath peete, aur use ghar se nikaal dete, aur woh ghar mein unke saath nahi rehti; so Nabi ﷺ se iske baare mein poocha gaya, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat naazil ki: "Aur woh aapse haiz ke baare mein poochte hain, kahiye: woh takleef-dah cheez hai" [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 222]; so Rasulullah ﷺ ne unhein hukum diya "ke woh unke saath khaayein, aur unke saath piyein, aur woh unke saath gharon mein rahein, aur jima ke siwa har cheez karein." To Yahoodiyon ne kaha, "Yeh shakhs humare kisi maamle ko chhodna hi nahi chahta jismein woh humari mukhalifat na kare." Fir Abbad ibn Bishr, aur Usayd ibn Hudayr رضي الله عنهما Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaye aur unhein yeh baat batayi, aur kaha, "Ya Rasulullah, kya hum unse haiz mein jima nahi karenge?" "To Rasulullah ﷺ ka chehra sakhti se badal gaya, yahan tak ke humein laga ke aap un dono se naaraaz ho gaye hain, so woh uthe aur bahar chale gaye," [saath le kar] "doodh ka ek tohfa," to Rasulullah ﷺ ne unke peechhe [kisi ko] bheja aur unhein wapas bulaaya aur unhein woh pilaaya, "to humein pata chala ke aap un dono se naaraaz nahi the."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هِلَالٍ ، حَدَّثَنِي شَيْبَةُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ الرَّاسِبِيُّ ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ الرَّجُلِ يُضَاجِعُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ فِي لِحَافٍ وَاحِدٍ، فَقَالَ :" أَمَّا نَحْنُ آلَ عُمَرَ فَنَهْجُرُهُنَّ إِذَا كُنَّ حُيَّضًا "
1.en: Narrated by Shaybah ibn Hisham al-Rasibi, about Salim ibn Abdullah: He said: I asked Salim ibn Abdullah about the man who lies with his wife while she is menstruating in a single blanket, so he said: "As for us, the family of Umar, we avoid them when they are menstruating."
1.hi: Shaybah ibn Hisham al-Rasibi ne bataya: Maine Salim ibn Abdullah se us aadmi ke baare mein poocha jo apni haiz wali biwi ke saath ek hi chaadar mein leta hai, to unhone kaha: "Rahi baat humari, Umar ke khaandan ki, to hum unse alag ho jaate hain jab woh haiz mein hoti hain."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" لَا بَأْسَ بِفَضْلِ وَضُوءِ الْمَرْأَةِ مَا لَمْ تَكُنْ جُنُبًا أَوْ حَائِضًا "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: "There is no harm in the leftover water of the woman's ablution, as long as she is not in janabah or menstruating."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Ishaq ne Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Aurat ke wudu ke bache hue paani mein koi harj nahi, jab tak woh janabat ya haiz mein na ho."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ غَيْلَانَ ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ ، قَالَ :" تَضَعُهُ وَضْعًا يَعْنِي عَلَى الْفَرْجِ "
1.en: Narrated by Sufyan, from Ghaylan, from al-Hakam: He said: "She places it directly" - meaning, upon the private part.
1.hi: Sufyan ne Ghaylan se, al-Hakam se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Woh use seedha rakh de" - yaani, sharamgah par.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ  مَوْلَى عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ نُدْبَةَ  مَوْلَاةِ مَيْمُونَةَ ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ   زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" يُبَاشِرُ الْمَرْأَةَ مِنْ نِسَائِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ إِذَا كَانَ عَلَيْهَا إِزَارٌ، يَبْلُغُ أَنْصَافَ الْفَخِذَيْنِ أَوْ الرُّكْبَتَيْنِ مُحْتَجِزَةً بِهِ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Layth, from Ibn Shihab, from Habib, freed servant of Urwah, from Nudbah, freed servant-woman of Maymunah, from Maymunah رضي الله عنها, wife of the Prophet ﷺ: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to "engage in intimate contact with a woman among his wives while she was menstruating, if she had a wrap upon her, reaching to the middle of the thighs or the knees, wrapped tightly with it."
1.hi: Al-Layth ne Ibn Shihab se, Habib se (Urwah ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), Nudbah se (Maymunah ki azaad ki hui laundi), Maymunah رضي الله عنها, Nabi ﷺ ki biwi, se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "apni biwiyon mein se kisi se mubaashirat karte jabke woh haiz mein hoti, agar uspar izaar hoti, jo raanon ke aadhe tak ya ghutnon tak pahunchti, use kaskar baandhe hue."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ :" كُنْتُ أُرَجِّلُ رَأْسَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ "
1.en: Aisha رضي الله عنها narrated: She said: "I used to comb the head of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while I was menstruating."
1.hi: Aisha رضي الله عنها ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Main Rasulullah ﷺ ke sar mein kanghi kiya karti thi jabke main haiz mein hoti."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ :" كُنْتُ أُرَجِّلُ رَأْسَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ "
1.en: Aisha رضي الله عنها narrated: She said: "I used to comb the head of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while I was menstruating."
1.hi: Aisha رضي الله عنها ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Main Rasulullah ﷺ ke sar mein kanghi kiya karti thi jabke main haiz mein hoti."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، قَالَ :" كُنَّ جَوَارِي ابْنِ عُمَرَ يَغْسِلْنَ رِجْلَيْهِ وَهُنَّ حُيَّضٌ، وَيُعْطِينَهُ الْخُمْرَةَ "
1.en: Narrated by Nafi': He said: "The servant-girls of Ibn Umar used to wash his feet while they were menstruating, and give him the prayer-mat."
1.hi: Nafi' ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Ibn Umar ki laundiyaan uske pair dhoti thin jabke woh haiz mein hoti thin, aur use jaa-namaz de deti thin."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ الْمِقْدَامِ بْنِ شُرَيْحِ بْنِ هَانِئٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : كُنْتُ أُوتَى بِالْإِنَاءِ فَأَضَعُ فَمِي فَأَشْرَبُ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ،" فَيَضَعُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَمَهُ عَلَى الْمَكَانِ الَّذِي وَضَعْتُ فَيَشْرَبُ، وَأُوتَى بِالْعَرْقِ فَأَنْتَهِسُ، فَيَضَعُ فَاهُ عَلَى الْمَكَانِ الَّذِي وَضَعْتُ فَيَنْتَهِسُ، ثُمَّ يَأْمُرُنِي فَأَتَّزِرُ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ، وَكَانَ يُبَاشِرُنِي "
1.en: Aisha رضي الله عنها narrated: She said: I used to be given the vessel, and I would put my mouth [to it] and drink while I was menstruating, "so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would put his mouth on the place where I had put mine, and drink; and I would be given the bone [with meat] and I would gnaw it, so he would put his mouth on the place where I had put mine and gnaw it, then he would command me, and I would wrap myself while I was menstruating, and he would engage in intimate contact with me."
1.hi: Aisha رضي الله عنها ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe bartan diya jaata, aur main apna muh laga kar peeti jabke main haiz mein hoti, "to Rasulullah ﷺ apna muh usi jagah rakhte jahan maine rakha hota, aur peete; aur mujhe haddi [gosht ke saath] di jaati aur main use chabaati, to aap apna muh usi jagah rakhte jahan maine rakha hota aur chabaate, fir aap mujhe hukum dete, aur main haiz ki haalat mein izaar baandh leti, aur aap mere saath mubaashirat karte."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ : كَانَ يُقَالُ :" الْحَائِضُ لَيْسَتْ الْحِيضَةُ فِي يَدِهَا، تَغْسِلُ يَدَهَا وَتَعْجِنُ وَتَنْبِذُ "
1.en: Narrated by Sufyan, from Mughirah, from Ibrahim: He said: It used to be said: "The menstruating woman - her menstruation is not in her hand, she washes her hand and kneads dough and brews [nabidh]."
1.hi: Sufyan ne Mughirah se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha: Kaha jaata tha, "Haiz wali aurat - uska haiz uske haath mein nahi hota, woh apna haath dho kar aata gundh sakti hai aur nabidh (khajoor/kishmish ka sharbat) bana sakti hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو زَيْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ : كَانَ يَقُولُ :" إِنَّ الْحَائِضَ حِيضَتُهَا لَيْسَتْ فِي يَدِهَا "، وَكَانَ يَقُولُ : " الْحَائِضُ حُبُّ الْحَيِّ "
1.en: Narrated by Abu Zayd, from Shu'bah, from Mughirah, from Ibrahim: He said: he used to say: "Indeed the menstruating woman - her menstruation is not in her hand," and he used to say: "The menstruating woman is the love/beloved of the household."
1.hi: Abu Zayd ne Shu'bah se, Mughirah se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha: woh kaha karte the, "Haiz wali aurat - uska haiz uske haath mein nahi hota," aur woh kaha karte the: "Haiz wali aurat ghar wale ki mehboob hoti hai [uske saath mohabbat rakhi jaati hai]."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  عَنْ مُصَافَحَةِ الْيَهُودِيِّ ، وَالنَّصْرَانِيِّ ، وَالْمَجُوسِيِّ ، وَالْحَائِضِ" فَلَمْ يَرَ فِيهِ وُضُوءًا "
1.en: Narrated by Sufyan, from Hammad, from Ibrahim: He said: I asked Ibrahim about shaking hands with the Jew, and the Christian, and the Magian, and the menstruating woman, "and he did not see any [need for] ablution in it."
1.hi: Sufyan ne Hammad se, Ibrahim se bataya: Maine Ibrahim se Yahoodi, Nasrani (Isaai), Majoosi, aur haiz wali aurat se haath milane ke baare mein poocha, "to unhone ismein wudu ki koi zaroorat nahi samjhi."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل السُّدِّيُّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَهِيِّ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَقَالَ لِلْجَارِيَةِ :" نَاوِلِينِي الْخُمْرَةَ "، قَالَتْ : أَرَادَ أَنْ يَبْسُطَهَا، وَيُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهَا، فَقَالَتْ : إِنَّهَا حَائِضٌ، فَقَالَ : " إِنَّ حِيضَتَهَا لَيْسَ فِي يَدِهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Abdullah al-Bahi, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: He said: Aisha رضي الله عنها narrated to me, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was in the mosque, and he said to the servant-girl: "Hand me the prayer-mat." She said: He wanted to spread it and pray on it, so she said: "It [she] is menstruating." So he said: "Indeed her menstruation is not in her hand."
1.hi: Abdullah al-Bahi ne bataya: Aisha رضي الله عنها ne mujhse bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ masjid mein the, to aapne laundi se kaha: "Mujhe jaa-namaz de do." Unhone bataya: Aap ise bichhaakar usi par namaz padhna chahte the, to laundi ne kaha: "Woh haiz mein hai." To aapne farmaya: "Uska haiz uske haath mein to nahi hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ تَمِيمِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يُخْرِجُ إِلَيَّ رَأْسَهُ مِنْ الْمَسْجِدِ فَأَغْسِلُهُ "، يَعْنِي : وَهُوَ مُعْتَكِفٌ
1.en: Aisha رضي الله عنها narrated: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ "used to put his head out to me from the mosque, and I would wash it" - meaning, while he was in i'tikaf.
1.hi: Aisha رضي الله عنها ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ "masjid se apna sar mere paas nikaal dete, aur main use dho deti" - yaani, jabke aap i'tikaf mein hote.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  كَانَ :" لَا يَرَى بَأْسًا أَنْ تُوَضِّئَ الْحَائِضُ الْمَرِيضَ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Mu'alla ibn Asad, from Abu Awanah, from Mughirah, from Ibrahim: He "did not see any harm in the menstruating woman performing ablution for the sick person."
1.hi: Al-Mu'alla ibn Asad ne Abu Awanah se, Mughirah se, Ibrahim se bataya ke woh "haiz wali aurat ke bimar ko wudu karwane mein koi harj nahi samajhte the."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ :" كُنْتُ أَغْسِلُ رَأْسَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ "
1.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Ja'far ibn al-Harith, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: She said: "I used to wash the head of the Prophet ﷺ while I was menstruating."
1.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Ja'far ibn al-Harith se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se, al-Aswad se, Aisha رضي الله عنها se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Main Nabi ﷺ ka sar dhoti thi jabke main haiz mein hoti."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ تَمِيمِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ :" لَقَدْ كُنْتُ أَغْسِلُ رَأْسَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ، وَهُوَ عَاكِفٌ "
1.en: Narrated by Ya'la ibn Ubayd, from al-A'mash, from Tamim ibn Salamah, from Urwah, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: She said: "I used to wash the head of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while I was menstruating, and he was in i'tikaf."
1.hi: Ya'la ibn Ubayd ne al-A'mash se, Tamim ibn Salamah se, Urwah se, Aisha رضي الله عنها se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Main Rasulullah ﷺ ka sar dhoti thi jabke main haiz mein hoti, aur aap i'tikaf mein hote."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ مُغِيرَةَ ، قَالَ : أَرْسَلَ أَبُو ظَبْيَانَ إِلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ  يَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ الْحَائِضِ تُوَضِّئُ الْمَرِيضَ؟، قَالَ :" نَعَمْ، وَتُسْنِدُهُ "، قَالَ : لَا، فَقُلْتُ لِلْمُغِيرَةِ : سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ؟، قَالَ : لَا، قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : وَتُسْنِدُهُ يَعْنِي فِي الصَّلَاةِ
1.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from Mughirah; with Abdullah al-Darimi's clarification: He said: I heard Mughirah say: Abu Zabyan sent to Ibrahim asking him about the menstruating woman performing ablution for the sick person, he said: "Yes, and she may support him." He said: No. So I said to Mughirah: "Did you hear it from Ibrahim?" He said, "No." Abdullah said: "and she may support him" means in the prayer.
1.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne bataya: Maine Mughirah ko kehte suna: Abu Zabyan ne Ibrahim ke paas [aadmi] bheja yeh poochne ke haiz wali aurat bimar ko wudu karwaye [to kya hukum hai], unhone kaha: "Haan, aur woh use sahaara bhi de sakti hai." Unhone kaha: Nahi [ek doosri riwayat mein]. To maine Mughirah se poocha: "Kya aapne yeh Ibrahim se suna?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi." Abdullah kehte hain: "Aur woh use sahaara de sakti hai" ka matlab hai namaz mein.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ  : أَخْبَرَنِي عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ لَهَا :" نَاوِلِينِي الْخُمْرَةَ "، قَالَتْ : إِنِّي حَائِضٌ، قَالَ : " إِنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ فِي يَدِكِ "
1.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Sulayman, from Thabit ibn Ubayd, from al-Qasim, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: That the Prophet ﷺ said to her: "Hand me the mat." She said: "I am menstruating." He said: "It is not in your hand."
1.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se, Sulayman se, Thabit ibn Ubayd se, al-Qasim se, Aisha رضي الله عنها se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne unse farmaya: "Mujhe khumrah (chhoti jaa-namaz) de do." Unhone kaha: "Main haiz mein hoon." Aapne farmaya: "Woh to tumhare haath mein nahi hai."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ شِنْظِيرٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  " أَنَّهُسُئِلَ عَنْ امْرَأَةٍ حَائِضٍ شَرِبَتْ مِنْ مَاءٍ، أَيُتَوَضَّأُ بِهِ؟ فَضَحِكَ، وَقَالَ : نَعَمْ "
1.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Kathir ibn Shinzir, from al-Hasan: That he was asked about a menstruating woman who drank from water, is ablution to be performed with it? So he laughed, and said: "Yes."
1.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Kathir ibn Shinzir se, al-Hasan se bataya ke unse ek haiz wali aurat ke baare mein poocha gaya jisne paani se piya, kya usi paani se wudu kiya jaaye? To woh muskaraaye, aur kaha: "Haan."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَجَّاجِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ  ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ حَرَامِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ  ،  عَنْ عَمِّهِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَعَنْ مُؤَاكَلَةِ الْحَائِضِ، قَالَ : " وَاكِلْهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn al-Hajjaj, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi, from Mu'awiyah ibn Salih, from al-Ala ibn al-Harith, from Haram ibn Mu'awiyah, from his uncle Abdullah ibn Sa'd رضي الله عنه: He said: I asked the Prophet ﷺ about eating with the menstruating woman, he said: "Eat with her."
1.hi: Ahmad ibn al-Hajjaj ne Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi se, Mu'awiyah ibn Salih se, al-Ala ibn al-Harith se, Haram ibn Mu'awiyah se, apne chacha Abdullah ibn Sa'd رضي الله عنه se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Nabi ﷺ se haiz wali aurat ke saath khaana khaane ke baare mein poocha, to aapne farmaya: "Usi ke saath khaana khao."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَأْمُرُ جَارِيَتَهُ أَنْ تُنَاوِلَهُ الْخُمْرَةَ مِنْ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَتَقُولُ : إِنِّي حَائِضٌ، فَيَقُولُ :" إِنَّ حِيضَتَكِ لَيْسَتْ فِي كَفِّكِ فَتُنَاوِلُهُ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه: That he used to command his servant-girl to hand him the mat from the mosque, so she would say: "I am menstruating." So he would say: "Your menstruation is not in your palm, so hand it to me."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه se bataya ke woh apni laundi ko hukum dete ke woh masjid se unhein khumrah pakda de, to woh kehti: "Main haiz mein hoon." To woh kehte: "Tumhara haiz to tumhari hatheli mein nahi hai, so mujhe de do."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْهَيْثَمُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْعَلَاءُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ حَرَامِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ  ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ مُؤَاكَلَةِ الْحَائِضِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " إِنَّبَعْضَ أَهْلِي لَحَائِضٌ، وَإِنَّا لَمُتَعَشُّونَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ جَمِيعًا "
1.en: Narrated by Marwan ibn Muhammad, from al-Haytham ibn Humayd, from al-Ala ibn al-Harith, from Haram ibn Hakim, from his uncle: He said: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about eating with the menstruating woman, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed some of my family are menstruating, and we do have dinner all together, if Allah wills."
1.hi: Marwan ibn Muhammad ne al-Haytham ibn Humayd se, al-Ala ibn al-Harith se, Haram ibn Hakim se, apne chacha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ se haiz wali aurat ke saath khaana khaane ke baare mein poocha, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Meri kuch biwiyan haiz mein hoti hain, aur hum sab milkar Insha Allah shaam ka khaana khaate hain."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا : أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ" لَا تَرَى بَأْسًا أَنْ تَمَسَّ الْحَائِضُ الْخُمْرَةَ "
1.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from his father, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: That she used to "not see any harm in the menstruating woman touching the mat."
1.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se, Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim se, apne walid se, Aisha رضي الله عنها se bataya ke woh "haiz wali aurat ke khumrah chhoone mein koi harj nahi samajhti thin."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا مُغِيرَةُ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، وَيُونُسُ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، وَعَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ ، وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ ، فِي الْحَائِضِ" إِذَا طَهُرَتْ مِنْ الدَّمِ لَا يَقْرَبُهَا زَوْجُهَا حَتَّى تَغْتَسِلَ "، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ ، عَن مُجَاهِدٍ ، مِثْلَهُ سَوَاءً
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Hushaym, from Mughirah, from Ibrahim, and Yunus, from al-Hasan, and Abd al-Malik, from Ata; a similar chain also via Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Qattan and via Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Uthman ibn al-Aswad, from Mujahid: Concerning the menstruating woman: "When she becomes pure from the blood, her husband does not approach her until she performs ghusl." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Uthman ibn al-Aswad, from Mujahid, the same, exactly.]
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Hushaym se, Mughirah se, Ibrahim se, aur Yunus se, al-Hasan se, aur Abd al-Malik se, Ata se bataya; aur Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Qattan se, Uthman ibn al-Aswad se, Mujahid se, haiz wali aurat ke baare mein: "Jab woh khoon se paak ho jaaye, to uska shohar uske paas nahi jaata jab tak woh ghusl na kare." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se, Ubaydullah ibn Musa se, Uthman ibn al-Aswad se, Mujahid se, bilkul isi tarah aayi hai.]

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ سُفْيَانُ  :" أَيُجَامِعُ الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ إِذَا انْقَطَعَ عَنْهَا الدَّمُ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ؟، فَقَالَ : لَا، فَقِيلَ : أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ تَرَكَتْ الْغُسْلَ يَوْمَيْنِ أَوْ أَيَّامًا؟، قَالَ : تُسْتَتَابُ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, about Sufyan: He said: Sufyan was asked: "Does the man have intercourse with his wife when the blood has stopped from her, before she performs ghusl?" So he said, "No." So it was said, "What do you think if she leaves the ghusl two days or [several] days?" He said: "She is asked to repent."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne bataya: Sufyan se poocha gaya: "Kya aadmi apni biwi se jima kar sakta hai jab uska khoon ruk chuka ho, ghusl se pehle?" To unhone kaha, "Nahi." To poocha gaya, "Aapka kya khayal hai agar woh ghusl do din ya kayi din chhod de?" Unhone kaha: "Usse tauba karwaayi jaaye."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ " # وَلا تَقْرَبُوهُنَّ حَتَّى يَطْهُرْنَ سورة البقرة آية 222 #، قَالَ : حَتَّى يَنْقَطِعَ الدَّمُ، # فَإِذَا تَطَهَّرْنَ سورة البقرة آية 222 #، قَالَ : إِذَا اغْتَسَلْنَ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from someone who narrated to him, from Mujahid, concerning Surah al-Baqarah verse 222: "'And do not approach them until they are pure' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 222]," he said: "[meaning] until the blood stops," "'but when they have purified themselves' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 222]," he said: "[meaning] when they have performed ghusl."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, ek shakhs se jisne unhein bataya, Mujahid se, is aayat ke baare mein bataya: "'Aur unke paas na jao jab tak woh paak na ho jaayein' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 222]," unhone kaha: "[yaani] jab tak khoon na ruk jaaye," "'fir jab woh khud ko paak kar lein' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 222]," unhone kaha: "[yaani] jab woh ghusl kar lein."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ ،  عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ " # حَتَّى يَطْهُرْنَ سورة البقرة آية 222 #، قَالَ : إِذَا انْقَطَعَ الدَّمُ، # فَإِذَا تَطَهَّرْنَ سورة البقرة آية 222 #، قَالَ : اغْتَسَلْنَ "
1.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Sufyan, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, concerning Surah al-Baqarah verse 222: "'until they are pure' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 222]," he said: "when the blood stops," "'but when they have purified themselves' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 222]," he said: "[when] they have performed ghusl."
1.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Sufyan se, Ibn Abi Najih se, Mujahid se is aayat ke baare mein bataya: "'Jab tak woh paak na ho jaayein' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 222]," unhone kaha: "jab khoon ruk jaaye," "'fir jab woh khud ko paak kar lein' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 222]," unhone kaha: "[yaani] woh ghusl kar lein."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ الْأَسْوَدِ ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ مُجَاهِدًا ، عَنْ امْرَأَةٍ رَأَتْ الطُّهْرَ : أَيَحِلُّ لِزَوْجِهَا أَنْ يَأْتِيَهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ؟، قَالَ :" لَا حَتَّى تَحِلَّ لَهَا الصَّلَاةُ "
1.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah, from Uthman ibn al-Aswad, from Mujahid: He said: I asked Mujahid about a woman who sees purity: "Is it lawful for her husband to come to her before she performs ghusl?" He said: "No, not until the prayer becomes lawful for her."
1.hi: Ubaydullah ne Uthman ibn al-Aswad se bataya: Maine Mujahid se us aurat ke baare mein poocha jo paaki dekhe: "Kya uske shohar ke liye ghusl se pehle uske paas aana halal hai?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, jab tak uske liye namaz halal na ho jaaye."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ هُوَ ابْنُ زِيَادٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ أَرْطَاةَ ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ عَطَاءً ، وَمَيْمُونَ بْنَ مِهْرَانَ ، وَحَدَّثَنِي حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالُوا :" لَا يَغْشَاهَا حَتَّى تَغْتَسِلَ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Mu'alla ibn Asad, from Abd al-Wahid ibn Ziyad, from al-Hajjaj ibn Artah, from Ata, Maymun ibn Mihran, and Hammad, from Ibrahim: He said: I asked Ata, and Maymun ibn Mihran, and Hammad narrated to me, from Ibrahim: they said: "He does not have intercourse with her until she performs ghusl."
1.hi: Al-Mu'alla ibn Asad ne Abd al-Wahid ibn Ziyad se, al-Hajjaj ibn Artah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ata se aur Maymun ibn Mihran se poocha, aur Hammad ne mujhse Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Woh uske saath jima na kare jab tak woh ghusl na kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  فِي الرَّجُلِ يَطَأُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَقَدْ رَأَتْ الطُّهْرَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ، قَالَ :" هِيَ حَائِضٌ مَا لَمْ تَغْتَسِلْ، وَعَلَيْهِ الْكَفَّارَةُ، وَلَهُ أَنْ يُرَاجِعَهَا مَا لَمْ تَغْتَسِلْ "
1.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hisham, from al-Hasan, concerning the man who has intercourse with his wife after she has seen purity but before she performs ghusl: He said: "She is [still] menstruating as long as she has not performed ghusl, and expiation is due upon him, and he may take her back as long as she has not performed ghusl."
1.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hisham se, al-Hasan se, us aadmi ke baare mein bataya jo apni biwi se jima kare jabke usne paaki dekh li ho lekin ghusl se pehle: Unhone kaha, "Woh haiz mein hi hai jab tak woh ghusl nahi kar leti, aur uspar kaffara wajib hai, aur woh usay wapas le sakta hai jab tak woh ghusl na kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ،  عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" لَا يَغْشَاهَا زَوْجُهَا "
1.en: Narrated by al-Mu'alla ibn Asad, from Abd al-Wahid, from Yunus, from al-Hasan: He said: "Her husband does not have intercourse with her."
1.hi: Al-Mu'alla ibn Asad ne Abd al-Wahid se, Yunus se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Uska shohar uske saath jima na kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ يَزِيدَ بْنَ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ أَبُو الْخَيْرِ مَرْثَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْيَزَنِيُّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيَّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، يَقُولُ :" وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لَا أُجَامِعُ امْرَأَتِي فِي الْيَوْمِ الَّذِي تَطْهُرُ فِيهِ حَتَّى يَمُرَّ يَوْمٌ "
1.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Haywah ibn Shurayh, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Abu al-Khayr Marthad ibn Abdullah al-Yazani, from Uqbah ibn Amir al-Juhani رضي الله عنه: He said: "By Allah, I do not have intercourse with my wife on the day she becomes pure, until a [full] day passes."
