1.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid ne Haywah ibn Shurayh se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Yazid ibn Abi Habib ko kehte suna: Abu al-Khayr Marthad ibn Abdullah al-Yazani ne kaha: Maine Uqbah ibn Amir al-Juhani رضي الله عنه ko kehte suna: "Allah ki qasam, main apni biwi se us din jima nahi karta jis din woh paak hoti hai, jab tak ek din na guzar jaaye."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَرَى الطُّهْرَ : أَيَأْتِيهَا زَوْجُهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ؟، قَالَ :" لَا، حَتَّى تَغْتَسِلَ "
1.en: Narrated by Ya'la ibn Ubayd, from Abd al-Malik, from Ata, concerning the woman who sees purity: "Does her husband come to her before she performs ghusl?" He said: "No, not until she performs ghusl."
1.hi: Ya'la ibn Ubayd ne Abd al-Malik se, Ata se, us aurat ke baare mein bataya jo paaki dekhe: "Kya uska shohar ghusl se pehle uske paas aa sakta hai?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, jab tak woh ghusl na kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ لَيْثِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  فِي الْمَرْأَةِ يَنْقَطِعُ عَنْهَا الدَّمُ، قَالَ :" إِنْ أَدْرَكَهُ الشَّبَقُ، غَسَلَتْ فَرْجَهَا ثُمَّ يَأْتِيَها "
1.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Abu Awanah, from Layth ibn Abi Sulaym, from Ata, concerning the woman whose blood has stopped: He said: "If desire overcomes him, she washes her private part, then he may come to her."
1.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Abu Awanah se, Layth ibn Abi Sulaym se, Ata se, us aurat ke baare mein bataya jiska khoon ruk gaya ho: Unhone kaha, "Agar use shiddat ki khwahish (shabaq) ho jaaye, to woh apni sharamgah dho le, fir woh uske paas aa sakta hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا فَرْوَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَغْرَاءِ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ شَرِيكًا وَسَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ ، فَقَالَ : الْمَرْأَةُ يَنْقَطِعُ عَنْهَا الدَّمُ : أَيَأْتِيهَا زَوْجُهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ؟، فَقَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ : عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، أَنَّهُ" رَخَّصَ فِي ذَلِكَ لِلشَّبِقِ "، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : أَخَافُ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَخَطَأً، وأَخَافُ أَنْ يَكُونَ مِنْ حَدِيثِ لَيْثٍ، لَا أَعْرِفُهُ مِنْ حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ ، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : الشَّبِقُ الَّذِي يَشْتَهِي
1.en: Narrated by Farwah ibn Abi al-Maghra, from Sharik, from Abd al-Malik, from Ata; with Abu Muhammad's caution: He said: I heard Sharik, and a man asked him, and said: "The woman whose blood has stopped from her - does her husband come to her before she performs ghusl?" So he said: Abd al-Malik said: from Ata, that he "gave a concession in that case for [severe] desire." Abu Muhammad said: I fear that this may be an error, and I fear that it may be from the hadith of Layth, I do not recognize it as being from the hadith of Abd al-Malik. Abu Muhammad said: "shabaq" is [severe] desire.
1.hi: Farwah ibn Abi al-Maghra ne bataya: Maine Sharik ko suna, aur ek aadmi ne unse poocha, aur kaha: "Woh aurat jiska khoon ruk gaya ho - kya uska shohar ghusl se pehle uske paas aa sakta hai?" To unhone kaha: Abd al-Malik ne Ata se bataya ke unhone "is surat mein shiddat ki khwahish ke liye rukhsat di." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Mujhe dar hai ke yeh ghalti ho, aur mujhe dar hai ke yeh Layth ki riwayat se ho, main ise Abd al-Malik ki riwayat se nahi pehchaanta. Abu Muhammad kehte hain: "Shabaq" shiddat ki khwahish ko kehte hain.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، قَالَ : زَعَمَ لَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، عَنْ أَبِي حُرَّةَ وَاصِلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" رَأَيْتُ نِسَاءً مِنْ نِسَاءِ الْمَدِينَةِ يُصَلِّينَ فِي الْخِضَابِ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Hushaym, from Abu Hurrah Wasil ibn Abd al-Rahman, from al-Hasan: He said: "I saw women from among the women of Madinah praying with dye on."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne bataya: Hushaym ne humein Abu Hurrah Wasil ibn Abd al-Rahman se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Maine Madinah ki auraton mein se kuch auraton ko rang [mehndi/khidab] laga kar namaz padhte dekha."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ  ، عَمَّنْ  سَمِعَ عَائِشَةَ   سُئِلَتْ عَنْ الْمَرْأَةِ تَمْسَحُ عَلَى الْخِضَابِ، فَقَالَتْ :" لَأَنْ تُقْطَعَ يَدِي بِالسَّكَاكِينِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ "
1.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Ibn Abi Najih, from someone who heard Aisha: She was asked about the woman who wipes over the dye, so she said: "That my hand be cut off with knives would be more beloved to me than that."
1.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Ibn Abi Najih se, us shakhs se bataya jisne Aisha ko suna: Unse us aurat ke baare mein poocha gaya jo [wudu mein] rang (khidab) ke upar hi masah kar leti hai, to unhone kaha: "Mera haath chaakuon se kaat diya jaaye, yeh mujhe usse zyada pasand hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ  ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً سَأَلَت عَائِشَةَ   تُصَلِّي الْمَرْأَةُ فِي الْخِضَابِ؟، قَالَتْ :" اسْلُتِيهِ وَرَغْمًا "، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : أَبُو سَعِيدٍ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي الْعَنَبْسِ، وَاسْمُ أَبِي الْعَنَبْسِ : سَعِيدُ بْنُ كَثِيرِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ
1.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Ibn Awn, from Abu Sa'id: That a woman asked Aisha: "Does the woman pray with dye on?" She said: "Wipe/remove it off, and shame [on the practice]." Abu Muhammad said: Abu Sa'id is Ibn Abi al-Anbas, and the name of Abu al-Anbas is Sa'id ibn Kathir ibn Ubayd.
1.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Ibn Awn se, Abu Sa'id se bataya ke ek aurat ne Aisha se poocha: "Kya aurat rang (khidab) laga kar namaz padh sakti hai?" Unhone kaha: "Use utaar do, aur [is amal par] afsos hai." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Abu Sa'id, Ibn Abi al-Anbas hain, aur Abu al-Anbas ka naam Sa'id ibn Kathir ibn Ubayd hai.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ :" كُنَّ نِسَاءَنَا يَخْتَضِبْنَ بِاللَّيْلِ، فَإِذَا أَصْبَحْنَ، فَتَحْنَهُ فَتَوَضَّأْنَ وَصَلَّيْنَ، ثُمَّ يَخْتَضِبْنَ بَعْدَ الصَّلَاةِ، فَإِذَا كَانَ عِنْدَ الظُّهْرِ، فَتَحْنَهُ فَتَوَضَّأْنَ وَصَلَّيْنَ فَأَحْسَنَّ خِضَابًا، وَلَا يَمْنَعُ مِنْ الصَّلَاةِ "
1.en: Narrated by Qatadah, from Abu Mijlaz, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: He said: "Our women used to apply dye at night, then when morning came, they would open it and perform ablution and pray, then apply dye again after the prayer, then when it was near Zuhr, they would open it and perform ablution and pray, so their dye turned out well, and it did not prevent them from the prayer."
1.hi: Qatadah ne Abu Mijlaz se, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Humari auratein raat ko rang (khidab) lagati thin, fir jab subah hoti, to use khol kar wudu karti aur namaz padhtin, fir namaz ke baad phir rang lagatin, fir jab Zuhr ke qareeb hota, to use khol kar wudu karti aur namaz padhtin, so unka rang bhi achha hota aur namaz se bhi na rukti thin."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، أَنَّ نِسَاءَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ كُنّ" يَخْتَضِبْنَ وَهُنَّ حُيَّضٌ "
1.en: Narrated by Hammad, from Ayyub, from Nafi', about the wives of Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه: That the women of Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه used to "apply dye while they were menstruating."
1.hi: Hammad ne Ayyub se, Nafi' se bataya ke Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه ki auraten "haiz ki haalat mein rang (khidab) lagati thin."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" كُنَّ نِسَاؤُنَا إِذَا صَلَّيْنَ الْعِشَاءَ الْآخِرَةَ، اخْتَضَبْنَ، فَإِذَا أَصْبَحْنَ أَطْلَقْنَهُ وَتَوَضَّأْنَ وَصَلَّيْنَ، وَإِذَا صَلَّيْنَ الظُّهْرَ اخْتَضَبْنَ، فَإِذَا أَرَدْنَ أَنْ يُصَلِّينَ الْعَصْرَ، أَطْلَقْنَهُ فَأَحْسَنَّ خِضَابَهُ وَلَا يَحْبِسْنَ عَنْ الصَّلَاةِ "
1.en: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه narrated: He said: "Our women, when they prayed the last Isha, would apply dye, then when morning came they would loosen it and perform ablution and pray, and when they prayed Zuhr they would apply dye, then when they wanted to pray Asr, they would loosen it, so their dye turned out well and they were not held back from the prayer."
1.hi: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Humari auratein jab Isha ki namaz padh letin, to rang lagatin, fir jab subah hoti to use khol kar wudu karti aur namaz padhtin, aur jab Zuhr padhtin to rang lagatin, fir jab Asr padhna chahtin to use khol detin, so unka rang bhi achha hota aur namaz se bhi na rukti thin."

1.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُغِيرَةُ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ .
ح وأَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  فِيمَنْ أَتَى أَهْلَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ، قَالَا :" ذَنْبٌ أَتَاهُ، يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، وَيَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ، وَلَا يَعُودُ "، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ ، عَنْ الْمُثَنَّى ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، مِثْلَهُ
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Hushaym, from Mughirah, from Ibrahim; and from Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid, from Amir; a similar chain also via al-Muthanna, from Ata: Concerning the one who comes to his wife while she is menstruating, they both said: "It is a sin he has committed; he seeks Allah's forgiveness, and repents to Him, and does not return to it." [Another chain, the same, from al-Muthanna, from Ata.]
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Hushaym se, Mughirah se, Ibrahim se; aur Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid se, Amir se, us shakhs ke baare mein bataya jo apni haiz wali biwi ke paas jaaye: Dono ne kaha, "Yeh ek gunah hai jo usne kiya; woh Allah se maghfirat maange, aur uski taraf tauba kare, aur dobara na kare." [Ek aur sanad, isi tarah, al-Muthanna se, Ata se.]

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، وَأَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ ، قَالَ :" ذَنْبٌ أَتَاهُ، وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ كَفَّارَةٌ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, and Abu al-Nu'man, from Abdullah ibn al-Mubarak, from Ya'qub ibn al-Qa'qa', from Muhammad ibn Zayd, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr: He said: "It is a sin he has committed, and no expiation is due upon him."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa aur Abu al-Nu'man ne Abdullah ibn al-Mubarak se, Ya'qub ibn al-Qa'qa' se, Muhammad ibn Zayd se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Yeh ek gunah hai jo usne kiya, aur uspar koi kaffara wajib nahi."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ الَّذِي يَأْتِي امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ، قَالَ :" يَعْتَذِرُ إِلَى اللَّهِ، وَيَتُوبُ إِلَى اللَّهِ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Ubaydullah ibn Umar, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from his father: That he was asked about the one who comes to his wife while she is menstruating, he said: "He apologizes to Allah, and repents to Allah."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Ubaydullah ibn Umar se, Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim se, apne walid se bataya ke unse us shakhs ke baare mein poocha gaya jo apni haiz wali biwi ke paas jaaye, unhone kaha: "Woh Allah se maazrat kare, aur Allah ki taraf tauba kare."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ :" تَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ شَيْءٌ "، يَعْنِي : إِذَا وَقَعَ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ata: He said: "He seeks Allah's forgiveness, and nothing is due upon you" - meaning, when he has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating.
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Ibn Jurayj se, Ata se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Woh Allah se maghfirat maange, aur tumpar kuch wajib nahi" - yaani, jab woh apni haiz wali biwi se jima kare.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ الْعَنْبِرِيِّ ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ عَنْ الرَّجُلِ يَأْتِي امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ، قَالَ :" يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ "
1.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal, from Malik ibn al-Khattab al-Anbari, from Ibn Abi Mulaykah: He said: it was asked, while I was listening, about the man who comes to his wife while she is menstruating, he said: "He seeks Allah's forgiveness."
1.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal se, Malik ibn al-Khattab al-Anbari se, Ibn Abi Mulaykah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mere saamne us aadmi ke baare mein poocha gaya jo apni haiz wali biwi ke paas jaaye, unhone kaha: "Woh Allah se maghfirat maange."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَتَى أَبَا بَكْرٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، فَقَالَ : رَأَيْتُ فِي الْمَنَامِ كَأَنِّي أَبُولُ دَمًا، قَالَ : تَأْتِي امْرَأَتَكَ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ؟، قَالَ : نَعَمْ، قَالَ :" اتَّقِ اللَّهَ، وَلَا تَعُدْ "
1.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah: That a man came to Abu Bakr رضي الله عنه, and said: "I saw in a dream as if I were urinating blood." He said: "Do you come to your wife while she is menstruating?" He said, "Yes." He said: "Fear Allah, and do not return to it."
1.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ayyub se, Abu Qilabah se bataya ke ek aadmi Abu Bakr رضي الله عنه ke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Maine khwab mein dekha jaise main khoon peshaab kar raha hoon." Unhone poocha: "Kya tum apni biwi ke paas jaate ho jabke woh haiz mein hoti hai?" Usne kaha, "Haan." Unhone kaha: "Allah se daro, aur dobara aisa na karo."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ ، فِي الَّذِي يَقَعُ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ، قَالَ :" يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Hisham, from Muhammad ibn Sirin: Concerning the one who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating, he said: "He seeks Allah's forgiveness."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Hisham se, Muhammad ibn Sirin se, us shakhs ke baare mein bataya jo apni haiz wali biwi se jima kare: Unhone kaha, "Woh Allah se maghfirat maange."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ ، يَقُولُ فِي الَّذِي يُفْطِرُ يَوْمًا مِنْ رَمَضَانَ، قَالَ :" عَلَيْهِ عِتْقُ رَقَبَةٍ، أَوْ بَدَنَةٌ، أَوْ عِشْرِينَ صَاعًا لِأَرْبَعِينَ مِسْكِينًا، وَفِي الَّذِي يَغْشَى امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ، مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ "
1.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Yazid ibn Ibrahim, from al-Hasan: He said: I heard al-Hasan say, concerning the one who breaks his fast for a day of Ramadan, he said: "Upon him is the freeing of a slave, or a sacrificial animal, or twenty sa' [of food] for forty poor persons; and concerning the one who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating, the same."
1.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Yazid ibn Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Hasan ko kehte suna, us shakhs ke baare mein jo Ramzan ka koi din bina roze ke guzaare, unhone kaha: "Uspar ek ghulam ko azaad karna, ya ek qurbani ka jaanwar, ya chalis miskeenon ke liye bees sa' [khaana] wajib hai; aur us shakhs ke baare mein jo apni haiz wali biwi se jima kare, wahi hukum hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ خُصَيْفٍ  ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي الَّذِي يَأْتِي امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ، قَالَ :" يَتَصَدَّقُ بِنِصْفِ دِينَارٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Sharik, from Khusayf, from Miqsam, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما, from the Prophet ﷺ: Concerning the one who comes to his wife while she is menstruating, he said: "He gives half a dinar in charity."
1.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Sharik se, Khusayf se, Miqsam se, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se, Nabi ﷺ se, us shakhs ke baare mein bataya jo apni haiz wali biwi ke paas jaaye, aapne farmaya: "Woh aadha dinar sadqa de."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ  ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، فِي الَّذِي يَأْتِي امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ، قَالَ :" يَتَصَدَّقُ بِدِينَارٍ، أَوْ نِصْفِ دِينَارٍ شَكَّ الْحَكَمُ "
1.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, from Abd al-Hamid, from Miqsam, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: Concerning the one who comes to his wife while she is menstruating, he said: "He gives a dinar, or half a dinar, in charity" - al-Hakam was uncertain [which].
1.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se, al-Hakam se, Abd al-Hamid se, Miqsam se, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se, us shakhs ke baare mein bataya jo apni haiz wali biwi ke paas jaaye, unhone kaha: "Woh ek dinar, ya aadha dinar sadqa de" - al-Hakam ko shak tha [kaunsa].

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ  ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، فِي الَّذِي يَغْشَى امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ" يَتَصَدَّقُ بِدِينَارٍ، أَوْ نِصْفِ دِينَارٍ "، قَالَ شُعْبَةُ : أَمَّا حِفْظِي فَهُوَ مَرْفُوعٌ، وَأَمَّا فُلَانٌ وَفُلَانٌ، فَقَالَا : غَيْرُ مَرْفُوعٍ، فَقَالَ بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ : حَدِّثْنَا بِحِفْظِكَ، وَدَعْ مَا قَالَ فُلَانٌ وَفُلَانٌ، فَقَالَ : " وَاللَّهِ مَا أُحِبُّ أَنِّي عُمِّرْتُ فِي الدُّنْيَا عُمُرَ نُوحٍ وَأَنِّي حَدَّثْتُ بِهَذَا، أَوْ سَكَتُّ عَنْ هَذَا "، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : عَبْدُ الحَمِيدِ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحمَنِ بْنِ زَيدِ بْنِ الخَطَّابِ وَكَانَ وَالِيَ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ عَلَى الْكُوفَةِ
1.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, from Abd al-Hamid, from Miqsam, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما; with Shu'bah's cautious remark: Concerning the one who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating: "He gives a dinar, or half a dinar, in charity." Shu'bah said: "As for my memory, it is [attributed] as raised [to the Prophet]; but as for so-and-so and so-and-so, they said it is not raised." Some of the people said, "Narrate to us according to your memory, and leave what so-and-so and so-and-so said." So he said: "By Allah, I would not love to be given the lifespan of Nuh in this world, and that I narrate this [wrongly], or remain silent about this." Abu Muhammad said: Abd al-Hamid ibn Zayd ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Zayd ibn al-Khattab, and he was the governor of Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz over Kufah.
1.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, al-Hakam se, Abd al-Hamid se, Miqsam se, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se, us shakhs ke baare mein bataya jo apni haiz wali biwi se jima kare: "Woh ek dinar, ya aadha dinar sadqa de." Shu'bah kehte hain: "Meri yaadasht ke mutaabiq to yeh marfu' (Nabi tak pahunchi hui) hai; lekin fulaan aur fulaan kehte hain ke yeh marfu' nahi." Kuch logon ne kaha, "Humein apni yaadasht ke mutaabiq bataiye, aur fulaan-fulaan ki baat chhod dijiye." To unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, mujhe pasand nahi ke mujhe Nuh jitni umar duniya mein di jaaye aur main yeh [ghalat] bayaan karun, ya is baare mein khamosh rahun." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Abd al-Hamid ibn Zayd ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Zayd ibn al-Khattab, aur woh Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz ke Kufah ke gawarnar the.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ  ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ :" إِذَا أَتَاهَا فِي دَمٍ فَدِينَارٌ، وَإِذَا أَتَاهَا وَقَدْ انْقَطَعَ الدَّمُ فَنِصْفُ دِينَارٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abd al-Karim, from a man, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: He said: "If he comes to her while there is blood, then a dinar; and if he comes to her after the blood has stopped, then half a dinar."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Ibn Jurayj se, Abd al-Karim se, ek shakhs se, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Agar woh khoon ki haalat mein uske paas jaaye, to ek dinar; aur agar khoon ruk chuka ho tab jaaye, to aadha dinar."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ خُصَيْفٍ  ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ : قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي الَّذِي يَقَعُ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ :" يَتَصَدَّقُ بِنِصْفِ دِينَارٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Khusayf, from Miqsam, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: He said: The Prophet ﷺ said, concerning the one who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating: "He gives half a dinar in charity."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Khusayf se, Miqsam se, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ ne us shakhs ke baare mein farmaya jo apni haiz wali biwi se jima kare: "Woh aadha dinar sadqa de."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي مَالِكٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ  رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : كَانَ لِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ امْرَأَةٌ تَكْرَهُ الْجِمَاعَ، فَكَانَ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَهَا اعْتَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ بِالْحَيْضِ، فَوَقَعَ عَلَيْهَا، فَإِذَا هِيَ صَادِقَةٌ، فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَأَمَرَهُ :" أَنْ يَتَصَدَّقَ بِخُمُسَيْ دِينَارٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from al-Awza'i, from Yazid ibn Abi Malik, from Abd al-Hamid ibn Zayd ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه: He said: Umar ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه had a wife who disliked intercourse, so whenever he wanted to come to her, she would make an excuse to him of menstruation, so he had intercourse with her, and then found out she was truthful, so he went to the Prophet ﷺ, and he commanded him "to give two-fifths of a dinar in charity."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne al-Awza'i se, Yazid ibn Abi Malik se, Abd al-Hamid ibn Zayd ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه se bataya: Unhone kaha, Umar ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه ki ek biwi thi jo jima na-pasand karti thi, so jab bhi woh unke paas jaana chahte, to woh haiz ka bahaana bana deti, so unhone [ek din] uske saath jima kiya, to pata chala ke woh sach keh rahi thi, so woh Nabi ﷺ ke paas gaye, to aapne unhein hukum diya "ke woh do-panchwa hissa dinar sadqa dein."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ الرَّازِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ  ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" إِذَا أَتَى الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ، فَإِنْ كَانَ الدَّمُ عَبِيطًا، فَلْيَتَصَدَّقْ بِدِينَارٍ، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ صُفْرَةً، فَلْيَتَصَدَّقْ بِنِصْفِ دِينَارٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Abu Ja'far al-Razi, from Abd al-Karim, from Miqsam, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "When the man comes to his wife while she is menstruating, if the blood is fresh/bright red, let him give a dinar in charity, and if it is yellowish, let him give half a dinar in charity."
1.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Abu Ja'far al-Razi se, Abd al-Karim se, Miqsam se, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jab aadmi apni haiz wali biwi ke paas jaaye, agar khoon taaza surkh ho, to woh ek dinar sadqa de, aur agar zard ho, to woh aadha dinar sadqa de."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ الَّذِي يَأْتِي امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ، قَالَ :" يَتَصَدَّقُ بِدِينَارٍ، أَوْ بِنِصْفِ دِينَارٍ "، وقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ : " يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ "
1.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from al-A'mash, from al-Hakam, from Miqsam, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما; with Ibrahim's differing view: That he was asked about the one who comes to his wife while she is menstruating, he said: "He gives a dinar, or half a dinar, in charity." And Ibrahim said: "He seeks Allah's forgiveness."
1.hi: Abdullah ibn Muhammad ne Hafs ibn Ghiyath se, al-A'mash se, al-Hakam se, Miqsam se, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se bataya ke unse us shakhs ke baare mein poocha gaya jo apni haiz wali biwi ke paas jaaye, unhone kaha: "Woh ek dinar, ya aadha dinar sadqa de." Aur Ibrahim ne kaha: "Woh Allah se maghfirat maange."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ :" إِذَا وَقَعَ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَتَصَدَّقَ بِدِينَارٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid ibn Abdullah, from Ibn Abi Layla, from Ata, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: He said: "If he has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating, he must give a dinar in charity."
1.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid ibn Abdullah se, Ibn Abi Layla se, Ata se, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Agar woh apni haiz wali biwi se jima kare, to uspar ek dinar sadqa dena wajib hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  فِي رَجُلٍ جَامَعَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ، قَالَ :" يَتَصَدَّقُ بِدِينَارٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Ya'la ibn Ubayd, from Abd al-Malik, from Ata, concerning a man who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating: He said: "He gives a dinar in charity."
1.hi: Ya'la ibn Ubayd ne Abd al-Malik se, Ata se, us aadmi ke baare mein bataya jo apni haiz wali biwi se jima kare: Unhone kaha, "Woh ek dinar sadqa de."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ :" يَتَصَدَّقُ بِدِينَارٍ، أَوْ نِصْفِ دِينَارٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Ibn Abi Layla, from Miqsam, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: He said: "He gives a dinar, or half a dinar, in charity."
1.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Ibn Abi Layla se, Miqsam se, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Woh ek dinar, ya aadha dinar sadqa de."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  فِي رَجُلٍ يَغْشَى امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ، أَوْ رَأَتْ الطُّهْرَ وَلَمْ تَغْتَسِلْ، قَالَ :" يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، وَيَتَصَدَّقُ بِخُمُسَيْ دِينَارٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Wahb ibn Sa'id, from Shu'ayb ibn Ishaq, from al-Awza'i: Concerning a man who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating, or she has seen purity but not yet performed ghusl, he said: "He seeks Allah's forgiveness, and gives two-fifths of a dinar in charity."
1.hi: Wahb ibn Sa'id ne Shu'ayb ibn Ishaq se, al-Awza'i se, us aadmi ke baare mein bataya jo apni haiz wali biwi se jima kare, ya jisne paaki dekh li ho lekin ghusl na kiya ho: Unhone kaha, "Woh Allah se maghfirat maange, aur do-panchwa hissa dinar sadqa de."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا وَقَعَ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ يَتَصَدَّقُ بِنِصْفِ دِينَارٍ "، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ الْقَوْمِ : فَإِنَّ الْحَسَنَ، يَقُولُ : يُعْتِقُ رَقَبَةً، فَقَالَ : " مَا أَنْهَاكُمْ أَنْ تَقَرَّبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Abd al-Malik, from Ata: He said: "If the man has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating, he gives half a dinar in charity." So a man among the people said to him, "But al-Hasan says: he frees a slave." So he said: "I do not forbid you from drawing near to Allah with whatever you are able."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Abd al-Malik se, Ata se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Agar aadmi apni haiz wali biwi se jima kare, to woh aadha dinar sadqa de." To ek shakhs ne unse kaha, "Lekin al-Hasan kehte hain: woh ek ghulam azaad kare." To unhone kaha: "Main tumhein Allah ke qareeb hone se, jitna tum kar sako, nahi rokta."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، فِي الَّذِي يَقَعُ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ، قَالَ :" يَتَصَدَّقُ بِدِينَارٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Ibn Abi Layla, from Ata, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: Concerning the one who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating, he said: "He gives a dinar in charity."
1.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Ibn Abi Layla se, Ata se, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se, us shakhs ke baare mein bataya jo apni haiz wali biwi se jima kare: Unhone kaha, "Woh ek dinar sadqa de."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ سَابِطٍ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، قُلْتُ لَهَا : إِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكِ عَنْ شَيْءٍ، وَأَنَا أَسْتَحْيِي أَنْ أَسْأَلَكِ عَنْهُ، قَالَتْ : سَلْ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي عَمَّا بَدَا لَكَ، قَالَ : أَسْأَلُكِ عَنْ إِتْيَانِ النِّسَاءِ فِي أَدْبَارِهِنَّ، فَقَالَتْ : حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : كَانَتْ الْأَنْصَارُ لَا تُجَبِّي، وَكَانَتْ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ تُجَبِّي، فَتَزَوَّجَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ امْرَأَةً مِنْ الْأَنْصَارِ، فَجَبَّاهَا، فَأَبَتْ الْأَنْصَارِيَّةُ، فَأَتَتْ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ ، فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لَهَا، فَلَمَّا أَنْ جَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ اسْتَحْيَتْ الْأَنْصَارِيَّةُ وَخَرَجَتْ، فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ :" ادْعُوهَا لِي "، فَدُعِيَتْ لَهُ، فَقَالَ لَهَا : " # نِسَاؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَكُمْ فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ سورة البقرة آية 223 #، صِمَامًا وَاحِدًا "، وَالصِّمَامُ : السَّبِيلُ الْوَاحِدُ
1.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Uthman ibn Khuthaym, from Ibn Sabit, from Hafsah bint Abd al-Rahman: He said: I asked Hafsah bint Abd al-Rahman - she is the daughter of Abu Bakr - I said to her: "I want to ask you about something, and I am shy to ask you about it." She said: "Ask, O son of my brother, about what has occurred to you." He said: I ask you about approaching women from their rears. So she said: Umm Salamah رضي الله عنها narrated to me, she said: The Ansar did not turn [women] over, while the Muhajirun did turn them over. So a man from the Muhajirun married a woman from the Ansar, and turned her over, so the Ansariyyah refused, and she went to Umm Salamah, and mentioned that to her. When the Prophet ﷺ came, the Ansariyyah felt shy and went out, so Umm Salamah mentioned that to the Prophet ﷺ, so he said: "Call her to me." So she was called to him, and he said to her: "'Your women are a tilth for you, so come to your tilth however you wish' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 223], [meaning] one single passage." And "al-sammam" means: the one passage.
1.hi: Abdullah ibn Uthman ibn Khuthaym ne Ibn Sabit se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Hafsah bint Abd al-Rahman - jo Abu Bakr ki beti hain - se poocha, maine unse kaha: "Main aapse ek baat poochna chahta hoon, aur mujhe poochne mein sharam aa rahi hai." Unhone kaha: "Poocho, ae mere bhai ke bete, jo tumhare dil mein aaye." Unhone kaha: Main aapse auraton ke peechhe wale raaste se aane ke baare mein poochta hoon. To unhone kaha: Umm Salamah رضي الله عنها ne mujhse bayaan kiya, unhone kaha: Ansar auraton ko [jima ke liye] palat kar nahi karte the, jabke Muhajireen unhein palat kar karte the. So Muhajireen mein se ek shakhs ne Ansar ki ek aurat se nikaah kiya, aur usay palat kar kiya, to Ansariyyah ne inkaar kar diya, aur woh Umm Salamah ke paas gayi, aur unhein yeh baat batayi. Jab Nabi ﷺ aaye, Ansariyyah sharma kar bahar chali gayi, so Umm Salamah ne yeh baat Nabi ﷺ ko batayi, to aapne farmaya: "Use mere paas bulaao." To use bulaaya gaya, aur aapne usse farmaya: "'Tumhari auratein tumhare liye khet hain, so apne khet mein jaise chaho aao' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 223], [yaani] ek hi raaste se." Aur 'sammam' ka matlab hai: ek hi raasta.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  ، قَالَ : لَقَدْ عَرَضْتُ الْقُرْآنَ عَلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا ثَلَاثَ عَرَضَاتٍ، أَقِفُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ آيَةٍ أَسْأَلُهُ فِيمَ أُنْزِلَتْ، وَفِيمَ كَانَتْ؟، فَقُلْتُ : يَا ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، أَرَأَيْتَ قَوْلَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى : # فَإِذَا تَطَهَّرْنَ فَأْتُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ سورة البقرة آية 222 #، قَالَ :" مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمْ أَنْ تَعْتَزِلُوهُنَّ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Muhammad ibn Salamah, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Aban ibn Salih, from Mujahid: He said: I presented the Qur'an to Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما three times, stopping at every verse asking him about what it was revealed concerning, and what it was about. So I said: "O Ibn Abbas, what do you think of the saying of Allah the Exalted: 'But when they have purified themselves, then come to them from where Allah has commanded you' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 222]?" He said: "From where He has commanded you to withdraw from them."
1.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Muhammad ibn Salamah se, Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, Aban ibn Salih se, Mujahid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما ke saamne Quran teen martaba pesh kiya, har aayat par ruk kar unse poochta ke yeh kis baare mein naazil hui, aur kis silsile mein thi. To maine kaha: "Ae Ibn Abbas, Allah Ta'ala ke is farman ke baare mein aapki kya raay hai: 'Fir jab woh paak ho jaayein to unke paas jao jahan se Allah ne tumhein hukum diya hai' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 222]?" Unhone kaha: "Jahan se usne tumhein unse alag rehne ka hukum diya tha."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  : # فَأْتُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ سورة البقرة آية 222 #، قَالَ :" أُمِرُوا أَنْ يَأْتُوا مِنْ حَيْثُ نُهُوا "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Uthman ibn al-Aswad, from Mujahid: "'then come to them from where Allah has commanded you' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 222]," he said: "They were commanded to come from where they were forbidden."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Uthman ibn al-Aswad se, Mujahid se is aayat ke baare mein bataya: "'Fir unke paas jao jahan se Allah ne tumhein hukum diya hai' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 222]," unhone kaha: "Unhein hukum diya gaya ke wahin se aayein jahan se unhein mana kiya gaya tha [haiz khatam hone ke baad]."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ أَبِي رَزِينٍ  : # فَأْتُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ سورة البقرة آية 222 #، قَالَ :" مِنْ قِبَلِ الطُّهْرِ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from al-A'mash, from Abu Razin: "'then come to them from where Allah has commanded you' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 222]," he said: "From the direction of purity."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, al-A'mash se, Abu Razin se is aayat ke baare mein bataya: "'Fir unke paas jao jahan se Allah ne tumhein hukum diya hai' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 222]," unhone kaha: "Paaki ki taraf se."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْبَزَّازُ ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُهَاجِرٍ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  : # وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ سورة الشعراء آية 166 #، قَالَ :" هُوَ وَاللَّهِ الْقُبُلُ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Bazzaz, from Sharik, from Ibrahim ibn Muhajir, from Mujahid: "'and leave what your Lord has created for you of your wives' [Surah al-Shu'ara, verse 166]," he said: "It is, by Allah, the front."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Bazzaz ne Sharik se, Ibrahim ibn Muhajir se, Mujahid se is aayat ke baare mein bataya: "'Aur jo tumhare Rab ne tumhari biwiyon mein se tumhare liye paida kiya hai use chhod dete ho' [Surah Ash-Shu'ara, aayat 166]," unhone kaha: "Yeh, Allah ki qasam, aage wala hissa hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ رَبَاحٍ ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  : # نِسَاؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَكُمْ فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ سورة البقرة آية 223 #، قَالَ :" إِنَّمَا هُوَ الْفَرْجُ "
1.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Khalid ibn Rabah, from Ikrimah: "'Your women are a tilth for you, so come to your tilth however you wish' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 223]," he said: "It is only the vulva."
1.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Khalid ibn Rabah se, Ikrimah se is aayat ke baare mein bataya: "'Tumhari auratein tumhare liye khet hain, so apne khet mein jaise chaho aao' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 223]," unhone kaha: "Yeh sirf sharamgah [aage wala hissa] hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الرِّفَاعِيُّ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ ، يَقُولُ : كَانَتْ الْيَهُودُ لَا تَأْلُو مَا شَدَّدَتْ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ، كَانُوا يَقُولُونَ : يَا أَصْحَابَ مُحَمَّدٍ ، إِنَّهُ وَاللَّهِ مَا يَحِلُّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَأْتُوا نِسَاءَكُمْ إِلَّا مِنْ وَجْهٍ وَاحِدٍ، قَالَ : فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ : # نِسَاؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَكُمْ فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ سورة البقرة آية 223 #" فَخَلَّى اللَّهُ بَيْنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَبَيْنَ حَاجَتِهِمْ "
1.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Ali ibn Ali al-Rifa'i, from al-Hasan: He said: I heard al-Hasan say: The Jews did not fail to be strict/harsh with the Muslims, they used to say: "O companions of Muhammad, by Allah, it is not lawful for you to come to your women except from one direction." He said: So Allah revealed: "'Your women are a tilth for you, so come to your tilth however you wish' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 223]" "so Allah left [gave latitude] between the believers and their need."
1.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Ali ibn Ali al-Rifa'i se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Hasan ko kehte suna: Yahoodi Musalmanon ke saath sakhti karne mein koi kasar nahi chhodte the, woh kehte the: "Ae Muhammad ke sathiyo, Allah ki qasam, tumhare liye apni auraton ke paas sirf ek hi taraf se jaana halal hai." Unhone bataya: To Allah ne naazil kiya: "'Tumhari auratein tumhare liye khet hain, so apne khet mein jaise chaho aao' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 223]" "so Allah ne momino aur unki zaroorat ke darmiyan raah khol di."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا : # فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ سورة البقرة آية 223 #، قَالَ :" ائْتِهَا مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهَا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهَا بَعْدَ أَنْ يَكُونَ فِي الْمَأْتَى "
1.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid ibn Abdullah, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: "'so come to your tilth however you wish' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 223]," he said: "Come to her from in front of her and from behind her, as long as it is in the [proper] place of coming."
1.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid ibn Abdullah se, Ata ibn al-Sa'ib se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se is aayat ke baare mein bataya: "'So apne khet mein jaise chaho aao' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 223]," unhone kaha: "Uske paas uske saamne se aur uske peechhe se aao, bashart yeh ke woh sahi jagah (mahal) mein ho."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَلِيفَةُ بْنُ خَيَّاطٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ أَهْلُ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ يَصْنَعُونَ فِي الْحَائِضِ نَحْوًا مِنْ صَنِيعِ الْمَجُوسِ ، فَذُكِرَ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَنَزَلَتْ" # وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى فَاعْتَزِلُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي الْمَحِيضِ وَلا تَقْرَبُوهُنَّ حَتَّى يَطْهُرْنَ سورة البقرة آية 222 #، فَلَمْ يَزْدَدْ الْأَمْرُ فِيهِنَّ إِلَّا شِدَّةً "
1.en: Narrated by Khalifah ibn Khayyat, from Abd al-Wahhab, from Khalid, from Ikrimah: He said: The people of Jahiliyyah used to do with the menstruating woman something like the practice of the Magians, so that was mentioned to the Prophet ﷺ, so it was revealed: "'And they ask you about menstruation, say: it is harm, so keep away from women during menstruation, and do not approach them until they are pure' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 222]," "so the matter concerning them only increased in strictness."
1.hi: Khalifah ibn Khayyat ne Abd al-Wahhab se, Khalid se, Ikrimah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ahl-e-Jahiliyyah haiz wali aurat ke saath Majoosiyon jaisa amal karte the, so yeh baat Nabi ﷺ se zikr ki gayi, to yeh aayat naazil hui: "'Aur woh aapse haiz ke baare mein poochte hain, kahiye: yeh takleef-dah cheez hai, so auraton se haiz ke dauran alag raho, aur unke paas na jao jab tak woh paak na ho jaayein' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 222]," "so unke baare mein hukum sakhti mein hi badha."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَلِيفَةُ ، حَدَّثَنَا مُؤَمَّلٌ ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ " # قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى سورة البقرة آية 222 #، قَالَ : هُوَ الدَّمُ "
1.en: Narrated by Khalifah, from Mu'ammal, from Sufyan, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid: "'Say: it is harm' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 222]," he said: "It is the blood."
1.hi: Khalifah ne Mu'ammal se, Sufyan se, Ibn Abi Najih se, Mujahid se is aayat ke baare mein bataya: "'Kahiye: yeh takleef-dah cheez hai' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 222]," unhone kaha: "Yeh khoon hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ " # قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى سورة البقرة آية 222 #، قَالَ : قَذَرٌ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Salt, from Ibn al-Mubarak, from Ma'mar, from Qatadah: "'Say: it is harm' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 222]," he said: "Filth."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Salt ne Ibn al-Mubarak se, Ma'mar se, Qatadah se is aayat ke baare mein bataya: "'Kahiye: yeh takleef-dah cheez hai' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 222]," unhone kaha: "Gandagi."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَلِيفَةُ بْنُ خَيَّاطٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ لَيْثًا حَدَّثَ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ قَيْسٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  : # نِسَاؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَكُمْ فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ سورة البقرة آية 223 #، قَالَ :" إِنْ شِئْتَ فَاعْزِلْ، وَإِنْ شِئْتَ فَلَا تَعْزِلْ "
1.en: Narrated by Khalifah ibn Khayyat, from al-Mu'tamir, from Layth, from Isa ibn Qays, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab: "'Your women are a tilth for you, so come to your tilth however you wish' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 223]," he said: "If you wish, practice withdrawal, and if you wish, do not practice withdrawal."
1.hi: Khalifah ibn Khayyat ne al-Mu'tamir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Layth ko bayaan karte suna, Isa ibn Qays se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se is aayat ke baare mein: "'Tumhari auratein tumhare liye khet hain, so apne khet mein jaise chaho aao' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 223]," unhone kaha: "Agar chaho to azl (bahar nikaalna) karo, aur agar chaho to na karo."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَلِيفَةُ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ ، عَنْ عَوْفٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" كَيْفَ شِئْتَ، يَعْنِي : إِتْيَانَهَا فِي الْفَرْجِ "
1.en: Narrated by Khalifah, from Abd al-Wahhab, from Awf, from al-Hasan: He said: "However you wish" - meaning, coming to her in the vagina.
1.hi: Khalifah ne Abd al-Wahhab se, Awf se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jaise chaho" - yaani, uske paas aage wale raaste se aana.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ" أَنَّ الْيَهُودَ قَالُوا لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ : مَنْ أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ مُدْبِرَةٌ، جَاءَ وَلَدُهُ أَحْوَلَ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى : # نِسَاؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَكُمْ فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ سورة البقرة آية 223 # "
1.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Yunus, from Malik, from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari رضي الله عنه: That the Jews said to the Muslims: "Whoever comes to his wife while she is turned away, his child will be born cross-eyed." So Allah the Exalted revealed: "'Your women are a tilth for you, so come to your tilth however you wish' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 223]."
1.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Yunus ne Malik se, Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir se, Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari رضي الله عنه se bataya ke Yahoodiyon ne Musalmanon se kaha: "Jo apni biwi ke paas is haalat mein jaaye ke woh muh phera hui ho, uska bachcha bhengaa paida hoga." To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh naazil kiya: "'Tumhari auratein tumhare liye khet hain, so apne khet mein jaise chaho aao' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 223]."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  : # فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ سورة البقرة آية 223 #، قَالَ :" يَأْتِي أَهْلَهُ كَيْفَ شَاءَ قَائِمًا وَقَاعِدًا وَبَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid ibn Abdullah, from Khalid al-Hadhdha, from Ikrimah: "'so come to your tilth however you wish' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 223]," he said: "He comes to his wife however he wishes, standing or sitting, from in front of her and from behind her."
1.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid ibn Abdullah se, Khalid al-Hadhdha se, Ikrimah se is aayat ke baare mein bataya: "'So apne khet mein jaise chaho aao' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 223]," unhone kaha: "Woh apni biwi ke paas jaise chahe aa sakta hai, khada hokar ya baith kar, uske saamne se aur uske peechhe se [magar sahi jagah mein]."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْأَشَجُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ " # فَأْتُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ سورة البقرة آية 222 #، قَالَ : فِي الْفَرْجِ "
1.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id al-Ashajj, from Ibn Idris, from his father, from Yazid ibn al-Walid, from Ibrahim: "'then come to them from where Allah has commanded you' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 222]," he said: "In the vagina."
1.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id al-Ashajj ne Ibn Idris se, apne walid se, Yazid ibn al-Walid se, Ibrahim se is aayat ke baare mein bataya: "'Fir unke paas jao jahan se Allah ne tumhein hukum diya hai' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 222]," unhone kaha: "Aage wale raaste mein."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ ، قَالَ :" مَنْ أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ فِي دُبُرِهَا فَهُوَ مِنْ الْمَرْأَةِ مِثْلُهُ مِنْ الرَّجُلِ، ثُمَّ تَلَا : # وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى فَاعْتَزِلُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي الْمَحِيضِ وَلا تَقْرَبُوهُنَّ حَتَّى يَطْهُرْنَ فَإِذَا تَطَهَّرْنَ فَأْتُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ سورة البقرة آية 222 #، أَنْ تَعْتَزِلُوهُنَّ فِي الْمَحِيضِ : الْفَرْجَ، ثُمَّ تَلَا : # نِسَاؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَكُمْ فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ سورة البقرة آية 223 # قَائِمَةً، وَقَاعِدَةً، وَمُقْبِلَةً، وَمُدْبِرَةً فِي الْفَرْجِ "
1.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Uthman ibn al-Aswad, from Mujahid: He said: "Whoever comes to his wife in her rear, it is from the woman like it is from the man," then he recited: "'And they ask you about menstruation, say: it is harm, so keep away from women during menstruation, and do not approach them until they are pure, but when they have purified themselves, then come to them from where Allah has commanded you' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 222]" - [meaning] that you withdraw from them during menstruation: the vagina. Then he recited: "'Your women are a tilth for you, so come to your tilth however you wish' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 223]" - standing, or sitting, facing, or turned away, [always] in the vagina.
1.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Uthman ibn al-Aswad se, Mujahid se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo apni biwi ke peechhe wale raaste se aaye, to yeh aurat ki taraf se bhi waisa hi hai jaisa mard ki taraf se hota," fir unhone yeh aayat padhi: "'Aur woh aapse haiz ke baare mein poochte hain, kahiye: yeh takleef-dah cheez hai, so auraton se haiz ke dauran alag raho, aur unke paas na jao jab tak woh paak na ho jaayein, fir jab woh paak ho jaayein to unke paas jao jahan se Allah ne tumhein hukum diya hai' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 222]" - [yaani] ke tum haiz ke dauran unse alag raho: sharamgah [se]. Fir unhone yeh aayat padhi: "'Tumhari auratein tumhare liye khet hain, so apne khet mein jaise chaho aao' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 223]" - khada ho, ya baitha ho, saamne ho, ya peechhe ho, [hamesha] sharamgah mein.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ حَكِيمٍ الْأَثْرَمِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي تَمِيمَةَ الْهُجَيْمِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" مَنْ أَتَى حَائِضًا، أَوْ امْرَأَةً فِي دُبُرِهَا، أَوْ كَاهِنًا فَصَدَّقَهُ بِمَا يَقُولُ، فَقَدْ كَفَرَ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Hakim al-Athram, from Abu Tamimah al-Hujaymi, from Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whoever comes to a menstruating woman, or a woman in her rear, or a fortune-teller and believes what he says, has disbelieved in what was revealed to Muhammad."
1.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Hakim al-Athram se, Abu Tamimah al-Hujaymi se, Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jo haiz wali aurat ke paas jaaye, ya kisi aurat ke peechhe wale raaste se aaye, ya kaahin (falgo) ke paas jaakar uski baaton ki tasdeeq kare, usne Muhammad par nazil ki gayi cheez ka inkaar kar diya."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الشَّقَرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْقَعْقَاعِ الْجَرْمِيِّ  ، قَالَ : جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ  ،  فَقَالَ : يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ آتِي امْرَأَتِي حَيْثُ شِئْتُ؟، قَالَ : نَعَمْ، قَالَ : وَمِنْ أَيْنَ شِئْتُ؟، قَالَ : نَعَمْ، قَالَ : وَكَيْفَ شِئْتُ؟، قَالَ : نَعَمْ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ : يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، إِنَّ هَذَا يُرِيدُ السُّوءَ، قَالَ :" لَا، مَحَاشُّ النِّسَاءِ عَلَيْكُمْ حَرَامٌ "، سُئِلَ عَبْد اللَّهِ تَقُولُ بِهِ؟، قَالَ : نَعَمْ
1.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Abu Hilal, from Abu Abdullah al-Shaqari, from Abu al-Qa'qa' al-Jarmi; with Abdullah al-Darimi's confirmation: He said: A man came to Abdullah ibn Mas'ud, and said: "O Abu Abd al-Rahman, may I come to my wife wherever I wish?" He said, "Yes." He said, "And from wherever I wish?" He said, "Yes." He said, "And however I wish?" He said, "Yes." So a man said to him, "O Abu Abd al-Rahman, this man wants evil." He said: "No, the rears of women are forbidden to you." Abdullah was asked: "Do you hold this view?" He said, "Yes."
1.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Abu Hilal se, Abu Abdullah al-Shaqari se, Abu al-Qa'qa' al-Jarmi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi Abdullah ibn Mas'ud ke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Ae Abu Abd al-Rahman, kya main apni biwi ke paas jahan chahoon jaa sakta hoon?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Usne poocha, "Aur jis taraf se chahoon?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Usne poocha, "Aur jaise chahoon?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." To ek aadmi ne unse kaha, "Ae Abu Abd al-Rahman, yeh shakhs bura irada rakhta hai." Unhone kaha: "Nahi, auraton ke peechhe wale raaste tumpar haraam hain." Abdullah se poocha gaya: "Kya aap isi ke qaail hain?" Unhone kaha, "Haan."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ" يَكْرَهُ إِتْيَانَ الرَّجُلِ امْرَأَتَهُ فِي دُبُرِهَا، وَيَعِيبُهُ عَيْبًا شَدِيدًا "
1.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Wuhayb, from Da'ud, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas: That he used to "dislike a man coming to his wife in her rear, and considered it a severe fault."
1.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Wuhayb se, Da'ud se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya ke woh "aadmi ke apni biwi ke peechhe wale raaste se aane ko na-pasand karte the, aur ise sakht buraai samajhte the."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  : # إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُمْ بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ سورة العنكبوت آية 28 #، قَالَ :" مَا نَزَا ذَكَرٌ عَلَى ذَكَرٍ حَتَّى كَانَ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Mu'alla ibn Asad, from Isma'il ibn Ulayyah, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Amr ibn Dinar: "'Indeed you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you in from among the worlds' [Surah al-Ankabut, verse 28]," he said: "No male mounted a male until it was the people of Lut."
1.hi: Al-Mu'alla ibn Asad ne Isma'il ibn Ulayyah se, Ibn Abi Najih se, Amr ibn Dinar se is aayat ke baare mein bataya: "'Beshak tum aisi be-hayaai karte ho jo tumse pehle duniya walon mein se kisi ne nahi ki' [Surah Al-Ankabut, aayat 28]," unhone kaha: "Kisi mard ne kisi mard par aisa amal nahi kiya tha jab tak Lut ki qaum nahi aayi."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ مُخَلَّدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" مَنْ أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ فِي دُبُرِهَا لَمْ يَنْظُرْ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى إِلَيْهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ "
1.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Sufyan, from Suhayl ibn Abi Salih, from al-Harith ibn Mukhallad, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whoever comes to his wife in her rear, Allah the Exalted will not look at him on the Day of Resurrection."
1.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Sufyan se, Suhayl ibn Abi Salih se, al-Harith ibn Mukhallad se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jo apni biwi ke peechhe wale raaste se aaye, Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din uski taraf nazar-e-rehmat nahi karega."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَحْيَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الْأَحْوَلِ  ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ حِطَّانَ  ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ سَلَّامٍ الْحَنَفِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ طَلْقٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا أَحْدَثَ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الصَّلَاةِ، فَلْيَنْصَرِفْ، وَلْيَتَوَضَّأْ، ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي "، وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " لَا تَأْتُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي أَدْبَارِهِنَّ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَسْتَحْيِي مِنْ الْحَقِّ "، سُئِلَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : عَلِيُّ بْنُ طَلْقٍ لَهُ صُحْبَةٌ؟، قَالَ : نَعَمْ
1.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yahya, from Abd al-Wahid ibn Ziyad, from Asim al-Ahwal, from Isa ibn Hittan, from Muslim ibn Sallam al-Hanafi, from Ali ibn Talq: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you experiences hadath during the prayer, let him withdraw, and perform ablution, then pray." And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do not come to women in their rears, for indeed Allah is not shy of the truth." Abdullah was asked: "Did Ali ibn Talq have companionship [with the Prophet]?" He said, "Yes."
1.hi: Abdullah ibn Yahya ne Abd al-Wahid ibn Ziyad se, Asim al-Ahwal se, Isa ibn Hittan se, Muslim ibn Sallam al-Hanafi se, Ali ibn Talq se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se kisi ka namaz mein wudu toot jaaye, to woh palat jaaye, aur wudu kare, fir namaz padhe." Aur Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Auraton ke peechhe wale raaste se na aao, kyunki Allah haq baat se sharmaata nahi." Abdullah se poocha gaya: "Kya Ali ibn Talq sahabi hain?" Unhone kaha, "Haan."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ أَبِي الْحُبَابِ  ، قَالَ : قُلْت لِابْنِ عُمَرَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ :" مَا تَقُولُ فِي الْجَوَارِي حِينَ أُحَمِّضُ لَهُنَّ؟، قَالَ : وَمَا التَّحْمِيضُ؟ فَذَكَرْتُ الدُّبُرَ، فَقَالَ : هَلْ يَفْعَلُ ذَاكَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ الْمُسْلِمِينَ؟ "
1.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from al-Harith ibn Ya'qub, from Sa'id ibn Yasar Abu al-Hubab, about Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه: He said: I said to Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه: "What do you say concerning the slave-girls, when I 'sour' them?" He said, "What is tahmid?" So I mentioned the rear. So he said: "Does any of the Muslims do that?"
1.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se, al-Harith ibn Ya'qub se, Sa'id ibn Yasar Abu al-Hubab se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه se poocha: "Aap laundiyon ke baare mein kya kehte hain jab main unhein 'tahmid' [ek ishaara] karta hoon?" Unhone poocha, "Tahmid kya hai?" To maine peechhe wale raaste ka zikr kiya. To unhone kaha: "Kya koi Musalman aisa karta hai?"

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ قَيْسٍ  رَجُلٌ مِنْ قَوْمِي وَكَانَ مِنْ أَسْنَانِي، حَدَّثَنِي هَرَمِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : تَذَاكَرْنَا شَأْنَ النِّسَاءِ فِي مَجْلِسِ بَنِي وَاقِفٍ وَمَا يُؤْتَى مِنْهُنَّ، فَقَالَ خُزَيْمَةُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ : " أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ،إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَسْتَحْيِي مِنْ الْحَقِّ لَا تَأْتُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي أَعْجَازِهِنَّ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqqashi, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Husayn al-Ansari, from Abd al-Malik ibn Amr ibn Qays, from Harami ibn Abdullah, about Khuzaymah ibn Thabit رضي الله عنه: He said: We discussed the matter of women in the gathering of Banu Waqif, and how they are approached, so Khuzaymah ibn Thabit رضي الله عنه said, I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "O people, indeed Allah is not shy of the truth, do not come to women in their buttocks/rears."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqqashi ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Husayn al-Ansari se, Abd al-Malik ibn Amr ibn Qays se, Harami ibn Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Humne Banu Waqif ki majlis mein auraton ke maamle par aur unke paas kaise jaaya jaaye is par baatcheet ki, to Khuzaymah ibn Thabit رضي الله عنه ne kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna: "Ae logo, Allah haq baat se sharmaata nahi, auraton ke peechhe wale hisse se na aao."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا خُصَيْفٌ  ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  ، قَالَ : " كَانُوا يَجْتَنِبُونَ النِّسَاءَ فِي الْمَحِيضِ، وَيَأْتُونَهُنَّ فِي أَدْبَارِهِنَّ، فَسَأَلُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى :" # وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى فَاعْتَزِلُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي الْمَحِيضِ وَلا تَقْرَبُوهُنَّ حَتَّى يَطْهُرْنَ فَإِذَا تَطَهَّرْنَ فَأْتُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ سورة البقرة آية 222 #، فِي الْفَرْجِ وَلَا تَعْدُوهُ "
1.en: Narrated by Mujahid: He said: "They used to keep away from women during menstruation, and come to them in their rears, so they asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about that, so Allah the Exalted revealed: 'And they ask you about menstruation, say: it is harm, so keep away from women during menstruation, and do not approach them until they are pure, but when they have purified themselves, then come to them from where Allah has commanded you' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 222]" - in the vagina, and do not exceed it.
1.hi: Mujahid ne bataya: "Woh haiz ke dauran auraton se alag rehte the, aur unke paas peechhe wale raaste se aate the, so unhone Rasulullah ﷺ se iske baare mein poocha, to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh naazil kiya: 'Aur woh aapse haiz ke baare mein poochte hain, kahiye: yeh takleef-dah cheez hai, so auraton se haiz ke dauran alag raho, aur unke paas na jao jab tak woh paak na ho jaayein, fir jab woh paak ho jaayein to unke paas jao jahan se Allah ne tumhein hukum diya hai' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 222]" - sharamgah mein, aur usse tajaawuz na karo.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ إِسْحَاق ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبَانُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ ، وَسَعِيدٍ ، وَمُجَاهِدٍ ، وَعَطَاءٍ ، أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا" يُنْكِرُونَ إِتْيَانَ النِّسَاءِ فِي أَدْبَارِهِنَّ، وَيَقُولُونَ : هُوَ الْكُفْرُ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yazid, from Yunus ibn Bukayr, from Ibn Ishaq, from Aban ibn Salih, from Tawus, Sa'id, Mujahid, and Ata: That they used to "disapprove of coming to women in their rears, and say: it is disbelief."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Yazid ne Yunus ibn Bukayr se, Ibn Ishaq se, Aban ibn Salih se, Tawus, Sa'id, Mujahid, aur Ata se bataya ke woh "auraton ke peechhe wale raaste se aane ko na-pasand karte the, aur kehte the: yeh kufr hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، وَالزُّهْرِيِّ ، قَالَا :" الْغُسْلُ مِنْ الْجَنَابَةِ، وَالْحَيْضِ وَاحِدٌ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from al-Awza'i, from Ata and al-Zuhri: They said: "The ghusl from janabah, and from menstruation, is one [and the same]."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne al-Awza'i se, Ata aur al-Zuhri se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Janabat ka ghusl, aur haiz ka ghusl, ek hi hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" لِامْرَأَتِهِ خَلِّلِي شَعْرَكِ بِالْمَاءِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَخَلَّلَهُ نَارٌ قَلِيلَةُ الْبُقْيَا عَلَيْهِ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sharik, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from Hudhayfah رضي الله عنه: He said to his wife: "Loosen your hair with water before a fire loosens it, one that leaves little of it."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sharik se, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se, Hudhayfah رضي الله عنه se bataya: Unhone apni biwi se kaha: "Apne baalon mein paani se khilal karo is se pehle ke aag unmein khilal kare, aisi aag jo unmein se thoda hi bacha chhode."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ  ، عَنْ صَدَقَةَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الْحَنَفِيِّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي جُمَيْعُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ  أَحَدُ بَنِي تَيْمِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ثَعْلَبَةَ، قَالَ : دَخَلْتُ مَعَ أُمِّي وَخَالَتِي عَلَى عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، فَسَأَلَتْهَا إِحْدَاهُمَا : كَيْفَ تَصْنَعِينَ عِنْدَ الْغُسْلِ؟، فَقَالَتْ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يَتَطَهَّرُ طُهُورَهُ لِلصَّلَاةِ، وَيُفِيضُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، وَنَحْنُ نُفِيضُ عَلَى رُءُوسِنَا خَمْسًا مِنْ أَجْلِ الضَّفْرِ "
1.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Za'idah, from Sadaqah ibn Sa'id al-Hanafi, from Jumay' ibn Umayr, one of Banu Taym Allah ibn Tha'labah: He said: I entered with my mother and my maternal aunt upon Aisha رضي الله عنها, and one of them asked her: "How do you do at the time of ghusl?" So she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ "used to purify himself for the prayer, and pour over his head three times, and we pour over our heads five times because of the braiding."
1.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Za'idah se, Sadaqah ibn Sa'id al-Hanafi se, Jumay' ibn Umayr se (jo Banu Taym Allah ibn Tha'labah mein se the) bataya: Unhone kaha, Main apni maa aur khaala ke saath Aisha رضي الله عنها ke paas gaya, to unmein se ek ne unse poocha: "Aap ghusl ke waqt kya karti hain?" To unhone bataya: Rasulullah ﷺ "namaz ke liye taharat karte, aur apne sar par teen martaba paani unhdelte, aur hum apne baalon ke gundhe hone ki wajah se paanch martaba unhdelte hain."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ زَاذِي  ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ عَائِشَةَ   عَنْ الْمَرْأَةِ تَغْتَسِلُ، تَنْقُضُ شَعْرَهَا؟، فَقَالَتْ :" بَخٍ، وَإِنْ أَنْفَقَتْ فِيهِ أُوقِيَّةً؟ إِنَّمَا يَكْفِيهَا أَنْ تُفْرِغَ عَلَى رَأْسِهَا ثَلَاثًا "
1.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Yazid ibn Zadhi, from Abu Zur'ah, from Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه, about Aisha: That he asked Aisha about the woman performing ghusl, does she undo her hair? So she said: "How strange, even if she spent an ounce [of silver on perfuming it]? It is only enough for her to pour on her head three times."
1.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Yazid ibn Zadhi se, Abu Zur'ah se, Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه se bataya ke unhone Aisha se ghusl karne wali aurat ke baare mein poocha, kya woh apne baal khol le? To unhone kaha: "Achha, chahe woh isme ek uqiyah [chandi ki matra] hi kyun na kharch kar chuki ho? Uske liye bas itna kaafi hai ke woh apne sar par teen martaba [paani] unhdele."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ  ، عَنْ فُضَيْلِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" تُخَلِّلُهُ بِأَصَابِعِهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Khalid, from Hajjaj, from Fudayl ibn Amr, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah, from Abdullah رضي الله عنه: He said: "She combs it through with her fingers."
1.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Khalid se, Hajjaj se, Fudayl ibn Amr se, Ibrahim se, Alqamah se, Abdullah رضي الله عنه se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Woh apni ungliyon se usmein khilal kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، فِي الْحَائِضِ وَالْجُنُبِ" يَصُبَّانِ الْمَاءَ صَبًّا "، وَلَا يَنْقُضَانِ شُعُورَهُمَا "، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، مِثْلَهُ
1.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Khalid, from Hajjaj, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir رضي الله عنه; a similar chain also via Hajjaj, from Ata: Concerning the menstruating woman and the one in janabah: "The two of them pour the water, pouring it," "and the two of them do not undo their hair." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Hajjaj, from Ata, the same.]
1.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Khalid se, Hajjaj se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir رضي الله عنه se, haiz wali aurat aur janabat wale ke baare mein bataya: "Dono paani unhdelte hain," "aur dono apne baal na kholein." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Hajjaj se, Ata se bhi aayi hai.]

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، قَالَ : قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ  :" إِذَا بَلَّتْ أُصُولَهُ وَأَطْرَافَهُ، لَمْ تَنْقُضْهُ "
1.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Mansur, from Ibrahim: He said: Ibrahim said: "When she has moistened its roots and its ends, she does not need to undo it."
1.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Mansur se bataya: Ibrahim ne kaha, "Jab woh baalon ki jadon aur unke kinaaron ko geela kar le, to use unhein kholne ki zaroorat nahi."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، أَنَّنِسَاءَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، وَأُمَّهَاتِ أَوْلَادِهِ كُنَّ إِذَا اغْتَسَلْنَ لَمْ يَنْقُضْنَ عِقَصَهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْضٍ، وَلَا جَنَابَةٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad, from Ubaydullah ibn Umar, from Nafi', about the wives of Ibn Umar: That the wives of Ibn Umar, and the mothers of his children, when they performed ghusl, "did not undo their braided hair, whether from menstruation or from janabah."
1.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad se, Ubaydullah ibn Umar se, Nafi' se bataya ke Ibn Umar ki biwiyan, aur unki laundiyan jinse aulaad thi, jab woh ghusl karti thin, to "apne gundhe hue baal na kholtin, na haiz se aur na janabat se."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ  ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ :" لَا يَنْقُضْنَ عِقَصَهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْضٍ، وَلَا مِنْ جَنَابَةٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Hajjaj, from Hammad, from Ali ibn Zayd, from Umm Muhammad, from Umm Salamah: That she said: "They did not undo their braided hair, whether from menstruation or from janabah."
1.hi: Hajjaj ne Hammad se, Ali ibn Zayd se, Umm Muhammad se, Umm Salamah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Woh apne gundhe hue baal na kholti thin, na haiz se aur na janabat se."

1.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ   زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَتْ : جَاءَتْ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَتْ : إِنِّي أَشُدُّ ضَفْرَ رَأْسِي أَوْ عُقَدَهُ، قَالَ :" احْفِنِي عَلَى رَأْسِكِ ثَلَاثَ حَفَنَاتٍ، ثُمَّ اغْمِزِي عَلَى إِثْرِ كُلِّ حَفْنَةٍ غَمْزَةً "
1.en: Narrated by Hajjaj, from Ubaydullah, from Usamah ibn Zayd, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id al-Maqburi, from Umm Salamah, wife of the Prophet ﷺ: She said: A woman came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "I braid my hair tightly," or "its knots," he said: "Take three handfuls [of water] over your head, then squeeze [the hair] once after each handful."
1.hi: Hajjaj ne Ubaydullah se, Usamah ibn Zayd se, Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id al-Maqburi se, Umm Salamah, Nabi ﷺ ki biwi, se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aurat Nabi ﷺ ke paas aayi aur kaha: "Main apne sar ki gunthaayi mazbooti se karti hoon," ya "uski gaanthein," aapne farmaya: "Apne sar par teen chullu [paani] daalo, fir har chullu ke baad ek baar unhein niche daba dena."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ  ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِامْرَأَتِهِ :" اسْتَأْصِلِي الشَّعْرَ لَا تَخَلَّلُهُ نَارٌ قَلِيلٌ بُقْيَاهَا عَلَيْهِ "، قَالَ مَنْصُورٌ : يَعْنِي : الْجَنَابَةَ
1.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Za'idah, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from Hammam ibn al-Harith, from Hudhayfah; Mansur's clarification also given: That he said to his wife: "Get to the root of the hair, [so that] fire does not touch/consume it, [a fire that] leaves little of it behind." Mansur said: meaning, janabah.
1.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Za'idah se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se, Hammam ibn al-Harith se, Hudhayfah se bataya ke unhone apni biwi se kaha: "Baalon ki jad tak paani pahuncha do, [taake] aag unhein na chhue, [aisi aag] jo unmein se thoda hi bacha chhode." Mansur kehte hain: yaani, janabat.

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ  ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِامْرَأَتِهِ :" اسْتَأْصِلِي الشَّعْرَ بِالْمَاءِ لَا تَخَلَّلُهُ نَارٌ قَلِيلٌ بُقْيَاهَا عَلَيْهِ "
1.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Ja'far ibn al-Harith, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from Hammam ibn al-Harith, from Hudhayfah: That he said to his wife: "Get to the root of the hair with water, [so that] fire does not touch/consume it, [a fire that] leaves little of it behind."
1.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Ja'far ibn al-Harith se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se, Hammam ibn al-Harith se, Hudhayfah se bataya ke unhone apni biwi se kaha: "Paani se baalon ki jad tak pahuncha do, [taake] aag unhein na chhue, [aisi aag] jo unmein se thoda hi bacha chhode."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" إِذَا اغْتَسَلَتْ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ الْجَنَابَةِ، فَلَا تَنْقُضْ شَعْرَهَا وَلَكِنْ تَصُبُّ الْمَاءَ عَلَى أُصُولِهِ وَتَبُلُّهُ "
1.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid ibn Abdullah, from Ibn Abi Layla, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir رضي الله عنه: He said: "When the woman performs ghusl from janabah, she does not undo her hair, but she pours water on its roots and wets it."
1.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid ibn Abdullah se, Ibn Abi Layla se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir رضي الله عنه se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab aurat janabat se ghusl kare, to woh apne baal na khole, balke unki jadon par paani daale aur unhein geela kare."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تُصِيبُهَا الْجَنَابَةُ، وَرَأْسُهَا مَعْقُوصٌ تَحُلُّهُ؟، قَالَ :" لَا، وَلَكِنْ تَصُبُّ عَلَى رَأْسِهَا الْمَاءَ صَبًّا حَتَّى تُرَوِّيَ أُصُولَ الشَّعْرِ "
1.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Abd al-Malik, from Ata, concerning the woman afflicted by janabah while her hair is braided: Does she undo it? He said: "No, but she pours water on her head, pouring it, until she has soaked the roots of the hair."
1.hi: Ya'la ne Abd al-Malik se, Ata se, us aurat ke baare mein bataya jise janabat ho jabke uske baal gundhe hue hon: kya woh unhein khole? Unhone kaha: "Nahi, balke woh apne sar par paani daale, daalte hue, yahan tak ke baalon ki jadein bhig jaayein."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمِنْهَالِ  ، حَدَّثَتْنِي حَبِيبَةُ بِنْتُ حَمَّادٍ L2277 ، حَدَّثَتْنِي عَمْرَةُ بِنْتُ حَيَّانَ السَّهْمِيَّةُ L6057 ، قَالَتْ : قَالَتْ لِي عَائِشَةُ   أُمُّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا :" أَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُ إِحْدَاكُنَّ إِذَا تطَهُرَتْ مِنْ حَيْضِهَا أَنْ تَتَدَخِّنَ شَيْئًا مِنْ قُسْطٍ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدْ فَشَيْئًا مِنْ آسٍ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدْ فَشَيْئًا مِنْ نَوًى، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدْ فَشَيْئًا مِنْ مِلْحٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Minhal, from Habibah bint Hammad, from Amrah bint Hayyan al-Sahmiyyah, about Aisha, Mother of the Believers, رضي الله عنها: She said: Aisha, Mother of the Believers, رضي الله عنها said to me: "Is one of you not able, when she becomes pure from her menstruation, to fumigate herself with something of qust, and if she does not find it, then something of myrtle, and if she does not find it, then something of date-pits, and if she does not find it, then something of salt?"
1.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Minhal ne Habibah bint Hammad se, Amrah bint Hayyan al-Sahmiyyah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ummul-Mumineen Aisha رضي الله عنها ne mujhse kaha: "Kya tum mein se koi apne haiz se paak hone par apne aap ko qust [ek khushbudaar jadi] ki dhuni na de sake, aur agar na mile to aas (myrtle) ki, aur agar woh na mile to khajoor ki guthli ki, aur agar woh na mile to namak ki?"

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ  ، عَنْ مُعَاذَةَ الْعَدَوِيَّةِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ :" إِذَا اغْتَسَلَتْ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ الْحَيْضِ، فَلْتُمِسَّ أَثَرَ الدَّمِ بِطِيبٍ "
1.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Thabit ibn Yazid, from Asim, from Mu'adhah al-Adawiyyah, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: She said: "When the woman performs ghusl from menstruation, let her apply perfume to the trace of the blood."
1.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Thabit ibn Yazid se, Asim se, Mu'adhah al-Adawiyyah se, Aisha رضي الله عنها se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab aurat haiz se ghusl kare, to woh khoon ki jagah par khushbu lagaaye."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّ" نِسَاءَهُ وَأُمَّهَاتِ أَوْلَادِهِ كُنَّ يَغْتَسِلْنَ مِنْ الْحِيضَةِ وَالْجَنَابَةِ، وَلَا يَنْقُضْنَ شُعُورَهُنَّ، وَلَكِنْ يُبَالِغْنَ فِي بَلِّهَا "
1.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه: That "his wives and the mothers of his children used to perform ghusl from menstruation and janabah, and did not undo their hair, but they were thorough in wetting it."
1.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه se bataya ke "unki biwiyan aur unki laundiyan jinse aulaad thi, haiz aur janabat se ghusl karti thin, aur apne baal na kholti thin, balke unhein achhi tarah geela karti thin."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" لَا بَأْسَ أَنْ تَتَنَاوَلَ الْحَائِضُ مِنْ الْمَسْجِدِ الشَّيْءَ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Mu'alla ibn Asad, from Abu Awanah, from Mughirah, from Ibrahim: He said: "There is no harm in the menstruating woman taking something from the mosque."
1.hi: Al-Mu'alla ibn Asad ne Abu Awanah se, Mughirah se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Haiz wali aurat ke masjid se koi cheez le lene mein koi harj nahi."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" تَتَنَاوَلُ الْحَائِضُ الشَّيْءَ مِنْ الْمَسْجِدِ، وَلَا تَدْخُلُهُ "
1.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Ja'far ibn al-Harith, from Mansur, from Ibrahim: He said: "The menstruating woman may take something from the mosque, but she does not enter it."
1.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Ja'far ibn al-Harith se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Haiz wali aurat masjid se koi cheez le sakti hai, lekin usmein dakhil nahi hoti."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، قَالَ :" الْجُنُبُ يَأْخُذُ مِنْ الْمَسْجِدِ وَلَا يَضَعُ فِيهِ "
1.en: Narrated by Muslim, from Hisham, from Qatadah: He said: "The one in janabah takes from the mosque, but does not place [anything] in it."
1.hi: Muslim ne Hisham se, Qatadah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Janabat wala masjid se cheez le sakta hai, lekin usmein kuch rakh nahi sakta."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، فِي الْحَائِضِ" تَنَاوَلُ مِنْ الْمَسْجِدِ الشَّيْءَ، قَالَ : نَعَمْ، إِلَّا الْمُصْحَفَ "
1.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Abd al-Malik, from Ata, concerning the menstruating woman: "May she take something from the mosque?" He said: "Yes, except the Mushaf."
1.hi: Ya'la ne Abd al-Malik se, Ata se, haiz wali aurat ke baare mein bataya: "Kya woh masjid se koi cheez le sakti hai?" Unhone kaha: "Haan, Mushaf ke siwa."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ فِي قَوْلِهِ :" # وَلا جُنُبًا إِلا عَابِرِي سَبِيلٍ سورة النساء آية 43 #، قَالَ : هُوَ الْمُسَافِرُ "
1.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Hisham, from Qatadah, from Abu Mijlaz, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه, concerning Surah al-Nisa verse 43: "'nor in a state of janabah, except as one passing through' [Surah al-Nisa, verse 43]," he said: "It is the traveler."
1.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Hisham se, Qatadah se, Abu Mijlaz se, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه se is aayat ke baare mein bataya: "'Aur na hi janabat ki haalat mein, siwaay raaste se guzarne walon ke' [Surah An-Nisa, aayat 43]," unhone kaha: "Yeh musafir hai."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلْمٌ الْعَلَوِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ : # وَلا جُنُبًا إِلا عَابِرِي سَبِيلٍ سورة النساء آية 43 #، قَالَ :" الْجُنُبُ يَجْتَازُ بِالْمَسْجِدِ وَلَا يَجْلِسُ فِيهِ "
1.en: Narrated by Muslim, from al-Hasan ibn Abi Ja'far, from Salm al-Alawi, from Anas رضي الله عنه: "'nor in a state of janabah, except as one passing through' [Surah al-Nisa, verse 43]," he said: "The one in janabah passes through the mosque but does not sit in it."
1.hi: Muslim ne al-Hasan ibn Abi Ja'far se, Salm al-Alawi se, Anas رضي الله عنه se is aayat ke baare mein bataya: "'Aur na hi janabat ki haalat mein, siwaay raaste se guzarne walon ke' [Surah An-Nisa, aayat 43]," unhone kaha: "Janabat wala masjid se guzar sakta hai lekin usmein baithta nahi."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، وَأَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ الْجَزَرِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ ، قَالَ :" الْجُنُبُ يَمُرُّ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، وَلَا يَقْعُدُ فِيهِ "، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ : # وَلا جُنُبًا إِلا عَابِرِي سَبِيلٍ سورة النساء آية 43 #
1.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, and Abu Nu'aym, from Sharik, from Abd al-Karim al-Jazari, from Abu Ubaydah: He said: "The one in janabah passes through the mosque, but does not sit in it," then he recited this verse: "'nor in a state of janabah, except as one passing through' [Surah al-Nisa, verse 43]."
1.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak aur Abu Nu'aym ne Sharik se, Abd al-Karim al-Jazari se, Abu Ubaydah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Janabat wala masjid se guzarta hai, lekin usmein baithta nahi," fir unhone yeh aayat padhi: "'Aur na hi janabat ki haalat mein, siwaay raaste se guzarne walon ke' [Surah An-Nisa, aayat 43]."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ ، وَسَالِمٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ ، قَالَا :" يَمُرُّ وَلَا يَقْعُدُ فِيهِ "
1.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Sharik, from Simak, from Ikrimah, and Salim, from Sa'id: They both said: "He passes through, but does not sit in it."
1.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Sharik se, Simak se, Ikrimah se, aur Salim se, Sa'id se bataya: Dono ne kaha, "Woh guzarta hai, lekin usmein baithta nahi."

1.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" كُنَّا نَمْشِي فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَنَحْنُ جُنُبٌ لَا نَرَى بِذَلِكَ بَأْسًا "
