2.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid al-Hanafi ne Ibn Abi Dhi'b se, Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Ata se, Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Thawban se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "jab bhi namaz ke liye khade hote, to apne haath poori tarah utha lete."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَمِّهْ الْمَاجِشُونَ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا افْتَتَحَ الصَّلَاةَ، كَبَّرَ ثُمَّ قَالَ :" وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا، وَمَا أَنَا مِنْ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ.
اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْمَلِكُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي جَمِيعًا، لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَاهْدِنِي لِأَحْسَنِ الْأَخْلَاقِ لَا يَهْدِي لِأَحْسَنِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا لَا يَصْرِفُ سَيِّئَهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ وَالْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ فِي يَدَيْكَ، وَالشَّرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْكَ، أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ، تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ "
2.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Salamah, from his uncle al-Majishun, from al-A'raj, from Ubaydullah ibn Abi Rafi', from Ali ibn Abi Talib رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he opened the prayer, said the takbir, then said: "I have turned my face to the One who created the heavens and the earth, as one inclining toward truth, and I am not of the polytheists; indeed my prayer, my rites, my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds, no partner has He; and with that I have been commanded, and I am the first of the Muslims. O Allah, You are the King, there is no god but You, You are my Lord and I am Your servant; I have wronged myself, and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me all my sins, none forgives sins but You; and guide me to the best of manners, none guides to the best of them but You; and turn away from me the evil of them, none turns away their evil but You. At Your service and at Your command, and all good is in Your hands, and evil is not attributed to You; I am by You and to You; blessed and exalted are You; I seek Your forgiveness and I turn to You in repentance."
2.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Salamah se, apne chacha al-Majishun se, al-A'raj se, Ubaydullah ibn Abi Rafi' se, Ali ibn Abi Talib رضي الله عنه se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ jab namaz shuru karte, to takbir kehte, fir farmaate: "Wajjahtu wajhiya lilladhi fataras-samawati wal-arda haneefaw-wa ma ana minal-mushrikeen. Inna salaati wa nusuki wa mahyaya wa mamaati lillahi Rabbil-'alameena la shareeka lahu, wa bidhalika umirtu wa ana awwalul-muslimeen. Allahumma antal-Maliku la ilaha illa Anta, Anta Rabbi wa ana 'abduka, zalamtu nafsi wa'taraftu bidhambi, faghfirli dhunubi jami'an, la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa Anta, wahdini li-ahsanil-akhlaqi la yahdi li-ahsaniha illa Anta, wasrif 'anni sayyi'aha la yasrifu sayyi'aha illa Anta. Labbayka wa sa'dayka wal-khayru kulluhu fi yadayka, wash-sharru laysa ilayka, ana bika wa ilayka, tabarakta wa ta'alayta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayka" [Maine apna chehra us Zaat ki taraf mod diya jisne aasmanon aur zameen ko paida kiya, Hanif bankar, aur main mushrikon mein se nahi. Beshak meri namaz, meri qurbani, mera jeena aur marna sab Allah Rabb-ul-Aalameen ke liye hai, uska koi shareek nahi; aur mujhe isi ka hukum diya gaya hai, aur main sabse pehla Musalman hoon. Ae Allah, tu hi Baadshah hai, tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi, tu mera Rab hai aur main tera banda hoon; maine apne aap par zulm kiya aur apne gunah ka iqrar karta hoon, so mere sab gunah maaf kar de, gunah tere siwa koi maaf nahi karta; aur mujhe behtareen akhlaq ki hidayat de, uski hidayat tere siwa koi nahi deta; aur mujhse uski buraai door kar, use tere siwa koi door nahi karta. Main teri hi taraf raghbat rakhta hoon aur teri hi taraf sab bhalaai hai, aur burai teri taraf mansoob nahi; main teri hi wajah se hoon aur teri hi taraf laut kar jaunga, tu bharpoor barkat wala aur azmat wala hai; main tujhse maghfirat maangta hoon aur teri taraf tauba karta hoon].

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا قَامَ مِنْ اللَّيْلِ فَكَبَّرَ، قَالَ :" سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ.
أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنْ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ : مِنْ هَمْزِهِ وَنَفْثِهِ وَنَفْخِهِ " ثُمَّ يَسْتَفْتِحُ صَلَاتَهُ.
قَالَ جَعْفَرٌ : وَفَسَّرَهُ مَطَرٌ : هَمْزُهُ : الْمُوتَةُ، وَنَفْثُهُ : الشِّعْرُ، وَنَفْخُهُ : الْكِبْرُ
2.en: Narrated by Zakariya ibn Adi, from Ja'far ibn Sulayman, from Ali ibn Ali, from Abu al-Mutawakkil, from Abu Sa'id; with Ja'far's and Matar's explanation: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he rose at night and said the takbir, said: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, wa tabaraka ismuka, wa ta'ala jadduka, wa la ilaha ghayruka. A'udhu billahis-Sami'il-'Alimi minash-shaytanir-rajim: min hamzihi wa nafthihi wa nafkhihi" [Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise; blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god besides You. I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from the accursed Shaytan: from his madness-inducing whisper, and his poetry-inspiring blow, and his pride-inducing puff], then he would begin his prayer. Ja'far said: And Matar explained it: his madness-inducing whisper: fits, his poetry-inspiring blow: poetry, his pride-inducing puff: arrogance.
2.hi: Zakariya ibn Adi ne Ja'far ibn Sulayman se, Ali ibn Ali se, Abu al-Mutawakkil se, Abu Sa'id se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ jab raat ko uthte aur takbir kehte, to farmaate: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, wa tabaraka ismuka, wa ta'ala jadduka, wa la ilaha ghayruka. A'udhu billahis-Sami'il-'Alimi minash-shaytanir-rajim: min hamzihi wa nafthihi wa nafkhihi" fir aap apni namaz shuru karte. Ja'far kehte hain: Aur Matar ne iski tashreeh ki: uska 'hamz' (waswasa): junoon/mirgi ka daura, uska 'nafth': shayari, uska 'nafkh': ghuroor.

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَأَبَا بَكْرٍ، وَعُمَرَ، وَعُثْمَانَ كَانُوا" يَفْتَتِحُونَ الْقِرَاءَةَ بِ # الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ سورة الفاتحة آية 2 # ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : بِهَذَا نَقُولُ، وَلَا أَرَى الْجَهْرَ بِ # بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ سورة الفاتحة آية 1 #
2.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Hisham, from Qatadah, from Anas; with Abu Muhammad's note: That the Prophet ﷺ, and Abu Bakr, Umar, and Uthman used to "open the recitation with 'Al-hamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin' [Surah al-Fatihah]." Abu Muhammad said: This is our view, and I do not hold that "Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim" [Surah al-Fatihah, verse 1] should be recited aloud.
2.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Hisham se, Qatadah se, Anas se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ, aur Abu Bakr, Umar, aur Uthman "qiraat ki shuruaat 'Al-hamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin' [Surah Al-Fatihah] se karte the." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Yehi humara qaul hai, aur main "Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Raheem" [Surah Al-Fatihah, aayat 1] ko bulund awaaz se padhna sahih nahi samajhta.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْجَبَّارِ بْنِ وَائِلٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يَضَعُ يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى الْيُسْرَى قَرِيبًا مِنْ الرُّسْغِ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zuhayr, from Abu Ishaq, from Abd al-Jabbar ibn Wa'il, from his father: He said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "place his right hand upon his left, near the wrist."
2.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zuhayr se, Abu Ishaq se, Abd al-Jabbar ibn Wa'il se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko dekha ke aapne "apna daayan haath apne baaye haath par rakha, kalaai ke qareeb."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ  ،  عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" مَنْ لَمْ يَقْرَأْ بِأُمِّ الْكِتَابِ، فَلَا صَلَاةَ لَهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Yunus, from al-Zuhri, from Mahmud ibn al-Rabi', from Ubadah ibn al-Samit: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever does not recite the Mother of the Book [al-Fatihah], there is no prayer for him."
2.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Yunus se, al-Zuhri se, Mahmud ibn al-Rabi' se, Ubadah ibn al-Samit se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jo Umm-ul-Kitab (Surah Al-Fatihah) na padhe, uski namaz nahi hoti."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " كَانَيَسْكُتُ سَكْتَتَيْنِ : إِذَا دَخَلَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ، وَإِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْ الْقِرَاءَةِ "، فَأَنْكَرَ ذَلِكَ عِمْرَانُ بْنُ حُصَيْنٍ، فَكَتَبُوا إِلَى أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِمْ أَنْ قَدْ صَدَقَ سَمُرَةُ.
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : كَانَ قَتَادَةُ يَقُولُ : ثَلَاثُ سَكَتَاتٍ، وَفِي الْحَدِيثِ الْمَرْفُوعِ سَكْتَتَانِ
2.en: Narrated by Affan, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Humayd, from al-Hasan, from Samurah ibn Jundub; with Abu Muhammad's note on Qatadah's view: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "used to observe two pauses of silence: when he entered the prayer, and when he finished the recitation." Imran ibn Husayn disapproved of that, so they wrote to Ubayy ibn Ka'b, and he wrote back to them that Samurah had spoken the truth. Abu Muhammad said: Qatadah used to say: three pauses of silence, but in the raised hadith, [there are] two pauses.
2.hi: Affan ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Humayd se, al-Hasan se, Samurah ibn Jundub se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "do martaba khamoshi ikhtiyaar karte the: jab namaz mein dakhil hote, aur jab qiraat se faarigh hote." Imran ibn Husayn ne isse inkaar kiya, so unhone Ubayy ibn Ka'b ko likha, aur unhone jawab mein likha ke Samurah ne sach kaha. Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Qatadah kaha karte the: teen khamoshiyaan, lekin marfu' hadith mein do khamoshiyaan hain.

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ آدَمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَارَةُ بْنُ الْقَعْقَاعِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَسْكُتُ بَيْنَ التَّكْبِيرِ وَالْقِرَاءَةِ إِسْكَاتَةً حَسِبْتُهُ قَالَ : هُنَيَّةً فَقُلْتُ لَهُ : بِأَبِي وَأُمِّي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَرَأَيْتَ إِسْكَاتَتَكَ بَيْنَ التَّكْبِيرِ وَالْقِرَاءَةِ، مَا تَقُولُ؟ قَالَ : أَقُولُ :" اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ.
اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنْ الدَّنَسِ.
اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ بِالثَّلْجِ وَالْمَاءِ الْبَارِدِ "
2.en: Narrated by Bishr ibn Adam, from Abd al-Wahid ibn Ziyad, from Umarah ibn al-Qa'qa', from Abu Zur'ah ibn Amr, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pause between the takbir and the recitation with a pause - I think he said: a little pause - so I said to him: "May my father and mother be sacrificed for you, O Messenger of Allah, tell me about your pause between the takbir and the recitation, what do you say?" He said: I say: "Allahumma ba'id bayni wa bayna khatayaya kama ba'adta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib. Allahumma naqqini min khatayaya kama yunaqqa al-thawb al-abyad min al-danas. Allahumma ighsilni min khatayaya bith-thalji wal-ma'il-barid."
2.hi: Bishr ibn Adam ne Abd al-Wahid ibn Ziyad se, Umarah ibn al-Qa'qa' se, Abu Zur'ah ibn Amr se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ takbir aur qiraat ke darmiyan khamosh reh jaate - main samajhta hoon unhone kaha: thodi der ke liye - to maine unse poocha: "Mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon, Ya Rasulullah, mujhe bataiye ke aap takbir aur qiraat ke darmiyan apni khamoshi mein kya kehte hain?" Aapne farmaya: Main kehta hoon: "Allahumma ba'id bayni wa bayna khatayaya kama ba'adta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib. Allahumma naqqini min khatayaya kama yunaqqath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas. Allahummagh-silni min khatayaya bith-thalji wal-ma'il-barid" [Ae Allah, mere aur mere gunahon ke darmiyan itni door kar de jitna tune Mashriq aur Maghrib ke darmiyan door kiya hai. Ae Allah, mujhe apne gunahon se aise paak kar jaise safed kapda maile-pan se paak kiya jaata hai. Ae Allah, mujhe apne gunahon se barf aur thande paani se dho de].

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا قَالَ الْقَارِئُ # غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلا الضَّالِّينَ سورة الفاتحة آية 7 #، فَقَالَ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ : آمِينَ، فَوَافَقَ ذَلِكَ أَهْلَ السَّمَاءِ، غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When the reciter says, 'Not of those who have earned [Your] anger, nor of those who have gone astray' [Surah al-Fatihah, verse 7], and those behind him say: Amin, and it coincides with that of the inhabitants of heaven, what has preceded of his sins will be forgiven him."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab qaari 'Ghayril-maghdoobi 'alayhim wa lad-dalleen' [Surah Al-Fatihah, aayat 7] kahe, aur uske peechhe wale 'Ameen' kahein, aur yeh asmaan walon ke 'Ameen' se mel kha jaaye, to uske pichhle gunah maaf kar diye jaate hain."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْأَعْلَى  ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِذَا قَالَ الْإِمَامُ : # غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلا الضَّالِّينَ سورة الفاتحة آية 7 # فَقُولُوا : آمِينَ، فَإِنَّ الْمَلَائِكَةَ تَقُولُ : آمِينَ، وَإِنَّ الْإِمَامَ يَقُولُ : آمِينَ، فَمَنْ وَافَقَ تَأْمِينُهُ تَأْمِينَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ، غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Nasr ibn Ali, from Abd al-A'la, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, and Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: "When the imam says: 'Not of those who have earned [Your] anger, nor of those who have gone astray' [Surah al-Fatihah, verse 7], then say: Amin, for indeed the angels say: Amin, and indeed the imam says: Amin, so whoever's saying of Amin coincides with the angels' saying of Amin, what has preceded of his sins will be forgiven him."
2.hi: Nasr ibn Ali ne Abd al-A'la se, Ma'mar se, al-Zuhri se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab aur Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jab imam 'Ghayril-maghdoobi 'alayhim wa lad-dalleen' [Surah Al-Fatihah, aayat 7] kahe, to tum 'Ameen' kaho, kyunki farishte 'Ameen' kehte hain, aur imam bhi 'Ameen' kehta hai, so jiska 'Ameen' kehna farishton ke 'Ameen' se mel kha jaaye, uske pichhle gunah maaf kar diye jaate hain."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، أَنْبأَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ حُجْرِ بْنِ الْعَنْبس  ، عَنْ وَائِلِ بْنِ حُجْرٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَإِذَا قَرَأَ : # وَلا الضَّالِّينَ سورة الفاتحة آية 7 # قَالَ : " آمِينَ " وَيَرْفَعُ بِهَا صَوْتَهُ
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir, from Sufyan ibn Sa'id, from Salamah ibn Kuhayl, from Hujr ibn al-Anbas, from Wa'il ibn Hujr: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he recited "'nor of those who have gone astray' [Surah al-Fatihah, verse 7]," said: "Amin," and raised his voice with it.
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir ne Sufyan ibn Sa'id se, Salamah ibn Kuhayl se, Hujr ibn al-Anbas se, Wa'il ibn Hujr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ jab "'Wa lad-dalleen' [Surah Al-Fatihah, aayat 7]" padhte, to "Ameen" kehte, aur usmein apni awaaz bulund karte.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْأَعْلَى  ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، وَعَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّهُمَا صَلَّيَا خَلْفَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ،فَلَمَّا رَكَعَ، كَبَّرَ، فَلَمَّا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ، قَالَ : " سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ "، ثُمَّ سَجَدَ وَكَبَّرَ، ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ وَكَبَّرَ، ثُمَّ كَبَّرَ حِينَ قَامَ مِنْ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، إِنِّي لَأَقْرَبُكُمْ شَبَهًا بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، مَا زَالَ هَذِهِ صَلَاتُهُ حَتَّى فَارَقَ الدُّنْيَا "
2.en: Narrated by Nasr ibn Ali, from Abd al-A'la, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Bakr ibn Abd al-Rahman, and from Abu Salamah, about Abu Hurairah: That the two of them prayed behind Abu Hurairah, and when he bowed, he said the takbir, and when he raised his head, he said: "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah," then he said: "Rabbana wa lakal-hamd," then he prostrated and said the takbir, then he raised his head and said the takbir, then he said the takbir when he stood from the two rak'ahs, then he said: "By the One in whose hand is my soul, indeed I am the closest of you in resemblance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, this remained his prayer until he departed the world."
2.hi: Nasr ibn Ali ne Abd al-A'la se, Ma'mar se, al-Zuhri se, Abu Bakr ibn Abd al-Rahman se, aur Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah ke baare mein bataya ke dono ne Abu Hurairah ke peechhe namaz padhi, aur jab woh ruku mein gaye, to takbir kahi, aur jab sar uthaya, to kaha: "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah," fir kaha: "Rabbana wa lakal-hamd," fir sajda kiya aur takbir kahi, fir sar uthaya aur takbir kahi, fir do rakat se khade hote waqt takbir kahi, fir farmaya: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main tum sab mein Rasulullah ﷺ se shakl-o-surat mein sabse zyada milta-julta hoon, unki namaz duniya se ruksat hone tak isi tarah rahi."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، وَعَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يُكَبِّرُ فِي كُلِّ رَفْعٍ وَوَضْعٍ، وَقِيَامٍ، وَقُعُودٍ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Abu Khaythamah, from Abu Ishaq, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Aswad, from his father, and from Alqamah, from Abdullah: He said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "say the takbir at every rise and lowering, and standing, and sitting."
2.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Abu Khaythamah se, Abu Ishaq se, Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Aswad se, apne walid se, aur Alqamah se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko dekha ke aap "har uthne aur jhukne, khade hone, aur baithne par takbir kehte the."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" إِذَا دَخَلَ الصَّلَاةَ، كَبَّرَ وَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حَذْوَ مَنْكِبَيْهِ، وَإِذَا رَكَعَ كَبَّرَ وَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ، وَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنْ الرُّكُوعِ، فَعَلَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، وَلَا يَرْفَعُ بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ أَوْ فِي السُّجُودِ "
2.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Malik, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from his father: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to "when he entered the prayer, say the takbir and raise his hands level with his shoulders, and when he bowed, say the takbir and raise his hands, and when he raised his head from bowing, he did the like of that, and he did not raise [his hands] between the two prostrations or in the prostration."
2.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Malik se, al-Zuhri se, Salim se, apne walid se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "jab namaz mein dakhil hote, to takbir kehte aur apne haath apne kandhon ke barabar utha lete, aur jab ruku karte, to takbir kehte aur haath utha lete, aur jab ruku se sar uthaate, to isi tarah karte, aur do sajdon ke darmiyan ya sajde mein haath na uthaate."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ نَصْرِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" إِذَا كَبَّرَ، رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى يُحَاذِيَ أُذُنَيْهِ، وَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ، وَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنْ الرُّكُوعِ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from Nasr ibn Asim, from Malik ibn al-Huwayrith: That the Prophet ﷺ used to "when he said the takbir, raise his hands until they were level with his ears, and when he intended to bow, and when he raised his head from bowing [do the same]."
2.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Shu'bah se, Qatadah se, Nasr ibn Asim se, Malik ibn al-Huwayrith se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ "jab takbir kehte, to apne haath apne kaanon ke barabar utha lete, aur jab ruku karna chahte, aur jab ruku se sar uthaate [tab bhi aisa hi karte]."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الْبَخْتَرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْيَحْصُبِيِّ  ، عَنْ وَائِلٍ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ  ، أَنَّهُ صَلَّى مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَكَانَ" يُكَبِّرُ إِذَا خَفَضَ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ، وَيَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ عِنْدَ التَّكْبِيرِ، وَيُسَلِّمُ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ ".
قَالَ : قُلْتُ : حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ وَضَحُ وَجْهِهِ؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ
2.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from Amr ibn Murrah, from Abu al-Bakhtari, from Abd al-Rahman al-Yahsubi, from Wa'il al-Hadrami: That he prayed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he used to "say the takbir when he lowered and when he raised, and raise his hands at the takbir, and give the salam to his right, and to his left." He said: I said: "Until the brightness of his face appeared?" He said, "Yes."
2.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se, Amr ibn Murrah se, Abu al-Bakhtari se, Abd al-Rahman al-Yahsubi se, Wa'il al-Hadrami se bataya ke unhone Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath namaz padhi, aur aap "jhukte aur uthate waqt takbir kehte, aur takbir ke waqt apne haath uthate, aur apne daayen aur baaye taraf salaam pherte." Unhone bataya: Maine poocha: "Yahan tak ke aapke chehre ki safedi zaahir ho jaati?" Unhone kaha, "Haan."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ  ، قَالَ : أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي نَفَرٍ مِنْ قَوْمِي وَنَحْنُ شَبَبَةٌ، فَأَقَمْنَا عِنْدَهُ عِشْرِينَ لَيْلَةً، وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَفِيقًا، فَلَمَّا رَأَى شَوْقَنَا إِلَى أَهْلِينَا، قَالَ :" ارْجِعُوا إِلَى أَهْلِيكُمْ فَكُونُوا فِيهِمْ، فَمُرُوهُمْ وَعَلِّمُوهُمْ، وَصَلُّوا كَمَا رَأَيْتُمُونِي أُصَلِّي، فَإِذَا حَضَرَتْ الصَّلَاةُ، فَلْيُؤَذِّنْ لَكُمْ أَحَدُكُمْ، ثُمَّ لِيَؤُمَّكُمْ أَكْبَرُكُمْ "
2.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Wuhayb ibn Khalid, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah, from Malik ibn al-Huwayrith: He said: I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a group of my people, and we were young men, and we stayed with him twenty nights, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was compassionate, so when he saw our longing for our families, he said: "Return to your families and stay among them, and teach them and instruct them, and pray as you have seen me pray, and when the prayer time comes, let one of you call the adhan for you, and then let the eldest of you lead you [in prayer]."
2.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Wuhayb ibn Khalid se, Ayyub se, Abu Qilabah se, Malik ibn al-Huwayrith se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main apni qaum ke kuch logon ke saath Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur hum jawaan the, so hum aapke paas bees raatein rahe, aur Rasulullah ﷺ narm-dil the, so jab aapne humari apne gharwalon ke liye tadap dekhi, to farmaya: "Apne gharwalon ke paas wapas jao aur unke saath raho, aur unhein hukum do aur sikhaao, aur waise namaz padho jaise tumne mujhe padhte dekha hai, aur jab namaz ka waqt aaye, to tum mein se koi ek azaan de, fir tum mein se sabse bada tumhein imamat karaaye."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا اجْتَمَعَ ثَلَاثَةٌ، فَلْيَؤُمَّهُمْ أَحَدُهُمْ، وَأَحَقُّهُمْ بِالْإِمَامَةِ أَقْرَؤُهُمْ "
2.en: Narrated by Affan, from Hammam, from Qatadah, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When three gather, let one of them lead them, and the most deserving of them to lead is the one most versed in recitation."
2.hi: Affan ne Hammam se, Qatadah se, Abu Nadrah se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab teen log jama hon, to unmein se ek imamat kare, aur imamat ka sabse zyada haqdar woh hai jo Quran sabse zyada padhne wala ho."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ : كُنْتُ عِنْدَ خَالَتِي مَيْمُونَةَ ، فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ فَصَلَّى أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ، ثُمَّ قَامَ، فَقَالَ : " أَنَامَ الْغُلَيِّمُ؟ " أَوْ كَلِمَةً نَحْوَهَا ، فَقَامَ فَصَلَّى فَجِئْتُ، فَقُمْتُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ،فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِي فَجَعَلَنِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: He said: I heard Sa'id ibn Jubayr narrating, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: He said: I was with my maternal aunt Maymunah, and the Prophet ﷺ came after Isha and prayed four rak'ahs, then he stood, and said: "Has the little boy fallen asleep?" or a word like it, then he stood and prayed, so I came and stood on his left, so he took my hand and placed me on his right.
2.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Shu'bah se, al-Hakam se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Sa'id ibn Jubayr ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se: Unhone kaha, Main apni khaala Maymunah ke paas tha, to Nabi ﷺ Isha ke baad aaye aur chaar rakat namaz padhi, fir khade hue, aur farmaya: "Kya ladka so gaya?" ya isi jaisi baat, fir aap khade hue aur namaz padhi, so main aaya, aur aapke baaye taraf khada ho gaya, to aapne mera haath pakda aur mujhe apne daaye taraf kar diya.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَكِبَ فَرَسًا فَصُرِعَ عَنْهُ، فَجُحِشَ شِقُّهُ الْأَيْمَنُ، فَصَلَّى صَلَاةً مِنْ الصَّلَوَاتِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ، فَصَلَّيْنَا مَعَهُ جُلُوسًا، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ، قَالَ : " إِنَّمَاجُعِلَ الْإِمَامُ لِيُؤْتَمَّ بِهِ، فَلَا تَخْتَلِفُوا عَلَيْهِ، فَإِذَا صَلَّى قَائِمًا، فَصَلُّوا قِيَامًا، وَإِذَا رَكَعَ فَارْكَعُوا، وَإِذَا رَفَعَ، فَارْفَعُوا، وَإِذَا قَالَ : سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، فَقُولُوا : رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، وَإِنْ صَلَّى قَاعِدًا، فَصَلُّوا قُعُودًا أَجْمَعُونَ "
2.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Anas رضي الله عنه: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ rode a horse and was thrown from it, and his right side was scraped/injured, so he prayed one of the prayers while sitting, and we prayed with him sitting, and when he finished, he said: "The imam is only appointed to be followed, so do not differ from him: when he prays standing, pray standing, and when he bows, bow, and when he raises [his head], raise [yours], and when he says: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah,' say: 'Rabbana wa lakal-hamd,' and if he prays sitting, then pray sitting, all of you."
2.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Malik se, Ibn Shihab se, Anas رضي الله عنه se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ghode par sawaar hue aur usse gir gaye, aur aapki daayen taraf khraash aa gayi, so aapne ek namaz baith kar padhi, aur humne bhi aapke saath baith kar padhi, aur jab aap faarigh hue, to farmaya: "Imam sirf isliye banaya jaata hai ke uski pairwi ki jaaye, so uske khilaf na karo: jab woh khade hokar padhe, to tum bhi khade hokar padho, aur jab woh ruku kare, to tum bhi ruku karo, aur jab woh sar uthaaye, to tum bhi uthao, aur jab woh kahe: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah,' to tum kaho: 'Rabbana wa lakal-hamd,' aur agar woh baith kar padhe, to tum sab bhi baith kar padho."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : دَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ   فَقُلْتُ لَهَا : لا تُحَدِّثِينِي عَنْ مَرَضِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟ فَقَالَتْ : بَلَى، ثَقُلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : " أَصَلَّى النَّاسُ؟ " قُلْنَا : لَا، هُمْ يَنْتَظِرُونَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ : " ضَعُوا لِي مَاءً فِي الْمِخْضَبِ ".
قَالَتْ : فَفَعَلْنَا، فَاغْتَسَلَ، ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ لِيَنُوءَ فَأُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ أَفَاقَ، فَقَالَ : " أَصَلَّى النَّاسُ؟ " فَقُلْنَا : لَا، هُمْ يَنْتَظِرُونَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ : " ضَعُوا لِي مَاءً فِي الْمِخْضَبِ ".
فَفَعَلْنَا، ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ لِيَنُوءَ، فَأُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ أَفَاقَ، فَقَالَ : " أَصَلَّى النَّاسُ؟ " فَقُلْنَا : لَا، هُمْ يَنْتَظِرُونَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ.
قَالَتْ : وَالنَّاسُ عُكُوفٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ يَنْتَظِرُونَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِصَلَاةِ الْعِشَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ.
قَالَتْ : فَأَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بِالنَّاسِ.
قَالَتْ : فَأَتَاهُ الرَّسُولُ، فَقَالَ : إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَأْمُرُكَ بِأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ بِالنَّاسِ.
 فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَكَانَ رَجُلًا رَقِيقًا : يَا عُمَرُ، صَلِّ بِالنَّاسِ.
فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ : أَنْتَ أَحَقُّ بِذَلِكَ.
قَالَتْ : فَصَلَّى بِهِمْ أَبُو بَكْرٍ تِلْكَ الْأَيَّامَ.
قَالَتْ : ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَجَدَ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ خِفَّةً فَخَرَجَ بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَا الْعَبَّاسُ لِصَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ، وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ، فَلَمَّا رَآهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ذَهَبَ لِيَتَأَخَّرَ، فَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْ لَا يَتَأَخَّرَ، وَقَالَ لَهُمَا : " أَجْلِسَانِي إِلَى جَنْبِهِ ".
فَأَجْلَسَاهُ إِلَى جَنْبِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ.
قَالَتْ :فَجَعَلَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ بِصَلَاةِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَالنَّاسُ يُصَلُّونَ بِصَلَاةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَالنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَاعِدٌ ".
قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ : فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فَقُلْتُ لَهُ : أَلَا أَعْرِضُ عَلَيْكَ مَا حَدَّثَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ عَنْ مَرَضِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟ فَقَالَ : هَاتِ، فَعَرَضْتُ حَدِيثَهَا عَلَيْهِ، فَمَا أَنْكَرَ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ : أَسَمَّتْ لَكَ الرَّجُلَ الَّذِي كَانَ مَعَ الْعَبَّاسِ؟ قُلْتُ : لَا، فَقَالَ : هُوَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ
2.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Yunus, from Za'idah, from Musa ibn Abi Aishah, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah, from Aisha: He said: I entered upon Aisha and said to her: "Will you not narrate to me about the illness of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" She said: Of course. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ became heavy [with illness], and said: "Have the people prayed?" We said: "No, they are waiting for you, O Messenger of Allah." So he said: "Put water for me in the basin." She said: So we did, and he bathed, then he went to rise but fainted, then he recovered, and said: "Have the people prayed?" We said: "No, they are waiting for you, O Messenger of Allah." So he said: "Put water for me in the basin." So we did, then he went to rise, and he fainted, then he recovered, and said: "Have the people prayed?" We said: "No, they are waiting for you, O Messenger of Allah." She said: And the people were remaining in the mosque waiting for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for the last Isha prayer. She said: So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent to Abu Bakr to pray with the people. She said: So the messenger came to him, and said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commands you to pray with the people. So Abu Bakr said - and he was a tender-hearted man - "O Umar, lead the people in prayer." So Umar said to him: "You are more deserving of that." She said: So Abu Bakr led them in prayer during those days. She said: Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ found in himself a lightness, so he went out between two men, one of them al-Abbas, for the Zuhr prayer, while Abu Bakr was leading the people, so when Abu Bakr saw him, he went to step back, but the Prophet ﷺ signaled to him not to step back, and said to the two of them: "Seat me next to him." So they seated him next to Abu Bakr. She said: So Abu Bakr began to pray standing, following the prayer of the Prophet ﷺ, and the people prayed following the prayer of Abu Bakr, while the Prophet ﷺ was sitting. Ubaydullah said: So I entered upon Abdullah ibn Abbas, and said to him: "Shall I not present to you what Aisha narrated to me about the illness of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" He said: "Go ahead," so I presented her hadith to him, and he did not deny anything of it except that he said: "Did she name for you the man who was with al-Abbas?" I said, "No," so he said: "He is Ali ibn Abi Talib."
2.hi: Ahmad ibn Yunus ne Za'idah se, Musa ibn Abi Aishah se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Aisha ke paas gaya aur unse kaha: "Kya aap mujhe Rasulullah ﷺ ki bimari ke baare mein nahi bataayengi?" Unhone kaha: Zaroor. Rasulullah ﷺ shiddat se bimar ho gaye, aur farmaya: "Kya logon ne namaz padh li?" Humne kaha: "Nahi, woh aapka intezaar kar rahe hain, Ya Rasulullah." To aapne farmaya: "Mere liye tashtari mein paani rakho." Unhone bataya: So humne aisa kiya, aur aapne ghusl kiya, fir uthne lage to behosh ho gaye, fir hosh mein aaye, aur farmaya: "Kya logon ne namaz padh li?" Humne kaha: "Nahi, woh aapka intezaar kar rahe hain, Ya Rasulullah." To aapne farmaya: "Mere liye tashtari mein paani rakho." So humne aisa kiya, fir aap uthne lage, to phir behosh ho gaye, fir hosh mein aaye, aur farmaya: "Kya logon ne namaz padh li?" Humne kaha: "Nahi, woh aapka intezaar kar rahe hain, Ya Rasulullah." Unhone bataya: Aur log masjid mein Rasulullah ﷺ ka Isha-e-Aakhir ki namaz ke liye intezaar kar rahe the. Unhone bataya: So Rasulullah ﷺ ne Abu Bakr ke paas [kisi ko] bheja ke woh logon ko namaz padhaayein. Unhone bataya: So qasid unke paas aaya, aur kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ aapko hukum dete hain ke aap logon ko namaz padhaayein. To Abu Bakr ne kaha - aur woh narm-dil aadmi the - "Ae Umar, tum logon ko namaz padhao." To Umar ne unse kaha: "Aap iske zyada haqdar hain." Unhone bataya: So Abu Bakr ne un dinon logon ko namaz padhaayi. Unhone bataya: Fir Rasulullah ﷺ ne apne aap mein halkapan mehsoos kiya, so aap do aadmiyon ke darmiyan, jinmein se ek Abbas the, Zuhr ki namaz ke liye bahar nikle, jabke Abu Bakr logon ko namaz padha rahe the, so jab Abu Bakr ne aapko dekha, to woh peechhe hatne lage, lekin Nabi ﷺ ne unhein ishara kiya ke peechhe na hatein, aur un dono se farmaya: "Mujhe unke pehlu mein bitha do." So unhone aapko Abu Bakr ke pehlu mein bitha diya. Unhone bataya: So Abu Bakr Nabi ﷺ ki namaz ki pairwi karte hue khade hokar namaz padhaane lage, aur log Abu Bakr ki namaz ki pairwi karte hue namaz padh rahe the jabke Nabi ﷺ baithe hue the. Ubaydullah kehte hain: So main Abdullah ibn Abbas ke paas gaya, aur unse kaha: "Kya main aapko woh na pesh karun jo Aisha ne mujhse Rasulullah ﷺ ki bimari ke baare mein bataya?" Unhone kaha: "Sunao," so maine unki riwayat unke saamne pesh ki, to unhone usmein se kisi baat se inkaar nahi kiya siwaay iske ke unhone poocha: "Kya unhone tumhein us aadmi ka naam bataya jo Abbas ke saath tha?" Maine kaha, "Nahi," to unhone kaha: "Woh Ali ibn Abi Talib hain."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، قَالَ : رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" جَلَسَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ فَكَبَّرَ، فَكَبَّرَ النَّاسُ خَلْفَهُ، ثُمَّ رَكَعَ وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ، ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ فَنَزَلَ الْقَهْقَرَى فَسَجَدَ فِي أَصْلِ الْمِنْبَرِ، ثُمَّ عَادَ حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنْ آخِرِ صَلَاتِهِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : فِي ذَلِكَ رُخْصَةٌ لِلْإِمَامِ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَرْفَعَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ وَقَدْرُ هَذَا الْعَمَلِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ أَيْضًا
2.en: Narrated by Abu Ma'mar Isma'il ibn Ibrahim, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Hazim, from his father, from Sahl ibn Sa'd; with Abu Muhammad's note: He said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "sit on the pulpit, and say the takbir, and the people said the takbir behind him, then he bowed while on the pulpit, then he raised his head and descended backward, and prostrated at the foot of the pulpit, then he returned until he finished the rest of his prayer." Abu Muhammad said: In this is a concession that the imam may be higher than his companions, and this action is also relevant/applicable in the prayer.
2.hi: Abu Ma'mar Isma'il ibn Ibrahim ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Hazim se, apne walid se, Sahl ibn Sa'd se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko dekha ke aap "mimbar par baithe aur takbir kahi, aur log aapke peechhe takbir kehte, fir aapne mimbar par hi ruku kiya, fir sar uthaya aur peechhe ki taraf utre aur mimbar ke neeche sajda kiya, fir wapas laut kar aapne apni baaki namaz mukammal ki." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Ismein imam ke apne sathiyon se bulund jagah par hone ki gunjaish hai, aur namaz mein bhi is amal ki gunjaish hai.

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَنْبأَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ، قَالَ : جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لَأَتَأَخَّرُ عَنْ صَلَاةِ الْغَدَاةِ مِمَّا يُطِيلُ بِنَا فِيهَا فُلَانٌ، فَمَا رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَشَدَّ غَضَبًا فِي مَوْعِظَةٍ مِنْهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ.
فَقَالَ : " أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ، إِنَّ مِنْكُمْ مُنَفِّرِينَ،فَمَنْ صَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ فَلْيَتَجَوَّزْ، فَإِنَّ فِيهِمْ الْكَبِيرَ وَالضَّعِيفَ وَذَا الْحَاجَةِ "
2.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid, from Qays, from Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari: He said: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, by Allah, I stay away from the Fajr prayer because so-and-so prolongs it for us," and I never saw the Prophet ﷺ more severely angry in a admonition than on that day. So he said: "O people, indeed some of you cause aversion, so whoever leads the people in prayer, let him be brief, for indeed among them are the elderly, and the weak, and the one with a need."
2.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid se, Qays se, Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi Nabi ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, Allah ki qasam, main Subh ki namaz se peechhe reh jaata hoon kyunki fulaan shakhs use lamba kar deta hai," aur maine Nabi ﷺ ko us din se zyada sakht naaraaz kisi naseehat mein kabhi nahi dekha. To aapne farmaya: "Ae logo, tum mein se kuch log logon ko [namaz se] bhagaane wale hain, so jo koi logon ko namaz padhaaye, use mukhtasar karna chahiye, kyunki unmein budhe, kamzor, aur zaroorat wale log bhi hote hain."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا   يَقُولُ : كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" أَخَفَّ النَّاسِ صَلَاةً فِي تَمَامٍ "
2.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from Anas: He said: I heard Anas say: The Prophet ﷺ was "the lightest of people in prayer while [still] complete."
2.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se, Qatadah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Anas ko kehte suna: Nabi ﷺ "namaz mukammal rakhte hue bhi logon mein sabse mukhtasar padhne wale the."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، قَالَ : كَتَبَ إِلَيَّ يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" إِذَا نُودِيَ لِلصَّلَاةِ، فَلَا تَقُومُوا حَتَّى تَرَوْنِي "
2.en: Narrated by Wahb ibn Jarir, from Hisham, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah, from his father: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When the call to prayer is made, do not stand until you see me."
2.hi: Wahb ibn Jarir ne Hisham se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Yahya ibn Abi Kathir ne likha, Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah se, apne walid se, ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jab namaz ke liye azaan di jaaye, to jab tak tum mujhe [aata] na dekho khade na ho."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ  : أَنَّ أَبَاهُ   حَدَّثَهُ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" إِذَا أُقِيمَتْ الصَّلَاةُ، فَلَا تَقُومُوا حَتَّى تَرَوْنِي "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hammam, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah, from his father: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "When the iqamah for prayer is made, do not stand until you see me."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hammam se, Yahya ibn Abi Kathir se, Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah se, apne walid se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jab namaz ki iqamah kahi jaaye, to jab tak tum mujhe [aata] na dekho khade na ho."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ،  عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" سَوُّوا صُفُوفَكُمْ، فَإِنَّ تَسْوِيَةَ الصُّفُوفِ مِنْ تَمَامِ الصَّلَاةِ "
2.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, and Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from Anas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Straighten your rows, for indeed the straightening of the rows is part of the completeness of the prayer."
2.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim aur Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Qatadah se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Apni safein seedhi karo, kyunki safon ki durusti namaz ki takmeel mein se hai."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي طَلْحَةُ بْنُ مُصَرِّفٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَوْسَجَةَ  ، عَنْ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" سَوُّوا صُفُوفَكُمْ لَا تَخْتَلِفُ قُلُوبُكُمْ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Talhah ibn Musarrif, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Awsajah, from al-Bara' ibn Azib: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Straighten your rows, [so that] your hearts do not differ."
2.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se, Talhah ibn Musarrif se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Awsajah se, al-Bara' ibn Azib se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Apni safein seedhi karo, [taake] tumhare dil aapas mein alag na ho jaayein."

2.ar: قَالَ : وَكَانَ يَقُولُ : " إِنَّاللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى الصَّفِّ الْأَوَّلِ أَوْ الصُّفُوفِ الْأُوَلِ "
2.en: Continuing the same narration from al-Bara' ibn Azib: He said: And he used to say: "Indeed Allah and His angels send blessings upon the first row, or the foremost rows."
2.hi: Isi riwayat mein aage bataya gaya: Aur aap farmaya karte the: "Beshak Allah aur uske farishte pehli saf par, ya sabse aage ki safon par rahmatein bhejte hain."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ  ، عَنْ عِرْبَاضِ بْنِ سَارِيَةَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ "يَسْتَغْفِرُ لِلصَّفِّ الْأَوَّلِ ثَلَاثًا، وَلِلصَّفِّ الثَّانِي مَرَّةً ".
أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى الْأَشْيَبُ  ، عَنْ شَيْبَانَ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ  ، عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ عِرْبَاضِ بْنِ سَارِيَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، نَحْوَهُ
2.en: Narrated by Wahb ibn Jarir, from Hisham, from Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim, from Khalid ibn Ma'dan, from al-Irbad ibn Sariyah; a similar chain also via al-Hasan ibn Ali: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to "seek forgiveness for the first row three times, and for the second row once." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Ashyab, from Shayban, from Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim, from Khalid ibn Ma'dan, from Jubayr ibn Nufayr, from al-Irbad ibn Sariyah, from the Prophet ﷺ.]
2.hi: Wahb ibn Jarir ne Hisham se, Yahya se, Muhammad ibn Ibrahim se, Khalid ibn Ma'dan se, al-Irbad ibn Sariyah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "pehli saf ke liye teen martaba maghfirat maangte, aur doosri saf ke liye ek martaba." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se al-Hasan ibn Ali se, al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Ashyab se, Shayban se, Yahya se, Muhammad ibn Ibrahim se, Khalid ibn Ma'dan se, Jubayr ibn Nufayr se, al-Irbad ibn Sariyah se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai.]

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَمْسَحُ مَنَاكِبَنَا فِي الصَّلَاةِ وَيَقُولُ :" لَا تَخْتَلِفُوا، فَتَخْتَلِفَ قُلُوبُكُمْ، لِيَلِيَنِّي مِنْكُمْ أُولُو الْأَحْلَامِ وَالنُّهَى، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مَسْعُودٍ : فَأَنْتُمْ الْيَوْمَ أَشَدُّ اخْتِلَافًا
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from al-A'mash, from Umarah ibn Umayr, from Abu Ma'mar, from Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to touch our shoulders in the prayer and say: "Do not differ, or your hearts will differ; let those of maturity and understanding be closest to me among you, then those next to them, then those next to them." Abu Mas'ud said: "So you today are more severe in differing."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, al-A'mash se, Umarah ibn Umayr se, Abu Ma'mar se, Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ namaz mein humare kandhon ko chhoo kar seedha karte aur farmaate: "Ikhtilaaf na karo, warna tumhare dil aapas mein alag ho jaayenge; tum mein se aqal-mand log mere qareeb rahein, fir jo unke qareeb hon, fir jo unke qareeb hon." Abu Mas'ud kehte hain: "So aaj tum log ikhtilaaf mein bahut zyada sakht ho gaye ho."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لِيَلِيَنِّي مِنْكُمْ أُولُو الْأَحْلَامِ وَالنُّهَى، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ.
وَلَا تَخْتَلِفُوا فَتَخْتَلِفَ قُلُوبُكُمْ.
وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَهَوْشَاتِ الْأَسْوَاقِ "
2.en: Narrated by Zakariya ibn Adi, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Khalid, from Abu Ma'shar, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah, from Abdullah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Let those of maturity and understanding be closest to me among you, then those next to them, then those next to them. And do not differ, or your hearts will differ. And beware of the tumult of the marketplaces."
2.hi: Zakariya ibn Adi ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Khalid se, Abu Ma'shar se, Ibrahim se, Alqamah se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tum mein se aqal-mand log mere qareeb rahein, fir jo unke qareeb hon, fir jo unke qareeb hon. Aur ikhtilaaf na karo, warna tumhare dil aapas mein alag ho jaayenge. Aur bazaaron ke shor-o-gul se bacho."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" خَيْرُ صُفُوفِ الرِّجَالِ أَوَّلُهَا، وَشَرُّهَا آخِرُهَا، وَخَيْرُ صُفُوفِ النِّسَاءِ آخِرُهَا، وَشَرُّهَا أَوَّلُهَا "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Ajlan, from his father, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "The best of the men's rows is the first of them, and the worst of them is the last of them, and the best of the women's rows is the last of them, and the worst of them is the first of them."
2.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Ajlan se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Mardon ki safon mein sabse behtar pehli saf hai, aur sabse buri aakhri saf; aur auraton ki safon mein sabse behtar aakhri saf hai, aur sabse buri pehli saf."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ  ،  عَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ  ، قَالَ : صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ صَلَاةَ الصُّبْحِ، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا بِوَجْهِهِ، فَقَالَ : " أَشَاهِدٌ فُلَانٌ؟ قَالُوا : لَا، فَقَالَ : أَشَاهِدٌ فُلَانٌ، فَقَالُوا : لَا، لِنَفَرٍ مِنْ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لَمْ يَشْهَدُوا الصَّلَاةَ، فَقَالَ : " إِنَّهَاتَيْنِ الصَّلَاتَيْنِ أَثْقَلُ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَى الْمُنَافِقِينَ، وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا فِيهِمَا لَأَتَوْهُمَا وَلَوْ حَبْوًا ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ  قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي  ، عَنْ أُبَيٍّ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَسَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ أُبَيٍّ  .
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ.
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِثْلَهُ
2.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Abu Ishaq, from Abdullah ibn Abi Basir, from Ubayy ibn Ka'b; with Abu Muhammad's note and similar chains via Abu Ghassan and Sa'id ibn Amir again: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed the Subh prayer, then turned his face to us, and said: "Is so-and-so present?" They said: "No." So he said: "Is so-and-so present?" They said: "No" - referring to a group of the hypocrites who were not present for the prayer. So he said: "Indeed these two prayers are the heaviest of the prayers upon the hypocrites, and if they knew what is in them, they would come to them even if crawling." Abu Muhammad said: Abdullah ibn Abi Basir said: My father narrated to me, from Ubayy, from the Prophet ﷺ, and I heard it from Ubayy [directly, as well]. [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Abu Ghassan, from Zuhayr, from Abu Ishaq, from Abdullah ibn Abi Basir, from his father, from Ubayy ibn Ka'b, from the Prophet ﷺ, the like of that. Another chain, from Sa'id ibn Amir, from Sa'id ibn Abi Arubah, from Khalid ibn Maymun, from Abu Ishaq, from Abdullah ibn Abi Basir, from his father, from Ubayy ibn Ka'b, from the Prophet ﷺ, the like of it.]
2.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Abu Ishaq se, Abdullah ibn Abi Basir se, Ubayy ibn Ka'b se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne Subh ki namaz padhi, fir humari taraf apna chehra mudka, aur farmaya: "Kya fulaan maujood hai?" Logon ne kaha: "Nahi." To aapne farmaya: "Kya fulaan maujood hai?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi" - munafiqon ke ek giroh ka zikr karte hue jo namaz mein maujood nahi the. To aapne farmaya: "Yeh do namazein munafiqon par sabse bhaari hain, aur agar unhein pata hota ke inmein kya [ajr] hai, to woh ghisatte hue bhi inmein aate." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Abdullah ibn Abi Basir ne kaha: Mere walid ne mujhse bataya, Ubayy se, Nabi ﷺ se, aur maine ise Ubayy se bhi [seedha] suna. [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se, Abu Ghassan se, Zuhayr se, Abu Ishaq se, Abdullah ibn Abi Basir se, apne walid se, Ubayy ibn Ka'b se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai. Ek aur sanad, Sa'id ibn Amir se, Sa'id ibn Abi Arubah se, Khalid ibn Maymun se, Abu Ishaq se, Abdullah ibn Abi Basir se, apne walid se, Ubayy ibn Ka'b se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi isi tarah aayi hai.]

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " إِنَّهُلَيْسَ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ أَثْقَلُ عَلَى الْمُنَافِقِينَ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْعِشَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ، وَصَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ، وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا فِيهِمَا، لَأَتَوْهُمَا وَلَوْ حَبْوًا "
2.en: Narrated by al-Hasan ibn al-Rabi', from Abu al-Ahwas, from al-A'mash, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There is no prayer heavier upon the hypocrites than the last Isha prayer, and the Fajr prayer, and if they knew what is in them, they would come to them even if crawling."
2.hi: Al-Hasan ibn al-Rabi' ne Abu al-Ahwas se, al-A'mash se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Munafiqon par Isha-e-Aakhir ki namaz aur Fajr ki namaz se zyada bhaari koi namaz nahi hai, aur agar unhein pata hota ke inmein kya hai, to woh ghisatte hue bhi inmein aate."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " لَقَدْهَمَمْتُ أَنْ آمُرَ فِتْيَانِي فَيَجْمَعُوا حَطَبًا، فَآمُرَ رَجُلًا يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ، ثُمَّ أُخَالِفَ إِلَى أَقْوَامٍ يَتَخَلَّفُونَ عَنْ هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةِ، فَأُحَرِّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ بُيُوتَهُمْ، لَوْ كَانَ عَرْقًا سَمِينًا، أَوْ مُعَرَّقَتَيْنِ لَشَهِدُوهَا، وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا فِيهِمَا، لَأَتَوْهُمَا وَلَوْ حَبْوًا "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Ajlan, from his father, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I have resolved to command my young men to gather firewood, then command a man to lead the people in prayer, then I would go against people who hold back from this prayer, and burn their houses over them; if it were a fatty bone, or two trotters, they would attend it, and if they knew what is in them, they would come to them even if crawling."
2.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Ajlan se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Maine socha ke main apne jawaano ko lakdiyaan jama karne ka hukum dun, fir ek aadmi ko hukum dun ke woh logon ko namaz padhaaye, fir main un logon ke paas jaaun jo is namaz se peechhe rehte hain, aur unke gharon ko unpar jala dun; agar yeh chikni haddi ka gosht hota, ya do khurr hote, to woh hazir ho jaate, aur agar unhein pata hota ke inmein kya [ajr] hai, to woh ghisatte hue bhi inmein aate."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنَّهُ نَزَلَ بِضَجْنَانَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ بَارِدَةٍ، فَأَمَرَ مُنَادِيًا فَنَادَى : الصَّلَاةُ فِي الرِّحَالِ، ثُمَّ أَخْبَرَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ " إِذَا كَانَ فِي سَفَرٍ فِي لَيْلَةٍ بَارِدَةٍ أَوْ الْمَطَرِأَمَرَ مُنَادِيًا فَنَادَى : الصَّلَاةُ فِي الرِّحَالِ "
2.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That he stopped at Dajnan on a cold night, and commanded a caller, and he called: "Pray in your dwellings," then he informed that the Prophet ﷺ used to "when he was on a journey on a cold night or in rain, command a caller, and he would call: 'Pray in your dwellings.'"
2.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ayyub se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke woh ek thandi raat Dajnan mein utre, aur ek pukaarne wale ko hukum diya, so usne pukaara: "Namaz apne dero mein [padho]," fir unhone bataya ke Nabi ﷺ "jab safar mein hote aur raat thandi hoti ya baarish hoti, to ek pukaarne wale ko hukum dete, aur woh pukaarta: 'Namaz apne dero mein [padho].'"

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِنْدٍ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِسَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  : رَجُلٌ صَلَّى فِي بَيْتِهِ، ثُمَّ أَدْرَكَ الْإِمَامَ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي، أَيُصَلِّي مَعَهُ؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ، قُلْتُ : بِأَيَّتِهِمَا يَحْتَسِبُ؟ قَالَ : بِالَّتِي صَلَّى مَعَ الْإِمَامِ، فَإِنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ   حَدَّثَنَا، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" صَلَاةُ الرَّجُلِ فِي الْجَمِيعِ تَزِيدُ عَلَى صَلَاتِهِ وَحْدَهُ بِضْعًا وَعِشْرِينَ جُزْءًا "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Da'ud ibn Abi Hind, about Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab: He said: I said to Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab: "A man prays in his house, then catches the imam while he is [still] praying, does he pray with him?" He said, "Yes." I said, "Which of the two does he count [as his obligatory prayer]?" He said: "The one he prayed with the imam, for indeed Abu Hurairah narrated to us, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'The prayer of a man in a group exceeds his prayer alone by twenty-something parts.'"
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Da'ud ibn Abi Hind se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se poocha: "Ek aadmi apne ghar mein namaz padh leta hai, fir imam ko [abhi bhi] namaz padhte hue paata hai, kya woh unke saath padhe?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Maine poocha, "Woh dono mein se kis ko [farz] shumaar karega?" Unhone kaha: "Jo usne imam ke saath padhi, kyunki Abu Hurairah ne humein bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: 'Aadmi ki jama'at mein namaz uski akeli namaz se biis-o-kuchh (baees ke qareeb) hisson se zyada hai.'"

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" صَلَاةُ الرَّجُلِ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ تَزِيدُ عَلَى صَلَاتِهِ وَحْدَهُ سَبْعًا وَعِشْرِينَ دَرَجَةً "
2.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Yahya, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Abdullah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The prayer of a man in congregation exceeds his prayer alone by twenty-seven degrees."
2.hi: Musaddad ne Yahya se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Abdullah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Aadmi ki jama'at mein namaz uski akeli namaz se satais darjay zyada hai."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا اسْتَأْذَنَتْ أَحَدَكُمْ زَوْجَتُهُ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ، فَلَا يَمْنَعْهَا "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from al-Awza'i, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn Umar: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of your wife asks his permission to [go to] the mosque, let him not prevent her."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne al-Awza'i se, al-Zuhri se, Salim se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se kisi ki biwi masjid jaane ki ijaazat maange, to woh use na roke."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا تَمْنَعُوا إِمَاءَ اللَّهِ مَسَاجِدَ اللَّهِ، وَلْيَخْرُجْنَ إِذَا خَرَجْنَ تَفِلَاتٍ ".
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، بِإِسْنَادِ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ.
قَالَ : قَالَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ : التَّفِلَةُ : الَّتِي لَا طِيبَ لَهَا
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah; a similar chain also via Sa'id ibn Amir, with Sa'id's clarification: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do not prevent the female servants of Allah from the mosques of Allah, and let them go out, when they go out, unperfumed." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Sa'id ibn Amir, from Muhammad ibn Amr, with the chain of this hadith.] Sa'id ibn Amir said: "Tafilah" is: she who has no perfume on her.
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah ki bandiyon ko Allah ki masjidon mein jaane se na roko, aur jab woh nikalein to bagair khushbu lagaaye nikalein." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Sa'id ibn Amir se, Muhammad ibn Amr se bhi aayi hai.] Sa'id ibn Amir kehte hain: "Tafilah" us aurat ko kehte hain jispar koi khushbu na lagi ho.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ،  عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا وُضِعَ الْعَشَاءُ وَحَضَرَتْ الصَّلَاةُ، فَابْدَءُوا بِالْعَشَاءِ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When dinner is served and the prayer time comes, begin with dinner."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Hisham se, apne walid se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab khaana rakh diya jaaye aur namaz ka waqt aa jaaye, to pehle khaana khaao."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، وَسُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" إِذَا حَضَرَ الْعَشَاءُ وَأُقِيمَتْ الصَّلَاةُ، فَابْدَءُوا بِالْعَشَاءِ "
2.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, and Sulayman ibn Kathir, from al-Zuhri, from Anas ibn Malik: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When dinner is present and the prayer is established, begin with dinner."
2.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah aur Sulayman ibn Kathir se, al-Zuhri se, Anas ibn Malik se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jab khaana maujood ho aur namaz ki iqamah ho jaaye, to pehle khaana khaao."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِذَا أَتَيْتُمْ الصَّلَاةَ، فَلَا تَأْتُوهَا تَسْعَوْنَ، وَأْتُوهَا تَمْشُونَ وَعَلَيْكُمْ السَّكِينَةُ، فَمَا أَدْرَكْتُمْ فَصَلُّوا وَمَا فَاتَكُمْ، فَأَتِمُّوا "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Ibn Uyaynah, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "When you come to the prayer, do not come to it running, and come to it walking, and let there be tranquility upon you; what you catch, pray, and what you have missed, complete [make up]."
2.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Ibn Uyaynah se, al-Zuhri se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jab tum namaz ke liye aao, to daudte hue na aao, aur chalte hue aao, aur tumpar sukoon rahe; jo tum paa lo woh padho, aur jo chhoot jaaye use poora karo."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا أَتَيْتُمْ الصَّلَاةَ فَعَلَيْكُمْ بِالسَّكِينَةِ، فَمَا أَدْرَكْتُمْ، فَصَلُّوا، وَمَا سُبِقْتُمْ، فَأَتِمُّوا "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Shayban, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah, from his father: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When you come to the prayer, you must have tranquility, so what you catch, pray, and what you have been preceded in, complete [make up]."
2.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Shayban se, Yahya ibn Abi Kathir se, Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum namaz ke liye aao, to sukoon rakho, so jo tum paa lo woh padho, aur jismein tumse pehle ho chuka ho use poora karo."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا التَّيْمِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ  ، عَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَجُلٌ بِالْمَدِينَةِ لَا أَعْلَمُ بِالْمَدِينَةِ مِمَّنْ يُصَلِّي إِلَى الْقِبْلَةِ أَبْعَدَ مَنْزِلًا مِنْ الْمَسْجِدِ مِنْهُ، وَكَانَ يُصَلَّي الصَّلَوَاتِ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ : لَوْ ابْتَعْتَ حِمَارًا تَرْكَبُهُ فِي الرَّمْضَاءِ وَالظَّلْمَاءِ؟ قَالَ : وَاللَّهِ مَا يَسُرُّنِي أَنَّ مَنْزِلِي بِلِزْقِ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَأُخْبِرَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِذَلِكَ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، كَيْمَا يُكْتَبَ أَثَرِي وَخُطَايَ، وَرُجُوعِي إِلَى أَهْلِي، وَإِقْبَالِي وَإِدْبَارِي، أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ.
فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَنْطَاكَ اللَّهُ ذَلِكَ كُلَّهُ، وَأَعْطَاكَ مَا احْتَسَبْتَ أَجْمَعَ " أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Taymi, from Abu Uthman, from Ubayy ibn Ka'b: He said: There was a man in Madinah - I do not know of anyone in Madinah among those who prayed toward the Qiblah who had a dwelling farther from the mosque than him - and he used to pray the prayers with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so it was said to him: "Why don't you buy a donkey to ride on in the scorching heat and the darkness?" He said: "By Allah, it would not please me for my dwelling to be adjacent to the mosque." So the Prophet ﷺ was informed of that and asked him about it, so he said: "O Messenger of Allah, so that my tracks and my steps, and my return to my family, and my going and coming, be recorded" - or words to that effect. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah has given you all of that, and has given you all that you sought reward for" - or words to that effect.
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Taymi se, Abu Uthman se, Ubayy ibn Ka'b se bataya: Unhone kaha, Madinah mein ek aadmi tha - main Madinah mein Qibla ki taraf namaz padhne walon mein se aisa koi nahi jaanta jiska ghar masjid se usse zyada door ho - aur woh Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath namazein padha karta tha, so usse kaha gaya: "Tum ek gadha kyun nahi khareed lete jispar tez dhoop aur andhere mein sawaar ho sako?" Usne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, mujhe achha nahi lagta ke mera ghar masjid se sata hua ho." To yeh baat Nabi ﷺ ko batayi gayi aur aapne usse iske baare mein poocha, to usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, taake mere qadam ke nishaan aur mere qadam, aur apne ghar wapas jaana, aur mera aana aur jaana likha jaaye" - ya isi tarah kuch kaha. To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Allah ne tumhein yeh sab de diya, aur jo bhi tumne sawaab ki niyat ki thi woh sab tumhein de diya" - ya isi tarah farmaya.

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُبَيْدٍ هُوَ عَبْثَرُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ  ، عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ يَسَافٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخَذَ بِيَدِي زِيَادُ بْنُ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ  ، فَأَقَامَنِي عَلَى شَيْخٍ مِنْ بَنِي أَسَدٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ : وَابِصَةُ بْنُ مَعْبَدٍ  ، فَقَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي هَذَا وَالرَّجُلُ يَسْمَعُ أَنَّهُ رَأَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَقَدْ صَلَّى خَلْفَهُ رَجُلٌ، وَلَمْ يَتَّصِلْ بِالصُّفُوفِ،" فَأَمَرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْ يُعِيدَ الصَّلَاةَ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : كَانَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ يُثْبِتُ حَدِيثَ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، وَأَنَا أَذْهَبُ إِلَى حَدِيثِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ زِيَادِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ
2.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Zubayd (Abthar ibn al-Qasim), from Husayn, from Hilal ibn Yasaf, from Wabisah ibn Ma'bad; with Abu Muhammad's note: He said: Ziyad ibn Abi al-Ja'd took my hand, and stood me before a shaykh from Banu Asad called Wabisah ibn Ma'bad, and he said: This one narrated to me, while the man was listening, that he saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and a man had prayed behind him and had not connected with the rows, "so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded him to repeat the prayer." Abu Muhammad said: Ahmad ibn Hanbal used to affirm the hadith of Amr ibn Murrah, but I go by the hadith of Yazid ibn Ziyad ibn Abi al-Ja'd.
2.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Zubayd (jo Abthar ibn al-Qasim hain) se, Husayn se, Hilal ibn Yasaf se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ziyad ibn Abi al-Ja'd ne mera haath pakda, aur mujhe Banu Asad ke ek shaykh, Wabisah ibn Ma'bad naam ke, ke saamne khada kiya, aur kaha: Isne mujhse bataya, jabke woh aadmi khud sun raha tha, ke unhone Rasulullah ﷺ ko dekha, aur ek aadmi ne aapke peechhe namaz padhi thi aur safon se juda nahi hua tha, "so Rasulullah ﷺ ne use namaz dohraane ka hukum diya." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Ahmad ibn Hanbal Amr ibn Murrah ki riwayat ko sahih maanate the, lekin main Yazid ibn Ziyad ibn Abi al-Ja'd ki riwayat par amal karta hoon.

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دَاوُدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ  ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ  ، عَنْ وَابِصَةَ بْنِ مَعْبَدٍ  ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا صَلَّى خَلْفَ الصُّفُوفِ وَحْدَهُ،" فَأَمَرَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْ يُعِيدَ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : أَقُولُ بِهَذَا
2.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Abdullah ibn Da'ud, from Yazid ibn Ziyad, from Ubayd ibn Abi al-Ja'd, from Ziyad ibn Abi al-Ja'd, from Wabisah ibn Ma'bad; with Abu Muhammad's confirmation: That a man prayed behind the rows alone, "so the Prophet ﷺ commanded him to repeat [the prayer]." Abu Muhammad said: I hold to this.
2.hi: Musaddad ne Abdullah ibn Da'ud se, Yazid ibn Ziyad se, Ubayd ibn Abi al-Ja'd se, Ziyad ibn Abi al-Ja'd se, Wabisah ibn Ma'bad se bataya ke ek aadmi ne safon ke peechhe akele namaz padhi, "so Nabi ﷺ ne use dohraane ka hukum diya." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Main isi par amal karta hoon.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ  ،  عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، أَنَّ جَدَّتَهُ مُلَيْكَةَ دَعَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِطَعَامٍ صَنَعَتْهُ، فَأَكَلَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ :" قُومُوا فَلِأُصَلِّيَ بِكُمْ "، قَالَ أَنَسٌ : فَقُمْتُ إِلَى حَصِيرٍ لَنَا قَدْ اسْوَدَّ مِنْ طُولِ مَا لُبِسَ، فَنَضَحْتُهُ بِمَاءٍ، فَقَامَ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَصَفَفْتُ أَنَا وَالْيَتِيمُ وَرَاءَهُ، وَالْعَجُوزُ وَرَاءَنَا، فَصَلَّى لَنَا رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ
2.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Malik, from Ishaq ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah, from Anas ibn Malik, about his grandmother Mulaykah: That his grandmother Mulaykah invited the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for food she had prepared, so he ate, then said: "Rise, so I may pray with you [leading you]." Anas said: So I stood toward a mat of ours which had become black from long use, so I sprinkled it with water, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood on it, and I and the orphan lined up behind him, and the old woman [was] behind us, so he prayed two rak'ahs for us, then departed.
2.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Malik se, Ishaq ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah se, Anas ibn Malik se bataya ke unki dadi Mulaykah ne Rasulullah ﷺ ko woh khaana khaane bulaaya jo unhone banaya tha, so aapne khaya, fir farmaya: "Uthiye, main aapko namaz padhaaun." Anas ne bataya: So main humare us chatai ki taraf gaya jo lambe istemal se kaali ho chuki thi, so maine use paani se chidka, aur Rasulullah ﷺ uspar khade hue, aur main aur yateem aapke peechhe saf mein khade hue, aur budhi aurat humare peechhe, so aapne humein do rakat namaz padhaayi, fir chale gaye.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ زَاذَانَ  ، عَنْ الْوَلِيدِ : أَبِي بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الصِّدِّيقِ النَّاجِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" يَقُومُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأُولَيَيْنِ مِنْ الظُّهْرِ قَدْرَ ثَلَاثِينَ آيَةً، وَفِي الْأُخْرَيَيْنِ عَلَى قَدْرِ النِّصْفِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ، وَفِي الْعَصْرِ عَلَى قَدْرِ الْأُخْرَيَيْنِ مِنْ الظُّهْرِ، وَفِي الْأُخْرَيَيْنِ عَلَى قَدْرِ النِّصْفِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ "، أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ الْوَلِيدِ أَبِي بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الصِّدِّيقِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ   بِنَحْوِهِ، وَزَادَ : قَدْرَ قِرَاءَةِ الم تَنْزِيلُ السَّجْدَةِ
2.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hammad, from Abu Awanah, from Mansur ibn Zadhan, from al-Walid Abu Bishr, from Abu al-Siddiq al-Naji, from Abu Sa'id; a similar chain also via Amr ibn Awn, from Hushaym: That the Prophet ﷺ used to "stand in the first two rak'ahs of Zuhr for about the measure of thirty verses, and in the last two, about half of that, and in Asr, about the measure of the last two of Zuhr, and in its last two, about half of that." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Amr ibn Awn, from Hushaym, from Mansur, from al-Walid Abu Bishr, from Abu al-Siddiq, from Abu Sa'id, with an addition: about the measure of the recitation of "Alif Lam Mim, Tanzil" of al-Sajdah.]
2.hi: Yahya ibn Hammad ne Abu Awanah se, Mansur ibn Zadhan se, al-Walid Abu Bishr se, Abu al-Siddiq al-Naji se, Abu Sa'id se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ "Zuhr ki pehli do rakaton mein taqreeban tees aayaton ki miqdar tak qayam karte, aur aakhri do mein uske aadhe ki miqdar tak, aur Asr mein Zuhr ki aakhri do rakaton ki miqdar tak, aur uski aakhri do mein uske aadhe ki miqdar tak." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Amr ibn Awn se, Hushaym se, Mansur se, al-Walid Abu Bishr se, Abu al-Siddiq se, Abu Sa'id se bhi aayi hai, is izafe ke saath: 'Alif Lam Mim Tanzil' Surah As-Sajdah ki qiraat ki miqdar tak.]

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" يَقْرَأُ فِي الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ بِالسَّمَاءِ وَالطَّارِقِ، وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الْبُرُوجِ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Simak ibn Harb, from Jabir ibn Samurah: That the Prophet ﷺ used to "recite in Zuhr and Asr 'By the sky and the night comer' [Surah al-Tariq], and 'By the sky containing the great stars' [Surah al-Buruj]."
2.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Simak ibn Harb se, Jabir ibn Samurah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ "Zuhr aur Asr mein 'Was-samaa'i wat-Tariq' [Surah At-Tariq], aur 'Was-samaa'i dhaatil-Buruj' [Surah Al-Buruj] padhte the."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" يَقْرَأُ بِأُمِّ الْقُرْآنِ وَبِسُورَتَيْنِ مَعَهَا فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأُولَيَيْنِ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ وَصَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ، وَيُسْمِعُنَا الْآيَةَ أَحْيَانًا، وَكَانَ يُطَوِّلُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الْأُولَى ".
 أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، بِإِسْنَادِهِ نَحْوَهُ
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah, from his father; a similar chain also via Abu Asim: That the Prophet ﷺ used to "recite the Mother of the Qur'an and two surahs with it in the first two rak'ahs of the Zuhr prayer and the Asr prayer, and make us hear the verse sometimes, and he used to prolong the first rak'ah." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Abu Asim, from al-Awza'i, from Yahya, with his chain.]
2.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se, Yahya se, Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah se, apne walid se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ "Zuhr aur Asr ki pehli do rakaton mein Umm-ul-Quran (Surah Al-Fatihah) aur uske saath do surahtein padhte, aur kabhi-kabhi humein aayat sunaate, aur pehli rakat lambi rakhte." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Abu Asim se, al-Awza'i se, Yahya se bhi aayi hai.]

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ  ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ   حَدَّثَهُ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" يَقْرَأُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأُولَيَيْنِ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ بِأُمِّ الْكِتَابِ وَبِسُورَتَيْنِ، وَفِي الْأُخْرَيَيْنِ بِأُمِّ الْكِتَابِ، وَكَانَ يُسْمِعُنَا الْآيَةَ، وَكَانَ يُطِيلُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الْأُولَى مَا لَا يُطِيلُ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ، وَهَكَذَا فِي صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ، وَهَكَذَا فِي صَلَاةِ الْغَدَاةِ "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hammam, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah, from his father: That the Prophet ﷺ used to "recite in the first two rak'ahs of the Zuhr prayer the Mother of the Book and two surahs, and in the last two, the Mother of the Book, and he used to make us hear the verse, and he used to prolong the first rak'ah longer than he prolonged the second, and likewise in the Asr prayer, and likewise in the morning prayer."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hammam se, Yahya ibn Abi Kathir se, Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah se, apne walid se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ "Zuhr ki pehli do rakaton mein Umm-ul-Kitab aur do surahtein padhte, aur aakhri do mein sirf Umm-ul-Kitab, aur humein aayat sunaate, aur pehli rakat ko doosri se zyada lamba karte, aur isi tarah Asr mein, aur isi tarah Fajr mein."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ،  عَنْ أُمِّ الْفَضْلِ  ، أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتْ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يَقْرَأُ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ بِ : وَالْمُرْسَلَاتِ "
2.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Yunus, from al-Zuhri, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah, from Ibn Abbas, from Umm al-Fadl: That she heard the Prophet ﷺ "recite in Maghrib: 'By those sent forth' [Surah al-Mursalat]."
2.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Yunus se, al-Zuhri se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah se, Ibn Abbas se, Umm al-Fadl se bataya ke unhone Nabi ﷺ ko "Maghrib mein 'Wal-mursalaat' [Surah Al-Mursalat] padhte suna."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يَقْرَأُ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ بِوَالطُّورِ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Ibn Uyaynah, from al-Zuhri, from Muhammad ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im, from his father: That he heard the Prophet ﷺ "recite in Maghrib 'By the Mount' [Surah al-Tur]."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Ibn Uyaynah se, al-Zuhri se, Muhammad ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im se, apne walid se bataya ke unhone Nabi ﷺ ko "Maghrib mein 'Wat-Tur' [Surah At-Tur] padhte suna."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، أَنَّ مُعَاذًا كَانَ يُصَلِّي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، ثُمَّ يَأْتِي قَوْمَهُ فَيُصَلِّي بِهِمْ، فَجَاءَ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ فَصَلَّى الْعَتَمَةَ، وَقَرَأَ الْبَقَرَةَ، فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ الْأَنْصَارِ فَصَلَّى، ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ، فَبَلَغَهُ أَنَّ مُعَاذًا يَنَالُ مِنْهُ، فَشَكَى ذَلِكَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِمُعَاذٍ :" فَاتِنًا، فَاتِنًا، فَاتِنًا، أَوْ فَتَّانًا، فَتَّانًا، فَتَّانًا، ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ بِسُورَتَيْنِ مِنْ وَسَطِ الْمُفَصَّلِ ".
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : نَأْخُذُ بِهَذَا
2.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Jabir ibn Abdullah; with Abu Muhammad's note: That Mu'adh used to pray with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, then come to his people and lead them in prayer, so he came one night and prayed Isha, and recited al-Baqarah, so a man from the Ansar came and prayed, then left, then it reached him that Mu'adh was speaking against him, so he complained of that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Mu'adh: "A trial-maker, a trial-maker, a trial-maker" - or "a mischief-maker, a mischief-maker, a mischief-maker" - then he commanded him to [recite] two surahs from the middle of the mufassal. Abu Muhammad said: We take this [view].
