2.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Jabir ibn Abdullah se bataya ke Mu'adh Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath namaz padhte, fir apni qaum ke paas jaakar unhein namaz padhaate, so ek raat aaye aur Isha padhi, aur Surah Al-Baqarah padhi, so Ansar ka ek aadmi aaya aur namaz padhi, fir chala gaya, fir usay khabar mili ke Mu'adh uske baare mein bura keh rahe hain, so usne iski shikayat Rasulullah ﷺ se ki, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne Mu'adh se farmaya: "Fitna daalne wale, fitna daalne wale, fitna daalne wale" - ya "logon ko azmaish mein daalne wale, azmaish mein daalne wale, azmaish mein daalne wale" - fir aapne unhein mufassal (chhoti surahton) ke beech ki do surahtein [padhne] ka hukum diya. Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Hum isi par amal karte hain.

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلَاقَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَمِّي   يَقُولُ : إِنَّهُ صَلَّى مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَسَمِعَهُ" يَقْرَأُ فِي إِحْدَى الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ مِنْ الصُّبْحِ وَالنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَاتٍ ".
قَالَ شُعْبَةُ : وَسَأَلْتُهُ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُهُ يَقْرَأُ بـقَ
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Ziyad ibn Alaqah, from his uncle: He said: I heard my uncle say: that he prayed with the Prophet ﷺ, and heard him "recite in one of the two rak'ahs of Subh 'And the towering palm trees' [Surah Qaf, verse 10]." Shu'bah said: And I asked him another time, he said: I heard him recite Surah Qaf.
2.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se, Ziyad ibn Alaqah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine apne chacha ko kehte suna: ke unhone Nabi ﷺ ke saath namaz padhi, aur aapko "Subh ki do rakaton mein se ek mein 'Wan-nakhla baasiqaat' [Surah Qaf, aayat 10] padhte suna." Shu'bah kehte hain: Aur maine unse ek aur martaba poocha, unhone kaha: Maine unhein Surah Qaf padhte suna.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا قَبِيصَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلَاقَةَ  ، عَنْ قُطْبَةَ بْنِ مَالِكٍ   قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يَقْرَأُ فِي الْفَجْرِ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الْأُولَى : وَالنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَاتٍ لَهَا طَلْعٌ نَضِيدٌ "
2.en: Narrated by Qabisah, from Sufyan, from Ziyad ibn Alaqah, from Qutbah ibn Malik: He said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ "recite in Fajr in the first rak'ah: 'And the towering palm trees, having [fruit] arranged in layers' [Surah Qaf, verse 10]."
2.hi: Qabisah ne Sufyan se, Ziyad ibn Alaqah se, Qutbah ibn Malik se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Nabi ﷺ ko "Fajr ki pehli rakat mein 'Wan-nakhla baasiqaatil-laha tal'un nadeed' [Surah Qaf, aayat 10] padhte suna."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ  ، عَنْ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ سَرِيعٍ  ،  عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يَقْرَأُ فِي صَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ إِذَا الشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ، فَلَمَّا انْتَهَى إِلَى هَذِهِ الْآيَةِ # وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ سورة التكوير آية 17 #، جَعَلْتُ أَقُولُ فِي نَفْسِي : مَا اللَّيْلُ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ؟ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ  ، عَنْ الْوَلِيدِ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ  ، بِنَحْوِهِ
2.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from al-Mas'udi, from al-Walid ibn Sari', from Amr ibn Hurayth; a similar chain also via Mis'ar: That he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "recite in the Subh prayer 'When the sun is wrapped up' [Surah al-Takwir], and when he reached this verse: 'And the night as it recedes' [Surah al-Takwir, verse 17], I began saying to myself: What is meant by 'the night as it recedes'?" [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Abu Nu'aym, from Mis'ar, from al-Walid, from Amr ibn Hurayth.]
2.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne al-Mas'udi se, al-Walid ibn Sari' se, Amr ibn Hurayth se bataya ke unhone Rasulullah ﷺ ko "Subh ki namaz mein 'Idhash-shamsu kuwwirat' [Surah At-Takwir] padhte suna, aur jab aap is aayat par pahunche: 'Wal-layli idhaa 'as'as' [Surah At-Takwir, aayat 17], to main apne dil mein kehne laga: 'Al-layli idhaa 'as'as' ka kya matlab hai?" [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Abu Nu'aym se, Mis'ar se, al-Walid se, Amr ibn Hurayth se bhi aayi hai.]

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَوْفٌ  ، عَنْ سَيَّارِ بْنِ سَلَامَةَ  ، قَالَ : دَخَلْتُ مَعَ أَبِي عَلَى أَبِي بَرْزَةَ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ   وَهُوَ عَلَى عُلْوٍ مِنْ قَصَبٍ، فَسَأَلَهُ أَبِي عَنْ وَقْتِ صَلَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : " كَانَيُصَلِّي الْهَجِيرَ الَّتِي تَدْعُونَ الظُّهْرَ إِذَا دَحَضَتْ الشَّمْسُ، وَكَانَ يُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ ثُمَّ يَنْطَلِقُ أَحَدُنَا إِلَى أَهْلِهِ فِي أَقْصَى الْمَدِينَةِ وَالشَّمْسُ حَيَّةٌ قَالَ : وَنَسِيتُ مَا ذَكَرَ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ ، وَكَانَ يَسْتَحِبُّ أَنْ يُؤَخِّرَ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْعِشَاءِ الَّتِي تَدْعُونَ الْعَتَمَةَ، وَكَانَ يَنْصَرِفُ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ وَالرَّجُلُ يَعْرِفُ جَلِيسَهُ، وَكَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِيهَا مِنْ السِّتِّينَ إِلَى الْمِئَةِ "
2.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Awf, from Sayyar ibn Salamah, about Abu Barzah al-Aslami: He said: I entered with my father upon Abu Barzah al-Aslami, and he was on an upper floor of reed, so my father asked him about the time of the Messenger of Allah's ﷺ prayer, so he said: "He used to pray the midday prayer, which you call Zuhr, when the sun had declined, and he used to pray Asr, then one of us would go to his family at the far end of Madinah while the sun was still bright." He said: "And I forgot what he mentioned about Maghrib," "and he used to love to delay the Isha prayer, which you call al-'Atamah, and he used to finish the Subh prayer while a man could recognize the one sitting next to him, and he used to recite in it from sixty to a hundred [verses]."
2.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Awf se, Sayyar ibn Salamah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main apne walid ke saath Abu Barzah al-Aslami ke paas gaya, aur woh nay/sarkanday ke ek upari maale par the, so mere walid ne unse Rasulullah ﷺ ki namaz ke waqt ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: "Aap dopahar ki namaz, jise tum Zuhr kehte ho, us waqt padhte jab suraj dhal jaata, aur aap Asr padhte, fir humein se koi apne ghar Madinah ke doosre kinaare tak jaata jabke suraj abhi tez hota." Unhone bataya: "Aur mujhe yaad nahi raha ke unhone Maghrib ke baare mein kya kaha," "aur aap Isha ki namaz ko, jise tum al-Atamah kehte ho, der se padhna pasand karte, aur aap Subh ki namaz us waqt khatam karte jab ek aadmi apne saath baithe wale ko pehchaan sakta, aur aap usmein saath se sau [aayaton] tak padhte the."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ خَلِيلٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ  ، أَنْبأَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ الْمُسَيَّبِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ تَمِيمِ بْنِ طَرَفَةَ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ  ، قَالَ : دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْمَسْجِدَ وَقَدْ رَفَعُوا أَبْصَارَهُمْ فِي الصَّلَاةِ، فَقَالَ :" لَتَنْتَهُنَّ أَوْ لَا تَرْجِعُ إِلَيْكُمْ أَبْصَارُكُمْ "
2.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Khalil, from Ali ibn Mushir, from al-A'mash, from al-Musayyab ibn Rafi', from Tamim ibn Tarafah, from Jabir ibn Samurah: He said: The Prophet ﷺ entered the mosque and [some people] had raised their eyes during the prayer, so he said: "You must stop, or your eyes will not return to you."
2.hi: Isma'il ibn Khalil ne Ali ibn Mushir se, al-A'mash se, al-Musayyab ibn Rafi' se, Tamim ibn Tarafah se, Jabir ibn Samurah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ masjid mein dakhil hue aur [kuch logon ne] namaz mein apni nazrein uthaayi hui thin, to aapne farmaya: "Ya to iss se ruk jao, warna tumhari aankhein tumhare paas wapas nahi aayengi."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَنَّهُ، قَالَ :" مَا بَالُ أَقْوَامٍ يَرْفَعُونَ أَبْصَارَهُمْ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فِي صَلَاتِهِمْ؟ " فَاشْتَدَّ قَوْلُهُ فِي ذَلِكَ حَتَّى قَالَ : " لَتَنْتَهُنَّ عَنْ ذَلِكَ أَوْ لَيَخْطَفَنَّ اللَّهُ أَبْصَارَكُمْ "
2.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Bishr, from Sa'id, from Qatadah, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ: That he said: "What is wrong with people who raise their eyes to the sky in their prayer?" So his statement about that grew severe until he said: "You must stop that, or Allah will surely snatch away your eyesight."
2.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Muhammad ibn Bishr se, Sa'id se, Qatadah se, Anas se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya ke aapne farmaya: "Un logon ko kya hua hai jo apni namaz mein aasmaan ki taraf nazrein uthaate hain?" To iske baare mein aapki baat sakht hoti gayi yahan tak ke aapne farmaya: "Ya to iss se ruk jao, warna Allah zaroor tumhari nazrein cheen lega."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو يَعْفُورٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي مُصْعَبُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ بَنُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ إِذَا رَكَعُوا، جَعَلُوا أَيْدِيَهُمْ بَيْنَ أَفْخَاذِهِمْ، فَصَلَّيْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِ سَعْدٍ  ، فَصَنَعْتُهُ، فَضَرَبَ يَدِي، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ، قَالَ : يَا بُنَيَّ، اضْرِبْ بِيَدَيْكَ رُكْبَتَيْكَ، ثُمَّ فَعَلْتُهُ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ بِيَوْمٍ فَصَلَّيْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، فَضَرَبَ يَدِي، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ قَالَ : " كُنَّا نَفْعَلُ هَذَا،وَأُمِرْنَا أَنْ نَضْرِبَ بِالْأَكُفِّ عَلَى الرُّكَبِ ".
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ  ، عَنْ مُصْعَبٍ  ، بِإِسْنَادِهِ نَحْوَهُ
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Isra'il, from Abu Ya'fur al-Abdi, from Mus'ab ibn Sa'd; a similar chain also via Isra'il, from Abu Ishaq, from Mus'ab: He said: The sons of Abdullah ibn Mas'ud, when they bowed, used to place their hands between their thighs, so I prayed next to Sa'd, and did that, so he struck my hand, and when he finished, he said: "O my son, strike your knees with your hands," then I did it another time after that, a day later, and I prayed next to him, and he struck my hand, and when he finished, he said: "We used to do this, and we were commanded to strike the knees with the palms." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Isra'il, from Abu Ishaq, from Mus'ab, with his chain.]
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Isra'il se, Abu Ya'fur al-Abdi se, Mus'ab ibn Sa'd se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ibn Mas'ud ke bete jab ruku karte, to apne haath apni raanon ke darmiyan rakh lete, so maine Sa'd ke pehlu mein namaz padhi, aur aisa hi kiya, to unhone mera haath maara, aur jab woh faarigh hue, to kaha: "Ae mere bete, apne haathon se apne ghutne pakdo," fir maine iske baad ek din phir aisa kiya aur unke pehlu mein namaz padhi, to unhone phir mera haath maara, aur jab woh faarigh hue to kaha: "Hum yeh kiya karte the, aur humein hukum diya gaya ke hum hatheliyon se ghutnon ko pakdein." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Muhammad ibn Yusuf se, Isra'il se, Abu Ishaq se, Mus'ab se bhi aayi hai.]

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَطَاءُ بْنُ السَّائِبِ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ الْبَرَّادِ  ، قَالَ : وَكَانَ عِنْدِي أَوْثَقَ عِنْدِي مِنْ نَفْسِي، قَالَ : قَالَ لَنَا أَبُو مَسْعُودٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ   : أَلَا أُصَلِّي بِكُمْ صَلَاةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" فَكَبَّرَ وَرَكَعَ، وَوَضَعَ يَدَيْهِ عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ، وَفَرَّجَ بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِهِ حَتَّى اسْتَقَرَّ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ مِنْهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Hammam, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Salim al-Barrad, about Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari: He said - and he was more trustworthy in my view than myself - Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari said to us: "Shall I not pray for you the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" He said: "So he said the takbir and bowed, and placed his hands on his knees, and spread his fingers apart until every part of him settled still."
2.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Hammam se, Ata ibn al-Sa'ib se, Salim al-Barrad se bataya: Unhone kaha - aur woh mere nazdeek mujhse zyada mo'tabar the - Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari ne humse kaha: "Kya main tumhein Rasulullah ﷺ ki namaz na padhaun?" Unhone bataya: "So unhone takbir kahi aur ruku kiya, aur apne haath apne ghutnon par rakhe, aur apni ungliyan phaila din yahan tak ke unke jism ka har hissa sukoon se aa gaya."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْمُقْرِئُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عَمِّي إِيَاسُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ  ، يَقُولُ : لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ # فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ سورة الواقعة آية 74 #، قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" اجْعَلُوهَا فِي رُكُوعِكُمْ "، فَلَمَّا نَزَلَتْ # سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الأَعْلَى سورة الأعلى آية 1 # قَالَ : " اجْعَلُوهَا فِي سُجُودِكُمْ "
2.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid al-Muqri, from Musa ibn Ayyub, from his uncle Iyas ibn Amir, from Uqbah ibn Amir: He said: I heard Uqbah ibn Amir say: When "'So glorify the name of your Lord, the Magnificent' [Surah al-Waqi'ah, verse 74]" was revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to us: "Make it in your bowing," so when "'Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High' [Surah al-A'la, verse 1]" was revealed, he said: "Make it in your prostration."
2.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid al-Muqri ne Musa ibn Ayyub se, apne chacha Iyas ibn Amir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Uqbah ibn Amir ko kehte suna: Jab "'Fa sabbih bismi Rabbikal-'Azeem' [Surah Al-Waqi'ah, aayat 74]" naazil hui, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne humse farmaya: "Ise apne ruku mein padho," fir jab "'Sabbih isma Rabbikal-A'la' [Surah Al-A'la, aayat 1]" naazil hui, to farmaya: "Ise apne sajde mein padho."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ الْمُسْتَوْرِدِ  ، عَنْ صِلَةَ بْنِ زُفَرَ  ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ  ، أَنَّهُ صَلَّى مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ، فَكَانَ يَقُولُ فِي رُكُوعِهِ :" سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ "، وَفِي سُجُودِهِ : " سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى "، وَمَا أَتَى عَلَى آيَةِ رَحْمَةٍ إِلَّا وَقَفَ عِنْدَهَا فَسَأَلَ، وَمَا أَتَى عَلَى آيَةِ عَذَابٍ إِلَّا تَعَوَّذَ
2.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Sulayman, from al-Mustawrid, from Silah ibn Zufar, from Hudhayfah: That he prayed with the Prophet ﷺ one night, and he used to say in his bowing: "Subhana Rabbiyal-Azim," and in his prostration: "Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la," and he never came upon a verse of mercy except that he stopped at it and asked [Allah], and he never came upon a verse of punishment except that he sought refuge [with Allah].
2.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Sulayman se, al-Mustawrid se, Silah ibn Zufar se, Hudhayfah se bataya ke unhone Nabi ﷺ ke saath ek raat namaz padhi, aur aap apne ruku mein kehte: "Subhana Rabbiyal-Azeem," aur apne sajde mein: "Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la," aur aap jab bhi kisi rehmat wali aayat par pahunchte to wahan ruk kar dua maangte, aur jab bhi kisi azaab wali aayat par pahunchte to panah maangte.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ  ، قَالَ : اجْتَمَعَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، وَأَبُو أُسَيْدٍ، وَأَبُو حُمَيْدٍ، وَسَهْلُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، فَذَكَرُوا صَلَاةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ أَبُو حُمَيْدٍ   : أَنَا أَعْلَمُكُمْ بِصَلَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" قَامَ فَكَبَّرَ وَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ، ثُمَّ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حِينَ كَبَّرَ لِلرُّكُوعِ، ثُمَّ رَكَعَ وَوَضَعَ يَدَيْهِ عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ كَأَنَّهُ قَابِضٌ عَلَيْهِمَا، وَوَتَرَ يَدَيْهِ فَنَحَّاهُمَا عَنْ جَنْبَيْهِ، وَلَمْ يُصَوِّبْ رَأْسَهُ، وَلَمْ يُقْنِعْهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Amir al-Aqadi, from Fulayh ibn Sulayman, from Abbas ibn Sahl, about Abu Humayd: He said: Muhammad ibn Maslamah, Abu Usayd, Abu Humayd, and Sahl ibn Sa'd gathered, and they mentioned the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Abu Humayd said: "I am the most knowledgeable of you concerning the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ 'stood and said the takbir and raised his hands, then raised his hands when he said the takbir for bowing, then he bowed and placed his hands on his knees as if gripping them, and held his hands firm, keeping them away from his sides, and did not point his head downward, nor raise it up.'"
2.hi: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ne Abu Amir al-Aqadi se, Fulayh ibn Sulayman se, Abbas ibn Sahl se bataya: Unhone kaha, Muhammad ibn Maslamah, Abu Usayd, Abu Humayd, aur Sahl ibn Sa'd jama hue, aur unhone Rasulullah ﷺ ki namaz ka zikr kiya. Abu Humayd ne kaha: "Main tum sab mein Rasulullah ﷺ ki namaz ke baare mein sabse zyada jaanne wala hoon; Rasulullah ﷺ 'khade hote aur takbir kehte aur apne haath uthaate, fir ruku ke liye takbir kehte waqt haath uthaate, fir ruku karte aur apne haath apne ghutnon par is tarah rakhte jaise unhein pakad rahe hon, aur apne haathon ko mazbooti se apne pehluon se door rakhte, aur na apna sar neeche jhukaate, na upar uthaate.'"

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا افْتَتَحَ الصَّلَاةَ، رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حَذْوَ مَنْكِبَيْهِ، فَإِذَا رَكَعَ، فَعَلَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، وَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنْ الرُّكُوعِ، فَعَلَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، وَقَالَ :" سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ "، وَلَا يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ فِي السُّجُودِ.
أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، مِثْلَهُ.
إِلَّا أَنَّهُ قَالَ : " رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ "
2.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim, from his father; a similar chain also via Uthman ibn Umar, from Malik ibn Anas, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn Umar: He said: The Prophet ﷺ, when he opened the prayer, would raise his hands level with his shoulders, and when he bowed, he would do the like of that, and when he raised his head from bowing, he would do the like of that, and would say: "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah, Allahumma Rabbana wa lakal-hamd," and he did not do that in the prostration. [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Uthman ibn Umar, from Malik ibn Anas, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet ﷺ, the like of it, except that he said: "Rabbana wa lakal-hamd."]
2.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Ibn Shihab se, Salim se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ jab namaz shuru karte, to apne haath apne kandhon ke barabar uthaate, aur jab ruku karte, to isi tarah karte, aur jab ruku se sar uthaate, to isi tarah karte, aur farmaate: "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah, Allahumma Rabbana wa lakal-hamd," aur sajde mein aisa na karte. [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se, Uthman ibn Umar se, Malik ibn Anas se, al-Zuhri se, Salim se, Ibn Umar se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai, siwaay iske ke usmein "Rabbana wa lakal-hamd" kaha gaya hai.]

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" وَإِذَا قَالَ الْإِمَامُ : سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، فَقُولُوا : رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ "
2.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ: That he said: "And when the imam says: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah,' say: 'Rabbana wa lakal-hamd.'"
2.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Malik se, Ibn Shihab se, Anas se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya ke aapne farmaya: "Aur jab imam kahe: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah,' to tum kaho: 'Rabbana wa lakal-hamd.'"

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " إِنَّمَاجُعِلَ الْإِمَامُ لِيُؤْتَمَّ بِهِ، فَإِذَا كَبَّرَ، فَكَبِّرُوا، وَإِذَا رَكَعَ، فَارْكَعُوا وَإِذَا سَجَدَ فَاسْجُدُوا، وَإِذَا قَالَ : سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، فَقُولُوا : اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ، وَإِذَا صَلَّى قَائِمًا، فَصَلُّوا قِيَامًا، وَإِذَا صَلَّى جَالِسًا، فَصَلُّوا جُلُوسًا أَجْمَعُونَ "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The imam is only appointed to be followed; so when he says the takbir, say the takbir, and when he bows, bow, and when he prostrates, prostrate, and when he says: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah,' say: 'Allahumma Rabbana lakal-hamd,' and if he prays standing, pray standing, and if he prays sitting, pray sitting, all of you."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Imam sirf isliye banaya jaata hai ke uski pairwi ki jaaye; so jab woh takbir kahe, to tum bhi takbir kaho, aur jab woh ruku kare, to tum bhi ruku karo, aur jab woh sajda kare, to tum bhi sajda karo, aur jab woh kahe: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah,' to tum kaho: 'Allahumma Rabbana lakal-hamd,' aur agar woh khade hokar padhe, to tum bhi khade hokar padho, aur agar woh baith kar padhe, to tum sab bhi baith kar padho."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ حِطَّانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى  ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَطَبَنَا فَعَلَّمَنَا صَلَاتَنَا وَسَنَّ لَنَا سُنَّتَنَا قَالَ : أَحْسَبُهُ قَالَ :" إِذَا أُقِيمَتْ الصَّلَاةُ، فَلْيَؤُمَّكُمْ أَحَدُكُمْ، فَإِذَا كَبَّرَ، فَكَبِّرُوا، وَإِذَا قَالَ : # غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلا الضَّالِّينَ سورة الفاتحة آية 7 #، فَقُولُوا : آمِينَ، يُجِبْكُمْ اللَّهُ، وَإِذَا كَبَّرَ وَرَكَعَ، فَكَبِّرُوا وَارْكَعُوا، فَإِنَّ الْإِمَامَ يَرْكَعُ قَبْلَكُمْ، وَيَرْفَعُ قَبْلَكُمْ قَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : فَتِلْكَ بِتِلْكَ، وَإِذَا قَالَ : سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، فَقُولُوا : اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَوْ قَالَ : رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ G قَالَ عَلَى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّهِ : سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Sa'id ibn Abi Arubah, from Qatadah, from Yunus ibn Jubayr, from Hittan ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi, from Abu Musa: That he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ addressed us and taught us our prayer and established our practice for us, he said: I think he said: "When the prayer is established, let one of you lead you; when he says the takbir, say the takbir, and when he says: 'Not of those who have earned [Your] anger, nor of those who have gone astray' [Surah al-Fatihah, verse 7], say: 'Amin,' Allah will respond to you; and when he says the takbir and bows, say the takbir and bow, for the imam bows before you, and rises before you." The Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: "So that is for that." "And when he says: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah,' say: 'Allahumma Rabbana lakal-hamd,'" or he said: "'Rabbana lakal-hamd,' for indeed Allah, exalted is He, said on the tongue of His Prophet: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah.'"
2.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Sa'id ibn Abi Arubah se, Qatadah se, Yunus ibn Jubayr se, Hittan ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi se, Abu Musa se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein khutba diya aur humein humari namaz sikhaayi aur humare liye humara tareeqa qaayam kiya, unhone kaha: mera khayal hai aapne farmaya: "Jab namaz ki iqamah ho, to tum mein se koi ek tumhein padhaaye; jab woh takbir kahe, to tum bhi takbir kaho, aur jab woh kahe: 'Ghayril-maghdoobi 'alayhim wa lad-dalleen' [Surah Al-Fatihah, aayat 7], to tum 'Ameen' kaho, Allah tumhari dua qabool karega; aur jab woh takbir kahe aur ruku kare, to tum bhi takbir kaho aur ruku karo, kyunki imam tumse pehle ruku karta hai, aur tumse pehle uthta hai." Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "So woh us [pehle uthne] ke badle mein hai." "Aur jab woh kahe: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah,' to tum kaho: 'Allahumma Rabbana lakal-hamd,'" ya aapne kaha: "'Rabbana lakal-hamd,' kyunki Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ki zubaan par farmaya: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah.'"

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ  ، عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ قَزَعَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنْ الرُّكُوعِ، قَالَ :" رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الْأَرْضِ، وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدُ، أَهْلَ الثَّنَاءِ وَالْمَجْدِ، أَحَقُّ مَا قَالَ الْعَبْدُ، وَكُلُّنَا لَكَ عَبْدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ "
2.en: Narrated by Marwan ibn Muhammad, from Sa'id ibn Abd al-Aziz, from Atiyyah ibn Qays, from Qaza'ah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he raised his head from bowing, said: "Rabbana lakal-hamd mil'as-samawati wa mil'al-ardi, wa mil'a ma shi'ta min shay'in ba'du, ahlath-thana'i wal-majdi, ahaqqu ma qalal-'abdu, wa kulluna laka 'abdun, Allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayta, wa la mu'tiya lima mana'ta, wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jaddu."
2.hi: Marwan ibn Muhammad ne Sa'id ibn Abd al-Aziz se, Atiyyah ibn Qays se, Qaza'ah se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ jab ruku se sar uthaate, to farmaate: "Rabbana lakal-hamdu mil'as-samawaati wa mil'al-ardi, wa mil'a ma shi'ta min shay'im ba'd, ahlath-thanaa'i wal-majd, ahaqqu ma qaalal-'abd, wa kullunaa laka 'abd, Allahumma laa maani'a limaa a'tayt, wa laa mu'tiya limaa mana'ta, wa laa yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd" [Ae humare Rab, tera hi shukar hai, aasmanon ko bhar dene wala aur zameen ko bhar dene wala, aur us se aage jo kuch tu chahe use bhar dene wala, saraahna aur azmat ke laayak, jo banda kahe usse zyada sacha, aur hum sab tere bande hain, Ae Allah, jo tu de use koi rokne wala nahi, aur jo tu roke use koi dene wala nahi, aur kisi bhagya-shaali ke liye uski khush-naseebi teri taraf se kuch faida nahi de sakti].

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَمِّهْ الْمَاجِشُونَ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنْ الرُّكُوعِ، قَالَ :" سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الْأَرْضِ، وَمِلْءَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا، وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدُ ".
قِيلَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ : تَأْخُذُ بِهِ؟ قَالَ : لَا، وَقِيلَ لَهُ : تَقُولُ هَذَا فِي الْفَرِيضَةِ؟ قَالَ : عَسَى، وَقَالَ : كُلُّهُ طَيِّبٌ
2.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Salamah, from his uncle al-Majishun, from al-A'raj, from Ubaydullah ibn Abi Rafi', from Ali ibn Abi Talib; with Abdullah al-Darimi's response: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he raised his head from bowing, said: "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah, Rabbana wa lakal-hamd mil'as-samawati wa mil'al-ardi, wa mil'a ma baynahuma, wa mil'a ma shi'ta min shay'in ba'du." It was said to Abdullah: "Do you take this [view]?" He said, "No." And it was said to him: "Do you say this in the obligatory prayer?" He said, "Perhaps." And he said: "All of it is good."
2.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Salamah se, apne chacha al-Majishun se, al-A'raj se, Ubaydullah ibn Abi Rafi' se, Ali ibn Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ jab ruku se sar uthaate, to farmaate: "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah, Rabbana wa lakal-hamdu mil'as-samawaati wa mil'al-ardi, wa mil'a maa baynahumaa, wa mil'a maa shi'ta min shay'im ba'd." Abdullah se poocha gaya: "Kya aap isi ke qaail hain?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi." Aur unse poocha gaya: "Kya aap ise farz namaz mein kehte hain?" Unhone kaha, "Shayad." Aur unhone kaha: "Yeh sab achha hai."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلَانَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ مُحَيْرِيزٍ  ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ : " إِنِّيقَدْ بَدَّنْتُ، فَلَا تَسْبِقُونِي بِالرُّكُوعِ، وَلَا بِالسُّجُودِ، فَإِنِّي مَهْمَا أَسْبِقُكُمْ حِينَ أَرْكَعُ، تُدْرِكُونِي حِينَ أَرْفَعُ، وَمَهْمَا أَسْبِقُكُمْ حِينَ أَسْجُدُ، تُدْرِكُونِي حِينَ أَرْفَعُ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from al-Layth ibn Sa'd, from Muhammad ibn Ajlan, from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban, from Ibn Muhayriz, from Mu'awiyah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed I have grown heavy [stout], so do not precede me in bowing or in prostration, for indeed whenever I precede you when I bow, you will catch up with me when I rise, and whenever I precede you when I prostrate, you will catch up with me when I rise."
2.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne al-Layth ibn Sa'd se, Muhammad ibn Ajlan se, Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban se, Ibn Muhayriz se, Mu'awiyah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Main mota ho gaya hoon, so mujhse ruku ya sajda mein aage na badho, kyunki main jab bhi tumse pehle ruku karun, tum uthte waqt mujhe paa loge, aur main jab bhi tumse pehle sajda karun, tum uthte waqt mujhe paa loge."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ   يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَمَا يَخْشَى أَحَدُكُمْ أَوْ أَلَا يَخْشَى أَحَدُكُمْ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ قَبْلَ الْإِمَامِ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ رَأْسَهُ رَأْسَ حِمَارٍ أَوْ صُورَتَهُ صُورَةَ حِمَارٍ "
2.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Abu Hurairah: He said: I heard Abu Hurairah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Does not one of you fear - or does not one of you fear, when he raises his head before the imam, that Allah will make his head the head of a donkey, or his form the form of a donkey?"
2.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se, Muhammad ibn Ziyad se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Hurairah ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Kya tum mein se koi nahi darta - ya kya tum mein se koi nahi darta, jab woh imam se pehle apna sar uthaata hai, ke Allah uska sar gadhe ka sar bana de, ya uski shakl gadhe ki shakl bana de?"

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُخْتَارُ بْنُ فُلْفُلٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَحَثَّهُمْ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ، وَنَهَاهُمْ أَنْ يَسْبِقُوهُ إِذَا كَانَ يَؤُمُّهُمْ بِالرُّكُوعِ وَالسُّجُودِ، وَأَنْ يَنْصَرِفُوا قَبْلَ انْصِرَافِهِ مِنْ الصَّلَاةِ، وَقَالَ : " إِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ مِنْ خَلْفِي وَأَمَامِي "
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Za'idah, from al-Mukhtar ibn Fulful, from Anas ibn Malik: That the Prophet ﷺ urged them concerning the prayer, and forbade them from preceding him when he was leading them in bowing and prostration, and from leaving before he finished leaving the prayer, and said: "Indeed I see you from behind me and in front of me."
2.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Za'idah se, al-Mukhtar ibn Fulful se, Anas ibn Malik se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne unhein namaz ki taakeed ki, aur unhein mana kiya ke jab aap unhein ruku aur sajda karaayein to unse aage na badhein, aur namaz se apni ruksati se pehle na chalein jaayein, aur farmaya: "Main tumhein apne peechhe se aur apne saamne se dekhta hoon."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النَّضْرِ هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ طَاوُسًا  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : " أُمِرَ نَبِيُّكُمْ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْيَسْجُدَ عَلَى سَبْعَةٍ أَعْظُمٍ، وَأُمِرَ أَنْ لَا يَكُفَّ شَعَرًا وَلَا ثَوْبًا "قَالَ شُعْبَةُ : وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى قَالَ : " أُمِرْتُ بِالسُّجُودِ، وَلَا أَكُفَّ شَعَرًا وَلَا ثَوْبًا "
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nadr Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "Your Prophet ﷺ was commanded to prostrate on seven bones, and was commanded not to gather up hair or garment." Shu'bah said: And he narrated it to me another time, he said: "I was commanded with prostration, and not to gather up hair or garment."
2.hi: Abu al-Nadr Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se, Amr ibn Dinar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Tawus ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Ibn Abbas se: Unhone kaha, "Tumhare Nabi ﷺ ko saat haddiyon par sajda karne ka hukum diya gaya, aur hukum diya gaya ke baal ya kapda [sameta hua] na rakha jaaye." Shu'bah kehte hain: Aur unhone mujhse ek aur martaba bayaan kiya, unhone kaha: "Mujhe sajda karne ka hukum diya gaya, aur baal ya kapda [sameta hua] na rakhne ka."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَاوُسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : " أُمِرْتُ أَنْأَسْجُدَ عَلَى سَبْعَةِ أَعْظُمٍ : الْجَبْهَةِ قَالَ وُهَيْبٌ : وَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى أَنْفِهِ وَالْيَدَيْنِ وَالرُّكْبَتَيْنِ، وَأَطْرَافِ الْقَدَمَيْنِ، وَلَا نَكُفَّ الثِّيَابَ وَلَا الشَّعَرَ "
2.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, and Yahya ibn Hassan, from Wuhayb, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, from Ibn Abbas, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "I was commanded to prostrate on seven bones: the forehead" - Wuhayb said: and he gestured with his hand to his nose - "and the two hands, and the two knees, and the tips of the two feet, and we do not gather up the garments nor the hair."
2.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim aur Yahya ibn Hassan ne Wuhayb se bataya: Unhone kaha, Humein Ibn Tawus ne apne walid se, Ibn Abbas se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Mujhe saat haddiyon par sajda karne ka hukum diya gaya: peshani" - Wuhayb kehte hain: aur unhone apne haath se apni naak ki taraf ishara kiya - "aur dono haath, aur dono ghutne, aur dono paaon ke agle hisse, aur hum kapdon ya baalon ko [sameta hua] na rakhein."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ كُلَيْبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ وَائِلِ بْنِ حُجْرٍ  ، قَالَ : رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" إِذَا سَجَدَ، يَضَعُ رُكْبَتَيْهِ قَبْلَ يَدَيْهِ، وَإِذَا نَهَضَ، رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ قَبْلَ رُكْبَتَيْهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Sharik, from Asim ibn Kulayb, from his father, from Wa'il ibn Hujr: He said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, "when he prostrated, place his knees before his hands, and when he rose, raise his hands before his knees."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Sharik se, Asim ibn Kulayb se, apne walid se, Wa'il ibn Hujr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko dekha ke aap "jab sajda karte, to apne ghutne apne haathon se pehle rakhte, aur jab uthte, to apne haath apne ghutnon se pehle uthaate."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" إِذَا صَلَّى أَحَدُكُمْ، فَلَا يَبْرُكْ كَمَا يَبْرُكُ الْبَعِيرُ، وَلْيَضَعْ يَدَيْهِ قَبْلَ رُكْبَتَيْهِ ".
قِيلَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ : مَا تَقُولُ؟ قَالَ : كُلُّهُ طَيِّبٌ.
وَقَالَ : أَهْلُ الْكُوفَةِ يَخْتَارُونَ الْأَوَّلَ
2.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn al-Hasan, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurairah; with Abdullah's remark: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you prays, let him not kneel down as the camel kneels, and let him place his hands before his knees." It was said to Abdullah: "What do you say?" He said: "All of it is good." And he said: "The people of Kufah prefer the first [way]."
2.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn al-Hasan se, Abu al-Zinad se, al-A'raj se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi namaz padhe, to woh oont ki tarah na baithe, aur apne haath apne ghutnon se pehle rakhe." Abdullah se poocha gaya: "Aap kya kehte hain?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh sab achha hai." Aur unhone kaha: "Kufah wale pehle [tareeqe] ko pasand karte hain."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ  ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" اعْتَدِلُوا فِي الرُّكُوعِ وَالسُّجُودِ، وَلَا يَبْسُطْ أَحَدُكُمْ ذِرَاعَيْهِ بِسَاطَ الْكَلْبِ "
2.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, and Sa'id ibn al-Rabi', from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from Anas ibn Malik: He said: I heard Anas ibn Malik say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Be moderate in bowing and prostration, and let none of you spread his forearms [on the ground] like the spreading of a dog."
2.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim aur Sa'id ibn al-Rabi' ne Shu'bah se, Qatadah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Anas ibn Malik ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Ruku aur sajda mein miyaana-ravi rakho, aur tum mein se koi apni baazuein kutte ki tarah na phailaaye."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ تَمِيمِ بْنِ مَحْمُودٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ شِبْلٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْافْتِرَاشِ السَّبُعِ، وَنَقْرَةِ الْغُرَابِ، وَأَنْ يُوطِنَ الرَّجُلُ الْمَكَانَ كَمَا يُوطِنُ الْبَعِيرُ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Abd al-Hamid ibn Ja'far, from his father, from Tamim ibn Mahmud, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Shibl al-Ansari: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the spreading of the beast of prey, and the pecking of the crow, and that a man make a fixed spot [for himself in the mosque] as the camel makes its fixed spot."
2.hi: Abu Asim ne Abd al-Hamid ibn Ja'far se, apne walid se, Tamim ibn Mahmud se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Shibl al-Ansari se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne darinde ki tarah [baazu] phailaane se, aur kauve ki tarah [jaldi jaldi] chonch maarne se, aur aadmi ke masjid mein oont ki tarah ek muqarrar jagah bana lene se mana kiya."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ  ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ،  عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَقُولُ بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ :" رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي ".
 فَقِيلَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ : تَقُولُ هَذَا؟ قَالَ : رُبَّمَا قُلْتُ، وَرُبَّمَا سَكَتُّ
2.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zuhayr, from al-Ala ibn al-Musayyab, from Amr ibn Murrah, from Talhah ibn Yazid al-Ansari, from Hudhayfah; with Abdullah's response: That the Prophet ﷺ used to say between the two prostrations: "Rabbighfir li." So it was said to Abdullah: "Do you say this?" He said: "Sometimes I say it, and sometimes I remain silent."
2.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zuhayr se, al-Ala ibn al-Musayyab se, Amr ibn Murrah se, Talhah ibn Yazid al-Ansari se, Hudhayfah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ do sajdon ke darmiyan farmaate: "Rabbighfir li" [Ae mere Rab, mujhe bakhsh de]. To Abdullah se poocha gaya: "Kya aap yeh kehte hain?" Unhone kaha: "Kabhi keh leta hoon, aur kabhi khamosh reh jaata hoon."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ سُحَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَعْبَدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ،  عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : كَشَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ السِّتَارَةَ وَالنَّاسُ صُفُوفٌ خَلْفَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، فَقَالَ : " يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ، إِنَّهُلَمْ يَبْقَ مِنْ مُبَشِّرَاتِ النُّبُوَّةِ إِلَّا الرُّؤْيَا الصَّالِحَةُ يَرَاهَا الْمُسْلِمُ أَوْ تُرَى لَهُ، أَلَا إِنِّي نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَقْرَأَ رَاكِعًا أَوْ سَاجِدًا، فَأَمَّا الرُّكُوعُ، فَعَظِّمُوا رَبَّكُمْ، وَأَمَّا السُّجُودُ، فَاجْتَهِدُوا فِي الدُّعَاءِ، فَقَمِنٌ أَنْ يُسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ibn Uyaynah, from Sulayman ibn Suhaym, from Ibrahim ibn Abdullah ibn Ma'bad, from his father, from Ibn Abbas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ uncovered the curtain while the people were in rows behind Abu Bakr, and said: "O people, indeed nothing remains of the glad tidings of prophethood except the true vision which the Muslim sees or which is seen for him. Indeed I have been forbidden to recite while bowing or prostrating; as for bowing, then glorify your Lord in it, and as for prostration, then strive in supplication, for it is worthy that it be answered for you."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ne Ibn Uyaynah se, Sulayman ibn Suhaym se, Ibrahim ibn Abdullah ibn Ma'bad se, apne walid se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne parda hataaya jabke log Abu Bakr ke peechhe saf mein khade the, aur farmaya: "Ae logo, nabuwwat ki khush-khabariyon mein se sirf sachcha khwab baaki reh gaya hai jise Musalman khud dekhe ya uske liye dekha jaaye. Sun lo, mujhe ruku ya sajda ki haalat mein [Quran] padhne se mana kiya gaya hai; rahi baat ruku ki, to usmein apne Rab ki azmat bayaan karo, aur rahi baat sajde ki, to usmein dua mein mehnat karo, kyunki uska qabool hona zyada munaasib hai."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ سُحَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " إِنِّينُهِيتُ أَنْ أَقْرَأَ وَأَنَا رَاكِعٌ أَوْ سَاجِدٌ، فَأَمَّا الرُّكُوعُ، فَعَظِّمُوا فِيهِ الرَّبَّ، وَأَمَّا السُّجُودُ، فَاجْتَهِدُوا فِي الدُّعَاءِ، فَقَمِنٌ أَنْ يُسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ "
2.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, and Isma'il ibn Ja'far, from Sulayman ibn Suhaym, from Ibrahim ibn Abdullah ibn Ma'bad ibn Abbas, from his father, from Ibn Abbas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed I have been forbidden to recite while I am bowing or prostrating; as for bowing, then glorify the Lord in it, and as for prostration, then strive in supplication, for it is worthy that it be answered for you."
2.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah aur Isma'il ibn Ja'far se, Sulayman ibn Suhaym se, Ibrahim ibn Abdullah ibn Ma'bad ibn Abbas se, apne walid se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Mujhe ruku ya sajda ki haalat mein [Quran] padhne se mana kiya gaya hai; rahi baat ruku ki, to usmein Rab ki azmat bayaan karo, aur rahi baat sajde ki, to usmein dua mein mehnat karo, kyunki uska qabool hona zyada munaasib hai."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ هُوَ ابْنُ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا تُجْزِئُ صَلَاةٌ لَا يُقِيمُ الرَّجُلُ فِيهَا صُلْبَهُ فِي الرُّكُوعِ وَالسُّجُودِ "
2.en: Narrated by Ya'la ibn Ubayd, from al-A'mash, from Umarah ibn Umayr, from Abu Ma'mar, from Abu Mas'ud: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A prayer in which a man does not straighten his back in bowing and prostration does not suffice."
2.hi: Ya'la ibn Ubayd ne al-A'mash se, Umarah ibn Umayr se, Abu Ma'mar se, Abu Mas'ud se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Woh namaz kaafi nahi jismein aadmi ruku aur sajda mein apni kamar seedhi na kare."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَسْوَأُ النَّاسِ سَرِقَةً الَّذِي يَسْرِقُ صَلَاتَهُ ".
قَالُوا : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، وَكَيْفَ يَسْرِقُ صَلَاتَهُ؟ قَالَ : " لَا يُتِمُّ رُكُوعَهَا وَلَا سُجُودَهَا "
2.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Musa, from al-Walid ibn Muslim, from al-Awza'i, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah, from his father: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The worst of people in theft is the one who steals from his prayer." They said: "O Messenger of Allah, how does he steal from his prayer?" He said: "He does not complete its bowing nor its prostration."
2.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Musa ne al-Walid ibn Muslim se, al-Awza'i se, Yahya ibn Abi Kathir se, Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Chori mein logon mein sabse bura woh hai jo apni namaz se chori kare." Sahaba ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, woh apni namaz se kaise chori kare?" Aapne farmaya: "Woh uska ruku aur sajda poora na kare."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ خَلَّادٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ رَافِعٍ  ، وَكَانَ رِفَاعَةُ وَمَالِكُ ابْنَيْ رَافِعٍ أَخَوَيْنِ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَدْرٍ ، قَالُوا : بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ جُلُوسٌ حَوْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَوْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ جَالِسٌ وَنَحْنُ حَوْلَهُ، شَكَّ هَمَّامٌ ، إِذْ دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ فَصَلَّى، فَلَمَّا قَضَى الصَّلَاةَ، جَاءَ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَعَلَى الْقَوْمِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " وَعَلَيْكَ، ارْجِعْ فَصَلِّ، فَإِنَّكَ لَمْ تُصَلِّ ".
فَرَجَعَ الرَّجُلُ فَصَلَّى، وَجَعَلْنَا نَرْمُقُ صَلَاتَهُ، لَا نَدْرِي مَا يَعِيبُ مِنْهَا، فَلَمَّا قَضَى صَلَاتَهُ، جَاءَ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَعَلَى الْقَوْمِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " وَعَلَيْكَ، ارْجِعْ فَصَلِّ، فَإِنَّكَ لَمْ تُصَلِّ ".
قَالَ هَمَّامٌ : فَلَا أَدْرِي أَمَرَهُ بِذَلِكَ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلَاثًا.
قَالَ الرَّجُلُ : مَا أَلَوْتُ، فَلَا أَدْرِي مَا عِبْتَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ صَلَاتِي.
 فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " إِنَّهَالَا تَتِمُّ صَلَاةُ أَحَدِكُمْ حَتَّى يُسْبِغَ الْوُضُوءَ كَمَا أَمَرَهُ اللَّهُ G فَيَغْسِلُ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ، وَيَمْسَحُ بِرَأْسِهِ، وَرِجْلَيْهِ إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يُكَبِّرُ اللَّهَ وَيَحْمَدُهُ، ثُمَّ يَقْرَأُ مِنْ الْقُرْآنِ مَا أَذِنَ اللَّهُ G لَهُ فِيهِ، ثُمَّ يُكَبِّرُ فَيَرْكَعُ، فَيَضَعُ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ حَتَّى تَطْمَئِنَّ مَفَاصِلُهُ وَتَسْتَرْخِيَ، وَيَقُولُ : سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، فَيَسْتَوِي قَائِمًا حَتَّى يُقِيمَ صُلْبَهُ، فَيَأْخُذَ كُلُّ عَظْمٍ مَأْخَذَهُ، ثُمَّ يُكَبِّرُ فَيَسْجُدُ فَيُمَكِّنُ وَجْهَهُ، قَالَ هَمَّامٌ : وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ : جَبْهَتَهُ مِنْ الْأَرْضِ حَتَّى تَطْمَئِنَّ مَفَاصِلُهُ وَتَسْتَرْخِيَ، ثُمَّ يُكَبِّرُ، فَيَسْتَوِي قَاعِدًا عَلَى مَقْعَدِهِ وَيُقِيمُ صُلْبَهُ، فَوَصَفَ الصَّلَاةَ هَكَذَا أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ حَتَّى فَرَغَ، لَا تَتِمُّ صَلَاةُ أَحَدِكُمْ حَتَّى يَفْعَلَ ذَلِكَ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Hammam, from Ishaq ibn Abdullah, from Ali ibn Yahya ibn Khallad, from his father, from his uncle Rifa'ah ibn Rafi' (Rifa'ah and Malik, the two sons of Rafi', were brothers among the people of Badr): They said: While we were sitting around the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, or the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was sitting and we were around him - Hammam was uncertain [which] - a man entered, and faced the Qiblah and prayed, then when he finished the prayer, he came and greeted the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the people, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "And upon you, go back and pray, for indeed you have not prayed." So the man went back and prayed, and we began watching his prayer, not knowing what was defective in it, then when he finished his prayer, he came and greeted the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the people, so the Prophet ﷺ said to him: "And upon you, go back and pray, for indeed you have not prayed." Hammam said: So I do not know whether he commanded him with that twice or three times. The man said: "I have not fallen short, so I do not know what you find defective in my prayer." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed the prayer of one of you is not complete until he performs the ablution thoroughly as Allah, exalted is He, has commanded him: washing his face and his hands to the elbows, and wiping his head, and his feet to the ankles, then he says the takbir to Allah and praises Him, then he recites from the Qur'an what Allah, exalted is He, has permitted him in it, then he says the takbir and bows, placing his palms on his knees until his joints settle and relax, and says: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah,' then he stands upright until he straightens his back, so that every bone takes its place, then he says the takbir and prostrates, and makes his face secure" - Hammam said: and sometimes he said: "his forehead, from the ground, until his joints settle and relax, then he says the takbir, and sits upright on his seat and straightens his back" - so he described the prayer in this manner for four rak'ahs until he finished - "the prayer of one of you is not complete until he does that."
2.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Hammam se, Ishaq ibn Abdullah se, Ali ibn Yahya ibn Khallad se, apne walid se, apne chacha Rifa'ah ibn Rafi' se bataya - aur Rifa'ah aur Malik, Rafi' ke do bete, Badr ke logon mein se bhai the - unhone bataya: Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke ird-gird baithe the, ya Rasulullah ﷺ baithe the aur hum aapke ird-gird the - Hammam ko shak tha [kaunsa] - itne mein ek aadmi dakhil hua, aur Qibla ki taraf rukh karke namaz padhi, fir jab namaz khatam ki, to aaya aur Rasulullah ﷺ ko aur logon ko salaam kiya, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Tumpar bhi salaam ho, wapas jaao aur namaz padho, kyunki tumne namaz nahi padhi." So woh aadmi wapas gaya aur namaz padhi, aur hum uski namaz ko dekhne lage, yeh na samajhte hue ke usmein kya kami hai, fir jab usne apni namaz khatam ki, to aaya aur Rasulullah ﷺ ko aur logon ko salaam kiya, to Nabi ﷺ ne usse farmaya: "Tumpar bhi salaam ho, wapas jaao aur namaz padho, kyunki tumne namaz nahi padhi." Hammam kehte hain: So mujhe nahi maloom ke aapne use yeh do martaba kaha ya teen martaba. Aadmi ne kaha: "Maine koi kami nahi chhodi, so mujhe nahi pata ke aapne meri namaz mein kya kami paayi." To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Tum mein se kisi ki namaz mukammal nahi hoti jab tak woh wudu mukammal (achhi tarah) na kare jaisa Allah Ta'ala ne use hukum diya hai: apna chehra aur haath kohniyon tak dhoye, aur apne sar ka masah kare, aur apne pair takhnon tak dhoye, fir Allah ki takbir kahe aur uski hamd kare, fir Quran mein se jitna Allah Ta'ala ne use ijaazat di ho utna padhe, fir takbir kahe aur ruku kare, apni hatheliyan apne ghutnon par is tarah rakhe ke uske jodh sukoon aur narmi mein aa jaayein, aur kahe: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah,' fir seedha khada ho yahan tak ke apni kamar seedhi kar le, taake har haddi apni jagah aa jaaye, fir takbir kahe aur sajda kare, aur apna chehra jama de" - Hammam kehte hain: aur kabhi kehte: "apni peshani, zameen par, yahan tak ke uske jodh sukoon aur narmi mein aa jaayein, fir takbir kahe, aur apni baithak par seedha baithe aur apni kamar seedhi kare" - so aapne namaz ko isi tarah chaar rakat tak bayaan kiya yahan tak ke khatam ki - "tum mein se kisi ki namaz mukammal nahi hoti jab tak woh aisa na kare."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ بُرْقَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ الْأَصَمِّ  ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ  ، قَالَتْ : " كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَإِذَا سَجَدَ، جَافَى حَتَّى يَرَى مَنْ خَلْفَهُ وَضَحَ إِبِطَيْهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Ja'far ibn Burqan, from Yazid ibn al-Asamm, from Maymunah bint al-Harith: She said: "The Prophet ﷺ, when he prostrated, would spread his arms out until whoever was behind him could see the whiteness of his armpits."
2.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Ja'far ibn Burqan se, Yazid ibn al-Asamm se, Maymunah bint al-Harith se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Nabi ﷺ jab sajda karte, to apni baazuein itni phailaate ke aapke peechhe wala aapki bagalon ki safedi dekh leta."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، وَإِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ زَكَرِيَّا  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَصَمِّ  ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْأَصَمِّ  ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : " كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَإِذَا سَجَدَ، جَافَى حَتَّى لَوْ شَاءَتْ بَهْمَةٌ تَمُرُّ تَحْتَهُ لَمَرَّتْ "
2.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, and Isma'il ibn Zakariya, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn al-Asamm, from his uncle Yazid ibn al-Asamm, from Maymunah: She said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he prostrated, would spread his arms out so much that if a young lamb wanted to pass beneath him, it could have passed."
2.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah aur Isma'il ibn Zakariya se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn al-Asamm se, apne chacha Yazid ibn al-Asamm se, Maymunah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ jab sajda karte, to itni baazuein phailaate ke agar koi mema (bhed ka bachcha) aapke neeche se guzarna chahta to guzar sakta."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَصَمِّ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْأَصَمِّ  ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ   زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَتْ : " كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَإِذَا سَجَدَ، خَوَّى بِيَدَيْهِ يَعْنِي : جَنَّحَ حَتَّى يُرَى وَضَحُ إِبْطَيْهِ مِنْ وَرَاءَهُ، وَإِذَا قَعَدَ اطْمَأَنَّ عَلَى فَخِذِهِ الْيُسْرَى "
2.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Marwan, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn al-Asamm, from Yazid ibn al-Asamm, from Maymunah, wife of the Prophet ﷺ: She said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he prostrated, would spread his hands wide" - meaning: hold them out - "until the whiteness of his armpits could be seen from behind him, and when he sat, he settled on his left thigh."
2.hi: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ne Marwan se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn al-Asamm se, Yazid ibn al-Asamm se, Maymunah, Nabi ﷺ ki biwi, se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ jab sajda karte, to apne haath phailaate" - yaani, unhein baahar rakhte - "yahan tak ke aapki bagalon ki safedi peechhe se dikhayi deti, aur jab baithte to apni baayen raan par tik jaate."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنِي الْبَرَاءُ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " كَانَرُكُوعُهُ إِذَا رَكَعَ، وَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنْ الرُّكُوعِ، وَسُجُودُهُ، وَبَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ، قَرِيبًا مِنْ السَّوَاءِ "
2.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Rabi', from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, from Ibn Abi Layla, from al-Bara': That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, "his bowing, when he bowed, and when he raised his head from bowing, and his prostration, and between the two prostrations, were close to equal [in duration]."
2.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Rabi' ne Shu'bah se, al-Hakam se, Ibn Abi Layla se, al-Bara' se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ka "ruku jab woh ruku karte, aur jab ruku se sar uthaate, aur unka sajda, aur do sajdon ke darmiyan, taqreeban barabar hota tha."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ الْوَزَّانِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، عَنْ الْبَرَاءِ  ، قَالَ : " رَمَقْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي صَلَاتِهِ فَوَجَدْتُقِيَامَهُ، وَرَكْعَتَهُ، وَاعْتِدَالَهُ بَعْدَ الرَّكْعَةِ، فَسَجْدَتَهُ، فَجِلْسَتَهُ بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ، فَسَجْدَتَهُ، فَجِلْسَتَهُ بَيْنَ التَّسْلِيمِ وَالِانْصِرَافِ، قَرِيبًا مِنْ السَّوَاءِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : هِلَالُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ : أُرَى أَبُو حُمَيْدٍ الْوَزَّانُ
2.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Abu Awanah, from Hilal ibn Humayd al-Wazzan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla, from al-Bara'; with Abu Muhammad's note: He said: "I watched the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in his prayer, and I found his standing, and his bowing, and his straightening after the bowing, then his prostration, then his sitting between the two prostrations, then his prostration, then his sitting between the taslim and departing, close to equal." Abu Muhammad said: Hilal ibn Humayd: I believe [his kunyah is] Abu Humayd al-Wazzan.
2.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Abu Awanah se, Hilal ibn Humayd al-Wazzan se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla se, al-Bara' se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ki namaz ko gaur se dekha, to maine paaya ke aapka qayam, aur aapka ruku, aur ruku ke baad aapka seedha khada hona, fir aapka sajda, fir do sajdon ke darmiyan baithna, fir sajda, fir salaam aur namaz khatam karne ke darmiyan baithna, taqreeban barabar hota tha." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Hilal ibn Humayd: mera khayal hai [unki kunyat] Abu Humayd al-Wazzan hai.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبَّادُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، وَحَمْزَةَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ شُعْبَةَ   يُخْبِرُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَقْبَلَ وَأَقْبَلَ مَعَهُ الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ، حَتَّى وَجَدُوا النَّاسَ قَدْ أَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ صَلَاةَ الْفَجْرِ وَقَدَّمُوا عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَوْفٍ يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ، فَصَلَّى بِهِمْ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ رَكْعَةً مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ،فَصَفَّ مَعَ النَّاسِ وَرَاءَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ، فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ثُمَّ صَلَّى، فَفَزِعَ النَّاسُ لِذَلِكَ، وَأَكْثَرُوا التَّسْبِيحَ، فَلَمَّا قَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ صَلَاتَهُ، قَالَ لِلنَّاسِ : " قَدْ أَصَبْتُمْ أَوْ قَدْ أَحْسَنْتُمْ "
2.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth ibn Sa'd, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, from Abbad ibn Ziyad, from Urwah ibn al-Mughirah, and Hamzah ibn al-Mughirah, from al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came forward, and al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah came forward with him, until they found the people had established the Fajr prayer and had put forward Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf to lead them in prayer, so Abd al-Rahman led them in one rak'ah of the Fajr prayer before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ arrived, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came, and lined up with the people behind Abd al-Rahman in the second rak'ah, so when Abd al-Rahman gave the taslim, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood then prayed, so the people were alarmed at that, and increased their glorification, so when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished his prayer, he said to the people: "You have done rightly" or "You have done well."
2.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth ibn Sa'd se, Uqayl se, Ibn Shihab se, Abbad ibn Ziyad se, Urwah ibn al-Mughirah aur Hamzah ibn al-Mughirah se bataya ke dono ne al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah ko yeh bataate suna ke Rasulullah ﷺ aage badhe, aur aapke saath al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah bhi aage badhe, yahan tak ke unhone dekha ke logon ne Fajr ki namaz ki iqamah kar di thi aur Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf ko unhein padhaane ke liye aage kar diya tha, so Abd al-Rahman ne Rasulullah ﷺ ke aane se pehle Fajr ki namaz ki ek rakat unhein padhaayi, fir Rasulullah ﷺ aaye, aur doosri rakat mein logon ke saath Abd al-Rahman ke peechhe saf mein khade ho gaye, so jab Abd al-Rahman ne salaam phera, to Rasulullah ﷺ khade hue fir namaz padhi, so log iss se ghabra gaye, aur zyada tasbih karne lage, so jab Rasulullah ﷺ apni namaz se faarigh hue, to logon se farmaya: "Tumne theek kiya" ya "Tumne achha kiya."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ الطَّوِيلُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِيُّ  ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : " فَانْتَهَيْنَا إِلَى الْقَوْمِ وَقَدْ قَامُوا إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ وَقَدْ رَكَعَ بِهِمْ، فَلَمَّا أَحَسَّ بِالنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ذَهَبَ يَتَأَخَّرُ،فَأَوْمَأْ إِلَيْهِ بِيَدِهِ، فَصَلَّى بِهِمْ، فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ، قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَقُمْتُ، فَرَكَعْنَا الرَّكْعَةَ الَّتِي سُبِقْنَا "، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : أَقُولُ فِي الْقَضَاءِ بِقَوْلِ أَهْلِ الْكُوفَةِ : أَنْ يَجْعَلَ مَا فَاتَهُ مِنْ الصَّلَاةِ قَضَاءً
2.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Humayd al-Tawil, from Bakr ibn Abdullah al-Muzani, from Hamzah ibn al-Mughirah, from his father; with Abu Muhammad's view: That he said: "So we reached the people, and they had risen for the prayer, Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf leading them, and he had already bowed with them, so when he sensed the Prophet ﷺ, he went to step back, but he [the Prophet] gestured to him with his hand [to continue], so he led them in prayer, and when he gave the taslim, the Prophet ﷺ stood and I stood, and we bowed the rak'ah in which we had been preceded [missed]." Abu Muhammad said: I hold, concerning making up [missed prayer], to the view of the people of Kufah: that what he has missed of the prayer, he makes it up as the completion/end.
2.hi: Musaddad ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Humayd al-Tawil se, Bakr ibn Abdullah al-Muzani se, Hamzah ibn al-Mughirah se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, "So hum logon tak pahunche, aur woh namaz ke liye khade ho chuke the, Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf unhein padha rahe the, aur woh unke saath ruku kar chuke the, so jab unhein Nabi ﷺ ka ehsaas hua, to woh peechhe hatne lage, lekin aapne apne haath se unhein ishara kiya [jaari rakhne ka], so unhone unhein namaz padhaayi, aur jab unhone salaam phera, to Nabi ﷺ khade hue aur main khada hua, aur humne woh rakat padhi jo humse choot gayi thi." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Qaza ke maamle mein main ahl-e-Kufah ke qaul par amal karta hoon: ke jo namaz chhoot gayi ho use aakhir mein poora kiya jaaye.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا غَالِبٌ الْقَطَّانُ  ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : " كُنَّانُصَلِّي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي شِدَّةِ الْحَرِّ، فَإِذَا لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَحَدُنَا أَنْ يُمَكِّنَ جَبْهَتَهُ مِنْ الْأَرْضِ، بَسَطَ ثَوْبَهُ فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Affan, from Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal, from Ghalib al-Qattan, from Bakr ibn Abdullah, from Anas: He said: "We used to pray with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the intensity of the heat, and when one of us was not able to place his forehead firmly on the ground, he would spread out his garment and pray on it."
2.hi: Affan ne Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal se, Ghalib al-Qattan se, Bakr ibn Abdullah se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath shadeed garmi mein namaz padhte, aur jab humein se koi apni peshani zameen par mazbooti se na rakh paata, to woh apna kapda bichha kar usi par namaz padhta."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ  ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يَدْعُو هَكَذَا فِي الصَّلَاةِ، وَأَشَارَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ بِأُصْبُعِهِ، وَأَشَارَ أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ بِالسَّبَّاحَةِ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Ibn Uyaynah, from Ibn Ajlan, from Amir ibn Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr, from his father: He said: I saw the Prophet ﷺ "supplicate like this in the prayer," and Ibn Uyaynah gestured with his finger, and Abu al-Walid gestured with the index finger.
2.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Ibn Uyaynah se, Ibn Ajlan se, Amir ibn Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Nabi ﷺ ko dekha ke aap "namaz mein isi tarah dua karte the," aur Ibn Uyaynah ne apni ungli se ishara kiya, aur Abu al-Walid ne apni shahaadat ki ungli se ishara kiya.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" إِذَا قَعَدَ فِي آخِرِ الصَّلَاةِ، وَضَعَ يَدَهُ الْيُسْرَى عَلَى رُكْبَتِهِ الْيُسْرَى، وَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى رُكْبَتِهِ الْيُمْنَى، وَنَصَبَ إِصْبَعَهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ayyub, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That the Prophet ﷺ used to "when he sat at the end of the prayer, place his left hand on his left knee, and place his right hand on his right knee, and raise his finger."
2.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ayyub se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ "jab namaz ke aakhir mein baithte, to apna baayan haath apne baaye ghutne par rakhte, aur apna daayan haath apne daaye ghutne par rakhte, aur apni ungli khadi karte."

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ  ،  عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : كُنَّا إِذَا صَلَّيْنَا خَلْفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قُلْنَا : السَّلَامُ عَلَى اللَّهِ قَبْلَ عِبَادِهِ، السَّلَامُ عَلَى جِبْرِيلَ ، السَّلَامُ عَلَى مِيكَائِيلَ ، السَّلَامُ عَلَى إِسْرَافِيلَ ، السَّلَامُ عَلَى فُلَانٍ وَفُلَانٍ.
قَالَ : فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : " إِنَّاللَّهَ تَعَالَى هُوَ السَّلَامُ، فَإِذَا جَلَسْتُمْ فِي الصَّلَاةِ، فَقُولُوا : التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ، وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، فَإِنَّكُمْ إِذَا قُلْتُمُوهَا أَصَابَتْ كُلَّ عَبْدٍ صَالِحٍ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، ثُمَّ لِيَتَخَيَّرْ مَا شَاءَ "
2.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from al-A'mash, from Shaqiq, from Abdullah: He said: We used to, when we prayed behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, say: "Peace be upon Allah before His servants, peace be upon Jibril, peace be upon Mika'il, peace be upon Israfil, peace be upon so-and-so and so-and-so." He said: So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned to us, and said: "Indeed Allah the Exalted, He is [the source of] peace, so when you sit in the prayer, say: 'At-tahiyyatu lillahi, was-salawatu wat-tayyibatu, as-salamu 'alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuhu, as-salamu 'alayna wa 'ala 'ibadillahis-salihin,' for indeed when you say it, it reaches every righteous servant in the heaven and the earth, 'Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa Rasuluh,' then let him choose whatever he wishes [to supplicate for]."
2.hi: Ya'la ne al-A'mash se, Shaqiq se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Hum jab Rasulullah ﷺ ke peechhe namaz padhte, to kehte: "As-salaamu 'alallahi qabla 'ibaadihi, as-salaamu 'ala Jibreel, as-salaamu 'ala Mika'eel, as-salaamu 'ala Israfeel, as-salaamu 'ala fulaan wa fulaan." Unhone bataya: To Rasulullah ﷺ ne humari taraf mudkar farmaya: "Allah Ta'ala khud 'As-Salam' hai, so jab tum namaz mein baitho, to kaho: 'At-tahiyyaatu lillahi, was-salawaatu wat-tayyibaat, as-salaamu 'alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakaatuh, as-salaamu 'alaynaa wa 'ala 'ibaadillahis-saaliheen' [Sab tazeemein Allah ke liye hain, aur salaawaat aur paak-o-saaf cheezein bhi; aapko salaam ho, ae Nabi, aur Allah ki rehmat aur barkatein; humpar aur Allah ke naik bandon par salaam ho], kyunki jab tum yeh kehte ho, to yeh asmaan aur zameen ke har naik bande tak pahunchta hai, 'Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illallah wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa Rasooluh' [Main gawahi deta hoon ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur main gawahi deta hoon ke Muhammad uske bande aur rasool hain],' fir jo chaahe woh maang le."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ حُرٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ مُخَيْمِرَةَ  ، قَالَ : أَخَذَ عَلْقَمَةُ  بِيَدِي فَحَدَّثَنِي، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ أَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ، وَأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَخَذَ بِيَدِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، فَعَلَّمَهُ التَّشَهُّدَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ :" التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ، وَالصَّلَوَاتُ، وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ : أُرَاهُ قَالَ : أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ ".
أَيْضًا شَكَّ فِي هَاتَيْنِ الْكَلِمَتَيْنِ : إِذَا فَعَلْتَ هَذَا أَوْ قَضَيْتَ، فَقَدْ قَضَيْتَ صَلَاتَكَ، إِنْ شِئْتَ أَنْ تَقُومَ، فَقُمْ، وَإِنْ شِئْتَ أَنْ تَقْعُدَ، فَاقْعُدْ
2.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zuhayr, from al-Hasan ibn Hurr, from al-Qasim ibn Mukhaymirah, from Alqamah, from Abdullah: He said: Alqamah took my hand and narrated to me, that Abdullah took his hand, and that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ took the hand of Abdullah, and taught him the tashahhud in the prayer: "At-tahiyyatu lillahi, was-salawatu, wat-tayyibatu, as-salamu 'alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuhu, as-salamu 'alayna wa 'ala 'ibadillahis-salihin" - Zuhayr said: I believe he said: "Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa Rasuluh." Also uncertain about these two phrases: "When you have done this or completed it, you have completed your prayer; if you wish to stand, then stand, and if you wish to sit, then sit."
2.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zuhayr se, al-Hasan ibn Hurr se, al-Qasim ibn Mukhaymirah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Alqamah ne mera haath pakda aur mujhse bataya, ke Abdullah ne unka haath pakda tha, aur ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne Abdullah ka haath pakda tha, aur unhein namaz mein tashahhud sikhaaya: "At-tahiyyaatu lillahi, was-salawaatu, wat-tayyibaat, as-salaamu 'alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakaatuh, as-salaamu 'alaynaa wa 'ala 'ibaadillahis-saaliheen" - Zuhayr kehte hain: mera khayal hai unhone kaha: "Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illallah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa Rasooluh." In do jumlon mein bhi shak hai: "Jab tum yeh kar chuko ya poora kar chuko, to tumne apni namaz poori kar li; agar khade hona chaho to khade ho jao, aur agar baithna chaho to baithe raho."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، قَالَ : الْحَكَمُ  أَخْبَرَنِي قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى  يَقُولُ : لَقِيَنِي كَعْبُ بْنُ عُجْرَةَ  ، فَقَالَ : أَلَا أُهْدِي لَكَ هَدِيَّةً؟ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا، فَقُلْنَا : قَدْ عَلِمْنَا كَيْفَ السَّلَامَ عَلَيْكَ، فَكَيْفَ نُصَلِّي عَلَيْكَ؟ قَالَ : " قُولُوا :اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ ، وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ ، وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, from Ibn Abi Layla, about Ka'b ibn Ujrah: He said: al-Hakam informed me, he said: I heard Ibn Abi Layla say: Ka'b ibn Ujrah met me, and said: "Shall I not give you a gift? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to us, so we said: 'We already know how to give you the salutation of peace, so how do we send blessings upon you?'" He said: "Say: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin, wa 'ala ali Muhammadin, kama sallayta 'ala ali Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid, wa barik 'ala Muhammadin, wa 'ala ali Muhammadin, kama barakta 'ala ali Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid."
2.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, al-Hakam ne mujhe bataya, unhone kaha: Maine Ibn Abi Layla ko kehte suna: Ka'b ibn Ujrah mujhse mile, aur kaha: "Kya main tumhein ek tohfa na dun? Rasulullah ﷺ humare paas aaye, to humne kaha: 'Humein maloom ho chuka hai ke aapko salaam kaise karein, to aap par durood kaise bhejein?'" Aapne farmaya: "Kaho: 'Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadiw-wa 'ala aali Muhammadin, kamaa sallayta 'ala aali Ibraheema, innaka Hameedum-Majeed, wa baarik 'ala Muhammadiw-wa 'ala aali Muhammadin, kamaa baarakta 'ala aali Ibraheema, innaka Hameedum-Majeed' [Ae Allah, Muhammad par aur Muhammad ki aal par rehmat naazil farma, jaise tune Ibrahim ki aal par ki, beshak tu qaabil-e-tareef aur azmat wala hai; aur Muhammad par aur Muhammad ki aal par barkat naazil farma, jaise tune Ibrahim ki aal par ki, beshak tu qaabil-e-tareef aur azmat wala hai]."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ نُعَيْمٍ الْمُجْمِرِ  مَوْلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ  الَّذِي كَانَ أُرِيَ النِّدَاءَ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّ أَبَا مَسْعُودٍ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ  ، قَالَ : أَتَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَجَلَسَ مَعَنَا فِي مَجْلِسِ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ بَشِيرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ وَهُوَ أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ : أَمَرَنَا اللَّهُ أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَكَيْفَ نُصَلِّي عَلَيْكَ؟ قَالَ : فَصَمَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَتَّى تَمَنَّيْنَا أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَسْأَلْهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " قُولُوا :اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، فِي الْعَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، وَالسَّلَامُ كَمَا قَدْ عَلِمْتُمْ "
2.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Malik, from Nu'aym al-Mujmir, freed servant of Umar ibn al-Khattab, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Zayd al-Ansari, about Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari: That Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to us and sat with us in the gathering of Sa'd ibn Ubadah, so Bashir ibn Sa'd - and he is the father of al-Nu'man ibn Bashir - said to him: "Allah has commanded us to send blessings upon you, O Messenger of Allah, so how do we send blessings upon you?" He said: So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ remained silent until we wished he had not asked him, then he said: "Say: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin, kama sallayta 'ala Ibrahima, wa barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin, kama barakta 'ala ali Ibrahima, fil-'alamina innaka Hamidun Majid, was-salamu kama qad 'alimtum."
2.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Malik se, Nu'aym al-Mujmir se (Umar ibn al-Khattab ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Zayd al-Ansari se bataya, jinhein Rasulullah ﷺ ke zamane mein azaan ki soorat dikhayi gayi thi: ke Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari ne kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ humare paas aaye aur Sa'd ibn Ubadah ki majlis mein humare saath baithe, to Bashir ibn Sa'd - jo al-Nu'man ibn Bashir ke walid hain - ne aapse poocha: "Allah ne humein aap par durood bhejne ka hukum diya hai, Ya Rasulullah, so hum aap par durood kaise bhejein?" Unhone bataya: To Rasulullah ﷺ khamosh ho gaye yahan tak ke humein khwaish hui ke kaash unhone na poocha hota, fir aapne farmaya: "Kaho: 'Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadiw-wa 'ala aali Muhammadin, kamaa sallayta 'ala Ibraheema, wa baarik 'ala Muhammadiw-wa 'ala aali Muhammadin, kamaa baarakta 'ala aali Ibraheema, fil-'aalameena innaka Hameedum-Majeed, was-salaamu kamaa qad 'alimtum' [...aur salaam waisa hi jaisa tumhein maloom hai]."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، عَنْ حَسَّانَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا فَرَغَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْ التَّشَهُّدِ، فَلْيَتَعَوَّذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ أَرْبَعٍ : مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَفِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَشَرِّ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ ".
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، نَحْوَهُ
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from Hassan, from Muhammad ibn Abi Aishah, from Abu Hurairah; a similar chain also via Muhammad ibn Kathir: He said: I heard Abu Hurairah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you finishes the tashahhud, let him seek refuge with Allah from four things: from the punishment of Hell, and the punishment of the grave, and the trial of life and death, and the evil of the Masih al-Dajjal." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Muhammad ibn Kathir, from al-Awza'i.]
2.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se, Hassan se, Muhammad ibn Abi Aishah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Hurairah ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se koi tashahhud se faarigh ho, to woh chaar cheezon se Allah ki panah maange: jahannam ke azaab se, aur qabar ke azaab se, jeene aur marne ke fitne se, aur Maseeh Dajjal ki buraai se." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Muhammad ibn Kathir se, al-Awza'i se bhi aayi hai.]

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : " كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَيُسَلِّمُ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ حَتَّى يُرَى بَيَاضُ خَدِّهِ، ثُمَّ يُسَلِّمُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ حَتَّى يُرَى بَيَاضُ خَدِّهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Abdullah ibn Ja'far, from Isma'il ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'd, from Amir ibn Sa'd, from his father: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to give the taslim to his right until the whiteness of his cheek could be seen, then give the taslim to his left until the whiteness of his cheek could be seen."
2.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Abdullah ibn Ja'far se, Isma'il ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'd se, Amir ibn Sa'd se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ apne daayen taraf salaam phertay yahan tak ke aapke gaal ki safedi dikhayi deti, fir apne baaye taraf salaam phertay yahan tak ke aapke gaal ki safedi dikhayi deti."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، وَمَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ  ، قَالَ : صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ رَجُلٍ بِمَكَّةَ" فَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمَتَيْنِ "، فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، فَقَالَ : أَنَّى عَلِقَهَا؟ وَقَالَ الْحَكَمُ : كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ
2.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Yahya, from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, and Mansur, from Mujahid, from Abu Ma'mar; with al-Hakam's note: He said: I prayed behind a man in Makkah, "and he gave two taslims," so I mentioned that to Abdullah, and he said: "Where did he pick that up?" And al-Hakam said: The Prophet ﷺ used to do that.
2.hi: Musaddad ne Yahya se, Shu'bah se, al-Hakam se, aur Mansur se, Mujahid se, Abu Ma'mar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Makkah mein ek aadmi ke peechhe namaz padhi, "to unhone do salaam pheray," so maine yeh baat Abdullah se zikr ki, to unhone kaha: "Yeh unhone kahan se seekha?" Aur al-Hakam ne kaha: Nabi ﷺ aisa kiya karte the.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا عَاصِمٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْوَلِيدِ هُوَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : مَا كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَجْلِسُ بَعْدَ الصَّلَاةِ إِلَّا قَدْرَ مَا يَقُولُ :" اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Asim, from Abu al-Walid (Abdullah ibn al-Harith), from Aisha: She said: The Prophet ﷺ would not sit after the prayer except for the measure of time it took to say: "Allahumma antas-salamu wa minkas-salamu, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Asim se, Abu al-Walid se (jo Abdullah ibn al-Harith hain), Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ namaz ke baad utni hi der baithte jitni der mein yeh kaha jaaye: "Allahumma antas-salaamu wa minkas-salaam, tabaarakta yaa dhal-jalaali wal-ikraam" [Ae Allah, tu hi Salam hai, aur tujhi se salaamati aati hai, tu bharpoor barkat wala hai, ae Jalaal aur Izzat wale].

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، عَنْ شَدَّادٍ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ الرَّحَبِيِّ  ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَنْصَرِفَ مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ، اسْتَغْفَرَ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، ثُمَّ قَالَ :" اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ "
