2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from Shaddad Abu Ammar, from Abu Asma al-Rahabi, from Thawban: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he wanted to leave [depart] from his prayer, would seek forgiveness three times, then say: "Allahumma antas-salamu wa minkas-salamu, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram."
2.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se, Shaddad Abu Ammar se, Abu Asma al-Rahabi se, Thawban se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ jab apni namaz se faarigh hona chahte, to teen martaba istighfaar karte, fir kehte: "Allahumma antas-salaamu wa minkas-salaam, tabaarakta yaa dhal-jalaali wal-ikraam."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ وَرَّادٍ  كَاتِبِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ : أَمْلَى عَلَيَّ الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ   فِي كِتَابٍ إِلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ مَكْتُوبَةٍ :" لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr, from Warrad, scribe of al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah: He said: al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah dictated to me in a letter to Mu'awiyah, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say at the end of every obligatory prayer: "La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayta, wa la mu'tiya lima mana'ta, wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr se, Warrad se, al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah ke katib, bataya: Unhone kaha, Al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah ne mujhse Mu'awiyah ko likhe hue khat mein likhwaya ke Rasulullah ﷺ har farz namaz ke baad kaha karte the: "Laa ilaaha illallahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadeer. Allahumma laa maani'a limaa a'tayt, wa laa mu'tiya limaa mana'ta, wa laa yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd" [Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, akela hai, uska koi shareek nahi, uski hi baadshahat hai aur usi ki tareef hai, aur woh har cheez par qaadir hai. Ae Allah, jo tu de use koi rokne wala nahi, aur jo tu roke use koi dene wala nahi, aur kisi khush-naseeb ki khush-naseebi teri taraf se kuch faida nahi de sakti].

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ  ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : لَا يَجْعَلْ أَحَدُكُمْ لِلشَّيْطَانِ نَصِيبًا مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ : يَرَى أَنَّ حَقًّا عَلَيْهِ أَنْ لَا يَنْصَرِفَ إِلَّا عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَثِيرًا" يَنْصَرِفُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from al-A'mash, from Umarah, from al-Aswad, from Abdullah: He said: "Let none of you make a portion for Shaytan in his prayer: thinking it is a duty upon him not to leave except to his right. Indeed I have often seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ 'leave to his left.'"
2.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Shu'bah se, al-A'mash se, Umarah se, al-Aswad se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Tum mein se koi apni namaz mein shaytan ke liye hissa na banaaye: yeh samajh kar ke uspar wajib hai ke woh sirf apne daayen taraf se hi namaz se hate. Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko aksar 'apne baaye taraf se hatte' dekha hai."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، عَنْ السُّدِّيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا  ، يَقُولُ : رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يَنْصَرِفُ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Isra'il, from al-Suddi, from Anas: He said: I heard Anas say: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "leave to his right."
2.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Isra'il se, al-Suddi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Anas ko kehte suna: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko "apne daayen taraf se hatte" dekha.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ السُّدِّيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ  ، قَالَ :" انْصَرَفَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ يَعْنِي : فِي الصَّلَاةِ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from al-Suddi, from Anas ibn Malik: He said: "The Prophet ﷺ left to his right" - meaning: in the prayer.
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, al-Suddi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Anas ibn Malik ko kehte suna: "Nabi ﷺ apne daayen taraf se hatte" - yaani, namaz mein.

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِقْلٌ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي حَسَّانُ بْنُ عَطِيَّةَ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ أَبُو ذَرٍّ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، ذَهَبَ أَصْحَابُ الدُّثُورِ بِالْأُجُورِ، يُصَلُّونَ كَمَا نُصَلِّي، وَيَصُومُونَ كَمَا نَصُومُ، وَلَهُمْ فُضُولُ أَمْوَالٍ يَتَصَدَّقُونَ، بِهَا وَلَيْسَ لَنَا مَا نَتَصَدَّقُ.
قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَفَلَا أُعَلِّمُكَ كَلِمَاتٍ إِذَا أَنْتَ قُلْتَهُنَّ، أَدْرَكْتَ مَنْ سَبَقَكَ، وَلَمْ يَلْحَقْكَ مَنْ خَلَفَكَ إِلَّا مَنْ عَمِلَ بِمِثْلِ عَمَلِكَ؟ ".
قَالَ : قُلْتُ : بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ.
قَالَ : " تُسَبِّحُ دُبُرَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ، وَتَحْمَدُهُ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ، وَتُكَبِّرُهُ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ، وَتَخْتِمُهَا بِلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ "
2.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Musa, from Hiql, from al-Awza'i, from Hassan ibn Atiyyah, from Muhammad ibn Abi Aishah, from Abu Hurairah, about Abu Dharr: He said: Abu Dharr said: "O Messenger of Allah, the wealthy have taken away the rewards, they pray as we pray, and fast as we fast, and they have surplus wealth with which they give charity, and we have nothing with which to give charity." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Shall I not teach you words, that if you say them, you will catch up with those who preceded you, and none who come after you will catch up with you, except one who does the like of your deed?" He said: I said: "Yes indeed, O Messenger of Allah." He said: "You glorify [Allah] at the end of every prayer thirty-three times, and praise Him thirty-three times, and magnify Him thirty-three times, and conclude it with: 'La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulku, wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.'"
2.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Musa ne Hiql se, al-Awza'i se, Hassan ibn Atiyyah se, Muhammad ibn Abi Aishah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abu Dharr ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, maal-daar log sawaab le gaye, woh namaz padhte hain jaise hum padhte hain, aur roze rakhte hain jaise hum rakhte hain, aur unke paas ziyaada maal hai jisse woh sadqa dete hain, aur humare paas kuch nahi jisse hum sadqa dein." Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Kya main tumhein aise kalimaat na sikhaun ke agar tum unhein kaho, to tum unse aage badh jao jo tumse aage hain, aur tumse peechhe wale tumse aage na badh sakein, siwaay us shakhs ke jo tumhare jaisa hi amal kare?" Unhone bataya: Maine kaha: "Zaroor, Ya Rasulullah." Aapne farmaya: "Tum har namaz ke baad taintees martaba tasbih karo, aur taintees martaba hamd karo, aur taintees martaba takbir karo, aur ise is se khatam karo: 'Laa ilaaha illallahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku, wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadeer.'"

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ أَفْلَحَ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ  ، قَالَ :" أُمِرْنَا أَنْ نُسَبِّحَ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ، وَنَحْمَدَهُ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ، وَنُكَبِّرَ أَرْبَعًا وَثَلَاثِينَ "، فَأُتِيَ رَجُلٌ أَوْ أُرِيَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ الْأَنْصَارِ فِي الْمَنَامِ، فَقِيلَ : أَمَرَكُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْ تُسَبِّحُوا اللَّهَ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ، وَتَحْمَدُوا ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ، وَتُكَبِّرُوا أَرْبَعًا وَثَلَاثِينَ؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ.
قَالَ : فَاجْعَلُوهَا خَمْسًا وَعِشْرِينَ، خَمْسًا وَعِشْرِينَ، وَاجْعَلُوا مَعَهَا التَّهْلِيلَ، فَأُخْبِرَ بِذَلِكَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : " افْعَلُوهَا "
2.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Hisham ibn Hassan, from Muhammad ibn Sirin, from Kathir ibn Aflah, from Zayd ibn Thabit: He said: "We were commanded to glorify [Allah] at the end of every prayer thirty-three times, and to praise Him thirty-three times, and to magnify Him thirty-four times," so a man came to, or a man from the Ansar was shown in a dream, and it was said [to him]: "Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ command you to glorify Allah at the end of every prayer thirty-three times, and praise Him thirty-three times, and magnify Him thirty-four times?" He said, "Yes." He said: "Then make them twenty-five, twenty-five, and add with them the tahlil," so the Prophet ﷺ was informed of that, and he said: "Do it."
2.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Hisham ibn Hassan se, Muhammad ibn Sirin se, Kathir ibn Aflah se, Zayd ibn Thabit se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Humein hukum diya gaya tha ke hum har namaz ke baad taintees martaba tasbih karein, aur taintees martaba hamd karein, aur chauntees martaba takbir karein," so ek aadmi aaya, ya Ansar ke ek aadmi ko khwab mein dikhaaya gaya, aur usse poocha gaya: "Kya Rasulullah ﷺ ne tumhein hukum diya tha ke tum har namaz ke baad Allah ki taintees martaba tasbih karo, aur taintees martaba hamd karo, aur chauntees martaba takbir karo?" Usne kaha, "Haan." Usne kaha: "To inhein pachees-pachees kar do, aur inke saath tahlil ('La ilaha illallah') bhi shaamil karo," so yeh baat Nabi ﷺ ko batayi gayi, to aapne farmaya: "Aisa hi karo."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ  ، عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى  ، عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " إِنَّأَوَّلَ مَا يُحَاسَبُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ الصَّلَاةُ، فَإِنْ وَجَدَ صَلَاتَهُ كَامِلَةً، كُتِبَتْ لَهُ كَامِلَةً، وَإِنْ كَانَ فِيهَا نُقْصَانٌ، قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى لِمَلَائِكَتِهِ : انْظُرُوا هَلْ لِعَبْدِي مِنْ تَطَوُّعٍ فَأَكْمِلُوا لَهُ مَا نَقَصَ مِنْ فَرِيضَتِهِ، ثُمَّ الزَّكَاةُ، ثُمَّ الْأَعْمَالُ عَلَى حَسَبِ ذَلِكَ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : لَا أَعْلَمُ أَحَدًا رَفَعَهُ غَيْرَ حَمَّادٍ.
قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ : صَحَّ هَذَا؟ قَالَ : لَا
2.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Da'ud ibn Abi Hind, from Zurarah ibn Awfa, from Tamim al-Dari; with Abu Muhammad's confirmation exchange: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The first thing for which the servant will be brought to account is the prayer; if he finds his prayer complete, it is recorded for him complete, and if there is in it a deficiency, Allah the Exalted says to His angels: 'Look, does My servant have any voluntary [prayer]? Then complete for him what is lacking of his obligatory [prayer],' then the zakah, then the [rest of the] deeds are according to that." Abu Muhammad said: I do not know of anyone who raised it except Hammad. It was said to Abu Muhammad: "Is this authentic?" He said, "No."
2.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Da'ud ibn Abi Hind se, Zurarah ibn Awfa se, Tamim al-Dari se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Banda se sabse pehle jiska hisaab liya jaayega woh namaz hai; agar usne apni namaz mukammal paayi, to woh use mukammal likh di jaayegi, aur agar usmein kami ho, to Allah Ta'ala apne farishton se farmata hai: 'Dekho, kya mere bande ke paas koi nafl hai? To uski farz namaz ki kami usse poori kar do,' fir zakat, fir baaki a'maal isi tarah [ka hisaab hota hai]." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Mujhe Hammad ke siwa kisi ke bare mein nahi maloom jisne ise marfu' (Nabi tak) bayaan kiya ho. Abu Muhammad se poocha gaya: "Kya yeh sahih hai?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَطَاءٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا حُمَيْدٍ السَّاعِدِيَّ   فِي عَشَرَةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَحَدُهُمْ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ : أَنَا أَعْلَمُكُمْ بِصَلَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
 فَقَالُوا : لِمَ؟ فَمَا كُنْتَ أَكْثَرَنَا لَهُ تَبَعَةً، وَلَا أَقْدَمَنَا لَهُ صُحْبَةً؟ قَالَ : بَلَى.
قَالُوا : فَاعْرِضْ.
قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" إِذَا قَامَ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ، رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى يُحَاذِيَ بِهِمَا مَنْكِبَيْهِ، ثُمَّ كَبَّرُ حَتَّى يَقَرَّ كُلُّ عَظْمٍ فِي مَوْضِعِهِ، ثُمَّ يَقْرَأُ، ثُمَّ يُكَبِّرُ وَيَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى يُحَاذِيَ بِهِمَا مَنْكِبَيْهِ، ثُمَّ يَرْكَعُ وَيَضَعُ رَاحَتَيْهِ عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ كُلُّ عَظْمٍ إِلَى مَوْضِعِهِ، وَلَا يُصَوِّبُ رَأْسَهُ وَلَا يُقْنِعُ، ثُمَّ يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ فَيَقُولُ : سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، ثُمَّ يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى يُحَاذِيَ بِهِمَا مَنْكِبَيْهِ يَظُنُّ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ : حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ كُلُّ عَظْمٍ إِلَى مَوْضِعِهِ مُعْتَدِلًا ، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ : اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، ثُمَّ يَهْوِي إِلَى الْأَرْضِ فَيُجَافِي يَدَيْهِ عَنْ جَنْبَيْهِ، ثُمَّ يَسْجُدُ، ثُمَّ يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ فَيَثْنِي رِجْلَهُ الْيُسْرَى فَيَقْعُدُ عَلَيْهَا، وَيَفْتَحُ أَصَابِعَ رِجْلَيْهِ إِذَا سَجَدَ، ثُمَّ يَعُودُ فَيَسْجُدُ، ثُمَّ يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ فَيَقُولُ : اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَيَثْنِي رِجْلَهُ الْيُسْرَى فَيَقْعُدُ عَلَيْهَا مُعْتَدِلًا، حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ كُلُّ عَظْمٍ إِلَى مَوْضِعِهِ مُعْتَدِلًا، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيَصْنَعُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الْأُخْرَى مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، فَإِذَا قَامَ مِنْ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ، كَبَّرَ وَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى يُحَاذِيَ بِهِمَا مَنْكِبَيْهِ كَمَا فَعَلَ عِنْدَ افْتِتَاحِ الصَّلَاةِ، ثُمَّ يَصْنَعُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ فِي بَقِيَّةِ صَلَاتِهِ، حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَتْ السَّجْدَةُ أَوْ الْقَعْدَةُ الَّتِي يَكُونُ فِيهَا التَّسْلِيمُ، أَخَّرَ رِجْلَهُ الْيُسْرَى وَجَلَسَ مُتَوَرِّكًا عَلَى شِقِّهِ الْأَيْسَرِ ".
قَالَ : قَالُوا : صَدَقْتَ، هَكَذَا كَانَتْ صَلَاةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
2.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Abd al-Hamid ibn Ja'far, from Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Ata, from Abu Humayd al-Sa'idi, among ten Companions including Abu Qatadah: He said: I heard Abu Humayd al-Sa'idi say, among ten of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ, one of them Abu Qatadah: "I am the most knowledgeable of you concerning the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." They said: "Why? You were not more of a follower of him than us, nor were you more senior in companionship than us?" He said: "Yes indeed [I am]." They said: "Then present it." He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ "when he stood for the prayer, would raise his hands until they were level with his shoulders, then say the takbir until every bone settled in its place, then he would recite, then he would say the takbir and raise his hands until they were level with his shoulders, then he would bow and place his palms on his knees until every bone returned to its place, and he would not lower his head nor raise it up, then he would raise his head and say: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah,' then raise his hands until they were level with his shoulders" - Abu Asim thinks he said: "until every bone returned to its place, evenly," "then he would say: 'Allahu Akbar,' then descend to the ground and hold his arms away from his sides, then he would prostrate, then he would raise his head and fold his left leg and sit on it, and he would spread the toes of his feet when he prostrated, then he would return and prostrate, then raise his head and say: 'Allahu Akbar,' and fold his left leg and sit on it evenly, until every bone returned to its place evenly, then he would stand and do the like of that in the other rak'ah, so when he stood from the two prostrations, he would say the takbir and raise his hands until they were level with his shoulders as he did at the opening of the prayer, then he would do the like of that in the rest of his prayer, until when it was the prostration or the sitting in which the taslim occurs, he would draw back his left leg and sit resting on his left side." He said: They said: "You have spoken the truth, this is how the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was."
2.hi: Abu Asim ne Abd al-Hamid ibn Ja'far se, Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Ata se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Humayd al-Sa'idi ko das sahaba-e-Nabi ﷺ ke darmiyan kehte suna, jinmein se ek Abu Qatadah the: "Main tum sabse zyada Rasulullah ﷺ ki namaz ke baare mein jaanne wala hoon." Unhone poocha: "Kyun? Aap humse zyada aapki pairwi karne wale to nahi the, aur na hi aap humse zyada pehle sahabi bane?" Unhone kaha: "Balke [main hoon]." Unhone kaha: "To pesh kijiye." Unhone kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ "jab namaz ke liye khade hote, to apne haath apne kandhon ke barabar uthaate, fir takbir kehte yahan tak ke har haddi apni jagah aa jaati, fir aap qiraat karte, fir takbir kehte aur apne haath apne kandhon ke barabar uthaate, fir ruku karte aur apni hatheliyan apne ghutnon par is tarah rakhte yahan tak ke har haddi apni jagah wapas aa jaati, aur na apna sar neeche karte na upar uthaate, fir apna sar uthaate aur kehte: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah,' fir apne haath apne kandhon ke barabar uthaate" - Abu Asim ka khayal hai unhone kaha: "yahan tak ke har haddi seedhi hokar apni jagah wapas aa jaati," "fir kehte: 'Allahu Akbar,' fir zameen ki taraf jhukte aur apni baazuein apne pehluon se door rakhte, fir sajda karte, fir apna sar uthaate aur apni baayen taang mod kar uspar baith jaate, aur jab sajda karte to apne paaon ki ungliyan phaila lete, fir wapas jaate aur sajda karte, fir sar uthaate aur kehte: 'Allahu Akbar,' aur apni baayen taang mod kar seedha uspar baith jaate, yahan tak ke har haddi seedhi hokar apni jagah wapas aa jaati, fir khade hote aur doosri rakat mein isi tarah karte, so jab do sajdon se khade hote, to takbir kehte aur apne haath apne kandhon ke barabar uthaate jaise namaz ki shuruaat mein karte the, fir baaki namaz mein isi tarah karte, yahan tak ke jab woh sajda ya baithak hoti jismein salaam hota, to apni baayen taang peechhe kar lete aur apne baaye pehlu par tik kar baith jaate." Unhone bataya: Unhone kaha: "Aapne sach kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ki namaz isi tarah hoti thi."

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ بْنُ قُدَامَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ كُلَيْبٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي  ، أَنَّ وَائِلَ بْنَ حُجْرٍ   أَخْبَرَهُ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : لَأَنْظُرَنَّ إِلَى صَلَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَيْفَ يُصَلِّي؟ فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَيْهِ" فَقَامَ فَكَبَّرَ، فَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى حَاذَتَا بِأُذُنَيْهِ، وَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى ظَهْرِ كَفِّهِ الْيُسْرَى، قَالَ : ثُمَّ لَمَّا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ، رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ مِثْلَهَا، وَوَضَعَ يَدَيْهِ عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ، ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ، فَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ مِثْلَهَا، ثُمَّ سَجَدَ فَجَعَلَ كَفَّيْهِ بِحِذَاءِ أُذُنَيْهِ، ثُمَّ قَعَدَ فَافْتَرَشَ رِجْلَهُ الْيُسْرَى، وَوَضَعَ كَفَّهُ الْيُسْرَى عَلَى فَخِذِهِ وَرُكْبَتِهِ الْيُسْرَى، وَجَعَلَ مِرْفَقَهُ الْأَيْمَنَ عَلَى فَخْذِهِ الْيُمْنَى، ثُمَّ قَبَضَ ثِنْتَيْنِ، فَحَلَّقَ حَلْقَةً، ثُمَّ رَفَعَ أُصْبُعَهُ فَرَأَيْتُهُ يُحَرِّكُهَا، يَدْعُو بِهَا ".
قَالَ : ثُمَّ جِئْتُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فِي زَمَانٍ فِيهِ بَرْدٌ، فَرَأَيْتُ عَلَى النَّاسِ جُلَّ الثِّيَابِ يُحَرِّكُونَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ مِنْ تَحْتِ الثِّيَابِ
2.en: Narrated by Mu'awiyah ibn Amr, from Za'idah ibn Qudamah, from Asim ibn Kulayb, from his father, from Wa'il ibn Hujr: He said: I said: I will surely look at the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, how does he pray? So I looked at him, "so he stood and said the takbir, and raised his hands until they were level with his ears, and placed his right hand on the back of his left palm." He said: Then when he wanted to bow, he raised his hands the same way, and placed his hands on his knees, then he raised his head, and raised his hands the same way, then he prostrated and placed his palms level with his ears, then he sat and spread out his left leg, and placed his left palm on his left thigh and knee, and placed his right elbow on his right thigh, then he closed two [fingers], and formed a circle, then he raised his finger, and I saw him move it, supplicating with it." He said: Then I came after that in a time when it was cold, and I saw the people wearing thick garments, moving their hands from beneath the garments.
2.hi: Mu'awiyah ibn Amr ne Za'idah ibn Qudamah se, Asim ibn Kulayb se, apne walid se, Wa'il ibn Hujr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine kaha: Main zaroor Rasulullah ﷺ ki namaz dekhunga, aap kaise padhte hain? So maine aapko dekha, "to aap khade hue aur takbir kahi, aur apne haath apne kaanon ke barabar uthaaye, aur apna daaya haath apni baayen hatheli ki pusht par rakha." Unhone bataya: Fir jab aap ruku karna chahte, to isi tarah apne haath uthaate, aur apne haath apne ghutnon par rakhte, fir sar uthaate, aur isi tarah apne haath uthaate, fir sajda karte aur apni hatheliyan apne kaanon ke barabar rakhte, fir baithte aur apni baayen taang phaila dete, aur apni baayen hatheli apni baayen raan aur ghutne par rakhte, aur apni daayen kohni apni daayen raan par rakhte, fir do [ungliyan] band karte, aur ek chhalla banaate, fir apni ungli uthaate, aur maine unhein use hilaate dekha, usse dua karte hue. Unhone bataya: Fir main iske baad ek aisi ritu mein aaya jismein sardi thi, to maine logon ko mote kapde pehne dekha, apne haath kapdon ke neeche se hilaate hue.

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ حِطَّانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيِّ  ، قَالَ : صَلَّى بِنَا أَبُو مُوسَى : إِحْدَى صَلَاتَيْ الْعِشيِّ، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ الْقَوْمِ : أُقِرَّتْ الصَّلَاةُ بِالْبِرِّ وَالزَّكَاةِ، فَلَمَّا قَضَى أَبُو مُوسَى الصَّلَاةَ، قَالَ : أَيُّكُمْ الْقَائِلُ كَلِمَةَ كَذَا وَكَذَا، فَأَرَمَّ الْقَوْمُ.
فَقَالَ : لَعَلَّكَ يَا حِطَّانُ قُلْتَهَا؟ قَالَ : مَا أَنَا قُلْتُهَا، وَقَدْ خِفْتُ أَنْ تَبْكَعَنِي بِهَا.
فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ الْقَوْمِ : أَنَا قُلْتُهَا، وَمَا أَرَدْتُ بِهَا إِلَّا الْخَيْرَ.
 فَقَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى   : أَوَ مَا تَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَقُولُونَ فِي صَلَاتِكُمْ؟ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَطَبَنَا فَعَلَّمَنَا صَلَاتَنَا، وَبَيَّنَ لَنَا سُنَّتَنَا.
قَالَ : أَحْسَبُهُ قَالَ :" إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ، فَلْيَؤُمَّكُمْ أَحَدُكُمْ، فَإِذَا كَبَّرَ، فَكَبِّرُوا، وَإِذَا قَالَ : # غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلا الضَّالِّينَ سورة الفاتحة آية 7 #، فَقُولُوا : آمِينَ، يُجِبْكُمْ اللَّهُ، فَإِذَا كَبَّرَ، وَرَكَعَ فَكَبِّرُوا، وَارْكَعُوا، فَإِنَّ الْإِمَامَ يَرْكَعُ قَبْلَكُمْ وَيَرْفَعُ قَبْلَكُمْ "، قَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " فَتِلْكَ بِتِلْكَ، فَإِذَا قَالَ : سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، فَقُولُوا : اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَوْ قَالَ : رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَالَ عَلَى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّهِ : سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، فَإِذَا كَبَّرَ وَسَجَدَ، فَكَبِّرُوا وَاسْجُدُوا، فَإِنَّ الْإِمَامَ يَسْجُدُ قَبْلَكُمْ، وَيَرْفَعُ قَبْلَكُمْ "، قَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " فَتِلْكَ بِتِلْكَ، فَإِذَا كَانَ عِنْدَ الْقَعْدَةِ فَلْيَكُنْ مِنْ أَوَّلِ قَوْلِ أَحَدِكُمْ : التَّحِيَّاتُ الطَّيِّبَاتُ الصَّلَوَاتُ لِلَّهِ، السَّلَامُ أَوْ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ أَوْ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Sa'id ibn Abi Arubah, from Qatadah, from Yunus ibn Jubayr, from Hittan ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi, about Abu Musa: He said: Abu Musa led us in one of the two evening prayers, so a man from the group said: "The prayer has been established with righteousness and zakah," so when Abu Musa finished the prayer, he said: "Which of you said such-and-such a word?" So the people remained silent. So he said: "Perhaps you, O Hittan, said it?" He said: "I did not say it, and indeed I feared you would rebuke me for it." So a man from the group said: "I said it, and I intended by it nothing but good." So Abu Musa said: "Do you not know what you say in your prayer? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ addressed us and taught us our prayer, and made clear to us our practice." He said: I think he said: "When the prayer is established, let one of you lead you; when he says the takbir, say the takbir, and when he says: 'Not of those who have earned [Your] anger, nor of those who have gone astray' [Surah al-Fatihah, verse 7], say: Amin, Allah will respond to you; and when he says the takbir and bows, say the takbir and bow, for indeed the imam bows before you and rises before you." The Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: "So that is for that; and when he says: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah,' say: 'Allahumma Rabbana lakal-hamd,' or he said: 'Rabbana wa lakal-hamd,' for indeed Allah said on the tongue of His Prophet: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah'; and when he says the takbir and prostrates, say the takbir and prostrate, for indeed the imam prostrates before you and rises before you." The Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: "So that is for that; and when it is at the sitting, let the first thing one of you says be: 'At-tahiyyatut-tayyibatus-salawatu lillah, as-salamu' or 'salamun 'alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuhu, as-salamu' or 'salamun 'alayna wa 'ala 'ibadillahis-salihin, ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa Rasuluh.'"
2.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Sa'id ibn Abi Arubah se, Qatadah se, Yunus ibn Jubayr se, Hittan ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abu Musa ne humein shaam ki do namazon mein se ek padhaayi, to jama'at mein se ek shakhs ne kaha: "Namaz neki aur zakat ke saath qaayam ki gayi." So jab Abu Musa namaz se faarigh hue, to unhone poocha: "Tum mein se kisne fulaana-fulaana baat kahi?" To log khamosh ho gaye. To unhone kaha: "Shayad tumne kaha ho, ae Hittan?" Unhone kaha: "Maine nahi kaha, aur mujhe dar tha ke aap mujhe iske liye daantenge." To jama'at mein se ek aadmi ne kaha: "Maine kaha, aur mera irada isse sirf khair ka tha." To Abu Musa ne kaha: "Kya tumhein nahi maloom ke tum apni namaz mein kya kehte ho? Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein khutba diya aur humein humari namaz sikhaayi, aur humare liye humara tareeqa saaf kar diya." Unhone bataya: Mera khayal hai aapne farmaya: "Jab namaz ki iqamah ho, to tum mein se koi ek tumhein padhaaye; jab woh takbir kahe, to tum bhi takbir kaho, aur jab woh kahe: 'Ghayril-maghdoobi 'alayhim wa lad-dalleen' [Surah Al-Fatihah, aayat 7], to 'Ameen' kaho, Allah tumhari dua qabool karega; aur jab woh takbir kahe aur ruku kare, to tum bhi takbir kaho aur ruku karo, kyunki imam tumse pehle ruku karta hai aur tumse pehle uthta hai." Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "So woh us [pehle uthne] ke badle mein hai; aur jab woh kahe: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah,' to tum kaho: 'Allahumma Rabbana lakal-hamd,' ya aapne kaha: 'Rabbana wa lakal-hamd,' kyunki Allah ne apne Nabi ki zubaan par farmaya: 'Sami' Allahu liman hamidah'; aur jab woh takbir kahe aur sajda kare, to tum bhi takbir kaho aur sajda karo, kyunki imam tumse pehle sajda karta hai aur tumse pehle uthta hai." Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "So woh us [pehle uthne] ke badle mein hai; aur jab baithne ka waqt aaye, to tum mein se sabse pehle yeh kahe: 'At-tahiyyaatut-tayyibaatus-salawaatu lillah, as-salaamu' ya 'salaamun 'alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakaatuh, as-salaamu' ya 'salaamun 'alaynaa wa 'ala 'ibaadillahis-saaliheen, ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illallah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa Rasooluh.'"

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ هُوَ النَّبِيلُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ  ، عَنْ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" خَرَجَ يُصَلِّي وَقَدْ حَمَلَ عَلَى عُنُقِهِ أَوْ عَاتِقِهِ أُمَامَةَ بِنْتَ زَيْنَبَ ، فَإِذَا رَكَعَ، وَضَعَهَا، وَإِذَا قَامَ، حَمَلَهَا "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Asim al-Nabil, from Ibn Ajlan, from al-Maqburi, from Amr ibn Sulaym, from Abu Qatadah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "went out to pray, and had carried on his neck or shoulder Umamah bint Zaynab, and when he bowed, he put her down, and when he stood, he carried her."
2.hi: Abu Asim al-Nabil ne Ibn Ajlan se, al-Maqburi se, Amr ibn Sulaym se, Abu Qatadah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "namaz ke liye nikle jabke Umamah bint Zaynab ko apni gardan ya kandhe par uthaya hua tha, so jab ruku karte, to unhein rakh dete, aur jab khade hote, to unhein uthaa lete."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ الزُّرَقِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ، قَالَ :" حَمَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أُمَامَةَ بِنْتَ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُوَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ، فَإِذَا سَجَدَ، وَضَعَهَا، وَإِذَا قَامَ حَمَلَهَا "
2.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Amir ibn Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr, from Amr ibn Sulaym al-Zuraqi, from Abu Qatadah al-Ansari: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ carried Umamah bint Zaynab, daughter of the Messenger of Allah's ﷺ daughter, while he was in the prayer, and when he prostrated, he put her down, and when he stood, he carried her."
2.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Amir ibn Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr se, Amr ibn Sulaym al-Zuraqi se, Abu Qatadah al-Ansari se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Umamah bint Zaynab, Rasulullah ﷺ ki beti ki beti, ko namaz ki haalat mein uthaya, so jab sajda karte, to unhein rakh dete, aur jab khade hote, to unhein uthaa lete."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ هُوَ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي بُكَيْرٌ هُوَ ابْنُ الْأَشَجِّ  ، عَنْ نَابِلٍ  صَاحِبِ الْعَبَاءِ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ صُهَيْبٍ  ، قَالَ :" مَرَرْتُ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي، فَرَدَّ إِلَيَّ إِشَارَةً ".
قَالَ لَيْثٌ : أَحْسَبُهُ قَالَ : بِأُصْبُعِهِ
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Layth ibn Sa'd, from Bukayr ibn al-Ashajj, from Nabil (companion of the cloak), from Ibn Umar, from Suhayb: He said: "I passed by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and greeted him while he was praying, so he returned to me a gesture." Layth said: I believe he said: with his finger.
2.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Layth ibn Sa'd se, Bukayr ibn al-Ashajj se, Nabil (chaadar wale sahabi) se, Ibn Umar se, Suhayb se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Main Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas se guzra aur aapko salaam kiya jabke aap namaz padh rahe the, to aapne mujhe ishare se jawab diya." Layth kehte hain: Mera khayal hai unhone kaha: apni ungli se.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ دَخَلَ مَسْجِدَ بَنِي عَمْرِو بْنِ عَوْفٍ، فَدَخَلَ النَّاسُ يُسَلِّمُونَ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ، قَالَ : فَسَأَلْتُ صُهَيْبًا : كَيْفَ كَانَ يَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِمْ؟ قَالَ :" هَكَذَا، وَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from Ibn Umar, about Suhayb: That the Prophet ﷺ entered the mosque of Banu Amr ibn Awf, and the people entered greeting him while he was in the prayer, he said: So I asked Suhayb: "How did he return their greeting?" He said: "Like this," and he gestured with his hand.
2.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se, Zayd ibn Aslam se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ Banu Amr ibn Awf ki masjid mein dakhil hue, aur log dakhil hokar aapko salaam karne lage jabke aap namaz mein the, unhone bataya: To maine Suhayb se poocha: "Aap unhein salaam ka jawab kaise dete the?" Unhone kaha: "Isi tarah," aur apne haath se ishara kiya.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" التَّسْبِيحُ لِلرِّجَالِ، وَالتَّصْفِيقُ لِلنِّسَاءِ "
2.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Sufyan, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Glorification is for the men, and clapping is for the women."
2.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Sufyan se, al-Zuhri se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Tasbih mardon ke liye hai, aur taali (hath par hath maarna) auraton ke liye."

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ  ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" إِذَا نَابَكُمْ شَيْءٌ فِي صَلَاتِكُمْ، فَلْيُسَبِّحْ الرِّجَالُ، وَلْتُصَفِّحْ النِّسَاءُ ".
أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْجُمَحِيُّ  ، وَعَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، وَعَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ  ، وَسُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ  ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، مِثْلَهُ
2.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Abu Hazim, from Sahl ibn Sa'd; a similar chain also via Sa'id ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Jumahi, Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Hazim, and Sufyan ibn Uyaynah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When something occurs to you in your prayer, let the men glorify [Allah], and let the women clap." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Sa'id ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Jumahi, and Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, and Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Hazim, and Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Abu Hazim, from Sahl ibn Sa'd, from the Prophet ﷺ, the like of it.]
2.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Abu Hazim se, Sahl ibn Sa'd se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jab tumhari namaz mein kuch [waqia] pesh aaye, to mard tasbih karein, aur auratein taali bajaayein." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Sa'id ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Jumahi se, aur Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, aur Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Hazim se, aur Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se, Abu Hazim se, Sahl ibn Sa'd se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai.]

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ  ، عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" عَلَيْكُمْ بِالصَّلَاةِ فِي بُيُوتِكُمْ، فَإِنَّ خَيْرَ صَلَاةِ الْمَرْءِ فِي بَيْتِهِ إِلَّا الْجَمَاعَةَ "
2.en: Narrated by Makki ibn Ibrahim, from Abdullah ibn Sa'id ibn Abi Hind, from Abu al-Nadr, from Busr ibn Sa'id, from Zayd ibn Thabit: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "You must pray in your houses, for indeed the best prayer of a man is in his house, except the obligatory [congregational prayer]."
2.hi: Makki ibn Ibrahim ne Abdullah ibn Sa'id ibn Abi Hind se, Abu al-Nadr se, Busr ibn Sa'id se, Zayd ibn Thabit se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Apne gharon mein namaz padha karo, kyunki aadmi ki behtareen namaz uske ghar mein hoti hai, siwaay farz [jama'at wali namaz] ke."

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ السُّوَائِيَّ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، أَنَّهُ صَلَّى مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ صَلَاةَ الصُّبْحِ، قَالَ : فَإِذَا رَجُلَانِ حِينَ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَاعِدَانِ فِي نَاحِيَةٍ لَمْ يُصَلِّيَا، قَالَ : فَدَعَاهُمَا، فَجِيءَ بِهِمَا تُرْعَدُ فَرَائِصُهُمَا.
قَالَ : " مَا مَنَعَكُمَا أَنْ تُصَلِّيَا؟ " قَالَا : صَلَّيْنَا فِي رِحَالِنَا، قَالَ : " فَلَا تَفْعَلَا،إِذَا صَلَّيْتُمَا فِي رِحَالِكُمَا ثُمَّ أَدْرَكْتُمَا الْإِمَامَ، فَصَلِّيَا فَإِنَّهَا لَكُمَا نَافِلَةٌ ".
قَالَ : فَقَامَ النَّاسُ يَأْخُذُونَ بِيَدِهِ يَمْسَحُونَ بِهَا وُجُوهَهُمْ، قَالَ : فَأَخَذْتُ بِيَدِهِ فَمَسَحْتُ بِهَا وَجْهِي، فَإِذَا هِيَ أَبْرَدُ مِنْ الثَّلْجِ، وَأَطْيَبُ رِيحًا مِنْ الْمِسْكِ
2.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Ya'la ibn Ata, from Jabir ibn Yazid ibn al-Aswad al-Suwa'i, from his father: He said: I heard Jabir ibn Yazid ibn al-Aswad al-Suwa'i narrating, from his father: that he prayed the Subh prayer with the Prophet ﷺ, he said: So there were two men, when the Prophet ﷺ had prayed, sitting to one side, who had not prayed, he said: So he called the two of them, and they were brought, their sinews trembling. He said: "What kept the two of you from praying?" They said: "We prayed in our lodgings." He said: "Do not do that; when you have prayed in your lodgings then catch up with the imam, then pray, for indeed it is a voluntary [prayer] for you." He said: So the people stood up taking his hand, wiping their faces with it, he said: So I took his hand and wiped my face with it, and it was colder than snow, and more fragrant than musk.
2.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se, Ya'la ibn Ata se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Jabir ibn Yazid ibn al-Aswad al-Suwa'i ko apne walid se yeh bayaan karte suna: ke unhone Nabi ﷺ ke saath Subh ki namaz padhi, unhone bataya: To jab Nabi ﷺ ne namaz padh li, to do aadmi ek konay mein baithe the, jinhone namaz nahi padhi thi, unhone bataya: To aapne unhein bulaya, aur unhein laaya gaya, unki naseen kaanp rahi thin. Aapne poocha: "Tum dono ko namaz padhne se kis cheez ne roka?" Unhone kaha: "Humne apne dero mein namaz padh li thi." Aapne farmaya: "Aisa mat karo; jab tum apne dero mein namaz padh chuko, fir imam ko paao, to unke saath [dobara] namaz padho, kyunki yeh tumhare liye nafl hai." Unhone bataya: To log uthkar aapka haath pakadne lage, usse apne chehre poonchte hue, unhone bataya: To maine bhi aapka haath pakda aur apna chehra usse poonchha, to woh barf se zyada thanda tha, aur mushk se zyada khushbudaar.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ الْأَسْوَدُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ النَّاجِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَأَى رَجُلًا يُصَلِّي وَحْدَهُ، فَقَالَ :" أَلَا رَجُلٌ يَتَصَدَّقُ عَلَى هَذَا فَيُصَلِّي مَعَهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Wuhayb, from Sulayman al-Aswad, from Abu al-Mutawakkil al-Naji, from Abu Sa'id: That the Prophet ﷺ saw a man praying alone, so he said: "Will not a man give charity to this one by praying with him?"
2.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Wuhayb se, Sulayman al-Aswad se, Abu al-Mutawakkil al-Naji se, Abu Sa'id se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne ek aadmi ko akela namaz padhte dekha, to farmaya: "Kya koi is [aadmi] par ehsaan karke iske saath namaz nahi padhega?"

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ الْأَسْوَدُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ النَّاجِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ وَقَدْ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ :" أَلَا رَجُلٌ يَتَصَدَّقُ عَلَى هَذَا فَيُصَلِّي مَعَهُ؟ ".
 قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : يُصَلِّي صَلَاةَ الْعَصْرِ وَيُصَلِّي الْمَغْرِبَ وَلَكِنْ يَشْفَعُ
2.en: Narrated by Affan, from Wuhayb, from Sulayman al-Aswad, from Abu al-Mutawakkil al-Naji, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri; with Abdullah's clarification: That a man entered the mosque and the Prophet ﷺ had [already] prayed, so he said: "Will not a man give charity to this one by praying with him?" Abdullah said: He prays the Asr prayer and prays the Maghrib, but he makes it an even [number of rak'ahs].
2.hi: Affan ne Wuhayb se, Sulayman al-Aswad se, Abu al-Mutawakkil al-Naji se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se bataya ke ek aadmi masjid mein dakhil hua jabke Nabi ﷺ [pehle hi] namaz padh chuke the, to aapne farmaya: "Kya koi is [aadmi] par ehsaan karke iske saath namaz nahi padhega?" Abdullah kehte hain: Woh Asr ki namaz padhta hai aur Maghrib padhta hai, lekin usay juft (mila kar rakaton ki tadaad) rakhta hai.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَيُصَلِّي الرَّجُلُ فِي الثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ؟ قَالَ :" أَوَ كُلُّكُمْ يَجِدُ ثَوْبَيْنِ، أَوْ لِكُلِّكُمْ ثَوْبَانِ؟ "
2.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Hisham, from Muhammad, from Abu Hurairah: That a man said: "O Messenger of Allah, may a man pray in a single garment?" He said: "Does each of you find two garments, or does each of you have two garments?"
2.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Hisham se, Muhammad se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke ek aadmi ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, kya aadmi ek hi kapde mein namaz padh sakta hai?" Aapne farmaya: "Kya tum mein se har ek ke paas do kapde milte hain, ya har ek ke paas do kapde hote hain?"

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا يُصَلِّيَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ لَيْسَ عَلَى عَاتِقِهِ مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ "
2.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, and Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "None of you should pray in a single garment with nothing of it on his shoulder."
2.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa aur Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Abu al-Zinad se, al-A'raj se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tum mein se koi ek kapde mein namaz na padhe jabke uska koi hissa uske kandhe par na ho."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ :" نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ لِبْسَتَيْنِ : أَنْ يَحْتَبِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ لَيْسَ بَيْنَ فَرْجِهِ وَبَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ شَيْءٌ، وَعَنْ الصَّمَّاءِ اشْتِمَالِ الْيَهُودِ "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade two ways of wearing garments: that one of you sit hugging his knees wrapped in a single garment, with nothing between his private part and the sky, and the 'samma', the wrapping of the Jews."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne do tarah ke libaas se mana kiya: ke tum mein se koi ek hi kapde mein ghutnon ko baandh kar baithe jabke uski sharamgah aur aasman ke darmiyan kuch na ho, aur 'samma' se jo Yahoodiyon ka lapetne ka tareeqa hai [is tarah kaske lapetna ke baazuein na nikal saken]."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، وَأَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ  ،  عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" يُصَلِّي عَلَى الْخُمْرَةِ "
2.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, and Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Sulayman al-Shaybani, from Abdullah ibn Shaddad, from Maymunah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to "pray on the khumrah."
2.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir aur Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se, Sulayman al-Shaybani se, Abdullah ibn Shaddad se, Maymunah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "khumrah (chhoti jaa-namaz) par namaz padhte the."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ إِسْحَاق بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" صَلَّى عَلَى حَصِيرٍ "
2.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, and Abdullah ibn Maslamah, from Malik, from Ishaq ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah, from Anas: That the Prophet ﷺ "prayed on a mat."
2.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid aur Abdullah ibn Maslamah ne Malik se, Ishaq ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah se, Anas se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ "chatai par namaz padhte the."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُدَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ  ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ   :هَلْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُصَلِّي فِي الثَّوْبِ الَّذِي يُضَاجِعُكِ فِيهِ؟ قَالَتْ : نَعَمْ، إِذَا لَمْ يَرَ فِيهِ أَذًى "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Abd al-Hamid ibn Ja'far, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Mu'awiyah ibn Hudayj, from Mu'awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan, about Umm Habibah: That he asked Umm Habibah: "Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pray in the garment in which he lay with you?" She said: "Yes, when he did not see any impurity/harm in it."
2.hi: Abu Asim ne Abd al-Hamid ibn Ja'far se, Yazid ibn Abi Habib se, Mu'awiyah ibn Hudayj se, Mu'awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan se bataya ke unhone Umm Habibah se poocha: "Kya Rasulullah ﷺ us kapde mein namaz padhte the jismein aap aapke saath lete hote the?" Unhone kaha: "Haan, jab usmein koi napaaki na dekhte."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  ، عَنْ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُدَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ أُخْتِهِ أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ   زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ سَأَلَهَا :" هَلْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُصَلِّي فِي الثَّوْبِ الَّذِي يُجَامِعُهَا فِيهِ؟ قَالَتْ : نَعَمْ إِذَا لَمْ يَرَ فِيهِ أَذًى "
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Layth ibn Sa'd, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Suwayd ibn Qays, from Mu'awiyah ibn Hudayj, from Mu'awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan, from his sister Umm Habibah, wife of the Prophet ﷺ: That he asked her: "Did the Prophet ﷺ pray in the garment in which he had intercourse with her?" She said: "Yes, when he did not see any impurity/harm in it."
2.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Layth ibn Sa'd se, Yazid ibn Abi Habib se, Suwayd ibn Qays se, Mu'awiyah ibn Hudayj se, Mu'awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan se, apni behen Umm Habibah, Nabi ﷺ ki biwi, se bataya ke unhone unse poocha: "Kya Nabi ﷺ us kapde mein namaz padhte the jismein aap unse jima karte the?" Unhone kaha: "Haan, jab usmein koi napaaki na dekhte."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْلَمَةَ هُوَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْأَزْدِيُّ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ   : " أَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَيُصَلِّي فِي نَعْلَيْهِ؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ "
2.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Shu'bah, from Abu Maslamah (Sa'id ibn Yazid al-Azdi), about Anas ibn Malik: He said: I asked Anas ibn Malik: "Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pray in his sandals?" He said, "Yes."
2.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Shu'bah se, Abu Maslamah se (jo Sa'id ibn Yazid al-Azdi hain) bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Anas ibn Malik se poocha: "Kya Rasulullah ﷺ apni jootiyon mein namaz padhte the?" Unhone kaha, "Haan."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، وَأَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي نَعَامَةَ السَّعْدِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : بَيْنَمَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُصَلِّي بِأَصْحَابِهِ إِذْ خَلَعَ نَعْلَيْهِ فَوَضَعَهُمَا عَنْ يَسَارِهِ، فَخَلَعُوا نِعَالَهُمْ، فَلَمَّا قَضَى صَلَاتَهُ، قَالَ : " مَا حَمَلَكُمْ عَلَى إِلْقَائِكُمْ نِعَالَكُمْ؟ " قَالُوا : رَأَيْنَاكَ خَلَعْتَ فَخَلَعْنَا ، قَالَ : " إِنَّ جِبْرِيلَ أَتَانِي أَوْ أَتَى فَأَخْبَرَنِي أَنَّ فِيهِمَا أَذًى أَوْ قَذَرًا،فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدُكُمْ الْمَسْجِدَ، فَلْيُقَلِّبْ نَعْلَيْهِ، فَإِنْ رَأَى فِيهِمَا أَذًى، فَلْيُمِطْ وَلْيُصَلِّ فِيهِمَا "
2.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, and Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Abu Na'amah al-Sa'di, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: He said: While the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was praying with his companions, he took off his sandals and put them on his left, so they took off their sandals, so when he finished his prayer, he said: "What made you throw down your sandals?" They said: "We saw you take them off, so we took them off." He said: "Indeed Jibril came to me - or came - and informed me that there was filth or dirt in them; so when one of you comes to the mosque, let him turn over his sandals, and if he sees filth on them, let him wipe it off and pray in them."
2.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal aur Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Abu Na'amah al-Sa'di se, Abu Nadrah se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se bataya: Unhone kaha, Jabke Rasulullah ﷺ apne sahaba ke saath namaz padh rahe the, aapne apni jootiyan utaarin aur unhein apne baaye taraf rakh diya, to sahaba ne bhi apni jootiyan utaar din, so jab aap namaz se faarigh hue, to farmaya: "Tumhein apni jootiyan utaarne par kis cheez ne ubhaara?" Unhone kaha: "Humne aapko utaarte dekha, to humne bhi utaar din." Aapne farmaya: "Jibreel mere paas aaye - ya aaye - aur mujhe bataya ke unmein napaaki ya gandagi thi; so jab tum mein se koi masjid aaye, to woh apni jootiyan palat kar dekh le, aur agar unmein koi napaaki paaye, to use saaf kare aur unhi mein namaz padhe."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ  ، عَنْ عِسْلٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّهُ" كَرِهَ السَّدْلَ "، وَرَفَعَ ذَلِكَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
2.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Sa'id ibn Abi Arubah, from Isl, from Ata, from Abu Hurairah: That he "disliked sadl," and he attributed that to the Prophet ﷺ.
2.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Sa'id ibn Abi Arubah se, Isl se, Ata se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke woh "sadl [kapda dhile andaaz mein latkaana, baazuein aasteenon mein daale bagair] ko na-pasand karte the," aur unhone ise Nabi ﷺ tak pahunchaya.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ مِخْوَلٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ  ، قَالَ :رَآنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَنَا سَاجِدٌ، وَقَدْ عَقَصْتُ شَعْرِي، أَوْ قَالَ : عَقَدْتُ " فَأَطْلَقَهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Mikhwal, from Abu Sa'id, from Abu Rafi': He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw me while I was prostrating, and I had tied up my hair, or he said: knotted it, "so he loosened it."
2.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Mikhwal se, Abu Sa'id se, Abu Rafi' se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhe dekha jabke main sajda mein tha, aur maine apne baal baandh rakhe the, ya unhone kaha: gaanth laga rakhi thi, "to aapne use khol diya."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي بَكْرٌ هُوَ ابْنُ مُضَرَ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ بُكَيْرٍ  ، أَنَّ كُرَيْبًا  مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ حَدَّثَهُ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُ رَأَى عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ يُصَلِّي وَرَأْسُهُ مَعْقُوصٌ مِنْ وَرَائِهِ فَقَامَ وَرَاءَهُ، فَجَعَلَ يَحُلُّهُ، وَأَقَرَّ لَهُ الْآخَرُ، ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، فَقَالَ : مَا لَكَ وَرَأْسِي؟ قَالَ : إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ : " إِنَّمَامَثَلُ هَذَا كَمَثَلِ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي وَهُوَ مَكْتُوفٌ "
2.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from Bakr ibn Mudar, from Amr ibn al-Harith, from Bukayr, from Kurayb, freed servant of Ibn Abbas: That Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه saw Abdullah ibn al-Harith praying with his hair tied up behind him, so he stood behind him, and began to loosen it, and the other let him, then he turned to Ibn Abbas, and said: "What is it with you and my head?" He said: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Indeed the likeness of this is like the likeness of one who prays while his hands are bound.'"
2.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne Bakr ibn Mudar se, Amr ibn al-Harith se, Bukayr se, Kurayb se, Ibn Abbas ke azaad kiye hue ghulam, bataya ke Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه ne Abdullah ibn al-Harith ko dekha ke woh namaz padh rahe hain aur unke baal peechhe se baandhe hue hain, to woh unke peechhe khade ho gaye, aur unhein khol'ne lage, aur doosre ne unhein aisa karne diya, fir woh Ibn Abbas ki taraf mudkar aaye, aur poocha: "Aapko mere sar se kya lena-dena?" Unhone kaha: "Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna: 'Iski misaal us shakhs ki tarah hai jo bandhe hue haathon ke saath namaz padhe.'"

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ هُوَ ابْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِذَا تَثَاءَبَ أَحَدُكُمْ، فَلْيَشُدَّ يَدَهُ، فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَدْخُلُ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : يَعْنِي عَلَى فِيهِ
2.en: Narrated by Nu'aym ibn Hammad, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Suhayl, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Sa'id, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: "When one of you yawns, let him hold his hand tightly, for indeed the Shaytan enters." Abu Muhammad said: meaning, over his mouth.
2.hi: Nu'aym ibn Hammad ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, Suhayl se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Sa'id se, apne walid se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se kisi ko jamhaai (angdai) aaye, to woh apna haath mazbooti se rakhe, kyunki shaytan andar dakhil ho jaata hai." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: yaani, apne muh par.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِذَا وَجَدَ أَحَدُكُمْ النَّوْمَ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي فَلْيَنَمْ، حَتَّى يَذْهَبَ نَوْمُهُ، فَإِنَّهُ عَسَى يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرَ، فَيَسُبَّ نَفْسَهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "When one of you feels sleepy while he is praying, let him sleep, until his sleepiness goes away, for indeed he may intend to seek forgiveness, but curse himself instead."
2.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Aisha se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se kisi ko namaz padhte waqt neend aane lage, to woh so jaaye, yahan tak ke uski neend jaati rahe, kyunki ho sakta hai woh istighfaar karna chahe, lekin [neend ki wajah se] apne aap ko bura-bhala keh de."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرٌ هُوَ ابْنُ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ هِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، قَالَ : بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" صَلَاةُ الرَّجُلِ جَالِسًا نِصْفُ الصَّلَاةِ "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Ja'far ibn al-Harith, from Mansur, from Hilal, from Abu Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Amr: He said: It reached me that the Prophet ﷺ said: "The prayer of a man sitting is half the prayer."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Ja'far ibn al-Harith se, Mansur se, Hilal se, Abu Yahya se, Abdullah ibn Amr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe khabar mili ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, "Aadmi ki baith kar padhi hui namaz aadhi namaz hai."

2.ar: قَالَ : فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي جَالِسًا، فَقُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّهُ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّكَ قُلْتَ : " صَلَاةُ الرَّجُلِ جَالِسًا نِصْفُ الصَّلَاةِ "، وَأَنْتَ تُصَلِّي جَالِسًا؟ قَالَ : " أَجَلْ، وَلَكِنِّيلَسْتُ كَأَحَدٍ مِنْكُمْ "
2.en: Continuing the same narration [Abdullah ibn Amr]: He said: So I entered upon the Prophet ﷺ while he was praying sitting, so I said: "O Messenger of Allah, it has reached me that you said: 'The prayer of a man sitting is half the prayer,' yet you are praying sitting?" He said: "Indeed, but I am not like any of you."
2.hi: Unhone bataya: To main Nabi ﷺ ke paas gaya jabke aap baith kar namaz padh rahe the, so maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, mujhe khabar mili hai ke aapne farmaya: 'Aadmi ki baith kar padhi hui namaz aadhi namaz hai,' jabke aap khud baith kar namaz padh rahe hain?" Aapne farmaya: "Haan, lekin main tum mein se kisi jaisa nahi hoon."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي السَّائِبُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ الْمُطَّلِبِ بْنِ أَبِي وَدَاعَةَ  ، أَنَّ حَفْصَةَ   زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَتْ :" لَمْ أَرَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُصَلِّي فِي سُبْحَتِهِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ، حَتَّى كَانَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُتَوَفَّى بِعَامٍ وَاحِدٍ أَوْ عَامَيْنِ، فَرَأَيْتُهُ يُصَلِّي فِي سُبْحَتِهِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ، فَيُرَتِّلُ السُّورَةَ حَتَّى تَكُونَ أَطْوَلَ مِنْ أَطْوَلَ مِنْهَا ".
أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ الْمُطَّلِبِ بْنِ أَبِي وَدَاعَةَ  ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ
2.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yunus, from Ibn Shihab, from al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid, from al-Muttalib ibn Abi Wada'ah, about Hafsah; a similar chain also via Uthman ibn Umar: That Hafsah, wife of the Prophet ﷺ, said: "I did not see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pray his supererogatory prayer while sitting, until it was a year or two before he passed away, then I saw him pray his supererogatory prayer sitting, and he would recite the surah slowly until it became longer than the longest [when done standing]." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Uthman ibn Umar, from Malik, from al-Zuhri, from al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid, from al-Muttalib ibn Abi Wada'ah, from Hafsah, from the Prophet ﷺ, with this hadith.]
2.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se, Yunus se, Ibn Shihab se, al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid se, al-Muttalib ibn Abi Wada'ah se bataya ke Hafsah, Nabi ﷺ ki biwi, ne kaha: "Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko apni nafl namaz baith kar padhte nahi dekha, jab tak aapke wisaal se ek ya do saal pehle nahi hua, fir maine aapko apni nafl namaz baith kar padhte dekha, aur aap surah itni thehar-thehar kar padhte ke woh apni [khade padhne wali] sabse lambi se bhi lambi ho jaati." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Uthman ibn Umar se, Malik se, al-Zuhri se, al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid se, al-Muttalib ibn Abi Wada'ah se, Hafsah se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai.]

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي مُعَيْقِيبٌ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ،قِيلَ لَهُ فِي الْمَسْحِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ قَالَ : " إِنْ كُنْتَ لَا بُدَّ فَاعِلًا، فَوَاحِدَةً ".
قَالَ هِشَامٌ : أُرَاهُ قَالَ : يَعْنِي : مَسْحِ الْحَصَا
2.en: Narrated by Wahb ibn Jarir, from Hisham, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Abu Salamah, from Mu'ayqib: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about wiping [smoothing pebbles] in the mosque, he said: "If you must do it, then once." Hisham said: I believe he said: meaning: wiping the pebbles.
2.hi: Wahb ibn Jarir ne Hisham se, Yahya ibn Abi Kathir se, Abu Salamah se, Mu'ayqib se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ se masjid mein [kankariyan] hataane ke baare mein poocha gaya, to aapne farmaya: "Agar tumhein zaroor karna hi hai, to ek hi baar karo." Hisham kehte hain: mera khayal hai unhone kaha: yaani, kankariyan seedhi karna.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا قَامَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ، فَإِنَّ الرَّحْمَةَ تُوَاجِهُهُ، فَلَا يَمسْحِ الْحَصَا "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Ibn Uyaynah, from al-Zuhri, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Abu Dharr: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you stands for prayer, indeed mercy faces him, so let him not wipe/smooth the pebbles."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Ibn Uyaynah se, al-Zuhri se, Abu al-Ahwas se, Abu Dharr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se koi namaz ke liye khada ho, to rehmat uske saamne hoti hai, so woh kankariyan na hataaye."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَيَّارٌ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ يَزِيدَ الْفَقِيرَ  يَقُولُ : سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أُعْطِيتُ خَمْسًا لَمْ يُعْطَهُنَّ نَبِيٌّ قَبْلِي : كَانَ النَّبِيُّ يُبْعَثُ إِلَى قَوْمِهِ خَاصَّةً، وَبُعِثْتُ إِلَى النَّاسِ كَافَّةً، وَأُحِلَّتْ لِيَ الْمَغَانِمُ، وَحُرِّمَتْ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلِي، وَجُعِلَتْ لِيَ الْأَرْضُ طَيِّبَةً مَسْجِدًا وَطَهُورًا، وَيَرْعَبُ مِنَّا عَدُوُّنَا مَسِيرَةَ شَهْرٍ، وَأُعْطِيتُ الشَّفَاعَةَ "
2.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Hushaym, from Sayyar, from Yazid al-Faqir, from Jabir ibn Abdullah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I have been given five things which no prophet before me was given: every prophet was sent to his people specifically, and I was sent to all people generally; and the spoils of war were made lawful for me, and were forbidden to whoever was before me; and the earth was made for me pure, a place of prayer and a means of purification; and our enemy is struck with terror at a distance of a month's journey [from us]; and I have been given intercession."
2.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Hushaym se, Sayyar se, Yazid al-Faqir se, Jabir ibn Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Mujhe paanch cheezein di gayi hain jo mujhse pehle kisi Nabi ko nahi di gayin: har Nabi khaas apni qaum ki taraf bheja jaata tha, aur mujhe tamam logon ki taraf aam tor par bheja gaya; aur ghaneemat mere liye halal ki gayi, jabke mujhse pehle logon par woh haraam thi; aur mere liye zameen ko paak, namaz ki jagah aur pakeezgi ka zariya bana diya gaya; aur humara dushman humse ek mahine ki masaafat par [hi] khaufzada ho jaata hai; aur mujhe shafaa'at di gayi hai."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، أَنْبأَنَا سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" الْأَرْضُ كُلُّهَا مَسْجِدٌ إِلَّا الْمَقْبَرَةَ وَالْحَمَّامَ ".
قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ : تُجْزِئُ الصَّلَاةُ فِي الْمَقْبَرَةِ؟ قَالَ : إِذَا لَمْ تَكُنْ عَلَى الْقَبْرِ فَنَعَمْ، وَقَالَ : الْحَدِيثُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ أَرْسَلُوهُ
2.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Mansur, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Amr ibn Yahya, from his father, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri; with Abu Muhammad's responses: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The whole earth is a place of prayer except the graveyard and the bathhouse." It was said to Abu Muhammad: "Does the prayer suffice in the graveyard?" He said: "If it is not upon the grave itself, then yes," and he said: "most of them transmitted this hadith as mursal."
2.hi: Sa'id ibn Mansur ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, Amr ibn Yahya se, apne walid se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Poori zameen namaz ki jagah hai, siwaay qabristan aur hammam ke." Abu Muhammad se poocha gaya: "Kya qabristan mein namaz kaafi hoti hai?" Unhone kaha: "Agar woh khud qabar par na ho, to haan," aur unhone kaha: "Aksar logon ne is hadith ko mursal (bagair mukammal sanad ke) naql kiya hai."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا حَضَرَتْ الصَّلَاةُ فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا إِلَّا مَرَابِضَ الْغَنَمِ، وَأَعْطَانَ الْإِبِلِ، فَصَلُّوا فِي مَرَابِضِ الْغَنَمِ، وَلَا تُصَلُّوا فِي أَعْطَانِ الْإِبِلِ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Minhal, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Hisham ibn Hassan, from Muhammad, from Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When the prayer is present and you find nothing but the resting places of sheep, and the watering places of camels, pray in the resting places of sheep, and do not pray in the watering places of camels."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Minhal ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Hisham ibn Hassan se, Muhammad se, Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab namaz ka waqt aaye aur tumhein bhedon ke baithne ki jagah aur oonton ke paani peene ki jagah ke siwa kuch na mile, to bhedon ke baithne ki jagah mein namaz padho, aur oonton ke paani peene ki jagah mein namaz na padho."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي  ، عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ لَبِيدٍ  ، أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ لَمَّا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَبْنِيَ الْمَسْجِدَ كَرِهَ النَّاسُ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ عُثْمَانُ   : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" مَنْ بَنَى لِلَّهِ مَسْجِدًا، بَنَى اللَّهُ لَهُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ مِثْلَهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Abd al-Hamid ibn Ja'far, from his father, from Mahmud ibn Labid, about Uthman: That when Uthman wanted to build the mosque, the people disliked that, so Uthman said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Whoever builds a mosque for Allah, Allah builds for him the like of it in Paradise."
2.hi: Abu Asim ne Abd al-Hamid ibn Ja'far se, apne walid se, Mahmud ibn Labid se bataya ke jab Uthman ne masjid banane ka irada kiya, to logon ne isse na-pasand kiya, to Uthman ne kaha: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Jo Allah ke liye ek masjid banaaye, Allah uske liye Jannat mein usi jaisi ek [masjid] banaata hai."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ  ، وَفُلَيْحُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ الزُّرَقِيّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدُكُمْ الْمَسْجِدَ، فَلْيَرْكَعْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ "
2.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Malik ibn Anas, and Fulayh ibn Sulayman, from Amir ibn Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr, from Amr ibn Sulaym al-Zuraqi, from Abu Qatadah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you comes to the mosque, let him pray two rak'ahs before he sits."
2.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Malik ibn Anas aur Fulayh ibn Sulayman se, Amir ibn Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr se, Amr ibn Sulaym al-Zuraqi se, Abu Qatadah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi masjid mein aaye, to baithne se pehle do rakat namaz padhe."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا حُمَيْدٍ  ، أَوْ أَبَا أُسَيْدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ  ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا دَخَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ الْمَسْجِدَ، فَلْيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ، ثُمَّ لِيَقُلْ : اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ، وَإِذَا خَرَجَ، فَلْيَقُلْ : اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ "
2.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Rabi'ah ibn Abi Abd al-Rahman, from Abd al-Malik ibn Sa'id ibn Suwayd, from Abu Humayd or Abu Usayd al-Ansari: He said: I heard Abu Humayd, or Abu Usayd al-Ansari, say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you enters the mosque, let him send salutations upon the Prophet, then say: 'Allahumma iftah li abwaba rahmatika,' and when he goes out, let him say: 'Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlika.'"
2.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, Rabi'ah ibn Abi Abd al-Rahman se, Abd al-Malik ibn Sa'id ibn Suwayd se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Humayd, ya Abu Usayd al-Ansari, ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se koi masjid mein dakhil ho, to Nabi par durood bheje, fir kahe: 'Allahummaftah li abwaaba rahmatik' [Ae Allah, mere liye apni rehmat ke darwaze khol de], aur jab woh bahar nikle, to kahe: 'Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik' [Ae Allah, main tujhse tera fazl maangta hoon]."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِقَتَادَةَ  : أَسَمِعْتَ أَنَسًا  ، يَقُولُ عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" الْبُزَاقُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ خَطِيئَةٌ؟ " قَالَ : نَعَمْ، وَكَفَّارَتُهَا دَفْنُهَا "
2.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from Anas: He said: I said to Qatadah: "Did you hear Anas say, about the Prophet ﷺ, that he said: 'Spitting in the mosque is a sin'?" He said, "Yes, and its expiation is burying it."
2.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Qatadah se poocha: "Kya aapne Anas ko Nabi ﷺ ke baare mein kehte suna ke aapne farmaya: 'Masjid mein thookna gunah hai'?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, aur uska kaffara use dafna dena hai."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا حُمَيْدٌ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : " إِنَّالْعَبْدَ إِذَا صَلَّى، فَإِنَّمَا يُنَاجِي رَبَّهُ أَوْ رَبُّهُ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْقِبْلَةِ ، فَإِذَا بَزَقَ أَحَدُكُمْ، فَلْيَبْصُقْ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ أَوْ تَحْتَ قَدَمِهِ ، أَوْ يَقُولُ هَكَذَا "، وَبَزَقَ فِي ثَوْبِهِ وَدَلَكَ بَعْضَهُ بِبَعْضٍ
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Humayd, from Anas: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed the servant, when he prays, is indeed confiding [in private conversation] with his Lord, or his Lord is between him and the Qiblah; so when one of you spits, let him spit to his left or beneath his foot, or he said thus," and he spat into his garment and rubbed part of it against another.
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Humayd se, Anas se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Banda jab namaz padhta hai, to woh apne Rab se sarguzashti kar raha hota hai, ya uska Rab uske aur Qibla ke darmiyan hota hai; so jab tum mein se koi thooke, to woh apne baaye taraf ya apne paaon ke neeche thooke, ya aap ne isi tarah farmaya," aur aapne apne kapde mein thooka aur usay ek doosre se rugad diya.

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : بَيْنَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَخْطُبُ، إِذْ رَأَى نُخَامَةً فِي قِبْلَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَتَغَيَّظَ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْمَسْجِدِ، وَقَالَ : " إِنَّاللَّهَ قِبَلَ أَحَدِكُمْ إِذَا كَانَ فِي صَلَاتِهِ، فَلَا يَبْزُقَنَّ أَوْ قَالَ : لَا يَتَنَخَّعَنَّ "، ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهَا فَحُكَّ مَكَانُهَا، وَأَمَرَ بِهَا فَلُطِخَتْ.
قَالَ حَمَّادٌ : لَا أَعْلَمُهُ إِلَّا قَالَ : بِزَعْفَرَانٍ
2.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar; with Hammad's note: He said: While the Prophet ﷺ was giving a sermon, he saw phlegm in the direction of the Qiblah of the mosque, so he became angry at the people of the mosque, and said: "Indeed Allah is in front of one of you when he is in his prayer, so let him not spit, or he said: let him not clear his throat," then he commanded regarding it, and its place was scraped, and he commanded regarding it, and it was smeared [with something]. Hammad said: I only know that he said: with saffron.
2.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ayyub se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Jabke Nabi ﷺ khutba de rahe the, aapne masjid ke Qibla ki taraf balgam dekha, to aap masjid walon par naaraaz hue, aur farmaya: "Allah tum mein se kisi ke saamne hota hai jab woh namaz mein hota hai, so woh na thooke, ya farmaya: woh gala saaf na kare [us taraf]," fir aapne uske baare mein hukum diya aur uski jagah khuraachi gayi, aur aapne uske baare mein hukum diya aur usay [kisi cheez se] lipa gaya. Hammad kehte hain: Mujhe sirf itna maloom hai ke unhone kaha: kesar se.

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ  ، وَأَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ   أَخْبَرَاهُ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَأَى نُخَامَةً فِي جِدَارِ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَتَنَاوَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَصَاةً وَحَتَّهَا ثُمَّ قَالَ :" إِذَا تَنَخَّمَ أَحَدُكُمْ، فَلَا يَتَنَخَّمَنَّ قِبَلَ وَجْهِهِ، وَلَا عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، وَلْيَبْصُقْ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ أَوْ تَحْتَ قَدَمِهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Da'ud, from Ibrahim ibn Sa'd, from al-Zuhri, from Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Sa'id and Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw phlegm on the wall of the mosque, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ took a pebble and scraped it, then said: "When one of you clears his throat, let him not do so in the direction of his face, nor to his right, and let him spit to his left or beneath his foot."
2.hi: Sulayman ibn Da'ud ne Ibrahim ibn Sa'd se, al-Zuhri se, Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman se bataya ke Abu Sa'id aur Abu Hurairah ne unhein bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne masjid ki deewar par balgam dekha, to aapne ek kankari li aur usay khuraach diya, fir farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi gala saaf kare, to woh apne chehre ki taraf na kare, na apne daayen taraf, aur woh apne baaye taraf ya apne paaon ke neeche thooke."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ  ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حَرْبِ بْنِ أَبِي الْأَسْوَدِ الدِّئلِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ  ، قَالَ : أَتَانِي نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَنَا نَائِمٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَضَرَبَنِي بِرِجْلِهِ، قَالَ :" أَلَا أَرَاكَ نَائِمًا فِيهِ؟ " قُلْتُ : يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ، غَلَبَتْنِي عَيْنِي
2.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah, from Mu'tamir, from Da'ud ibn Abi Hind, from Abu Harb ibn Abi al-Aswad al-Di'ili, from his uncle, from Abu Dharr: He said: The Prophet of Allah ﷺ came to me while I was sleeping in the mosque, and struck me with his foot, and said: "Do I not see you sleeping in it?" I said: "O Prophet of Allah, my eyes overcame me."
2.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah ne Mu'tamir se, Da'ud ibn Abi Hind se, Abu Harb ibn Abi al-Aswad al-Di'ili se, apne chacha se, Abu Dharr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ mere paas aaye jabke main masjid mein so raha tha, aur aapne apne paaon se mujhe hilaya, aur farmaya: "Kya main tumhein isme sota hua nahi dekh raha?" Maine kaha: "Ya Nabi Allah, meri aankhon par neend ghaalib aa gayi."

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق الْفَزَارِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ أَبِيتُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لِي أَهْلٌ، فَرَأَيْتُ فِي الْمَنَامِ كَأَنَّمَا انْطُلِقَ بِي إِلَى بِئْرٍ فِيهَا رِجَالٌ مُعَلَّقُونَ، فَقِيلَ : انْطَلِقُوا بِهِ إِلَى ذَاتِ الْيَمِينِ.
فَذَكَرْتُ الرُّؤْيَا لِحَفْصَةَ ، فَقُلْتُ : قُصِّيهَا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَصَّتْهَا عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ : " مَنْ رَأَى هَذِهِ؟ قَالَتْ : ابْنُ عُمَرَ.
فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " نِعْمَ الْفَتَى أَوْ قَالَ : نِعْمَ الرَّجُلُلَوْ كَانَ يُصَلِّي مِنْ اللَّيْلِ ".
 قَالَ : وَكُنْتُ إِذَا نِمْتُ لَمْ أَقُمْ حَتَّى أُصْبِحَ.
قَالَ : فَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يُصَلِّي اللَّيْلَ
2.en: Narrated by Musa ibn Khalid, from Abu Ishaq al-Fazari, from Ubaydullah ibn Umar, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: I used to spend the night in the mosque, and I had no family, so I saw in a dream as if I were taken to a well in which there were men hanging, and it was said: "Take him to the right side." So I mentioned the vision to Hafsah, and I said: "Relate it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ," so she related it to him, so he said: "Who saw this?" She said: "Ibn Umar." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "What a fine young man - or he said: what a fine man - if only he prayed at night." He said: And I used to, when I slept, not get up until morning. He said: So Ibn Umar used to pray at night [after that].
2.hi: Musa ibn Khalid ne Abu Ishaq al-Fazari se, Ubaydullah ibn Umar se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main masjid mein raat guzaara karta tha, aur mera koi ghar-bar nahi tha, so maine khwab mein dekha ke jaise mujhe ek kuen tak le jaaya gaya jismein log latke hue the, aur kaha gaya: "Ise daayen taraf le jao." So maine yeh khwab Hafsah se zikr kiya, aur kaha: "Ise Rasulullah ﷺ ko sunao," to unhone aapko sunaya, to aapne poocha: "Kisne yeh dekha?" Unhone kaha: "Ibn Umar." To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Kya achha jawaan hai - ya farmaya: kya achha aadmi hai - agar woh raat ko namaz padhta." Unhone bataya: Aur main jab sota, to subah tak nahi uthta tha. Unhone bataya: To iske baad Ibn Umar raat ko namaz padha karte the.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَبِي زَيْدٍ الْكُوفِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ خُصَيْفَةَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ ثَوْبَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" إِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ مَنْ يَبِيعُ، أَوْ يَبْتَاعُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَقُولُوا : لَا أَرْبَحَ اللَّهُ تِجَارَتَكَ، وَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ مَنْ يَنْشُدُ فِيهِ الضَّالَّةَ، فَقُولُوا : لَا أَدَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ "
2.en: Narrated by al-Hasan ibn Abi Zayd al-Kufi, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Yazid ibn Khusayfah, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Thawban, from Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When you see someone selling, or buying, in the mosque, say: 'La arbahallahu tijarataka,' and when you see someone seeking a lost item in it, say: 'La addallahu 'alayk.'"
2.hi: Al-Hasan ibn Abi Zayd al-Kufi ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, Yazid ibn Khusayfah se, Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Thawban se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jab tum kisi ko masjid mein khareedte ya bechte dekho, to kaho: 'Laa arbahallahu tijaaratak' [Allah tumhari tijaarat ko faida-mand na banaaye], aur jab tum kisi ko masjid mein gumshuda cheez talaash karte dekho, to kaho: 'Laa addallahu 'alayk' [Allah use tumhein na lautaaye]."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِعَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  : أَسَمِعْتَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   يَقُولُ : مَرَّ رَجُلٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ يَحْمِلُ نَبْلًا، فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَمْسِكْ نُصُولَهَا "؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, about Amr ibn Dinar and Jabir ibn Abdullah: He said: I said to Amr ibn Dinar: "Did you hear Jabir ibn Abdullah say: A man passed through the mosque carrying arrows, so the Prophet ﷺ said to him: 'Hold their heads/points'?" He said, "Yes."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Amr ibn Dinar se poocha: "Kya aapne Jabir ibn Abdullah ko kehte suna: Ek aadmi masjid mein teer liye guzra, to Nabi ﷺ ne usse farmaya: 'Unke phal (nok) pakad lo'?" Unhone kaha, "Haan."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، أَنْبأَنَا شُعَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ  ، وَعَائِشَةَ   ، قَالَا : لَمَّا نُزِلَ بِالنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، طَفِقَ يَطْرَحُ خَمِيصَةً لَهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ، فَإِذَا اغْتَمَّ، كَشَفَهَا عَنْ وَجْهِهِ، فَقَالَ وَهُوَ كَذَلِكَ :" لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى الْيَهُودِ وَالنَّصَارَى ، اتَّخَذُوا قُبُورَ أَنْبِيَائِهِمْ مَسَاجِدَ ".
يُحَذِّرُ مِثْلَ مَا صَنَعُوا
2.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah, from Ibn Abbas and Aisha: That Ibn Abbas, and Aisha, said: When the Prophet ﷺ was afflicted [with his final illness], he began throwing a cloak of his over his face, then when he felt distressed, he would remove it from his face, so he said while in that state: "The curse of Allah is upon the Jews and the Christians, they took the graves of their prophets as places of prayer" - warning against doing the like of what they did.
2.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb se, al-Zuhri se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah se bataya ke Ibn Abbas aur Aisha ne kaha: Jab Nabi ﷺ ki bimari shadeed hui, to aap apni ek chaadar apne chehre par daalne lage, fir jab dam ghutne lagta, to use apne chehre se hataa lete, so is haalat mein aapne farmaya: "Allah ki lanat ho Yahoodiyon aur Nasaraon par, unhone apne nabiyon ki qabron ko masjid bana liya" - is se woh khabardaar kar rahe the ke unke jaisa kaam na kiya jaaye.
