2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ الْفَرَّاءُ  ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ أَبِي ثُمَامَةَ الْحَنَّاطِ  ، قَالَ : أَدْرَكَنِي كَعْبُ بْنُ عُجْرَةَ   بِالْبَلَاطِ، وَأَنَا مُشَبِّكٌ بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِي، فَقَالَ : إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ أَحَدُكُمْ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ عَامِدًا إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ، فَلَا يُشَبِّكُ بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Da'ud ibn Qays al-Farra', from Sa'd ibn Ishaq, from Abu Thumamah al-Hannat, about Ka'b ibn Ujrah: He said: Ka'b ibn Ujrah caught up with me at al-Balat, while I had my fingers interlaced, so he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you performs ablution, then goes out heading for the prayer, let him not interlace his fingers."
2.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Da'ud ibn Qays al-Farra' se, Sa'd ibn Ishaq se, Abu Thumamah al-Hannat se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ka'b ibn Ujrah al-Balat mein mujhse mile, jabke meri ungliyan aapas mein phansi hui thin, to unhone kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se koi wudu kare, fir namaz ka irada karte hue nikle, to woh apni ungliyan aapas mein na phansaaye."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلَانَ  ، عَنْ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ  ، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا تَوَضَّأْتَ فَعَمَدْتَ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ، فَلَا تُشَبِّكَنَّ بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِكَ، فَإِنَّكَ فِي صَلَاةٍ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Muhammad ibn Ajlan, from al-Maqburi, from Ka'b ibn Ujrah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When you perform ablution and head for the mosque, do not interlace your fingers, for indeed you are in a state of prayer."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Muhammad ibn Ajlan se, al-Maqburi se, Ka'b ibn Ujrah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum wudu karo aur masjid ka irada karo, to apni ungliyan aapas mein na phansaao, kyunki tum namaz ki haalat mein hote ho."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْهَيْثَمُ بْنُ جَمِيلٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ  ، عَنْ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ يُرِيدُ الصَّلَاةَ، فَهُوَ فِي صَلَاةٍ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ إِلَى بَيْتِهِ، فَلَا تَقُولُوا هَكَذَا "يَعْنِي : يُشَبِّكُ بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِهِ
2.en: Narrated by al-Haytham ibn Jamil, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Isma'il ibn Umayyah, from al-Maqburi, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever performs ablution then goes out intending the prayer, he is in a state of prayer until he returns to his house, so do not do like this" - meaning: interlacing his fingers.
2.hi: Al-Haytham ibn Jamil ne Muhammad ibn Muslim se, Isma'il ibn Umayyah se, al-Maqburi se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo wudu kare, fir namaz ka irada karte hue nikle, to woh apne ghar wapas jaane tak namaz ki haalat mein hota hai, so aisa mat karo" - yaani, apni ungliyan aapas mein phansaana.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا تَزَالُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ تُصَلِّي عَلَى الْعَبْدِ مَا دَامَ فِي مُصَلَّاهُ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي فِيهِ، مَا لَمْ يَقُمْ أَوْ يُحْدِثْ، تَقُولُ : اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The angels continue to pray for the servant as long as he remains in the place where he prayed, as long as he does not stand or break his ablution, saying: 'O Allah, forgive him, O Allah, have mercy on him.'"
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Farishte banda ke liye dua karte rehte hain jab tak woh us jagah baitha rahe jahan usne namaz padhi thi, jab tak woh na uthe aur na uska wudu toote, kehte hain: 'Ae Allah, ise bakhsh de, Ae Allah, is par reham kar.'"

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ،  عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَا تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى يَتَبَاهَى النَّاسُ فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ "
2.en: Narrated by Affan, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah, from Anas ibn Malik, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "The Hour will not come until people compete in [boasting about] their mosques."
2.hi: Affan ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ayyub se, Abu Qilabah se, Anas ibn Malik se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Qayamat tab tak nahi aayegi jab tak log apni masjidon [ki khoobsoorati] mein ek-doosre par fakhr na karne lagein."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ عُتَيْبَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جُحَيْفَةَ   يَقُولُ : " خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَى الْبَطْحَاءِ بِالْهَاجِرَةِ،فَصَلَّى الظُّهْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَالْعَصْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَبَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ عَنَزَةٌ، وَإِنَّ الظُّعُنَ لَتَمُرُّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam ibn Utaybah, from Abu Juhayfah: He said: I heard Abu Juhayfah say: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out to al-Batha at midday, and prayed Zuhr two rak'ahs, and Asr two rak'ahs, with a small spear before him, and the women's litters passed in front of him."
2.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Shu'bah se, al-Hakam ibn Utaybah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Juhayfah ko kehte suna: "Rasulullah ﷺ dopahar ke waqt al-Batha ki taraf nikle, aur Zuhr do rakat padhi, aur Asr do rakat padhi, aapke saamne ek chhoti neza thi, aur auraton ki palkiyan aapke saamne se guzar rahi thin."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " كَانَتْتُرْكَزُ لَهُ الْعَنَزَةُ يُصَلِّي إِلَيْهَا "
2.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That a small spear used to "be stuck [in the ground] for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he would pray facing it."
2.hi: Musaddad ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ke liye ek chhoti neza "zameen mein gaad di jaati, aur aap uski taraf rukh karke namaz padhte."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُمْ يُصَلِّي، فَلَا يَدَعْ أَحَدًا يَمُرُّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، فَإِنْ أَبَى، فَلْيُقَاتِلْهُ، فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ شَيْطَانٌ "
2.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Malik, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Sa'id, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you is praying, let him not let anyone pass before him, and if he refuses, let him fight him, for indeed he is only a Shaytan."
2.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Malik se, Zayd ibn Aslam se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Sa'id se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi namaz padh raha ho, to woh kisi ko apne saamne se guzarne na de, aur agar woh na maane, to usse ladai kare, kyunki woh sirf shaytan hai."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ الْأَحْمَرِ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " كَانَيُصَلِّي إِلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ "
2.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, and Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Khalid al-Ahmar, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That the Prophet ﷺ "used to pray facing his mount."
2.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak aur Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Khalid al-Ahmar se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ "apni sawaari ki taraf rukh karke namaz padhte the."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ  ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ   أَخْبَرَتْهُ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " كَانَيُصَلِّي وَهِيَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْقِبْلَةِ عَلَى فِرَاشِ أَهْلِهِ اعْتِرَاضَ الْجَنَازَةِ "
2.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, from Urwah ibn al-Zubayr, from Aisha: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "used to pray while she was between him and the Qiblah, on the bedding of his household, lying crosswise as a bier."
2.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se, Uqayl se, Ibn Shihab se, Urwah ibn al-Zubayr se, Aisha se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "namaz padhte jabke woh aapke aur Qibla ke darmiyan hoti thin, ghar ke bistar par, janaaze ki tarah tirchhi leti hui."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، وَحَجَّاجٌ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ هِلَالٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الصَّامِتِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ  ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" يَقْطَعُ صَلَاةَ الرَّجُلِ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ كَآخِرَةِ الرَّحْلِ : الْحِمَارُ وَالْكَلْبُ الْأَسْوَدُ، وَالْمَرْأَةُ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, and Hajjaj, from Shu'bah, from Humayd ibn Hilal, from Abdullah ibn al-Samit, from Abu Dharr: That he said: "The prayer of a man is cut off, if there is nothing in front of him like the back part of a saddle, by: the donkey, and the black dog, and the woman."
2.hi: Abu al-Walid aur Hajjaj ne Shu'bah se, Humayd ibn Hilal se, Abdullah ibn al-Samit se, Abu Dharr se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Aadmi ki namaz toot jaati hai, agar uske saamne pichli kaathi ke barabar koi cheez na ho, in cheezon se: gadha, aur kaala kutta, aur aurat."

2.ar: قَالَ : قُلْتُ : فَمَا بَالُ الْأَسْوَدِ مِنْ الْأَحْمَرِ مِنْ الْأَصْفَرِ، فَقَالَ : سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَمَا سَأَلْتَنِي، فَقَالَ :" الْأَسْوَدُ شَيْطَانٌ "
2.en: Continuing the same narration from Abu Dharr: He said: I said: "What is the difference between the black and the red and the yellow [dog]?" So he said: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as you have asked me, and he said: "The black is a devil."
2.hi: Unhone bataya: Maine poocha: "Kaale [kutte] aur laal aur pile mein kya farq hai?" To unhone kaha: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ se aisa hi poocha jaisa tumne mujhse poocha, to aapne farmaya: "Kaala shaytan hai."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : جِئْتُ أَنَا وَالْفَضْلُ يَعْنِي : عَلَى أَتَانٍ، وَالنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَيُصَلِّي بِمِنًى أَوْ بِعَرَفَةَ ، فَمَرَرْتُ عَلَى بَعْضِ الصَّفِّ فَنَزَلْتُ عَنْهَا وَتَرَكْتُهَا تَرْعَى، وَدَخَلْتُ فِي الصَّفِّ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Ibn Uyaynah, from al-Zuhri, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah, from Ibn Abbas: He said: I came, I and al-Fadl, meaning: on a she-donkey, while the Prophet ﷺ was praying at Mina or at Arafah, so I passed in front of part of the row, then I dismounted from it and left it to graze, and entered into the row.
2.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Ibn Uyaynah se, al-Zuhri se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main aur al-Fadl aaye - yaani, ek gadhi par - jabke Nabi ﷺ Mina ya Arafah mein namaz padh rahe the, so main saf ke kuch hisse ke saamne se guzra, fir main usse utra aur use charne ke liye chhod diya, aur saf mein shaamil ho gaya.

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ أَبِي النَّضْرِ  ، عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، قَالَ : أَرْسَلَنِي أَبُو جُهَيْمٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ إِلَى زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ   أَسْأَلُهُ مَا سَمِعَ مِنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي الَّذِي يَمُرُّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ الْمُصَلِّي، فَقَالَ : إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَأَنْ يَقُومَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَرْبَعِينَ، خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَمُرَّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ الْمُصَلِّي ".
قَالَ : فَلَا أَدْرِي سَنَةً أَوْ شَهْرًا أَوْ يَوْمًا
2.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Ibn Uyaynah, from Salim Abu al-Nadr, from Busr ibn Sa'id, about Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani: He said: Abu Juhaym al-Ansari sent me to Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani, to ask him what he heard from the Prophet ﷺ concerning the one who passes in front of the one praying, so he said: Indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "For one of you to stand [waiting] for forty, is better for him than that he pass in front of the one praying." He said: So I do not know [if he said] a year or a month or a day.
2.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Ibn Uyaynah se, Salim Abu al-Nadr se, Busr ibn Sa'id se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abu Juhaym al-Ansari ne mujhe Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani ke paas bheja yeh poochne ke unhone Nabi ﷺ se us shakhs ke baare mein kya suna jo namaz padhne wale ke saamne se guzarta hai, to unhone kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tum mein se kisi ka chaalis [tak] khada rehna, iske liye behtar hai is se ke woh namaz padhne wale ke saamne se guzre." Unhone bataya: So mujhe nahi maloom [aapne kaha ho] saal ya mahina ya din.

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ  مَوْلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَعْمَرٍ، أَنَّ بُسْرَ بْنَ سَعِيدٍ  أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيَّ أَرْسَلَهُ إِلَى أَبِي جُهَيْمٍ يَسْأَلُهُ : مَاذَا سَمِعَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ فِي الْمَارِّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ الْمُصَلِّي.
 فَقَالَ أَبُو جُهَيْمٍ   : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَوْ يَعْلَمُ الْمَارُّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ الْمُصَلِّي مَاذَا عَلَيْهِ فِي ذَلِكَ، لَكَانَ أَنْ يَقِفَ أَرْبَعِينَ خَيْرًا لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَمُرَّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو النَّضْرِ : لَا أَدْرِي : أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا، أَوْ شَهْرًا، أَوْ سَنَةً
2.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Malik, from Abu al-Nadr, freed servant of Umar ibn Ubaydullah ibn Ma'mar, about Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani and Abu Juhaym: That Busr ibn Sa'id informed him, that Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani sent him to Abu Juhaym to ask him: what he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say concerning the one who passes in front of the one praying. So Abu Juhaym said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If the one who passes in front of the one praying knew what [burden] is upon him for that, standing for forty would be better for him than passing in front of him." Abu al-Nadr said: I do not know: forty days, or a month, or a year.
2.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Malik se, Abu al-Nadr se (Umar ibn Ubaydullah ibn Ma'mar ke azaad kiye hue ghulam) bataya ke Busr ibn Sa'id ne unhein bataya ke Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani ne unhein Abu Juhaym ke paas bheja yeh poochne ke unhone Rasulullah ﷺ se namaz padhne wale ke saamne se guzarne wale ke baare mein kya suna. To Abu Juhaym ne kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Agar namaz padhne wale ke saamne se guzarne wala jaan le ke iska kya [wabaal] uspar hai, to uska chaalis [tak] khada rehna iske liye behtar hoga is se ke woh uske saamne se guzre." Abu al-Nadr kehte hain: Mujhe nahi maloom: chaalis din, ya mahina, ya saal.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَفْلَحُ هُوَ ابْنُ حُمَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي سَلْمَانُ الْأَغَرُّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" صَلَاةٌ فِي مَسْجِدِي هَذَا كَأَلْفِ صَلَاةٍ فِيمَا سِوَاهُ مِنْ الْمَسَاجِدِ، إِلَّا الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ "
2.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Aflah ibn Humayd, from Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad, from Salman al-Aghar, from Abu Hurairah: He said: I heard Abu Hurairah say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A prayer in this mosque of mine is like a thousand prayers in what is besides it, of the mosques, except al-Masjid al-Haram."
2.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Aflah ibn Humayd se, Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad se, Salman al-Aghar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Hurairah ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Meri is masjid mein ek namaz aur masjidon mein padhi hui hazaar namazon ke barabar hai, siwaay Masjid-e-Haram ke."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ،  عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" صَلَاةٌ فِي مَسْجِدِي هَذَا أَفْضَلُ مِنْ أَلْفِ صَلَاةٍ فِيمَا سِوَاهُ، إِلَّا الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ "
2.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A prayer in this mosque of mine is better than a thousand prayers in what is besides it, except al-Masjid al-Haram."
2.hi: Musaddad ne Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Meri is masjid mein ek namaz aur jagahon mein padhi hui hazaar namazon se behtar hai, siwaay Masjid-e-Haram ke."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" صَلَاةٌ فِي مَسْجِدِي هَذَا أَفْضَلُ مِنْ أَلْفِ صَلَاةٍ فِيمَا سِوَاهُ إِلَّا الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ "
2.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Ibn Uyaynah, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "A prayer in this mosque of mine is better than a thousand prayers in what is besides it, except al-Masjid al-Haram."
2.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Ibn Uyaynah se, al-Zuhri se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Meri is masjid mein ek namaz aur jagahon mein padhi hui hazaar namazon se behtar hai, siwaay Masjid-e-Haram ke."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا تُشَدُّ الرِّحَالُ إِلَّا إِلَى ثَلَاثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ : مَسْجِدُ الْكَعْبَةِ ، وَمَسْجِدِي هَذَا ، وَمَسْجِدِ الْأَقْصَى "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The saddles [of travel] are not to be tightened except to three mosques: the Mosque of the Ka'bah, and this mosque of mine, and the Aqsa Mosque."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Safar sirf teen masjidon ke liye kiya jaaye: Masjid-e-Ka'bah, aur meri yeh masjid, aur Masjid-e-Aqsa."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ  ، عَنْ جُنَادَةَ  ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ مَشَى فِي ظُلْمَةِ لَيْلٍ إِلَى صَلَاةٍ، آتَاهُ اللَّهُ نُورًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ "
2.en: Narrated by Zakariya ibn Adi, from Ubaydullah ibn Amr, from Zayd ibn Abi Unaysah, from Junadah, from Makhul, from Abu Idris, from Abu al-Darda, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whoever walks in the darkness of night to a prayer, Allah will bring him light on the Day of Resurrection."
2.hi: Zakariya ibn Adi ne Ubaydullah ibn Amr se, Zayd ibn Abi Unaysah se, Junadah se, Makhul se, Abu Idris se, Abu al-Darda se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jo raat ke andhere mein namaz ke liye chale, Allah use Qayamat ke din noor ata karega."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْأَحْوَصِ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ  ، أَنَّ أَبَا ذَرٍّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا يَزَالُ اللَّهُ مُقْبِلًا عَلَى الْعَبْدِ مَا لَمْ يَلْتَفِتْ، فَإِذَا صَرَفَ وَجْهَهُ، انْصَرَفَ عَنْهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yunus, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Dharr: That Abu Dharr said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah continues to face the servant as long as he does not turn away; so when he turns his face [away], He turns away from him."
2.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se, Yunus se, Ibn Shihab se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu al-Ahwas ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Ibn al-Musayyab se, ke Abu Dharr ne kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah banda ki taraf mutwajjih rehta hai jab tak woh [namaz mein] idhar-udhar na dekhe; so jab woh apna chehra mod le, to Allah bhi uski taraf se mud jaata hai."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ  : أَخْبَرَنِي عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ الْأَزْدِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ اللَّيْثِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُبْشِيٍّ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سُئِلَ : أَيُّ الْأَعْمَالِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ :" إِيمَانٌ لَا شَكَّ فِيهِ، وَجِهَادٌ لَا غُلُولَ فِيهِ، وَحَجَّةٌ مَبْرُورَةٌ ".
قِيلَ : فَأَيُّ الصَّلَاةِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ : " طُولُ الْقِيَامِ ".
 قِيلَ : فَأَيُّ الصَّدَقَةِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ : " جُهْدُ مُقِلٍّ ".
قِيلَ : فَأَيُّ الْهِجْرَةِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ : " أَنْ تَهْجُرَ مَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ ".
قِيلَ : فَأَيُّ الْجِهَادِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ : " مَنْ جَاهَدَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ بِمَالِهِ وَنَفْسِهِ ".
قِيلَ : فَأَيُّ الْقَتْلِ أَشْرَفُ؟ قَالَ : " مَنْ عُقِرَ جَوَادُهُ وَأُهْرِيقَ دَمُهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Hajjaj ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Jurayj, from Uthman ibn Abi Sulayman, from Ali al-Azdi, from Ubayd ibn Umayr al-Laythi, from Abdullah ibn Hubshi: That the Prophet ﷺ was asked: Which deeds are best? He said: "Faith in which there is no doubt, and jihad in which there is no misappropriation, and an accepted Hajj." It was said: "So which prayer is best?" He said: "Length of standing." It was said: "So which charity is best?" He said: "The effort of one who has little." It was said: "So which emigration is best?" He said: "That you emigrate from what Allah has forbidden you." It was said: "So which jihad is best?" He said: "Whoever strives against the polytheists with his wealth and his self." It was said: "So which killing [death] is most honorable?" He said: "One whose horse is hamstrung and whose blood is shed."
2.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Hajjaj ibn Muhammad se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ibn Jurayj ne kaha: Mujhe Uthman ibn Abi Sulayman ne bataya, Ali al-Azdi se, Ubayd ibn Umayr al-Laythi se, Abdullah ibn Hubshi se, ke Nabi ﷺ se poocha gaya: Kaunsa amal sabse behtar hai? Aapne farmaya: "Aisa imaan jismein koi shak na ho, aur aisa jihad jismein khiyanat na ho, aur maqbool Hajj." Poocha gaya: "To kaunsi namaz sabse behtar hai?" Aapne farmaya: "Lamba qayam." Poocha gaya: "To kaunsa sadqa sabse behtar hai?" Aapne farmaya: "Kam maal wale ki mehnat." Poocha gaya: "To kaunsi hijrat sabse behtar hai?" Aapne farmaya: "Yeh ke tum un cheezon ko chhod do jo Allah ne tumpar haraam ki hain." Poocha gaya: "To kaunsa jihad sabse behtar hai?" Aapne farmaya: "Jo mushrikon se apne maal aur apni jaan se jihad kare." Poocha gaya: "To kaunsi maut sabse izzat wali hai?" Aapne farmaya: "Jiska ghoda kaat diya jaaye aur uska khoon bahaaya jaaye."

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي جَمْرَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ صَلَّى الْبَرْدَيْنِ، دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ ".
قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ : مَا الْبَرْدَيْنِ؟ قَالَ : الْغَدَاةُ وَالْعَصْرُ
2.en: Narrated by Affan, from Hammam, from Abu Jamrah, from Abu Bakr ibn Abi Musa, from his father; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever prays the two cool [prayers], enters Paradise." It was said to Abu Muhammad: "What are the two cool [prayers]?" He said: The morning and the Asr.
2.hi: Affan ne Hammam se, Abu Jamrah se, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Musa se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo do thandi [namazein] padhe, Jannat mein dakhil hoga." Abu Muhammad se poocha gaya: "Yeh do thandi namazein kya hain?" Unhone kaha: Fajr aur Asr.

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ أَبِي أُسَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" مَنْ صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ، فَهُوَ فِي جِوَارِ اللَّهِ، فَلَا تُخْفِرُوا اللَّهَ فِي جَارِهِ، وَمَنْ صَلَّى الْعَصْرَ، فَهُوَ فِي جِوَارِ اللَّهِ، فَلَا تُخْفِرُوا اللَّهَ فِي جَارِهِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : إِذَا أُمِّنَ وَلَمْ يَفِ، فَقَدْ غَدَرَ وَأَخْفَرَ
2.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Sulayman ibn Bilal, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Usayd, from his grandfather, from Abu Hurairah; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever prays the Subh, is under the protection of Allah, so do not betray Allah in his protected one, and whoever prays the Asr, is under the protection of Allah, so do not betray Allah in his protected one." Abu Muhammad said: When someone is granted safety and does not fulfill it, he has betrayed and violated protection.
2.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Sulayman ibn Bilal se, Ibrahim ibn Abi Usayd se, apne dada se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jo Subh padhe, woh Allah ki panah mein hai, so Allah ko uske panah-yaafta ke maamle mein dhoka na do, aur jo Asr padhe, woh Allah ki panah mein hai, so Allah ko uske panah-yaafta ke maamle mein dhoka na do." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Jab kisi ko aman di jaaye aur woh poori na ki jaaye, to yeh dhoka aur ahad-shikni hai.

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كُنَانَةَ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ،  عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَرْقَمِ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، ، قَالَ :" إِذَا حَضَرَتْ الصَّلَاةُ وَأَرَادَ الرَّجُلُ الْخَلَاءَ، فَابْدَأْ بِالْخَلَاءِ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kinanah, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Arqam, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "When the prayer is present and the man wants to relieve himself, begin with relieving yourself."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Kinanah ne Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Abdullah ibn al-Arqam se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jab namaz ka waqt aaye aur aadmi ko qaza-e-hajat ki bhi zaroorat ho, to pehle qaza-e-hajat se shuru karo."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْيُصَلِّيَ الرَّجُلُ مُخْتَصِرًا "
2.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Khalid, from Hisham, from Ibn Sirin, from Abu Hurairah: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade a man from praying mukhtasiran."
2.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Khalid se, Hisham se, Ibn Sirin se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne aadmi ko 'mukhtasiran' (kamar par haath rakh kar) namaz padhne se mana kiya."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْحَوْضِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ سَيَّارٍ أَبِي الْمِنْهَالِ الرِّيَاحِيِّ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي بَرْزَةَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يَكْرَهُ النَّوْمَ قَبْلَ الْعِشَاءِ، وَالْحَدِيثَ بَعْدَهَا "
2.en: Narrated by Hafs ibn Umar al-Hawdi, from Shu'bah, from Sayyar Abu al-Minhal al-Riyahi, from Abu Barzah: He said: The Prophet ﷺ "disliked sleeping before Isha, and conversation after it."
2.hi: Hafs ibn Umar al-Hawdi ne Shu'bah se, Sayyar Abu al-Minhal al-Riyahi se, Abu Barzah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ "Isha se pehle sone ko, aur uske baad baaton karne ko na-pasand karte the."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ الْبَزَّارُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ الْمُحَرَّرِ بْنِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ مَعَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ لَمَّا بَعَثَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَنَادَى بِأَرْبَعٍ حَتَّى صَهِلَ صَوْتُهُ : " أَلَا إِنَّهُلَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ إِلَّا نَفْسٌ مُؤْمِنَةٌ، وَلَا يَحُجَّنَّ بَعْدَ الْعَامِ مُشْرِكٌ، وَلَا يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ عُرْيَانٌ، وَمَنْ كَانَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَهْدٌ، فَإِنَّ أَجَلَهُ إِلَى أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْهُرٍ، فَإِذَا مَضَتْ الْأَرْبَعَةُ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بَرِيءٌ مِنْ الْمُشْرِكِينَ وَرَسُولُهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Bishr ibn Thabit al-Bazzar, from Shu'bah, from al-Mughirah, from al-Sha'bi, from al-Muharrar ibn Abi Hurairah, from his father: He said: I was with Ali ibn Abi Talib when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent him, and he called out four things until his voice grew hoarse: "Indeed no soul will enter Paradise except a believing soul, and no polytheist shall perform Hajj after this year, and no one shall circumambulate the House naked, and whoever has a treaty between him and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, his term is until four months; then when the four have passed, then Allah is free of obligation to the polytheists, and so is His Messenger."
2.hi: Bishr ibn Thabit al-Bazzar ne Shu'bah se, al-Mughirah se, al-Sha'bi se, al-Muharrar ibn Abi Hurairah se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Ali ibn Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ke saath tha jab Rasulullah ﷺ ne unhein bheja, to unhone chaar baatein pukaarin yahan tak ke unki awaaz baithh gayi: "Sun lo, koi rooh Jannat mein dakhil nahi hogi siwaay momin rooh ke, aur is saal ke baad koi mushrik Hajj na kare, aur koi barhna Baitullah ka tawaaf na kare, aur jiska Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath koi ahad ho, uski muddat chaar mahine tak hai; fir jab chaar [mahine] guzar jaayein, to Allah aur uske Rasool mushrikon se bari-ul-zimma hain."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ سَبْرَةَ بْنِ مَعْبَدٍ الْجُهَنِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عَمِّي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ سَبْرَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" عَلِّمُوا الصَّبِيَّ الصَّلَاةَ ابْنَ سَبْعِ سِنِينَ، وَاضْرِبُوهُ عَلَيْهَا ابْنَ عَشْرٍ "
2.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr al-Humaydi, from Harmalah ibn Abd al-Aziz ibn al-Rabi' ibn Sabrah ibn Ma'bad al-Juhani, from his uncle Abd al-Malik ibn al-Rabi' ibn Sabrah, from his father, from his grandfather: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Teach the child prayer at seven years old, and strike him over it at ten."
2.hi: Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr al-Humaydi ne Harmalah ibn Abd al-Aziz ibn al-Rabi' ibn Sabrah ibn Ma'bad al-Juhani se, apne chacha Abd al-Malik ibn al-Rabi' ibn Sabrah se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Bachche ko saat saal ki umar mein namaz sikhaao, aur das saal ki umar mein [na padhne par] isi par usay maaro."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عَلِيٍّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبِي  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ  ، قَالَ :" ثَلَاثُ سَاعَاتٍ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَنْهَانَا أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ فِيهِنَّ، أَوْ أَنْ نَقْبُرَ فِيهِنَّ مَوْتَانَا : حِينَ تَطْلُعُ الشَّمْسُ بَازِغَةً حَتَّى تَرْتَفِعَ، وَحِينَ يَقُومُ قَائِمُ الظَّهِيرَةِ حَتَّى تَمِيلَ الشَّمْسُ، وَحِينَ تَضَيَّفُ الشَّمْسُ لِلْغُرُوبِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ "
2.en: Narrated by Wahb ibn Jarir, from Musa ibn Ali, from his father, from Uqbah ibn Amir: He said: "There are three times during which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to forbid us from praying, or from burying our dead: when the sun rises visibly until it climbs up, and when the sun stands at midday until it declines, and when the sun approaches setting until it sets."
2.hi: Wahb ibn Jarir ne Musa ibn Ali se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine apne walid ko kehte suna: Maine Uqbah ibn Amir ko kehte suna: "Teen waqt aise hain jinmein Rasulullah ﷺ humein namaz padhne se, ya apne murdon ko dafan karne se mana karte the: jab suraj chamakta hua nikle yahan tak ke woh bulund ho jaaye, aur jab dopahar ka waqt aaye yahan tak ke suraj dhal jaaye, aur jab suraj doobne ke qareeb aaye yahan tak ke woh doob jaaye."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي رِجَالٌ مَرْضِيُّونَ فِيهِمْ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ   وَأَرْضَاهُمْ عِنْدِي عُمَرُ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" لَا صَلَاةَ بَعْدَ صَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ، وَلَا صَلَاةَ بَعْدَ صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ "
2.en: Narrated by Affan, from Hammam, from Qatadah, from Abu al-Aliyah, from Ibn Abbas: He said: Trustworthy men narrated to me, among them Umar ibn al-Khattab - and Umar was the most trustworthy of them to me - that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There is no prayer after the Subh prayer until the sun rises, and no prayer after the Asr prayer until the sun sets."
2.hi: Affan ne Hammam se, Qatadah se, Abu al-Aliyah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhse bharosemand logon ne bataya, jinmein Umar ibn al-Khattab bhi the - aur Umar unmein se mere nazdeek sabse zyada bharosemand hain - ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Subh ki namaz ke baad koi namaz nahi jab tak suraj na nikal aaye, aur Asr ki namaz ke baad koi namaz nahi jab tak suraj na doob jaaye."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ الْأَسْوَدَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ  ، وَمَسْرُوقًا  ، يَشْهَدَانِ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ  ، أَنَّهَا شَهِدَتْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ عِنْدَهَا يَوْمًا إِلَّا" صَلَّى هَاتَيْنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : تَعْنِي : بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ
2.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Rabi', from Shu'bah, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Aswad ibn Yazid and Masruq, about Aisha; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: I heard al-Aswad ibn Yazid, and Masruq, testifying about Aisha, that she testified about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that there was not a day with her except that he "prayed these two rak'ahs." Abu Muhammad said: meaning: after Asr.
2.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Rabi' ne Shu'bah se, Abu Ishaq se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Aswad ibn Yazid aur Masruq ko Aisha ke baare mein gawahi dete suna, ke unhone Rasulullah ﷺ ke baare mein gawahi di ke unke paas koi din aisa nahi guzra jismein aapne "yeh do rakat na padhi ho." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: yaani: Asr ke baad.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا فَرْوَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَغْرَاءِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ :" مَا تَرَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ قَطُّ "
2.en: Narrated by Farwah ibn Abi al-Maghra, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha: She said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never left the two rak'ahs after Asr."
2.hi: Farwah ibn Abi al-Maghra ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Asr ke baad wali do rakat kabhi nahi chhodi."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ  ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ  مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، وَعَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَزْهَرَ، وَالْمِسْوَرَ بْنَ مَخْرَمَةَ، أَرْسَلُوهُ إِلَى عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالُوا : " اقْرَأْ عَلَيْهَا السَّلَامَ مِنَّا جَمِيعًا، وَسَلْهَا عَنْ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ، وَقُلْ : إِنَّا أُخْبِرْنَا أَنَّكِ تُصَلِّينَهُمَا، وَقَدْ بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَهَى عَنْهُمَا.
قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ : وَكُنْتُ أَضْرِبُ مَعَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهِمَا.
قَالَ كُرَيْبٌ : فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهَا وَبَلَّغْتُهَا مَا أَرْسَلُونِي بِهِ.
فَقَالَتْ : سَلْ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ .
فَخَرَجْتُ إِلَيْهِمْ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُمْ بِقَوْلِهَا، فَرَدُّونِي إِلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ بِمِثْلِ مَا أَرْسَلُونِي إِلَى عَائِشَةَ .
 فَقَالَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ   : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَيَنْهَى عَنْهُمَا، ثُمَّ رَأَيْتُهُ يُصَلِّيهِمَا، أَمَّا حِينَ صَلَّاهُمَا، فَإِنَّهُ صَلَّى الْعَصْرَ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ وَعِنْدِي نِسْوَةٌ مِنْ بَنِي حَرَامٍ مِنْ الْأَنْصَارِ، فَصَلَّاهُمَا، فَأَرْسَلْتُ إِلَيْهِ الْجَارِيَةَ، فَقُلْتُ : قُومِي بِجَنْبِهِ، فَقُولِي : أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ تَقُولُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَلَمْ أَسْمَعْكَ تَنْهَى عَنْ هَاتَيْنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ، وَأَرَاكَ تُصَلِّيهِمَا؟ فَإِنْ أَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ فَاسْتَأْخِرِي عَنْهُ، قَالَتْ : فَفَعَلَتْ الْجَارِيَةُ، فَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ فَاسْتَأْخَرَتْ عَنْهُ، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ، قَالَ : " يَا ابْنَةَ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ ، سَأَلْتِ عَنْ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ؟ إِنَّهُ أَتَانِي نَاسٌ مِنْ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ بِالْإِسْلَامِ مِنْ قَوْمِهِمْ، فَشَغَلُونِي عَنْ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اللَّتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الظُّهْرِ، فَهُمَا هَاتَانِ ".
سُئِلَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد عَنْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ، فَقَالَ : أَنَا أَقُولُ بِحَدِيثِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " لَا صَلَاةَ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ، وَلَا بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ "
2.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Isa, from Abdullah ibn Wahb, from Amr ibn al-Harith, from Bukayr ibn al-Ashajj, from Kurayb, freed servant of Ibn Abbas; with Abu Muhammad's final view: That Abdullah ibn Abbas, and Abd al-Rahman ibn Azhar, and al-Miswar ibn Makhramah, sent him to Aisha, wife of the Prophet ﷺ, and said: "Convey our greeting of peace to her all together, and ask her about the two rak'ahs after Asr, and say: we have been informed that you pray them, and it has reached us that the Prophet ﷺ forbade them." Ibn Abbas said: And I used to strike people, along with Umar ibn al-Khattab, for [doing] them. Kurayb said: So I entered upon her and conveyed what they sent me with. So she said: "Ask Umm Salamah." So I went out to them and informed them of her saying, so they sent me back to Umm Salamah with the like of what they sent me to Aisha with. So Umm Salamah said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbidding them, then I saw him praying them; as for when he prayed them, he prayed Asr, then entered while I had women from Banu Haram of the Ansar with me, so he prayed them, so I sent the servant-girl to him, and I said: "Stand next to him, and say: 'Umm Salamah says: O Messenger of Allah, did I not hear you forbidding these two rak'ahs, yet I see you praying them?' And if he gestures with his hand, then step back from him." She said: So the servant-girl did that, so he gestured with his hand, so she stepped back from him, so when he finished, he said: "O daughter of Abu Umayyah, you asked about the two rak'ahs after Asr? Indeed people from Abd al-Qays came to me with [news of the] Islam of their people, and they occupied me from the two rak'ahs that are after Zuhr, so these are those two." Abu Muhammad was asked about this hadith, so he said: I hold to the hadith of Umar, from the Prophet ﷺ: "There is no prayer after Asr until the sun sets, and none after Fajr until the sun rises."
2.hi: Ahmad ibn Isa ne Abdullah ibn Wahb se, Amr ibn al-Harith se, Bukayr ibn al-Ashajj se, Kurayb (Ibn Abbas ke azaad kiye hue ghulam) se bataya ke Abdullah ibn Abbas, aur Abd al-Rahman ibn Azhar, aur al-Miswar ibn Makhramah ne unhein Aisha, Nabi ﷺ ki biwi, ke paas bheja, aur kaha: "Unhein humari taraf se sab ka salaam pahunchao, aur unse Asr ke baad wali do rakat ke baare mein poocho, aur kaho: humein khabar mili hai ke aap unhein padhti hain, aur humein yeh bhi khabar mili hai ke Nabi ﷺ ne unse mana kiya tha." Ibn Abbas kehte hain: Aur main Umar ibn al-Khattab ke saath logon ko inke [padhne] par maara karta tha. Kurayb kehte hain: To main unke paas gaya aur jo mujhe bheja gaya tha woh unhein pahunchaya. To unhone kaha: "Umm Salamah se poochho." To main unke paas wapas gaya aur unhein unka jawab bataya, to unhone mujhe wapas Umm Salamah ke paas usi tarah bheja jaise mujhe Aisha ke paas bheja tha. To Umm Salamah ne kaha: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko inse mana karte suna, fir maine aapko unhein padhte dekha; jab aapne unhein padha, to aapne Asr padhi, fir andar aaye jabke mere paas Ansar ke Banu Haram ki kuch auratein thin, to aapne unhein padha, so maine aapke paas laundi bheji, aur maine kaha: "Uske pehlu mein khadi ho jao, aur kaho: 'Umm Salamah kehti hain: Ya Rasulullah, kya maine aapko in do rakaton se mana karte nahi suna, aur main aapko inhein padhte dekh rahi hoon?' Aur agar woh apne haath se ishara karein, to unse peechhe hat jaana." Unhone bataya: To laundi ne aisa hi kiya, to aapne apne haath se ishara kiya, to woh peechhe hat gayi, so jab aap faarigh hue, to farmaya: "Ae Abu Umayyah ki beti, tumne Asr ke baad wali do rakaton ke baare mein poocha? Mere paas Abd al-Qays ke kuch log apni qaum ke Islam laane ki khabar lekar aaye, to unhone mujhe Zuhr ke baad wali do rakaton se roke rakha, so yeh wahi do hain." Abu Muhammad se is hadith ke baare mein poocha gaya, to unhone kaha: Main Umar ki riwayat par amal karta hoon, Nabi ﷺ se: "Asr ke baad koi namaz nahi jab tak suraj na doobe, aur Fajr ke baad koi namaz nahi jab tak suraj na nikle."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " كَانَيُصَلِّي قَبْلَ الظُّهْرِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَبَعْدَ الظُّهْرِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَبَعْدَ الْمَغْرِبِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فِي بَيْتِهِ، وَبَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَبَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فِي بَيْتِهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That the Prophet ﷺ "used to pray before Zuhr two rak'ahs, and after Zuhr two rak'ahs, and after Maghrib two rak'ahs in his house, and after Isha two rak'ahs, and after Jumu'ah two rak'ahs in his house."
2.hi: Abu Asim ne Malik se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ "Zuhr se pehle do rakat padhte, aur Zuhr ke baad do rakat, aur Maghrib ke baad apne ghar mein do rakat, aur Isha ke baad do rakat, aur Jumu'ah ke baad apne ghar mein do rakat."

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ أَوْسٍ الثَّقَفِيَّ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ عَنْبَسَةَ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ   زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتْ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ مُسْلِمٍ يُصَلِّي كُلَّ يَوْمٍ ثِنْتَيْ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً تَطَوُّعًا، غَيْرَ الْفَرِيضَةِ، إِلَّا لَهُ بَيْتٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ، أَوْ بُنِيَ لَهُ بَيْتٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ ".
 قَالَتْ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ : فَمَا بَرِحْتُ أُصَلِّيهِنَّ بَعْدُ.
وَقَالَ عَمْرٌو مِثْلَهُ.
وَقَالَ النُّعْمَانُ مِثْلَهُ
2.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from al-Nu'man ibn Salim, from Amr ibn Aws al-Thaqafi, from Anbasah ibn Abi Sufyan, from Umm Habibah, wife of the Prophet ﷺ: That she heard the Prophet ﷺ say: "There is no Muslim servant who prays twelve rak'ahs voluntarily every day, other than the obligatory [prayers], except that he has a house in Paradise, or a house is built for him in Paradise." Umm Habibah said: So I have not ceased praying them since. And Amr said the like of it. And al-Nu'man said the like of it.
2.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se, al-Nu'man ibn Salim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Amr ibn Aws al-Thaqafi ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Anbasah ibn Abi Sufyan se, Umm Habibah, Nabi ﷺ ki biwi, se: ke unhone Nabi ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Koi Musalman banda aisa nahi jo har din farz ke ilawa baarah rakat nafl padhe, magar uske liye Jannat mein ek ghar hai, ya uske liye Jannat mein ek ghar banaya jaata hai." Umm Habibah ne kaha: To main tab se inhein padhna kabhi nahi chhodti. Aur Amr ne isi jaisa kaha. Aur al-Nu'man ne isi jaisa kaha.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : " كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَلَا يَدَعُ أَرْبَعًا قَبْلَ الظُّهْرِ، وَرَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ "
2.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Shu'bah, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad ibn al-Muntashir, from his father, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: She said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never left four before Zuhr, and two rak'ahs before Fajr."
2.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Shu'bah se, Ibrahim ibn Muhammad ibn al-Muntashir se, apne walid se, Aisha رضي الله عنها se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Zuhr se pehle chaar [rakat], aur Fajr se pehle do rakat kabhi nahi chhodi."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا الْجُرَيْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" بَيْنَ كُلِّ أَذَانَيْنِ صَلَاةٌ، بَيْنَ كُلِّ أَذَانَيْنِ صَلَاةٌ، بَيْنَ كُلِّ أَذَانَيْنِ صَلَاةٌ لِمَنْ شَاءَ "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Jurayri, from Abdullah ibn Buraydah, from Abdullah ibn Mughaffal: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Between every two calls there is a prayer, between every two calls there is a prayer, between every two calls there is a prayer, for whoever wishes."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Jurayri se, Abdullah ibn Buraydah se, Abdullah ibn Mughaffal se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Har do azaanon (azaan aur iqamah) ke darmiyan ek namaz hai, har do azaanon ke darmiyan ek namaz hai, har do azaanon ke darmiyan ek namaz hai, jo chahe [padh le]."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَامِرٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : " كَانَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ يُؤَذِّنُ لِصَلَاةِ الْمَغْرِبِ عَلَى عَهْدِ ِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَفَيَقُومُ لُبَابُ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَيَبْتَدِرُونَ السَّوَارِيَ حَتَّى يَخْرُجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُمْ كَذَلِكَ ".
قَالَ : وَقَلَّ مَا كَانَ يَلْبَثُ
2.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Rabi', from Shu'bah, from Amr ibn Amir, from Anas رضي الله عنه: He said: "The mu'adhdhin used to call the adhan for the Maghrib prayer in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so the core group of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would stand, and race to the pillars, until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would come out while they were like that." He said: And he rarely delayed [after that].
2.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Rabi' ne Shu'bah se, Amr ibn Amir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Anas رضي الله عنه ko kehte suna: "Rasulullah ﷺ ke zamane mein muazzin Maghrib ki azaan deta, to Rasulullah ﷺ ke khaas sahaba khade ho jaate, aur satoono ki taraf daudte, yahan tak ke Rasulullah ﷺ bahar aa jaate jabke woh isi haalat mein hote." Unhone bataya: Aur aap kam hi der karte.

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   قَالَتْ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يُخْفِي مَا يَقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا، وَذَكَرَتْ قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ وَقُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ".
قَالَ سَعِيدٌ : فِي رَكْعَتَيْ الْفَجْرِ
2.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Hisham, from Muhammad, from Aisha; with Sa'id's clarification: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ "used to recite quietly what he recited in them," and she mentioned "Say: O disbelievers" and "Say: He is Allah, One." Sa'id said: in the two rak'ahs of Fajr.
2.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Hisham se, Muhammad se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ "unmein jo padhte the woh aahista padhte the," aur unhone "Qul yaa ayyuhal-kaafiroon" aur "Qul huwallahu Ahad" ka zikr kiya. Sa'id kehte hain: Fajr ki do rakaton mein.

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  قَالَ : حَدَّثَتْنِي حَفْصَةُ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" يُصَلِّي سَجْدَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ مَا يَطْلُعُ الْفَجْرُ ".
وَكَانَتْ سَاعَةً لَا أَدْخُلُ فِيهَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
2.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Yahya, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, from Hafsah: He said: Hafsah narrated to me, that the Prophet ﷺ used to "pray two light prostrations [rak'ahs] after dawn had broken." And it was a time when I did not enter upon the Prophet ﷺ.
2.hi: Musaddad ne Yahya se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Hafsah ne mujhse bataya ke Nabi ﷺ "subah sadiq hone ke baad do halki [rakat] padhte the." Aur woh aisa waqt tha jismein main Nabi ﷺ ke paas nahi jaata tha.

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ   زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَتْ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " إِذَا سَكَتَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ مِنْ أَذَانِ الصُّبْحِ وَبَدَا الصُّبْحُ،صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُقَامَ الصَّلَاةُ "
2.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, from Hafsah, wife of the Prophet ﷺ: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, "when the mu'adhdhin fell silent from the Subh adhan and dawn had appeared, would pray two light rak'ahs before the prayer was established."
2.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se, Hafsah, Nabi ﷺ ki biwi, se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ "jab muazzin Subh ki azaan se khamosh ho jaata aur subah zaahir ho jaati, to namaz ki iqamah se pehle do halki rakat padhte."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" يُصَلِّي بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Amr, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from his father: That the Prophet ﷺ used to "pray two rak'ahs after Jumu'ah."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se, Amr se, al-Zuhri se, Salim se, apne walid se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ "Jumu'ah ke baad do rakat padhte the."

2.ar: وَأَخْبَرَتْهُ حَفْصَةُ  ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ" يُصَلِّي إِذَا أَضَاءَ الصُّبْحُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ "
2.en: Continuing the same narration, from Hafsah: And Hafsah informed him, that he used to "pray two rak'ahs when dawn became light."
2.hi: Aur Hafsah ne unhein bataya ke aap "subah roshan hone par do rakat padhte the."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ  ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ أَبِي النَّضْرِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" إِذَا صَلَّى الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ، فَإِنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ حَاجَةٌ، كَلَّمَنِي بِهَا، وَإِلَّا، خَرَجَ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ "
2.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abdullah ibn Idris, from Malik ibn Anas, from Salim Abu al-Nadr, from Abu Salamah, from Aisha: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, "when he had prayed the two rak'ahs before Fajr, if he had a need, he would speak to me about it, and otherwise, he would go out to the prayer."
2.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abdullah ibn Idris se, Malik ibn Anas se, Salim Abu al-Nadr se, Abu Salamah se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ "jab Fajr se pehle wali do rakat padh chukte, to agar aapko koi zaroorat hoti, to aap mujhse usme baat karte, warna namaz ke liye nikal jaate."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يُصَلِّي مَا بَيْنَ الْعِشَاءِ إِلَى الْفَجْرِ إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً يُسَلِّمُ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، يُوتِرُ بِوَاحِدَةٍ، فَإِذَا سَكَتَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ مِنْ الْأَذَانِ الْأَوَّلِ رَكَعَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ فَيَخْرُجُ مَعَهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha: She said: The Prophet ﷺ "used to pray, between Isha and Fajr, eleven rak'ahs, giving the taslim after every two, [and] making one rak'ah witr; then when the mu'adhdhin fell silent from the first call, he would pray two light rak'ahs, then he would lie down until the mu'adhdhin came to him, and he would go out with him."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Ibn Abi Dhi'b se, al-Zuhri se, Urwah se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ "Isha aur Fajr ke darmiyan gyaarah rakat padhte the, har do rakat par salaam phertay, [aur] ek rakat witr padhte; fir jab muazzin pehli azaan se khamosh ho jaata, to aap do halki rakat padhte, fir let jaate yahan tak ke muazzin unke paas aata, aur aap uske saath nikalte."

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا أُقِيمَتْ الصَّلَاةُ، فَلَا صَلَاةَ إِلَّا الْمَكْتُوبَةُ ".
 أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو حَفْصٍ عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْفَلَّاسُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ وَرْقَاءَ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، نَحْوَهُ
2.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Zakariya ibn Ishaq, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Sulayman ibn Yasar, from Abu Hurairah; a similar chain also via Abu Hafs Amr ibn Ali al-Fallas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When the prayer is established, there is no prayer except the obligatory one." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Abu Hafs Amr ibn Ali al-Fallas, from Ghundar, from Shu'bah, from Warqa, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Ata ibn Yasar, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ, similarly.]
2.hi: Abu Asim ne Zakariya ibn Ishaq se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Sulayman ibn Yasar se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab namaz ki iqamah ho jaaye, to farz ke siwa koi namaz nahi." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Abu Hafs Amr ibn Ali al-Fallas se, Ghundar se, Shu'bah se, Warqa se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Ata ibn Yasar se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai.]

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ  ، قَالَ : أُقِيمَتْ الصَّلَاةُ، فَرَأَى النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَجُلًا يُصَلِّي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ، فَلَمَّا قَضَى النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ صَلَاتَهُ، لَاثَ بِهِ النَّاسُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَتُصَلِّي الصُّبْحَ أَرْبَعًا؟ "
2.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Sa'd ibn Ibrahim, from Hafs ibn Asim ibn Umar, from Ibn Buhaynah: He said: The prayer was established, and the Prophet ﷺ saw a man praying two rak'ahs, so when the Prophet ﷺ finished his prayer, the people surrounded him, so the Prophet ﷺ said to him: "Are you praying the Subh four [rak'ahs]?"
2.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se, Sa'd ibn Ibrahim se, Hafs ibn Asim ibn Umar se, Ibn Buhaynah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Namaz ki iqamah ho gayi, to Nabi ﷺ ne ek aadmi ko do rakat padhte dekha, so jab Nabi ﷺ apni namaz se faarigh hue, to log usay ghere mein le liya, to Nabi ﷺ ne usse farmaya: "Kya tum Subh chaar [rakat] padh rahe ho?"

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِذَا أُقِيمَتْ الصَّلَاةُ، فَلَا صَلَاةَ إِلَّا الْمَكْتُوبَةُ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : إِذَا كَانَ فِي بَيْتِهِ، فَالْبَيْتُ أَهْوَنُ
2.en: Narrated by Muslim, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Ata ibn Yasar, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: "When the prayer is established, there is no prayer except the obligatory one." Abu Muhammad said: If he is in his house, then the house is easier.
2.hi: Muslim ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Ata ibn Yasar se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jab namaz ki iqamah ho jaaye, to farz ke siwa koi namaz nahi." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Agar woh apne ghar mein ho, to ghar mein zyada gunjaish hai.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ بُرْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ  ، عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ  ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ الْجُذَامِيِّ  ، عَنْ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ هَمَّارٍ الْغَطَفَانِيِّ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى : ابْنَ آدَمَ ، صَلِّ لِي أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ النَّهَارِ، أَكْفِكَ آخِرَهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Mu'tamir ibn Sulayman, from Burd, from Sulayman ibn Musa, from Makhul, from Kathir ibn Murrah al-Hadrami, from Qays al-Judhami, from Nu'aym ibn Hammar al-Ghatafani, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Allah the Exalted said: 'O son of Adam, pray for Me four rak'ahs at the beginning of the day, and I will suffice you for its remainder.'"
2.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Mu'tamir ibn Sulayman se, Burd se, Sulayman ibn Musa se, Makhul se, Kathir ibn Murrah al-Hadrami se, Qays al-Judhami se, Nu'aym ibn Hammar al-Ghatafani se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: 'Ae Aadam ke bete, din ke shuru mein mere liye chaar rakat padh, main baaki din ke liye tere liye kaafi ho jaunga.'"

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، قَالَ : عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ  أَنْبَأَنِي، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى  يَقُولُ : مَا أَخْبَرَنَا أَحَدٌ أَنَّهُ رَأَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُصَلِّي الضُّحَى غَيْرُ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ  ، فَإِنَّهَا ذَكَرَتْ أَنَّهُ يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ" اغْتَسَلَ فِي بَيْتِهَا، ثُمَّ صَلَّى ثَمَانَ رَكَعَاتٍ، قَالَتْ : وَلَمْ أَرَهُ صَلَّى صَلَاةً أَخَفَّ مِنْهَا، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ يُتِمُّ الرُّكُوعَ وَالسُّجُودَ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from Amr ibn Murrah, from Ibn Abi Layla, about Umm Hani: He said: Amr ibn Murrah informed me, he said: I heard Ibn Abi Layla say: No one informed us that he saw the Prophet ﷺ pray the Duha prayer except Umm Hani, for she mentioned that on the day of the conquest of Makkah, he "bathed in her house, then prayed eight rak'ahs." She said: "And I never saw him pray a lighter prayer than it, except that he completed the bowing and the prostration."
2.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Amr ibn Murrah ne mujhe bataya, unhone kaha: Maine Ibn Abi Layla ko kehte suna: Humein Umm Hani ke siwa kisi ne nahi bataya ke usne Nabi ﷺ ko Duha ki namaz padhte dekha ho, kyunki unhone bataya ke Fateh-e-Makkah ke din aapne "unke ghar mein ghusl kiya, fir aath rakat padhi." Unhone bataya: "Aur maine aapko is se halki koi namaz padhte kabhi nahi dekha, siwaay iske ke aap ruku aur sajda mukammal karte the."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ  ، أَنَّ أَبَا مُرَّةَ  مَوْلَى عَقِيلِ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أُمَّ هَانِئٍ   بِنْتَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهَا ذَهَبَتْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ فَوَجَدَتْهُ يَغْتَسِلُ، وَفَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُهُ تَسْتُرُهُ بِثَوْبٍ.
قَالَتْ : فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ وَذَلِكَ ضُحًى.
قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " مَنْ هَذِهِ؟ ".
فَقُلْتُ : أَنَا أُمُّ هَانِئٍ .
قَالَتْ :" فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ مِنْ غُسْلِهِ، قَامَ فَصَلَّى ثَمَانَ رَكَعَاتٍ مُلْتَحِفًا فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ، ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ "
2.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Malik, from Abu al-Nadr, from Abu Murrah, freed servant of Aqil ibn Abi Talib, about Umm Hani bint Abi Talib: That Abu Murrah, freed servant of Aqil ibn Abi Talib, informed him, that he heard Umm Hani bint Abi Talib narrating that she went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the year of the Conquest, and found him bathing, while Fatimah his daughter was screening him with a garment. She said: So I greeted him, and that was in the forenoon. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Who is this?" So I said: "I am Umm Hani." She said: "So when he finished his bath, he stood and prayed eight rak'ahs, wrapped in a single garment, then departed."
2.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Malik se, Abu al-Nadr se bataya ke Abu Murrah, Aqil ibn Abi Talib ke azaad kiye hue ghulam, ne unhein bataya ke unhone Umm Hani bint Abi Talib ko yeh bayaan karte suna ke woh Fateh ke saal Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas gayi aur unhein ghusl karte paaya, jabke aapki beti Fatimah aapko kapde se parda kar rahi thin. Unhone bataya: To maine aapko salaam kiya, aur woh chaasht (duha) ka waqt tha. Rasulullah ﷺ ne poocha: "Yeh kaun hai?" To maine kaha: "Main Umm Hani hoon." Unhone bataya: "So jab aap ghusl se faarigh hue, to khade hue aur aath rakat padhi, ek hi kapde mein lipte hue, fir chale gaye."

2.ar:
فَقُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، زَعَمَ ابْنُ أُمِّي أَنَّهُ قَاتِلٌ رَجُلًا أَجَرْتُهُ : فُلَانَ بْنَ هُبَيْرَةَ.
فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " قَدْأَجَرْنَا مَنْ أَجَرْتِ يَا أُمَّ هَانِئٍ "
2.en: Continuing the same narration [Umm Hani]: So I said: "O Messenger of Allah, my mother's son claims that he will kill a man I have granted protection to: so-and-so ibn Hubayrah." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "We have granted protection to whoever you have granted protection to, O Umm Hani."
2.hi: To maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, meri maa ke bete [Ali (Alayhis Salam)] ka dawa hai ke woh us aadmi ko qatal karega jise maine panah di hai: fulaan ibn Hubayrah." Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Humne bhi usay panah de di jise tumne panah di hai, ae Umm Hani."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَبَّاسٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : " أَوْصَانِي خَلِيلِي بِثَلَاثٍ لَا أَدَعُهُنَّ حَتَّى أَمُوتَ :الْوِتْرِ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَنَامَ، وَصَوْمِ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ مِنْ كُلِّ شَهْرٍ، وَمِنْ الضُّحَى رَكْعَتَيْنِ "
2.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Shu'bah, from Abbas al-Jurayri, from Abu Uthman, from Abu Hurairah: He said: "My close friend advised me with three things which I will not leave until I die: witr before I sleep, and fasting three days from every month, and two rak'ahs of Duha."
2.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Shu'bah se, Abbas al-Jurayri se, Abu Uthman se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Mere khaleel (mahboob dost) ne mujhe teen baaton ki wasiyat ki jinhein main marte dam tak nahi chhodunga: sone se pehle witr, aur har mahine mein teen din ka roza, aur Duha ki do rakat."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ :" مَا صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سُبْحَةَ الضُّحَى فِي سَفَرٍ وَلَا حَضَرٍ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from al-Awza'i, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha: She said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never prayed the supererogatory prayer of Duha in journey or at home."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne al-Awza'i se, al-Zuhri se, Urwah se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne kabhi Duha ki nafl namaz na safar mein padhi na ghar mein."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ الْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ فَضَالَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ   رَأَى أُنَاسًا يُصَلُّونَ صَلَاةَ الضُّحَى، فَقَالَ : " أَمَا إِنَّهُمْلَيُصَلُّونَ صَلَاةً مَا صَلَّاهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَلَا عَامَّةُ أَصْحَابِهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Sadaqah ibn al-Fadl, from Mu'adh ibn Mu'adh, from Shu'bah, from al-Fudayl ibn Fadalah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakrah, about his father: That his father saw people praying the Duha prayer, and said: "Indeed they are praying a prayer which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ never prayed, nor did the majority of his Companions."
2.hi: Sadaqah ibn al-Fadl ne Mu'adh ibn Mu'adh se, Shu'bah se, al-Fudayl ibn Fadalah se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakrah se bataya ke unke walid ne kuch logon ko Duha ki namaz padhte dekha, to kaha: "Sun lo, yeh log aisi namaz padh rahe hain jo na Rasulullah ﷺ ne kabhi padhi na aapke aksar sahaba ne."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتَوَائِيُّ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَرَجَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَهُمْ يُصَلُّونَ بَعْدَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" صَلَاةُ الْأَوَّابِينَ إِذَا رَمِضَتْ الْفِصَالُ "
2.en: Narrated by Wahb ibn Jarir, from Hisham al-Dastawa'i, from al-Qasim ibn Awf, from Zayd ibn Arqam: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to them while they were praying after sunrise, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The prayer of those who often turn [to Allah] is when the young camels feel the heat of the sun."
2.hi: Wahb ibn Jarir ne Hisham al-Dastawa'i se, al-Qasim ibn Awf se, Zayd ibn Arqam se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ unke paas nikle jabke woh suraj nikalne ke baad namaz padh rahe the, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Zyada rujoo karne walon ki namaz woh hai jab oont ke bacchon ko dhoop ki tapish mehsoos hone lage."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ  ، وَغُنْدَرٌ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ الْأَزْدِيِّ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" صَلَاةُ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى ".
وَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا : رَكْعَتَيْنِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ
2.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Shaybah, from Waki', and Ghundar, from Shu'bah, from Ya'la ibn Ata, from Ali al-Azdi, from Ibn Umar: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The prayer of night and day is two by two." And one of the two [narrators] said: "rak'ah by rak'ah."
2.hi: Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Shaybah ne Waki' aur Ghundar se, Shu'bah se, Ya'la ibn Ata se, Ali al-Azdi se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Raat aur din ki namaz do-do rakat hai." Aur dono raawiyon mein se ek ne kaha: "rakat-rakat karke."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ صَلَاةِ اللَّيْلِ، فَقَالَ :" مَثْنَى مَثْنَى، فَإِذَا خَشِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ الصُّبْحَ، فَلْيُصَلِّ رَكْعَةً وَاحِدَةً تُوتِرُ مَا قَدْ صَلَّى "
2.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about the night prayer, so he said: "Two by two, and when one of you fears the approach of dawn, let him pray a single rak'ah, making witr what he has prayed."
2.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi ne Rasulullah ﷺ se raat ki namaz ke baare mein poocha, to aapne farmaya: "Do-do rakat, aur jab tum mein se kisi ko subah aane ka khauf ho, to woh ek rakat padh le, jo padh chuka hai use witr banaate hue."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ عَوْفٍ  ، عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلَامَ  ، قَالَ : لَمَّا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْمَدِينَةَ ، اسْتَشْرَفَهُ النَّاسُ فَقَالُوا : قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ : فَخَرَجْتُ فِيمَنْ خَرَجَ، فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتُ وَجْهَهُ، عَرَفْتُ أَنَّ وَجْهَهُ لَيْسَ بِوَجْهِ كَذَّابٍ، وَكَانَ أَوَّلُ مَا سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ : " يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ،أَفْشُوا السَّلَامَ، وَأَطْعِمُوا الطَّعَامَ، وَصِلُوا الْأَرْحَامَ، وَصَلُّوا وَالنَّاسُ نِيَامٌ، تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِسَلَامٍ "
2.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Awf, from Zurarah ibn Awfa, from Abdullah ibn Salam: He said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ arrived at Madinah, the people looked out for him, and said: "The Messenger of Allah has arrived, the Messenger of Allah has arrived." He said: So I went out with those who went out, and when I saw his face, I knew that his face was not the face of a liar, and the first thing I heard him say was: "O people, spread peace, and feed food, and maintain the ties of kinship, and pray while the people are asleep, [and] you will enter Paradise in peace."
2.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Awf se, Zurarah ibn Awfa se, Abdullah ibn Salam se bataya: Unhone kaha, Jab Rasulullah ﷺ Madinah pahunche, to log unhein dekhne ke liye jhaank ne lage, aur kehne lage: "Rasulullah aa gaye, Rasulullah aa gaye." Unhone bataya: To main un logon ke saath nikla jo nikle the, aur jab maine aapka chehra dekha, to jaan liya ke yeh chehra jhoote ka nahi ho sakta, aur sabse pehle maine aapko yeh farmaate suna: "Ae logo, salaam ko phailaao, aur khaana khilaao, aur rishtedaari ke rishte joda karo, aur raat ko namaz padho jabke log so rahe hon, [to] tum salaamati ke saath Jannat mein dakhil hoge."

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ رِيَابٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَحْنَفِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ  ، قَالَ : دَخَلْتُ مَسْجِدَ دِمَشْقَ ، فَإِذَا رَجُلٌ يُكْثِرُ الرُّكُوعَ وَالسُّجُودَ قُلْتُ : لَا أَخْرُجُ حَتَّى أَنْظُرَ أَيَدْرِي هَذَا عَلَى شَفْعٍ انْصَرِفْتُ أَمْ عَلَى وِتْرٍ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ، قُلْتُ : يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، أَتَدْرِي عَلَى شَفْعٍ انْصَرَفْتَ أَمْ عَلَى وِتْرٍ؟ فَقَالَ : إِنْ أَكُ لَا أَدْرِي، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَدْرِي.
ثُمَّ قَالَ : إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ خَلِيلِي أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ :" مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يَسْجُدُ لِلَّهِ سَجْدَةً إِلَّا رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ بِهَا دَرَجَةً، وَحَطَّ عَنْهُ بِهَا خَطِيئَةً ".
قُلْتُ : مَنْ أَنْتَ رَحِمَكَ اللَّهُ؟ قَالَ : أَنَا أَبُو ذَرٍّ  .
قَالَ : فَتَقَاصَرَتْ إِلَيَّ نَفْسِي
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir, from al-Awza'i, from Harun ibn Riyab, from al-Ahnaf ibn Qays, about Abu Dharr: He said: I entered the mosque of Damascus, and there was a man doing much bowing and prostration; I said [to myself]: I will not leave until I see whether this one knows if he finished on an even or an odd [number of rak'ahs]. So when he finished, I said: "O servant of Allah, do you know whether you finished on an even or an odd?" He said: "If I do not know, then Allah knows." Then he said: "I heard my close friend Abu al-Qasim ﷺ say: 'There is no servant who prostrates a single prostration to Allah, except that Allah raises him by it a degree, and removes from him by it a sin.'" I said: "Who are you, may Allah have mercy on you?" He said: "I am Abu Dharr." He said: So I felt myself shrink [in awe].
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir ne al-Awza'i se, Harun ibn Riyab se, al-Ahnaf ibn Qays se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Damascus ki masjid mein dakhil hua, to ek aadmi bahut ruku aur sajda kar raha tha; maine [apne dil mein] kaha: Main tab tak nahi jaunga jab tak yeh na dekh lun ke isay pata hai ke yeh juft [rakat] par khatam hua ya taaq par. So jab woh faarigh hua, to maine kaha: "Ae Allah ke bande, kya aapko pata hai aap juft par khatam hue ya taaq par?" Unhone kaha: "Agar mujhe nahi pata, to Allah ko pata hai." Fir unhone kaha: "Maine apne khaleel Abu al-Qasim ﷺ ko farmaate suna: 'Koi banda Allah ke liye ek sajda nahi karta, magar Allah usse ek darja bulund kar deta hai, aur ek gunah mita deta hai.'" Maine poocha: "Aap kaun hain, Allah aap par reham kare?" Unhone kaha: "Main Abu Dharr hoon." Unhone bataya: To main apne aap ko chhota mehsoos karne laga.

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ  ، حَدَّثَتْنَا شَعْثَاءُ  قَالَتْ : رَأَيْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى   صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَقَالَ :صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الضُّحَى رَكْعَتَيْنِ حِينَ بُشِّرَ بِالْفَتْحِ، أَوْ بِرَأْسِ أَبِي جَهْلٍ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Salamah ibn Raja, from Sha'tha', about Ibn Abi Awfa: She said: I saw Ibn Abi Awfa pray two rak'ahs and say: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed Duha two rak'ahs when he was given the glad tidings of the conquest, or of the head of Abu Jahl."
2.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Salamah ibn Raja se, Sha'tha' se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibn Abi Awfa ko do rakat padhte aur yeh kehte dekha: "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Duha ki do rakat padhi thi jab aapko fatah ki, ya Abu Jahl ke sar ki, khush-khabri di gayi thi."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق الْأَزْرَقُ  ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ  ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، قَالَ : أَتَيْتُ الْحِيرَةَ فَرَأَيْتُهُمْ يَسْجُدُونَ لِمَرْزُبَانَ لَهُمْ، فَقُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَلَا نَسْجُدُ لَكَ؟ قَالَ :" لَوْ أَمَرْتُ أَحَدًا أَنْ يَسْجُدَ لأَحَدٍ، لَأَمَرْتُ النِّسَاءَ أَنْ يَسْجُدْنَ لِأَزْوَاجِهِنَّ لِمَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ حَقِّهِمْ "
2.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Ishaq al-Azraq, from Sharik, from Husayn, from al-Sha'bi, from Qays ibn Sa'd: He said: I came to al-Hirah, and I saw them prostrating to a marzban of theirs, so I said: "O Messenger of Allah, shall we not prostrate to you?" He said: "If I were to command anyone to prostrate to anyone, I would command the women to prostrate to their husbands, because of the right Allah has placed upon them."
2.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Ishaq al-Azraq se, Sharik se, Husayn se, al-Sha'bi se, Qays ibn Sa'd se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main al-Hirah aaya, aur maine unhein apne ek marzban (haakim) ko sajda karte dekha, to maine [Nabi ﷺ se] poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, kya hum aapko sajda na karein?" Aapne farmaya: "Agar main kisi ko kisi ke saamne sajda karne ka hukum deta, to auraton ko apne shohar ke saamne sajda karne ka hukum deta, us haq ki wajah se jo Allah ne unpar [shohar ke liye] rakha hai."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْحِزَامِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حِبَّانُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ  ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ حَبَّانَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، ائْذَنْ لِي فَلِأَسْجُدَ لَكَ.
قَالَ :" لَوْ كُنْتُ آمِرًا أَحَدًا أَنْ يَسْجُدَ لِأَحَدٍ، لَأَمَرْتُ الْمَرْأَةَ أَنْ تَسْجُدُ لِزَوْجِهَا "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Hizami, from Hibban ibn Ali, from Salih ibn Habban, from Ibn Buraydah, from his father: He said: A Bedouin came to the Prophet ﷺ, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, permit me that I may prostrate to you." He said: "If I were commanding anyone to prostrate to anyone, I would command the woman to prostrate to her husband."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Hizami ne Hibban ibn Ali se, Salih ibn Habban se, Ibn Buraydah se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek Bedouin Nabi ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, mujhe ijaazat dijiye ke main aapko sajda karun." Aapne farmaya: "Agar main kisi ko kisi ke saamne sajda karne ka hukum deta, to aurat ko apne shohar ke saamne sajda karne ka hukum deta."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ  ،  عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" قَرَأَ النَّجْمَ فَسَجَدَ فِيهَا "، فَلَمْ يَبْقَ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا سَجَدَ، إِلَّا شَيْخٌ أَخَذَ كَفًّا مِنْ حَصا فَرَفَعَهُ إِلَى جَبْهَتِهِ وَقَالَ : يَكْفِينِي هَذَا
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Aswad, from Abdullah ibn Mas'ud: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "recited al-Najm and prostrated in it," so no one remained except that he prostrated, except an old man who took a handful of pebbles and raised it to his forehead, and said: "This suffices me."
2.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Shu'bah se, Abu Ishaq se, al-Aswad se, Abdullah ibn Mas'ud se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "Surah An-Najm padhi aur usmein sajda kiya," to koi aisa na bacha jisne sajda na kiya ho, siwaay ek budhe aadmi ke jisne ek mutthi kankariyon ki li aur use apni peshani tak uthaya, aur kaha: "Yeh mere liye kaafi hai."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي هِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمًافَقَرَأَ ص ، فَلَمَّا مَرَّ بِالسَّجْدَةِ، نَزَلَ فَسَجَدَ وَسَجَدْنَا مَعَهُ، وَقَرَأَهَا مَرَّةً أُخْرَى، فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ السَّجْدَةَ تَيَسَّرْنَا لِلسُّجُودِ فَلَمَّا رَآنَا، قَالَ : " إِنَّمَا هِيَ تَوْبَةُ نَبِيٍّ، وَلَكِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ قَدْ اسْتَعْدَدْتُمْ لِلسُّجُودِ "، فَنَزَلَ فَسَجَدَ وَسَجَدْنَا
2.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Khalid ibn Yazid, from Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal, from Iyad ibn Abdullah ibn Sa'd, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: That he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave us a sermon one day, and recited "Sad," and when he passed the verse of prostration, he descended and prostrated, and we prostrated with him, and he recited it another time, and when he reached the verse of prostration, we made ready for prostration, so when he saw us, he said: "It is only the repentance of a prophet, but I see you have prepared for prostration," so he descended and prostrated, and we prostrated.
2.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se, Khalid ibn Yazid se, Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal se, Iyad ibn Abdullah ibn Sa'd se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne ek din humein khutba diya, aur "Sad" padhi, aur jab aayat-e-sajdah par pahunche, to utre aur sajda kiya, aur humne aapke saath sajda kiya, aur aapne use dobara padha, aur jab aayat-e-sajdah tak pahunche, to hum sajde ke liye taiyaar ho gaye, so jab aapne humein dekha, to farmaya: "Yeh to bas ek Nabi ki tauba hai, lekin main dekh raha hoon tum sajde ke liye taiyaar ho gaye ho," so aap utre aur sajda kiya, aur humne bhi sajda kiya.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل هُوَ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ،  عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنَّهُقَالَ فِي السُّجُودِ فِي ص : " لَيْسَتْ مِنْ عَزَائِمِ السُّجُودِ، وَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سَجَدَ فِيهَا "
2.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Zurarah, from Isma'il ibn Ulayyah, from Ayyub, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas: That he said, concerning the prostration in "Sad": "It is not among the required prostrations, but I have seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prostrate in it."
2.hi: Amr ibn Zurarah ne Isma'il ibn Ulayyah se, Ayyub se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se, "Sad" mein sajde ke baare mein bataya: Unhone kaha, "Yeh farz sajdon mein se nahi hai, lekin maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko usmein sajda karte dekha hai."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، قَالَ : رَأَيْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  يَسْجُدُ فِي إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ : تَسْجُدُ فِي سُورَةٍ مَا يُسْجَدُ فِيهَا؟ فَقَالَ : " إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَسْجُدُ فِيهَا "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, about Abu Hurairah: He said: I saw Abu Hurairah prostrate in "When the sky splits asunder" [Surah al-Inshiqaq], so it was said to him: "You prostrate in a surah in which prostration is not [normally] made?" So he said: "Indeed I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prostrate in it."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Hurairah ko "Idhas-samaa'u inshaqqat" [Surah Al-Inshiqaq] mein sajda karte dekha, to unse poocha gaya: "Aap us surah mein sajda karte hain jismein [aam tor par] sajda nahi kiya jaata?" To unhone kaha: "Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko usmein sajda karte dekha hai."
