2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، قَالَ : رَأَيْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَسْجُدُ فِي إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ ، فَقُلْتُ : يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَرَاكَ تَسْجُدُ فِي إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ ، فَقَالَ :" لَوْ لَمْ أَرَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سَجَدَ فِيهَا، لَمْ أَسْجُدْ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from al-Awza'i, from Yahya, from Abu Salamah, about Abu Hurairah: He said: I saw Abu Hurairah prostrate in "When the sky splits asunder," so I said: "O Abu Hurairah, I see you prostrating in 'When the sky splits asunder'?" So he said: "Had I not seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prostrate in it, I would not have prostrated."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne al-Awza'i se, Yahya se, Abu Salamah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Hurairah ko "Idhas-samaa'u inshaqqat" mein sajda karte dekha, to maine poocha: "Ae Abu Hurairah, main aapko 'Idhas-samaa'u inshaqqat' mein sajda karte dekh raha hoon?" To unhone kaha: "Agar maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko usmein sajda karte na dekha hota, to main sajda na karta."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" سَجَدَ فِي إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, from Sufyan, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm, from Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz, from Abu Bakr ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Harith ibn Hisham, from Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet ﷺ "prostrated in 'When the sky splits asunder.'"
2.hi: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah ne Sufyan se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm se, Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz se, Abu Bakr ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Harith ibn Hisham se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne "'Idhas-samaa'u inshaqqat' mein sajda kiya."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ مِينَاء  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ :" سَجَدْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ وَاقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Ayyub ibn Musa, from Ata ibn Mina, from Abu Hurairah: He said: "We prostrated with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in 'When the sky splits asunder' and 'Recite in the name of your Lord' [Surah al-Alaq]."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Ayyub ibn Musa se, Ata ibn Mina se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Humne Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath 'Idhas-samaa'u inshaqqat' aur 'Iqra bismi Rabbik' [Surah Al-Alaq] mein sajda kiya."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قُسَيْطٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ  ، قَالَ : "قَرَأْتُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ النَّجْمَ فَلَمْ يَسْجُدْ فِيهَا "
2.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from Yazid ibn Abdullah ibn Qusayt, from Ata ibn Yasar, from Zayd ibn Thabit: He said: "I recited al-Najm before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he did not prostrate in it."
2.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Ibn Abi Dhi'b se, Yazid ibn Abdullah ibn Qusayt se, Ata ibn Yasar se, Zayd ibn Thabit se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ke saamne Surah An-Najm padhi, aur aapne usmein sajda nahi kiya."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يُصَلِّي مَا بَيْنَ الْعِشَاءِ إِلَى الْفَجْرِ إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً يُسَلِّمُ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَيُوتِرُ بِوَاحِدَةٍ، وَيَسْجُدُ فِي سُبْحَتِهِ بِقَدْرِ مَا يَقْرَأُ أَحَدُكُمْ خَمْسِينَ آيَةً قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرْفَعَ رَأْسَهُ، فَإِذَا سَكَتَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ مِنْ الْأَذَانِ الْأَوَّلِ رَكَعَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ، فَيَخْرُجَ مَعَهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to "pray, between Isha and Fajr, eleven rak'ahs, giving the taslim after every two rak'ahs, and making witr with one, and prostrating in his supererogatory prayer for as long as it takes one of you to recite fifty verses before he raised his head, then when the mu'adhdhin fell silent from the first adhan, he would bow two light rak'ahs, then he would lie down until the mu'adhdhin came to him, and he would go out with him."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Ibn Abi Dhi'b se, al-Zuhri se, Urwah se, Aisha رضي الله عنها se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ "Isha aur Fajr ke darmiyan gyaarah rakat padhte, har do rakat par salaam phertay, aur ek se witr karte, aur apni nafl namaz mein itni der sajda karte jitni der mein tum mein se koi sar uthaane se pehle pachas aayaton ki tilaawat kare, fir jab muazzin pehli azaan se khamosh ho jaata, to aap do halki rakat ka ruku karte, fir let jaate yahan tak ke muazzin unke paas aata, aur aap uske saath nikalte."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، وَوَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ   عَنْ صَلَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِاللَّيْلِ، فَقَالَتْ : كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يُصَلِّي ثَلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً، يُصَلِّي ثَمَانَ رَكَعَاتٍ ثُمَّ يُوتِرُ، ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ، فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ، قَامَ فَرَكَعَ، وَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ بَيْنَ النِّدَاءِ وَالْإِقَامَةِ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, and Wahb ibn Jarir, from Hisham, from Yahya, from Abu Salamah, about Aisha: He said: I asked Aisha about the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at night, so she said: The Prophet ﷺ used to "pray thirteen rak'ahs, praying eight rak'ahs then making witr, then he would pray two rak'ahs while sitting, and when he wanted to bow, he would stand and bow, and he would pray two rak'ahs between the call and the iqamah of the Subh prayer."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun aur Wahb ibn Jarir ne Hisham se, Yahya se, Abu Salamah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Aisha se Rasulullah ﷺ ki raat ki namaz ke baare mein poocha, to unhone bataya: Nabi ﷺ "terah rakat padhte, aath rakat padhte fir witr karte, fir baith kar do rakat padhte, aur jab ruku karna chahte to khade hokar ruku karte, aur Subh ki azaan aur iqamah ke darmiyan do rakat padhte."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى  ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ  أَنَّهُ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَأَتَى الْمَدِينَةَ لِبَيْعِ عَقَارِهِ فَيَجْعَلَهُ فِي السِّلَاحِ وَالْكُرَاعِ، فَلَقِيَ رَهْطًا   مِنْ الْأَنْصَارِ، فَقَالُوا : أَرَادَ ذَلِكَ سِتَّةٌ مِنَّا عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَفَمَنَعَهُمْ وَقَالَ : " أَمَا لَكُمْ فِيَّ أُسْوَةٌ؟ "
2.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Mu'adh ibn Hisham, from his father, from Qatadah, from Zurarah ibn Awfa, from Sa'd ibn Hisham: That he had divorced his wife and came to Madinah to sell his property to put it toward weapons and horses [for jihad], so he met a group from the Ansar, and they said: "Six of us intended that in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, but he forbade them, and said: 'Do you not have in me a good example?'"
2.hi: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ne Mu'adh ibn Hisham se, apne walid se, Qatadah se, Zurarah ibn Awfa se, Sa'd ibn Hisham se bataya ke unhone apni biwi ko talaaq de di thi aur apni jaayedaad bechne Madinah aaye the taake use hathiyaar aur ghodon [jihad ke liye] mein lagaa saken, so unki mulaqaat Ansar ke kuch logon se hui, unhone kaha: "Humein se chhe logon ne Rasulullah ﷺ ke zamane mein aisa hi irada kiya tha, lekin aapne unhein mana kiya, aur farmaya: 'Kya tumhare liye mujhme achhi misaal nahi hai?'"

2.ar:
ثُمَّ إِنَّهُ قَدِمَ الْبَصْرَةَ ، فَحَدَّثَنَا أَنَّهُ لَقِيَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ الْوِتْرِ، فَقَالَ : أَلَا أُحَدِّثُكَ بِأَعْلَمِ النَّاسِ بِوِتْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟ قُلْتُ : بَلَى، قَالَ : أُمُّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَائِشَةُ ، فَأْتِهَا فَاسْأَلْهَا ثُمَّ ارْجِعْ إِلَيَّ فَحَدِّثْنِي بِمَا تُحَدِّثُكَ.
فَأَتَيْتُ حَكِيمَ بْنَ أَفْلَحَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ : انْطَلِقْ مَعِي إِلَى أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَ : إِنِّي لَا آتِيهَا، إِنِّي نَهَيْتُ عَنْ هَاتَيْنِ الشِّيعَتَيْنِ، فَأَبَتْ إِلَّا مُضِيًّا.
قُلْتُ : أَقْسَمْتُ عَلَيْكَ لَمَا انْطَلَقْتَ، فَانْطَلَقْنَا، فَسَلَّمْنَا، فَعَرَفَتْ صَوْتَ حَكِيمٍ، فَقَالَتْ : مَنْ هَذَا؟ قُلْتُ : سَعْدُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ.
قَالَتْ : مَنْ هِشَامٌ؟ قُلْتُ : هِشَامُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ.
قَالَتْ : نِعْمَ الْمَرْءُ، قُتِلَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ.
 قُلْتُ : أَخْبِرِينَا عَنْ خُلُقِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
قَالَتْ :" أَلَسْتَ تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ؟ قُلْتُ : بَلَى.
قَالَتْ : فَإِنَّهُ خُلُقُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "، فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَقُومَ وَلَا أَسْأَلَ أَحَدًا عَنْ شَيْءٍ حَتَّى أَلْحَقَ بِاللَّهِ، فَعَرَضَ لِي الْقِيَامُ
2.en: Continuing the same narration [Sa'd ibn Hisham, about Aisha]: Then he arrived at Basrah, and narrated to us that he met Abdullah ibn Abbas and asked him about witr, so he said: "Shall I not tell you of the one most knowledgeable of people about the witr of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" I said: "Yes indeed." He said: "The Mother of the Believers Aisha, so go to her and ask her, then return to me and tell me what she tells you." So I came to Hakim ibn Aflah, and said to him: "Come with me to the Mother of the Believers Aisha." He said: "I will not go to her, I have forbidden [involvement in] these two factions." But he refused except to go along [eventually]. I said: "I adjure you that you come," so we went, and we greeted, and she recognized Hakim's voice, and said: "Who is this?" I said: "Sa'd ibn Hisham." She said: "Who is Hisham?" I said: "Hisham ibn Amir." She said: "What a fine man, he was killed on the day of Uhud." I said: "Inform us about the character of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." She said: "Do you not recite the Qur'an?" I said: "Yes indeed." She said: "Then indeed it is the character of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ," so I intended to get up and not ask anyone about anything until I met Allah, but standing up presented itself to me.
2.hi: Fir woh Basrah aaye, aur humein bataya ke unki mulaqaat Abdullah ibn Abbas se hui aur unhone unse witr ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: "Kya main tumhein Rasulullah ﷺ ke witr ke baare mein sabse zyada jaanne wali ke baare mein na bataun?" Maine kaha: "Zaroor." Unhone kaha: "Ummul-Mumineen Aisha, so unke paas jao aur unse poocho, fir mere paas laut kar aana aur jo woh tumhein batayein woh mujhe bataana." So main Hakim ibn Aflah ke paas gaya, aur usse kaha: "Mere saath Ummul-Mumineen Aisha ke paas chalo." Usne kaha: "Main unke paas nahi jaunga, maine in do firqon [ke jhagdon mein padne] se mana kar rakha hai." Lekin usne aakhirkaar saath jaane par razamandi zaahir ki. Maine kaha: "Main tumhein qasam deta hoon ke tum chalo," so hum gaye, aur humne salaam kiya, to unhone Hakim ki awaaz pehchaan li, aur poocha: "Yeh kaun hai?" Maine kaha: "Sa'd ibn Hisham." Unhone poocha: "Hisham kaun?" Maine kaha: "Hisham ibn Amir." Unhone kaha: "Kya achha aadmi tha, Uhud ke din shaheed hua." Maine kaha: "Humein Rasulullah ﷺ ke akhlaaq ke baare mein bataayein." Unhone poocha: "Kya tum Quran nahi padhte?" Maine kaha: "Zaroor." Unhone kaha: "To woh Rasulullah ﷺ ka akhlaaq hai," so maine irada kiya ke uthkar chala jaaun aur Allah se milne tak kisi se kuch na poochun, lekin mujhe uthne ka khayal aaya.

2.ar:
فَقُلْتُ : أَخْبِرِينَا عَنْ قِيَامِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
قَالَتْ :" أَلَسْتَ تَقْرَأُ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُزَّمِّلُ ؟ قُلْتُ : بَلَى.
قَالَتْ : فَإِنَّهَا كَانَتْ قِيَامَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أُنْزِلَ أَوَّلُ السُّورَةِ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَصْحَابُهُ حَتَّى انْتَفَخَتْ أَقْدَامُهُمْ، وَحُبِسَ آخِرُهَا فِي السَّمَاءِ سِتَّةَ عَشَرَ شَهْرًا، ثُمَّ أُنْزِلَ، فَصَارَ قِيَامُ اللَّيْلِ تَطَوُّعًا بَعْدَ أَنْ كَانَ فَرِيضَةً "، فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَقُومَ وَلَا أَسْأَلَ أَحَدًا عَنْ شَيْءٍ حَتَّى أَلْحَقَ بِاللَّهِ، فَعَرَضَ لِي الْوِتْرُ
2.en: Continuing the same narration [Sa'd ibn Hisham, about Aisha]: So I said: "Inform us about the standing [night prayer] of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." She said: "Do you not recite 'O you wrapped in garments' [Surah al-Muzzammil]?" I said: "Yes indeed." She said: "Then indeed it was the standing prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ - the beginning of the surah was revealed, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and his Companions stood until their feet swelled, and its end was withheld in the heaven for sixteen months, then it was revealed, so the standing of the night became voluntary after it had been obligatory," so I intended to get up and not ask anyone about anything until I met Allah, but the witr presented itself to me.
2.hi: To maine kaha: "Humein Rasulullah ﷺ ke qayam (raat ki namaz) ke baare mein bataayein." Unhone poocha: "Kya tum 'Ya ayyuhal-Muzzammil' [Surah Al-Muzzammil] nahi padhte?" Maine kaha: "Zaroor." Unhone kaha: "To woh Rasulullah ﷺ ka qayam tha - surah ka shuruaati hissa naazil hua, so Rasulullah ﷺ aur aapke sahaba khade rahe yahan tak ke unke paaon soojh gaye, aur iska aakhri hissa aasman mein solah mahine tak roka gaya, fir naazil hua, so raat ka qayam farz hone ke baad nafl ban gaya," so maine irada kiya ke uthkar chala jaaun aur Allah se milne tak kisi se kuch na poochun, lekin mujhe witr ka khayal aaya.

2.ar:
فَقُلْتُ : أَخْبِرِينَا عَنْ وِتْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَتْ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" إِذَا نَامَ، وَضَعَ سِوَاكَهُ عِنْدِي فَيَبْعَثُهُ اللَّهُ لِمَا شَاءَ أَنْ يَبْعَثَهُ، فَيُصَلِّي تِسْعَ رَكَعَاتٍ لَا يَجْلِسُ إِلَّا فِي الثَّامِنَةِ، فَيَحْمَدُ اللَّهَ وَيَدْعُو رَبَّهُ، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ وَلَا يُسَلِّمُ، ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ فِي التَّاسِعَةِ، فَيَحْمَدُ اللَّهَ وَيَدْعُو رَبَّهُ وَيُسَلِّمُ تَسْلِيمَةً يُسْمِعُنَا، ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ، فَتِلْكَ إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً، يَا بُنَيَّ، فَلَمَّا أَسَنَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَحَمَلَ اللَّحْمَ، صَلَّى سَبْعَ رَكَعَاتٍ لَا يَجْلِسُ إِلَّا فِي السَّادِسَةِ، فَيَحْمَدُ اللَّهَ وَيَدْعُو رَبَّهُ، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ وَلَا يُسَلِّمُ، ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ فِي السَّابِعَةِ، فَيَحْمَدُ اللَّهَ وَيَدْعُو رَبَّهُ، ثُمَّ يُسَلِّمُ تَسْلِيمَةً، ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ، فَتِلْكَ تِسْعٌ، يَا بُنَيَّ، وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا غَلَبَهُ نَوْمٌ أَوْ مَرَضٌ، صَلَّى مِنْ النَّهَارِ ثِنْتَيْ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً، وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَخَذَ خُلُقًا، أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُدَاوِمَ عَلَيْهِ، وَمَا قَامَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَيْلَةً حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ، وَلَا قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ كُلَّهُ فِي لَيْلَةٍ، وَلَا صَامَ شَهْرًا كَامِلًا غَيْرَ رَمَضَانَ ".
فَأَتَيْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، فَحَدَّثْتُهُ، فَقَالَ : صَدَقَتْكَ، أَمَا إِنِّي لَوْ كُنْتُ أَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهَا، لَشَافَهْتُهَا مُشَافَهَةً.
قَالَ : فَقُلْتُ : أَمَا إِنِّي لَوْ شَعَرْتُ أَنَّكَ لَا تَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهَا مَا حَدَّثْتُكَ
2.en: Continuing the same narration [Sa'd ibn Hisham, about Aisha]: So I said: "Inform us about the witr of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." So she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to "when he slept, place his tooth-stick by me, then Allah would wake him whenever He willed to wake him, so he would pray nine rak'ahs, not sitting except in the eighth, so he would praise Allah and supplicate to his Lord, then he would stand without giving the taslim, then he would sit in the ninth, and praise Allah and supplicate to his Lord, and give one taslim loud enough for us to hear, then he would pray two rak'ahs while sitting, so that was eleven rak'ahs, O my son. Then when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ grew old and put on weight, he prayed seven rak'ahs, not sitting except in the sixth, so he would praise Allah and supplicate to his Lord, then he would stand without giving the taslim, then he would sit in the seventh, and praise Allah and supplicate to his Lord, then give one taslim, then he would pray two rak'ahs while sitting, so that was nine, O my son. And the Prophet ﷺ, when sleep or illness overcame him, would pray twelve rak'ahs during the day. And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he adopted a practice, loved to make it constant. And the Prophet of Allah ﷺ never stood a night [in prayer] until morning, nor did he recite the whole Qur'an in one night, nor did he fast a complete month other than Ramadan." So I came to Ibn Abbas, and narrated it to him, so he said: "She has told you the truth; indeed, had I been able to visit her, I would have spoken to her face to face." He said: So I said: "Had I known that you do not visit her, I would not have narrated to you."
2.hi: To maine kaha: "Humein Rasulullah ﷺ ke witr ke baare mein bataayein." To unhone kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ "jab sote, to apni miswak mere paas rakh dete, fir Allah aapko jab bhi jagaana chahta jaga deta, to aap nau rakat padhte, aathvi ke siwa kahin baithe bagair, so aap Allah ki hamd karte aur apne Rab se dua karte, fir bina salaam phere khade ho jaate, fir nauwi mein baithte, aur Allah ki hamd karte aur apne Rab se dua karte, aur ek salaam humein sunaate hue phertay, fir baith kar do rakat padhte, so yeh gyaarah rakat hoti thin, ae mere bete. Fir jab Rasulullah ﷺ umar-daraz ho gaye aur mota badan ho gaya, to aap saat rakat padhte, chhathi ke siwa kahin baithe bagair, so aap Allah ki hamd karte aur apne Rab se dua karte, fir bina salaam phere khade ho jaate, fir saatwi mein baithte, aur Allah ki hamd karte aur apne Rab se dua karte, fir ek salaam phertay, fir baith kar do rakat padhte, so yeh nau hoti thin, ae mere bete. Aur Nabi ﷺ, jab aapko neend ya bimari ghaalib aati, to din mein baarah rakat padhte. Aur Rasulullah ﷺ, jab koi amal ikhtiyaar karte, to use hamesha rakhna pasand karte the. Aur Nabi Allah ﷺ ne kabhi kisi raat subah tak qayam nahi kiya, aur na hi kabhi poora Quran ek raat mein padha, aur na hi Ramzan ke siwa kabhi poora mahina roza rakha." So main Ibn Abbas ke paas gaya, aur unhein yeh bataya, to unhone kaha: "Unhone tumse sach kaha; sun lo, agar main unke paas jaa sakta, to main unse aamne-saamne baat karta." Unhone bataya: To maine kaha: "Agar mujhe pata hota ke aap unke paas nahi jaate, to main aapko na bataata."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ عَوْفٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" أَفْضَلُ الصَّلَاةِ بَعْدَ الْفَرِيضَةِ، الصَّلَاةُ فِي جَوْفِ اللَّيْلِ "
2.en: Narrated by Zayd ibn Awf, from Abu Awanah, from Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr, from Muhammad ibn al-Muntashir, from Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "The best prayer after the obligatory one is the prayer in the depth of the night."
2.hi: Zayd ibn Awf ne Abu Awanah se, Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr se, Muhammad ibn al-Muntashir se, Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Farz ke baad sabse behtar namaz raat ke andar wali namaz hai."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي السَّائِبُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَبْدٍ  قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ   يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ نَامَ عَنْ حِزْبِهِ أَوْ عَنْ شَيْءٍ مِنْهُ، فَقَرَأَهُ فِيمَا بَيْنَ صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ وَصَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ، كُتِبَ لَهُ كَأَنَّمَا قَرَأَهُ مِنْ اللَّيْلِ "
2.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yunus, from Ibn Shihab, from al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid and Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abd, from Umar ibn al-Khattab: That Abd al-Rahman ibn Abd said: I heard Umar ibn al-Khattab say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever sleeps through his portion [of nightly recitation], or part of it, and reads it between the Fajr prayer and the Zuhr prayer, it is recorded for him as if he had recited it at night."
2.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se, Yunus se, Ibn Shihab se, al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid aur Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah se bataya ke Abd al-Rahman ibn Abd ne kaha: Maine Umar ibn al-Khattab ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo apne [raat ke] wird se ya uske kisi hisse se so kar reh jaaye, aur use Fajr ki namaz aur Zuhr ki namaz ke darmiyan padh le, to uske liye aise likh diya jaata hai jaise usne use raat ko padha ho."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" يَنْزِلُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ لِنِصْفِ اللَّيْلِ الْآخِرِ، أَوْ لِثُلُثِ اللَّيْلِ الْآخِرِ، فَيَقُولُ : مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَدْعُونِي فَأَسْتَجِيبَ لَهُ؟ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَسْأَلُنِي، فَأُعْطِيَهُ؟ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَسْتَغْفِرُنِي فَأَغْفِرَ لَهُ؟ حَتَّى يَطْلُعَ الْفَجْرُ أَوْ يَنْصَرِفَ الْقَارِئُ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah the Exalted descends to the lowest heaven every night, at the last half of the night, or the last third of the night, and says: 'Who is calling upon Me that I may answer him? Who is asking of Me that I may give him? Who is seeking My forgiveness that I may forgive him?' until dawn breaks or the reciter finishes from the Fajr prayer."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah Ta'ala har raat aasman-e-duniya (sabse qareeb wale aasman) par utarta hai, raat ke aakhri aadhe hisse mein, ya aakhri tihai hisse mein, aur farmaata hai: 'Kaun hai jo mujhse dua maange, main uski dua qabool karun? Kaun hai jo mujhse maange, main use dun? Kaun hai jo mujhse maghfirat maange, main use bakhsh dun?' yahan tak ke subah ho jaaye ya qaari Fajr ki namaz se faarigh ho jaaye."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، وَأَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَغَرُّ  صَاحِبَا أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ   أَخْبَرَهُمَا، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" يَنْزِلُ رَبُّنَا تَبَارَكَ اسْمُهُ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ حِينَ يَبْقَى ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ الْآخِرُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا، فَيَقُولُ : مَنْ يَدْعُونِي فَأَسْتَجِيبَ لَهُ؟ مَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرُنِي فَأَغْفِرَ لَهُ؟ مَنْ يَسْأَلُنِي فَأُعْطِيَهُ؟ حَتَّى الْفَجْرِ "
2.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb ibn Abi Hamzah, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman, and Abu Abdullah al-Aghar, companions of Abu Hurairah: That Abu Hurairah informed the two of them, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Our Lord, blessed is His name, descends every night, when a third of the last part of the night remains, to the lowest heaven, and says: 'Who calls upon Me that I may answer him? Who seeks My forgiveness that I may forgive him? Who asks of Me that I may give him?' until dawn."
2.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb ibn Abi Hamzah se, al-Zuhri se, Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman aur Abu Abdullah al-Aghar se, jo Abu Hurairah ke sathi the, bataya ke Abu Hurairah ne un dono ko bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Humara Rab, jiska naam bharpoor barkat wala hai, har raat, jab raat ka aakhri tihai hissa baaki reh jaata hai, aasman-e-duniya par utarta hai, aur farmaata hai: 'Kaun mujhse dua maangta hai, main uski dua qabool karun? Kaun mujhse maghfirat maangta hai, main use bakhshun? Kaun mujhse maangta hai, main use dun?' yahan tak ke subah ho jaaye."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" يَنْزِلُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا، فَيَقُولُ : هَلْ مِنْ سَائِلٍ فَأُعْطِيَهُ؟ هَلْ مِنْ مُسْتَغْفِرٍ فَأَغْفِرَ لَهُ؟ "
2.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Nafi' ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im, from his father: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah the Exalted descends every night to the lowest heaven, and says: 'Is there anyone asking, that I may give him? Is there anyone seeking forgiveness, that I may forgive him?'"
2.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Nafi' ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im se, apne walid se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah Ta'ala har raat aasman-e-duniya par utarta hai, aur farmaata hai: 'Koi maangne wala hai, ke main use dun? Koi maghfirat maangne wala hai, ke main use bakhshun?'"

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ عَرَابَةَ الْجُهَنِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا مَضَى مِنْ اللَّيْلِ نِصْفُهُ أَوْ ثُلُثَاهُ، هَبَطَ اللَّهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ : لَا أَسْأَلُ عَنْ عِبَادِي غَيْرِي، مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَسْأَلُنِي فَأُعْطِيَهُ؟ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَسْتَغْفِرُنِي فَأَغْفِرَ لَهُ؟ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَدْعُونِي فَأَسْتَجِيبَ لَهُ، حَتَّى يَطْلُعَ الْفَجْرُ ".
حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، أَنَّ رِفَاعَةَ   أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، بِنَحْوِهِ
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Hilal ibn Abi Maymunah, from Ata ibn Yasar, from Rifa'ah ibn Arabah al-Juhani; a similar chain also via Wahb ibn Jarir: He said: The Prophet ﷺ said: "When half of the night has passed, or two-thirds of it, Allah descends to the lowest heaven, then says: 'I do not ask about My servants other than Myself: who is it that asks of Me that I may give him? Who is it that seeks My forgiveness that I may forgive him? Who is it that calls upon Me that I may answer him?' until dawn breaks." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Wahb ibn Jarir, from Hisham, from Yahya, from Hilal ibn Abi Maymunah, from Ata ibn Yasar: that Rifa'ah informed him, from the Prophet ﷺ, similarly.]
2.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se, Yahya ibn Abi Kathir se, Hilal ibn Abi Maymunah se, Ata ibn Yasar se, Rifa'ah ibn Arabah al-Juhani se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab raat ka aadha hissa guzar jaaye, ya uska do-tihai, to Allah aasman-e-duniya par utarta hai, fir farmaata hai: 'Main apne bandon ke baare mein apne siwa kisi se nahi poochta: kaun hai jo mujhse maange, main use dun? Kaun hai jo mujhse maghfirat maange, main use bakhshun? Kaun hai jo mujhse dua maange, main uski dua qabool karun?' yahan tak ke subah ho jaaye." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Wahb ibn Jarir se, Hisham se, Yahya se, Hilal ibn Abi Maymunah se, Ata ibn Yasar se bhi aayi hai: ke Rifa'ah ne unhein Nabi ﷺ se isi tarah bataya.]

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُخْتَارٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ أبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا كَانَ ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ أَوْ نِصْفُ اللَّيْلِ " فَذَكَرَ النُّزُولَ
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Humayd, from Ibrahim ibn Mukhtar, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from his uncle Abd al-Rahman ibn Yasar, from Ubaydullah ibn Abi Rafi', from his father, from Ali: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When it is a third of the night, or half of the night" - then he mentioned the descent.
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Humayd ne Ibrahim ibn Mukhtar se, Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, apne chacha Abd al-Rahman ibn Yasar se, Ubaydullah ibn Abi Rafi' se, apne walid se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab raat ka tihai hissa ho, ya aadha hissa" - fir unhone Allah ke utarne ka zikr kiya.

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي  ، عَنْ ابْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيُّ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  مَوْلَى أُمِّ صُبَيَّةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ :" لَوْلَا أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَى أُمَّتِي لَأَمَرْتُهُمْ بِالسِّوَاكِ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ، وَلَأَخَّرْتُ الْعِشَاءَ الْآخِرَةَ إِلَى ثُلُثِ اللَّيْلِ، فَإِنَّهُ إِذَا مَضَى ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ الْأَوَّلُ، هَبَطَ اللَّهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا، فَلَمْ يَزَلْ هُنَالِكَ حَتَّى يَطْلُعَ الْفَجْرُ، يَقُولُ قَائِلٌ : أَلَا سَائِلٌ يُعْطَى؟ أَلَا دَاعٍ يُجَابُ؟ أَلَا سَقِيمٌ يَسْتَشْفِي فَيُشْفَى؟ أَلَا مُذْنِبٌ مُسْتَغْفِرٌ فَيُغْفَرَ لَهُ؟ ".
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي  ، عَنْ ابْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنِي عَمِّي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ  مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ   ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Ishaq, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id al-Maqburi, from Ata freed servant of Umm Subayyah, from Abu Hurairah; a similar chain also via Ali ibn Abi Talib: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Were it not that I would burden my nation, I would have commanded them with the tooth-stick at every prayer, and I would have delayed the last Isha prayer until a third of the night, for indeed when the first third of the night has passed, Allah descends to the lowest heaven, and remains there until dawn breaks, saying, one who says: 'Is there anyone asking, that he may be given? Is there anyone calling, that he may be answered? Is there anyone sick seeking healing, that he may be healed? Is there anyone sinning seeking forgiveness, that he may be forgiven?'" [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Muhammad, from Ya'qub, from his father, from Ibn Ishaq, from his uncle Abd al-Rahman ibn Yasar, from Ubaydullah ibn Abi Rafi', freed servant of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, from his father, from Ali ibn Abi Talib, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, the like of the hadith of Abu Hurairah.]
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yahya ne Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim se, apne walid se, Ibn Ishaq se, Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id al-Maqburi se, Ata (Umm Subayyah ke azaad kiye hue ghulam) se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Agar mujhe apni ummat par mushkil daalne ka khauf na hota, to main unhein har namaz ke waqt miswak ka hukum deta, aur main Isha-e-Aakhir ko raat ke tihai hisse tak der karta, kyunki jab raat ka pehla tihai hissa guzar jaata hai, to Allah aasman-e-duniya par utarta hai, aur wahan subah tak rehta hai, kehne wala kehta hai: 'Koi maangne wala hai, ke use diya jaaye? Koi pukaarne wala hai, ke uski dua qabool ki jaaye? Koi bimar shifa maangne wala hai, ke use shifa mile? Koi gunahgaar maghfirat maangne wala hai, ke use bakhsha jaaye?'" [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Muhammad se, Ya'qub se, apne walid se, Ibn Ishaq se, apne chacha Abd al-Rahman ibn Yasar se, Ubaydullah ibn Abi Rafi' se (Rasulullah ﷺ ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), apne walid se, Ali ibn Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) se, Rasulullah ﷺ se bhi Abu Hurairah ki riwayat jaisi aayi hai.]

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ هُوَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الْأَحْوَلِ  ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا قَامَ يَتَهَجَّدُ مِنْ اللَّيْلِ قَالَ :" اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ، أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، أَنْتَ قَيُّومُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، أَنْتَ مَلِكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، أَنْتَ الْحَقُّ، وَقَوْلُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَوَعْدُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَلِقَاؤُكَ حَقٌّ، وَالْجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّارُ حَقٌّ، وَالْبَعْثُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّبِيُّونَ حَقٌّ، وَمُحَمَّدٌّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَقٌّ.
اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ، وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ حَاكَمْتُ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ، أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِكَ "
2.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Sulayman al-Ahwal, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he rose to pray tahajjud at night, said: "Allahumma lakal-hamd, anta nurus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinna, wa lakal-hamd, anta qayyumus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinna, wa lakal-hamd, anta Malikus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinna, antal-Haqqu, wa qawluka al-haqqu, wa wa'duka al-haqqu, wa liqa'uka haqqun, wal-jannatu haqqun, wan-naru haqqun, wal-ba'thu haqqun, wan-nabiyyuna haqqun, wa Muhammadun ﷺ haqqun. Allahumma laka aslamtu, wa bika amantu, wa 'alayka tawakkaltu, wa ilayka anabtu, wa bika khasamtu, wa ilayka hakamtu, faghfir li ma qaddamtu wa ma akhkhartu, wa ma a'lantu wa ma asrartu, antal-Muqaddimu wa antal-Mu'akhkhiru, la ilaha illa anta, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa bika."
2.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se, Sulayman al-Ahwal se, Tawus se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ jab raat ko tahajjud ke liye uthte, to farmaate: "Allahumma lakal-hamd, anta nurus-samawaati wal-ardi wa man feehinn, wa lakal-hamd, anta qayyumus-samawaati wal-ardi wa man feehinn, wa lakal-hamd, anta Malikus-samawaati wal-ardi wa man feehinn, antal-Haqq, wa qawlukal-haqq, wa wa'dukal-haqq, wa liqaa'uka haqq, wal-jannatu haqq, wan-naaru haqq, wal-ba'thu haqq, wan-nabiyyoona haqq, wa Muhammadun ﷺ haqq. Allahumma laka aslamtu, wa bika aamantu, wa 'alayka tawakkaltu, wa ilayka anabtu, wa bika khaasamtu, wa ilayka haakamtu, faghfir li maa qaddamtu wa maa akhkhartu, wa maa a'lantu wa maa asrartu, antal-Muqaddimu wa antal-Mu'akhkhiru, laa ilaaha illaa Anta, wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa bika" [Ae Allah, teri hi tareef hai, tu aasmanon aur zameen aur unmein jo kuch hai uska noor hai, aur teri hi tareef hai, tu aasmanon aur zameen aur unmein jo kuch hai unhein qaayam rakhne wala hai, aur teri hi tareef hai, tu aasmanon aur zameen aur unmein jo kuch hai uska Baadshah hai, tu haq hai, teri baat haq hai, tera wada haq hai, tujhse milna haq hai, Jannat haq hai, Jahannam haq hai, dobara zinda hona haq hai, Ambiya haq hain, aur Muhammad ﷺ haq hain. Ae Allah, main tere aage jhuk gaya, aur tujhpar imaan laaya, aur tujhpar bharosa kiya, aur teri taraf rujoo kiya, aur teri madad se jhagda kiya, aur tera hi faisla maana, so mujhe bakhsh de jo maine aage bheja aur jo peechhe chhoda, aur jo zaahir kiya aur jo chhupaya, tu hi aage badhaane wala aur peechhe karne wala hai, tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur teri madad ke bagair koi taaqat aur zor nahi].

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ الْآيَتَيْنِ الْآخِرَتَيْنِ مِنْ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ، كَفَتَاهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid, from Abu Mas'ud, from the Prophet ﷺ: That he said: "Whoever recites the last two verses of Surah al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him."
2.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid se, Abu Mas'ud se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jo Surah Al-Baqarah ki aakhri do aayaten raat ko padh le, woh use kaafi ho jaayengi."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَا أَذِنَ اللَّهُ لِشَيْءٍ كَإِذْنِهِ لِنَبِيٍّ يَتَغَنَّى بِالْقُرْآنِ يَجْهَرُ بِهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah has not permitted anything as He has permitted a prophet to chant the Qur'an aloud."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah ne kisi cheez ki itni ijaazat nahi di jitni Nabi ko Quran khush-elhaani se bulund awaaz mein padhne ki di hai."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ : أُرَاهُ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   قَالَتْ : سَمِعَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَبَا مُوسَى وَهُوَ يَقْرَأُ، فَقَالَ : " لَقَدْأُوتِيَ هَذَا مِنْ مَزَامِيرِ آلِ دَاوُدَ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Ibn Uyaynah, from al-Zuhri (uncertain, believed from Urwah), from Aisha: She said: The Prophet ﷺ heard Abu Musa while he was reciting, and said: "This one has indeed been given some of the psaltery of the family of David."
2.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Ibn Uyaynah se, al-Zuhri se bataya - Ibn Uyaynah ka khayal hai Urwah se - Aisha se: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ ne Abu Musa ko qiraat karte suna, to farmaya: "Isay to Aal-e-Dawud ke rango (mazameer) mein se kuch diya gaya hai."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو يَعْنِي ابْنَ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي نَهِيكٍ  ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ لَمْ يَتَغَنَّ بِالْقُرْآنِ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf, from Sufyan, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Ibn Abi Mulaykah, from Ubaydullah ibn Abi Nahik, from Sa'd: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "He is not of us who does not chant the Qur'an."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf ne Sufyan se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Ibn Abi Mulaykah se, Ubaydullah ibn Abi Nahik se, Sa'd se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Woh humme se nahi jo Quran ko khush-elhaani se na padhe."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَا أَذِنَ اللَّهُ لِشَيْءٍ مَا أَذِنَ لِنَبِيٍّ يَتَغَنَّى بِالْقُرْآنِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : يُرِيدُ بِهِ الِاسْتِغْنَاءَ
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Sufyan, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ; with Abu Muhammad's explanation: He said: "Allah has not permitted anything as He has permitted a prophet to chant the Qur'an." Abu Muhammad said: He means by it, self-sufficiency.
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ne Sufyan se, al-Zuhri se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Allah ne kisi cheez ki itni ijaazat nahi di jitni Nabi ko Quran khush-elhaani se padhne ki di hai." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Isse murad khud-kifayati (dusron ki mohtaji na hona) hai.

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُعَلَّى  ، قَالَ : مَرَّ بِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ : " أَلَمْ يَقُلْ اللَّهُ : # يَأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَجِيبُوا لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ سورة الأنفال آية 24 # "، ثُمَّ قَالَ :" أَلَا أُعَلِّمُكَ سُورَةً أَعْظَمَ سُورَةٍ مِنْ الْقُرْآنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَخْرُجَ مِنْ الْمَسْجِدِ؟ ".
فَلَمَّا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ، قَالَ : " الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ، وَهِيَ السَّبْعُ الْمَثَانِي وَالْقُرْآنُ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِي أُوتِيتُمْ "
2.en: Narrated by Bishr ibn Umar al-Zahrani, from Shu'bah, from Khubayb ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Hafs ibn Asim, from Abu Sa'id ibn al-Mu'alla: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by me, and said: "Did Allah not say: 'O you who believe, respond to Allah and to the Messenger when he calls you' [Surah al-Anfal, verse 24]?" then he said: "Shall I not teach you a surah, the greatest surah in the Qur'an, before I leave the mosque?" So when he wanted to leave, he said: "Al-hamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin [Surah al-Fatihah] - it is the seven oft-repeated [verses] and the Great Qur'an which you have been given."
2.hi: Bishr ibn Umar al-Zahrani ne Shu'bah se, Khubayb ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Hafs ibn Asim se, Abu Sa'id ibn al-Mu'alla se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ mere paas se guzre, to farmaya: "Kya Allah ne nahi farmaya: 'Ae imaan walo, Allah aur Rasool ki pukaar par labbaik kaho jab woh tumhein bulaayein' [Surah Al-Anfal, aayat 24]?" fir farmaya: "Kya main tumhein masjid se nikalne se pehle Quran ki sabse bulund surah na sikhaun?" So jab aap nikalne lage, to farmaya: "'Al-hamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alameen' [Surah Al-Fatihah] - yeh saat baar-baar dohraayi jaane wali aayaten aur Quran-e-Azeem hai jo tumhein diya gaya hai."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمِنْهَالِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَلَاءِ : يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا يَفْقَهُ مَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ ثَلَاثٍ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Minhal, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from Abu al-Ala (Yazid ibn Abdullah), from Abdullah ibn Amr: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "He does not understand who recites the Qur'an in less than three [days]."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Minhal ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Shu'bah se, Qatadah se, Abu al-Ala (Yazid ibn Abdullah) se, Abdullah ibn Amr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo Quran ko teen din se kam mein padhe woh usay samajh nahi paata."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِذَا نُودِيَ بِالْأَذَانِ، أَدْبَرَ الشَّيْطَانُ لَهُ ضُرَاطٌ حَتَّى لَا يَسْمَعَ الْأَذَانَ، فَإِذَا قُضِيَ الْأَذَانُ، أَقْبَلَ، فَإِذَا ثُوِّبَ، أَدْبَرَ، فَإِذَا قُضِيَ التَّثْوِيبُ، أَقْبَلَ حَتَّى يَخْطِرَ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَنَفْسِهِ فَيَقُولُ : اذْكُرْ كَذَا، اذْكُرْ كَذَا، لِمَا لَمْ يَكُنْ يَعْنِي يَذْكُرُ، حَتَّى يَظَلَّ الرَّجُلُ إِنْ يَدْرِي كَمْ صَلَّى، فَإِذَا لَمْ يَدْرِ أَحَدُكُمْ كَمْ صَلَّى ثَلَاثًا أَمْ أَرْبَعًا، فَلْيَسْجُدْ سَجْدَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hisham, from Yahya, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "When the call is made with the adhan, the Shaytan turns away, breaking wind, so that he does not hear the adhan; then when the adhan is finished, he comes forward; then when the iqamah is called, he turns away; then when the iqamah finishes, he comes forward until he interposes between the man and his own soul, and says: 'Remember such-and-such, remember such-and-such,' for what he was not remembering, meaning: things he was not thinking of, until the man remains uncertain how much he has prayed; so when one of you does not know how much he has prayed, three or four, let him prostrate two prostrations while sitting."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hisham se, Yahya se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jab azaan di jaati hai, to shaytan peeth phera kar bhaag jaata hai, gozte hue, taake woh azaan na sune; fir jab azaan khatam ho jaati hai, to woh aage aa jaata hai; fir jab iqamah kahi jaati hai, to woh phir peeth pher leta hai; fir jab iqamah khatam ho jaati hai, to woh phir aage aa jaata hai yahan tak ke woh insaan aur uske dil ke darmiyan aa jaata hai, aur kehta hai: 'Fulaan cheez yaad karo, fulaan cheez yaad karo,' aisi cheezein jinhein woh yaad nahi kar raha hota - yaani, jinke baare mein woh soch nahi raha hota - yahan tak ke aadmi ko shak ho jaata hai ke usne kitni namaz padhi; so jab tum mein se kisi ko na maloom ho ke usne kitni padhi, teen ya chaar, to woh baith kar do sajde kare."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ الْمَاجِشُونُ  ، أَنْبأَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا لَمْ يَدْرِ أَحَدُكُمْ أَثَلَاثًا صَلَّى أَمْ أَرْبَعًا، فَلْيَقُمْ، فَلْيُصَلِّ رَكْعَةً، ثُمَّ يَسْجُدُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ، فَإِنْ كَانَ صَلَّى خَمْسًا شَفَعَتَا لَهُ صَلَاتَهُ، وَإِنْ كَانَ صَلَّى أَرْبَعًا، كَانَتَا تَرْغِيمًا لِلشَّيْطَانِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : آخُذُ بِهِ
2.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Salamah al-Majishun, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from Ata ibn Yasar, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri; with Abu Muhammad's confirmation: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you does not know whether he has prayed three or four, let him stand, and pray a rak'ah, then prostrate after that two prostrations; then if he had prayed five, the two [extra prostrations] will make his prayer even; and if he had prayed four, they will be a humiliation for the Shaytan." Abu Muhammad said: I hold to this.
2.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Salamah al-Majishun se, Zayd ibn Aslam se, Ata ibn Yasar se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se kisi ko na maloom ho ke usne teen padhi hain ya chaar, to woh khada ho jaaye, aur ek rakat padhe, fir uske baad do sajde kare; fir agar usne paanch padhi hongi, to yeh [do sajde] uski namaz ko juft bana denge, aur agar usne chaar padhi hongi, to yeh shaytan ke liye zillat ban jaayenge." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Main isi par amal karta hoon.

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِحْدَى صَلَاتَيْ الْعَشِيِّ، فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ وَقَامَ إِلَى خَشَبَةٍ مُعْتَرِضَةٍ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا قَالَ يَزِيدُ : وَأَرَانَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ ، وَوَضَعَ كَفَّيْهِ إِحْدَاهُمَا عَلَى ظَهْرِ الْأُخْرَى، وَأَدْخَلَ أَصَابِعَهُ الْعُلْيَا فِي السُّفْلَى وَاضِعًا وَقَامَ كَأَنَّهُ غَضْبَانُ، قَالَ : فَخَرَجَ السَّرَعَانُ مِنْ النَّاسِ وَجَعَلُوا يَقُولُونَ : قُصِرَتْ الصَّلَاةُ، قُصِرَتْ الصَّلَاةُ.
وَفِي الْقَوْمِ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ، فَلَمْ يَتَكَلَّمَا، وَفِي الْقَوْمِ رَجُلٌ طَوِيلُ الْيَدَيْنِ يُسَمَّى ذُو الْيَدَيْنِ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَنَسِيتَ الصَّلَاةَ أَمْ قُصِرَتْ؟ فَقَالَ : " مَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا قُصِرَتْ الصَّلَاةُ " فَقَالَ : " أَوَ كَذَلِكَ؟ " قَالُوا : نَعَمْ.
 قَالَ : فَرَجَعَ" فَأَتَمَّ مَا بَقِيَ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ وَكَبَّرَ فَسَجَدَ طَوِيلًا، ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ، فَكَبَّرَ وَسَجَدَ مِثْلَ مَا سَجَدَ، ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ وَانْصَرَفَ "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Ibn Awn, from Muhammad, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed one of the two afternoon prayers, and he prayed two rak'ahs, then gave the taslim, and stood toward a piece of wood placed crosswise in the mosque, and placed his hand on it - Yazid said: And Ibn Awn showed us, placing one of his palms on the back of the other, and inserting his upper fingers into the lower - resting [like this], and stood as if he were angry. He said: So the quick-tempered among the people went out, and began saying: "The prayer has been shortened, the prayer has been shortened." And among the people were Abu Bakr and Umar, but they did not speak. And among the people was a man with long hands, called Dhu al-Yadayn, so he said: "O Messenger of Allah, did you forget the prayer, or was it shortened?" So he said: "I did not forget, nor was the prayer shortened." So he said: "Is it really so?" They said: "Yes." He said: So he returned, "and completed what remained, then gave the taslim, and said the takbir and prostrated at length, then raised his head, and said the takbir and prostrated like he had prostrated, then he raised his head and departed."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Ibn Awn se, Muhammad se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne dopahar baad ki do namazon mein se ek padhi, aur aapne do rakat padhi, fir salaam pher diya, aur masjid mein tirchhi rakhi hui ek lakdi ki taraf khade hue aur uspar apna haath rakha - Yazid kehte hain: Aur Ibn Awn ne humein dikhaya, apni ek hatheli doosri ki pusht par rakh kar, aur apni upar wali ungliyan neechi mein daal kar - is tarah tik kar, aur aap aise khade hue jaise ghusse mein hon. Unhone bataya: To jaldbaaz log bahar nikal gaye, aur kehne lage: "Namaz kam ho gayi, namaz kam ho gayi." Aur logon mein Abu Bakr aur Umar bhi the, lekin unhone kuch na kaha. Aur logon mein ek lambe haathon wala aadmi tha jise Dhu al-Yadayn kaha jaata tha, to usne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, kya aap namaz bhool gaye, ya woh kam ho gayi?" To aapne farmaya: "Na main bhoola, na namaz kam hui." To usne poocha: "Kya waqai aisa hai?" Logon ne kaha: "Haan." Unhone bataya: To aap palte "aur jo baaki thi use poora kiya, fir salaam phera, aur takbir kahi aur lamba sajda kiya, fir sar uthaya, aur takbir kahi aur waisa hi sajda kiya jaisa pehle kiya tha, fir sar uthaya aur chale gaye."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ  ، وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ   قَالَ : صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ صَلَاةَ الظُّهْرِ أَوْ الْعَصْرِ، فَسَلَّمَ فِي رَكْعَتَيْنِ مِنْ إِحْدَاهُمَا، فَقَالَ لَهُ ذُو الشِّمَالَيْنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ عَمْرِو بْنِ نَضْلَةَ الْخُزَاعِيُّ، وَهُوَ حَلِيفُ بَنِي زُهْرَةَ : أَقُصِرَتْ أَمْ نَسِيتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " لَمْ أَنْسَ، وَلَمْ تُقْصَرْ ".
فَقَالَ ذُو الشِّمَالَيْنِ : قَدْ كَانَ بَعْضُ ذَلِكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَأَقْبَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَى النَّاسِ فَقَالَ : " أَصَدَقَ ذُو الْيَدَيْنِ؟ " قَالُوا : نَعَمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" فَأَتَمَّ الصَّلَاةَ، وَلَمْ يُحَدِّثْنِي أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ فِي تِلْكَ الصَّلَاةِ "، وَذَلِكَ فِيمَا نُرَى وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّ النَّاسَ يَقَّنُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَتَّى اسْتَيْقَنَ
2.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yunus, from Ibn Shihab, from Ibn al-Musayyab, and Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman, and Abu Bakr ibn Abd al-Rahman, and Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah, about Abu Hurairah: That Abu Hurairah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed the Zuhr or the Asr prayer, and gave the taslim after two rak'ahs of one of the two, so Dhu al-Shimalayn ibn Abd Amr ibn Nadlah al-Khuza'i, who was an ally of Banu Zuhrah, said to him: "Was it shortened, or did you forget, O Messenger of Allah?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I did not forget, nor was it shortened." So Dhu al-Shimalayn said: "Some of that did occur, O Messenger of Allah." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned to the people and said: "Did Dhu al-Yadayn speak the truth?" They said: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood, "and completed the prayer, and none of them narrated to me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prostrated two prostrations while sitting in that prayer," and that is, in our view, and Allah knows best, because the people made the Messenger of Allah ﷺ certain, until he became certain.
2.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se, Yunus se, Ibn Shihab se, Ibn al-Musayyab aur Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman aur Abu Bakr ibn Abd al-Rahman aur Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah se bataya ke Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne Zuhr ya Asr ki namaz padhi, aur do rakaton mein se ek ke baad salaam pher diya, to Dhu al-Shimalayn ibn Abd Amr ibn Nadlah al-Khuza'i, jo Banu Zuhrah ke saathi the, ne aapse poocha: "Kya woh kam hui, ya aap bhool gaye, Ya Rasulullah?" Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Na main bhoola, na woh kam hui." To Dhu al-Shimalayn ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, kuch to aisa hua hai." To Rasulullah ﷺ logon ki taraf mudkar bole: "Kya Dhu al-Yadayn ne sach kaha?" Unhone kaha: "Haan, Ya Rasulullah." To Rasulullah ﷺ khade hue "aur namaz poori ki, aur inmein se kisi ne mujhe nahi bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne us namaz mein baith kar do sajde kiye," aur yeh, humari raay mein, Allah behtar jaanta hai, isliye hai ke logon ne Rasulullah ﷺ ko yaqeen dilaya yahan tak ke aap ko yaqeen ho gaya.

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَنَّهُ" صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ خَمْسًا، فَقِيلَ لَهُ فَسَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ "
2.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah, from Abdullah, from the Prophet ﷺ: That he "prayed the Zuhr [with] five [rak'ahs], so it was said to him [about it], so he prostrated two prostrations."
2.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, al-Hakam se, Ibrahim se, Alqamah se, Abdullah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya ke aapne "Zuhr paanch [rakat] padhi, to aapse iske baare mein kaha gaya, to aapne do sajde kiye."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هُرْمُزَ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ  ، قَالَ : " صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ قَامَ وَلَمْ يَجْلِسْ، وَقَامَ النَّاسُ،فَلَمَّا قَضَى الصَّلَاةَ، نَظَرْنَا تَسْلِيمَهُ فَكَبَّرَ، فَسَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسَلِّمَ، ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ "
2.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Hurmuz al-A'raj, from Ibn Buhaynah: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed with us two rak'ahs, then stood without sitting, and the people stood, so when he finished the prayer, we looked for his taslim, and he said the takbir, and prostrated two prostrations while sitting, before he gave the taslim, then gave the taslim."
2.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Malik se, Ibn Shihab se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Hurmuz al-A'raj se, Ibn Buhaynah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein do rakat padhaayi, fir bagair baithe khade ho gaye, aur log bhi khade ho gaye, so jab aapne namaz poori ki, hum aapke salaam ka intezaar karne lage, to aapne takbir kahi, aur baith kar do sajde kiye salaam phere-ne se pehle, fir salaam phera."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ مَالِكِ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " قَامَ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ مِنْ الظُّهْرِ أَوْ الْعَصْرِ، فَلَمْ يَرْجِعْ حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ ثُمَّسَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْ الْوَهْمِ، ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Fadl, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Abd al-Rahman al-A'raj, from Malik ibn Buhaynah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "stood at the two rak'ahs of Zuhr or Asr, and did not go back until he finished his prayer, then prostrated the two prostrations of forgetfulness, then gave the taslim."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Fadl ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Abd al-Rahman al-A'raj se, Malik ibn Buhaynah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "Zuhr ya Asr ki do rakaton par khade ho gaye, aur wapas nahi palte jab tak apni namaz mukammal na kar li, fir sahv (bhool) ke do sajde kiye, fir salaam phera."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، عَنْ الْمَسْعُودِيِّ  ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلَاقَةَ  ، قَالَ : صَلَّى بِنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ  ، فَلَمَّا صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، قَامَ وَلَمْ يَجْلِسْ، فَسَبَّحَ بِهِ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ، فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْهِمْ : أَنْ قُومُوا، فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ،" سَلَّمَ وَسَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْ السَّهْوِ وَسَلَّمَ وَقَالَ : هَكَذَا صَنَعَ بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ".
 قَالَ يَزِيدُ : يُصَحِّحُونَهُ
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Mas'udi, from Ziyad ibn Alaqah: He said: al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah led us in prayer, and when he prayed two rak'ahs, he stood without sitting, so those behind him said "subhan Allah", so he gestured to them: to stand [continue], so when he finished his prayer, "he gave the taslim and prostrated the two prostrations of inadvertence and gave the taslim, and said: This is how the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did with us." Yazid said: They authenticate it.
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Mas'udi se, Ziyad ibn Alaqah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mughirah ibn Shu'bah ne humein namaz padhaayi, aur jab unhone do rakat padh li, to bagair baithe khade ho gaye, to unke peechhe walon ne "Subhan Allah" kaha, to unhone unhein ishara kiya: khade rehne ka, so jab woh apni namaz se faarigh hue, to "unhone salaam phera aur sahv ke do sajde kiye aur salaam phera, aur kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne humare saath aisa hi kiya tha." Yazid kehte hain: Log ise sahih maante hain.

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ السُّلَمِيِّ  ، قَالَ : بَيْنَا أَنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ، إِذْ عَطَسَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ الْقَوْمِ، فَقُلْتُ : يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، قَالَ : فَحَدَّقَنِي الْقَوْمُ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ، فَقُلْتُ : وَاثُكْلَاهُ ! مَا لَكُمْ تَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيَّ؟ قَالَ : فَضَرَبَ الْقَوْمُ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ عَلَى أَفْخَاذِهِمْ، فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتُهُمْ يُسْكِتُونَنِي قُلْتُ : مَا لَكُمْ تُسْكِتُونَنِي؟ لَكِنِّي سَكَتُّ.
قَالَ : فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَبِأَبِي هُوَ وَأُمِّي، مَا رَأَيْتُ مُعَلِّمًا قَبْلَهُ وَلَا بَعْدَهُ أَحْسَنَ تَعْلِيمًا مِنْهُ، وَاللَّهِ مَا ضَرَبَنِي، وَلَا كَهَرَنِي، وَلَا سَبَّنِي، وَلَكِنْ قَالَ : " إِنَّصَلَاتَنَا هَذِهِ لَا يَصْلُحُ فِيهَا شَيْءٌ مِنْ كَلَامِ النَّاسِ، إِنَّمَا هِيَ التَّسْبِيحُ وَالتَّكْبِيرُ وَتِلَاوَةُ الْقُرْآنِ ".
 حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ  ، أَنْبأَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ  ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ الصَّوَّافِ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ هِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ   ، بِنَحْوِهِ
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from Yahya, from Hilal ibn Abi Maymunah, from Ata ibn Yasar, from Mu'awiyah ibn al-Hakam al-Sulami; a similar chain also via Ibn Ulayyah and Yahya ibn Sa'id: He said: While I was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the prayer, a man from the people sneezed, so I said: "Yarhamuk Allah." He said: So the people stared at me with their eyes, so I said: "O my calamity! What is wrong with you, that you look at me?" He said: So the people struck their hands on their thighs, so when I saw them silencing me, I said: "What is wrong with you, silencing me?" But I fell silent. He said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished, may my father and mother be sacrificed for him, I never saw a teacher before him nor after him better in teaching than him; by Allah, he did not strike me, nor did he rebuke me harshly, nor did he curse me, but he said: "Indeed this prayer of ours, nothing of the speech of people is befitting in it; it is only glorification, and magnification, and recitation of the Qur'an." [A similar report is narrated through another chain.]
2.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se, Yahya se, Hilal ibn Abi Maymunah se, Ata ibn Yasar se, Mu'awiyah ibn al-Hakam al-Sulami se bataya: Unhone kaha, Jabke main Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath namaz mein tha, jama'at mein se ek aadmi ne cheenk maari, to maine kaha: "Yarhamukallah." Unhone bataya: To log mujhe apni aankhon se ghoornay lage, to maine kaha: "Haaye meri maut! Tumhein kya hua ke mujhe dekh rahe ho?" Unhone bataya: To log apne haath apni raanon par maarne lage, so jab maine dekha ke woh mujhe khamosh karana chahte hain, maine kaha: "Tumhein kya hua ke mujhe khamosh kara rahe ho?" Lekin main khamosh ho gaya. Unhone bataya: Jab Rasulullah ﷺ namaz se faarigh hue, mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon, maine aapse pehle ya baad koi bhi ustaad aisa achha sikhaane wala nahi dekha; Allah ki qasam, aapne na mujhe maara, na daanta, na bura-bhala kaha, balke farmaya: "Yeh humari namaz, ismein logon ki kisi baat ki gunjaish nahi; yeh to sirf tasbih, aur takbir, aur Quran ki tilaawat hai." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se bhi aayi hai.]

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ ضَمْضَمٍ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" أَمَرَ بِقَتْلِ الْأَسْوَدَيْنِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ ".
قَالَ يَحْيَى : وَالْأَسْوَدَيْنِ : الْحَيَّةُ وَالْعَقْرَبُ
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hisham, from Yahya, from Damdam, from Abu Hurairah; with Yahya's clarification: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "commanded that the two black ones be killed during the prayer." Yahya said: And the two black ones are: the snake and the scorpion.
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hisham se, Yahya se, Damdam se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "hukum diya ke namaz mein do kaali cheezon ko maar diya jaaye." Yahya kehte hain: Aur do kaali cheezon se murad hain: saanp aur bichhoo.

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بَابَيْهِ  ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ  قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ   : قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى : # فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَنْ تَقْصُرُوا مِنَ الصَّلاةِ إِنْ خِفْتُمْ سورة النساء آية 101 #، فَقَدْ أَمِنَ النَّاسُ.
قَالَ : عَجِبْتُ مِمَّا عَجِبْتَ مِنْهُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" صَدَقَةٌ تَصَدَّقَ اللَّهُ بِهَا عَلَيْكُمْ، فَاقْبَلُوهَا "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ibn Abi Ammar, from Abdullah ibn Babayh, from Ya'la ibn Umayyah, about Umar ibn al-Khattab: He said: I said to Umar ibn al-Khattab: Allah the Exalted said: "There is no blame upon you if you shorten the prayer, if you fear" [Surah al-Nisa, verse 101], yet the people are now safe. He said: I was amazed at what you are amazed at, so I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he said: "It is a charity which Allah has bestowed upon you, so accept it."
2.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Ibn Abi Ammar se, Abdullah ibn Babayh se, Ya'la ibn Umayyah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Umar ibn al-Khattab se kaha: Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "Tumpar koi gunah nahi ke tum namaz kam kar do, agar tumhein khauf ho" [Surah An-Nisa, aayat 101], jabke ab log aman mein hain. Unhone kaha: Mujhe bhi wahi tajjub hua tha jo tumhein hua hai, so maine Rasulullah ﷺ se poocha, to aapne farmaya: "Yeh ek sadqa hai jo Allah ne tum par ata kiya hai, so use qabool karo."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" صَلَّى بِمِنًى رَكْعَتَيْنِ "، وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَعُمَرُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَعُثْمَانُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، صَدْرًا مِنْ إِمَارَتِهِ، ثُمَّ أَتَمَّهَا بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from al-Awza'i, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from his father: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "prayed at Mina two rak'ahs," and Abu Bakr two rak'ahs, and Umar two rak'ahs, and Uthman two rak'ahs, at the start of his rule, then he completed it [made it four] after that.
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne al-Awza'i se, al-Zuhri se, Salim se, apne walid se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "Mina mein do rakat padhi," aur Abu Bakr ne do rakat, aur Umar ne do rakat, aur Uthman ne apni khilaafat ke shuru mein do rakat, fir baad mein use poora (chaar rakat) kar diya.

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، قَالَ :" صَلَّيْنَا الظُّهْرَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ أَرْبَعًا، وَصَلَّيْنَا مَعَهُ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Anas ibn Malik: He said: "We prayed Zuhr with the Prophet ﷺ at Madinah, four [rak'ahs], and we prayed with him at Dhu al-Hulayfah, two rak'ahs."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir se, Anas ibn Malik se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Humne Nabi ﷺ ke saath Madinah mein Zuhr chaar [rakat] padhi, aur Dhu al-Hulayfah mein aapke saath do rakat padhi."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ  ، وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ  ، أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ   يَقُولُ :" صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ أَرْبَعًا، وَبِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ "
2.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Ibrahim ibn Maysarah, and Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, about Anas ibn Malik: That the two of them heard Anas ibn Malik say: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed at Madinah four, and at Dhu al-Hulayfah two rak'ahs."
2.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se, Ibrahim ibn Maysarah aur Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir se bataya ke dono ne Anas ibn Malik ko kehte suna: "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Madinah mein chaar, aur Dhu al-Hulayfah mein do rakat padhi."

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ  يَذْكُرُ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : " إِنَّالصَّلَاةَ أَوَّلَ مَا فُرِضَتْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَأُقِرَّتْ صَلَاةُ السَّفَرِ، وَأُتِمَّتْ صَلَاةُ الْحَضَرِ ".
فَقُلْتُ : مَا لَهَا كَانَتْ تُتِمُّ الصَّلَاةَ فِي السَّفَرِ؟ قَالَ : إِنَّهَا تَأَوَّلَتْ كَمَا تَأَوَّلَ عُثْمَانُ
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah ibn al-Zubayr, from Aisha: She said: "The prayer, when it was first made obligatory, was two rak'ahs, so the prayer of travel was confirmed [as it was], and the prayer of residence was made complete." So I said: "What was it that she used to complete the prayer during travel?" He said: She interpreted it as Uthman interpreted it.
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Zuhri ko yeh zikr karte suna, Urwah ibn al-Zubayr se, Aisha se: Unhone kaha, "Namaz jab pehli baar farz ki gayi thi, to woh do rakat thi, so safar ki namaz waise hi rehne di gayi, aur haalat-e-iqaamat (ghar par) ki namaz mukammal (chaar) kar di gayi." To maine poocha: "To kya wajah thi ke woh khud safar mein namaz poori padha karti thin?" Unhone kaha: Unhone isi tarah ta'weel ki jaise Uthman ne ki thi.

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ،  عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، قَالَ : " خَرَجْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَجَعَلَيَقْصُرُ حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا مَكَّةَ ، فَأَقَامَ بِهَا عَشَرَةَ أَيَّامٍ يَقْصُرُ حَتَّى رَجَعَ، وَذَلِكَ فِي حَجَّتِهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Yahya ibn Abi Ishaq, from Anas ibn Malik: He said: "We went out with the Prophet ﷺ, and he began shortening [the prayer] until we arrived at Makkah, and he stayed there ten days shortening, until he returned, and that was during his Hajj."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Yahya ibn Abi Ishaq se, Anas ibn Malik se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Hum Nabi ﷺ ke saath nikle, to aap [namaz] kam karne lage yahan tak ke hum Makkah pahunche, aur aap wahan das din tak kam karte rahe, yahan tak ke wapas laut aaye, aur yeh aapke Hajj ke mauqe par tha."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ  ، عَنْ السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  ،  عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مُكْثُ الْمُهَاجِرِ بَعْدَ قَضَاءِ نُسُكِهِ ثَلَاثٌ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Isma'il ibn Muhammad, from Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf, from al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid, from al-Ala ibn al-Hadrami: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The stay of the emigrant [in Makkah] after completing his rites is three [days]."
2.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Isma'il ibn Muhammad se, Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf se, al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid se, al-Ala ibn al-Hadrami se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Muhajir ke liye apni manaasik poori karne ke baad [Makkah mein] rukna teen [din tak] hai."

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ  ، عَنْ السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ  ، قَالَ :" رَخَّصَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِلْمُهَاجِرِينَ أَنْ يُقِيمُوا ثَلَاثًا بَعْدَ الصَّدَرِ بِمَكَّةَ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : أَقُولُ بِهِ
2.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Hafs, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf, from al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid, from al-Ala ibn al-Hadrami; with Abu Muhammad's confirmation: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave a concession to the emigrants that they might stay three days after their return [from the pilgrimage rites] in Makkah." Abu Muhammad said: I hold to this.
2.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Hafs se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf se, al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid se, al-Ala ibn al-Hadrami se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne muhajireen ko yeh rukhsat di ke woh [manaasik se] wapasi ke baad Makkah mein teen din tak rukein." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Main isi par amal karta hoon.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبأَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتَوَائِيُّ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ ثَوْبَانَ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" يُصَلِّي عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ نَحْوَ الْمَشْرِقِ، فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ الْمَكْتُوبَةَ، نَزَلَ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hisham al-Dastawa'i, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Thawban, from Jabir: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to "pray on his mount facing the east, and when he wanted to pray the obligatory [prayer], he would dismount and face the Qiblah."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hisham al-Dastawa'i se, Yahya ibn Abi Kathir se, Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Thawban se, Jabir se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "apni sawaari par mashriq ki taraf rukh karke namaz padhte, aur jab farz namaz padhna chahte, to utar kar Qibla ki taraf rukh karte."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ  ، أَنَّ عَامِرَ بْنَ رَبِيعَةَ  ، قَالَ : رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يُسَبِّحُ وَهُوَ عَلَى الرَّاحِلَةِ، وَيُومِئُ بِرَأْسِهِ قِبَلَ أَيِّ وَجْهٍ تَوَجَّهَ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَصْنَعُ ذَلِكَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ "
2.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Uqayl, from al-Zuhri, from Abdullah ibn Amir ibn Rabi'ah, from Amir ibn Rabi'ah: He said: Abdullah ibn Amir ibn Rabi'ah informed me, that Amir ibn Rabi'ah said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "glorify [Allah] while he was on the mount, and gesture with his head toward whatever direction he was facing, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not do that in the obligatory prayer."
2.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se, Uqayl se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Abdullah ibn Amir ibn Rabi'ah ne bataya, ke Amir ibn Rabi'ah ne kaha: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko dekha ke aap "sawaari par hote hue tasbih karte, aur apna sar jis bhi taraf rukh hota us taraf jhukaate, lekin Rasulullah ﷺ farz namaz mein aisa nahi karte the."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَلِيٍّ الْحَنَفِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ الْمَكِّيِّ  ، أَنَّ أَبَا الطُّفَيْلِ عَامِرَ بْنَ وَاثِلَةَ  أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّ مُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ   أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ : خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَامَ غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ، فَكَانَ يَجْمَعُ الصَّلَاةَ :" فَصَلَّى الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ جَمِيعًا، ثُمَّ دَخَلَ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَصَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ جَمِيعًا "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Ali al-Hanafi, from Malik ibn Anas, from Abu al-Zubayr al-Makki, from Abu al-Tufayl Amir ibn Wathilah, from Mu'adh ibn Jabal: He said: We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the year of the expedition of Tabuk, and he used to combine the prayer: "he prayed Zuhr and Asr together, then entered [his tent], then went out after that and prayed Maghrib and Isha together."
2.hi: Abu Ali al-Hanafi ne Malik ibn Anas se, Abu al-Zubayr al-Makki se bataya ke Abu al-Tufayl Amir ibn Wathilah ne unhein bataya ke Mu'adh ibn Jabal ne unhein bataya: Unhone kaha, Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath ghazwa-e-Tabuk ke saal nikle, to aap namaz jama karte: "aap Zuhr aur Asr ekathay padhte, fir andar chale jaate, fir uske baad bahar nikalte aur Maghrib aur Isha ekathay padhte."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الْخَطْمِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" صَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ بِجَمْعٍ، فَجَمَعَ بَيْنَهُمَا "
2.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Adi ibn Thabit, from Abdullah ibn Yazid al-Khatmi, from Abu Ayyub al-Ansari: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "prayed Maghrib and Isha at Jam', and combined between them."
2.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Adi ibn Thabit se, Abdullah ibn Yazid al-Khatmi se, Abu Ayyub al-Ansari se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "Jam' (Muzdalifah) mein Maghrib aur Isha padhi, aur inhein jama kiya."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ إِذَا جَدَّ بِهِ السَّيْرُ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Ibn Uyaynah, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from Abdullah ibn Umar: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to "combine between Maghrib and Isha when he was hastened in travel."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Ibn Uyaynah se, al-Zuhri se, Salim se, Abdullah ibn Umar se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "Maghrib aur Isha ko jama kar dete the jab safar mein jaldi hoti."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَكَمُ  ، وَسَلَمَةُ بْنُ كُهَيْلٍ  ، قَالَا :" صَلَّى بِنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ   بِجَمْعٍ بِإِقَامَةٍ الْمَغْرِبَ ثَلَاثًا، فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ، قَامَ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ الْعِشَاءَ "، ثُمَّ حَدَّثَ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  أَنَّهُ صَنَعَ بِهِمْ فِي ذَلِكَ الْمَكَانِ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، وَحَدَّثَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ صَنَعَ فِي ذَلِكَ الْمَكَانِ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ.
 حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، بِإِسْنَادِهِ، نَحْوَهُ
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, and Salamah ibn Kuhayl, about Sa'id ibn Jubayr and Ibn Umar; a similar chain also via Sa'id ibn al-Rabi': They said: "Sa'id ibn Jubayr prayed Maghrib with us at Jam' with the [single] iqamah as three [rak'ahs], then when he gave the taslim, he stood and prayed two rak'ahs of Isha," then he narrated, from Ibn Umar, that he did the like of that with them in that place, and Ibn Umar narrated: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did the like of that in that place. [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Sa'id ibn al-Rabi', from Shu'bah, with his chain.]
2.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Shu'bah se, al-Hakam aur Salamah ibn Kuhayl se bataya: Dono ne kaha, "Sa'id ibn Jubayr ne humein Jam' mein ek iqamah se Maghrib teen [rakat] padhaayi, fir jab salaam phera, khade hue aur Isha ki do rakat padhi," fir unhone Ibn Umar se bataya ke unhone bhi usi jagah unke saath aisa hi kiya tha, aur Ibn Umar ne bataya: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne bhi usi jagah aisa hi kiya tha. [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Sa'id ibn al-Rabi' se, Shu'bah se bhi aayi hai.]

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، وَعَمِّهِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ابْنَيْ كَعْبٍ، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" لَا يَقْدَمُ مِنْ سَفَرٍ إِلَّا بِالنَّهَارِ ضُحًى، ثُمَّ يَدْخُلُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ لِلنَّاسِ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ibn Shihab, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abdullah ibn Ka'b ibn Malik, from his father Abdullah, and his uncle Ubaydullah, from Ka'b ibn Malik: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to "not arrive from a journey except during the day, in the forenoon, then he would enter the mosque and pray two rak'ahs, then sit for the people."
2.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Ibn Shihab se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Abdullah ibn Ka'b ibn Malik se, apne walid Abdullah se, aur apne chacha Ubaydullah se, Ka'b ibn Malik se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "safar se sirf din mein, chaasht ke waqt, wapas aate, fir masjid mein dakhil hote aur do rakat padhte, fir logon ke liye baithte."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  : أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : " غَزَوْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ غَزْوَةً قِبَلَ نَجْدٍ ، فَوَازَيْنَا الْعَدُوَّ وَصَافَفْنَاهُمْ،فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُصَلِّي لَنَا، فَقَامَ طَائِفَةٌ مِنَّا مَعَهُ، وَأَقْبَلَ طَائِفَةٌ عَلَى الْعَدُوِّ، فَرَكَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِمَنْ مَعَهُ رَكْعَةً، وَسَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفُوا، فَكَانُوا مَكَانَ الطَّائِفَةِ الَّتِي لَمْ تُصَلِّ، وَجَاءَتْ الطَّائِفَةُ الَّتِي لَمْ تُصَلِّ فَرَكَعَ بِهِمْ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَكْعَةً وسَجَدَ َسَجْدَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَامَ كُلُّ رَجُلٍ مِنْ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَرَكَعَ لِنَفْسِهِ رَكْعَةً وسَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ "
2.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri, from Salim ibn Abdullah, about Abdullah ibn Umar: That Abdullah ibn Umar said: "I went on an expedition with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ toward Najd, and we came alongside the enemy and lined up facing them, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood to pray for us, so a group of us stood with him, and a group faced the enemy, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ bowed with those who were with him one rak'ah, and prostrated two prostrations, then they departed, and they took the place of the group that had not prayed, and the group that had not prayed came, and the Prophet ﷺ bowed with them one rak'ah and prostrated two prostrations, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave the taslim, so each man of the Muslims stood and bowed for himself a rak'ah and prostrated two prostrations."
