2.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Mujhe Salim ibn Abdullah ne bataya: ke Abdullah ibn Umar ne kaha: "Main Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath Najd ki taraf ek ghazwe mein gaya, humne dushman ke saamne saf bandhi, to Rasulullah ﷺ humein namaz padhaane khade hue, so humme se ek giroh aapke saath khada hua, aur ek giroh dushman ki taraf mutwajjih raha, so Rasulullah ﷺ ne apne saath walon ke saath ek rakat ruku kiya, aur do sajde kiye, fir woh chale gaye, aur woh us giroh ki jagah le li jisne namaz nahi padhi thi, aur woh giroh jisne namaz nahi padhi thi aaya, aur Nabi ﷺ ne unke saath ek rakat ruku kiya aur do sajde kiye, fir Rasulullah ﷺ ne salaam phera, so Musalmanon mein se har aadmi ne khade hokar apne liye ek rakat ruku kiya aur do sajde kiye."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ خَوَّاتٍ  ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ  ، فِي صَلَاةِ الْخَوْفِ، قَالَ :" يُصَلِّي الْإِمَامُ بِطَائِفَةٍ، وَطَائِفَةٌ مُوَاجِهَةُ الْعَدُوِّ، فَيُصَلِّي بِالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ رَكْعَةً، وَيَذْهَبُ هَؤُلَاءِ إِلَى مَصَافِّ أَصْحَابِهِمْ، وَيَجِيءُ أُولَئِكَ فَيُصَلِّي بِهِمْ رَكْعَةً، وَيَقْضُونَ رَكْعَةً لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ ".
 حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدُ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ خَوَّاتٍ  ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، مِثْلَهُ
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Bashshar, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Ansari, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Salih ibn Khawwat, from Sahl ibn Abi Hathmah, concerning the prayer of fear; a similar chain also via Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Shu'bah: He said: "The imam prays with a group, and a group faces the enemy, so he prays with those who are with him one rak'ah, and these go to the ranks of their companions, and those come and he prays with them one rak'ah, and they make up a rak'ah for themselves." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Muhammad ibn Bashshar, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Shu'bah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Salih ibn Khawwat, from Sahl ibn Abi Hathmah, from the Prophet ﷺ, the like of it.]
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Bashshar ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Ansari se, al-Qasim ibn Muhammad se, Salih ibn Khawwat se, Sahl ibn Abi Hathmah se, salaat-ul-khauf (khauf ki namaz) ke baare mein bataya: Unhone kaha, "Imam ek giroh ke saath namaz padhe, aur ek giroh dushman ki taraf mutwajjih rahe, so woh apne saath walon ko ek rakat padhaaye, aur yeh log apne sathiyon ki safon mein chale jaayein, aur woh log aayein aur woh unhein ek rakat padhaaye, aur woh apne liye ek rakat qaza karein." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Muhammad ibn Bashshar se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Shu'bah se, Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim ibn Muhammad se, apne walid se, Salih ibn Khawwat se, Sahl ibn Abi Hathmah se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai.]

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ  ، عَنْ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : حُبِسْنَا يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ حَتَّى ذَهَبَ هَوِيٌّ مِنْ اللَّيْلِ حَتَّى كُفِينَا، وَذَلِكَ قَوْلُ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى : # وَكَفَى اللَّهُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ الْقِتَالَ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ قَوِيًّا عَزِيزًا سورة الأحزاب آية 25 #،" فَدَعَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِلَالًا فَأَمَرَهُ، فَأَقَامَ فَصَلَّى الظُّهْرَ، فَأَحْسَنَ كَمَا كَانَ يُصَلِّيهَا فِي وَقْتِهَا، ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ فَأَقَامَ الْعَصْرَ فَصَلَّاهَا، ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ فَأَقَامَ الْمَغْرِبَ فَصَلَّاهَا، ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ فَأَقَامَ الْعِشَاءَ فَصَلَّاهَا، وَذَلِكَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَنْزِلَ : # فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ فَرِجَالا أَوْ رُكْبَانًا سورة البقرة آية 239 # "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from al-Maqburi, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Sa'id al-Khudri, from his father: He said: We were held back on the day of the Trench until part of the night had passed, until we were relieved, and that is the saying of Allah the Exalted: "And Allah sufficed the believers in the battle, and Allah is Powerful, Mighty" [Surah al-Ahzab, verse 25], "so the Prophet ﷺ called Bilal and commanded him, so he made the iqamah and he prayed Zuhr, and did it well as he used to pray it in its time, then he commanded him and he made the iqamah for Asr and he prayed it, then he commanded him and he made the iqamah for Maghrib and he prayed it, then he commanded him and he made the iqamah for Isha and he prayed it," and that was before this was revealed: "But if you fear, then [pray] on foot or riding" [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 239].
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Ibn Abi Dhi'b se, al-Maqburi se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Sa'id al-Khudri se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Hum Khandaq ke din tab tak roke gaye jab tak raat ka kuch hissa guzar nahi gaya, yahan tak ke humein aaraam mila, aur yehi Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai: "Aur Allah ne momino ke liye jung kaafi kar di, aur Allah zabardast, zabardast hai" [Surah Al-Ahzab, aayat 25], "so Nabi ﷺ ne Bilal ko bulaaya aur hukum diya, so unhone iqamah kahi aur aapne Zuhr padhi, aur usay achhi tarah padha jaise aap usay uske waqt par padha karte the, fir aapne hukum diya aur unhone Asr ki iqamah kahi aur aapne padhi, fir aapne hukum diya aur unhone Maghrib ki iqamah kahi aur aapne padhi, fir aapne hukum diya aur unhone Isha ki iqamah kahi aur aapne padhi," aur yeh us waqt se pehle tha jab yeh naazil hua: "Fir agar tumhein khauf ho, to paidal ya sawaar [padho]" [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 239].

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل  ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ  ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : " إِنَّالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ لَيْسَا يَنْكَسِفَانِ لِمَوْتِ أَحَدٍ مِنْ النَّاسِ، وَلَكِنَّهُمَا آيَتَانِ مِنْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمُوهُمَا، فَقُومُوا، فَصَلُّوا "
2.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Isma'il, from Qays, from Abu Mas'ud, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: He said: "Indeed the sun and the moon do not eclipse for the death of anyone among people, but they are two signs from among the signs of Allah, so when you see them, then stand, and pray."
2.hi: Ya'la ne Isma'il se, Qays se, Abu Mas'ud se, Rasulullah ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Suraj aur chaand kisi bhi insaan ki maut ki wajah se grahan nahi hote, balke yeh Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se do nishaaniyan hain, so jab tum inhein dekho, to khade ho jao, aur namaz padho."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمَدِينِيُّ  ، وَمُسَدَّدٌ  قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي حَبِيبُ بْنُ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" صَلَّى فِي كُسُوفٍ ثَمَانَ رَكَعَاتٍ فِي أَرْبَعِ سَجَدَاتٍ "
2.en: Narrated by Ali ibn Abdullah al-Madini, and Musaddad, from Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Qattan, from Sufyan ibn Sa'id, from Habib ibn Abi Thabit, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas: That the Prophet ﷺ "prayed during an eclipse eight rak'ahs in four prostrations."
2.hi: Ali ibn Abdullah al-Madini aur Musaddad ne Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Qattan se, Sufyan ibn Sa'id se, Habib ibn Abi Thabit se, Tawus se, Ibn Abbas se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne "grahan mein aath rakat chaar sajde ke saath padhi."

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، أَنَّ يَهُودِيَّةً دَخَلَتْ عَلَيْهَا، فَقَالَتْ : أَعَاذَكِ اللَّهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، فَلَمَّا جَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سَأَلَتْهُ : أَيُعَذَّبُ النَّاسُ فِي قُبُورِهِمْ؟ قَالَ : " عَائِذًا بِاللَّهِ ".
 قَالَتْ : إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " رَكِبَ يَوْمًا مَرْكَبًا فَخَسَفَتْ الشَّمْسُ، فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَنَزَلَ، ثُمَّعَمِدَ إِلَى مَقَامِهِ الَّذِي كَانَ يُصَلِّي فِيهِ، قَامَ النَّاسُ خَلْفَهُ فَأَطَالَ الْقِيَامَ، ثُمَّ رَكَعَ فَأَطَالَ الرُّكُوعَ، ثُمَّ رَفَعَ فَأَطَالَ الْقِيَامَ، وَهُوَ دُونَ الْقِيَامِ الْأَوَّلِ، ثُمَّ رَكَعَ فَأَطَالَ الرُّكُوعَ، وَهُوَ دُونَ الرُّكُوعِ الْأَوَّلِ، ثُمَّ سَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ قَامَ فَفَعَلَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ تَجَلَّتْ الشَّمْسُ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman, from Aisha: That a Jewish woman entered upon her, and said: "May Allah protect you from the punishment of the grave," so when the Prophet ﷺ came, she asked him: "Are people punished in their graves?" He said: "[I take] refuge in Allah [from that]." She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ "rode one day on a mount, and the sun eclipsed, so the Prophet ﷺ came and dismounted, then went to the place where he used to pray, the people stood behind him, so he prolonged the standing, then he bowed and prolonged the bowing, then he raised [his head] and prolonged the standing, and it was less than the first standing, then he bowed and prolonged the bowing, and it was less than the first bowing, then he prostrated two prostrations, then he stood and did the like of that, then the sun became clear."
2.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman se, Aisha se bataya ke ek Yahoodi aurat unke paas aayi, aur kaha: "Allah tumhein qabar ke azaab se bachaaye," so jab Nabi ﷺ aaye, to unhone aapse poocha: "Kya log apni qabron mein azaab diye jaate hain?" Aapne farmaya: "[Main] Allah ki panah [maangta hoon]." Unhone bataya: Rasulullah ﷺ "ek din sawaari par gaye, aur suraj ko grahan lag gaya, to Nabi ﷺ aaye aur utar gaye, fir us jagah gaye jahan aap namaz padhte the, log aapke peechhe khade hue, to aapne lamba qayam kiya, fir ruku kiya aur ruku lamba kiya, fir sar uthaya aur qayam lamba kiya, aur yeh pehle qayam se kam tha, fir ruku kiya aur lamba kiya, aur yeh pehle ruku se kam tha, fir do sajde kiye, fir khade hue aur isi tarah kiya, fir suraj saaf ho gaya."

2.ar: فَدَخَلَ عَلَيَّ فَقَالَ : " إِنِّيأُرَاكُمْ تُفْتَنُونَ فِي قُبُورِكُمْ كَفِتْنَةِ الدَّجَّالِ "
2.en: Continuing the same narration [Aisha]: So he entered upon me and said: "Indeed I see that you [plural] will be tried in your graves like the trial of the Dajjal."
2.hi: So aap mere paas aaye aur farmaya: "Main dekhta hoon ke tumhein apni qabron mein Dajjal ke fitne jaisi azmaish di jaayegi."

2.ar: سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ :" اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ "
2.en: Continuing the same narration [Aisha]: I heard him say: "O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the punishment of the grave, and I seek refuge with You from the punishment of the Fire."
2.hi: Maine aapko yeh kehte suna: "Allahumma inni a'oozu bika min 'azaabil-qabr, wa a'oozu bika min 'azaabin-naar" [Ae Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon qabar ke azaab se, aur teri panah maangta hoon aag ke azaab se].

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو يَعْقُوبَ يُوسُفُ الْبُوَيْطِيُّ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ هُوَ الشَّافِعِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ،  عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : خَسَفَتْ الشَّمْسُ فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَحَكَى ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ : أَنَّ صَلَاتَهُ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ خَطَبَهُمْ، فَقَالَ : " إِنَّالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ آيَتَانِ مِنْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ لَا يَخْسِفَانِ لِمَوْتِ أَحَدٍ، وَلَا لِحَيَاتِهِ، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ ذَلِكَ، فَافْزَعُوا إِلَى ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Ya'qub Yusuf al-Buwayti, from Muhammad ibn Idris al-Shafi'i, from Malik ibn Anas, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from Ata ibn Yasar, from Ibn Abbas: He said: The sun eclipsed, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed, and Ibn Abbas described: that his ﷺ prayer was two rak'ahs, in each rak'ah two bowings, then he gave them a sermon, and said: "Indeed the sun and the moon are two signs from among the signs of Allah, they do not eclipse for anyone's death, nor for anyone's life; so when you see that, hasten to the remembrance of Allah."
2.hi: Abu Ya'qub Yusuf al-Buwayti ne Muhammad ibn Idris (al-Shafi'i) se, Malik ibn Anas se, Zayd ibn Aslam se, Ata ibn Yasar se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Suraj ko grahan laga, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne namaz padhi, aur Ibn Abbas ne bayaan kiya: ke aapki namaz do rakat thi, har rakat mein do ruku, fir aapne unhein khutba diya, aur farmaya: "Suraj aur chaand Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se do nishaaniyan hain, yeh kisi ki maut ya zindagi ki wajah se grahan nahi hote; so jab tum yeh dekho, to Allah ke zikr ki taraf jaldi karo."

2.ar:
قَالَ : وَأَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  .
قَالَ : وَأَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : " خَسَفَتْ الشَّمْسُ فَصَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَحَكَتْ أَنَّهُصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ رَكْعَتَيْنِ "
2.en: Narrated by Malik, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha; and from Malik, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Amrah, from Aisha: She said: "The sun eclipsed, so the Prophet ﷺ prayed," and she described: that he prayed two rak'ahs, in each rak'ah two bowings.
2.hi: Aur Malik ne Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Aisha se bataya; aur Malik se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Amrah se, Aisha se: Unhone kaha, "Suraj ko grahan laga, to Nabi ﷺ ne namaz padhi," aur unhone bayaan kiya: ke aapne do rakat padhi, har rakat mein do ruku.

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ الْمُنْذِرِ  ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" أَمَرَ حِينَ كَسَفَتْ الشَّمْسُ بِعَتَاقَةٍ ".
قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حُذَيْفَةَ مُوسَى بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ  ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَة  ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، نَحْوَهُ
2.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from Fatimah bint al-Mundhir, from Asma bint Abi Bakr; a similar chain also via Abu Hudhayfah Musa ibn Mas'ud: That the Prophet ﷺ "commanded, at the time of the solar eclipse, freeing a slave." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Abu Hudhayfah Musa ibn Mas'ud, from Za'idah, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from Fatimah, from Asma, from the Prophet ﷺ.]
2.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, Fatimah bint al-Mundhir se, Asma bint Abi Bakr se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne "suraj grahan ke waqt ghulam azaad karne ka hukum diya." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Abu Hudhayfah Musa ibn Mas'ud se, Za'idah se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, Fatimah se, Asma se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai.]

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ  ، أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرِ بْنَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ  أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ زَيْدٍ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُ، يَذْكُرُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " خَرَجَ بِالنَّاسِ إِلَى الْمُصَلَّى يَسْتَسْقِي،فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ وَحَوَّلَ رِدَاءَهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Ansari, from Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm, from Abbad ibn Tamim, from Abdullah ibn Zayd رضي الله عنه: That he heard Abdullah ibn Zayd رضي الله عنه mention that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "went out with the people to the prayer-ground to pray for rain, and faced the Qiblah, and turned his cloak."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Ansari se bataya ke Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm ne unhein bataya, Abbad ibn Tamim se, ke unhone Abdullah ibn Zayd رضي الله عنه ko yeh zikr karte suna ke Rasulullah ﷺ "logon ke saath istisqa (baarish ki dua) ke liye namaz-gaah gaye, aur Qibla ki taraf rukh kiya, aur apni chaadar ulat di."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبَّادُ بْنُ تَمِيمٍ  : أَنَّ عَمَّهُ   أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " خَرَجَ بِالنَّاسِ إِلَى الْمُصَلَّى يَسْتَسْقِي لَهُمْ،فَقَامَ فَدَعَا اللَّهَ قَائِمًا، ثُمَّ تَوَجَّهَ قِبَلَ الْقِبْلَةِ، فَحَوَّلَ رِدَاءَهُ فَأُسْقُوا "
2.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri, from Abbad ibn Tamim, from his uncle: That the Prophet ﷺ "went out with the people to the prayer-ground to pray for rain for them, and stood and called upon Allah standing, then he turned toward the Qiblah, and turned his cloak, and rain was given to them."
2.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Mujhe Abbad ibn Tamim ne bataya: ke unke chacha ne unhein bataya ke Nabi ﷺ "logon ke saath istisqa ke liye namaz-gaah gaye, aur khade hokar Allah se dua maangi, fir Qibla ki taraf rukh kiya, aur apni chaadar ulat di, to unhein baarish di gayi."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : " كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَلَا يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنْ الدُّعَاءِ إِلَّا فِي الِاسْتِسْقَاءِ "
2.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Abdah, from Sa'id, from Qatadah, from Anas: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never raised his hands in any supplication except for [the prayer for] rain."
2.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Abdah se, Sa'id se, Qatadah se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne kabhi kisi dua mein apne haath nahi uthaaye siwaay istisqa ke."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ،  عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدُكُمْ الْجُمُعَةَ فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ "
2.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you comes to Jumu'ah, let him perform ghusl."
2.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se koi Jumu'ah ke liye aaye, to woh ghusl kare."

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" غُسْلُ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ وَاجِبٌ عَلَى كُلِّ مُحْتَلِمٍ ".
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، مِثْلَهُ
2.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Safwan ibn Sulaym, from Ata ibn Yasar, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri; a similar chain also via Abu Nu'aym: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The ghusl of the day of Jumu'ah is obligatory upon every adult." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Abu Nu'aym, from Ibn Uyaynah, from Safwan ibn Sulaym, from Ata ibn Yasar, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, from the Prophet ﷺ, the like of it.]
2.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Safwan ibn Sulaym se, Ata ibn Yasar se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jumu'ah ke din ka ghusl har baaligh par wajib hai." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Abu Nu'aym se, Ibn Uyaynah se, Safwan ibn Sulaym se, Ata ibn Yasar se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai.]

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : بَيْنَمَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ   يَخْطُبُ، إِذْ دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ فَعَرَّضَ بِهِ عُمَرُ، فَقَالَ : يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، مَا زِدْتُ أَنْ تَوَضَّأْتُ حِينَ سَمِعْتُ النِّدَاءَ.
فَقَالَ : وَالْوُضُوءَ أَيْضًا؟ أَلَمْ تَسْمَعْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ، فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from al-Awza'i, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman, about Umar ibn al-Khattab: He said: Abu Hurairah narrated to me: He said: While Umar ibn al-Khattab was giving the sermon, a man entered, so Umar hinted at him, so he said: "O Commander of the Believers, I did nothing more than perform ablution when I heard the call." So he said: "And ablution too? Did you not hear the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'When one of you comes for the day of Jumu'ah, let him perform ghusl'?"
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne al-Awza'i se, Yahya ibn Abi Kathir se, Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhse Abu Hurairah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Jabke Umar ibn al-Khattab khutba de rahe the, ek aadmi dakhil hua, to Umar ne ishaare mein usse kuch kaha, to usne kaha: "Ae Ameer-ul-Mumineen, maine sirf itna kiya ke azaan sunte hi wudu kar liya." To unhone kaha: "Aur sirf wudu bhi? Kya tumne Rasulullah ﷺ ko yeh farmaate nahi suna: 'Jab tum mein se koi Jumu'ah ke din ke liye aaye, to woh ghusl kare'?"

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، أَنْبأَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ لِلْجُمُعَةِ فَبِهَا وَنِعْمَتْ، وَمَنْ اغْتَسَلَ، فَالْغُسْلُ أَفْضَلُ "
2.en: Narrated by Affan, from Hammam, from Qatadah, from al-Hasan, from Samurah: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever performs ablution for Jumu'ah, that suffices and is good, and whoever performs ghusl, ghusl is better."
2.hi: Affan ne Hammam se, Qatadah se, al-Hasan se, Samurah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jo Jumu'ah ke liye wudu kare, woh kaafi hai aur achha hai, aur jo ghusl kare, ghusl behtar hai."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ  ، عَنْ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ وَدِيعَةَ  ، عَنْ سَلْمَانَ الْفَارِسِيِّ   صَاحِبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" مَنْ اغْتَسَلَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَتَطَهَّرَ بِمَا اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْ طُهْرٍ، ثُمَّ ادَّهَنَ مِنْ دُهْنِهِ، أَوْ مَسَّ مِنْ طِيبِ بَيْتِهِ، ثُمَّ رَاحَ فَلَمْ يُفَرِّقْ بَيْنَ اثْنَيْنِ وَصَلَّى مَا كُتِبَ لَهُ، فَإِذَا خَرَجَ الْإِمَامُ أَنْصَتَ، غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجُمُعَةِ الْأُخْرَى "
2.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from al-Maqburi, from his father, from Abdullah ibn Wadi'ah, from Salman al-Farisi, companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: That the Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever performs ghusl on the day of Jumu'ah, and purifies himself as much as he is able of purification, then applies oil from his oil, or touches some perfume of his house, then goes out and does not separate between two [people], and prays what has been decreed for him, then when the imam comes out he is silent, it will be forgiven for him what is between it and the next Jumu'ah."
2.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Ibn Abi Dhi'b se, al-Maqburi se, apne walid se, Abdullah ibn Wadi'ah se, Salman al-Farisi, Rasulullah ﷺ ke sahabi, se bataya ke Nabi Allah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jo Jumu'ah ke din ghusl kare, aur jitni ho sake taharat kare, fir apni tel se tel lagaaye, ya apne ghar ki khushbu lagaaye, fir nikle aur do logon ke darmiyan ghusa na de [jabran raasta na banaaye], aur jitni namaz uske muqaddar mein likhi ho padhe, fir jab imam bahar aaye to khamosh rahe, uske aur agli Jumu'ah ke darmiyan ke gunah maaf kar diye jaayenge."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هُرْمُزَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يَقْرَأُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فِي صَلَاةِ الْغَدَاةِ تَنْزِيلُ السَّجْدَةَ، وَهَلْ أَتَى عَلَى الْإِنْسَانِ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Sa'd ibn Ibrahim, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Hurmuz, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Prophet ﷺ used to "recite on the day of Jumu'ah in the morning prayer 'Alif Lam Mim, Tanzil, al-Sajdah' and 'Has there come upon man' [Surah al-Insan]."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Sa'd ibn Ibrahim se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Hurmuz se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ "Jumu'ah ke din Fajr ki namaz mein 'Alif Lam Mim, Tanzil, As-Sajdah' aur 'Hal ataa 'alal-insaan' [Surah Al-Insan] padhte the."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" الْمُتَعَجِّلُ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ كَالْمُهْدِي جَزُورًا، ثُمَّ الَّذِي يَلِيهِ كَالْمُهْدِي بَقَرَةً، ثُمَّ الَّذِي يَلِيهِ كَالْمُهْدِي شَاةً، فَإِذَا جَلَسَ الْإِمَامُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ، طُوِيَتْ الصُّحُفُ، وَجَلَسُوا يَسْتَمِعُونَ الذِّكْرَ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from al-Awza'i, from Yahya, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The one who hastens early to Jumu'ah is like one who sacrifices a camel, then the one who follows him is like one who sacrifices a cow, then the one who follows him is like one who sacrifices a sheep, so when the imam sits on the pulpit, the pages [of deeds] are folded up, and they sit listening to the reminder."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne al-Awza'i se, Yahya se, Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jumu'ah ke liye jaldi jaane wala aise hai jaise oont ki qurbani de raha ho, fir uske baad wala aise jaise gaay ki qurbani de raha ho, fir uske baad wala aise jaise bhed ki qurbani de raha ho, so jab imam mimbar par baith jaata hai, to [a'maal ke] sahifay lapet diye jaate hain, aur log yaad-dahaani (khutba) sunne baith jaate hain."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْأَعْلَى  ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ الْأَغَرِّ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  صَاحِبِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ، قَعَدَتْ الْمَلَائِكَةُ عَلَى أَبْوَابِ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَكَتَبُوا مَنْ جَاءَ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ، فَإِذَا رَاحَ الْإِمَامُ، طَوَتْ الْمَلَائِكَةُ الصُّحُفَ وَدَخَلَتْ تَسْتَمِعُ الذِّكْرَ "
2.en: Narrated by Nasr ibn Ali, from Abd al-A'la, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from al-Aghar Abu Abdullah, companion of Abu Hurairah, from Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "When it is the day of Jumu'ah, the angels sit at the doors of the mosque, and record whoever comes for the Jumu'ah, so when the imam goes out, the angels fold up the pages and enter to listen to the reminder."
2.hi: Nasr ibn Ali ne Abd al-A'la se, Ma'mar se, al-Zuhri se, al-Aghar Abu Abdullah se, Abu Hurairah ke sathi, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jab Jumu'ah ka din hota hai, to farishte masjid ke darwazon par baith jaate hain, aur jo Jumu'ah ke liye aata hai use likhte hain, so jab imam nikalta hai, to farishte sahifay lapet dete hain aur andar aakar yaad-dahaani sunte hain."

2.ar: قَالَ : وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" الْمُتَهَجِّرُ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ كَالْمُهْدِي بَدَنَةً، ثُمَّ كَالْمُهْدِي بَقَرَةً، ثُمَّ كَالْمُهْدِي شَاةً، ثُمَّ كَالْمُهْدِي بَطَّةً، ثُمَّ كَالْمُهْدِي دَجَاجَةً، ثُمَّ كَالْمُهْدِي بَيْضَةً "
2.en: Continuing the same narration [Abu Hurairah]: He said: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The one who goes early to Jumu'ah is like one who sacrifices a camel, then like one who sacrifices a cow, then like one who sacrifices a sheep, then like one who sacrifices a duck, then like one who sacrifices a chicken, then like one who sacrifices an egg."
2.hi: Unhone bataya: Aur Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jumu'ah ke liye jaldi jaane wala aise hai jaise oont ki qurbani de raha ho, fir jaise gaay ki qurbani, fir jaise bhed ki qurbani, fir jaise batakh ki qurbani, fir jaise murgi ki qurbani, fir jaise ande ki qurbani."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ  ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ الْعَوَّامٍ  ، قَالَ : " كُنَّانُصَلِّي مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْجُمُعَةَ، ثُمَّ نَرْجِعُ فَنَتَبَادِرُ الظِّلَّ فِي أُطُمِ بَنِي غَنْمٍ، فَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا مَوَاضِعُ أَقْدَامِنَا "
2.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from Muslim ibn Jundub, from al-Zubayr ibn al-Awwam: He said: "We used to pray Jumu'ah with the Prophet ﷺ, then return and race for the shade in the fortress of Banu Ghanm, and it was nothing but the size of our footsteps."
2.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Ibn Abi Dhi'b se, Muslim ibn Jundub se, al-Zubayr ibn al-Awwam se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Hum Nabi ﷺ ke saath Jumu'ah padhte, fir wapas jaate aur Banu Ghanm ke qile mein saaye ki taraf daudte, aur woh sirf humare qadamon jitna hi hota."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ الْحَارِثِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ إِيَاسَ بْنَ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الْأَكْوَعِ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : " كُنَّانُصَلِّي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْجُمُعَةَ، ثُمَّ نَنْصَرِفُ وَلَيْسَ لِلْحِيطَانِ فَيْءٌ يُسْتَظَلُّ بِهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Affan ibn Muslim, from Ya'la ibn al-Harith, from Iyas ibn Salamah ibn al-Akwa', from his father: He said: "We used to pray Jumu'ah with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, then depart, and there was no shade on the walls to shade oneself with."
2.hi: Affan ibn Muslim ne Ya'la ibn al-Harith se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Iyas ibn Salamah ibn al-Akwa' ko apne walid se yeh bayaan karte suna: Unhone kaha, "Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath Jumu'ah padhte, fir chale jaate, aur deewaron par itna saaya bhi nahi hota jismein saaya liya jaa sake."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ هُوَ ابْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَشْعَثِ الصَّنْعَانِيِّ  ، يَرُدُّهُ إِلَى أَوْسِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ  ، يَرُدُّهُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ غَسَّلَ وَاغْتَسَلَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ، ثُمَّ غَدَا وَابْتَكَرَ، ثُمَّ جَلَسَ قَرِيبًا مِنْ الْإِمَامِ وَأَنْصَتَ، وَلَمْ يَلْغُ حَتَّى يَنْصَرِفَ الْإِمَامُ، كَانَ لَهُ بِكُلِّ خُطْوَةٍ يَخْطُوهَا كَعَمَلِ سَنَةٍ صِيَامِهَا وَقِيَامِهَا "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak, from Sadaqah ibn Khalid, from Yahya ibn al-Harith, from Abu al-Ash'ath al-San'ani, traced to Aws ibn Aws, traced to the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whoever washes [thoroughly] and performs ghusl on the day of Jumu'ah, then goes early and arrives at the beginning, then sits near the imam and listens attentively, and does not engage in idle talk until the imam finishes, will have, for every step he takes, the reward of a year's deeds - its fasting and its standing [in prayer]."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak ne Sadaqah ibn Khalid se, Yahya ibn al-Harith se, Abu al-Ash'ath al-San'ani se bataya, jo ise Aws ibn Aws tak, aur Aws Nabi ﷺ tak pahunchate hain: Aapne farmaya, "Jo Jumu'ah ke din [achhi tarah] naha-dho kar ghusl kare, fir jaldi jaaye aur shuru mein pahunche, fir imam ke qareeb baithe aur dhyan se sune, aur imam ke faarigh hone tak fuzool baatein na kare, uske liye har qadam ke badle ek saal ke roze aur qayam jitna ajr hoga."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا قُلْتَ لِصَاحِبِكَ : أَنْصِتْ وَالْإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ فَقَدْ لَغَوْتَ "
2.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If you say to your companion 'be silent' while the imam is giving the sermon, you have indeed engaged in idle talk."
2.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Abu al-Zinad se, al-A'raj se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Agar tum apne sathi se kaho 'khamosh raho' jabke imam khutba de raha ho, to tumne fuzool baat kar li."

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا قُلْتَ لِصَاحِبِكَ : أَنْصِتْ، وَالْإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ فَقَدْ لَغَوْتَ ".
أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، مِثْلَهُ
2.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id, from Abu Hurairah; a similar chain also via al-Mu'alla ibn Asad: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If you say to your companion 'be silent,' while the imam is giving the sermon, you have indeed engaged in idle talk." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from al-Mu'alla ibn Asad, from Wuhayb, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ, the like of it.]
2.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, al-Zuhri se, Sa'id se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Agar tum apne sathi se kaho 'khamosh raho,' jabke imam khutba de raha ho, to tumne fuzool baat kar li." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se al-Mu'alla ibn Asad se, Wuhayb se, Ma'mar se, al-Zuhri se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai.]

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدُكُمْ وَالْإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ أَوْ قَدْ خَرَجَ، فَلْيُصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ "
2.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Jabir ibn Abdullah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: I heard Jabir ibn Abdullah narrating, from the Prophet ﷺ: he said: "When one of you comes while the imam is giving the sermon, or has [already] come out, let him pray two rak'ahs."
2.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se, Amr ibn Dinar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Jabir ibn Abdullah ko Nabi ﷺ se yeh bayaan karte suna: Aapne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se koi aaye jabke imam khutba de raha ho, ya nikal chuka ho, to woh do rakat padhe."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا صَدَقَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ  ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : جَاءَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ   وَمَرْوَانُ يَخْطُبُ،" فَقَامَ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ، فَأَتَاهُ الْحَرَسُ يَمْنَعُونَهُ، فَقَالَ : مَا كُنْتُ أَتْرُكُهُمَا وَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَأْمُرُ بِهِمَا "
2.en: Narrated by Sadaqah, from Sufyan, from Ibn Ajlan, from Iyad ibn Abdullah, about Abu Sa'id: He said: Abu Sa'id came while Marwan was giving the sermon, "so he stood to pray two rak'ahs, so the guards came to him to prevent him, so he said: I would not leave them, for I have seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanding them."
2.hi: Sadaqah ne Sufyan se, Ibn Ajlan se, Iyad ibn Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abu Sa'id aaye jabke Marwan khutba de rahe the, "to woh do rakat padhne khade ho gaye, to unhein rokne ke liye pehredaar aaye, to unhone kaha: Main inhein nahi chhodunga, kyunki maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko in dono ka hukum dete dekha hai."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ الرَّبِيعِ هُوَ ابْنُ صَبِيحٍ الْبَصْرِيُّ  ، قَالَ : رَأَيْتُ الْحَسَنَ " يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَالْإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ ".
وَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ   : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدُكُمْ وَالْإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ، فَلْيُصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ يَتَجَوَّزُ فِيهِمَا ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : أَقُولُ بِهِ
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from al-Rabi' ibn Sabih al-Basri, about al-Hasan; with Abu Muhammad's confirmation: He said: I saw al-Hasan "pray two rak'ahs while the imam was giving the sermon." And al-Hasan said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you comes while the imam is giving the sermon, let him pray two light rak'ahs, making them brief." Abu Muhammad said: I hold to this.
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, al-Rabi' ibn Sabih al-Basri se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Hasan ko "do rakat padhte dekha jabke imam khutba de raha tha." Aur al-Hasan ne kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se koi aaye jabke imam khutba de raha ho, to woh do halki rakat padhe, unhein mukhtasar rakhte hue." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Main isi par amal karta hoon.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي خَالِدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : " خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمًافَقَرَأَ ص ، فَلَمَّا مَرَّ بِالسَّجْدَةِ نَزَلَ فَسَجَدَ "
2.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Khalid ibn Yazid, from Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal, from Iyad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave us a sermon one day, and recited 'Sad,' and when he passed the verse of prostration, he descended and prostrated."
2.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se, Khalid ibn Yazid se, Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal se, Iyad ibn Abdullah se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein ek din khutba diya, aur 'Sad' padhi, aur jab aayat-e-sajdah par pahunche, to utre aur sajda kiya."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، يَقُولُ : دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ الْمَسْجِدَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَخْطُبُ، قَالَ : " أَصَلَّيْتَ؟ قَالَ : لَا، قَالَ :" فَصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : أَقُولُ بِهِ
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Ibn Uyaynah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Jabir ibn Abdullah; with Abu Muhammad's confirmation: He said: I heard Jabir ibn Abdullah say: A man entered the mosque on the day of Jumu'ah while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was giving the sermon, he said: "Have you prayed?" He said, "No." He said: "Then pray two rak'ahs." Abu Muhammad said: I hold to this.
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Ibn Uyaynah se, Amr ibn Dinar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Jabir ibn Abdullah ko kehte suna: Ek aadmi Jumu'ah ke din masjid mein dakhil hua jabke Rasulullah ﷺ khutba de rahe the, aapne poocha: "Kya tumne namaz padh li?" Usne kaha, "Nahi." Aapne farmaya: "To do rakat padho." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Main isi par amal karta hoon.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْعَلَاءُ بْنُ عُصَيْمٍ الْجُعْفِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبْجَرَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أبْجَرَ  ، عَنْ وَاصِلِ بْنِ حَيَّانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ  ، قَالَ : خَطَبَنَا عَمَّارُ بْنُ يَاسِرٍ   فَأَبْلَغَ وَأَوْجَزَ، فَقُلْنَا : يَا أَبَا الْيَقْظَانِ، لَوْ كُنْتَ نَفَّسْتَ شَيْئًا؟ قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ : " إِنَّطُولَ صَلَاةِ الرَّجُلِ، وَقِصَرَ خُطْبَتِهِ مَئِنَّةٌ مِنْ فِقْهِهِ، فَأَطِيلُوا هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةَ، وَاقْصُرُوا هَذِهِ الْخُطَبَ، فَإِنَّ مِنْ الْبَيَانِ لَسِحْرًا "
2.en: Narrated by al-Ala ibn Usaym al-Ju'fi, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abd al-Malik ibn Abjar, from his father Abdullah ibn Abjar, from Wasil ibn Hayyan, from Abu Wa'il, about Ammar ibn Yasir: He said: Ammar ibn Yasir gave us a sermon and it was concise and effective, so we said: "O Abu al-Yaqzan, if only you had drawn it out a bit?" He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Indeed the length of a man's prayer, and the brevity of his sermon, is a sign of his understanding, so lengthen the prayer and shorten the sermons, for indeed some eloquence is [like] magic."
2.hi: Al-Ala ibn Usaym al-Ju'fi ne Abd al-Rahman ibn Abd al-Malik ibn Abjar se, apne walid Abdullah ibn Abjar se, Wasil ibn Hayyan se, Abu Wa'il se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ammar ibn Yasir ne humein khutba diya jo mukhtasar aur pur-asar tha, to humne kaha: "Ae Abu al-Yaqzan, kaash aap thoda lamba karte?" Unhone kaha: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Aadmi ki namaz ka lamba hona, aur uske khutbe ka mukhtasar hona, uski samajh ki nishaani hai, so namaz lambi karo aur khutbe mukhtasar rakho, kyunki kuch bayaan jadu jaisa hota hai."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ  ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ  ، قَالَ : " صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَكَانَتْصَلَاتُهُ قَصْدًا وَخُطْبَتُهُ قَصْدًا "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Simak, from Jabir ibn Samurah: He said: "I prayed with the Prophet ﷺ, and his prayer was moderate and his sermon was moderate."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Sa'id ne Abu al-Ahwas se, Simak se, Jabir ibn Samurah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Maine Nabi ﷺ ke saath namaz padhi, to aapki namaz miyaana thi aur aapka khutba bhi miyaana tha."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " كَانَيَخْطُبُ خُطْبَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ، وَكَانَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمَا بِجُلُوسٍ "
2.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "used to give two sermons while standing, and would separate between them by sitting."
2.hi: Musaddad ne Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "khade hokar do khutbay dete, aur inke darmiyan baith kar faasla karte."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ  ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ  ، قَالَ : " كَانَتْلِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خُطْبَتَانِ يَجْلِسُ بَيْنَهُمَا يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ وَيُذَكِّرُ النَّاسَ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Simak, from Jabir ibn Samurah: He said: "The Prophet ﷺ had two sermons, sitting between them, reciting the Qur'an and reminding the people."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Sa'id ne Abu al-Ahwas se, Simak se, Jabir ibn Samurah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Nabi ﷺ ke do khutbay hote, inke darmiyan baithte, Quran padhte aur logon ko naseehat karte."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُبَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنٌ  قَالَ : رَأَى عُمَارَةُ بْنُ رُوَيْبَةَ   بِشْرَ بْنَ مَرْوَانَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ رَافِعًا يَدَيْهِ، فَقَالَ : " قَبَّحَ اللَّهُ هَاتَيْنِ الْيَدَيْنِ، لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَعَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ، وَمَا يُشِيرُ إِلَّا بِإِصْبُعِهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Zubayd, from Husayn, about Umarah ibn Ruwaybah and Bishr ibn Marwan: He said: Umarah ibn Ruwaybah saw Bishr ibn Marwan on the pulpit raising his hands, so he said: "May Allah disfigure these two hands, I certainly saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the pulpit, and he did not gesture except with his finger."
2.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Zubayd se, Husayn se bataya: Unhone kaha, Umarah ibn Ruwaybah ne Bishr ibn Marwan ko mimbar par apne haath uthaate dekha, to unhone kaha: "Allah in dono haathon ko badsoorat kare, maine to Rasulullah ﷺ ko mimbar par dekha hai, aur aap sirf apni ungli se hi ishara karte the."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ حُصَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ رُوَيْبَةَ  ، قَالَ : رَأَى بِشْرَ بْنَ مَرْوَانَ رَافِعًا يَدَيْهِ يَدْعُو عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ، قَالَ : فَسَبَّهُ، وَقَالَ : " لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَعَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ وَمَا يَقُولُ بِأُصْبُعِهِ إِلَّا هَكَذَا، وَأَشَارَ بِالسَّبَّابَةِ عِنْدَ الْخَاصِرَةِ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Husayn ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Umarah ibn Ruwaybah: He said: He saw Bishr ibn Marwan raising his hands, supplicating on the pulpit on the day of Jumu'ah, he said: So he cursed him, and said: "I certainly saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the pulpit, and he only said [gestured] with his finger like this," and he gestured with the index finger near the waist.
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Husayn ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Umarah ibn Ruwaybah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Unhone Bishr ibn Marwan ko Jumu'ah ke din mimbar par apne haath uthaakar dua karte dekha, unhone bataya: To unhone use bura-bhala kaha, aur kaha: "Maine to Rasulullah ﷺ ko mimbar par dekha hai, aur aap sirf apni ungli se isi tarah ishara karte the," aur unhone shahaadat ki ungli se kamar ke qareeb ishara kiya.

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : " كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَيَقُومُ إِلَى جِذْعٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُجْعَلَ الْمِنْبَرُ، فَلَمَّا جُعِلَ الْمِنْبَرُ، حَنَّ ذَلِكَ الْجِذْعُ حَتَّى سَمِعْنَا حَنِينَهُ، فَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَدَهُ عَلَيْهِ، فَسَكَنَ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir, from Sulayman ibn Kathir, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Jabir ibn Abdullah: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to stand by a palm trunk before the pulpit was made, so when the pulpit was made, that trunk yearned/moaned until we heard its moaning, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ placed his hand on it, and it calmed down."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir ne Sulayman ibn Kathir se, al-Zuhri se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se, Jabir ibn Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Mimbar banaaye jaane se pehle Rasulullah ﷺ khajoor ke ek tane ke paas khade hua karte the, so jab mimbar banaya gaya, to woh tana isqadar tarpa ke humne uski aah suni, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne apna haath uspar rakha, to woh shaant ho gaya."

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَيَخْطُبُ إِلَى جِذْعٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ الْمِنْبَرَ، فَلَمَّا اتَّخَذَ الْمِنْبَرَ، تَحَوَّلَ إِلَيْهِ، حَنَّ الْجِذْعُ فَاحْتَضَنَهُ فَسَكَنَ، وَقَالَ : " لَوْ لَمْ أَحْتَضِنْهُ، لَحَنَّ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ".
حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ   ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، مِثْلَهُ
2.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ammar ibn Abi Ammar, from Ibn Abbas; a similar chain also via Hajjaj, from Hammad, from Thabit, from Anas: That the Prophet ﷺ used to give sermons by a palm trunk before he took the pulpit, so when he took the pulpit, he moved to it, the trunk moaned, so he embraced it and it calmed down, and he said: "Had I not embraced it, it would have moaned until the Day of Resurrection." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Hajjaj, from Hammad, from Thabit, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, the like of it.]
2.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ammar ibn Abi Ammar se, Ibn Abbas se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ mimbar banaane se pehle khajoor ke ek tane ke paas khutba dete the, so jab aapne mimbar banaya, to us taraf mud gaye, tane ne aah bhari to aapne use apne seene se lagaaya, to woh shaant ho gaya, aur farmaya: "Agar main use na lagaata, to yeh Qayamat tak aah bharta rehta." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Hajjaj se, Hammad se, Thabit se, Anas se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai.]

2.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ  ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، قَالَ : لَمَّا كَثُرَ النَّاسُ بِالْمَدِينَةِ ، جَعَلَ الرَّجُلُ يَجِيءُ وَالْقَوْمُ يَجِيئُونَ فَلَا يَكَادُونَ أَنْ يَسْمَعُونَ كَلَامَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَتَّى يَرْجِعُوا مِنْ عِنْدِهِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّاسُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ كَثُرُوا، وَإِنَّ الْجَائِيَ يَجِيءُ فَلَا يَكَادُ يَسْمَعُ كَلَامَكَ.
قَالَ : " فَمَا شِئْتُمْ "، فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَى غُلَامٍ لِامْرَأَةٍ مِنْ الْأَنْصَارِ، نَجَّارٍ، وَإِلَى طَرْفَاءِ الْغَابَةِ، فَجَعَلُوا لَهُ مِرْقَاتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلَاثَةً، فَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يَجْلِسُ عَلَيْهِ وَيَخْطُبُ عَلَيْهِ، فَلَمَّا فَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ حَنَّتِ الْخَشَبَةُ الَّتِي كَانَ يَقُومُ عِنْدَهَا، فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَيْهَا فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا، فَسَكَنَتْ "
2.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid, from al-Mas'udi, from Abu Hazim, from Sahl ibn Sa'd: He said: When the people at Madinah increased [in number], a man would come, and the people would come, but they could hardly hear the speech of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ before they returned from him, so the people said to him: "O Messenger of Allah, indeed the people have increased, and the one coming can hardly hear your speech." He said: "What do you wish?" So a message was sent to a young man of a woman of the Ansar, a carpenter, and to the tamarisk of the forest, so they made for him two or three steps, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "used to sit on it and give the sermon on it, so when they did that, the wood by which he used to stand moaned, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood toward it and placed his hand on it, and it calmed down."
2.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid ne al-Mas'udi se, Abu Hazim se, Sahl ibn Sa'd se bataya: Unhone kaha, Jab Madinah mein log zyada ho gaye, to koi aadmi aata, aur log aate lekin Rasulullah ﷺ ki baat mushkil se hi sun paate is se pehle ke woh aapke paas se wapas jaayein, to logon ne aapse kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, log zyada ho gaye hain, aur aane wala mushkil se hi aapki baat sun paata hai." Aapne farmaya: "Tum kya chahte ho?" So Ansar ki ek aurat ke bete, jo ek badhai tha, ke paas aur jangal ki jhaau ki lakdi ke paas paigham bheja gaya, so unhone aapke liye do ya teen sidhiyaan banayin, aur Rasulullah ﷺ "uspar baithte aur khutba dete, so jab unhone yeh kiya, to woh lakdi jiske paas aap khade hote the, aah bharne lagi, to Rasulullah ﷺ uski taraf khade hue aur apna haath uspar rakha, to woh shaant ho gayi."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ ضَمْرَةَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الْمَازِنِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ  ، أَنَّ الضَّحَّاكَ بْنَ قَيْسٍ سَأَلَ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرٍ الْأَنْصَارِيّ   :" مَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقْرَأُ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ عَلَى إِثْرِ سُورَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ ؟ قَالَ : هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ "
2.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Damrah ibn Sa'id al-Mazini, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah, about al-Dahhak ibn Qays and al-Nu'man ibn Bashir al-Ansari: That al-Dahhak ibn Qays asked al-Nu'man ibn Bashir al-Ansari: "What did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ recite on the day of Jumu'ah following Surah al-Jumu'ah?" He said: "'Has there come to you the narration of the Overwhelming' [Surah al-Ghashiyah]."
2.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Damrah ibn Sa'id al-Mazini se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah se bataya ke al-Dahhak ibn Qays ne al-Nu'man ibn Bashir al-Ansari se poocha: "Rasulullah ﷺ Jumu'ah ke din Surah Al-Jumu'ah ke baad kya padhte the?" Unhone kaha: "'Hal ataaka hadithul-Ghaashiyah' [Surah Al-Ghashiyah]."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُوَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ ضَمْرَةَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الْمَازِنِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ  ، عَنْ الضَّحَّاكِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ الْفِهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْنَاهُ :" مَا كَانَ يَقْرَأُ بِهِمْ النَّبِيُّ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ مَعَ السُّورَةِ الَّتِي ذُكِرَتْ فِيهَا الْجُمُعَةُ؟ قَالَ : كَانَ يَقْرَأُ مَعَهَا هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ "
2.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Aban, from Abu Uways, from Damrah ibn Sa'id al-Mazini, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah, from al-Dahhak ibn Qays al-Fihri, from al-Nu'man ibn Bashir al-Ansari: He said: We asked him: "What did the Prophet recite for them on the day of Jumu'ah along with the surah in which Jumu'ah is mentioned?" He said: "He used to recite with it 'Has there come to you the narration of the Overwhelming.'"
2.hi: Isma'il ibn Aban ne Abu Uways se, Damrah ibn Sa'id al-Mazini se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah se, al-Dahhak ibn Qays al-Fihri se, al-Nu'man ibn Bashir al-Ansari se bataya: Unhone kaha, Humne unse poocha: "Nabi Jumu'ah ke din unhein us surah ke saath jismein Jumu'ah ka zikr hai kya padhaate the?" Unhone kaha: "Aap iske saath 'Hal ataaka hadithul-Ghaashiyah' padhte the."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ  ، قَالَ : " كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَيَقْرَأُ فِي الْعِيدَيْنِ وَالْجُمُعَةِ ب سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى وَهَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ، وَرُبَّمَا اجْتَمَعَا فَقَرَأَ بِهِمَا "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad ibn al-Muntashir, from his father, from Habib ibn Salim, from al-Nu'man ibn Bashir: He said: "The Prophet ﷺ used to recite in the two Eids and Jumu'ah 'Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High' and 'Has there come to you the narration of the Overwhelming,' and sometimes both fell together, so he recited both of them."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Ibrahim ibn Muhammad ibn al-Muntashir se, apne walid se, Habib ibn Salim se, al-Nu'man ibn Bashir se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Nabi ﷺ dono Eidon aur Jumu'ah mein 'Sabbihisma Rabbikal-A'la' aur 'Hal ataaka hadithul-Ghaashiyah' padhte the, aur kabhi-kabhi dono ek saath aa jaate, to aap dono padhte."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ مَخْلَدِ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : الْتَقَيْتُ أَنَا وَكَعْبٌ، فَجَعَلْتُ أُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَجَعَلَ يُحَدِّثُنِي عَنْ التَّوْرَاةِ، حَتَّى أَتَيْنَا عَلَى ذِكْرِ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ.
فَقُلْتُ : إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ : " إِنَّفِيهَا لَسَاعَةً لَا يُوَافِقُهَا عَبْدٌ مُسْلِمٌ يُصَلِّي يَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ فِيهَا خَيْرًا، إِلَّا أَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir, from Makhlad ibn Husayn, from Hisham, from Ibn Sirin, from Abu Hurairah, about Ka'b: He said: I met Ka'b, and I began narrating from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he began narrating to me from the Torah, until we came to mention the day of Jumu'ah. So I said: Indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed in it there is a moment which no Muslim servant coincides with, praying, asking Allah for good therein, except that He gives it to him."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir ne Makhlad ibn Husayn se, Hisham se, Ibn Sirin se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Meri mulaqaat Ka'b se hui, to main Rasulullah ﷺ se riwayatein bayaan karne laga, aur woh mujhse Taurat se bayaan karne lage, yahan tak ke hum Jumu'ah ke din ke zikr par aaye. To maine kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Ismein ek aisi ghadi hai jismein koi Musalman banda namaz mein ho aur Allah se koi bhalaai maange, magar Allah use woh ata karega."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ سَلَّامٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ سَلَّامٍ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا سَلَّامٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مِينَا  ،  أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ  حَدَّثَهُ وَأَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ   ، أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ وَهُوَ عَلَى أَعْوَادِ مِنْبَرِهِ :" لَيَنْتَهِيَنَّ أَقْوَامٌ عَنْ وَدَعِهِمْ الْجُمُعَاتِ، أَوْ لَيَخْتِمَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ، ثُمَّ لَيَكُونُنَّ مِنْ الْغَافِلِينَ "
2.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Mu'awiyah ibn Sallam, from Zayd ibn Sallam, from Abu Sallam, from al-Hakam ibn Mina, from Ibn Umar and Abu Hurairah: That Ibn Umar narrated to him, and Abu Hurairah: that the two of them heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, while he was on the planks of his pulpit: "Let peoples surely cease their leaving off of the Jumu'ah prayers, or Allah will surely seal their hearts, then they will surely be of the heedless."
2.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Mu'awiyah ibn Sallam se, Zayd ibn Sallam se, Abu Sallam se, al-Hakam ibn Mina se bataya ke Ibn Umar ne unhein bataya, aur Abu Hurairah ne bhi, ke un dono ne Rasulullah ﷺ ko apne mimbar ke takhton par farmaate suna: "Log Jumu'ah ki namazein chhodna zaroor band kar dein, warna Allah unke dilon par zaroor mohar laga dega, fir woh zaroor ghaafil ho jaayenge."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ الضَّمْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ تَرَكَ الْجُمُعَةَ تَهَاوُنًا بِهَا، طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلَى قَلْبِهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abidah ibn Sufyan, from Abu al-Ja'd al-Damri: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever leaves the Jumu'ah out of negligence toward it, Allah seals his heart."
2.hi: Ya'la ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abidah ibn Sufyan se, Abu al-Ja'd al-Damri se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo Jumu'ah ko sustee ki wajah se chhode, Allah uske dil par mohar laga deta hai."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَشْعَثِ الصَّنْعَانِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَوْسِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " إِنَّأَفْضَلَ أَيَّامِكُمْ يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ : فِيهِ خُلِقَ آدَمُ ، وَفِيهِ النَّفْخَةُ، وَفِيهِ الصَّعْقَةُ، فَأَكْثِرُوا عَلَيَّ مِنْ الصَّلَاةِ فِيهِ، فَإِنَّ صَلَاتَكُمْ مَعْرُوضَةٌ عَلَيَّ "
2.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Ali, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid ibn Jabir, from Abu al-Ash'ath al-San'ani, from Aws ibn Aws: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed the best of your days is the day of Jumu'ah: in it Adam was created, and in it is the Blast [of the Trumpet], and in it is the Swoon, so send abundant blessings upon me in it, for indeed your blessings are presented to me."
2.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne al-Husayn ibn Ali se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid ibn Jabir se, Abu al-Ash'ath al-San'ani se, Aws ibn Aws se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tumhare dinon mein sabse behtar din Jumu'ah ka din hai: isi din Aadam paida kiye gaye, aur isi din soor phoonka jaayega, aur isi din behoshi (maut) aayegi, so is din mujh par kasrat se durood bhejo, kyunki tumhara durood mujh par pesh kiya jaata hai."

2.ar:
قَالَ رَجُلٌ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، كَيْفَ تُعْرَضُ صَلَاتُنَا عَلَيْكَ وَقَدْ أَرَمْتَ؟ يَعْنِي : بَلِيتَ.
قَالَ : " إِنَّاللَّهَ حَرَّمَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ أَنْ تَأْكُلَ أَجْسَادَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ "
2.en: Continuing the same narration [Aws ibn Aws]: A man said: "O Messenger of Allah, how are our blessings presented to you when you will have decayed?" - meaning: worn away. He said: "Indeed Allah has forbidden the earth to consume the bodies of the prophets."
2.hi: Ek aadmi ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, humara durood aap par kaise pesh kiya jaayega jabke aap [zameen mein] gal chuke honge?" - yaani, boseeda ho chuke honge. Aapne farmaya: "Allah ne zameen par yeh haraam kar diya hai ke woh Ambiya ke jismon ko khaaye."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " كَانَيُصَلِّي بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فِي بَيْتِهِ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That the Prophet ﷺ "used to pray two rak'ahs after Jumu'ah in his house."
2.hi: Abu Asim ne Malik se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ "Jumu'ah ke baad apne ghar mein do rakat padhte the."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو يَعْنِي : ابْنَ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " كَانَيُصَلِّي بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ "
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf, from Sufyan, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim, from his father: That the Prophet ﷺ "used to pray two rak'ahs after Jumu'ah."
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf ne Sufyan se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Ibn Shihab se, Salim se, apne walid se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ "Jumu'ah ke baad do rakat padhte the."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ كَانَ مِنْكُمْ مُصَلِّيًا بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ، فَلْيُصَلِّ بَعْدَهَا أَرْبَعًا ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : أُصَلِّي بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ أَوْ أَرْبَعًا
2.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Suhayl ibn Abi Salih, from his father, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ; with Abu Muhammad's practice: He said: "Whoever among you is going to pray after Jumu'ah, let him pray four after it." Abu Muhammad said: I pray two or four rak'ahs after Jumu'ah.
2.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Suhayl ibn Abi Salih se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jo tum mein se Jumu'ah ke baad namaz padhna chaahe, to woh iske baad chaar padhe." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Main Jumu'ah ke baad do ya chaar rakat padhta hoon.

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ هُوَ ابْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ الزَّوْفِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي مُرَّةَ الزَّوْفِيِّ  ، عَنْ خَارِجَةَ بْنِ حُذَافَةَ الْعَدَوِيِّ  ، قَالَ : خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : " إِنَّاللَّهَ قَدْ أَمَدَّكُمْ بِصَلَاةٍ هِيَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ مِنْ حُمْرِ النَّعَمِ، جَعَلَهُ لَكُمْ فِيمَا بَيْنَ صَلَاةِ الْعِشَاءِ إِلَى أَنْ يَطْلُعَ الْفَجْرُ "
2.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Layth ibn Sa'd, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Abdullah ibn Rashid al-Zawfi, from Abdullah ibn Abi Murrah al-Zawfi, from Kharijah ibn Hudhafah al-Adawi: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to us, and said: "Indeed Allah has supplied you with a prayer which is better for you than red camels, He has made it for you between the Isha prayer and the breaking of dawn."
2.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Layth ibn Sa'd se, Yazid ibn Abi Habib se, Abdullah ibn Rashid al-Zawfi se, Abdullah ibn Abi Murrah al-Zawfi se, Kharijah ibn Hudhafah al-Adawi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ humare paas nikle, aur farmaya, "Allah ne tumhein ek namaz se madad di hai jo tumhare liye surkh oonton se behtar hai, usne ise tumhare liye Isha ki namaz aur subah saadiq ke darmiyan rakha hai" - [yaani, witr].

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ  ، أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ  أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّ ابْنَ مُحَيْرِيزٍ الْقُرَشِيَّ ثُمَّ الْجُمَحِيَّ  أَخْبَرَهُ وَكَانَ يَسْكُنُ بِالشَّامِ ، وَكَانَ أَدْرَكَ مُعَاوِيَةَ ، أَنَّ الْمُخْدَجِيَّ  رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي كِنَانَةَ أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ الشَّامِ ، وَكَانَتْ لَهُ صُحْبَةٌ، يُكْنَى أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ : أَنَّ الْوِتْرَ وَاجِبٌ، فَرَاحَ الْمُخْدَجِيُّ إِلَى عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ.
فَقَالَ عُبَادَةُ   : كَذَبَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ، سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ :" خَمْسُ صَلَوَاتٍ كَتَبَهُنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَى الْعِبَادِ، مَنْ أَتَى بِهِنَّ لَمْ يُضَيِّعْ مِنْ حَقِّهِنَّ شَيْئًا اسْتِخْفَافًا بِحَقِّهِنَّ، كَانَ لَهُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ عَهْدٌ أَنْ يُدْخِلَهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَأْتِ بِهِنَّ، جَاءَ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ عَهْدٌ إِنْ شَاءَ عَذَّبَهُ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ، أَدْخَلَهُ الْجَنَّةَ "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Ansari, from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban, from Ibn Muhayriz al-Qurashi al-Jumahi, from al-Mukhdaji, about Ubadah ibn al-Samit: That Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban informed him, that Ibn Muhayriz al-Qurashi, then al-Jumahi, informed him - and he lived in Sham, and had met Mu'awiyah - that al-Mukhdaji, a man from Banu Kinanah, informed him, that a man from Sham, who had companionship [with the Prophet], known by the kunyah Abu Muhammad, informed him: that witr is obligatory, so al-Mukhdaji went to Ubadah ibn al-Samit and mentioned that to him. So Ubadah said: "Abu Muhammad has lied. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Five prayers which Allah has written upon the servants; whoever comes with them, not neglecting anything of their right out of contempt for their right, has with Allah a covenant that He will admit him to Paradise; and whoever does not come with them, comes and has no covenant with Allah - if He wills, He punishes him, and if He wills, He admits him to Paradise.'"
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Ansari se bataya ke unhein Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban ne bataya, ke unhein Ibn Muhayriz al-Qurashi, phir al-Jumahi ne bataya - aur woh Sham mein rehte the, aur unhone Mu'awiyah ko paaya tha - ke al-Mukhdaji, Banu Kinanah ke ek shakhs, ne unhein bataya, ke Sham ke ek shakhs ne, jinki sohbat (Nabi se) thi aur jinki kunyat Abu Muhammad thi, unhein bataya: ke witr farz hai, so al-Mukhdaji Ubadah ibn al-Samit ke paas gaye aur yeh unhein bataya. To Ubadah ne kaha: "Abu Muhammad ne jhoot kaha. Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna: 'Paanch namazein jo Allah ne bandon par likh di hain; jo unhein ada kare, aur unke haq mein se kuch bhi kami na kare unke haq ko halka samajhte hue, uske liye Allah ke paas ahad hai ke woh use Jannat mein dakhil karega; aur jo unhein ada na kare, woh aayega aur uska Allah ke paas koi ahad nahi hoga - agar Allah chahe to use azaab de, aur agar chahe to Jannat mein dakhil kar de.'"

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سُهَيْلٍ نَافِعِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، أَنَّ أَعْرَابِيًّا جَاءَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ثَائِرَ الرَّأْسِ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَاذَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ مِنْ الصَّلَاةِ؟ قَالَ :" الصَّلَوَاتِ الْخَمْسَ، وَالصِّيَامَ "، فَأَخْبَرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِشَرَائِعِ الْإِسْلَامِ، فَقَالَ : وَالَّذِي أَكْرَمَكَ لَا أَتَطَوَّعُ شَيْئًا، وَلَا أَنْقُصُ مِمَّا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ.
فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَفْلَحَ وَأَبِيهِ إِنْ صَدَقَ، أَوْ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَبِيهِ إِنْ صَدَقَ "
2.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Isma'il ibn Ja'far, from Abu Suhayl Nafi' ibn Malik, from his father, from Talhah ibn Ubaydullah: That a Bedouin came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, his hair disheveled, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, what has Allah made obligatory upon me of prayer?" He said: "The five prayers, and the fasting" - so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ informed him of the laws of Islam. So he said: "By the One who has honored you, I will not do anything voluntary, nor will I diminish from what Allah has made obligatory upon me." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "He has succeeded, by his father, if he speaks the truth, or he has entered Paradise, by his father, if he speaks the truth."
2.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Isma'il ibn Ja'far se, Abu Suhayl Nafi' ibn Malik se, apne walid se, Talhah ibn Ubaydullah se bataya ke ek Bedouin, apne bikhre baalon ke saath, Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, Allah ne mujhpar namaz mein se kya farz kiya hai?" Aapne farmaya: "Paanch namazein, aur roza" - so Rasulullah ﷺ ne use Islam ke ahkaam bataaye. To usne kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko izzat di, main na koi nafl karunga, na jo Allah ne mujhpar farz kiya hai usmein kami karunga." To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Yeh kaamyaab ho gaya, uske baap ki qasam, agar isne sach kaha, ya yeh Jannat mein dakhil ho gaya, uske baap ki qasam, agar isne sach kaha."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَاصِمَ بْنَ ضَمْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَلِيًّا  ، يَقُولُ : " إِنَّالْوِتْرَ لَيْسَ بِحَتْمٍ كَالصَّلَاةِ، وَلَكِنَّهُ سُنَّةٌ، فَلَا تَدَعُوهُ "
2.en: Narrated by Affan, from Shu'bah, from Abu Ishaq, from Asim ibn Damrah, from Ali: He said: I heard Asim ibn Damrah, he said: I heard Ali say: "Indeed witr is not an absolute obligation like the [obligatory] prayer, but it is a sunnah, so do not abandon it."
2.hi: Affan ne Shu'bah se, Abu Ishaq se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Asim ibn Damrah ko suna, unhone kaha: Maine Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko kehte suna: "Witr farz namaz ki tarah lazmi nahi hai, lekin yeh sunnat hai, so ise mat chhodo."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ هِقْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : " إِنَّاللَّهَ وِتْرٌ يُحِبُّ الْوِتْرَ "
2.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Musa, from Hiql ibn Ziyad, from Hisham, from Ibn Sirin, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Indeed Allah is witr [odd/One], He loves the witr [the odd number]."
2.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Musa ne Hiql ibn Ziyad se, Hisham se, Ibn Sirin se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Allah Witr (yaani, Yakta, Ek) hai, woh taaq [tadaad] ko pasand karta hai."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهَا، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " كَانَتْصَلَاتُهُ مِنْ اللَّيْلِ ثَلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً، يُوتِرُ مِنْهَا بِخَمْسٍ، لَا يَجْلِسُ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنْ الْخَمْسِ حَتَّى يَجْلِسَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ، فَيُسَلِّمَ "
2.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, "his prayer at night was thirteen rak'ahs, making witr from them with five, not sitting in any of the five until he sat in the last, and gave the taslim."
2.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Hisham se, apne walid se, Aisha رضي الله عنها se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ki "raat ki namaz terah rakat hoti thi, inmein se paanch se witr karte, in paanch mein se kisi mein bhi na baithte jab tak aakhri mein na baithte, fir salaam phertay."

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُ قَالَ : قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَوْتِرْ بِخَمْسٍ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَسْتَطِعْ فَبِثَلَاثٍ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَسْتَطِعْ، فَبِوَاحِدَةٍ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَسْتَطِعْ فَأَوْمِئْ إِيمَاءً ".
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، نَحْوَهُ
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Sufyan ibn Husayn, from al-Zuhri, from Ata ibn Yazid al-Laythi, from Abu Ayyub al-Ansari رضي الله عنه; a similar chain also via Muhammad ibn Yusuf: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: "Perform witr with five, and if you are not able, then with three, and if you are not able, then with one, and if you are not able, then gesture with a gesture." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from al-Awza'i, from al-Zuhri, from Ata ibn Yazid al-Laythi, from Abu Ayyub al-Ansari رضي الله عنه, from the Prophet ﷺ.]
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Sufyan ibn Husayn se, al-Zuhri se, Ata ibn Yazid al-Laythi se, Abu Ayyub al-Ansari رضي الله عنه se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhse farmaya: "Paanch se witr karo, agar na kar sako to teen se, agar na kar sako to ek se, agar na kar sako to ishara karke [kar lo]." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Muhammad ibn Yusuf se, al-Awza'i se, al-Zuhri se, Ata ibn Yazid al-Laythi se, Abu Ayyub al-Ansari رضي الله عنه se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai.]

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ صَلَاةِ اللَّيْلِ، فَقَالَ :" مَثْنَى مَثْنَى، فَإِذَا خَشِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ الصُّبْحَ، فَلْيُصَلِّ رَكْعَةً وَاحِدَةً تُوتِرُ، مَا قَدْ صَلَّى ".
 قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ : تَأْخُذُ بِهِ؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ
2.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar; with Abu Muhammad's confirmation: He said: A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about the night prayer, so he said: "Two by two, and when one of you fears the dawn, let him pray a single rak'ah, making witr what he has prayed." It was said to Abu Muhammad: "Do you hold to this?" He said, "Yes."
2.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi ne Rasulullah ﷺ se raat ki namaz ke baare mein poocha, to aapne farmaya: "Do-do rakat, aur jab tum mein se kisi ko subah aane ka khauf ho, to woh ek rakat padh le, jo padh chuka hai use witr banaate hue." Abu Muhammad se poocha gaya: "Kya aap isi ke qaail hain?" Unhone kaha, "Haan."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يُصَلِّي مَا بَيْنَ الْعِشَاءِ إِلَى الْفَجْرِ إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً، يُسَلِّمُ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَيُوتِرُ بِوَاحِدَةٍ "
2.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to "pray between Isha and Fajr eleven rak'ahs, giving the taslim after every two, and making witr with one."
2.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Ibn Abi Dhi'b se, al-Zuhri se, Urwah se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ "Isha aur Fajr ke darmiyan gyaarah rakat padhte, har do par salaam phertay, aur ek se witr karte."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : " كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَيُوتِرُ بِثَلَاثٍ : بِ سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى وَقُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ وَقُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ "
2.en: Narrated by Malik ibn Isma'il, from Isra'il, from Abu Ishaq, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "The Prophet ﷺ used to perform witr with three: with 'Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High,' and 'Say: O disbelievers,' and 'Say: He is Allah, One.'"
2.hi: Malik ibn Isma'il ne Isra'il se, Abu Ishaq se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Nabi ﷺ teen [rakat] se witr karte: 'Sabbihisma Rabbikal-A'la,' aur 'Qul yaa ayyuhal-kaafiroon,' aur 'Qul huwallahu Ahad' padh kar."

2.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا قَبِيصَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ وَثَّابٍ  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : " فِي كُلِّ اللَّيْلِ قَدْأَوْتَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَانْتَهَى وِتْرُهُ إِلَى السَّحَرِ "
2.en: Narrated by Qabisah, from Sufyan, from Abu Hasin, from Yahya ibn Wathab, from Masruq, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: She said: "Every night the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has indeed performed witr, and his witr ended at the pre-dawn [time]."
2.hi: Qabisah ne Sufyan se, Abu Hasin se, Yahya ibn Wathab se, Masruq se, Aisha رضي الله عنها se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Har raat Rasulullah ﷺ zaroor witr karte, aur aapka witr sahar (subah se pehle) tak khatam ho jaata."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْعَطَّارُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو نَضْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيّ   حَدَّثَهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ سُئِلَ عَنْ الْوِتْرِ، فَقَالَ :" أَوْتِرُوا قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ "
2.en: Narrated by Affan, from Aban ibn Yazid al-Attar, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: That Abu Sa'id al-Khudri narrated to him, that the Messenger of Allah was asked about witr, so he said: "Perform witr before dawn."
2.hi: Affan ne Aban ibn Yazid al-Attar se, Yahya ibn Abi Kathir se, Abu Nadrah se bataya ke Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ne unhein bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ se witr ke baare mein poocha gaya, to aapne farmaya: "Subah se pehle witr kar lo."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : " كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَيُوتِرُ بِثَلَاثٍ : يَقْرَأُ فِي الْأُولَى بِسَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى، وَفِي الثَّانِيَةِ بِقُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ، وَفِي الثَّالِثَةِ بِقُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ "
2.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Usamah, from Zakariya, from Abu Ishaq, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "The Prophet ﷺ used to perform witr with three: he would recite in the first with 'Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High,' and in the second with 'Say: O disbelievers,' and in the third with 'Say: He is Allah, One.'"
2.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Usamah se, Zakariya se, Abu Ishaq se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Nabi ﷺ teen [rakat] se witr karte: pehli mein 'Sabbihisma Rabbikal-A'la' padhte, aur doosri mein 'Qul yaa ayyuhal-kaafiroon,' aur teesri mein 'Qul huwallahu Ahad.'"

2.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " كَانَيُوتِرُ عَلَى الْبَعِيرِ ".
قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ : تَقُولُ بِهِ؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ
2.en: Narrated by Marwan ibn Muhammad, from Malik, from Abu Bakr ibn Umar, from Sa'id ibn Yasar, from Ibn Umar; with Abu Muhammad's confirmation: That the Prophet ﷺ "used to perform witr on the camel." It was said to Abu Muhammad: "Do you hold this view?" He said, "Yes."
2.hi: Marwan ibn Muhammad ne Malik se, Abu Bakr ibn Umar se, Sa'id ibn Yasar se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ "oont par witr kar lete the." Abu Muhammad se poocha gaya: "Kya aap isi ke qaail hain?" Unhone kaha, "Haan."

2.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْحَوْرَاءِ السَّعْدِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ   : مَا تَذْكُرُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟ قَالَ : " حَمَلَنِي عَلَى عَاتِقِهِ، فَأَخَذْتُ تَمْرَةً مِنْ تَمْرِ الصَّدَقَةِ، فَأَدْخَلْتُهَا فِي فَمِي، فَقَالَ لِي : " أَلْقِهَا، أَمَا شَعَرْتَأَنَّا لَا تَحِلُّ لَنَا الصَّدَقَةُ؟ "
2.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Shu'bah, from Burayd ibn Abi Maryam, from Abu al-Hawra al-Sa'di, about al-Hasan ibn Ali: He said: I said to al-Hasan ibn Ali: "What do you remember from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" He said: "He carried me on his shoulder, so I took a date from the dates of charity, and put it in my mouth, so he said to me: 'Spit it out, did you not know that charity is not lawful for us?'"
2.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Shu'bah se, Burayd ibn Abi Maryam se, Abu al-Hawra al-Sa'di se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Hasan ibn Ali (Alayhis Salam) se poocha: "Aapko Rasulullah ﷺ se kya yaad hai?" Unhone kaha: "Aapne mujhe apne kandhe par uthaya, to maine sadqe ki khajooron mein se ek khajoor li, aur use apne muh mein daala, to aapne mujhse farmaya: 'Ise phenk do, kya tumhein nahi pata ke humare liye sadqa halal nahi hai?'"

2.ar:
قَالَ : وَكَانَ يَدْعُو بِهَذَا الدُّعَاءِ :" اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ، إِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ، وَإِنَّهُ لَا يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ، تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ ".
أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْحَوْرَاءِ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : عَلَّمَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَلِمَاتٍ أَقُولُهُنَّ فِي الْقُنُوتِ، فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ
