3.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from Sulayman, from Abu Wa'il, from Amr ibn al-Harith, from Zaynab, wife of Abdullah: That she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O assembly of women, give charity, even from your jewelry."
3.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Sulayman ne mujhe bataya, unhone kaha: Maine Abu Wa'il ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Amr ibn al-Harith se, Zaynab, Abdullah ki biwi, se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Ae auraton ki jama'at, sadqa do, chahe apne zewaraat mein se hi ho."

3.ar: وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ خَفِيفَ ذَاتِ الْيَدِ، فَجِئْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَسْأَلُهُ، فَوَافَقَتْ زَيْنَبَ ، امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ الْأَنْصَارِ، تَسْأَلُ عَمَّا أَسْأَلُ عَنْهُ، فَقُلْتُ لِبِلَالٍ : سَلْ لِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَيْنَ أَضَعُ صَدَقَتِي؟ : عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَوْ فِي قَرَابَتِي؟ فَسَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ : أَيُّ الزَّيَانِبِ؟ فَقَالَ : امْرَأَةُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ :" لَهَا أَجْرَانِ، أَجْرُ الْقَرَابَةِ، وَأَجْرُ الصَّدَقَةِ "
3.en: Continuing the same narration [Zaynab]: And Abdullah was light of hand [poor], so I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to ask him, and Zaynab, a woman from the Ansar, coincided [in her arrival], asking about the same thing I was asking about, so I said to Bilal: "Ask the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for me: where do I place my charity? On Abdullah, or on my relatives?" So he asked the Prophet ﷺ, so he said: "Which Zaynab?" He said: "The wife of Abdullah." So he said: "She has two rewards: the reward of kinship, and the reward of charity."
3.hi: Aur Abdullah [ki jeb] halki thi [maali tangi thi], so main Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas poochne aayi, aur mujhse Zaynab, Ansar ki ek aurat, milin, jo bhi yehi poochne aayi thi jo main poochne aayi thi, so maine Bilal se kaha: "Rasulullah ﷺ se mere liye poocho: main apna sadqa kahan rakhun? Abdullah par, ya apne rishtedaron par?" So unhone Nabi ﷺ se poocha, to aapne farmaya: "Konsi Zaynab?" Unhone kaha: "Abdullah ki biwi." To aapne farmaya: "Uske liye do ajr hain: rishtedaari ka ajr, aur sadqe ka ajr."

3.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ إِسْحَاق بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ أَكْثَرَ أَنْصَارِيٍّ بِالْمَدِينَةِ مَالًا نَخْلًا، وَكَانَتْ أَحَبَّ أَمْوَالِهِ إِلَيْهِ بَيْرُحَاءُ ، وَكَانَتْ مُسْتَقْبِلَةَ الْمَسْجِدِ، وَكَانَ يَعْنِي النَّبِي صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَدْخُلُهَا وَيَشْرَبُ مِنْ مَاءٍ فِيهَا طَيِّبٌ.
فَقَالَ أَنَسٌ : فَلَمَّا أُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ : # لَنْ تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتَّى تُنْفِقُوا مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ وَمَا تُنْفِقُوا مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بِهِ عَلِيمٌ سورة آل عمران آية 92 #، قَالَ : إِنَّ أَحَبَّ أَمْوَالِي إِلَيَّ بَيْرُحَاءُ ، وَإِنَّهَا صَدَقَةٌ للَّهِ أَرْجُو بِرَّهَا وَذُخْرَهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ، فَضَعْهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ حَيْثُ شِئْتَ.
فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" بَخٍ ذَلِكَ مَالٌ رَابِحٌ أَوْ رَائِحٌ، وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ مَا قُلْتَ فِيهِ، وَإِنِّي أَرَى أَنْ تَجْعَلَهُ فِي الْأَقْرَبِينَ ".
فَقَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ : أَفْعَلُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَقَسَّمَهُ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ فِي قَرَابَةِ بَنِي عَمِّهِ
3.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Malik, from Ishaq ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah, from Anas: He said: Abu Talhah was the wealthiest of the Ansar in Madinah in palm-tree property, and the most beloved of his properties to him was Bayrha, and it was facing the mosque, and the Prophet ﷺ used to enter it and drink from water in it that was good. So Anas said: So when this verse was revealed: "You will never attain righteousness until you spend from that which you love, and whatever you spend of anything, indeed Allah is Knowing of it" [Surah Ali Imran, verse 92], he said: "The most beloved of my properties to me is Bayrha, and it is a charity for Allah, I hope for its righteousness and its reserve with Allah, so place it, O Messenger of Allah, wherever you wish." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Bakh! That is profitable wealth, or wealth that returns [reward], and I have heard what you said about it, and indeed I see that you should place it among your near relatives." So Abu Talhah said: "I will do so, O Messenger of Allah," so Abu Talhah distributed it among the relatives of his paternal cousins.
3.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Malik se, Ishaq ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abu Talhah Madinah mein Ansar mein sabse zyada khajoor ki jaayedaad wale the, aur unki sabse mahboob jaayedaad Bayrha thi, aur woh masjid ke saamne thi, aur Nabi ﷺ usmein dakhil hote aur usmein achhe paani se peete. Anas ne bataya: Fir jab yeh aayat naazil hui: "Tum kabhi neki ko nahi paa sakoge jab tak apni mahboob cheezon mein se kharch na karo, aur jo kuch bhi kharch karo, Allah use zaroor jaanta hai" [Surah Aal-e-Imran, aayat 92], to unhone kaha: "Meri sabse mahboob jaayedaad Bayrha hai, aur woh Allah ke liye sadqa hai, main uski nekiyaan aur uska zakheera Allah ke paas rakhna chahta hoon, so ise, Ya Rasulullah, jahan chahein rakh dijiye." To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Bakh! Yeh fayde wala maal hai, ya loutne wala maal, aur maine tumhari baat sun li hai, aur main dekhta hoon ke ise apne qareebi rishtedaron mein rakh do." To Abu Talhah ne kaha: "Aisa hi karunga, Ya Rasulullah," so Abu Talhah ne ise apne chacha-zaad rishtedaron mein taqseem kar diya.

3.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ هَيَّاجِ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ  ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ  ، قَالَ : " مَا خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَّاأَمَرَنَا فِيهَا بِالصَّدَقَةِ، وَنَهَانَا عَنْ الْمُثْلَةِ "
3.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Bashshar, from Mu'adh ibn Hisham, from his father, from Qatadah, from al-Hasan, from Hayyaj ibn Imran, from Imran ibn Husayn: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never gave us a sermon except that he commanded us in it with charity, and forbade us from mutilation."
3.hi: Muhammad ibn Bashshar ne Mu'adh ibn Hisham se, apne walid se, Qatadah se, al-Hasan se, Hayyaj ibn Imran se, Imran ibn Husayn se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein kabhi koi khutba nahi diya jismein aapne humein sadqe ka hukum na diya ho, aur humein muslah (jism ko bigaadne) se mana na kiya ho."

3.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ خَيْثَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، ، قَالَ :" اتَّقُوا النَّارَ وَلَوْ بِشِقِّ تَمْرَةٍ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدُوا، فَبِكَلِمَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ "
3.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from Amr ibn Murrah, from Khaythamah, from Adi ibn Hatim, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Guard yourselves against the Fire, even with half a date, and if you do not find [that], then with a good word."
3.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Amr ibn Murrah ne bataya, unhone kaha: Maine Khaythamah ko suna, Adi ibn Hatim se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Aag se bacho, chahe aadhi khajoor de kar hi ho, aur agar woh na mile, to achhi baat se."

3.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ دُحَيْمٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ  ، أَنَّ أَبَا لُبَابَةَ   أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّهُ لَمَّا رَضِيَ عَنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ مِنْ تَوْبَتِي أَنْ أَهْجُرَ دَارَ قَوْمِي، وَأُسَاكِنَكَ، وَأَنْخَلِعَ مِنْ مَالِي صَدَقَةً لِلَّهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ.
فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" يُجْزِي عَنْكَ الثُّلُثُ "
3.en: Narrated by Abd al-Rahman ibn Ibrahim al-Dimashqi Duhaym, from Sa'id ibn Maslamah, from Isma'il ibn Umayyah, from al-Zuhri, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Lubabah, about Abu Lubabah: That Abu Lubabah informed him, that when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ became pleased with him, he said: "O Messenger of Allah, part of my repentance is that I abandon the dwelling of my people, and dwell with you, and give up my wealth as charity for Allah and His Messenger." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A third suffices for you."
3.hi: Abd al-Rahman ibn Ibrahim al-Dimashqi (Duhaym) ne Sa'id ibn Maslamah se, Isma'il ibn Umayyah se, al-Zuhri se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Lubabah se bataya ke Abu Lubabah ne unhein bataya ke jab Rasulullah ﷺ unse razi ho gaye, to unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, meri tauba ka hissa yeh hai ke main apni qaum ka ghar chhod dun, aur aapke saath rahun, aur apna maal Allah aur uske Rasool ke liye sadqa kar dun." To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Tumhare liye tihai kaafi hai."

3.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ لَبِيدٍ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : بَيْنَا نَحْنُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، إِذْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ بِمِثْلِ الْبَيْضَةِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ أَصَابَهَا فِي بَعْضِ الْمَغَازِي، قَالَ أَحْمَدُ : فِي بَعْضِ الْمَعَادِنِ، وَهُوَ الصَّوَابُ ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، خُذْهَا مِنِّي صَدَقَةً، فَوَاللَّهِ مَا لِي مَالٌ غَيْرَهَا، فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ، ثُمَّ جَاءَهُ عَنْ رُكْنِهِ الْأَيْسَرِ، فَقَالَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ جَاءَهُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ، فَقَالَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " هَاتِهَا "، مُغْضَبًا، فَحَذَفَهُ بِهَا حَذْفَةً لَوْ أَصَابَهُ لَأَوْجَعَهُ أَوْ عَقَرَهُ ثُمَّ، قَالَ :" يَعْمِدُ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى مَالِهِ لَا يَمْلِكُ غَيْرَهُ فَيَتَصَدَّقُ بِهِ، ثُمَّ يَقْعُدُ يَتَكَفَّفُ النَّاسَ، إِنَّمَا الصَّدَقَةُ عَنْ ظَهْرِ غِنًى، خُذْ الَّذِي لَكَ لَا حَاجَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ".
فَأَخَذَ الرَّجُلُ مَالَهُ وَذَهَبَ.
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : كَانَ مَالِكٌ يَقُولُ : إِذَا جَعَلَ الرَّجُلُ مَالَهُ فِي الْمَسَاكِينِ يَتَصَدَّقُ بِثُلُثِ مَالِهِ
3.en: Narrated by Ya'la, and Ahmad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Asim ibn Umar ibn Qatadah, from Mahmud ibn Labid, from Jabir ibn Abdullah; with Abu Muhammad's note on Malik's view: He said: While we were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, a man came with something like an egg made of gold that he had obtained in some of the campaigns - Ahmad said: in some of the mines, and that is correct - and he said: "O Messenger of Allah, take it from me as charity, for by Allah I have no wealth besides it." So he turned away from him, then the man came to him from his left side, and said the like of that, then he came to him from before him, and said the like of that, then he said: "Give it here," angrily, and he flung it at him with a fling that, had it struck him, would have hurt him or wounded him, then he said: "One of you resorts to his wealth, which he owns nothing besides, and gives it away in charity, then he sits begging from people; charity is only [to be given] while one has sufficiency, take what is yours, we have no need of it." So the man took his wealth and left. Abu Muhammad said: Malik used to say: When a man puts his wealth toward the poor, he gives a third of his wealth in charity.
3.hi: Ya'la aur Ahmad ibn Khalid ne Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, Asim ibn Umar ibn Qatadah se, Mahmud ibn Labid se, Jabir ibn Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas the, ke ek aadmi sone ka ande jaisa ek tukda le kar aaya jo usne kisi jung mein paaya tha - Ahmad kehte hain: kisi khaan mein, aur yehi sahih hai - aur usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, ise mujhse sadqa mein le lijiye, Allah ki qasam iske siwa mere paas koi maal nahi." To aap uski taraf se mud gaye, fir woh aadmi aapke baaye taraf se aaya, aur waisi hi baat kahi, fir woh aapke saamne se aaya, aur waisi hi baat kahi, fir aapne ghusse mein farmaya: "Ise laao," aur use aisi zor se phenka ke agar woh usay lagta to takleef pahunchaata ya zakhmi kar deta, fir farmaya: "Tum mein se koi apne maal ki taraf jaata hai jiske siwa uske paas kuch nahi hota, aur use sadqa de deta hai, fir logon ke saamne haath phailaane baith jaata hai; sadqa to sirf ghina ke waqt hota hai, apni cheez wapas le lo, humein iski zaroorat nahi." So us aadmi ne apna maal le liya aur chala gaya. Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Malik kaha karte the: Jab aadmi apna maal miskeenon mein daale, to woh apne maal ka tihai sadqa de.

3.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْنَتَصَدَّقَ، فَوَافَقَ ذَلِكَ مَالًا عِنْدِي، فَقُلْتُ : الْيَوْمَ أَسْبِقُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ إِنْ سَبَقْتُهُ يَوْمًا.
قَالَ : فَجِئْتُ بِنِصْفِ مَالِي، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " مَا أَبْقَيْتَ لِأَهْلِكَ؟ " قُلْتُ : مِثْلَهُ، قَالَ : فَأَتَى أَبُو بَكْرٍ بِكُلِّ مَا عِنْدَهُ، فَقَالَ : " يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ، مَا أَبْقَيْتَ لِأَهْلِكَ؟ ".
فَقَالَ : أَبْقَيْتُ لَهُمْ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ.
فَقُلْتُ : لَا أُسَابِقُكَ إِلَى شَيْءٍ أَبَدًا
3.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Hisham ibn Sa'd, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from his father, from Umar: He said I heard Umar say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to give charity, and that coincided with [me having] wealth with me, so I said: "Today I will outdo Abu Bakr, if ever I outdo him on a day." He said: So I came with half my wealth, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "What have you left for your family?" I said: "The like of it." He said: So Abu Bakr came with all that he had, so he said: "O Abu Bakr, what have you left for your family?" So he said: "I have left for them Allah and His Messenger." So I said: "I will never race you to anything [again]."
3.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Hisham ibn Sa'd se, Zayd ibn Aslam se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Umar ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein sadqa dene ka hukum diya, aur us waqt mere paas kuch maal maujood tha, to maine socha: "Aaj main Abu Bakr se aage badhunga, agar kabhi kisi din unse aage badh sakun." Unhone bataya: So main apna aadha maal le kar aaya, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne poocha: "Tumne apne gharwalon ke liye kya chhoda?" Maine kaha: "Utna hi [aadha]." Unhone bataya: Fir Abu Bakr apna sara maal le kar aaye, to aapne poocha: "Ae Abu Bakr, tumne apne gharwalon ke liye kya chhoda?" To unhone kaha: "Maine unke liye Allah aur uske Rasool ko chhoda hai." To maine kaha: "Main kabhi bhi tumse kisi cheez mein aage badhne ki koshish nahi karunga."

3.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" فَرَضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ زَكَاةَ الْفِطْرِ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ صَاعًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ أَوْ صَاعًا، مِنْ شَعِيرٍ عَلَى كُلِّ حُرٍّ وَعَبْدٍ، ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنْثَى، مِنْ الْمُسْلِمِينَ ".
قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ : تَقُولُ بِهِ؟ قَالَ : مَالِكٌ كَانَ يَقُولُ بِهِ
3.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Nafi', from Abdullah ibn Umar; with Abu Muhammad's confirmation: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ made obligatory the charity of Fitr from Ramadan, a sa' of dates or a sa' of barley, upon every free person and slave, male or female, among the Muslims." It was said to Abu Muhammad: "Do you hold this?" He said: Malik used to hold this.
3.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Nafi' se, Abdullah ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Ramzan ke Fitr ki zakat farz ki, ek sa' khajoor ya ek sa' jau, har aazad aur ghulam, mard ya aurat, Musalman par." Abu Muhammad se poocha gaya: "Kya aap isi ke qaail hain?" Unhone kaha: Malik isi ke qaail the.

3.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : " أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَبِزَكَاةِ الْفِطْرِ عَنْ كُلِّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ، حُرٍّ وَعَبْدٍ، صَاعًا مِنْ شَعِيرٍ، أَوْ صَاعًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ ".
قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ : فَعَدَلَهُ النَّاسُ بِمُدَّيْنِ مِنْ بُرٍّ
3.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded the charity of Fitr for every young and old, free and slave, a sa' of barley, or a sa' of dates." Ibn Umar said: So the people equated it with two mudds of wheat.
3.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne har chhote-bade, aazad-ghulam ke liye Fitr ki zakat ka hukum diya, ek sa' jau, ya ek sa' khajoor." Ibn Umar ne bataya: To logon ne ise gehun ke do mudd ke barabar kar diya.

3.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : " كُنَّانُخْرِجُ زَكَاةَ الْفِطْرِ إِذْ كَانَ فِينَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ كُلِّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ، حُرٍّ وَمَمْلُوكٍ، صَاعًا مِنْ طَعَامٍ، أَوْ صَاعًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ، أَوْ صَاعًا مِنْ شَعِيرٍ، أَوْ صَاعًا مِنْ أَقِطٍ، أَوْ صَاعًا مِنْ زَبِيبٍ، فَلَمْ يَزَلْ ذَلِكَ كَذَلِكَ حَتَّى قَدِمَ عَلَيْنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ الْمَدِينَةَ حَاجًّا، أَوْ مُعْتَمِرًا، فَقَالَ : إِنِّي أَرَى مُدَّيْنِ مِنْ سَمْرَاءِ الشَّامِ يَعْدِلُ صَاعًا مِنْ التَّمْرِ، فَأَخَذَ النَّاسُ بِذَلِكَ ".
قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ : أَمَّا أَنَا، فَلَا أَزَالُ أُخْرِجُهُ كَمَا كُنْتُ أُخْرِجُهُ.
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : أَرَى صَاعًا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
3.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Da'ud ibn Qays, from Iyad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri; with Abu Muhammad's confirmation: He said: "We used to give out the charity of Fitr, when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was among us, for every young and old, free and slave, a sa' of food, or a sa' of dates, or a sa' of barley, or a sa' of dried curd, or a sa' of raisins, and that continued to be so until Mu'awiyah came to us at Madinah, performing Hajj, or Umrah, and said: 'Indeed I see that two mudds of Sham wheat equal a sa' of dates,' so the people took to that." Abu Sa'id said: "As for me, I will continue giving it out as I used to give it out." Abu Muhammad said: I hold to a sa' of everything.
3.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Da'ud ibn Qays se, Iyad ibn Abdullah se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Hum, jab Rasulullah ﷺ humare darmiyan the, Fitr ki zakat nikaalte, har chhote-bade, aazad-ghulam ke liye, ek sa' khaana, ya ek sa' khajoor, ya ek sa' jau, ya ek sa' pani hua doodh (aqit), ya ek sa' kishmish, aur yeh isi tarah rahaa yahan tak ke Mu'awiyah humare paas Madinah aaye, Hajj ya Umrah ke liye, aur kaha: 'Main dekhta hoon ke Sham ke gehun ke do mudd ek sa' khajoor ke barabar hain,' so log isi par aa gaye." Abu Sa'id kehte hain: "Rahi baat meri, to main isay waise hi nikaalta rahunga jaise pehle nikaalta tha." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Main har cheez ka ek sa' rakhta hoon.

3.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ  ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَرْحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : " كُنَّانُخْرِجُ زَكَاةَ الْفِطْرِ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ صَاعًا مِنْ طَعَامٍ، أَوْ صَاعًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ، أَوْ صَاعًا مِنْ شَعِيرٍ، أَوْ صَاعًا مِنْ زَبِيبٍ، أَوْ صَاعًا مِنْ أَقِطٍ ".
أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ  ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ  ، قَالَ : كُنَّا نُعْطِي عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ
3.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from Iyad ibn Abdullah ibn Sa'd ibn Abi Sarh, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri; a similar chain also via Ubaydullah ibn Musa: He said: "We used to give out the charity of Fitr from Ramadan, a sa' of food, or a sa' of dates, or a sa' of barley, or a sa' of raisins, or a sa' of dried curd." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Sufyan, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from Iyad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Sa'id: He said: We used to give, in the time of the Prophet ﷺ, then he mentioned the like of it.]
3.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Zayd ibn Aslam se, Iyad ibn Abdullah ibn Sa'd ibn Abi Sarh se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Hum Ramzan ki Fitr ki zakat nikaalte the, ek sa' khaana, ya ek sa' khajoor, ya ek sa' jau, ya ek sa' kishmish, ya ek sa' aqit." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Ubaydullah ibn Musa se, Sufyan se, Zayd ibn Aslam se, Iyad ibn Abdullah se, Abu Sa'id se bhi aayi hai: Unhone kaha, Hum Nabi ﷺ ke zamane mein dete the, fir unhone isi jaisa zikr kiya.]

3.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ شِمَاسَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ   يَقُولُ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ :" لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ صَاحِبُ مَكْسٍ ".
قَالَ : قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : يَعْنِي : عَشَّارًا
3.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Shimasah, from Uqbah ibn Amir; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: I heard Uqbah ibn Amir say: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "The one who imposes unjust tolls/tax will not enter Paradise." Abu Muhammad said: meaning: a tax-collector.
3.hi: Ahmad ibn Khalid ne Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, Yazid ibn Abi Habib se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Shimasah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Uqbah ibn Amir ko kehte suna: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Naajaayez chungi (mehsool) lene wala Jannat mein dakhil nahi hoga." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: yaani, mehsool wasool karne wala.

3.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  ، عَنْ مُعَاذٍ  ، قَالَ : " بَعَثَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَى الْيَمَنِ ،فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ آخُذَ مِنْ الثِّمَارِ مَا يُسْقَى بَعْلًا الْعُشْرَ، وَمَا سُقِيَ بِالسَّانِيَةِ، فَنِصْفَ الْعُشْرِ "
3.en: Narrated by Asim ibn Yusuf, from Abu Bakr, from Asim, from Abu Wa'il, from Masruq, from Mu'adh: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent me to Yemen, and commanded me that I take from the fruits, whatever is watered by rain [naturally], the tenth, and whatever is watered by irrigation-animal, half the tenth."
3.hi: Asim ibn Yusuf ne Abu Bakr se, Asim se, Abu Wa'il se, Masruq se, Mu'adh se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhe Yemen bheja, aur mujhe hukum diya ke main phalon mein se, jo baarish se seencha jaaye us mein se dasvaan hissa, aur jo jaanwar se seencha jaaye us mein se dasvaan hisse ka aadha lun."

3.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" جُرْحُ الْعَجْمَاءِ جُبَارٌ، وَالْبِئْرُ جُبَارٌ، وَالْمَعْدِنُ جُبَارٌ، وَفِي الرِّكَازِ الْخُمُسُ "
3.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, and Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "The wound of a dumb animal is without liability, and the well is without liability, and the mine is without liability, and in buried treasure there is a fifth."
3.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Ibn Shihab se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab aur Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Gungay jaanwar ka zakhm mu'af hai [uska koi mu'aawza nahi], aur kuen [mein girne] ka koi mu'aawza nahi, aur khaan [ki wajah se nuqsan ka] koi mu'aawza nahi, aur gaday hue khazane mein paanchwa hissa [wajib] hai."

3.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ ثُمَّ السَّاعِدِيّ   أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ اسْتَعْمَلَ عَامِلًا عَلَى الصَّدَقَةِ، فَجَاءَهُ الْعَامِلُ حِينَ فَرَغَ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَذَا الَّذِي لَكُمْ، وَهَذَا أُهْدِيَ لِي.
فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " فَهَلَّا قَعَدْتَ فِي بَيْتِ أَبِيكَ وَأُمِّكَ، فَنَظَرْتَ أَيُهْدَى لَكَ أَمْ لَا؟ ثُمَّ قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَشِيَّةً بَعْدَ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ، فَتَشَهَّدَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَى اللَّهِ بِمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " أَمَّا بَعْدُمَا بَالُ الْعَامِلِ نَسْتَعْمِلُهُ فَيَأْتِينَا فَيَقُولُ : هَذَا مِنْ عَمَلِكُمْ وَهَذَا أُهْدِيَ لِي؟ ! فَهَلَّا قَعَدَ فِي بَيْتِ أَبِيهِ وَأُمِّهِ فَيَنْظُرَ هَلْ يُهْدَى لَهُ أَمْ لَا؟ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ، لَا يَغُلُّ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْهَا شَيْئًا، إِلَّا جَاءَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَحْمِلُهُ عَلَى عُنُقِهِ : إِنْ كَانَ بَعِيرًا، جَاءَ بِهِ لَهُ رُغَاءٌ، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ بَقَرَةً، جَاءَ بِهَا لَهَا خُوَارٌ، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ شَاةً، جَاءَ بِهَا تَيْعَرُ، فَقَدْ بَلَّغْتُ ".
قَالَ أَبُو حُمَيْدٍ : ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى إِنَّا لَنَنْظُرُ إِلَى عُفْرَةِ إِبْطَيْهِ.
قَالَ أَبُو حُمَيْدٍ : وَقَدْ سَمِعَ ذَلِكَ مَعِي مِنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ زَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ ، فَسَلُوهُ
3.en: Narrated by Abu al-Yaman al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah ibn al-Zubayr, from Abu Humayd al-Ansari, then al-Sa'idi: That he informed him that the Prophet ﷺ employed a worker over charity [collection], and the worker came to him when he had finished his work, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, this is for you, and this was given to me as a gift." So the Prophet ﷺ said: "Then why did you not sit in the house of your father and your mother, and see whether it would be given to you [as a gift] or not?" Then the Prophet ﷺ stood one evening after the prayer on the pulpit, and testified [the shahadah] and praised Allah as He deserves, then said: "As for what follows - what is the matter with the worker whom we employ, so he comes to us and says: 'This is from your work, and this was given to me as a gift'? Then why did he not sit in the house of his father and his mother and see whether it would be given to him or not? By the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, none of you takes anything from it, except he will come on the Day of Resurrection carrying it on his neck: if it was a camel, he comes with it, it having a groaning sound, and if it was a cow, he comes with it, it having a lowing sound, and if it was a sheep, he comes with it, it bleating, so I have conveyed [the message]." Abu Humayd said: Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ raised his hands until we could indeed see the whiteness of his armpits. Abu Humayd said: And Zayd ibn Thabit heard that with me from the Prophet ﷺ, so ask him.
3.hi: Abu al-Yaman al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Mujhse Urwah ibn al-Zubayr ne bataya, Abu Humayd al-Ansari, phir al-Sa'idi se: ke unhone unhein bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne zakat ki wasooli par ek karyakartaa muqarrar kiya, so woh karyakartaa apna kaam khatam karne par aapke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, yeh aapka hai, aur yeh mujhe tohfe mein diya gaya." To Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "To tum apne baap aur maa ke ghar mein kyun nahi baithe, aur dekhte ke tumhein tohfa milta hai ya nahi?" Fir Nabi ﷺ ek shaam namaz ke baad mimbar par khade hue, aur shahaadat di aur Allah ki tareef ki jaisi uski haqdaar hai, fir farmaya: "Amma ba'd - us karyakartaa ko kya hua hai jise hum kaam par lagaate hain, fir woh humare paas aakar kehta hai: 'Yeh tumhare kaam ka hai aur yeh mujhe tohfe mein diya gaya'? To woh apne baap aur maa ke ghar mein kyun nahi baitha aur dekhta ke usse tohfa milta hai ya nahi? Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, tum mein se koi bhi usmein se kuch nahi lega, magar woh Qayamat ke din use apni gardan par uthaaye laayega: agar woh oont hoga, to use is haal mein laayega ke woh boonk raha hoga, aur agar gaay hogi, to use is haal mein laayega ke woh awaaz kar rahi hogi, aur agar bhed hogi, to use is haal mein laayega ke woh mimya rahi hogi, so maine [paighaam] pahuncha diya." Abu Humayd kehte hain: Fir Rasulullah ﷺ ne apne haath itna uthaaye ke hum aapki bagalon ki safedi dekhne lage. Abu Humayd kehte hain: Aur Zayd ibn Thabit ne bhi yeh mere saath Nabi ﷺ se suna, so unse poocho.

3.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ  ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ  ، وَمُجَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا جَاءَكُمْ الْمُصَدِّقُ، فَلَا يَصْدُرَنَّ عَنْكُمْ إِلَّا وَهُوَ رَاضٍ ".
 حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق الْفَزَارِيِّ  ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَحْوَهُ
3.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Hushaym, from Da'ud, and Mujalid, from al-Sha'bi, from Jarir; a similar chain also via Muhammad ibn Uyaynah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When the charity collector comes to you, let him not leave you except while he is satisfied." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Abu Ishaq al-Fazari, from Da'ud ibn Abi Hind, from Amir, from Jarir, from the Prophet ﷺ.]
3.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Hushaym se, Da'ud aur Mujalid se, al-Sha'bi se, Jarir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab zakat wasool karne wala tumhare paas aaye, to woh tum se raazi hokar hi jaaye." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Muhammad ibn Uyaynah se, Abu Ishaq al-Fazari se, Da'ud ibn Abi Hind se, Amir se, Jarir se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai.]

3.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُعَاذٍ الْأَشْهَلِيِّ  ، عَنْ جَدَّتِهِ يُقَالُ لَهَا حَوَّاءُ  ، قَالَتْ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ يَا صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " يَا نِسَاءَ الْمُسْلِمَاتِ،لَا تَحْقِرَنَّ إِحْدَاكُنَّ لِجَارَتِهَا، وَلَوْ كُرَاعُ شَاةٍ مُحَرَّقٌ "
3.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Malik, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from Amr ibn Mu'adh al-Ashhali, from his grandmother, called Hawwa: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O Muslim women, let none of you belittle [as a gift] to her neighbor, even if it be a burnt sheep's trotter."
3.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Malik se, Zayd ibn Aslam se, Amr ibn Mu'adh al-Ashhali se, apni dadi Hawwa se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Ae Musalman auraton, tum mein se koi apni padosan ke liye [tohfe ko] chhota na samjhe, chahe woh bhed ka jala hua khurr hi kyun na ho."

3.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَجَلِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ  ،  عَنْ صَخْرِ بْنِ الْعَيْلَةِ  ، قَالَ : أُخِذَتْ عَمَّةُ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، فَقَدِمَتْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَسَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَمَّتَهُ، فَقَالَ : " يَا صَخْرُ، إِنَّالْقَوْمَ إِذَا أَسْلَمُوا، أَحْرَزُوا أَمْوَالَهُمْ وَدِمَاءَهُمْ، فَادْفَعْهَا إِلَيْهِمْ ".
وَكَانَ مَاءٌ لِبَنِي سُلَيْمٍ، فَأَسْلَمُوا، فَسَأَلُوهُ ذَلِكَ فَدَعَانِي، فَقَالَ : " يَا صَخْرُ، إِنَّ الْقَوْمَ إِذَا أَسْلَمُوا، أَحْرَزُوا أَمْوَالَهُمْ وَدِمَاءَهُمْ، فَادْفَعْهَا إِلَيْهِمْ " فَدَفَعْتُهَا.
 أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ صَخْرٍ  ، أَطْوَلَ مِنْ حَدِيثِ أَبِي نُعَيْمٍ
3.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Aban ibn Abdullah al-Bajali, from Uthman ibn Abi Hazim, from Sakhr ibn al-Aylah; a similar chain also via Muhammad ibn Yusuf: He said: The paternal aunt of al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah was captured, and she came before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he asked the Prophet ﷺ about his aunt, so he said: "O Sakhr, indeed a people, when they become Muslim, they secure their properties and their blood [lives], so give it back to them." And there was water [property] belonging to Banu Sulaym, and they became Muslim, so they asked him for that, so he called me, and said: "O Sakhr, indeed a people, when they become Muslim, they secure their properties and their blood, so give it back to them," so I gave it back. [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Aban ibn Abdullah, from Uthman ibn Abi Hazim, from his father, from his grandfather Sakhr, longer than the hadith of Abu Nu'aym.]
3.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Aban ibn Abdullah al-Bajali se, Uthman ibn Abi Hazim se, Sakhr ibn al-Aylah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah ki phuphi ko qaid kar liya gaya tha, so woh Rasulullah ﷺ ke saamne laayi gayi, to Mughirah ne Nabi ﷺ se apni phuphi ke baare mein poocha, to aapne farmaya: "Ae Sakhr, jab log Musalman ho jaate hain, to unka maal aur unka khoon mehfooz ho jaata hai, so use unhein wapas kar do." Aur Banu Sulaym ka paani (jaayedaad) tha, aur woh Musalman ho gaye, so unhone bhi yehi maanga, to aapne mujhe bulaaya, aur farmaya: "Ae Sakhr, jab log Musalman ho jaate hain, to unka maal aur unka khoon mehfooz ho jaata hai, so use unhein wapas kar do," so maine wapas kar diya. [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Muhammad ibn Yusuf se, Aban ibn Abdullah se, Uthman ibn Abi Hazim se, apne walid se, apne dada Sakhr se bhi Abu Nu'aym ki riwayat se lambi aayi hai.]

3.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ يُونُسَ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَا تَصَدَّقَ امْرُؤٌ بِصَدَقَةٍ مِنْ كَسْبٍ طَيِّبٍ، وَلَا يَقْبَلُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا طَيِّبًا، إِلَّا وَضَعَهَا حِينَ يَضَعُهَا فِي كَفِّ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيُرَبِّي لِأَحَدِكُمْ التَّمْرَةَ كَمَا يُرَبِّي أَحَدُكُمْ فَلُوَّهُ أَوْ فَصِيلَهُ حَتَّى تَكُونَ مِثْلَ أُحُدٍ "
3.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah, from Isa ibn Yunus, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Sa'id ibn Yasar, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "No person gives charity from good earnings - and Allah does not accept except what is good - except that He takes it, when He takes it, into the palm of the Most Merciful, and indeed Allah nurtures for one of you the [single] date, just as one of you nurtures his young colt or foal, until it becomes like [the mountain of] Uhud."
3.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah ne Isa ibn Yunus se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Sa'id ibn Yasar se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Koi shakhs paak kamaai se sadqa nahi deta - aur Allah paak cheez ke siwa kuch qabool nahi karta - magar Allah use, jab qabool karta hai, apne hi haath mein rakhta hai, aur Allah tum mein se kisi ke liye ek khajoor ko yun parwarish karta hai jaise tum mein se koi apne bacche ghode ya oont ko parwarish karta hai, yahan tak ke woh [pahaad] Uhud jitna ho jaata hai."

3.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ  ، عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ، وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلَّا عِزًّا، وَمَا تَوَاضَعَ أَحَدٌ لِلَّهِ، إِلَّا رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ "
3.en: Narrated by Abu al-Rabi' al-Zahrani, from Isma'il ibn Ja'far, from al-Ala, from his father, from Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Charity does not decrease wealth, and Allah does not increase a servant in forgiveness except in honor, and no one humbles himself for the sake of Allah, except that Allah raises him."
3.hi: Abu al-Rabi' al-Zahrani ne Isma'il ibn Ja'far se, al-Ala se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Sadqa maal ko kam nahi karta, aur Allah bande ko maafi dene se sirf izzat mein badhaata hai, aur koi bhi Allah ke liye tawaadu (aajizi) nahi ikhtiyaar karta magar Allah use bulund kar deta hai."

3.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدَّهِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ :" فِي كُلِّ إِبِلٍ سَائِمَةٍ فِي كُلِّ أَرْبَعِينَ بِنْتُ لَبُونٍ، لَا تُفَرَّقُ إِبِلٌ عَنْ حِسَابِهَا، مَنْ أَعْطَاهَا مُؤْتَجِرًا بِهَا، فَلَهُ أَجْرُهَا، وَمَنْ مَنَعَهَا، فَإِنَّا آخِذُوهَا وَشَطْرَ مَالِهِ عَزْمَةٌ مِنْ عَزَمَاتِ اللَّهِ، لَا يَحِلُّ لِآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ مِنْهَا شَيْءٌ "
3.en: Narrated by al-Nadr ibn Shumayl, from Bahz ibn Hakim, from his father, from his grandfather: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "For every grazing camel-herd, for every forty, a bint labun; the camels are not to be separated from their reckoning. Whoever gives it, seeking reward by it, has its reward; and whoever withholds it, then indeed we shall take it, and half of his wealth, as a firm decree from among the decrees of our Lord - nothing of it is lawful for the family of Muhammad."
3.hi: Al-Nadr ibn Shumayl ne Bahz ibn Hakim se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Har charne wale oonton ke jhund mein, har chaalis mein ek bint-e-laboon; oonton ko unke hisaab se alag nahi kiya jaayega [zakat bachaane ke liye]. Jo ise sawaab ki niyat se de, uske liye uska ajr hai, aur jo use rok le, to hum use zaroor lenge, aur uska aadha maal, humare Rab ke faislon mein se ek pukhta faisla hai - ismein se Muhammad ke khaandan ke liye kuch bhi halal nahi."

3.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، وَأَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ رِئَابٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي كِنَانَةُ بْنُ نُعَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ قَبِيصَةَ بْنِ مُخَارِقٍ الْهِلَالِيِّ  ، قَالَ : تَحَمَّلْتُ بِحَمَالَةٍ فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَسْأَلُهُ فِيهَا، فَقَالَ : " أَقِمْ يَا قَبِيصَةُ حَتَّى تَأْتِيَنَا الصَّدَقَةُ، فَنَأْمُرَ لَكَ بِهَا "، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " يَا قَبِيصَةُ إِنَّالْمَسْأَلَةَ لَا تَحِلُّ إِلَّا لِأَحَدِ ثَلَاثَةٍ : رَجُلٍ تَحَمَّلَ حَمَالَةً فَحَلَّتْ لَهُ الْمَسْأَلَةُ، فَسَأَلَ حَتَّى يُصِيبَهَا، ثُمَّ يُمْسِكَ.
 وَرَجُلٍ أَصَابَتْهُ جَائِحَةٌ فَاجْتَاحَتْ مَالَهُ، فَحَلَّتْ لَهُ الْمَسْأَلَةُ، فَسَأَلَ حَتَّى يُصِيبَ قِوَامًا مِنْ عَيْشٍ أَوْ قَالَ : سِدَادًا مِنْ عَيْشٍ .
وَرَجُلٍ أَصَابَتْهُ فَاقَةٌ حَتَّى يَقُولَ ثَلَاثَةٌ مِنْ ذَوِي الْحِجَى مِنْ قَوْمِهِ : قَدْ أَصَابَ فُلَانًا الْفَاقَةُ، فَحَلَّتْ لَهُ الْمَسْأَلَةُ، فَسَأَلَ حَتَّى يُصِيبَ قِوَامًا مِنْ عَيْشٍ، أَوْ سِدَادًا مِنْ عَيْشٍ، ثُمَّ يُمْسِكَ، وَمَا سِوَاهُنَّ مِنْ الْمَسْأَلَةِ سُحْتٌ يَا قَبِيصَةُ يَأْكُلُهَا صَاحِبُهَا سُحْتًا "
3.en: Narrated by Musaddad, and Abu Nu'aym, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Harun ibn Ri'ab, from Kinanah ibn Nu'aym, from Qabisah ibn Mukhariq al-Hilali: He said: I bore a debt-guarantee, so I came to the Prophet ﷺ to ask him about it, so he said: "Stay, O Qabisah, until the charity comes to us, and we will order it for you," then he said: "O Qabisah, asking is not lawful except for one of three: a man who bears a debt-guarantee, for him asking is lawful, so he asks until he obtains it, then he stops; and a man afflicted by a calamity which consumed his wealth, for him asking is lawful, so he asks until he obtains a sustenance of livelihood, or he said: a support of livelihood; and a man afflicted by poverty until three people of sound judgment among his people say: 'So-and-so has indeed been afflicted by poverty,' for him asking is lawful, so he asks until he obtains a sustenance of livelihood, or a support of livelihood, then he stops; and whatever besides these of asking is forbidden [wealth], O Qabisah, its owner consumes it as forbidden [wealth]."
3.hi: Musaddad aur Abu Nu'aym ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Harun ibn Ri'ab se, Kinanah ibn Nu'aym se, Qabisah ibn Mukhariq al-Hilali se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine ek zamaanat ka bojh uthaya, to main Nabi ﷺ ke paas iske baare mein poochne aaya, to aapne farmaya: "Thehro, ae Qabisah, yahan tak ke humare paas zakat aaye, to hum tumhare liye uska hukum denge," fir farmaya: "Ae Qabisah, sawaal karna sirf teen mein se kisi ek ke liye halal hai: ek aadmi jisne zamaanat ka bojh uthaya ho, uske liye sawaal halal hai, so woh us waqt tak maange jab tak use woh na mil jaaye, fir woh ruk jaaye; aur ek aadmi jispar koi museebat aayi ho jisne uska maal khatam kar diya ho, uske liye sawaal halal hai, so woh us waqt tak maange jab tak use zindagi ka guzar-basar na mil jaaye, ya farmaya: zindagi ki koi sahara na mil jaaye; aur ek aadmi jispar aisi tangdasti aayi ho ke uski qaum ke teen aqal-mand log kahein: 'Fulaan par waqai tangdasti aayi hai,' uske liye sawaal halal hai, so woh us waqt tak maange jab tak use guzar-basar ka sahara na mil jaaye, fir woh ruk jaaye; aur inke siwa jo bhi sawaal ho woh haraam maal hai, ae Qabisah, jise uska maalik haraam maal ki tarah khaata hai."

3.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ الْعَوَّامِ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ  ، عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ  ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ الصَّدَقَاتِ أَيُّهَا أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ :" عَلَى ذِي الرَّحِمِ الْكَاشِحِ "
3.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Sulayman, from Abbad ibn al-Awwam, from Sufyan ibn Husayn, from al-Zuhri, from Ayyub ibn Bashir, from Hakim ibn Hizam: That a man asked the Prophet ﷺ about which charities are best? He said: "To the hostile relative."
3.hi: Sa'id ibn Sulayman ne Abbad ibn al-Awwam se, Sufyan ibn Husayn se, al-Zuhri se, Ayyub ibn Bashir se, Hakim ibn Hizam se bataya ke ek aadmi ne Nabi ﷺ se poocha ke sadqaat mein sabse behtar kaunsa hai? Aapne farmaya: "Us rishtedaar par jo dushmani rakhta ho."

3.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ الْبَصْرِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ الرَّائِحِ بِنْتِ صُلَيْعٍ  ، عَنْ سَلْمَانَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ الضَّبِّيِّ  ، ذَكَرَ أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : " إِنَّالصَّدَقَةَ عَلَى الْمِسْكِينِ صَدَقَةٌ، وَإِنَّهَا عَلَى ذِي الرَّحِمِ اثْنَتَانِ، صَدَقَةٌ وَصِلَةٌ "
3.en: Narrated by Abu Hatim al-Basri, from Ibn Awn, from Hafsah bint Sirin, from Umm al-Ra'ih bint Sulay', from Salman ibn Amir al-Dabbi: He mentioned that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Charity to the poor is [a single reward of] charity, and to a relative it is two: charity and a bond of kinship."
3.hi: Abu Hatim al-Basri ne Ibn Awn se, Hafsah bint Sirin se, Umm al-Ra'ih bint Sulay' se, Salman ibn Amir al-Dabbi se bataya ke unhone zikr kiya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Miskeen par sadqa sadqa hi hai, aur rishtedaar par woh do hain: sadqa bhi aur sila-e-rahmi (rishta jodna) bhi."

3.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، قَالَ : وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنَ الثَّوْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ الرَّبَابِ  ، عَنْ سَلْمَانَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ الضَّبِّيِّ   يَرْفَعُهُ، قَالَ :" الصَّدَقَةُ عَلَى الْمِسْكِينِ صَدَقَةٌ، وَهِيَ عَلَى ذِي الرَّحِمِ اثْنَتَانِ : صَدَقَةٌ وَصِلَةٌ "
3.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Ibn Uyaynah; also heard from al-Thawri, from Asim, from Hafsah bint Sirin, from al-Rabab, from Salman ibn Amir al-Dabbi: He said: And I heard it from al-Thawri, from Asim, from Hafsah bint Sirin, from al-Rabab, from Salman ibn Amir al-Dabbi, raising it: he said: "Charity to the poor is charity, and it is to a relative two: charity and a bond of kinship."
3.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Ibn Uyaynah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Aur maine ise al-Thawri se bhi suna, Asim se, Hafsah bint Sirin se, al-Rabab se, Salman ibn Amir al-Dabbi se, marfu'an: Unhone kaha, "Miskeen par sadqa sadqa hai, aur woh rishtedaar par do hai: sadqa aur sila-e-rahmi."

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الْأَحْمَرُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ قَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ صِلَةَ  ، قَالَ : كُنَّا عِنْدَ عَمَّارِ بْنِ يَاسِرٍ، فَأُتِيَ بِشَاةٍ مَصْلِيَّةٍ، فَقَالَ : كُلُوا، فَتَنَحَّى بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ، فَقَالَ : إِنِّي صَائِمٌ.
 فَقَالَ عَمَّارُ بْنُ يَاسِرٍ   :" مَنْ صَامَ الْيَوْمَ الَّذِي يُشَكُّ فِيهِ، فَقَدْ عَصَى أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "
4.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Khalid al-Ahmar, from Amr ibn Qays, from Abu Ishaq, from Silah, about Ammar ibn Yasir: He said: We were with Ammar ibn Yasir, and a roasted sheep was brought, so he said: "Eat," so one of the group withdrew, and said: "I am fasting." So Ammar ibn Yasir said: "Whoever fasts on the day about which there is doubt has indeed disobeyed Abu al-Qasim ﷺ."
4.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Khalid al-Ahmar se, Amr ibn Qays se, Abu Ishaq se, Silah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Hum Ammar ibn Yasir ke paas the, to unke paas bhuni hui bhed laayi gayi, to unhone kaha: "Khaao," to jama'at mein se koi ek alag hat gaya, aur kaha: "Main roze se hoon." To Ammar ibn Yasir ne kaha: "Jo us din roza rakhe jismein shak ho, usne Abu al-Qasim ﷺ ki nafarmani ki."

4.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ عُلَيَّةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ أَبِي صَغِيرَةَ  ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ  ، قَالَ : أَصْبَحْتُ فِي يَوْمٍ قَدْ أُشْكِلَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ، أَوْ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ، فَأَصْبَحْتُ صَائِمًا، فَأَتَيْتُ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، فَإِذَا هُوَ يَأْكُلُ خُبْزًا وَبَقْلًا، فَقَالَ : هَلُمَّ إِلَى الْغَدَاءِ.
فَقُلْتُ : إِنِّي صَائِمٌ.
فَقَالَ : أُقْسِمُ بِاللَّهِ لَتُفْطِرَنَّ.
فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتُهُ حَلَفَ وَلَا يَسْتَثْنِي، تَقَدَّمْتُ فَعَذَّرْتُ وَإِنَّمَا تَسَحَّرْتُ قُبَيْلَ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ قُلْتُ : هَاتِ الْآنَ مَا عِنْدَكَ.
فَقَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" صُومُوا لِرُؤْيَتِهِ وَأَفْطِرُوا لِرُؤْيَتِهِ، فَإِنْ حَالَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُ سَحَابٌ، فَكَمِّلُوا الْعِدَّةَ ثَلَاثِينَ، وَلَا تَسْتَقْبِلُوا الشَّهْرَ اسْتِقْبَالًا "
4.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Isma'il ibn Ulayyah, from Hatim ibn Abi Saghirah, from Simak ibn Harb: He said: I awoke on a day which was uncertain to me, whether from Sha'ban or from the month of Ramadan, so I awoke fasting, and I came to Ikrimah, and he was eating bread and vegetables, so he said: "Come to breakfast." So I said: "I am fasting." So he said: "I swear by Allah that you will break your fast." So when I saw that he swore without making an exception, I proceeded and made an excuse, and indeed I had only eaten suhoor shortly before that, then I said: "Now bring what you have." So he said: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما narrated to us: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Fast at its sighting, and break the fast at its sighting, and if clouds obstruct [your view] between you and it, then complete the count as thirty, and do not anticipate the month with anticipation."
4.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Isma'il ibn Ulayyah se, Hatim ibn Abi Saghirah se, Simak ibn Harb se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main ek aise din subah utha jismein mujhe shak tha ke yeh Sha'ban hai ya Ramzan ka mahina, so main roze se subah utha, aur main Ikrimah ke paas gaya, to woh roti aur saag kha rahe the, unhone kaha: "Aao naashta karo." Maine kaha: "Main roze se hoon." Unhone kaha: "Main Allah ki qasam khaata hoon ke tum zaroor roza tod doge." So jab maine dekha ke unhone bagair 'inshaallah' kahe qasam khaayi, to main aage badha aur uzr pesh kiya, kyunki maine to isse kuch pehle hi sehri ki thi, fir maine kaha: "Ab jo aapke paas hai woh sunaiye." To unhone kaha: Humein Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Chaand dekh kar roza rakho, aur chaand dekh kar roza tod do, aur agar badal tumhare aur uske darmiyan aa jaaye, to ginti poori teen karo, aur mahine ka pehle se andaaza na lagaao."

4.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ،  عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُمَا، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ذَكَرَ رَمَضَانَ، فَقَالَ :" لَا تَصُومُوا حَتَّى تَرَوْا الْهِلَالَ، وَلَا تُفْطِرُوا حَتَّى تَرَوْهُ، فَإِنْ غُمَّ عَلَيْكُمْ، فَاقْدُرُوا لَهُ "
4.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar رضي الله عنهما: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ mentioned Ramadan, and said: "Do not fast until you see the crescent, and do not break the fast until you see it, and if it is obscured for you, then estimate it."
4.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Malik se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar رضي الله عنهما se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne Ramzan ka zikr kiya, aur farmaya: "Chaand dekhe bagair roza na rakho, aur chaand dekhe bagair roza na todo, aur agar woh tumpar chhup jaaye, to uska andaaza lagaao."

4.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَوْ قَالَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" صُومُوا لِرُؤْيَتِهِ، وَأَفْطِرُوا لِرُؤْيَتِهِ، فَإِنْ غُمَّ عَلَيْكُمْ الشَّهْرُ، فَعُدُّوا ثَلَاثِينَ "
4.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, or Abu al-Qasim ﷺ said: "Fast at its sighting, and break the fast at its sighting, and if the month is obscured for you, then count thirty."
4.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Muhammad ibn Ziyad ne bataya, unhone kaha: Maine Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, ya Abu al-Qasim ﷺ ne farmaya: "Chaand dekh kar roza rakho, aur chaand dekh kar roza tod do, aur agar mahina tumpar chhup jaaye, to tees ginn lo."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو يَعْنِي ابْنَ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّهُ عَجِبَ مِمَّنْ يَتَقَدَّمُ الشَّهْرَ ، وَيَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا رَأَيْتُمُوهُ، فَصُومُوا، وَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمُوهُ فَأَفْطِرُوا، فَإِنْ غُمَّ عَلَيْكُمْ، فَأَكْمِلُوا الْعِدَّةَ ثَلَاثِينَ يَوْمًا "
4.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Sa'id, from Sufyan, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Muhammad ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: That he was amazed at those who anticipate the month, and he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When you see it, fast, and when you see it, break the fast, and if it is obscured for you, then complete the count as thirty days."
4.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Sa'id ne Sufyan se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Muhammad ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se bataya ke unhein un logon par tajjub tha jo mahine ka pehle se andaaza lagaate hain, aur unhone kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum ise dekho, to roza rakho, aur jab dekho, to tod do, aur agar tumpar chhup jaaye, to tees din ginti poori karo."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، وَعَمِّهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا رَأَى الْهِلَالَ، قَالَ :" اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا يُحِبُّ رَبُّنَا وَيَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ "
4.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Sulayman, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Uthman ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from his father and his uncle, from Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he saw the crescent, said: "Allahu Akbar. Allahumma ahillahu 'alayna bil-amni wal-iman, was-salamati wal-Islam, wat-tawfiqi lima yuhibbu Rabbuna wa yarda, Rabbuna wa Rabbuka Allah."
4.hi: Sa'id ibn Sulayman ne Abd al-Rahman ibn Uthman ibn Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhse mere walid ne bataya, apne walid se, aur apne chacha se, Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ jab chaand dekhte, to farmaate: "Allahu Akbar. Allahumma ahillahu 'alayna bil-amni wal-eeman, was-salaamati wal-Islam, wat-tawfeeqi limaa yuhibbu Rabbunaa wa yarda, Rabbunaa wa Rabbukallah" [Allah sabse bada hai. Ae Allah, ise humpar aman aur imaan, salaamati aur Islam, aur us cheez ki taufeeq ke saath tulu farma jise humara Rab pasand karta hai aur jisse woh razi hota hai; humara aur tera Rab Allah hai].

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الرِّفَاعِيُّ  ، وَإِسْحَاق بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْعَقَدِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ الْمَدَينِيُّ  ، عَنْ بِلَالِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ : كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا رَأَى الْهِلَالَ، قَالَ :" اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ، رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ "
4.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Rifa'i, and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from al-Aqadi, from Sulayman ibn Sufyan al-Madini, from Bilal ibn Yahya ibn Talhah, from his father, from Talhah رضي الله عنهما: He said: The Prophet ﷺ, when he saw the crescent, said: "Allahumma ahillahu 'alayna bil-amni wal-iman, was-salamati wal-Islam, Rabbi wa Rabbuka Allah."
4.hi: Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Rifa'i aur Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ne al-Aqadi se, Sulayman ibn Sufyan al-Madini se, Bilal ibn Yahya ibn Talhah se, apne walid se, Talhah رضي الله عنهما se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ jab chaand dekhte, to farmaate: "Allahumma ahillahu 'alayna bil-amni wal-eeman, was-salaamati wal-Islam, Rabbi wa Rabbukallah" [Ae Allah, ise humpar aman aur imaan, salaamati aur Islam ke saath tulu farma; mera aur tera Rab Allah hai].

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا تَقَدَّمُوا قَبْلَ رَمَضَانَ يَوْمًا، وَلَا يَوْمَيْنِ، إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ رَجُلًا كَانَ يَصُومُ صَوْمًا، فَلْيَصُمْهُ "
4.en: Narrated by Wahb ibn Jarir, from Hisham, from Yahya, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do not advance [fasting] before Ramadan by a day or two days, except that it be a man who was [already habitually] fasting a [particular recurring] fast, then let him fast it."
4.hi: Wahb ibn Jarir ne Hisham se, Yahya se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Ramzan se ek ya do din pehle roza mat rakho, siwaay us aadmi ke jo pehle se koi [muqarrar] roza rakhta ho, to woh use rakh le."

4.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " إِنَّمَاالشَّهْرُ تِسْعٌ وَعِشْرُونَ، فَلَا تَصُومُوا حَتَّى تَرَوْهُ، وَلَا تُفْطِرُوا حَتَّى تَرَوْهُ، فَإِنْ غُمَّ عَلَيْكُمْ، فَاقْدُرُوا لَهُ "
4.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar رضي الله عنهما: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The month is indeed twenty-nine [days at times], so do not fast until you see it, and do not break the fast until you see it, and if it is obscured for you, then estimate it."
4.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ayyub se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar رضي الله عنهما se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Mahina uncatis [din] ka bhi hota hai, so jab tak dekho na roza mat rakho, aur jab tak dekho na roza mat todo, aur agar tumpar chhup jaaye, to andaaza lagaao."

4.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : تَرَاءَى النَّاسُ الْهِلَالَ، فَأَخْبَرْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنِّي رَأَيْتُهُ، " فَصَامَوَأَمَرَ النَّاسَ بِالصِّيَامِ "
4.en: Narrated by Marwan ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn Wahb, from Yahya ibn Salim, from Abu Bakr ibn Nafi', from his father, from Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه: He said: The people looked for the crescent, and I informed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that I had seen it, "so he fasted, and commanded the people to fast."
4.hi: Marwan ibn Muhammad ne Abdullah ibn Wahb se, Yahya ibn Salim se, Abu Bakr ibn Nafi' se, apne walid se, Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه se bataya: Unhone kaha, Log chaand dekhne lage, aur maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko bataya ke maine use dekh liya hai, "to aapne roza rakha aur logon ko roza rakhne ka hukum diya."

4.ar:
حَدَّثَنِي عِصْمَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ الْجُعْفِيُّ  ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ  ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ : جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَقَالَ : إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ الْهِلَالَ.
فَقَالَ : " أَتَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ؟ " قَالَ : نَعَمْ.
قَالَ : " يَا بِلَالُ،نَادِ فِي النَّاسِ، فَلْيَصُومُوا غَدًا "
4.en: Narrated by Ismah ibn al-Fadl, from Husayn al-Ju'fi, from Za'idah, from Simak, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: He said: A Bedouin came to the Prophet ﷺ, and said: "Indeed I saw the crescent." So he said: "Do you testify that there is no god but Allah, and that I am the Messenger of Allah?" He said, "Yes." He said: "O Bilal, announce among the people, so let them fast tomorrow."
4.hi: Ismah ibn al-Fadl ne Husayn al-Ju'fi se, Za'idah se, Simak se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek Bedouin Nabi ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Maine chaand dekha hai." To aapne poocha: "Kya tum gawahi dete ho ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur main Allah ka Rasool hoon?" Usne kaha, "Haan." Aapne farmaya: "Ae Bilal, logon mein elaan karo, ke woh kal roza rakhein."

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الْبَرَاءِ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ أَصْحَابُ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا كَانَ الرَّجُلُ صَائِمًا فَحَضَرَ الْإِفْطَارُ، فَنَامَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُفْطِرَ لَمْ يَأْكُلْ لَيْلَتَهُ وَلَا يَوْمَهُ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، وَإِنَّ قَيْسَ بْنَ صِرْمَةَ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ كَانَ صَائِمًا، فَلَمَّا حَضَرَ الْإِفْطَارُ، أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ، فَقَالَ : عِنْدَكِ طَعَامٌ؟ فَقَالَتْ : لَا، وَلَكِنْ أَنْطَلِقُ فَأَطْلُبُ لَكَ، وَكَانَ يَوْمَهُ يَعْمَلُ، فَغَلَبَتْهُ عَيْنُهُ، وَجَاءَتْ امْرَأَتُهُ، فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ، قَالَتْ : خَيْبَةً لَكَ.
فَلَمَّا انْتَصَفَ النَّهَارُ، غُشِيَ عَلَيْهِ فَذُكِرَ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ،" فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ : # أُحِلَّ لَكُمْ لَيْلَةَ الصِّيَامِ الرَّفَثُ إِلَى نِسَائِكُمْ هُنَّ لِبَاسٌ لَكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ لِبَاسٌ لَهُنَّ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ أَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَخْتَانُونَ أَنْفُسَكُمْ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَعَفَا عَنْكُمْ فَالآنَ بَاشِرُوهُنَّ وَابْتَغُوا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمُ الْخَيْطُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الْخَيْطِ الأَسْوَدِ مِنَ الْفَجْرِ ثُمَّ أَتِمُّوا الصِّيَامَ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ وَلا تُبَاشِرُوهُنَّ وَأَنْتُمْ عَاكِفُونَ فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ تِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ فَلا تَقْرَبُوهَا كَذَلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ آيَاتِهِ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ سورة البقرة آية 187 #، فَفَرِحُوا بِهَا فَرَحًا شَدِيدًا، وَأَكُلُوا وَاشَرِبُوا حَتَّى تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ الْخَيْطُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنْ الْخَيْطِ الْأَسْوَدِ "
4.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Isra'il, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Bara': He said: The companions of Muhammad ﷺ, when a man was fasting and the time to break the fast arrived, if he slept before he broke his fast, he would not eat that night nor that day until evening came; and indeed Qays ibn Sirmah al-Ansari was fasting, so when the time to break the fast arrived, he came to his wife, and said: "Do you have food?" She said, "No, but I will go and seek some for you," and he had been working that day, so his eyes overcame him [with sleep], and his wife came, so when she saw him, she said: "Ruin be upon you." Then when midday came, he fainted, so that was mentioned to the Prophet ﷺ, "so this verse was revealed: 'It has been made lawful for you, on the night of the fast, to approach your wives, they are a garment for you and you are a garment for them; Allah knew that you were betraying yourselves, so He turned to you in forgiveness and pardoned you; so now have relations with them and seek what Allah has decreed for you, and eat and drink until the white thread of dawn becomes distinct from the black thread, then complete the fast until the night; and do not have relations with them while you are in i'tikaf in the mosques; these are the limits of Allah, so do not approach them; thus does Allah make clear His signs to the people that they may become righteous' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 187]," so they rejoiced at it with great joy, and ate and drank until the white thread became distinct from the black thread for them.
4.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Isra'il se, Abu Ishaq se, al-Bara' se bataya: Unhone kaha, Muhammad ﷺ ke sahaba, jab koi aadmi roze se hota aur iftaar ka waqt aata, agar woh iftaar karne se pehle so jaata, to woh us raat aur us din shaam tak kuch nahi khaata; aur Qays ibn Sirmah al-Ansari roze se the, so jab iftaar ka waqt aaya, to woh apni biwi ke paas gaye, aur poocha: "Tumhare paas khaana hai?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi, lekin main jaakar aapke liye dhoondhti hoon," aur woh us din kaam kar rahe the, so unhein neend ne ghayr diya, aur unki biwi aayin, so jab unhone unhein dekha, to kaha: "Tumhari barbaadi ho." Fir jab dopahar hui, to unhein behoshi aa gayi, so yeh baat Nabi ﷺ ko batayi gayi, "to yeh aayat naazil hui: 'Roze ki raat mein tumhare liye apni biwiyon ke paas jaana halal kar diya gaya, woh tumhare liye libaas hain aur tum unke liye libaas ho; Allah ko maloom tha ke tum khud se khiyanat kar rahe the, so usne tumhari tauba qabool ki aur tumhein maaf kiya; so ab unse mubaashirat karo aur jo Allah ne tumhare liye likha hai use talaash karo, aur khaao aur piyo yahan tak ke tumhein subah ka safed dhaaga kaale dhaage se juda nazar aaye, fir raat tak roza poora karo; aur jab tum masjidon mein i'tikaf mein ho to unse mubaashirat na karo; yeh Allah ki hadein hain, so unke qareeb na jao; isi tarah Allah apni nishaaniyaan logon ke liye saaf karta hai taake woh muttaqi ban jaayein' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 187]," so woh isse bahut khush hue, aur khaate-peete rahe yahan tak ke unhein safed dhaaga kaale dhaage se juda nazar aaya.

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ،  عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، لَقَدْ جَعَلْتُ تَحْتَ وِسَادَتِي خَيْطًا أَبْيَضَ وَخَيْطًا أَسْوَدَ، فَمَا تَبَيَّنَ لِي شَيْءٌ.
قَالَ : " إِنَّكَ لَعَرِيضُ الْوِسَادِ، وَإِنَّمَاذَلِكَ اللَّيْلُ مِنْ النَّهَارِ فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى : # وَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمُ الْخَيْطُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الْخَيْطِ الأَسْوَدِ مِنَ الْفَجْرِ ثُمَّ أَتِمُّوا الصِّيَامَ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ وَلا تُبَاشِرُوهُنَّ وَأَنْتُمْ عَاكِفُونَ فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ تِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ فَلا تَقْرَبُوهَا كَذَلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ آيَاتِهِ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ سورة البقرة آية 187 # "
4.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Sharik, from Husayn, from al-Sha'bi, from Adi ibn Hatim: He said: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have indeed placed under my pillow a white thread and a black thread, but nothing has become distinct to me." He said: "Indeed you are wide of pillow! It is only that [refers to] the night [as distinguished] from the day, in His saying, exalted is He: 'And eat and drink until the white thread becomes distinct to you from the black thread of dawn, then complete the fast until the night, and do not have relations with them while you are in i'tikaf in the mosques; these are the limits of Allah, so do not approach them; thus does Allah make clear His signs to the people that they may become righteous' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 187]."
4.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Sharik se, Husayn se, al-Sha'bi se, Adi ibn Hatim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, maine apne takiye ke neeche ek safed dhaaga aur ek kaala dhaaga rakh diya tha, lekin mujhe kuch bhi saaf nahi hua." Aapne farmaya: "Tumhara takiya to bahut chauda hai! Yeh to sirf raat aur din ka [farq] hai, Allah Ta'ala ke is farman mein: 'Aur khaao aur piyo yahan tak ke tumhein subah ka safed dhaaga kaale dhaage se juda nazar aaye, fir raat tak roza poora karo, aur jab tum masjidon mein i'tikaf mein ho to unse mubaashirat na karo; yeh Allah ki hadein hain, so unke qareeb na jao; isi tarah Allah apni nishaaniyaan logon ke liye saaf karta hai taake woh muttaqi ban jaayein' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 187]."

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ،  عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ  ، قَالَ :" تَسَحَّرْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : ثُمَّ قَامَ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ.
قَالَ : قُلْتُ : كَمْ كَانَ بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَالسُّحُورِ؟ قَالَ : قَدْرُ قِرَاءَةِ خَمْسِينَ آيَةً "
4.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Hisham, from Qatadah, from Anas, from Zayd ibn Thabit: He said: "We ate suhoor with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ," he said: "Then he stood for the prayer." He said: I said: "How long was between the adhan and the suhoor?" He said: "The measure of the recitation of fifty verses."
4.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Hisham se, Qatadah se, Anas se, Zayd ibn Thabit se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Humne Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath sehri khaayi," unhone bataya: "Fir aap namaz ke liye khade hue." Unhone bataya: Maine poocha: "Azaan aur sehri ke darmiyan kitna waqfa tha?" Unhone kaha: "Pachas aayaton ki tilaawat jitna."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" تَسَحَّرُوا فَإِنَّ فِي السُّحُورِ بَرَكَةً "
4.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Suhayb, from Anas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Eat suhoor, for indeed in suhoor there is blessing."
4.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Abd al-Aziz ibn Suhayb se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Sehri khaao, kyunki sehri mein barkat hai."

4.ar: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُلَيٍّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبِي  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ أَبِي قَيْسٍ  مَوْلَى عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، قَالَ : كَانَ عَمْرُو بْنُ الْعَاصِ   يَأْمُرُنَا أَنْ نَصْنَعَ لَهُ الطَّعَامَ يَتَسَحَّرُ بِهِ فَلَا يُصِيبُ مِنْهُ كَثِيرًا، فَقُلْنَا : تَأْمُرُنَا بِهِ وَلَا تُصِيبُ مِنْهُ كَثِيرًا؟ قَالَ : إِنِّي لَا آمُرُكُمْ بِهِ أَنِّي أَشْتَهِيهِ، وَلَكِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ :" فَصْلُ مَا بَيْنَ صِيَامِنَا وَصِيَامِ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ أَكْلَةُ السَّحَرِ "
4.en: Narrated by Wahb ibn Jarir, from Musa ibn Ulayy, from his father, from Abu Qays, freed servant of Amr ibn al-As: He said: Amr ibn al-As used to command us to prepare food for him with which to eat suhoor, but he would not eat much of it, so we said: "You command us with it, but you do not eat much of it?" He said: I do not command you with it because I crave it, but I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "The dividing line between our fasting and the fasting of the People of the Book is the meal of suhoor."
4.hi: Wahb ibn Jarir ne Musa ibn Ulayy se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine apne walid ko bayaan karte suna, Abu Qays se, jo Amr ibn al-As ke azaad kiye hue ghulam the: Unhone kaha, Amr ibn al-As humein hukum dete ke hum unke liye sehri ka khaana taiyaar karein, lekin woh usmein se zyada nahi khaate, to humne poocha: "Aap humein iska hukum dete hain, lekin khud zyada nahi khaate?" Unhone kaha: Main tumhein iska hukum isliye nahi deta ke mujhe iski khwaahish hai, balke maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna: "Humare roze aur Ahl-e-Kitab ke roze ke darmiyan farq sehri ka khaana hai."

4.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ شُرَحْبِيلَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ،  عَنْ حَفْصَةَ  ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ لَمْ يُبَيِّتْ الصِّيَامَ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ، فَلَا صِيَامَ لَهُ ".
قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : فِي فَرْضِ الْوَاجِبِ أَقُولُ بِهِ
4.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Shurahbil, from Layth ibn Sa'd, from Yahya ibn Ayyub, from Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr, from Salim ibn Abdullah ibn Umar, from Ibn Umar, from Hafsah, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; with Abdullah al-Darimi's confirmation: He said: "Whoever does not settle his intention to fast before dawn, there is no fast for him." Abdullah said: Concerning the obligatory required [fast], I say [hold to] this.
4.hi: Sa'id ibn Shurahbil ne Layth ibn Sa'd se, Yahya ibn Ayyub se, Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr se, Salim ibn Abdullah ibn Umar se, Ibn Umar se, Hafsah se, Rasulullah ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jo subah sadiq se pehle roze ki niyat pukhta na kare, uska roza nahi hota." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Farz roze ke maamle mein main isi ka qaail hoon.

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ  ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا يَزَالُ النَّاسُ بِخَيْرٍ مَا عَجَّلُوا الْفِطْرَ "
4.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan al-Thawri, from Abu Hazim, from Sahl ibn Sa'd: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The people will remain in good state as long as they hasten breaking the fast."
4.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan al-Thawri se, Abu Hazim se, Sahl ibn Sa'd se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Log achhi haalat mein rahenge jab tak woh iftaar mein jaldi karte rahenge."

4.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا أَقْبَلَ اللَّيْلُ وَأَدْبَرَ النَّهَارُ وَغَابَتْ الشَّمْسُ، فَقَدْ أَفْطَرْتَ "
4.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Abdah, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Asim ibn Umar, from Umar: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When the night approaches, and the day retreats, and the sun sets, then you have broken the fast [it is time]."
4.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Abdah se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Asim ibn Umar se, Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab raat aa jaaye, aur din chala jaaye, aur suraj doob jaaye, to tum iftaar kar sakte ho."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ  ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ  ، عَنْ الرَّبَاب الضَّبِّيَّةِ  ،  عَنْ عَمِّهَا سَلْمَانَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" إِذَا أَفْطَرَ أَحَدُكُمْ، فَلْيُفْطِرْ عَلَى تَمْرٍ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ، فَلْيُفْطِرْ عَلَى مَاءٍ، فَإِنَّ الْمَاءَ طَهُورٌ "
4.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Thabit ibn Yazid, from Asim, from Hafsah, from al-Rabab al-Dabbiyyah, from her uncle Salman ibn Amir: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "When one of you breaks the fast, let him break it with dates, and if he does not find [that], let him break it with water, for indeed water is purifying."
4.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Thabit ibn Yazid se, Asim se, Hafsah se, al-Rabab al-Dabbiyyah se, apne chacha Salman ibn Amir se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi iftaar kare, to woh khajoor se iftaar kare, aur agar na mile, to paani se iftaar kare, kyunki paani paak karne wala hai."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ فَطَّرَ صَائِمًا، كُتِبَ لَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِهِ، إِلَّا أَنَّهُ لَا يَنْقُصُ مِنْ أَجْرِ الصَّائِمِ "
4.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Abd al-Malik, from Ata, from Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whoever gives a fasting person to break his fast, will have recorded for him the like of his reward, without anything being diminished from the reward of the one fasting."
4.hi: Ya'la ne Abd al-Malik se, Ata se, Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jo kisi roze wale ko iftaar karaaye, uske liye uske jitna hi ajr likh diya jaayega, bagair iske ke roze wale ke ajr mein se kuch kam ho."

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " إِيَّاكُمْ وَالْوِصَالَ " مَرَّتَيْنِ.
قَالُوا : فَإِنَّكَ تُوَاصِلُ؟ قَالَ : " إِنِّيلَسْتُ مِثْلَكُمْ، إِنِّي أَبِيتُ يُطْعِمُنِي رَبِّي وَيَسْقِينِي "
4.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Beware of continuous [uninterrupted] fasting," twice. They said: "But you fast continuously?" He said: "Indeed I am not like you; indeed I spend the night with my Lord feeding me and giving me drink."
4.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Abu al-Zinad se, al-A'raj se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Wisaal (lagataar roze rakhne) se bacho," do martaba. Sahaba ne poocha: "Lekin aap to wisaal karte hain?" Aapne farmaya: "Main tum jaisa nahi hoon; main raat guzarta hoon jismein mera Rab mujhe khilaata aur pilaata hai."

4.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " لَا تُوَاصِلُوا.
قِيلَ : إِنَّكَ تَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ.
قَالَ : " إِنِّيلَسْتُ كَأَحَدِكُمْ، إِنِّي أُطْعَمُ وَأُسْقَى "
4.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Rabi', from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from Anas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do not fast continuously." It was said: "Indeed you do that." He said: "I am not like one of you; indeed I am fed and given drink."
4.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Rabi' ne Shu'bah se, Qatadah se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Wisaal na karo." Kaha gaya: "Lekin aap to aisa karte hain." Aapne farmaya: "Main tum mein se kisi jaisa nahi hoon; mujhe khilaya aur pilaya jaata hai."

4.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ خَبَّابٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ : " لَا تُوَاصِلُوا، فَأَيُّكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُوَاصِلَ، فَلْيُوَاصِلْ إِلَى السَّحَرِ ".
قَالُوا : إِنَّكَ تُوَاصِلُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ.
قَالَ : " إِنِّيأَبِيتُ لِي مُطْعِمٌ يُطْعِمُنِي، وَيَسْقِينِي "
4.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yazid ibn Abdullah, from Abdullah ibn Khabbab, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: That he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Do not fast continuously, and whichever of you wishes to fast continuously, let him fast continuously until suhoor time." They said: "But you fast continuously, O Messenger of Allah." He said: "Indeed I have one who feeds me and gives me drink through the night."
4.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se, Yazid ibn Abdullah se, Abdullah ibn Khabbab se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se bataya ke unhone Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna: "Wisaal na karo, aur jo tum mein se wisaal karna chahe, to woh sehri ke waqt tak wisaal kare." Sahaba ne poocha: "Lekin aap to wisaal karte hain, Ya Rasulullah." Aapne farmaya: "Mere paas raat bhar koi hai jo mujhe khilaata aur pilaata hai."

4.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ   قَالَ : نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ الْوِصَالِ.
فَقَالَ لَهُ رِجَالٌ مِنْ الْمُسْلِمِينَ : فَإِنَّكَ تُوَاصِلُ.
قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " إِنِّيلَسْتُ مِثْلَكُمْ، إِنِّي أَبِيتُ يُطْعِمُنِي رَبِّي وَيَسْقِينِي ".
فَلَمَّا أَبَوْا أَنْ يَنْتَهُوا عَنْ الْوِصَالِ، وَاصَلَ بِهِمْ يَوْمًا ثُمَّ يَوْمًا، ثُمَّ رَأَوْا الْهِلَالَ، فَقَالَ : " لَوْ تَأَخَّرَ لَزِدْتُكُمْ "، كَالْمُنَكِّلِ لَهُمْ حِينَ أَبَوْا أَنْ يَنْتَهُوا
4.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman, about Abu Hurairah: That Abu Hurairah said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade continuous fasting. So some men from the Muslims said to him: "But you fast continuously." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed I am not like you; indeed I spend the night with my Lord feeding me and giving me drink." So when they refused to stop continuous fasting, he fasted continuously with them a day then another day, then they saw the crescent, so he said: "Had it delayed, I would have increased it for you," as a rebuke to them since they had refused to stop.
4.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se, Uqayl se, Ibn Shihab se, Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman se bataya ke Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne wisaal se mana kiya. To Musalmanon mein se kuch logon ne aapse kaha: "Lekin aap to wisaal karte hain." Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Main tum jaisa nahi hoon; main raat guzarta hoon jismein mera Rab mujhe khilaata aur pilaata hai." So jab unhone wisaal se rukna mana kiya, to aapne unke saath ek din, fir ek aur din wisaal kiya, fir unhone chaand dekh liya, to aapne farmaya: "Agar chaand der se aata to main tumhare liye [wisaal ki muddat] aur badha deta," jaise unhein saza dete hue jab unhone rukne se inkaar kiya tha.

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، أَنَّ حَمْزَةَ بْنَ عَمْرٍو الْأَسْلَمِيَّ سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ السَّفَرَ، فَمَا تَأْمُرُنِي؟ قَالَ :" إِنْ شِئْتَ، فَصُمْ، وَإِنْ شِئْتَ، فَأَفْطِرْ "
4.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from Urwah, from Aisha, about Hamzah ibn Amr al-Aslami: That Hamzah ibn Amr al-Aslami asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, I want to travel, so what do you command me?" He said: "If you wish, fast, and if you wish, break the fast."
4.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, Urwah se, Aisha se bataya ke Hamzah ibn Amr al-Aslami ne Rasulullah ﷺ se poocha, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, main safar karna chahta hoon, to aap mujhe kya hukum dete hain?" Aapne farmaya: "Agar chaho to roza rakho, aur agar chaho to na rakho."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : " خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَامَ الْفَتْحِفَصَامَ وَصَامَ النَّاسُ حَتَّى بَلَغَ الْكَدِيد، ثُمَّ أَفْطَرَ، فَأَفْطَرَ النَّاسُ، فَكَانُوا يَأْخُذُونَ بِالْأَحْدَثِ فَالْأَحْدَثِ مِنْ فِعْلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "
4.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from al-Zuhri, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out in the year of the Conquest, fasting, and the people fasted, until he reached al-Kadid, then he broke his fast, so the people broke their fast, and they used to take the most recent of the actions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ."
4.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, al-Zuhri se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ Fateh ke saal roze ki haalat mein nikle, aur logon ne bhi roza rakha, yahan tak ke aap al-Kadid pahunche, fir aapne roza tod diya, to logon ne bhi tod diya, aur woh Rasulullah ﷺ ke sabse aakhri amal ko apnaate the."

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، وَأَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَسَنِ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، أَنَّهُ ذَكَرَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ فِي سَفَرٍ فَرَأَى زِحَامًا وَرَجُلٌ قَدْ ظُلِّلَ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ : " مَا هَذَا؟ قَالُوا : هَذَا صَائِمٌ.
فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَيْسَ مِنْ الْبِرِّ الصَّوْمُ فِي السَّفَرِ "
