4.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, and Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Ansari, from Muhammad ibn Amr ibn al-Hasan, from Jabir ibn Abdullah: He said: I heard Muhammad ibn Amr ibn al-Hasan narrating, from Jabir ibn Abdullah: that he mentioned that the Prophet ﷺ was on a journey and saw a crowd, and a man being shaded, so he said: "What is this?" They said: "This is a fasting man." So the Prophet ﷺ said: "It is not righteousness to fast on a journey."
4.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim aur Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se, Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Ansari se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Muhammad ibn Amr ibn al-Hasan ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Jabir ibn Abdullah se: ke unhone zikr kiya ke Nabi ﷺ ek safar mein the aur aapne bheed dekhi, aur ek aadmi jispar saaya kiya ja raha tha, to aapne poocha: "Yeh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh ek roze wala aadmi hai." To Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Safar mein roza rakhna neki nahi hai."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ  ، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ الْأَشْعَرِيِّ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَيْسَ مِنْ الْبِرِّ الصِّيَامُ فِي السَّفَرِ "
4.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Yunus, from al-Zuhri, from Safwan ibn Abdullah, from Umm al-Darda, from Ka'b ibn Asim al-Ash'ari: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "It is not righteousness to fast on a journey."
4.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Yunus se, al-Zuhri se, Safwan ibn Abdullah se, Umm al-Darda se, Ka'b ibn Asim al-Ash'ari se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Safar mein roza rakhna neki nahi hai."

4.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ صَفْوَانَ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ  ، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ الْأَشْعَرِيِّ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَيْسَ مِنْ الْبِرِّ الصِّيَامُ فِي السَّفَرِ "
4.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Sufyan, from al-Zuhri, from Safwan ibn Abdullah ibn Safwan, from Umm al-Darda, from Ka'b ibn Asim al-Ash'ari, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "It is not righteousness to fast on a journey."
4.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ne Sufyan se, al-Zuhri se, Safwan ibn Abdullah ibn Safwan se, Umm al-Darda se, Ka'b ibn Asim al-Ash'ari se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Safar mein roza rakhna neki nahi hai."

4.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَاجِرِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ الضَّمْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَدِمْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ، فَلَمَّا ذَهَبْتُ لِأَخْرُجَ، قَالَ : " انْتَظِرْ الْغَدَاءَ يَا أَبَا أُمَيَّةَ ".
قَالَ : فَقُلْتُ : إِنِّي صَائِمٌ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ.
فَقَالَ :" تَعَالَ أُخْبِرْكَ عَنْ الْمُسَافِرِ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَضَعَ عَنْهُ الصِّيَامَ، وَنِصْفَ الصَّلَاةِ ".
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : إِنْ شَاءَ، صَامَ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ، أَفْطَرَ
4.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from Yahya, from Abu Qilabah, from Abu al-Muhajir, from Abu Umayyah al-Damri; with Abu Muhammad's note: He said: I arrived at the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from a journey, and greeted him, so when I went to leave, he said: "Wait for lunch, O Abu Umayyah." He said: So I said: "I am fasting, O Prophet of Allah." So he said: "Come, let me inform you about the traveler: Allah has removed from him the fast, and half the prayer." Abu Muhammad said: If he wishes, he fasts, and if he wishes, he breaks the fast.
4.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se, Yahya se, Abu Qilabah se, Abu al-Muhajir se, Abu Umayyah al-Damri se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main safar se Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas pahuncha aur aapko salaam kiya, so jab main jaane laga, to aapne farmaya: "Khaane ka intezaar karo, Ae Abu Umayyah." Unhone bataya: To maine kaha: "Main roze se hoon, Ae Nabi Allah." To aapne farmaya: "Aao main tumhein musafir ke baare mein bataun: Allah ne uspar se roza, aur namaz ka aadha hissa hataa diya hai." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Agar woh chahe to roza rakhe, aur agar chahe to na rakhe.

4.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْمُقْرِئُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  ، أَنَّ كُلَيْبَ بْنَ ذُهْلٍ الْحَضْرَمِيَّ  أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، قَالَ : رَكِبْتُ مَعَ أَبِي بَصْرَةَ الْغِفَارِيِّ سَفِينَةً مِنْ الْفُسْطَاطِ فِي رَمَضَانَ، فَدَفَعَ،فَقَرَّبَ غَدَاءَهُ.
ثُمَّ قَالَ : اقْتَرِبْ.
فَقُلْتُ : أَلَسْتَ تَرَى الْبُيُوتَ؟ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَصْرَةَ   : " أَرَغِبْتَ عَنْ سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟ "
4.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid al-Muqri, from Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Kulayb ibn Dhuhl al-Hadrami, from Ubayd ibn Jubayr, about Abu Basrah al-Ghifari: He said: I rode with Abu Basrah al-Ghifari on a ship from al-Fustat in Ramadan, so he set off, and brought forward his lunch. Then he said: "Come near." So I said: "Do you not see the houses [i.e., we are still near land]?" So Abu Basrah said: "Have you turned away from the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?"
4.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid al-Muqri ne Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub se, Yazid ibn Abi Habib se, Kulayb ibn Dhuhl al-Hadrami se, Ubayd ibn Jubayr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Ramzan mein Abu Basrah al-Ghifari ke saath al-Fustat se ek kashti mein sawaar hua, so unhone kashti chalaayi, aur apna khaana samne rakha. Fir kaha: "Qareeb aao." To maine kaha: "Kya aap ghar nahi dekh rahe [ke abhi kinaare hi hain]?" To Abu Basrah ne kaha: "Kya tum Rasulullah ﷺ ki sunnat se peechhe hat gaye ho?"

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُطَوِّسِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ أَفْطَرَ يَوْمًا مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مِنْ غَيْرِ رُخْصَةٍ وَلَا مَرَضٍ، فَلَا يَقْضِيَهِ صِيَامُ الدَّهْرِ كُلِّهِ وَلَوْ صَامَ الدَّهْرَ "
4.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Habib ibn Abi Thabit, from Ibn al-Mutawwis, from his father, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever breaks a day's fast from the month of Ramadan without a concession or illness, the fasting of an entire lifetime will not make up for it, even if he fasted for a lifetime."
4.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Habib ibn Abi Thabit se, Ibn al-Mutawwis se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo Ramzan ke mahine ka ek din bagair kisi rukhsat ya bimari ke roza tode, to poori umar ke roze bhi iski qaza nahi kar sakte, chahe woh poori umar roza rakhe."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي حَبِيبُ بْنُ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عُمَارَةَ بْنَ عُمَيْرٍ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُطَوِّسِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ أَفْطَرَ يَوْمًا مِنْ رَمَضَانَ مِنْ غَيْرِ رُخْصَةٍ رَخَّصَهُ اللَّهُ لَهُ، لَمْ يَقْضِ عَنْهُ صِيَامُ الدَّهْرِ "
4.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Habib ibn Abi Thabit, from Umarah ibn Umayr, from Abu al-Mutawwis, from his father, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whoever breaks a day's fast of Ramadan without a concession that Allah granted him, the fasting of a lifetime will not make up for it."
4.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Habib ibn Abi Thabit ne bataya, unhone kaha: Maine Umarah ibn Umayr ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Abu al-Mutawwis se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Jo Ramzan ka ek din bagair us rukhsat ke roza tode jo Allah ne use di ho, to poori umar ke roze bhi iski qaza nahi kar sakte."

4.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الْهَاشِمِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ : هَلَكْتُ؟ فَقَالَ : " وَمَا أَهْلَكَكَ؟ قَالَ : وَاقَعْتُ امْرَأَتِي فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ، قَالَ :" فَأَعْتِقْ رَقَبَةً ".
قَالَ : لَيْسَ عِنْدِي.
قَالَ : " فَصُمْ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ ".
قَالَ : لَا أَسْتَطِيعُ.
قَالَ : " فَأَطْعِمْ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا ".
قَالَ : لَا أَجِدُ.
قَالَ : فَأُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِعَرَقٍ فِيهِ تَمْرٌ، فَقَالَ : " أَيْنَ السَّائِلُ؟ تَصَدَّقْ بِهَذَا ".
 فَقَالَ : أَعَلَى أَفْقَرَ مِنْ أَهْلِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا بَيْنَ لَابَتَيْهَا أَهْلُ بَيْتٍ أَفْقَرَ مِنَّا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " فَأَنْتُمْ إِذًا " وَضَحِكَ حَتَّى بَدَتْ أَنْيَابُهُ.
حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَفْطَرَ فِي رَمَضَانَ فَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ
4.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Da'ud al-Hashimi, from Ibrahim ibn Sa'd, from al-Zuhri, from Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Hurairah; a similar chain also via Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid: He said: A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and said: "I am ruined." He said: "What has ruined you?" He said: "I had intercourse with my wife in the month of Ramadan." He said: "Then free a slave." He said: "I have none." He said: "Then fast two consecutive months." He said: "I am not able." He said: "Then feed sixty poor persons." He said: "I cannot find [the means]." He said: Then a basket containing dates was brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he said: "Where is the questioner? Give this in charity." So he said: "To someone poorer than my family, O Messenger of Allah? By Allah, between its two lava plains there is no family poorer than us." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Then feed your own family with it," and he laughed until his eye-teeth showed. [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Hurairah: that a man broke his fast during Ramadan, and he mentioned the hadith.]
4.hi: Sulayman ibn Da'ud al-Hashimi ne Ibrahim ibn Sa'd se, al-Zuhri se, Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Main barbaad ho gaya." Aapne poocha: "Tumhein kis cheez ne barbaad kiya?" Usne kaha: "Maine Ramzan ke mahine mein apni biwi se sohbat kar li." Aapne farmaya: "To ek ghulam azaad karo." Usne kaha: "Mere paas nahi hai." Aapne farmaya: "To lagataar do mahine roza rakho." Usne kaha: "Main iski taaqat nahi rakhta." Aapne farmaya: "To sath miskeenon ko khaana khilaao." Usne kaha: "Mujhe woh nahi milega." Unhone bataya: Fir Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas khajooron se bhara ek tokra laaya gaya, to aapne farmaya: "Sawaal karne wala kahan hai? Ise sadqa kar do." To usne kaha: "Mere gharwalon se bhi zyada gareeb par, Ya Rasulullah? Allah ki qasam, iski dono kaali chatyaanon ke darmiyan humse zyada gareeb koi gharaana nahi." To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "To phir apne hi gharwalon ko khila do," aur aap itna hanse ke aapki daadhein nazar aa gayin. [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid se, Malik se, Ibn Shihab se, Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Abu Hurairah se bhi aayi hai: ke ek aadmi ne Ramzan mein roza toda, aur unhone hadith zikr ki.]

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى يَعْنِي بْنَ سَعِيدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ  ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الْقَاسِمِ  أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ  أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبَّادَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَائِشَةَ  ، تَقُولُ : إِنَّ رَجُلًا سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : إِنَّهُ احْتَرَقَ، فَسَأَلَهُ : مَا لَهُ؟ فَقَالَ :أَصَابَ أَهْلَهُ فِي رَمَضَانَ.
فَأُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِمِكْتَلٍ يُدْعَى الْعَرَقَ فِيهِ تَمْرٌ، فَقَالَ : " أَيْنَ الْمُحْتَرِقُ؟ " فَقَامَ الرَّجُلُ، فَقَالَ : " تَصَدَّقْ بِهَذَا "
4.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Ansari, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from Muhammad ibn Ja'far ibn al-Zubayr, from Abbad ibn Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr, from Aisha: That a man asked the Prophet ﷺ, and said that he had "burned," so he asked him: "What is wrong with him?" So he said: "He had relations with his wife during Ramadan." So a basket called the 'araq, containing dates, was brought to the Prophet ﷺ, so he said: "Where is the one who burned?" So the man stood up, so he said: "Give this in charity."
4.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Ansari se, Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim se, Muhammad ibn Ja'far ibn al-Zubayr se, Abbad ibn Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr se, Aisha se bataya ke ek aadmi ne Nabi ﷺ se poocha, aur kaha ke woh "jal gaya hai," to aapne usse poocha: "Usay kya hua?" To usne kaha: "Usne Ramzan mein apni biwi se sohbat kar li." So Nabi ﷺ ke paas khajooron se bhara 'araq' naam ka ek tokra laaya gaya, to aapne farmaya: "Jalne wala kahan hai?" To woh aadmi khada hua, to aapne farmaya: "Ise sadqa kar do."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِامْرَأَةٍ :" لَا تَصُومِي إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ "
4.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Sharik, from al-A'mash, from Abu Salih, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, from the Prophet ﷺ: That he said to a woman: "Do not fast except with his permission."
4.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Sharik se, al-A'mash se, Abu Salih se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya ke aapne ek aurat se farmaya: "Uski [shohar ki] ijaazat ke bagair roza mat rakho."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَا تَصُومُ الْمَرْأَةُ يَوْمًا تَطَوُّعًا فِي غَيْرِ رَمَضَانَ، وَزَوْجُهَا شَاهِدٌ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ "
4.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Sufyan, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said, "A woman should not fast a voluntary day outside of Ramadan while her husband is present, except with his permission."
4.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ne Sufyan se, Abu al-Zinad se, al-A'raj se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Aurat Ramzan ke ilawa koi nafl din, jabke uska shohar maujood ho, uski ijaazat ke bagair roza na rakhe."

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ  ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَا تَصُومُ الْمَرْأَةُ يَوْمًا وَزَوْجُهَا شَاهِدٌ، إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ".
قَالَ : فِي النُّذُورِ تَفِي بِهَا
4.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Abu al-Zinad, from Musa ibn Abi Uthman, from his father, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said, "A woman should not fast a day while her husband is present, except with his permission." He said: Concerning vows, she fulfills them.
4.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Abu al-Zinad se, Musa ibn Abi Uthman se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Aurat koi din, jabke uska shohar maujood ho, uski ijaazat ke bagair roza na rakhe." Unhone bataya: Mannaton (nazr) ke maamle mein woh unhein poora karti hai.

4.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " كَانَيُقَبِّلُ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ ".
 فَقَالَ عُرْوَةُ : أَمَا إِنَّهَا لَا تَدْعُو إِلَى خَيْرٍ
4.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "used to kiss while he was fasting." So Urwah said: "Indeed it does not lead to good."
4.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Aisha se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "roze ki haalat mein bosa liya karte the." To Urwah ne kaha: "Yeh baat kisi achhi cheez ki taraf nahi bulaati [yaani, is baat ko baar-baar bayaan karna sahi nahi]."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ الطَّلْحِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" يُقَبِّلُهَا وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ "
4.en: Narrated by Sa'd ibn Hafs al-Talhi, from Shayban, from Yahya ibn Kathir, from Abu Salamah, from Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz, from Urwah, from Aisha: That the Prophet ﷺ used to "kiss her while he was fasting."
4.hi: Sa'd ibn Hafs al-Talhi ne Shayban se, Yahya ibn Kathir se, Abu Salamah se, Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz se, Urwah se, Aisha se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ "roze ki haalat mein unhein bosa dete the."

4.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ  ، قَالَ : هَشِشْتُ فَقَبَّلْتُ وَأَنَا صَائِمٌ، فَجِئْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقُلْتُ : إِنِّي صَنَعْتُ الْيَوْمَ أَمْرًا عَظِيمًا :قَبَّلْتُ وَأَنَا صَائِمٌ.
قَالَ : " أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ مَضْمَضْتَ مِنْ الْمَاءِ؟ " قُلْتُ : إِذًا لَا يَضُرُّ.
قَالَ : " فَفِيمَ؟ "
4.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Layth ibn Sa'd, from Bukayr ibn Abdullah ibn al-Ashajj, from Abd al-Malik ibn Sa'id al-Ansari, from Jabir ibn Abdullah, from Umar ibn al-Khattab: He said: "I felt playful [aroused], so I kissed while I was fasting, so I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and said: 'I have done a great thing today: I kissed while fasting.'" He said: "What do you think if you had rinsed with water?" I said: "In that case, no harm." He said: "Then what [is the issue]?"
4.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Layth ibn Sa'd se, Bukayr ibn Abdullah ibn al-Ashajj se, Abd al-Malik ibn Sa'id al-Ansari se, Jabir ibn Abdullah se, Umar ibn al-Khattab se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Mujhe tabiyat mein hushaari mehsoos hui, to maine roze ki haalat mein bosa le liya, so main Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha: 'Aaj maine ek bahut badi baat ki: maine roze ki haalat mein bosa liya.'" Aapne farmaya: "Tumhara kya khayal hai agar tum paani se kulli karte?" Maine kaha: "Tab koi harj nahi." Aapne farmaya: "To iska [is bose ka] bhi wahi hukum hai."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ يَعْنِي ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ  ، أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ  أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ  ، وَعَائِشَةَ   أَخْبَرتَاهُ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " كَانَيُصْبِحُ جُنُبًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، ثُمَّ يَصُومُ "
4.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Abd al-Malik (Ibn Jurayj), from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Bakr, from his father, from Umm Salamah and Aisha: That Abu Bakr informed him, from his father, that Umm Salamah, and Aisha, informed him: that the Prophet ﷺ "used to awaken in a state of janabah from [being with] his wife, then fast."
4.hi: Abu Asim ne Abd al-Malik (jo Ibn Jurayj hain) se bataya: Mujhe Ibn Shihab ne bataya, ke Abu Bakr ne unhein bataya, apne walid se, ke Umm Salamah, aur Aisha, ne unhein bataya: ke Nabi ﷺ "apni biwi ke saath [sohbat karne] ki wajah se janabat ki haalat mein subah karte, fir roza rakhte."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ نَسِيَ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ فَأَكَلَ أَوْ شَرِبَ، فَلْيُتِمَّ صَوْمَهُ، فَإِنَّمَا أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ وَسَقَاهُ "
4.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Jarir, from Hisham, from Ibn Sirin, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whoever forgets while fasting and eats or drinks, let him complete his fast, for indeed it is only Allah who has fed him and given him drink."
4.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Jarir se, Hisham se, Ibn Sirin se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jo roze ki haalat mein bhool jaaye aur khaa ya pee le, to woh apna roza poora kare, kyunki use to sirf Allah ne khilaaya aur pilaaya hai."

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ الْجَمَّالُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، عَنْ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي ذُبَابٍ  ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَوْ شَرِبَ نَاسِيًا وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ، ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ، فَلْيُتِمَّ صِيَامَهُ، فَإِنَّمَا أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ وَسَقَاهُ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : أَهْلُ الْحِجَازِ يَقُولُونَ : يَقْضِي، وَأَنَا أَقُولُ : لَا يَقْضِي
4.en: Narrated by Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Mihran al-Jammal, from Hatim ibn Isma'il, from al-Harith ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Dhubab, from his uncle, from Abu Hurairah; with Abu Muhammad's differing view: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you eats or drinks forgetfully while he is fasting, then remembers, let him complete his fast, for indeed it is only Allah who has fed him and given him drink." Abu Muhammad said: The people of the Hijaz say: he makes it up, and I say: he does not make it up.
4.hi: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Mihran al-Jammal ne Hatim ibn Isma'il se, al-Harith ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Dhubab se, apne chacha se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se koi bhool kar roze mein khaa ya pee le, fir use yaad aaye, to woh apna roza poora kare, kyunki use to sirf Allah ne khilaaya aur pilaaya hai." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Ahl-e-Hijaz kehte hain: woh qaza karega, aur main kehta hoon: woh qaza nahi karega.

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي  ، حَدَّثَنِي حُسَيْنٌ الْمُعَلِّمُ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، عَنْ يَعِيشَ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" قَاءَ فَأَفْطَرَ ".
قَالَ : فَلَقِيتُ ثَوْبَانَ بِمَسْجِدِ دِمَشْقَ ، فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، فَقَالَ : صَدَقَ، أَنَا صَبَبْتُ لَهُ الْوَضُوءَ.
 قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : إِذَا اسْتَقَاءَ
4.en: Narrated by Abd al-Samad ibn Abd al-Warith, from his father, from Husayn al-Mu'allim, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from al-Awza'i, from Ya'ish ibn al-Walid, from his father, from Ma'dan ibn Abi Talhah, from Abu al-Darda; with Abdullah al-Darimi's clarification: That the Prophet ﷺ "vomited, and broke his fast." He said: Then I met Thawban at the mosque of Damascus, and mentioned that to him, so he said: He spoke the truth, I poured the ablution water for him. Abdullah said: [The ruling applies] when he induces vomiting.
4.hi: Abd al-Samad ibn Abd al-Warith ne bataya: Mujhse mere walid ne bataya: Mujhse Husayn al-Mu'allim ne bataya, Yahya ibn Abi Kathir se, al-Awza'i se, Ya'ish ibn al-Walid se, apne walid se, Ma'dan ibn Abi Talhah se, Abu al-Darda se ke Nabi ﷺ ne "qay (ulti) ki, aur roza tod diya." Unhone bataya: Fir main Thawban se Damascus ki masjid mein mila, aur unhein yeh baat batayi, to unhone kaha: Unhone sach kaha, maine unke liye wudu ka paani unhdela tha. Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: [Yeh hukum tab hai] jab woh jaan-boojh kar qay kare.

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا ذَرَعَ الصَّائِمَ الْقَيْءُ وَهُوَ لَا يُرِيدُهُ، فَلَا قَضَاءَ عَلَيْهِ، وَإِذَا اسْتَقَاءَ، فَعَلَيْهِ الْقَضَاءُ ".
قَالَ عِيسَى : زَعَمَ أَهْلُ الْبَصْرَةِ أَنَّ هِشَامًا أَوْهَمَ فِيهِ، فَمَوْضِعُ الْخِلَافِ هَهُنَا
4.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Isa ibn Yunus, from Hisham ibn Hassan, from Ibn Sirin, from Abu Hurairah; with Isa's note: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When vomit overcomes the fasting person unintentionally, there is no making up due upon him, and when he induces vomiting, then making up is due upon him." Isa said: The people of Basrah claim that Hisham was confused about it, so this is the point of disagreement.
4.hi: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ne Isa ibn Yunus se, Hisham ibn Hassan se, Ibn Sirin se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab roze wale ko bagair irade ke qay aa jaaye, to uspar qaza nahi, aur jab woh jaan-boojh kar qay kare, to uspar qaza wajib hai." Isa kehte hain: Basrah walon ka dawa hai ke Hisham isme ghalat-fehmi mein pad gaye, so ikhtilaaf ki jagah yehi hai.

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمٌ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زِيدَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَشْعَثِ الصَّنْعَانِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ الرَّحَبِيِّ  ، عَنْ شَدَّادِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ  ، قَالَ : مَرَرْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي ثَمَانِ عَشْرَةَ خَلَتْ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ، فَأَبْصَرَ رَجُلًا يَحْتَجِمُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَفْطَرَ الْحَاجِمُ وَالْمَحْجُومُ "
4.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Asim, from Abdullah ibn Zayd, from Abu al-Ash'ath al-San'ani, from Abu Asma al-Rahabi, from Shaddad ibn Aws: He said: I passed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the eighteenth [day] that had passed of Ramadan, and he saw a man cupping, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The cupper and the one cupped have broken their fast."
4.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Asim se, Abdullah ibn Zayd se, Abu al-Ash'ath al-San'ani se, Abu Asma al-Rahabi se, Shaddad ibn Aws se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath Ramzan ke ath'aarhwen din se guzra, to aapne ek aadmi ko hijaama (pachhne lagwate) dekha, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Hijaama karne wale aur karwaane wale dono ka roza toot gaya."

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، أَنَّ أَبَا أَسْمَاءَ الرَّحَبِيَّ  حَدَّثَهُ، أَنَّ ثَوْبَانَ   حَدَّثَهُ، قَالَ : بَيْنَمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَمْشِي بِالْبَقِيعِ إِذَا رَجُلٌ يَحْتَجِمُ، فَقَالَ :" أَفْطَرَ الْحَاجِمُ وَالْمَحْجُومُ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : أَنَا أَتَّقِي الْحِجَامَةَ فِي الصَّوْمِ فِي رَمَضَانَ
4.en: Narrated by Wahb ibn Jarir, from Hisham, from Yahya, from Abu Qilabah, from Abu Asma al-Rahabi, from Thawban; with Abu Muhammad's practice: He said: While the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was walking at al-Baqi', suddenly a man was cupping, so he said: "The cupper and the one cupped have broken their fast." Abu Muhammad said: I am cautious about cupping while fasting in Ramadan.
4.hi: Wahb ibn Jarir ne Hisham se, Yahya se, Abu Qilabah se bataya ke Abu Asma al-Rahabi ne unhein bataya, ke Thawban ne unhein bataya: Unhone kaha, Jabke Rasulullah ﷺ al-Baqi' mein chal rahe the, ek aadmi hijaama karwa raha tha, to aapne farmaya: "Hijaama karne wale aur karwaane wale dono ka roza toot gaya." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Main Ramzan mein roze ki haalat mein hijaama se bachta hoon.

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ وَاصِلٍ  مَوْلَى أَبِي عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ بَشَّارِ بْنِ أَبِي سَيْفٍ  ، عَنْ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ غُطَيْفٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ الْجَرَّاحِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" الصَّوْمُ جُنَّةٌ مَا لَمْ يَخْرِقْهَا ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : يَعْنِي : بِالْغِيبَةِ
4.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid ibn Abdullah, from Wasil, freed servant of Abu Uyaynah, from Bashshar ibn Abi Sayf, from al-Walid ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Iyad ibn Ghutayf, from Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Fasting is a shield, as long as one does not tear it." Abu Muhammad said: meaning: by backbiting.
4.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid ibn Abdullah se, Wasil se (Abu Uyaynah ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), Bashshar ibn Abi Sayf se, al-Walid ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Iyad ibn Ghutayf se, Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Roza ek dhaal hai, jab tak koi use phaad na de." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: yaani, ghibat (chughli) se.

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي  ، عَنْ جَدِّي  ، وَكَانَ جَدِّي قَدْ أُتِيَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَمَسَحَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ، وَقَالَ :" لَا تَكْتَحِلْ بِالنَّهَارِ وَأَنْتَ صَائِمٌ، اكْتَحِلْ لَيْلًا، بِالْإِثْمِدِ، فَإِنَّهُ يَجْلُو الْبَصَرَ وَيُنْبِتُ الشَّعَرَ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : لَا أَرَى بِالْكُحْلِ بَأْسًا
4.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Nu'man Abu al-Nu'man al-Ansari, from his father, from his grandfather; with Abu Muhammad's note: He said: My father narrated to me, from my grandfather - and my grandfather had been brought to the Prophet ﷺ, and he wiped over his head, and said: "Do not apply kohl during the day while you are fasting, apply kohl at night, with ithmid, for indeed it clarifies the sight and grows the hair." Abu Muhammad said: I see no harm in kohl.
4.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Nu'man Abu al-Nu'man al-Ansari se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhse mere walid ne bataya, apne walid (mere dada) se - aur mere dada ko Nabi ﷺ ke paas laaya gaya tha, aur aapne unke sar par masah kiya, aur farmaya: "Din mein roze ki haalat mein surma na lagaao, raat mein 'ithmid' (surma) lagaao, kyunki yeh nazar saaf karta hai aur baal ugaata hai." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Mujhe surme mein koi harj nazar nahi aata.

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي بَكْرٌ هُوَ ابْنُ مُضَرَ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ  مَوْلَى سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الْأَكْوَعِ،  عَنْ سَلَمَةَ  ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ : # وَعَلَى الَّذِينَ يُطِيقُونَهُ فِدْيَةٌ طَعَامُ مِسْكِينٍ سورة البقرة آية 184 #، قَالَ :" كَانَ مَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُفْطِرَ وَيَفْتَدِيَ، فَعَلَ، حَتَّى نَزَلَتْ الْآيَةُ الَّتِي بَعْدَهَا، فَنَسَخَتْهَا "
4.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from Bakr ibn Mudar, from Amr ibn al-Harith, from Yazid, freed servant of Salamah ibn al-Akwa', from Salamah: That he said: When this verse was revealed: "And upon those who are able [to fast, with hardship], a ransom of feeding a poor person" [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 184], he said: "Whoever wanted to break the fast and pay the ransom, did so, until the verse after it was revealed, and it abrogated it."
4.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne bataya: Mujhse Bakr ibn Mudar ne bataya, Amr ibn al-Harith se, Yazid se (Salamah ibn al-Akwa' ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), Salamah se: ke unhone kaha, Jab yeh aayat naazil hui: "Aur jo log isme muqaddar bhar taaqat rakhte hain [mushkil ke saath], unpar fidiya hai ek miskeen ko khilaana" [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 184], unhone bataya: "Jo roza todna aur fidiya dena chahta, karta, yahan tak ke iske baad wali aayat naazil hui, jisne ise mansookh kar diya."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ  ، عَنْ هَارُونَ ابْنِ ابْنَةِ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ أَوْ ابْنِ ابْنِ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا وَهِيَ صَائِمَةٌ، فَأُتِيَ بِإِنَاءٍ فَشَرِبَ ثُمَّ نَاوَلَهَا فَشَرِبَتْ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنْ كَانَ قَضَاءَ رَمَضَانَ، فَصُومِي يَوْمًا آخَرَ، وَإِنْ كَانَ تَطَوُّعًا، فَإِنْ شِئْتِ، فَاقْضِيهِ، وَإِنْ شِئْتِ، فَلَا تَقْضِيهِ "
4.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Simak ibn Harb, from Harun (grandson of Umm Hani), from Umm Hani: That the Prophet ﷺ entered upon her while she was fasting, so a vessel was brought and he drank, then he handed it to her and she drank, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If it was making up for Ramadan, then fast another day, and if it was voluntary, then if you wish, make it up, and if you wish, do not make it up."
4.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Simak ibn Harb se, Harun se (Umm Hani ki beti ke bete ya bete ke bete) bataya, Umm Hani se: ke Nabi ﷺ unke paas dakhil hue jabke woh roze se thin, so ek bartan laaya gaya aur aapne piya, fir unhein diya aur unhone piya, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Agar yeh Ramzan ki qaza thi, to koi aur din roza rakh lo, aur agar yeh nafl thi, to agar chaho to qaza karo, aur agar chaho to na karo."

4.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ  ، قَالَتْ : لَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ، جَاءَتْ فَاطِمَةُ فَجَلَسَتْ عَنْ يَسَارِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأُمُّ هَانِئٍ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ.
قَالَتْ : فَجَاءَتْ الْوَلِيدَةُ بِإِنَاءٍ فِيهِ شَرَابٌ فَنَاوَلَتْهُ، فَشَرِبَ مِنْهُ ثُمَّ نَاوَلَهُ أُمَّ هَانِئٍ ، فَشَرِبَتْ مِنْهُ ثُمَّ قَالَتْ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، لَقَدْ أَفْطَرْتُ، وَكُنْتُ صَائِمَةً.
فَقَالَ لَهَا :" أَكُنْتِ تَقْضِينَ شَيْئًا؟ قَالَتْ : لَا.
قَالَ : " فَلَا يَضُرُّكِ إِنْ كَانَ تَطَوُّعًا ".
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : أَقُولُ بِهِ
4.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Jarir, from Yazid ibn Abi Ziyad, from Abdullah ibn al-Harith, from Umm Hani; with Abu Muhammad's confirmation: She said: When it was the day of the conquest of Makkah, Fatimah came and sat to the left of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and Umm Hani to his right. She said: So a young slave-girl brought a vessel containing a drink and handed it [to him], so he drank from it, then he handed it to Umm Hani, and she drank from it, then she said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have indeed broken my fast, and I was fasting." So he said to her: "Were you making up something [obligatory]?" She said, "No." He said: "Then it does not harm you if it was voluntary." Abu Muhammad said: I hold to this.
4.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Jarir se, Yazid ibn Abi Ziyad se, Abdullah ibn al-Harith se, Umm Hani se bataya: Unhone kaha, Jab Fateh-e-Makkah ka din tha, to Fatimah aayi aur Rasulullah ﷺ ke baaye taraf baith gayi, aur Umm Hani aapke daaye taraf. Unhone bataya: To ek laundi ek bartan laayi jismein sharbat tha aur diya, to aapne usme se piya, fir Umm Hani ko diya, aur unhone usme se piya, fir unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, mera roza toot gaya, jabke main roze se thi." To aapne unse poocha: "Kya tum kisi [farz] ki qaza kar rahi thi?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi." Aapne farmaya: "To tumhein koi nuqsaan nahi agar yeh nafl thi." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Main isi par amal karta hoon.

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى طَعَامٍ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ، فَلْيَقُلْ : إِنِّي صَائِمٌ "
4.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you is invited to food while he is fasting, let him say: 'I am fasting.'"
4.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se, Abu al-Zinad se, al-A'raj se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se kisi ko khaane ki dawat di jaaye jabke woh roze se ho, to woh kahe: 'Main roze se hoon.'"

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ مَوْلَاةً لَنَا يُقَالُ لَهَا لَيْلَى  تُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ جَدَّتِهَا أُمِّ عُمَارَةَ بِنْتِ كَعْبٍ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا، فَدَعَتْ لَهُ بِطَعَامٍ، فَقَالَ لَهَا : " كُلِي ".
فَقَالَتْ : إِنِّي صَائِمَةٌ.
 فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " إِنَّالصَّائِمَ إِذَا أُكِلَ عِنْدَهُ، صَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ حَتَّى يَفْرُغُوا، وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ : حَتَّى يَقْضُوا أَكْلَهُمْ "
4.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Habib al-Ansari, from Layla, from her grandmother Umm Umarah bint Ka'b: He said: I heard a freed servant-woman of ours called Layla narrating, from her grandmother Umm Umarah bint Ka'b: that the Prophet ﷺ entered upon her, and she called for food for him, and he said to her: "Eat." So she said: "I am fasting." So the Prophet ﷺ said: "Indeed when food is eaten in the presence of the fasting person, the angels send blessings upon him until they finish," and sometimes he said: "until they complete their eating."
4.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Habib al-Ansari ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine humari ek azaad ki hui laundi ko jise Layla kaha jaata tha bayaan karte suna, apni dadi Umm Umarah bint Ka'b se: ke Nabi ﷺ unke paas dakhil hue, to unhone aapke liye khaana mangwaaya, aapne farmaya: "Khaao." To unhone kaha: "Main roze se hoon." To Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jab roze wale ke saamne khaana khaaya jaata hai, to farishte uske liye dua karte hain jab tak woh khaana khatam na kar lein," aur kabhi-kabhi farmaate: "jab tak woh apna khaana poora na kar lein."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ  ، قَالَتْ :" مَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ صَامَ شَهْرًا تَامًّا إِلَّا شَعْبَانَ، فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يَصِلُهُ بِرَمَضَانَ لِيَكُونَا شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ، وَكَانَ يَصُومُ مِنْ الشَّهْرِ حَتَّى نَقُولَ : لَا يُفْطِرُ، وَيُفْطِرُ حَتَّى نَقُولَ : لَا يَصُومُ "
4.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah, from Isra'il, from Mansur, from Salim, from Abu Salamah, from Umm Salamah: She said: "I never saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ fast a complete month except Sha'ban, for indeed he used to connect it with Ramadan so that they would be two consecutive months, and he used to fast from the month until we would say: 'He will not break his fast,' and he would break his fast until we would say: 'He will not fast.'"
4.hi: Ubaydullah ne Isra'il se, Mansur se, Salim se, Abu Salamah se, Umm Salamah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko Sha'ban ke siwa kabhi poora mahina roza rakhte nahi dekha, kyunki aap ise Ramzan se joda karte the taake woh do lagataar mahine ban jaayein, aur aap mahine mein itna roza rakhte ke hum kehte: 'Aap roza nahi todenge,' aur itna roza chhodte ke hum kehte: 'Aap roza nahi rakhenge.'"

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحَنَفِيُّ  يُقَالُ : عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا كَانَ النِّصْفُ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ، فَأَمْسِكُوا عَنْ الصَّوْمِ ".
  أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، نَحْوَ هَذَا
4.en: Narrated by Abd al-Samad ibn Abd al-Warith, from Abd al-Rahman al-Hanafi, from al-Ala, from his father, from Abu Hurairah; a similar chain also via al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When it is the middle of Sha'ban, refrain from fasting." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from al-Ala, from his father, from Abu Hurairah.]
4.hi: Abd al-Samad ibn Abd al-Warith ne Abd al-Rahman al-Hanafi se bataya - kaha jaata hai: Abd al-Rahman ibn Ibrahim - al-Ala se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab Sha'ban ka aadha hissa aa jaaye, to [nafl] roze rakhne se ruk jao." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak se, Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, al-Ala se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se bhi aayi hai.]

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْجُرَيْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ  ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ  ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ لِرَجُلٍ : " هَلْ صُمْتَ مِنْ سَرَرِ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ؟ " فَقَالَ : لَا.
قَالَ :" إِذَا أَفْطَرْتَ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ، فَصُمْ يَوْمَيْنِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : سَرَرُهُ : آخِرُهُ
4.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Jurayri, from Abu al-Ala ibn al-Shikhkhir, from Mutarrif, from Imran ibn Husayn; with Abu Muhammad's note: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to a man: "Did you fast [any days] from the sarar of this month?" So he said, "No." He said: "When you break your fast from Ramadan, then fast two days." Abu Muhammad said: its sarar: its end.
4.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Jurayri se, Abu al-Ala ibn al-Shikhkhir se, Mutarrif se, Imran ibn Husayn se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne ek aadmi se poocha: "Kya tumne is mahine ke 'sarar' mein se koi roza rakha?" Usne kaha, "Nahi." Aapne farmaya: "Jab tum Ramzan mein [roza] chhod do, to do din roza rakh lo." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: 'Sarar' ka matlab hai: mahine ka aakhri hissa.

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ :" مَا صَامَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ شَهْرًا كَامِلًا غَيْرَ رَمَضَانَ، وَإِنْ كَانَ لَيَصُومُ إِذَا صَامَ حَتَّى يَقُولَ الْقَائِلُ : لَا وَاللَّهِ لَا يُفْطِرُ، وَيُفْطِرُ إِذَا أَفْطَرَ حَتَّى يَقُولَ الْقَائِلُ : لَا وَاللَّهِ لَا يَصُومُ "
4.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abu Awanah, from Abu Bishr, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "The Prophet ﷺ never fasted a complete month other than Ramadan, and indeed he would fast, when he fasted, until one would say: 'No, by Allah, he will not break his fast,' and he would break his fast, when he broke it, until one would say: 'No, by Allah, he will not fast.'"
4.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Abu Awanah se, Abu Bishr se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Nabi ﷺ ne Ramzan ke siwa kabhi poora mahina roza nahi rakha, aur jab aap roza rakhte, to itna rakhte ke koi kehne wala kehta: 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, aap roza nahi chhodenge,' aur jab roza chhodte, to itna chhodte ke koi kehne wala kehta: 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, aap roza nahi rakhenge.'"

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : ذُكِرَ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَجُلٌ يَصُومُ الدَّهْرَ، فَقَالَ :" لَا صَامَ وَلَا أَفْطَرَ "
4.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from al-Awza'i, from Qatadah, from Mutarrif ibn Abdullah ibn al-Shikhkhir, from his father: He said: A man who fasts perpetually was mentioned in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he said: "He has neither fasted nor broken his fast."
4.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne al-Awza'i se, Qatadah se, Mutarrif ibn Abdullah ibn al-Shikhkhir se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ke saamne us aadmi ka zikr hua jo hamesha roza rakhta hai, to aapne farmaya: "Na usne roza rakha na chhoda [yaani, iska koi ajr nahi]."

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْعَوَّامُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، يَقُولُ : أَوْصَانِي خَلِيلِي بِثَلَاثٍ لَسْتُ بِتَارِكِهِنَّ : " أَنْلَا أَنَامَ إِلَّا عَلَى وِتْرٍ، وَأَنْ أَصُومَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ مِنْ كُلِّ شَهْرٍ، وَأَنْ لَا أَدَعَ رَكْعَتَيْ الضُّحَى ".
 أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَبَّاسٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، نَحْوَهُ
4.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Awwam, from Sulayman ibn Abi Sulayman, from Abu Hurairah; a similar chain also via Abu al-Walid: He said: My father narrated to me: Sulayman ibn Abi Sulayman narrated to me: that he heard Abu Hurairah say: "My close friend advised me with three things which I will not leave: that I not sleep except upon witr, and that I fast three days from every month, and that I not abandon the two rak'ahs of Duha." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Abbas al-Jurayri, from Abu Uthman, from Abu Hurairah.]
4.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Awwam se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhse Sulayman ibn Abi Sulayman ne bataya: ke unhone Abu Hurairah ko kehte suna: "Mere khaleel (mahboob dost) ne mujhe teen baaton ki wasiyat ki jinhein main nahi chhodunga: ke main witr ke bagair na soun, aur ke main har mahine teen din roza rakhun, aur ke main Duha ki do rakat na chhodun." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Abu al-Walid se, Shu'bah se, Abbas al-Jurayri se, Abu Uthman se, Abu Hurairah se bhi aayi hai.]

4.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" صِيَامُ الْبِيضِ صِيَامُ الدَّهْرِ وَإِفْطَارُهُ "
4.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Mu'awiyah ibn Qurrah, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said, "Fasting the white [days, i.e. the 13th, 14th, 15th of the month] is [equivalent to] fasting perpetually, and breaking them likewise."
4.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se, Mu'awiyah ibn Qurrah se, apne walid se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Ayyaam-e-beed (mahine ke 13, 14, 15 tareekh) ke roze rakhna hamesha roza rakhne jaisa hai, aur unhein chhodna [bhi usi tarah hai]."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ شَيْبَةَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبَّادِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِجَابِرٍ   :" أَنَهَى النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ صَوْمِ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ وَرَبِّ هَذَا الْبَيْتِ "
4.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abd al-Hamid ibn Jubayr ibn Shaybah, from Muhammad ibn Abbad ibn Ja'far, about Jabir: He said: I said to Jabir: "Did the Prophet ﷺ forbid fasting on the day of Jumu'ah?" He said: "Yes, by the Lord of this House."
4.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Abd al-Hamid ibn Jubayr ibn Shaybah se, Muhammad ibn Abbad ibn Ja'far se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Jabir se poocha: "Kya Nabi ﷺ ne Jumu'ah ke din roza rakhne se mana kiya tha?" Unhone kaha: "Haan, is Ghar ke Rab ki qasam."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ثَوْرٍ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُسْرٍ  ، عَنْ أُخْتِهِ يُقَالُ لَهَا الصَّمَّاءُ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَا تَصُومُوا يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ إِلَّا فِيمَا افْتُرِضَ عَلَيْكُمْ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَّا كَذَا أَوْ لِحَاءَ شَجَرَةٍ فَلْيَمْضَغْهُ "
4.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Thawr, from Khalid ibn Ma'dan, from Abdullah ibn Busr, from his sister al-Samma': That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do not fast on Saturday except within what has been made obligatory upon you, and if one of you finds nothing but such-and-such, or the bark of a tree, let him chew it."
4.hi: Abu Asim ne Thawr se, Khalid ibn Ma'dan se bataya: Mujhse Abdullah ibn Busr ne bataya, apni behen se jise al-Samma' kaha jaata tha: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Sanicharwaar (Saturday) ko roza mat rakho, siwaay us cheez ke jo tumpar farz ki gayi hai, aur agar tum mein se kisi ko sirf fulaan cheez ya darakht ki chhaal hi mile, to woh use chaba le [taake roze wali cheez na ho, balke haqeeqat mein khaana samjha jaaye]."

4.ar: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ ثَوْبَانَ  ، أَنَّ مَوْلَى  قُدَامَةَ بْنِ مَظْعُونٍ حَدَّثَهُ، أَنَّ مَوْلَى  أُسَامَةَ حَدَّثَهُ، قَالَ : كَانَ أُسَامَةُ   يَرْكَبُ إِلَى مَالٍ لَهُ بِوَادِي الْقُرَى، فَيَصُومُ الِاثْنَيْنِ وَالْخَمِيسَ فِي الطَّرِيقِ، فَقُلْتُ لَهُ : لِمَ تَصُومُ الِاثْنَيْنِ وَالْخَمِيسَ فِي السَّفَرِ وَقَدْ كَبِرْتَ وَضَعُفْتَ أَوْ رَقِقْتَ؟ فَقَالَ : إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَصُومُ الِاثْنَيْنِ وَالْخَمِيسَ، وَقَالَ : " إِنَّأَعْمَالَ النَّاسِ تُعْرَضُ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ وَالْخَمِيسِ "
4.en: Narrated by Wahb ibn Jarir, from Hisham, from Yahya, from Umar ibn al-Hakam ibn Thawban, from the freed servant of Qudamah ibn Maz'un, from the freed servant of Usamah: He said: Usamah used to ride to some property of his at Wadi al-Qura, and he would fast Monday and Thursday on the way, so I said to him: "Why do you fast Monday and Thursday while traveling, when you have grown old and weak, or frail?" So he said: "Indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to fast Monday and Thursday," and said: "Indeed the deeds of people are presented on Monday and Thursday."
4.hi: Wahb ibn Jarir ne Hisham se, Yahya se, Umar ibn al-Hakam ibn Thawban se bataya ke Qudamah ibn Maz'un ke azaad kiye hue ghulam ne unhein bataya, ke Usamah ke azaad kiye hue ghulam ne unhein bataya: Unhone kaha, Usamah apni Wadi al-Qura mein jaayedaad ki taraf sawaari par jaaya karte the, aur raaste mein Somwaar aur Jumeraat ka roza rakhte, to maine unse poocha: "Aap safar mein Somwaar aur Jumeraat ka roza kyun rakhte hain jabke aap budhe ho gaye hain aur kamzor, ya narm ho gaye hain?" To unhone kaha: "Rasulullah ﷺ Somwaar aur Jumeraat ka roza rakha karte the," aur farmaate: "Logon ke a'maal Somwaar aur Jumeraat ke din pesh kiye jaate hain."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ  ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَصُومُ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ وَالْخَمِيسِ، فَسَأَلْتُهُ، فَقَالَ : " إِنَّالْأَعْمَالَ تُعْرَضُ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ وَالْخَمِيسِ "
4.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Muhammad ibn Rifa'ah, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet ﷺ used to fast Monday and Thursday, so I asked him, and he said: "Indeed deeds are presented on Monday and Thursday."
4.hi: Abu Asim ne Muhammad ibn Rifa'ah se, Suhayl se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ Somwaar aur Jumeraat ka roza rakha karte the, so maine aapse poocha, to aapne farmaya: "A'maal Somwaar aur Jumeraat ke din pesh kiye jaate hain."

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو يَعْنِي ابْنَ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَوْسٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، يَرْفَعُهُ قَالَ :" أَحَبُّ الصِّيَامِ إِلَى اللَّهِ G صِيَامُ دَاوُدَ ، كَانَ يَصُومُ يَوْمًا وَيُفْطِرُ يَوْمًا، وَأَحَبُّ الصَّلَاةِ إِلَى اللَّهِ G صَلَاةُ دَاوُدَ ، كَانَ يُصَلِّي نِصْفًا، وَيَنَامُ ثُلُثًا، وَيُسَبِّحُ سُدُسًا ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : هَذَا اللَّفْظُ الْأَخِيرُ غَلَطٌ أَوْ خَطَأٌ، إِنَّمَا هُوَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَنَامُ نِصْفَ اللَّيْلِ وَيُصَلِّي ثُلُثَهُ، وَيُسَبِّحُ تَسْبِيحَةً
4.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Amr ibn Aws, from Abdullah ibn Amr, raising it [to the Prophet ﷺ]; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: "The most beloved fasting to Allah, exalted is He, is the fasting of Dawud, he used to fast a day and break a day, and the most beloved prayer to Allah, exalted is He, is the prayer of Dawud, he used to pray a half, and sleep a third, and glorify [Allah, staying awake] a sixth." Abu Muhammad said: This last wording is a mistake or error, it is rather that he used to sleep half the night and pray a third of it, and glorify [Allah] for one portion.
4.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Amr ibn Aws se, Abdullah ibn Amr se, marfu'an bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Allah Ta'ala ko sabse mahboob roza Dawud ka roza hai, woh ek din roza rakhte aur ek din chhodte, aur Allah Ta'ala ko sabse mahboob namaz Dawud ki namaz hai, woh aadhi raat namaz padhte, aur tihai [raat] sote, aur chhati hisse mein tasbih karte." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Yeh aakhri jumla ghalat hai, asal baat yeh hai ke woh aadhi raat sote the aur uska tihai hissa namaz padhte, aur chhati hisse mein tasbih karte.

4.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ قَزَعَةَ  مَوْلَى زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَا صَوْمَ يَوْمَيْنِ : يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ وَيَوْمَ النَّحْرِ "
4.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr, from Qaza'ah, freed servant of Ziyad, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "There is no fasting on two days: the day of Fitr and the day of Sacrifice."
4.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr se, Qaza'ah se (Ziyad ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Do dinon mein koi roza nahi: Eid-ul-Fitr ke din aur Eid-ul-Adha (qurbani) ke din."

4.ar: حَدَّثَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ  ، وسَعْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ صَامَ رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَهُ سِتَّةً مِنْ شَوَّالٍ، فَذَلِكَ صِيَامُ الدَّهْرِ "
4.en: Narrated by Nu'aym ibn Hammad, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Safwan and Sa'd ibn Sa'id, from Umar ibn Thabit, from Abu Ayyub, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whoever fasts Ramadan, then follows it with six [days] of Shawwal, that is [equivalent to] fasting perpetually."
4.hi: Nu'aym ibn Hammad ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, Safwan aur Sa'd ibn Sa'id se, Umar ibn Thabit se, Abu Ayyub se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jo Ramzan ka roza rakhe, fir Shawwal ke chhe [din ka roza] uske baad rakhe, to yeh hamesha roza rakhne jaisa hai."

4.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ الْحَارِثِ الذِّمَارِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ الرَّحَبِيِّ  ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" صِيَامُ شَهْرٍ بِعَشَرَةِ أَشْهُرٍ، وَسِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ بَعْدَهُنَّ بِشَهْرَيْنِ، فَذَلِكَ تَمَامُ سَنَةٍ "، يَعْنِي شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ، وَسِتَّةَ أَيَّامٍ بَعْدَهُ
4.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Yahya ibn al-Harith al-Dhimari, from Abu Asma al-Rahabi, from Thawban: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Fasting a month equals ten months, and six days after them equals two months, so that is the completion of a year," meaning: the month of Ramadan, and the six days after it.
4.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se, Yahya ibn al-Harith al-Dhimari se, Abu Asma al-Rahabi se, Thawban se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Ek mahine ka roza das mahinon ke barabar hai, aur uske baad chhe din do mahinon ke barabar, so yeh ek saal poora hona hai" - yaani, Ramzan ka mahina, aur uske baad ke chhe din.

4.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، قَالَ : جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى عَلِيٍّ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ شَهْرٍ بَعْدَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ يَصُومُهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عَلِيٌّ   : مَا سَأَلَنِي أَحَدٌ عَنْ هَذَا بَعْدَ إِذْ سَمِعْتُ رَجُلًا سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : أَيُّ شَهْرٍ يَصُومُهُ مِنْ السَّنَةِ بَعْدَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ.فَأَمَرَهُ بِصِيَامِ الْمُحَرَّمِ، وَقَالَ : " إِنَّ فِيهِ يَوْمًا تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَى قَوْمٍ وَيَتُوبُ فِيهِ عَلَى قَوْمٍ "
4.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Fudayl, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Ishaq, from al-Nu'man ibn Sa'd: He said: A man came to Ali and asked him about a month after the month of Ramadan to fast, so Ali said to him: "No one has asked me about this since I heard a man ask the Prophet ﷺ: which month should he fast in the year after the month of Ramadan?" So he commanded him to fast al-Muharram, and said: "Indeed in it is a day on which Allah accepted the repentance of a people, and He accepts repentance in it for a people."
4.hi: Muhammad ibn Sa'id ne Muhammad ibn Fudayl se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Ishaq se, al-Nu'man ibn Sa'd se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke paas aaya aur unse Ramzan ke baad kaunsa mahina roza rakhein poocha, to Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne usse kaha: "Mujhse iske baare mein kisi ne nahi poocha jab se maine ek aadmi ko Nabi ﷺ se poochte suna: saal mein Ramzan ke baad kaunsa mahina roza rakhun." To aapne use Muharram ka roza rakhne ka hukum diya, aur farmaya: "Ismein ek din hai jismein Allah ne ek qaum ki tauba qabool ki thi, aur woh isme [aage bhi] ek qaum ki tauba qabool karta hai."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ عَوْفٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" أَفْضَلُ الصِّيَامِ بَعْدَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ شَهْرُ اللَّهِ الَّذِي تَدْعُونَهُ الْمُحَرَّمَ "
4.en: Narrated by Zayd ibn Awf, from Abu Awanah, from Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr, from Muhammad ibn al-Muntashir, from Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "The best fasting after the month of Ramadan is the month of Allah which you call al-Muharram."
4.hi: Zayd ibn Awf ne Abu Awanah se, Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr se, Muhammad ibn al-Muntashir se, Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Ramzan ke mahine ke baad sabse behtar roza Allah ke us mahine ka hai jise tum Muharram kehte ho."

4.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، وَأَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِمْيَرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" أَفْضَلُ الصِّيَامِ بَعْدَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ الْمُحَرَّمُ "
4.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, and Yahya ibn Hassan, from Abu Awanah, from Abu Bishr, from Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Himyari, from Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "The best fasting after the month of Ramadan is al-Muharram."
4.hi: Abu Nu'aym aur Yahya ibn Hassan ne Abu Awanah se, Abu Bishr se, Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Himyari se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Ramzan ke mahine ke baad sabse behtar roza Muharram hai."

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْمَدِينَةَ ، وَالْيَهُودُ يَصُومُونَ يَوْمَ عَاشُورَاءَ، فَسَأَلَهُمْ، فَقَالُوا : هَذَا الْيَوْمُ الَّذِي ظَهَرَ فِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَى فِرْعَوْنَ.
فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَنْتُمْ أَوْلَى بِمُوسَى فَصُومُوهُ "
4.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from Abu Bishr, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas: That he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ arrived at Madinah, and the Jews were fasting the day of Ashura, so he asked them, and they said: "This is the day on which Musa prevailed over Fir'awn." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "We have more right to Musa, so fast it."
4.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se, Abu Bishr se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ Madinah pahunche, aur Yahoodi Ashura ka roza rakh rahe the, to aapne unse poocha, unhone kaha: "Yeh woh din hai jismein Musa ne Fir'awn par ghalba paaya tha." To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Hum Musa ke zyada haqdaar hain, so isay roza rakho."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَصُومُ يَوْمَ عَاشُورَاءَ،" وَيَأْمُرُنَا بِصِيَامِهِ "
4.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha: That the Prophet ﷺ used to fast the day of Ashura, "and command us to fast it."
4.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Ibn Abi Dhi'b se, al-Zuhri se, Urwah se, Aisha se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ Ashura ka roza rakha karte the, "aur humein isay rakhne ka hukum dete the."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الْأَكْوَعِ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَعَثَ يَوْمَ عَاشُورَاءَ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَسْلَمَ : " إِنَّالْيَوْمَ يَوْمُ عَاشُورَاءَ، فَمَنْ كَانَ أَكَلَ أَوْ شَرِبَ، فَلْيُتِمَّ بَقِيَّةَ يَوْمِهِ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ أَكَلَ أَوْ شَرِبَ، فَلْيَصُمْهُ "
4.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Yazid ibn Abi Ubayd, from Salamah ibn al-Akwa': That the Prophet ﷺ sent, on the day of Ashura, a man from Aslam [to announce]: "Indeed today is the day of Ashura, so whoever has eaten or drunk, let him complete the rest of his day, and whoever has not eaten or drunk, let him fast it."
4.hi: Abu Asim ne Yazid ibn Abi Ubayd se, Salamah ibn al-Akwa' se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne Ashura ke din Aslam qabeele ke ek aadmi ko bheja [elaan karne ke liye]: "Aaj Ashura ka din hai, so jisne khaa ya pee liya ho, to woh apne din ka baaki hissa [bagair khaaye] poora kare, aur jisne na khaaya na piya ho, to woh isay roza rakhe."

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" هَذَا يَوْمُ عَاشُورَاءَ، وَكَانَتْ قُرَيْشٌ تَصُومُهُ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، فَمَنْ أَحَبَّ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَصُومَهُ، فَلْيَصُمْهُ، فَمَنْ أَحَبَّ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَتْرُكَهُ فَلْيَتْرُكْهُ ".
وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ لَا يَصُومُهُ إِلَّا أَنْ يُوَافِقَ صِيَامَهُ
4.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "This is the day of Ashura, and Quraysh used to fast it in the Jahiliyyah, so whoever among you wishes to fast it, let him fast it, and whoever among you wishes to leave it, let him leave it." And Ibn Umar would not fast it except when it coincided with a fast of his.
4.hi: Ya'la ne Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Yeh Ashura ka din hai, aur Quraysh Jahiliyat mein isay roza rakha karte the, so tum mein se jo isay roza rakhna chahe, rakhe, aur jo chhodna chahe, chhod de." Aur Ibn Umar isay tab hi roza rakhte jab yeh unke [pehle se muqarrar] kisi roze ke saath mel khaa jaata.

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : " كَانَ يَوْمُ عَاشُورَاءَ يَوْمًا تَصُومُهُ قُرَيْشٌ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْمَدِينَةَ ، صَامَهُوَأَمَرَ بِصِيَامِهِ، حَتَّى إِذَا فُرِضَ رَمَضَانُ، كَانَ رَمَضَانُ هُوَ الْفَرِيضَةُ، وَتُرِكَ يَوْمُ عَاشُورَاءَ فَمَنْ شَاءَ صَامَهُ، وَمَنْ شَاءَ تَرَكَهُ "
4.en: Narrated by Abd al-Wahhab ibn Sa'id, from Shu'ayb ibn Ishaq, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha: She said: "The day of Ashura was a day which Quraysh used to fast in the Jahiliyyah, so when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ arrived at Madinah, he fasted it and commanded fasting it, until when Ramadan was made obligatory, Ramadan was the obligation, and the day of Ashura was left, so whoever wished, fasted it, and whoever wished, left it."
4.hi: Abd al-Wahhab ibn Sa'id ne Shu'ayb ibn Ishaq se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Ashura ka din woh din tha jise Quraysh Jahiliyat mein roza rakha karte the, so jab Rasulullah ﷺ Madinah pahunche, to aapne isay roza rakha aur isay rakhne ka hukum diya, yahan tak ke jab Ramzan farz hua, to Ramzan hi farz ban gaya, aur Ashura ke din ko chhod diya gaya, so jo chahe isay roza rakhe, aur jo chahe chhod de."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُلَيٍّ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" يَوْمُ عَرَفَةَ ، وَأَيَّامُ التَّشْرِيقِ عِيدُنَا أَهْلَ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَهِيَ أَيَّامُ أَكْلٍ وَشُرْبٍ "
4.en: Narrated by Wahb ibn Jarir, from Musa ibn Ulayy, from his father, from Uqbah ibn Amir: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The day of Arafah, and the days of Tashriq, are our Eid, the people of Islam, and they are days of eating and drinking."
4.hi: Wahb ibn Jarir ne Musa ibn Ulayy se, apne walid se, Uqbah ibn Amir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Arafah ka din, aur ayyaam-e-tashriq, humare, ahl-e-Islam ke, Eid hain, aur yeh khaane-peene ke din hain."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ   عَنْ صَوْمِ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ ، فَقَالَ :" حَجَجْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَلَمْ يَصُمْهُ، وَحَجَجْتُ مَعَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَلَمْ يَصُمْهُ، وَحَجَجْتُ مَعَ عُمَرَ، فَلَمْ يَصُمْهُ، وَحَجَجْتُ مَعَ عُثْمَانَ، فَلَمْ يَصُمْهُ، وَأَنَا لَا أَصُومُهُ، وَلَا آمُرُ بِهِ، وَلَا أَنْهَى عَنْهُ "
4.en: Narrated by al-Mu'alla ibn Asad, from Isma'il ibn Ulayyah, from Ibn Abi Najih, from his father, about Ibn Umar: He said: Ibn Umar was asked about fasting the day of Arafah, so he said: "I performed Hajj with the Prophet ﷺ, and he did not fast it, and I performed Hajj with Abu Bakr, and he did not fast it, and I performed Hajj with Umar, and he did not fast it, and I performed Hajj with Uthman, and he did not fast it, and I do not fast it, nor do I command it, nor do I forbid it."
4.hi: Al-Mu'alla ibn Asad ne Isma'il ibn Ulayyah se, Ibn Abi Najih se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ibn Umar se Arafah ke din ke roze ke baare mein poocha gaya, to unhone kaha: "Maine Nabi ﷺ ke saath Hajj kiya, aur aapne isay roza nahi rakha, aur maine Abu Bakr ke saath Hajj kiya, aur unhone isay roza nahi rakha, aur maine Umar ke saath Hajj kiya, aur unhone isay roza nahi rakha, aur maine Uthman ke saath Hajj kiya, aur unhone isay roza nahi rakha, aur main isay roza nahi rakhta, na iska hukum deta hoon, na isse mana karta hoon."

4.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ بِشْرِ بْنِ سُحَيْمٍ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَمَرَهُ أَوْ أَمَرَ رَجُلًا يُنَادِي أَيَّامَ التَّشْرِيقِ : " أَنَّهُلَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ إِلَّا مُؤْمِنٌ، وَهِيَ أَيَّامُ أَكْلٍ وَشُرْبٍ "
4.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Nafi' ibn Jubayr, from Bishr ibn Suhaym: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded him, or commanded a man, to announce on the days of Tashriq: "That none enters Paradise except a believer, and they are days of eating and drinking."
4.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Nafi' ibn Jubayr se, Bishr ibn Suhaym se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne unhein, ya kisi aadmi ko, hukum diya ke woh ayyaam-e-tashriq mein elaan kare: "Jannat mein sirf momin hi dakhil hoga, aur yeh khaane-peene ke din hain."

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُرَّةَ  مَوْلَى عَقِيلٍ، أَنَّهُ : دَخَلَ هُوَ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَلَى عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، وَذَلِكَ الْغَدَ أَوْ بَعْدَ الْغَدِ مِنْ يَوْمِ الْأَضْحَى، فَقَرَّبَ إِلَيْهِمْ عَمْرٌو طَعَامًا، فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ : إِنِّي صَائِمٌ.
 فَقَالَ عَمْرٌو   : " أَفْطِرْ، فَإِنَّهَذِهِ الْأَيَّامَ الَّتِي كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَأْمُرُنَا بِفِطْرِهَا وَيَنْهَانَا عَنْ صِيَامِهَا.
فَأَفْطَرَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، فَأَكَلَ وَأَكَلْتُ مَعَهُ "
4.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yazid ibn Abdullah, from Abu Murrah, freed servant of Aqil, about Abdullah ibn Amr and Amr ibn al-As: That he entered, he and Abdullah ibn Amr, upon Amr ibn al-As, and that was the day after, or the day after the day after, the day of Sacrifice, so Amr brought food near to them, so Abdullah said: "I am fasting." So Amr said: "Break your fast, for indeed these are the days which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to command us to break our fast in, and forbade us from fasting in." So Abdullah broke his fast, and ate, and I ate with him.
4.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne bataya: Mujhse al-Layth ne bataya: Mujhse Yazid ibn Abdullah ne bataya, Abu Murrah se (Aqil ke azaad kiye hue ghulam): ke woh aur Abdullah ibn Amr, Amr ibn al-As ke paas gaye, aur yeh Eid-ul-Adha ke agle ya us se agle din ki baat hai, so Amr ne unke saamne khaana rakha, to Abdullah ne kaha: "Main roze se hoon." To Amr ne kaha: "Roza tod do, kyunki yeh woh din hain jinmein Rasulullah ﷺ humein roza todne ka hukum dete the aur roza rakhne se mana karte the." So Abdullah ne roza toda, aur khaya, aur maine bhi unke saath khaya.

4.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً نَذَرَتْ أَنْ تَصُومَ، فَمَاتَتْ، فَجَاءَ أَخُوهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " لَوْ كَانَ عَلَيْهَا دَيْنٌ أَكُنْتَ قَاضِيَهُ؟ " قَالَ : نَعَمْ.
 قَالَ :" فَاقْضُوا اللَّهَ، فَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ بِالْوَفَاءِ ".
قَالَ : فَصَامَ عَنْهَا
4.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from Abu Bishr, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas: That a woman vowed to fast, then she died, so her brother came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and asked him about that, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: "If there was a debt upon her, would you pay it off?" He said, "Yes." He said: "Then pay off Allah's due, for Allah has more right to fulfillment." He said: So he fasted on her behalf.
4.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se, Abu Bishr se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas se bataya ke ek aurat ne roza rakhne ki nazar maani, fir woh mar gayi, so uska bhai Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaya aur unse iske baare mein poocha, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne usse farmaya: "Agar uspar koi qarz hota, to kya tum use ada karte?" Usne kaha, "Haan." Aapne farmaya: "To Allah ka haq ada karo, kyunki Allah ka haq wafa ke zyada haqdaar hai." Unhone bataya: To usne uski taraf se roza rakha.

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَخُلُوفُ فَمِ الصَّائِمِ أَطْيَبُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنْ رِيحِ الْمِسْكِ، وَلِلصَّائِمِ فَرْحَتَانِ : فَرْحَةٌ عِنْدَ فِطْرِهِ، وَفَرْحَةٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ "
4.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed the smell of the mouth of the fasting person is more pleasant to Allah than the fragrance of musk, and for the fasting person there are two joys: a joy at the time of breaking his fast, and a joy on the Day of Resurrection."
4.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Roze wale ke muh ki badbu Allah ke nazdeek mushk ki khushbu se zyada pasandeeda hai, aur roze wale ke liye do khushiyaan hain: iftaar ke waqt ki khushi, aur Qayamat ke din ki khushi."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " يَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى :كُلُّ عَمَلِ ابْنِ آدَمَ لَهُ : فَالْحَسَنَةُ بِعَشْرِ أَمْثَالِهَا إِلَى سَبْعِ مِئَةِ ضِعْفٍ، إِلَّا الصِّيَامَ هُوَ لِي وَأَنَا أَجْزِي بِهِ، إِنَّهُ يَتْرُكُ الطَّعَامَ وَشَهْوَتَهُ مِنْ أَجْلِي، وَيَتْرُكُ الشَّرَابَ وَشَهْوَتَهُ مِنْ أَجْلِي، فَهُوَ لِي وَأَنَا أَجْزِي بِهِ "
4.en: Narrated by Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah the Exalted says: Every deed of the son of Adam is for him: the good deed, ten times its like up to seven hundred times, except fasting, it is for Me, and I reward for it, for he leaves food and his desire for it for My sake, and he leaves drink and his desire for it for My sake, so it is for Me, and I reward for it."
4.hi: Yazid ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah Ta'ala farmaata hai: Aadam ke bete ka har amal uske liye hai: naiki das guna se saat sau guna tak, siwaay roze ke, woh mere liye hai aur main hi iska badla dunga, kyunki woh mere liye khaana aur uski khwaahish chhodta hai, aur mere liye peena aur uski khwaahish chhodta hai, so woh mere liye hai aur main hi iska badla dunga."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" الصَّوْمُ جُنَّةٌ "
4.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from al-A'mash, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Fasting is a shield."
4.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne al-A'mash se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Roza ek dhaal hai."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتَوَائِيُّ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَ أُنَاسٍ، قَالَ :" أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمْ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمْ الْأَبْرَارُ، وَتَنَزَّلَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ الْمَلَائِكَةُ "
4.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hisham al-Dastawa'i, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Anas ibn Malik: That the Prophet ﷺ, when he broke his fast among people, said: "Aftara 'indakum as-sa'imun, wa akala ta'amakum al-abrar, wa tanazzalat 'alaykum al-mala'ikah" [The fasting have broken their fast among you, and the righteous have eaten your food, and the angels have descended upon you].
4.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hisham al-Dastawa'i se, Yahya ibn Abi Kathir se, Anas ibn Malik se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ jab kisi ke ghar mein iftaar karte, to farmaate: "Aftara 'indakum as-saa'imun, wa akala ta'aamakumul-abraar, wa tanazzalat 'alaykumul-malaa'ikah" [Roze walon ne tumhare paas iftaar kiya, aur neik logon ne tumhara khaana khaya, aur farishte tumpar utre].

4.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ مُسْلِمًا الْبَطِينَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُمَا، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَا الْعَمَلُ، فِي أَيَّامٍ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ الْعَمَلِ فِي عَشْرِ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ ".
قِيلَ : وَلَا الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ : " وَلَا الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، إِلَّا رَجُلٌ خَرَجَ بِنَفْسِهِ وَمَالِهِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْجِعْ بِشَيْءٍ "
4.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Rabi', from Shu'bah, from Sulayman, from Muslim al-Batin, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "No deed done in [any] days is more excellent than deeds done in the ten days of Dhu al-Hijjah." It was said: "Not even jihad in the path of Allah?" He said: "Not even jihad in the path of Allah, except a man who went out with his self and his wealth then did not return with anything."
4.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Rabi' ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Sulayman ko suna, unhone kaha: Maine Muslim al-Batin ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Koi din aisa nahi jisme amal Zi'l-Hijjah ke das dinon ke amal se behtar ho." Poocha gaya: "Aur Allah ki raah mein jihad bhi nahi?" Aapne farmaya: "Allah ki raah mein jihad bhi nahi, siwaay us shakhs ke jo apni jaan aur apna maal le kar nikla aur kuch bhi le kar wapas na aaya."

4.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَصْبَغُ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَا مِنْ عَمَلٍ أَزْكَى عِنْدَ اللَّهِ G وَلَا أَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا، مِنْ خَيْرٍ يَعْمَلُهُ فِي عَشْرِ الْأَضْحَى ".
قِيلَ : وَلَا الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ : " وَلَا الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ G إِلَّا رَجُلٌ خَرَجَ بِنَفْسِهِ وَمَالِهِ فَلَمْ يَرْجِعْ مِنْ ذَلِكَ بِشَيْءٍ ".
 قَالَ : وَكَانَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ إِذَا دَخَلَ أَيَّامُ الْعَشْرِ، اجْتَهَدَ اجْتِهَادًا شَدِيدًا حَتَّى مَا يَكَادُ يَقْدِرُ عَلَيْهِ
4.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Asbagh, from al-Qasim ibn Abi Ayyub, from Sa'id, from Ibn Abbas, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "There is no deed more purifying with Allah, exalted is He, nor greater in reward, than a good deed done in the ten days of al-Adha." It was said: "Not even jihad in the path of Allah?" He said: "Not even jihad in the path of Allah, exalted is He, except a man who went out with his self and his wealth and did not return from that with anything." He said: And Sa'id ibn Jubayr, when the ten days entered, would exert himself severely until he could hardly manage it.
4.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Asbagh se, al-Qasim ibn Abi Ayyub se, Sa'id se, Ibn Abbas se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Koi amal Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek us achhe amal se zyada paak aur zyada bade ajr wala nahi jo Zi'l-Hijjah ke [pehle] das dinon mein kiya jaaye." Poocha gaya: "Aur Allah ki raah mein jihad bhi nahi?" Aapne farmaya: "Allah Ta'ala ki raah mein jihad bhi nahi, siwaay us shakhs ke jo apni jaan aur apna maal le kar nikla aur usmein se kuch bhi le kar wapas na aaya." Unhone bataya: Aur Sa'id ibn Jubayr, jab yeh das din aate, to itni sakht mehnat karte ke unke liye mushkil ho jaati.

4.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سُهَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" إِذَا جَاءَ رَمَضَانُ، فُتِحَتْ أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ، وَغُلِّقَتْ أَبْوَابُ النَّارِ، وَصُفِّدَتْ الشَّيَاطِينُ "
4.en: Narrated by Abu al-Rabi' al-Zahrani, from Isma'il ibn Ja'far, from Abu Suhayl, from his father, from Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When Ramadan comes, the gates of heaven are opened, and the gates of Hell are closed, and the devils are chained."
4.hi: Abu al-Rabi' al-Zahrani ne Isma'il ibn Ja'far se, Abu Suhayl se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jab Ramzan aata hai, to aasman ke darwaze khol diye jaate hain, aur Jahannam ke darwaze band kar diye jaate hain, aur shayateen ko zanjeeron mein jakad diya jaata hai."

4.ar: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" مَنْ قَامَ رَمَضَانَ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا ، غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ، وَمَنْ قَامَ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ، غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ "
4.en: Narrated by Wahb ibn Jarir, from Hisham, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever stands [in prayer] Ramadan, out of faith and seeking reward, what has preceded of his sins will be forgiven him, and whoever stands [in prayer] the Night of Decree, what has preceded of his sins will be forgiven him."
4.hi: Wahb ibn Jarir ne Hisham se, Yahya ibn Abi Kathir se, Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jo Ramzan mein imaan aur sawaab ki niyat se [raaton mein namaz ke liye] khada ho, uske pichhle gunah maaf kar diye jaate hain, aur jo Shab-e-Qadr mein khada ho, uske pichhle gunah maaf kar diye jaate hain."

4.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ  ، عَنْ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ  ، قَالَ : صُمْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ، قَالَ : فَلَمْ يَقُمْ بِنَا مِنْ الشَّهْرِ شَيْئًا حَتَّى بَقِيَ سَبْعٌ.
قَالَ : فَقَامَ بِنَا حَتَّى ذَهَبَ ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ.
