قَالَ : فَلَمَّا كَانَتْ السَّادِسَةُ، لَمْ يَقُمْ بِنَا، فَلَمَّا كَانَتْ الْخَامِسَةُ، قَامَ بِنَا حَتَّى ذَهَبَ شَطْرُ اللَّيْلِ الْآخِرُ، قُلْنَا : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، لَوْ نَفَّلْتَنَا بَقِيَّةَ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، فَقَالَ : " إِنَّالرَّجُلَ إِذَا قَامَ مَعَ الْإِمَامِ حَتَّى يَنْصَرِفَ مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ، حُسِبَ لَهُ قِيَامُ لَيْلَتِهِ "، فَلَمَّا كَانَتْ الرَّابِعَةُ لَمْ يَقُمْ بِنَا، فَلَمَّا كَانَتْ الثَّالِثَةُ، جَمَعَ أَهْلَهُ وَنِسَاءَهُ، وَالنَّاسَ فَقَامَ بِنَا حَتَّى خَشِينَا أَنْ يَفُوتَنَا الْفَلَاحُ.
قُلْنَا : وَمَا الْفَلَاحُ؟ قَالَ : السُّحُورُ، قَالَ : ثُمَّ لَمْ يَقُمْ بِنَا بَقِيَّةَ الشَّهْرِ.
حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ  ، عَنْ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْجُرَشِيِّ  ، عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ  ، نَحْوَهُ
4.en: Narrated by Zakariya ibn Adi, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Da'ud ibn Abi Hind, from al-Walid ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Jubayr ibn Nufayr, from Abu Dharr; a similar chain also via Ubaydullah ibn Musa: He said: We fasted with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ the month of Ramadan, he said: he did not stand [for night prayer] with us any of the month until seven [nights] remained. He said: Then he stood with us until a third of the night had gone. He said: Then when it was the sixth [from the end], he did not stand with us; then when it was the fifth [from the end], he stood with us until half the latter part of the night had gone, we said: "O Messenger of Allah, if only you had given us extra [prayer] for the rest of this night." So he said: "Indeed when a man stands with the imam until he departs from his prayer, it is counted for him as if he stood the whole night." Then when it was the fourth [from the end], he did not stand with us; then when it was the third [from the end], he gathered his household and his wives, and the people, and he stood with us until we feared that we would miss the falah [pre-dawn success]. We said: "And what is the falah?" He said: The suhoor. He said: Then he did not stand with us for the rest of the month. [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Sufyan, from Da'ud, from al-Walid ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Jurashi, from Jubayr ibn Nufayr al-Hadrami, from Abu Dharr.]
4.hi: Zakariya ibn Adi ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Da'ud ibn Abi Hind se, al-Walid ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Jubayr ibn Nufayr se, Abu Dharr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Humne Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath Ramzan ka roza rakha, unhone bataya: To aapne mahine mein tab tak humein [raat ki namaz mein] khade hokar namaz nahi padhaayi jab tak saat [raatein] baaki na reh gayin. Unhone bataya: Fir aapne us raat humein padhaayi yahan tak ke raat ka tihai hissa guzar gaya. Unhone bataya: Fir jab chhati [aakhri se] raat aayi, to aapne humein nahi padhaayi; fir jab paanchvi [aakhri se] aayi, to aapne humein padhaayi yahan tak ke raat ka aakhri aadha hissa guzar gaya, humne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, kaash aap humein is raat ke baaki hisse mein bhi nafl padha dete." To aapne farmaya: "Jab aadmi imam ke saath khada ho yahan tak ke woh apni namaz se faarigh ho jaaye, to uske liye poori raat khade hone jaisa likh diya jaata hai." Fir jab chauthi [aakhri se] raat aayi, to aapne humein nahi padhaayi; fir jab teesri [aakhri se] aayi, to aapne apne ghar walon, apni biwiyon, aur logon ko jama kiya aur humein padhaayi yahan tak ke humein dar hua ke kahin falaah (sehri ka waqt) na chhoot jaaye. Humne poocha: "Falaah kya hai?" Aapne farmaya: Sehri. Unhone bataya: Fir aapne baaki mahine humein nahi padhaayi. [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Ubaydullah ibn Musa se, Sufyan se, Da'ud se, al-Walid ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Jurashi se, Jubayr ibn Nufayr al-Hadrami se, Abu Dharr se bhi aayi hai.]

4.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنِ عَيَّاشٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : " كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَيَعْتَكِفُ الْعَشْرَ الْأَوَاخِرَ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ الْعَامُ الَّذِي قُبِضَ فِيهِ، اعْتَكَفَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْمًا "
4.en: Narrated by Asim ibn Yusuf, from Abu Bakr ibn Ayyash, from Abu Hasin, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurairah: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to make i'tikaf the last ten [days], so when it was the year in which he passed away, he made i'tikaf twenty days."
4.hi: Asim ibn Yusuf ne Abu Bakr ibn Ayyash se, Abu Hasin se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ aakhri das din i'tikaf kiya karte the, so jis saal aapka wisaal hua, us saal aapne bees din i'tikaf kiya."

4.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ  ، أَنَّ صَفِّيَةَ بِنْتَ حُيَيٍّ   أَخْبَرَتْهُ، أَنَّهَا جَاءَتْ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ تَزُورُهُ فِي" اعْتِكَافِهِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فِي الْعَشْرِ الْأَوَاخِرِ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ، فَتَحَدَّثَتْ عِنْدَهُ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ قَامَتْ "
4.en: Narrated by Abu al-Yaman, from Shu'ayb ibn Abi Hamzah, from al-Zuhri, from Ali ibn Husayn, from Safiyyah bint Huyayy: That she informed him, that she came to the Prophet ﷺ visiting him during "his i'tikaf in the mosque, in the last ten of Ramadan, and she spoke with him for a while then stood [to leave]."
4.hi: Abu al-Yaman ne Shu'ayb ibn Abi Hamzah se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Mujhe Ali ibn Husayn ne bataya, ke Safiyyah bint Huyayy ne unhein bataya ke woh Nabi ﷺ ke paas milne aayi jabke aap "masjid mein i'tikaf mein the, Ramzan ke aakhri das dinon mein, so unhone aapke paas thodi der baat ki fir khadi ho gayin."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ  ، قَالَ : خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُوَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُخْبِرَنَا بِلَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ، فَتَلَاحَى رَجُلَانِ مِنْ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " إِنِّي خَرَجْتُ إِلَيْكُمْ، وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخْبِرَكُمْ بِلَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ، وَكَانَ بَيْنَ فُلَانٍ وَفُلَانٍ لِحَاءٌ فَرُفِعَتْ، وَعَسَى أَنْ يَكُونَ خَيْرًا،فَالْتَمِسُوهَا فِي الْعَشْرِ الْأَوَاخِرِ : فِي الْخَامِسَةِ، وَالسَّابِعَةِ، وَالتَّاسِعَةِ "
4.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Humayd, from Anas, from Ubadah ibn al-Samit: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to us while he wanted to inform us of the Night of Decree, but two men from the Muslims quarreled, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I came out to you, and I wanted to inform you of the Night of Decree, and there was a quarrel between so-and-so and so-and-so, so it was raised [taken away], and perhaps it is better, so seek it in the last ten [nights]: on the fifth, and the seventh, and the ninth [from the end]."
4.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Humayd se, Anas se, Ubadah ibn al-Samit se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ humare paas nikle jabke aap humein Shab-e-Qadr ke baare mein bataana chahte the, lekin Musalmanon mein se do aadmi aapas mein jhagad pade, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Main tumhare paas nikla, aur main tumhein Shab-e-Qadr ke baare mein bataana chahta tha, aur fulaan aur fulaan ke darmiyan jhagda hua, so woh [ilm] utha liya gaya, aur shayad yeh tumhare liye behtar ho, so isay aakhri das raaton mein talaash karo: paanchvi, saatvi, aur nauvi mein."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، قَالَ : وَقَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ : " أُرِيتُ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ ثُمَّ أَيْقَظَنِي بَعْضُ أَهْلِي فَنَسِيتُهَا،فَالْتَمِسُوهَا فِي الْعَشْرِ الْغَوَابِرِ "
4.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yunus, from Ibn Shihab, and via Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I was shown the Night of Decree, then some of my family woke me and I forgot it, so seek it in the last [remaining] ten."
4.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se, Yunus se, Ibn Shihab se bataya: Unhone kaha, aur Abu Salamah ne bhi kaha, Abu Hurairah se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Mujhe Shab-e-Qadr dikhaayi gayi, fir mere ghar wale kisi ne mujhe jaga diya to main bhool gaya, so isay baaki aakhri das mein talaash karo."

4.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" الْتَمِسُوا لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ فِي السَّبْعِ الْأَوَاخِرِ "
4.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim ibn Abdullah, from Abdullah ibn Umar: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Seek the Night of Decree in the last seven [nights].'"
4.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se, Uqayl se, Ibn Shihab se bataya: Mujhe Salim ibn Abdullah ne bataya, ke Abdullah ibn Umar ne kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Shab-e-Qadr ko aakhri saat raaton mein talaash karo."

5.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الْفُقَيْمِيُّ  ، عَنْ مِهْرَانَ أَبِي صَفْوَانَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ أَرَادَ الْحَجَّ فَلْيَتَعَجَّلْ "
5.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Mu'awiyah, from al-Hasan ibn Amr al-Fuqaymi, from Mihran Abu Safwan, from Ibn Abbas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever intends the Hajj, let him hasten."
5.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Mu'awiyah se, al-Hasan ibn Amr al-Fuqaymi se, Mihran Abu Safwan se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo Hajj ka irada rakhe, use jaldi kar leni chahiye."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ  ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَابِطٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ لَمْ يَمْنَعْهُ عَنْ الْحَجِّ حَاجَةٌ ظَاهِرَةٌ، أَوْ سُلْطَانٌ جَائِرٌ، أَوْ مَرَضٌ حَابِسٌ، فَمَاتَ وَلَمْ يَحُجَّ، فَلْيَمُتْ إِنْ شَاءَ يَهُودِيًّا ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ نَصْرَانِيًّا "
5.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Sharik, from Layth, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Sabit, from Abu Umamah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever is not prevented from Hajj by an evident need, or an oppressive ruler, or a detaining illness, and dies without performing Hajj, let him die, if he wishes, as a Jew, and if he wishes, as a Christian."
5.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Sharik se, Layth se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Sabit se, Abu Umamah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jise Hajj se koi zaahiri zaroorat, ya zaalim hukmaraan, ya rok denay wali bimari na roke, aur woh bagair Hajj kiye mar jaaye, to woh chaahe Yahoodi ban kar mare, ya Isaai ban kar mare."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُجَاهِدُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ أَرْقَمَ  ، يَقُولُ :" حَجَّ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَعْدَ هِجْرَتِهِ حَجَّةً "
5.en: Narrated by Mujahid ibn Musa, from Yahya ibn Adam, from Zuhayr, from Abu Ishaq, from Zayd ibn Arqam: He said: "The Prophet ﷺ performed Hajj once after his emigration."
5.hi: Mujahid ibn Musa ne Yahya ibn Adam se, Zuhayr se, Abu Ishaq se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Zayd ibn Arqam ko kehte suna: "Nabi ﷺ ne apni hijrat ke baad ek martaba Hajj kiya."

5.ar: قَالَ : وَقَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاق   :" حَجَّ قَبْلَ هِجْرَتِهِ حَجَّةً "
5.en: Continuing the same narration, from Abu Ishaq: He said: And Abu Ishaq said: "He performed Hajj once before his emigration."
5.hi: Unhone bataya: Aur Abu Ishaq ne kaha: "Aapne hijrat se pehle ek martaba Hajj kiya."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِأَنَسٍ   : كَمْ حَجَّ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟ قَالَ :" حَجَّةً وَاحِدَةً، وَاعْتَمَرَ أَرْبَعًا : عُمْرَتُهُ الْأُولَى الَّتِي صَدَّهُ الْمُشْرِكُونَ عَنْ الْبَيْتِ ، وَعُمْرَتُهُ الثَّانِيَةُ حِينَ صَالَحُوهُ فَرَجَعَ مِنْ الْعَامِ الْمُقْبِلِ، وَعُمْرَتُهُ مِنْ الْجِعْرَانَةِ حِينَ قَسَّمَ غَنِيمَةَ حُنَيْنٍ فِي ذِي الْقَعْدَةِ، وَعُمْرَتُهُ مَعَ حَجَّتِهِ "
5.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Hammam, from Qatadah, from Anas: He said: I said to Anas: "How many times did the Prophet ﷺ perform Hajj?" He said: "Once, and he performed Umrah four times: his first Umrah when the polytheists barred him from the House, and his second Umrah when they made peace with him, so he returned the following year, and his Umrah from al-Ji'ranah when he distributed the spoils of Hunayn in Dhu al-Qa'dah, and his Umrah with his Hajj."
5.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Hammam se, Qatadah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Anas se poocha: "Nabi ﷺ ne kitni martaba Hajj kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Ek martaba, aur chaar martaba Umrah kiya: pehla Umrah jab mushrikeen ne aapko Baitullah se roka tha, aur doosra Umrah jab unhone aapse sulah ki, to aap agle saal wapas aaye, aur al-Ji'ranah se Umrah jab aapne Hunayn ki ghaneemat Zi'l-Qa'dah mein taqseem ki, aur apne Hajj ke saath Umrah."

5.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ سِنَانٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمْ الْحَجُّ ".
فَقِيلَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فِي كُلِّ عَامٍ؟ قَالَ : " لَا، وَلَوْ قُلْتُهَا لَوَجَبَتْ، الْحَجُّ مَرَّةٌ فَمَا زَادَ فَهُوَ تَطَوُّعٌ ".
 أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ  ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، نَحْوَهُ
5.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir, from Sulayman ibn Kathir, from al-Zuhri, from Sinan, from Ibn Abbas; a similar chain also via Ubaydullah ibn Musa: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Hajj has been prescribed for you." So it was said: "O Messenger of Allah, every year?" He said: "No, and had I said it, it would have become obligatory; Hajj is once, and whatever exceeds it is voluntary." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Sharik, from Simak, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas.]
5.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir ne Sulayman ibn Kathir se, al-Zuhri se, Sinan se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tumpar Hajj farz kiya gaya hai." To poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah, har saal?" Aapne farmaya: "Nahi, aur agar main haan kehta, to yeh wajib ho jaata; Hajj ek martaba hai, aur jo zyada ho woh nafl hai." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Ubaydullah ibn Musa se, Sharik se, Simak se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se bhi aayi hai.]

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" وَقَّتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِأَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ ذَا الْحُلَيْفَةِ ، وَلِأَهْلِ الشَّامِ الْجُحْفَةَ ، وَلِأَهْلِ نَجْدٍ قَرْنًا ".
قَالَ : قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ : أَمَّا هَذِهِ الثَّلَاثُ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُهُنَّ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَبَلَغَنِي أَنَّهُ وَقَّتَ لِأَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ يَلَمْلَمَ .
أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، مِثْلَهُ
5.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Yunus, from Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar; a similar chain also via Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Malik, from Abdullah ibn Dinar: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ appointed for the people of Madinah Dhu al-Hulayfah, and for the people of Sham al-Juhfah, and for the people of Najd Qarn." He said: Ibn Umar said: As for these three, I heard them from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and it reached me that he appointed for the people of Yemen Yalamlam. [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Malik, from Abdullah ibn Dinar, from Ibn Umar, the like of it.]
5.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Yunus ne Malik se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Madinah walon ke liye Dhu al-Hulayfah, aur Sham walon ke liye al-Juhfah, aur Najd walon ke liye Qarn ki miqaat muqarrar ki." Unhone bataya: Ibn Umar ne kaha: Rahi baat in teenon ki, to maine inhein Rasulullah ﷺ se suna, aur mujhe khabar mili ke aapne Yemen walon ke liye Yalamlam muqarrar ki. [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Ahmad ibn Abdullah se, Malik se, Abdullah ibn Dinar se, Ibn Umar se bhi aayi hai.]

5.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَاوُسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" وَقَّتَ لِأَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ ذَا الْحُلَيْفَةِ ، وَلِأَهْلِ الشَّامِ الْجُحْفَةَ ، وَلِأَهْلِ نَجْدٍ قَرْنَ الْمَنَازِلِ ، وَلِأَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ يَلَمْلَمَ ، هُنَّ لِأَهْلِهِنَّ، وَلِكُلِّ آتٍ أَتَى عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ غَيْرِهِنَّ مِمَّنْ أَرَادَ الْحَجَّ وَالْعُمْرَةَ، وَمَنْ كَانَ دُونَ ذَلِكَ فَمِنْ حَيْثُ أَنْشَأَ، حَتَّى أَهْلُ مَكَّةَ مِنْ مَكَّةَ "
5.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Wuhayb, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, from Ibn Abbas: That the Prophet ﷺ "appointed for the people of Madinah Dhu al-Hulayfah, and for the people of Sham al-Juhfah, and for the people of Najd Qarn al-Manazil, and for the people of Yemen Yalamlam, these are for their people, and for every comer who passes by them from other than them, of those intending Hajj and Umrah, and whoever is short of that, then from where he sets out, even the people of Makkah, from Makkah."
5.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Wuhayb se, Ibn Tawus se, apne walid se, Ibn Abbas se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne "Madinah walon ke liye Dhu al-Hulayfah, aur Sham walon ke liye al-Juhfah, aur Najd walon ke liye Qarn al-Manazil, aur Yemen walon ke liye Yalamlam muqarrar ki, yeh unke apne logon ke liye hain, aur har uske liye jo inse guzarte hue aaye, chahe woh in ilaqon ka na ho, jo Hajj aur Umrah ka irada rakhta ho, aur jo isse kareeb ho, to woh jahan se chale wahi uski miqaat hai, yahan tak ke Makkah wale khud Makkah se [ehraam baandhein]."

5.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : امْتَرَى الْمِسْوَرُ بْنُ مَخْرَمَةَ، وَابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فِي غَسْلِ الْمُحْرِمِ رَأْسَهُ، فَأَرْسَلُونِي إِلَى أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الْأَنْصَارِيّ : كَيْفَ رَأَيْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَغْسِلُ رَأْسَهُ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ؟ فَأَتَيْتُ أَبَا أَيُّوبَ   وَهُوَ بَيْنَ قَرْنَيْ الْبِئْرِ وَقَدْ سُتِرَ عَلَيْهِ بِثَوْبٍ، فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَضَمَّ الثَّوْبَ إِلَيْهِ، فَقُلْتُ : أَرْسَلَنِي إِلَيْكَ ابْنُ أَخِيكَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ : كَيْفَ رَأَيْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَغْسِلُ رَأْسَهُ؟" فَأَمَرَّ يَدَيْهِ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ مُقْبِلًا وَمُدْبِرًا "
5.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yunus, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim ibn Abdullah ibn Hunayn, from his father, about al-Miswar ibn Makhramah, Ibn Abbas, and Abu Ayyub al-Ansari: He said: al-Miswar ibn Makhramah, and Ibn Abbas, disputed concerning the muhrim washing his head, so they sent me to Abu Ayyub al-Ansari [to ask]: "How did you see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wash his head while he was in ihram?" So I came to Abu Ayyub while he was between the two posts of a well and had been screened with a garment, so I greeted him, and he drew the garment toward himself, so I said: "Your nephew's son Ibn Abbas has sent me to you [to ask]: How did you see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wash his head?" "So he passed his hands over his head, forward and backward."
5.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se, Yunus se, Ibn Shihab se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Salim ibn Abdullah ibn Hunayn ne bataya, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, al-Miswar ibn Makhramah, aur Ibn Abbas, muhrim ke sar dhone ke maamle mein ikhtilaaf karne lage, to unhone mujhe Abu Ayyub al-Ansari ke paas bheja [poochne ke liye]: "Aapne Rasulullah ﷺ ko kaise dekha ke aap ehraam ki haalat mein apna sar dhoya karte the?" So main Abu Ayyub ke paas gaya jabke woh kuen ke do khambon ke darmiyan the aur unpar ek kapde ka parda daala hua tha, to maine unhein salaam kiya, aur unhone kapda apni taraf khainch liya, to maine kaha: "Aapke bhatije ke bete Ibn Abbas ne mujhe aapke paas bheja hai [yeh poochne]: Aapne Rasulullah ﷺ ko apna sar dhote kaise dekha?" "To unhone apne haath apne sar par aage se peechhe ki taraf phera."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي زِيَادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ الْمَدَنِيُّ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ خَارِجَةَ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" تَجَرَّدَ لِلْإِهْلَالِ وَاغْتَسَلَ "
5.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Abi Ziyad, from Abdullah ibn Ya'qub al-Madani, from Ibn Abi al-Zinad, from his father, from Kharijah ibn Zayd ibn Thabit, from his father: That the Prophet ﷺ "undressed for the talbiyah and bathed."
5.hi: Abdullah ibn Abi Ziyad ne Abdullah ibn Ya'qub al-Madani se, Ibn Abi al-Zinad se, apne walid se, Kharijah ibn Zayd ibn Thabit se, apne walid se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne "talbiyah ke liye [apne pehne hue silay kapde] utaar diye aur ghusl kiya."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ سُمَيٍّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" حَجَّةٌ مَبْرُورَةٌ لَيْسَ لَهَا ثَوَابٌ إِلَّا الْجَنَّةُ، وَعُمْرَتَانِ تُكَفِّرَانِ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا مِنْ الذُّنُوبِ "
5.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Sufyan, from Sumayy, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "An accepted Hajj has no reward except Paradise, and two Umrahs expiate what is between them of sins."
5.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Sufyan se, Sumayy se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Maqbool Hajj ka sawaab Jannat ke siwa kuch nahi, aur do Umre unke darmiyan ke gunahon ka kaffara ban jaate hain."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي مَنْصُورٌ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا حَازِمٍ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" مَنْ حَجَّ الْبَيْتَ فَلَمْ يَرْفُثْ وَلَمْ يَفْسُقْ، رَجَعَ كَمَا وَلَدَتْهُ أُمُّهُ "
5.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from Mansur, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: That he said: "Whoever performs Hajj to the House and does not engage in obscene speech nor commit transgression, returns as [pure as] the day his mother bore him."
5.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Shu'bah se bataya: Mujhse Mansur ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Hazim ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se: ke aapne farmaya, "Jo Baitullah ka Hajj kare aur be-hayaai ki baat na kare aur na gunah kare, woh waise wapas aata hai jaise us din tha jab uski maa ne use janam diya."

5.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ  ، عَنْ الضَّحَّاكِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَرْبُوعٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ  ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : أَيُّ الْحَجِّ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ :" الْعَجُّ وَالثَّجُّ ".
  الْعَجُّ يَعْنِي : التَّلْبِيَةَ، وَالثَّجُّ يَعْنِي : إِهْرَاقَ الدَّمِ
5.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Abi Fudayk, from al-Dahhak ibn Uthman, from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Yarbu', from Abu Bakr: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked: Which Hajj is best? He said: "Al-'ajj wa al-thajj." Al-'ajj means: the talbiyah, and al-thajj means: the shedding of blood.
5.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Ala ne Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Abi Fudayk se, al-Dahhak ibn Uthman se, Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Yarbu' se, Abu Bakr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ se poocha gaya: Kaunsa Hajj sabse behtar hai? Aapne farmaya, "Al-'Ajju wath-Thajj." Al-'Ajj ka matlab hai: talbiyah, aur al-Thajj ka matlab hai: [qurbani ka] khoon bahaana.

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى هُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : مَا نَلْبَسُ مِنْ الثِّيَابِ إِذَا أَحْرَمْنَا؟ قَالَ :" لَا تَلْبَسُوا الْقُمُصَ، وَلَا السَّرَاوِيلَاتِ، وَلَا الْعَمَائِمَ، وَلَا الْبَرَانِسَ، وَلَا الْخِفَافَ، إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ أَحَدٌ لَيْسَتْ لَهُ نَعْلَانِ، فَلْيَلْبَسْ الْخُفَّيْنِ وَلْيَجْعَلْهُمَا أَسْفَلَ مِنْ الْكَعْبَيْنِ، وَلَا تَلْبَسُوا مِنْ الثِّيَابِ شَيْئًا مَسَّهُ وَرْسٌ وَلَا زَعْفَرَانٌ "
5.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Umar ibn Nafi', from his father, from Ibn Umar: That a man asked the Prophet ﷺ: What garments do we wear when we enter ihram? He said: "Do not wear shirts, nor trousers, nor turbans, nor hooded cloaks, nor leather socks, except one who has no sandals, let him wear the leather socks and make them lower than the ankles, and do not wear any garment touched by wars or saffron."
5.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Umar ibn Nafi' se, apne walid se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke ek aadmi ne Nabi ﷺ se poocha: Jab hum ehraam baandhein to kaunse kapde pehnein? Aapne farmaya: "Qamees na pehno, na paajaame, na ammame (pagdiyaan), na topi wale burnus, na moze, siwaay us shakhs ke jiske paas jootiyan na hon, to woh moze pehen le aur unhein takhnon se neeche kaat de, aur koi aisa kapda na pehno jisse 'wars' ya kesar chhua ho."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" مَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ إِزَارًا، فَلْيَلْبَسْ سَرَاوِيلَ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ نَعْلَيْنِ، فَلْيَلْبَسْ خُفَّيْنِ ".
قَالَ : قُلْتُ أَوْ قِيلَ : أَيَقْطَعُهُمَا؟ قَالَ : " لَا "
5.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Abu al-Sha'tha, from Ibn Abbas: That he heard the Prophet ﷺ say: "Whoever does not find a lower wrap, let him wear trousers, and whoever does not find sandals, let him wear leather socks." He said: I said, or it was said: "Should he cut them?" He said: "No."
5.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Abu al-Sha'tha se bataya: Mujhe Ibn Abbas ne bataya, ke unhone Nabi ﷺ ko farmaate suna: "Jise izaar na mile, woh paajaama pehen le, aur jise jootiyan na milein, woh moze pehen le." Unhone bataya: Maine poocha, ya poocha gaya: "Kya unhein kaatna hoga?" Aapne farmaya: "Nahi."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَمَّا يَلْبَسُ الْمُحْرِمُ، قَالَ :" لَا يَلْبَسُ الْقُمُصَ، وَلَا الْعَمَائِمَ، وَلَا السَّرَاوِيلَاتِ، وَلَا الْبَرَانِسَ، وَلَا الْخِفَافَ، إِلَّا أَنْ لَا يَجِدَ نَعْلَيْنِ، فَلْيَلْبَسَ خُفَّيْنِ وَيَقْطَعَهُمَا أَسْفَلَ مِنْ الْكَعْبَيْنِ "
5.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about what the muhrim wears, he said: "He does not wear shirts, nor turbans, nor trousers, nor hooded cloaks, nor leather socks, except that if he does not find sandals, let him wear leather socks and cut them below the ankles."
5.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ se poocha gaya ke muhrim kya pehne, aapne farmaya: "Woh qamees na pehne, na ammame, na paajaame, na burnus, na moze, siwaay iske ke agar use jootiyan na milein, to woh moze pehen le aur unhein takhnon se neeche kaat de."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ : "كُنْتُ أُطَيِّبُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُحْرِمَ بِأَطْيَبِ الطِّيبِ "، قَالَ : وَكَانَ عُرْوَةُ يَقُولُ لَنَا : " تَطَيَّبُوا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُحْرِمُوا وَقَبْلَ أَنْ تُفِيضُوا يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ "
5.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha: That she said: "I used to perfume the Messenger of Allah ﷺ before he entered ihram with the best perfume." He said: And Urwah used to say to us: "Perfume yourselves before you enter ihram and before you depart on the day of Sacrifice."
5.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Main Rasulullah ﷺ ko ehraam baandhne se pehle behtareen khushbu lagaaya karti thi." Unhone bataya: Aur Urwah humse kaha karte the: "Ehraam baandhne se pehle aur qurbani ke din nafr (waapasi) karne se pehle khushbu lagaao."

5.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : " لَقَدْ كُنْتُأُطَيِّبُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عِنْدَ إِحْرَامِهِ بِأَطْيَبِ مَا أَجِدُ "
5.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Hisham, from Uthman ibn Urwah, from Urwah, from Aisha: She said: "I used to perfume the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at his ihram with the best that I could find."
5.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se, Hisham se, Uthman ibn Urwah se, Urwah se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Main Rasulullah ﷺ ko unke ehraam ke waqt behtareen khushbu se, jo bhi mujhe milti, lagaaya karti thi."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، وَجَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الْقَاسِمِ  أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا، تَقُولُ :" طَيَّبْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِحُرْمِهِ، وَطَيَّبْتُهُ بِمِنًى قَبْلَ أَنْ يُفِيضَ "
5.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, and Ja'far ibn Awn, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from his father, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: He said: I heard Aisha رضي الله عنها say: "I perfumed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for his ihram, and I perfumed him at Mina before he departed."
5.hi: Yazid ibn Harun aur Ja'far ibn Awn ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se bataya ke Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim ne unhein bataya, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, Maine Aisha رضي الله عنها ko kehte suna: "Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko unke ehraam ke liye khushbu lagaayi, aur Mina mein bhi khushbu lagaayi unke [Baitullah ki taraf] jaane se pehle."

5.ar: حَدَّثَنِي عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : " نُفِسَتْ أَسْمَاءُ بِمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ بِالشَّجَرَةِ فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَنْ" تَغْتَسِلَ وَتُهِلَّ "
5.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Abdah, from Ubaydullah ibn Umar, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from his father, from Aisha: She said: "Asma went into labor with Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr at al-Shajarah, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded Abu Bakr that she should bathe and enter ihram."
5.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Abdah se, Ubaydullah ibn Umar se, Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim se, apne walid se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Asma ko Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr ki paidaish ka dard al-Shajarah mein shuru hua, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne Abu Bakr ko hukum diya ke woh ghusl karke ehraam baandh lein."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، فِي حَدِيثِ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ عُمَيْسٍ ، حِينَ نُفِسَتْ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ ، فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَنْ يَأْمُرَهَا أَنْ" تَغْتَسِلَ وَتُهِلَّ "
5.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Jarir, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Jabir: In the hadith of Asma bint Umays, when she went into labor at Dhu al-Hulayfah, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded Abu Bakr to command her that she should bathe and enter ihram.
5.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Jarir se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Ja'far ibn Muhammad se, apne walid se, Jabir se bataya, Asma bint Umays ki hadith mein, jab unhein Dhu al-Hulayfah mein paidaish ka dard shuru hua, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne Abu Bakr ko hukum diya ke woh unhein hukum dein ke woh ghusl karke ehraam baandh lein.

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، عَنْ خُصَيْفٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" أَحْرَمَ دُبُرَ الصَّلَاةِ "
5.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Abd al-Salam ibn Harb, from Khusayf, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: That the Prophet ﷺ "entered ihram after [immediately following] a prayer."
5.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Abd al-Salam ibn Harb se, Khusayf se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne "namaz ke turant baad ehraam baandha."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ هُوَ ابْنُ شُمَيْلٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَشْعَثُ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" أَحْرَمَ وَأَهَلَّ فِي دُبُرِ الصَّلَاةِ "
5.en: Narrated by Ishaq, from al-Nadr ibn Shumayl, from Ash'ath, from al-Hasan, from Anas ibn Malik: That the Prophet ﷺ "entered ihram and said the talbiyah, following a prayer."
5.hi: Ishaq ne al-Nadr ibn Shumayl se, Ash'ath se, al-Hasan se, Anas ibn Malik se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne "namaz ke baad ehraam baandha aur talbiyah kahi."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا لَبَّى، قَالَ :" لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ "
5.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That the Prophet ﷺ, when he said the talbiyah, said: "Labbayka Allahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk, innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak."
5.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ jab talbiyah kehte, to farmaate: "Labbayka Allahumma labbayk, labbayka laa shareeka laka labbayk, innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, laa shareeka lak" [Main haazir hoon, Ae Allah, main haazir hoon, main haazir hoon, tera koi shareek nahi, main haazir hoon, beshak tareef aur ne'mat teri hai, aur baadshahat bhi, tera koi shareek nahi].

5.ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى  : وَذَكَرَ نَافِعٌ  أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ   كَانَ يَزِيدُ هَؤُلَاءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ :" لَبَّيْكَ وَالرَّغْبَاءُ إِلَيْكَ وَالْعَمَلُ، لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ "
5.en: Continuing from Yahya, mentioning Nafi's and Ibn Umar's addition: Yahya said: And Nafi' mentioned that Ibn Umar used to add these words: "Labbayka war-raghba'u ilayka wal-'amal, labbayka labbayk."
5.hi: Yahya kehte hain: Aur Nafi' ne zikr kiya ke Ibn Umar in alfaaz ka izafa kiya karte the: "Labbayka war-raghbaa'u ilayka wal-'amal, labbayka labbayk" [Main haazir hoon, aur raghbat aur amal teri hi taraf hai, main haazir hoon, main haazir hoon].

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ خَلَّادِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَتَانِي جِبْرَائِيلُ ، فَقَالَ : مُرْ أَصْحَابَكَ أَوْ مَنْ مَعَكَ أَنْ يَرْفَعُوا أَصْوَاتَهُمْ بِالتَّلْبِيَةِ أَوْ بِالْإِهْلَالِ ".
حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ  ، بِإِسْنَادِهِ نَحْوَهُ
5.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr, from Khallad ibn al-Sa'ib, from his father; a similar chain also via Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Uyaynah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Jibril came to me, and said: 'Command your companions, or those with you, to raise their voices with the talbiyah, or with the entering into ihram.'" [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Uyaynah, from Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr, with his chain.]
5.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr se, Khallad ibn al-Sa'ib se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jibreel mere paas aaye, aur kaha: 'Apne sathiyon ko, ya jo tumhare saath hain unhein, hukum do ke woh talbiyah mein, ya ehraam baandhne mein, apni awaaz bulund karein.'" [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Uthman ibn Muhammad se, Ibn Uyaynah se, Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr se, unki sanad ke saath bhi aayi hai.]

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِلَالُ بْنُ خَبَّابٍ  ، قَالَ : فَحَدَّثْتُ عِكْرِمَةَ  فَحَدَّثَنِي،  عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   : أَنَّ ضُبَاعَةَ بِنْتَ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ ، أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَتْ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَحُجَّ، فَكَيْفَ أَقُولُ؟ قَالَ : " قُولِي :لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، وَمَحِلِّي حَيْثُ تَحْبِسُنِي، فَإِنَّ لَكِ عَلَى رَبِّكِ مَا اسْتَثْنَيْتِ "
5.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Thabit ibn Yazid, from Hilal ibn Khabbab, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas, about Duba'ah bint al-Zubayr: That Duba'ah bint al-Zubayr ibn Abd al-Muttalib came to the Prophet ﷺ, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, I want to perform Hajj, so how should I say [my intention]?" He said: "Say: Labbayka Allahumma labbayk, wa mahilli haythu tahbisuni, fa inna laki 'ala Rabbiki ma istathnayt."
5.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Thabit ibn Yazid se, Hilal ibn Khabbab se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ikrimah ko bataya, to unhone mujhe bataya, Ibn Abbas se: ke Duba'ah bint al-Zubayr ibn Abd al-Muttalib Nabi ﷺ ke paas aayin, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, main Hajj karna chahti hoon, to kya kahoon?" Aapne farmaya: "Kaho: 'Labbayka Allahumma labbayk, wa mahilli haythu tahbisuni, fa inna laki 'ala Rabbiki ma istathnayt' [Main haazir hoon, Ae Allah, main haazir hoon, aur mera nikalne ka jagah wahi hai jahan tu mujhe roke, kyunki jo tumne shart lagaayi hai woh tumhare Rab ke zimme hai]."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْهَا، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" أَفْرَدَ الْحَجَّ "
5.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from his father, from Aisha رضي الله تعالى عنها: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "performed Hajj alone [ifrad]."
5.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim se, apne walid se, Aisha رضي الله تعالى عنها se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "sirf Hajj kiya [Umrah ke saath jama kiye bagair]."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو هِلَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عِمْرَانُ بْنُ حُصَيْنٍ   : إِنِّي مُحَدِّثُكَ بِحَدِيثٍ لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَنْفَعَكَ بِهِ بَعْدُ، إِنَّهُ كَانَ يُسَلَّمُ عَلَيَّ وَإِنَّ ابْنَ زِيَادٍ أَمَرَنِي فَاكْتَوَيْتُ، فَاحْتُبِسَ عَنِّي حَتَّى ذَهَبَ أَثَرُ الْمَكَاوِي، وَاعْلَمْ أَنَّ" الْمُتْعَةَ حَلَالٌ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ، لَمْ يَنْهَ عَنْهَا نَبِيٌّ، وَلَمْ يَنْزِلْ فِيهَا كِتَابٌ "، قَالَ رَجُلٌ بِرَأْيِهِ مَا بَدَا لَهُ
5.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Abu Hilal, from Qatadah, from Mutarrif, from Imran ibn Husayn: He said: I will narrate to you a hadith which perhaps Allah will benefit you with afterward - indeed I used to be greeted [by angels], and Ibn Ziyad commanded me, so I was cauterized, and then it was withheld from me until the trace of the cauterization went away, and know that "mut'ah is lawful in the Book of Allah, no prophet forbade it, and no [abrogating] revelation came down concerning it," a man said [something against it] based on his own opinion, whatever occurred to him.
5.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Abu Hilal se, Qatadah se, Mutarrif se bataya: Unhone kaha, Imran ibn Husayn ne kaha: Main tumhein ek hadith bayaan karunga jissey shayad Allah tumhein baad mein faida de - mujhe [farishton ka] salaam mila karta tha, aur Ibn Ziyad ne mujhe hukum diya to maine daagh lagwaaya, so daagh ka asaar jaane tak yeh [salaam] mujhse rok diya gaya, aur jaan lo ke "mut'ah (Hajj-e-tamattu') Allah ki Kitaab mein halal hai, kisi Nabi ne isse mana nahi kiya, aur na hi iske baare mein koi [mansookh karne wali] Kitaab naazil hui," ek aadmi ne apni raay se jo bhi usay theek laga woh kaha.

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَامَ حَجَّ مُعَاوِيَةُ يَسْأَلُ سَعْدَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ   :" كَيْفَ تَقُولُ بِالتَّمَتُّعِ بِالْعُمْرَةِ إِلَى الْحَجِّ؟ قَالَ : حَسَنَةٌ جَمِيلَةٌ ".
فَقَالَ : قَدْ كَانَ عُمَرُ يَنْهَى عَنْهَا، فَأَنْتَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ عُمَرَ؟ قَالَ : عُمَرُ خَيْرٌ مِنِّي، وَقَدْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ عُمَرَ
5.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from al-Zuhri, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Nawfal, about Mu'awiyah and Sa'd ibn Malik: He said: I heard, in the year Mu'awiyah performed Hajj, him asking Sa'd ibn Malik: "What do you say about tamattu' with Umrah [combined] with Hajj?" He said: "A good and beautiful thing." So he said: "But Umar used to forbid it, are you better than Umar?" He said: "Umar is better than me, but the Prophet ﷺ did that, and he is better than Umar."
5.hi: Ahmad ibn Khalid ne Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, al-Zuhri se, Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Nawfal se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine us saal jab Mu'awiyah ne Hajj kiya, unhein Sa'd ibn Malik se poochte suna: "Aap Umrah ko Hajj ke saath jama karne (tamattu') ke baare mein kya kehte hain?" Unhone kaha: "Achhi aur khoobsurat baat hai." To unhone kaha: "Lekin Umar isse mana karte the, kya aap Umar se behtar hain?" Unhone kaha: "Umar mujhse behtar hain, lekin yeh Nabi ﷺ ne kiya, aur woh Umar se behtar hain."

5.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ  ، عَنْ طَارِقٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى  ، قَالَ : أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حِينَ حَجَّ وَهُوَ مُنِيخٌ بِالْبَطْحَاءِ ، فَقَالَ لِي : " أَحَجَجْتَ؟ " قُلْتُ : نَعَمْ.
قَالَ : " كَيْفَ أَهْلَلْتَ؟ ".
قَالَ : قُلْتُ : لَبَّيْكَ بِإِهْلَالٍ كَإِهْلَالِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
قَالَ : " أَحْسَنْتَ،اذْهَبْ فَطُفْ بِالْبَيْتِ ، وَبِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ ، ثُمَّ حِلَّ ".
قَالَ : فَطُفْتُ بِالْبَيْتِ ، وَبِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ ، ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُ امْرَأَةً مِنْ نِسَاءِ بَنِي قَيْسٍ فَجَعَلَتْ تَفْلِي رَأْسِي، فَجَعَلْتُ أُفْتِي النَّاسَ بِذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ لِي رَجُلٌ : يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ، رُوَيْدًا بَعْضَ فُتْيَاكَ، فَإِنَّكَ لَا تَدْرِي مَا أَحْدَثَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي النُّسُكِ بَعْدَكَ.
فَقُلْتُ : يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ، مَنْ كُنَّا أَفْتَيْنَاهُ فُتْيَا، فَلْيَتَّئِدْ، فَإِنَّ أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ قَادِمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ فَبِهِ فَأْتَمُّوا.
فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ أَتَيْتُهُ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، فَقَالَ : إِنْ نَأْخُذْ بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ، فَإِنَّ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ يَأْمُرُ بِالتَّمَامِ، وَإِنْ نَأْخُذْ بِسُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَمْ يَحِلَّ حَتَّى بَلَغَ الْهَدْيُ مَحِلَّهُ
5.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from Qays ibn Muslim, from Tariq, from Abu Musa: He said: I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he performed Hajj, and he was resting his camel at al-Batha, so he said to me: "Have you performed Hajj?" I said, "Yes." He said: "How did you enter ihram [what did you intend]?" He said: I said: "Labbayk, with an entering into ihram like the entering into ihram of the Prophet ﷺ." He said: "You have done well, go and circumambulate the House, and [go between] al-Safa and al-Marwah, then release [from ihram]." He said: So I circumambulated the House, and [went between] al-Safa and al-Marwah, then I came to a woman from the women of Banu Qays and she began to pick lice from my head, and I began giving legal rulings to the people about that, so a man said to me: "O Abdullah ibn Qays, go slow with some of your rulings, for you do not know what the Commander of the Believers has newly introduced in the rites after you [left him]." So I said: "O people, whoever we have given a ruling to, let him be deliberate, for the Commander of the Believers is arriving among you, so follow him." So when he arrived, I came to him and mentioned that to him, so he said: "If we take by the Book of Allah, then the Book of Allah commands completion, and if we take by the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not release [from ihram] until the sacrificial animal reached its place [of sacrifice]."
5.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se, Qays ibn Muslim se, Tariq se, Abu Musa se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas Hajj ke waqt aaya jabke aapne apna oont al-Batha mein bithaya hua tha, to aapne mujhse poocha: "Kya tumne Hajj ka ehraam baandha?" Maine kaha, "Haan." Aapne poocha: "Tumne kaisi niyat ki?" Unhone bataya: Maine kaha: "Labbayk, Nabi ﷺ ke jaisi niyat ke saath." Aapne farmaya: "Achha kiya, jao Baitullah ka tawaaf karo, aur Safa aur Marwah ke [darmiyan sa'ee] karo, fir halaal ho jao." Unhone bataya: To maine Baitullah ka tawaaf kiya, aur Safa aur Marwah ke darmiyan sa'ee ki, fir main Banu Qays ki auraton mein se ek aurat ke paas gaya to woh mere sar se joonein nikaalne lagi, aur main logon ko isi ka fatwa dene laga, to ek aadmi ne mujhse kaha: "Ae Abdullah ibn Qays, apne fatwon mein zara thehro, kyunki tumhein nahi maloom ke Ameer-ul-Mumineen ne tumhare [wahan se jaane ke] baad manaasik mein kya naya hukum diya hai." To maine kaha: "Ae logo, jisko humne koi fatwa diya ho, woh sabr se kaam le, kyunki Ameer-ul-Mumineen tumhare paas pahunch rahe hain, so unhi ki pairwi karo." So jab woh pahunche, to main unke paas gaya aur yeh unhein bataya, to unhone kaha: "Agar hum Kitaab-Allah lein, to Kitaab-Allah takmeel (poora karne) ka hukum deti hai, aur agar hum Rasulullah ﷺ ki sunnat lein, to Rasulullah ﷺ tab tak halaal nahi hue jab tak qurbani apni jagah tak na pahunch gayi."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" خَمْسٌ لَا جُنَاحَ فِي قَتْلِ مَنْ قُتِلَ مِنْهُنَّ : الْغُرَابُ، وَالْفَأْرَةُ، وَالْحِدَأَةُ، وَالْعَقْرَبُ، وَالْكَلْبُ الْعَقُورُ "
5.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Yahya, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "Five, there is no blame in killing whichever of them is killed: the crow, and the mouse, and the kite, and the scorpion, and the biting dog."
5.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Yahya se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Paanch cheezein hain jinmein se kisi ko bhi maar dene mein koi harj nahi: kauwa, chuha, cheel, bichhoo, aur kaatne wala kutta."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : " أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَبِقَتْلِ خَمْسِ فَوَاسِقَ فِي الْحِلِّ وَالْحَرَمِ : الْحِدَأَةِ، وَالْغُرَابِ، وَالْفَأْرَةِ، وَالْعَقْرَبِ، وَالْكَلْبِ الْعَقُورِ ".
قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : الْكَلْبُ الْعَقُورُ، وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ : الْأَسْوَدُ.
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ  ، قَالَ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا  : إِنَّ مَعْمَرًا  كَانَ يَذْكُرُهُ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ   وعُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
5.en: Narrated by Ishaq, from Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha رضي الله عنها; with Abdullah's clarification; a similar chain also via Salim, from his father and Urwah: She said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded the killing of five noxious creatures in the profane area and the sacred area: the kite, and the crow, and the mouse, and the scorpion, and the biting dog." Abdullah said: the biting dog, and some of them said: the black one. [Abd al-Razzaq said: some of our companions said: that Ma'mar used to mention it, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from his father, and Urwah, from Aisha رضي الله عنها, from the Prophet ﷺ.]
5.hi: Ishaq ne Abd al-Razzaq se, Ma'mar se, al-Zuhri se, Urwah se, Aisha رضي الله عنها se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne hill aur Haram dono mein paanch nuqsaan-deh jaanwaron ko maarne ka hukum diya: cheel, kauwa, chuha, bichhoo, aur kaatne wala kutta." Abdullah kehte hain: kaatne wala kutta, aur kuch ne kaha: kaala kutta. [Abd al-Razzaq ne bataya: Humare kuch sathiyon ne kaha: ke Ma'mar ise al-Zuhri se, Salim se, apne walid se, aur Urwah se, Aisha رضي الله عنها se, Nabi ﷺ se naql kiya karte the.]

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ :" احْتَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ "
5.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Abdullah ibn Uthman, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had cupping done while he was in ihram."
5.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Abdullah ibn Uthman se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne hijaama karwaya jabke aap ehraam mein the."

5.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلْقَمَةُ بْنُ أَبِي عَلْقَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ  ، قَالَ :" احْتَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِلَحْيِ جَمَلٍ ، وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ "
5.en: Narrated by Marwan ibn Muhammad, from Sulayman ibn Bilal, from Alqamah ibn Abi Alqamah, from Abd al-Rahman al-A'raj, from Abdullah ibn Buhaynah: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had cupping done at Lahy Jamal, while he was in ihram."
5.hi: Marwan ibn Muhammad ne Sulayman ibn Bilal se, Alqamah ibn Abi Alqamah se, Abd al-Rahman al-A'raj se, Abdullah ibn Buhaynah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Lahy Jamal mein hijaama karwaya, jabke aap ehraam mein the."

5.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، وَطَاوُسٍ  ،  عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" احْتَجَمَ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ ".
قَالَ إِسْحَاق L927 : قَالَ سُفْيَانُ مَرَّةً : عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، وَمَرَّةً، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، وَجَمَعَهُمَا مَرَّةً
5.en: Narrated by Ishaq, from Sufyan, from Amr, from Ata, and Tawus, from Ibn Abbas; with Ishaq's note: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "had cupping done while he was in ihram." Ishaq said: Sufyan said once: from Ata, and once: from Tawus, and combined them once.
5.hi: Ishaq ne Sufyan se, Amr se, Ata aur Tawus se, Ibn Abbas se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "hijaama karwaya jabke aap ehraam mein the." Ishaq kehte hain: Sufyan ne ek martaba kaha: Ata se, aur ek martaba: Tawus se, aur ek martaba dono ko jama kiya.

5.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ :" تَزَوَّجَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ "
5.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Jabir ibn Zayd, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "The Prophet ﷺ married while he was in ihram."
5.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Jabir ibn Zayd se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Nabi ﷺ ne nikaah kiya jabke aap ehraam mein the."

5.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ نُبَيْهِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ   : أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ خَطَبَ إِلَى أَبَانَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ وَهُوَ أَمِيرُ الْمَوْسِمِ ، فَقَالَ أَبَانُ : لَا أُرَاهُ إِلا عِرَاقِيًّا جَافِيًا، " إِنَّالْمُحْرِمَ لَا يَنْكِحُ وَلَا يُنْكِحُ ".
أَخْبَرَنَا بِذَلِكَ عُثْمَانُ  ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
سُئِلَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : تَقُولُ بِهَذَا؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ
5.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Nafi', from Nubayh ibn Wahb; with Abu Muhammad's confirmation: That a man from Quraysh proposed [marriage] to Aban ibn Uthman, while he was the commander of the pilgrimage season, so Aban said: "I do not see him except as a rough Iraqi, indeed the muhrim does not marry nor arrange marriage for another." He informed us of that, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Abu Muhammad was asked: "Do you hold to this?" He said, "Yes."
5.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ayyub se, Nafi' se, Nubayh ibn Wahb se bataya ke Quraysh ke ek shakhs ne Aban ibn Uthman se rishta maanga, jabke woh Hajj ke mausam ke ameer the, to Aban ne kaha: "Mujhe yeh sirf ek ganwaar Iraqi lagta hai, muhrim na khud nikaah karta hai na kisi aur ka karwata hai." Unhone yeh baat Rasulullah ﷺ se humein bataayi. Abu Muhammad se poocha gaya: "Kya aap isi ke qaail hain?" Unhone kaha, "Haan."

5.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ الشَّهِيدِ  ، عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْأَصَمِّ  ، أَنَّ مَيْمُونَةَ  ، قَالَتْ :" تَزَوَّجَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَنَحْنُ حَلَالَانِ بَعْدَمَا رَجَعَ مِنْ مَكَّةَ بِسَرِفَ "
5.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Asim, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Habib ibn al-Shahid, from Maymun ibn Mihran, from Yazid ibn al-Asamm, from Maymunah: She said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ married me while we were both free of ihram, after he returned from Makkah at Sarif."
5.hi: Amr ibn Asim ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Habib ibn al-Shahid se, Maymun ibn Mihran se, Yazid ibn al-Asamm se, Maymunah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhse nikaah kiya jabke hum dono ehraam se aazad the, Makkah se wapas aane ke baad Sarif mein."

5.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ مَطَرٍ الْوَرَّاقِ  ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ  ، قَالَ :" تَزَوَّجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَيْمُونَةَ حَلَالًا، وَبَنَى بِهَا حَلَالًا، وَكُنْتُ الرَّسُولَ بَيْنَهُمَا "
5.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Matar al-Warraq, from Rabi'ah ibn Abi Abd al-Rahman, from Sulayman ibn Yasar, from Abu Rafi': He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ married Maymunah while free of ihram, and consummated the marriage while free of ihram, and I was the messenger between the two of them."
5.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Matar al-Warraq se, Rabi'ah ibn Abi Abd al-Rahman se, Sulayman ibn Yasar se, Abu Rafi' se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Maymunah se nikaah kiya jabke halaal (ehraam se aazad) the, aur unke saath rukhsati bhi halaal haalat mein hui, aur main un dono ke darmiyan qasid tha."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتَوَائِيُّ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ  ، قَالَ : انْطَلَقَ أَبِي   مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَامَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ، فَأَحْرَمَ أَصْحَابُهُ وَلَمْ يُحْرِمْ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ، فَأَصَابَ حِمَارَ وَحْشٍ، فَطَعَنَهُ وَأَكَلَ مِنْ لَحْمِهِ، فَقُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي أَصَبْتُ حِمَارَ وَحْشٍ، فَطَعَنْتُهُ، فَقَالَ لِلْقَوْمِ :" كُلُوا " وَهُمْ مُحْرِمُونَ
5.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hisham al-Dastawa'i, from Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah: He said: My father set out with the Prophet ﷺ in the year of al-Hudaybiyyah, and his companions entered ihram but Abu Qatadah did not enter ihram, so he hit a wild donkey, and stabbed it, and ate from its meat, so I said: "O Messenger of Allah, I hit a wild donkey and stabbed it," so he said to the group: "Eat," while they were in ihram.
5.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hisham al-Dastawa'i se, Yahya se, Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mere walid Hudaybiyyah ke saal Nabi ﷺ ke saath gaye, unke sathiyon ne ehraam baandha lekin Abu Qatadah ne nahi baandha, to unhone ek jangli gadha [dekh kar] shikaar kiya, aur usay bhonka, aur uska gosht khaya, to maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, maine jangli gadha shikaar kiya aur usay bhonka," to aapne jama'at se farmaya: "Khaao," jabke woh ehraam mein the.

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ نَسِيرُ وَهُمْ مُحْرِمُونَ، وَأَبُو قَتَادَةَ حَلَالٌ، إِذْ رَأَيْتُ حِمَارًا، فَرَكِبْتُ فَرَسًا، فَأَصَبْتُهُ، فَأَكَلُوا مِنْ لَحْمِهِ وَهُمْ مُحْرِمُونَ وَلَمْ آكُلْ، فَأَتَوْا النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَسَأَلُوهُ، فَقَالَ :" أَشَرْتُمْ، قَتَلْتُمْ؟ أَوْ قَالَ : ضَرَبْتُمْ؟ قَالُوا : لَا، قَالَ : فَكُلُوا "
5.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Uthman ibn Abdullah ibn Mawhab, from Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah, from his father: He said: While we were traveling and they were in ihram, and Abu Qatadah was free of ihram, suddenly I saw a donkey, so I rode a horse, and I hit it, so they ate from its meat while in ihram, and I did not eat, so they came to the Prophet ﷺ and asked him, so he said: "Did you point/signal to it? Did you kill it? Or he said: Did you strike it?" They said, "No." He said: "Then eat."
5.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se, Uthman ibn Abdullah ibn Mawhab se, Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Jabke hum chal rahe the aur woh ehraam mein the, aur Abu Qatadah halaal the, achanak maine ek gadha dekha, to main ghode par sawaar hua, aur usay maara, to unhone ehraam mein hote hue uska gosht khaya, aur maine nahi khaaya, to woh Nabi ﷺ ke paas aaye aur unse poocha, to aapne farmaya: "Kya tumne ishara kiya tha? Kya tumne isay maara tha? Ya farmaya: Kya tumne isay ghayel kiya tha?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi." Aapne farmaya: "To khaao."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنْ الصَّعْبِ بْنِ جَثَّامَةَ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أُتِيَ بِلَحْمِ حِمَارِ وَحْشٍ، فَرَدَّهُ وَقَالَ : " إِنَّاحُرُمٌ لَا نَأْكُلُ الصَّيْدَ "
5.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Salih ibn Kaysan, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah, from Ibn Abbas, from al-Sa'b ibn Jaththamah: That the Prophet ﷺ was brought meat of a wild donkey, so he returned it and said: "We are in ihram, we do not eat game."
5.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Salih ibn Kaysan se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah se, Ibn Abbas se, al-Sa'b ibn Jaththamah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ke paas jangli gadhe ka gosht laaya gaya, to aapne use lautaa diya, aur farmaya: "Hum ehraam mein hain, hum shikaar nahi khaate."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ  ، عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : كُنَّا مَعَ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  فِي سَفَرٍ، فَأُهْدِيَ لَهُ طَيْرٌ وَهُمْ مُحْرِمُونَ، وَهُوَ رَاقِدٌ، فَمِنَّا مَنْ أَكَلَ، وَمِنَّا مَنْ تَوَرَّعَ، فَاسْتَيْقَظَ طَلْحَةُ فَأَخْبَرُوهُ، فَوَفَّقَ مَنْ أَكَلَهُ، وَقَالَ : " أَكَلْنَاهُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "
5.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ibn al-Munkadir, from Mu'adh ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Uthman al-Taymi, from his father: He said: We were with Talhah ibn Ubaydullah on a journey, so a bird was given to him as a gift while they were in ihram, and he was asleep, so some of us ate, and some of us abstained, so Talhah woke up and they informed him, so he agreed with the one who ate it, and said: "We ate it with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ."
5.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Ibn al-Munkadir se, Mu'adh ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Uthman al-Taymi se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Hum Talhah ibn Ubaydullah ke saath safar mein the, to unhein ek parinda tohfe mein diya gaya jabke woh ehraam mein the, aur woh so rahe the, to humme se kuch ne khaya, aur kuch ne bachne ki koshish ki, to Talhah jaage aur unhein bataya gaya, to unhone khaane wale ki taraf sahmati zaahir ki, aur kaha: "Humne isay Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath khaaya tha."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي الصَّعْبُ بْنُ جَثَّامَةَ  ، قَالَ : مَرَّ بِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَنَا بِالْأَبْوَاءِ أَوْ بِوَدَّانَ ، فَأَهْدَيْتُ لَهُ لَحْمَ حِمَارِ وَحْشٍ، فَرَدَّهُ عَلَيَّ، فَلَمَّا رَأَى فِي وَجْهِي الْكَرَاهِيَةَ، قَالَ : " إِنَّهُلَيْسَ بِنَا رَدٌّ عَلَيْكَ، وَلَكِنَّا حُرُمٌ "
5.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Ibn Uyaynah, from al-Zuhri, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah, from Ibn Abbas, from al-Sa'b ibn Jaththamah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by me while I was at al-Abwa or Waddan, so I gave him a gift of meat of a wild donkey, so he returned it to me, but when he saw dislike in my face, he said: "Indeed there is no rejection of you from us, but we are in ihram."
5.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Ibn Uyaynah se, al-Zuhri se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Mujhse al-Sa'b ibn Jaththamah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ mere paas se guzre jabke main al-Abwa ya Waddan mein tha, to maine aapko jangli gadhe ka gosht tohfe mein diya, to aapne mujhe use wapas kar diya, lekin jab aapne mere chehre par na-pasandeedgi dekhi, to farmaya: "Yeh tumhein radd karna nahi hai, balke hum ehraam mein hain."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنْ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ رَدِيفَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، جَاءَتْ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ خَثْعَمَ، فَقَالَتْ : إِنَّ فَرِيضَةَ اللَّهِ فِي الْحَجِّ عَلَى عِبَادِهِأَدْرَكَتْ أَبِي شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا لَا يَسْتَمْسِكُ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ، وَلَمْ يَحُجَّ، أَفَأَحُجُّ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : " نَعَمْ ".
 سُئِلَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : تَقُولُ بِهَذَا؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ
5.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi, from Wuhayb, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Sulayman ibn Yasar, from Ibn Abbas, from al-Fadl ibn Abbas; with Abu Muhammad's confirmation: That he was riding behind the Prophet ﷺ on the Farewell Pilgrimage, a woman from Khath'am came, and said: "The obligation of Allah upon His servants in Hajj found my father an old man, unable to hold himself firm on his mount, and he has not performed Hajj, so shall I perform Hajj on his behalf?" He said, "Yes." Abu Muhammad was asked: "Do you hold to this?" He said, "Yes."
5.hi: Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi ne Wuhayb se, Ma'mar se, al-Zuhri se, Sulayman ibn Yasar se, Ibn Abbas se, al-Fadl ibn Abbas se bataya ke woh Hajjat-ul-Wida' mein Nabi ﷺ ke peechhe sawaar the, ek aurat Khath'am se aayi, aur kaha: "Allah ka Hajj ka farz uske bandon par, mere walid ko budhaape mein paaya, woh apni sawaari par sambhal nahi paate, aur unhone Hajj nahi kiya, to kya main unki taraf se Hajj karun?" Aapne farmaya, "Haan." Abu Muhammad se poocha gaya: "Kya aap isi ke qaail hain?" Unhone kaha, "Haan."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنْ الْفَضْلِ هُوَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً سَأَلَتْ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَتْ : إِنَّأَبِي شَيْخٌ لَا يَسْتَوِي عَلَى الْبَعِيرِ أَدْرَكَتْهُ فَرِيضَةُ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " حُجِّي عَنْهُ "
5.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ibn Shihab, from Sulayman ibn Yasar, from Ibn Abbas, from al-Fadl ibn Abbas: That a woman asked the Prophet ﷺ, and said: "My father is an old man who cannot sit steady on the camel, the obligation of Allah has found him." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Perform Hajj on his behalf."
5.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Ibn Shihab se, Sulayman ibn Yasar se, Ibn Abbas se, al-Fadl ibn Abbas se bataya ke ek aurat ne Nabi ﷺ se poocha, aur kaha: "Mere walid budhe hain jo oont par sambhal kar nahi baith paate, Allah ka farz unpar aa chuka hai." To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Unki taraf se Hajj karo."

5.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً مِنْ خَثْعَمَ اسْتَفْتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، وَالْفَضْلُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ رَدِيفُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَتْ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ فَرِيضَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ أَدْرَكَتْ أَبِي شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا، لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَسْتَوِيَ عَلَى الرَّاحِلَةِ،فَهَلْ يَقْضِي أَنْ أَحُجَّ عَنْهُ؟ قَالَ : " نَعَمْ ".
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، نَحْوًا مِنْ حَدِيثِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ
5.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from al-Awza'i, from al-Zuhri, from Sulayman ibn Yasar, from Ibn Abbas; a similar chain also via Ibn Uyaynah: That a woman from Khath'am sought a ruling from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the Farewell Pilgrimage, while al-Fadl ibn Abbas was riding behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so she said: "O Messenger of Allah, the obligation of Allah upon His servants has found my father an old man, unable to sit steady on the mount, so is it valid that I perform Hajj on his behalf?" He said, "Yes." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Ibn Uyaynah, from al-Zuhri, from Sulayman ibn Yasar, from Ibn Abbas, from the Prophet ﷺ, near to the hadith of al-Awza'i.]
5.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne al-Awza'i se, al-Zuhri se, Sulayman ibn Yasar se, Ibn Abbas se bataya ke Khath'am ki ek aurat ne Hajjat-ul-Wida' mein Rasulullah ﷺ se fatwa maanga, jabke al-Fadl ibn Abbas Rasulullah ﷺ ke peechhe sawaar the, to usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, Allah ka farz uske bandon par mere walid ko budhaape mein paa gaya, woh sawaari par sambhal nahi paate, to kya theek hoga ke main unki taraf se Hajj karun?" Aapne farmaya, "Haan." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Muhammad ibn Yusuf se, Ibn Uyaynah se, al-Zuhri se, Sulayman ibn Yasar se, Ibn Abbas se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi al-Awza'i ki riwayat ke qareeb aayi hai.]

5.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي الْفَضْلُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ  أَوْ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْعَبَّاسِ  ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ أَبِي أَوْ أُمِّي عَجُوزٌ كَبِيرٌ، إِنْ أَنَا حَمَلْتُهَا لَمْ تَسْتَمْسِكْ، وَإِنْ رَبَطْتُهَا، خَشِيتُ أَنْ أَقْتُلَهَا.
قَالَ : " أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ عَلَى أَبِيكَ أَوْ أُمِّكَ دَيْنٌ، أَكُنْتَ تَقْضِيهِ؟ ".
 قَالَ : نَعَمْ، قَالَ :" فَحُجَّ عَنْ أَبِيكَ، أَوْ أُمِّكَ "
5.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Yahya ibn Abi Ishaq, from Sulayman ibn Yasar, from al-Fadl ibn Abbas or Ubaydullah ibn al-Abbas: That a man said: "O Messenger of Allah, my father, or my mother, is a very old person, if I carry her she will not hold steady, and if I tie her, I fear I will kill her." He said: "Do you see, if there was a debt upon your father or your mother, would you pay it off?" He said, "Yes." He said: "Then perform Hajj on behalf of your father, or your mother."
5.hi: Musaddad ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Yahya ibn Abi Ishaq se, Sulayman ibn Yasar se bataya: Mujhse al-Fadl ibn Abbas, ya Ubaydullah ibn al-Abbas, ne bataya ke ek aadmi ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, mere walid, ya meri waalida, bahut budhe hain, agar main unhein uthaaun to woh sambhal nahi paate, aur agar main unhein baandh dun, to mujhe dar hai ke main unhein maar dun." Aapne poocha: "Kya tum batao, agar tumhare walid ya waalida par koi qarz hota, to kya tum use ada karte?" Usne kaha, "Haan." Aapne farmaya: "To apne walid, ya waalida, ki taraf se Hajj karo."

5.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ  مَوْلًى لِآلِ الْزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ  ، قَالَ : جَاءَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ خَثْعَمَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : إِنَّأَبِي أَدْرَكَهُ الْإِسْلَامُ وَهُوَ شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ رُكُوبَ الرَّحْلِ، وَالْحَجُّ مَكْتُوبٌ عَلَيْهِ، أَفَأَحُجُّ عَنْهُ؟ قَالَ : " أَنْتَ أَكْبَرُ وَلَدِهِ؟ ".
قَالَ : نَعَمْ.
قَالَ : " أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ كَانَ عَلَى أَبِيكَ دَيْنٌ فَقَضَيْتَهُ عَنْهُ، أَكَانَ ذَلِكَ يُجْزِئُ عَنْهُ؟ ".
قَالَ : نَعَمْ.
قَالَ : " فَاحْجُجْ عَنْهُ "
5.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Humayd, from Jarir, from Mansur, from Mujahid, from Yusuf ibn al-Zubayr, freed servant of Al al-Zubayr, from Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr: He said: A man from Khath'am came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and said: "My father, Islam found him an old man, unable to ride the saddle, and Hajj has been written upon him, so shall I perform Hajj on his behalf?" He said: "Are you his eldest child?" He said, "Yes." He said: "Do you see, if there was a debt upon your father and you paid it off on his behalf, would that suffice for him?" He said, "Yes." He said: "Then perform Hajj on his behalf."
5.hi: Muhammad ibn Humayd ne Jarir se, Mansur se, Mujahid se, Yusuf ibn al-Zubayr (Al al-Zubayr ke azaad kiye hue ghulam) se, Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Khath'am ka ek aadmi Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Mere walid ko Islam budhaape mein mila, woh sawaari par baith nahi sakte, aur unpar Hajj farz hai, to kya main unki taraf se Hajj karun?" Aapne poocha: "Kya tum unki sabse badi aulaad ho?" Usne kaha, "Haan." Aapne farmaya: "Kya tum batao, agar tumhare walid par koi qarz hota aur tum unki taraf se ada karte, to kya woh kaafi ho jaata?" Usne kaha, "Haan." Aapne farmaya: "To unki taraf se Hajj karo."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا صَالِحُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ هُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  ، عَنْ مَوْلَى ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، يُقَالُ لَهُ : يُوسُفُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ أَوْ الزُّبَيْرُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سَوْدَةَ بِنْتِ زَمْعَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : إِنَّ أَبِي شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَحُجَّ.
قَالَ : " أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ كَانَ عَلَى أَبِيكَ دَيْنٌ فَقَضَيْتَهُ عَنْهُ، قُبِلَ مِنْهُ؟ ".
قَالَ : نَعَمْ.
قَالَ : " اللَّهُ أَرْحَمُ،حُجَّ عَنْ أَبِيكَ "
5.en: Narrated by Salih ibn Abdullah, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Abd al-Samad, from Mansur, from Mujahid, from the freed servant of Ibn al-Zubayr (Yusuf ibn al-Zubayr or al-Zubayr ibn Yusuf), from Sawdah bint Zam'ah: She said: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ, and said: "My father is a very old man, unable to perform Hajj." He said: "Do you see, if there was a debt upon your father and you paid it off on his behalf, would it be accepted from him?" He said, "Yes." He said: "Allah is more merciful, perform Hajj on behalf of your father."
5.hi: Salih ibn Abdullah ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Abd al-Samad se, Mansur se, Mujahid se, Ibn al-Zubayr ke azaad kiye hue ghulam se, jinhein Yusuf ibn al-Zubayr ya al-Zubayr ibn Yusuf kaha jaata hai, Sawdah bint Zam'ah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi Nabi ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Mere walid bahut budhe hain, Hajj nahi kar sakte." Aapne poocha: "Kya tum batao, agar tumhare walid par koi qarz hota aur tum unki taraf se ada karte, to kya woh unse qabool kiya jaata?" Usne kaha, "Haan." Aapne farmaya: "Allah zyada reham karne wala hai, apne walid ki taraf se Hajj karo."

5.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" مَا تَرَكْتُ اسْتِلَامَ هَذَيْنِ الرُّكْنَيْنِ فِي شِدَّةٍ وَلَا رَخَاءٍ مُنْذُ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَسْتَلِمُهُمَا ".
قُلْتُ لِنَافِعٍ : أَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَمْشِي بَيْنَ الرُّكْنَيْنِ ؟ قَالَ : إِنَّمَا كَانَ يَمْشِي لِيَكُونَ أَيْسَرَ لِاسْتِلَامِهِ
5.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Yahya, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: "I have not left off touching these two corners in hardship nor in ease since I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ touching them." [Narrator] I said to Nafi': "Did Ibn Umar walk between the two corners?" He said: He only walked so that it would be easier for him to touch it.
5.hi: Musaddad ne Yahya se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Maine in do konon (Hajr-e-Aswad aur Rukn-e-Yamani) ko chhoona kabhi na sakhti mein na aasaani mein chhoda, jab se maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko inhein chhote dekha hai." Maine Nafi' se poocha: "Kya Ibn Umar dono konon ke darmiyan chalte the?" Unhone kaha: Woh isliye chalte the taake unhein chhoona aasan ho jaaye.

5.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، وَسُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَيَبْعَثَنَّ اللَّهُ الْحَجَرَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ لَهُ عَيْنَانِ يُبْصِرُ بِهِمَا، وَلِسَانٌ يَنْطِقُ بِهِ، يَشْهَدُ عَلَى مَنْ اسْتَلَمَهُ بِحَقٍّ ".
قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ : لِمَنْ اسْتَلَمَهُ
5.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, and Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Abdullah ibn Uthman ibn Khuthaym, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas; with Sulayman's note: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah will surely raise up the Stone on the Day of Resurrection having two eyes with which it sees, and a tongue with which it speaks, testifying for whoever touched it in truth." Sulayman said: for whoever touched it.
5.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal aur Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Abdullah ibn Uthman ibn Khuthaym se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Allah Qayamat ke din us Pathar ko zaroor uthaayega jiski do aankhein hongi jinse woh dekhega, aur ek zubaan hogi jisse woh bolega, gawahi dega us shakhs ke liye jisne haq ke saath usay chhua ho." Sulayman kehte hain: [gawahi dega] uske liye jisne usay chhua ho.

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ :" رَمَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنْ الْحَجَرِ إِلَى الْحَجَرِ ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْوَاطٍ "
5.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Malik ibn Anas, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Jabir: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed the ramal from the [Black] Stone to the [Black] Stone for three circuits."
5.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Malik ibn Anas se, Ja'far ibn Muhammad se, apne walid se, Jabir se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Hajr-e-Aswad se Hajr-e-Aswad tak teen chakron mein tez chaal (ramal) chali."

5.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" إِذَا طَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ الطَّوَافَ الْأَوَّلَ، خَبَّ ثَلَاثَةً، وَمَشَى أَرْبَعَةً، وَكَانَ يَسْعَى بِبَطْنِ الْمَسِيلِ إِذَا سَعَى بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ ".
فَقُلْتُ لِنَافِعٍ : أَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَمْشِي إِذَا بَلَغَ الرُّكْنَ الْيَمَانِيَ ؟ قَالَ : لَا، إِلَّا أَنْ يُزَاحَمَ عَلَى الرُّكْنِ ، فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يَدَعُهُ حَتَّى يَسْتَلِمَهُ
5.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Uqbah ibn Khalid, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to "when he circumambulated the House the first circumambulation, trot three [circuits], and walk four, and he used to run/hasten in the bottom of the valley when he did sa'i between al-Safa and al-Marwah." [Narrator] I said to Nafi': "Did Abdullah walk when he reached the Yemeni corner?" He said: No, except if he was crowded at the corner, for he would not leave it until he touched it.
5.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Uqbah ibn Khalid se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "jab pehla tawaaf karte, teen chakron mein tez chaal chalte, aur chaar chakron mein chalte, aur jab Safa aur Marwah ke darmiyan sa'ee karte to waadi ke tale mein daudte." Maine Nafi' se poocha: "Kya Abdullah Rukn-e-Yamani tak pahunch kar [aam] chaal chalte the?" Unhone kaha: Nahi, siwaay iske ke agar rukn par bheed hoti, kyunki woh usay chhue bagair nahi chhodte the.

5.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" رَمَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنْ الْحَجَرِ إِلَى الْحَجَرِ ثَلَاثًا، وَمَشَى أَرْبَعًا "
5.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Umar ibn Aban, from Abdullah ibn al-Mubarak, from Ubaydullah ibn Umar, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed the ramal from the [Black] Stone to the [Black] Stone three [circuits], and walked four."
5.hi: Abdullah ibn Umar ibn Aban ne Abdullah ibn al-Mubarak se, Ubaydullah ibn Umar se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Hajr-e-Aswad se Hajr-e-Aswad tak teen chakron mein tez chaal chali, aur chaar chakron mein chale."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ هُوَ ابْنُ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ يَعْلَى  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، " أَنَّهُطَافَ مُضْطَبِعًا "
5.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abd al-Hamid ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Ya'la, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ: "That he circumambulated with his shoulder bared."
5.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Ibn Jurayj se, Abd al-Hamid ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Ya'la se, apne walid se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya ke "aapne idtiba' (ek kandha khula rakh kar) tawaaf kiya."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ، كَفَاهُ لَهُمَا طَوَافٌ وَاحِدٌ، وَلَا يَحِلُّ حَتَّى يَحِلَّ مِنْهُمَا "
5.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Mansur, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Ubaydullah ibn Umar, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever enters ihram for Hajj and Umrah, one circumambulation suffices him for both, and he does not release [from ihram] until he is released from both of them."
5.hi: Sa'id ibn Mansur ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, Ubaydullah ibn Umar se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jo Hajj aur Umrah dono ke liye ehraam baandhe, uske liye ek hi tawaaf dono ke liye kaafi hai, aur woh tab tak halaal nahi hota jab tak dono se halaal na ho jaaye."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" طَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ، كُلَّمَا أَتَى عَلَى الرُّكْنِ ، أَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ بِشَيْءٍ فِي يَدِهِ، وَكَبَّرَ "
5.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid ibn Abdullah, from Khalid al-Hadhdha, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "circumambulated the House on a camel, every time he came to the corner, he pointed toward it with something in his hand, and said the takbir."
5.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid ibn Abdullah se, Khalid al-Hadhdha se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "Baitullah ka tawaaf oont par baithkar kiya, jab bhi rukn ke paas pahunchte, apne haath mein kisi cheez se uski taraf ishara karte, aur takbir kehte."
