5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : قَدِمْتُ مَكَّةَ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ، وَلَمْ أَطُفْ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ ، فَشَكَوْتُ ذَلِكَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ :" افْعَلِي مَا يَفْعَلُ الْحَاجُّ، غَيْرَ أَنْ لَا تَطُوفِي بِالْبَيْتِ "
5.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from his father, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: She said: I arrived at Makkah while I was menstruating, and I did not circumambulate between al-Safa and al-Marwah, so I complained of that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he said: "Do what the pilgrim does, except do not circumambulate the House."
5.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim se, apne walid se, Aisha رضي الله عنها se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Makkah pahunchi jabke main haiz mein thi, aur maine Safa aur Marwah ke darmiyan tawaaf (sa'ee) nahi ki, to maine yeh Rasulullah ﷺ se shikaayat ki, to aapne farmaya: "Woh sab karo jo Hajji karta hai, magar Baitullah ka tawaaf na karo."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفُضَيْلُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ  ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" الطَّوَافُ بِالْبَيْتِ صَلَاةٌ، إِلَّا أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَحَلَّ فِيهِ الْمَنْطِقَ، فَمَنْ نَطَقَ فِيهِ، فَلَا يَنْطِقْ إِلَّا بِخَيْرٍ ".
 أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَعْبَدٍ  ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَعْيَنَ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ  ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، نَحْوَهُ
5.en: Narrated by al-Humaydi, from al-Fudayl ibn Iyad, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas; a similar chain also via Ali ibn Ma'bad: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Circumambulation of the House is [like] prayer, except that Allah has made speech lawful in it, so whoever speaks in it, let him not speak except good." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Ali ibn Ma'bad, from Musa ibn A'yan, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas, from the Prophet ﷺ.]
5.hi: Al-Humaydi ne al-Fudayl ibn Iyad se, Ata ibn al-Sa'ib se, Tawus se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Baitullah ka tawaaf namaz hai, siwaay iske ke Allah ne isme baat karna halal kiya hai, so jo isme bole, woh achhi baat ke siwa na bole." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Ali ibn Ma'bad se, Musa ibn A'yan se, Ata ibn al-Sa'ib se, Tawus se, Ibn Abbas se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai.]

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ   رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ : وَافَقْتُ رَبِّي فِي ثَلَاثٍ، قُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ،" لَوْ اتَّخَذْتَ مِنْ مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى : # وَاتَّخِذُوا مِنْ مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى سورة البقرة آية 125 # "
5.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Humayd, from Anas, about Umar ibn al-Khattab: He said: Umar ibn al-Khattab رضوان الله عليه said: "I agreed with my Lord in three [matters]: I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, if only you took the station of Ibrahim as a place of prayer,' so Allah the Exalted revealed: 'And take the station of Ibrahim as a place of prayer' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 125]."
5.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Humayd se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Umar ibn al-Khattab (رضوان الله عليه) ne kaha: "Main apne Rab se teen baaton mein muwaafiq hua: Maine kaha, 'Ya Rasulullah, kaash aap Maqam-e-Ibrahim ko namaz ki jagah bana lete,' to Allah Ta'ala ne yeh naazil kiya: 'Aur Maqam-e-Ibrahim ko namaz ki jagah banao' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 125]."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ  ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ : دَخَلْنَا عَلَى جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، فَسَأَلَ عَنْ الْقَوْمِ حَتَّى انْتَهَى إِلَيَّ، فَقُلْتُ أَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، فَأَهْوَى بِيَدِهِ إِلَى زِرِّيَ الْأَعْلَى وَزِرِّيَ الْأَسْفَلِ، ثُمَّ وَضَعَ فَمَهُ بَيْنَ ثَدْيَيَّ، وَأَنَا يَوْمَئِذٍ غُلَامٌ شَابٌّ، فَقَالَ : مَرْحَبًا بِكَ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي، سَلْ عَمَّا شِئْتَ.
فَسَأَلْتُهُ، وَهُوَ أَعْمَى، وَجَاءَ وَقْتُ الصَّلَاةِ، فَقَامَ فِي سَاجَةٍ مُلْتَحِفًا بِهَا، كُلَّمَا وَضَعَهَا عَلَى مَنْكِبَيْهِ، رَجَعَ طَرَفُهَا إِلَيْهِ مِنْ صِغَرِهَا، وَرِدَاؤُهُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ عَلَى الْمِشْجَبِ، فَصَلَّى، فَقُلْتُ : أَخْبِرْنِي عَنْ حَجَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟ فَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ فَعَقَدَ تِسْعًا، فَقَالَ :مَكَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ تِسْعَ سِنِينَ لَمْ يَحُجَّ، ثُمَّ أُذِّنَ فِي النَّاسِ بِالْحَجِّ فِي الْعَاشِرَةِ : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَاجٌّ، فَقَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ بَشَرٌ كَثِيرٌ كُلُّهُمْ يَلْتَمِسُ أَنْ يَأْتَمَّ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَيَعْمَلَ مِثْلَ عَمَلِهِ، فَخَرَجْنَا مَعَهُ حَتَّى أَتَيْنَا ذَا الْحُلَيْفَةِ ، فَوَلَدَتْ أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ عُمَيْسٍ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُمْ، فَأَرْسَلَتْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : كَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ؟ فَقَالَ : " اغْتَسِلِي وَاسْتَثْفِرِي بِثَوْبٍ وَأَحْرِمِي ".
فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، ثُمَّ رَكِبَ الْقَصْوَاءَ حَتَّى اسْتَوَتْ بِهِ نَاقَتُهُ عَلَى الْبَيْدَاءِ، فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَى مَدِّ بَصَرِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ مِنْ رَاكِبٍ وَمَاشٍ، وَعَنْ يَمِينِهِ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ، وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ، وَخَلْفَهُ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِنَا، وَعَلَيْهِ يُنْزَلُ الْقُرْآنُ وَهُوَ يَعْرِفُ تَأْوِيلَهُ، فَأَهَلَّ بِالتَّوْحِيدِ : " لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ ".
فَأَهَلَّ النَّاسُ بِهَذَا الَّذِي يُهِلُّونَ بِهِ، فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِمْ شَيْئًا، وَلَبَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ تَلْبِيَتَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا أَتَيْنَا الْبَيْتَ مَعَهُ.
قَالَ جَابِرٌ : لَسْنَا نَنْوِي إِلَّا الْحَجَّ، لَسْنَا نَعْرِفُ الْعُمْرَةَ، حَتَّى إِذَا أَتَيْنَا الْبَيْتَ مَعَهُ، اسْتَلَمَ الرُّكْنَ فَرَمَلَ ثَلَاثًا، وَمَشَى أَرْبَعًا، ثُمَّ تَقَدَّمَ إِلَى مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فَصَلَّى، فَقَرَأَ # وَاتَّخِذُوا مِنْ مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى سورة البقرة آية 125 #، فَجَعَلَ الْمَقَامَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْبَيْتِ ، وَكَانَ أَبِي يَقُولُ : وَلَا أَعْلَمُهُ ذَكَرَهُ عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : كَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ : قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ وَقُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَى الرُّكْنِ فَاسْتَلَمَهُ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ مِنْ الْبَاب إِلَى الصَّفَا ، فَلَمَّا أَتَى الصَّفَا ، قَرَأَ : # إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ سورة البقرة آية 158 #، " أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ ".
فَبَدَأَ بِالصَّفَا فَرَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى رَأَى الْبَيْتَ ، فَوَحَّدَ اللَّهَ وَكَبَّرَهُ، وَقَالَ : " لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ ".
ثُمَّ دَعَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ مِثْلَ هَذَا ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، ثُمَّ نَزَلَ إِلَى الْمَرْوَةِ ، حَتَّى إِذَا انْصَبَّتْ قَدَمَاهُ فِي بَطْنِ الْوَادِي، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ : يَعْنِي : فَرَمَلَ ، حَتَّى إِذَا صَعِدْنَا مَشَى، حَتَّى إِذَا أَتَيْنَا الْمَرْوَةَ ، فَفَعَلَ عَلَى الْمَرْوَةِ كَمَا فَعَلَ عَلَى الصَّفَا ، حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ آخِرَ طَوَافٍ عَلَى الْمَرْوَةِ ، قَالَ : " إِنِّي لَوْ اسْتَقْبَلْتُ مِنْ أَمْرِي مَا اسْتَدْبَرْتُ، لَمْ أَسُقْ الْهَدْيَ وَجَعَلْتُهَا عُمْرَةً، فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْكُمْ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ هَدْيٌ، فَلْيُحِلَّ وَيَجْعَلْهَا عُمْرَةً ".
فَقَامَ سُرَاقَةُ بْنُ مَالِكِ بْنِ جُعْشُمٍ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَلِعَامِنَا هَذَا أَمْ لِأَبَدِ؟ فَشَبَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَصَابِعَهُ فِي الْأُخْرَى، فَقَالَ : " دَخَلَتِ الْعُمْرَةُ فِي الْحَجِّ "، هَكَذَا مَرَّتَيْنِ " لَا، بَلْ لِأَبَدِ أَبَدًا، لَا بَلْ لَأَبَدِ أَبَدٍ ".
وَقَدِمَ عَلِيٌّ بِبُدْنٍ مِنْ الْيَمَنِ لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَوَجَدَ فَاطِمَةَ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا مِمَّنْ حَلَّ، وَلَبِسَتْ ثِيَابًا صَبِيغًا، وَاكْتَحَلَتْ، فَأَنْكَرَ عَلِيٌّ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهَا، فَقَالَتْ : إِنَّ أَبِي أَمَرَنِي، فَكَانَ عَلِيٌّ يَقُولُ : ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أُحَرِّشُهُ عَلَى فَاطِمَةَ فِي الَّذِي صَنَعَتْ، مُسْتَفْتِيًا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِيمَا ذَكَرَتْ، فَأَنْكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهَا، فَقَالَ : " صَدَقَتْ، مَا فَعَلْتَ حِينَ فَرَضْتَ الْحَجَّ؟ ".
قَالَ : قُلْتُ : اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُهِلُّ بِمَا أَهَلَّ بِهِ رَسُولُكَ.
قَالَ : " فَإِنَّ مَعِيَ الْهَدْيَ فَلَا تَحِلَّ ".
قَالَ : فَكَانَ جَمَاعَةُ الْهَدْيِ الَّذِي قَدِمَ بِهِ عَلِيٌّ مِنْ الْيَمَنِ ، وَالَّذِي أَتَى بِهِ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِئَةَ بَدَنَةٍ، فَحَلَّ النَّاسُ كُلُّهُمْ وَقَصَّرُوا إِلَّا النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَمَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ هَدْيٌ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ التَّرْوِيَةِ، وَجَّهَ إِلَى مِنًى ، فَأَهْلَلْنَا بِالْحَجِّ، وَرَكِبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَصَلَّى بِمِنًى الظُّهْرَ، وَالْعَصْرَ، وَالْمَغْرِبَ، وَالْعِشَاءَ، وَالصُّبْحَ، ثُمَّ مَكَثَ قَلِيلًا حَتَّى إِذَا طَلَعَتْ الشَّمْسُ، أَمَرَ بِقُبَّةٍ مِنْ الشَّعْرِ فَضُربَتْ لَهُ بِنَمِرَةَ، ثُمَّ رَكِبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَسَارَ لَا تَشُكُّ قُرَيْشٌ إِلَّا أَنَّهُ وَاقِفٌ عِنْدَ الْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ ، كَمَا كَانَتْ قُرَيْشٌ تَصْنَعُ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فِي الْمُزْدَلِفَةِ ، فَسَارَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَتَّى أَتَى عَرَفَةَ ، فَوَجَدَ الْقُبَّةَ قَدْ ضُرِبَتْ بِنَمِرَةَ، فَنَزَلَهَا حَتَّى إِذَا زَاغَتِ يَعْنِي الشَّمْسَ، أَمَرَ بِالْقَصْوَاءِ فَرُحِّلَتْ لَهُ، فَأَتَى بَطْنَ الْوَادِي، فَخَطَبَ النَّاسَ وَقَالَ : " إِنَّ دِمَاءَكُمْ وَأَمْوَالَكُمْ حَرَامٌ كَحُرْمَةِ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا، فِي شَهْرِكُمْ هَذَا، فِي بَلَدِكُمْ هَذَا، أَلَا إِنَّ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ مِنْ أَمْرِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ تَحْتَ قَدَمَيَّ مَوْضُوعٌ، وَدِمَاءُ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ مَوْضُوعَةٌ وَأَوَّلُ دَمٍ أَضَعُ دِمَاءَنَا : دَمُ ابْنِ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، كَانَ مُسْتَرْضَعًا فِي بَنِي سَعْدٍ، فَقَتَلَتْهُ هُذَيْلٌ.
وَرِبَا الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ مَوْضُوعٌ، وَأَوَّلُ رِبًا أَضَعُهُ رِبَا عَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، فَإِنَّهُ مَوْضُوعٌ كُلُّهُ، فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ فِي النِّسَاءِ، فَإِنَّمَا أَخَذْتُمُوهُنَّ بِأَمَانَةِ اللَّهِ، وَاسْتَحْلَلْتُمْ فُرُوجَهُنَّ بِكَلِمَةِ اللَّهِ، وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ عَلَيْهِنَّ أَنْ لَا يُوطِئْنَ فُرُشَكُمْ أَحَدًا تَكْرَهُونَهُ، فَإِنْ فَعَلْنَ ذَلِكَ، فَاضْرِبُوهُنَّ ضَرْبًا غَيْرَ مُبَرِّحٍ، وَلَهُنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ رِزْقُهُنَّ وَكِسْوَتُهُنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ.
وَأَنْتُمْ مَسْئولونَ عَنِّي فَمَا أَنْتُمْ قَائِلُونَ؟ " قَالُوا : نَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ قَدْ بَلَّغْتَ وَأَدَّيْتَ وَنَصَحْتَ.
فَقَالَ بِأُصْبُعِهِ السَّبَّابَةِ فَرَفَعَهَا إِلَى السَّمَاءِ، وَيَنْكُتُهَا إِلَى النَّاسِ : " اللَّهُمَّ اشْهَدْ، اللَّهُمَّ اشْهَدْ، اللَّهُمَّ اشْهَدْ ".
ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ بِلَالٌ بِنِدَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ وَإِقَامَةٍ، فَصَلَّى الظُّهْرَ، ثُمَّ أَقَامَ فَصَلَّى الْعَصْرَ، لَمْ يُصَلِّ بَيْنَهُمَا شَيْئًا، ثُمَّ رَكِبَ حَتَّى وَقَفَ، فَجَعَلَ بَطْنَ نَاقَتِهِ الْقَصْوَاءِ إِلَى الصُّخَيْرَاتِ، وَقَالَ إِسْمَاعِيل : إِلَى الشُّجَيْرَاتِ ، وَجَعَلَ حَبْلَ الْمُشَاةِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، ثُمَّ اسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ، فَلَمْ يَزَلْ وَاقِفًا حَتَّى غَرَبَتْ الشَّمْسُ وَذَهَبَتْ الصُّفْرَةُ، حَتَّى غَابَ الْقُرْصُ، فَأَرْدَفَ أُسَامَةَ خَلْفَهُ، ثُمَّ دَفَعَ، وَقَدْ شَنَقَ لِلْقَصْوَاءِ الزِّمَامَ، حَتَّى إِنَّهُ لَيُصِيبُ رَأْسُهَا مَوْرِكَ رَحْلِهِ، وَيَقُولُ بِيَدِهِ الْيُمْنَى : " السَّكِينَةَ السَّكِينَةَ ".
كُلَّمَا أَتَى حَبْلًا مِنْ الْحِبَالِ، أَرْخَى لَهَا قَلِيلًا حَتَّى تَصْعَدَ، حَتَّى أَتَى الْمُزْدَلِفَةَ ، فَصَلَّى بِهَا الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ بِأَذَانٍ وَإِقَامَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ حَتَّى إِذَا طَلَعَ يَعْنِي الْفَجْرُ، صَلَّى الْفَجْرَ، بِأَذَانٍ وَإِقَامَةٍ، ثُمَّ رَكِبَ الْقَصْوَاءَ حَتَّى وَقَفَ عَلَى الْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ ، وَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ، فَدَعَا اللَّهَ وَكَبَّرَهُ وَهَلَّلَهُ وَوَحَّدَهُ حَتَّى أَسْفَرَ جِدًا، ثُمَّ دَفَعَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ، وَأَرْدَفَ الْفَضْلَ بْنَ عَبَّاسِ، وَكَانَ رَجُلًا حَسَنَ الشَّعْرِ، أَبْيَضَ، وَسِيمًا، فَلَمَّا دَفَعَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، مَرَّ بِالظُّعُنِ يَجْرِينَ، فَطَفِقَ الْفَضْلُ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِنَّ، فَأَخَذَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَدَهُ فَوَضَعَهَا عَلَى وَجْهِ الْفَضْلِ، فَحَوَّلَ الْفَضْلُ رَأْسَهُ مِنْ الشِّقِّ الْآخَرِ، فَوَضَعَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَدَهُ مِنْ الشِّقِّ الْآخَرِ حَتَّى إِذَا أَتَى مُحَسِّرَ، حَرَّكَ قَلِيلًا، ثُمَّ سَلَكَ الطَّرِيقَ الْوُسْطَى الَّتِي تُخْرِجُكَ إِلَى الْجَمْرَةِ الْكُبْرَى، حَتَّى إِذَا أَتَى الْجَمْرَةَ الَّتِي عِنْدَهَا الشَّجَرَةُ، فَرَمَى بِسَبْعِ حَصَيَاتٍ يُكَبِّرُ عَلَى كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ مِنْ حَصَى الْخَذْفِ، ثُمَّ رَمَى مِنْ بَطْنِ الْوَادِي، ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ إِلَى الْمَنْحَرِ، فَنَحَرَ ثَلَاثًا وَسِتِّينَ بَدَنَةً بِيَدِهِ، ثُمَّ أَعْطَى عَلِيًّا فَنَحَرَ مَا غَبَرَ، وَأَشْرَكَهُ فِي بُدْنِهِ، ثُمَّ أَمَرَ مِنْ كُلِّ بَدَنَةٍ بِبَضْعَةٍ، فَجُعِلَتْ فِي قِدْرٍ، فَطُبِخَتْ فَأَكَلَا مِنْ لُحُومِهَا، وَشَرِبَا مِنْ مَرَقِهَا، ثُمَّ رَكِبَ فَأَفَاضَ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ ، فَأَتَى الْبَيْتَ فَصَلَّى الظُّهْرَ بِمَكَّةَ ، وَأَتَى بَنِي عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ وَهُمْ يَسْتَقُونَ مِنْ زَمْزَمَ ، فَقَالَ : " انْزِعُوا بَنِي عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، فَلَوْلَا يَغْلِبَنَّكُمُ النَّاسُ عَلَى سِقَايَتِكُمْ، لَنَزَعْتُ مَعَكُمْ ".
فَنَاوَلُوهُ دَلْوًا فَشَرِبَ.
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْأَصْبَهَانِيُّ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، بِهَذَا
5.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Aban, from Hatim ibn Isma'il, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Jabir ibn Abdullah رضي الله عنهما; a similar chain also via Muhammad ibn Sa'id al-Asbahani: Abu Ja'far said: We entered upon Jabir ibn Abdullah, and he asked about the people until he reached me, so I said, I am Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali, so he reached with his hand to my upper button and my lower button, then placed his mouth between my nipples, and I was a young boy that day, and he said: "Welcome, O son of my brother, ask whatever you wish." So I asked him, and he was blind, and the time of prayer came, so he stood in a cloak wrapping himself with it, every time he placed it on his shoulders, its edge would return to him because of its smallness, and his outer garment was beside him on the clothes-rack, so he prayed, so I said: "Inform me about the Hajj of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" So he gestured with his hand and counted nine, then said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ remained nine years not performing Hajj, then it was announced among the people in the tenth [year] that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was going on Hajj, so many people arrived at Madinah, all of them seeking to follow the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and to do like his deed, so we went out with him until we came to Dhu al-Hulayfah, and Asma bint Umays gave birth to Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr رضي الله عنهم, so she sent to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: "How should I do?" He said: "Bathe, and bind yourself with a cloth, and enter ihram." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed in the mosque, then he rode al-Qaswa, until his she-camel stood erect with him on al-Bayda, then I looked as far as my sight could reach in front of him, riders and walkers, and to his right the like of that, and to his left the like of that, and behind him the like of that, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was among us, and the Qur'an was being revealed to him and he knew its interpretation, so he entered ihram with the affirmation of Oneness: "Labbayka Allahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk, innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak." So the people entered ihram with this that they enter ihram with, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not respond to them with anything, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ continued his talbiyah until we came to the House with him. Jabir said: We did not intend anything but Hajj, we did not know [about Umrah combined], until when we came to the House with him, he touched the corner, then he did ramal three [circuits], and walked four, then he went forward to the Station of Ibrahim, and prayed, and recited: "And take the Station of Ibrahim as a place of prayer" [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 125], so he made the Station between him and the House, and my father used to say - and I do not know if he mentioned it from Jabir, from the Prophet ﷺ - that he used to recite in the two rak'ahs: "Say: He is Allah, One" and "Say: O disbelievers," then he returned to the corner and touched it, then went out from the door to al-Safa, so when he came to al-Safa, he recited: "Indeed al-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah" [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 158], "I begin with what Allah began with." So he began with al-Safa and climbed it until he saw the House, and he declared Allah's Oneness and magnified Him, and said: "La ilaha illallahu wahdahu, la sharika lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. La ilaha illallahu wahdahu, anjaza wa'dahu, wa nasara 'abdahu, wa hazamal-ahzaba wahdahu." Then he supplicated in between that, and he said the like of this three times, then he descended to al-Marwah, until when his feet went down into the bottom of the valley, Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Darimi said: meaning: he did ramal, until when we ascended he walked, until we came to al-Marwah, so he did on al-Marwah as he did on al-Safa, until when it was the last circuit on al-Marwah, he said: "If I had known beforehand what I have come to know afterward, I would not have driven the sacrificial animal, and I would have made it an Umrah, so whoever among you does not have a sacrificial animal with him, let him release [from ihram] and make it an Umrah." So Suraqah ibn Malik ibn Ju'shum stood, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, is this for this year of ours, or forever?" So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ interlaced his fingers into the other, and said: "Umrah has entered into Hajj," like this, twice: "No, rather it is forever, forever; no, rather it is forever, forever." And Ali arrived with sacrificial camels from Yemen for the Prophet ﷺ, and he found Fatimah رضوان الله عليها among those who had released [from ihram], and she had worn dyed clothes, and applied kohl, so Ali objected to that against her, so she said: "My father commanded me," so Ali used to say: I went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ provoking him against Fatimah concerning what she had done, seeking a ruling from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ concerning what she mentioned, and I had objected to that against her, so he said: "She has spoken the truth, what did you do when you decided upon [your intention for] Hajj?" He said: I said: "O Allah, I enter ihram with what Your messenger has entered ihram with." He said: "Then I have the sacrificial animal with me, so do not release [from ihram]." He said: So the total of the sacrificial animals that Ali brought from Yemen, and that the Prophet ﷺ brought, was one hundred camels, so all the people released [from ihram] and shortened [their hair] except the Prophet ﷺ and whoever had a sacrificial animal with him. Then when it was the day of Tarwiyah, he headed toward Mina, so we entered ihram for Hajj, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ rode and prayed at Mina the Zuhr, and the Asr, and the Maghrib, and the Isha, and the Subh, then he remained a little while until the sun rose, then he commanded a tent of hair to be pitched for him at Namirah, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ rode and proceeded, and Quraysh did not doubt except that he would stop at al-Mash'ar al-Haram, as Quraysh used to do in the Jahiliyyah at Muzdalifah, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ proceeded until he came to Arafah, and he found the tent had been pitched at Namirah, so he stopped there, until when the sun had passed its zenith, he commanded al-Qaswa and it was saddled for him, so he came to the bottom of the valley, and addressed the people, and said: "Indeed your blood and your wealth are sacred to you as the sanctity of this day of yours, in this month of yours, in this land of yours. Indeed, everything from the affairs of the Jahiliyyah is placed beneath my feet, and the blood-feuds of the Jahiliyyah are abolished, and the first blood I abolish of our blood [feuds] is the blood of Ibn Rabi'ah ibn al-Harith, who was being nursed among Banu Sa'd, and Hudhayl killed him. And the usury of the Jahiliyyah is abolished, and the first usury I abolish is the usury of al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib, for indeed it is all abolished. So fear Allah concerning women, for indeed you have taken them by the trust of Allah, and made their private parts lawful by the word of Allah, and you have upon them that they not allow anyone you dislike to tread your beds, and if they do that, then strike them with a beating that is not severe, and they have upon you their provision and their clothing in a fair manner. And you will be asked about me, so what will you say?" They said: "We testify that you have conveyed, and fulfilled, and given sincere advice." So he raised his index finger, and raised it to the sky, and pointed it down to the people: "O Allah, bear witness, O Allah, bear witness, O Allah, bear witness." Then Bilal called the adhan with a single call and iqamah, and he prayed the Zuhr, then he made the iqamah and prayed the Asr, he did not pray anything between them, then he rode until he stopped, and he made the belly of his she-camel al-Qaswa face toward the small rocks - and Isma'il said: toward the small trees - and made the path of the walkers before him, then he faced the Qiblah, and he remained standing until the sun set and the yellowness went away, until the disc disappeared, then he seated Usamah behind him, then he moved on, and he had tightened the rein for al-Qaswa, until indeed her head would touch the pommel of his saddle, and he would say with his right hand: "Tranquility, tranquility." Every time he came to a rope of the ropes [of the crowd], he loosened it a little for her until she climbed, until he came to Muzdalifah, and he prayed there the Maghrib and the Isha with one adhan and two iqamahs, then he lay down until when it dawned, he prayed the Fajr, with an adhan and an iqamah, then he rode al-Qaswa until he stood at al-Mash'ar al-Haram, and he faced the Qiblah, and supplicated to Allah, and magnified Him, and declared His Oneness, and affirmed His Unity, until it became bright indeed, then he moved on before the sun rose, and he seated al-Fadl ibn Abbas behind him, and he was a man with beautiful hair, white, handsome, so when the Prophet ﷺ moved on, he passed by the women's litters running, so al-Fadl began looking at them, so the Prophet ﷺ took his hand and placed it on al-Fadl's face, so al-Fadl turned his head to the other side, so the Prophet ﷺ placed his hand on the other side, until when he came to Muhassir, he moved quickly a little, then he took the middle path which brings you out to the large Jamrah, until he came to the Jamrah which is by the tree, and he threw seven pebbles, saying the takbir with every pebble, of the size of pebbles for flicking, then he threw from the bottom of the valley, then he departed to the place of sacrifice, and sacrificed sixty-three camels with his own hand, then he gave [the rest] to Ali, and he sacrificed what remained, and he shared him in his sacrificial animals, then he commanded that a piece be taken from every camel, and it was placed in a pot, and cooked, so the two of them ate from its meat, and drank from its broth, then he rode and went to the House, so he came to the House and prayed the Zuhr at Makkah, and he came to Banu Abd al-Muttalib while they were drawing water from Zamzam, and said: "Draw, O Banu Abd al-Muttalib, for were it not that the people would overpower you concerning your water-drawing, I would draw with you." So they handed him a bucket, and he drank. [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Muhammad ibn Sa'id al-Asbahani, from Hatim ibn Isma'il, from Ja'far, from his father, from Jabir, with this.]
5.hi: Isma'il ibn Aban ne Hatim ibn Isma'il se, Ja'far ibn Muhammad se, apne walid se, Jabir ibn Abdullah رضي الله عنهما se bataya: Abu Ja'far ne kaha: Hum Jabir ibn Abdullah ke paas gaye, unhone logon ke baare mein poocha yahan tak ke mere paas pahunche, to maine kaha, main Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn (Alayhis Salam) ibn Ali (Alayhis Salam) hoon, to unhone apna haath mere upar wale button aur neeche wale button tak badhaya, fir apna muh mere seene par rakha, aur main us din jawaan ladka tha, aur unhone kaha: "Khush-aamdeed, ae mere bhai ke bete, jo poochna hai poocho." So maine unse poocha, aur woh andhe the, aur namaz ka waqt aaya, to woh ek chaadar mein khade hue us se lipete hue, jab bhi use apne kandhon par rakhte, uska kinaara chhote hone ki wajah se wapas aa jaata, aur unki ridaa unke pehlu mein khunte par thi, so unhone namaz padhi, to maine kaha: "Mujhe Rasulullah ﷺ ke Hajj ke baare mein bataayein?" To unhone apne haath se ishara karke nau gina, fir bataya: Rasulullah ﷺ nau saal tak Hajj kiye bagair rahe, fir das ke saal logon mein elaan kiya gaya ke Rasulullah ﷺ Hajj ko ja rahe hain, so bahut se log Madinah pahunche, sabhi Rasulullah ﷺ ki pairwi karna aur unke jaisa amal karna chahte the, so hum aapke saath nikle yahan tak ke Dhu al-Hulayfah pahunche, aur Asma bint Umays ko Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr رضي الله عنهم paida hue, to unhone Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas [poochne] bheja: "Main kya karun?" Aapne farmaya: "Ghusl karo, aur kapde se apne aap ko bandho, aur ehraam baandh lo." Fir Rasulullah ﷺ ne masjid mein namaz padhi, fir aap al-Qaswa par sawaar hue, yahan tak ke aapki oontni al-Bayda mein aapko lekar seedhi khadi hui, fir maine jahan tak meri nazar jaati thi dekha, aapke aage sawaar aur paidal chalne wale, aur aapke daaye taraf bhi utne hi, aur baaye taraf bhi utne hi, aur peechhe bhi utne hi, aur Rasulullah ﷺ humare darmiyan the, aur aap par Quran naazil ho raha tha aur aap uski tafseer jaante the, so aapne tawheed ke saath ehraam baandha: "Labbayka Allahumma labbayk, labbayka laa shareeka laka labbayk, innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, laa shareeka lak." So logon ne isi tarah ehraam baandha jaise woh baandha karte the, aur Rasulullah ﷺ ne unhein kuch jawab nahi diya, aur Rasulullah ﷺ apni talbiyah kehte rahe yahan tak ke hum aapke saath Baitullah pahunche. Jabir kehte hain: Humara irada sirf Hajj ka tha, hum Umrah [jama karne] ko nahi jaante the, yahan tak ke jab hum aapke saath Baitullah pahunche, aapne rukn ko chhua, fir teen chakron mein ramal kiya, aur chaar mein chale, fir Maqam-e-Ibrahim ki taraf aage badhe, aur namaz padhi, aur padha: "Aur Maqam-e-Ibrahim ko namaz ki jagah banao" [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 125], so aapne Maqam ko apne aur Baitullah ke darmiyan rakha, aur mere walid kaha karte the - aur mujhe nahi maloom ke unhone yeh Jabir se, Nabi ﷺ se zikr kiya ho - ke aap in do rakaton mein 'Qul huwallahu Ahad' aur 'Qul yaa ayyuhal-kaafiroon' padhte the, fir aap rukn ki taraf laute aur usay chhua, fir darwaze se Safa ki taraf nikle, so jab Safa par pahunche, to padha: "Beshak Safa aur Marwah Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se hain" [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 158], "Main wahin se shuru karta hoon jahan se Allah ne shuru kiya." So aapne Safa se shuru kiya aur uspar chadhe yahan tak ke aapne Baitullah dekha, aur Allah ki wahdaniyat bayan ki aur uski takbir kahi, aur farmaya: "Laa ilaaha illallahu wahdahu, laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadeer. Laa ilaaha illallahu wahdahu, anjaza wa'dahu, wa nasara 'abdahu, wa hazamal-ahzaaba wahdahu." Fir aapne is ke darmiyan dua ki, aur aapne isi tarah teen martaba kaha, fir Marwah ki taraf utre, yahan tak ke jab aapke paaon waadi ke tale mein utre, Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Darimi kehte hain: yaani, aapne ramal kiya, yahan tak ke jab hum chadhe to aap chale, yahan tak ke hum Marwah pahunche, so aapne Marwah par waisa hi kiya jaisa Safa par kiya tha, yahan tak ke jab Marwah par aakhri chakr hua, to aapne farmaya: "Agar mujhe pehle wahi maloom ho jaata jo baad mein hua, to main qurbani ka jaanwar saath na laata aur ise Umrah bana leta, so tum mein se jiske saath qurbani ka jaanwar na ho, woh halaal ho jaaye aur ise Umrah bana le." To Suraqah ibn Malik ibn Ju'shum khade hue, aur poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, yeh humare is saal ke liye hai ya hamesha ke liye?" To Rasulullah ﷺ ne apni ungliyan ek-doosre mein phansaayi, aur farmaya: "Umrah Hajj mein dakhil ho gaya," isi tarah, do martaba: "Nahi, balke yeh hamesha ke liye hai, hamesha ke liye; nahi, balke yeh hamesha ke liye hai, hamesha ke liye." Aur Ali Yemen se Nabi ﷺ ke liye qurbani ke oont le kar aaye, aur unhone Fatimah (رضوان الله عليها) ko un logon mein paaya jo halaal ho chuke the, aur unhone rangeen kapde pehne hue the, aur surma lagaaya hua tha, to Ali ne unse iska aitraaz kiya, to unhone kaha: "Mere walid ne mujhe hukum diya tha," so Ali kaha karte the: Main Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas gaya, Fatimah ke khilaaf unhein bhadkaate hue jo unhone kiya tha, Rasulullah ﷺ se jo unhone bataya uske baare mein fatwa poochte hue, aur maine unse iska aitraaz kiya tha, to aapne farmaya: "Unhone sach kaha, tumne kya kiya tha jab tumne Hajj ka faisla kiya?" Unhone bataya: Maine kaha: "Ya Allah, main wahi ehraam baandhta hoon jo tere rasool ne baandha hai." Aapne farmaya: "To mere saath qurbani ka jaanwar hai, so halaal na ho." Unhone bataya: So Ali jo qurbani ke jaanwar Yemen se laaye, aur jo Nabi ﷺ laaye the, unka kul jama' sau oont tha, so tamaam log halaal ho gaye aur baal katwaaye siwaay Nabi ﷺ ke aur un logon ke jinke saath qurbani ka jaanwar tha. Fir jab Tarwiyah ka din aaya, to aap Mina ki taraf rawaana hue, so humne Hajj ka ehraam baandha, aur Rasulullah ﷺ sawaar hue aur Mina mein Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, aur Subh padhi, fir thodi der thehre yahan tak ke suraj nikla, fir hukum diya ke baal ka ek khaymah Namirah mein lagaaya jaaye, fir Rasulullah ﷺ sawaar hue aur chale, aur Quraysh ko yeh shak bhi nahi tha ke aap al-Mash'ar al-Haram par rukenge, jaisa Quraysh Jahiliyat mein Muzdalifah mein kiya karte the, so Rasulullah ﷺ chalte rahe yahan tak ke Arafah pahunche, aur khaymah Namirah mein lagaa hua paaya, so wahan utre, yahan tak ke jab suraj dhal gaya, to aapne al-Qaswa ka hukum diya aur usay kaathi dee gayi, so aap waadi ke tale mein aaye, aur logon ko khutba diya, aur farmaya: "Tumhara khoon aur tumhara maal tumpar aise haraam hai jaise is tumhare din ki, is tumhare mahine ki, is tumhare shehar ki hurmat hai. Sun lo, Jahiliyat ke tamaam maamle mere paaon ke neeche rakh diye gaye hain, aur Jahiliyat ki khoon-rezi khatam kar di gayi hai, aur sabse pehla khoon jo main apne khoon [ke jhagdon] mein se khatam karta hoon, woh Ibn Rabi'ah ibn al-Harith ka khoon hai, jo Banu Sa'd mein doodh pi raha tha, to Hudhayl ne use maar diya. Aur Jahiliyat ka sood khatam kar diya gaya hai, aur sabse pehla sood jo main khatam karta hoon woh Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib ka sood hai, kyunki woh sab khatam hai. So auraton ke maamle mein Allah se daro, kyunki tumne unhein Allah ki amanat se liya hai, aur unki sharamgaahon ko Allah ke kalima se halaal kiya hai, aur tumhara unpar haq hai ke woh tumhare bistar par kisi aise shakhs ko na baithne dein jise tum na-pasand karte ho, aur agar woh aisa karein, to unhein maaro, magar sakht nahi, aur unka tumpar haq hai ke unhein achhe tareeke se khaana aur kapda do. Aur tum mujhse [mere baare mein] poochhe jaaoge, to tum kya kahoge?" Unhone kaha: "Hum gawahi dete hain ke aapne paighaam pahunchaya, aur farz ada kiya, aur naseehat ki." To aapne apni shahaadat ki ungli utha kar aasman ki taraf ki, aur logon ki taraf jhukaate hue kaha: "Allahumma ashhad, Allahumma ashhad, Allahumma ashhad" [Ae Allah, gawah reh, Ae Allah, gawah reh, Ae Allah, gawah reh]. Fir Bilal ne ek azaan aur ek iqamah di, aur aapne Zuhr padhi, fir iqamah kahi aur Asr padhi, in dono ke darmiyan kuch aur nahi padha, fir aap sawaar hue yahan tak ke ruk gaye, aur apni oontni al-Qaswa ka pet chhote pathron ki taraf kiya - aur Isma'il ne kaha: chhote darakhton ki taraf - aur paidal chalne walon ka raasta apne saamne rakha, fir Qibla ki taraf mudke, aur khade rahe yahan tak ke suraj dooba aur zardi khatam ho gayi, yahan tak ke suraj ka gola chhup gaya, fir Usamah ko apne peechhe bithaya, fir chale, aur al-Qaswa ki lagaam kaskar pakdi hui thi, yahan tak ke uska sar unki kaathi ke agle hisse se takraata tha, aur woh apne daaye haath se kehte: "Sukoon, sukoon." Jab bhi bheed ki kisi rassi tak pahunchte, use thoda dheela chhod dete yahan tak ke woh chadh jaati, yahan tak ke Muzdalifah pahunche, aur wahan ek azaan aur do iqamaton se Maghrib aur Isha padhi, fir let gaye yahan tak ke jab subah hui, aap ne ek azaan aur iqamah se Fajr padhi, fir al-Qaswa par sawaar hue yahan tak ke al-Mash'ar al-Haram par ruke, aur Qibla ki taraf mudkar Allah se dua ki aur uski takbir kahi aur tahleel aur tawheed ki yahan tak ke achhi tarah roshni ho gayi, fir suraj nikalne se pehle chale, aur al-Fadl ibn Abbas ko apne peechhe bithaya, aur woh achhe baalon wale, gore, khoobsurat aadmi the, so jab Nabi ﷺ chale, to auraton ki daudti hui palkiyon ke paas se guzre, to al-Fadl unhein dekhne laga, to Nabi ﷺ ne uska haath pakda aur al-Fadl ke chehre par rakha, to al-Fadl ne apna sar doosri taraf pher liya, to Nabi ﷺ ne apna haath doosri taraf rakha, yahan tak ke jab Muhassir pahunche, to thoda tez chale, fir woh darmiyani raasta liya jo tumhein badi Jamrah ki taraf le jaata hai, yahan tak ke us Jamrah tak pahunche jiske paas darakht hai, aur saat kankariyan maarin, har kankari par takbir kehte hue, jaisi phenkne wali kankariyan hoti hain, fir waadi ke tale se phenki, fir qurbaangaah ki taraf gaye, aur apne haath se terasath oont zabah kiye, fir Ali ko diya aur unhone baaki zabah kiye, aur unhein apne qurbaani ke jaanwaron mein shareek kiya, fir har oont mein se ek tukda lene ka hukum diya, aur use ek deg mein daala gaya, aur pakaya gaya, so dono ne uska gosht khaya, aur uska shorba piya, fir sawaar hokar Baitullah ki taraf gaye, so Baitullah pahunche aur Makkah mein Zuhr padhi, aur Banu Abd al-Muttalib ke paas gaye jabke woh Zamzam se paani kheench rahe the, aur farmaya: "Kheencho, Banu Abd al-Muttalib, agar aisa na hota ke log tumhare paani kheenchne [ke sharaf] par ghaalib aa jaayenge, to main bhi tumhare saath kheenchta." So unhone aapko ek dol diya, aur aapne piya. [Isi hadith ki riwayat ek aur sanad se Muhammad ibn Sa'id al-Asbahani se, Hatim ibn Isma'il se, Ja'far se, apne walid se, Jabir se bhi aayi hai.]

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ هُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : بَيْنَا رَجُلٌ وَاقِفٌ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِعَرَفَةَ ، فَوَقَعَ عَنْ رَاحِلَتِهِ أَوْ قَالَ : فَأَقْعَصَتْهُ ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" اغْسِلُوهُ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ، وَكَفِّنُوهُ فِي ثَوْبَيْنِ، وَلَا تُحَنِّطُوهُ، وَلَا تُخَمِّرُوا رَأْسَهُ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى يَبْعَثُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُلَبِّيًا "
5.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas: He said: While a man was standing with the Prophet ﷺ at Arafah, he fell from his mount, or he said: it threw him down and killed him, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Wash him with water and lote-leaves, and shroud him in two garments, and do not perfume him, and do not cover his head, for indeed Allah the Exalted will raise him up on the Day of Resurrection saying the talbiyah."
5.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ayyub se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Jabke ek aadmi Nabi ﷺ ke saath Arafah mein khada tha, woh apni sawaari se gir gaya, ya unhone kaha: usne use giraa kar maar diya, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Isay paani aur beri ke pattoan se ghusl do, aur do kapdon mein kafan do, aur isay khushbu na lagaao, aur iska sar na dhako, kyunki Allah Ta'ala isay Qayamat ke din talbiyah kehte hue uthaayega."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ  ،  عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : " إِنَّمَاجُعِلَ الطَّوَافُ بِالْبَيْتِ ، وَرَمْيُ الْجِمَارِ، وَالسَّعْيُ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ ، لِإِقَامَةِ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ : كَانَ يَرْفَعُهُ.
 أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، نَحْوَهُ
5.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ubaydullah ibn Abi Ziyad, from al-Qasim, from Aisha; with Abu Asim's note; a similar chain also via Abu Nu'aym and Muhammad ibn Yusuf: She said: "The tawaf around the House, and the throwing of the jamarat, and the sa'i between al-Safa and al-Marwah, were only made for establishing the remembrance of Allah." Abu Asim said: he used to raise it [to the Prophet ﷺ]. [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Abu Nu'aym, and Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Ubaydullah ibn Abi Ziyad, from al-Qasim, from Aisha, from the Prophet ﷺ.]
5.hi: Abu Asim ne Ubaydullah ibn Abi Ziyad se, al-Qasim se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Baitullah ka tawaaf, aur kankariyan maarna, aur Safa aur Marwah ke darmiyan sa'ee, sirf Allah ka zikr qaayam karne ke liye rakhi gayi hain." Abu Asim kehte hain: Woh ise marfu'an (Nabi tak) bayaan karte the. [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Abu Nu'aym se, aur Muhammad ibn Yusuf se, Sufyan se, Ubaydullah ibn Abi Ziyad se, al-Qasim se, Aisha se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai.]

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ بِلَالِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ :فَسْخُ الْحَجِّ لَنَا خَاصَّةً، أَمْ لِمَنْ بَعْدَنَا؟ قَالَ : " بَلْ لَنَا خَاصَّةً "
5.en: Narrated by Nu'aym ibn Hammad, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Rabi'ah ibn Abi Abd al-Rahman, from Bilal ibn al-Harith, from his father: He said: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, is the annulment of Hajj [to Umrah] specific to us, or for those after us?" He said: "Rather, specific to us."
5.hi: Nu'aym ibn Hammad ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, Rabi'ah ibn Abi Abd al-Rahman se, Bilal ibn al-Harith se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, Hajj ka faskh (Umrah mein badalna) khaas humare liye hai, ya humare baad walon ke liye bhi?" Aapne farmaya: "Balke, khaas humare liye."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" هَذِهِ عُمْرَةٌ اسْتَمْتَعْنَا بِهَا، فَمَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَعَهُ هَدْيٌ فَلْيَحِلَّ الْحِلَّ كُلَّهُ، فَقَدْ دَخَلَتِ الْعُمْرَةُ فِي الْحَجِّ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ "
5.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, from Mujahid, from Ibn Abbas, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "This is an Umrah with which we have enjoyed [combined with Hajj]; whoever does not have a sacrificial animal with him, let him release himself completely, for Umrah has entered into Hajj until the Day of Resurrection."
5.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se, al-Hakam se, Mujahid se, Ibn Abbas se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Yeh ek Umrah hai jise humne [Hajj se] jama karke faida uthaaya, so jiske paas qurbani ka jaanwar na ho, woh poori tarah halaal ho jaaye, kyunki Umrah Qayamat ke din tak Hajj mein dakhil ho chuka hai."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ  ، عَنْ رَبِيعِ بْنِ سَبْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ   حَدَّثَهُ : أَنَّهُمْ سَارُوا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَتَّى بَلَغُوا عُسْفَانَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي مُدْلِجٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ مَالِكُ بْنُ سُرَاقَةَ أَوْ سُرَاقَةُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ : اقْضِ لَنَا قَضَاءَ قَوْمٍ وُلِدُوا الْيَوْمَ.
قَالَ : " إِنَّاللَّهَ قَدْ أَدْخَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي حَجِّكُمْ هَذَا عُمْرَةً، فَإِذَا أَنْتُمْ قَدِمْتُمْ فَمَنْ تَطَوَّفَ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ ، فَقَدْ حَلَّ إِلَّا مَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ هَدْيٌ "
5.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz, from Rabi' ibn Sabrah, from his father: That they marched with the Prophet ﷺ until they reached Usfan, so a man from Banu Mudlij called Malik ibn Suraqah or Suraqah ibn Malik said to him: "Give us a ruling like the ruling for a people born today." He said: "Indeed Allah has brought into your Hajj this Umrah, so when you arrive, whoever circumambulates the House and [does sa'i] between al-Safa and al-Marwah, has released himself, except whoever has a sacrificial animal with him."
5.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz se, Rabi' ibn Sabrah se, apne walid se bataya ke woh Nabi ﷺ ke saath chalte rahe yahan tak ke Usfan pahunche, to Banu Mudlij ke ek aadmi ne, jise Malik ibn Suraqah ya Suraqah ibn Malik kaha jaata tha, aapse kaha: "Humein aisa hukum dijiye jaisa un logon ke liye ho jo aaj paida hue hon." Aapne farmaya: "Allah ne tumhare is Hajj mein yeh Umrah shaamil kar diya hai, so jab tum pahuncho, to jo Baitullah ka tawaaf kare aur Safa aur Marwah ke darmiyan sa'ee kare, woh halaal ho jaayega, siwaay us shakhs ke jiske saath qurbani ka jaanwar ho."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا شِهَابُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَاعْتَمَرَ أَرْبَعَ عُمَرٍ : عُمْرَةَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ ، وَعُمْرَةَ الْقَضَاءِ أَوْ قَالَ : عُمْرَةَ الْقِصَاصِ، شَكَّ شِهَابُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ مِنْ قَابِلٍ، وَالثَّالِثَةَ مِنْ الْجِعْرَانَةِ ، وَالرَّابِعَةَ الَّتِي مَعَ حَجَّتِهِ "
5.en: Narrated by al-Aswad ibn Amir, from Da'ud ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas: That the Prophet ﷺ performed Umrah four times: the Umrah of al-Hudaybiyyah, and the Umrah of al-Qada or he said: the Umrah of al-Qisas - Shihab ibn Abbad was uncertain about the following - and the third from al-Ji'ranah, and the fourth which was with his Hajj.
5.hi: Al-Aswad ibn Amir ne Da'ud ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne chaar martaba Umrah kiya: Umrah al-Hudaybiyyah, aur Umrah al-Qada ya farmaya: Umrah al-Qisas - Shihab ibn Abbad ko aage ke baare mein shak tha - aur teesra al-Ji'ranah se, aur chautha jo aapke Hajj ke saath tha.

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ لِامْرَأَةٍ :" اعْتَمِرِي فِي رَمَضَانَ، فَإِنَّ عُمْرَةً فِي رَمَضَانَ تَعْدِلُ حَجَّةً "
5.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ata, from Ibn Abbas: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to a woman: "Perform Umrah in Ramadan, for indeed an Umrah in Ramadan equals a Hajj."
5.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Ata se, Ibn Abbas se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne ek aurat se farmaya: "Ramzan mein Umrah karo, kyunki Ramzan mein Umrah Hajj ke barabar hai."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ مَعْقِلِ بْنِ أَبِي مَعْقَلٍ الْأَسَدِيِّ أَسَدُ خُزَيْمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يُوسُفُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلَامٍ  ، عَنْ جَدَّتِهِ أُمِّ مَعْقَلٍ  ، قَالَتْ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" عُمْرَةٌ فِي رَمَضَانَ تَعْدِلُ حَجَّةً "
5.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Isa ibn Ma'qil ibn Abi Ma'qal al-Asadi, from Yusuf ibn Abdullah ibn Salam, from his grandmother Umm Ma'qal: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "An Umrah in Ramadan equals a Hajj."
5.hi: Ahmad ibn Khalid ne Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, Isa ibn Ma'qil ibn Abi Ma'qal al-Asadi se bataya: Mujhse Yusuf ibn Abdullah ibn Salam ne bataya, apni dadi Umm Ma'qal se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Ramzan mein Umrah Hajj ke barabar hai."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْبَزَّازُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّا  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُزَاحِمُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَاحِمٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ مُحَرِّشٍ الْكَعْبِيِّ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" خَرَجَ مِنْ الْجِعْرَانَةِ حِينَ أَنْشَأَ مُعْتَمِرًا، فَدَخَلَ مَكَّةَ لَيْلًا، فَقَضَى عُمْرَتَهُ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ مِنْ تَحْتِ لَيْلَتِهِ، فَأَصْبَحَ بِالْجِعْرَانَةِ كَبَائِتٍ "
5.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Bazzaz, from Yahya ibn Zakariya, from Ibn Jurayj, from Muzahim ibn Abi Muzahim, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Abdullah, from Muharrish al-Ka'bi: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "went out from al-Ji'ranah when he set out for Umrah, and entered Makkah at night, and completed his Umrah, then he went out before that night [ended], so he was at al-Ji'ranah in the morning as one who had stayed overnight."
5.hi: Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Bazzaz ne Yahya ibn Zakariya se, Ibn Jurayj se, Muzahim ibn Abi Muzahim se, Abd al-Aziz ibn Abdullah se, Muharrish al-Ka'bi se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "al-Ji'ranah se nikle jab aapne Umrah ka irada kiya, aur raat ko Makkah mein dakhil hue, aur apna Umrah poora kiya, fir usi raat ke andar bahar nikal aaye, so subah al-Ji'ranah mein aise the jaise waheen raat guzari ho."

5.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو  ، سَمِعَ عَمْرَو بْنَ أَوْسٍ  يَقُولُ : أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ   يَقُولُ : " أَمَرَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْأُرْدِفَ عَائِشَةَ فَأُعْمِرَهَا مِنْ التَّنْعِيمِ ".
قَالَ سُفْيَانُ : كَانَ شُعْبَةُ يُعْجِبُهُ مِثْلَ هَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ
5.en: Narrated by Sadaqah ibn al-Fadl, from Ibn Uyaynah, from Amr, from Amr ibn Aws, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakr; with Sufyan's note: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded me to mount Aisha behind me and take her for Umrah from al-Tan'im." Sufyan said: Shu'bah used to be impressed by [a chain] like this one.
5.hi: Sadaqah ibn al-Fadl ne Ibn Uyaynah se, Amr se bataya: Unhone Amr ibn Aws ko kehte suna: Mujhe Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakr ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhe hukum diya ke main Aisha ko apne peechhe sawaar karun aur unhein al-Tan'im se Umrah karwaaun." Sufyan kehte hain: Shu'bah aisi sanad se bahut khush hote the.

5.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ الْعَطَّارُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ خُثَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مَاهَكَ  ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهَا  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ لِعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ :" أَرْدِفْ أُخْتَكَ يَعْنِي : عَائِشَةَ وَأَعْمِرْهَا مِنْ التَّنْعِيمِ ، فَإِذَا هَبَطْتَ مِنْ الْأَكَمَةِ ، فَمُرْهَا فَلْتُحْرِمْ، فَإِنَّهَا عُمْرَةٌ مُتَقَبَّلَةٌ "
5.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Yunus, from Da'ud al-Attar, from Ibn Khuthaym, from Yusuf ibn Mahak, from Hafsah bint Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakr al-Siddiq, from her father: That the Prophet ﷺ said to Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakr: "Mount your sister - meaning Aisha - and take her for Umrah from al-Tan'im, and when you descend from the hill, command her to enter ihram, for indeed it is an accepted Umrah."
5.hi: Ahmad ibn Yunus ne Da'ud al-Attar se, Ibn Khuthaym se, Yusuf ibn Mahak se, Hafsah bint Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakr al-Siddiq se, apne walid se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakr se farmaya: "Apni behen - yaani Aisha - ko sawaar karo aur unhein al-Tan'im se Umrah karwaao, aur jab tum pahaadi se utro, to unhein ehraam baandhne ka hukum do, kyunki yeh ek maqbool Umrah hai."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ   قَالَ : " إِنِّيلَأُقَبِّلُكَ، وَإِنِّي لَأَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ حَجَرٌ، وَلَكِنِّي رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُقَبِّلُكَ "
5.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, about Umar: That Umar said: "Indeed I kiss you, and indeed I know that you are [only] a stone, but I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ kiss you."
5.hi: Musaddad ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ayyub se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Umar ne kaha: "Main tujhe bosa deta hoon, aur mujhe pata hai ke tu ek pathar hai, lekin maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko tujhe bosa dete dekha hai."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ  ، قَالَ : رَأَيْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَبَّادِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ  " يَسْتَلِمُ الْحَجَرَ، ثُمَّ يُقَبِّلُهُ وَيَسْجُدُ عَلَيْهِ "، فَقُلْتُ لَهُ : مَا هَذَا؟ فَقَالَ : رَأَيْتُ خَالَكَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ  رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ يَفْعَلُهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : رَأَيْتُ عُمَرَ   فَعَلَهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : إِنِّي لَأَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ حَجَرٌ، وَلَكِنِّي رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَفْعَلُ هَذَا
5.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ja'far ibn Abdullah ibn Uthman, about Muhammad ibn Abbad ibn Ja'far: He said: I saw Muhammad ibn Abbad ibn Ja'far "touch the Stone, then kiss it, and prostrate upon it," so I said to him: "What is this?" So he said: I saw your maternal uncle Abdullah ibn Abbas, may Allah's pleasure be upon him, do it, then he said: I saw Umar do it, then he said: Indeed I know that you are a stone, but I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ do this.
5.hi: Abu Asim ne Ja'far ibn Abdullah ibn Uthman se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Muhammad ibn Abbad ibn Ja'far ko dekha ke unhone "Hajr-e-Aswad ko chhua, fir chooma aur uspar sajda kiya," to maine unse poocha: "Yeh kya hai?" To unhone kaha: Maine tumhare mamu Abdullah ibn Abbas (رضوان الله عليه) ko yeh karte dekha, fir kaha: Maine Umar ko yeh karte dekha, fir kaha: Mujhe pata hai ke tu ek pathar hai, lekin maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko yeh karte dekha hai.

5.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَكَّةَ وَرَدِيفُهُ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، فَأَنَاخَ فِي أَصْلِ الْكَعْبَةِ ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ : وَسَعَى النَّاسُ، فَدَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَبِلَالٌ وَأُسَامَةُ، فَقُلْتُ لِبِلَالٍ مِنْ وَرَاءِ الْبَاب : " أَيْنَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟ فَقَالَ : بَيْنَ السَّارِيَتَيْنِ ".
أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْبَيْتَ هُوَ وَأُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، وَبِلَالٌ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ الْحَجَبِيُّ، فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ
5.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ayyub, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar; a similar chain also via Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Yunus: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered Makkah with Usamah ibn Zayd riding behind him, so he made [his mount] kneel at the base of the Ka'bah, so Ibn Umar said: And the people ran [to see], so the Prophet ﷺ entered, with Bilal and Usamah, so I said to Bilal from behind the door: "Where did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pray?" So he said: "Between the two pillars." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Yunus, from Layth, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim, from Abdullah: that he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered the House, he and Usamah ibn Zayd, and Bilal, and Uthman ibn Talhah al-Hajabi, and he mentioned similarly.]
5.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ayyub se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ Makkah mein dakhil hue jabke Usamah ibn Zayd aapke peechhe sawaar the, so aapne [apni sawaari] Ka'bah ke tale bithaayi, to Ibn Umar ne bataya: Aur log daudte hue aaye, to Nabi ﷺ dakhil hue, Bilal aur Usamah ke saath, to maine Bilal se darwaze ke peechhe se poocha: "Rasulullah ﷺ ne kahan namaz padhi?" To unhone kaha: "Do satoono ke darmiyan." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Yunus se, Layth se, Ibn Shihab se, Salim se, Abdullah se bhi aayi hai: ke unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ Baitullah mein dakhil hue, aap aur Usamah ibn Zayd, aur Bilal, aur Uthman ibn Talhah al-Hajabi, aur unhone isi jaisa zikr kiya.]

5.ar: حَدَّثَنِي فَرْوَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَغْرَاءِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَوْلَا حَدَاثَةُ عَهْدِ قَوْمِكِ بِالْكُفْرِ، لَنَقَضْتُ الْكَعْبَةَ ثُمَّ لَبَنَيْتُهَا عَلَى أُسِّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، فَإِنَّ قُرَيْشًا حِينَ بَنَتْ اسْتَقْصَرَتْ، ثُمَّ جَعَلَتْ لَهَا خَلْفًا "
5.en: Narrated by Farwah ibn Abi al-Maghra, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: "Were it not for the recency of your people's covenant with disbelief, I would have demolished the Ka'bah and rebuilt it upon the foundation of Ibrahim, for indeed Quraysh, when they built it, made it too short, then they made a rear part for it."
5.hi: Farwah ibn Abi al-Maghra ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhse farmaya: "Agar tumhari qaum ka kufr se taaza ahad na hota, to main Ka'bah ko toad kar Ibrahim ki buniyaad par dobara banaata, kyunki Quraysh ne jab isay banaya to isay chhota kar diya, fir iske liye ek peechla hissa (Hijr) bana diya."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ  ، عَنْ الْأَشْعَثِ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ الْحَجَرِ : أَمِنَ الْبَيْتِ هُوَ؟.
قَالَ : نَعَمْ.
قُلْتُ : فَمَا لَهُمْ لَمْ يُدْخِلُوهُ فِي الْبَيْتِ ؟ فَقَالَ : " إِنَّ قَوْمَكِ قَصَّرَتْ بِهِمْ النَّفَقَةُ ".
 قُلْتُ : فَمَا شَأْنُ بَابِهِ مُرْتَفِعًا؟ قَالَ : " فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ قَوْمُكِ لِيُدْخِلُوا مَنْ شَاءُوا وَيَمْنَعُوا مَنْ شَاءُوا،وَلَوْلَا أَنَّ قَوْمَكِ حَدِيثُ عَهْدٍ بِجَاهِلِيَّةٍ فَأَخَافُ أَنْ تُنْكِرَ قُلُوبُهُمْ، لَعَمَدْتُ إِلَى الْحِجْرِ فَجَعَلْتُهُ فِي الْبَيْتِ وَأَلْزَقْتُ بَابَهُ بِالْأَرْضِ "
5.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abu al-Ahwas, from al-Ash'ath ibn Sulaym, from al-Aswad, from Aisha: She said: I asked the Prophet ﷺ about the Stone: "Is it part of the House?" He said, "Yes." I said: "Then why did they not include it in the House?" So he said: "Indeed your people's funds fell short." I said: "Then what is the matter with its door being raised [high]?" He said: "Your people did that so they could let in whoever they wished and prevent whoever they wished, and were it not that your people are recent from Jahiliyyah, and I fear that their hearts would reject it, I would have intended the Hijr and placed it in the House, and made its door level with the ground."
5.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Abu al-Ahwas se, al-Ash'ath ibn Sulaym se, al-Aswad se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Nabi ﷺ se Hijr (Hatim) ke baare mein poocha: "Kya yeh Baitullah ka hissa hai?" Aapne farmaya, "Haan." Maine poocha: "To phir unhone isay Baitullah mein shaamil kyun nahi kiya?" Aapne farmaya: "Tumhari qaum ke paas kharcha kam pad gaya tha." Maine poocha: "To iske darwaze ke bulund hone ka kya sabab hai?" Aapne farmaya: "Tumhari qaum ne yeh isliye kiya taake woh jise chahein andar aane dein aur jise chahein rokein, aur agar yeh baat na hoti ke tumhari qaum abhi Jahiliyat se taaza-taaza nikli hai, aur mujhe dar hai ke unke dil ise na-pasand karein, to main Hijr ka irada karta aur isay Baitullah mein shaamil kar deta, aur iska darwaza zameen ke barabar kar deta."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ  ، يَقُولُ : " التَّحْصِيبُ لَيْسَ بِشَيْءٍ، إِنَّمَاهُوَ مَنْزِلٌ نَزَلَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ".
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : التَّحْصِيبُ مَوْضِعٌ بِمَكَّةَ ، وَهُوَ مَوْضِعٌ بِبَطْحَاءَ
5.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Amr, from Ata, from Ibn Abbas; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: "Al-Tahsib is nothing, it is only a stopping-place where the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stopped." Abu Muhammad said: al-Tahsib is a place at Makkah, it is a place at al-Batha.
5.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se, Amr se, Ata se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibn Abbas ko kehte suna: "Tahsib (al-Muhassab mein rukna) koi cheez nahi hai, yeh to bas ek jagah hai jahan Rasulullah ﷺ ne pdaao kiya tha." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Tahsib Makkah mein ek jagah hai, yeh al-Batha mein ek jagah hai.

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُدَيْنَةَ هُوَ يَحْيَى بْنُ الْمُهَلَّبِ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ :" صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِمِنًى خَمْسَ صَلَوَاتٍ "
5.en: Narrated by al-Aswad ibn Amir, from Abu Kudaynah (Yahya ibn al-Muhallab), from al-A'mash, from al-Hakam, from Miqsam, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed at Mina five prayers."
5.hi: Al-Aswad ibn Amir ne Abu Kudaynah (Yahya ibn al-Muhallab) se, al-A'mash se, al-Hakam se, Miqsam se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Mina mein paanch namazein padhin."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ  ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَنْبَلٍ  ، عَنْ إِسْحَاق بْنِ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِأَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ   : حَدِّثْنِي بِشَيْءٍ عَقَلْتَهُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : أَيْنَ صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ يَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ؟ قَالَ : بِمِنًى .
قَالَ : قُلْتُ : فَأَيْنَ صَلَّى الْعَصْرَ يَوْمَ النَّفْرِ؟ قَالَ : بِالْأَبْطَحِ ، ثُمَّ قَالَ :" اصْنَعْ مَا يَصْنَعُ أُمَرَاؤُكَ "
5.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad, and Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Hanbal, from Ishaq ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan al-Thawri, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Rufay', about Anas ibn Malik: He said: I said to Anas ibn Malik: "Tell me something you remember from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: Where did he pray Zuhr on the day of Tarwiyah?" He said: At Mina. He said: I said: "Then where did he pray Asr on the day of departure?" He said: At al-Abtah, then he said: "Do as your rulers do."
5.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad aur Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Hanbal ne Ishaq ibn Yusuf se, Sufyan al-Thawri se, Abd al-Aziz ibn Rufay' se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Anas ibn Malik se poocha: "Mujhe Rasulullah ﷺ ke baare mein woh baat bataayein jo aapko yaad hai: Aapne Tarwiyah ke din Zuhr kahan padhi?" Unhone kaha: Mina mein. Unhone bataya: Maine poocha: "To aapne wapasi ke din Asr kahan padhi?" Unhone kaha: al-Abtah mein, fir kaha: "Jo tumhare hukmaraan karein woh karo."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدٌ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ،  عَنْ أَنَسٍ   أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُ : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ وَالْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ، وَرَقَدَ رَقْدَةً بِمِنًى ، ثُمَّ رَكِبَ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ فَطَافَ بِهِ "
5.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Khalid, from Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal, from Qatadah, from Anas: That he told him: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "prayed Zuhr, and Asr, and Maghrib, and Isha, and slept a sleep at Mina, then he rode to the House and circumambulated it."
5.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhse Khalid ne bataya, Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal se, Qatadah se, Anas se: ke unhone unhein bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, aur Isha padhi, aur Mina mein ek neend so gaye, fir Baitullah ki taraf sawaar hokar gaye aur uska tawaaf kiya."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ أَبِي الْأَسْوَدِ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   وَصَلَّى مَعَ عُثْمَانَ بِمِنًى أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ : " لَقَدْصَلَّيْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي هَذَا الْمَكَانِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَمَعَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ رَكْعَتَيْنِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَمَعَ عُمَرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ تَفَرَّقَتْ بِكُمْ الطُّرُقُ، فَلَيْتَ حَظِّي مِنْ أَرْبَعِ رَكَعَاتٍ رَكْعَتَانِ مُتَقَبَّلَتَانِ "
5.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Salt, from Mansur ibn Abi al-Aswad, from Sulayman, from Ibrahim, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid, about Abdullah and Uthman: He said: Abdullah said - and he had prayed with Uthman at Mina four rak'ahs: "I have indeed prayed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at this place two by two rak'ahs, and with Abu Bakr two by two rak'ahs, and with Umar two by two rak'ahs, then the paths diverged with you [after that], so I wish that my portion of the four rak'ahs were [only] two accepted rak'ahs."
5.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Salt ne Mansur ibn Abi al-Aswad se, Sulayman se, Ibrahim se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ne kaha - aur unhone Uthman ke saath Mina mein chaar rakat padhi thi: "Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath is jagah do-do rakat padhi, aur Abu Bakr ke saath do-do rakat, aur Umar ke saath do-do rakat, fir tumhare saath raaste alag ho gaye, so mera afsos hai ke kaash mera in chaar rakaton mein se hissa sirf do maqbool rakat hota."

5.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ   أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" صَلَّى بِمِنًى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَأَبَا بَكْرٍ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَعُمَرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَعُثْمَانَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ صَدْرًا مِنْ إِمَارَتِهِ، ثُمَّ أَتَمَّهَا بَعْدُ "
5.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from al-Awza'i, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from his father: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "prayed at Mina two rak'ahs, and Abu Bakr two rak'ahs, and Umar two rak'ahs, and Uthman two rak'ahs at the start of his rule, then he completed it after that."
5.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne al-Awza'i se, al-Zuhri se, Salim se, apne walid se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "Mina mein do rakat padhi, aur Abu Bakr ne do rakat, aur Umar ne do rakat, aur Uthman ne apni khilaafat ke shuru mein do rakat, fir baad mein isay poora kiya."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ الْمَاجِشُونِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : " خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنْ مِنًى ،فَمِنَّا مَنْ يُكَبِّرُ وَمِنَّا مَنْ يُلَبِّي "
5.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Sufyan, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Abdullah ibn Abi Salamah al-Majishun, from Ibn Umar: He said: "We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from Mina, so some of us would say the takbir and some of us would say the talbiyah."
5.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Sufyan se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Abdullah ibn Abi Salamah al-Majishun se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath Mina se nikle, to humme se kuch takbir kehte aur kuch talbiyah kehte."

5.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الثَّقَفِيُّ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ   وَنَحْنُ غَادِيَانِ مِنْ مِنًى إِلَى عَرَفَاتٍ عَنْ التَّلْبِيَةِ : كَيْفَ كُنْتُمْ تَصْنَعُونَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟ قَالَ : " كَانَيُلَبِّي الْمُلَبِّي فَلَا يُنْكَرُ عَلَيْهِ، وَيُكَبِّرُ الْمُكَبِّرُ فَلَا يُنْكَرُ عَلَيْهِ "
5.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Malik, from Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr al-Thaqafi, about Anas ibn Malik: He said: I asked Anas ibn Malik, while we were going in the morning from Mina to Arafat, about the talbiyah: "How did you use to do with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" He said: "The one saying the talbiyah would say the talbiyah, and it was not disapproved of him, and the one saying the takbir would say the takbir, and it was not disapproved of him."
5.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Malik se bataya: Mujhse Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr al-Thaqafi ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Anas ibn Malik se poocha, jabke hum subah Mina se Arafat ja rahe the, talbiyah ke baare mein: "Aap Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath kaise karte the?" Unhone kaha: "Jo talbiyah kehta woh talbiyah kehta, aur usay bura nahi samjha jaata, aur jo takbir kehta woh takbir kehta, aur usay bura nahi samjha jaata."

5.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ جُبَيْرٌ   : أَضْلَلْتُ بَعِيرًا لِي فَذَهَبْتُ أَطْلُبُهُ، فَرَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" وَاقِفًا مَعَ النَّاسِ بِعَرَفَةَ "، فَقُلْتُ : وَاللَّهِ إِنَّ هَذَا لَمِنْ الْحُمْسِ، فَمَا شَأْنُهُ هَهُنَا
5.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Ibn Uyaynah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Muhammad ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im, about Jubayr: He said: Jubayr said: I lost a camel of mine, so I went to search for it, and I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "standing with the people at Arafah," so I said: "By Allah, indeed this one is from the Hums, so what is his business here?"
5.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Ibn Uyaynah se bataya: Mujhse Amr ibn Dinar ne bataya, Muhammad ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im se: Unhone kaha, Jubayr ne kaha: Mera ek oont kho gaya, so main usay talaash karne gaya, to maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko "logon ke saath Arafah mein khada dekha," to maine kaha: "Allah ki qasam, yeh to Hums (Quraysh) mein se hai, to yeh yahan kya kar raha hai?"

5.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَمَى، ثُمَّ قَعَدَ لِلنَّاسِ، فَجَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّيحَلَقْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَنْحَرَ؟ قَالَ : " لَا حَرَجَ "
5.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Usamah ibn Zayd, from Ata, from Jabir: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ threw [the pebbles], then sat down for the people, so a man came to him, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, I shaved before I sacrificed?" He said: "There is no harm."
5.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Usamah ibn Zayd se, Ata se, Jabir se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne [kankariyan] maarin, fir logon ke liye baith gaye, to ek aadmi aapke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, maine qurbani se pehle sar mundwaa liya?" Aapne farmaya: "Koi harj nahi."

5.ar:
ثُمَّ جَاءَهُ آخَرُ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ،طُفْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْمِيَ؟ قَالَ : " لَا حَرَجَ ".
قَالَ : فَمَا سُئِلَ عَنْ شَيْءٍ إِلَّا قَالَ : " لَا حَرَجَ "
5.en: Continuing the same narration [Ibn Abbas]: Then another man came to him, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, I circumambulated before I threw?" He said: "No harm." He said: So he was not asked about anything except that he said: "No harm."
5.hi: Fir ek aur aadmi aapke paas aaya, aur poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, maine kankariyan maarne se pehle tawaaf kar liya?" Aapne farmaya: "Koi harj nahi." Unhone bataya: So aapse jo bhi poocha gaya, aapne yehi farmaya: "Koi harj nahi."

5.ar: ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" كُلُّ عَرَفَةَ مَوْقِفٌ، وَكُلُّ مُزْدَلِفَةَ مَوْقِفٌ، وَمِنًى كُلُّهَا مَنْحَرٌ، وَكُلُّ فِجَاجِ مَكَّةَ طَرِيقٌ وَمَنْحَرٌ "
5.en: Continuing the same narration: Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "All of Arafah is a standing-place, and all of Muzdalifah is a standing-place, and all of Mina is a place of sacrifice, and all the mountain-passes of Makkah are a path and a place of sacrifice."
5.hi: Fir Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Poora Arafah wuquf ki jagah hai, aur poori Muzdalifah wuquf ki jagah hai, aur poora Mina qurbani ki jagah hai, aur Makkah ke sab raste qurbani aur guzarne ki jagah hain."

5.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ  ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ رَدِيفَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" فَأَفَاضَ مِنْ عَرَفَةَ ، وَكَانَ يَسِيرُ الْعَنَقَ، فَإِذَا أَتَى عَلَى فَجْوَةٍ، نَصَّ "
5.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Usamah ibn Zayd: That he was riding behind the Prophet ﷺ "so he departed from Arafah, and he was moving at a jog-trot pace, and when he came to an open space, he sped up."
5.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Usamah ibn Zayd se bataya ke woh Nabi ﷺ ke peechhe sawaar the, "to aap Arafah se rawaana hue, aur aap dulki chaal chal rahe the, aur jab kholi jagah aati, to tez ho jaate."

5.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي كُرَيْبٌ  أَنَّهُ : سَأَلَ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبِرْنِي عَشِيَّةَ رَدِفْتَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : كَيْفَ فَعَلْتُمْ أَوْ صَنَعْتُمْ؟ قَالَ : " جِئْنَا الشِّعْبَ الَّذِي يُنِيخُ النَّاسُ فِيهِ لِلْمُعَرَّسِ، فَأَنَاخَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَاقَتَهُ، ثُمَّ بَالَ وَمَا قَالَ : أَهْرَاقَ الْمَاءَ ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِالْوَضُوءِ فَتَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءًا لَيْسَ بِالسَّابِغِ جِدًّا، ثُمَّ قُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، الصَّلَاةَ؟ قَالَ : الصَّلَاةُ أَمَامَكَ.
قَالَ :فَرَكِبَ حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا الْمُزْدَلِفَةَ ، فَأَقَامَ الْمَغْرِبَ، ثُمَّ أَنَاخَ وَالنَّاسُ فِي مَنَازِلِهِمْ، فَلَمْ يَحِلُّوا حَتَّى أَقَامَ الْعِشَاءَ الْآخِرَةَ، فَصَلَّى، ثُمَّ حَلَّ النَّاسُ ".
قَالَ : قُلْتُ : أَخْبِرْنِي كَيْفَ فَعَلْتُمْ حِينَ أَصْبَحْتُمْ؟.
 قَالَ : رَدِفَهُ الْفَضْلُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، فَانْطَلَقْتُ أَنَا فِي سُبَّاقِ قُرَيْشٍ عَلَى رِجْلَيَّ.
أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ  ، عَنْ كُرَيْبِ بْنِ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ  ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ  ، نَحْوَهُ
5.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zuhayr, from Ibrahim ibn Uqbah, from Kurayb, about Usamah ibn Zayd; a similar chain also via Hajjaj: That he asked Usamah ibn Zayd, and said: "Tell me, the evening you rode behind the Prophet ﷺ: how did you do or what did you do?" He said: "We came to the mountain pass where the people halt to rest at night, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ made his she-camel kneel, then he urinated - and he did not say: 'he passed water' - then he called for ablution water and performed ablution, an ablution that was not very complete, then I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, the prayer?' He said: 'The prayer is ahead of you.'" He said: So he rode until we arrived at Muzdalifah, so he made the iqamah for Maghrib, then he made [his camel] kneel while the people were in their places, and they did not release [themselves] until he made the iqamah for the last Isha, and prayed, then the people were released. He said: I said: "Tell me how you did when you reached morning." He said: al-Fadl ibn Abbas rode behind him, and I went off among the racers of Quraysh on my feet. [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Hajjaj, from Hammad, from Musa ibn Uqbah, from Kurayb ibn Abi Muslim, from Usamah.]
5.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zuhayr se, Ibrahim ibn Uqbah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Kurayb ne bataya ke unhone Usamah ibn Zayd se poocha: "Mujhe bataayein, jis shaam aap Nabi ﷺ ke peechhe sawaar the: aapne kaise kiya ya kya kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Hum us pahaadi raaste tak pahunche jahan log raat ko rukte hain, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne apni oontni ko bithaya, fir peshaab kiya - aur unhone [narrator ne] yeh nahi kaha: 'aapne paani gira' - fir wudu ka paani mangwaaya aur wudu kiya, aisa wudu jo bahut mukammal nahi tha, fir maine kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah, namaz?' Aapne farmaya: 'Namaz tumhare aage hai.'" Unhone bataya: To aap sawaar hue yahan tak ke hum Muzdalifah pahunche, so aapne Maghrib ki iqamah kahi, fir [oont] bithaya jabke log apni jagahon par the, aur woh [apne oont] tab tak azaad nahi hue jab tak aapne Isha-e-Aakhir ki iqamah nahi kahi, aur namaz padhi, fir log azaad hue. Unhone bataya: Maine poocha: "Mujhe bataayein aapne subah kaise kiya." Unhone kaha: al-Fadl ibn Abbas aapke peechhe sawaar hue, aur main Quraysh ke daudne walon mein apne paaon par [paidal] chala. [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Hajjaj se, Hammad se, Musa ibn Uqbah se, Kurayb ibn Abi Muslim se, Usamah se bhi aayi hai.]

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، قَالَ عَدِيُّ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ  : أَنْبَأَنِي، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" جَمَعَ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ "يَعْنِي : بِجَمْعٍ
5.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Adi ibn Thabit, from Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Abu Ayyub: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "combined between Maghrib and Isha" meaning: at Jam' [Muzdalifah].
5.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se bataya: Adi ibn Thabit ne mujhe bataya, unhone kaha: Maine Abdullah ibn Yazid ko suna, Abu Ayyub se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "Maghrib aur Isha ko jama kiya" - yaani, Jam' (Muzdalifah) mein.

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" صَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ ، لَمْ يُنَادِ فِي وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْإِقَامَةِ، وَلَمْ يُسَبِّحْ بَيْنَهُمَا، وَلَا عَلَى إِثْرِ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُمَا "
5.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim, from his father: That the Prophet ﷺ "prayed Maghrib and Isha at Muzdalifah, and did not call out for either of them except with the iqamah, and did not glorify [pray voluntary prayers] between them, nor following either of them."
5.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Ibn Abi Dhi'b se, Ibn Shihab se, Salim se, apne walid se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne "Muzdalifah mein Maghrib aur Isha padhi, dono mein se kisi ke liye bhi sirf iqamah kahi, aur dono ke darmiyan ya dono mein se kisi ke baad koi nafl namaz nahi padhi."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شَوَّالٍ  : أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ   أَخْبَرَتْهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" أَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَنْفِرَ مِنْ جَمْعٍ بِلَيْلٍ "
5.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ata, from Ibn Shawwal, from Umm Habibah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "commanded her to depart from Jam' [Muzdalifah] at night."
5.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Ata se, Ibn Shawwal se bataya: Unhein Umm Habibah ne bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "unhein hukum diya ke woh Jam' se raat mein nikal jaayein."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَفْلَحُ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ  يُحَدِّثُ،  عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : " اسْتَأْذَنَتْ سَوْدَةُ بِنْتُ زَمْعَةَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْيَأْذَنَ لَهَا فَتَدْفَعَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَدْفَعَ، فَأَذِنَ لَهَا ".
قَالَ الْقَاسِمُ : وَكَانَتْ امْرَأَةً ثَبِطَةً قَالَ الْقَاسِمُ : الثَّبِطَةُ : الثَّقِيلَةُ ، فَدَفَعَتْ وَحُبِسْنَا مَعَهُ حَتَّى دَفَعْنَا بِدَفْعِهِ
5.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Aflah, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Aisha; with al-Qasim's clarification: She said: "Sawdah bint Zam'ah sought the Messenger of Allah's ﷺ permission that he permit her to depart before he departed, so he permitted her." Al-Qasim said: And she was a heavy [slow-moving] woman, al-Qasim said: al-thabitah means: heavy, so she departed, and we were held back with him until we departed with his departure.
5.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Aflah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Qasim ibn Muhammad ko yeh hadith bayaan karte suna, Aisha se: Unhone kaha, "Sawdah bint Zam'ah ne Rasulullah ﷺ se ijaazat maangi ke aap unhein apne se pehle jaane dein, to aapne unhein ijaazat de di." Al-Qasim kehte hain: Aur woh ek bhaari-bharkam (dheemi) aurat thin, al-Qasim kehte hain: 'Thabitah' ka matlab hai: bhaari; so woh chali gayin, aur hum aapke saath roke gaye yahan tak ke aapke jaane ke saath hum bhi gaye.

5.ar: قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ   :" فَلَأَنْ أَكُونَ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَمَا اسْتَأْذَنَتْ سَوْدَةُ ، فَأَدْفَعَ قَبْلَ النَّاسِ، أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ مَفْرُوحٍ بِهِ "
5.en: Continuing the same narration [Aisha]: Aisha said: "That I had sought the Messenger of Allah's ﷺ permission as Sawdah sought permission, and departed before the people, is more beloved to me than something to be delighted about."
5.hi: Aisha ne kaha: "Ke maine Rasulullah ﷺ se ijaazat maangi hoti jaise Sawdah ne maangi thi, aur logon se pehle chali jaati, yeh mujhe kisi khushi dilaane wali cheez se zyada aziz hota."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا بُكَيْرُ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ يَعْمُرَ الدِّيلِيَّ   يَقُولُ : سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ الْحَجِّ، فَقَالَ :" الْحَجُّ عَرَفَاتٌ أَوْ قَالَ : عَرَفَةَ ، وَمَنْ أَدْرَكَ لَيْلَةَ جَمْعٍ قَبْلَ صَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ، فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ "
5.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from Bukayr ibn Ata, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Ya'mur al-Dili: He said: The Prophet ﷺ was asked about Hajj, so he said: "Hajj is Arafat," or he said: "Arafah, and whoever catches the night of Jam' [Muzdalifah] before the Subh prayer has indeed caught it [Hajj]."
5.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Shu'bah se bataya: Mujhse Bukayr ibn Ata ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abd al-Rahman ibn Ya'mur al-Dili ko kehte suna: Nabi ﷺ se Hajj ke baare mein poocha gaya, to aapne farmaya: "Hajj Arafat hai," ya farmaya: "Arafah, aur jo Subh ki namaz se pehle Jam' ki raat paa le, usne [Hajj] paa liya."

5.ar: وَقَالَ :" أَيَّامُ مِنًى ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ # فَمَنْ تَعَجَّلَ فِي يَوْمَيْنِ فَلا إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ وَمَنْ تَأَخَّرَ فَلا إِثْمَ سورة البقرة آية 203 # "
5.en: Continuing the same narration [al-Prophet ﷺ]: And he said: "The days of Mina are three days, so whoever hastens in two days there is no sin upon him, and whoever delays there is no sin" [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 203].
5.hi: Aur aapne farmaya: "Mina ke din teen din hain, so jo do dinon mein jaldi kare uspar koi gunah nahi, aur jo der kare uspar bhi koi gunah nahi" [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 203].

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ مُضَرِّسٍ  ، قَالَ : جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالْمَوْقِفِ عَلَى رُؤُوسِ النَّاسِ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، جِئْتُ مِنْ جَبَلَيْ طَيِّءٍ ، أَكْلَلْتُ مَطِيَّتِي : وَأَتْعَبْتُ نَفْسِي، وَاللَّهِ إِنْ بَقِيَ جَبَلٌ إِلَّا وَقَفْتُ عَلَيْهِ، فَهَلْ لِي مِنْ حَجٍّ؟ قَالَ :" مَنْ شَهِدَ مَعَنَا هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةَ، وَقَدْ أَتَى عَرَفَاتٍ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ لَيْلًا أَوْ نَهَارًا، فَقَدْ قَضَى تَفَثَهُ، وَتَمَّ حَجُّهُ ".
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي السَّفَرِ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ مُضَرِّسِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ بْنِ لَامٍ  ، قَالَ : أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ
5.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Isma'il, from Amir, from Urwah ibn Mudarris; a similar chain also via Abu al-Walid: He said: A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at the standing-place, above the heads of the people, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have come from the two mountains of Tayy, I have exhausted my mount and tired myself, and by Allah, no mountain remained except that I stopped upon it, so do I have a Hajj?" He said: "Whoever witnesses this prayer with us, and has come to Arafat before that, by night or day, has indeed fulfilled his rites and completed his Hajj." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Abdullah ibn Abi al-Safar, from al-Sha'bi, from Urwah ibn Mudarris ibn Harithah ibn Lam.]
