5.hi: Ya'la ne Isma'il se, Amir se, Urwah ibn Mudarris se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas wuquf ki jagah aaya, logon ke sar par khada hokar, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, main Tayy ke do pahaadon se aaya hoon, maine apni sawaari thaka di aur khud ko bhi thaka diya, aur Allah ki qasam, koi pahaad aisa nahi bacha jispar main na thehra hun, to kya mera Hajj ho gaya?" Aapne farmaya: "Jo hamare saath yeh namaz haazir ho, aur uske pehle raat ya din mein Arafat aa chuka ho, usne apna manaasik poora kiya aur uska Hajj mukammal ho gaya." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Abu al-Walid se, Shu'bah se, Abdullah ibn Abi al-Safar se, al-Sha'bi se, Urwah ibn Mudarris ibn Harithah ibn Lam se bhi aayi hai.]

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ أَهْلُ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ يُفِيضُونَ مِنْ جَمْعٍ بَعْدَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ، وَكَانُوا يَقُولُونَ : أَشْرِقْ ثَبِيرُ لَعَلَّنَا نُغِيرُ، وَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَالَفَهُمْ" فَدَفَعَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ بِقَدْرِ صَلَاةِ الْمُسْفِرِينَ أَوْ قَالَ : الْمُشْرِقِينَ بِصَلَاةِ الْغَدَاةِ "
5.en: Narrated by Abu Ghassan Malik ibn Isma'il, from Isra'il, from Abu Ishaq, from Amr ibn Maymun, from Umar ibn al-Khattab: He said: The people of the Jahiliyyah used to depart from Jam' [Muzdalifah] after sunrise, and they used to say: "Shine forth, O Thabir, that we may hasten," and indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ differed from them, "so he departed before sunrise, at the time of the prayer of those who pray at dawn," or he said: "those who pray at sunrise, with the morning prayer."
5.hi: Abu Ghassan Malik ibn Isma'il ne Isra'il se, Abu Ishaq se, Amr ibn Maymun se, Umar ibn al-Khattab se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ahl-e-Jahiliyat suraj nikalne ke baad Jam' se rawaana hote the, aur kehte the: "Chamak ja, ae Thabir, taake hum jaldi kar sakein," aur Rasulullah ﷺ ne unse ikhtilaaf kiya, "so aap suraj nikalne se pehle rawaana hue, us waqt jab log subah ki namaz jaldi padhne wale, ya farmaya: raushni mein padhne wale, subah ki namaz padhte hain."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ  : أَنَّ أَبَا مَعْبَدٍ  مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنْ الْفَضْلِ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ فِي عَشِيَّةِ عَرَفَةَ وَغَدَاةِ جَمْعٍ حِينَ دَفَعُوا : " عَلَيْكُمْ السَّكِينَةَ "،وَهُوَ كَافٌّ نَاقَتَهُ، حَتَّى إِذَا دَخَلَ وَادِي مُحَسِّرًا ، أَوْضَعَ.
أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، بِإِسْنَادِهِ نَحْوَهُ.
قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : الْإِيضَاعُ لِلْإِبِلِ، وَالْإِيجَافُ لِلْخَيْلِ
5.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Isa ibn Yunus, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Abu Ma'bad, freed servant of Ibn Abbas, from Ibn Abbas, from al-Fadl; with Abdullah's clarification; a similar chain also via Ahmad ibn Abdullah: That the Prophet ﷺ said, on the evening of Arafah and the morning of Jam' [Muzdalifah] when they departed: "Tranquility is upon you," while he was restraining his she-camel, until when he entered the valley of Muhassir, he sped up. [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Layth, from Abu al-Zubayr, with his chain.] Abdullah said: al-Idaa' is for camels, and al-Ijaf is for horses.
5.hi: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ne Isa ibn Yunus se, Ibn Jurayj se bataya: Mujhe Abu al-Zubayr ne bataya: ke Abu Ma'bad, Ibn Abbas ke azaad kiye hue ghulam, ne unhein bataya, Ibn Abbas se, al-Fadl se: ke Nabi ﷺ ne Arafah ki shaam aur Jam' ki subah, jab woh rawaana huye, farmaya: "Sukoon rakho," jabke aap apni oontni ko rok rahe the, yahan tak ke jab Muhassir ki waadi mein dakhil hue, to tez ho gaye. [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Ahmad ibn Abdullah se, Layth se, Abu al-Zubayr se, unki sanad ke saath bhi aayi hai.] Abdullah kehte hain: 'Al-Idaa'' oonton ke liye hota hai, aur 'Al-Ijaf' ghodon ke liye.

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَسَالِمًا كَلَّمَا ابْنَ عُمَرَ   لَيَالِيَ نَزَلَ الْحَجَّاجُ بِابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْتَلَ، فَقَالَا : لَا يَضُرُّكَ أَنْ لَا تَحُجَّ الْعَامَ، نَخَافُ أَنْ يُحَالَ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ الْبَيْتِ .
 فَقَالَ : " قَدْ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مُعْتَمِرِينَ، فَحَالَ كُفَّارُ قُرَيْشٍ دُونَ الْبَيْتِ ،فَنَحَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ هَدْيَهُ، وَحَلَقَ رَأْسَهُ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَ، فَأُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنِّي قَدْ أَوْجَبْتُ عُمْرَةً، فَإِنْ خُلِّيَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ الْبَيْتِ ، طُفْتُ، وَإِنْ حِيلَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ، فَعَلْتُ كَمَا كَانَ فَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَنَا مَعَهُ، فَأَهَلَّ بِالْعُمْرَةِ مِنْ ذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ ، ثُمَّ سَارَ، فَقَالَ : إِنَّمَا شَأْنُهُمَا وَاحِدٌ، أُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنِّي قَدْ أَوْجَبْتُ حَجًّا مَعَ عُمْرَتِي.
قَالَ نَافِعٌ : فَطَافَ لَهُمَا طَوَافًا وَاحِدًا، وَسَعَى لَهُمَا سَعْيًا وَاحِدًا، ثُمَّ لَمْ يَحِلَّ حَتَّى جَاءَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ فَأَهْدَى، وَكَانَ يَقُولُ : مَنْ جَمَعَ الْعُمْرَةَ وَالْحَجَّ فَأَهَلَّ بِهُمَا جَمِيعًا، فَلَا يَحِلَّ حَتَّى يَحِلَّ مِنْهُمَا جَمِيعًا يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ "
5.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Usamah, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', about Abdullah ibn Abdullah and Salim, and Ibn Umar: That Abdullah ibn Abdullah, and Salim, spoke to Ibn Umar in the nights when al-Hajjaj besieged Ibn al-Zubayr, before he was killed, and they said: "It would not harm you if you did not perform Hajj this year, we fear that a barrier would come between you and the House." So he said: "We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performing Umrah, so the disbelievers of Quraysh barred [us] from the House, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sacrificed his sacrificial animal, and shaved his head, then returned, so I call you to witness that I have made Umrah obligatory [upon myself], for if I am allowed between myself and the House, I will circumambulate, and if a barrier comes between me and it, I will do as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did while I was with him." So he entered ihram for Umrah from Dhu al-Hulayfah, then set out, and said: "Indeed their affair is one, I call you to witness that I have made Hajj obligatory [upon myself] along with my Umrah." Nafi' said: So he circumambulated for both of them with a single circumambulation, and did sa'i for both of them with a single sa'i, then he did not release [from ihram] until the day of Sacrifice came, and he sacrificed, and he used to say: "Whoever combines Umrah and Hajj, and enters ihram for both of them together, does not release [from ihram] until he is released from both of them together on the day of Sacrifice."
5.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Usamah se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se bataya ke Abdullah ibn Abdullah, aur Salim, ne Ibn Umar se un raaton mein baat ki jab al-Hajjaj ne Ibn al-Zubayr ko gher liya tha, unke qatal se pehle, aur unhone kaha: "Aapko koi nuqsaan nahi agar aap is saal Hajj na karein, humein dar hai ke aapke aur Baitullah ke darmiyan rukawat aa jaaye." To unhone kaha: "Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath Umrah karne nikle, to Quraysh ke kaafiron ne humein Baitullah se roka, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne apni qurbani zabah ki, aur apna sar mundwaaya, fir wapas aaye, so main tumhein gawah banaata hoon ke maine Umrah farz kar liya hai, so agar mujhe Baitullah tak pahunchne diya gaya, to main tawaaf karunga, aur agar mere aur uske darmiyan rukawat aa gayi, to main wahi karunga jo Rasulullah ﷺ ne kiya tha jabke main unke saath tha." So unhone Dhu al-Hulayfah se Umrah ka ehraam baandha, fir chal pade, aur kaha: "Un dono ka maamla ek hi hai, main tumhein gawah banaata hoon ke maine apne Umrah ke saath Hajj bhi farz kar liya hai." Nafi' kehte hain: So unhone dono ke liye ek hi tawaaf kiya, aur dono ke liye ek hi sa'ee ki, fir woh tab tak halaal nahi hue jab tak qurbani ka din nahi aa gaya, aur unhone qurbani ki, aur woh kaha karte the: "Jo Umrah aur Hajj jama kare, aur dono ke liye ekathe ehraam baandhe, to woh tab tak halaal nahi hota jab tak qurbani ke din dono se ekathe halaal na ho jaaye."

5.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ الصَّوَّافِ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنْ الْحَجَّاجِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ كُسِرَ، أَوْ عُرِجَ، فَقَدْ حَلَّ، وَعَلَيْهِ حَجَّةٌ أُخْرَى ".
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : رَوَاهُ مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ سَلَّامٍ  ، وَمَعْمَرٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَجَّاجِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
5.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Hajjaj al-Sawwaf, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Ikrimah, from al-Hajjaj ibn Amr al-Ansari, from the Prophet ﷺ; with Abu Muhammad's note on a differing chain: He said: "Whoever breaks a bone, or is lamed, has indeed become released [from ihram], and another Hajj is due upon him." Abu Muhammad said: Mu'awiyah ibn Sallam, and Ma'mar, narrated it, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Ikrimah, from Abdullah ibn Rafi', from al-Hajjaj ibn Amr, from the Prophet ﷺ.
5.hi: Abu Asim ne Hajjaj al-Sawwaf se, Yahya ibn Abi Kathir se, Ikrimah se, al-Hajjaj ibn Amr al-Ansari se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jiski haddi toot jaaye, ya woh langda ho jaaye, woh halaal ho gaya, aur uspar ek aur Hajj wajib hai." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Mu'awiyah ibn Sallam, aur Ma'mar, ne ise Yahya ibn Abi Kathir se, Ikrimah se, Abdullah ibn Rafi' se, al-Hajjaj ibn Amr se, Nabi ﷺ se naql kiya.

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ :" رَمَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْجَمْرَةَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ : الضُّحَى، وَبَعْدَ ذَلِكَ عِنْدَ زَوَالِ الشَّمْسِ "
5.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ threw the Jamrah on the day of Sacrifice in the forenoon, and after that at the decline of the sun."
5.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Ibn Jurayj se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne qurbani ke din chaasht mein Jamrah ko kankariyan maarin, aur uske baad [saal ke doosre dinon mein] suraj dhalne par."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْبَدَّاحِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " أَرْخَصَ لِرِعَاءِ الْإِبِلِ أَنْيَرْمُوا يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ، ثُمَّ يَرْمُوا الْغَدَ وَمِنْ بَعْدِ الْغَدِ لِيَوْمَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يَرْمُوا يَوْمَ النَّفْرِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : مِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ : عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْبَدَّاحِ
5.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Maslamah, from Malik, from Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr, from Abu al-Baddah ibn Asim, from his father; with Abu Muhammad's note: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "gave a concession to the shepherds of camels that they might throw on the day of Sacrifice, then throw the next day and the day after for two days, then throw on the day of departure." Abu Muhammad said: Some of them say: Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr, from his father, from Abu al-Baddah.
5.hi: Abdullah ibn Maslamah ne Malik se, Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr se, Abu al-Baddah ibn Asim se, apne walid se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "oonton ke charwaahon ko rukhsat di ke woh qurbani ke din kankariyan maarein, fir agle din aur uske agle din, do dinon ke liye, maarein, fir waapasi ke din maarein." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Kuch log kehte hain: Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr, apne walid se, Abu al-Baddah se.

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُرَّةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ  ، قَالَ : " أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ أَنْنَرْمِيَ الْجَمْرَةَ بِمِثْلِ حَصَى الْخَذْفِ "
5.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Uthman ibn Murrah, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Uthman al-Taymi: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us on the Farewell Pilgrimage that we throw the Jamrah with pebbles the size of pebbles for flicking."
5.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Uthman ibn Murrah se, Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Uthman al-Taymi se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Hajjat-ul-Wida' mein humein hukum diya ke hum Jamrah ko chutki bhar kankariyon jaisi kankariyon se maarein."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ : " أَمَرَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَفَرَمَوْا بِمِثْلِ حَصَى الْخَذْفِ، وَأَوْضَعَ فِي وَادِي مُحَسِّرٍ ، وَقَالَ : عَلَيْكُمْ السَّكِينَةَ "
5.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Sufyan, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded them and they threw pebbles the size of pebbles for flicking, and he sped up in the valley of Muhassir, and said: 'Tranquility is upon you.'"
5.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Sufyan se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne unhein hukum diya to unhone chutki bhar kankariyon jaisi kankariyan maarin, aur aap Muhassir ki waadi mein tez ho gaye, aur farmaya: 'Sukoon rakho.'"

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَأْمُرُنَا أَنْ" نَرْمِيَ الْجِمَارَ بِمِثْلِ حَصَى الْخَذْفِ ".
قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ : عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ لَهُ صُحْبَةٌ؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ
5.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid, from Humayd al-A'raj, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Mu'adh; with Abu Muhammad's confirmation: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to command us that "we throw the Jamrahs with pebbles the size of pebbles for flicking." It was said to Abu Muhammad: "Does Abd al-Rahman ibn Mu'adh have companionship [with the Prophet]?" He said, "Yes."
5.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid se, Humayd al-A'raj se, Muhammad ibn Ibrahim se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Mu'adh se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ humein hukum diya karte the ke "hum Jamron ko chutki bhar kankariyon jaisi kankariyon se maarein." Abu Muhammad se poocha gaya: "Kya Abd al-Rahman ibn Mu'adh sahabi hain?" Unhone kaha, "Haan."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، وَالْمُؤَمَّلُ  ، وَأَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ أَيْمَنَ بْنِ نَابِلٍ  ، عَنْ قُدَامَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ الْكِلَابِيِّ  ، قَالَ : " رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَيَرْمِي الْجِمَارَ عَلَى نَاقَةٍ صَهْبَاءَ لَيْسَ ثَمَّ ضَرْبٌ، وَلَا طَرْدٌ، وَلَا إِلَيْكَ إِلَيْكَ "
5.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, and al-Mu'ammal, and Abu Nu'aym, from Ayman ibn Nabil, from Qudamah ibn Abdullah ibn Ammar al-Kilabi: He said: "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ throwing the Jamrahs on a reddish-brown she-camel, there was no striking there, nor driving away, nor [shouts of] 'move aside, move aside.'"
5.hi: Abu Asim, aur al-Mu'ammal, aur Abu Nu'aym ne Ayman ibn Nabil se, Qudamah ibn Abdullah ibn Ammar al-Kilabi se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko ek surkh-bhuri oontni par Jamron ko kankariyan maarte dekha, wahan na koi maarna tha, na koi hataana, aur na koi 'hato, hato' kehna."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ هُوَ الْجَزَرِيُّ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنْ الْفَضْلِ  ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ رِدْفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " فَلَمْ يَزَلْيُلَبِّي حَتَّى رَمَى الْجَمْرَةَ "
5.en: Narrated by Zakariya ibn Adi, from Ubaydullah ibn Amr, from Abd al-Karim al-Jazari, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, from al-Fadl: He said: I was riding behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "so he did not cease saying the talbiyah until he threw the Jamrah."
5.hi: Zakariya ibn Adi ne Ubaydullah ibn Amr se, Abd al-Karim al-Jazari se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Mujhe al-Fadl ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Rasulullah ﷺ ke peechhe sawaar tha, "to aap talbiyah kehte rahe yahan tak ke Jamrah ko kankariyan maar din."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" إِذَا رَمَى الْجَمْرَةَ الَّتِي تَلِي الْمَسْجِدَ مَسْجِدَ مِنًى ، يَرْمِيهَا بِسَبْعِ حَصَيَاتٍ يُكَبِّرُ مَعَ كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ، ثُمَّ تَقَدَّمَ أَمَامَهَا فَوَقَفَ مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ رَافِعًا يَدَيْهِ، وَكَانَ يُطِيلُ الْوُقُوفَ، ثُمَّ يَأْتِي الْجَمْرَةَ الثَّانِيَةَ فَيَرْمِيهَا بِسَبْعِ حَصَيَاتٍ يُكَبِّرُ كُلَّمَا رَمَى بِحَصَاةٍ، ثُمَّ يَنْحَدِرُ مِنْ ذَاتِ الْيَسَارِ مِمَّا يَلِي الْوَادِي رَافِعًا يَدَيْهِ يَدْعُو، ثُمَّ يَأْتِي الْجَمْرَةَ الَّتِي عِنْدَ الْعَقَبَةِ، فَيَرْمِيهَا بِسَبْعِ حَصَيَاتٍ، يُكَبِّرُ كُلَّمَا رَمَى بِحَصَاةٍ، ثُمَّ يَنْصَرِفُ وَلَا يَقِفُ عِنْدَهَا ".
قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ : سَمِعْتُ سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  يُحَدِّثُ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَفْعَلُهُ
5.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Yunus, from al-Zuhri, from Salim ibn Abdullah, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to "when he threw the Jamrah that is next to the mosque, the mosque of Mina, throw it with seven pebbles, saying the takbir with every pebble, then he would go forward in front of it and stop facing the Qiblah, raising his hands, and he used to prolong the standing, then he would come to the second Jamrah and throw it with seven pebbles, saying the takbir every time he threw a pebble, then he would descend from the left side, from what is next to the valley, raising his hands, supplicating, then he would come to the Jamrah which is at al-Aqabah, and throw it with seven pebbles, saying the takbir every time he threw a pebble, then he would depart and not stop by it." al-Zuhri said: I heard Salim ibn Abdullah narrating this hadith, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, he said: And Ibn Umar used to do it.
5.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Yunus se, al-Zuhri se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "jab masjid, Mina ki masjid, se qareeb wali Jamrah ko kankariyan maarte, to saat kankariyan maarte, har kankari par takbir kehte, fir uske aage badh kar Qibla ki taraf rukh karke apne haath uthaakar khade hote, aur aap qayam lamba karte, fir doosri Jamrah ke paas aakar usay saat kankariyan maarte, har kankari par takbir kehte, fir baayen taraf se, waadi ke qareeb wali jagah se, utar jaate, apne haath uthaakar dua karte, fir us Jamrah ke paas aate jo Aqabah ke paas hai, aur usay saat kankariyan maarte, har kankari par takbir kehte, fir waapas hote aur wahan nahi rukte." Al-Zuhri kehte hain: Maine Salim ibn Abdullah ko yeh hadith bayaan karte suna, apne walid se, Nabi ﷺ se, unhone bataya: Aur Ibn Umar bhi aisa hi karte the.

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ هُوَ الْمَاجِشُونُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ هُوَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَا نَذْكُرُ إِلَّا الْحَجَّ، فَلَمَّا جِئْنَا سَرِفَ ، طَمِثْتُ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ، طَهُرْتُ، فَأَرْسَلَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَأَفَضْتُ، فَأُتِيَ بِلَحْمِ بَقَرٍ، فَقُلْتُ : مَا هَذَا؟ قَالُوا :" أَهْدَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ نِسَائِهِ الْبَقَرَةَ "
5.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Abd al-Aziz al-Majishun, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from al-Qasim, from Aisha: She said: We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ mentioning nothing but Hajj, so when we came to Sarif, I menstruated, so when it was the day of Sacrifice, I became pure, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent me and I did the tawaf al-ifadah, then beef was brought, so I said: "What is this?" They said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has sacrificed the cow on behalf of his wives."
5.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Abd al-Aziz al-Majishun se, Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim se, al-Qasim se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath nikle, Hajj ke siwa kuch aur zikr nahi kar rahe the, so jab hum Sarif pahunche, mujhe haiz aa gaya, so jab qurbani ka din aaya, main paak ho gayi, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhe bheja aur maine tawaaf-e-ifaadah kiya, fir gaay ka gosht laaya gaya, to maine poocha: "Yeh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah ﷺ ne apni biwiyon ki taraf se gaay ki qurbani ki hai."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمَدِينِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : أَخْبَرَتْنِي أُمُّ عُثْمَانَ بِنْتُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ  ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ   قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَيْسَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ حَلْقٌ، إِنَّمَا عَلَى النِّسَاءِ التَّقْصِيرُ "
5.en: Narrated by Ali ibn Abdullah al-Madini, from Hisham ibn Yusuf, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abd al-Hamid ibn Jubayr, from Safiyyah bint Shaybah, from Umm Uthman bint Abi Sufyan, from Ibn Abbas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There is no shaving upon women, only shortening [of the hair] is upon women."
5.hi: Ali ibn Abdullah al-Madini ne Hisham ibn Yusuf se, Ibn Jurayj se bataya: Mujhe Abd al-Hamid ibn Jubayr ne bataya, Safiyyah bint Shaybah se: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Umm Uthman bint Abi Sufyan ne bataya, ke Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Auraton par sar mundwaana nahi hai, sirf baal chhote karna hai."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" رَحِمَ اللَّهُ الْمُحَلِّقِينَ ".
قِيلَ : وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ؟ قَالَ : " رَحِمَ اللَّهُ الْمُحَلِّقِينَ ".
قَالَ فِي الرَّابِعَةِ : " وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ "
5.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet ﷺ: That he said: "Allah has mercy on those who shave." It was said: "And those who shorten?" He said: "Allah has mercy on those who shave." He said, on the fourth time: "And those who shorten."
5.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Allah sar mundwaane walon par reham kare." Poocha gaya: "Aur baal chhote karne walon par?" Aapne farmaya, "Allah sar mundwaane walon par reham kare." Chauthi baar farmaya: "Aur baal chhote karne walon par [bhi]."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ الْمَاجِشُونُ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، قَالَ : رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عِنْدَ الْجَمْرَةِ وَهُوَ يُسْأَلُ، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، نَحَرْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْمِيَ؟ قَالَ :" ارْمِ وَلَا حَرَجَ "
5.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Salamah al-Majishun, from al-Zuhri, from Isa ibn Talhah, from Abdullah ibn Amr: He said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at the Jamrah while he was being asked, so a man said: "O Messenger of Allah, I sacrificed before I threw?" He said: "Throw, and no harm."
5.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Salamah al-Majishun se, al-Zuhri se, Isa ibn Talhah se, Abdullah ibn Amr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko Jamrah ke paas dekha jabke aapse sawaal kiya ja raha tha, to ek aadmi ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, maine kankariyan maarne se pehle qurbani kar li?" Aapne farmaya: "Kankariyan maar lo, koi harj nahi."

5.ar:
قَالَ آخَرُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، حَلَقْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَنْحَرَ؟ قَالَ :" انْحَرْ وَلَا حَرَجَ ".
قَالَ : فَمَا سُئِلَ عَنْ شَيْءٍ قُدِّمَ وَلَا أُخِّرَ إِلَّا قَالَ : " افْعَلْ وَلَا حَرَجَ "
5.en: Continuing the same narration [Abdullah ibn Amr]: Another said: "O Messenger of Allah, I shaved before I sacrificed?" He said: "Sacrifice, and no harm." He said: So he was not asked about anything that had been done first or later except that he said: "Do it, and no harm."
5.hi: Ek aur ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, maine qurbani se pehle sar mundwaa liya?" Aapne farmaya: "Qurbani kar lo, koi harj nahi." Unhone bataya: So us din aap se jis bhi cheez ke aage-peechhe hone ke baare mein poocha gaya, aapne yahi farmaya: "Kar lo, koi harj nahi."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَقَفَ لِلنَّاسِ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ،حَلَقْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَذْبَحَ؟ قَالَ : " لَا حَرَجَ "
5.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Yahya, from Malik ibn Anas, from al-Zuhri, from Isa ibn Talhah, from Abdullah ibn Amr: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood for the people on the Farewell Pilgrimage, so a man said to him: "O Messenger of Allah, I shaved before I sacrificed?" He said: "No harm."
5.hi: Musaddad ne Yahya se, Malik ibn Anas se, al-Zuhri se, Isa ibn Talhah se, Abdullah ibn Amr se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ Hajjat-ul-Wida' mein logon ke liye khade hue, to ek aadmi ne aapse poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, maine qurbani se pehle sar mundwaa liya?" Aapne farmaya: "Koi harj nahi."

5.ar:
قَالَ : لَمْ أَشْعُرْ،ذَبَحْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْمِيَ؟ قَالَ : " لَا حَرَجَ ".
فَلَمْ يُسْأَلْ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنْ شَيْءٍ قُدِّمَ أَوْ أُخِّرَ إِلَّا قَالَ : " لَا حَرَجَ ".
قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : أَنَا أَقُولُ بِهَذَا، وَأَهْلُ الْكُوفَةِ يُشَدِّدُونَ
5.en: Continuing the same narration [Abdullah ibn Amr]; with Abdullah al-Darimi's note: He said: "I did not realize, I slaughtered before I threw?" He said: "No harm." So he was not asked that day about anything done first or later except that he said: "No harm." Abdullah said: I hold to this, and the people of Kufah are strict about it.
5.hi: Usne kaha: "Mujhe khayal nahi raha, maine kankariyan maarne se pehle zabah kar li?" Aapne farmaya: "Koi harj nahi." So us din aapse jis bhi cheez ke aage-peechhe hone ke baare mein poocha gaya, aapne yahi farmaya: "Koi harj nahi." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Main isi ka qaail hoon, aur ahl-e-Kufah is maamle mein sakhti karte hain.

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ نَاجِيَةَ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ   صَاحِبِ هَدْيِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : كَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ بِمَا عَطِبَ مِنْ الْهَدْيِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" كُلُّ بَدَنَةٍ عَطِبَتْ فَانْحَرْهَا، ثُمَّ أَلْقِ نَعْلَهَا فِي دَمِهَا، ثُمَّ خَلِّ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ النَّاسِ فَلْيَأْكُلُوهَا ".
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ نَاجِيَةَ  ، نَحْوَهُ
5.en: Narrated by Abd al-Wahhab ibn Sa'id, from Shu'ayb ibn Ishaq, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Najiyah al-Aslami, keeper of the Messenger of Allah's ﷺ sacrificial animals; a similar chain also via Muhammad ibn Sa'id: He said: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: How should I deal with a sacrificial animal that becomes injured/unable to continue? So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Any camel that becomes unable to continue, then slaughter it, then throw its sandal into its blood, then leave it between it and the people, so let them eat it." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Najiyah, the like of it.]
5.hi: Abd al-Wahhab ibn Sa'id ne Shu'ayb ibn Ishaq se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Najiyah al-Aslami se, jo Rasulullah ﷺ ke qurbani ke jaanwaron ke saathi the, bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ se poocha: Main us qurbani ke jaanwar ka kya karun jo raaste mein chal na sake? To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jo bhi oont chal na sake, use zabah kar do, fir uska nishaan (jooti) uske khoon mein daal do, fir usay logon ke haath chhod do, taake woh use khaayein." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Muhammad ibn Sa'id se, Hafs ibn Ghiyath se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Najiyah se bhi aayi hai.]

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ  ، وَأَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ :" أَهْدَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَرَّةً غَنَمًا "
5.en: Narrated by Ya'la ibn Ubayd, and Abu Nu'aym, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Aisha: She said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ once sent sheep as a sacrificial gift."
5.hi: Ya'la ibn Ubayd aur Abu Nu'aym ne al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se, al-Aswad se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne ek martaba bhedein qurbani ke tor par bheji thin."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا حَسَّانَ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِبَدَنَةٍ فَأَشْعَرَهَا مِنْ صَفْحَةِ سَنَامِهَا الْأَيْمَنِ، ثُمَّ سَلَتَ الدَّمَ عَنْهَا وَقَلَّدَهَا نَعْلَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِرَاحِلَتِهِ، فَلَمَّا قَعَدَ عَلَيْهَا وَاسْتَوَتْ عَلَى الْبَيْدَاءِ، أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ "
5.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from Abu Hassan, from Ibn Abbas: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "prayed Zuhr at Dhu al-Hulayfah, then called for an oont, and marked it from the right side of its hump, then wiped away the blood and hung two sandals on it, then his mount was brought to him, so when he sat on it and it stood erect on al-Bayda, he entered ihram for Hajj."
5.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Qatadah se poocha, to unhone kaha: Maine Abu Hassan ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Ibn Abbas se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "Dhu al-Hulayfah mein Zuhr padhi, fir ek oont mangwaya aur usay uski kohaan ke daaye taraf se nishaan lagaaya, fir uska khoon poonchha aur usay do jootiyan pehnaayi, fir aapki sawaari laayi gayi, so jab aap uspar baithe aur woh al-Bayda mein khadi hui, aapne Hajj ka ehraam baandha."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النَّضْرِ هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، قَالَ : قَتَادَةُ  أَخْبَرَنِي، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا   يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَنَّهُ انْتَهَى إِلَى رَجُلٍ يَسُوقُ بَدَنَتَهُ، قَالَ :" ارْكَبْهَا ".
قَالَ : إِنَّهَا بَدَنَةٌ.
قَالَ : " ارْكَبْهَا ".
قَالَ : إِنَّهَا بَدَنَةٌ، قَالَ : " ارْكَبْهَا وَيْحَكَ ! "
5.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nadr Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from Anas: He said: He said: I heard Anas narrating, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, that he came upon a man driving his sacrificial camel, he said: "Ride it." He said: "It is a sacrificial camel." He said: "Ride it." He said: "It is a sacrificial camel," he said: "Ride it, woe to you!"
5.hi: Abu al-Nadr Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Qatadah ne mujhe bataya, unhone kaha: Maine Anas ko Rasulullah ﷺ se yeh bayaan karte suna, ke aap ek aadmi ke paas pahunche jo apna qurbani ka oont hankta hua le ja raha tha, aapne farmaya: "Isper sawaar ho jao." Usne kaha: "Yeh qurbani ka oont hai." Aapne farmaya: "Isper sawaar ho jao." Usne kaha: "Yeh qurbani ka oont hai," aapne farmaya: "Tumpar afsos! Isper sawaar ho jao."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ،  عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنَّهُ رَأَى رَجُلًا قَدْ أَنَاخَ بَدَنَةً، فَقَالَ :" ابْعَثْهَا قِيَامًا مُقَيَّدَةً، سُنَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "
5.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Yunus ibn Ubayd, from Ziyad ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Umar: That he saw a man who had made a sacrificial camel kneel, so he said: "Send it up standing, hobbled, [as] the sunnah of Muhammad ﷺ."
5.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Yunus ibn Ubayd se, Ziyad ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke unhone ek aadmi ko apna qurbani ka oont bithaate dekha, to unhone kaha: "Isay khada aur bandha hua uthaao, yeh Muhammad ﷺ ki sunnat hai."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، قَالَ : قَرَأْتُ عَلَى أَبِي قُرَّةَ : هُوَ مُوسَى بْنُ طَارِقٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حِينَ رَجَعَ مِنْ عُمْرَةِ الْجِعْرَانَةِ ، بَعَثَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ عَلَى الْحَجِّ، فَأَقْبَلْنَا مَعَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا بِالْعَرْجِ ثُوِّبَ بِالصُّبْحِ، فَلَمَّا اسْتَوَى لِيُكَبِّرَ، سَمِعَ الرَّغْوَةَ خَلْفَ ظَهْرِهِ، فَوَقَفَ عَنْ التَّكْبِيرِ، فَقَالَ : هَذِهِ رَغْوَةُ نَاقَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْجَدْعَاءِ، لَقَدْ بَدَا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي الْحَجِّ، فَلَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يَكُونَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَنُصَلِّيَ مَعَهُ، فَإِذَا عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهَا، فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ : أَمِيرٌ أَمْ رَسُولٌ؟ قَالَ : لَا، بَلْ رَسُولٌ،" أَرْسَلَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِبَرَاءَةٌ أَقْرَؤُهَا عَلَى النَّاسِ فِي مَوَاقِفِ الْحَجِّ ".
فَقَدِمْنَا مَكَّةَ ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ قَبْلَ التَّرْوِيَةِ بِيَوْمٍ، قَامَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَخَطَبَ النَّاسَ، فَحَدَّثَهُمْ عَنْ مَنَاسِكِهِمْ حَتَّى إِذَا فَرَغَ، قَامَ عَلِيٌّ فَقَرَأَ عَلَى النَّاسِ بَرَاءَةٌ حَتَّى خَتَمَهَا.
ثُمَّ خَرَجْنَا مَعَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ عَرَفَةَ ، قَامَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَخَطَبَ النَّاسَ، فَحَدَّثَهُمْ عَنْ مَنَاسِكِهِمْ، حَتَّى إِذَا فَرَغَ، قَامَ عَلِيٌّ فَقَرَأَ عَلَى النَّاسِ بَرَاءَةٌ حَتَّى خَتَمَهَا.
ثُمَّ كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ فَأَفَضْنَا، فَلَمَّا رَجَعَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ خَطَبَ النَّاسَ، فَحَدَّثَهُمْ عَنْ إِفَاضَتِهِمْ، وَعَنْ نَحْرِهِمْ، وَعَنْ مَنَاسِكِهِمْ، فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ، قَامَ عَلِيٌّ فَقَرَأَ عَلَى النَّاسِ بَرَاءَةٌ حَتَّى خَتَمَهَا، فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّفْرِ الْأَوَّلُ، قَامَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَخَطَبَ النَّاسَ، فَحَدَّثَهُمْ كَيْفَ يَنْفِرُونَ، وَكَيْفَ يَرْمُونَ، فَعَلَّمَهُمْ مَنَاسِكَهُمْ، فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ، قَامَ عَلِيٌّ فَقَرَأَ بَرَاءَةٌ عَلَى النَّاسِ حَتَّى خَتَمَهَا
5.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Qurrah (Musa ibn Tariq), from Ibn Jurayj, from Abdullah ibn Uthman ibn Khuthaym, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ibn Abdullah: That the Prophet ﷺ, when he returned from the Umrah of al-Ji'ranah, sent Abu Bakr in charge of the Hajj, so we came forward with him until when we were at al-Arj, the second call for Subh was made, so when he stood straight to say the takbir, he heard the sound of a she-camel's braying behind him, so he stopped from the takbir, and said: This is the braying of the she-camel of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, al-Jad'a, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has decided something about the Hajj, and perhaps the Messenger of Allah ﷺ will [arrive] so we may pray with him, so behold, Ali was upon it, so Abu Bakr said: An emir or a messenger? He said, "No, rather a messenger, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has sent me with Bara'ah [Surah al-Tawbah] to recite it to the people at the stopping-places of Hajj." So we arrived at Makkah, and when it was a day before Tarwiyah, Abu Bakr stood and gave a sermon to the people, and told them about their rites, until when he finished, Ali stood and recited Bara'ah to the people until he completed it. Then we went out with him until when it was the day of Arafah, Abu Bakr stood and gave a sermon to the people, and told them about their rites, until when he finished, Ali stood and recited Bara'ah to the people until he completed it. Then it was the day of Sacrifice, and we did the ifadah, so when Abu Bakr returned, he gave a sermon to the people, and told them about their ifadah, and their sacrifice, and their rites, so when he finished, Ali stood and recited Bara'ah to the people until he completed it, so when it was the first day of departure, Abu Bakr stood and gave a sermon to the people, and told them how to depart, and how to throw, and taught them their rites, so when he finished, Ali stood and recited Bara'ah to the people until he completed it.
5.hi: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ne bataya: Maine Abu Qurrah (Musa ibn Tariq) ke saamne padha: Ibn Jurayj se: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Abdullah ibn Uthman ibn Khuthaym ne bataya, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir ibn Abdullah se: ke Nabi ﷺ ne, jab al-Ji'ranah ke Umrah se wapas aaye, Abu Bakr ko Hajj ke liye ameer bana kar bheja, so hum unke saath aage badhe, yahan tak ke jab hum al-Arj mein the, Subh ki doosri azaan di gayi, so jab woh takbir kehne ke liye seedhe khade hue, unhone apne peechhe oontni ki aawaaz suni, so unhone takbir se ruk gaye, aur kaha: Yeh Rasulullah ﷺ ki oontni al-Jad'a ki aawaaz hai, Rasulullah ﷺ ne Hajj ke baare mein kuch faisla kiya hai, aur shayad Rasulullah ﷺ [aayein] taake hum unke saath namaz padhein, to dekha to Ali (Alayhis Salam) uspar sawaar the, to Abu Bakr ne poocha: Ameer hain ya qasid? Unhone kaha, "Nahi, balke qasid hoon, Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhe 'Bara'ah' [Surah At-Tawbah] ke saath bheja hai taake main isay logon ko Hajj ke maqamon par padh kar sunaaun." So hum Makkah pahunche, aur jab Tarwiyah se ek din pehle tha, to Abu Bakr khade hue aur logon ko khutba diya, aur unhein unke manaasik ke baare mein bataaya, yahan tak ke jab faarigh hue, to Ali (Alayhis Salam) khade hue aur logon ko 'Bara'ah' padh kar sunaayi yahan tak ke usay poora kiya. Fir hum unke saath nikle yahan tak ke jab Arafah ka din aaya, Abu Bakr khade hue aur logon ko khutba diya, aur unhein unke manaasik ke baare mein bataaya, yahan tak ke jab faarigh hue, to Ali khade hue aur logon ko 'Bara'ah' padh kar sunaayi yahan tak ke usay poora kiya. Fir qurbani ka din aaya aur humne ifaadah kiya, so jab Abu Bakr wapas aaye, unhone logon ko khutba diya, aur unhein unke ifaadah, aur unki qurbani, aur unke manaasik ke baare mein bataaya, so jab faarigh hue, to Ali khade hue aur logon ko 'Bara'ah' padh kar sunaayi yahan tak ke usay poora kiya, so jab pehla waapasi ka din aaya, Abu Bakr khade hue aur logon ko khutba diya, aur unhein bataaya ke kaise waapas jaayein, aur kaise kankariyan maarein, aur unhein unke manaasik sikhaaye, so jab faarigh hue, to Ali khade hue aur logon ko 'Bara'ah' padh kar sunaayi yahan tak ke usay poora kiya.

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ أَشْهَلُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : لَمَّا كَانَ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمُ، قَعَدَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ لَا أَدْرِي جَمَلٌ أَوْ نَاقَةٌ، وَأَخَذَ إِنْسَانٌ بِخِطَامِهِ أَوْ قَالَ : بِزِمَامِهِ ، فَقَالَ : " أَيُّ يَوْمٍ هَذَا؟ " قَالَ : فَسَكَتْنَا حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ سَيُسَمِّيهِ سِوَى اسْمِهِ، فَقَالَ : " أَلَيْسَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ؟ " قُلْنَا : بَلَى.
قَالَ : " فَأَيُّ شَهْرٍ هَذَا؟ " قَالَ : فَسَكَتْنَا حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ سَيُسَمِّيهِ سِوَى اسْمِهِ، فَقَالَ : " أَلَيْسَ ذُو الْحِجَّةِ؟ ".
قُلْنَا : بَلَى.
قَالَ : " فَأَيُّ بَلَدٍ هَذَا؟ ".
قَالَ : فَسَكَتْنَا حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ سَيُسَمِّيهِ سِوَى اسْمِهِ، فَقَالَ : " أَلَيْسَ الْبَلْدَةَ؟ ".
قُلْنَا : بَلَى.
قَالَ : " فَإِنَّدِمَاءَكُمْ وَأَمْوَالَكُمْ وَأَعْرَاضَكُمْ بَيْنَكُمْ حَرَامٌ كَحُرْمَةِ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا، فِي شَهْرِكُمْ هَذَا، فِي بَلَدِكُمْ هَذَا، أَلَا لِيُبَلِّغْ الشَّاهِدُ الْغَائِبَ، فَإِنَّ الشَّاهِدَ عَسَى أَنْ يُبَلِّغَ مَنْ هُوَ أَوْعَى مِنْهُ "
5.en: Narrated by Abu Hatim Ashhal ibn Hatim, from Ibn Awn, from Muhammad, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakrah, from his father: He said: When it was that day, the Prophet ﷺ sat on a camel - I do not know if it was a male or a female - and a man took its halter, or he said: its rein, so he said: "What day is this?" He said: So we remained silent until we thought he would name it other than its [known] name, so he said: "Is it not the day of Sacrifice?" We said, "Yes." He said: "Then what month is this?" He said: So we remained silent until we thought he would name it other than its name, so he said: "Is it not Dhu al-Hijjah?" We said, "Yes." He said: "Then what land is this?" He said: So we remained silent until we thought he would name it other than its name, so he said: "Is it not the [Sacred] Land?" We said, "Yes." He said: "Then indeed your blood and your wealth and your honor are sacred among you as the sanctity of this day of yours, in this month of yours, in this land of yours. Behold, let the one present convey to the one absent, for indeed the one present may convey to one more retentive than himself."
5.hi: Abu Hatim Ashhal ibn Hatim ne Ibn Awn se, Muhammad se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakrah se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Jab woh din tha, Nabi ﷺ ek oont par baithe - mujhe nahi maloom nar tha ya maada - aur ek shakhs ne uski nakel, ya kaha: uski lagaam, pakdi, to aapne poocha: "Yeh kaunsa din hai?" Unhone bataya: To hum khamosh rahe yahan tak ke humein laga ke aap iska naam iske [maloom] naam ke siwa kuch aur lenge, to aapne farmaya: "Kya yeh qurbani ka din nahi?" Humne kaha, "Kyun nahi." Aapne poocha: "To yeh kaunsa mahina hai?" Unhone bataya: To hum khamosh rahe yahan tak ke humein laga ke aap iska naam iske naam ke siwa kuch aur lenge, to aapne farmaya: "Kya yeh Zi'l-Hijjah nahi?" Humne kaha, "Kyun nahi." Aapne poocha: "To yeh kaunsa shehar hai?" Unhone bataya: To hum khamosh rahe yahan tak ke humein laga ke aap iska naam iske naam ke siwa kuch aur lenge, to aapne farmaya: "Kya yeh woh shehar nahi [Makkah]?" Humne kaha, "Kyun nahi." Aapne farmaya: "To tumhara khoon aur tumhara maal aur tumhari izzat tumhare darmiyan aise haraam hai jaise is tumhare din ki, is tumhare mahine mein, is tumhare shehar mein hurmat hai. Sun lo, jo haazir hai woh ghaayab tak yeh baat pahunchaaye, kyunki ho sakta hai ke haazir kisi aise tak pahunchaaye jo usse zyada yaad rakhne wala ho."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : حَاضَتْ صَفِيَّةُ ، فَلَمَّا كَانَتْ لَيْلَةُ النَّفْرِ، قَالَتْ : أَيْ حَلْقَى، أَيْ عَقْرَى ! بِلُغَةٍ لَهُنَّ.
فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَلَسْتِ قَدْ طُفْتِ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ؟ " قَالَتْ : بَلَى.
قَالَ : " فَارْكَبِي ".
حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، بِنَحْوِهِ
5.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Aisha; a similar chain also via Sahl ibn Hammad: She said: Safiyyah menstruated, so when it was the night of departure, she said: "Ay halqa, ay 'aqra!" [an expression of frustration, in their dialect]. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Have you not circumambulated on the day of Sacrifice?" She said, "Yes." He said: "Then ride out." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Aisha, the like of it.]
5.hi: Ya'la ne al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se, al-Aswad se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Safiyyah ko haiz aa gaya, to jab waapasi ki raat aayi, unhone kaha: "Ay halqa, ay 'aqra!" apni zubaan mein [ek jazbaati ibaarat]. To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Kya tumne qurbani ke din tawaaf nahi kiya tha?" Unhone kaha, "Kyun nahi." Aapne farmaya: "To chal padho." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Sahl ibn Hammad se, Shu'bah se, al-Hakam se, Ibrahim se, al-Aswad se, Aisha se bhi aayi hai.]

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْبَزَّازُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ يُثَيْعٍ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْنَا عَلِيًّا   : بِأَيِّ شَيْءٍ بُعِثْتَ؟.
قَالَ : " بُعِثْتُ بِأَرْبَعٍ :لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ إِلَّا نَفْسٌ مُؤْمِنَةٌ، وَلَا يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ عُرْيَانٌ، وَلَا يَجْتَمِعُ مُسْلِمٌ وَكَافِرٌ فِي الْحَجِّ بَعْدَ عَامِهِمْ هَذَا، وَمَنْ كَانَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَهْدٌ، فَعَهْدُهُ إِلَى مُدَّتِهِ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ عَهْدٌ، فَهِيَ أَرْبَعَةُ أَشْهُرٍ.
يَقُولُ بَعْدَ يَوْمِ النَّحْرِ أَجَلُهُمْ عِشْرِينَ مِنْ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ، فَاقْتُلُوهُمْ بَعْدَ الْأَرْبَعَةِ "
5.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Bazzaz, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Abu Ishaq, from Zayd ibn Yuthay', about Ali: He said: We asked Ali: "With what were you sent [to announce]?" He said: "I was sent with four things: No one enters Paradise except a believing soul, and no naked person circumambulates the House, and no Muslim and disbeliever shall gather in the Hajj after this year of theirs, and whoever has a treaty between him and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, his treaty is until its term, and whoever has no treaty, then it is four months, saying, after the day of Sacrifice, their term ends on the twentieth of Dhu al-Hijjah, so kill them after the four [months]."
5.hi: Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Bazzaz ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se, Abu Ishaq se, Zayd ibn Yuthay' se bataya: Unhone kaha, Humne Ali (Alayhis Salam) se poocha: "Aap kis cheez ke saath bheje gaye the?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe chaar cheezon ke saath bheja gaya: Jannat mein sirf momin rooh dakhil hogi, aur koi barhna Baitullah ka tawaaf nahi karega, aur is saal ke baad koi Musalman aur kaafir Hajj mein ekathe nahi honge, aur jiska Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath koi ahad ho, uska ahad uski muddat tak hai, aur jiska koi ahad na ho, to woh chaar mahine hai," kehte hue, qurbani ke din ke baad, unka muahida bees Zi'l-Hijjah ko khatam hoga, so unhein chaar [mahinon] ke baad qatal karo.

5.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ الْحَنَفِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو قَزَعَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ مُهَاجِرًا  يَقُولُ : سُئِلَ جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   عَنْ رَفْعِ الْأَيْدِي عِنْدَ الْبَيْتِ ، فَقَالَ : " إِنَّمَا كَانَ يَصْنَعُ ذَلِكَ الْيَهُودُ،حَجَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَفَصَنَعْنَا ذَلِكَ؟ "
5.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid al-Hanafi, from Shu'bah, from Abu Qaza'ah, from Muhajir, about Jabir ibn Abdullah: He said: I heard Muhajir say: Jabir ibn Abdullah was asked about raising the hands near the House, so he said: "The Jews only used to do that, we performed Hajj with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, did we do that?"
5.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid al-Hanafi ne Shu'bah se bataya: Mujhe Abu Qaza'ah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Muhajir ko kehte suna: Jabir ibn Abdullah se Baitullah ke paas haath uthaane ke baare mein poocha gaya, to unhone kaha: "Yeh sirf Yahoodi karte the, humne Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath Hajj kiya, kya humne aisa kiya?"

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، وَحَجَّاجٌ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُدْرِكٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا زُرْعَةَ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ : " اسْتَنْصَتَ النَّاسَ "، فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ :" لَا تَرْجِعُوا بَعْدِي كُفَّارًا يَضْرِبُ بَعْضُكُمْ رِقَابَ بَعْضٍ "
5.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, and Hajjaj, from Shu'bah, from Ali ibn Mudrik, from Abu Zur'ah, from Jarir ibn Abdullah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Ask the people to be silent," on the Farewell Pilgrimage, then said: "Do not return after me as disbelievers, striking each other's necks."
5.hi: Abu al-Walid aur Hajjaj ne Shu'bah se bataya: Mujhe Ali ibn Mudrik ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Zur'ah ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Jarir ibn Abdullah se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Logon ko khamosh karo," Hajjat-ul-Wida' mein, fir farmaya: "Mere baad kaafir na ban jaana ke ek-doosre ki gardanein maaro."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ  ، قَالَ : وَسَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى   يَقُولُ :" سَعَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ ، وَنَحْنُ نَسْتُرُهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ أَنْ يُصِيبَهُ أَحَدٌ بِحَجَرٍ أَوْ بِرَمْيَةٍ "
5.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid, from Ibn Abi Awfa: He said: And I heard Ibn Abi Awfa say: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did sa'i between al-Safa and al-Marwah, and we shielded him from the people of Makkah lest anyone strike him with a stone or a throw."
5.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Aur maine Ibn Abi Awfa ko kehte suna: "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Safa aur Marwah ke darmiyan sa'ee ki, aur hum aapko Makkah walon se bachaate the taake koi aapko pathar ya kisi cheez se na maare."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ  ، عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ  ، أَنَّهُ شَهِدَ عَلِيًّا وَعُثْمَانَ بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ ، وَعُثْمَانُ يَنْهَى عَنْ الْمُتْعَةِ، فَلَمَّا رَأَى ذَلِكَ عَلِيٌّ  ،" أَهَلَّ بِهِمَا جَمِيعًا، فَقَالَ : لَبَّيْكَ بِحَجَّةٍ وَعُمْرَةٍ مَعًا ".
فَقَالَ : تَرَانِي أَنْهَى عَنْهُ وَتَفْعَلُهُ؟ فَقَالَ : لَمْ أَكُنْ لِأَدَعَ سُنَّةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِقَوْلِ أَحَدٍ مِنْ النَّاسِ
5.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, from Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Marwan ibn al-Hakam, about Ali and Uthman: That he witnessed Ali and Uthman between Makkah and Madinah, and Uthman was forbidding mut'ah, so when Ali saw that, "he entered ihram for both together, and said: 'Labbayk with Hajj and Umrah together.'" So he said: You see me forbidding it and you do it? So he said: I would not leave the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for the saying of anyone among the people.
5.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se, al-Hakam se, Ali ibn al-Husayn se, Marwan ibn al-Hakam se bataya ke unhone Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Uthman ko Makkah aur Madinah ke darmiyan dekha, aur Uthman mut'ah se mana kar rahe the, to jab Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne yeh dekha, "unhone dono ka ehraam ekathe baandh liya, aur kaha: 'Labbayk Hajj aur Umrah dono ke saath.'" To unhone (Uthman ne) kaha: Tum dekhte ho ke main isse mana kar raha hoon aur tum ise karte ho? To unhone kaha: Main Rasulullah ﷺ ki sunnat ko kisi ki bhi baat ke liye nahi chhodunga.

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" لَبَّيْكَ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَحَجٍّ "
5.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Humayd, from Anas: That he heard the Prophet ﷺ, say: "Labbayk with Umrah and Hajj."
5.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Humayd se, Anas se bataya ke unhone Nabi ﷺ ko farmaate suna: "Labbayk Umrah aur Hajj ke saath."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ الشَّهِيدِ  ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" أَهَلَّ بِهِمَا جَمِيعًا "، فَلَقِيتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ   فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ بِقَوْلِ أَنَسٍ، فَقَالَ : إِنَّمَا أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ، فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَى أَنَسٍ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ بِقَوْلِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، فَقَالَ : مَا يَعُدُّونَا إِلَّا صِبْيَانًا
5.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Habib ibn al-Shahid, from Bakr ibn Abdullah, from Anas; with Ibn Umar's differing note: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "entered ihram for both together," so I met Ibn Umar and informed him of Anas's saying, so he said: He only entered ihram for Hajj, so I returned to Anas and informed him of Ibn Umar's saying, so he said: They only count us as children.
5.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Habib ibn al-Shahid se, Bakr ibn Abdullah se, Anas se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "dono ka ehraam ekathe baandha," to main Ibn Umar se mila aur unhein Anas ki baat batayi, to unhone kaha: Aapne sirf Hajj ka ehraam baandha tha, so main Anas ke paas wapas gaya aur unhein Ibn Umar ki baat batayi, to unhone kaha: Woh humein bacche hi samajhte hain.

5.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بَابَاهُ  ، عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : " يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ مَنَافٍ،إِنْ وَلِيتُمْ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ، فَلَا تَمْنَعُوا أَحَدًا طَافَ أَوْ صَلَّى أَيَّ سَاعَةٍ شَاءَ مِنْ لَيْلٍ أَوْ نَهَارٍ "
5.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Abdullah ibn Babayh, from Jubayr ibn Mut'im: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "O Banu Abd Manaf, if you are given charge of this affair, do not prevent anyone who circumambulates or prays at whatever hour he wishes, of night or day."
5.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Abdullah ibn Babayh se, Jubayr ibn Mut'im se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Ae Banu Abd Manaf, agar tumhein is maamle ka ikhtiyaar mil jaaye, to kisi ko bhi jo tawaaf ya namaz karna chahe, raat ya din ke kisi bhi waqt, na roko."

5.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" بَاتَ بِذِي طُوًى حَتَّى أَصْبَحَ، ثُمَّ دَخَلَ مَكَّةَ "، وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَفْعَلُهُ
5.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "spent the night at Dhu Tuwa until morning, then entered Makkah," and Ibn Umar used to do it.
5.hi: Musaddad ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "Dhu Tuwa mein raat guzari subah tak, fir Makkah mein dakhil hue," aur Ibn Umar bhi aisa hi karte the.

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " كَانَيَدْخُلُ مَكَّةَ مِنْ الثَّنِيَّةِ الْعُلْيَا ، وَيَخْرُجُ مِنْ الثَّنِيَّةِ السُّفْلَى "
5.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Uqbah ibn Khalid, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "used to enter Makkah from the upper pass, and leave from the lower pass."
5.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Uqbah ibn Khalid se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ "Makkah mein upar wale raaste se dakhil hote, aur neeche wale raaste se nikalte."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " إِذَا أَدْخَلَ رِجْلَهُ فِي الْغَرْزِ وَاسْتَوَتْ بِهِ نَاقَتُهُ،أَهَلَّ مِنْ مَسْجِدِ ذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ "
5.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Uqbah ibn Khalid, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ "when he put his foot in the stirrup and his she-camel stood erect with him, entered ihram from the mosque of Dhu al-Hulayfah."
5.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Uqbah ibn Khalid se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ "jab apna paaon rikaab mein daalte aur aapki oontni aapko lekar seedhi khadi ho jaati, to aap Dhu al-Hulayfah ki masjid se ehraam baandhte."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ  ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ نُبَيْهِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ فِي الْمُحْرِمِ إِذَا اشْتَكَى عَيْنَيْهِ :" يَضْمِدُهَا بِالصَّبِرِ "
5.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Shaybah, and Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf, from Sufyan, from Ayyub ibn Musa, from Nubayh ibn Wahb, from Aban ibn Uthman, from his father: That the Prophet ﷺ said, concerning the muhrim when his eyes ache: "He treats them with aloe."
5.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Shaybah aur Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf ne Sufyan se, Ayyub ibn Musa se, Nubayh ibn Wahb se, Aban ibn Uthman se, apne walid se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne us muhrim ke baare mein farmaya jiski aankhon mein dard ho: "Woh unpar sabar (ek karvi jadi) ka lep lagaaye."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ  ، يَقُولُ : " قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَفَطَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ وَصَلَّى عِنْدَ الْمَقَامِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ إِلَى الصَّفَا ".
قَالَ شُعْبَةُ  : فَحَدَّثَنِي أَيُّوبُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : هِيَ السُّنَّةُ
5.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Ibn Umar; with Shu'bah's addition from Ayyub: He said: "The Prophet ﷺ arrived, and circumambulated the House and prayed at the Station two rak'ahs, then went out to al-Safa." Shu'bah said: Then Ayyub narrated to me, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Ibn Umar, he said: It is the sunnah.
5.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se, Amr ibn Dinar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibn Umar ko kehte suna: "Nabi ﷺ pahunche to Baitullah ka tawaaf kiya aur Maqam ke paas do rakat padhi, fir Safa ki taraf nikle." Shu'bah kehte hain: Fir mujhse Ayyub ne bataya, Amr ibn Dinar se, Ibn Umar se, unhone kaha: Yeh sunnat hai.

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الْأَحْوَلِ  ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ  ،  عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ النَّاسُ يَنْصَرِفُونَ فِي كُلِّ وَجْهٍ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا يَنْفِرَنَّ أَحَدٌ حَتَّى يَكُونَ آخِرُ عَهْدِهِ بِالْبَيْتِ "
5.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Ibn Uyaynah, from Sulayman al-Ahwal, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas: He said: The people used to leave in every direction, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Let none of you leave until his last engagement is with the House."
5.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Ibn Uyaynah se, Sulayman al-Ahwal se, Tawus se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Log har taraf chale jaate the, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Koi bhi tab tak na jaaye jab tak uski aakhri mulaqaat Baitullah se na ho."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَاوُسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ :" رُخِّصَ لِلْحَائِضِ أَنْ تَنْفِرَ إِذَا أَفَاضَتْ ".
قَالَ : وَسَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ   عَامَ أَوَّلَ : أَنَّهَا لَا تَنْفِرُ، ثُمَّ سَمِعْتُهُ، يَقُولُ : تَنْفِرُ، إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَخَّصَ لَهُنَّ
5.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Wuhayb, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, from Ibn Abbas; with note about Ibn Umar's change of view: He said: "A concession was given to the menstruating woman that she may depart after doing the ifadah." He said: And I heard Ibn Umar, the first year, saying: that she does not depart, then I heard him say: she departs, indeed the Prophet ﷺ gave the women a concession.
5.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Wuhayb se, Ibn Tawus se, apne walid se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Haiz wali aurat ko yeh rukhsat di gayi ke woh ifaadah karne ke baad rawaana ho sakti hai." Unhone bataya: Aur maine Ibn Umar ko pehle saal yeh kehte suna: ke woh na jaaye, fir maine unhein kehte suna: woh jaaye, kyunki Nabi ﷺ ne auraton ko rukhsat di thi.

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، يَقُولُ : حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي طَاوُسٌ الْيَمَانِيُّ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ  وَهُوَ يُسْأَلُ عَنْ حَبْسِ النِّسَاءِ عَنْ الطَّوَافِ بِالْبَيْتِ إِذَا حِضْنَ قَبْلَ النَّفْرِ، وَقَدْ أَفَضْنَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ، فَقَالَ : " إِنَّ عَائِشَةَ   كَانَتْتَذْكُرُ رُخْصَةً لِلنِّسَاءِ ".
وَذَلِكَ قَبْلَ مَوْتِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بِعَامٍ
5.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, from Tawus al-Yamani, about Abdullah ibn Umar: That he heard Abdullah ibn Umar being asked about detaining women from circumambulating the House if they menstruate before departure, having already done the ifadah on the day of Sacrifice, so he said: "Aisha used to mention a concession for women." And that was a year before the death of Abdullah ibn Umar.
5.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se, Uqayl se, Ibn Shihab se bataya: Mujhe Tawus al-Yamani ne bataya, ke unhone Abdullah ibn Umar se poocha jaate hue suna ke agar auraton ko rawaangi se pehle haiz aa jaaye jabke woh qurbani ke din ifaadah kar chuki hon, to unhein Baitullah ke tawaaf se rokna kaisa hai, to unhone kaha: "Aisha auraton ke liye ek rukhsat ka zikr kiya karti thin." Aur yeh Abdullah ibn Umar ki maut se ek saal pehle ki baat hai.

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِعَائِشَةَ   : يَا أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، إِنَّ رِجَالًا يَبْعَثُ أَحَدُهُمْ بِالْهَدْيِ مَعَ الرَّجُلِ، فَيَقُولُ : إِذَا بَلَغْتَ مَكَانَ كَذَا وَكَذَا، فَقَلِّدْهُ، فَإِذَا بَلَغَ ذَلِكَ الْمَكَانَ، لَمْ يَزَلْ مُحْرِمًا حَتَّى يَحِلَّ النَّاسُ.
قَالَ : فَسَمِعْتُ صَفْقَتَهَا بِيَدِهَا مِنْ وَرَاءِ الْحِجَابِ، وَقَالَتْ : " لَقَدْكُنْتُ أَفْتِلُ الْقَلَائِدَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَيَبْعَثُ بِالْهَدْيِ إِلَى الْكَعْبَةِ ، مَا يَحْرُمُ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ مِمَّا يَحِلُّ لِلرَّجُلِ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ النَّاسُ "
5.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid, from Amir, from Masruq, about Aisha: That he said to Aisha: "O Mother of the Believers, some men send a sacrificial animal with another man, and say: 'When you reach such-and-such a place, garland it,' so when he reaches that place, he remains in ihram until the people become halal." He said: So I heard the clap of her hand from behind the curtain, and she said: "I used to twist the garlands for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he would send the sacrificial animal to the Ka'bah, and nothing was forbidden to him of what was lawful for a man from his household, until the people returned."
5.hi: Ya'la ne Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid se, Amir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Masruq ko suna, unhone Aisha se kaha: "Ae Ummul-Mumineen, kuch log apni qurbani kisi doosre aadmi ke saath bhejte hain, aur kehte hain: 'Jab tum fulaan jagah pahuncho, to isay qalaadah pehnaa dena,' to jab woh us jagah pahuncha, to woh tab tak ehraam mein rehta hai jab tak log halaal na ho jaayein." Unhone bataya: To maine parde ke peechhe se unke haath ki taali ki aawaaz suni, aur unhone kaha: "Main Rasulullah ﷺ ke liye qalaade banaya karti thi, aur aap qurbani Ka'bah bhej dete, aur aap par kuch bhi haraam nahi hota jo aadmi ke liye apne ghar mein halaal hota hai, yahan tak ke log wapas aa jaate."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ  ، وَعَمْرَةُ بِنْتُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ   قَالَتْ :" كُنْتُ أَفْتِلُ قَلَائِدَ هَدْيِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَيَبْعَثُ بِهَدْيِهِ مُقَلَّدَةً، وَيُقِيمُ بِالْمَدِينَةِ وَلَا يَجْتَنِبُ شَيْئًا حَتَّى يُنْحَرَ هَدْيُهُ "
5.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah ibn al-Zubayr, and Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman, from Aisha: That Aisha said: "I used to twist the garlands for the sacrificial animal of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he would send his sacrificial animal garlanded, and stay in Madinah and avoid nothing, until his sacrificial animal was sacrificed."
5.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Mujhe Urwah ibn al-Zubayr, aur Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman, ne bataya, ke Aisha ne kaha: "Main Rasulullah ﷺ ke qurbani ke jaanwar ke liye qalaade banaya karti thi, aur aap apni qurbani qalaade pehnaa kar bhej dete, aur Madinah mein rehte aur kisi cheez se parhez nahi karte, yahan tak ke aapki qurbani zabah kar di jaati."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُهَاجِرٍ  ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مَاهَكَ  ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ مُسَيْكَةَ  وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهَا خَيْرًا ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : قُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ،أَلَا نَبْنِي لَكَ بِمِنًى بِنَاءً يُظِلُّكَ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " لَا، مِنًى مُنَاخُ مَنْ سَبَقَ "
5.en: Narrated by Ishaq, from Waki', from Isra'il, from Ibrahim ibn Muhajir, from Yusuf ibn Mahak, from his mother Musaykah, praising her well, from Aisha: She said: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, shall we not build a shelter for you at Mina that would shade you?" So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "No, Mina is a resting-place for whoever gets there first."
5.hi: Ishaq ne Waki' se, Isra'il se, Ibrahim ibn Muhajir se, Yusuf ibn Mahak se, apni maa Musaykah se (jinki unhone achhi tareef ki) bataya, Aisha se: Unhone kaha, Maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, kya hum aapke liye Mina mein ek chhat na banaa dein jo aapko saaya de?" To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Nahi, Mina to jo pehle pahunche uski aaraam-gaah hai."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ دَخَلَ مَكَّةَ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ وَعَلَى رَأْسِهِ مِغْفَرٌ، فَلَمَّا نَزَعَهُ جَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ،هَذَا ابْنُ خَطَلٍ مُتَعَلِّقٌ بِأَسْتَارِ الْكَعْبَةِ ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " اقْتُلُوهُ ".
قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ خَالِدٍ : وَقُرِئَ عَلَى مَالِكٍ : قَالَ : قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ : وَلَمْ يَكُنْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُحْرِمًا
5.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Khalid, from Malik ibn Anas, from Ibn Shihab, from Anas ibn Malik; with the additional note from Ibn Shihab: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered Makkah in the year of the Conquest with a helmet on his head, so when he took it off, a man came to him, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, this is Ibn Khatal clinging to the coverings of the Ka'bah," so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Kill him." Abdullah ibn Khalid said: And it was read to Malik: he said: Ibn Shihab said: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was not in ihram that day.
5.hi: Abdullah ibn Khalid ne Malik ibn Anas se, Ibn Shihab se, Anas ibn Malik se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ Fateh ke saal Makkah mein dakhil hue jabke aapke sar par khod (helmet) thi, so jab aapne use utaara, to ek aadmi aapke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, yeh Ibn Khatal hai jo Ka'bah ke gilaaf se chimta hua hai," to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Isay qatal karo." Abdullah ibn Khalid kehte hain: Aur Malik ke saamne padha gaya: unhone kaha, Ibn Shihab ne kaha: Aur us din Rasulullah ﷺ ehraam mein nahi the.

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ الدُّهْنِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ :" دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَكَّةَ حِينَ افْتَتَحَهَا وَعَلَيْهِ عِمَامَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ بِغَيْرِ إِحْرَامٍ ".
قَالَ إِسْمَاعِيل : سَمِعَهُ مِنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ.
كَانَ مَعَ أَبِيهِ
5.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Aban, from Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar al-Dhuhni, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir; with Isma'il's note: He said: "The Prophet ﷺ entered Makkah when he conquered it wearing a black turban without ihram." Isma'il said: He heard it from Abu al-Zubayr - he was with his father.
5.hi: Isma'il ibn Aban ne Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar al-Dhuhni se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Nabi ﷺ Makkah mein us waqt dakhil hue jab aapne isay fatah kiya, aap kaali pagdi pehne hue the, bagair ehraam ke." Isma'il kehte hain: Unhone ise Abu al-Zubayr se suna - woh apne walid ke saath the.

5.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ  ، وَعَبْدُ الْكَرِيمِ الْجَزَرِيُّ  ، أَنَّ مُجَاهِدًا  أَخْبَرَهُمَا، أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى  أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّ عَلِيًّا   أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَقُومَ عَلَى بُدْنِهِ، وَأَنْ يَقْسِمَ بُدْنَهُ كُلَّهَا : لُحُومَهَا وَجُلُودَهَا وَجِلَالَهَا، وَلَا يُعْطِيَ فِي جِزَارَتِهَا مِنْهَا شَيْئًا "
5.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Yahya, from Ibn Jurayj, from al-Hasan ibn Muslim and Abd al-Karim al-Jazari, from Mujahid, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla, from Ali: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "commanded him to stand over his sacrificial camels, and to distribute all of his sacrificial camels: their meat, and their hides, and their trappings, and not to give anything from them to the butcher [as payment]."
5.hi: Musaddad ne Yahya se, Ibn Jurayj se bataya: Mujhe al-Hasan ibn Muslim, aur Abd al-Karim al-Jazari, ne bataya, ke Mujahid ne un dono ko bataya, ke Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla ne unhein bataya, ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unhein bataya, ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "unhein hukum diya ke woh apne qurbani ke oonton par khade hon, aur unke tamaam qurbaani ke jaanwaron ko taqseem karein: unka gosht, unki khaal, aur unke poshaak, aur inmein se qassab (zabah karne wale) ko iski majoori mein kuch na dein."

5.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ الضَّبُعِ، فَقَالَ :" هُوَ صَيْدٌ وَفِيهِ كَبْشٌ إِذَا أَصَابَهُ الْمُحْرِمُ "
5.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Jarir ibn Hazim, from Abdullah ibn Ubayd ibn Umayr, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Ammar, from Jabir: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about the hyena, so he said: "It is game, and there is [a fine of] a ram [due] for it if the muhrim strikes it."
5.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Jarir ibn Hazim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abdullah ibn Ubayd ibn Umayr ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Ammar se, Jabir se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ se lakdbaghe ke baare mein poocha gaya, to aapne farmaya: "Yeh shikaar hai, aur agar muhrim ise maare, to ek mendha [zaroori] hai."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ  ، قَالَ :سَأَلْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   عَنْ الضَّبُعِ آكُلُهُ؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ، قُلْتُ : هُوَ صَيْدٌ؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ ".
قُلْتُ : سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ.
قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ : مَا تَقُولُ فِي الضَّبُعِ تَأْكُلُهُ؟ قَالَ : أَنَا أَكْرَهُ أَكْلَهُ
5.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abdullah ibn Ubayd ibn Umayr, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Ammar; with Abu Muhammad's response: He said: I asked Jabir ibn Abdullah: "[Is it lawful for] me to eat the hyena?" He said, "Yes." I said: "Is it game?" He said, "Yes." I said: "Did you hear it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" He said, "Yes." It was said to Abu Muhammad: "What do you say about eating the hyena?" He said: "I dislike eating it."
5.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Abdullah ibn Ubayd ibn Umayr se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Ammar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Jabir ibn Abdullah se poocha: "Kya main lakdbaghe ko khaa sakta hoon?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Maine poocha: "Yeh shikaar hai?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Maine poocha: "Kya aapne yeh Rasulullah ﷺ se suna?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Abu Muhammad se poocha gaya: "Aap lakdbaghe khaane ke baare mein kya kehte hain?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe isay khaana na-pasand hai."

5.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   : أَنَّ الْعَّبَاسَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ اسْتَأْذَنَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَلِيَبِيتَ بِمَكَّةَ لَيَالِيَ مِنًى مِنْ أَجْلِ سِقَايَتِهِ.
فَأَذِنَ لَهُ ".
 حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ يُونُسَ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ  ، نَحْوَهُ
5.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Usamah, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar; a similar chain also via Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah: That al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib sought the Messenger of Allah's ﷺ permission to spend the nights of Mina in Makkah, for the sake of his water-supplying [duty]. "So he permitted him." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah, from Isa ibn Yunus, from Ubaydullah ibn Umar, the like of it.]
5.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Usamah se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib ne Rasulullah ﷺ se Mina ki raatein Makkah mein guzarne ki ijaazat maangi, apni saqaayah (paani pilaane) ki zimmedaari ki wajah se. "To aapne unhein ijaazat de di." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah se, Isa ibn Yunus se, Ubaydullah ibn Umar se bhi aayi hai.]

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ :" ضَحَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِكَبْشَيْنِ أَمْلَحَيْنِ أَقْرَنَيْنِ، وَيُسَمِّي وَيُكَبِّرُ، لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ يَذْبَحُهُمَا بِيَدِهِ وَاضِعًا عَلَى صِفَاحِهِمَا قَدَمَهُ "، قُلْتُ : أَنْتَ سَمِعْتَهُ؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ
6.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from Anas: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sacrificed two horned, black-and-white rams, and pronounced Allah's name and magnified Him, I saw him slaughter them with his own hand, placing his foot on their sides." I said: "Did you hear it yourself?" He said, "Yes."
6.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Qatadah se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne do sing-daar, kaale-safed mendhe zabah kiye, aur Allah ka naam liya aur takbir kahi, maine aapko apne haath se unhein zabah karte dekha, apna paaon unke pehlu par rakhte hue." Maine poocha: "Kya aapne khud suna?" Unhone kaha, "Haan."

6.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : ضَحَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِكَبْشَيْنِ فِي يَوْمِ الْعِيدِ، فَقَالَ حِينَ وَجَّهَهُمَا : " إِنِّيوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنْ الْمُشْرِكِينَ.
إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ.
 اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذَا مِنْكَ وَلَكَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأُمَّتِهِ "، ثُمَّ سَمَّى اللَّهَ وَكَبَّرَ وَذَبَحَ
6.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Abu Ayyash, from Jabir ibn Abdullah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sacrificed two rams on the day of Eid, and said as he directed them: "I have turned my face to the One who created the heavens and the earth, as one inclining toward truth, and I am not of the polytheists. Indeed my prayer, my rites, my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds, no partner has He; and with that I have been commanded, and I am the first of the Muslims. O Allah, indeed this is from You and for You, on behalf of Muhammad and his nation," then he pronounced the name of Allah and magnified Him, and slaughtered.
6.hi: Ahmad ibn Khalid ne Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, Yazid ibn Abi Habib se, Abu Ayyash se, Jabir ibn Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne Eid ke din do mendhe zabah kiye, aur unhein rukh karte waqt farmaya: "Inni wajjahtu wajhiya lilladhi fataras-samawati wal-arda haneefaw-wa maa ana minal-mushrikeen. Inna salaati wa nusuki wa mahyaya wa mamaati lillahi Rabbil-'alameena laa shareeka lah, wa bidhalika umirtu wa ana awwalul-muslimeen. Allahumma inna haadha minka wa laka, 'an Muhammadin wa ummatih," fir Allah ka naam liya aur takbir kahi aur zabah kiya.

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدٌ يَعْنِي : ابْنَ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدٌ يَعْنِي : ابْنَ أَبِي هِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ  ، أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ   أَخْبَرَتْهُ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ، قَالَ :" مَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُضَحِّيَ، فَلَا يُقَلِّمْ أَظْفَارَهُ، وَلَا يَحْلِقْ شَيْئًا مِنْ شَعْرِهِ فِي الْعَشْرِ الْأُوَلِ مِنْ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ "
6.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Khalid ibn Yazid, from Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal, from Amr ibn Muslim, from Ibn al-Musayyab, from Umm Salamah: That she informed him, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he said: "Whoever intends to sacrifice, let him not clip his nails, nor shave any of his hair, in the first ten days of Dhu al-Hijjah."
6.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhse Khalid ibn Yazid ne bataya: Mujhse Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal ne bataya, Amr ibn Muslim se: Mujhe Ibn al-Musayyab ne bataya, ke Umm Salamah ne unhein bataya, Rasulullah ﷺ se, ke aapne farmaya: "Jo qurbani karna chahe, woh apne naakhoon na kaate, aur na apne kisi baal ko mundwaaye, Zi'l-Hijjah ke pehle das dinon mein."

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ،  عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِذَا دَخَلَتْ الْعَشْرُ، وَأَرَادَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يُضَحِّيَ، فَلَا يَمَسَّ مِنْ شَعْرِهِ وَلَا أَظْفَارِهِ شَيْئًا "
6.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Sufyan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Humayd, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Umm Salamah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "When the ten [days] enter, and one of you wants to sacrifice, let him not touch anything of his hair nor his nails."
6.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ne Sufyan se bataya: Mujhse Abd al-Rahman ibn Humayd ne bataya, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se, Umm Salamah se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Jab das [din] aa jaayein, aur tum mein se koi qurbani karna chahe, to woh apne baal ya naakhoon ko kuch bhi na chhue."

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ فَيْرُوزَ  ، عَنْ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ  ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَا يُتَّقَى مِنْ الضَّحَايَا؟ قَالَ :" الْعَوْرَاءُ الْبَيِّنُ عَوَرُهَا، وَالْعَرْجَاءُ الْبَيِّنُ ظَلْعُهَا، وَالْمَرِيضَةُ الْبَيِّنُ مَرَضُهَا، وَالْعَجْفَاءُ الَّتِي لَا تُنْقِي "
6.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Amr ibn al-Harith, from Ubayd ibn Fayruz, from al-Bara' ibn Azib: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked: What should be avoided among sacrificial animals? He said: "The one clearly blind in an eye, and the one clearly lame, and the one clearly sick, and the emaciated one which has no marrow [fat]."
6.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Amr ibn al-Harith se, Ubayd ibn Fayruz se, al-Bara' ibn Azib se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ se poocha gaya: Qurbani ke jaanwaron mein kin cheezon se bachna chahiye? Aapne farmaya: "Woh jiski andhapan saaf zaahir ho, aur woh jiska langdaapan saaf zaahir ho, aur woh jiski bimari saaf zaahir ho, aur woh dubla jaanwar jismein margh (chhupi) tak na ho."

6.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ فَيْرُوزَ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ الْبَرَاءَ   عَمَّا نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنْ الْأَضَاحِيِّ، فَقَالَ :" أَرْبَعٌ لَا يُجْزِئْنَ : الْعَوْرَاءُ الْبَيِّنُ عَوَرُهَا، وَالْعَرْجَاءُ الْبَيِّنُ ظَلْعُهَا، وَالْمَرِيضَةُ الْبَيِّنُ مَرَضُهَا، وَالْكَسِيرُ الَّتِي لَا تُنْقِي ".
قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِلْبَرَاءِ : فَإِنِّي أَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَكُونَ فِي السِّنِّ نَقْصٌ، وَفِي الْأُذُنِ نَقْصٌ، وَفِي الْقَرْنِ نَقْصٌ، قَالَ : فَمَا كَرِهْتَ فَدَعْهُ، وَلَا تُحَرِّمْهُ عَلَى أَحَدٍ
6.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Sulayman ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Ubayd ibn Fayruz, about al-Bara': He said: I asked al-Bara': What did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbid among sacrificial animals? So he said: "Four do not suffice: the one clearly blind in an eye, and the one clearly lame, and the one clearly sick, and the one so broken/thin it has no marrow." He said: I said to al-Bara': "I dislike there being a deficiency in the tooth, and a deficiency in the ear, and a deficiency in the horn." He said: What you dislike, leave it, but do not make it forbidden for anyone.
