6.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Sulayman ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Ubayd ibn Fayruz se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Bara' se poocha jo cheezein Rasulullah ﷺ ne qurbani mein mana ki thin, to unhone kaha: "Chaar cheezein kaafi nahi: woh jiski andhapan saaf zaahir ho, aur woh jiska langdaapan saaf zaahir ho, aur woh jiski bimari saaf zaahir ho, aur woh itni kamzor ke usmein margh na ho." Unhone bataya: Maine al-Bara' se kaha: "Mujhe na-pasand hai ke daant mein kami ho, aur kaan mein kami ho, aur seengh mein kami ho." Unhone kaha: Jo tumhein na-pasand hai use chhod do, lekin kisi par isay haraam mat karo.

6.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ حُجَيَّةَ بْنَ عَدِيٍّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَلِيًّا   وَسَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ : يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، الْبَقَرَةُ؟ قَالَ : عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ، قُلْتُ : الْقَرْنُ؟ قَالَ : لَا يَضُرُّكَ.
قَالَ : قُلْتُ : الْعَرَجُ؟ قَالَ : إِذَا بَلَغَتْ الْمَنْسَكَ.
ثُمَّ قَالَ : " أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْنَسْتَشْرِفَ الْعَيْنَ وَالْأُذُنَ "
6.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Salamah ibn Kuhayl, from Hujayyah ibn Adi, about Ali: He said: I heard Hujayyah ibn Adi say: I heard Ali, and a man asked him, and said: "O Commander of the Believers, the cow?" He said: For seven [people]. I said: "The horn?" He said: It does not harm you. He said: I said: "The limp?" He said: If it reaches the place of sacrifice. Then he said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to inspect closely the eye and the ear."
6.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Salamah ibn Kuhayl ko kehte suna: Maine Hujayyah ibn Adi ko suna, unhone kaha: Maine Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko suna, aur ek aadmi ne unse poocha, aur kaha: "Ae Ameer-ul-Mumineen, gaay?" Unhone kaha: Saat logon ke liye. Maine poocha: "Seengh [ki kami]?" Unhone kaha: Isse tumhein nuqsaan nahi. Unhone bataya: Maine poocha: "Langdaapan?" Unhone kaha: Agar woh manaasik ki jagah tak pahunch jaaye [to theek hai]. Fir unhone kaha: "Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein hukum diya ke hum aankh aur kaan ko achhi tarah dekh lein."

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ شُرَيْحِ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ الصَّائِدِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ : " أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْنَسْتَشْرِفَ الْعَيْنَ وَالْأُذُنَ، وَأَنْ لَا نُضَحِّيَ بِمُقَابَلَةٍ وَلَا مُدَابَرَةٍ وَلَا خَرْقَاءَ، وَلَا شَرْقَاءَ، فَالْمُقَابَلَةُ : مَا قُطِعَ طَرَفُ أُذُنِهَا، وَالْمُدَابَرَةُ : مَا قُطِعَ مِنْ جَانِبِ الْأُذُنِ، وَالْخَرْقَاءُ : الْمَثْقُوبَةُ، وَالشَّرْقَاءُ : الْمَشْقُوقَةُ "
6.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Isra'il, from Abu Ishaq, from Shurayh ibn al-Nu'man al-Sa'idi, from Ali رضي الله عنه: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to inspect closely the eye and the ear, and not to sacrifice with an animal missing part of the front or back of the ear, nor a torn-eared or split-eared one, so al-Muqabalah is: whose ear-tip is cut off, and al-Mudabarah is: what is cut from the side of the ear, and al-Kharqa is: the pierced one, and al-Sharqa is: the split one."
6.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Isra'il se, Abu Ishaq se, Shurayh ibn al-Nu'man al-Sa'idi se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) رضي الله عنه se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein hukum diya ke hum aankh aur kaan ko achhi tarah dekh lein, aur hum aise jaanwar se qurbani na karein jiske kaan ke aage ya peechhe ka hissa kata ho, aur na phati hui ya kati hui kaan wale se, so 'al-Muqabalah' woh hai jiske kaan ka kinaara kata ho, aur 'al-Mudabarah' woh hai jiski kaan ke ek taraf se kata ho, aur 'al-Kharqa' chhedi hui hai, aur 'al-Sharqa' phati hui hai."

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ بَعْجَةَ الْجُهَنِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَسَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ضَحَايَا بَيْنَ أَصْحَابِهِ فَأَصَابَنِي جَذَعٌ، فَقُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّهَاصَارَتْ لِي جَذَعَةً، فَقَالَ : " ضَحِّ بِهِ "
6.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hisham, from Yahya, from Ba'jah al-Juhani, from Uqbah ibn Amir al-Juhani: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ distributed sacrificial animals among his companions, and I received a young [under one year old] one, so I said: "O Messenger of Allah, it has become a jadha'ah for me," so he said: "Sacrifice it."
6.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hisham se, Yahya se, Ba'jah al-Juhani se, Uqbah ibn Amir al-Juhani se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne apne sahaba mein qurbani ke jaanwar taqseem kiye, to mujhe ek jadha' mila, to maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, yeh mere liye jadha'ah ban gaya hai [ek saal ki umar se kam]," to aapne farmaya: "Isi se qurbani kar lo."

6.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ  ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ  ، قَالَ : أَعْطَانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ غَنَمًا أَقْسِمُهَا عَلَى أَصْحَابِهِ،فَقَسَمْتُهَا وَبَقِيَ مِنْهَا عَتُودٌ، فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : " ضَحِّ بِهِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : الْعَتُودُ : الْجَذَعُ مِنْ الْمَعْزِ
6.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from al-Layth, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Abu al-Khayr, from Uqbah ibn Amir; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave me sheep to distribute among his companions, so I distributed them and an 'atud remained, so I mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he said: "Sacrifice it." Abu Muhammad said: al-'Atud is: the young one of the goats.
6.hi: Abu al-Walid ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhse Yazid ibn Abi Habib ne bataya, Abu al-Khayr se, Uqbah ibn Amir se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhe bhedein din taake main unhein aapke sahaba mein taqseem karun, to maine unhein taqseem kiya aur ek 'atud (bakri ka bachcha) bach gaya, to maine yeh baat Rasulullah ﷺ se zikr ki, to aapne farmaya: "Isi se qurbani kar lo." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: 'Al-'Atud' bakri ka jadha' (chhota bachcha) hota hai.

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ : نَحَرْنَا يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ سَبْعِينَ بَدَنَةً، الْبَدَنَةُ عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" اشْتَرِكُوا فِي الْهَدْيِ "
6.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Sufyan, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir: He said: We sacrificed seventy camels on the day of al-Hudaybiyyah, the camel for seven [people], so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Share in the sacrificial animal."
6.hi: Ya'la ne Sufyan se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Humne Hudaybiyyah ke din sattar oont zabah kiye, ek oont saat logon ki taraf se, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Qurbani mein shareek ho jao."

6.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" نَحَرْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْبَقَرَةَ عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ ".
قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ : تَقُولُ بِهِ؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ
6.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ibn Abdullah; with Abu Muhammad's confirmation: He said: "We sacrificed a cow with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on behalf of seven [people]." It was said to Abu Muhammad: "Do you hold to this?" He said, "Yes."
6.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir ibn Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Humne Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath gaay saat logon ki taraf se zabah ki." Abu Muhammad se poocha gaya: "Kya aap isi ke qaail hain?" Unhone kaha, "Haan."

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَهَى عَنْ لُحُومِ الْأَضَاحِيِّ، أَوْ قَالَ :" لَا تَأْكُلُوا لُحُومَ الْأَضَاحِيِّ بَعْدَ ثَلَاثٍ "
6.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade [eating] the meat of sacrificial animals [after three days], or he said: "Do not eat the meat of sacrificial animals after three [days]."
6.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne qurbani ke gosht se mana kiya, ya farmaya: "Qurbani ka gosht teen din ke baad na khaao."

6.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ هُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الطَّحَّانُ  ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمَلِيحِ  ، عَنْ نُبَيْشَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، ، قَالَ : " إِنَّاكُنَّا نَهَيْنَاكُمْ عَنْ لُحُومِ الْأَضَاحِيِّ أَنْ تَأْكُلُوهَا فَوْقَ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ كَيْ تَسَعَكُمْ، فَقَدْ جَاءَ اللَّهُ بِالسَّعَةِ، فَكُلُوا، وَادَّخِرُوا، وَائْتَجِرُوا ".
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : ائْتَجِرُوا : اطْلُبُوا فِيهِ الْأَجْرَ
6.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid ibn Abdullah al-Tahhan, from Khalid al-Hadhdha, from Abu Qilabah, from Abu al-Malih, from Nubayshah, from the Prophet ﷺ; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: "We had forbidden you from [eating] the meat of sacrificial animals beyond three days so that it would be enough for you [to distribute], but Allah has now brought abundance, so eat, and store, and seek reward." Abu Muhammad said: 'i'tajiru' means: seek reward in it.
6.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid ibn Abdullah al-Tahhan se, Khalid al-Hadhdha se, Abu Qilabah se, Abu al-Malih se, Nubayshah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Humne tumhein teen din se zyada qurbani ka gosht khaane se isliye mana kiya tha taake sab ko kaafi ho jaaye, so Allah ne ab wus'at ata ki hai, so khaao, aur zakheera karo, aur sawaab talaash karo." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: 'I'tajiru' ka matlab hai: isme sawaab talaash karo.

6.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَدْ نَهَى عَنْ لُحُومِ الْأَضَاحِيِّ بَعْدَ ثَلَاثٍ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ الْعَامُ الْقَابِلُ وَضَحَّى النَّاسُ، قُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنْ كَانَتْ هَذِهِ الْأَضَاحِيُّ لَتَرْفُقُ بِالنَّاسِ، كَانُوا يَدَّخِرُونَ مِنْ لُحُومِهَا وَوَدَكِهَا.
قَالَ : " فَمَا يَمْنَعُهُمْ مِنْ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمَ؟ " قُلْتُ : يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ، أَوَ لَمْ تَنْهَهُمْ عَامَ أَوَّلَ عَنْ أَنْ يَأْكُلُوا لُحُومَهَا فَوْقَ ثَلَاثٍ؟ فَقَالَ : " إِنَّمَانَهَيْتُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ لِلْحَاضِرَةِ الَّتِي حَضَرَتْهُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَادِيَةِ لِيَبُثُّوا لُحُومَهَا فِيهِمْ، فَأَمَّا الْآنَ، فَلْيَأْكُلُوا وَلْيَدَّخِرُوا "
6.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr, from Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had forbidden [eating] the meat of sacrificial animals beyond three days, so when it was the following year and the people sacrificed, I said: "O Messenger of Allah, these sacrificial animals were indeed a help to the people, they used to store some of their meat and fat." He said: "Then what prevents them from that today?" I said: "O Prophet of Allah, did you not forbid them the previous year from eating their meat beyond three days?" So he said: "I only forbade that for the sake of those who arrived, from among the desert-dwellers, so that they could spread its meat among them, but as for now, let them eat and store."
6.hi: Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Muhammad ibn Ishaq se bataya: Mujhse Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr ne bataya, Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman se, Aisha رضي الله عنها se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne qurbani ka gosht teen din se zyada khaane se mana kiya tha, to jab agla saal aaya aur logon ne qurbani ki, maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, yeh qurbaaniyaan to logon ki madad karti thin, woh unke gosht aur charbi mein se zakheera kar liya karte the." Aapne farmaya: "To aaj unhein isse kya rok raha hai?" Maine poocha: "Ya Nabi Allah, kya aapne pichhle saal unhein iska gosht teen din se zyada khaane se mana nahi kiya tha?" To aapne farmaya: "Maine woh mana sirf un badiya (registaan) walon ke liye kiya tha jo unke paas aaye the, taake woh apna gosht unmein baant sakein, lekin ab, woh khaayein aur zakheera karein."

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ الزَّبِيدِيُّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ثَوْبَانَ   مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَنَحْنُ بِمِنًى :" أَصْلِحْ لَنَا مِنْ هَذَا اللَّحْمِ " فَأَصْلَحْتُ لَهُ مِنْهُ، فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ حَتَّى بَلَغْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ
6.en: Narrated by Marwan ibn Muhammad, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid al-Zubaydi, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Jubayr ibn Nufayr, from his father, from Thawban, freed servant of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: That he heard him say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me while we were at Mina: "Prepare for us some of this meat." So I prepared it for him, and he continued eating from it until we reached Madinah.
6.hi: Marwan ibn Muhammad ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se bataya: Mujhse Muhammad ibn al-Walid al-Zubaydi ne bataya, Abd al-Rahman ibn Jubayr ibn Nufayr se: Mujhse mere walid ne bataya, ke unhone Thawban, Rasulullah ﷺ ke azaad kiye hue ghulam, ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhse farmaya jabke hum Mina mein the: "Humare liye is gosht mein se kuch taiyaar karo." To maine aapke liye taiyaar kiya, aur aap Madinah pahunchne tak isme se khaate rahe.

6.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَطَاءً  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا  ، يَقُولُ : " إِنْكُنَّا لَنَتَزَوَّدُ مِنْ مَكَّةَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ".
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : يَعْنِي : لُحُومَ الْأَضَاحِيِّ
6.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Rabi', from Shu'bah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Ata, from Jabir; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: I heard Ata say: I heard Jabir say: "We used to take provisions from Makkah to Madinah in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." Abu Muhammad said: meaning: the meat of sacrificial animals.
6.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Rabi' ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Amr ibn Dinar ko suna, unhone kaha: Maine Ata ko suna, unhone kaha: Maine Jabir ko kehte suna: "Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke zamane mein Makkah se Madinah tak zaad-e-raah le jaaya karte the." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: yaani, qurbani ka gosht.

6.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، وَزُبَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ  ، أَنَّ أَبَا بُرْدَةَ بْنَ نِيَارٍ ضَحَّى قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ، فَلَمَّا صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، دَعَاهُ فَذَكَرَ لَهُ مَا فَعَلَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " إِنَّمَاشَاتُكَ شَاةُ لَحْمٍ ".
فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، عِنْدِي عَنَاقٌ جَذَعَةٌ مِنْ الْمَعْزِ هِيَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ شَاتَيْنِ.
قَالَ : " فَضَحِّ بِهَا، وَلَا تُجْزِئُ عَنْ أَحَدٍ بَعْدَكَ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : قُرِئَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ : وَمَنْ ذَبَحَ بَعْدَ الصَّلَاةِ وَالْإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ أَجْزَأَهُ
6.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Mansur, and Zubayd, from al-Sha'bi, from al-Bara' ibn Azib, about Abu Burdah ibn Niyar; with Abu Muhammad's added note: That Abu Burdah ibn Niyar sacrificed before he prayed, so when the Prophet ﷺ prayed, he called him and mentioned to him what he had done, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: "Your sheep is only a sheep of meat." So he said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have a young female goat which is more beloved to me than two sheep." He said: "Then sacrifice it, but it will not suffice for anyone after you." Abu Muhammad said: It was read to Muhammad, from Sufyan: whoever slaughters after the prayer while the imam is giving the sermon, it suffices him.
6.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Mansur aur Zubayd se, al-Sha'bi se, al-Bara' ibn Azib se bataya ke Abu Burdah ibn Niyar ne namaz se pehle qurbani kar di, so jab Nabi ﷺ ne namaz padhi, to aapne unhein bulaaya aur unhone bataaya ke unhone kya kiya, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne unse farmaya: "Tumhari bhed to bas gosht ki bhed hai [qurbani nahi hui]." To unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, mere paas ek jawaan bakri hai jo mujhe do bhedon se zyada aziz hai." Aapne farmaya: "To usi se qurbani karo, lekin yeh tumhare baad kisi aur ke liye kaafi nahi hogi." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Muhammad ke saamne Sufyan se padha gaya: aur jo namaz ke baad zabah kare jabke imam khutba de raha ho, to woh kaafi hai.

6.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَلِيٍّ الْحَنَفِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ بْنِ نِيَارٍ  ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا ذَبَحَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَنْصَرِفَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُعِيدَ "
6.en: Narrated by Abu Ali al-Hanafi, from Malik, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Bushayr ibn Yasar, from Abu Burdah ibn Niyar: That a man slaughtered before the Prophet ﷺ finished [his prayer], "so he commanded him to repeat it."
6.hi: Abu Ali al-Hanafi ne Malik se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Bushayr ibn Yasar se, Abu Burdah ibn Niyar se bataya ke ek aadmi ne Nabi ﷺ ke namaz se faarigh hone se pehle zabah kar diya, "to aapne use dobaara karne ka hukum diya."

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا فَرَعَ وَلَا عَتِيرَةَ "
6.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Uyaynah, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "No fara', and no atirah" [pre-Islamic pagan sacrificial customs].
6.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Ibn Uyaynah se, al-Zuhri se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Na Fara' hai, na Atirah" [Jahiliyat ki qurbaani ki rasmein].

6.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ وَكِيعِ بْنِ حُدُسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي رَزِينٍ الْعُقَيْلِيِّ : لَقِيطِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّا كُنَّانَذْبَحُ فِي رَجَبٍ فَمَا تَرَى؟ قَالَ : " لَا بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ ".
قَالَ وَكِيعٌ : لَا أَدَعُهُ أَبَدًا
6.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abu Awanah, from Ya'la ibn Ata, from Waki' ibn Hudus, from Abu Razin al-Uqayli (Laqit ibn Amir); with Waki's note: He said: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, we used to slaughter in Rajab, so what do you think?" He said: "There is no harm in that." Waki' said: I never leave it [ever again].
6.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Abu Awanah se, Ya'la ibn Ata se, Waki' ibn Hudus se, Abu Razin al-Uqayli (Laqit ibn Amir) se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, hum Rajab mein zabah kiya karte the, to aap iske baare mein kya kehte hain?" Aapne farmaya: "Isme koi harj nahi." Waki' kehte hain: Main isay kabhi na chhodunga.

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ  ، عَنْ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتِ مَيْسَرَةَ بْنِ أَبِي خُثَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ كُرْزٍ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، ، قَالَ فِي الْعَقِيقَةِ :" عَنْ الْغُلَامِ شَاتَانِ مُكَافِئَتَانِ، وَعَنْ الْجَارِيَةِ شَاةٌ "
6.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ata, from Habibah bint Maysarah ibn Abi Khuthaym, from Umm Kurz, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said, concerning the aqiqah [the birth sacrifice]: "For the boy, two equal sheep, and for the girl, one sheep."
6.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Ata ne bataya, Habibah bint Maysarah ibn Abi Khuthaym se, Umm Kurz se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne 'aqiqah' ke baare mein farmaya: "Ladke ki taraf se barabar do bhedein, aur ladki ki taraf se ek bhed."

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ سَلْمَانَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ الضَّبِّيِّ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" مَعَ الْغُلَامِ عَقِيقَةٌ، فَأَهْرِيقُوا عَنْهُ الدَّمَ، وَأَمِيطُوا عَنْهُ الْأَذَى "
6.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Hisham, from Hafsah bint Sirin, from Salman ibn Amir al-Dabbi: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "With the boy is an aqiqah, so shed blood for him, and remove harm from him."
6.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Hisham se, Hafsah bint Sirin se, Salman ibn Amir al-Dabbi se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Ladke ke saath aqiqah hai, so uski taraf se khoon bahaao, aur usse gandagi door karo."

6.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ سِبَاعِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ كُرْزٍ  ، قَالَتْ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" عَنْ الْغُلَامِ شَاتَانِ مِثْلَانِ، وَعَنْ الْجَارِيَةِ شَاةٌ "
6.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ubaydullah ibn Abi Yazid, from Sibaʻ ibn Thabit, from Umm Kurz: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "For the boy, two equal sheep, and for the girl, one sheep."
6.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ubaydullah ibn Abi Yazid se, Sibaʻ ibn Thabit se, Umm Kurz se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Ladke ki taraf se barabar do bhedein, aur ladki ki taraf se ek bhed."

6.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" كُلُّ غُلَامٍ رَهِينَةٌ بِعَقِيقَتِهِ يُذْبَحُ عَنْهُ يَوْمَ سَابِعِهِ، وَيُحْلَقُ وَيُدَمَّى ".
وَكَانَ قَتَادَةُ يَصِفُ الدَّمَ، فَيَقُولُ : إِذَا ذُبِحَتْ الْعَقِيقَةُ، تُؤْخَذُ صُوفَةٌ فَيُسْتَقْبَلُ بِهَا أَوْدَاجُ الذَّبِيحَةِ، ثُمَّ يُوضَعُ عَلَى يَافُوخِ الصَّبِيِّ حَتَّى إِذَا سَالَ شَبَهُ الْخَيْطِ، غُسِلَ رَأْسُهُ، ثُمَّ حُلِقَ بَعْدُ.
 حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ  ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ، قَالَ : وَيُسَمَّى.
قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : وَلَا أُرَاهُ وَاجِبًا
6.en: Narrated by Affan ibn Muslim, from Hammam, from Qatadah, from al-Hasan, from Samurah; with Qatadah's description and Abdullah's note: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "Every boy is pledged in trust for his aqiqah, it is slaughtered for him on his seventh day, and he is shaved and given blood [applied to his head, per the old custom before it was replaced]." And Qatadah used to describe the blood, and say: When the aqiqah is slaughtered, wool is taken and the arteries of the sacrifice are received with it, then it is placed on the crown of the baby's head until, when a thread-like trace flows, his head is washed, then it is shaved after that. [Affan narrated this hadith, saying]: and he is named. Abdullah said: And I do not consider it obligatory.
6.hi: Affan ibn Muslim ne Hammam se, Qatadah se, al-Hasan se, Samurah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Har ladka apni aqiqah ke saath giravi hai, uski taraf se saatven din zabah kiya jaata hai, aur usay mundwaya jaata hai aur khoon lagaaya jaata hai." Aur Qatadah khoon ka tareeqa bayaan karte the, aur kehte the: Jab aqiqah zabah ki jaati hai, ek oon ka tukda liya jaata hai aur usse jaanwar ki rag ka khoon liya jaata hai, fir bachche ki chandi par rakha jaata hai yahan tak ke jab dhaage jaisi lakeer bahe, to uska sar dho diya jaata hai, fir uske baad mundwaaya jaata hai. Affan ne yeh hadith bataayi, kaha: aur uska naam rakha jaata hai. Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Aur main isay wajib nahi samajhta.

6.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَشْعَثِ الصَّنْعَانِيِّ  ، عَنْ شَدَّادِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ  ، قَالَ : حَفِظْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ اثْنَتَيْنِ : قَالَ : " إِنَّاللَّهَ كَتَبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْإِحْسَانَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءِ، فَإِذَا قَتَلْتُمْ فَأَحْسِنُوا الْقِتْلَةَ، وَإِذَا ذَبَحْتُمْ، فَأَحْسِنُوا الذَّبْحَ، وَلْيُحِدَّ أَحَدُكُمْ شَفْرَتَهُ، ثُمَّ لِيُرِحْ ذَبِيحَتَهُ "
6.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Khalid al-Hadhdha, from Abu Qilabah, from Abu al-Ash'ath al-San'ani, from Shaddad ibn Aws: He said: I retained two things from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: He said: "Indeed Allah has written excellence upon everything, so when you kill, kill well, and when you slaughter, slaughter well, and let one of you sharpen his blade, and let him give ease to his slaughtered animal."
6.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Khalid al-Hadhdha se, Abu Qilabah se, Abu al-Ash'ath al-San'ani se, Shaddad ibn Aws se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ se do baatein yaad rakhi hain: Aapne farmaya, "Allah ne har cheez par ehsaan farz kiya hai, so jab tum qatal karo, to achhi tarah qatal karo, aur jab zabah karo, to achhi tarah zabah karo, aur tum mein se koi apni chhuri tez kare, aur apne zabah kiye jaane wale jaanwar ko aaraam dile."

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   : أَنَّ امْرَأَةً كَانَتْ تَرْعَى لِآلِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ غَنَمًا بِسَلْعٍ، فَخَافَتْ عَلَى شَاةٍ مِنْهَا أَنْ تَمُوتَ، فَأَخَذَتْ حَجَرًا فَذَبَحَتْهَا بِهِ، وَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ ذُكِرَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" فَأَمَرَهُمْ بِأَكْلِهَا "
6.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That a woman used to graze sheep for the family of Ka'b ibn Malik at Sal', so she feared for one of the sheep that it would die, so she took a stone and slaughtered it with it, and that was mentioned to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, "so he commanded them to eat it."
6.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke ek aurat Ka'b ibn Malik ke khaandaan ke liye Sal' mein bhedein charaati thi, to usay ek bhed ke marne ka dar hua, to usne ek pathar liya aur usse usay zabah kar diya, aur yeh baat Rasulullah ﷺ se zikr ki gayi, "to aapne unhein usay khaane ka hukum diya."

6.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، وَعَفَّانُ  ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعُشَرَاءِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَمَا تَكُونُ الذَّكَاةُ إِلَّا فِي الْحَلْقِ وَاللَّبَّةِ؟ فَقَالَ :" لَوْ طَعَنْتَ فِي فَخِذِهَا، لَأَجْزَأَ عَنْكَ ".
قَالَ حَمَّادٌ : حَمَلْنَاهُ عَلَى الْمُتَرَدِّي
6.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, and Uthman ibn Umar, and Affan, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Abu al-Ushara, from his father: He said: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, is slaughtering not only in the throat and the upper chest?" So he said: "If you stabbed in its thigh, it would suffice you." Hammad said: We took this to mean the case of an animal that has fallen [into a pit, uncontrollable].
6.hi: Abu al-Walid, aur Uthman ibn Umar, aur Affan ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Abu al-Ushara se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, kya zabah sirf gale aur seene ke upar hi hoti hai?" To aapne farmaya: "Agar tum uski raan mein bhonk dete, to woh bhi tumhare liye kaafi hota." Hammad kehte hain: Humne ise us jaanwar par mahmool kiya jo [gaddhe mein] gir gaya ho [aur qaabu na aata ho].

6.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي الْمِنْهَالُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ  ، يَقُولُ : خَرَجْتُ مَعَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ فِي طَرِيقٍ مِنْ طُرُقِ الْمَدِينَةِ ، فَإِذَا غِلْمَةٌ يَرْمُونَ دَجَاجَةً، فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ   : مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا؟ فَتَفَرَّقُوا.
فَقَالَ : إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" لَعَنَ مَنْ مَثَّلَ بِالْحَيَوَانِ "
6.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from al-Minhal ibn Amr, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, about Ibn Umar: He said: I heard Sa'id ibn Jubayr say: I went out with Ibn Umar on one of the roads of Madinah, and there were some boys throwing [stones] at a chicken, so Ibn Umar said: "Who did this?" So they scattered. So he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ "cursed whoever mutilates an animal."
6.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se bataya: Mujhse al-Minhal ibn Amr ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Sa'id ibn Jubayr ko kehte suna: Main Ibn Umar ke saath Madinah ke ek raaste par nikla, to kuch ladke ek murgi ko [pathar] maar rahe the, to Ibn Umar ne poocha: "Yeh kisne kiya?" To woh bhaag gaye. To unhone kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne "jo jaanwar ka muslah kare (uski shakl bigade) usper lanat ki hai."

6.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ تِعْلَى  ،  عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ   : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" نَهَى عَنْ صَبْرِ الدَّابَّةِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو أَيُّوبَ : لَوْ كَانَتْ دَجَاجَةً مَا صَبَرْتُهَا
6.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Abd al-Hamid ibn Ja'far, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Bukayr ibn Abdullah al-Ashajj, from his father, from Ubayd ibn Ti'la, from Abu Ayyub al-Ansari; with Abu Ayyub's note: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "forbade confining an animal [as a target]." Abu Ayyub said: Were it a chicken, I would not confine it.
6.hi: Abu Asim ne Abd al-Hamid ibn Ja'far se, Yazid ibn Abi Habib se, Bukayr ibn Abdullah al-Ashajj se, apne walid se, Ubayd ibn Ti'la se, Abu Ayyub al-Ansari se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "jaanwar ko [nishaana banaane ke liye] rok kar rakhne se mana kiya." Abu Ayyub ne kaha: Agar yeh murgi bhi hoti, to main use aisay na rokta.

6.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" نَهَى عَنْ الْمُجَثَّمَةِ ".
فَقَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : الْمُجَثَّمَةُ : الْمَصْبُورَةُ
6.en: Narrated by Affan, from Hammad, from Qatadah, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "forbade al-mujaththamah [an animal used as a target while restrained]." Abu Muhammad said: al-mujaththamah is: the confined one.
6.hi: Affan ne Hammad se, Qatadah se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "al-mujaththamah se mana kiya." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: 'Al-mujaththamah' woh hai jise nishaane ke liye rok kar rakha jaaye.

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ هُوَ ابْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، أَنَّ قَوْمًا قَالُوا : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ قَوْمًا يَأْتُونَا بِاللَّحْمِ لَا نَدْرِي أَذُكِرَ اسْمُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ أَمْ لَا؟ فَقَالَ :" سَمُّوا أَنْتُمْ وَكُلُوا "وَكَانُوا حَدِيثَ عَهْدٍ بِجَاهِلِيَّةٍ
6.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Abd al-Rahim ibn Sulayman, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha, Mother of the Believers: That some people said: "O Messenger of Allah, some people bring us meat, and we do not know whether the name of Allah was mentioned over it or not?" So he said: "You mention the name [yourselves], and eat," and they were recent from Jahiliyyah.
6.hi: Muhammad ibn Sa'id ne Abd al-Rahim ibn Sulayman se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Aisha, Ummul-Mumineen, se bataya ke kuch logon ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, kuch log hamare paas gosht laate hain, humein nahi maloom ke uspar Allah ka naam liya gaya ya nahi?" To aapne farmaya: "Tum khud Bismillah kaho, aur khaao," aur woh Jahiliyat se taaza-taaza nikle the.

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَبَايَةَ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ ابْنِ رَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ   : أَنَّ بَعِيرًا نَدَّ وَلَيْسَ فِي الْقَوْمِ إِلَّا خَيْلٌ يَسِيرَةٌ، فَرَمَاهُ رَجُلٌ بِسَهْمٍ، فَحَبَسَهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " إِنَّلِهَذِهِ الْبَهَائِمِ أَوَابِدَ كَأَوَابِدِ الْوَحْشِ، فَمَا غَلَبَكُمْ مِنْهَا، فَاصْنَعُوا بِهِ هَكَذَا "
6.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from his father, from Abayah ibn Rifa'ah ibn Rafi', from his grandfather Rafi' ibn Khadij: That a camel fled and there was only a little cavalry among the people, so a man shot it with an arrow, and it stopped it, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: "Indeed these animals have wild/unruly behaviors like the unruliness of wild game, so whatever of them overpowers you, do to it like this."
6.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, apne walid se, Abayah ibn Rifa'ah ibn Rafi' se, apne dada Rafi' ibn Khadij se bataya ke ek oont bhaag gaya aur logon ke paas thodi hi sawaari thi, to ek aadmi ne usay teer maara, to woh ruk gaya, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne usse farmaya: "In jaanwaron mein bhi jangli jaanwaron jaisi be-qaabu-pan hoti hai, so jo tum par ghaalib aa jaaye, to usse aisa hi karo."

6.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو هُوَ ابْنُ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ صُهَيْبٍ  مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو  ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ قَتَلَ عُصْفُورًا بِغَيْرِ حَقِّهِ، سَأَلَهُ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ".
قِيلَ : وَمَا حَقُّهُ؟ قَالَ : " أَنْ تَذْبَحَهُ فَتَأْكُلَهُ "
6.en: Narrated by Isma'il Abu Ma'mar ibn Ibrahim, from Sufyan, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Suhayb, freed servant of Ibn Amir, from Abdullah ibn Amr: He said: I heard Abdullah ibn Amr say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever kills a sparrow without its right, Allah will question him about it on the Day of Resurrection." It was said: "And what is its right?" He said: "That you slaughter it and eat it."
6.hi: Isma'il Abu Ma'mar ibn Ibrahim ne Sufyan se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Amr ibn Dinar ko suna, Suhayb (Ibn Amir ke azaad kiye hue ghulam) se: Unhone kaha, Maine Abdullah ibn Amr ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo kisi chidiya ko uske haq ke bagair maare, Allah usse Qayamat ke din iske baare mein sawaal karega." Poocha gaya: "Aur uska haq kya hai?" Aapne farmaya: "Ke tum use zabah karo aur khaao."

6.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَتَّابُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" ذَكَاةُ الْجَنِينِ ذَكَاةُ أُمِّهِ ".
قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ : يُؤْكَلُ؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ
6.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Attab ibn Bashir, from Ubaydullah ibn Abi Ziyad, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, from the Prophet ﷺ; with Abu Muhammad's confirmation: He said: "The slaughtering of the fetus is the slaughtering of its mother." It was said to Abu Muhammad: "Is it eaten?" He said, "Yes."
6.hi: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ne Attab ibn Bashir se, Ubaydullah ibn Abi Ziyad se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Hamal (peT) mein maujood bachche ka zabah uski maa ka zabah hai [maa ke zabah karne se hi woh bhi paak hota hai]." Abu Muhammad se poocha gaya: "Kya use khaaya jaayega?" Unhone kaha, "Haan."

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلَانِيِّ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيِّ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْأَكْلِ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنْ السِّبَاعِ "
6.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Idris al-Khawlani, from Abu Tha'labah al-Khushani: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade eating every fanged beast of prey."
6.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Ibn Shihab se, Abu Idris al-Khawlani se, Abu Tha'labah al-Khushani se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne har naab wale darinde jaanwar ko khaane se mana kiya."

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُوَيْسٍ  ابْنُ عَمِّ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلَانِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيِّ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْالْخَطْفَةِ، وَالْمُجَثَّمَةِ، وَالنُّهْبَةِ، وَعَنْ أَكْلِ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنْ السِّبَاعِ "
6.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Maslamah, from Abu Uways (cousin of Malik ibn Anas), from al-Zuhri, from Abu Idris al-Khawlani, from Abu Tha'labah al-Khushani: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade al-khatfah, and al-mujaththamah, and plunder, and eating every fanged beast of prey."
6.hi: Abdullah ibn Maslamah ne Abu Uways se (Malik ibn Anas ke chachazaad), al-Zuhri se, Abu Idris al-Khawlani se, Abu Tha'labah al-Khushani se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne al-khatfah (chheenna), aur al-mujaththamah, aur loot-maar se, aur har naab wale darinde ko khaane se mana kiya."

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْأَكْلِ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنْ السِّبَاعِ، وَكُلِّ ذِي مِخْلَبٍ مِنْ الطَّيْرِ "
6.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hammad, from Abu Awanah, from Abu Bishr, from Maymun ibn Mihran, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade eating every fanged beast of prey, and every clawed bird."
6.hi: Yahya ibn Hammad ne Abu Awanah se, Abu Bishr se, Maymun ibn Mihran se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne har naab wale darinde, aur har panje wale parinde ko khaane se mana kiya."

6.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْمَرُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمَلِيحِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" نَهَى عَنْ جُلُودِ السِّبَاعِ أَنْ تُفْتَرَشَ ".
 أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ  عن قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمَلِيحِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، نَحْوَهُ
6.en: Narrated by Ya'mar ibn Bishr, from Ibn al-Mubarak, from Sa'id, from Qatadah, from Abu al-Malih, from his father; a similar chain also via Musaddad: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "forbade that the hides of beasts of prey be used as rugs." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Musaddad, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Sa'id, from Qatadah, from Abu al-Malih, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ.]
6.hi: Ya'mar ibn Bishr ne Ibn al-Mubarak se, Sa'id se, Qatadah se, Abu al-Malih se, apne walid se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "darinde jaanwaron ki khaal ko bichhona banaane se mana kiya." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Musaddad se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Sa'id se, Qatadah se, Abu al-Malih se, apne walid se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai.]

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ وَعْلَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ   عَنْ الْأَسْقِيَةِ، فَقَالَ : مَا أَدْرِي مَا أَقُولُ لَكَ، غَيْرَ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ :" أَيُّمَا إِهَابٍ دُبِغَ فَقَدْ طَهُرَ "
6.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Wa'lah: He said: I asked Ibn Abbas about waterskins, so he said: "I do not know what to say to you, except that I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Whatever hide is tanned, it has become pure.'"
6.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Zayd ibn Aslam se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Wa'lah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibn Abbas se mashkeezon (waterskins) ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: "Mujhe nahi maloom tumse kya kahun, siwaay iske ke maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna: 'Jo bhi khaal daabgh ki jaaye, woh paak ho jaati hai.'"

6.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الْقَعْقَاعِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ وَعْلَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ   عَنْ جُلُودِ الْمَيْتَةِ، فَقَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" دِبَاغُهَا طَهُورُهَا ".
قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ : تَقُولُ بِهَذَا؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ، إِذَا كَانَ يُؤْكَلُ لَحْمُهُ
6.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from al-Qa'qa' ibn Hakim, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Wa'lah; with Abdullah al-Darimi's confirmation: He said: I asked Ibn Abbas about the hides of dead animals, so he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Its tanning is its purification." It was said to Abu Muhammad Abdullah: "Do you say this?" He said, "Yes, if its meat is [normally] eaten."
6.hi: Ya'la ne Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, al-Qa'qa' ibn Hakim se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Wa'lah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibn Abbas se murda jaanwaron ki khaal ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Uska daabgh hona hi uski taharat hai." Abu Muhammad Abdullah se poocha gaya: "Kya aap yeh kehte hain?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, agar uska gosht khaaya jaata ho."

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ قُسَيْطٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ ثَوْبَانَ  ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : " أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْيُسْتَمْتَعَ بِجُلُودِ الْمَيْتَةِ إِذَا دُبِغَتْ "
6.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Yazid ibn Qusayt, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Thawban, from his mother, from Aisha: She said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded that use be made of the hides of dead animals when they are tanned."
6.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Yazid ibn Qusayt se, Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Thawban se, apni maa se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne hukum diya ke murda jaanwaron ki khaal se faida uthaaya jaaye jab woh daabgh ki jaaye."

6.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ،  عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : مَاتَتْ شَاةٌ لِمَيْمُونَةَ ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَوْ اسْتَمْتَعْتُمْ بِإِهَابِهَا؟ " قَالُوا : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّهَا مَيْتَةٌ، قَالَ : " إِنَّمَا حُرِّمَ أَكْلُهَا ".
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُصَفَّى  ، حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ  ، عَنْ الزُّبَيْدِيِّ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، نَحْوَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ.
قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ : مَا تَقُولُ فِي الثَّعَالِبِ إِذَا دُبِغَتْ؟ قَالَ : أَكْرَهُهَا
6.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from al-Zuhri, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah, from Ibn Abbas; a similar chain also via Muhammad ibn al-Musaffa; with Abu Muhammad's note on foxes: He said: A sheep of Maymunah died, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Why do you not make use of its hide?" They said: "O Messenger of Allah, it is a dead animal." He said: "Only its eating is forbidden." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Muhammad ibn al-Musaffa, from Baqiyyah, from al-Zubaydi, from al-Zuhri, from Ubaydullah, from Ibn Abbas, from the Prophet ﷺ, near this hadith.] It was said to Abu Muhammad: "What do you say about foxes when tanned?" He said: "I dislike them."
6.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se, al-Zuhri se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maymunah ki ek bhed mar gayi, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Tum iski khaal se faida kyun nahi uthaate?" Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, yeh to murda jaanwar hai." Aapne farmaya: "Sirf iska khaana haraam kiya gaya hai." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Muhammad ibn al-Musaffa se, Baqiyyah se, al-Zubaydi se, al-Zuhri se, Ubaydullah se, Ibn Abbas se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi is hadith ke qareeb aayi hai.] Abu Muhammad se poocha gaya: "Lomdi ke baare mein aap kya kehte hain jab woh daabgh ki jaaye?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe na-pasand hai."

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ابْنَيْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، أَنَّ عَلِيًّا   قَالَ لِابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْمُتْعَةِ النِّسَاءِ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ، وَعَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الْإِنْسِيَّةِ "
6.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Malik, from al-Zuhri, from al-Hasan and Abdullah, sons of Muhammad, from their father, about Ali and Ibn Abbas: That Ali said to Ibn Abbas: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade mut'ah of women on the day of Khaybar, and [forbade] the meat of domestic donkeys."
6.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Malik se, al-Zuhri se, al-Hasan aur Abdullah, jo Muhammad ke bete hain, se, apne walid se bataya ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne Ibn Abbas se kaha: "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Khaybar ke din auraton ke mut'ah se, aur ghareloo gadhon ke gosht se mana kiya."

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، قَالَ : قَامَ رَجُلٌ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أُكِلَتْ الْحُمُرُ أَوْ أُفْنِيَتِ الْحُمُرُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أُفْنِيَتِ الْحُمُرُ أَوْ أُكِلَتْ الْحُمُرُ، " فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَجُلًا فَنَادَى إِنَّاللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يَنْهَيَانِكُمْ عَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ، فَإِنَّهَا رِجْسٌ "
6.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Hisham, from Ibn Sirin, from Anas ibn Malik: He said: A man stood on the day of Khaybar, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, the donkeys have been eaten," or "the donkeys have run out," then he said: "O Messenger of Allah, the donkeys have run out," or "the donkeys have been eaten," "so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded a man and he called out: Allah and His Messenger forbid you the meat of donkeys, for indeed it is impure."
6.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Hisham se, Ibn Sirin se, Anas ibn Malik se bataya: Unhone kaha, Khaybar ke din ek aadmi khada hua, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, gadhe khaa liye gaye," ya "gadhe khatam ho gaye," fir kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, gadhe khatam ho gaye," ya "gadhe khaa liye gaye," "to Rasulullah ﷺ ne ek aadmi ko hukum diya aur usne pukaara: Allah aur uske Rasool tumhein gadhon ke gosht se mana karte hain, kyunki yeh napaak hai."

6.ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ الْمُنْذِرِ  ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ  ، قَالَتْ :" أَكَلْنَا لَحْمَ فَرَسٍ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ "
6.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from Fatimah bint al-Mundhir, from Asma bint Abi Bakr: She said: "We used to eat horse meat in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at Madinah."
6.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Hisham ibn Urwah se, Fatimah bint al-Mundhir se, Asma bint Abi Bakr se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke zamane mein Madinah mein ghode ka gosht khaaya karte the."

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ عَنْلُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الْأَهْلِيَّةِ، وَأَذِنَ فِي لُحُومِ الْخَيْلِ "
6.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Jabir ibn Abdullah: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade, on the day of Khaybar, the meat of domestic donkeys, and permitted the meat of horses."
6.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Muhammad ibn Ali se, Jabir ibn Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Khaybar ke din ghareloo gadhon ke gosht se mana kiya, aur ghodon ke gosht ki ijaazat di."

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" لَا يَنْتَهِبُ نُهْبَةً ذَاتَ شَرَفٍ يَرْفَعُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ فِيهَا أَبْصَارَهُمْ وَهُوَ حِينَ يَنْتَهِبُهَا مُؤْمِنٌ "
6.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, and Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Let none of you plunder plunder of high value, in which the believers raise their eyes toward it, while he is, at the time he plunders it, [still calling himself] a believer."
6.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se, al-Zuhri se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab aur Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Koi bhi qeemat wali loot ki cheez, jispar momino ki nazrein uthein, koi na lute, jabke woh use lootne ke waqt momin ho."

6.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ حَكِيمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي لَبِيدٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ  ، قَالَ : "نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ النُّهْبَةِ ".
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : هَذَا فِي الْغَزْوِ إِذَا غَنِمُوا قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْسَمَ
6.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Wahb ibn Jarir ibn Hazim, from his father, from Ya'la ibn Hakim, from Abu Labid, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Samurah; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade plunder [before proper distribution]." Abu Muhammad said: This is in war, when they take spoils before it is divided.
6.hi: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ne Wahb ibn Jarir ibn Hazim se, apne walid se, Ya'la ibn Hakim se, Abu Labid se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Samurah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne loot-maar se mana kiya." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Yeh jung mein hai, jab woh taqseem hone se pehle ghaneemat le lein.

6.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، عَنْ حَسَّانَ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي وَاقِدٍ  ، قَالَ : قُلْنَا : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّا بِأَرْضٍ تَكُونُ بِهَا الْمَخْمَصَةُ، فَمَا يَحِلُّ لَنَا مِنْ الْمَيْتَةِ؟ قَالَ :" إِذَا لَمْ تَصْطَبِحُوا، وَلَمْ تَغْتَبِقُوا، وَلَمْ تَخْتَفِئُوا بَقْلًا فَشَأْنُكُمْ بِهَا ".
قَالَ : النَّاسُ يَقُولُونَ بِالْحَاءِ، وَهَذَا قَالَ بِالْخَاءِ
6.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from al-Awza'i, from Hassan ibn Atiyyah, from Abu Waqid; with the narrator's note: He said: We said: "O Messenger of Allah, we are in a land where there is famine, so what is lawful for us of dead animals?" He said: "If you have not had a morning drink, nor an evening drink, nor sought out edible herbs, then it is your affair." He said: The people say it with 'h' [istakhfa'], but this narrator said it with 'kh' [ikhtafa'a].
6.hi: Abu Asim ne al-Awza'i se, Hassan ibn Atiyyah se, Abu Waqid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Humne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, hum aise ilaqe mein hain jahan kaal padta hai, to humare liye murda jaanwar se kya halal hai?" Aapne farmaya: "Agar tumne subah ka doodh na piya ho, na shaam ka, na koi saag talaash kiya ho, to woh tumhara maamla hai [khaa sakte ho]." Unhone bataya: Log ise 'h' se kehte hain [istakhfa'], lekin isne 'kh' se kaha [ikhtafa'a].

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ بَحِيرٍ  ، عَنْ ضِرَارِ بْنِ الْأَزْوَرِ  ، قَالَ : أَهْدَيْتُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِقْحَةً، فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَحْلُبَهَا، فَحَلَبْتُهَا، فَجَهَدْتُ فِي حَلْبِهَا، فَقَالَ" دَعْ دَاعِيَ اللَّبَنِ "
6.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from al-A'mash, from Ya'qub ibn Bahir, from Dirar ibn al-Azwar: He said: I gave the Messenger of Allah ﷺ a milk-camel as a gift, so he commanded me to milk it, so I milked it, and I exerted myself in milking it, so he said: "Leave the reserve of milk [do not milk it dry]."
6.hi: Ya'la ne al-A'mash se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ya'qub ibn Bahir ko suna, Dirar ibn al-Azwar se: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko ek doodh wali oontni tohfe mein di, to aapne mujhe use doodhne ka hukum diya, so maine use doodha, aur maine doodhne mein poori mehnat ki, to aapne farmaya: "Doodh ka kuch hissa reserve mein chhod do."

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْقَارِظِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" نَهَى عَنْ قَتْلِ الضِّفْدَعِ "
6.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from Sa'id ibn Khalid al-Qarizi, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Uthman: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "forbade killing the frog."
6.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Ibn Abi Dhi'b se, Sa'id ibn Khalid al-Qarizi se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Uthman se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "mendhak ko maarne se mana kiya."

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْقَتْلِ أَرْبَعَةٍ مِنْ الدَّوَابِّ : النَّمْلَةِ، وَالنَّحْلَةِ، وَالْهُدْهُدِ، وَالصُّرَدِ "
6.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade killing four creatures: the ant, and the bee, and the hoopoe, and the shrike."
6.hi: Muhammad ibn Yahya ne Abd al-Razzaq se bataya: Humein Ma'mar ne bataya, al-Zuhri se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah se, Ibn Abbas se: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne chaar jaanwaron ko maarne se mana kiya: cheenti, madhumakkhi, hudhud, aur surad (ek chidiya)."

6.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ شَيْبَةَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  عَنْ أُمِّ شَرِيكٍ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" أَمَرَ بِقَتْلِ الْأَوْزَاغِ "
6.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abd al-Hamid ibn Jubayr ibn Shaybah, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Umm Sharik: That the Prophet ﷺ "commanded the killing of geckos."
6.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Abd al-Hamid ibn Jubayr ibn Shaybah se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se, Umm Sharik se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne "chhipkaliyon (aw'zaagh) ko maarne ka hukum diya."

6.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زَيْدٍ : سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتَوَائِيُّ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" نَهَى عَنْ الْمُجَثَّمَةِ، وَعَنْ لَبَنِ الْجَلَّالَةِ، وَأَنْ يُشْرَبَ مِنْ فِي السِّقَاءِ "
6.en: Narrated by Abu Zayd Sa'id ibn al-Rabi', from Hisham al-Dastawa'i, from Qatadah, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "forbade al-mujaththamah, and the milk of the jallalah [an animal fed on filth], and drinking from the mouth of the waterskin."
6.hi: Abu Zayd Sa'id ibn al-Rabi' ne Hisham al-Dastawa'i se, Qatadah se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "al-mujaththamah se, aur jallalah (gandagi khaane wale jaanwar) ke doodh se, aur mashkeeze ke muh se peene se mana kiya."

7.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ صَيْدِ الْكَلْبِ، فَقَالَ :" مَا أَمْسَكَ عَلَيْكَ كَلْبِكَ فَكُلْ، فَإِنَّ أَخْذَهُ ذَكَاتُهُ، وَإِنْ وَجَدْتَ مَعَهُ كَلْبًا فَخَشِيتَ أَنْ يَكُونَ قَدْ أَخَذَهُ مَعَهُ، وَقَدْ قَتَلَهُ، فَلَا تَأْكُلْهُ، فَإِنَّكَ إِنَّمَا ذَكَرْتَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَى كَلْبِكَ، وَلَمْ تَذْكُرْهُ عَلَى غَيْرِهِ ".
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ صَيْدِ الْمِعْرَاضِ، فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ
7.en: Narrated by Ya'la ibn Ubayd, from Zakariya, from Amir, from Adi ibn Hatim; a similar chain also via Abu Nu'aym: He said: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about hunting with a dog, so he said: "Whatever your dog catches for you, eat, for indeed its catching it is its slaughtering; and if you find another dog with it, and you fear it may have caught it along with your dog, and it has killed it, then do not eat it, for indeed you only mentioned the name of Allah over your own dog, and did not mention it over the other." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Abu Nu'aym, from Zakariya, from Amir, from Adi ibn Hatim: He said: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about hunting with a throwing-stick (mi'rad), and he mentioned the like of it.]
7.hi: Ya'la ibn Ubayd ne Zakariya se, Amir se, Adi ibn Hatim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ se kutte se shikaar karne ke baare mein poocha, to aapne farmaya: "Jo tumhara kutta tumhare liye pakde, use khaao, kyunki uska pakadna hi uska zabah hai; aur agar tum uske saath koi doosra kutta paao, aur tumhein dar ho ke usne bhi isse pakda ho, aur usay maar diya ho, to use na khaao, kyunki tumne sirf apne kutte par Allah ka naam liya, doosre par nahi." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Abu Nu'aym se, Zakariya se, Amir se, Adi ibn Hatim se bhi aayi hai: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ se mi'rad (phenkne wali lakdi) se shikaar karne ke baare mein poocha, to aapne isi jaisa zikr kiya.]

7.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ اقْتَنَى كَلْبًا إِلَّا كَلْبَ صَيْدٍ أَوْ مَاشِيَةٍ، نَقَصَ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ قِيرَاطَانِ "
7.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from Abdullah ibn Dinar, from Ibn Umar: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever keeps a dog, except a hunting dog or a herding dog, two qirats are deducted from his deeds every day."
7.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se, Abdullah ibn Dinar se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo koi kutta paale, siwaay shikaar ke kutte ya charaane wale kutte ke, uske a'maal mein se har din do qeeraat kam kar diye jaate hain."

7.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ خُصَيْفَةَ  ، عَنْ السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سُفْيَانَ بْنَ أَبِي زُهَيْرٍ   يُحَدِّثُ نَاسًا مَعَهُ عِنْدَ بَاب الْمَسْجِدِ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ :" مَنْ اقْتَنَى كَلْبًا لَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُ زَرْعًا وَلَا ضَرْعًا، نَقَصَ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ قِيرَاطٌ ".
قَالُوا : أَنْتَ سَمِعْتَ هَذَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟ قَالَ : إِي وَرَبِّ هَذَا الْمَسْجِدِ
7.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Malik, from Yazid ibn Khusayfah, from al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid, about Sufyan ibn Abi Zuhayr: That he heard Sufyan ibn Abi Zuhayr narrating to people with him at the door of the mosque, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Whoever keeps a dog that does not benefit him for crops or livestock, one qirat is deducted from his deeds every day." They said: "Did you hear this from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" He said: Yes, by the Lord of this mosque.
7.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Malik se, Yazid ibn Khusayfah se, al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid se bataya ke unhone Sufyan ibn Abi Zuhayr ko masjid ke darwaze par apne saath ke logon ko bayaan karte suna, unhone kaha: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Jo koi kutta paale jo use kheti ya maweshiyon ke liye kaam na aaye, uske a'maal mein se har din ek qeeraat kam kar diya jaata hai." Logon ne poocha: "Kya aapne yeh Rasulullah ﷺ se suna?" Unhone kaha: Haan, is masjid ke Rab ki qasam.

7.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ  ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَأَمَرَ بِقَتْلِ الْكِلَابِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " مَا بَالِي وَلِلْكِلَابِ؟ "، ثُمَّ رَخَّصَ فِي كَلْبِ الرَّعْيِ وَكَلْبِ الصَّيْدِ
7.en: Narrated by Wahb ibn Jarir, from Shu'bah, from Abu al-Tayyah, from Mutarrif, from Abdullah ibn Mughaffal: That the Prophet ﷺ commanded the killing of dogs, then said: "What is wrong with me and dogs?" then he gave a concession for the herding dog and the hunting dog.
7.hi: Wahb ibn Jarir ne Shu'bah se, Abu al-Tayyah se, Mutarrif se, Abdullah ibn Mughaffal se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne kutton ko maarne ka hukum diya, fir farmaya: "Mujhe kutton se kya lena-dena?" fir aapne charaane wale kutte aur shikaari kutte ki rukhsat di.

7.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : " أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَبِقَتْلِ الْكِلَابِ "
7.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded the killing of dogs."
7.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne kutton ko maarne ka hukum diya."

7.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَوْفٌ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ،  عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَوْلَا أَنَّ الْكِلَابَ أُمَّةٌ مِنْ الْأُمَمِ، لَأَمَرْتُ بِقَتْلِهَا كُلِّهَا، وَلَكِنْ اقْتُلُوا مِنْهَا كُلَّ أَسْوَدَ بَهِيمٍ ".
قَالَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ : الْبَهِيمُ : الْأَسْوَدُ كُلُّهُ
7.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Awf, from al-Hasan, from Abdullah ibn Mughaffal; with Sa'id ibn Amir's clarification: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Were it not that dogs are a nation among the nations, I would have commanded the killing of them all, but kill among them every pure black one." Sa'id ibn Amir said: al-bahim means: the wholly black.
7.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Awf se, al-Hasan se, Abdullah ibn Mughaffal se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Agar kutte bhi ek qaum na hote doosri qaumon ki tarah, to main sabko maarne ka hukum de deta, lekin unmein se har pure kaale ko maaro." Sa'id ibn Amir kehte hain: 'Al-bahim' ka matlab hai: bilkul kaala.

7.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي السَّفَرِ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَدِيَّ بْنَ حَاتِمٍ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ الْمِعْرَاضِ، فَقَالَ :" إِذَا أَصَابَ بِحَدِّهِ، فَكُلْ، وَإِذَا أَصَابَ بِعَرْضِهِ فَقَتَلَ، فَإِنَّهُ وَقِيذٌ، فَلَا تَأْكُلْ "
7.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Shu'bah, from Abdullah ibn Abi al-Safar, from al-Sha'bi, from Adi ibn Hatim: He said: I asked the Prophet ﷺ about the throwing-stick (mi'rad), so he said: "If it strikes with its edge, then eat, and if it strikes with its flat side and kills, then it is a struck [killed by blunt force] animal, so do not eat."
7.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Shu'bah se, Abdullah ibn Abi al-Safar se, al-Sha'bi se, Adi ibn Hatim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Nabi ﷺ se mi'rad (phenkne wali lakdi) ke baare mein poocha, to aapne farmaya: "Agar woh apni dhaar se lage, to khaao, aur agar woh apni chaudi taraf se lag kar maar de, to yeh maara hua (waqeez) jaanwar hai, so na khaao."

7.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى  ، قَالَ : " غَزَوْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سَبْعَ غَزَوَاتٍنَأْكُلُ الْجَرَادَ "
7.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Abu Ya'fur, from Abdullah ibn Abi Awfa: He said: "We fought seven battles with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, [and] we would eat locusts."
7.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Abu Ya'fur se, Abdullah ibn Abi Awfa se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Humne Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath saat ghazwe kiye, [aur] hum tiddiyan khaate the."

7.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، قِرَاءَةً، عَنْ مَالِكٍ  ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ  مِنْ آلِ الْأَزْرَقِ، أَنَّ الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ  وَهُوَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي عَبْدِ الدَّارِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، يَقُولُ : سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : إِنَّا نَرْكَبُ الْبَحْرَ وَنَحْمِلُ مَعَنَا الْقَلِيلَ مِنْ الْمَاءِ، فَإِنْ تَوَضَّأْنَا بِهِ، عَطِشْنَا، أَفَنَتَوَضَّأُ مِنْ مَاءِ الْبَحْرِ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" هُوَ الطَّهُورُ مَاؤُهُ، الْحِلُّ مَيْتَتُهُ "
7.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak, from Malik, from Safwan ibn Sulaym, from Sa'id ibn Salamah of Al al-Azraq, from al-Mughirah ibn Abi Burdah, from Abu Hurairah: He said: A man asked the Prophet ﷺ, and said: "We ride the sea and carry a little water with us, so if we perform ablution with it, we become thirsty, shall we perform ablution from the water of the sea?" So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "It is - its water, the purifier; its dead [creatures], lawful."
7.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak ne Malik ke saamne padha: Safwan ibn Sulaym se, Sa'id ibn Salamah se (Al al-Azraq ke khaandaan se), ke al-Mughirah ibn Abi Burdah ne, jo Banu Abd al-Dar ke ek shakhs the, unhein bataya ke unhone Abu Hurairah ko kehte suna: Ek aadmi ne Nabi ﷺ se poocha, aur kaha: "Hum samundar mein safar karte hain aur apne saath thoda paani le jaate hain, so agar hum usse wudu karein, to pyaase reh jaayenge, to kya hum samundar ke paani se wudu karein?" To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Iska paani paak-karne wala hai; iske mure hue [jeev] halal hain."

7.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو يَعْنِي : ابْنَ دِينَارٍ  ،  عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ : " بَعَثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي ثَلَاثِ مِئَةٍ،فَأَصَابَنَا جُوعٌ حَتَّى أَتَيْنَا الْبَحْرَ وَقَدْ قَذَفَ دَابَّةً، فَأَكَلْنَا مِنْهَا حَتَّى ثَابَتْ أَجْسَامُنَا، فَأَخَذَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ ضِلْعًا مِنْ أَضْلَاعِهَا فَوَضَعَهُ، ثُمَّ حَمَلَ أَطْوَلَ رَجُلٍ فِي الْجَيْشِ عَلَى أَعْظَمِ بَعِيرٍ فِي الْجَيْشِ فَمَرَّ تَحْتَهُ، هَذَا مَعْنَاهُ "
7.en: Narrated by Zakariya ibn Adi, from Ibn Uyaynah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Jabir: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent us as three hundred, so hunger overtook us until we came to the sea and it had cast up a creature, so we ate from it until our bodies were restored, so Abu Ubaydah took a rib from its ribs and set it up, then he had the tallest man in the army ride on the largest camel in the army and pass beneath it, this is its meaning."
7.hi: Zakariya ibn Adi ne Ibn Uyaynah se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Jabir se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein teen sau ki tadaad mein bheja, to humein bhookh ne ghayr diya yahan tak ke hum samundar tak pahunche aur usne ek jaanwar phenka hua tha, so humne usse itna khaaya ke humare jism theek ho gaye, to Abu Ubaydah ne uski paslion mein se ek pasli li aur usse khada kiya, fir lashkar ke sabse lambe aadmi ko lashkar ke sabse bade oont par sawaar kiya aur woh uske neeche se guzra," yeh iska matlab hai.

7.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، قَالَ : هِشَامُ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ  أَخْبَرَنِي، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ  ، يَقُولُ :أَنْفَجْنَا أَرْنَبًا وَنَحْنُ بِمَرِّ الظَّهْرَانِ ، فَسَعَى الْقَوْمُ فَلَغِبُوا، فَأَخَذْتُهَا وَجِئْتُ بِهَا إِلَى أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، فَذَبَحَهَا وَبَعَثَ بِوَرِكَيْهَا أَوْ فَخِذَيْهَا، شَكَّ شُعْبَةُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " فَقَبِلَهَا "
7.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Hisham ibn Zayd ibn Anas, from Anas ibn Malik: He said: "We startled a rabbit while we were at Marr al-Zahran, so the people ran but grew weary, so I caught it and brought it to Abu Talhah, so he slaughtered it and sent its haunches or its thighs" - Shu'bah was uncertain - "to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he accepted it."
7.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Hisham ibn Zayd ibn Anas ne bataya, unhone kaha: Maine Anas ibn Malik ko kehte suna: "Humne Marr al-Zahran mein ek khargosh ubhaara, to log daude lekin thak gaye, so maine usay pakda aur Abu Talhah ke paas laaya, to unhone usay zabah kiya aur uska peechla hissa ya raanein" - Shu'bah ko shak tha - "Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas bheja, to aapne use qabool kiya."

7.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِنْدٍ  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ صَفْوَانَ  ، أَنَّهُ مَرَّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِأَرْنَبَيْنِ مُعَلِّقُهُمَا، فَقَالَ : " يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّيدَخَلْتُ غَنَمَ أَهْلِي فَاصْطَدْتُ هَذَيْنِ الْأَرْنَبَيْنِ، فَلَمْ أَجِدْ حَدِيدَةً أُذَكِّيهِمَا بِهَا، فَذَكَّيْتُهُمَا بِمَرْوَةٍ، أَفَآكُلُ؟ قَالَ : " نَعَمْ "
7.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Da'ud ibn Abi Hind, from Amir, from Muhammad ibn Safwan: That he passed by the Prophet ﷺ with two hung-up rabbits, so he said: "O Messenger of Allah, I entered my family's sheep [pen] and hunted these two rabbits, but I did not find a blade to slaughter them with, so I slaughtered them with a sharp stone, may I eat them?" He said: "Yes."
7.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Da'ud ibn Abi Hind se, Amir se, Muhammad ibn Safwan se bataya: ke woh Nabi ﷺ ke paas se do latke hue khargoshon ke saath guzre, to unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, main apne ghar walon ki bhedon [ke bare] mein dakhil hua aur maine yeh do khargosh shikaar kiye, lekin mujhe unhein zabah karne ke liye chhuri nahi mili, so maine unhein tez pathar se zabah kiya, kya main inhein khaa sakta hoon?" Aapne farmaya: "Haan."

7.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ الضَّبِّ، فَقَالَ :" لَسْتُ بِآكِلِهِ وَلَا مُحَرِّمِهِ "
7.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Abdullah ibn Dinar, from Ibn Umar: He said: The Prophet ﷺ was asked about the dabb [spiny-tailed lizard], so he said: "I do not eat it, nor do I forbid it."
7.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Abdullah ibn Dinar se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ se dabb (chipkali jaisa jaanwar) ke baare mein poocha gaya, to aapne farmaya: "Main na ise khaata hoon na haraam qaraar deta hoon."

7.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ وَهْبٍ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ وَدِيعَةَ  ، قَالَ : أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِضَبٍّ، فَقَالَ :" أُمَّةٌ مُسِخَتْ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ "
7.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, from Zayd ibn Wahb, from al-Bara' ibn Azib, from Thabit ibn Wadi'ah: He said: The Prophet ﷺ was brought a dabb, so he said: "A nation that was transformed [into another creature], and Allah knows best."
7.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se, al-Hakam se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Zayd ibn Wahb ko yeh bayaan karte suna, al-Bara' ibn Azib se, Thabit ibn Wadi'ah se: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ ke paas ek dabb laaya gaya, to aapne farmaya: "Yeh ek qaum hai jo [surat] badal di gayi thi, aur Allah behtar jaanta hai."

7.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو أُمَامَةَ بْنُ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ  ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ  أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّ خَالِدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ   الَّذِي يُقَالُ لَهُ سَيْفُ اللَّهِ أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّهُ دَخَلَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَى مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهِيَ خَالَتُهُ وَخَالَةُ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فَوَجَدَ عِنْدَهَا ضَبًّا مَحْنُوذًا قَدِمَتْ بِهِ أُخْتُهَا حُفَيْدَةُ بِنْتُ الْحَارِثِ مِنْ نَجْدٍ ، فَقَدَّمَتْ الضَّبَّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَكَانَ قَلَّمَا يُقَدِّمُ يَدَهُ لِطَعَامٍ حَتَّى يُحَدَّثَ بِهِ وَيُسَمَّى لَهُ، فَأَهْوَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَدَهُ إِلَى الضَّبِّ، فَقَالَتْ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ نِسْوَةِ الْحُضُورِ : أَخْبِرْنَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَا قَدَّمْتُنَّ لَهُ.
قُلْنَ : هَذَا الضَّبُّ، فَرَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَدَهُ، فَقَالَ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ :أَتُحَرِّمُ الضَّبَّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ : " لَا، وَلَكِنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ بِأَرْضِ قَوْمِي، فَأَجِدُنِي أَعَافُهُ ".
قَالَ خَالِدٌ : فَاجْتَرَرْتُهُ فَأَكَلْتُهُ، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَنْظُرُ، فَلَمْ يَنْهَنِي
7.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yunus, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Umamah ibn Sahl ibn Hunayf al-Ansari, from Ibn Abbas, from Khalid ibn al-Walid: That Khalid ibn al-Walid, who is called the Sword of Allah, informed him: that he entered with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ upon Maymunah, wife of the Prophet ﷺ, who was his maternal aunt and the maternal aunt of Ibn Abbas, and he found with her a roasted dabb which her sister Hufaydah bint al-Harith had brought from Najd, so she presented the dabb to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he rarely extended his hand to food until it was described to him and named for him, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ leaned his hand toward the dabb, so a woman among the women present said: "Inform the Messenger of Allah ﷺ what you have presented to him." They said: "This is the dabb," so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ raised his hand, so Khalid ibn al-Walid said: "Do you forbid the dabb, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "No, but it was not in the land of my people, and I find myself averse to it." Khalid said: So I pulled it toward me and ate it, while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was watching, and he did not forbid me.
7.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhse Yunus ne bataya, Ibn Shihab se: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Abu Umamah ibn Sahl ibn Hunayf al-Ansari ne bataya, ke Abdullah ibn Abbas ne unhein bataya, ke Khalid ibn al-Walid, jinhein 'Saifullah' kaha jaata hai, ne unhein bataya: ke woh Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath Maymunah, Nabi ﷺ ki biwi, ke paas dakhil hue, jo unki aur Ibn Abbas ki khaala thin, to unke paas ek bhuna hua dabb paaya jise unki behen Hufaydah bint al-Harith Najd se laayi thin, so unhone dabb Rasulullah ﷺ ko pesh kiya, aur aap kam hi apna haath khaane ki taraf badhaate the jab tak use bataaya na jaata aur uska naam na liya jaata, so Rasulullah ﷺ ne apna haath dabb ki taraf jhukaaya, to haazir auraton mein se ek aurat ne kaha: "Rasulullah ﷺ ko bataao ke tumne aapko kya pesh kiya hai." Unhone kaha: "Yeh dabb hai," to Rasulullah ﷺ ne apna haath utha liya, to Khalid ibn al-Walid ne poocha: "Kya aap dabb ko haraam qaraar dete hain, Ya Rasulullah?" Aapne farmaya: "Nahi, lekin yeh meri qaum ki zameen mein nahi hota, so mujhe ismein tabiyat ki na-pasandeedgi mehsoos hoti hai." Khalid kehte hain: To maine usay apni taraf khaincha aur khaya, jabke Rasulullah ﷺ dekh rahe the, aur aapne mujhe mana nahi kiya.

7.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ  ، قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ : أَحْسَبُهُ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي وَاقِدٍ اللَّيْثِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْمَدِينَةَ ، وَالنَّاسُ يَجُبُّونَ أَسْنِمَةَ الْإِبِلِ وَأَلْيَاتِ الْغَنَمِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَا قُطِعَ مِنْ بَهِيمَةٍ وَهِيَ حَيَّةٌ، فَهُوَ مَيْتَةٌ "
7.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abdullah ibn Dinar, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from Ata ibn Yasar, from Abu Waqid al-Laythi: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ arrived at Madinah, and the people used to cut off the humps of camels and the fat tails of sheep, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whatever is cut off from a living animal while it is [still] alive, it is [as] dead [meat, i.e. forbidden]."
7.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Abd al-Rahman ibn Abdullah ibn Dinar se bataya: Mujhse Zayd ibn Aslam ne bataya - Abd al-Rahman kehte hain: mera khayal hai - Ata ibn Yasar se, Abu Waqid al-Laythi se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ Madinah pahunche, aur log oonton ki kohaanein aur bhedon ki dumein kaat lete the, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jo bhi kisi zinda jaanwar se uski zindagi mein kaat liya jaaye, woh murda [gosht ke hukum mein] hai."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ لَهُ :" سَمِّ اللَّهَ وَكُلْ مِمَّا يَلِيكَ "
8.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Wahb ibn Kaysan, from Umar ibn Abi Salamah: That the Prophet ﷺ said to him: "Mention the name of Allah, and eat from what is near you."
8.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Wahb ibn Kaysan se, Umar ibn Abi Salamah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne unse farmaya: "Bismillah kaho, aur jo tumhare qareeb hai usme se khaao."

8.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ بُدَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَأْكُلُ طَعَامًا فِي سِتَّةِ نَفَرٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ، فَجَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَأَكَلَهُ بِلُقْمَتَيْنِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَمَا إِنَّهُ لَوْ ذَكَرَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ، لَكَفَاكُمْ، فَإِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ، فَلْيَذْكُرْ اسْمَ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ نَسِيَ أَنْ يَذْكُرَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ، فَلْيَقُلْ : بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ ".
أَخْبَرَنَا بُنْدَارٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ بُدَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ كُلْثُومٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ
8.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hisham, from Budayl, from Abdullah ibn Ubayd ibn Umayr, from Aisha; a similar chain also via Bundar: That the Prophet ﷺ used to eat food with six people from among his companions, so a Bedouin came and ate it in two mouthfuls, so the Prophet ﷺ said: "Had he mentioned the name of Allah, it would have sufficed you, so when one of you eats, let him mention the name of Allah, and if he forgets to mention the name of Allah, let him say: 'In the name of Allah, at its beginning and at its end.'" [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Bundar, from Mu'adh ibn Hisham, from his father, from Budayl, from Abdullah ibn Ubayd ibn Umayr, from Umm Kulthum, from Aisha, with this hadith.]
8.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hisham se, Budayl se, Abdullah ibn Ubayd ibn Umayr se, Aisha se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ apne chhe sathiyon ke saath khaana khaa rahe the, to ek Bedouin aaya aur usay do lukmon mein khaa gaya, to Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Agar usne Allah ka naam liya hota, to yeh tum sabko kaafi hota, so jab tum mein se koi khaaye, to Allah ka naam le, aur agar Allah ka naam lena bhool jaaye, to kahe: 'Bismillahi awwalahu wa aakhirahu.'" [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Bundar se, Mu'adh ibn Hisham se, apne walid se, Budayl se, Abdullah ibn Ubayd ibn Umayr se, Umm Kulthum se, Aisha se bhi aayi hai.]

8.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ  ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُسْرٍ   وَكَانَتْ لَهُ صُحْبَةٌ يَسِيرَةٌ ، قَالَ : قَالَ أَبِي لِأُمِّي : لَوْ صَنَعْتِ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ طَعَامًا؟ فَصَنَعَتْ ثَرِيدَةً، وَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ يُقْلِلُ، فَانْطَلَقَ أَبِي فَدَعَاهُ، فَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَدَهُ عَلَى ذِرْوَتِهَا، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " خُذُوا بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ ".
فَأَخَذُوا مِنْ نَوَاحِيهَا، فَلَمَّا طَعِمُوا دَعَا لَهُمْ، فَقَالَ :" اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ وَبَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي رِزْقِهِمْ "
8.en: Narrated by Musa ibn Khalid, from Isa ibn Yunus, from Safwan ibn Amr, from Abdullah ibn Busr (who had brief companionship [with the Prophet]): He said: My father said to my mother: "If only you prepared food for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" So she prepared tharid, and he gestured with his hand to indicate a small quantity, so my father went and invited him, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ placed his hand on top of it, then said: "Take, in the name of Allah." So they took from its sides, and when they had eaten, he supplicated for them, and said: "O Allah, forgive them, and have mercy on them, and bless them in their provision."
8.hi: Musa ibn Khalid ne Isa ibn Yunus se, Safwan ibn Amr se bataya: Mujhse Abdullah ibn Busr ne, jinki thodi si sohbat thi, bataya: Unhone kaha, Mere walid ne meri maa se kaha: "Kaash tum Rasulullah ﷺ ke liye khaana banaati?"
