To unhone tharid banaayi, aur apne haath se ishara kiya ke kam banaana, so mere walid gaye aur aapko dawat di, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne apna haath uske ooper rakha, fir farmaya: "Allah ke naam se lo." So unhone iske kinaaron se liya, aur jab woh khaa chuke, to aapne unke liye dua ki, aur farmaya: "Allahumma-ghfir lahum wa-rhamhum wa baarik lahum fi rizqihim" [Ae Allah, unhein bakhsh de, aur unpar reham kar, aur unke rizq mein barkat de].

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ الْأَسَدِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَوْرٌ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَكَلَ أَوْ شَرِبَ، قَالَ :" الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، غَيْرَ مَكْفُورٍ، وَلَا مُوَدَّعٍ، وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْ رَبِّنَا "
8.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Qasim al-Asadi, from Thawr, from Khalid ibn Ma'dan, from Abu Umamah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he ate or drank, said: "Al-hamdu lillahi hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fih, ghayra makfurin, wa la muwadda'in, wa la mustaghnan 'an Rabbina" [All praise be to Allah, abundant, good, blessed praise, not disbelieved-in, nor bidden farewell, nor dispensed-with from our Lord].
8.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Qasim al-Asadi ne Thawr se, Khalid ibn Ma'dan se, Abu Umamah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ jab khaate ya peete, to farmaate: "Al-hamdu lillahi hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubaarakan feeh, ghayra makfoorin, wa laa muwadda'in, wa laa mustaghnan 'an Rabbinaa" [Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai, bahut, achhi, barkat wali tareef, jo na inkaar ki jaaye, na chhodi jaaye, na jiske bagair kaam chal sake, humare Rab se].

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي حُرَّةَ  ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ  ، عَنْ سِنَانِ بْنِ سَنَّةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" الطَّاعِمُ الشَّاكِرُ كَالصَّائِمِ الصَّابِرِ "
8.en: Narrated by Nu'aym ibn Hammad, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Hurrah, from his uncle, from Sinan ibn Sannah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The grateful eater is like the patient faster."
8.hi: Nu'aym ibn Hammad ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Hurrah se, apne chacha se, Sinan ibn Sannah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Shukar karne wala khaane wala sabr karne wale roze wale jaisa hai."

8.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ عِيسَى  ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ، فَلْيَلْعَقْ أَصَابِعَهُ الثَّلَاثَ "
8.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Isa, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Thabit, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "When one of you eats, let him lick his three fingers."
8.hi: Ishaq ibn Isa ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Thabit se, Anas se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se koi khaaye, to woh apni teen ungliyan chaate."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ، فَلَا يَمْسَحْ يَدَهُ حَتَّى يَلْعَقَ أَصَابِعَهُ أَوْ يُلْعِقَهَا "
8.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Ibn Uyaynah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Ata, from Ibn Abbas: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "When one of you eats, let him not wipe his hand until he licks his fingers or has them licked."
8.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Ibn Uyaynah se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Ata se, Ibn Abbas se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi khaaye, to apna haath tab tak na poonchhe jab tak apni ungliyan chaat na le ya chatwaa na le."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ الْبَرَّاءُ وَهُوَ : مُعَلَّى بْنُ رَاشِدٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَتْنِي جَدَّتِي أُمُّ عَاصِمٍ  ، قَالَتْ : دَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا نُبَيْشَةُ   مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَنَحْنُ نَأْكُلُ طَعَامًا، فَدَعَوْنَاهُ، فَأَكَلَ مَعَنَا، ثُمَّ قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ :" مَنْ أَكَلَ فِي قَصْعَةٍ ثُمَّ لَحِسَهَا، اسْتَغْفَرَتْ لَهُ الْقَصْعَةُ "
8.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Abu al-Yaman al-Barra' (Mu'alla ibn Rashid), from his grandmother Umm Asim, about Nubayshah: She said: Nubayshah, freed servant of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, entered upon us while we were eating food, so we invited him, and he ate with us, then said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ narrated to us that: "Whoever eats from a bowl then licks it clean, the bowl seeks forgiveness for him."
8.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Abu al-Yaman al-Barra' se bataya (jo Mu'alla ibn Rashid hain): Unhone kaha, Mujhse meri dadi Umm Asim ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Nubayshah, Rasulullah ﷺ ke azaad kiye hue ghulam, humare paas aaye jabke hum khaana khaa rahe the, to humne unhein dawat di, aur unhone humare saath khaya, fir kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein bataya ke: "Jo bartan mein khaana khaaye fir usay chaat le, to bartan uske liye maghfirat ki dua karta hai."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا سَقَطَتْ لُقْمَةُ أَحَدِكُمْ، فَلْيَمْسَحْ عَنْهَا التُّرَابَ، وَلْيُسَمِّ اللَّهَ، وَلْيَأْكُلْهَا "
8.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Isa, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Thabit, from Anas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When the morsel of one of you falls, let him wipe off the dirt from it, and mention the name of Allah, and eat it."
8.hi: Ishaq ibn Isa ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Thabit se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se kisi ka lukma gir jaaye, to woh usse mitti poonchh de, aur Allah ka naam le, aur usay khaa le."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ مَعْقِلُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ   يَتَغَدَّى، فَسَقَطَتْ لُقْمَتُهُ، فَأَخَذَهَا فَأَمَاطَ مَا بِهَا مِنْ أَذًى، ثُمَّ أَكَلَهَا، قَالَ : فَجَعَلَ أُولَئِكَ الدَّهَاقِينُ يَتَغَامَزُونَ بِهِ، فَقَالُوا لَهُ : مَا تَرَى مَا يَقُولُ هَؤُلَاءِ الْأَعَاجِمُ، يَقُولُونَ : انْظُرُوا إِلَى مَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنْ الطَّعَامِ، وَإِلَى مَا يَصْنَعُ بِهَذِهِ اللُّقْمَةِ؟ فَقَالَ : إِنِّي لَمْ أَكُنْ أَدَعُ مَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِقَوْلِ هَؤُلَاءِ الْأَعَاجِمِ، " إِنَّا كُنَّانُؤْمَرُ إِذَا سَقَطَتْ لُقْمَةُ أَحَدِنَا أَنْ يُمِيطَ مَا بِهَا مِنْ الْأَذَى، وَأَنْ يَأْكُلَهَا "
8.en: Narrated by Zakariya ibn Adi, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Yunus, from al-Hasan, about Ma'qil ibn Yasar: He said: Ma'qil ibn Yasar was having lunch, and his morsel fell, so he took it and removed what dirt was on it, then ate it, he said: So those Persian nobles began winking at each other about him, and they said to him: "Do you not see what these foreigners are saying, they say: Look at how much food is in front of him, and at what he does with this morsel?" So he said: I would not leave what I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for the saying of these foreigners, "we were indeed commanded, when the morsel of one of us fell, to remove what dirt was on it, and to eat it."
8.hi: Zakariya ibn Adi ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Yunus se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ma'qil ibn Yasar khaana khaa rahe the, unka lukma gir gaya, to unhone usay uthaya aur usmein se jo gandagi thi use hataaya, fir usay khaaya, unhone bataya: To woh farsi zameendaar unke baare mein aankh maarne lage, aur unse kaha: "Kya aapko nahi maloom yeh gair-Arab log kya kehte hain, woh kehte hain: Dekho unke saamne kitna khaana hai, aur woh is lukme ke saath kya kar rahe hain?" To unhone kaha: Main Rasulullah ﷺ se suni hui baat ko in gair-Arab logon ki baat ki wajah se nahi chhodunga, "humein hukum diya gaya tha ke jab humme se kisi ka lukma gire, to woh usmein se gandagi hataaye, aur usay khaa le."

8.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَلَّي الْحَنَفِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ، فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِيَمِينِهِ، وَلْيَشْرَبْ بِيَمِينِهِ، فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَأْكُلُ بِشِمَالِهِ وَيَشْرَبُ بِشِمَالِهِ ".
 أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، بِنَحْوِهِ
8.en: Narrated by Abu Ali al-Hanafi, from Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Bakr ibn Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Umar, from Abdullah ibn Umar; a similar chain also via Amr ibn Awn: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you eats, let him eat with his right hand, and let him drink with his right hand, for indeed the Shaytan eats with his left hand and drinks with his left hand." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Amr ibn Awn, from Ibn Uyaynah, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Bakr, from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet ﷺ, near it.]
8.hi: Abu Ali al-Hanafi ne Malik se, Ibn Shihab se, Abu Bakr ibn Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Umar se, Abdullah ibn Umar se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jab tum mein se koi khaaye, to daaye haath se khaaye, aur daaye haath se piye, kyunki shaytan baaye haath se khaata hai aur baaye haath se peeta hai." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Amr ibn Awn se, Ibn Uyaynah se, al-Zuhri se, Abu Bakr se, Ibn Umar se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi is ke qareeb aayi hai.]

8.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي إِيَاسُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي  ، قَالَ : أَبْصَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بُسْرَ بْنَ رَاعِي الْعِيرِ يَأْكُلُ بِشِمَالِهِ، فَقَالَ :" كُلْ بِيَمِينِكَ ".
قَالَ : لَا أَسْتَطِيعُ، قَالَ : " لَا اسْتَطَعْتَ ".
قَالَ : فَمَا وَصَلَتْ يَمِينُهُ إِلَى فِيهِ
8.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Ikrimah ibn Ammar, from Iyas ibn Salamah, from his father: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw Busr, the herder of the caravan's camels, eating with his left hand, so he said: "Eat with your right." He said, "I cannot." He said: "May you not be able to!" He said: So his right hand never again reached his mouth [i.e., it became paralyzed].
8.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Ikrimah ibn Ammar se bataya: Mujhse Iyas ibn Salamah ne bataya: Mujhse mere walid ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne Busr, qaafile ke oonton ke charwaahe, ko baaye haath se khaate dekha, to farmaya: "Daaye haath se khaao." Usne kaha, "Main nahi kar sakta." Aapne farmaya: "Tu kabhi na kar sake!" Unhone bataya: To uska daaya haath phir kabhi uske muh tak nahi pahuncha.

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ الْمَدَنِيِّ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" يَأْكُلُ بِثَلَاثِ أَصَابِعَ، وَلَا يَمْسَحُ يَدَهُ حَتَّى يَلْعَقَهَا "
8.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abu Mu'awiyah, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Sa'd al-Madani, from Ibn Ka'b ibn Malik, from his father: He said: The Prophet ﷺ used to "eat with three fingers, and would not wipe his hand until he had licked it."
8.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Abu Mu'awiyah se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Sa'd al-Madani se, Ibn Ka'b ibn Malik se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ "teen ungliyon se khaate the, aur apna haath tab tak na poonchhte jab tak use chaat na lete."

8.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ الْمَدَنِيِّ  ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ كَعْبٍ  أَوْ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ كَعْبٍ  شَكَّ هِشَامٌ أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" يَأْكُلُ بِأَصَابِعِهِ الثَّلَاثِ، فَإِذَا فَرَغَ، لَعِقَهَا "، وَأَشَارَ هِشَامٌ بِأَصَابِعِهِ الثَّلَاثِ
8.en: Narrated by Musa ibn Khalid, from Isa ibn Yunus, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Sa'd al-Madani, from Abdullah ibn Ka'b or Abd al-Rahman ibn Ka'b, from his father: That the Prophet ﷺ used to "eat with his three fingers, and when he finished, he would lick them," and Hisham gestured with his three fingers.
8.hi: Musa ibn Khalid ne Isa ibn Yunus se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Sa'd al-Madani se bataya ke Abdullah ibn Ka'b, ya Abd al-Rahman ibn Ka'b - Hisham ko shak tha - ne unhein bataya, apne walid se: ke Nabi ﷺ "apni teen ungliyon se khaate the, aur jab faarigh hote, to unhein chaat lete," aur Hisham ne apni teen ungliyon se ishara kiya.

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ الْخُزَاعِيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ :" مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ، فَلْيُكْرِمْ جَارَهُ ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ، فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا، أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ، فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ، جَائِزَتَهُ يَوْمًا وَلَيْلَةً، وَالضِّيَافَةُ ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ صَدَقَةٌ "
8.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id, from Abu Shurayh al-Khuza'i: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his neighbor, and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him say good or remain silent, and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his guest, his reward [of special hospitality] for a day and a night, and hospitality is three days, and whatever is beyond that is charity."
8.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id se, Abu Shurayh al-Khuza'i se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta ho, woh apne padosi ki izzat kare, aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta ho, woh achhi baat kahe ya khamosh rahe, aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta ho, woh apne mehmaan ki izzat kare, uska hissa ek din aur ek raat hai, aur mehmaan-nawaazi teen din hai, aur uske baad jo hai woh sadqa hai."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ نَافِعَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ الْخُزَاعِيِّ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ، فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ، فَلْيُحْسِنْ إِلَى جَارِهِ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ، فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَسْكُتْ "
8.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Nafi' ibn Jubayr, from Abu Shurayh al-Khuza'i: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his guest, and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him do good to his neighbor, and whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him say good or remain silent."
8.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Amr ibn Dinar ko suna: Unhone kaha, Maine Nafi' ibn Jubayr ko suna, Abu Shurayh al-Khuza'i se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta ho, woh apne mehmaan ki izzat kare, aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta ho, woh apne padosi se achhaai kare, aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta ho, woh achhi baat kahe ya khamosh rahe."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْجُودِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ  ، عَنْ الْمِقْدَامِ بْنِ مَعْدِي كَرِبَ : أَبِي كَرِيمَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَيُّمَا مُسْلِمٍ ضَافَ قَوْمًا، فَأَصْبَحَ الضَّيْفُ مَحْرُومًا، فَإِنَّ عَلَى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ نَصْرَهُ حَتَّى يَأْخُذَ لَهُ بِقِرَى لَيْلَتِهِ مِنْ زَرْعِهِ وَمَالِهِ "
8.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Shu'bah, from Abu al-Judi, from Sa'id ibn al-Muhajir, from al-Miqdam ibn Ma'dikarib, Abu Karimah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whichever Muslim visits a people [as a guest], and the guest becomes deprived [of hospitality], then it is upon every Muslim to help him until he takes for himself, from their crops and their wealth, the provision for his night."
8.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Shu'bah se, Abu al-Judi se, Sa'id ibn al-Muhajir se, al-Miqdam ibn Ma'dikarib se (Abu Karimah) bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo Musalman kisi qaum ke paas mehmaan bane, aur mehmaan mehroom reh jaaye, to har Musalman par uski madad karna zaroori hai yahan tak ke woh unki kheti aur maal mein se apni raat ki mehmaan-nawaazi le le."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ  ، أَنَّ عُبَيْدَ بْنَ حُنَيْنٍ  أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا سَقَطَ الذُّبَابُ فِي شَرَابِ أَحَدِكُمْ، فَلْيَغْمِسْهُ كُلَّهُ ثُمَّ لِيَنْزِعْهُ، فَإِنَّ فِي أَحَدِ جَنَاحَيْهِ دَاءً، وَفِي الْآخَرِ شِفَاءً "
8.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Maslamah, from Sulayman ibn Bilal, from Utbah ibn Muslim, from Ubayd ibn Hunayn, from Abu Hurairah: That he heard him say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When a fly falls into the drink of one of you, let him immerse it completely, then remove it, for indeed in one of its wings is a disease, and in the other is a cure."
8.hi: Abdullah ibn Maslamah ne Sulayman ibn Bilal se, Utbah ibn Muslim se bataya ke Ubayd ibn Hunayn ne unhein bataya, ke unhone Abu Hurairah ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se kisi ke peene ki cheez mein makkhi gir jaaye, to use poora doob de, fir nikaal de, kyunki uske ek par mein bimari hai, aur doosre mein shifa."

8.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ ثُمَامَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِذَا وَقَعَ الذُّبَابُ فِي إِنَاءِ أَحَدِكُمْ، فَلْيَغْمِسْهُ، فَإِنَّ فِي أَحَدِ جَنَاحَيْهِ دَاءً، وَفِي الْآخَرِ شِفَاءً ".
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : قَالَ غَيْرُ  حَمَّادٍ  : ثُمَامَةُ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، مَكَانَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ . وَقَوْمٌ  يَقُولُونَ : عَنْ الْقَعْقَاع  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، وَحَدِيثُ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ أَصَحُّ
8.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Thumamah ibn Abdullah ibn Anas, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ; with Abu Muhammad's note: He said: "When a fly falls into the vessel of one of you, let him immerse it, for indeed in one of its wings is a disease, and in the other is a cure." Abu Muhammad said: Others besides Hammad said: Thumamah, from Anas, in place of Abu Hurairah. And some people say: from al-Qa'qa', from Abu Hurairah, and the hadith of Ubayd ibn Hunayn is more authentic.
8.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Thumamah ibn Abdullah ibn Anas se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se kisi ke bartan mein makkhi gir jaaye, to use doob de, kyunki uske ek par mein bimari hai, aur doosre mein shifa." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Hammad ke ilaawa doosron ne kaha: Thumamah, Anas se, Abu Hurairah ki jagah. Aur kuch log kehte hain: al-Qa'qa' se, Abu Hurairah se, aur Ubayd ibn Hunayn ki hadith zyada sahih hai.

8.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ   رَضِيَ اللهِ عَنْهُ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" الْمُؤْمِنُ يَأْكُلُ فِي مِعًى وَاحِدٍ، وَالْكَافِرُ يَأْكُلُ فِي سَبْعَةِ أَمْعَاءٍ ".
 أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْوَدَّاكِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ   ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
8.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir رضي الله عنه, from the Prophet ﷺ; a similar chain also via Ubaydullah ibn Umar al-Qawariri: He said: "The believer eats in one intestine, and the disbeliever eats in seven intestines." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Ubaydullah ibn Umar al-Qawariri, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet ﷺ. And Yahya narrated to me also, from Mujalid, from Abu al-Waddak, from Abu Sa'id, from the Prophet ﷺ.]
8.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir رضي الله عنه se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Momin ek aant mein khaata hai, aur kaafir saat aanton mein khaata hai." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Ubaydullah ibn Umar al-Qawariri se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai. Aur mujhse Yahya ne bhi bataya, Mujalid se, Abu al-Waddak se, Abu Sa'id se, Nabi ﷺ se.]

8.ar: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" الْمُؤْمِنُ يَأْكُلُ فِي مِعًى وَاحِدٍ، وَالْكَافِرُ يَأْكُلُ فِي سَبْعَةِ أَمْعَاءٍ "
8.en: Continuing narrated by Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "The believer eats in one intestine, and the disbeliever eats in seven intestines."
8.hi: Mujhse Yahya ne bataya, Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Momin ek aant mein khaata hai, aur kaafir saat aanton mein khaata hai."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" طَعَامُ الْوَاحِدِ يَكْفِي الِاثْنَيْنِ، وَطَعَامُ الِاثْنَيْنِ يَكْفِي الْأَرْبَعَةَ، وَطَعَامُ الْأَرْبَعَةِ يَكْفِي ثَمَانِيَةً "
8.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "The food of one suffices for two, and the food of two suffices for four, and the food of four suffices for eight."
8.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Ek aadmi ka khaana do ke liye kaafi hai, aur do ka khaana chaar ke liye, aur chaar ka khaana aath ke liye."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ لَهُ :" سَمِّ اللَّهَ وَكُلْ مِمَّا يَلِيكَ "
8.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Wahb ibn Kaysan, from Umar ibn Abi Salamah: That the Prophet ﷺ said to him: "Say Bismillah, and eat from what is near you."
8.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Wahb ibn Kaysan se, Umar ibn Abi Salamah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne unse farmaya: "Bismillah kaho, aur jo tumhare qareeb hai usme se khaao."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أُتِيَ بِجَفْنَةٍ، أَوْ قَالَ : قَصْعَةٍ مِنْ ثَرِيدٍ فَقَالَ :" كُلُوا مِنْ حَافَاتِهَا أَوْ قَالَ : جَوَانِبِهَا وَلَا تَأْكُلُوا مِنْ وَسَطِهَا، فَإِنَّ الْبَرَكَةَ تَنْزِلُ فِي وَسَطِهَا "
8.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was brought a large bowl, or he said: a bowl, of tharid, so he said: "Eat from its edges, or he said: its sides, and do not eat from its middle, for indeed the blessing descends in its middle."
8.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Ata ibn al-Sa'ib se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas ek badi tashtari, ya farmaya: kaasa, tharid ki laayi gayi, to aapne farmaya: "Iske kinaaron se khaao, ya farmaya: iske aas-paas se, aur iske beech se na khaao, kyunki barkat iske beech mein utarti hai."

8.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ  ، عَنْ قُرَّةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ  ، أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ إِذَا أُتِيَتْ بِثَرِيدٍ، أَمَرَتْ بِهِ فَغُطِّيَ حَتَّى يَذْهَبَ فَوْرَةُ دُخَانِهِ، وَتَقُولُ : إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" هُوَ أَعْظَمُ لِلْبَرَكَةِ "
8.en: Narrated by Abd al-Rahman ibn Ibrahim al-Dimashqi, from Ibn Wahb, from Qurrah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Asma bint Abi Bakr: That she, when tharid was brought to her, would command that it be covered until its steam had gone, and would say: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'It is greater for the blessing.'"
8.hi: Abd al-Rahman ibn Ibrahim al-Dimashqi ne Ibn Wahb se, Qurrah ibn Abd al-Rahman se, al-Zuhri se, Urwah se, Asma bint Abi Bakr se bataya ke woh jab unke paas tharid laaya jaata, to hukum detin ke use dhaka jaaye jab tak uski bhaap na nikal jaaye, aur kehtin: "Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, 'Yeh barkat ke liye zyada behtar hai.'"

8.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُثَنَّى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا طَلْحَةُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  : أَبُو سُفْيَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : أَخَذَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِيَدِي ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ إِلَى مَنْزِلِهِ، فَقَالَ : " هَلْ مِنْ غَدَاءٍ أَوْ مِنْ عَشَاءٍ؟ " شَكَّ طَلْحَةُ.
 قَالَ : فَأَخْرَجَ إِلَيْهِ فِلَقٌ مِنْ خُبْزٍ، فَقَالَ : " مَا مِنْ أُدْمٍ؟ " قَالُوا : لَا، إِلَّا شَيْءٌ مِنْ خَلٍّ، فَقَالَ : " هَاتُوهُ،فَنِعْمَ الْإِدَامُ الْخَلُّ ".
قَالَ جَابِرٌ : فَمَا زِلْتُ أُحِبُّ الْخَلَّ مُنْذُ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
فَقَالَ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ : فَمَا زِلْتُ أُحِبُّهُ مُنْذُ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ جَابِرٍ
8.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Muthanna ibn Sa'id, from Talhah ibn Nafi' (Abu Sufyan), from Jabir ibn Abdullah: He said: The Prophet ﷺ took my hand one day toward his house, and said: "Is there any lunch, or dinner?" - Talhah was uncertain. He said: So he brought out to him some pieces of bread, so he said: "Is there no seasoning?" They said: "No, except something of vinegar." So he said: "Bring it, for vinegar is an excellent seasoning." Jabir said: So I never ceased loving vinegar since I heard it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. So Abu Sufyan said: I never ceased loving it since I heard it from Jabir.
8.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Muthanna ibn Sa'id se bataya: Mujhse Talhah ibn Nafi' (Abu Sufyan) ne bataya: Humse Jabir ibn Abdullah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ ne mera haath pakda ek din apne ghar ki taraf, aur poocha: "Kya khaana hai, naashta ya raat ka khaana?" Talhah ko shak tha. Unhone bataya: To unhone aapke saamne roti ke kuch tukde nikaale, to aapne poocha: "Koi salaan nahi?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, siwaay thode se sirke ke." To aapne farmaya: "Laao, sirka behtareen salaan hai." Jabir ne bataya: To main tab se sirke se mohabbat karta hoon jab se maine yeh Rasulullah ﷺ se suna hai. To Abu Sufyan ne kaha: Main bhi tab se isse mohabbat karta hoon jab se maine yeh Jabir se suna.

8.ar: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، ، قَالَ :" نِعْمَ الْإِدَامُ أَوْ الْأُدْمُ الْخَلُّ "
8.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Sulayman ibn Bilal, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Vinegar is an excellent seasoning."
8.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Sulayman ibn Bilal se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Aisha se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Sirka behtareen salaan hai."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ إِسْحَاق بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ  ،  عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : " رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أُتِيَ بِمَرَقَةٍ فِيهَا دُبَّاءٌ وَقَدِيدٌ، فَرَأَيْتُهُيَتَتَبَّعُ الدُّبَّاءَ يَأْكُلُهُ "
8.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Malik, from Ishaq ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah, from Anas: He said: "I saw the Prophet ﷺ being brought a broth in which there was gourd and dried meat, and I saw him seeking out the gourd, eating it."
8.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Malik se, Ishaq ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Maine Nabi ﷺ ko dekha ke aapke paas ek shorba laaya gaya jismein kaddu aur sukha gosht tha, aur maine aapko kaddu talaash karke khaate dekha."

8.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : " كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَيُعْجِبُهُ الْقَرْعُ ".
قَالَ : فَقُدِّمَ إِلَيْهِ، فَجَعَلْتُ أَتَنَاوَلُهُ وَأَجْعَلُهُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ
8.en: Narrated by al-Aswad ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from Anas: He said: "The Prophet ﷺ liked the gourd." He said: So it was presented to him, and I began taking it and putting it before him.
8.hi: Al-Aswad ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Qatadah se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Nabi ﷺ ko kaddu pasand tha." Unhone bataya: To woh aapke saamne pesh kiya gaya, aur main isay le-le kar aapke saamne rakhne laga.

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عِيسَى  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  وَلَيْسَ بِابْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي أَسِيدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" كُلُوا الزَّيْتَ فَإِنَّهُ مُبَارَكٌ، وَائْتَدِمُوا بِهِ، وَادَّهِنُوا بِهِ، فَإِنَّهُ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ مُبَارَكَةٍ "
8.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from Abdullah ibn Isa, from Ata (not Ibn Abi Rabah), from Abu Usayd al-Ansari: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Eat olive oil, for indeed it is blessed, and use it as a seasoning, and anoint yourselves with it, for indeed it comes from a blessed tree."
8.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se, Abdullah ibn Isa se, Ata se (jo Ibn Abi Rabah nahi hain) bataya, Abu Usayd al-Ansari se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Zaitoon ka tel khaao, kyunki yeh bara-barkat hai, aur ise salaan banaao, aur isse malo, kyunki yeh ek bara-barkat darakht se nikalta hai."

8.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ فِي غَزْوَةِ خَيْبَرَ :" مَنْ أَكَلَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ يَعْنِي : الثُّومَ، فَلَا يَأْتِيَنَّ الْمَسَاجِدَ "
8.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That the Prophet ﷺ said during the expedition of Khaybar: "Whoever eats from this plant - meaning: garlic - let him not come near the mosques."
8.hi: Musaddad ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne ghazwa-e-Khaybar mein farmaya: "Jo is paudhe se khaaye - yaani, lehsun - to woh masjidon ke qareeb na aaye."

8.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، أَنَّ أُمَّ أَيُّوبَ   أَخْبَرَتْهُ، قَالَتْ : نَزَلَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَتَكَلَّفْنَا لَهُ طَعَامًا فِيهِ شَيْءٌ مِنْ بَعْضِ هَذِهِ الْبُقُولِ، فَلَمَّا أَتَيْنَاهُ بِهِ كَرِهَهُ، وَقَالَ لِأَصْحَابِهِ :" كُلُوهُ، فَإِنِّي لَسْتُ كَأَحَدٍ مِنْكُمْ، إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ أُوذِيَ صَاحِبِي ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : إِذَا لَمْ يُؤْذِ أَحَدًا، فَلَا بَأْسَ بِأَكْلِهِ
8.en: Narrated by Ali ibn Abdullah, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Ubaydullah ibn Abi Yazid, from his father, from Umm Ayyub; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stayed with us, so we made an effort for him with food in which there was something of these vegetables, so when we brought it to him, he disliked it, and said to his companions: "Eat it, for I am not like any of you, indeed I fear that I would trouble my companion." Abu Muhammad said: If it does not trouble anyone, then there is no harm in eating it.
8.hi: Ali ibn Abdullah ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se bataya: Mujhse Ubaydullah ibn Abi Yazid ne bataya, apne walid se: ke Umm Ayyub ne unhein bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ humare paas thehre, to humne aapke liye ek khaana taiyaar karne mein mehnat ki jismein in saagon mein se kuch tha, to jab humne aapke paas laaya, aapne isay na-pasand kiya, aur apne sathiyon se farmaya: "Isay khaao, kyunki main tum mein se kisi jaisa nahi hoon, mujhe dar hai ke main apne sathi ko takleef pahunchaaun." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Agar isse kisi ko takleef na ho, to isay khaane mein koi harj nahi.

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ التَّمِيمِيِّ  ، عَنْ زَهْدَمٍ الْجَرْمِيِّ  ، قَالَ : كُنَّا عِنْدَ أَبِي مُوسَى فَقُدِّمَ طَعَامُهُ، فَقُدِّمَ فِي طَعَامِهِ لَحْمُ دَجَاجٍ، وَفِي الْقَوْمِ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي تَيْمِ اللَّهِ أَحْمَرُ، فَلَمْ يَدْنُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُو مُوسَى   : " ادْنُ، فَإِنِّي قَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَيَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ "
8.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Ulayyah, from Ayyub, from al-Qasim al-Tamimi, from Zahdam al-Jarmi: He said: We were with Abu Musa, and his food was brought, and chicken meat was in his food, and among the group was a red-complexioned man from Banu Taym Allah, so he did not come near, so Abu Musa said to him: "Come near, for I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ eating from it."
8.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Ibn Ulayyah se, Ayyub se, al-Qasim al-Tamimi se, Zahdam al-Jarmi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Hum Abu Musa ke paas the, to unka khaana laaya gaya, aur unke khaane mein murgi ka gosht tha, aur jama'at mein Banu Taym Allah ka ek surkh-rang aadmi tha, so woh qareeb nahi aaya, to Abu Musa ne usse kaha: "Qareeb aao, kyunki maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko isse khaate dekha hai."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ زَهْدَمٍ الْجَرْمِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى  ، أَنَّهُذَكَرَ الدَّجَاجَ، فَقَالَ : " رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَأْكُلُهُ "
8.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah, from Zahdam al-Jarmi, from Abu Musa: That he mentioned chicken, and said: "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ eating it."
8.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Ayyub se, Abu Qilabah se, Zahdam al-Jarmi se, Abu Musa se bataya ke unhone murgi ka zikr kiya, aur kaha: "Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko isay khaate dekha hai."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْمُقْرِئُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَالِمُ بْنُ غَيْلَانَ  : أَنَّ الْوَلِيدَ بْنَ قَيْسٍ  أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ  ، أَوْ عَنْ أَبِي الْهَيْثَمِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ :" لَا تَصْحَبْ إِلَّا مُؤْمِنًا، وَلَا يَأْكُلْ طَعَامَكَ إِلَّا تَقِيٌّ "
8.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid al-Muqri, from Haywah, from Salim ibn Ghaylan, from al-Walid ibn Qays, from Abu Sa'id or Abu al-Haytham, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: That he heard the Prophet of Allah ﷺ say: "Do not accompany [as a close friend] except a believer, and let none eat your food except a pious person."
8.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid al-Muqri ne Haywah se bataya: Mujhse Salim ibn Ghaylan ne bataya: ke al-Walid ibn Qays ne unhein bataya, ke unhone Abu Sa'id, ya Abu al-Haytham se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se suna: ke unhone Nabi Allah ﷺ ko farmaate suna: "Sirf momin ko apna saathi banao, aur tumhara khaana sirf taqwa wala hi khaaye."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ  ، قَالَ : " رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَيَأْكُلُ الْقِثَّاءَ بِالرُّطَبِ "
8.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibrahim ibn Sa'd, from his father, from Abdullah ibn Ja'far: He said: "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ eating cucumber with fresh dates."
8.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Ibrahim ibn Sa'd se, apne walid se, Abdullah ibn Ja'far se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko khira taazi khajooron ke saath khaate dekha."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَبَلَةُ بْنُ سُحَيْمٍ  ، قَالَ : كُنَّا بِالْمَدِينَةِ ، فَأَصَابَتْنَا سَنَةٌ، فَكَانَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ يَرْزُقُ التَّمْرَ، وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ   يَمُرُّ بِنَا وَيَقُولُ : لَا تُقَارِنُوا، فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" نَهَى عَنْ الْقِرَانِ، إِلَّا أَنْ يَسْتَأْذِنَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ "
8.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from Jabalah ibn Suhaym, about Ibn al-Zubayr and Ibn Umar: He said: We were at Madinah, and a year of famine struck us, so Ibn al-Zubayr used to provide dates as sustenance, and Ibn Umar used to pass by us and say: Do not combine [two dates in one hand at a time], for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "forbade combining [dates], except that a man ask permission of his brother."
8.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Shu'bah se bataya: Mujhse Jabalah ibn Suhaym ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Hum Madinah mein the, to humpar kaal ka saal pada, so Ibn al-Zubayr khajoor bataur rizq deta tha, aur Ibn Umar humare paas se guzarte aur kehte: Do-do na milaao, kyunki Rasulullah ﷺ ne "do khajoorein saath milaane se mana kiya, siwaay iske ke aadmi apne bhai se ijaazat le le."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ طَحْلَاءَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الرِّجَالِ  ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ عَمْرَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ : " يَا عَائِشَةُ ،بَيْتٌ لَا تَمْرَ فِيهِ جِيَاعٌ أَهْلُهُ أَوْ جَاعَ أَهْلُهُ " مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلَاثًا
8.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Maslamah, from Ya'qub ibn Muhammad ibn Tahla', from Abu al-Rijal, from his mother Amrah, from Aisha, wife of the Prophet ﷺ: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O Aisha, a house with no dates in it, its people are hungry," or "its people go hungry," two or three times.
8.hi: Abdullah ibn Maslamah ne Ya'qub ibn Muhammad ibn Tahla' se, Abu al-Rijal se, apni maa Amrah se, Aisha, Nabi ﷺ ki biwi, se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Ae Aisha, jis ghar mein khajoor na ho, uske log bhookhe hain," ya "uske log bhookhe rehte hain," do ya teen martaba.

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" لَا يَجُوعُ أَهْلُ بَيْتٍ عِنْدَهُمْ التَّمْرُ "
8.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Sulayman ibn Bilal, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "The people of a house with dates near them do not go hungry."
8.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Sulayman ibn Bilal se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Aisha se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jis ghar ke paas khajoor ho, uske log bhookhe nahi rehte."

8.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُصْعَبُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ   يَقُولُ :" أُهْدِيَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ تَمْرٌ فَأَخَذَ يُهَدِّيهِ "
8.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Mus'ab ibn Sulaym, from Anas ibn Malik: He said: I heard Anas ibn Malik say: "Dates were given to the Prophet ﷺ as a gift, so he began giving them out as gifts [in turn]."
8.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Mus'ab ibn Sulaym se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Anas ibn Malik ko kehte suna: "Nabi ﷺ ko khajoorein tohfe mein di gayin, to aap unhein [aage] tohfe mein dene lage."

8.ar:
وَقَالَ : " رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَيَأْكُلُ تَمْرًا مُقْعِيًا مِنْ الْجُوعِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : يُهَدِّيهِ : يَعْنِي : يُرْسِلُهُ هَهُنَا وَهَهُنَا
8.en: Continuing the narration from Anas ibn Malik [previous hadith]; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: And he said: "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ eating dates, squatting, out of hunger." Abu Muhammad said: 'Yuhaddihi' means: he sends it here and there.
8.hi: Aur unhone kaha: "Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko khajoorein khaate dekha, ukdu baithe hue, bhookh ki wajah se." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: 'Yuhaddihi' ka matlab hai: woh use idhar-udhar bhejta hai.

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ نَامَ وَفِي يَدِهِ رِيحُ غَمَرٍ فَعَرَضَ لَهُ عَارِضٌ، فَلَا يَلُومَنَّ إِلَّا نَفْسَهُ "
8.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever sleeps while there is a greasy smell on his hand, and something befalls him [some harm], let him blame no one but himself."
8.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid se, Suhayl se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo aisi haalat mein soye ke uske haath mein chikni (chikai wali) badbu ho, aur usay koi museebat pesh aaye, to woh apni hi jaan ka dosh de."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا حُمَيْدٌ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ لِعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، وَرَأَى عَلَيْهِ وَضَرًا مِنْ صُفْرَةٍ : " مَهْيَمْ؟ " قَالَ : تَزَوَّجْتُ، قَالَ :" أَوْلِمْ وَلَوْ بِشَاةٍ "
8.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Humayd, from Anas: That the Prophet ﷺ, seeing on Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf a trace of yellow [perfume], said to him: "What is this?" He said: I have married. He said: "Give a wedding feast, even if with a single sheep."
8.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Humayd se, Anas se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf par zardi ka nishaan dekh kar unse poocha: "Yeh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: Maine nikaah kiya hai. Aapne farmaya: "Waleema karo, chahe ek hi bhed se ho."

8.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ الثَّقَفِيِّ  ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ  مِنْ ثَقِيفَ أَعْوَرَ، قَالَ : كَانَ يُقَالُ لَهُ مَعْرُوفٌ : أَيْ يُثْنَى عَلَيْهِ خَيْرٌ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ اسْمُهُ زُهَيْرَ بْنَ عُثْمَانَ  ، فَلَا أَدْرِي مَا اسْمُهُ ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" الْوَلِيمَةُ أَوَّلَ يَوْمٍ حَقٌّ، وَالثَّانِيَ مَعْرُوفٌ، وَالثَّالِثَ سُمْعَةٌ وَرِيَاءٌ ".
قَالَ قَتَادَةُ  : وَحَدَّثَنِي رَجُلٌ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، أَنَّهُ دُعِيَ أَوَّلَ يَوْمٍ فَأَجَابَ، وَدُعِيَ الْيَوْمَ الثَّانِيَ فَأَجَابَ، وَدُعِيَ الْيَوْمَ الثَّالِثَ فَحَصَبَ الرَّسُولَ وَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ، وَقَالَ : " أَهْلُ سُمْعَةٍ وَرِيَاءٍ "
8.en: Narrated by Affan, from Hammam, from Qatadah, from al-Hasan, from Abdullah ibn Uthman al-Thaqafi, from a one-eyed man of Thaqif; with Qatadah's added note: He said: he used to be called Ma'ruf: meaning, good was said of him; if his name was not Zuhayr ibn Uthman, then I do not know what his name was; that the Prophet ﷺ said: "The wedding feast: the first day is a right [obligation to attend], and the second is a good deed [voluntary], and the third is for reputation and show." Qatadah said: And a man narrated to me, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab: that he was invited on the first day and he responded, and was invited the second day and he responded, and was invited the third day, so he threw pebbles at the messenger and did not respond to him, and said: "People of reputation and show."
8.hi: Affan ne Hammam se, Qatadah se, al-Hasan se, Abdullah ibn Uthman al-Thaqafi se bataya: Mujhse Thaqif ke ek kaane aadmi ne bataya, jinhein Ma'ruf kaha jaata tha: yaani, unki tareef ki jaati thi; agar unka naam Zuhayr ibn Uthman nahi tha, to mujhe nahi maloom unka naam kya tha; ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, "Waleema, pehle din haq hai, aur doosre din nek amal hai, aur teesre din shohrat aur dikhawa hai." Qatadah kehte hain: Aur mujhse ek aadmi ne bataya, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se: ke unhein pehle din bulaaya gaya to woh gaye, aur doosre din bulaaya gaya to woh gaye, aur teesre din bulaaya gaya, to unhone qasid ko kankariyan maarin aur uski dawat qabool nahi ki, aur kaha: "Shohrat aur dikhawe wale log."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" شَرُّ الطَّعَامِ طَعَامُ الْوَلِيمَةِ، يُدْعَى إِلَيْهِ الْأَغْنِيَاءُ، وَيُتْرَكُ الْمَسَاكِينُ، وَمَنْ تَرَكَ الدَّعْوَةَ، فَقَدْ عَصَى اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ "
8.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from al-Zuhri, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurairah: That he said: "The worst of food is the food of the wedding feast, to which the rich are invited, and the poor are left out, and whoever leaves off the invitation has disobeyed Allah and His Messenger."
8.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se, al-Zuhri se, al-A'raj se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Sabse bura khaana woh hai jo waleeme ka khaana ho, jismein maal-daaron ko bulaaya jaaye, aur miskeenon ko chhod diya jaaye, aur jo dawat chhode, usne Allah aur uske Rasool ki nafarmani ki."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : جَاءَ رَجُلٌ قَدْ صَنَعَ طَعَامًا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَكَذَا وَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ بِيَدِهِ، قَالَ : يَقُولُ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : هَكَذَا، وَأَشَارَ إِلَى عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَ : لَا، فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ الثَّانِيَةَ : وَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ الثَّالِثَةَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " وَهَذِهِ؟ " قَالَ : نَعَمْ، فَانْطَلَقَ مَعَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَائِشَةُفَأَكَلَا مِنْ طَعَامِهِ "
8.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Sulayman, from Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah, from Thabit, from Anas: He said: A man who had prepared food came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, like this," and gestured toward him with his hand, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: like this, and gestured toward Aisha, he said: No, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned away from him, so he gestured to him a second time, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gestured to him, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned away from him, so he gestured to him a third time, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: "And this one?" He said: Yes, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and Aisha went with him, "and the two of them ate from his food."
8.hi: Sa'id ibn Sulayman ne Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah se, Thabit se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi jisne khaana taiyaar kiya tha Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, aise," aur apne haath se aapki taraf ishara kiya, unhone bataya: Rasulullah ﷺ ne usse kaha: aise, aur Aisha ki taraf ishara kiya, usne kaha: nahi, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne usse muh pher liya, so usne dobara ishara kiya, aur Rasulullah ﷺ ne usse ishara kiya, so Rasulullah ﷺ ne usse muh pher liya, so usne teesri baar ishara kiya, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne usse poocha: "Aur yeh [Aisha]?" Usne kaha: Haan, so Rasulullah ﷺ aur Aisha uske saath gaye, "aur dono ne uska khaana khaya."

8.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَجُلٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ أَبُو شُعَيْبٍ، وَكَانَ لَهُ غُلَامٌ لَحَّامٌ، فَقَالَ : اصْنَعْ لِي طَعَامًا أَدْعُو رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَامِسَ خَمْسَةٍ.
قَالَ : فَدَعَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَامِسَ خَمْسَةٍ، فَتَبِعَهُمْ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " إِنَّكَدَعَوْتَنَا خَامِسَ خَمْسَةٍ، وَهَذَا رَجُلٌ قَدْ تَبِعَنِي، فَإِنْ شِئْتَ أَذِنْتَ لَهُ، وَإِنْ شِئْتَ تَرَكْتَهُ ".
قَالَ : فَأَذِنَ لَهُ
8.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from al-A'mash, from Abu Wa'il, from Abu Mas'ud: He said: There was a man called Abu Shu'ayb, and he had a slave-boy who was a butcher, so he said: "Prepare food for me, I want to invite the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as the fifth of five." He said: So he invited the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as the fifth of five, so a man followed them, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "You invited us as the fifth of five, and this is a man who has followed me, if you wish, permit him, and if you wish, leave him." He said: So he permitted him.
8.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, al-A'mash se, Abu Wa'il se, Abu Mas'ud se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi tha jise Abu Shu'ayb kaha jaata tha, aur uska ek ghulam tha jo qassab tha, to usne kaha: "Mere liye khaana taiyaar karo, main Rasulullah ﷺ ko paanchvein ke tor par bulaana chahta hoon, paanch mein se." Unhone bataya: To usne Rasulullah ﷺ ko paanchvein ke tor par bulaaya, paanch mein se, to ek aadmi unke peechhe chal pada, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Tumne humein paanchvein ke tor par bulaaya, paanch mein se, aur yeh ek aadmi hai jo mere peechhe chala aaya, agar chaho to usay ijaazat do, aur agar chaho to chhod do." Unhone bataya: To usne usay ijaazat de di.

8.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي طُوَالَةَ : عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مَعْمَرٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" فَضْلُ عَائِشَةَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ، كَفَضْلِ الثَّرِيدِ عَلَى سَائِرِ الطَّعَامِ "
8.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid, from Abu Tuwalah (Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Ma'mar), from Anas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The excellence of Aisha over women is like the excellence of tharid over all other food."
8.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid se, Abu Tuwalah (Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Ma'mar) se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Auraton par Aisha ki fazeelat aisi hai jaisi baaki khaanon par tharid ki fazeelat."

8.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْمَدِينِيِّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْكَرِيمِ : أَبُو أُمَيَّةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ  : زَوَّجَنِي أَبِي فِي إِمَارَةِ عُثْمَانَ، فَدَعَا رَهْطًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَكَانَ فِيمَنْ دَعَا صَفْوَانُ بْنُ أُمَيَّةَ   وَهُوَ شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ، فَقَالَ : إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" انْهَسُوا اللَّحْمَ نَهْسًا، فَإِنَّهُ أَشْهَى وَأَمْرَأُ "
8.en: Narrated by Ali ibn al-Madini, from Sufyan, from Abd al-Karim Abu Umayyah, about Abdullah ibn al-Harith ibn Nawfal and Safwan ibn Umayyah: He said: Abdullah ibn al-Harith ibn Nawfal said: My father arranged my marriage during the caliphate of Uthman, and he invited a group of the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and among those he invited was Safwan ibn Umayyah, and he was a very old man, so he said: Indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Tear the meat with your teeth, for indeed it is more appetizing and more agreeable."
8.hi: Ali ibn al-Madini ne Sufyan se bataya: Humse Abd al-Karim Abu Umayyah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ibn al-Harith ibn Nawfal ne kaha: Mere walid ne Uthman ki khilaafat mein mera nikaah kiya, aur unhone Rasulullah ﷺ ke sahaba mein se kuch logon ko bulaaya, aur jinhein unhone bulaaya unmein Safwan ibn Umayyah bhi the, aur woh bahut budhe the, to unhone kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Gosht ko daanton se noch kar khaao, kyunki yeh zyada mazedaar aur zyada anukool hai."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْأَقْمَرِ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو جُحَيْفَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا آكُلُ مُتَّكِئًا "
8.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from Ali ibn al-Aqmar, from Abu Juhayfah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I do not eat while reclining."
8.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se, Ali ibn al-Aqmar se bataya: Mujhse Abu Juhayfah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Main tek lagaakar nahi khaata."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أُتِيَ بِالْبَاكُورَةِ بِأَوَّلِ الثَّمَرَةِ، قَالَ :" اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا ، وَفِي ثَمَرَتِنَا، وَفِي مُدِّنَا، وَفِي صَاعِنَا بَرَكَةً مَعَ بَرَكَةٍ "، ثُمَّ يُعْطِيهِ أَصْغَرَ مَنْ يَحْضُرُهُ مِنْ الْوِلْدَانِ
8.en: Narrated by Nu'aym ibn Hammad, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he was brought the first ripe fruit, would say: "Allahumma barik lana fi madinatina, wa fi thamaratina, wa fi muddina, wa fi sa'ina barakatan ma'a barakah" [O Allah, bless for us our city, and our fruit, and our mudd, and our sa', a blessing with a blessing], then he would give it to the youngest of the children present.
8.hi: Nu'aym ibn Hammad ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, Suhayl se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ jab aapke paas pehla pakka phal laaya jaata, to farmaate: "Allahumma baarik lanaa fi madeenatinaa, wa fi thamaratinaa, wa fi muddinaa, wa fi saa'inaa barakatam-ma'a barakah" [Ae Allah, humare shehar mein, aur humare phal mein, aur humare mudd mein, aur humare sa' mein barkat de, barkat ke saath barkat], fir jo bacchon mein se sabse chhota haazir hota, use de dete.

8.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا جَاءَ خَادِمُ أَحَدِكُمْ بِالطَّعَامِ، فَلْيُجْلِسْهُ، فَإِنْ أَبَى، فَلْيُنَاوِلْهُ "
8.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid, from his father, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When the servant of one of you brings food, let him seat him [to eat with him], and if he refuses, let him hand him some."
8.hi: Ya'la ne Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se kisi ka naukar khaana laaye, to use bithaao, aur agar woh mana kare, to usay kuch de do."

8.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ   يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِذَا أَتَى أَحَدَكُمْ خَادِمُهُ بِطَعَامٍ، فَلْيُجْلِسْهُ مَعَهُ، أَوْ لَيُنَاوِلْهُ لُقْمَةً أَوْ لُقْمَتَيْنِ، أَوْ أُكْلَةً أَوْ أُكْلَتَيْنِ، فَإِنَّهُ وَلِيَ حَرَّهُ وَدُخَانَهُ "
8.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "When the servant of one of you brings him food, let him seat him with him, or let him hand him a mouthful or two, or a meal or two, for indeed he took charge of its heat and its smoke."
8.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se bataya: Mujhse Muhammad ibn Ziyad ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Hurairah ko Nabi ﷺ se yeh bayaan karte suna: Aapne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se kisi ka naukar usay khaana laaye, to use apne saath bithaaye, ya usay ek ya do lukma de, ya ek ya do khaana de, kyunki usne uski garmi aur uske dhuein ki zimmedaari li thi."

8.ar: حَدَّثَنَا فَرْوَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَغْرَاءِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ،  عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : " كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَيُحِبُّ الْحَلْوَاءَ وَالْعَسَلَ "
8.en: Narrated by Farwah ibn Abi al-Maghra, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: She said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ liked sweets and honey."
8.hi: Farwah ibn Abi al-Maghra ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Aisha رضي الله عنها se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ko meethi cheez aur shahad pasand tha."

8.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي الْحُوَيْرِثِ  ،  عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنْ الْبِرَازِ فَقُدِّمَ إِلَيْهِ طَعَامٌ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ : أَلَا تَوَضَّأُ؟ قَالَ : فَقَالَ :" أُصَلِّي فَأَتَوَضَّأُ؟ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : إِنَّمَا هُوَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْحُوَيْرِثِ .
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  .
قَالَ : وَسَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَاصِمٍ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، بِإِسْنَادِهِ
8.en: Narrated by Qabisah, from Sufyan, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Sa'id ibn Abi al-Huwayrith, from Ibn Abbas; with Abu Muhammad's correction; a similar chain also via Abu Nu'aym and Abu Asim: He said: The Prophet ﷺ came out from relieving himself, and food was brought to him, so it was said to him: "Will you not perform ablution?" He said: "Am I about to pray, that I should perform ablution?" Abu Muhammad said: it is only Sa'id ibn al-Huwayrith. [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Sa'id ibn al-Huwayrith, from Ibn Abbas. He said: And I heard Abu Asim narrating, from Ibn Jurayj, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Sa'id ibn al-Huwayrith, from Ibn Abbas, with his chain.]
8.hi: Qabisah ne Sufyan se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Sa'id ibn Abi al-Huwayrith se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ qaza-e-hajat se nikle to aapke paas khaana laaya gaya, to aapse poocha gaya: "Kya aap wudu nahi karenge?" Aapne farmaya: "Kya main namaz padhne wala hoon ke wudu karun?" Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Sahih naam Sa'id ibn al-Huwayrith hai. [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Abu Nu'aym se, Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Sa'id ibn al-Huwayrith se, Ibn Abbas se bhi aayi hai. Unhone kaha: Aur maine Abu Asim ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Ibn Jurayj se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Sa'id ibn al-Huwayrith se, Ibn Abbas se, unki sanad ke saath.]

8.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : " كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَإِذَا أَجْنَبَ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ أَوْ يَنَامَ، تَوَضَّأَ "
8.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Aisha: She said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he was in janabah and wanted to eat or sleep, would perform ablution."
8.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se, al-Hakam se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibrahim ko yeh bayaan karte suna, al-Aswad se, Aisha se: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ jab janabat mein hote aur khaana ya sona chahte, to wudu karte."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ  ، قَالَ : أَوْصَانِي خَلِيلِي صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ :" إِذَا طَبَخْتَ مَرَقَةً ، فَأَكْثِرْ مَاءَهَا، ثُمَّ انْظُرْ أَهْلَ بَيْتٍ مِنْ جِيرَانِكَ، فَاغْرِفْ لَهُمْ مِنْهَا "
8.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Shu'bah, from Abu Imran al-Jawni, from Abdullah ibn al-Samit, from Abu Dharr: He said: My close friend ﷺ advised me, and said: "When you cook a broth, then make plenty of its water, then look for a family of your neighbors, and give them from it with a ladle."
8.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Shu'bah se, Abu Imran al-Jawni se, Abdullah ibn al-Samit se, Abu Dharr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mere khaleel ﷺ ne mujhe wasiyat ki, aur farmaya: "Jab tum shorba pakaao, to uska paani zyada karo, fir apne padosiyon mein se kisi khaandaan ko dekho, aur unhein isme se karchi bhar de do."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا وُضِعَ الطَّعَامُ، فَاخْلَعُوا نِعَالَكُمْ، فَإِنَّهُ أَرْوَحُ لِأَقْدَامِكُمْ "
8.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Uqbah ibn Khalid, from Musa ibn Muhammad ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Anas ibn Malik: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When food is placed, take off your sandals, for indeed it is more comfortable for your feet."
8.hi: Muhammad ibn Sa'id ne Uqbah ibn Khalid se bataya: Mujhse Musa ibn Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ne bataya: Mujhse mere walid ne bataya, Anas ibn Malik se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab khaana rakha jaaye, to apni jootiyaan utaar do, kyunki yeh tumhare paaon ke liye zyada aaraam-deh hai."

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" اعْبُدُوا الرَّحْمَنَ، وَأَفْشُوا السَّلَامَ، وَأَطْعِمُوا الطَّعَامَ، تَدْخُلُوا الْجِنَانَ "
8.en: Narrated by Ibrahim ibn Musa, from Jarir, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from his father, from Abdullah ibn Amr: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Worship the Most Merciful, and spread the greeting of peace, and feed food, and you will enter the gardens [of Paradise]."
8.hi: Ibrahim ibn Musa ne Jarir se, Ata ibn al-Sa'ib se, apne walid se, Abdullah ibn Amr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Rahman ki ibaadat karo, aur salaam phailaao, aur khaana khilaao, tum Jannaton mein dakhil hoge."

8.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" أَجِيبُوا الدَّاعِيَ إِذَا دُعِيتُمْ ".
قَالَ : وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَأْتِي الدَّعْوَةَ فِي الْعُرْسِ، وَفِي غَيْرِ الْعُرْسِ، وَيَأْتِيهَا وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ
8.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Musa ibn Uqbah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar; with a note about Abdullah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Respond to the one who invites when you are invited." He said: And Abdullah used to attend the invitation for a wedding, and for other than a wedding, and would attend it while he was fasting.
8.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, Musa ibn Uqbah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Bulaane wale ki dawat qabool karo jab tumhein bulaaya jaaye." Unhone bataya: Aur Abdullah shaadi ki dawat mein aate the, aur shaadi ke ilawa bhi, aur roze ki haalat mein bhi aate the.

8.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سُئِلَ عَنْ فَأْرَةٍ وَقَعَتْ فِي السَمْنٍ فَقَالَ :" أَلْقُوهَا وَمَا حَوْلَهَا، وَكُلُوا ".
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، بِإِسْنَادِهِ
8.en: Narrated by Ali ibn Abdullah, from Sufyan, from al-Zuhri, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah, from Ibn Abbas, from Maymunah; a similar chain also via Muhammad ibn Yusuf: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about a mouse that fell into ghee, so he said: "Throw it and what is around it away, and eat." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Ibn Uyaynah, with his chain.]
8.hi: Ali ibn Abdullah ne Sufyan se, al-Zuhri se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah se, Ibn Abbas se, Maymunah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ se ek chuhiya ke baare mein poocha gaya jo ghee mein gir gayi thi, to aapne farmaya: "Isay aur iske ird-gird ko phenk do, aur khaao." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Muhammad ibn Yusuf se, Ibn Uyaynah se, unki sanad ke saath bhi aayi hai.]

8.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ فَأْرَةٍ وَقَعَتْ فِي سَمْنٍ فَمَاتَتْ، فَقَالَ :" خُذُوهَا وَمَا حَوْلَهَا فَاطْرَحُوهُ ".
حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، نَحْوَهُ.
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : إِذَا كَانَ ذَائِبًا أُهَرِيقَ
8.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah, from Ibn Abbas; a similar chain also via Zayd ibn Yahya; with Abu Muhammad's addition: He said: The Prophet ﷺ was asked about a mouse that fell into ghee and died, so he said: "Take it and what is around it, and throw it away." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Zayd ibn Yahya, from Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah, from Ibn Abbas, from Maymunah, from the Prophet ﷺ, near it.] Abu Muhammad said: If it is [already] melted, it is [all] poured out.
8.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Ibn Shihab se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ se ek chuhiya ke baare mein poocha gaya jo ghee mein gir kar mar gayi thi, to aapne farmaya: "Isay aur iske ird-gird ko le lo aur phenk do." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Zayd ibn Yahya se, Malik se, Ibn Shihab se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah se, Ibn Abbas se, Maymunah se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi is ke qareeb aayi hai.] Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Agar woh pighla hua ho, to woh sab bahaa diya jaayega.

8.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَوْرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنٌ الْحِمْيَرِيُّ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَعْدٍ الْخَيْرُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْهُ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ أَكَلَ، فَلْيَتَخَلَّلْ، فَمَا تَخَلَّلَ، فَلْيَلْفِظْهُ، وَمَا لَاكَ بِلِسَانِهِ، فَلْيَبْتَلِعْ "
8.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Thawr ibn Yazid, from Husayn al-Himyari, from Abu Sa'd al-Khayr, from Abu Hurairah رضي الله تعالى عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever eats, let him use a toothpick, and whatever comes out with it, let him spit it out, and whatever he chews with his tongue, let him swallow."
8.hi: Abu Asim ne Thawr ibn Yazid se, Husayn al-Himyari se bataya: Mujhe Abu Sa'd al-Khayr ne bataya, Abu Hurairah رضي الله تعالى عنه se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo khaana khaaye, woh khilaal kare, aur jo nikal aaye use phenk de, aur jo zubaan se chaba jaaye use nigal le."

9.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، يَقُولُ :" أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَيْلَةَ أُسْرِيَ بِهِ بِإِيلْيَاءَ بِقَدَحَيْنِ مِنْ خَمْرٍ وَلَبَنٍ، فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِمَا ثُمَّ أَخَذَ اللَّبَنَ، فَقَالَ جِبْرِيلُ : الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي هَدَاكَ لِلْفِطْرَةِ، لَوْ أَخَذْتَ الْخَمْرَ، غَوَتْ أُمَّتُكَ "
9.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurairah: That he heard him say: "The Prophet ﷺ was brought, on the night he was taken on the night journey, at Iliya, two cups, of wine and of milk, so he looked at them then took the milk, so Jibril said: 'Praise be to Allah who guided you to the fitrah [natural inclination], had you taken the wine, your nation would have gone astray.'"
9.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Mujhe Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab ne bataya, ke unhone Abu Hurairah ko kehte suna: "Nabi ﷺ ko, jis raat aapko Isra karaaya gaya, Iliya (Bait-ul-Maqdis) mein, do pyaale laaye gaye, sharaab ka aur doodh ka, to aapne unhein dekha fir doodh liya, to Jibreel ne kaha: 'Al-hamdu lillah jisne aapko fitrat ki taraf hidayat di, agar aapne sharaab li hoti, to aapki ummat gumraah ho jaati.'"

9.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ سَاقِيَ الْقَوْمِ فِي مَنْزِلِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، قَالَ : فَنَزَلَ تَحْرِيمُ الْخَمْرِ، قَالَ : فَأَمَرَ مُنَادِيًا فَنَادَى، فَقَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ : اخْرُجْ فَانْظُرْ مَا هَذَا.
قَالَ : فَخَرَجْتُ فَقُلْتُ : هَذَا مُنَادٍ يُنَادِي : " أَلَا إِنَّالْخَمْرَ قَدْ حُرِّمَتْ ".
فَقَالَ لِيَ : اذْهَبْ فَأَهْرِقْهَا، قَالَ : فَجَرَتْ فِي سِكَكِ الْمَدِينَةِ .
قَالَ : وَكَانَتْ خَمْرُهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْفَضِيخَ.
فَقَالَ بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ : قُتِلَ قَوْمٌ وَهِيَ فِي بُطُونِهِمْ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ G : # لَيْسَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا طَعِمُوا إِذَا مَا اتَّقَوْا وَآمَنُوا سورة المائدة آية 93 #
9.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Thabit, from Anas: He said: I was the server of the people in the house of Abu Talhah, he said: So the prohibition of wine was revealed, he said: So he commanded a caller, and he called out, so Abu Talhah said: "Go out and see what this is." He said: So I went out and said: "This is a caller calling: 'Indeed wine has been made forbidden.'" So he said to me: "Go and pour it out," he said: So it flowed in the lanes of Madinah. He said: And their wine at that time was fadikh [a date-wine]. So some of the people said: "People were killed while it was in their bellies," so Allah, mighty and majestic is He, revealed: "There is no blame upon those who believe and do righteous deeds in what they have eaten, when they fear Allah and believe" [Surah al-Ma'idah, verse 93].
9.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Thabit se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Abu Talhah ke ghar mein logon ka saqi (paani/sharaab pilaane wala) tha, unhone bataya: To sharaab ki haraam hone ki aayat naazil hui, unhone bataya: To aapne ek pukaarne wale ko hukum diya, aur usne elaan kiya, to Abu Talhah ne kaha: "Bahar jaao aur dekho yeh kya hai." Unhone bataya: To main bahar gaya aur kaha: "Yeh ek pukaarne wala pukaar raha hai: 'Sharaab haraam kar di gayi hai.'" To unhone mujhse kaha: "Jao aur isay bahaa do," unhone bataya: To woh Madinah ki galiyon mein beh gayi. Unhone bataya: Aur us waqt unki sharaab 'fadikh' (khajoor ki sharaab) thi. To kuch logon ne kaha: "Kuch log maare gaye jabke woh unke pet mein thi," to Allah, Azza wa Jall, ne naazil kiya: "Un logon par jo imaan laaye aur nek amal kiye koi gunah nahi jo unhone [pehle] khaaya, jab woh Allah se darte hon aur imaan rakhte hon" [Surah Al-Ma'idah, aayat 93].

9.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ فِي الدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُبْ مِنْهَا، حُرِمَهَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ فَلَمْ يُسْقَهَا "
9.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever drinks wine in this world and does not repent from it, he will be deprived of it in the Hereafter, so he will not be given it to drink."
9.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo duniya mein sharaab piye fir usse tauba na kare, to Aakhirat mein usse mehroom kar diya jaayega, so usay pilaayi nahi jaayegi."

9.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي رَبِيعَةُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الدَّيْلَمِيِّ  ، قَالَ : دَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ فِي حَائِطٍ لَهُ بِالطَّائِفِ ، يُقَالُ لَهُ : الْوَهْطُ ، فَإِذَا هُوَ مُخَاصِرٌ فَتًى مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ يُزَنُّ ذَلِكَ الْفَتَى بِشُرْبِ الْخَمْرِ، فَقُلْتُ : خِصَالٌ بَلَغَتْنِي عَنْكَ أَنَّكَ تُحَدِّثُ بِهَا، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَنَّهُ : مَنْ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ شَرْبَةً، لَمْ تُقْبَلْ لَهُ صَلَاةٌ أَرْبَعِينَ صَبَاحًا، فَلَمَّا أَنْ سَمِعَهُ الْفَتَى بِذِكُرُ الْخَمْرَ، اخْتَلَجَ يَدَهُ مِنْ يَدِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، ثُمَّ وَلَّى.
فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   : اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي لَا أُحِلُّ لِأَحَدٍ أَنْ يَقُولَ عَلَيَّ مَا لَمْ أَقُلْ، وَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" مَنْ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ شَرْبَةً، لَمْ تُقْبَلْ لَهُ صَلَاةٌ أَرْبَعِينَ صَبَاحًا، فَإِنْ تَابَ، تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ، فَلَا أَدْرِي فِي الثَّالِثَةِ أَمْ فِي الرَّابِعَةِ : كَانَ حَقًّا عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يَسْقِيَهُ مِنْ رَدْغَةِ الْخَبَالِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ "
9.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from al-Awza'i, from Rabi'ah ibn Yazid, from Abdullah al-Daylami, about Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As: He said: I entered upon Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As in his orchard at al-Ta'if, called al-Wahat, and there he was, walking arm in arm with a young man of Quraysh who was accused of drinking wine, so I said: "Some qualities have reached me about you which you narrate, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, that: Whoever drinks a draught of wine, his prayer is not accepted for forty mornings." So when the young man heard him mention wine, his hand jerked away from Abdullah's hand, then he turned away. So Abdullah said: "O Allah, I do not permit anyone to say about me what I did not say, and indeed I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Whoever drinks a draught of wine, his prayer is not accepted for forty mornings, so if he repents, Allah accepts his repentance, but I do not know if it was on the third or fourth time: it becomes a right upon Allah that He give him to drink from the discharge/ooze of the people of Hell on the Day of Resurrection.'"
9.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne al-Awza'i se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhse Rabi'ah ibn Yazid ne bataya, Abdullah al-Daylami se: Unhone kaha, Main Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As ke paas unke Ta'if ke ek baagh mein gaya, jise al-Wahat kaha jaata tha, to woh Quraysh ke ek jawaan ke saath baazu mein baazu daale chal rahe the, jispar sharaab peene ka ilzaam tha, to maine kaha: "Kuch baatein mujhe aapke baare mein pahunchi hain ke aap unhein Rasulullah ﷺ se naql karte hain, ke: Jo sharaab ka ek ghoont bhi piye, uski namaz chaalis subah tak qabool nahi hoti." To jab jawaan ne unhein sharaab ka zikr karte suna, to uska haath Abdullah ke haath se jhatka kar door ho gaya, fir woh mud gaya. To Abdullah ne kaha: "Ae Allah, main kisi ko yeh ijaazat nahi deta ke woh mere baare mein kahe jo maine nahi kaha, aur maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna: 'Jo sharaab ka ek ghoont piye, uski namaz chaalis subah tak qabool nahi hoti, fir agar woh tauba kare, to Allah uski tauba qabool karta hai, lekin mujhe nahi maloom teesri baar tha ya chauthi baar: ke Allah par yeh haq ban jaata hai ke woh use Qayamat ke din jahannamiyon ke ghaao ka rasaav pilaaye.'"

9.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ، فَلَا يَقْعُدْ عَلَى مَائِدَةٍ يُشْرَبُ عَلَيْهَا الْخَمْرُ "
9.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from al-Hasan ibn Abi Ja'far, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him not sit at a table where wine is drunk."
9.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne al-Hasan ibn Abi Ja'far se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta ho, woh us dastarkhwaan par na baithe jispar sharaab pi jaa rahi ho."

9.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ الْبَصْرِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ  ، عَنْ جَابَانَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، ، قَالَ :" لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ وَلَدُ زِنْيَةٍ، وَلَا مَنَّانٌ، وَلَا عَاقٌّ، وَلَا مُدْمِنُ خَمْرٍ "
9.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir al-Basri, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd, from Jaban, from Abdullah ibn Amr, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "A child of adultery does not enter Paradise, nor an ungrateful giver [who reminds others of favors], nor an undutiful child, nor a habitual wine-drinker."
9.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir al-Basri ne Sufyan se, Mansur se, Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd se, Jaban se, Abdullah ibn Amr se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Zina ka bachcha Jannat mein dakhil nahi hoga, aur na hi ehsaan jataane wala, aur na hi maa-baap ka na-farmaan, aur na hi sharaab ka aadi."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَجَّاجِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ  ، عَنْ نُبَيْطِ بْنِ شَرِيطٍ  ، عَنْ جَابَانَ  ،  عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ عَاقٌّ، وَلَا مَنَّانٌ، وَلَا مُدْمِنُ خَمْرٍ "
9.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn al-Hajjaj, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi, from Shu'bah, from Mansur, from Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd, from Nubayt ibn Sharit, from Jaban, from Abdullah ibn Amr, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "An undutiful child does not enter Paradise, nor an ungrateful giver, nor a habitual wine-drinker."
9.hi: Ahmad ibn al-Hajjaj ne Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi se, Shu'bah se, Mansur se, Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd se, Nubayt ibn Sharit se, Jaban se, Abdullah ibn Amr se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Maa-baap ka na-farmaan Jannat mein dakhil nahi hoga, aur na hi ehsaan jataane wala, aur na hi sharaab ka aadi."

9.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُهَلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سِمَاكٌ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنَ وَائِلٍ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَائِلٍ  ، أَنَّ سُوَيْدَ بْنَ طَارِقٍ سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ الْخَمْرِ، فَنَهَاهُ عَنْهَا أَنْ يَصْنَعَهَا، فَقَالَ : إِنَّهَا دَوَاءٌ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " إِنَّهَالَيْسَتْ دَوَاءً وَلَكِنَّهَا دَاءٌ "
9.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from Simak, from Alqamah ibn Wa'il, from his father Wa'il, about Suwayd ibn Tariq: That Suwayd ibn Tariq asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about wine, so he forbade him from making it, so he said: "It is a medicine," so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "It is not a medicine, but it is a disease."
9.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se bataya: Mujhse Simak ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Alqamah ibn Wa'il ko yeh bayaan karte suna, apne walid Wa'il se: ke Suwayd ibn Tariq ne Rasulullah ﷺ se sharaab ke baare mein poocha, to aapne unhein isse banaane se mana kiya, to usne kaha: "Yeh to dawa hai," to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Yeh dawa nahi, balke yeh khud ek bimari hai."

9.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا كَثِيرٍ  يَقُولُ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ   يَقُولُ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ :" الْخَمْرُ مِنْ هَاتَيْنِ الشَّجَرَتَيْنِ : النَّخْلَةِ وَالْعِنَبِ "
9.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from Abu Kathir, from Abu Hurairah: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Wine is from these two trees: the palm and the grapevine."
9.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Kathir ko kehte suna: Maine Abu Hurairah ko kehte suna: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Sharaab in do darakhton se banti hai: khajoor aur angoor ki bail."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سُئِلَ عَنْ الْبِتْعِ، قَالَ :" كُلُّ شَرَابٍ أَسْكَرَ حَرَامٌ "
9.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Salamah, from Aisha: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about al-bit' [honey wine], he said: "Every drink that intoxicates is forbidden."
9.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Malik se, Ibn Shihab se, Abu Salamah se, Aisha se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ se al-bit' (shahad ki sharaab) ke baare mein poocha gaya, to aapne farmaya: "Har nashe wala mashroob haraam hai."
