So Abu Bakr said: "Your eye slept, O Messenger of Allah, this expedition which you sent out, they took spoils twice, both times they found a man seeking your protection/covenant." So I said to Mujalid: "What is 'seeking your protection'?" He said: it means: saying: 'There is no god but Allah.'
10.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Ala ne Yahya ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Abidah ibn al-Aswad se, Mujalid se, Amir se, Jabir se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya ke aapne ek din farmaya: "Maine khwab mein dekha ke ek aadmi mere paas khajoor ka ek pind laaya aur maine usay khaya, to maine usmein ek guthli paayi, aur jab maine use chabaaya to usne mujhe takleef di, fir usne mujhe ek aur pind diya, to maine kaha: 'Jo tumne mujhe diya, usmein maine guthli paayi jisne mujhe takleef di, so maine use khaya.'" To Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Aapki aankh soi hai, Ya Rasulullah, yeh lashkar jo aapne bheja tha, unhone do martaba ghaneemat li, dono martaba unhein aisa aadmi mila jo aapki panah maang raha tha." To maine Mujalid se poocha: "'Panah maangna' kya hai?" Unhone kaha: iska matlab hai: kehna: 'La ilaha illallah.'

10.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ يَعِيشَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ هُوَ ابْنُ بُكَيْرٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَتْ : كَانَتْ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ لَهَا زَوْجٌ تَاجِرٌ يَخْتَلِفُ، فَكَانَتْ تَرَى رُؤْيَا كُلَّمَا غَابَ عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا، وَقَلَّمَا يَغِيبُ إِلَّا تَرَكَهَا حَامِلًا، فَتَأْتِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَتَقُولُ : إِنَّ زَوْجِي خَرَجَ تَاجِرًا فَتَرَكَنِي حَامِلًا، فَرَأَيْتُ فِيمَا يَرَى النَّائِمُ : أَنَّ سَارِيَةَ بَيْتِي انْكَسَرَتْ، وَأَنِّي وَلَدْتُ غُلَامًا أَعْوَرَ.
فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " خَيْرٌ، يَرْجِعُ زَوْجُكِ عَلَيْكِ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى صَالِحًا، وَتَلِدِينَ غُلَامًا بَرًّا ".
فَكَانَتْ تَرَاهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلَاثًا، كُلُّ ذَلِكَ تَأْتِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَيَقُولُ ذَلِكَ لَهَا فَيَرْجِعُ زَوْجُهَا، وَتَلِدُ غُلَامًا، فَجَاءَتْ يَوْمًا كَمَا كَانَتْ تَأْتِيهِ، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ غَائِبٌ، وَقَدْ رَأَتْ تِلْكَ الرُّؤْيَا، فَقُلْتُ لَهَا : عَمَّ تَسْأَلِينَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَا أَمَةَ اللَّهِ؟ فَقَالَتْ : رُؤْيَا كُنْتُ أُرَاهَا، فَآتِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَأَسْأَلُهُ عَنْهَا فَيَقُولُ خَيْرًا، فَيَكُونُ كَمَا قَالَ.
فَقُلْتُ : فَأَخْبِرِينِي مَا هِيَ.
قَالَتْ : حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَأَعْرِضَهَا عَلَيْهِ كَمَا كُنْتُ أَعْرِضُ.
فَوَاللَّهِ مَا تَرَكْتُهَا حَتَّى أَخْبَرَتْنِي، فَقُلْتُ : وَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ صَدَقَتْ رُؤْيَاكِ، لَيَمُوتَنَّ زَوْجُكِ وَتَلِدِينَ غُلَامًا فَاجِرًا، فَقَعَدَتْ تَبْكِي، وَقَالَتْ مَا لِي حِينَ عَرَضْتُ عَلَيْكِ رُؤْيَايَ؟ فَدَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهِيَ تَبْكِي، فَقَالَ لَهَا : مَا لَهَا يَا عَائِشَةُ ؟ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ الْخَبَرَ وَمَا تَأَوَّلْتُ لَهَا.
 فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " مَهْ يَا عَائِشَةُ ،إِذَا عَبَرْتُمْ لِلْمُسْلِمِ الرُّؤْيَا، فَاعْبُرُوهَا عَلَى الْخَيْرِ، فَإِنَّ الرُّؤْيَا تَكُونُ عَلَى مَا يَعْبُرُهَا صَاحِبُهَا ".
فَمَاتَ وَاللَّهِ زَوْجُهَا، وَلَا أُرَاهَا إِلَّا وَلَدَتْ غُلَامًا فَاجِرًا
10.en: Narrated by Ubayd ibn Ya'ish, from Yunus ibn Bukayr, from Ibn Ishaq, from Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Ata, from Sulayman ibn Yasar, from Aisha, wife of the Prophet ﷺ: She said: There was a woman among the people of Madinah whose husband was a traveling merchant, so she used to have a dream every time her husband was absent, and he was rarely absent except that he left her pregnant, so she would come to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and say: My husband went out as a merchant and left me pregnant, and I saw in my sleep that the pillar of my house had broken, and that I gave birth to a one-eyed boy. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Good, your husband will return to you, Allah willing, safely, and you will give birth to a righteous boy." So she used to see it two or three times, each time coming to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he would say that to her, and her husband would return, and she would give birth to a boy, so one day she came as she used to come to him, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was absent, and she had seen that dream, so I said to her: "What are you asking the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about, O maidservant of Allah?" So she said: A dream I used to see, and I come to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and ask him about it, and he says good, and it turns out as he said. So I said: "Then tell me what it is." She said: Until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ comes, and I present it to him as I used to present it. By Allah, I did not leave her until she told me, so I said: "By Allah, if your dream is true, your husband will indeed die and you will give birth to a wicked boy," so she sat crying, and said: What is wrong that when I present my dream to you...? So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered while she was crying, and said to her: "What is wrong with her, O Aisha?" So I told him the story and what I had interpreted for her. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Enough, O Aisha, when you interpret a dream for a Muslim, interpret it toward good, for indeed the dream comes to be according to how its interpreter interprets it." So by Allah, her husband died, and I believe she gave birth to nothing but a wicked boy.
10.hi: Ubayd ibn Ya'ish ne Yunus ibn Bukayr se, Ibn Ishaq se, Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Ata se, Sulayman ibn Yasar se, Aisha, Nabi ﷺ ki biwi, se bataya: Unhone kaha, Madinah walon mein ek aurat thi jiska shohar musaafir taajir tha, so woh har baar khwab dekhti jab uska shohar ghar se door hota, aur woh mushkil hi kabhi door hota jab woh usay haamila na chhode, to woh Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aati, aur kehti: Mera shohar taajir bankar nikla aur mujhe haamila chhod gaya, aur maine so kar dekha: ke mere ghar ka satoon toot gaya, aur maine ek kaana ladka janam diya. To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Achhi baat hai, tumhara shohar Inshaallah salaamat wapas aayega, aur tum ek neik ladke ko janam dogi." So woh isay do ya teen martaba dekhti, har baar Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aati, aur aap yehi kehte, aur uska shohar wapas aa jaata, aur woh ladka janamti, so ek din woh aayi jaise woh aapke paas aaya karti thi, aur Rasulullah ﷺ ghair-haazir the, aur usne wahi khwab dekha tha, to maine usse poocha: "Tum Rasulullah ﷺ se kya poochna chaahti ho, Ae Allah ki bandi?" To usne kaha: Ek khwab jo main dekha karti hoon, aur main Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aati hoon, aur unse iske baare mein poochti hoon, to woh achhi baat kehte hain, aur waisa hi hota hai jaisa woh kehte hain. To maine kaha: "To mujhe bataao ke yeh kya hai." Usne kaha: Jab tak Rasulullah ﷺ na aayein, main isay unke saamne pesh karungi jaise pesh karti thi. Allah ki qasam, maine usay tab tak na chhoda jab tak usne mujhe bataya nahi, to maine kaha: "Allah ki qasam, agar tumhara khwab sach hai, to tumhara shohar zaroor marega aur tum ek fasiq ladke ko janam dogi," to woh baithi rone lagi, aur kaha: Mujhe kya hua jab maine apna khwab tumhein bataaya...? To Rasulullah ﷺ dakhil hue jabke woh ro rahi thi, aapne usse poocha: "Isay kya hua hai, Ae Aisha?" To maine aapko poori baat batayi aur jo maine uske liye ta'weel ki thi. To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Bas karo, Ae Aisha, jab tum kisi Musalman ke liye khwab ki ta'weel karo, to usse achhaai ki taraf karo, kyunki khwab waise hi hota hai jaisa uski ta'weel karne wala use ta'weel kare." So Allah ki qasam, uska shohar mar gaya, aur mera khayal hai usne ek fasiq ladke ke siwa kisi ko janam nahi diya.

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْج  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُغَلِّسِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ  ، قَال : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ قَدَرَ عَلَى أًنّ يَنْكِح، فَلَمْ يَنْكِحْ، فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا "
11.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abu al-Mughallis, from Abu Najih: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever has the means to marry and does not marry, is not of us."
11.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Abu al-Mughallis se, Abu Najih se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo nikaah karne ki taaqat rakhta ho aur nikaah na kare, woh humme se nahi."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ عُمَارَة  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  ، قَال : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّه   : كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ شَبَابًا لَيْسَ لَنَا شَيْءٌ، فَقَال : " يَا مَعْشَرَ الشَّبَابِمَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْكُمُ الْبَاءَة ، فَلْيَتَزَوَّجْ فَإِنَّهُ أَغَضُّ لِلْبَصَرِ وَأَحْصَنُ لِلْفَرْجِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ، فَعَلَيْهِ بِالصَّوْمِ فَإِنَّ الصَّوْمَ لَهُ وِجَاءٌ "
11.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from al-A'mash, from Umarah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid, about Abdullah: He said: Abdullah said: We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, young men with nothing [to give as dowry], so he said: "O assembly of young men, whoever among you is able to marry, let him marry, for indeed it lowers the gaze and guards the private parts more, and whoever is not able, then he must fast, for indeed fasting is a restraint for him."
11.hi: Ya'la ne al-A'mash se, Umarah se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ne kaha: Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath the, jawaan the aur humare paas kuch nahi tha, to aapne farmaya: "Ae jawaanon ki jama'at, tum mein se jo nikaah karne ki taaqat rakhta ho, woh nikaah kare, kyunki yeh nazar niche rakhta hai aur sharamgah ki zyada hifaazat karta hai, aur jo taaqat na rakhta ho, to woh roza rakhe, kyunki roza uske liye rok hai."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَة  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : لَقِيَهُ عُثْمَانُ وَأَنَا مَعَهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ : يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ هَلْ لَكَ فِي جَارِيَةٍ بِكْرٍ تُذَكِّرُك؟، فَقَالَ : قُلْتَ : ذَاكَ فَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ : " يَا مَعْشَرَ الشَّبَابِمَنْ كَانَ يَسْتَطِيعُ مِنْكُمْ الْبَاءَةَ فَلْيَتَزَوَّجْ فَإِنَّهُ أَغَضُّ لِلْبَصَرِ وَأَحْصَنُ لِلْفَرْجِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَلْيَصُمْ فَإِنَّ الصَّوْمَ لَهُ وِجَاءٌ "
11.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah, about Abdullah: He said: Uthman met him, and I was with him, so he said to him: "O Abu Abd al-Rahman, would you like a young virgin girl who would remind you [of your youth]?" So he said: You have said that, but I have heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "O assembly of young men, whoever among you is able to marry, let him marry, for indeed it lowers the gaze and guards the private parts more, and whoever is not able, then let him fast, for indeed fasting is a restraint for him."
11.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se, Alqamah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Uthman unse mile, aur main unke saath tha, to unhone kaha: "Ae Abu Abd al-Rahman, kya aap ek kuwari ladki chahenge jo aapko [jawaani ki] yaad dilaaye?" To unhone kaha: Aap yeh kehte hain, lekin maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna: "Ae jawaanon ki jama'at, tum mein se jo nikaah karne ki taaqat rakhta ho, woh nikaah kare, kyunki yeh nazar niche rakhta hai aur sharamgah ki zyada hifaazat karta hai, aur jo taaqat na rakhta ho, to woh roza rakhe, kyunki roza uske liye rok hai."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا شُعَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ  ، يَقُولُ :" لَقَدْ رَدَّ ذَلِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَى عُثْمَانَ، وَلَوْ أَجَازَ لَهُ التَّبَتُّلَ، لَاخْتَصَيْنَا "
11.en: Narrated by Abu al-Yaman, from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, about Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas: That he heard Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas say: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ indeed rejected that [request] of Uthman, and had he permitted him celibacy, we would have castrated ourselves."
11.hi: Abu al-Yaman ne Shu'ayb se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Mujhe Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab ne bataya, ke unhone Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas ko kehte suna: "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Uthman ka woh [taqaaza] radd kar diya, aur agar aap unhein tabattul (shaadi se door raho, brahmacharya) ki ijaazat de dete, to hum khud ko khassi (castrate) kar lete."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ  ،  عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : "نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنِ التَّبَتُّلِ "
11.en: Narrated by Ishaq, from Hammad ibn Mas'adah, from al-Ash'ath ibn Abd al-Malik, from al-Hasan, from Sa'd ibn Hisham, from Aisha: She said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade celibacy."
11.hi: Ishaq ne Hammad ibn Mas'adah se, al-Ash'ath ibn Abd al-Malik se, al-Hasan se, Sa'd ibn Hisham se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne tabattul (celibacy/brahmacharya) se mana kiya."

11.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْحِزَامِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ  ، قَالَ : لَمَّا كَانَ مِنْ أَمْرِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ مَظْعُونٍ الَّذِي كَانَ مِنْ تَرْكِ النِّسَاءِ، بَعَثَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : " يَا عُثْمَانُ إِنِّي لَمْ أُومَرْ بِالرَّهْبَانِيَّةِ أَرَغِبْتَ عَنْ سُنَّتِي؟ "، قَالَ : لَا، يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ مِنْ سُنَّتِي أَنْ أُصَلِّي، وَأَنَام، وَأَصُومَ، وَأَطْعَمَ، وَأَنْكِحَ، وَأُطَلِّقَ، فَمَنْ رَغِبَ عَنْ سُنَّتِي، فَلَيْسَ مِنِّي يَا عُثْمَانُ، إِنَّ لِأَهْلِكَ عَلَيْكَ حَقًّا، وَلِنَفْسِكَ عَلَيْكَ حَقًّا ".
قَالَ سَعْدٌ : فَوَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ كَانَ أَجْمَعَ رِجَالٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ عَلَى أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِنْ هُوَ أَقَرَّ عُثْمَانَ عَلَى مَا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ نَخْتَصِيَ فَنَتَبَتَّلَ
11.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Hizami, from Yunus ibn Bukayr, from Ibn Ishaq, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas: He said: When it came to the matter of Uthman ibn Maz'un, which was about abandoning women, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent for him, and said: "O Uthman, I have not been commanded with monasticism, have you turned away from my sunnah?" He said: "No, O Messenger of Allah." He said: "Indeed part of my sunnah is that I pray, and sleep, and fast, and eat, and marry, and divorce, so whoever turns away from my sunnah is not of me, O Uthman, indeed your family has a right upon you, and your own self has a right upon you." Sa'd said: By Allah, some men among the Muslims had agreed that if the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had confirmed Uthman upon what he was doing, we would have castrated ourselves and practiced celibacy.
11.hi: Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Hizami ne Yunus ibn Bukayr se bataya: Mujhse Ibn Ishaq ne bataya: Mujhse al-Zuhri ne bataya, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas se: Unhone kaha, Jab Uthman ibn Maz'un ka maamla hua jismein woh auraton ko chhodne ki baat kar rahe the, Rasulullah ﷺ ne unhein bulaaya, aur farmaya: "Ae Uthman, mujhe rahbaniyat (monasticism) ka hukum nahi diya gaya, kya tum meri sunnat se peechhe hat gaye ho?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, Ya Rasulullah." Aapne farmaya: "Meri sunnat mein se yeh hai ke main namaz padhta hoon, aur sota hoon, aur roza rakhta hoon, aur khaata hoon, aur nikaah karta hoon, aur talaq deta hoon, so jo meri sunnat se peechhe hate, woh mujhse nahi, Ae Uthman, tumhare gharwalon ka tumpar haq hai, aur tumhare apne nafs ka bhi tumpar haq hai." Sa'd kehte hain: Allah ki qasam, Musalmanon mein se kuch log is baat par ittefaaq kar chuke the ke agar Rasulullah ﷺ Uthman ko jo woh kar rahe the uspar qaayam rehne dete, to hum apne aap ko khassi kar lete aur tabattul ikhtiyaar kar lete.

11.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" تُنْكَحُ النِّسَاءُ لِأَرْبَعٍ : لِلدِّينِ، وَالْجَمَالِ، وَالْمَالِ، وَالْحَسَبِ، فَعَلَيْكَ بِذَاتِ الدِّينِ تَرِبَتْ يَدَاك ".
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ   ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّم، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ
11.en: Narrated by Sadaqah ibn al-Fadl, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Ubaydullah, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id, from his father, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ; a similar chain also via Muhammad ibn Uyaynah: He said: "Women are married for four reasons: for her religion, and her beauty, and her wealth, and her lineage, so seek the one with religion, may your hands be in the dust [otherwise, a proverbial expression]." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Abd al-Malik, from Ata ibn Abi Rabah, from Jabir, from the Prophet ﷺ, with this hadith.]
11.hi: Sadaqah ibn al-Fadl ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Ubaydullah se, Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Auraton se nikaah chaar cheezon ke liye kiya jaata hai: uske deen ke liye, aur uski khoobsurati ke liye, aur uske maal ke liye, aur uske khaandaan ke liye, so deen wali ko chuno, tumhare haath mitti mein saney (agar aisa na karo)." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Muhammad ibn Uyaynah se, Ali ibn Mushir se, Abd al-Malik se, Ata ibn Abi Rabah se, Jabir se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi is hadith ke saath aayi hai.]

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا قَبِيصَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الْأَحْوَلِ  ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِي  ، عَنْ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ   أَنَّهُ خَطَبَ امْرَأَةً مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" اذْهَبْ، فَانْظُرْ إِلَيْهَا، فَإِنَّهُ أَجْدَرُ أَنْ يُؤْدَمَ بَيْنَكُمَا "
11.en: Narrated by Qabisah, from Sufyan, from Asim al-Ahwal, from Bakr ibn Abdullah al-Muzani, about al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah: That he proposed marriage to a woman from the Ansar, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: "Go and look at her, for indeed it is more fitting that harmony be established between the two of you."
11.hi: Qabisah ne Sufyan se, Asim al-Ahwal se, Bakr ibn Abdullah al-Muzani se bataya ke al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah ne Ansar ki ek aurat se nikaah ka paighaam diya, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne unse farmaya: "Jaao, aur usay dekho, kyunki isse tum dono ke darmiyan mohabbat qaayam hone ke zyada aasaar hain."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ الْبَصْرِيُّ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ  ، يَقُولُ : قَدِمَ عَقِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ   الْبَصْرَةَ ، فَتَزَوَّجَ امْرَأَةً مِنْ بَنِي جُشَمٍ، فَقَالُوا لَهُ : بِالرِّفَاءِ وَالْبَنِينَ، فَقَالَ : لَا تَقُولُوا ذَلِكَ، إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَهَانَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ، وَأَمَرَنَا أَنْ نَقُولَ :" بَارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ "
11.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir al-Abdi al-Basri, from Sufyan, from Yunus, from al-Hasan, about Aqil ibn Abi Talib: He said: Aqil ibn Abi Talib arrived at Basra, and married a woman from Banu Jusham, so they said to him: "Bi'r-rifa'i wal-banin" [With harmony and sons, a Jahili blessing], so he said: "Do not say that, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us from that, and commanded us to say: 'Barakallahu laka, wa baraka 'alayk' [May Allah bless you, and bless upon you]."
11.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir al-Abdi al-Basri ne Sufyan se, Yunus se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Hasan ko kehte suna: Aqil ibn Abi Talib Basra pahunche, aur Banu Jusham ki ek aurat se nikaah kiya, to unhone unse kaha: "Bir-rifaa'i wal-baneen" [Muhabbat aur betoan ke saath, ek Jahili dua], to unhone kaha: "Yeh mat kaho, Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein isse mana kiya, aur humein kehne ka hukum diya: 'Barakallahu laka, wa baraka 'alayk' [Allah tumhein barkat de, aur tumpar barkat de]."

11.ar: حَدَّثَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ  ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا رَفَّأَ لِإِنْسَانٍ، قَالَ :" بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ "
11.en: Narrated by Nu'aym ibn Hammad, from Abd al-Aziz, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: That he, when he congratulated someone [on marriage], would say: "Barakallahu laka, wa baraka 'alayk, wa jama'a baynakuma fi khayr" [May Allah bless you, and bless upon you, and gather the two of you in good].
11.hi: Nu'aym ibn Hammad ne Abd al-Aziz se, Suhayl se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya ke jab aap kisi ko [shaadi ki] mubaarakbaad dete, to farmaate: "Barakallahu laka, wa baraka 'alayk, wa jama'a baynakuma fi khayr" [Allah tumhein barkat de, aur tumpar barkat de, aur tum dono ko bhalaai mein jama kare].

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَنَّهُنَهَى عَنْ أَنْ يَخْطُبَ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى خِطْبَةِ أَخِيهِ "
11.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from Suhayl ibn Abi Salih, from his father, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: "That he forbade a man to propose over the proposal of his brother."
11.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Shu'bah se, Suhayl ibn Abi Salih se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya ke aapne "aadmi ko apne bhai ke rishte ke paighaam par [apna] paighaam dene se mana kiya."

11.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَا يَخْطُبْ أَحَدُكُمْ عَلَى خِطْبَةِ أَخِيهِ وَلَا يَبِيعُ عَلَى بَيْعِ أَخِيهِ حَتَّى يَأْذَنَ لَهُ "
11.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Uqbah ibn Khalid, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "None of you should propose over the proposal of his brother, nor sell over the sale of his brother, until he permits him."
11.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Uqbah ibn Khalid se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi apne bhai ke rishte ke paighaam par apna paighaam na de, aur na apne bhai ke saude par apna saude, jab tak woh ijaazat na de."

11.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ،  عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ   : أَنَّهَا حَدَّثَتْهُ وَكَتَبَهُ مِنْهَا كِتَابًا أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَحْتَ رَجُلٍ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ، مِنْ بَنِي مَخْزُومٍ، فَطَلَّقَهَا الْبَتَّةَ، فَأَرْسَلَتْ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ تَبْتَغِي مِنْهُمُ النَّفَقَةَ، فَقَالُوا : لَيْسَ لَكِ نَفَقَةٌ، فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ :" لَيْسَ لَكِ نَفَقَةٌ، وَعَلَيْكِ الْعِدَّةُ، وَانْتَقِلِي إِلَى بَيْتِ أُمِّ شَرِيكٍ ، وَلَا تُفَوِّتِينَا بِنَفْسِكِ "، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " إِنَّ أُمَّ شَرِيكٍ امْرَأَةٌ يَدْخُلُ إِلَيْهَا إِخْوَانُهَا مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ، وَلَكِنِ انْتَقِلِي إِلَى بَيْتِ ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ فَإِنَّهُ رَجُلٌ أَعْمَى، إِنْ وَضَعْتِ ثِيَابَكِ لَمْ يَرَ شَيْئًا وَلَا تُفَوِّتِينَا بِنَفْسِكِ "، فَانْطَلَقَتْ إِلَى بَيْتِ ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ فَلَمَّا حَلَّتْ، ذَكَرَتْ أَنَّ مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَأَبَا جَهْمٍ خَطَبَاهَا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَمَّا مُعَاوِيَةُ، فَرَجُلٌ لَا مَالَ لَهُ، وَأَمَّا أَبُو جَهْمٍ، فَلَا يَضَعُ عَصَاهُ عَنْ عَاتِقِهِ، فَأَيْنَ أَنْتِ مِنْ أُسَامَةَ؟ " فَكَأَنَّ أَهْلَهَا كَرِهُوا ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَتْ : وَاللَّهِ لَا أَنْكِحُ إِلَّا الَّذِي قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَنَكَحَتْ أُسَامَةَ.
قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو : قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ : يَا فَاطِمَةُ ، اتَّقِي اللَّهَ، فَقَدْ عَلِمْتِ فِي أَيِّ شَيْءٍ كَانَ هَذَا، قَالَ : وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ : قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى : # يَأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحْصُوا الْعِدَّةَ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ لا تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِنْ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلا يَخْرُجْنَ إِلا أَنْ يَأْتِينَ بِفَاحِشَةٍ مُبَيِّنَةٍ سورة الطلاق آية 1 # وَالْفَاحِشَةُ أَنْ تَبْذُوَ عَلَى أَهْلِهَا، فَإِذَا فَعَلَتْ ذَلِكَ، فَقَدْ حَلَّ لَهُمْ أَنْ يُخْرِجُوهَا
11.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Fatimah bint Qays: That she narrated to him and he wrote it from her in a letter: that she was married to a man from Quraysh, from Banu Makhzum, and he divorced her irrevocably (finally), so she sent to his family seeking maintenance from them, so they said: "You have no maintenance," so that reached the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he said: "You have no maintenance, and upon you is the waiting period, and move to the house of Umm Sharik, and do not deprive us of yourself," then he said: "Indeed Umm Sharik is a woman whose brothers among the emigrants visit her, but move to the house of Ibn Umm Maktum, for he is a blind man, if you put down your garments, he will not see anything, and do not deprive us of yourself." So she went to the house of Ibn Umm Maktum, and when she became lawful [for remarriage], she mentioned that Mu'awiyah, and Abu Jahm, had proposed to her, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "As for Mu'awiyah, he is a man with no wealth, and as for Abu Jahm, he does not put his staff down from his shoulder [i.e., he beats women, or travels constantly], so what about Usamah?" So her family seemed to dislike that, so she said: "By Allah, I will not marry except the one the Messenger of Allah ﷺ mentioned," so she married Usamah. Muhammad ibn Amr said: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim said: "O Fatimah, fear Allah, for you know in what circumstances this was." He said: And Ibn Abbas said: Allah the Exalted said: "O Prophet, when you [believers] divorce women, divorce them for their prescribed waiting period, and count the waiting period, and fear Allah, your Lord, do not turn them out of their houses, nor should they leave, unless they commit an open immorality" [Surah al-Talaq, verse 1], and the immorality is that she be abusive/foul-mouthed to her husband's family, so if she does that, then it becomes lawful for them to turn her out.
11.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se bataya: Fatimah bint Qays ne unhein bataya aur unhone use ek khat mein likh liya: ke woh Quraysh ke Banu Makhzum ke ek aadmi ki biwi thin, to usne unhein hamesha ke liye talaq de di, to unhone uske gharwalon ko [poochne] bheja, unse nafqa (kharcha) maangte hue, to unhone kaha: "Tumhare liye koi nafqa nahi hai," to yeh baat Rasulullah ﷺ tak pahunchi, to aapne farmaya: "Tumhare liye nafqa nahi, aur tumpar iddat hai, aur Umm Sharik ke ghar chali jao, aur humein apni khud [ki dekh-bhaal] se mehroom mat karo," fir farmaya: "Umm Sharik aisi aurat hain jinke paas muhajireen mein se unke bhai aate hain, lekin tum Ibn Umm Maktum ke ghar chali jao, kyunki woh andhe aadmi hain, agar tum apne kapde utaaro to unhein kuch nazar nahi aayega, aur humein apni khud se mehroom mat karo." So woh Ibn Umm Maktum ke ghar chali gayi, fir jab woh halal ho gayi, to unhone bataaya ke Mu'awiyah, aur Abu Jahm, ne unhein rishta bheja tha, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Rahi baat Mu'awiyah ki, to woh aisa aadmi hai jiske paas maal nahi, aur rahi baat Abu Jahm ki, to woh apni laathi apne kandhe se neeche nahi rakhta [aurton ko maarta hai], to Usamah ke baare mein kya khayal hai?" To unke gharwalon ne isay na-pasand kiya, to unhone kaha: "Allah ki qasam, main sirf usi se nikaah karungi jiska naam Rasulullah ﷺ ne liya," so unhone Usamah se nikaah kiya. Muhammad ibn Amr kehte hain: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ne kaha: "Ae Fatimah, Allah se daro, tumhein maloom hai yeh kis maamle mein tha." Unhone bataya: Aur Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "Ae Nabi, jab tum [momino] auraton ko talaq do, to unhein unki iddat [ke shuru] mein talaq do, aur iddat ka hisaab rakho, aur Allah, apne Rab, se daro, unhein unke gharon se na nikaalo, aur woh khud bhi na nikalein, siwaay iske ke woh koi khula-khulla fahish kaam karein" [Surah At-Talaq, aayat 1], aur fahisha yeh hai ke woh apne shohar ke gharwalon ke saath bad-kalaami kare, so agar woh aisa kare, to unke liye use nikaalna halal ho jaata hai.

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي هِنْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَامِرٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ   : " أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَنَهَى أَنْ تُنْكَحَ الْمَرْأَةُ عَلَى عَمَّتِهَا، وَالْعَمَّةُ عَلَى ابْنَةِ أَخِيهَا، أَوْ الْمَرْأَةُ عَلَى خَالَتِهَا، أَوْ الْخَالَةُ عَلَى بِنْتِ أُخْتِهَا، وَلَا تُنْكَحُ الصُّغْرَى عَلَى الْكُبْرَى، وَلَا الْكُبْرَى عَلَى الصُّغْرَى "
11.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Da'ud ibn Abi Hind, from Amir, from Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "forbade that a woman be married in addition to her paternal aunt, and the paternal aunt in addition to her brother's daughter, or a woman in addition to her maternal aunt, or the maternal aunt in addition to her sister's daughter, and the younger should not be married in addition to the older, nor the older in addition to the younger."
11.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Da'ud ibn Abi Hind se, Amir se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "kisi aurat ko uski phuphi ke saath, aur phuphi ko uske bhatije ki beti ke saath nikaah mein laane se mana kiya, ya aurat ko uski khaala ke saath, ya khaala ko uski behen ki beti ke saath, aur na hi chhoti ko badi ke saath nikaah mein laaya jaaye, na badi ko chhoti ke saath."

11.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   : " أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَنَهَى أَنْ يُجْمَعَ بَيْنَ الْمَرْأَةِ وَعَمَّتِهَا وَالْمَرْأَةِ وَخَالَتِهَا "
11.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Malik, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "forbade combining between a woman and her paternal aunt, and a woman and her maternal aunt [in marriage]."
11.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Malik se, Abu al-Zinad se, al-A'raj se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "kisi aurat aur uski phuphi ke darmiyan, aur aurat aur uski khaala ke darmiyan [nikaah mein] jama karne se mana kiya."

11.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ نَافِع  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : "نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنِ الشِّغَارِ ".
قَالَ مَالِكٌ : وَالشِّغَارُ : أَنْ يُزَوِّجَ الرَّجُلُ الْآخَرَ ابْنَتَهُ، عَلَى أَنْ يُزَوِّجَهُ الْآخَرُ ابْنَتَهُ بِغَيْرِ صَدَاقٍ، قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ : تَرَى بَيْنَهُمَا نِكَاحًا؟.
قَالَ : لَا يُعْجِبُنِي
11.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar; with Malik's clarification: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade al-shighar." Malik said: al-shighar is: for one man to marry off his daughter to another, on condition that the other marries off his own daughter to him without a dowry. It was said to Abu Muhammad: "Do you consider there to be a [valid] marriage between them?" He said: "I am not pleased with it."
11.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne shighar se mana kiya." Malik kehte hain: Shighar yeh hai ke ek aadmi doosre se apni beti ka nikaah karaaye, is shart par ke doosra bhi apni beti ka nikaah usse bagair mahar ke karaaye. Abu Muhammad se poocha gaya: "Kya aap iske darmiyan nikaah maante hain?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe yeh pasand nahi."

11.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ أَبِي مُغِيثٍ  ، حَدَّثَتْنِي أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" أَنْكِحُوا الصَّالِحِينَ وَالصَّالِحَاتِ ".
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : وَسَقَطَ عَلَيَّ مِنَ الْحَدِيثِ " فَمَا تَبِعَهُمْ بَعْدُ فَحَسَنٌ "
11.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibrahim ibn Umar ibn Kaysan, from his father, from Wahb ibn Abi Mughith, from Asma bint Abi Bakr, from Aisha, from the Prophet ﷺ; with Abu Muhammad's note: He said: "Marry off the righteous men and righteous women." Abu Muhammad said: A part of the hadith fell away from me: "whatever follows it after that is good."
11.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibrahim ibn Umar ibn Kaysan se, apne walid se, Wahb ibn Abi Mughith se bataya: Mujhse Asma bint Abi Bakr ne bataya, Aisha se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Neik mardon aur neik auraton ka nikaah karaao." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Hadith ka ek hissa mujhse chhoot gaya: "jo bhi uske baad aaye woh achha hai."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا نِكَاحَ إِلَّا بِوَلِيٍّ "
11.en: Narrated by Malik ibn Isma'il, from Isra'il, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu Burdah, from his father: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There is no marriage except with a guardian."
11.hi: Malik ibn Isma'il ne Isra'il se, Abu Ishaq se, Abu Burdah se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Nikaah waali (guardian) ke bagair nahi hota."

11.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى  ، عِنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَا نِكَاحَ إِلَّا بِوَلِيٍّ "
11.en: Narrated by Ali ibn Hujr, from Sharik, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu Burdah, from Abu Musa, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "There is no marriage except with a guardian."
11.hi: Ali ibn Hujr ne Sharik se, Abu Ishaq se, Abu Burdah se, Abu Musa se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Nikaah waali ke bagair nahi hota."

11.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" أَيُّمَا امْرَأَةٍ نُكِحَتْ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ وَلِيِّهَا، فَنِكَاحُهَا بَاطِلٌ، فَنِكَاحُهَا بَاطِلٌ، فَنِكَاحُهَا بَاطِلٌ، فَإِنْ اشْتَجَرُوا، قَالَ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، وَقَالَ مَرَّةً : فَإِنْ تَشَاجَرُوا فَالسُّلْطَانُ وَلِيُّ مَنْ لَا وَلِيَّ لَهُ، فَإِنْ أَصَابَهَا، فَلَهَا الْمَهْرُ بِمَا اسْتَحَلَّ مِنْ فَرْجِهَا ".
قَالَ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ : أَمْلَاهُ عَلَيَّ سَنَةَ سِتٍّ وَأَرْبَعِينَ وَمِائَةٍ
11.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Sulayman ibn Musa, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha, from the Prophet ﷺ; with Abu Asim's note: He said: "Whichever woman is married without the permission of her guardian, her marriage is void, her marriage is void, her marriage is void, and if they dispute" - Abu Asim said, and said at another time: "and if they contend, then the ruler is the guardian of whoever has no guardian, and if he has consummated with her, then she has the dowry for what he made lawful of her private parts." Abu Asim said: He dictated it to me in the year one hundred and forty-six.
11.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Sulayman ibn Musa se, al-Zuhri se, Urwah se, Aisha se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jo bhi aurat apne waali ki ijaazat ke bagair nikaah kare, uska nikaah baatil hai, uska nikaah baatil hai, uska nikaah baatil hai, aur agar woh jhagden" - Abu Asim kehte hain, aur ek martaba kaha: "aur agar woh jhagden, to hukmaraan uska waali hai jiska koi waali na ho, aur agar usne uske saath sohbat ki ho, to uske liye mahar hai us cheez ke badle jo usne uski sharamgah se halal kiya." Abu Asim kehte hain: Unhone yeh mujhe ek sau chhiyaalis mein likhwaya.

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بُرْدَةَ بْنُ أَبِي مُوسَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" تُسْتَأْمَرُ الْيَتِيمَةُ فِي نَفْسِهَا، فَإِنْ سَكَتَتْ، فَقَدْ أَذِنَتْ، وَإِنْ أَبَتْ لَمْ تُكْرَهْ "
11.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Yunus ibn Abi Ishaq, from Abu Burdah ibn Abi Musa, from Abu Musa: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The orphan girl is consulted about herself, so if she remains silent, then she has consented, and if she refuses, she is not to be compelled."
11.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Yunus ibn Abi Ishaq se bataya: Mujhse Abu Burdah ibn Abi Musa ne bataya, Abu Musa se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Yateem ladki se uski raay li jaaye, so agar woh khamosh rahe, to usne ijaazat de di, aur agar woh mana kare, to use majboor nahi kiya jaayega."

11.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا تُنْكَحُ الثَّيِّبُ حَتَّى تُسْتَأْمَرَ، وَلَا تُنْكَحُ الْبِكْرُ حَتَّى تُسْتَأْذَنَ، وَإِذْنُهَا الصُّمُوتُ ".
أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  : أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ   حَدَّثَهُ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ
11.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from Yahya, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah; a similar chain also via Wahb ibn Jarir: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The previously-married woman is not married until she is consulted, and the virgin is not married until her permission is sought, and her permission is her silence." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Wahb ibn Jarir, from Hisham, from Yahya, from Abu Salamah: that Abu Hurairah narrated to him, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, with this hadith.]
11.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se bataya: Mujhse Yahya ne bataya, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Shauhar-yaafta aurat ka nikaah tab tak nahi hota jab tak uski raay na li jaaye, aur kuwari ka nikaah tab tak nahi hota jab tak uski ijaazat na li jaaye, aur uski ijaazat uski khamoshi hai." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Wahb ibn Jarir se, Hisham se, Yahya se, Abu Salamah se bhi aayi hai: ke Abu Hurairah ne unhein bataya, Rasulullah ﷺ se, is hadith ke saath.]

11.ar: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" الْأَيِّمُ أَحَقُّ بِنَفْسِهَا مِنْ وَلِيِّهَا، وَالْبِكْرُ تُسْتَأْذَنُ فِي نَفْسِهَا وَإِذْنُهَا صُمَاتُهَا "
11.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Abdullah ibn al-Fadl, from Nafi' ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im, from Ibn Abbas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The previously-married woman has more right to herself than her guardian, and the virgin is asked permission about herself, and her permission is her silence."
11.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Abdullah ibn al-Fadl se, Nafi' ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Shauhar-yaafta aurat apne aap par apne waali se zyada haqdaar hai, aur kuwari se uske baare mein ijaazat li jaaye aur uski ijaazat uski khamoshi hai."

11.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ  أَوَّلُ شَيْءٍ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" تُسْتَأْذَنُ الْبِكْرُ وَإِذْنُهَا صُمَاتُهَا "
11.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Isa, from Malik (the first thing he asked him about), from Abdullah ibn al-Fadl, from Nafi' ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The virgin's permission is sought, and her permission is her silence."
11.hi: Ishaq ibn Isa ne bataya: Mujhse Malik ne bataya - yeh pehli cheez thi jo maine unse poochi - unhone kaha: Humein Abdullah ibn al-Fadl ne bataya, Nafi' ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Kuwari se ijaazat li jaaye aur uski ijaazat uski khamoshi hai."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا نَافِعُ بْنُ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" الْأَيِّمُ أَمْلَكُ بِأَمْرِهَا مِنْ وَلِيِّهَا، وَالْبِكْرُ تُسْتَأْمَرُ فِي نَفْسِهَا، وَصَمْتُهَا إِقْرَارُهَا "
11.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Mawhab, from Nafi' ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im, from Ibn Abbas: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The previously-married woman has more control over her affair than her guardian, and the virgin is consulted about herself, and her silence is her consent."
11.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne bataya: Mujhse Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Mawhab ne bataya: Humein Nafi' ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im ne bataya, Ibn Abbas se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Shauhar-yaafta aurat apne maamle par apne waali se zyada ikhtiyaar rakhti hai, aur kuwari se uski raay li jaaye, aur uski khamoshi uski razaamandi hai."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ  : أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ  ، وَمُجَمِّعَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ   الْأَنْصَارِيَّيْنِ، حَدَّثَاهُ : أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْهُمْ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ يُدْعَى خِذَامًا أَنْكَحَ بِنْتًا لَهُ فَكَرِهَتْ نِكَاحَ أَبِيهَا، فَأَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ،فَرَدَّ عَنْهَا نِكَاحَ أَبِيهَا "، فَنَكَحَتْ أَبَا لُبَابَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْمُنْذِرِ فَذَكَرَ يَحْيَى : أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ ثَيِّبًا
11.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid and Mujammi' ibn Yazid al-Ansariyayn; with Yahya's added note: That they narrated to him: that a man among them from the Ansar, called Khidham, married off a daughter of his, but she disliked her father's marriage [arrangement], so she came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and mentioned that to him, and he rejected her father's marriage [arrangement] on her behalf, so she married Abu Lubabah ibn Abd al-Mundhir. Yahya mentioned: that it reached him that she had been previously married [not a virgin].
11.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se bataya: Unhone al-Qasim ibn Muhammad ko suna: ke unhone Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid, aur Mujammi' ibn Yazid, jo dono Ansari the, unhein bataate hue suna: ke Ansar mein se ek aadmi jise Khidham kaha jaata tha, ne apni ek beti ka nikaah kar diya, lekin usne apne walid ke nikaah [ke faisle] ko na-pasand kiya, to woh Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aayi aur yeh baat unhein batayi, to aapne uski taraf se uske walid ke nikaah ko radd kar diya, so usne Abu Lubabah ibn Abd al-Mundhir se nikaah kiya. Yahya ne zikr kiya: ke unhein khabar mili thi ke woh pehle shauhar-yaafta thi [kuwari nahi].

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ،  عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، وُمُجَمِّعٍ   ابْنَيْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَارِيَةَ ، أَنَّ خَنْسَاءَ بِنْتَ خِذَامٍ زَوَّجَهَا أَبُوهَا وَهِيَ ثَيِّبٌ، فَكَرِهَتْ ذَلِكَ، فَأَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" فَرَدَّ نِكَاحَهَا "
11.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from his father, from Abd al-Rahman and Mujammi', sons of Yazid ibn Jariyah: That Khansa bint Khidham was married off by her father while she was a previously-married woman, so she disliked that, and came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, "so he annulled her marriage."
11.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim se, apne walid se, Abd al-Rahman aur Mujammi', Yazid ibn Jariyah ke beton, se bataya ke Khansa bint Khidham ka nikaah unke walid ne kar diya jabke woh shauhar-yaafta thi, to unhone isay na-pasand kiya, aur Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aayi, "to aapne uska nikaah radd kar diya."

11.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدٌ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ  أَوْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ   ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" أَيُّمَا امْرَأَةٍ زَوَّجَهَا وَلِيَّانِ لَهَا، فَهِيَ لِلْأَوَّلِ مِنْهُمَا، وَأَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ بَاعَ بَيْعًا مِنْ رَجُلَيْنِ، فَهُوَ لِلْأَوَّلِ مِنْهُمَا ".
 حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّان  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ  ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، بِنَحْوِهِ
11.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Sa'id, from Qatadah, from al-Hasan, from Uqbah ibn Amir or Samurah ibn Jundub; a similar chain also via Affan: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whichever woman two guardians of hers marry off, she belongs to the first of the two, and whichever man sells a sale to two men, it belongs to the first of the two." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Affan, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Qatadah, from al-Hasan, from Samurah, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.]
11.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Sa'id se, Qatadah se, al-Hasan se, Uqbah ibn Amir ya Samurah ibn Jundub se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jis bhi aurat ka nikaah uske do waali kar dein, woh unmein se pehle ki hogi, aur jo bhi aadmi ek cheez do aadmiyon ko beche, woh unmein se pehle ki hogi." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Affan se, Hammad ibn Salamah se, Qatadah se, al-Hasan se, Samurah se, Rasulullah ﷺ se bhi aayi hai.]

11.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيز  ، عَنِ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ سَبْرَةَ  : أَنَّ أَبَاهُ   حَدَّثَهُ : أَنَّهُمْ سَارُوا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي حِجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، فَقَالَ : " اسْتَمْتِعُوا مِنْ هَذِهِ النِّسَاءِ ".
وَالِاسْتِمْتَاعُ عِنْدَنَا : التَّزْوِيجُ، فَعَرَضْنَا ذَلِكَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ، فَأَبَيْنَ أَنْ لَا نَضْرِبَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُنَّ أَجَلًا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " افْعَلُوا ".
فَخَرَجْتُ أَنَا وَابْنُ عَمٍّ لِي مَعَهُ بُرْدٌ، وَمَعِي بُرْدٌ، وَبُرْدُهُ أَجْوَدُ مِنْ بُرْدِي، وَأَنَا أَشَبُّ مِنْهُ، فَأَتَيْنَا عَلَى امْرَأَةٍ فَأَعْجَبَهَا شَبَابِي، وَأَعْجَبَهَا بُرْدُهُ، فَقَالَتْ : بُرْدٌ كَبُرْدٍ، وَكَانَ الْأَجَلُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهَا عَشْرًا، فَبِتُّ عِنْدَهَا تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةَ، ثُمَّ غَدَوْتُ، فَإِذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَائِمٌ بَيْنَ الرُّكْنِ وَالْبَابِ، فَقَالَ : " يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ،إِنِّي قَدْ كُنْتُ أَذِنْتُ لَكُمْ فِي الِاسْتِمْتَاعِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ، أَلَا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ حَرَّمَهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ، فَمَنْ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ مِنْهُنَّ شَيْءٌ، فَلْيُخَلِّ سَبِيلَهَا، وَلَا تَأْخُذُوا مِمَّا آتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ شَيْئًا "
11.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz, from al-Rabi' ibn Sabrah, from his father: That they marched with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ during the Farewell Pilgrimage, and he said: "Enjoy [contract] from these women." And al-istimta' among us was: marriage. So we presented that to the women, and they refused unless we set a term between us and them, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do it." So I and a cousin of mine went out, he had a striped garment, and I had a striped garment, and his garment was better than mine, and I was younger than him, so we came upon a woman, and she was impressed by my youth, and impressed by his garment, so she said: "A garment like a garment [either is fine]," and the term between me and her was ten [nights], so I spent that night with her, then in the morning, behold the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was standing between the corner and the door, and he said: "O people, I had permitted you to enjoy from women, but indeed Allah has now forbidden it until the Day of Resurrection, so whoever has any of them [under such an arrangement], let him release her, and do not take back anything of what you gave them."
11.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz se, al-Rabi' ibn Sabrah se, apne walid se bataya ke woh Hajjat-ul-Wida' mein Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath chale, to aapne farmaya: "In auraton se mut'ah karo." Aur humare nazdeek 'istimta'' ka matlab tha: nikaah. So humne yeh baat auraton ke saamne rakhi, to unhone inkaar kiya jab tak hum humare aur unke darmiyan koi muddat na muqarrar karein, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Karo." So main aur mera ek chachazaad nikle, uske paas ek dhaari-daar chaadar thi, aur mere paas bhi ek chaadar thi, aur uski chaadar meri se behtar thi, aur main usse zyada jawaan tha, so hum ek aurat ke paas aaye to woh meri jawaani se mutassar hui, aur uski chaadar se mutassar hui, to usne kaha: "Chaadar jaisi chaadar [dono theek hain]," aur mere aur uske darmiyan muddat das [raatein] thi, so main us raat uske paas raha, fir subah hui, to Rasulullah ﷺ rukn aur darwaze ke darmiyan khade the, aur farmaya: "Ae logo, maine tumhein auraton se mut'ah karne ki ijaazat di thi, sun lo, Allah ne isay Qayamat ke din tak haraam kar diya hai, so jiske paas unmein se koi ho, woh usay chhod de, aur jo tumne unhein diya hai usme se kuch bhi wapas na lo."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ سَبْرَةَ الْجُهَنِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْنِكَاحِ الْمُتْعَةِ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ "
11.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Ibn Uyaynah, from al-Zuhri, from al-Rabi' ibn Sabrah al-Juhani, from his father: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the marriage of mut'ah in the year of the Conquest."
11.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Ibn Uyaynah se, al-Zuhri se, al-Rabi' ibn Sabrah al-Juhani se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Fateh ke saal mut'ah ke nikaah se mana kiya."

11.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ  حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَلِيًّا  ، يَقُولُ لِابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ : " إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَنَهَى عَنِ الْمُتْعَةِ : مُتْعَةِ النِّسَاءِ، وَعَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الْأَهْلِيَّةِ عَامَ خَيْبَرَ "
11.en: Narrated by Muhammad, from Ibn Uyaynah, from al-Zuhri, from al-Hasan and Abdullah, from their father, about Ali and Ibn Abbas: He said: I heard Ali say to Ibn Abbas: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade mut'ah: the mut'ah of women, and the meat of domestic donkeys, in the year of Khaybar."
11.hi: Muhammad ne bataya: Mujhse Ibn Uyaynah ne bataya, al-Zuhri se, al-Hasan aur Abdullah se, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, Maine Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko Ibn Abbas se kehte suna: "Rasulullah ﷺ ne mut'ah se mana kiya: auraton ke mut'ah se, aur ghareloo gadhon ke gosht se, Khaybar ke saal."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ نُبَيْهِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ  ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" الْمُحْرِمُ لَا يَنْكِحُ وَلَا يُنْكِحُ "
11.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Uyaynah, from Ayyub ibn Musa, from Nubayh ibn Wahb, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Uthman, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "The muhrim does not marry, nor arrange marriage for another."
11.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Ibn Uyaynah se, Ayyub ibn Musa se, Nubayh ibn Wahb se, Aban ibn Uthman se, Uthman se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Muhrim na khud nikaah karta hai na kisi aur ka karwata hai."

11.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ هُوَ : ابْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ   كَمْ كَانَ صَدَاقُ أَزْوَاجِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَتْ :" كَانَ صَدَاقُهُ لِأَزْوَاجِهِ اثْنَتَيْ عَشْرَةَ أُوقِيَّةً، وَنَشًّا "، وَقَالَتْ : أَتَدْرِي مَا النَّشُّ؟.
قَالَ : قُلْتُ : لَا، قَالَتْ : " نِصْفُ أُوقِيَّةٍ، فَهَذَا صَدَاقُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِأَزْوَاجِهِ "
11.en: Narrated by Nu'aym ibn Hammad, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Yazid ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Salamah, about Aisha: He said: I asked Aisha how much was the dowry of the wives of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, she said: "His dowry for his wives was twelve uqiyyahs, and a nashsh," and she said: Do you know what an nashsh is? He said: I said, "No," she said: "Half an uqiyyah, so this was the dowry of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for his wives."
11.hi: Nu'aym ibn Hammad ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, Yazid ibn Abdullah se, Muhammad ibn Ibrahim se, Abu Salamah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Aisha se poocha Rasulullah ﷺ ki biwiyon ka mahar kitna tha, unhone kaha: "Aapki biwiyon ke liye aapka mahar baarah uqiyyah, aur ek nashsh tha," aur poocha: Tumhein maloom hai nashsh kya hai? Unhone kaha: Maine kaha, "Nahi," unhone kaha: "Aadha uqiyyah, so yeh Rasulullah ﷺ ka apni biwiyon ke liye mahar tha."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ زَاذَانَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَجْفَاءِ السُّلَمِيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ   خَطَبَ، فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ، ثُمّ قَالَ :" أَلَا لَا تُغَالُوا فِي صُدُقِ النِّسَاءِ، فَإِنَّهَا لَوْ كَانَتْ مَكْرُمَةً فِي الدُّنْيَا، أَوْ تَقْوَى عِنْدَ اللَّهِ، كَانَ أَوْلَاكُمْ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَا أَصْدَقَ امْرَأَةً مِنْ نِسَائِهِ، وَلَا أُصْدِقَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ بَنَاتِهِ فَوْقَ اثْنَتَيْ عَشْرَةَ أُوقِيَّةً، أَلَا وَإِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ لَيُغَالِي بِصَدَاقِ امْرَأَتِهِ حَتَّى يَبْقَى لَهَا فِي نَفْسِهِ عَدَاوَةٌ حَتَّى يَقُولَ : كَلِفْتُ علَيْكِ عَلَقَ الْقِرْبَةِ أَوْ عَرَقَ الْقِرْبَةِ "
11.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Hushaym, from Mansur ibn Zadhan, from Ibn Sirin, from Abu al-Ajfa al-Sulami: He said: I heard Umar ibn al-Khattab give a sermon, so he praised Allah and lauded Him, then said: "Do not go to excess in the dowries of women, for indeed if it were an honor in this world, or piety before Allah, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would have been most entitled to it among you: he did not give dowry to a woman of his wives, nor was a woman of his daughters given dowry, above twelve uqiyyahs; behold, one of you exaggerates the dowry of his wife until there remains enmity for her in his soul, until he says: 'I was burdened for you like the sweat/blood of the waterskin.'"
11.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Hushaym se, Mansur ibn Zadhan se, Ibn Sirin se, Abu al-Ajfa al-Sulami se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Umar ibn al-Khattab ko khutba dete suna, to unhone Allah ki hamd ki aur uski tareef ki, fir kaha: "Sun lo, auraton ke mahar mein hadd se zyada mat karo, kyunki agar yeh duniya mein izzat hoti, ya Allah ke nazdeek taqwa hoti, to Rasulullah ﷺ tum sabse zyada uske haqdaar hote: aapne apni kisi biwi ko baarah uqiyyah se zyada mahar nahi diya, aur na hi aapki kisi beti ko baarah uqiyyah se zyada mahar diya gaya; sun lo, tum mein se koi apni biwi ke mahar mein itni zyaadti karta hai ke uske dil mein uske liye dushmani reh jaati hai, yahan tak ke woh kehta hai: 'Mujhe tumhare liye mashkeeze ke rasse ki tarah bojh uthaana pada.'"

11.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ  ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ   قَالَ : أَتَتِ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَتْ : إِنَّهَا وَهَبَتْ نَفْسَهَا لِلَّهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ.
فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَالِي فِي النِّسَاءِ مِنْ حَاجَةٍ "، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ : زَوِّجْنِيهَا، فَقَالَ : " أَعْطِهَا ثَوْبًا "، فَقَالَ : لَا أَجِدُ، قَالَ : " أَعْطِهَا وَلَوْ خَاتَمًا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ "، قَالَ : فَاعْتَلَّ لَهُ، فَقَالَ : " مَا مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ؟ "، قَالَ : كَذَا وَكَذَا، قَالَ : " فَقَدْ زَوَّجْتُكَهَا عَلَى مَا مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ "
11.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Abu Hazim, from Sahl ibn Sa'd: He said: A woman came to the Prophet ﷺ, and said that she had given herself to Allah and His Messenger. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I have no need of women." So a man said: "Marry her to me." So he said: "Give her a garment." So he said: "I cannot find [one]." He said: "Give her even an iron ring." He said: So he made an excuse to him, so he said: "What do you have of the Qur'an?" He said: such-and-such. He said: "I have married her to you for what you have of the Qur'an."
11.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Abu Hazim se, Sahl ibn Sa'd se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aurat Nabi ﷺ ke paas aayi, aur kaha ke usne apne aap ko Allah aur uske Rasool ko de diya hai. To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Mujhe auraton ki koi zaroorat nahi." To ek aadmi ne kaha: "Iska nikaah mujhse kar dijiye." Aapne farmaya: "Isay ek kapda do." Usne kaha: "Mujhe nahi milega." Aapne farmaya: "Isay chahe loha ki angoothi hi do." Unhone bataya: To usne uzr pesh kiya, to aapne poocha: "Tumhein Quran mein se kya yaad hai?" Usne kaha: fulaan-fulaan. Aapne farmaya: "Maine iska nikaah tumse us Quran ke badle kar diya jo tumhein yaad hai."

11.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، وَحَجَّاجٌ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، قَالَ : أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاق  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : عَلَّمَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خُطْبَةَ الْحَاجَةِ :" الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ أَوْ إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ لِلَّهِ نَحْمَدُهُ وَنَسْتَعِينُهُ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُهُ، وَنَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شُرُورِ أَنْفُسِنَا، مَنْ يَهْدِهِ اللَّهُ، فَلَا مُضِلَّ لَهُ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ، فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ "، ثُمَّ يَقْرَأُ ثَلَاثَ آيَاتٍ : # يَأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِ وَلا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلا وَأَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ سورة آل عمران آية 102 #، # يَأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَبَثَّ مِنْهُمَا رِجَالا كَثِيرًا وَنِسَاءً وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِي تَسَاءَلُونَ بِهِ وَالأَرْحَامَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيبًا سورة النساء آية 1 #، # يَأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَقُولُوا قَوْلا سَدِيدًا { 70 } يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا { 71 } سورة الأحزاب آية 70-71 # ثُمَّ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِحَاجَتِهِ
11.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, and Hajjaj, from Shu'bah, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu Ubaydah, from Abdullah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ taught us the sermon for a need: "Al-hamdu lillah" or "Innal-hamda lillah, nahmaduhu wa nasta'inuhu wa nastaghfiruh, wa na'udhu billahi min shururi anfusina, man yahdihillahu fala mudilla lah, wa man yudlil fala hadiya lah, ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh" [Praise be to Allah, we praise Him and seek His help and forgiveness, and we seek refuge with Allah from the evils of our souls, whoever Allah guides, none can misguide him, and whoever He leaves astray, none can guide him, I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger], then he would recite three verses: "O you who believe, fear Allah as He should be feared, and do not die except as Muslims" [Surah Ali Imran, verse 102], "O mankind, fear your Lord who created you from a single soul, and created from it its mate, and dispersed from the two of them many men and women, and fear Allah, through whom you ask one another, and the wombs, indeed Allah is ever watchful over you" [Surah al-Nisa, verse 1], "O you who believe, fear Allah and speak a proper word, He will amend for you your deeds and forgive you your sins, and whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger has indeed attained a great attainment" [Surah al-Ahzab, verses 70-71], then he would speak of his need.
11.hi: Abu al-Walid aur Hajjaj ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Humein Abu Ishaq ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Ubaydah ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Abdullah se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein zaroorat ka khutba sikhaaya: "Al-hamdu lillah" ya "Innal-hamda lillah, nahmaduhu wa nasta'eenuhu wa nastaghfiruh, wa na'oodhu billahi min shuroori anfusina, man yahdihillahu fala mudilla lah, wa man yudlil fala haadiya lah, ash-hadu an la ilaaha illallah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasooluh," fir aap teen aayaten padhte: "Ae imaan walo, Allah se aisa daro jaisa uska haq hai, aur sirf Musalman hokar hi marna" [Surah Aal-e-Imran, aayat 102], "Ae logo, apne Rab se daro jisne tumhein ek jaan se paida kiya, aur usi se uska jodaa banaya, aur un dono se bahut se mard aur auratein phaila din, aur us Allah se daro jiske naam par tum ek-doosre se maangte ho, aur rishtedaari se, beshak Allah tumpar nigraan hai" [Surah An-Nisa, aayat 1], "Ae imaan walo, Allah se daro aur seedhi baat kaho, woh tumhare a'maal sudhaar dega aur tumhare gunah maaf kar dega, aur jo Allah aur uske Rasool ki itaa'at kare, woh zaroor badi kaamyaabi paayega" [Surah Al-Ahzab, aayat 70-71], fir aap apni zaroorat bayaan karte.

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  ، عَنْ مَرْثَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ أَحَقَّ الشُّرُوطِ أَنْ تُوفُوا بِهَا مَا اسْتَحْلَلْتُمْ بِهِ مِنَ الْفُرُوجِ "
11.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Abd al-Hamid ibn Ja'far, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Marthad ibn Abdullah, from Uqbah ibn Amir, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Indeed the most deserving conditions to be fulfilled by you are those by which you have made lawful the private parts."
11.hi: Abu Asim ne Abd al-Hamid ibn Ja'far se, Yazid ibn Abi Habib se, Marthad ibn Abdullah se, Uqbah ibn Amir se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Poori karne ke sabse zyada haqdaar shartein woh hain jinke zariye tumne sharamgaahon ko halal kiya hai."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَأَى عَلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ صُفْرَةً، فَقَالَ : " مَا هَذِهِ الصُّفْرَةُ؟ "، قَالَ : تَزَوَّجْتُ امْرَأَةً عَلَى وَزْنِ نَوَاةٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، قَالَ :" بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، أَوْلِمْ وَلَوْ بِشَاةٍ "
11.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Thabit, from Anas: That the Prophet ﷺ saw on Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf a trace of yellow [perfume], and said: "What is this yellow mark?" He said: I have married a woman for the weight of a date-pit's worth of gold. He said: "May Allah bless you, give a wedding feast, even if with a single sheep."
11.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Thabit se, Anas se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf par zardi ka nishaan dekha, aur poocha: "Yeh zardi ka nishaan kya hai?" Unhone kaha: Maine ek aurat se ek khajoor-guthli jitne sone ke badle nikaah kiya hai. Aapne farmaya: "Allah tumhein barkat de, waleema karo, chahe ek hi bhed se ho."

11.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى وَلِيمَةٍ، فَلْيُجِبْ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُجِيبَ وَلَيْسَ الْأَكْلُ عَلَيْهِ بِوَاجِبٍ
11.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Uqbah ibn Khalid, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you is invited to a wedding feast, let him accept." Abu Muhammad said: It is proper that he accept, but eating is not obligatory upon him.
11.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Uqbah ibn Khalid se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se kisi ko waleeme ki dawat di jaaye, to woh qabool kare." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Usay dawat qabool karni chahiye, lekin khaana usper wajib nahi.

11.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّضْرِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ نَهِيكٍ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ امْرَأَتَانِ، فَمَالَ إِلَى إِحْدَاهُمَا، جَاءَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَشِقُّهُ مَائِلٌ "
11.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Hammam, from Qatadah, from al-Nadr ibn Anas, from Bashir ibn Nahik, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whoever has two wives, and inclines toward one of them, will come on the Day of Resurrection with his side leaning [i.e., paralyzed/tilted]."
11.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Hammam se, Qatadah se, al-Nadr ibn Anas se, Bashir ibn Nahik se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jiski do biwiyaan hon, aur woh unmein se ek ki taraf jhuk jaaye, woh Qayamat ke din aayega jabke uska ek pehlu jhuka hua hoga."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الْخَطْمِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقْسِمُ فَيَعْدِلُ وَيَقُولُ :" اللَّهُمَّ هَذِهِ قِسْمَتِي فِيمَا أَمْلِكُ، فَلَا تَلُمْنِي فِيمَا تَمْلِكُ وَلَا أَمْلِكُ "
11.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Asim, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah, from Abdullah ibn Yazid al-Khatmi, from Aisha: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to divide [his time among his wives] and be just, and would say: "O Allah, this is my division in what I possess [control over], so do not blame me for what You possess and I do not possess [i.e., the heart's inclination]."
11.hi: Amr ibn Asim ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ayyub se, Abu Qilabah se, Abdullah ibn Yazid al-Khatmi se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ [apni biwiyon mein] taqseem karte aur insaaf karte, aur kehte: "Allahumma haadhihi qismati feema amlik, fala talumni feema tamliku wa la amlik" [Ae Allah, yeh meri taqseem hai us cheez mein jispar mera ikhtiyaar hai, so mujhe us cheez ke liye malaamat na kar jispar tera ikhtiyaar hai aur mera nahi].

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : " كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَإِذَا سَافَرَ، أَقْرَعَ بَيْنَ نِسَائِهِ، فَأَيَّتُهُنَّ خَرَجَ سَهْمُهَا، خَرَجَ بِهَا مَعَهُ "
11.en: Narrated by Isma'il, from Ibn al-Mubarak, from Yunus ibn Yazid, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha: She said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he traveled, would draw lots among his wives, so whichever of them her lot came out, he would take her out with him."
11.hi: Isma'il ne Ibn al-Mubarak se, Yunus ibn Yazid se, al-Zuhri se, Urwah se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ jab safar karte, to apni biwiyon ke darmiyan qura andaazi karte, so jiska bhi naam nikalta, aap usay apne saath le jaate."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ،  عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لِلْبِكْرِ سَبْعٌ، وَلِلثَّيِّبِ ثَلَاثٌ "
11.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah, from Anas ibn Malik: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "For the virgin, seven [nights], and for the previously-married, three."
11.hi: Ya'la ne Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, Ayyub se, Abu Qilabah se, Anas ibn Malik se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Kuwari ke liye saat [raatein], aur shauhar-yaafta ke liye teen."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَمَّا تَزَوَّجَ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ ، أَقَامَ عِنْدَهَا ثَلَاثًا، وَقَالَ :" إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ بِكِ عَلَى أَهْلِكِ هَوَانٌ، إِنْ شِئْتِ، سَبَّعْتُ لَكِ، وَإِنْ سَبَّعْتُ لَكِ، سَبَّعْتُ لِسَائِرِ نِسَائِي "
11.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Shaybah, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Sufyan, from Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr, from Abd al-Malik ibn Abi Bakr ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Harith ibn Hisham, from his father, from Umm Salamah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he married Umm Salamah, stayed with her three [nights], and said: "Indeed there is no lowliness upon you compared to your family, if you wish, I will give you seven, but if I give you seven, I will give the rest of my wives seven [as well]."
11.hi: Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Shaybah ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Sufyan se, Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr se, Abd al-Malik ibn Abi Bakr ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Harith ibn Hisham se, apne walid se, Umm Salamah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne, jab Umm Salamah se nikaah kiya, unke paas teen [raatein] guzaarin, aur farmaya: "Tumhare gharwalon ke muqaable mein tumpar koi kami nahi, agar tum chaho, to main tumhein saat dun, aur agar main tumhein saat dun, to apni baaki biwiyon ko bhi saat dunga."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ :" تَزَوَّجَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي شَوَّالٍ، وَأُدْخِلْتُ عَلَيْهِ فِي شَوَّالٍ، فَأَيُّ نِسَائِهِ كَانَ أَحْظَى عِنْدَهُ مِنِّي؟ " قَالَت : " وَكَانَتْ تَسْتَحِبُّ أَنْ تُدْخِلَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ فِي شَوَّالٍ "
11.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Sufyan, from Isma'il ibn Umayyah, from Abdullah ibn Urwah, from Urwah, from Aisha: She said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ married me in Shawwal, and I was taken to him in Shawwal, so which of his wives was more favored with him than me?" She said: "And she used to love that women be taken to their husbands in Shawwal."
11.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Sufyan se, Isma'il ibn Umayyah se, Abdullah ibn Urwah se, Urwah se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhse Shawwal mein nikaah kiya, aur mujhe Shawwal mein hi aapke paas laaya gaya, to aapki kaunsi biwi mujhse zyada aapke qareeb thi?" Unhone kaha: "Aur woh pasand karti thin ke auratein Shawwal mein apne shohar ke paas rukhsat ki jaayein."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَا يَمْنَعُ أَحَدَكُمْ أَنْ يَقُولَ حِينَ يُجَامِعُ أَهْلَهُ : بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا "، فَإِنْ قَضَى اللَّهُ وَلَدًا، لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ الشَّيْطَانُ
11.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Isra'il, from Mansur, from Salim, from Kurayb, from Ibn Abbas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "What prevents one of you, when he has intercourse with his family, from saying: 'Bismillah, Allahumma jannibna ash-shaytana, wa jannib ash-shaytana ma razaqtana' [In the name of Allah, O Allah, keep the Shaytan away from us, and keep the Shaytan away from what You provide us]"? for if Allah decrees a child, the Shaytan will not harm him.
11.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Isra'il se, Mansur se, Salim se, Kurayb se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tum mein se kisi ko yeh kehne se kya rokta hai jab woh apni biwi ke saath sohbat kare: 'Bismillah, Allahumma jannibnash-shaytana, wa jannibish-shaytana ma razaqtana' [Allah ke naam se, Ae Allah, humein shaytan se door rakh, aur jo tu humein de use shaytan se door rakh]"? kyunki agar Allah bachche ka faisla kare, to shaytan usay nuqsaan nahi pahunchaayega.

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ  ، عَنْ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ قَيْسٍ الْخَطْمِيِّ  ، عَنْ هَرَمِيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ خُزَيْمَةَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَسْتَحْيِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ، لَا تَأْتُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي أَعْجَازِهِنَّ "
11.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Usamah, from al-Walid ibn Kathir, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn al-Husayn, from Abd al-Malik ibn Amr ibn Qays al-Khatmi, from Harami ibn Abdullah, from Khuzaymah ibn Thabit: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Indeed Allah is not shy of the truth, do not come to women in their rears."
11.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Usamah se, al-Walid ibn Kathir se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn al-Husayn se, Abd al-Malik ibn Amr ibn Qays al-Khatmi se, Harami ibn Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Khuzaymah ibn Thabit ko kehte suna: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Allah haq [baat kehne] se sharm nahi karta, auraton ke paas unke peechhe (piche wale raaste) se na jao."

11.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ  ،  عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   : أَنَّ الْيَهُودَ، قَالُوا لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ :" مَنْ أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ مُدْبِرَةٌ، جَاءَ وَلَدُهُ أَحْوَلَ.
فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى : # نِسَاؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَكُمْ فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ سورة البقرة آية 223 # "
11.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Jabir ibn Abdullah: That the Jews said to the Muslims: "Whoever comes to his wife while she is facing away [from behind], his child will be born cross-eyed," so Allah the Exalted revealed: "Your wives are a tilth for you, so come to your tilth however you wish" [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 223].
11.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir se, Jabir ibn Abdullah se bataya ke Yahoodiyon ne Musalmanon se kaha: "Jo apni biwi ke paas is haal mein jaaye ke woh peeth farigh ho, uska bachcha bhengi aankhon wala paida hoga," to Allah Ta'ala ne naazil kiya: "Tumhari biwiyaan tumhare liye kheti hain, so apni kheti mein jis tarah chaaho aao" [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 223].

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا قَبِيصَةُ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَلَّامٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ  ، قَالَ : رَأَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ امْرَأَةً فَأَعْجَبَتْهُ، فَأَتَى سَوْدَةَ وَهِيَ تَصْنَعُ طِيبًا، وَعِنْدَهَا نِسَاءٌ، فَأَخْلَيْنَهُ، فَقَضَى حَاجَتَهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ :" أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ رَأَى امْرَأَةً تُعْجِبُهُ، فَلْيَقُمْ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ، فَإِنَّ مَعَهَا مِثْلَ الَّذِي مَعَهَا "
11.en: Narrated by Qabisah, from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from Abdullah ibn Hallam, from Abdullah ibn Mas'ud: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw a woman and she pleased him, so he came to Sawdah while she was making perfume, and there were women with her, so they left him alone with her, and he fulfilled his need, then said: "Whichever man sees a woman who pleases him, let him go to his family, for indeed she has with her the like of what the other has."
11.hi: Qabisah ne Sufyan se, Abu Ishaq se, Abdullah ibn Hallam se, Abdullah ibn Mas'ud se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne ek aurat dekhi aur woh aapko pasand aayi, to aap Sawdah ke paas gaye jabke woh khushbu banaa rahi thin, aur unke paas auratein thin, to unhone aapko unke saath akela chhod diya, to aapne apni zaroorat poori ki, fir farmaya: "Jo bhi aadmi kisi aurat ko dekhe jo usay pasand aaye, to woh apne gharwaale ke paas jaaye, kyunki uske paas bhi wahi hai jo doosri ke paas hai."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُطِيعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَيَّارٌ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي سَفَرٍ فَلَمَّا قَفَلْنَا تَعَجَّلْتُ، فَلَحِقَنِي رَاكِبٌ، قَالَ : فَالْتَفَتُّ، فَإِذَا أَنَا بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ لِي :" مَا أَعْجَلَكَ يَا جَابِرُ؟ " قَالَ : إِنِّي حَدِيثُ عَهْدٍ بِعُرْسٍ، قَالَ : " أَفَبِكْرًا تَزَوَّجْتَهَا أَمْ ثَيِّبًا؟ " قَالَ : قُلْتُ : بَلْ ثَيِّبًا، قَالَ : " فَهَلَّا بِكْرًا تُلَاعِبُهَا وَتُلَاعِبُكَ؟ " قَالَ : ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي : " إِذَا قَدِمْتَ فَالْكَيْسَ الْكَيْسَ "، قَالَ : فَلَمَّا قَدِمْنَا، ذَهَبْنَا نَدْخُلُ، قَالَ : " أَمْهِلُوا حَتَّى نَدْخُلَ لَيْلًا، أَيْ : عِشَاءً لِكَيْ تَمْتَشِطَ الشَّعِثَةُ، وَتَسْتَحِدَّ الْمُغِيبَةُ "
11.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Muti', from Hushaym, from Sayyar, from al-Sha'bi, from Jabir ibn Abdullah: He said: We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on a journey, so when we returned, I hurried, so a rider caught up with me, he said: So I turned, and behold it was the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he said to me: "What has made you hurry, O Jabir?" He said: I have recently married. He said: "A virgin have you married, or a previously-married woman?" He said: I said, "Rather, a previously-married woman." He said: "Why not a virgin, so you could play with her and she with you?" He said: Then he said to me: "When you arrive, be prudent, be prudent." He said: So when we arrived, we went to enter, he said: "Wait until we enter at night, that is: in the evening, so that the disheveled-haired one may comb her hair, and the one whose husband was away may remove her pubic hair."
11.hi: Abdullah ibn Muti' ne Hushaym se, Sayyar se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: Humein Jabir ibn Abdullah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath ek safar mein the, so jab hum wapas hue, main jaldi karne laga, to ek sawaar mujhse aa mila, unhone bataya: To main muda, to woh Rasulullah ﷺ the, aur aapne mujhse poocha: "Tumhein kis cheez ne jaldi karaayi, Ae Jabir?" Unhone bataya: Maine haal hi mein nikaah kiya hai. Aapne poocha: "Kya kuwari se nikaah kiya ya shauhar-yaafta se?" Unhone bataya: Maine kaha, "Balke, shauhar-yaafta se." Aapne farmaya: "Kuwari kyun nahi, taake tum usse khela karte aur woh tumse khelti?" Unhone bataya: Fir aapne mujhse farmaya: "Jab pahuncho, to sujh-bujh se kaam lena, sujh-bujh se." Unhone bataya: To jab hum pahunche, hum andar jaane lage, to aapne farmaya: "Thehro yahan tak ke hum raat ko dakhil hon," yaani: shaam ko, "taake bikhre baalon wali kanghi kar sake, aur jiske shohar door the woh apne baal saaf kar sake."

11.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ الْأَسَدِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَة  ، عَنْ جُدَامَةَ بِنْتِ وَهْبٍ الْأَسَدِيَّةِ  ، قَالَتْ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ أَنْهَى عَنِ الْغِيلَةِ حَتَّى ذَكَرْتُ أَنَّ فَارِسَ، وَالرُّومَ يَصْنَعُونَ ذَلِكَ فَلَا يَضُرُّ أَوْلَادَهُمْ ".
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : الْغِيلَةُ : أَنْ يُجَامِعَهَا وَهِيَ تُرْضِعُ
11.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Nawfal al-Asadi, from Urwah, from Aisha, from Judamah bint Wahb al-Asadiyyah; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I had indeed intended to forbid al-ghilah, until I remembered that the Persians and the Byzantines do that, and it does not harm their children." Abu Muhammad said: al-ghilah is: that he have intercourse with her while she is [still] breastfeeding.
11.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Nawfal al-Asadi se, Urwah se, Aisha se bataya: Judamah bint Wahb al-Asadiyyah ne unhein bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Maine ghilah se mana karne ka irada kiya tha, yahan tak ke mujhe yaad aaya ke Iran aur Rome wale bhi aisa karte hain, aur isse unke bacchon ko nuqsaan nahi hota." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Ghilah yeh hai ke woh biwi ke doodh pilaate waqt uske saath sohbat kare.

11.ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ :" مَا ضَرَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَادِمًا قَطُّ، وَلَا ضَرَبَ بِيَدِهِ شَيْئًا قَطُّ إِلَّا أَنْ يُجَاهِدَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ G "
