11.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha: She said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never struck a servant, nor ever struck anything with his hand, except when he fought jihad in the path of Allah, mighty and majestic is He."
11.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne kabhi kisi naukar ko nahi maara, aur na hi apne haath se kabhi kisi cheez ko maara, siwaay iske ke aap Allah, Azza wa Jall, ki raah mein jihad karte."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ إِيَاسِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي ذُبَابِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا تَضْرِبُوا إِمَاءَ اللَّهِ "، فَجَاءَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : قَدْ ذَئِرْنَ عَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِنَّ، فَرَخَّصَ لَهُمْ، فِي ضَرْبِهِنَّ، فَأَطَافَ بِآلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نِسَاءٌ كَثِيرٌ يَشْكُونَ أَزْوَاجَهُنَّ، فَقَالَ : فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " لَقَدْ طَافَ بِآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ نِسَاءٌ كَثِيرٌ يَشْكُونَ أَزْوَاجَهُنَّ لَيْسَ أُولَئِكَ بِخِيَارِكُمْ "
11.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf, from Sufyan, from al-Zuhri, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah, from Iyas ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Dhubab: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do not strike the female servants of Allah." So Umar ibn al-Khattab came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and said: Women have become forward toward their husbands, so he gave them a concession, in striking them, so many women went around the family of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ complaining about their husbands, he said: So the Prophet ﷺ said: "Many women have indeed gone around the family of Muhammad complaining about their husbands; those are not the best among you."
11.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf ne Sufyan se, al-Zuhri se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah se, Iyas ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Dhubab se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah ki bandiyon ko na maaro." To Umar ibn al-Khattab Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaye, aur kaha: Auratein apne shohar ke saamne saheem ho gayi hain, to aapne unhein rukhsat de di, unhein maarne ki, to bahut si auratein Rasulullah ﷺ ke ghar walon ke paas apne shohar ki shikaayat karte hue aayin, unhone bataya: To Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, "Bahut si auratein Muhammad ke ghar walon ke paas apne shohar ki shikaayat karte hue aayi hain; woh log tumhare behtareen log nahi hain."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَمَعَةَ  ، قَالَ : خَطَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ النَّاسَ يَوْمًا فَوَعَظَهُمْ فِي النِّسَاءِ، فَقَالَ :" مَا بَالُ الرَّجُلِ يَجْلِدُ امْرَأَتَهُ جَلْدَ الْعَبْدِ، وَلَعَلَّهُ يُضَاجِعُهَا فِي آخِرِ يَوْمِهِ؟ ! "
11.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Abdullah ibn Zam'ah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ addressed the people one day and admonished them about women, and said: "What is wrong with a man that he flogs his wife like a slave, yet perhaps he will lie with her at the end of his day?!"
11.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Abdullah ibn Zam'ah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne ek din logon ko khutba diya aur unhein auraton ke baare mein naseehat ki, aur farmaya: "Aadmi ko kya hua hai ke woh apni biwi ko ghulam ki tarah kode maare, aur shayad woh apne din ke aakhir mein uske saath ham-bistar ho?!"

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْجُرَيْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَلَاءِ  ، عَنْ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ   : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ الْمَرْأَةَ خُلِقَتْ مِنْ ضِلَعٍ، فَإِنْ تُقِمْهَا، كَسَرْتَهَا، فَدَارِهَا، فَإِنَّ فِيهَا أَوَدًا وَبُلْغَةً "
11.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi, from Abd al-Warith, from al-Jurayri, from Abu al-Ala, from Nu'aym ibn Qa'nab, from Abu Dharr: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed woman was created from a rib, so if you try to straighten her, you will break her, so deal gently with her, for indeed in her is crookedness and benefit."
11.hi: Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi ne Abd al-Warith se, al-Jurayri se, Abu al-Ala se, Nu'aym ibn Qa'nab se, Abu Dharr se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Aurat paslion se banaayi gayi hai, so agar tum usay seedha karne ki koshish karoge, to usay tod doge, so uske saath narmi se pesh aao, kyunki usmein tedhaapan aur faida dono hain."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّمَا الْمَرْأَةُ كَالضِّلَعِ : إِنْ تُقِمْهَا، تَكْسِرْهَا، وَإِنْ تَسْتَمْتِعْ بِهَا، تَسْتَمْتِعْ وَفِيهَا عِوَجٌ "
11.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Woman is only like a rib: if you try to straighten her, you will break her, and if you enjoy her, you will enjoy her while there remains crookedness in her."
11.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Abu al-Zinad se, al-A'raj se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Aurat pasli ki tarah hai: agar tum usay seedha karne ki koshish karoge, to usay tod doge, aur agar tum usse faida uthaana chaho, to faida uthaao jabke usmein tedhaapan baaki rahega."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الْهَاشِمِيُّ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَة  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنِ الْعَزْلِ، فَقَالَ :" أَوَ تَفْعَلُونَ ذَلِكَ؟ فَلَا عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ لَا تَفْعَلُوا، فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ نَسَمَةٍ قَضَى اللَّهُ تَعَالَى أَنْ تَكُونَ إِلَّا كَانَتْ "
11.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Da'ud al-Hashimi, from Ibrahim ibn Sa'd, from al-Zuhri, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah, from Abu Sa'id: He said: A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about al-'azl [coitus interruptus], so he said: "Do you do that? There is no harm upon you if you do not do it, for there is no soul which Allah the Exalted has decreed to exist except that it will exist."
11.hi: Sulayman ibn Da'ud al-Hashimi ne Ibrahim ibn Sa'd se, al-Zuhri se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah se, Abu Sa'id se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi ne Rasulullah ﷺ se al-'azl (baahar nikaalna) ke baare mein poocha, to aapne farmaya: "Kya tum aisa karte ho? Tumpar koi harj nahi agar tum na karo, kyunki koi bhi rooh jise Allah Ta'ala ne paida hone ka faisla kiya hai, woh zaroor paida hogi."

11.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ بِشْرٍ  يَرُدُّ الْحَدِيثَ إِلَى أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قُلْنَا : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّه، الرَّجُلُ تَكُونُ لَهُ الْجَارِيَةُ فَيُصِيبُ مِنْهَا، وَيَكْرَهُ أَنْ تَحْمِلَ، أَفَيَعْزِلُ عَنْهَا؟ وَتَكُونُ عِنْدَهُ الْمَرْأَةُ تُرْضِعُ فَيُصِيبُ مِنْهَا وَيَكْرَهُ أَنْ تَحْمِلَ.
أَفَيَعْزِلُ عَنْهَا؟ قَالَ :" لَا عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ لَا تَفْعَلُوا، فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ الْقَدَرُ ".
قَالَ ابْنُ عَوْنٍ : فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِلْحَسَنِ، فَقَالَ : وَاللَّهِ لَكَأَنَّ هَذَا زَجْرٌا، وَاللَّهِ لَكَأَنَّ هَذَا زَجْرٌا ! !
11.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Ibn Awn, from Muhammad ibn Sirin, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Bishr, tracing the hadith to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri; with Ibn Awn's added note: He said: We said: "O Messenger of Allah, a man has a slave-girl and has relations with her, but dislikes her becoming pregnant, so does he withdraw from her? And a man has a wife who is breastfeeding and has relations with her, but dislikes her becoming pregnant, so does he withdraw from her?" He said: "There is no harm upon you if you do not do it, for it is only decree." Ibn Awn said: So I mentioned that to al-Hasan, so he said: By Allah, it is as if this is a rebuke, by Allah, it is as if this is a rebuke!!
11.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Ibn Awn se, Muhammad ibn Sirin se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Bishr se bataya, jo hadith Abu Sa'id al-Khudri tak pahunchate hain: Unhone kaha, Humne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, ek aadmi ki ek laundi hai aur woh uske saath sohbat karta hai, lekin usay uska haamila hona na-pasand hai, to kya woh usse baahar nikaale? Aur ek aadmi ki biwi hai jo doodh pila rahi hai aur woh uske saath sohbat karta hai, lekin usay uska haamila hona na-pasand hai, to kya woh usse baahar nikaale?" Aapne farmaya: "Tumpar koi harj nahi agar tum na karo, kyunki yeh sirf taqdeer hai." Ibn Awn kehte hain: To maine yeh baat al-Hasan se zikr ki, to unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, yeh goya ek daant-si hai, Allah ki qasam, yeh goya ek daant-si hai!!

11.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ أَغْيَرَ مِنَ اللَّهِ، لِذَلِكَ حَرَّمَ الْفَوَاحِشَ وَلَيْسَ أَحَدٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ الْمَدْحُ مِنَ اللَّهِ "
11.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from al-A'mash, from Shaqiq, from Abdullah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "No one is more jealous than Allah, for that He has forbidden the obscenities, and no one loves praise more than Allah."
11.hi: Ya'la ne al-A'mash se, Shaqiq se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Koi bhi Allah se zyada ghairat mand nahi, isi liye usne fahisha kaam haraam kiye hain, aur koi bhi Allah se zyada tareef pasand karne wala nahi."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَتِيكٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مِنَ الْغَيْرَةِ مَا يُحِبُّ اللَّه، وَمِنْهَا مَا يُبْغِضُ اللَّهُ : فَالْغَيْرَةُ الَّتِي يُحِبُّ اللَّه : الْغَيْرَةُ فِي الرِّيبَةِ، وَالْغَيْرَةُ الَّتِي يُبْغِضُ اللَّه، الْغَيْرَةُ فِي غَيْرِ رِيبَةٍ "
11.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim, from Ibn Jabir ibn Atik, from his father: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Some jealousy Allah loves, and some jealousy Allah hates: the jealousy which Allah loves is jealousy in [reasonable] suspicion, and the jealousy which Allah hates is jealousy without suspicion."
11.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se, Yahya ibn Abi Kathir se, Muhammad ibn Ibrahim se bataya: Mujhse Ibn Jabir ibn Atik ne bataya: Mujhse mere walid ne bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Kuch ghairat Allah ko pasand hai, aur kuch ghairat Allah ko na-pasand hai: jo ghairat Allah ko pasand hai woh shak ki jagah ki ghairat hai, aur jo ghairat Allah ko na-pasand hai woh bila shak ke ghairat hai."

11.ar: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ وَرَّادٍ  مَوْلَى الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، قَالَ : بَلَغَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّ سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَادَةَ، يَقُولُ : لَوْ وَجَدْتُ مَعَهَا رَجُلًا لَضَرَبْتُهَا بِالسَّيْفِ غَيْرَ مُصْفَحٍ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَتَعْجَبُونَ مِنْ غَيْرَةِ سَعْدٍ؟ أَنَا أَغَيْرُ مِنْ سَعْدٍ وَاللَّهُ أَغَيْرُ مِنِّي، وَلِذَلِكَ حَرَّمَ الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَلَا شَخْصَ أَغَيْرُ مِنَ اللَّهِ، وَلَا أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَعَاذِيرِ، وَلِذَلِكَ بَعَثَ النَّبِيِّينَ مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنْذِرِينَ وَلَا شَخْصَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِ الْمَدْحُ مِنَ اللَّه، وَلِذَلِكَ وَعَدَ الْجَنَّةَ "
11.en: Narrated by Zakariya ibn Adi, from Ubaydullah ibn Amr, from Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr, from Warrad, freed servant of al-Mughirah, from al-Mughirah: He said: It reached the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that Sa'd ibn Ubadah was saying: If I found a man with her, I would strike her with the sword, not on its flat side. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Are you amazed at Sa'd's jealousy? I am more jealous than Sa'd, and Allah is more jealous than me, and for that He has forbidden the obscenities, whatever is apparent of them and whatever is concealed, and no one is more jealous than Allah, and none loves excuses more than He, and for that He sent the prophets as bringers of glad tidings and as warners, and none loves praise more than Allah, and for that He promised Paradise."
11.hi: Zakariya ibn Adi ne Ubaydullah ibn Amr se, Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr se, Warrad se (al-Mughirah ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), al-Mughirah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ tak khabar pahunchi ke Sa'd ibn Ubadah keh rahe hain: Agar main uske saath koi aadmi paata, to main usay talwar se maarta, chaudi taraf se nahi. To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Kya tumhein Sa'd ki ghairat par tajjub hai? Main Sa'd se zyada ghairat mand hoon, aur Allah mujhse zyada ghairat mand hai, aur isi liye usne fahisha kaam haraam kiye hain, chahe woh zaahir hon ya chhupe, aur koi bhi Allah se zyada ghairat mand nahi, aur koi bhi usse zyada uzr (bahaana) pasand nahi karta, aur isi liye usne Ambiya ko khush-khabri dene wale aur daraane wale bana kar bheja, aur koi bhi Allah se zyada tareef pasand karne wala nahi, aur isi liye usne Jannat ka wada kiya."

11.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى الْعَامِرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِذَا بَاتَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ هَاجِرَةً لِفِرَاشِ زَوْجِهَا، لَعَنَتْهَا الْمَلَائِكَةُ حَتَّى تَرْجِعَ "
11.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from Zurarah ibn Awfa al-Amiri, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "When a woman spends the night away from her husband's bed [refusing him], the angels curse her until she returns."
11.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se, Qatadah se, Zurarah ibn Awfa al-Amiri se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jab aurat apne shohar ke bistar se door raat guzaare [inkaar karte hue], to farishte usper lanat karte hain jab tak woh wapas na aaye."

11.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ   : أَنَّ عُوَيْمِرًا الْعَجْلَانِيَّ، قَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّه، أَرَأَيْتَ رَجُلًا وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلًا، أَيَقْتُلُهُ فَيَقْتُلُونَهُ، أَمْ كَيْفَ يَفْعَلُ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" قَدْ أَنْزَلَ اللَّه فِيكَ وَفِي صَاحِبَتِكَ، فَاذْهَبْ فَأْتِ بِهَا ".
قَالَ سَهْلٌ : فَتَلَاعَنَا، وَأَنَا مَعَ النَّاسِ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَا مِنْ تَلَاعُنِهِمَا، قَالَ : كَذَبْتُ عَلَيْهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنْ أَمْسَكْتُهَا، فَطَلَّقَهَا ثَلَاثًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْمُرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ : وَكَانَتْ تِلْكَ بَعْدُ سُنَّةَ الْمُتَلَاعِنَيْنِ.
 حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، أَنَّ عُوَيْمِرًا أَتَى عَاصِمَ بْنَ عَدِيّ، وَكَانَ سَيِّدَ بَنِي عَجْلَانَ، فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ، وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ " طَلَّقَهَا ثَلَاثًا "
11.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Sahl ibn Sa'd; a similar chain also via Muhammad ibn Yusuf: That Uwaymir al-Ajlani said: "O Messenger of Allah, what do you think of a man who finds a man with his wife, does he kill him and they kill him, or how does he act?" So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah has indeed revealed [a ruling] about you and your companion, so go and bring her." Sahl said: So they underwent li'an [mutual imprecation/cursing], while I was with the people at the Messenger of Allah's ﷺ side, so when they finished their li'an, he said: "I would have lied about her, O Messenger of Allah, if I kept her," so he divorced her three times before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded him. Ibn Shihab said: And that afterward became the sunnah of those undergoing li'an. [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from al-Awza'i, from Ibn Shihab, from Sahl ibn Sa'd: that Uwaymir came to Asim ibn Adi, who was the chief of Banu Ajlan, and he mentioned the like of it, but did not mention "he divorced her three times."]
11.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Malik se, Ibn Shihab se, Sahl ibn Sa'd se bataya ke Uwaymir al-Ajlani ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, aap us aadmi ke baare mein kya farmaate hain jo apni biwi ke saath [gair-mard ko] paaye, kya woh usay qatal kare aur log usay qatal karein, ya woh kya kare?" To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Allah ne tumhare aur tumhare saathi ke baare mein [hukum] naazil kar diya hai, so jaao aur usay le aao." Sahl kehte hain: To dono ne li'an kiya (ek-doosre par lanat bhejte hue gawahi di), jabke main Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas logon ke saath tha, so jab woh li'an se faarigh hue, to usne kaha: "Maine iske baare mein jhoot kaha hoga, Ya Rasulullah, agar main isay rakhun," so usne Rasulullah ﷺ ke hukum dene se pehle hi usay teen talaqein de din. Ibn Shihab kehte hain: Aur baad mein yehi li'an karne walon ki sunnat ban gayi. [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Muhammad ibn Yusuf se, al-Awza'i se, Ibn Shihab se, Sahl ibn Sa'd se bhi aayi hai: ke Uwaymir Asim ibn Adi ke paas gaye, jo Banu Ajlan ke sardaar the, aur unhone isi jaisa zikr kiya, lekin "usne teen talaqein din" ka zikr nahi kiya.]

11.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ  ، يَقُولُ : " سُئِلْتُ عَنِ الْمُتَلَاعِنَيْنِ فِي إِمَارَةِ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ : أَيُفَرَّقُ بَيْنَهُمَا؟ فَمَا دَرَيْتُ مَا أَقُولُ، قَالَ : فَقُمْتُ حَتَّى أَتَيْتُ مَنْزِلَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ  ، فَقُلْتُ لِلْغُلَامِ : اسْتَأْذِنْ لِي عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ : إِنَّهُ قَائِلٌ لَا تَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ تَدْخُلَ عَلَيْهِ، قَالَ : فَسَمِعَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ صَوْتِي، فَقَالَ : ابْنُ جُبَيْرٍ؟، فَقُلْتُ : نَعَمْ، فَقَالَ : ادْخُلْ، فَمَا جَاءَ بِكَ هَذِهِ السَّاعَةَ إِلَّا حَاجَةٌ، قَالَ : فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَوَجَدْتُهُ وَهُوَ مُفْتَرِشٌ بَرْذَعَةَ رَحْلِهِ، مُتَوَسِّدٌ مِرْفَقَةُ أَوْ قَالَ : نُمْرُقَةً، شَكَّ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ حَشْوُهَا لِيفٌ ، فَقُلْتُ : يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ : الْمُتَلَاعِنَانِ، أَيُفَرَّقُ بَيْنَهُمَا؟.
قَالَ : سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، نَعَمْ، إِنَّ أَوَّلَ مَنْ سَأَلَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فُلَانٌ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ، أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ أَنَّ أَحَدَنَا رَأَى امْرَأَتَهُ عَلَى فَاحِشَةٍ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ؟ إِنْ سَكَتَ، سَكَتَ عَلَى أَمْرٍ عَظِيمٍ، وَإِنْ تَكَلَّمَ فَمِثْلُ ذَلِكَ؟، قَالَ :فَسَكَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ، فَقَامَ لِحَاجَتِهِ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ الَّذِي سَأَلْتُكَ عَنْهُ قَدْ ابْتُلِيتُ بِهِ، قَالَ : فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى هَؤُلَاءِ الْآيَاتِ الَّتِي فِي سُورَةِ النُّورِ : # وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُمْ شُهَدَاءُ إِلا أَنْفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَادَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ { 6 } وَالْخَامِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعْنَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِنْ كَانَ مِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ { 7 } وَيَدْرَأُ عَنْهَا الْعَذَابَ أَنْ تَشْهَدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ { 8 } وَالْخَامِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا إِنْ كَانَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ { 9 } سورة النور آية 6-9 # حَتَّى خَتَمَ هَؤُلَاءِ الْآيَاتِ، قَالَ : فَدَعَا الرَّجُلَ، فَتَلَاهُنَّ عَلَيْهِ، وَذَكَّرَهُ بِاللَّهِ، وَأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَذَابَ الدُّنْيَا أَهْوَنُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْآخِرَةِ، فَقَالَ : مَا كَذَبْتُ عَلَيْهَا، .
ثُمَّ دَعَا الْمَرَأَةَ فَوَعَظَهَا وَذَكَّرَهَا، وَأَخْبَرَهَا أَنَّ عَذَابَ الدُّنْيَا أَهْوَنُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْآخِرَةِ، فَقَالَتْ : وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ إِنَّهُ لَكَاذِبٌ، فَدَعَا الرَّجُلَ فَشَهِدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَمِنْ الصَّادِقِينَ، وَالْخَامِسَةَ أَنَّ لَعْنَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِنْ كَانَ مِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ، ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِالْمَرْأَةِ فَشَهِدَتْ أَرْبَعَ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ وَالْخَامِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا إِنْ كَانَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ، ثُمَّ فَرَّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا "
11.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Abd al-Malik ibn Abi Sulayman, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, about Abdullah ibn Umar: He said: I heard Sa'id ibn Jubayr say: "I was asked about the two who underwent li'an, during the governorship of Mus'ab ibn al-Zubayr: are they to be separated? So I did not know what to say." He said: So I got up until I came to the house of Abdullah ibn Umar, so I said to the boy: "Ask permission for me to see him," so he said: he is resting, you cannot enter upon him. He said: So Ibn Umar heard my voice, and said: "Ibn Jubayr?" So I said, "Yes." So he said: "Enter, only a need brought you at this hour." He said: So I entered upon him and found him resting on the saddle-blanket of his mount, leaning on a cushion, or he said: a pillow - Abdullah was uncertain - stuffed with palm fiber, so I said: "O Abu Abd al-Rahman: the two who underwent li'an, are they to be separated?" He said: "Glory be to Allah, yes, indeed the first one who asked about that was so-and-so, and he said: 'O Messenger of Allah, may Allah's peace be upon you, do you think if one of us saw his wife committing an obscenity, how should he act? If he remains silent, he remains silent over a great matter, and if he speaks, then likewise?' He said: So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ remained silent and did not answer him, so he stood up for his need, then after that, he came to the Prophet ﷺ, and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, the matter about which I asked you has indeed befallen me.'" He said: So Allah the Exalted revealed these verses which are in Surah al-Nur: "And those who accuse their wives and have no witnesses except themselves, then the testimony of one of them is four testimonies by Allah that he is indeed of the truthful. And the fifth is that the curse of Allah be upon him if he is of the liars. And it will avert the punishment from her if she testifies four testimonies by Allah that he is indeed of the liars. And the fifth, that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he is of the truthful" [Surah al-Nur, verses 6-9], until he finished these verses. He said: So he called the man, and recited them to him, and reminded him of Allah, and informed him that the punishment of this world is lighter than the punishment of the Hereafter, so he said: "I have not lied about her." Then he called the woman, and admonished her and reminded her, and informed her that the punishment of this world is lighter than the punishment of the Hereafter, so she said: "By the One who sent you with the truth, he is indeed a liar," so he called the man, and he testified four testimonies by Allah that he was indeed of the truthful, and the fifth that the curse of Allah be upon him if he was of the liars, then the woman was brought, and she testified four testimonies by Allah that he was indeed of the liars, and the fifth that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he was of the truthful, then he separated the two of them."
11.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Abd al-Malik ibn Abi Sulayman se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Sa'id ibn Jubayr ko kehte suna: "Mujhse Mus'ab ibn al-Zubayr ki hukumat mein li'an karne walon ke baare mein poocha gaya: kya unhein alag kiya jaaye? To mujhe pata nahi tha kya kahun." Unhone bataya: To main uthkar Abdullah ibn Umar ke ghar gaya, to maine ghulam se kaha: "Mere liye unse mulaqaat ki ijaazat maango," to usne kaha: woh aaraam kar rahe hain, aap unke paas nahi ja sakte. Unhone bataya: To Ibn Umar ne meri awaaz suni, aur poocha: "Ibn Jubayr?" To maine kaha, "Haan." To unhone kaha: "Andar aao, is waqt tumhein sirf koi zaroorat hi le kar aayi hogi." Unhone bataya: To main unke paas gaya aur unhein paaya ke woh apni sawaari ki jeen ki chatai par let'e hue the, ek gaddi, ya kaha: takiya - Abdullah ko shak tha - jismein khajoor ke resse bhare the, uspar tikaa hua, to maine kaha: "Ae Abu Abd al-Rahman: li'an karne wale, kya unhein alag kiya jaaye?" Unhone kaha: "Subhan-Allah, haan, sabse pehle jisne iske baare mein poocha woh fulaan tha, aur usne kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah, Allah ki salaamati aap par ho, aap batao agar humme se koi apni biwi ko fahisha kaam karte dekhe, to woh kya kare? Agar woh khamosh rahe, to woh ek badi baat par khamosh rahega, aur agar woh bole, to bhi wahi?' Unhone bataya: To Rasulullah ﷺ khamosh rahe aur usay jawab nahi diya, to woh apni zaroorat ke liye khada hua, fir uske baad, woh Nabi ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah, jis maamle ke baare mein maine aapse poocha tha woh mujhpar aa pada hai.'" Unhone bataya: To Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayaten naazil kin jo Surah An-Nur mein hain: "Aur jo apni biwiyon par tuhmat lagayein aur unke paas apne siwa koi gawah na ho, to unmein se ek ki gawahi yeh hai ke woh chaar martaba Allah ki qasam khaakar gawahi de ke woh sacha hai. Aur paanchvi baar ye ke agar woh jhoota ho to usper Allah ki lanat ho. Aur aurat se azaab tab tal jaayega jab woh chaar martaba Allah ki qasam khaakar gawahi de ke woh (mard) jhoota hai. Aur paanchvi baar ye ke agar woh (mard) sacha ho to usper Allah ka gazab ho" [Surah An-Nur, aayat 6-9], yahan tak ke inhein poora kiya. Unhone bataya: To aapne aadmi ko bulaaya, aur yeh usey padh kar sunaayin, aur usay Allah ki yaad dilaayi, aur usay bataaya ke duniya ka azaab Aakhirat ke azaab se halka hai, to usne kaha: "Maine iske baare mein jhoot nahi kaha." Fir aapne aurat ko bulaaya aur usay naseehat ki aur yaad dilaayi, aur usay bataaya ke duniya ka azaab Aakhirat ke azaab se halka hai, to usne kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke saath bheja, yeh zaroor jhoota hai," to aapne aadmi ko bulaaya aur usne chaar martaba Allah ki qasam khaakar gawahi di ke woh sacha hai, aur paanchvi baar ke agar woh jhoota ho to usper Allah ki lanat ho, fir aurat ko laaya gaya aur usne chaar martaba Allah ki qasam khaakar gawahi di ke woh (mard) jhoota hai, aur paanchvi baar ke agar woh (mard) sacha ho to usper Allah ka gazab ho, fir aapne un dono ko alag kar diya.

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ نَافِعًا  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" فَرَّقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَيْنَ الْمُتَلَاعِنَيْنِ، وَأَلْحَقَ الْوَلَدَ بِأُمِّهِ "
11.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi, from Malik, from Nafi', from Abdullah ibn Umar: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ separated the two who underwent li'an, and attributed the child to its mother."
11.hi: Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi ne bataya: Mujhse Malik ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Nafi' ko suna, Abdullah ibn Umar se: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne li'an karne walon ko alag kiya, aur bachche ko uski maa se joda."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا  ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَيُّمَا عَبْدٍ تَزَوَّجَ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ مَوَالِيهِ أَوْ أَهْلِهِ، فَهُوَ عَاهِرٌ "
11.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from al-Hasan ibn Salih, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Aqil, from Jabir: He said: I heard Jabir say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whichever slave marries without the permission of his masters or his family, he is a fornicator."
11.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne al-Hasan ibn Salih se, Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Aqil se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Jabir ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo bhi ghulam apne maalik ya apne gharwalon ki ijaazat ke bagair nikaah kare, woh zaani hai."

11.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، حَدَّثَنَا مِنْدَلُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبة  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" أَيُّمَا عَبْدٍ تَزَوَّجَ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ مَوَالِيهِ، فَهُوَ زَانٍ "
11.en: Narrated by Malik ibn Isma'il, from Mindal ibn Ali, from Ibn Jurayj, from Musa ibn Uqbah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whichever slave marries without the permission of his masters, he is an adulterer."
11.hi: Malik ibn Isma'il ne Mindal ibn Ali se, Ibn Jurayj se, Musa ibn Uqbah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jo bhi ghulam apne maalik ki ijaazat ke bagair nikaah kare, woh zaani hai."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، يَرْفَعُهُ، قَالَ :" الْوَلَدُ لِلْفِرَاشِ، وَلِلْعَاهِرِ الْحَجَرُ "
11.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Ibn Uyaynah, from al-Zuhri, from Ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurairah, raising it [to the Prophet ﷺ]: He said: "The child belongs to the [marriage] bed, and for the fornicator is the stone [i.e., stoning, or deprivation]."
11.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Ibn Uyaynah se, al-Zuhri se, Ibn al-Musayyab se, Abu Hurairah se, marfu'an bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Bachcha [nikaah ke] bistar ka hota hai, aur zaani ke liye pathar hai."

11.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" الْوَلَدُ لِلْفِرَاشِ "
11.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Maslamah, from Malik, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha, wife of the Prophet ﷺ: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The child belongs to the [marriage] bed."
11.hi: Abdullah ibn Maslamah ne Malik se, al-Zuhri se, Urwah se, Aisha, Nabi ﷺ ki biwi, se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Bachcha [nikaah ke] bistar ka hota hai."

11.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَتْ : كَانَ عُتْبَةُ بْنُ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ عَهِدَ إِلَى أَخِيهِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ : أَنْ يَقْبِضَ إِلَيْهِ ابْنَ وَلِيدَةِ زَمْعَةَ، فَقَالَ عُتْبَةُ : إِنَّهُ ابْنِي، فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ زَمَنَ الْفَتْحِ، أَخَذَ سَعْدُ بْنُ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ ابْنَ وَلِيدَةِ زَمْعَةَ ، فَإِذَا هُوَ أَشْبَهُ النَّاسِ بِعُتْبَةَ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" هُوَ لَكَ يَا عَبْدُ بْنَ زَمْعَةَ مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّهُ وُلِدَ عَلَى فِرَاشِ أَبِيهِ "، وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " احْتَجِبِي مِنْهُ يَا سَوْدَةُ بِنْتَ زَمْعَةَ مِمَّا رَأَى مِنْ شَبَهِهِ بِعُتْبَةَ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، وَسَوْدَةُ بِنْتُ زَمْعَةَ "
11.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha, wife of the Prophet ﷺ: She said: Utbah ibn Abi Waqqas had entrusted his brother Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas: to take custody of the son of Zam'ah's slave-girl, and Utbah said: he is my son, so when the Prophet ﷺ arrived at the time of the Conquest, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas took the son of Zam'ah's slave-girl, and behold, he resembled Utbah ibn Abi Waqqas most among people, so the Prophet ﷺ said: "He is yours, O Abd ibn Zam'ah, because he was born on his father's [marriage] bed," and the Prophet ﷺ said: "Veil yourself from him, O Sawdah bint Zam'ah," because of what he saw of his resemblance to Utbah ibn Abi Waqqas, and Sawdah bint Zam'ah [was his wife].
11.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Mujhe Urwah ne bataya, Aisha, Nabi ﷺ ki biwi, se: Unhone kaha, Utbah ibn Abi Waqqas ne apne bhai Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas ko wasiyat ki thi: ke woh Zam'ah ki laundi ke bete ko apne paas le lein, aur Utbah ne kaha tha: yeh mera beta hai, to jab Nabi ﷺ Fateh ke waqt pahunche, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas ne Zam'ah ki laundi ke bete ko liya, to woh logon mein sabse zyada Utbah ibn Abi Waqqas se milta tha, to Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Yeh tumhara hai, Ae Abd ibn Zam'ah, kyunki woh apne baap ke [nikaah ke] bistar par paida hua," aur Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Uske saamne parda karo, Ae Sawdah bint Zam'ah," uski Utbah ibn Abi Waqqas se milti-julti shakl dekh kar, aur Sawdah bint Zam'ah [aapki biwi thin].

11.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُول حِينَ أُنْزِلَتْ آيَةُ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ :" أَيُّمَا امْرَأَةٍ أَدْخَلَتْ عَلَى قَوْمٍ نَسَبًا لَيْسَ مِنْهُمْ، فَلَيْسَتْ مِنَ اللَّهِ فِي شَيْءٍ، وَلَنْ يُدْخِلْهَا اللَّهُ جَنَّتَهُ، وَأَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ جَحَدَ وَلَدَهُ وَهُوَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ، احْتَجَبَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ وَفَضَحَهُ عَلَى رُءُوسِ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْآخِرِينَ ".
 قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ : قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَعْبٍ الْقُرَظِيّ، وَسَعِيدٌ يُحَدِّثَهْ بِهِ، بِهَذَا : وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
11.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yazid ibn Abdullah, from Abdullah ibn Yunus, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id, from Abu Hurairah; with Abdullah al-Darimi's note: That he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, when the verse of li'an was revealed: "Whichever woman brings into a people a lineage not from them, she is nothing to Allah at all, and Allah will never admit her into His Paradise, and whichever man disowns his child while he sees him [as his own], Allah will veil Himself from him and disgrace him before the first and the last." Abdullah said: Muhammad ibn Ka'b al-Qurazi said, and Sa'id was narrating it thus: And this hadith has reached me from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
11.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhse Yazid ibn Abdullah ne bataya, Abdullah ibn Yunus se, Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id se, Abu Hurairah se: ke unhone Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, jab li'an ki aayat naazil hui: "Jo bhi aurat kisi qaum mein aisi nasab daale jo unse na ho, woh Allah ke nazdeek kuch bhi nahi hai, aur Allah usay kabhi apni Jannat mein dakhil nahi karega, aur jo bhi aadmi apne bachche ka inkaar kare jabke woh use dekh raha ho, Allah usse parda kar lega aur usay agle aur pichhle logon ke saamne ruswa karega." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Muhammad ibn Ka'b al-Qurazi ne kaha, aur Sa'id ise isi tarah bayaan karte the: Aur yeh hadith mujhe Rasulullah ﷺ se pahunchi hai.

11.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الرَّقِّيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْبَرَاءِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : لَقِيتُ عَمِّي وَمَعَهُ رَايَةٌ، فَقُلْتُ : أَيْنَ تُرِيدُ؟ قَالَ :" بَعَثَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَى رَجُلٍ نَكَحَ امْرَأَةَ أَبِيهِ، فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَضْرِبَ عُنُقَهُ وَآخُذَ مَالَهُ "
11.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Raqqi, from Ubaydullah ibn Amr, from Zayd, from Adi ibn Thabit, from Yazid ibn al-Bara', from his father: He said: I met my uncle, and he had a banner, so I asked: "Where are you headed?" He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has sent me to a man who married his father's wife, and commanded me to strike his neck and take his wealth."
11.hi: Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Raqqi ne Ubaydullah ibn Amr se, Zayd se, Adi ibn Thabit se, Yazid ibn al-Bara' se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main apne chacha se mila, aur unke paas ek jhanda tha, to maine poocha: "Kahan jaana chahte hain?" Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhe us aadmi ke paas bheja hai jisne apne baap ki biwi se nikaah kar liya, aur mujhe hukum diya hai ke main uski gardan maar dun aur uska maal le lun."

11.ar: حَدَّثَنِي مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى  ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ يُسَمَّى : زِيَادًا  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِأُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ   : أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ أَنَّ أَزْوَاجَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مُتْنَ، كَانَ يَحِلُّ لَهُ أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَ؟ قَالَ : " نَعَمْ،إِنَّمَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَهُ ضَرْبًا مِنَ النِّسَاءِ، وَوَصَفَ لَهُ صِفَةً "، فَقَالَ : " لَا يَحِلُّ لَكَ النِّسَاءُ مِنْ بَعْدُ، مِنْ بَعْدِ هَذِهِ الصِّفَةِ "
11.en: Narrated by Mu'alla ibn Asad, from Wuhayb, from Da'ud ibn Abi Hind, from Muhammad ibn Abi Musa, from a man from the Ansar called Ziyad: He said: I said to Ubayy ibn Ka'b: "What do you think, if the wives of the Prophet ﷺ had died, would it be lawful for him to marry?" He said: "Yes, Allah only made lawful for him a category of women, and He described a description for him," so he said: "No women are lawful for you after that, after this description."
11.hi: Mu'alla ibn Asad ne Wuhayb se bataya: Unhone kaha, Humein Da'ud ibn Abi Hind ne bataya, Muhammad ibn Abi Musa se, Ansar ke ek aadmi se jise Ziyad kaha jaata tha: Unhone kaha, Maine Ubayy ibn Ka'b se poocha: "Aap kya kehte hain, agar Nabi ﷺ ki biwiyaan mar jaatin, to kya aapke liye [dobara] nikaah karna halal hota?" Unhone kaha: "Haan, Allah ne aapke liye sirf ek qism ki auraton ko halal kiya, aur unki ek sift bayaan ki," fir Allah ne farmaya: "Iske baad, is sift ke baad, tumhare liye [aur] auratein halal nahi hain."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ :" مَا تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَتَّى أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَهُ أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ مَا شَاءَ "
11.en: Narrated by al-Mu'alla, from Wuhayb, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ata, from Ubayd ibn Umayr, from Aisha: She said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not pass away until Allah had made it lawful for him to marry whichever women he wished."
11.hi: Al-Mu'alla ne Wuhayb se, Ibn Jurayj se, Ata se, Ubayd ibn Umayr se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ka wisaal us waqt tak nahi hua jab tak Allah ne aapke liye jitni auraton se chaahein nikaah karna halal nahi kar diya tha."

11.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ الْحَبْحَابِ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ   : " أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَأَعْتَقَ صَفِيَّةَ وَجَعَلَ عِتْقَهَا صَدَاقَهَا "
11.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Shu'ayb ibn al-Habhab, from Anas: That "the Messenger of Allah ﷺ freed Safiyyah and made her freedom her dowry."
11.hi: Musaddad ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Shu'ayb ibn al-Habhab se, Anas se bataya ke "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Safiyyah ko azaad kiya aur unki azaadi ko unka mahar bana diya."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ،  عَنْ أَنَسٍ   : " أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَأَعْتَقَ صَفِيَّةَ وَتَزَوَّجَهَا وَجَعَلَ عِتْقَهَا صَدَاقَهَا "
11.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Abu Awanah, from Qatadah, from Anas: That "the Messenger of Allah ﷺ freed Safiyyah and married her and made her freedom her dowry."
11.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Abu Awanah se, Qatadah se, Anas se bataya ke "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Safiyyah ko azaad kiya aur unse nikaah kiya aur unki azaadi ko unka mahar bana diya."

11.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ  ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ صَالِحِ بْنِ حَيٍّ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ  ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ عِنْدَ الشَّعْبِيِّ فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ خُرَاسَانَ ، فَقَالَ : يَا أَبَا عَمْرٍو، إِنَّ مَنْ قِبَلَنَا مِنْ أَهْلِ خُرَاسَانَ يَقُولُونَ فِي الرَّجُلِ : إِذَا أَعْتَقَ أَمَتَهُ ثُمَّ تَزَوَّجَهَا، فَهُوَ كَالرَّاكِبِ بَدَنَتَهُ؟ فَقَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ  : حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بُرْدَةَ بْنُ أَبِي مُوسَى  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" ثَلَاثَةٌ يُؤْتَوْنَ أَجْرَهُمْ مَرَّتَيْنِ : رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ آمَنَ بِنَبِيِّهِ، ثُمَّ أَدْرَكَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَآمَنَ بِهِ وَاتَّبَعَهُ، وَعَبْدٌ مَمْلُوكٌ أَدَّى حَقَّ اللَّهِ وَحَقَّ مَوَالِيهِ، فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ، وَرَجُلٌ كَانَتْ لَهُ أَمَةٌ فَغَذَّاهَا، فَأَحْسَنَ غِذَاءَهَا، وَأَدَّبَهَا فَأَحْسَنَ تَأْدِيبَهَا فَأَعْتَقَهَا وَتَزَوَّجَهَا، فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ ".
 ثُمَّ قَالَ لِلرَّجُلِ : خُذْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ بِغَيْرِ شَيْءٍ، فَقَدْ كَانَ يُرْحَلُ فِيمَا دُونَ هَذَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ ، فَقَالَ هُشَيْمٌ : أَفَادُونِي بِالْبَصْرَةِ فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْهُ.
أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ حَيٍّ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، نَحْوَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ
11.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Hushaym, from Salih ibn Salih ibn Hayy al-Hamdani, about a man from Khurasan and al-Sha'bi; a similar chain also via Sahl ibn Hammad: He said: I was with al-Sha'bi, and a man from Khurasan came to him, and said: "O Abu Amr, the people of Khurasan among us say about a man: if he frees his slave-girl then marries her, he is like the one who rides his own sacrificial camel [taking undue advantage]?" So al-Sha'bi said: Abu Burdah ibn Abi Musa narrated to me, from his father: he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Three [types of people] are given their reward twice: a man from the People of the Book who believed in his prophet, then met the Prophet ﷺ and believed in him and followed him; and an owned slave who fulfills the right of Allah and the right of his masters, for him is a double reward; and a man who had a slave-girl and nourished her, nourishing her well, and disciplined her, disciplining her well, then freed her and married her, for him is a double reward." Then he said to the man: Take this hadith for nothing, though people used to travel for less than this to Madinah. Hushaym said: They benefited me with it at Basra, so I came to him and asked him about it. [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from Salih ibn Hayy, from al-Sha'bi, from Abu Burdah, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, near this hadith.]
11.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Hushaym se, Salih ibn Salih ibn Hayy al-Hamdani se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main al-Sha'bi ke paas tha to Khurasan ke ahl mein se ek aadmi unke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Ae Abu Amr, humare paas Khurasan wale kehte hain ke aadmi ke baare mein: agar woh apni laundi ko azaad kare fir usse nikaah kare, to woh apne oont par sawaar hone jaisa hai?" To al-Sha'bi ne kaha: Mujhse Abu Burdah ibn Abi Musa ne bataya, apne walid se: unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Teen [tarah ke log] apna ajr do martaba paate hain: Ahl-e-Kitab mein se woh aadmi jo apne Nabi par imaan laaya, fir Nabi ﷺ ko paaya aur unpar imaan laaya aur unki pairwi ki; aur ek ghulam jo Allah ka haq aur apne maalik ka haq ada kare, uske liye do ajr hain; aur ek aadmi jiski ek laundi ho aur usne usay parwarish di, achhi parwarish di, aur usay adab sikhaaya, achhi tarah adab sikhaaya, fir usay azaad kiya aur usse nikaah kiya, uske liye do ajr hain." Fir aapne aadmi se kaha: Yeh hadith bagair kisi kharche ke le lo, halaanke pehle log isse kam ke liye Madinah tak safar kiya karte the. Hushaym kehte hain: Unhone mujhe Basra mein iska faida diya to main unke paas gaya aur isse poocha. [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Sahl ibn Hammad se, Shu'bah se, Salih ibn Hayy se, al-Sha'bi se, Abu Burdah se, apne walid se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi is hadith ke qareeb aayi hai.]

11.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، فِي رَجُلٍ تَزَوَّجَ امْرَأَةً وَلَمْ يَكُنْ فَرَضَ لَهَا شَيْئًا، وَلَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِهَا، وَمَاتَ عَنْهَا، قَالَ فِيهَا : لَهَا صَدَاقُ نِسَائِهَا، وَعَلَيْهَا الْعِدَّةُ، وَلَهَا الْمِيرَاثُ، قَالَ مَعْقِلٌ الْأَشْجَعِيُّ   :" قَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي بِرْوَعَ بِنْتِ وَاشِقٍ امْرَأَةٍ مِنْ بَنِي رُوَاسٍ بِمِثْلِ مَا قَضَيْتَ ".
 قَالَ : فَفَرِحَ بِذَلِكَ، قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ، وَسُفْيَانُ : نَأْخُذُ بِهَذَا
11.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah, from Abdullah; with Ma'qil al-Ashja'i's confirmation: Concerning a man who married a woman and had not set a dowry for her, and had not consummated with her, and died leaving her: He said about her: she has the dowry of women like her, and upon her is the waiting period, and she has inheritance. Ma'qil al-Ashja'i said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled concerning Birwa' bint Washiq, a woman from Banu Ruwas, with the like of what you have ruled." He said: So he was pleased with that. Muhammad and Sufyan said: We hold to this.
11.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se, Alqamah se, Abdullah se, us aadmi ke baare mein bataya jisne ek aurat se nikaah kiya aur uske liye koi mahar muqarrar nahi kiya tha, aur uske saath sohbat nahi ki thi, aur usay chhodkar mar gaya: Unhone uske baare mein kaha: uske liye uski jaisi auraton ka mahar hai, aur uspar iddat hai, aur usay virasat milegi. Ma'qil al-Ashja'i ne kaha: "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Birwa' bint Washiq, Banu Ruwas ki ek aurat, ke baare mein waisa hi faisla kiya jaisa aapne kiya hai." Unhone bataya: To woh isse khush hue. Muhammad aur Sufyan ne kaha: Hum isi par amal karte hain.

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   : أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي بَيْتِ حَفْصَةَ ، فَسَمِعَتْ صَوْتَ إِنْسَانٍ، قَالَتْ : قُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، سَمِعْتُ صَوْتَ إِنْسَانٍ فِي بَيْتِكَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أُرَاهُ فُلَانًا لِعَمِّ حَفْصَةَ مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ "، قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، وَلَوْ كَانَ فُلَانٌ حَيًّا لِعَمِّهَا مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ دَخَلَ عَلَيَّ؟، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " نَعَمْ، يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ مَا يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الْوِلَادَةِ "
11.en: Narrated by Ishaq, from Rawh, from Malik, from Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr ibn Amr ibn Hazm, from Amrah, from Aisha: That she was with the Prophet ﷺ in Hafsah's house, and she heard the voice of a person, she said: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, I heard the voice of a person in your house," so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I believe it is so-and-so, the foster-uncle of Hafsah." Aisha said: O Messenger of Allah, and if so-and-so were alive, her foster-uncle, would he enter upon me? So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Yes, what is forbidden by fosterage is what is forbidden by birth [blood relation]."
11.hi: Ishaq ne Rawh se, Malik se, Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr ibn Amr ibn Hazm se, Amrah se, Aisha se bataya ke woh Nabi ﷺ ke saath Hafsah ke ghar mein thin, aur unhone ek aadmi ki awaaz suni, unhone kaha: Maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, maine aapke ghar mein ek aadmi ki awaaz suni," to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Mera khayal hai woh fulaan hai, Hafsah ka doodh-chacha." Aisha ne poocha: Ya Rasulullah, aur agar fulaan zinda hota, uska doodh-chacha, to kya woh mere paas aa sakta? To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Haan, doodh se woh cheezein haraam hoti hain jo nasab se haraam hoti hain."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ   : أَنَّ عَمَّهَا أَخَا أَبِي الْقُعَيْسِ جَاءَ يَسْتَأْذِنُ عَلَيْهَا بَعْدَمَا ضُرِبَ الْحِجَابُ، فَأَبَتْ أَنْ تَأْذَنَ لَهُ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَأَسْتَأْذِنَهُ، فَلَمَّا جَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، فَقَالَتْ : جَاءَ عَمِّي أَخُو أَبِي الْقُعَيْسِ فَرَدَدْتُهُ حَتَّى أَسْتَأْذِنَكَ، قَالَ :" أَوَ لَيْسَ بِعَمِّكِ؟ "، قَالَتْ : إِنَّمَا أَرْضَعَتْنِيَ الْمَرْأَةُ وَلَمْ يُرْضِعْنِي الرَّجُلُ، فَقَالَ : " إِنَّهُ عَمُّكِ فَلْيَلِجْ عَلَيْكِ "، قَالَ : وَكَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ تَقُولُ : يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ مَا يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الْوِلَادَةِ
11.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, about Aisha: That Aisha informed him: that her uncle, brother of Abu al-Qu'ays, came seeking permission to enter upon her after the veil had been prescribed, so she refused to permit him until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came so she could ask him, so when the Prophet ﷺ came, she mentioned that to him, and said: My uncle, brother of Abu al-Qu'ays, came, and I turned him away until I asked you. He said: "Is he not your uncle?" She said: It was only the woman [i.e., his wife] who breastfed me, the man did not breastfeed me. So he said: "He is your uncle, so let him enter upon you." He said: And Aisha used to say: What is forbidden by fosterage is what is forbidden by birth.
11.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se bataya: Aisha ne unhein bataya: ke unke chacha, Abu al-Qu'ays ke bhai, unse milne ki ijaazat maangne aaye parde ka hukum aane ke baad, to unhone unhein ijaazat dene se inkaar kiya jab tak Rasulullah ﷺ na aayein taake woh aapse poochein, so jab Nabi ﷺ aaye, unhone yeh baat unhein batayi, aur kaha: Mere chacha, Abu al-Qu'ays ke bhai, aaye, aur maine unhein wapas bheja jab tak main aapse na poochun. Aapne poocha: "Kya woh tumhare chacha nahi hain?" Unhone kaha: Mujhe to sirf aurat [yaani, unki biwi] ne doodh pilaaya tha, mard ne nahi pilaaya. To aapne farmaya: "Woh tumhare chacha hain, so unhein tumhare paas aane do." Unhone bataya: Aur Aisha kaha karti thin: Doodh se woh cheezein haraam hoti hain jo nasab se haraam hoti hain.

11.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ مَا يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الْوِلَادَةِ ".
قَالَ مَالِكٌ  : وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، مِثْلَهُ
11.en: Narrated by Sadaqah ibn al-Fadl, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Malik, from Abdullah ibn Dinar, from Sulayman ibn Yasar, from Urwah, from Aisha, from the Prophet ﷺ; with a similar chain from Malik via Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr: He said: "What is forbidden by fosterage is what is forbidden by birth." Malik said: And Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr narrated to me, from Amrah, from Aisha, from the Prophet ﷺ, the like of it.
11.hi: Sadaqah ibn al-Fadl ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Malik se, Abdullah ibn Dinar se, Sulayman ibn Yasar se, Urwah se, Aisha se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Doodh se woh cheezein haraam hoti hain jo nasab se haraam hoti hain." Malik kehte hain: Aur mujhse Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr ne bataya, Amrah se, Aisha se, Nabi ﷺ se, isi jaisi.

11.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَا تُحَرِّمُ الْمَصَّةُ وَالْمَصَّتَانِ "
11.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yunus, from Ibn Shihab, from Urwah, from Aisha, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "One or two sucklings do not make [marriage] forbidden."
11.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhse Yunus ne bataya, Ibn Shihab se, Urwah se, Aisha se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Ek ya do baar doodh choosna [nikaah] haraam nahi karta."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَلِيلِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ الْفَضْلِ   : أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي قَدْ تَزَوَّجْتُ امْرَأَةً وَعِنْدِي أُخْرَى، فَزَعَمَتِ الْأُولَى أَنَّهَا أَرْضَعَتِ الْحُدْثَى، فَقَالَ :" لَا تُحَرِّمُ الْإِمْلَاجَةُ وَلَا الْإِمْلَاجَتَانِ "
11.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Abu al-Khalil, from Abdullah ibn al-Harith, from Umm al-Fadl: That a man came to the Prophet ﷺ, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have married a woman and have another with me, and the first claimed that she had breastfed the newer one," so he said: "One or two sucklings do not make [marriage] forbidden."
11.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ayyub se, Abu al-Khalil se, Abdullah ibn al-Harith se, Umm al-Fadl se bataya ke ek aadmi Nabi ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, maine ek aurat se nikaah kiya hai aur mere paas doosri bhi hai, aur pehli ka dawa hai ke usne nayi wali ko doodh pilaaya tha," to aapne farmaya: "Ek ya do baar doodh choosna [nikaah] haraam nahi karta."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق  ، أَخْبَرَنَا رَوْحٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ  ،  عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ :" نَزَلَ الْقُرْآنُ بِعَشْرِ رَضَعَاتٍ مَعْلُومَاتٍ يُحَرِّمْنَ، ثُمَّ نُسِخْنَ بِخَمْسٍ مَعْلُومَاتٍ، فَتُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُنَّ مِمَّا يُقْرَأُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ "
11.en: Narrated by Ishaq, from Rawh, from Malik, from Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr, from Amrah, from Aisha: She said: "The Qur'an came down with ten known sucklings that make [marriage] forbidden, then they were abrogated by five known ones, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away while they were among what was recited of the Qur'an."
11.hi: Ishaq ne Rawh se, Malik se, Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr se, Amrah se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Quran das ma'lum doodh chusaaiyon ke saath naazil hua tha jo [nikaah] haraam karti hain, fir woh paanch ma'lum se mansookh ho gayin, so Rasulullah ﷺ ka wisaal us waqt hua jabke woh Quran mein padhi jaane wali cheezon mein se thin."

11.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيه  ، عَنْ حَجَّاجِ بْنِ حَجَّاجٍ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا يُذْهِبُ عَنِّي مَذَمَّةَ الرَّضَاعِ؟ قَالَ :" الْغُرَّةُ : الْعَبْدُ أَوِ الْأَمَةُ "
11.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Abdah, from Hisham, from his father, from Hajjaj ibn Hajjaj al-Aslami, from his father: That he said: "O Messenger of Allah, what removes from me the responsibility of the wet-nurse's fee?" He said: "A gift of value: a male or female slave."
11.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Abdah se, Hisham se, apne walid se, Hajjaj ibn Hajjaj al-Aslami se, apne walid se bataya: ke unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, mujhse doodh pilaane wali ka ehsaan/zimmedaari kya door karti hai?" Aapne farmaya: "Ek keemti tohfa: ek ghulam ya laundi."

11.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي عُقْبَةَ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ  ، ثُمّ قَالَ : لَمْ يُحَدِّثْنِيهِ وَلَكِنْ سَمِعْتُهُ يُحَدِّثُ الْقَوْمَ، قَالَ :" تَزَوَّجْتُ بِنْتَ أَبِي إِهَابٍ ، فَجَاءَتْ أَمَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ، فَقَالَتْ : إِنِّي أَرْضَعْتُكُمَا، فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنِّي.
قَالَ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ : قَالَ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ أَوْ الرَّابِعَةِ.
قَالَ : كَيْفَ وَقَدْ قِيلَ؟، وَنَهَاهُ عَنْهَا.
قَالَ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  : وَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ   : " فَكَيْفَ وَقَدْ قِيلَ؟ " وَلَمْ يَقُلْ : نَهَاهُ عَنْهَا.
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : كَذَا عِنْدَنَا
11.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ibn Abi Mulaykah, from Uqbah ibn al-Harith; with Abu Asim's note: He said: Uqbah ibn al-Harith narrated to me, then he said: he did not narrate it to me but I heard him narrating it to the people, he said: "I married the daughter of Abu Ihab, then a black slave-girl came, and said: I breastfed the two of you, so I came to the Prophet ﷺ, and mentioned that to him, and he turned away from me." Abu Asim said: he said [it] the third or fourth time. He said: "How, when it has been said?" and he forbade him from her. Abu Asim said: And Umar ibn Sa'id ibn Abi Husayn said, from Ibn Abi Mulaykah: "So how, when it has been said?" and did not say: he forbade him from her. Abu Muhammad said: Thus it is with us.
11.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Ibn Abi Mulaykah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhse Uqbah ibn al-Harith ne bataya, fir kaha: Unhone mujhe yeh nahi bataya lekin maine unhein logon ko bataate suna, unhone kaha: "Maine Abu Ihab ki beti se nikaah kiya, fir ek kaali laundi aayi, aur kaha: Maine tum dono ko doodh pilaya tha, to main Nabi ﷺ ke paas gaya, aur yeh baat unhein batayi, to aapne mujhse muh phera liya." Abu Asim kehte hain: Unhone teesri ya chauthi baar kaha. Aapne farmaya: "Ab kaise, jabke yeh keh diya gaya hai?" aur aapne usse mana kiya. Abu Asim kehte hain: Aur Umar ibn Sa'id ibn Abi Husayn ne kaha, Ibn Abi Mulaykah se: "To kaise, jabke yeh keh diya gaya hai?" aur "aapne usse mana kiya" nahi kaha. Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Humare paas isi tarah hai.

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا وَعِنْدَهَا رَجُلٌ فَتَغَيَّرَ وَجْهُهُ، وَكَأَنَّهُ كَرِهَ ذَلِكَ، فَقُلْتُ : إِنَّهُ أَخِي مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ، فَقَالَ :" انْظُرْنَ مَا إِخْوَانُكُنَّ فَإِنَّمَا الرَّضَاعَةُ مِنَ الْمَجَاعَةِ "
11.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from Ash'ath ibn Sulaym, from his father, from Masruq, about Aisha: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon her while a man was with her, and his face changed, as if he disliked that, so I said: He is my brother from fosterage, so he said: "Look carefully at who your brothers are, for indeed fosterage is [only what happens] from hunger."
11.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Shu'bah se, Ash'ath ibn Sulaym se, apne walid se, Masruq se bataya: ke Rasulullah ﷺ Aisha ke paas dakhil hue jabke unke paas ek aadmi tha, aur aapka chehra badal gaya, jaise aapko yeh na-pasand ho, to maine kaha: Yeh mera doodh-bhai hai, to aapne farmaya: "Achhi tarah dekh lo tumhare bhai kaun hain, kyunki doodh sirf [uska hukum rakhta hai jo] bhookh mein [pilaya jaaye]."

11.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيّ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : جَاءَتْ سَهْلَةُ بِنْتُ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو وَكَانَتْ تَحْتَ أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَتْ : إِنَّ سَالِمًا مَوْلَى أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْنَا وَأَنَا فُضُلٌ وَإِنَّمَا نَرَاهُ وَلَدًا، وَكَانَ أَبُو حُذَيْفَةَ تَبَنَّاهُ كَمَا تَبَنَّى النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ زَيْدًا، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى : # ادْعُوهُمْ لآبَائِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ سورة الأحزاب آية 5 #" فَأَمَرَهَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ أَنْ تُرْضِعَ سَالِمًا ".
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : هَذَا لِسَالِمٍ خَاصَّةً
11.en: Narrated by Abu al-Yaman al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha; with Abu Muhammad's note: She said: Sahlah bint Suhayl ibn Amr came, and she was the wife of Abu Hudhayfah ibn Utbah ibn Rabi'ah, to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and said: Salim, the freed servant of Abu Hudhayfah, comes to us and I am exposed [not fully covered as would be for a stranger], and we only see him as a child, and Abu Hudhayfah had adopted him as a son just as the Prophet ﷺ had adopted Zayd, so Allah the Exalted revealed: "Call them by [the names of] their fathers, that is more just with Allah" [Surah al-Ahzab, verse 5], "so the Prophet ﷺ commanded her at that, that she breastfeed Salim." Abu Muhammad said: This is specific to Salim.
11.hi: Abu al-Yaman al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb se, al-Zuhri se, Urwah se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Sahlah bint Suhayl ibn Amr, jo Abu Hudhayfah ibn Utbah ibn Rabi'ah ki biwi thin, Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aayin, aur kaha: Salim, Abu Hudhayfah ke azaad kiye hue ghulam, humare paas aate hain aur main khuli hoti hoon, aur hum unhein bas ek bachcha samajhte hain, aur Abu Hudhayfah ne unhein beta bana liya tha jaise Nabi ﷺ ne Zayd ko bana liya tha, to Allah Ta'ala ne naazil kiya: "Unhein unke baap ke naam se pukaaro, yeh Allah ke nazdeek zyada insaaf wali baat hai" [Surah Al-Ahzab, aayat 5], "to Nabi ﷺ ne is par unhein hukum diya ke woh Salim ko doodh pilaayein." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Yeh khaas Salim ke liye hai.

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ الْهُزَيْلِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْمُحِلَّ وَالْمُحَلَّلَ لَهُ "
11.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from Abu Qays, from al-Huzayl, from Abdullah: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the muhallil [one who marries a divorced woman with the intent of quickly divorcing her to make her lawful for her first husband] and the one for whom [it is done, i.e., the first husband]."
11.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se, Abu Qays se, al-Huzayl se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne muhallil (halala karne wale) aur jiske liye halala kiya jaaye [dono] par lanat ki."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، أَنَّ هِنْدًا أُمَّ مُعَاوِيَةَ امْرَأَةَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَتْ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ رَجُلٌ شَحِيحٌ وَإِنَّهُ لَا يُعْطِينِي مَا يَكْفِينِي وَبَنِيَّ إِلَّا مَا أَخَذْتُ مِنْهُ، وَهُوَ لَا يَعْلَمُ، فَهَلْ عَلَيَّ فِي ذَلِكَ جُنَاحٌ؟ فَقَالَ :" خُذِي مَا يَكْفِيكِ وَوَلَدَكِ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ "
11.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha: That Hind, mother of Mu'awiyah, wife of Abu Sufyan, came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, Abu Sufyan is a stingy man, and he does not give me what suffices me and my children, except what I take from him without his knowing, so is there any blame upon me in that?" So he said: "Take what suffices you and your child in a reasonable manner."
11.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Aisha se bataya ke Hind, Mu'awiyah ki maa, Abu Sufyan ki biwi, Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aayin, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, Abu Sufyan kanjoos aadmi hain aur woh mujhe utna nahi dete jo mujhe aur mere bacchon ke liye kaafi ho, siwaay us cheez ke jo main unse unko bataaye bagair le loon, to kya ismein mujhpar koi gunah hai?" To aapne farmaya: "Jo tumhare aur tumhare bacche ke liye kaafi ho, munaasib andaaz mein le lo."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" خَيْرُكُمْ خَيْرُكُمْ لِأَهْلِهِ، وَإِذَا مَاتَ صَاحِبُكُمْ، فَدَعُوهُ "
11.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The best of you is the best of you to his family, and when your companion dies, leave him [do not speak ill of the dead]."
11.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tum mein sabse behtar woh hai jo apne gharwalon ke saath sabse behtar ho, aur jab tumhara sathi mar jaaye, to usay chhod do [uski buraai na karo]."

11.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ خَلِيلٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ :" تَزَوَّجَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَنَا بِنْتُ سِتِّ سِنِينَ، فَقَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ ، فَنَزَلْنَا فِي بَنِي الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْخَزْرَجِ فَوُعِكْتُ، فَتَمزَّقَ رَأْسِي، فَأَوْفَى جُمَيْمَةً، فَأَتَتْنِي أُمُّ رُومَانَ وَإِنِّي لَفِي أُرْجُوحَةٍ وَمَعِي صَوَاحِبَاتٌ لِي، فَصَرَخَتْ بِي فَأَتَيْتُهَا وَمَا أَدْرِي مَا تُرِيدُ، فَأَخَذَتْ بِيَدِي حَتَّى أَوْقَفَتْنِي عَلَى بَابِ الدَّارِ، وَإِنِّي لَأَنْهَجُ حَتَّى سَكَنَ بَعْضُ نَفَسِي، ثُمَّ أَخَذَتْ شَيْئًا مِنْ مَاءٍ، فَمَسَحَتْ بِهِ وَجْهِي وَرَأْسِي، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَتْنِي الدَّارَ، فَإِذَا نِسْوَةٌ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ فِي بَيْتِ، فَقُلْنَ : عَلَى الْخَيْرِ وَالْبَرَكَةِ، وَعَلَى خَيْرِ طَائِرٍ، فَأَسْلَمَتْنِي إِلَيْهِنَّ، فَأَصْلَحْنَ مِنْ شَأْنِي، فَلَمْ يَرُعْنِي إِلَّا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ضُحى، فَأَسْلَمَتْنِي إِلَيْهِ وَأَنَا يَوْمَئِذٍ بِنْتُ تِسْعِ سِنِينَ "
11.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Khalil, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha: She said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ married me when I was six years old, then we came to Madinah, and we stayed among Banu al-Harith ibn al-Khazraj, then I fell ill, so my hair fell out, and it grew back thick, so Umm Ruman came to me while I was on a swing with some friends of mine, so she called out to me, so I came to her, not knowing what she wanted, so she took my hand until she made me stand at the door of the house, and I was panting until some of my breath calmed, then she took some water, and wiped my face and my head with it, then she brought me into the house, and there were women from the Ansar in the house, and they said: 'Upon good and blessing, and upon the best of fortune,' so she handed me over to them, and they fixed up my appearance, and nothing startled me except the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the forenoon, so she handed me over to him, and I was that day nine years old."
11.hi: Isma'il ibn Khalil ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Hisham se, apne walid se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhse nikaah kiya jab main chhe saal ki thi, fir hum Madinah aaye, to hum Banu al-Harith ibn al-Khazraj mein utre, fir mujhe bukhaar chadha, to mere baal jhad gaye, fir woh ghane hokar wapas aaye, to Umm Ruman mere paas aayin jabke main jhoole mein thi apni saathiyon ke saath, to unhone mujhe pukaara, to main unke paas gayi, na jaante hue ke woh kya chahti hain, to unhone mera haath pakda yahan tak ke unhone mujhe ghar ke darwaze par khada kar diya, aur main haansi le rahi thi yahan tak ke meri kuch saans sthir hui, fir unhone thoda paani liya, aur usse mera chehra aur mera sar poonchha, fir mujhe ghar mein le gayin, to wahan Ansar ki auratein thi ghar mein, aur unhone kaha: 'Bhalaai aur barkat par, aur behtareen naseeb par,' fir unhone mujhe unke supurd kar diya, aur unhone mera haal-chaal sudhaara, aur mujhe kuch bhi nahi chaunkaaya siwaay Rasulullah ﷺ ke chaasht ke waqt, to unhone mujhe aapke supurd kar diya, aur main us din nau saal ki thi."

12.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   : أَنَّهُ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ، فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ عُمَرُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ :" مُرْهُ أَنْ يُرَاجِعَهَا وَيُمْسِكَهَا حَتَّى تَطْهُرَ، ثُمَّ تَحِيضُ، ثُمَّ تَطْهُرُ، ثُمَّ إِنْ شَاءَ، أَمْسَكَ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ طَلَّقَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَمَسَّ، فَتِلْكَ الْعِدَّةُ الَّتِي أَمَرَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يُطَلَّقَ لَهَا النِّسَاءُ "
12.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That he divorced his wife while she was menstruating, so Umar mentioned that to the Prophet ﷺ, so he said: "Command him to take her back and keep her until she is pure, then she menstruates, then becomes pure, then if he wishes, he may keep her, and if he wishes, he may divorce her before he touches her, for that is the waiting period [for divorce] that Allah commanded women to be divorced according to."
12.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke unhone apni biwi ko talaq di jabke woh haiz mein thi, to Umar ne yeh baat Nabi ﷺ se zikr ki, to aapne farmaya: "Usay hukum do ke woh usay wapas le le aur usay rakhe jab tak woh paak na ho jaaye, fir usay haiz aaye, fir woh paak ho, fir agar woh chahe, to rakhe, aur agar chahe, to usse chhune se pehle talaq de de, kyunki yeh woh iddat hai jiske mutaabiq Allah ne auraton ko talaq dene ka hukum diya hai."

12.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ سَالِمًا  يَذْكُرُ،  عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   : أَنَّ عُمَرَ، قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حِينَ طَلَّقَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ امْرَأَتَهُ، فَقَالَ :" مُرْهُ فَلْيُرَاجِعْهَا، ثُمَّ لِيُطَلِّقْهَا وَهِيَ طَاهِرَةٌ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : رَوَاهُ ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، وَوَكِيعُ   : " أَوْ حَامِلٌ "
12.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Sufyan, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Salim, about Ibn Umar; with Abu Muhammad's note: That Umar said to the Prophet ﷺ when Ibn Umar divorced his wife, so he said: "Command him to take her back, then let him divorce her while she is pure." Abu Muhammad said: Ibn al-Mubarak and Waki' narrated it: "or pregnant."
12.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Sufyan se, Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Salim ko zikr karte suna, Ibn Umar se: ke Umar ne Nabi ﷺ se kaha jab Ibn Umar ne apni biwi ko talaq di, to aapne farmaya: "Usay hukum do ke woh usay wapas le le, fir usay talaq de jabke woh paak ho." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Ibn al-Mubarak aur Waki' ne ise naql kiya: "ya haamila."

12.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ خَلِيلٍ  ، وَإِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ  ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" طَلَّقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَفْصَةَ ثُمَّ رَاجَعَهَا "
12.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Khalil, and Isma'il ibn Aban, from Yahya ibn Abi Za'idah, from Salih ibn Salih, from Salamah ibn Kuhayl, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, from Umar: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ divorced Hafsah, then took her back."
12.hi: Isma'il ibn Khalil aur Isma'il ibn Aban ne Yahya ibn Abi Za'idah se, Salih ibn Salih se, Salamah ibn Kuhayl se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas se, Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Hafsah ko talaq di, fir unhein wapas le liya."

12.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ هُشَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" طَلَّقَ حَفْصَةَ ثُمَّ رَاجَعَهَا ".
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : كَانَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ الْمَدِينِيِّ أَنْكَرَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ، وَقَالَ : لَيْسَ عِنْدَنَا هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ بِالْبَصْرَةِ ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ
12.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Sulayman, from Hushaym, from Humayd, from Anas; with Abu Muhammad's note: That the Prophet ﷺ "divorced Hafsah, then took her back." Abu Muhammad said: Ali ibn al-Madini rejected this hadith, and said: We do not have this hadith at Basra, from Humayd.
12.hi: Sa'id ibn Sulayman ne Hushaym se, Humayd se, Anas se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne "Hafsah ko talaq di, fir unhein wapas le liya." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Ali ibn al-Madini is hadith ko radd karte the, aur kehte the: Humare paas Basra mein yeh hadith Humayd se nahi hai.

12.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ  ، قَالَ الْحَكَمُ  ، قَالَ لِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ   : أَفْصِلُ أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ :" أَنْ لَا يَمَسَّ الْقُرْآنَ إِلَّا طَاهِرٌ، وَلَا طَلَاقَ قَبْلَ إِمْلَاكٍ، وَلَا عَتَاقَ حَتَّى يَبْتَاعَ ".
سُئِلَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانُ، قَالَ : أَحْسَبُهُ كَاتِبًا مِنْ كُتَّابِ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ
12.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Musa, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Sulayman ibn Da'ud, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm, from his father, from his grandfather; with al-Hakam's and Abu Muhammad's notes: Al-Hakam said: Yahya ibn Hamzah said to me: I can state clearly that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen: "that none touch the Qur'an except one who is pure, and there is no divorce before marriage, and no manumission until one has purchased [the slave]." Abu Muhammad was asked about Sulayman, he said: I think he was a scribe among the scribes of Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz.
12.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Musa ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se bataya: Mujhse Sulayman ibn Da'ud ne bataya: Mujhse al-Zuhri ne bataya, Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm se, apne walid se, apne dada se: al-Hakam kehte hain, Yahya ibn Hamzah ne mujhse kaha: Main saaf tor par keh sakta hoon ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne Yemen walon ko likha: "ke Quran ko sirf paak shakhs hi chhue, aur nikaah se pehle koi talaq nahi, aur khareedne se pehle koi azaadi nahi." Abu Muhammad se Sulayman ke baare mein poocha gaya, unhone kaha: Mera khayal hai woh Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz ke katiban mein se ek katib the.

12.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةُ رِفَاعَةَ الْقُرَظِيِّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَعِنْدَهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، وَخَالِدُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِ عَلَى الْبَابِ يَنْتَظِرُ أَنْ يُؤْذَنَ لَهُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَتْ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي كُنْتُ عِنْدَ رِفَاعَةَ فَطَلَّقَنِي فَبَتَّ طَلَاقِي، قَالَ :" أَتُرِيدِينَ أَنْ تَرْجِعِي إِلَى رِفَاعَةَ؟ لَا، حَتَّى يَذُوقَ عُسَيْلَتَكِ، وَتَذُوقِي عُسَيْلَتَهُ ".
فَنَادَى خَالِدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ أَبَا بَكْرٍ : أَلَا تَرَى مَا تَجْهَرُ بِهِ هَذِهِ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟
12.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Ibn Uyaynah, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah ibn al-Zubayr, from Aisha: She said: The wife of Rifa'ah al-Qurazi came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while Abu Bakr was with him, and Khalid ibn Sa'id ibn al-As was at the door waiting to be permitted to see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so she said: "O Messenger of Allah, I was with Rifa'ah, and he divorced me, making it a final/irrevocable divorce," he said: "Do you want to return to Rifa'ah? No, not until he tastes your sweetness, and you taste his sweetness." So Khalid ibn Sa'id called out to Abu Bakr: "Do you not see what this woman is declaring openly before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?"
12.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Ibn Uyaynah se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Urwah ibn al-Zubayr ko suna, Aisha se: Unhone kaha, Rifa'ah al-Qurazi ki biwi Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aayi jabke unke paas Abu Bakr the, aur Khalid ibn Sa'id ibn al-As darwaze par Rasulullah ﷺ se milne ki ijaazat ka intezaar kar rahe the, to usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, main Rifa'ah ke saath thi, aur unhone mujhe talaq de di, mukammal talaq," aapne farmaya: "Kya tum Rifa'ah ke paas wapas jaana chahti ho? Nahi, jab tak woh tumhari meethaas na chakh le, aur tum uski meethaas na chakh lo." To Khalid ibn Sa'id ne Abu Bakr ko pukaara: "Kya aap dekh nahi rahe yeh aurat Rasulullah ﷺ ke saamne kya khule-aam keh rahi hai?"

12.ar: حَدَّثَنَا فَرْوَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَغْرَاءِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَة  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : طَلَّقَ رِفَاعَة رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي قُرَيْظَةَ امْرَأَتَهُ فَتَزَوَّجَهَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، فَدَخَلَتْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَتْ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، وَاللَّهِ إِنْ مَعَهُ إِلَّا مِثْلُ هُدْبَتِي هَذِهِ، فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَعَلَّكِ تُرِيدِينَ أَنْ تَرْجِعِي إِلَى رِفَاعَةَ؟ لَا، حَتَّى يَذُوقَ عُسَيْلَتَكِ أَوْ قَالَ تَذُوقِي عُسَيْلَتَهُ "
12.en: Narrated by Farwah ibn Abi al-Maghra, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha: She said: Rifa'ah, a man from Banu Qurayzah, divorced his wife, so Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Zubayr married her, so she entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, by Allah, he has nothing with him but the like of this fringe of mine," so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to her: "Perhaps you want to return to Rifa'ah? No, not until he tastes your sweetness, or he said: you taste his sweetness."
12.hi: Farwah ibn Abi al-Maghra ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rifa'ah, Banu Qurayzah ke ek aadmi, ne apni biwi ko talaq di, to Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Zubayr ne usse nikaah kiya, to woh Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas gayi, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, Allah ki qasam, uske paas mere is jhaalar jaisi hi cheez hai," to Rasulullah ﷺ ne usse farmaya: "Shayad tum Rifa'ah ke paas wapas jaana chahti ho? Nahi, jab tak woh tumhari meethaas na chakh le, ya farmaya: tum uski meethaas na chakh lo."

12.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ   عَنِ الْخِيَرَةِ، فَقَالَتْ :" قَدْ خَيَّرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَفَكَانَ طَلَاقًا؟ "
12.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid, from al-Sha'bi, from Masruq: He said: I asked Aisha about the [Prophet's] giving choice [to his wives], so she said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave us the choice, so was that a divorce?"
12.hi: Ya'la ne Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid se, al-Sha'bi se, Masruq se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Aisha se ikhtiyaar (choice) ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: "Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein ikhtiyaar diya tha, to kya woh talaq thi?"

12.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ  ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَيُّمَا امْرَأَةٍ سَأَلَتْ زَوْجَهَا الطَّلَاقَ مِنْ غَيْرِ بَأْسٍ، فَحَرَامٌ عَلَيْهَا رَائِحَةُ الْجَنَّةِ "
12.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Fadl, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah, from Abu Asma, from Thawban: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whichever woman asks her husband for divorce without cause, the fragrance of Paradise is forbidden to her."
12.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Fadl ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ayyub se, Abu Qilabah se, Abu Asma se, Thawban se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo bhi aurat apne shohar se bagair kisi sabab ke talaq maange, uspar Jannat ki khushbu haraam hai."

12.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى هُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، أَنَّ عَمْرَةَ  أَخْبَرَتْهُ، أَنَّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتَ سَهْلٍ   تَزَوَّجَهَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ قَيْسِ بْنِ شَمَّاسٍ، فَذَكَرَتْ أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ هَمَّ أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَهَا.
وَكَانَتْ جَارَةً لَهُ، وَأَنَّ ثَابِتًا ضَرَبَهَا، فَأَصْبَحَتْ عَلَى بَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي الْغَلَسِ، وَأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَرَجَ، فَرَأَى إِنْسَانًا فَقَالَ : " مَنْ هَذَا؟ " قَالَتْ : أَنَا حَبِيبَةُ بِنْتُ سَهْلٍ ، فَقَالَ : " مَا شَأْنُكِ؟ "، قَالَتْ : لَا أَنَا وَلَا ثَابِتٌ، فَأَتَى ثَابِتٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ :" خُذْ مِنْهَا وَخَلِّ سَبِيلَهَا "، فَقَالَتْ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، عِنْدِي كُلُّ شَيْءٍ أَعْطَانِيهِ فَأَخَذَ مِنْهَا، وَقَعَدَتْ عِنْدَ أَهْلِهَا
12.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Amrah, from Habibah bint Sahl: That Thabit ibn Qays ibn Shammas married her, and she mentioned that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had intended to marry her, and she had been his neighbor, and that Thabit hit her, so she came in the morning to the door of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the dim light [before dawn], and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out, and saw a person, and said: "Who is this?" She said: I am Habibah bint Sahl, so he said: "What is your matter?" She said: I will not [stay with], nor will Thabit [have me], so Thabit came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and the Messenger of Allah said to him: "Take from her and let her go her way," so she said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have everything he gave me," so he took it from her, and she stayed with her family.
12.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se bataya: Unhein Amrah ne bataya, ke Habibah bint Sahl se Thabit ibn Qays ibn Shammas ne nikaah kiya, to unhone zikr kiya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne unse nikaah karne ka irada kiya tha, aur woh aapki padosan thin, aur ke Thabit ne unhein maara, to woh subah tak Rasulullah ﷺ ke darwaze par andhere mein rahin, aur Rasulullah ﷺ bahar nikle, aur ek insaan dekha, to poocha: "Yeh kaun hai?"
