Unhone kaha: Main Habibah bint Sahl hoon. Aapne poocha: "Kya baat hai?" Unhone kaha: Na main [uske saath rah sakti hoon] na Thabit [mujhe rakh sakta hai]. To Thabit Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaye, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne unse farmaya: "Usse [jo diya hai] le lo aur usay chhod do." To unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, mere paas woh sab kuch hai jo unhone mujhe diya," to unhone woh usse le liya, aur woh apne gharwalon ke paas jaakar rahin.

12.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، قَالَ : بَلَغَنِي حَدِيثٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ رُكَانَةَ  ، وَهُوَ فِي قَرْيَةٍ لَهُ، فَأَتَيْتُهُ، فَسَأَلْتُهُ، فَقَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي  ، عَنْ جَدِّي   أَنَّهُ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ الْبَتَّةَ، فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، فَقَالَ :" مَا أَرَدْتَ؟ "، فَقَالَ : وَاحِدَةً، قَالَ : " آللَّهِ؟ " قَالَ : آللَّهِ، قَالَ : " هُوَ مَا نَوَيْتَ "
12.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Jarir ibn Hazim, from al-Zubayr ibn Sa'id, a man from Banu Abd al-Muttalib, about Abdullah ibn Ali ibn Yazid ibn Rukanah: He said: A hadith reached me from Abdullah ibn Ali ibn Yazid ibn Rukanah, and he was in a village of his, so I came to him, and asked him, so he said: My father narrated to me, from my grandfather: that he divorced his wife finally/absolutely, then came to the Prophet ﷺ and mentioned that to him, so he said: "What did you intend?" So he said: One [divorce]. He said: "By Allah?" He said: By Allah. He said: "It is what you intended."
12.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Jarir ibn Hazim se, al-Zubayr ibn Sa'id se, jo Banu Abd al-Muttalib ke ek aadmi hain, bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Abdullah ibn Ali ibn Yazid ibn Rukanah se ek hadith pahunchi, aur woh apne ek gaon mein the, to main unke paas gaya, aur unse poocha, to unhone kaha: Mujhse mere walid ne bataya, mere dada se: ke unhone apni biwi ko qat'i talaq de di, fir Nabi ﷺ ke paas aaye aur yeh baat unhein batayi, to aapne poocha: "Tumhara irada kya tha?" To unhone kaha: Ek [talaq]. Aapne poocha: "Allah ki qasam?" Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam. Aapne farmaya: "Yeh wahi hai jo tumne irada kiya tha."

12.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ صَخْرٍ الْبَيَاضِيِّ  ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ امْرَأً أُصِيبُ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ مَا لَا يُصِيبُ غَيْرِي، فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ، خِفْتُ أَنْ أُصِيبَ فِي لَيْلِي شَيْئًا، فَيَتَتَابَعَ بِي ذَلِكَ إِلَى أَنْ أُصْبِحَ، قَالَ : فَتَظَاهَرْتُ إِلَى أَنْ يَنْسَلِخَ، فَبَيْنَا هِيَ لَيْلَةً تَخْدُمُنِي، إِذْ تَكَشَّفَ لِي مِنْهَا شَيْءٌ، فَمَا لَبِثْتُ أَنْ نَزَوْتُ عَلَيْهَا فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحْتُ، خَرَجْتُ إِلَى قَوْمِي فَأَخْبَرْتُهُمْ، وَقُلْتُ : امْشُوا مَعِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالُوا : لَا وَاللَّهِ، لَا نَمْشِي مَعَكَ، مَا نَأْمَنُ أَنْ يَنْزِلَ فِيكَ الْقُرْآنُ، أَوْ أَنْ يَكُونَ فِيكَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَقَالَةٌ يَلْزَمُنَا عَارُهَا، وَلَنُسْلِمَنَّكَ بِجَرِيرَتِكَ.
فَانْطَلَقْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَصَصْتُ عَلَيْهِ خَبَرِي، فَقَالَ : " يَا سَلَمَةُ،أَنْتَ بِذَاكَ؟ " قُلْتُ : أَنَا بِذَاكَ، قَالَ : " يَا سَلَمَةُ، أَنْتَ بِذَاكَ؟ " قُلْتُ : أَنَا بِذَاكَ، قَالَ : " يَا سَلَمَةُ، أَنْتَ بِذَاكَ؟ " قُلْتُ : أَنَا بِذَاكَ، وَهَأَنَا صَابِرٌ نَفْسِي، فَاحْكُمْ فِيَّ مَا أَرَاكَ اللَّهُ، قَالَ : " فَأَعْتِقْ رَقَبَةً "، قَالَ : فَضَرَبْتُ صَفْحَةَ رَقَبَتِي، فَقُلْتُ : وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ مَا أَصْبَحْتُ أَمْلِكُ رَقَبَةً غَيْرَهَا، قَالَ : " فَصُمْ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ "، قُلْتُ : وَهَلْ أَصَابَنِي الَّذِي أَصَابَنِي إِلَّا فِي الصِّيَامِ؟ قَالَ : " فَأَطْعِمْ وَسْقًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا "، فَقُلْتُ : وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ، لَقَدْ بِتْنَا لَيْلَتَنَا وَحْشَى، مَالَنَا مِنَ الطَّعَام، قَالَ : " فَانْطَلِقْ إِلَى صَاحِبِ صَدَقَةِ بَنِي زُرَيْقٍ فَلْيَدْفَعْهَا إِلَيْكَ، وَأَطْعِمْ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا وَسْقًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ، وَكُلْ بَقِيَّتَهُ أَنْتَ وَعِيَالُكَ "، قَالَ : فَأَتَيْتُ قَوْمِي، فَقُلْتُ : وَجَدْتُ عِنْدَكُمُ الضِّيقَ وَسُوءَ الرَّأْيِ، وَوَجَدْتُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ السَّعَةَ وَحُسْنَ الرَّأْيِ، وَقَدْ أَمَرَ لِي بِصَدَقَتِكُمْ
12.en: Narrated by Zakariya ibn Adi, from Abdullah ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Sulayman ibn Yasar, from Salamah ibn Sakhr al-Bayadi: He said: I was a man who obtained from women what no other could, so when the month of Ramadan entered, I feared I would obtain something at night, and that it would continue for me until morning, he said: So I made zihar [a form of divorce-like oath] until it would pass, but while she was serving me one night, something of her was uncovered to me, and I did not delay before I fell upon her, so when morning came, I went out to my people and informed them, and said: "Walk with me to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ," so they said: "No, by Allah, we will not walk with you, we are not safe from the Qur'an being revealed about you, or that there be a statement about you from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that would attach its disgrace to us, and we will surely hand you over with your crime." So I went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and related my news to him, so he said: "O Salamah, is it you who did that?" I said, "It is I who did that." He said: "O Salamah, is it you who did that?" I said, "It is I who did that." He said: "O Salamah, is it you who did that?" I said, "It is I who did that, and here I am patient with myself, so judge concerning me as Allah shows you." He said: "Then free a slave." He said: So I struck the side of my neck, and said: "By the One who sent you with truth, I do not own a neck [slave] other than this one." He said: "Then fast two consecutive months." I said: "But did what befell me befall me except due to fasting?" He said: "Then feed a wasq of dates to sixty poor persons." So I said: "By the One who sent you with truth, we spent our night hungry, we have no food." He said: "Then go to the collector of charity of Banu Zurayq and let him give it to you, and feed sixty poor persons a wasq of dates, and eat the rest of it, you and your dependents." He said: So I came to my people, and said: "I found narrowness and bad opinion with you, and I found breadth and good opinion with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he has commanded for me your charity."
12.hi: Zakariya ibn Adi ne Abdullah ibn Idris se, Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, Muhammad ibn Amr se, Sulayman ibn Yasar se, Salamah ibn Sakhr al-Bayadi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main aisa aadmi tha jo auraton se woh haasil karta jo koi aur nahi karta, to jab Ramzan aaya, mujhe dar hua ke main raat mein kuch kar loonga, aur yeh mere liye subah tak jaari rahega, unhone bataya: To maine zihar kiya jab tak yeh guzar jaaye, lekin ek raat jab woh meri khidmat kar rahi thi, achanak unka kuch hissa mere saamne khul gaya, to maine der na ki aur unpar jhapat pada, so jab subah hui, main apni qaum ke paas gaya aur unhein bataya, aur kaha: "Mere saath Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas chalo," to unhone kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, hum tumhare saath nahi chalenge, humein iska yaqeen nahi ke tumhare baare mein Quran naazil ho jaaye, ya Rasulullah ﷺ ki koi baat aa jaaye jiski sharm humpar bhi aaye, aur hum tumhein tumhare gunah ke saath zaroor hawaale kar denge." To main Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas gaya aur apni khabar aapko sunaayi, to aapne farmaya: "Ae Salamah, kya yeh tumne kiya?" Maine kaha, "Yeh maine kiya." Aapne farmaya: "Ae Salamah, kya yeh tumne kiya?" Maine kaha, "Yeh maine kiya." Aapne farmaya: "Ae Salamah, kya yeh tumne kiya?" Maine kaha, "Yeh maine kiya, aur main apne aap ko sabr mein rakhta hoon, so mere baare mein woh faisla karein jo Allah aapko dikhaaye." Aapne farmaya: "To ek ghulam azaad karo." Unhone bataya: To maine apni gardan ke pehlu par haath maara, aur kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke saath bheja, is se siwa mere paas koi gardan (ghulam) nahi." Aapne farmaya: "To lagataar do mahine roza rakho." Maine kaha: "Lekin jo mujhpar aayi woh roze ki haalat mein hi to aayi thi?" Aapne farmaya: "To sath miskeenon ko khajoor ka ek wasq khilaao." To maine kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke saath bheja, humne apni raat bhookhe guzaari, humare paas khaana nahi hai." Aapne farmaya: "To Banu Zurayq ke sadqe ke zimmedaar ke paas jaao aur woh tumhein de de, aur sath miskeenon ko khajoor ka ek wasq khilaao, aur uska baaki tum aur tumhare gharwale khaao." Unhone bataya: To main apni qaum ke paas gaya, aur kaha: "Maine tumhare paas tangi aur bura khayal paaya, aur maine Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas wus'at aur achha khayal paaya, aur unhone mere liye tumhara sadqa dilwaaya hai."

12.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ   :" أَنَّ زَوْجَهَا طَلَّقَهَا ثَلَاثًا فَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ لَهَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَفَقَةً وَلَا سُكْنَى ".
قَالَ سَلَمَةُ : فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ، فَقَالَ : قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ : لَا نَدَعُ كِتَابَ رَبِّنَا وَسُنَّةَ نَبِيِّهِ بِقَوْلِ امْرَأَةٍ، فَجَعَلَ لَهَا السُّكْنَى وَالنَّفَقَةَ
12.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Salamah ibn Kuhayl, from al-Sha'bi, from Fatimah bint Qays; with Salamah's added note: "That her husband divorced her three times, and the Prophet ﷺ did not grant her maintenance nor housing." Salamah said: So I mentioned that to Ibrahim, so he said: Umar ibn al-Khattab said: We will not leave the Book of our Lord and the sunnah of His Prophet for the saying of a woman, so he granted her housing and maintenance.
12.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Salamah ibn Kuhayl se, al-Sha'bi se, Fatimah bint Qays se bataya: "Ke unke shohar ne unhein teen talaqein di, to Nabi ﷺ ne unke liye na nafqa (kharcha) muqarrar kiya na maskan (rehne ki jagah)." Salamah kehte hain: To maine yeh baat Ibrahim se zikr ki, to unhone kaha: Umar ibn al-Khattab ne kaha: Hum apne Rab ki Kitaab aur uske Nabi ki sunnat ko ek aurat ki baat ke liye nahi chhodenge, so unhone unke liye maskan aur nafqa muqarrar kiya.

12.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ، حَدَّثَتْنِي فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ قَيْسٍ   : " أَنَّ زَوْجَهَا طَلَّقَهَا ثَلَاثًا،فَأَمَرَهَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْ تَعْتَدَّ عِنْدَ ابْنِ عَمِّهَا ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ "
12.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Zakariya, from Amir, from Fatimah bint Qays: "That her husband divorced her three times, and the Prophet ﷺ commanded her to observe her waiting period at the house of her cousin Ibn Umm Maktum."
12.hi: Ya'la ne Zakariya se, Amir se bataya: Mujhse Fatimah bint Qays ne bataya: "Ke unke shohar ne unhein teen talaqein di, to Nabi ﷺ ne unhein hukum diya ke woh apni iddat apne chachazaad Ibn Umm Maktum ke ghar mein guzaarein."

12.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَشْعَثِ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، وَحَمَّادٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" لَا نَدَعُ كِتَابَ رَبِّنَا وَسُنَّةَ نَبِيِّهِ بِقَوْلِ امْرَأَةٍ : الْمُطَلَّقَةُ ثَلَاثًا لَهَا السُّكْنَى وَالنَّفَقَةُ ".
أَخْبَرَنَا طَلْقُ بْنُ غَنَّامٍ  ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ  ، نَحْوَهُ
12.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Ala, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from al-Ash'ath, from al-Hakam, and Hammad, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Umar; a similar chain also via Talq ibn Ghannam: He said: "We will not leave the Book of our Lord and the sunnah of His Prophet for the saying of a woman: the woman divorced three times has housing and maintenance." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Talq ibn Ghannam, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Umar.]
12.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Ala ne Hafs ibn Ghiyath se, al-Ash'ath se, al-Hakam se, aur Hammad se, Ibrahim se, al-Aswad se, Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Hum apne Rab ki Kitaab aur uske Nabi ki sunnat ko ek aurat ki baat ke liye nahi chhodenge: teen talaqein di gayi aurat ke liye maskan aur nafqa hai." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Talq ibn Ghannam se, Hafs ibn Ghiyath se, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se, al-Aswad se, Umar se bhi aayi hai.]

12.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عُمَرُ   :" لَا نُجِيزُ قَوْلَ امْرَأَةٍ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ : الْمُطَلَّقَةُ ثَلَاثًا لَهَا السُّكْنَى وَالنَّفَقَةُ ".
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : لَا أَرَى السُّكْنَى وَالنَّفَقَةَ لِلْمُطَلَّقَةِ
12.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Hafs, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, about Umar; with Abu Muhammad's differing view: He said: Umar said: "We will not accept the saying of a woman in the religion of Allah: the woman divorced three times has housing and maintenance." Abu Muhammad said: I do not hold that the divorced woman has housing and maintenance.
12.hi: Abdullah ibn Muhammad ne bataya: Humein Hafs ne bataya, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se, al-Aswad se: unhone kaha, Umar ne kaha: "Hum Allah ke deen mein aurat ki baat qabool nahi karenge: teen talaqein di gayi aurat ke liye maskan aur nafqa hai." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Main nahi maanta ke talaq-yaafta aurat ke liye maskan aur nafqa hai.

12.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، أَنَّ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ  أَخْبَرَهُ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  أَخْبَرَهُ : أَنَّهُ اجْتَمَعَ هُوَ وَابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ  عِنْدَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  فَذَكَرُوا الرَّجُلَ يُتَوَفَّى عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ فَتَلِدُ بَعْدَهُ بِلَيَالٍ قَلَائِلَ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ : حِلُّهَا آخِرُ الْأَجَلَيْنِ.
وَقَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ : إِذَا وَضَعَتْ، فَقَدْ حَلَّتْ، فَتَرَاجَعَا فِي ذَلِكَ بَيْنَهُمَا، فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ : أَنَا مَعَ ابْنِ أَخِي يَعْنِي أَبَا سَلَمَةَ، فَبَعَثُوا كُرَيْبًا  مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ إِلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ فَسَأَلَهَا، فَذَكَرَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ  ، " أَنَّ سُبَيْعَةَ بِنْتَ الْحَارِثِ الْأَسْلَمِيَّةَ مَاتَ عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا، فَنَفِسَتْ بَعْدَهُ بِلَيَالٍ وَأَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ بَنِي عَبْدِ الدَّارِ يُكْنَى أَبَا السَّنَابِلِ خَطَبَهَا، وَأَخْبَرَهَا أَنَّهَا قَدْ حَلَّتْ فَأَرَادَتْ أَنْ تَتَزَوَّجَ غَيْرَهُ، فَقَالَ لَهَا أَبُو السَّنَابِلِ : فَإِنَّكِ لَمْ تَحِلِّينَ، فَذَكَرَتْ سُبَيْعَةُ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَفَأَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَتَزَوَّجَ "
12.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Sulayman ibn Yasar, about Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman and Ibn Abbas, and Abu Hurairah: That Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman informed him: that he and Ibn Abbas gathered at Abu Hurairah's, and they mentioned the man who dies leaving his wife, and she gives birth a few nights after him, so Ibn Abbas said: her release is the later of the two terms [end of pregnancy or four months and ten days]. And Abu Salamah said: When she gives birth, she is released. So they went back and forth about that between them, so Abu Hurairah said: I am with my nephew, meaning Abu Salamah, so they sent Kurayb, freed servant of Ibn Abbas, to Umm Salamah, and he asked her, so Umm Salamah mentioned: "that Subay'ah bint al-Harith al-Aslamiyyah's husband died, and she gave birth [became pure from postpartum bleeding] a few nights after him, and a man from Banu Abd al-Dar, whose kunyah was Abu al-Sanabil, proposed to her, and informed her that she had become lawful [to remarry], and she wanted to marry someone else, so Abu al-Sanabil said to her: 'You have not become lawful,' so Subay'ah mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he commanded her to marry."
12.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se bataya ke unhein Sulayman ibn Yasar ne bataya, ke Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman ne unhein bataya: ke woh aur Ibn Abbas Abu Hurairah ke paas jama hue aur unhone us aadmi ka zikr kiya jo apni biwi ko chhodkar mar jaaye, aur woh uske baad kuch raaton mein bachcha janam de, to Ibn Abbas ne kaha: uska halal hona in do muddaton mein se aakhri par hoga. Aur Abu Salamah ne kaha: Jab woh janam de, to woh halal ho jaati hai. So dono ke darmiyan ismein aage-peechhe baat hui, to Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Main apne bhatije ke saath hoon, yaani Abu Salamah, to unhone Kurayb, Ibn Abbas ke azaad kiye hue ghulam, ko Umm Salamah ke paas bheja, aur usne unse poocha, to Umm Salamah ne zikr kiya: "ke Subay'ah bint al-Harith al-Aslamiyyah ka shohar mar gaya, aur woh uske kuch raaton baad janam se paak ho gayin, aur Banu Abd al-Dar ke ek aadmi ne, jinki kunyat Abu al-Sanabil thi, unhein rishta diya, aur unhein bataaya ke woh halal ho chuki hain, aur woh kisi aur se nikaah karna chahti thin, to Abu al-Sanabil ne unse kaha: 'Tum halal nahi hui,' to Subay'ah ne yeh baat Rasulullah ﷺ se zikr ki, to aapne unhein nikaah karne ka hukum diya."

12.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : " تُوُفِّيَ زَوْجُ سُبَيْعَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ ، فَوَضَعَتْ بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ زَوْجِهَا بِأَيَّامٍ،فَأَمَرَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْ تَتَزَوَّجَ "
12.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Sulayman ibn Yasar, from Kurayb, from Umm Salamah: She said: "The husband of Subay'ah bint al-Harith died, and she gave birth some days after her husband's death, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded her to marry."
12.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Sulayman ibn Yasar se, Kurayb se, Umm Salamah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Subay'ah bint al-Harith ke shohar ka intiqaal ho gaya, aur woh apne shohar ki maut ke kuch din baad janam se paak hui, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne unhein nikaah karne ka hukum diya."

12.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي السَّنَابِلِ  ، قَالَ : وَضَعَتْ سُبَيْعَةُ بِنْتُ الْحَارِثِ حَمْلَهَا بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ زَوْجِهَا بِبِضْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ لَيْلَةً، فَلَمَّا تَعَلَّتْ مِنْ نِفَاسِهَا تَشَوَّفَتْ، فَعِيبَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهَا، فَذُكِرَ أَمْرُهَا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ :" إِنْ تَفْعَلْ، فَقَدْ انْقَضَى أَجَلُهَا "
12.en: Narrated by Bishr ibn Umar al-Zahrani, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Abu al-Sanabil: He said: Subay'ah bint al-Harith gave birth to her pregnancy some twenty-odd nights after her husband's death, so when she had recovered from her postpartum bleeding, she adorned herself, so that was found fault with in her, and her matter was mentioned to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he said: "If she does that, her term has indeed ended."
12.hi: Bishr ibn Umar al-Zahrani ne Abu al-Ahwas se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se, al-Aswad se, Abu al-Sanabil se bataya: Unhone kaha, Subay'ah bint al-Harith ne apne shohar ki maut ke bees-baais raatein baad apni haamila-giri se janam diya, so jab woh apni nifas se theek hui, unhone singaar kiya, to isper unhein aitraaz kiya gaya, aur unka maamla Rasulullah ﷺ se zikr kiya gaya, to aapne farmaya: "Agar woh aisa karti hain, to unki muddat zaroor khatam ho chuki hai."

12.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ  : أَنَّ سُبَيْعَةَ وَضَعَتْ بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ زَوْجِهَا بِأَيَّامٍ فَتَشَوَّفَتْ، فَعَابَ أَبُو السَّنَابِلِ  ، فَسَأَلَتْ أَوْ ذَكَرَتْ أَمْرَهَا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" فَأَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَتَزَوَّجَ "
12.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad: That Subay'ah gave birth some days after her husband's death, so she adorned herself, so Abu al-Sanabil found fault with her, so she asked, or mentioned her matter, to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, "so he commanded her to marry."
12.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se, al-Aswad se bataya ke Subay'ah ne apne shohar ki maut ke kuch din baad janam diya, so unhone singaar kiya, to Abu al-Sanabil ne unpar aitraaz kiya, to unhone Rasulullah ﷺ se apna maamla poocha, ya zikr kiya, "to aapne unhein nikaah karne ka hukum diya."

12.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَا يَحِلُّ لِامْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ أَوْ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ أَنْ تَحِدَّ عَلَى أَحَدٍ فَوْقَ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ، إِلَّا عَلَى زَوْجِهَا "
12.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir, from Sulayman ibn Kathir, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "It is not lawful for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day, or believes in Allah, to mourn for anyone beyond three days, except for her husband."
12.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir ne Sulayman ibn Kathir se, al-Zuhri se, Urwah se, Aisha se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Us aurat ke liye halal nahi jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhti ho, ya Allah par imaan rakhti ho, ke woh kisi ke liye teen din se zyada sog (matam) kare, siwaay apne shohar ke."

12.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتَ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  تُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ   : أَنَّ أَخًا لَهَا مَاتَ أَوْ حَمِيمًا لَهَا فَعَمَدَتْ إِلَى صُفْرَةٍ فَجَعَلَتْ تَمْسَحُ يَدَيْهَا، وَقَالَتْ : إِنَّمَا أَفْعَلُ هَذَا لِأَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَا يَحِلُّ لِامْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ أَنْ تَحُدَّ فَوْقَ ثَلَاثٍ إِلَّا عَلَى زَوْجِهَا، فَإِنَّهَا تَحُدُّ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا ".
أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتَ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ  تُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أُمِّهَا   أَوْ امْرَأَةٍ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، نَحْوَهُ
12.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Humayd ibn Nafi', from Zaynab bint Abi Salamah, from Umm Habibah bint Abi Sufyan; a similar chain also via Hashim from Zaynab bint Umm Salamah: That a brother of hers, or a close relative, died, so she reached for a yellow perfume and began wiping her hands with it, and said: "I only do this because the Prophet ﷺ said: 'It is not lawful for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn beyond three [days] except for her husband, for she mourns four months and ten [days].'" [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Humayd ibn Nafi', from Zaynab bint Umm Salamah, narrating from her mother, or a woman from among the wives of the Prophet ﷺ, near it.]
12.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se, Humayd ibn Nafi' se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Zaynab bint Abi Salamah ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Umm Habibah bint Abi Sufyan se: ke unke ek bhai, ya koi qareebi rishtedaar, ka intiqaal hua, to unhone zardi wali khushbu li aur apne haathon par malne lagi, aur kaha: "Main yeh isliye karti hoon kyunki Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: 'Us aurat ke liye halal nahi jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhti ho, ke woh teen din se zyada sog kare siwaay apne shohar ke, kyunki woh chaar mahine das din sog karti hai.'" [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Hashim ibn al-Qasim se, Shu'bah se, Humayd ibn Nafi' se bhi aayi hai: ke Zaynab bint Umm Salamah ne apni maa se, ya Nabi ﷺ ki biwiyon mein se ek aurat se, isi ke qareeb bayaan kiya.]

12.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ  ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَا تَحِدُّ الْمَرْأَةُ فَوْقَ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ إِلَّا عَلَى زَوْجٍ، فَإِنَّهَا تَحِدُّ عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا : لَا تَلْبَسُ ثَوْبًا مَصْبُوغًا إِلَّا ثَوْبَ عَصْبٍ، وَلَا تَكْتَحِلُ، وَلَا تَمَسُّ طِيبًا إِلَّا فِي أَدْنَى طُهْرِهَا إِذَا اغْتَسَلَتْ مِنْ مَحِيضِهَا : نُبْذَةً مِنْ كُسْتٍ وَأَظْفَارٍ "
12.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Za'idah, from Hisham ibn Hassan, from Hafsah bint Sirin, from Umm Atiyyah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "A woman should not mourn beyond three days except for a husband, for she mourns for him four months and ten [days]: she should not wear a dyed garment except a garment of coarse striped cloth, and should not apply kohl, and should not touch perfume except at the end of her purification, when she bathes from her menstruation: a bit of qust and azfar [types of incense/perfume permitted minimally]."
12.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Za'idah se, Hisham ibn Hassan se, Hafsah bint Sirin se, Umm Atiyyah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Aurat teen din se zyada sog na kare siwaay shohar ke, kyunki uske liye woh chaar mahine das din sog karti hai: woh koi rangeen kapda na pehne siwaay motay dhaari-daar kapde ke, aur na surma lagaaye, aur na khushbu chhue siwaay apni taharat ke aakhir mein, jab woh apne haiz se ghusl kare: thodi si 'qust' aur 'azfar' [khushbuein]."

12.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ  ، عَنْ عَمَّتِهِ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ  : أَنَّ الْفُرَيْعَةَ بِنْتَ مَالِكٍ   أَخْبَرَتْهَا أَنَّهَا سَأَلَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْ يَأْذَنَ لَهَا أَنْ تَرْجِعَ إِلَى أَهْلِهَا، فَإِنَّ زَوْجِي قَدْ خَرَجَ فِي طَلَبِ أَعْبُدٍ لَهُ أَبَقُوا، فَأَدْرَكَهُمْ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ بِطَرَفِ الْقَدُومِ، قَتَلُوهُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" امْكُثِي فِي بَيْتِكِ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ الْكِتَابُ أَجَلَهُ "، فَقُلْتُ : إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَدَعْنِي فِي بَيْتٍ أَمْلِكُهُ، وَلَا نَفَقَةٍ، فَقَالَ : " امْكُثِي حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ الْكِتَابُ أَجَلَهُ "، فَاعْتَدَّتْ فِيهِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا، قَالَتْ : فَلَمَّا كَانَ عُثْمَانُ : أَرْسَلَ إِلَيَّ فَسَأَلَنِي عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ، فَاتَّبَعَ ذَلِكَ وَقَضَى بِهِ
12.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Malik, from Sa'd ibn Ishaq ibn Ka'b ibn Ujrah, from his aunt Zaynab bint Ka'b ibn Ujrah, from al-Furay'ah bint Malik: That she informed her that she asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to permit her to return to her family, [saying]: "my husband went out in pursuit of some slaves of his who had fled, and he caught up with them, until when he was at the edge of al-Qadum, they killed him," so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Stay in your house until the [waiting period] reaches its term." So I said: he did not leave me in a house I own, nor with maintenance, so he said: "Stay until the [waiting period] reaches its term." So I observed my waiting period there for four months and ten [days]. She said: Then when it was Uthman's time, he sent for me and asked me about that, and I informed him, so he followed that and ruled by it.
12.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Malik se, Sa'd ibn Ishaq ibn Ka'b ibn Ujrah se, apni phuphi Zaynab bint Ka'b ibn Ujrah se bataya: ke al-Furay'ah bint Malik ne unhein bataya ke unhone Rasulullah ﷺ se apne gharwalon ke paas wapas jaane ki ijaazat maangi, [kehte hue]: "mera shohar apne kuch bhaage hue ghulaamon ko dhoondhne nikla tha, aur usne unhein pakad liya, yahan tak ke jab woh al-Qadum ke kinaare tha, unhone usay maar diya," to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Apne ghar mein raho jab tak [iddat] apni muddat ko na pahunche." To maine kaha: usne mujhe aisa koi ghar nahi chhoda jispar mera ikhtiyaar ho, na koi nafqa, to aapne farmaya: "Raho jab tak [iddat] apni muddat ko na pahunche." So maine wahan chaar mahine das din apni iddat guzaari. Unhone bataya: Fir jab Uthman ka daur aaya, unhone mujhe bulaaya aur iske baare mein poocha, to maine unhein bataya, to unhone isi ka faisla kiya aur isi par amal kiya.

12.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ : طُلِّقَتْ خَالَتِي فَأَرَادَتْ أَنْ تَجُدَّ نَخْلًا لَهَا، فَقَالَ لَهَا رَجُلٌ : لَيْسَ لَكِ أَنْ تَخْرُجِين، قَالَتْ : فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، فَقَالَ :" اخْرُجِي فَجُدِّي نَخْلَكِ، فَلَعَلَّكِ أَنْ تَصَدَّقِي أَوْ تَصْنَعِي مَعْرُوفًا "
12.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir: He said: My maternal aunt was divorced, and she wanted to harvest date-palms of hers, so a man said to her: "You are not allowed to go out," she said: So I came to the Prophet ﷺ and mentioned that to him, so he said: "Go out and harvest your date-palms, for perhaps you may give charity or do a good deed."
12.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Meri khaala ko talaq de di gayi, to unhone apni khajoor ki fasal katni chaahi, to ek aadmi ne unse kaha: "Tumhein bahar jaane ki ijaazat nahi," unhone bataya: To main Nabi ﷺ ke paas gayi aur yeh baat unhein batayi, to aapne farmaya: "Bahar jaao aur apni khajoor ki fasal kaato, shayad tum sadqa ya koi neki kar sako."

12.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   : أَنَّهَا أَرَادَتْ أَنْ تَشْتَرِيَ بَرِيرَةَ ، فَأَرَادَ مَوَالِيهَا أَنْ يَشْتَرِطُوا وَلَاءَهَا، فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ :" اشْتَرِيهَا، فَإِنَّمَا الْوَلَاءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ "، فَاشْتَرَتْهَا فَأَعْتَقَتْهَا، وَخَيَّرَهَا مِنْ زَوْجِهَا وَكَانَ حُرًّا وَأَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أُتِيَ بِلَحْمٍ، فَقَالَ : " مِنْ أَيْنَ هَذَا؟ " قِيلَ : تُصُدِّقَ بِهِ عَلَى بَرِيرَةَ ، فَقَالَ : " هُوَ لَهَا صَدَقَةٌ، وَلَنَا هَدِيَّةٌ "
12.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, about Aisha and Barirah: That she wanted to buy Barirah, but her masters wanted to stipulate her wala' [right of inheritance/patronage], so she mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he said: "Buy her, for indeed wala' belongs to whoever frees [the slave]." So she bought her and freed her, and gave her the choice concerning her husband, who was free, and the Prophet ﷺ was brought meat, and he said: "Where is this from?" It was said: It was given in charity to Barirah, so he said: "It is charity for her, and a gift for us."
12.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se, al-Hakam se, Ibrahim se, al-Aswad se, Aisha se bataya ke woh Barirah ko khareedna chaahti thin, lekin unke maalik uska wala' shart lagaana chaahte the, to unhone yeh baat Rasulullah ﷺ se zikr ki, to aapne farmaya: "Usay khareed lo, kyunki wala' usi ka hota hai jo azaad kare." So unhone usay khareed liya aur azaad kar diya, aur unhein apne shohar ke baare mein ikhtiyaar diya, jo azaad the, aur Nabi ﷺ ke paas gosht laaya gaya, to aapne poocha: "Yeh kahan se hai?" Kaha gaya: Yeh Barirah ko sadqe mein diya gaya tha, to aapne farmaya: "Yeh unke liye sadqa hai, aur humare liye tohfa hai."

12.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ خَلِيلٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَيَّ فَقَرَّبْتُ إِلَيْهِ طَعَامًا لَيْسَ فِيهِ لَحْمٌ، فَقَالَ :" أَلَمْ أَرَ لَكُمْ قِدْرًا مَنْصُوبَةً؟ " قُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَذَا لَحْمٌ تُصُدِّقَ بِهِ عَلَى بَرِيرَةَ ، فَأَهْدَتْ لَنَا، قَالَ : " هُوَ عَلَيْهَا صَدَقَةٌ، وَهُوَ لَنَا مِنْهَا هَدِيَّةٌ "، وَكَانَ لَهَا زَوْجٌ، فَلَمَّا عُتِقَتْ، خُيِّرَتْ
12.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Khalil, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from his father, from Aisha: She said: The Prophet ﷺ entered upon me, and I served him food that had no meat in it, so he said: "Did I not see a pot set up for you?" I said: "O Messenger of Allah, this is meat that was given in charity to Barirah, and she gave us a gift from it." He said: "It is charity for her, and for us a gift from her." And she had a husband, so when she was freed, she was given the choice.
12.hi: Isma'il ibn Khalil ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim se, apne walid se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ mere paas dakhil hue to maine aapko khaana pesh kiya jismein gosht nahi tha, to aapne poocha: "Kya maine tumhare liye ek deg chadhi hui nahi dekhi?" Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, yeh gosht Barirah ko sadqe mein diya gaya tha, to unhone humein isme se tohfa diya." Aapne farmaya: "Yeh unke liye sadqa hai, aur humare liye unki taraf se tohfa." Aur unka ek shohar tha, to jab woh azaad hui, unhein ikhtiyaar diya gaya.

12.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الضَّحَّاكِ  ، عَنْ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمَخْزُومِيِّ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   : " أَنَّ بَرِيرَةَ حِينَ أَعْتَقَتْهَا عَائِشَةُ ، كَانَ زَوْجُهَا عَبْدًا،فَجَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَحُضُّهَا عَلَيْهِ، فَجَعَلَتْ تَقُولُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَلَيْسَ لِي أَنْ أُفَارِقَهُ؟ قَالَ : " بَلَى "، قَالَتْ : فَقَدْ فَارَقْتُهُ
12.en: Narrated by Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Dahhak, from al-Mughirah ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Makhzumi, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from his father, from Aisha: That when Aisha freed Barirah, her husband was a slave, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ began urging her toward him, so she began saying to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: Do I not have the right to part from him? He said, "Indeed you do." She said: Then I have parted from him.
12.hi: Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Dahhak ne al-Mughirah ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Makhzumi se, Hisham ibn Urwah se, Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim se, apne walid se, Aisha se bataya ke jab Aisha ne Barirah ko azaad kiya, to unka shohar ghulam tha, to Rasulullah ﷺ unhein unki taraf ubhaarne lage, to woh Rasulullah ﷺ se kehne lagin: Kya mujhe unse alag hone ka haq nahi? Aapne farmaya, "Kyun nahi." Unhone kaha: To main unse alag ho gayi.

12.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ يَعْنِي الْحَذَّاءَ  عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   : أَنَّ زَوْجَ بَرِيرَةَ كَانَ عَبْدًا يُقَالُ لَهُ : مُغِيثٌ، كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ يَطُوفُ خَلْفَهَا يَبْكِي وَدُمُوعُهُ تَسِيلُ عَلَى لِحْيَتِهِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِلْعَبَّاسِ : " يَا عَبَّاسُ،أَلَا تَعْجَبُ مِنْ شِدَّةِ حُبِّ مُغِيثٍ بَرِيرَةَ ، وَمِنْ شِدَّةِ بُغْضِ بَرِيرَةَ مُغِيثًا؟ " فَقَالَ لَهَا : " لَوْ رَاجَعْتِيهِ فَإِنَّهُ أَبُو وَلَدِكِ "، فَقَالَتْ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتَأْمُرُنِي؟ قَال : " إِنَّمَا أَنَا شَافِعٌ "، قَالَتْ : لَا حَاجَةَ لِي فِيهِ
12.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid ibn Abdullah, from Khalid al-Hadhdha, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas: That Barirah's husband was a slave called Mughith, [Ibn Abbas said]: it is as if I see him going around behind her, weeping, his tears flowing on his beard, so the Prophet ﷺ said to al-Abbas: "O Abbas, do you not marvel at the intensity of Mughith's love for Barirah, and the intensity of Barirah's hatred for Mughith?" So he said to her: "If you would take him back, for indeed he is the father of your child," so she said: "O Messenger of Allah, are you commanding me?" He said: "I am only an intercessor." She said: "I have no need of him."
12.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid ibn Abdullah se, Khalid al-Hadhdha se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya ke Barirah ka shohar ek ghulam tha jise Mughith kaha jaata tha, [Ibn Abbas ne kaha]: goya main use dekh raha hoon unke peechhe ghoomta hua, rota hua, uske aansu uski daadhi par bahte hue, to Nabi ﷺ ne al-Abbas se farmaya: "Ae Abbas, kya tumhein Mughith ki Barirah se mohabbat ki shiddat par, aur Barirah ki Mughith se nafrat ki shiddat par, tajjub nahi hota?" To aapne usse farmaya: "Kaash tum use wapas le leti, kyunki woh tumhare bachche ka baap hai," to usne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, kya aap mujhe hukum de rahe hain?" Aapne farmaya: "Main to sirf sifarish karne wala hoon." Usne kaha: "Mujhe uski koi zaroorat nahi."

12.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي زِيَادُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ أُسَامَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ سُلَيْمَانَ  مَوْلًى لِأَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ فَجَاءَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ، فَقَالَتْ : إِنَّ زَوْجِي يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَذْهَبَ بِوَلَدِي، فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ   : كُنْتُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذْ جَاءَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ، فَقَالَتْ : إِنَّ زَوْجِي يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَذْهَبَ بِوَلَدِي أَوْ بِابْنِي وَقَدْ نَفَعَنِي وَسَقَانِي مِنْ بِئْرِ أَبِي عِنَبَةَ ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : اسْتَهِمَا أَوْ قَالَ : تَسَاهَمَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ الشَّاكُّ ، فَجَاءَ زَوْجُهَا، فَقَالَ : مَنْ يُخَاصِمُنِي فِي وَلَدِي أَوْ فِي ابْنِي؟، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " يَا غُلَامُ،هَذَا أَبُوكَ وَهَذِهِ أُمُّكَ، فَخُذْ بِيَدِ أَيِّهِمَا شِئْتَ ".
وَقَدْ قَالَ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ : " فَاتْبَعْ أَيَّهُمَا شِئْتَ "، فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِ أُمِّهِ فَانْطَلَقَتْ بِهِ
12.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ziyad ibn Sa'd, from Hilal ibn Usamah, from Abu Maymunah Sulayman, freed servant of the people of Madinah, about Abu Hurairah: He said: I was with Abu Hurairah when a woman came to him, and said: "My husband wants to take my child away." So Abu Hurairah said: I was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when a woman came to him, and said: "My husband wants to take my child, or my son, away, and he has benefited me, and given me water from the well of Abu Inabah," so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Draw lots" or said: "Let the two of them draw lots" - Abu Asim was uncertain - so her husband came, and said: "Who is disputing with me about my child, or about my son?" So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O boy, this is your father and this is your mother, so take whichever of the two hands you wish." And Abu Asim also said: "So follow whichever of the two you wish," so he took his mother's hand, and she went off with him.
12.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se bataya: Mujhe Ziyad ibn Sa'd ne bataya, Hilal ibn Usamah se, Abu Maymunah Sulayman se, jo Madinah walon ke azaad kiye hue ghulam the: Unhone kaha, Main Abu Hurairah ke paas tha to unke paas ek aurat aayi, aur kaha: "Mera shohar mera bachcha le jaana chahta hai." To Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Main Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas tha jab aapke paas ek aurat aayi, aur usne kaha: "Mera shohar mera bachcha, ya mera beta, le jaana chahta hai, aur usne mujhe faida pahunchaya aur mujhe Abu Inabah ke kuen se paani pilaaya," to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Qura daalo" ya farmaya: "Dono qura daalein" - Abu Asim ko shak tha - to uska shohar aaya, aur kaha: "Mere bachche ke baare mein, ya mere bete ke baare mein, mujhse kaun jhagad raha hai?" To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Ae ladke, yeh tumhara baap hai aur yeh tumhari maa hai, so in dono mein se jiska haath chaho pakad lo." Aur Abu Asim ne bhi kaha: "To in dono mein se jiske saath jaana chaho jao," to usne apni maa ka haath pakda aur woh usay le kar chali gayi.

12.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُظَاهِرٌ وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَسْلَمَ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ  ،  عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" لِلْأَمَةِ تَطْلِيقَتَانِ وَقُرْؤُهَا حَيْضَتَانِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ : سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ مُظَاهِرٍ
12.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Muzahir ibn Aslam, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Aisha, from the Prophet ﷺ; with Abu Asim's note: He said: "The slave-girl has two divorces, and her waiting period is two menstrual periods." Abu Asim said: I heard it from Muzahir.
12.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se bataya: Mujhe Muzahir ibn Aslam ne bataya, ke unhone al-Qasim ibn Muhammad ko suna, Aisha se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Laundi ki do talaqein hain, aur uski iddat do haiz hai." Abu Asim kehte hain: Maine ise Muzahir se suna.

12.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْوَدَّاكِ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ   وَرَفَعَهُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي سَبَايَا أَوْطَاسٍ :" لَا تُوطَأُ حَامِلٌ حَتَّى تَضَعَ حَمْلَهَا، وَلَا غَيْرُ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَتَّى تَحِيضَ حَيْضَةً "
12.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Sharik, from Qays ibn Wahb, from Abu al-Waddak, from Abu Sa'id, raising it [to the Prophet ﷺ]: That he said, concerning the captives of Awtas: "A pregnant woman is not to be had intercourse with until she gives birth, and one who is not pregnant, until she menstruates once."
12.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Sharik se, Qays ibn Wahb se, Abu al-Waddak se, Abu Sa'id se, marfu'an bataya ke aapne Awtas ke qaidiyon ke baare mein farmaya: "Haamila se uski wiladat tak sohbat na ki jaaye, aur jo haamila na ho, uske ek haiz aane tak."

13.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" رُفِعَ الْقَلَمُ عَنْ ثَلَاثَةٍ : عَنِ النَّائِمِ حَتَّى يَسْتَيْقِظَ، وَعَنِ الصَّغِيرِ حَتَّى يَحْتَلِمَ، وَعَنِ الْمَجْنُونِ حَتَّى يَعْقِلَ ".
وَقَدْ قَالَ حَمَّادٌ أَيْضًا : " وَعَنْ الْمَعْتُوهِ حَتَّى يَعْقِلَ "
13.en: Narrated by Affan, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from Aisha, from the Prophet ﷺ; with Hammad's addition: He said: "The pen is lifted from three: from the sleeping one until he wakes, and from the child until he reaches puberty, and from the insane one until he regains reason." And Hammad also said: "and from the insane [feeble-minded] one until he regains reason."
13.hi: Affan ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Hammad se, Ibrahim se, al-Aswad se, Aisha se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Qalam teen se uthaaya gaya hai: sote hue se jab tak woh jaage, aur bachche se jab tak woh baaligh ho, aur pagal se jab tak use hosh aaye." Aur Hammad ne bhi kaha: "aur kamzor-e-aqal se jab tak use hosh aaye."

13.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ  ،  عَنْ عُثْمَانَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" لَا يَحِلُّ دَمُ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ إِلَّا بِإِحْدَى ثَلَاثٍ : بِكُفْرٍ بَعْدَ إِيمَانٍ، أَوْ بِزِنًى بَعْدَ إِحْصَانٍ، أَوْ يَقْتُلُ نَفْسًا بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ فَيُقْتَلُ "
13.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Abu Umamah ibn Sahl ibn Hunayf, from Uthman: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "The blood of a Muslim man is not lawful [to shed] except for one of three: disbelief after belief, or adultery after being married, or killing a soul without [that soul having killed another] soul, in which case he is killed."
13.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Abu Umamah ibn Sahl ibn Hunayf se, Uthman se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Kisi Musalman aadmi ka khoon halal nahi siwaay teen mein se ek ke: imaan ke baad kufr, ya shaadi-shuda hote hue zina, ya kisi jaan ko bagair [uske kisi jaan ko maarne ke] maarna, jispar use qatal kiya jaayega."

13.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا يَحِلُّ دَمُ رَجُلٍ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَّا أَحَدُ ثَلَاثَةِ نَفَرٍ : النَّفْسُ بِالنَّفْسِ، وَالثَّيِّبُ الزَّانِي، وَالتَّارِكُ لِدِينِهِ، الْمُفَارِقُ لِلْجَمَاعَةِ "
13.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from al-A'mash, from Abdullah ibn Murrah, from Masruq, from Abdullah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The blood of a man who testifies that there is no god but Allah, and that I am the Messenger of Allah, is not lawful except for one of three: a life for a life, the previously-married adulterer, and the one who leaves his religion, separating from the community."
13.hi: Ya'la ne al-A'mash se, Abdullah ibn Murrah se, Masruq se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Us aadmi ka khoon halal nahi jo gawahi de ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur main Allah ka Rasool hoon, siwaay teen mein se ek ke: jaan ke badle jaan, aur shaadi-shuda zaani, aur woh jo apna deen chhod de, jama'at se alag ho jaaye."

13.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ  ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ صَفْوَانُ بْنُ أُمَيَّةَ نَائِمًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ وَهُوَ نَائِمٌ، فَاسْتَلَّ رِدَاءَهُ مِنْ تَحْتِ رَأْسِهِ، فتَنَبَّهَ بِهِ، فَلَحِقَهُ فَأَخَذَهُ فَانْطَلَقَ بِهِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، كُنْتُ نَائِمًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَأَتَانِي هَذَا فَاسْتَلَّ رِدَائِي مِنْ تَحْتِ رَأْسِي، فَلَحِقْتُهُ فَأَخَذْتُهُ، فَأَمَرَ بِقَطْعِهِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ صَفْوَانُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ رِدَائِي لَمْ يَبْلُغْ أَنْ يُقْطَعَ فِيهِ هَذَا؟ قَالَ :" فَهَلَّا، قَبْلَ أَنْ تَأْتِيَنِي بِهِ؟ "
13.en: Narrated by Sa'd ibn Hafs, from Shayban, from Ash'ath, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas: He said: Safwan ibn Umayyah was sleeping in the mosque, so a man came to him while he was asleep, and pulled his cloak from beneath his head, so he woke because of it, and caught up with him and took him, and went with him to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, I was sleeping in the mosque, and this one came to me and pulled my cloak from beneath my head, so I caught up with him and took him," so he commanded that his hand be cut off, so Safwan said to him: "O Messenger of Allah, my cloak was not worth so much that his hand should be cut off for it?" He said: "Then why did you not [say this] before you brought him to me?"
13.hi: Sa'd ibn Hafs ne Shayban se, Ash'ath se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Safwan ibn Umayyah masjid mein so rahe the, to ek aadmi unke paas aaya jabke woh so rahe the, aur unki chaadar unke sar ke neeche se khainch li, to woh iski wajah se jaage, aur uska peechha karke usay pakad liya, aur usay lekar Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas gaye, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, main masjid mein so raha tha, aur yeh mere paas aaya aur meri chaadar mere sar ke neeche se khainch li, to maine iska peechha karke isay pakad liya," to aapne uska haath kaatne ka hukum diya, to Safwan ne aapse kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, meri chaadar itni qeemat ki nahi thi ke iske liye iska haath kaata jaaye?" Aapne farmaya: "To tumne mujhe isay laane se pehle [yeh baat] kyun nahi kahi?"

13.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الْهَاشِمِيُّ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" تُقْطَعُ الْيَدُ فِي رُبْعِ دِينَارٍ فَصَاعِدًا "
13.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Da'ud al-Hashimi, from Ibrahim ibn Sa'd, from al-Zuhri, from Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman, from Aisha: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The hand is cut off for a quarter of a dinar or more."
13.hi: Sulayman ibn Da'ud al-Hashimi ne Ibrahim ibn Sa'd se, al-Zuhri se, Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman se, Aisha se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Haath chaudai-e-dinar ya usse zyada mein kaata jaata hai."

13.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، وَإِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ  ، وَعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، وَمُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَة  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" قَطَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي مِجَنٍّ قِيمَتُهُ ثَلَاثَةُ دَرَاهِمَ "
13.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from Ayyub, and Isma'il ibn Umayyah, and Ubaydullah, and Musa ibn Uqbah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cut off [a hand] for a shield worth three dirhams."
13.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se, Ayyub se, aur Isma'il ibn Umayyah se, aur Ubaydullah se, aur Musa ibn Uqbah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne ek dhaal, jiski qeemat teen dirham thi, ke liye haath kaata."

13.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   : أَنَّ قُرَيْشًا أَهَمَّهُمْ شَأْنُ الْمَرْأَةِ الْمَخْزُومِيَّةِ الَّتِي سَرَقَتْ، فَقَالُوا : مَنْ يُكَلِّمُ فِيهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟، قَالُوا : وَمَنْ يَجْتَرِئُ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ حِبُّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟ فَكَلَّمَهُ أُسَامَةُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَتَشْفَعُ فِي حَدٍّ مِنْ حُدُودِ اللَّهِ؟ " ثُمَّ قَامَ فَاخْتَطَبَ، فَقَالَ :" إِنَّمَا هَلَكَ الَّذِينَ قَبْلَكُمْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا إِذَا سَرَقَ فِيهُمُ الشَّرِيفُ، تَرَكُوهُ، وَإِذَا سَرَقَ فِيهِمُ الضَّعِيفُ، أَقَامُوا عَلَيْهِ الْحَدَّ، وَايْمُ اللَّهِ، لَوْ أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ مُحَمَّدٍ سَرَقَتْ، لَقَطَعْتُ يَدَهَا "
13.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from al-Layth, from Ibn Shihab, from Urwah ibn al-Zubayr, from Aisha: That Quraysh was concerned about the matter of the Makhzumi woman who had stolen, so they said: "Who will speak to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about her?" They said: "And who would dare to, except Usamah ibn Zayd, the beloved of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" So Usamah spoke to him, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Are you interceding concerning one of the punishments prescribed by Allah?" Then he stood and gave a sermon, and said: "Those before you were only destroyed because when a noble person among them stole, they left him, but when a weak person among them stole, they applied the punishment to him. By Allah, if Fatimah, daughter of Muhammad, were to steal, I would cut off her hand."
13.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne al-Layth se, Ibn Shihab se, Urwah ibn al-Zubayr se, Aisha se bataya ke Quraysh us Makhzumi aurat ke maamle se pareshaan the jisne chori ki thi, to unhone kaha: "Iske baare mein Rasulullah ﷺ se kaun baat kare?" Unhone kaha: "Aur kaun himmat kar sakta hai siwaay Usamah ibn Zayd ke, jo Rasulullah ﷺ ke mahboob hain?" To Usamah ne aapse baat ki, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Kya tum Allah ki hudood mein se ek hadd mein sifarish kar rahe ho?" Fir aap khade hue aur khutba diya, aur farmaya: "Tumse pehle log sirf isliye halaak hue ke jab unmein koi izzat wala chori karta, to woh usay chhod dete, aur jab unmein koi kamzor chori karta, to uspar hadd qaayam karte. Allah ki qasam, agar Fatimah, Muhammad ki beti, chori karti, to main uska haath kaat deta."

13.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ إِسْحَاق بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُنْذِرِ  مَوْلَى أَبِي ذَرٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ الْمَخْزُومِيِّ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أُتِيَ بِسَارِقٍ اعْتَرَفَ اعْتِرَافًا، لَمْ يُوجَدْ مَعَهُ مَتَاعٌ، فَقَالَ :" مَا إِخَالُكَ سَرَقْتَ؟ " قَالَ : بَلَى، قَالَ : " مَا إِخَالُكَ سَرَقْتَ؟ " قَالَ : بَلَى، قَالَ : " فَاذْهَبُوا فَاقْطَعُوا يَدَهُ ثُمَّ جِيئُوا بِهِ " فَقَطَعُوا يَدَهُ، ثُمَّ جَاءُوا بِهِ، فَقَالَ : " اسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ وَتُبْ إِلَيْهِ "، فَقَالَ : أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ : " اللَّهُمَّ تُبْ عَلَيْهِ، اللَّهُمَّ تُبْ عَلَيْهِ "
13.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ishaq ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah, from Abu al-Mundhir, freed servant of Abu Dharr, from Abu Umayyah al-Makhzumi: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was brought a thief who confessed clearly, and no goods were found with him, so he said: "I do not think you stole?" He said, "Indeed I did." He said: "I do not think you stole?" He said, "Indeed I did." He said: "Then go and cut off his hand, then bring him," so they cut off his hand, then brought him, so he said: "Seek Allah's forgiveness and repent to Him." So he said: I seek Allah's forgiveness and repent to Him. So he said: "O Allah, accept his repentance, O Allah, accept his repentance."
13.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ishaq ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah se, Abu al-Mundhir se (Abu Dharr ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), Abu Umayyah al-Makhzumi se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas ek chor laaya gaya jisne saaf iqraar kiya, aur uske paas koi saaman nahi paaya gaya, to aapne farmaya: "Mera khayal nahi tha ke tumne chori ki hai?" Usne kaha, "Zaroor ki." Aapne farmaya: "Mera khayal nahi tha ke tumne chori ki hai?" Usne kaha, "Zaroor ki." Aapne farmaya: "To jao aur uska haath kaato, fir usay laao," to unhone uska haath kaata, fir usay laaye, to aapne farmaya: "Allah se maghfirat maango aur uski taraf tauba karo." To usne kaha: Main Allah se maghfirat maangta hoon aur uski taraf tauba karta hoon. To aapne farmaya: "Allahumma tub 'alayh, Allahumma tub 'alayh" [Ae Allah, uski tauba qabool kar, Ae Allah, uski tauba qabool kar].

13.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى هُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ  أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" لَا قَطْعَ فِي ثَمَرٍ وَلَا كَثَرٍ "
13.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban, from Rafi' ibn Khadij: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "There is no [hand] cutting for [stealing] fruit nor palm-shoots."
13.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se bataya: Unhein Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban ne bataya, Rafi' ibn Khadij se: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Phal aur khajoor ke jhaad mein [haath] kaatna nahi hota."

13.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ  ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ  مِنْ قَوْمِهِ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَا قَطْعَ فِي ثَمَرٍ وَلَا كَثَرٍ "
13.en: Narrated by al-Husayn ibn Mansur, from Abu Usamah, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban, from a man of his people, from Rafi' ibn Khadij, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "There is no [hand] cutting for [stealing] fruit nor palm-shoots."
13.hi: Al-Husayn ibn Mansur ne Abu Usamah se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban se, apni qaum ke ek aadmi se, Rafi' ibn Khadij se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Phal aur khajoor ke jhaad mein [haath] kaatna nahi hota."

13.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ  ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ وَاسِعِ بْنِ حَبَّانَ  ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا قَطْعَ فِي ثَمَرٍ وَلَا كَثَرٍ ".
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ  ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَحْوَهُ
13.en: Narrated by Ishaq, from Waki', from Sufyan, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban, from his uncle Wasi' ibn Habban, from Rafi' ibn Khadij; a similar chain also via Abu Nu'aym: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There is no [hand] cutting for [stealing] fruit nor palm-shoots." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban, from Rafi' ibn Khadij, from the Prophet ﷺ.]
13.hi: Ishaq ne Waki' se, Sufyan se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban se, apne chacha Wasi' ibn Habban se, Rafi' ibn Khadij se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Phal aur khajoor ke jhaad mein [haath] kaatna nahi hota." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Abu Nu'aym se, Sufyan se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban se, Rafi' ibn Khadij se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai.]

13.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ  ، وَالثَّقَفِيُّ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ  ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" لَا قَطْعَ فِي ثَمَرٍ وَلَا كَثَرٍ ".
قَالَ : وَهُوَ شَحْمُ النَّخْلِ.
وَالْكَثَرُ : الْجُمَّارُ
13.en: Narrated by Ishaq, from Jarir, and al-Thaqafi, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban, from Rafi' ibn Khadij; with clarification: He said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: "There is no [hand] cutting for [stealing] fruit nor kathar." He said: And it [fruit here] is the pulp/inner core of the date-palm. And al-kathar is: the palm heart/spadix.
13.hi: Ishaq ne Jarir aur al-Thaqafi se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se bataya: Mujhe Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban ne bataya, Rafi' ibn Khadij se: Unhone kaha, Maine Nabi ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Phal aur kathar mein [haath] kaatna nahi hota." Unhone bataya: Aur yeh khajoor ke darakht ka geeda hai. Aur al-kathar: khajoor ki gudi (jummar).

13.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَيْمُونٍ  ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" لَا قَطْعَ فِي كَثَرٍ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : الْقَوْلُ مَا قَالَ أَبُو أُسَامَةَ
13.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Mansur, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban, from Abu Maymun, from Rafi' ibn Khadij; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: "There is no [hand] cutting for kathar." Abu Muhammad said: The correct saying is what Abu Usamah said.
13.hi: Sa'id ibn Mansur ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban se, Abu Maymun se, Rafi' ibn Khadij se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Nabi ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Kathar mein [haath] kaatna nahi hota." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Sahih baat woh hai jo Abu Usamah ne kahi.

13.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، قَالَ : أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ  ، قَالَ جَابِرٌ   : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَيْسَ عَلَى الْمُنْتَهِبِ، وَلَا عَلَى الْمُخْتَلِسِ، وَلَا عَلَى الْخَائِنِ قَطْعٌ "
13.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There is no [hand] cutting upon the plunderer, nor upon the snatcher, nor upon the betrayer."
13.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se bataya: Unhein Abu al-Zubayr ne bataya, Jabir ne kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Loot lene wale par, na chheenne wale par, na khiyanat karne wale par [haath] kaatna hai."

13.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، " أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَأُتِيَ بِرَجُلٍ قَدْ شَرِبَ خَمْرًا فَضَرَبَهُ بِجَرِيدَتَيْنِ "، ثُمَّ فَعَلَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ عُمَرُ : اسْتَشَارَ النَّاسَ، فَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ : أَخَفُّ الْحُدُودِ : ثَمَانِينَ، قَالَ : فَفَعَلَ
13.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from Anas: That the Prophet ﷺ "was brought a man who had drunk wine, so he struck him with two palm branches," then Abu Bakr did the like of that, then when it was Umar's time, he consulted the people, so Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf said: the lightest of the [prescribed] punishments: eighty, he said: So he did it.
13.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se, Qatadah se, Anas se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ke paas "ek aadmi laaya gaya jisne sharaab pi thi, to aapne usay do khajoor ki daaliyon se maara," fir Abu Bakr ne isi tarah kiya, fir jab Umar ka daur aaya, unhone logon se mashwara kiya, to Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf ne kaha: hudood mein sabse halki: assi, unhone bataya: To unhone aisa kiya.

13.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُخْتَارِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ الدَّانَاجُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حُضَيْنُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ  ، قَالَ : شَهِدْتُ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ وَأُتِيَ بِالْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ   :" جَلَدَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَرْبَعِينَ، وَجَلَدَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَرْبَعِينَ، وَعُمَرُ ثَمَانِينَ، وَكُلٌّ سُنَّةٌ "
13.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Abd al-Aziz ibn al-Mukhtar, from Abdullah al-Danaj, from Hudayn ibn al-Mundhir al-Raqashi, about Uthman ibn Affan and al-Walid ibn Uqbah: He said: I witnessed Uthman ibn Affan when al-Walid ibn Uqbah was brought, so Ali said: "The Prophet ﷺ lashed forty, and Abu Bakr lashed forty, and Umar eighty, and all are sunnah."
13.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Abd al-Aziz ibn al-Mukhtar se bataya: Humein Abdullah al-Danaj ne bataya: Humein Hudayn ibn al-Mundhir al-Raqashi ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Uthman ibn Affan ke paas maujood tha jab al-Walid ibn Uqbah laaye gaye, to Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: "Nabi ﷺ ne chaalis kode maare, aur Abu Bakr ne chaalis, aur Umar ne assi, aur sab sunnat hain."

13.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ هُوَ ابْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ الثَّقَفِيُّ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الشَّرِيدِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" إِذَا شَرِبَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَاضْرِبُوهُ، ثُمَّ إِنْ عَادَ، فَاضْرِبُوهُ، ثُمَّ إِنْ عَادَ، فَاضْرِبُوهُ، ثُمَّ إِنْ عَادَ الرَّابِعَةَ فَاقْتُلُوهُ "
13.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Abdullah ibn Utbah ibn Urwah ibn Mas'ud al-Thaqafi, from Amr ibn al-Sharid, from his father: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "When one of you drinks, beat him, then if he returns [to it], beat him, then if he returns, beat him, then if he returns a fourth time, kill him."
13.hi: Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Muhammad ibn Ishaq se bataya: Humein Abdullah ibn Utbah ibn Urwah ibn Mas'ud al-Thaqafi ne bataya, Amr ibn al-Sharid se, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Jab tum mein se koi [sharaab] piye, use maaro, fir agar woh dobara kare, to use maaro, fir agar woh dobara kare, to use maaro, fir agar woh chauthi baar kare, to use qatal karo."

13.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ هُوَ ابْنُ جَابِرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ بْنِ نِيَارٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" لَا يَحِلُّ لِأَحَدٍ أَنْ يَضْرِبَ أَحَدًا فَوْقَ عَشْرَةِ أَصْوَاتٍ إِلَّا فِي حَدٍّ مِنْ حُدُودِ اللَّهِ "
13.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Bukayr ibn Abdullah ibn al-Ashajj, from Sulayman ibn Yasar, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Jabir, from Abu Burdah ibn Niyar: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "It is not lawful for anyone to strike anyone beyond ten lashes except in a punishment from among the punishments prescribed by Allah."
13.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid ne Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub se, Yazid ibn Abi Habib se, Bukayr ibn Abdullah ibn al-Ashajj se, Sulayman ibn Yasar se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Jabir se, Abu Burdah ibn Niyar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Kisi ke liye kisi ko das kode se zyada maarna halal nahi, siwaay Allah ki hudood mein se kisi hadd ke."

13.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ   : أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَسْلَمَ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَحَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ زَنَى فَشَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ أَنَّهُ زَنَى أَرْبَعًا،فَأَمَرَ بِرَجْمِهِ وَكَانَ قَدْ أُحْصِنَ "
13.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Salamah, from Jabir: That a man from Aslam came to the Prophet ﷺ, and told him that he had committed adultery, and he testified against himself four times that he had committed adultery, "so he commanded that he be stoned, and he had been married."
13.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se bataya: Mujhe Ibn Shihab ne bataya, Abu Salamah se, Jabir se: ke Aslam qabeele ka ek aadmi Nabi ﷺ ke paas aaya aur usne unhein bataya ke usne zina kiya hai aur usne apne khilaaf chaar martaba gawahi di ke usne zina kiya, "to aapne usay rajm (patharon se maarne) ka hukum diya, aur woh shaadi-shuda tha."

13.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ سَمُرَةَ   يَقُولُ : أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِمَاعِزِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَجُلٍ قَصِيرٍ فِي إِزَارٍ مَا عَلَيْهِ رِدَاءٌ، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مُتَّكِئٌ عَلَى وِسَادَةٍ عَلَى يَسَارِهِ فَكَلَّمَهُ، فَمَا أَدْرِي مَا يُكَلِّمُهُ بِهِ، وَأَنَا بَعِيدٌ مِنْهُ، بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ الْقَوْمُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ :" اذْهَبُوا بِهِ فَارْجُمُوهُ "، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " رُدُّوهُ "، فَكَلَّمَهُ أَيْضًا وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ الْقَوْمُ، فَقَالَ : " اذْهَبُوا بِهِ فَارْجُمُوهُ "، ثُمَّ قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَخَطَبَ وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " كُلَّمَا نَفَرْنَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، خَلَفَ أَحَدُهُمْ لَهُ نَبِيبٌ كَنَبِيبِ التَّيْسِ يَمْنَحُ إِحْدَاهُنَّ الْكُثْبَةَ مِنَ اللَّبَنِ؟ وَاللَّهِ لَا أَقْدِرُ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ، إِلَّا نَكَّلْتُ بِهِ "
13.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Isra'il, from Simak, about Jabir ibn Samurah: That he heard Jabir ibn Samurah say: The Prophet ﷺ was brought Ma'iz ibn Malik, a short man wearing an izar with no cloak, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was leaning on a cushion on his left, so he spoke to him, but I do not know what he said to him, and I was far from him, the people between me and him, then he said: "Take him away and stone him," then he said: "Bring him back," so he spoke to him again while I could hear, except that the people were between me and him, so he said: "Take him away and stone him." Then the Prophet ﷺ stood and gave a sermon and I heard it, then he said: "Whenever we go out in the path of Allah, one of them stays behind, with a bleating like the bleating of a billy-goat, granting one of the [women] a scoop of milk? By Allah, I will not have power over any of them, except that I will make an example of him."
13.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Isra'il se, Simak se bataya: Unhone Jabir ibn Samurah ko yeh kehte suna: Nabi ﷺ ke paas Ma'iz ibn Malik laaye gaye, ek chhota qad wala aadmi jo sirf izaar mein tha, koi chaadar nahi thi, aur Rasulullah ﷺ apni baaye taraf ek takiye par tik'e hue the, to aapne usse baat ki, lekin mujhe nahi maloom aapne usse kya kaha, aur main aapse door tha, mere aur aapke darmiyan log the, fir aapne farmaya: "Isay le jao aur rajm karo," fir farmaya: "Isay wapas lao," to aapne usse phir baat ki jabke main sun raha tha, siwaay iske ke mere aur aapke darmiyan log the, to aapne farmaya: "Isay le jao aur rajm karo." Fir Nabi ﷺ khade hue aur khutba diya aur main use sun raha tha, fir aapne farmaya: "Jab bhi hum Allah ki raah mein nikalte hain, unmein se koi peechhe reh jaata hai, uski aawaaz bakre ki maimyaahat jaisi hoti hai, in [auraton] mein se kisi ko doodh ka pyaala dete hue? Allah ki qasam, jab bhi mujhe unmein se kisi par qaboo milega, main usay ibrat-naak saza dunga."

13.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ  ، وَشِبْلٍ   ، قَالُوا : جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : أَنْشُدُكَ اللَّهَ إِلَّا قَضَيْتَ بَيْنَنَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ خَصْمُهُ وَكَانَ أَفْقَهَ مِنْهُ : صَدَقَ، اقْضِ بَيْنَنَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ، وَأْذَنْ لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنْ أَتَكَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " قُلْ "، فَقَالَ : إِنَّ ابْنِي كَانَ عَسِيفًا عَلَى أَهْلِ هَذَا، فَزَنَى بِامْرَأَتِهِ، فَافْتَدَيْتُ مِنْهُ بِمِائَةِ شَاةٍ وَخَادِمٍ، وَإِنِّي سَأَلْتُ رِجَالًا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ، فَأَخْبَرُونِي أَنَّ عَلَى ابْنِي جَلْدَ مِائَةٍ وَتَغْرِيبَ عَامٍ، وَأَنَّ عَلَى امْرَأَةِ هَذَا الرَّجْمَ، فَقَالَ : " وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ،لَأَقْضِيَنَّ بَيْنَكُمَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ : الْمِائَةُ شَاةٍ وَالْخَادِمُ رَدٌّ عَلَيْكَ، وَعَلَى ابْنِكَ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ وَتَغْرِيبُ عَامٍ، وَيَا أُنَيْسُ اغْدُ عَلَى امْرَأَةِ هَذَا فَسَلْهَا، فَإِنْ اعْتَرَفَتْ، فَارْجُمْهَا "، فَاعْتَرَفَتْ، فَرَجَمَهَا
13.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from al-Zuhri, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah, from Abu Hurairah, and Zayd ibn Khalid, and Shibl: They said: A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and said: "I ask you by Allah, only judge between us by the Book of Allah," so his opponent, who was more learned than him, said: "He speaks truly, judge between us by the Book of Allah, and permit me, O Messenger of Allah, to speak." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Speak." So he said: My son was a hired laborer with this one's family, and he committed adultery with his wife, so I ransomed [my son] from him with a hundred sheep and a servant, and I asked men of knowledge, and they informed me that my son owes a hundred lashes and a year's exile, and that this man's wife owes stoning, so he said: "By the One in whose hand is my soul, I will indeed judge between the two of you by the Book of Allah: the hundred sheep and the servant are to be returned to you, and upon your son is a hundred lashes and a year's exile, and O Unays, go early to this man's wife and question her, and if she confesses, then stone her," so she confessed, and he stoned her.
13.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se, al-Zuhri se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah se, Abu Hurairah se, aur Zayd ibn Khalid se, aur Shibl se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Main aapko Allah ki qasam deta hoon ke aap humare darmiyan Allah ki Kitaab se faisla karein," to uske muqaabil, jo usse zyada aqal-mand tha, ne kaha: "Usne sach kaha, humare darmiyan Allah ki Kitaab se faisla kijiye, aur mujhe ijaazat dijiye, Ya Rasulullah, ke main baat karun." To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Kaho." To usne kaha: Mera beta is aadmi ke gharwalon ke paas mazdoor tha, aur usne uski biwi ke saath zina kar liya, to maine sau bhedon aur ek naukar ke badle uske saath sulah kar li, aur maine ilm rakhne wale logon se poocha, to unhone mujhe bataaya ke mere bete par sau kode aur ek saal ki jila-watani hai, aur is aadmi ki biwi par rajm hai, to aapne farmaya: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main tum dono ke darmiyan Allah ki Kitaab se hi faisla karunga: sau bhedein aur naukar tumhein wapas kar diye jaayenge, aur tumhare bete par sau kode aur ek saal ki jila-watani hai, aur ae Unays, is aadmi ki biwi ke paas jaakar usse poocho, aur agar woh iqraar kare, to usay rajm kar dena," to usne iqraar kiya, to unhone usay rajm kiya.

13.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاق بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْهَيْثَمِ بْنِ نَصْرِ بْنِ دَهْرٍ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ فِيمَنْ رَجَمَهُ، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : يَعْنِي مَاعِزَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، فلَمَّا وَجَدَ مَسَّ الْحِجَارَةِ، جَزِعَ جَزَعًا شَدِيدًا، قَالَ : فَذَكَرْنَا ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" فَهَلَّا تَرَكْتُمُوهُ؟ "
13.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn Yasar, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim al-Taymi, from Abu al-Haytham ibn Nasr ibn Dahr al-Aslami, from his father; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: I was among those who stoned him, Abu Muhammad said: meaning Ma'iz ibn Malik, so when he felt the touch of the stones, he panicked severely, he said: So we mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said: "Then why did you not leave him [let him go]?"
13.hi: Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn Yasar se, Muhammad ibn Ibrahim al-Taymi se, Abu al-Haytham ibn Nasr ibn Dahr al-Aslami se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main un logon mein tha jinhone usay rajm kiya, Abu Muhammad kehte hain: yaani Ma'iz ibn Malik, to jab usne patharon ka lagna mehsoos kiya, to woh bahut ghabraaya, unhone bataya: To humne yeh baat Rasulullah ﷺ se zikr ki, aapne farmaya: "To tumne usay [jaane] kyun nahi diya?"

13.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ  ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" انْطَلِقُوا بِمَاعِزِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، فَارْجُمُوهُ ".
فَانْطَلَقْنَا بِهِ إِلَى بَقِيعِ الْغَرْقَدِ ، فَوَاللَّهِ مَا أَوْثَقْنَاهُ وَلَا حَفَرْنَا لَهُ، وَلَكِنْ قَامَ فَرَمَيْنَاهُ بِالْعِظَامِ وَالْخَزَفِ وَالْجَنْدَلِ
13.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yahya ibn Abi Za'idah, from Da'ud, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Take Ma'iz ibn Malik away and stone him." So we took him to Baqi' al-Gharqad, and by Allah, we did not tie him nor dig [a pit] for him, but he stood and we threw at him with bones and pottery and stones.
13.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Yahya ibn Abi Za'idah se, Da'ud se, Abu Nadrah se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Ma'iz ibn Malik ko le jao aur usay rajm karo." To hum usay Baqi' al-Gharqad le gaye, aur Allah ki qasam, na humne usay baandha na uske liye gaddha khoda, balke woh khada raha aur humne usper haddiyon, mitti ke bartanon aur pathron se maara.

13.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا بَشِيرُ بْنُ الْمُهَاجِرِ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ جَالِسًا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَجَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ مَاعِزُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، فَاعْتَرَفَ عِنْدَهُ بِالزِّنَا، فَرَدَّهُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ الرَّابِعَةَ فَاعْتَرَفَ،" فَأَمَرَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَحُفِرَ لَهُ حُفْرَةٌ فَجُعِلَ فِيهَا إِلَى صَدْرِهِ، وَأَمَرَ النَّاسَ أَنْ يَرْجُمُوهُ "
13.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Bashir ibn al-Muhajir, from Abdullah ibn Buraydah, from his father: He said: I was sitting with the Prophet ﷺ when a man called Ma'iz ibn Malik came to him, and confessed adultery before him, so he turned him away three times, then he came the fourth time and confessed, "so the Prophet ﷺ commanded regarding him, and a pit was dug for him and he was placed in it up to his chest, and he commanded the people to stone him."
13.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Bashir ibn al-Muhajir se bataya: Mujhse Abdullah ibn Buraydah ne bataya, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, Main Nabi ﷺ ke paas baitha tha ke ek aadmi jise Ma'iz ibn Malik kaha jaata tha aapke paas aaya, aur aapke saamne zina ka iqraar kiya, to aapne usay teen martaba mudakar phera, fir woh chauthi baar aaya aur iqraar kiya, "to Nabi ﷺ ne uske baare mein hukum diya, aur uske liye ek gaddha khoda gaya aur usay chhaati tak usmein rakha gaya, aur logon ko usay rajm karne ka hukum diya."

13.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   : أَنَّ الْيَهُودَ جَاءُوا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِرَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ وَامْرَأَةٍ قَدْ زَنَيَا، فَقَالَ :" كَيْفَ تَفْعَلُونَ بِمَنْ زَنَى مِنْكُمْ؟ ".
قَالُوا : لَا نَجِدُ فِيهَا شَيْئًا، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلَامٍ : كَذَبْتُمْ، فِي التَّوْرَاةِ الرَّجْمُ، فَأْتُوا بِالتَّوْرَاةِ فَاتْلُوهَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ فَجَاءُوا بِالتَّوْرَاةِ، فَوَضَعَ مِدْرَاسُهَا الَّذِي يَدْرُسُهَا مِنْهُمْ كَفَّهُ عَلَى آيَةِ الرَّجْمِ، فَقَالَ : مَا هَذِهِ؟ فَلَمَّا رَأَوْا ذَلِكَ قَالُوا : هِيَ آيَةُ الرَّجْمِ، " فَأَمَرَ بِهِمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " فَرُجِمَا قَرِيبًا مِنْ حَيْثُ تُوضَعُ الْجَنَائِزُ عِنْدَ الْمَسْجِدِ.
 قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ : فَرَأَيْتُ صَاحِبَهَا يُخْبِئُ عَلَيْهَا : يَقِيهَا الْحِجَارَةَ
13.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Zuhayr, from Musa ibn Uqbah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That the Jews came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a man from among them and a woman who had committed adultery, so he said: "What do you do with whoever among you commits adultery?" They said: "We find nothing about it," so Abdullah ibn Salam said to them: "You have lied, in the Torah is stoning, bring the Torah and recite it if you are truthful," so they brought the Torah, and the one who taught it among them placed his palm over the verse of stoning, and read what was before and after it, so [Ibn Salam] said: "What is this?" So when they saw that, they said: "It is the verse of stoning," "so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded regarding the two of them," and they were stoned near where the biers are placed by the mosque. Abdullah said: So I saw her companion shielding her, protecting her from the stones.
13.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Zuhayr se, Musa ibn Uqbah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Yahoodi Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas apne mein se ek aadmi aur ek aurat ko laaye jinhone zina kiya tha, to aapne poocha: "Tum apne mein se jo zina kare uske saath kya karte ho?" Unhone kaha: "Humein isme kuch nahi milta," to Abdullah ibn Salam ne unse kaha: "Tum jhoot kehte ho, Taurat mein rajm hai, Taurat laao aur agar tum sachche ho to isay padho," to woh Taurat laaye, to unmein se jo isay padhaata tha usne apni hatheli rajm ki aayat par rakh di, aur uske aage-peechhe padh diya, to [Ibn Salam] ne poocha: "Yeh kya hai?" To jab unhone yeh dekha, unhone kaha: "Yeh rajm ki aayat hai," "to Rasulullah ﷺ ne dono ke baare mein hukum diya," aur unhein masjid ke paas jahan janaaze rakhe jaate hain waheen rajm kiya gaya. Abdullah kehte hain: To maine uska saathi dekha ke woh usay chhupaate hue patharon se bacha raha tha.

13.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عُمَرُ   :" إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى، بَعَثَ مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالْحَقِّ، وَأَنْزَلَ عَلَيْهِ الْكِتَابَ، وَكَانَ فِيمَا أَنْزَلَ آيَةُ الرَّجْمِ، فَقَرَأْنَاهَا وَوَعَيْنَاهَا وَعَقَلْنَاهَا، وَرَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَرَجَمْنَا بَعْدَهُ، فَأَخْشَى إِنْ طَالَ بِالنَّاسِ زَمَانٌ أَنْ يَقُولَ الْقَائِلُ : لَا نَجِدُ حَدَّ آيَةِ الرَّجْمِ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ، وَالرَّجْمُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ عَلَى مَنْ زَنَى مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ إِذَا أُحْصِنَّ، إِذَا قَامَتْ عَلَيْهِ الْبَيِّنَةُ، أَوْ كَانَ الْحَبَلُ أَوِ الِاعْتِرَافُ "
13.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from al-Zuhri, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah, from Ibn Abbas, about Umar: He said: Umar said: "Indeed Allah the Exalted sent Muhammad ﷺ with the truth, and revealed to him the Book, and among what He revealed was the verse of stoning, so we read it, and understood it, and comprehended it, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stoned and we stoned after him, so I fear that if time grows long with the people, someone will say: 'We do not find the penalty of the stoning verse in the Book of Allah,' and stoning in the Book of Allah is true upon whoever commits adultery among men and women when they have been previously married, if evidence is established against him, or there is pregnancy or confession."
