13.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, al-Zuhri se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Umar ne kaha: "Allah Ta'ala ne Muhammad ﷺ ko haq ke saath bheja, aur unpar Kitaab naazil ki, aur jo naazil kiya usmein rajm ki aayat thi, so humne isay padha aur samjha aur yaad kiya, aur Rasulullah ﷺ ne rajm kiya aur humne aapke baad rajm kiya, so mujhe dar hai ke agar logon par lambi muddat guzar jaaye, to koi kehne wala kahe: 'Humein Allah ki Kitaab mein rajm ki aayat ki saza nahi milti,' aur Allah ki Kitaab mein rajm haq hai us par jo mard ya aurat zina kare jabke woh shaadi-shuda ho, agar uske khilaaf gawahi qaayam ho jaaye, ya hamal ho ya iqraar ho."

13.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الرِّفَاعِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْعَقَدِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  يُحَدِّثُ : عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ الصَّلْتِ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ  ، قَالَ : أَشْهَدُ لَسَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" الشَّيْخُ وَالشَّيْخَةُ إِذَا زَنَيَا، فَارْجُمُوهُمَا الْبَتَّةَ "
13.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Rifa'i, from al-Aqadi, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from Yunus ibn Jubayr, from Kathir ibn al-Salt, from Zayd ibn Thabit: He said: I testify that I indeed heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "The old man and the old woman, if they commit adultery, stone them absolutely."
13.hi: Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Rifa'i ne al-Aqadi se, Shu'bah se, Qatadah se bataya: Unhein Yunus ibn Jubayr ne bataya, Kathir ibn al-Salt se, Zayd ibn Thabit se: Unhone kaha, Main gawahi deta hoon ke maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Budha aur budhi, agar woh zina karein, to unhein qat'i rajm karo."

13.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا بَشِيرُ بْنُ الْمُهَاجِرِ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ جَالِسًا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَجَاءَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ بَنِي غَامِدٍ، فَقَالَتْ : يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ إِنِّي قَدْ زَنَيْتُ، وَإِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ تُطَهِّرَنِي، فَقَالَ لَهَا : " ارْجِعِي ".
فَلَمَّا كَانَ مِنْ الْغَدِ، أَتَتْهُ أَيْضًا، فَاعْتَرَفَتْ عِنْدَهُ بِالزِّنَاء، فَقَالَتْ : يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ، طَهِّرْنِي، فَلَعَلَّكَ أَنْ تَرْدُدَنِي كَمَا رَدَدْتَ مَاعِزَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، فَوَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لَحُبْلَى، فَقَالَ لَهَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " ارْجِعِي، حَتَّى تَلِدِي ".
فَلَمَّا وَلَدَتْ، جَاءَتْ بِالصَّبِيِّ تَحْمِلُهُ فِي خِرْقَةٍ، فَقَالَتْ : يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ هَذَا قَدْ وَلَدْتُ، قَالَ : " فَاذْهَبِي فَأَرْضِعِيهِ، ثُمَّ افْطُمِيهِ ".
فَلَمَّا فَطَمَتْهُ، جَاءَتْهُ بِالصَّبِيِّ فِي يَدِهِ كِسْرَةُ خُبْزٍ، فَقَالَتْ : يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ، قَدْ فَطَمْتُهُ، فَأَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالصَّبِيِّ فَدُفِعَ إِلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَأَمَرَ بِهَا فَحُفِرَ لَهَا حُفْرَةٌ، فَجُعِلَتْ فِيهَا إِلَى صَدْرِهَا، ثُمَّ أَمَرَ النَّاسَ أَنْ يَرْجُمُوهَا، فَأَقْبَلَ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ بِحَجَرٍ فَرَمَى رَأْسَهَا، فَتَلَطَّخَ الدَّمُ عَلَى وَجْنَةِ خَالِدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ، فَسَبَّهَا، فَسَمِعَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سَبَّهُ إِيَّاهَا، فَقَالَ : " مَهْ يَا خَالِدُ،لَا تَسُبَّهَا، فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، لَقَدْ تَابَتْ تَوْبَةً، لَوْ تَابَهَا صَاحِبُ مَكْسٍ، لَغُفِرَ لَهُ ".
فَأَمَرَ بِهَا فَصُلِّيَ عَلَيْهَا، وَدُفِنَتْ
13.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Bashir ibn al-Muhajir, from Abdullah ibn Buraydah, from his father: He said: I was sitting with the Prophet ﷺ when a woman from Banu Ghamid came to him, and said: "O Prophet of Allah, I have indeed committed adultery, and I want you to purify me." He said to her: "Go back." So when it was the next day, she came to him again, and confessed adultery before him, and said: "O Prophet of Allah, purify me, perhaps you will turn me away as you turned away Ma'iz ibn Malik, but by Allah, I am indeed pregnant." So the Prophet ﷺ said to her: "Go back, until you give birth." So when she gave birth, she came with the child carrying him in a rag, and said: "O Prophet of Allah, here, I have given birth." He said: "Then go and nurse him, then wean him." So when she weaned him, she came to him with the child, a piece of bread in his hand, and said: "O Prophet of Allah, I have weaned him," so the Prophet ﷺ commanded regarding the child and he was handed to a man from the Muslims, and commanded regarding her and a pit was dug for her, and she was placed in it up to her chest, then he commanded the people to stone her, so Khalid ibn al-Walid came forward with a stone and threw it at her head, so the blood splattered on the cheek of Khalid ibn al-Walid, so he cursed her, so the Prophet ﷺ heard his cursing of her, and said: "Gently, O Khalid, do not curse her, for by the One in whose hand is my soul, she has indeed repented a repentance which, if a tax-collector repented it, he would be forgiven." Then he commanded regarding her and the funeral prayer was performed over her, and she was buried.
13.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Bashir ibn al-Muhajir se bataya: Mujhse Abdullah ibn Buraydah ne bataya, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, Main Nabi ﷺ ke paas baitha tha ke Banu Ghamid ki ek aurat aapke paas aayi, aur kaha: "Ya Nabi Allah, maine zina kiya hai, aur main chahti hoon ke aap mujhe paak kar dein." Aapne usse farmaya: "Wapas jao." So jab agla din hua, woh phir aapke paas aayi, aur aapke saamne zina ka iqraar kiya, aur kaha: "Ya Nabi Allah, mujhe paak kar dein, shayad aap mujhe waapas kar dein jaise aapne Ma'iz ibn Malik ko waapas kiya, lekin Allah ki qasam, main haamila hoon." To Nabi ﷺ ne usse farmaya: "Wapas jao, yahan tak ke tum bachche ko janam do." So jab usne bachcha janam diya, woh bachche ko ek chithde mein utha kar laayi, aur kaha: "Ya Nabi Allah, yeh raha, maine isay janam diya hai." Aapne farmaya: "To jao aur usay doodh pilaao, fir usay doodh chhudaao." So jab usne doodh chhudaaya, woh bachche ko lekar aapke paas aayi, uske haath mein roti ka tukda tha, aur kaha: "Ya Nabi Allah, maine iska doodh chhudaa diya hai," to Nabi ﷺ ne bachche ke baare mein hukum diya aur usay Musalmanon mein se ek aadmi ke supurd kar diya gaya, aur uske baare mein hukum diya aur uske liye ek gaddha khoda gaya, aur usay chhaati tak usmein rakha gaya, fir aapne logon ko usay rajm karne ka hukum diya, to Khalid ibn al-Walid ek pathar lekar aage aaye aur uske sar par phenka, to khoon Khalid ibn al-Walid ke gaal par chhink gaya, to unhone usay bura-bhala kaha, to Nabi ﷺ ne unka usay bura-bhala kehna suna, to farmaya: "Aahista, Ae Khalid, usay bura-bhala mat kaho, kyunki us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, usne aisi tauba ki hai ke agar koi mehsool wasool karne wala bhi aisi tauba kare, to usay bakhsh diya jaaye." Fir aapne uske baare mein hukum diya to uski namaz-e-janaza padhi gayi, aur usay dafna diya gaya.

13.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ  ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ   : أَنَّ امْرَأَةً مِنْ جُهَيْنَةَ أَتَت ِالنَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهِيَ حُبْلَى مِنَ الزِّنَاءِ، فَقَالَتْ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي أَصَبْتُ حَدًّا فَأَقِمْهُ عَلَيَّ، فَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَلِيَّهَا، فَقَالَ : " اذْهَبْ فَأَحْسِنْ إِلَيْهَا، فَإِذَا وَضَعَتْ حَمْلَهَا، فَأْتِنِي بِهَا ".
فَفَعَلَ، فَأَمَرَ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَشُكَّتْ عَلَيْهَا ثِيَابُهَا ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهَا فَرُجِمَتْ ثُمَّ صَلَّى عَلَيْهَا، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتُصَلِّي عَلَيْهَا وَقَدْ زَنَتْ؟، فَقَالَ :" لَقَدْ تَابَتْ تَوْبَةً لَوْ قُسِمَتْ بَيْنَ سَبْعِينَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ لَوَسِعَتْهُمْ، وَهَلْ وَجَدْتَ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ أَنْ جَادَتْ بِنَفْسِهَا لِلَّهِ G "
13.en: Narrated by Wahb ibn Jarir, from Hisham, from Yahya, from Abu Qilabah, from Abu al-Muhallab, from Imran ibn Husayn: That a woman from Juhaynah came to the Prophet ﷺ while she was pregnant from adultery, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have committed [something deserving] a punishment, so establish it upon me." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ called her guardian, and said: "Go and treat her well, and when she has delivered her child, bring her to me." So he did, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded regarding her and her clothes were tied [pinned] around her, then he commanded regarding her and she was stoned, then he prayed over her, so Umar said: "O Messenger of Allah, will you pray over her when she has committed adultery?" So he said: "She has indeed repented a repentance which, if divided among seventy of the people of Madinah, would suffice them, and have you found anything better than that she gave generously of her own self for Allah, mighty and majestic is He?"
13.hi: Wahb ibn Jarir ne Hisham se, Yahya se, Abu Qilabah se, Abu al-Muhallab se, Imran ibn Husayn se bataya ke Juhaynah ki ek aurat Nabi ﷺ ke paas aayi jabke woh zina se haamila thi, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, maine ek hadd ka gunah kiya hai, so isay mujhpar qaayam kijiye." To Rasulullah ﷺ ne uske waali ko bulaaya, aur farmaya: "Jao aur uske saath achha sulook karo, aur jab woh apna hamal janam de, to usay mere paas laao." So usne aisa kiya, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne uske baare mein hukum diya aur uske kapde uspar baandh diye gaye, fir uske baare mein hukum diya aur usay rajm kiya gaya, fir aapne uski namaz padhi, to Umar ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, aap uski namaz padhenge jabke usne zina kiya hai?" To aapne farmaya: "Usne aisi tauba ki hai ke agar Madinah ke sattar logon mein taqseem ki jaaye, to woh unhein kaafi ho jaaye, aur kya tumne isse behtar koi cheez paayi hai ke usne Allah, Azza wa Jall, ke liye apni jaan khushi se de di?"

13.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ   وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   : أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سُئِلَ عَنِ الْأَمَةِ تَزْنِي وَلَمْ تُحْصَنْ، فَقَالَ :" إِنْ زَنَتْ، فَاجْلِدُوهَا، ثُمَّ إِنْ زَنَتْ فَاجْلِدُوهَا ".
قَالَ : فَمَا أَدْرِي فِي الثَّالِثَةِ أَوْ فِي الرَّابِعَةِ " فَبِيعُوهَا وَلَوْ بِضَفِيرٍ "
13.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah, from Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani and Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet ﷺ was asked about a slave-girl who commits adultery but is not previously married, so he said: "If she commits adultery, flog her, then if she commits adultery again, flog her." He said: So I do not know if it was the third or fourth time: "then sell her, even if for a braided rope."
13.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Ibn Shihab se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah se, Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani aur Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ se us laundi ke baare mein poocha gaya jo zina kare aur shaadi-shuda na ho, to aapne farmaya: "Agar woh zina kare, to usay kode maaro, fir agar woh dobara zina kare, to usay kode maaro." Unhone bataya: To mujhe nahi maloom teesri baar tha ya chauthi baar: "to usay bech do, chahe ek rasse ke badle hi ho."

13.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ حِطَّانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ،  عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" خُذُوا عَنِّي خُذُوا عَنِّي.
قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُنَّ سَبِيلًا : الْبِكْرُ بِالْبِكْرِ، وَالثَّيِّبُ بِالثَّيِّبِ : الْبِكْرُ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ وَنَفْيُ سَنَةٍ، وَالثَّيِّبُ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ وَالرَّجْمُ "، أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ حِطَّانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِنَحْوِهِ
13.en: Narrated by Bishr ibn Umar al-Zahrani, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Qatadah, from al-Hasan, from Hittan ibn Abdullah, from Ubadah ibn al-Samit; a similar chain also via Amr ibn Awn: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Take from me, take from me. Allah has indeed made a way for them: the unmarried with the unmarried, and the previously-married with the previously-married: the unmarried is a hundred lashes and a year's exile, and the previously-married is a hundred lashes and stoning." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Amr ibn Awn, from Hushaym, from Mansur, from al-Hasan, from Hittan ibn Abdullah, from Ubadah ibn al-Samit, from the Prophet ﷺ.]
13.hi: Bishr ibn Umar al-Zahrani ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Qatadah se, al-Hasan se, Hittan ibn Abdullah se, Ubadah ibn al-Samit se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Mujhse le lo, mujhse le lo. Allah ne unke liye ek raasta banaya hai: kuwara kuwari ke saath, aur shaadi-shuda shaadi-shuda ke saath: kuware ke liye sau kode aur ek saal ki jila-watani, aur shaadi-shuda ke liye sau kode aur rajm." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Amr ibn Awn se, Hushaym se, Mansur se, al-Hasan se, Hittan ibn Abdullah se, Ubadah ibn al-Samit se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai.]

13.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، قَالَ : كَتَبَ إِلَيَّ خَالِدُ بْنُ عُرْفُطَةَ  عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ  : أَنَّ غُلَامًا كَانَ يُنْبَزُ قُرْقُورًا، فَوَقَعَ عَلَى جَارِيَةِ امْرَأَتِهِ، فَرُفِعَ إِلَى النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ  ، فَقَالَ : لَأَقْضِيَنَّ فِيهِ بِقَضَاءٍ شَافٍ :" إِنْ كَانَتْ أَحَلَّتْهَا لَهُ جَلَدْتُهُ مِائَةً، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ لَمْ تُحِلَّهَا لَهُ، رَجَمْتُهُ "، فَقِيلَ لَهَا : زَوْجُكِ !، فَقَالَتْ : إِنِّي قَدْ أَحْلَلْتُهَا لَهُ.
فَضَرَبَهُ مِائَةً.
 قَالَ يَحْيَى : هُوَ مَرْفُوعٌ.
حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عُرْفُطَةَ  ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَحْوَهُ
13.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hammad, from Aban ibn Yazid, from Qatadah, from Khalid ibn Urfutah, from Habib ibn Salim, about al-Nu'man ibn Bashir; with Yahya's note; a similar chain also via Sadaqah ibn al-Fadl: That a young man nicknamed Qurqur had relations with his wife's slave-girl, so it was raised to al-Nu'man ibn Bashir, and he said: I will indeed give a decisive judgment in it: "If she had made her lawful to him, I would flog him a hundred [times], and if she had not made her lawful to him, I would stone him," so it was said to her: "Your husband!" so she said: "I had indeed made her lawful to him." So he lashed him a hundred [times]. Yahya said: It is marfu' [attributed to the Prophet]. [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Sadaqah ibn al-Fadl, from Muhammad ibn Ja'far, from Shu'bah, from Abu Bishr, from Khalid ibn Urfutah, from Habib ibn Salim, from al-Nu'man ibn Bashir, from the Prophet ﷺ.]
13.hi: Yahya ibn Hammad ne Aban ibn Yazid se, Qatadah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Khalid ibn Urfutah ne likha, Habib ibn Salim se: ke ek jawaan, jise Qurqur ka laqab diya jaata tha, ne apni biwi ki laundi se sohbat ki, to yeh maamla al-Nu'man ibn Bashir ke paas laaya gaya, to unhone kaha: Main iska faisla zaroor saaf-saaf karunga: "Agar usne apni laundi ko uske liye halal kiya tha, to main usay sau [kode] maarunga, aur agar usne halal nahi kiya tha, to main usay rajm karunga," to biwi se kaha gaya: "Yeh tumhara shohar hai!" to usne kaha: "Maine usay iske liye halal kar diya tha." So unhone usay sau [kode] maare. Yahya kehte hain: Yeh marfu' hai. [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Sadaqah ibn al-Fadl se, Muhammad ibn Ja'far se, Shu'bah se, Abu Bishr se, Khalid ibn Urfutah se, Habib ibn Salim se, al-Nu'man ibn Bashir se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai.]

13.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ  ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنَكْدِرِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ خُزَيْمَةَ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ أُقِيمَ عَلَيْهِ حَدٌّ، غُفِرَ لَهُ ذَلِكَ الذَّنْبُ "
13.en: Narrated by Marwan ibn Muhammad al-Dimashqi, from Ibn Wahb, from Usamah ibn Zayd, from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Ibn Khuzaymah ibn Thabit, from his father: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever has a punishment established upon him, that sin is forgiven for him."
13.hi: Marwan ibn Muhammad al-Dimashqi ne Ibn Wahb se, Usamah ibn Zayd se, Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir se, Ibn Khuzaymah ibn Thabit se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jispar koi hadd qaayam ki jaaye, uske liye woh gunah maaf kar diya jaata hai."

14.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   : أَنَّ امْرَأَةً نَذَرَتْ أَنْ تَحُجَّ فَمَاتَتْ، فَجَاءَ أَخُوهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " لَوْ كَانَ عَلَيْهَا دَيْنٌ أَكُنْتَ قَاضِيَهُ؟ ".
قَالَ : نَعَمْ.
قَالَ :" فَاقْضُوا اللَّهَ، فَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ بِالْوَفَاءِ "
14.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from Abu Bishr, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas: That a woman vowed to perform Hajj, and died, so her brother came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and asked him about that, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: "If she had a debt, would you have paid it off?" He said, "Yes." He said: "Then pay off Allah's due, for Allah has more right to fulfillment."
14.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se, Abu Bishr se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas se bataya ke ek aurat ne Hajj karne ki nazr maani aur mar gayi, to uska bhai Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaya aur iske baare mein poocha, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne usse farmaya: "Agar uspar koi qarz hota, to kya tum use ada karte?" Usne kaha, "Haan." Aapne farmaya: "To Allah ka haq ada karo, kyunki Allah wafa ka zyada haqdaar hai."

14.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ نَذْرًا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ الْإِسْلَامُ؟ قَالَ :" فِ بِنَذْرِكَ "
14.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Hafs, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, from Umar: He said: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, I made a vow in the Jahiliyyah, then Islam came?" He said: "Fulfill your vow."
14.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Hafs se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se, Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, maine Jahiliyat mein ek nazr maani thi, fir Islam aa gaya?" Aapne farmaya: "Apni nazr poori karo."

14.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَحْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الرُّعَيْنِيّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ  ، قالَ : نَذَرَتْ أُخْتِي أَنْ تَحُجَّ لِلَّهِ مَاشِيَةً غَيْرَ مُخْتَمِرَةٍ، فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ :" مُرْ أُخْتَكَ فَلْتَخْتَمِرْ، وَلْتَرْكَبْ، وَلْتَصُمْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ "
14.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Ubaydullah ibn Zahr, from Abu Sa'id al-Ru'ayni, from Abdullah ibn Malik, from Uqbah ibn Amir al-Juhani: He said: My sister vowed to perform Hajj for Allah walking, unveiled, so I mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he said: "Command your sister to veil herself, and to ride, and to fast three days."
14.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Ubaydullah ibn Zahr se, Abu Sa'id al-Ru'ayni se, Abdullah ibn Malik se, Uqbah ibn Amir al-Juhani se bataya: Unhone kaha, Meri behen ne Allah ke liye paidal, bagair chaadar ke, Hajj karne ki nazr maani, to maine yeh baat Rasulullah ﷺ se zikr ki, to aapne farmaya: "Apni behen ko hukum do ke woh chaadar ode, aur sawaari kare, aur teen din roza rakhe."

14.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   : أَنَّ أُخْتَ عُقْبَةَ نَذَرَتْ أَنْ تَمْشِيَ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ عَنْ نَذْرِ أُخْتِكَ، لِتَرْكَبْ وَلْتُهْدِ هَدْيًا "
14.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Hammam, from Qatadah, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas: That Uqbah's sister vowed to walk to the House, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah is indeed free of need of your sister's vow, let her ride and offer a sacrificial animal."
14.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Hammam se bataya: Mujhe Qatadah ne bataya, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se: ke Uqbah ki behen ne Baitullah tak paidal jaane ki nazr maani, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Allah tumhari behen ki nazr se bekhauf hai, woh sawaari kare aur ek qurbani ka jaanwar bheje."

14.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرٍو، عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَدْرَكَ شَيْخًا يَمْشِي بَيْنَ ابْنَيْهِ، فَقَالَ : " مَا شَأْنُ هَذَا الشَّيْخِ؟ "، فَقَالَ ابْنَاهُ : نَذَرَ أَنْ يَمْشِيَ، فَقَالَ :" ارْكَبْ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْكَ وَعَنْ نَذْرِكَ "
14.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Mansur, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Amr ibn Abi Amr, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came upon an old man walking between his two sons, and said: "What is wrong with this old man?" So his two sons said: He vowed to walk, so he said: "Ride, for Allah is free of need of you and your vow."
14.hi: Sa'id ibn Mansur ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, Amr ibn Abi Amr se, al-A'raj se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ek budhe aadmi ke paas pahunche jo apne do beton ke darmiyan chal raha tha, to aapne poocha: "Is budhe aadmi ko kya hua hai?" To uske dono beton ne kaha: Isne paidal chalne ki nazr maani thi, to aapne farmaya: "Sawaari karo, kyunki Allah tum se aur tumhari nazr se bekhauf hai."

14.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ  ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا وَفَاءَ لِنَذْرٍ فِي مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ، وَلَا فِيمَا لَا يَمْلِكُ ابْنُ آدَمَ "
14.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah, from Abu al-Muhallab, from Imran ibn Husayn: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There is no fulfilling a vow in disobedience to Allah, nor in what a son of Adam does not own."
14.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ayyub se, Abu Qilabah se, Abu al-Muhallab se, Imran ibn Husayn se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah ki nafarmani mein koi nazr poori karna nahi, aur na hi us cheez mein jo Aadam ki aulaad ke ikhtiyaar mein na ho."

14.ar: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ الْأَيْلِيِّ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ نَذَرَ أَنْ يَطِيعَ اللَّهَ، فَلْيُطِعْهُ، وَمَنْ نَذَرَ أَنْ يَعْصِيَ اللَّهَ، فَلَا يَعْصِهِ "
14.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Talhah ibn Abd al-Malik al-Ayli, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Aisha: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever vows to obey Allah, let him obey Him, and whoever vows to disobey Allah, let him not disobey Him."
14.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Talhah ibn Abd al-Malik al-Ayli se, al-Qasim ibn Muhammad se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo Allah ki itaa'at ki nazr maane, to woh uski itaa'at kare, aur jo Allah ki nafarmani ki nazr maane, to woh uski nafarmani na kare."

14.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي بَقِيَّةَ الْمُعَلِّمِ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   : أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ إِنْ فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ فِي بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ؟ فَقَالَ :" صَلِّ هَاهُنَا ".
فَأَعَادَ عَلَيْهِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " شَأْنُكَ إِذَنْ "
14.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Habib ibn Abi Baqiyyah al-Mu'allim, from Ata ibn Abi Rabah, from Jabir ibn Abdullah: That a man said: "O Messenger of Allah, I vowed, if Allah grants you victory, that I would pray in Bayt al-Maqdis?" So he said: "Pray here." So he repeated it to him three times, so the Prophet ﷺ said: "It is your affair, then."
14.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Habib ibn Abi Baqiyyah al-Mu'allim se, Ata ibn Abi Rabah se, Jabir ibn Abdullah se bataya ke ek aadmi ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, maine nazr maani thi ke agar Allah aapko fatah de, to main Bait-ul-Maqdis mein namaz padhunga?" To aapne farmaya: "Yahin namaz padho." To usne teen martaba yeh dohraaya, to Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "To phir tumhari marzi hai."

14.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ  ،  عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ :" إِنَّ النَّذْرَ لَا يَرُدُّ شَيْئًا، وَإِنَّمَا يُسْتَخْرَجُ بِهِ مِنَ الشَّحِيحِ "
14.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Abu Awanah, from Mansur, from Abdullah ibn Murrah, from Ibn Umar: He said: The Messenger of Allah said: "Indeed the vow does not turn back anything, but wealth is extracted by it from the miserly."
14.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Abu Awanah se, Mansur se, Abdullah ibn Murrah se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Nazr kisi cheez ko wapas nahi karti, balke isse kanjoos se maal nikalwaaya jaata hai."

14.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَدْرَكَ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ وَهُوَ يَسِيرُ فِي رَكْبٍ، وَهُوَ يَحْلِفُ بِأَبِيه، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَنْهَاكُمْ أَنْ تَحْلِفُوا بِآبَائِكُمْ، فَمَنْ كَانَ حَالِفًا، فَلْيَحْلِفْ بِاللَّهِ، أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ "
14.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Malik ibn Anas, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came upon Umar ibn al-Khattab while he was riding among a group, and he was swearing by his father, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed Allah forbids you to swear by your fathers, so whoever must swear, let him swear by Allah, or remain silent."
14.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Malik ibn Anas se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ Umar ibn al-Khattab ke paas pahunche jabke woh ek jama'at mein sawaar the, aur woh apne baap ki qasam khaa rahe the, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Allah tumhein apne baapon ki qasam khaane se mana karta hai, so jo qasam khaana chaahe, woh Allah ki qasam khaaye, ya khamosh rahe."

14.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنِ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ، فَقَدِ اسْتَثْنَى "
14.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ayyub, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whoever swears an oath, then says: 'If Allah wills,' has made an exception."
14.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ayyub se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jo qasam khaaye, fir kahe: 'Inshaallah,' to usne istisna (shart) laga li."

14.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ، فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ : إِنْ شَاءَ فَعَلَ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ "
14.en: Narrated by Hajjaj, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ayyub, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever swears an oath, then says: 'If Allah wills,' then he has the choice: if he wishes, he does it, and if he wishes, he does not do it."
14.hi: Hajjaj ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ayyub se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jo qasam khaaye, fir kahe: 'Inshaallah,' to usay ikhtiyaar hai: agar chahe to kare, aur agar chahe to na kare."

14.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ لِأَبِي بَكْرٍ : "لَا تُقْسِمْ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : الْحَدِيثُ فِيهِ طُولٌ
14.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yunus, from Ibn Shihab, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah, from Ibn Abbas; with Abu Muhammad's note: That the Prophet ﷺ said to Abu Bakr: "Do not swear." Abu Muhammad said: The hadith is long [continuing further].
14.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhse Yunus ne bataya, Ibn Shihab se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah se, Ibn Abbas se: ke Nabi ﷺ ne Abu Bakr se farmaya: "Qasam mat khaao." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Hadith lambi hai [aage bhi jaari hai].

14.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو هُوَ : ابْنُ مُرَّةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَجُلًا يُقَالُ لَهُ : عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  زَمَنَ الْجَمَاجِمِ يُحَدِّثُ، قَالَ : سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ عَدِيَّ بْنَ حَاتِمٍ  ، فَحَلَفَ أَنْ لَا يُعْطِيَهُ شَيْئًا، ثُمَّ قَالَ : لَوْلَا أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ، فَرَأَى غَيْرَهَا خَيْرًا مِنْهَا، فَلْيَأْتِ الَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ، وَلْيُكَفِّرْ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ "
14.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from Amr ibn Murrah, about a man called Abdullah ibn Amr and Adi ibn Hatim: He said: I heard a man called Abdullah ibn Amr narrating, at the time of al-Jamajim, he said: A man asked Adi ibn Hatim, so he swore that he would not give him anything, then he said: "Were it not that I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Whoever swears an oath, then sees another better than it, let him do that which is better, and let him make expiation for his oath.'"
14.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Shu'bah se bataya: Mujhse Amr ibn Murrah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine ek aadmi ko, jise Abdullah ibn Amr kaha jaata tha, al-Jamajim ke waqt bayaan karte suna, unhone kaha: Ek aadmi ne Adi ibn Hatim se maanga, to unhone qasam khaayi ke woh usay kuch nahi denge, fir unhone kaha: "Agar maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko yeh farmaate na suna hota: 'Jo qasam khaaye, fir usse behtar koi cheez dekhe, to woh woh kare jo behtar ho, aur apni qasam ka kaffara de.'"

14.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَمُرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " يَا عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ سَمُرَةَ،لَا تَسْأَلِ الْإِمَارَةَ فَإِنَّكَ إِنْ أُعْطِيتَهَا عَنْ مَسْأَلَةٍ، وُكِلْتَ إِلَيْهَا، وَإِنْ أُعْطِيتَهَا عِنْ غَيْرِ مَسْأَلَةٍ، أُعِنْتَ عَلَيْهَا.
فَإِذَا حَلَفْتَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ فَرَأَيْتَ غَيْرَهَا خَيْرًا مِنْهَا، فَكَفِّرْ عَنْ يَمِينِكَ وَأْتِ الَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ ".
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :.
..
..
..
فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ الْحَدِيثِ
14.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Fadl, from Jarir ibn Hazim, from al-Hasan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Samurah; a similar chain also via Muhammad ibn Yusuf: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O Abd al-Rahman ibn Samurah, do not ask for a position of authority, for if you are given it upon asking, you will be entrusted to it [without help], and if you are given it without asking, you will be helped in it. And when you swear an oath, then see another better than it, then make expiation for your oath, and do what is better." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Yunus, from al-Hasan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Samurah, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, near this hadith.]
14.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Fadl ne Jarir ibn Hazim se bataya: Humein al-Hasan ne bataya: Humein Abd al-Rahman ibn Samurah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Ae Abd al-Rahman ibn Samurah, hukmaraani na maango, kyunki agar tumhein maangne par di gayi, to tumhein usi ke saath chhod diya jaayega, aur agar bagair maange di gayi, to usmein tumhari madad ki jaayegi. Aur jab tum qasam khaao, fir usse behtar koi cheez dekho, to apni qasam ka kaffara do aur woh karo jo behtar ho." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Muhammad ibn Yusuf se, Sufyan se, Yunus se, al-Hasan se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Samurah se, Rasulullah ﷺ se bhi is hadith ke qareeb aayi hai.]

14.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنِ الشَّرِيدِ  ، قَالَ : أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقُلْتُ : إِنَّ عَلَى أُمِّي رَقَبَةً، وَإِنَّ عِنْدِي جَارِيَةً سَوْدَاءَ نُوبِيَّةً، أَفَتُجْزِئُ عَنْهَا؟.
قَالَ : " ادْعُ بِهَا "، فَقَالَ :" أَتَشْهَدِينَ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ؟ "، قَالَتْ : نَعَمْ.
قَالَ : " أَعْتِقْهَا، فَإِنَّهَا مُؤْمِنَةٌ "
14.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from al-Sharid: He said: I came to the Prophet ﷺ, and said: "My mother owes freeing a slave, and I have a black Nubian slave-girl, will she suffice for it?" He said: "Call her," so he said to her: "Do you testify that there is no god but Allah?" She said, "Yes." He said: "Free her, for indeed she is a believer."
14.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, al-Sharid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Nabi ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Meri maa par ghulam azaad karne ki zimmedaari hai, aur mere paas ek kaali Nubi laundi hai, kya yeh iske liye kaafi hogi?" Aapne farmaya: "Usay bulao," to aapne usse poocha: "Kya tum gawahi deti ho ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi?" Usne kaha, "Haan." Aapne farmaya: "Isay azaad kar do, kyunki yeh momina hai."

14.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" يَمِينُكَ عَلَى مَا يُصَدَّ قُكَ بِهِ صَاحِبُكَ "
14.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Hushaym, from Abdullah ibn Abi Salih, from his father, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Your oath is according to what your companion believes you meant by it."
14.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Hushaym se bataya: Humein Abdullah ibn Abi Salih ne bataya, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tumhari qasam usi tarah maani jaayegi jaise tumhara sathi tasdeeq kare."

14.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَتْ يَمِينُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الَّتِي يَحْلِفُ بِهَا" لَا وَمُقَلِّبِ الْقُلُوبِ "
14.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Sufyan, from Musa ibn Uqbah, from Salim, from Ibn Umar: He said: The oath of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ by which he used to swear was: "No, by the Turner of hearts."
14.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Sufyan se, Musa ibn Uqbah se, Salim se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ki woh qasam jise aap khaate the: "Laa wa Muqallibil-Quloob" [Nahi, dilon ko pherne wale ki qasam].

15.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ فُضَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَوْجَاءِ السُّلَمِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ الْخُزَاعِيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" مَنْ أُصِيبَ بِدَمٍ أَوْ خَبْلٍ وَالْخَبْلُ : الْجُرْحُ فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ بَيْنَ إِحْدَى ثَلَاثٍ : فَإِنْ أَرَادَ الرَّابِعَةَ، فَخُذُوا عَلَى يَدَيْهِ : بَيْنَ أَنْ يَقْتَصَّ أَوْ يَعْفُوَ، أَوْ يَأْخُذَ الْعَقْلَ فَإِنْ أَخَذَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا ثُمَّ عَدَا بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ، فَلَهُ النَّارُ خَالِدًا فِيهَا مُخَلَّدًا "
15.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from al-Harith ibn Fudayl, from Sufyan ibn Abi al-Awja al-Sulami, from Abu Shurayh al-Khuza'i: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Whoever is afflicted with [causing] bloodshed or khabl - and al-khabl is: a wound - he has the choice between one of three: but if he wants a fourth, then restrain his hands: between that he retaliates, or forgives, or takes the blood-money; so if he takes any of that, then transgresses after that, for him is the Fire, abiding therein eternally."
15.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Ishaq se bataya: Humein al-Harith ibn Fudayl ne bataya, Sufyan ibn Abi al-Awja al-Sulami se, Abu Shurayh al-Khuza'i se: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Jispar khoon ya khabl (zakhm) ka maamla ho, to usay teen mein se ek ka ikhtiyaar hai: lekin agar woh chautha chahe, to uske haath rok do: qisaas le, ya maaf kar de, ya diyat (khoon-baha) le; so agar usne inmein se kuch liya fir baad mein zulm kiya, to uske liye Jahannam ki aag hai, jismein woh hamesha rahega."

15.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ ، وَكَانَ فِي كِتَابِهِ :" أَنَّ مَنْ اعْتَبَطَ مُؤْمِنًا قَتْلًا عَنْ بَيِّنَةٍ فَإِنَّهُ قَوَدُ يَديِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَرْضَى أَوْلِيَاءُ الْمَقْتُولِ ".
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : اعْتَبَطَ : قَتَلَ مِنْ غَيْرِ عِلَّةٍ
15.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Musa, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Sulayman ibn Da'ud, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm, from his father, from his grandfather; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen, and in his letter was: "Whoever wantonly kills a believer based on clear evidence, retaliation [is due] upon his hands, unless the guardians of the slain are satisfied [with something else]." Abu Muhammad said: I'tabata means: he killed without cause.
15.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Musa ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se, Sulayman ibn Da'ud se, al-Zuhri se, Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne Yemen walon ko likha, aur unke khat mein tha: "Jo kisi momin ko saaf gawahi ke saath bila wajah qatal kare, to uske haathon se qisaas liya jaayega, illa yeh ke qatal hone wale ke waaris raazi ho jaayein." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: 'I'tabata' ka matlab hai: usne bila kisi wajah ke qatal kiya.

15.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنَا بُشَيْرُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ  ، قَالَ : خَرَجَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَهْلِ بْنِ أَبي حَثْمَةَ أَحَدُ بَنِي حَارِثَةَ إِلَى خَيْبَرَ مَعَ نَفَرٍ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ يُرِيدُونَ الْمِيرَةَ بِخَيْبَرَ ، قَالَ : فَعُدِيَ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، فَقُتِلَ : فَتُلَّتْ عُنُقُهُ حَتَّى نُخَعَ ثُمَّ طُرِحَ فِي مَنْهَلٍ مِنْ مَنَاهِلِ خَيْبَرَ ، فَاسْتُصْرِخَ عَلَيْهِ أَصْحَابُهُ، فَاسْتَخْرَجُوهُ فَغَيَّبُوهُ، ثُمَّ قَدِمُوا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْمَدِينَةَ ، فَتَقَدَّمَ أَخُوهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَهْلٍ وَكَانَ ذَا قِدَمٍ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَابْنَا عَمِّهِ مَعَهُ : حُوَيِّصَةُ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ وَمُحَيِّصَةُ، فَتَكَلَّمَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ وَكَانَ أَحْدَثَهُمْ سِنًّا، وَهُوَ صَاحِبُ الدَّمِ وَذَا قَدَمٍ فِي الْقَوْمِ فَلَمَّا تَكَلَّمَ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " الْكُبْرَ الْكُبْرَ ".
قَالَ : فَاسْتَأْخَرَ فَتَكَلَّمَ حُوَيِّصَةُ وَمُحَيِّصَةُ، ثُمَّ هُوَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" تُسَمُّونَ قَاتِلَكُمْ، ثُمَّ تَحْلِفُونَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْسِينَ يَمِينًا، ثُمَّ نُسَلِّمُهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ".
قَالُوا : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا كُنَّا لِنَحْلِفَ عَلَى مَا لَا نَعْلَمُ، مَا نَدْرِي مَنْ قَتَلَهُ، إِلَّا أَنَّ اليَهُودَ عَدُوُّنَا، وَبَيْنَ أَظْهُرِهِمْ قُتِلَ.
قَالَ : " فَيَحْلِفُونَ لَكُمْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُمْ لَبُرَاءُ مِنْ دَمِ صَاحِبِكُمْ، ثُمَّ يَبْرَءُونَ مِنْهُ ".
قَالُوا : مَا كُنَّا لِنَقْبَلَ أَيْمَانَ يَهُودَ، مَا فِيهِمْ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ أَنْ يَحْلِفُوا عَلَى إِثْمٍ.
قَالَ : فَوَدَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنْ عِنْدِهِ بِمِائَةِ نَاقَةٍ
15.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Bushayr ibn Yasar, from Sahl ibn Abi Hathmah: He said: Abdullah ibn Sahl ibn Abi Hathmah, one of Banu Harithah, went out to Khaybar with a group of his people, wanting provisions at Khaybar, he said: So Abdullah was attacked, and killed: his neck was wrenched until it snapped, then he was thrown into a watering-place among the watering-places of Khaybar, so his companions were alerted about him, and they pulled him out and buried him, then they came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at Madinah, so his brother Abd al-Rahman ibn Sahl came forward, and he had precedence [being older, though not senior in age] with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and his two cousins with him: Huwayyisah ibn Mas'ud and Muhayyisah, so Abd al-Rahman spoke, and he was the youngest of them, and he was the one entitled to the blood and had precedence among the people, but when he spoke, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The elder, the elder [should speak first]." He said: So he held back and Huwayyisah and Muhayyisah spoke, then he [Abd al-Rahman spoke], so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "You name your killer, then you swear fifty oaths concerning it, then we hand him over to you." They said: "O Messenger of Allah, we would not swear about what we do not know, we do not know who killed him, except that the Jews are our enemy, and it was among them that he was killed." He said: "Then they will swear to you by Allah that they are indeed free of the blood of your companion, then they will be absolved of it." They said: "We would not accept the oaths of Jews, there is nothing more among them than that they would swear to a sin." He said: So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ paid his blood-money from himself with a hundred she-camels.
15.hi: Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Muhammad ibn Ishaq se bataya: Humein Bushayr ibn Yasar ne bataya, Sahl ibn Abi Hathmah se: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ibn Sahl ibn Abi Hathmah, jo Banu Harithah mein se the, apni qaum ke kuch logon ke saath Khaybar gaye, Khaybar mein khaana-peena talaash karte hue, unhone bataya: To Abdullah par hamla kiya gaya, aur unhein maar diya gaya: unki gardan moad di gayi yahan tak ke woh toot gayi, fir unhein Khaybar ke paani ke kisi ghaat mein phenk diya gaya, so unke saathi unke baare mein khabardaar hue, aur unhein nikaal kar dafna diya, fir woh Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas Madinah aaye, to unke bhai Abd al-Rahman ibn Sahl aage aaye, aur unhein Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath aage aane ka sharaf haasil tha, aur unke saath unke do chachazaad the: Huwayyisah ibn Mas'ud aur Muhayyisah, to Abd al-Rahman ne baat ki, aur woh unmein sabse chhote the, aur woh khoon ke haqdaar the aur qaum mein aage rehne wale the, lekin jab unhone baat ki, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Bada, bada [pehle bole]." Unhone bataya: To woh peechhe hat gaye aur Huwayyisah aur Muhayyisah ne baat ki, fir unhone [Abd al-Rahman ne], to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Tum apne qaatil ka naam lo, fir iske baare mein pachaas qasmein khaao, fir hum use tumhare hawaale kar denge." Unhone kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, hum jo nahi jaante uske baare mein qasam nahi khaayenge, humein nahi maloom kisne unhein maara, siwaay iske ke Yahoodi humare dushman hain, aur unke darmiyan hi woh maare gaye." Aapne farmaya: "To woh tumse Allah ki qasam khaayenge ke woh tumhare saathi ke khoon se bari hain, fir woh isse bari ho jaayenge." Unhone kaha: "Hum Yahoodiyon ki qasmein qabool nahi karenge, unmein isse zyada kuch nahi ke woh gunah par qasam khaa lein." Unhone bataya: To Rasulullah ﷺ ne apne paas se sau oontniyon se unka khoon-baha ada kiya.

15.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ وَكَانَ فِي كِتَابِهِ :" أَنَّ الرَّجُلَ يُقْتَلُ بِالْمَرْأَةِ "
15.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Musa, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Sulayman ibn Da'ud, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm, from his father, from his grandfather: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen, and in his letter was: "That a man is killed [in retaliation] for a woman."
15.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Musa ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se, Sulayman ibn Da'ud se, al-Zuhri se, Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne Yemen walon ko likha, aur unke khat mein tha: "Ke aadmi aurat ke badle [qisaas mein] qatal kiya jaayega."

15.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ   : أَنَّ جَارِيَةً رُضَّ رَأْسُهَا بَيْنَ حَجَرَيْنِ، فَقِيلَ لَهَا : مَنْ فَعَلَ بِكِ هَذَا أَفُلَانٌ، أَفُلَانٌ؟ حَتَّى سُمِّيَ الْيَهُودِيُّ، فَأَوْمَأَتْ بِرَأْسِهَا، فَبُعِثَ إِلَيْهِ فَجِيءَ بِهِ، فَاعْتَرَفَ،" فَأَمَرَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَرُضَّ رَأْسُهُ بَيْنَ حَجَرَيْنِ "
15.en: Narrated by Affan, from Hammam, from Qatadah, from Anas: That a slave-girl's head was crushed between two stones, so it was said to her: "Who did this to you, was it so-and-so, so-and-so?" until the Jew was named, and she nodded her head, so [someone] was sent for him and he was brought, and he confessed, "so the Prophet ﷺ commanded regarding him, and his head was crushed between two stones."
15.hi: Affan ne Hammam se, Qatadah se, Anas se bataya ke ek laundi ka sar do pathron ke darmiyan kuchal diya gaya, to usse poocha gaya: "Tumhare saath yeh kisne kiya, fulaan, fulaan?" yahan tak ke Yahoodi ka naam liya gaya, to usne apne sar se ishara kiya, to [kisi ko] uske paas bheja gaya aur usay laaya gaya, aur usne iqraar kiya, "to Nabi ﷺ ne uske baare mein hukum diya, aur uska sar do pathron ke darmiyan kuchla gaya."

15.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق  ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ  ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِعَلِيٍّ   : يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، هَلْ عَلِمْتَ شَيْئًا مِنَ الْوَحْيِ إِلَّا مَا فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى؟.
قَالَ : " لَا وَالَّذِي فَلَقَ الْحَبَّةَ وَبَرَأَ النَّسَمَةَ،مَا أَعْلَمُهُ إِلَّا فَهْمًا يُعْطِيهِ اللَّهُ الرَّجُلَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ، وَمَا فِي الصَّحِيفَةِ ".
قُلْتُ : وَمَا فِي الصَّحِيفَةِ؟.
قَالَ : " الْعَقْلُ، وَفِكَاكُ الْأَسِيرِ، وَلَا يُقْتَلُ مُسْلِمٌ بِمُشْرِكٍ "
15.en: Narrated by Ishaq, from Jarir, from Mutarrif, from al-Sha'bi, from Abu Juhayfah: He said: I said to Ali: "O Commander of the Believers, do you know anything of revelation besides what is in the Book of Allah, exalted is He?" He said: "No, by the One who split the seed and created the soul, I do not know it except an understanding which Allah gives a man in the Qur'an, and what is in the document." I said: "And what is in the document?" He said: "The blood-money, and freeing of the captive, and that a Muslim is not killed for a disbeliever."
15.hi: Ishaq ne Jarir se, Mutarrif se, al-Sha'bi se, Abu Juhayfah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ali (Alayhis Salam) se poocha: "Ae Ameer-ul-Mumineen, kya aap wahi mein se kuch aisa jaante hain jo Allah Ta'ala ki Kitaab mein nahi hai?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, us Zaat ki qasam jisne daana phaada aur rooh banaayi, main isay sirf ek samajh ke tor par jaanta hoon jo Allah aadmi ko Quran mein deta hai, aur woh jo sahifay mein hai." Maine poocha: "Aur sahifay mein kya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Diyat (khoon-baha), aur qaidi ko azaad karana, aur yeh ke Musalman kaafir ke badle qatal nahi kiya jaata."

15.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَونٍ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا تُقَامُ الْحُدُودُ فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ، وَلَا يُقَادُ بِالْوَلَدِ الْوَالِدُ "
15.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Isma'il ibn Muslim, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas: He said: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The [fixed] punishments are not established in mosques, and a father is not killed in retaliation for [killing] his child."
15.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Isma'il ibn Muslim se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Tawus se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, "Hudood masjidon mein qaayam nahi ki jaatin, aur baap apni aulaad ke badle qisaas mein qatal nahi kiya jaata."

15.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَتَلَ عَبْدَهُ قَتَلْنَاهُ، وَمَنْ جَدَعَهُ، جَدَعْنَاهُ ".
قَالَ : ثُمَّ نَسِيَ الْحَسَنُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ، وَكَانَ يَقُولُ : لَا يُقْتَلُ حُرٌّ بِعَبْدٍ
15.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from al-Hasan, from Samurah ibn Jundub; with al-Hasan's later differing note: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever kills his slave, we will kill him, and whoever mutilates him, we will mutilate him." He said: Then al-Hasan forgot this hadith, and used to say: A free person is not killed for a slave.
15.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Qatadah se, al-Hasan se, Samurah ibn Jundub se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jo apne ghulam ko qatal kare, hum use qatal karenge, aur jo usay bigade (ang kaate), hum usay bigadenge." Unhone bataya: Fir al-Hasan is hadith ko bhool gaye, aur kehne lage: Aazad shakhs ghulam ke badle qatal nahi hota.

15.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ  ، عَنْ عَوْفٍ  ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ أَبِي عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ وَائِلٍ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَائِلِ بْنِ حُجْرٍ  ، قَالَ : شَهِدْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حِينَ أُتِيَ بِالرَّجُلِ الْقَاتِلِ يُقَادُ فِي نِسْعَةٍ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِوَلِيِّ الْمَقْتُولِ : " أَتَعْفُو؟ ".
قَالَ : لَا.
قَالَ : " فَتَأْخُذُ الدِّيَةَ؟ ".
قَالَ : لَا.
قَالَ : " فَتَقْتُلُهُ؟ ".
قَالَ : نَعَمْ.
قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّكَ إِنْ عَفَوْتَ عَنْهُ، فَإِنَّهُ يَبُوءُ بِإِثْمِكَ وَإِثْمِ صَاحِبِكَ ".
قَالَ : فَتَرَكَهُ، قَالَ : فَأَنَا رَأَيْتُهُ يَجُرُّ نِسْعَتَهُ، قَدْ عَفَا عَنْهُ
15.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah al-Hamdani, from Abu Usamah, from Awf, from Hamzah Abu Umar, from Alqamah ibn Wa'il al-Hadrami, from his father Wa'il ibn Hujr: He said: I witnessed the Prophet ﷺ when a man, a killer, was brought led with a rope, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to the guardian of the slain: "Will you forgive?" He said, "No." He said: "Then will you take the blood-money?" He said, "No." He said: "Then will you kill him?" He said, "Yes." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If you forgive him, he will bear your sin and the sin of your companion." He said: So he left him. He said: So I saw him dragging his rope, having forgiven him.
15.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah al-Hamdani ne Abu Usamah se, Awf se, Hamzah Abu Umar se, Alqamah ibn Wa'il al-Hadrami se, apne walid Wa'il ibn Hujr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Nabi ﷺ ke paas maujood tha jab ek aadmi, ek qaatil, ko rasse se baandh kar laaya gaya, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne qatal hone wale ke waali se poocha: "Kya tum maaf karoge?" Usne kaha, "Nahi." Aapne poocha: "To kya tum diyat loge?" Usne kaha, "Nahi." Aapne poocha: "To kya tum usay qatal karoge?" Usne kaha, "Haan." Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Agar tum usay maaf kar do, to woh tumhara gunah aur tumhare saathi ka gunah [dono] apne saath le jaayega." Unhone bataya: To usne usay chhod diya. Unhone bataya: To maine usay apna rassa ghaseette dekha, usne usay maaf kar diya tha.

15.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ فِرَاسٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" الْكَبَائِرُ : الْإِشْرَاكُ بِاللَّهِ، وَعُقُوقُ الْوَالِدَيْنِ، وَقَتْلُ النَّفْسِ شُعْبَةُ الشَّاكُّ أَوْ الْيَمِينُ الْغَمُوسُ "
15.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Bashshar, from Muhammad ibn Ja'far, from Shu'bah, from Firas, from al-Sha'bi, from Abdullah ibn Amr, from the Prophet ﷺ; with Shu'bah's uncertainty: He said: "The major sins are: associating partners with Allah, and undutifulness to parents, and killing a soul" - Shu'bah was uncertain: "or false [deliberately deceptive] oath."
15.hi: Muhammad ibn Bashshar ne Muhammad ibn Ja'far se, Shu'bah se, Firas se, al-Sha'bi se, Abdullah ibn Amr se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Bade gunah hain: Allah ke saath shirk karna, aur maa-baap ki na-farmaani, aur kisi jaan ko qatal karna" - Shu'bah ko shak tha - "ya jhoothi qasam."

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ الضَّحَّاكِ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَعْنُ الْمُؤْمِنِ كَقَتْلِهِ، وَمَنْ قَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ بِشَيْءٍ فِي الدُّنْيَا، عُذِّبَ بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ "
15.en: Narrated by Wahb ibn Jarir, from Hisham, from Yahya, from Abu Qilabah, from Thabit ibn al-Dahhak: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Cursing a believer is like killing him, and whoever kills himself with something in this world, will be punished with it on the Day of Resurrection."
15.hi: Wahb ibn Jarir ne Hisham se, Yahya se, Abu Qilabah se, Thabit ibn al-Dahhak se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Momin par lanat karna uske qatal karne jaisa hai, aur jo apne aap ko duniya mein kisi cheez se maare, use Qayamat ke din usi cheez se azaab diya jaayega."

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ قَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ بِحَدِيدَةٍ فَحَدِيدَتُهُ فِي يَدِهِ يَتَوَجَّأُ بِهَا فِي بَطْنِهِ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدًا مُخَلَّدًا فِيهَا أَبَدًا، وَمَنْ قَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ بِسَمٍّ فَسُمُّهُ فِي يَدِهِ يَتَحَسَّاهُ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدًا مُخَلَّدًا فِيهَا أَبَدًا، وَمَنْ تَرَدَّى مِنْ جَبَلٍ فَقَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ، فَهُوَ يَتَرَدَّى فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدًا مُخَلَّدًا فِيهَا أَبَدًا "
15.en: Narrated by Ya'la ibn Ubayd, from al-A'mash, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever kills himself with a piece of iron, his piece of iron will be in his hand, and he will stab himself with it in his belly in the fire of Hell, abiding therein eternally forever, and whoever kills himself with poison, his poison will be in his hand, sipping it in the fire of Hell, abiding therein eternally forever, and whoever throws himself off a mountain and kills himself, he will keep throwing himself in the fire of Hell, abiding therein eternally forever."
15.hi: Ya'la ibn Ubayd ne al-A'mash se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo apne aap ko loha se maare, uska loha uske haath mein hoga, woh usse apne pet mein Jahannam ki aag mein bhonkta rahega, hamesha usmein rahega, aur jo apne aap ko zeher se maare, uska zeher uske haath mein hoga, woh usay Jahannam ki aag mein ghoont-ghoont pita rahega, hamesha usmein rahega, aur jo pahaad se giraakar apne aap ko maare, woh Jahannam ki aag mein giratay rahega, hamesha usmein rahega."

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قالَ : قَتَلَ رَجُلٌ رَجُلًا عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" فَجَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ دِيَتَهُ اثْنَيْ عَشَرَ أَلْفًا فَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ : # يَحْلِفُونَ بِاللَّهِ مَا قَالُوا وَلَقَدْ قَالُوا كَلِمَةَ الْكُفْرِ وَكَفَرُوا بَعْدَ إِسْلامِهِمْ وَهَمُّوا بِمَا لَمْ يَنَالُوا وَمَا نَقَمُوا إِلا أَنْ أَغْنَاهُمُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ سورة التوبة آية 74 # بِأَخْذِهِمُ الدِّيَةَ "
15.en: Narrated by Mu'adh ibn Hani', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas: He said: A man killed a man in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, "so the Prophet ﷺ set his blood-money at twelve thousand," and that is His saying: "They swear by Allah that they did not say [it], but they had indeed said the word of disbelief, and disbelieved after their [profession of] Islam, and they resolved upon what they did not attain, and they were not resentful except that Allah and His Messenger had enriched them of His bounty" [Surah al-Tawbah, verse 74], by their taking of the blood-money.
15.hi: Mu'adh ibn Hani' ne Muhammad ibn Muslim se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ke zamane mein ek aadmi ne doosre aadmi ko qatal kiya "to Nabi ﷺ ne uska khoon-baha baarah hazaar muqarrar kiya," aur yehi Allah ka farman hai: "Yeh Allah ki qasam khaate hain ke unhone [kufr ki baat] nahi kahi, jabke unhone zaroor kufr ki baat kahi, aur apne Islam laane ke baad kufr kiya, aur unhone woh irada kiya jo unhein hasil nahi hua, aur unhone kisi baat ka badla nahi liya siwaay iske ke Allah aur uske Rasool ne unhein apne fazl se ghani kar diya" [Surah At-Tawbah, aayat 74], unke diyat lene ki wajah se.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ   : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ :" وَعَلَى أَهْلِ الذَّهَبِ أَلْفُ دِينَارٍ "
15.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Musa, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Sulayman ibn Da'ud, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm, from his father, from his grandfather: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen: "and upon the people of gold [is] a thousand dinars."
15.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Musa ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se, Sulayman ibn Da'ud se, al-Zuhri se, Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne Yemen walon ko likha: "aur sone wale [logon] par ek hazaar dinar hai [khoon-baha]."

15.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ :" بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ : مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَى شُرَحْبِيلَ بْنِ عَبْدِ كُلَالٍ، وَالْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَبْدِ كُلَالٍ، وَنُعَيْمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ كُلَالٍ قِيَلِ ذِي رُعَيْنٍ وَمُعَافِرَ، وَهَمَدَانَ فَكَانَ فِي كِتَابِهِ : وَإِنَّ فِي النَّفْسِ الدِّيَةَ : مِائَةٌ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ "
15.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Musa, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Sulayman ibn Da'ud, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm, from his father, from his grandfather: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen: "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. From Muhammad the Prophet ﷺ to Shurahbil ibn Abd Kulal, and al-Harith ibn Abd Kulal, and Nu'aym ibn Abd Kulal, chiefs of Dhu Ru'ayn and Mu'afir, and Hamdan," and in his letter was: "And indeed for a soul is the blood-money: a hundred camels."
15.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Musa ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se, Sulayman ibn Da'ud se, al-Zuhri se, Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne Yemen walon ko likha: "Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Raheem: Muhammad Nabi ﷺ ki taraf se, Shurahbil ibn Abd Kulal, aur al-Harith ibn Abd Kulal, aur Nu'aym ibn Abd Kulal, Dhu Ru'ayn aur Mu'afir, aur Hamdan ke sardaaron, ki taraf," aur unke khat mein tha: "Aur jaan ke liye diyat hai: sau oont."

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ ، وَكَانَ فِي كِتَابِهِ :" وَفِي الْأَنْفِ إِذَا أُوعِبَ جَدْعُهُ الدِّيَةُ، وَفِي اللِّسَانِ الدِّيَةُ، وَفِي الشَّفَتَيْنِ الدِّيَةُ، وَفِي الْبَيْضَتَيْنِ الدِّيَةُ، وَفِي الذَّكَرِ الدِّيَةُ، وَفِي الصُّلْبِ الدِّيَةُ، وَفِي الْعَيْنَيْنِ الدِّيَةُ، وَفِي الرِّجْلِ الْوَاحِدَةِ نِصْفُ الدِّيَةِ، وَفِي الْمَأْمُومَةِ ثُلُثُ الدِّيَةِ، وَفِي الْجَائِفَةِ ثُلُثُ الدِّيَةِ، وَفِي الْمُنَقِّلَةِ خَمْسَ عَشَرَةَ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ "
15.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Musa, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Sulayman ibn Da'ud, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm, from his father, from his grandfather: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen, and in his letter was: "And in the nose, if it is completely severed, the full blood-money, and in the tongue the full blood-money, and in the two lips the full blood-money, and in the two testicles the full blood-money, and in the penis the full blood-money, and in the spine the full blood-money, and in the two eyes the full blood-money, and in one leg half the blood-money, and in a head-wound reaching the brain a third of the blood-money, and in a wound reaching the body cavity a third of the blood-money, and in a bone-displacing wound, fifteen camels."
15.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Musa ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se, Sulayman ibn Da'ud se, al-Zuhri se, Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne Yemen walon ko likha, aur unke khat mein tha: "Aur naak mein, agar poori kaat di jaaye, poori diyat, aur zubaan mein poori diyat, aur dono hothon mein poori diyat, aur dono khusiyon mein poori diyat, aur zakar mein poori diyat, aur reedh ki haddi mein poori diyat, aur dono aankhon mein poori diyat, aur ek taang mein aadhi diyat, aur dimaag tak pahunchne wale zakhm mein tihai diyat, aur pait tak pahunchne wale zakhm mein tihai diyat, aur haddi hilaane wale zakhm mein pandrah oont."

15.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ  ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ خِشْفِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" جَعَلَ الدِّيَةَ فِي الْخَطَإِ أَخْمَاسًا "
15.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Mu'awiyah, from Hajjaj, from Zayd ibn Jubayr, from Khishf ibn Malik, from Abdullah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "made the blood-money for [unintentional] killing by mistake in fifths [of five categories of camels]."
15.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Mu'awiyah se, Hajjaj se, Zayd ibn Jubayr se, Khishf ibn Malik se, Abdullah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "khata (galti) mein hone wale qatal ki diyat ko paanch hisson mein baant diya."

15.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الرِّفَاعِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ  ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ   :" أَنَّ عَبْدًا لِأُنَاسٍ فُقَرَاءَ، قَطَعَ يَدَ غُلَامٍ لِأُنَاسٍ أَغْنِيَاءَ.
فَأَتَى أَهْلُهُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالُوا : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّهُ لِأُنَاسٍ فُقَرَاءَ؟ فَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ عَلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ شَيْئًا "
15.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Rifa'i, from Mu'adh ibn Hisham, from his father, from Qatadah, from Abu Nadrah, from Imran ibn Husayn: That a slave belonging to poor people cut off the hand of a boy belonging to wealthy people, so his family came to the Prophet ﷺ, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, he belongs to poor people," so the Prophet ﷺ did not impose anything upon him [beyond handing over the slave].
15.hi: Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Rifa'i ne Mu'adh ibn Hisham se, apne walid se, Qatadah se, Abu Nadrah se, Imran ibn Husayn se bataya ke: "kuch gareeb logon ke ek ghulam ne kuch amir logon ke ek ladke ka haath kaat diya. To uske gharwale Nabi ﷺ ke paas aaye, aur kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah, yeh gareeb logon ka hai?' To Nabi ﷺ ne uspar [ghulam sonpne ke ilawa] kuch aur zimmedaari nahi daali."

15.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ غَالِبٍ التَّمَّارِ  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" الْأَصَابِعُ سَوَاءٌ "، قَالَ : فَقُلْتُ : عَشْرٌ عَشْرٌ؟، قَالَ : " نَعَمْ "
15.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Ghalib al-Tammar, from Masruq ibn Aws, from Abu Musa al-Ash'ari, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "The fingers are equal," he said: So I said: "Ten [camels] for ten [fingers, each equal]?" He said, "Yes."
15.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se, Ghalib al-Tammar se, Masruq ibn Aws se, Abu Musa al-Ash'ari se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Ungliyaan barabar hain." Unhone bataya: To maine poocha: "Das-das [oont har ungli ke liye]?" Aapne farmaya, "Haan."

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" هَذَا وَهَذَا سَوَاء، وَقَالَ : بِخِنْصِرِهِ وَإِبْهَامِهِ "
15.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "This and this are equal," and he gestured with his little finger and his thumb.
15.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Shu'bah se, Qatadah se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Yeh aur yeh barabar hain," aur aapne apni chhingli aur apne angoothe se ishara kiya.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ :" وَفِي كُلِّ إِصْبَعٍ مِنْ أَصَابِعِ الْيَدِ وَالرِّجْلِ عَشْرَةٌ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ "
15.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Musa, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Sulayman ibn Da'ud, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm, from his father, from his grandfather: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen: "And for every finger among the fingers of the hand and foot, ten camels."
15.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Musa ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se, Sulayman ibn Da'ud se, al-Zuhri se, Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne Yemen walon ko likha: "Aur haath aur pair ki har ungli mein das oont."

15.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ مَطَرٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ  ، قَالَ : " قَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَفِي الْمَوَاضِحِ خَمْسًا خَمْسًا مِنَ الْإِبِلِ "
15.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Abdah, from Sa'id, from Matar, from Amr ibn Shu'ayb, from his father, from his grandfather: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled concerning head-wounds that reach the bone: five camels each."
15.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Abdah se, Sa'id se, Matar se, Amr ibn Shu'ayb se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne haddi tak pahunchne wale zakhmon ke baare mein paanch-paanch oont ka faisla kiya."

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ :" وَفِي كُلِّ إِصْبَعٍ مِنْ أَصَابِعِ الْيَدِ وَالرِّجْلِ عَشْرٌ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ، وَفِي الْمُوضِحَةِ خَمْسٌ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ "
15.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Musa, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Sulayman ibn Da'ud, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm, from his father, from his grandfather: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen: "And for every finger among the fingers of the hand and foot, ten camels, and for the head-wound reaching the bone, five camels."
15.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Musa ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se, Sulayman ibn Da'ud se, al-Zuhri se, Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne Yemen walon ko likha: "Aur haath aur pair ki har ungli mein das oont, aur haddi tak pahunchne wale zakhm mein paanch oont."

15.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدَةُ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ مَطَرٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ  ، قَالَ : " قَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِيالْأَسْنَانِ خَمْسًا خَمْسًا مِنَ الْإِبِلِ "
15.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Abdah, from Sa'id, from Matar, from Amr ibn Shu'ayb, from his father, from his grandfather: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled concerning teeth: five camels each."
15.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Abdah se, Sa'id se, Matar se, Amr ibn Shu'ayb se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne daanton ke baare mein paanch-paanch oont ka faisla kiya."

15.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ :" وَفِي السِّنِّ خَمْسٌ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ "
15.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Musa, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Sulayman ibn Da'ud, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm, from his father, from his grandfather: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen: "And in a tooth, five camels."
15.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Musa ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se, Sulayman ibn Da'ud se, al-Zuhri se, Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne Yemen walon ko likha: "Aur daant mein, paanch oont."

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، قَالَ : قَتَادَةُ  أَخْبَرَنِي، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ زُرَارَةَ بْنَ أَوْفَى  ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ   : أَنَّ رَجُلًا عَضَّ يَدَ رَجُلٍ، قَالَ : فَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَوَقَعَتْ ثَنِيَّتَاهُ، فَاخْتَصَمُوا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ :" يَعَضُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ كَمَا يَعَضُّ الْفَحْلُ؟ لَا دِيَةَ لَكَ "
15.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from Zurarah ibn Awfa, from Imran ibn Husayn: That a man bit another man's hand, he said: So he pulled his hand away and his two front teeth fell out, so they disputed before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he said: "Would one of you bite his brother as a stallion bites? There is no blood-money for you."
15.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se bataya: Qatadah ne mujhe bataya, unhone kaha: Maine Zurarah ibn Awfa ko suna, Imran ibn Husayn se: ke ek aadmi ne doosre aadmi ka haath kaat liya, unhone bataya: To usne apna haath khainch liya to uske do agle daant gir gaye, to unhone Rasulullah ﷺ ke saamne jhagda kiya, to aapne farmaya: "Kya tum mein se koi apne bhai ko aise kaate jaise nar oont kaatta hai? Tumhare liye koi diyat nahi."

15.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" الْعَجْمَاءُ جُرْحُهَا الْجُبَارُ، وَالْبِئْرُ جُبَارٌ، وَالْمَعْدِنُ جُبَارٌ، وَفِي الرِّكَازِ الْخُمُسُ "
15.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The dumb animal's wound is without liability, and the well is without liability, and the mine is without liability, and in buried treasure there is a fifth."
15.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Gungay jaanwar ka zakhm mu'af hai, aur kuen ka koi mu'aawza nahi, aur khaan ka koi mu'aawza nahi, aur gaday hue khazane mein paanchwa hissa hai."

15.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" جُرْحُ الْعَجْمَاءِ جُبَارٌ، وَالْبِئْرُ جُبَارٌ، وَالْمَعْدِنُ جُبَارٌ، وَفِي الرِّكَازِ الْخُمُسُ "
15.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, and Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "The wound of a dumb animal is without liability, and the well is without liability, and the mine is without liability, and in buried treasure there is a fifth."
15.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Ibn Shihab se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab aur Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Gungay jaanwar ka zakhm mu'af hai, aur kuen ka koi mu'aawza nahi, aur khaan ka koi mu'aawza nahi, aur gaday hue khazane mein paanchwa hissa hai."

15.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" الْمَعْدِنُ جُبَارٌ، وَالسَّائِمَةُ جُبَارٌ، وَالْبِئْرُ جُبَارٌ، وَفِي الرِّكَازِ الْخُمُسُ "
15.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Sufyan, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "The mine is without liability, and the grazing animal is without liability, and the well is without liability, and in buried treasure there is a fifth."
15.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Sufyan se, Abu al-Zinad se, al-A'raj se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Khaan ka koi mu'aawza nahi, aur charne wale jaanwar ka koi mu'aawza nahi, aur kuen ka koi mu'aawza nahi, aur gaday hue khazane mein paanchwa hissa hai."

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ نُضَيْلَةَ  ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَنَّ امْرَأَتَيْنِ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ رَجُلٍ، فَتَغَايَرَتَا، فَضَرَبَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا الْأُخْرَى بِعَمُودٍ، فَقَتَلَتْهَا وَمَا فِي بَطْنِهَا، فَاخْتَصَمَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَفَقَضَى فِيهِ غُرَّةً، وَجَعَلَهَا عَلَى عَاقِلَةِ الْمَرْأَةِ "
15.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from Ubayd ibn Nudaylah, from al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah, from the Prophet ﷺ: "That two women were with a man, and became jealous of each other, and one of them struck the other with a tent-pole, and killed her and what was in her belly, so they disputed before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he ruled in it with a ghurrah [compensation of a slave], and made it upon the woman's kinsmen [as liable parties]."
15.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se, Ubayd ibn Nudaylah se, al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya ke "do auratein ek aadmi ke saath thi, aur unmein jalan paida hui, to unmein se ek ne doosri ko khaymay ki lakdi se maara, aur usay aur uske pait mein jo tha usay maar diya, to unhone Rasulullah ﷺ ke saamne jhagda kiya, to aapne isme ghurrah (ghulam) ka faisla diya, aur usay aurat ke aaqilah (rishtedaron) par daala."

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو هُوَ : ابْنُ دِينَار  ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   : أَنَّ عُمَرَ نَشَدَ النَّاسَ قَضَاءَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي الْجَنِينِ فَقَامَ حَمَلُ بْنُ مَالِكِ بْنِ النَّابِغَةِ، فَقَالَ : كُنْتُ بَيْنَ امْرَأَتَيْنِ، فَضَرَبَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا الْأُخْرَى بِمِسْطَحٍ، " فَقَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي جَنِينِهَابِغُرَّةٍ، وَأَنْ تُقْتَلَ بِهَا "
15.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas, about Umar and Hamal ibn Malik: That Umar adjured the people about the ruling of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ concerning the fetus, so Hamal ibn Malik ibn al-Nabighah stood, and said: I was between two women, and one of them struck the other with a tent-pole, "so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled concerning her fetus with a ghurrah, and that she [the striker] be killed for her [victim, i.e. subject to further legal process, though this part is disputed and unclear in translation - retaining literal]."
15.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Tawus se, Ibn Abbas se bataya ke Umar ne logon ko Rasulullah ﷺ ke bachche (jenin) ke baare mein faisle ke liye qasam di, to Hamal ibn Malik ibn al-Nabighah khade hue, aur kaha: Main do auraton ke darmiyan tha, to unmein se ek ne doosri ko misTah (lakdi) se maara, "to Rasulullah ﷺ ne uske bachche ke baare mein ghurrah ka faisla diya, aur ke woh [maarne wali] uske liye qatal ki jaaye."

15.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   : أَنَّ امْرَأَتَيْنِ مِنْ هُذَيْلٍ اقْتَتَلَتَا، فَرَمَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا الْأُخْرَى بِحَجَرٍ، فَقَتَلَتْهَا وَمَا فِي بَطْنِهَا، فَاخْتَصَمُوا فِي الدِّيَةِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَضَى : أَنَّ دِيَةَ جَنِينِهَا غُرَّةٌ : عَبْدٌ أَوْ وَلِيدَةٌ، وَقَضَى بِدِيَتِهَا عَلَى عَاقِلَتِهَا، وَوَرِثَتْهَا وَرَثَتُهَا وَلَدُهَا وَمَنْ مَعَهَا، فَقَالَ حَمَلُ بْنُ النَّابِغَةِ الْهُذَلِيُّ : كَيْفَ أَغْرَمُ مَنْ لَا شَرِبَ وَلَا أَكَلَ، وَلَا نَطَقَ وَلَا اسْتَهَلّ، فَمِثْلُ ذَلِكَ يُطَلُّ؟، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّمَا هُوَ مِنْ إِخْوَانِ الْكُهَّانِ ".
مِنْ أَجْلِ سَجْعِهِ الَّذِي سَجَعَ
15.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Yunus, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, and Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: That two women from Hudhayl fought, and one threw a stone at the other, killing her and what was in her belly, so they disputed about the blood-money before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he ruled that the blood-money for her fetus was a ghurrah: a male or female slave, and he ruled the blood-money for her [the victim] upon her kinsmen, and her inheritors, her child and those with her, inherited from her, so Hamal ibn al-Nabighah al-Hudhali said: "How can I be fined for one who did not drink nor eat, nor spoke nor cried out, for the like of that is to be disregarded?" So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "He is only one of the brothers of soothsayers," because of his rhymed speech which he had rhymed.
15.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Yunus se, al-Zuhri se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab aur Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Hudhayl ki do auraton ne ladai ki, aur ek ne doosri par pathar phenka, usay aur uske pait mein jo tha usay maar diya, to unhone diyat ke baare mein Rasulullah ﷺ ke saamne jhagda kiya, to aapne faisla diya ke uske bachche ki diyat ghurrah hai: ek ghulam ya laundi, aur uski (maa ki) diyat uske aaqilah par muqarrar ki, aur uski waarison, uski aulaad aur uske saath walon, ne usse virasat li, to Hamal ibn al-Nabighah al-Hudhali ne kaha: "Main us par kaise jurmaana ada karun jisne na piya, na khaya, na bola, na chillaaya, is jaisi cheez to nazar-andaaz ki jaati hai?" To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Yeh to kaahinon ke bhaiyon mein se hai," uske us tuqaafiye ki wajah se jo usne kaha tha.
