17.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Salt ne Hibban ibn Ali se, Yunus aur Uqayl se, Ibn Shihab se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Behtareen saathi chaar hain, aur behtareen lashkar chaar hazaar, aur behtareen dasta chaar sau, aur jo bhi baarah hazaar tak pahunche, agar woh sabr karein, aur sachche rahein, to woh kam tadaad ki wajah se maghloob nahi hoga."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَمَّرَ رَجُلًا عَلَى سَرِيَّةٍ أَوْصَاهُ فِي خَاصَّةِ نَفْسِهِ بِتَقْوَى اللَّهِ، وَبِمَنْ مَعَهُ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ خَيْرًا، وَقَالَ :" اغْزُوا بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَفِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، قَاتِلُوا مَنْ كَفَرَ بِاللَّهِ، اغْزُوا وَلَا تَغْدِرُوا، وَلَا تَغُلُّوا، وَلَا تُمَثِّلُوا، وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا وَلِيدًا "
17.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Alqamah ibn Marthad, from Sulayman ibn Buraydah, from his father: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he appointed a man in command of an expeditionary force, would advise him particularly to fear Allah, and to treat well the Muslims with him, and would say: "Fight in the name of Allah, and in the path of Allah, fight those who disbelieve in Allah, fight but do not betray, and do not embezzle spoils, and do not mutilate, and do not kill a child."
17.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Alqamah ibn Marthad se, Sulayman ibn Buraydah se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ jab kisi aadmi ko kisi dastay ka ameer banaate, to usay khaas tor par Allah ka taqwa rakhne ki, aur uske saath ke Musalmanon ke saath achha sulook karne ki wasiyat karte, aur farmaate: "Allah ke naam se jang karo, aur Allah ki raah mein, un logon se lado jo Allah ka inkaar karte hain, jang karo lekin dagha na do, aur ghaneemat mein khiyanat na karo, aur muslah (jism bigaadna) na karo, aur kisi bacche ko qatal na karo."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَا تَتَمَنَّوْا لِقَاءَ الْعَدُوِّ، وَسَلُوا اللَّهَ الْعَافِيَةَ، فَإِنْ لَقِيتُمُوهُمْ، فَاثْبُتُوا، وَأَكْثِرُوا ذِكْرَ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ أَجْلَبُوا وَضَجُّوا، فَعَلَيْكُمْ بِالصَّمْتِ "
17.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Ziyad, from Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Abdullah ibn Amr: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do not wish to meet the enemy, and ask Allah for well-being, but if you meet them, then stand firm, and increase remembrance of Allah, and if they make a clamor and outcry, then hold to silence."
17.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid ne Abd al-Rahman ibn Ziyad se, Abdullah ibn Yazid se, Abdullah ibn Amr se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Dushman se milne ki tamanna na karo, aur Allah se aafiyat maango, lekin agar tum unse milo, to sabit-qadam raho, aur Allah ka zikr zyada karo, aur agar woh shor-o-gul aur cheekhein karein, to khamosh raho."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، عَنْ صُهَيْبٍ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَدْعُو أَيَّامَ حُنَيْنٍ :" اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أُحَاوِلُ، وَبِكَ أُصَاوِلُ، وَبِكَ أُقَاتِلُ "
17.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad, from Thabit, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla, from Suhayb: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to supplicate during the days of Hunayn: "O Allah, by You I strive, and by You I attack, and by You I fight."
17.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad se, Thabit se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla se, Suhayb se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ Hunayn ke dinon mein dua kiya karte: "Allahumma bika uhaawilu, wa bika usaawilu, wa bika uqaatil" [Ae Allah, tere hi sahaare koshish karta hoon, aur tere hi sahaare hamla karta hoon, aur tere hi sahaare jang karta hoon].

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَمَّرَ رَجُلًا عَلَى سَرِيَّةٍ أَوْصَاهُ :" إِذَا لَقِيتَ عَدُوَّكَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، فَادْعُهُمْ إِلَى إِحْدَى ثَلَاثِ خِلَالٍ أَوْ ثَلاثِ خِصَالٍ فَأَيَّتُهُمْ مَا أَجَابُوكَ إِلَيْهَا، فَاقْبَلْ مِنْهُمْ وَكُفَّ عَنْهُمْ ثُمَّ ادْعُهُمْ إِلَى الْإِسْلَامِ، فَإِنْ هُمْ أَجَابُوكَ فَاقْبَلْ مِنْهُمْ وَكُفَّ عَنْهُمْ، ثُمَّ ادْعُهُمْ إِلَى التَّحَوُّلِ مِنْ دَارِهِمْ إِلَى دَارِ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ، وَأَخْبِرْهُمْ إِنْ هُمْ فَعَلُوا أَنَّ لَهُمْ مَا لِلْمُهَاجِرِينَ، وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا عَلَى الْمُهَاجِرِينَ، فَإِنْ هُمْ أَبَوْا، فَأَخْبِرْهُمْ أَنَّهُمْ يَكُونُونَ كَأَعْرَابِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، يَجْرِي عَلَيْهِمْ حُكْمُ اللَّهِ الَّذِي يَجْرِي عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَيْسَ لَهُمْ فِي الْفَيْءِ وَالْغَنِيمَةِ نَصِيبٌ إِلَّا أَنْ يُجَاهِدُوا مَعَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ.
فَإِنْ هُمْ أَبَوْا أَنْ يَدْخُلُوا فِي الْإِسْلامِ، فَسَلْهُمْ إِعْطَاءَ الْجِزْيَةِ، فَإِنْ فَعَلُوا، فَاقْبَلْ مِنْهُمْ وَكُفَّ عَنْهُمْ، فَإِنْ هُمْ أَبَوْا، فَاسْتَعِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَقَاتِلْهُمْ.
 وَإِنْ حَاصَرْتَ أَهْلَ حِصْنٍ، فَإِنْ أَرَادُوكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ لَهُمْ ذِمَّةَ اللَّهِ وَذِمَّةَ نَبِيِّهِ، فَلَا تَجْعَلْ لَهُمْ ذِمَّةَ اللَّهِ، وَلَا ذِمَّةَ نَبِيِّهِ، وَلَكِنْ اجْعَلْ لَهُمْ ذِمَّتَكَ وَذِمَّةَ أَبِيكَ، وَذِمَّةَ أَصْحَابِكَ، فَإِنَّكُمْ إِنْ تُخْفِرُوا بِذِمَّتِكُمْ وَذِمَّةِ آبَائِكُمْ، أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ أَنْ تُخْفِرُوا ذِمَّةَ اللَّهِ وَذِمَّةَ رَسُولِهِ.
وَإِنْ حَاصَرْتَ حِصْنًا فَأَرَادُوكَ أَنْ يَنْزِلُوا عَلَى حُكْمِ اللَّهِ، فَلَا تُنْزِلْهُمْ عَلَى حُكْمِ اللَّهِ، وَلَكِنْ أَنْزِلْهُمْ عَلَى حُكْمِكَ، فَإِنَّكَ لَا تَدْرِي أَتُصِيبُ حُكْمَ اللَّهِ فِيهِمْ أَمْ لا، ثُمَّ اقْضِ فِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ ".
قَالَ عَلْقَمَةُ  : فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ مُقَاتِلَ بْنَ حَيَّانَ  ، فَقَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي مُسْلِمُ بْنُ هَيْصَمٍ  ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ مُقَرِّنٍ   ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِثْلَهُ
17.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Alqamah ibn Marthad, from Sulayman ibn Buraydah, from his father; with Alqamah's added note: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he appointed a man in command of an expeditionary force, would advise him: "When you meet your enemy from among the polytheists, call them to one of three qualities, or three things, whichever of them they respond to you with, accept it from them and hold back from them, then call them to Islam, so if they respond to you, accept it from them and hold back from them, then call them to move from their land to the land of the Emigrants, and inform them that if they do that, they will have what the Emigrants have, and what is due upon the Emigrants will be due upon them, but if they refuse, inform them that they will be like the Bedouins among the Muslims, the judgment of Allah which applies to the believers will apply to them, but they will have no share in the war-booty and spoils unless they fight along with the Muslims. But if they refuse to enter Islam, then ask them for the jizyah, so if they do that, accept it from them and hold back from them, but if they refuse, then seek Allah's help and fight them. And if you besiege the people of a fortress, and they want you to grant them the protection of Allah and the protection of His Prophet, do not grant them the protection of Allah, nor the protection of His Prophet, but grant them your own protection and the protection of your father, and the protection of your companions, for if you violate your own protection and that of your fathers, it is lighter upon you than that you violate the protection of Allah and the protection of His Messenger. And if you besiege a fortress and they want you to let them descend upon the judgment of Allah, do not let them descend upon the judgment of Allah, but let them descend upon your own judgment, for you do not know whether you will hit upon Allah's judgment concerning them or not, then decide concerning them whatever you wish." Alqamah said: So I narrated it to Muqatil ibn Hayyan, so he said: Muslim ibn Haysam narrated to me, from al-Nu'man ibn Muqarrin, from the Prophet ﷺ, the like of it.
17.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Alqamah ibn Marthad se, Sulayman ibn Buraydah se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ jab kisi aadmi ko kisi dastay ka ameer banaate, to usay wasiyat karte: "Jab tum apne mushrik dushman se milo, to unhein teen cheezon mein se ek ki taraf bulaao, jo bhi woh qabool karein, unse le lo aur unse ruk jao, fir unhein Islam ki taraf bulaao, agar woh qabool karein, to unse le lo aur unse ruk jao, fir unhein apni zameen chhodkar muhajireen ki zameen mein aane ki dawat do, aur unhein bataao ke agar woh aisa karein, to unhein woh milega jo muhajireen ko milta hai, aur unpar wahi zimmedaari hogi jo muhajireen par hai, lekin agar woh inkaar karein, to unhein bataao ke woh Musalmanon ke Bedouin jaise honge, unpar Allah ka wahi hukum lagu hoga jo momino par lagu hota hai, lekin unhein maal-e-ghaneemat mein koi hissa nahi milega jab tak woh Musalmanon ke saath jang na karein. Lekin agar woh Islam mein dakhil hone se inkaar karein, to unse jizya maango, agar woh aisa karein, to unse le lo aur unse ruk jao, lekin agar woh inkaar karein, to Allah ki madad maango aur unse jang karo. Aur agar tum kisi qile ke logon ko gher lo, aur woh chaahein ke tum unhein Allah ki panah aur uske Nabi ki panah do, to unhein Allah ki panah na do, na uske Nabi ki panah, balke unhein apni panah do aur apne baap ki panah, aur apne sathiyon ki panah, kyunki agar tum apni panah aur apne baapon ki panah todo, to yeh tumhare liye Allah ki panah aur uske Rasool ki panah todne se halka hai. Aur agar tum kisi qile ko gher lo aur woh chaahein ke Allah ke hukum par utrein, to unhein Allah ke hukum par mat utaaro, balke apne hukum par utaaro, kyunki tumhein nahi maloom ke tum unke baare mein Allah ke hukum ko sahi paaoge ya nahi, fir unke baare mein jo chaho faisla karo." Alqamah kehte hain: To maine ise Muqatil ibn Hayyan ko bataaya, to unhone kaha: Mujhse Muslim ibn Haysam ne bataya, al-Nu'man ibn Muqarrin se, Nabi ﷺ se, isi jaisi.

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ :" مَا قَاتَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَوْمًا حَتَّى دَعَاهُمْ "، قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : سُفْيَانُ لَمْ يَسْمَعْ مِنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ يَعْنِي : هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ
17.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Sufyan, from Ibn Abi Najih, from his father, from Ibn Abbas; with Abdullah al-Darimi's note: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never fought a people until he had called them [to Islam]." Abdullah said: Sufyan did not hear from Ibn Abi Najih, meaning: this hadith.
17.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Sufyan se, Ibn Abi Najih se, apne walid se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne kisi qaum se jang nahi ki jab tak unhein bulaaya na ho." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Sufyan ne Ibn Abi Najih se yeh hadith nahi suni [yaani, yeh sanad munqata' hai].

17.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" يُغِيرُ عِنْدَ صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ، وَكَانَ يَسْتَمِعُ، فَإِنْ سَمِعَ أَذَانًا، أَمْسَكَ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْ أَذَانًا، أَغَارَ "
17.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Thabit, from Anas: That the Prophet ﷺ used to "raid at the time of the Fajr prayer, and he used to listen, so if he heard an adhan, he would refrain, and if he did not hear an adhan, he would raid."
17.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Thabit se, Anas se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ "Fajr ki namaz ke waqt hamla karte, aur aap sunte, agar aapko azaan sunaayi deti, to woh ruk jaate, aur agar azaan nahi sunaayi deti, to hamla karte."

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَوْسَ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْسٍ الثَّقَفِيَّ  ، قَالَ : أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي وَفْدِ ثَقِيفٍ، قَالَ : وَكُنْتُ فِي أَسْفَلِ الْقُبَّةِ لَيْسَ فِيهَا أَحَدٌ إِلا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَائِمٌ إِذْ أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَسَارَّهُ، فَقَالَ : " اذْهَبْ فَاقْتُلْهُ "، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " أَلَيْسَ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ؟ ".
قَالَ شُعْبَةُ : وَأَشُكُّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ؟.
قَالَ : بَلَى.
قَالَ :" إِنِّي أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُقَاتِلَ النَّاسَ حَتَّى يَقُولُوا : لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، فَإِذَا قَالُوهَا، حَرُمَتْ عَلَيَّ دِمَاؤُهُمْ وَأَمْوَالُهُمْ إِلا بِحَقِّهَا ".
 قَالَ : وَهُوَ الَّذِي قَتَلَ أَبَا مَسْعُودٍ.
قَالَ : وَمَا مَاتَ حَتَّى قَتَلَ خَيْرَ إِنْسَانٍ بِالطَّائِفِ
17.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from al-Nu'man ibn Salim, from Aws ibn Abi Aws al-Thaqafi: He said: I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the delegation of Thaqif, he said: And I was at the lower part of the tent, no one in it except the Prophet ﷺ, asleep, when a man came to him and whispered to him, so he said: "Go and kill him," then he said: "Does he not testify that there is no god but Allah?" Shu'bah said: And I am uncertain [whether he also said]: "and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah?" He said, "Indeed." He said: "I was commanded to fight the people until they say: There is no god but Allah, and when they say it, their blood and their wealth become forbidden to me, except by its right." He said: And he is the one who killed Abu Mas'ud. He said: And he did not die until he had killed the best of people at al-Ta'if.
17.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se, al-Nu'man ibn Salim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Aws ibn Abi Aws al-Thaqafi ko kehte suna: Unhone kaha, Main Thaqif ke wafd mein Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaya, unhone bataya: Aur main khaymay ke niche wale hisse mein tha, jismein Nabi ﷺ ke siwa koi nahi tha, aap so rahe the, ke ek aadmi aapke paas aaya aur aapse sargoshi ki, to aapne farmaya: "Jao aur usay qatal karo," fir farmaya: "Kya woh gawahi nahi deta ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi?" Shu'bah kehte hain: Aur mujhe shak hai [ke aapne yeh bhi kaha]: "aur ke Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain?" Usne kaha, "Zaroor." Aapne farmaya: "Mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke main logon se ladun yahan tak ke woh kahein: Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur jab woh yeh kahein, to unka khoon aur unka maal mujhpar haraam ho jaayega, siwaay iske haq ke." Unhone bataya: Aur yehi woh hai jisne Abu Mas'ud ko qatal kiya. Unhone bataya: Aur woh tab tak nahi mara jab tak usne Ta'if mein sabse behtareen aadmi ko qatal na kar diya.

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا يَحِلُّ دَمُ رَجُلٍ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ إِلَّا إِحْدَى ثَلَاثَةِ نَفَرٍ : النَّفْسُ بِالنَّفْسِ، وَالثَّيِّبُ الزَّانِي، وَالتَّارِكُ لِدِينِهِ الْمُفَارِقُ لِلْجَمَاعَةِ "
17.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from al-A'mash, from Abdullah ibn Murrah, from Masruq, from Abdullah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The blood of a man who testifies that there is no god but Allah is not lawful except for one of three: a life for a life, the previously-married adulterer, and the one who leaves his religion, separating from the community."
17.hi: Ya'la ne al-A'mash se, Abdullah ibn Murrah se, Masruq se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Us aadmi ka khoon halal nahi jo gawahi de ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, siwaay teen mein se ek ke: jaan ke badle jaan, aur shaadi-shuda zaani, aur woh jo apna deen chhod de, jama'at se alag ho jaaye."

17.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ شَيْبَانَ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ سُمَيْرٍ  ، قَالَ : قَدِمَ عَلَيْنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَبَاحٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ  ، وَكَانَتْ الْأَنْصَارُ تُفَقِّهُهُ.
قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو قَتَادَةَ   : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " بَعَثَ جَيْشَ الْأُمَرَاءِ، قَالَ : فَانْطَلَقُوا فَلَبِثُوا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ، ثُمَّ صَعِدَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْمِنْبَرَ،فَأَمَرَ فَنُودِيَ : الصَّلَاةُ جَامِعَةٌ "
17.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from al-Aswad ibn Shayban, from Khalid ibn Sumayr, about Abdullah ibn Rabah al-Ansari and Abu Qatadah: He said: Abdullah ibn Rabah al-Ansari came to us, and the Ansar used to consult him for understanding. He said: Abu Qatadah narrated to us: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "sent the army of the commanders," he said: So they set off and stayed as long as Allah willed, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ascended the pulpit, and commanded, so it was announced: "The prayer, gathering [together, i.e. for a general assembly]."
17.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne al-Aswad ibn Shayban se, Khalid ibn Sumayr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ibn Rabah al-Ansari humare paas aaye, aur Ansar unse fiqh seekha karte the. Unhone bataya: Humein Abu Qatadah ne bataya: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "ameeron ka lashkar bheja," unhone bataya: To woh chal pade aur jitni der Allah ne chaaha thehre, fir Rasulullah ﷺ mimbar par chadhe, aur hukum diya, to elaan kiya gaya: "Namaz, sabko ikattha karo."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الْأَنْصَارِيّ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" الْمُسْتَشَارُ مُؤْتَمَنٌ "
17.en: Narrated by al-Aswad ibn Amir, from Sharik, from al-A'mash, from Abu Amr al-Shaybani, from Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "The one consulted is trusted."
17.hi: Al-Aswad ibn Amir ne Sharik se, al-A'mash se, Abu Amr al-Shaybani se, Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Mashwara diya jaane wala ameen (bharosemand) hota hai."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْحِزَامِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" إِذَا أَرَادَ غَزْوَةً وَرَّى بِغَيْرِهَا "
17.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Hizami, from Ibn al-Mubarak, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Ka'b ibn Malik, from Ka'b ibn Malik: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, "when he intended an expedition, would give a false impression [of another destination] than it."
17.hi: Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Hizami ne Ibn al-Mubarak se, Ma'mar se, al-Zuhri se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Ka'b ibn Malik se, Ka'b ibn Malik se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ "jab kisi ghazwe ka irada karte, to iske ilaawa kisi aur ka zaahir karte [jang ki soorat ko chhupaane ke liye]."

17.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عُمَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ إِيَاسِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الْأَكْوَعِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : " بَارَزْتُ رَجُلًا فَقَتَلْتُهُ،فَنَفَّلَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سَلَبَهُ ، فَكَانَ شِعَارُنَا مَعَ خَالِدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ : أَمِتْ، يَعْنِي : اقْتُلْ "
17.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Waki', from Abu Umays, from Iyas ibn Salamah ibn al-Akwa', from his father: He said: "I dueled with a man and killed him, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave me his spoils, and our slogan with Khalid ibn al-Walid was: 'Amit,' meaning: kill."
17.hi: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ne Waki' se, Abu Umays se, Iyas ibn Salamah ibn al-Akwa' se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Maine ek aadmi se muqabla kiya aur usay maar diya, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhe uska saaman ina'am mein diya, aur Khalid ibn al-Walid ke saath humara nara tha: 'Amit,' yaani: maaro."

17.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، وَعَفَّانُ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ أَبِي هَمَّامٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْفِهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي غَزْوَةِ حُنَيْنٍ، فَكُنَّا فِي يَوْمٍ قَائِظٍ شَدِيدِ الْحَرِّ، فَنَزَلْنَا تَحْتَ ظِلَالِ الشَّجَرِ، .
..
..
. فَذَكَرَ الْقِصَّةَ، ثُمَّ أَخَذَ كَفًّا مِنْ تُرَابٍ، قَالَ : فَحَدَّثَنِي الَّذِي هُوَ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنِّي أَنَّهُ ضَرَبَ بِهِ وُجُوهَهُمْ، وَقَالَ :" شَاهَتِ الْوُجُوهُ " فَهَزَمَ اللَّهُ الْمُشْرِكِينَ.
قَالَ يَعْلَى : فَحَدَّثَنِي أَبْنَاؤُهُمْ أَنَّ أَبَاءَهُمْ.
قَالُوا : فَمَا بَقِيَ مِنَّا أَحَدٌ إِلا امْتَلَأَتْ عَيْنَاهُ وَفَمُهُ تُرَابًا
17.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, and Affan, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ya'la ibn Ata, from Abdullah ibn Yasar Abu Hammam, from Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Fihri; with Ya'la's added note: He said: We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the expedition of Hunayn, and we were on a scorching hot day, so we descended under the shade of trees ... [and he mentioned the story], then he took a handful of dust, he said: So the one closer to him than me narrated to me that he struck their faces with it, and said: "May the faces be disfigured," so Allah routed the polytheists. Ya'la said: So their sons narrated to me that their fathers said: "None of us remained except that his eyes and mouth were filled with dust."
17.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal aur Affan ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ya'la ibn Ata se, Abdullah ibn Yasar Abu Hammam se, Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Fihri se bataya: Unhone kaha, Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath ghazwa-e-Hunayn mein the, to hum ek garmi bhare din mein the, so hum darakhton ke saaye mein utre ... [aur unhone qissa zikr kiya], fir aapne mitti ka ek mutthi liya, unhone bataya: To mujhse us shakhs ne bataya jo mujhse aapke zyada qareeb tha ke aapne isse unke chehron par maara, aur farmaya: "Chehre bigad jaayein," to Allah ne mushrikon ko shikast di. Ya'la kehte hain: To mujhse unke beton ne bataya ke unke walid ne kaha: "Humme se koi bhi aisa nahi bacha jiski aankhein aur muh mitti se bhar na gaya ho."

17.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ  ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَنَحْنُ مَعَهُ فِي مَجْلِسٍ :" بَايِعُونِي عَلَى أَنْ لا تُشْرِكُوا بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا، وَلَا تَسْرِقُوا، وَلَا تَزْنُوا، وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا أَوْلَادَكُمْ، وَلَا تَأْتُوا بِبُهْتَانٍ تَفْتَرُونَهُ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَأَرْجُلِكُمْ، فَمَنْ وَفَى مِنْكُمْ، فَأَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَمَنْ أَصَابَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا، فَسَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ، فَأَمْرُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ، إِنْ شَاءَ، عَاقَبَهُ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ عَفَا عَنْهُ، وَمَنْ أَصَابَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا فَعُوقِبَ بِهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا، فَهُوَ كَفَّارَةٌ لَهُ ".
قَالَ : فَبَايَعْنَاهُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ
17.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Yunus, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Idris, from Ubadah ibn al-Samit: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to us while we were with him in a gathering: "Pledge allegiance to me that you will not associate anything with Allah, and not steal, and not commit adultery, and not kill your children, and not bring a slander that you fabricate between your hands and your feet [i.e., knowingly], for whoever among you fulfills that, his reward is upon Allah, and whoever falls into any of that, and Allah conceals it, then his matter is to Allah: if He wills, He punishes him, and if He wills, He pardons him, and whoever falls into any of that and is punished for it in this world, it is an expiation for him." He said: So we pledged allegiance to him upon that.
17.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Yunus se, al-Zuhri se, Abu Idris se, Ubadah ibn al-Samit se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne humse farmaya jabke hum aapke saath ek majlis mein the: "Mujhse is baat par bay'at karo ke tum Allah ke saath kisi cheez ko shareek na karoge, aur chori na karoge, aur zina na karoge, aur apni aulaad ko qatal na karoge, aur apne haathon aur pairon ke darmiyan koi jhoothi tuhmat gadh kar na laoge, so jo tum mein se ise poora kare, uska ajr Allah par hai, aur jo isme se kisi cheez mein giraftar ho, aur Allah ise chhupaaye, to uska maamla Allah ke supurd hai: agar woh chahe, to usay saza de, aur agar woh chahe, to usay maaf kar de, aur jo isme se kisi cheez mein giraftar ho aur duniya mein isi ki saza paaye, to yeh uske liye kaffara hai." Unhone bataya: To humne isi par aapse bay'at ki.

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" كُنَّا يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ أَلْفًا وَأَرْبَعَ مِائَةٍ، فَبَايَعْنَاهُ وَعُمَرُ آخِذٌ بِيَدِهِ تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ وَهِيَ : سَمُرَةٌ ، وَقَالَ : بَايَعْنَاهُ عَلَى أَنْ لَا نَفِرّ، وَلَمْ نُبَايِعْهُ عَلَى الْمَوْتِ "
17.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Layth ibn Sa'd, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ibn Abdullah: That he said: "We were, on the day of al-Hudaybiyyah, one thousand four hundred, so we pledged allegiance to him, and Umar was holding his hand beneath the tree, which was a samurah tree, and he said: We pledged allegiance to him that we would not flee, and we did not pledge allegiance to him upon death."
17.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Layth ibn Sa'd se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir ibn Abdullah se bataya: ke unhone kaha, "Hum Hudaybiyyah ke din ek hazaar chaar sau the, so humne aapse bay'at ki jabke Umar aapka haath pakde hue the darakht ke neeche, jo samurah ka darakht tha, aur unhone kaha: Humne aapse is baat par bay'at ki ke hum nahi bhaagenge, aur humne aapse maut par bay'at nahi ki."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاق  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ  ، يَقُولُ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَنْقُلُ مَعَنَا التُّرَابَ يَوْمَ الْأَحْزَابِ، وَقَدْ " وَارَى التُّرَابُبَيَاضَ إِبِطَيْهِ "، وَهُوَ يَقُولُ : اللَّهُمَّ لَوْلَا أَنْتَ مَا اهْتَدَيْنَا وَلَا تَصَدَّقْنَا وَلَا صَلَّيْنَا فَأَنْزِلَنَّ سَكِينَةً عَلَيْنَا وَثَبِّتْ الْأَقْدَامَ إِنْ لَاقَيْنَا إِنَّ الْأُلَى قَدْ بَغَوْا عَلَيْنَا وَإِنْ أَرَادُوا فِتْنَةً أَبَيْنَا وَيَرْفَعُ بِهَا صَوْتَهُ
17.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Bara' ibn Azib: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to carry earth with us on the day of al-Ahzab, and "the earth had covered the whiteness of his armpits," while he was saying: "O Allah, were it not for You we would not have been guided, nor given charity, nor prayed, so send down tranquility upon us, and make our feet firm if we meet [the enemy]; indeed those [others] have transgressed against us, and if they intend a trial, we refuse," raising his voice with it.
17.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se bataya: Humein Abu Ishaq ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Bara' ibn Azib ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ghazwa-e-Ahzab ke din humare saath mitti dhoya karte the, aur "mitti ne aapki bagalon ki safedi chhupa di thi," jabke aap farmaate: "Allahumma law laa anta maa-hatadaynaa wa laa tasaddaqnaa wa laa sallaynaa, fa-anzilan sakeenatan 'alaynaa wa thabbitil-aqdaama in laaqaynaa, innal-ulaa qad baghaw 'alaynaa, wa in araadu fitnatan abaynaa" [Ae Allah, agar tu na hota to hum hidayat na paate, na sadqa dete, na namaz padhte, so humpar sukoon utaar aur humare qadam jamaaye rakh agar humaari mulaqaat ho; beshak in logon ne humpar zulm kiya hai, aur agar woh fitna chahein, to hum inkaar karte hain], aur apni awaaz isme bulund karte.

17.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ خَالِدِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ دَخَلَ مَكَّةَ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ وَعَلَى رَأْسِهِ مِغْفَرٌ، فَلَمَّا نَزَعَهُ، جَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ،" هَذَا ابْنُ خَطَلٍ مُتَعَلِّقٌ بِأَسْتَارِ الْكَعْبَةِ ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : اقْتُلُوهُ "
17.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Khalid ibn Hazim, from Malik, from al-Zuhri, from Anas: That the Prophet ﷺ entered Makkah in the year of the Conquest with a helmet on his head, so when he took it off, a man came to him, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, this is Ibn Khatal clinging to the coverings of the Ka'bah," so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Kill him."
17.hi: Abdullah ibn Khalid ibn Hazim ne Malik se, al-Zuhri se, Anas se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ Fateh ke saal Makkah mein dakhil hue jabke aapke sar par khod (helmet) thi, so jab aapne use utaara, to ek aadmi aapke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, yeh Ibn Khatal hai jo Ka'bah ke gilaaf se chimta hua hai," to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Isay qatal karo."

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ،  عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : " كَانَقَبِيعَةُ سَيْفِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ ".
 قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتَوَائِيُّ  خَالَفَهُ.
قَالَ : قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ   ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَزَعَمَ النَّاسُ أَنَّهُ هُوَ الْمَحْفُوظُ
17.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Jarir ibn Hazim, from Qatadah, from Anas; with Abdullah al-Darimi's note: He said: "The pommel of the Prophet's ﷺ sword was of silver." Abdullah said: Hisham al-Dastawa'i differed from him. He said: Qatadah, from Sa'id ibn Abi al-Hasan, from the Prophet ﷺ, and people claim that it is the [more] preserved [version].
17.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Jarir ibn Hazim se, Qatadah se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Nabi ﷺ ki talwar ka qabza chandi ka tha." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Hisham al-Dastawa'i ne unse ikhtilaaf kiya. Unhone kaha: Qatadah, Sa'id ibn Abi al-Hasan se, Nabi ﷺ se, aur log dawa karte hain ke yehi zyada mahfooz [riwayat] hai.

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ   : أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ " إِذَا ظَهَرَ عَلَى قَوْمٍأَحَبَّ أَنْ يُقِيمَ بِعَرْصَتِهِمْ ثَلَاثًا "
17.en: Narrated by al-Mu'alla ibn Asad, from Mu'adh ibn Mu'adh, from Sa'id ibn Abi Arubah, from Qatadah, from Anas, from Abu Talhah: That the Prophet ﷺ used to "when he prevailed over a people, love to stay in their courtyard for three [days]."
17.hi: Al-Mu'alla ibn Asad ne Mu'adh ibn Mu'adh se, Sa'id ibn Abi Arubah se, Qatadah se, Anas se, Abu Talhah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ "jab kisi qaum par ghaalib aate, to unke aangan mein teen din thehrna pasand karte."

17.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" حَرَّقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَخْلَ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ "
17.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Uqbah ibn Khalid, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ burned the palm-trees of Banu al-Nadir."
17.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Uqbah ibn Khalid se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Banu al-Nadir ki khajoorein jala din."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق الدَّوْسِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ الدَّوْسِيِّ  ، قَالَ : بَعَثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي سَرِيَّةٍ، فَقَالَ : " إِنْ ظَفِرْتُمْ بِفُلَانٍ وَفُلَانٍ فَحَرِّقُوهُمَا بِالنَّارِ " حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ الْغَدُ، بَعَثَ إِلَيْنَا، فَقَالَ :" إِنِّي قَدْ كُنْتُ أَمَرْتُكُمْ بِتَحْرِيقِ هَذَيْنِ الرَّجُلَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَأَيْتُ أَنَّهُ لَا يَنْبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ أَنْ يُعَذِّبَ بِالنَّارِ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، فَإِنْ ظَفِرْتُمْ بِهِمَا، فَاقْتُلُوهُمَا "
17.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Umar ibn Aban, from Abd al-Rahim ibn Sulayman, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Bukayr ibn Abdullah al-Ashajj, from Abu Ishaq al-Dawsi, from Abu Hurairah al-Dawsi: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent us on an expedition, and said: "If you overcome so-and-so and so-and-so, burn them both with fire," until when it was the next day, he sent to us, and said: "I had commanded you to burn these two men, then I saw that it is not fitting for anyone to punish with fire except Allah, so if you overcome them, kill them."
17.hi: Abdullah ibn Umar ibn Aban ne Abd al-Rahim ibn Sulayman se bataya: Mujhse Muhammad ibn Ishaq ne bataya, Yazid ibn Abi Habib se, Bukayr ibn Abdullah al-Ashajj se, Abu Ishaq al-Dawsi se, Abu Hurairah al-Dawsi se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein ek dastay mein bheja, aur farmaya: "Agar tum fulaan aur fulaan par qaabu paao, to unhein aag mein jala do," yahan tak ke jab agla din hua, aapne humare paas bheja, aur farmaya: "Maine tumhein in do aadmiyon ko jalaane ka hukum diya tha, fir mujhe laga ke kisi ke liye munaasib nahi ke woh Allah ke siwa aag se saza de, so agar tum unpar qaabu pao, to unhein qatal kar do."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ هُوَ : ابْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : وُجِدَ فِي بَعْضِ مَغَازِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ امْرَأَةٌ مَقْتُولَةٌ " فَنَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْقَتْلِ النِّسَاءِ وَالصِّبْيَانِ "
17.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Ubaydullah ibn Umar ibn Hafs ibn Asim, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: In one of the expeditions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, a slain woman was found, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "forbade the killing of women and children."
17.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Ubaydullah ibn Umar ibn Hafs ibn Asim se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ke kisi ghazwe mein ek maari gayi aurat mili, "to Rasulullah ﷺ ne auraton aur bacchon ko qatal karne se mana kiya."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاق الْفَزَارِيُّ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ سَرِيعٍ  ، قَالَ : خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي غَزَاةٍ فَظَفِرَ بِالْمُشْرِكِينَ فَأَسْرَعَ النَّاسُ فِي الْقَتْلِ حَتَّى قَتَلُوا الذُّرِّيَّةَ، فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ :" مَا بَالُ أَقْوَامٍ ذَهَبَ بِهِمْ الْقَتْلُ حَتَّى قَتَلُوا الذُّرِّيَّةَ؟ أَلا لا تُقْتَلَنَّ ذُرِّيَّةً ثَلَاثًا "
17.en: Narrated by Asim ibn Yusuf, from Abu Ishaq al-Fazari, from Yunus ibn Ubayd, from al-Hasan, from al-Aswad ibn Sari': He said: We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on an expedition, and he overcame the polytheists, so the people hastened in killing until they killed the offspring [children], so that reached the Prophet ﷺ, and he said: "What is the matter with people who were carried away by killing until they killed the offspring? Beware, let no offspring be killed," three times.
17.hi: Asim ibn Yusuf ne Abu Ishaq al-Fazari se, Yunus ibn Ubayd se, al-Hasan se, al-Aswad ibn Sari' se bataya: Unhone kaha, Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath ek ghazwe mein nikle to aapne mushrikon par ghalba paaya, so log qatal karne mein jaldi karne lage yahan tak ke unhone bacchon ko bhi qatal kar diya, to yeh baat Nabi ﷺ tak pahunchi, to aapne farmaya: "Kuch logon ko kya hua ke woh qatal mein itna aage badh gaye ke bacchon ko bhi qatal kar diya? Sun lo, kabhi kisi bachche ko qatal na karna," teen martaba.

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ الْقُرَظِيِّ  ، قالَ :" عُرِضْنَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ، فَمَنْ أَنْبَتَ الشَّعْرَ، قُتِلَ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يُنْبِتْ، تُرِكَ "، فَكُنْتُ أَنَا مِمَّنْ لَمْ يُنْبِتْ الشَّعْرَ، فَلَمْ يَقْتُلُونِي.
يَعْنِي : يَوْمَ قُرَيْظَةَ
17.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr, from Atiyyah al-Qurazi: He said: "We were presented to the Prophet ﷺ that day, so whoever had grown [pubic] hair was killed, and whoever had not grown it, was left," so I was among those who had not grown hair, so they did not kill me. Meaning: the day of [Banu] Qurayzah.
17.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr se, Atiyyah al-Qurazi se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Us din humein Nabi ﷺ ke saamne pesh kiya gaya, so jiske [zair-e-naaf] baal ug aaye the, use qatal kiya gaya, aur jiske nahi uge the, use chhod diya gaya," so main un mein se tha jinke baal nahi uge the, so unhone mujhe qatal nahi kiya. Yaani: Banu Qurayzah ka din.

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" فُكُّوا الْعَانِيَ وَأَطْعِمُوا الْجَائِعَ "
17.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Abu Wa'il, from Abu Musa, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Free the captive, and feed the hungry."
17.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Mansur se, Abu Wa'il se, Abu Musa se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Qaidi ko azaad karo, aur bhookhe ko khilaao."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ  ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" فَادَى رَجُلًا بِرَجُلَيْنِ "
17.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah, from Abu al-Muhallab, from Imran ibn Husayn: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "ransomed a man for two men."
17.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ayyub se, Abu Qilabah se, Abu al-Muhallab se, Imran ibn Husayn se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "ek aadmi ko do aadmiyon ke badle chhudwaaya."

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ   : أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" أُعْطِيتُ خَمْسًا لَمْ يُعْطَهُنَّ نَبِيٌّ قَبْلِي : بُعِثْتُ إِلَى الْأَحْمَرِ وَالْأَسْوَدِ، وَجُعِلَتْ لِيَ الْأَرْضُ مَسْجِدًا وَطَهُورًا وَأُحِلَّتْ لِيَ الْغَنَائِمُ، وَلَمْ تَحِلَّ لِأَحَدٍ قَبْلِي، وَنُصِرْتُ بِالرُّعْبِ شَهْرًا، يُرْعَبُ مِنِّي الْعَدُوُّ مَسِيرَةَ شَهْرٍ.
وَقِيلَ لِي : سَلْ تُعْطَهْ.
فَاخْتَبَأْتُ دَعْوَتِي شَفَاعَةً لِأُمَّتِي، وَهِيَ نَائِلَةٌ مِنْكُمْ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى مَنْ لَمْ يُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا "
17.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hammad, from Abu Awanah, from Sulayman, from Mujahid, from Ubayd ibn Umayr, from Abu Dharr: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "I have been given five things which no prophet before me was given: I was sent to the red and the black, and the earth was made for me a place of prayer and purification, and the spoils of war were made lawful for me, and were not lawful for anyone before me, and I have been given victory through fear/awe for a month's journey, the enemy being awed of me a month's journey [distant]." And it was said to me: "Ask and you shall be given." So I saved my supplication as intercession for my nation, and it will reach, Allah willing, whoever among you did not associate anything with Allah.
17.hi: Yahya ibn Hammad ne Abu Awanah se, Sulayman se, Mujahid se, Ubayd ibn Umayr se, Abu Dharr se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Mujhe paanch cheezein di gayin jo mujhse pehle kisi Nabi ko nahi di gayin: Mujhe surkh aur kaale [sab logon] ki taraf bheja gaya, aur mere liye zameen namaz aur taharat ki jagah banaayi gayi, aur mere liye ghaneemat halal ki gayi, jo mujhse pehle kisi ke liye halal nahi thi, aur mujhe ek mahine ki masaafat ke rob se madad di gayi, dushman mujhse ek mahine ki masaafat tak khauf-zada rehta hai. Aur mujhse kaha gaya: 'Maango, tumhein diya jaayega.' So maine apni dua apni ummat ki shifa'at ke liye bacha kar rakhi hai, aur woh, Inshaallah, tum mein se har us shakhs ko milegi jisne Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi kiya."

17.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ  ، قَالَ :" قَسَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ غَنَائِمَ حُنَيْنٍ بِالْجِعِرَّانَةِ ".
قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ   فِي الْإِسْنَادِ
17.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Asim, from Abu Wa'il; with Abdullah al-Darimi's note: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ distributed the spoils of Hunayn at al-Ji'ranah." Abdullah said: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud is in the chain [i.e., this is his narration].
17.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Asim se, Abu Wa'il se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne Hunayn ki ghaneemat al-Ji'ranah mein taqseem ki." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud isi sanad mein hain.

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الرَّقِّيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ :" شَهِدْتُ فَتْحَ خَيْبَرَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَانْهَزَمَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ، فَوَقَعْنَا فِي رِحَالِهِمْ، فَابْتَدَرَ النَّاسُ مَا وَجَدُوا مِنْ جَزُورٍ.
قَالَ : فَلَمْ يَكُنْ ذَلِكَ بِأَسْرَعَ مِنْ أَنْ فَارَتِ الْقُدُورُ فَأَمَرَ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَأُكْفِئَتْ.
قَالَ : ثُمَّ قَسَمَ بَيْنَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَجَعَلَ لِكُلِّ عَشْرَةٍ شَاةً.
قَالَ : وَكَانَ بَنُو فُلَانٍ مَعَهُ تِسْعَةً، وَكُنْتُ وَحْدِي فَالْتَفَتُّ إِلَيْهِمْ فَكُنَّا عَشْرَةً بَيْنَنَا شَاةٌ "، قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ صَاحِبَكُمْ يَقُولُ : عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ : كَأَنَّهُ يَقُولُ : إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَحْفَظْهُ .
أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ زَيْدٍ وهُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ  ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَحْوَهُ، قَالَ : فَأُلِّفْتُ إِلَيْهِمْ.
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : الصَّوَابُ عِنْدِي مَا قَالَ زَكَرِيَّا فِي الْإِسْنَادِ
17.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Raqqi, from Ubaydullah ibn Amr, from Zayd, from al-Hakam, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla, from his father: He said: "I witnessed the conquest of Khaybar with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and the polytheists were routed, so we fell upon their belongings, and the people rushed to whatever camels they found." He said: So that was no sooner than when the pots boiled, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded regarding them and they were overturned. He said: Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ distributed among us, and made a sheep for every ten. He said: And the family of so-and-so were nine along with him, and I was alone, so I turned to them, so we were ten, a sheep between us.
17.hi: Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Raqqi ne Ubaydullah ibn Amr se, Zayd se, al-Hakam se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Main Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath Khaybar ki fatah mein maujood tha, aur mushrikon ko shikast hui, so hum unke saaman par gire, aur log jo bhi oont paate uski taraf daudte." Unhone bataya: To isse pehle ke degein ubalne lagti, Rasulullah ﷺ ne unke baare mein hukum diya aur unhein ulta diya gaya. Unhone bataya: Fir Rasulullah ﷺ ne humare darmiyan taqseem ki, aur har das ke liye ek bhed rakhi. Unhone bataya: Aur fulaan ka khaandaan unke saath nau tha, aur main akela tha, to main unki taraf muda, to hum das ho gaye, humare darmiyan ek bhed.

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي قَيْسُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ هُرْمُزَ  ، قَالَ : كَتَبَ نَجْدَةُ بَنُ عَامِرٍ L7874 إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   يَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ، فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ : " إِنَّكَ سَأَلْتَ عَنْ سَهْمِ ذِي الْقُرْبَى الَّذِي ذَكَرَ اللَّهُ، وَإِنَّا كُنَّانَرَى أَنَّ قَرَابَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ هُمْ، فَأَبَى ذَلِكَ عَلَيْنَا قَوْمُنَا "
17.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Jarir ibn Hazim, from Qays ibn Sa'd, from Yazid ibn Hurmuz: He said: Najdah ibn Amir wrote to Ibn Abbas asking him about some things, so he wrote to him: "You asked about the share of the near relatives which Allah mentioned, and we used to see that it belonged to the relatives of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, but our people refused us that."
17.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Jarir ibn Hazim se bataya: Mujhse Qays ibn Sa'd ne bataya, Yazid ibn Hurmuz se: Unhone kaha, Najdah ibn Amir ne Ibn Abbas ko likha unse kuch baaton ke baare mein poochte hue, to unhone unhein likha: "Tumne 'zaee-l-qurba' ke hisse ke baare mein poocha jiska Allah ne zikr kiya, aur hum samajhte the ke yeh Rasulullah ﷺ ke rishtedaron ka hai, lekin humari qaum ne humein isse rok diya."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَازِمٍ أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" أَسْهَمَ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ لِلْفَارِسِ ثَلَاثَةَ أَسْهُمٍ، وَلِلرَّاجِلِ سَهْمًا "، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، نَحْوَهُ
17.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Khazim Abu Mu'awiyah, from Ubaydullah ibn Umar, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar; a similar chain also via Muhammad ibn Yusuf: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "gave shares on the day of Khaybar, three shares for the horseman, and one share for the foot-soldier." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, the same.]
17.hi: Ishaq ibn Isa ne Muhammad ibn Khazim Abu Mu'awiyah se, Ubaydullah ibn Umar se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "Khaybar ke din hisse diye, sawaar ke liye teen hisse, aur paidal ke liye ek hissa." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Muhammad ibn Yusuf se, Sufyan se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bhi aayi hai.]

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ :" مَا شَهِدْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَغْنَمًا إِلَّا قَسَمَ لِي، إِلا يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ، فَإِنَّهَا كَانَتْ لِأَهْلِ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ خَاصَّةً، وَكَانَ أَبُو مُوسَى وَأَبُو هُرَيْرَةً جَاءَا بَيْنَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ وَخَيْبَرَ "
17.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ali ibn Zayd, from Ammar ibn Abi Ammar, from Abu Hurairah: He said: "I never witnessed spoils with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ except that he distributed [a share] to me, except on the day of Khaybar, for it was specifically for the people of al-Hudaybiyyah, and Abu Musa and Abu Hurairah came between al-Hudaybiyyah and Khaybar."
17.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ali ibn Zayd se, Ammar ibn Abi Ammar se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Maine kabhi Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath koi ghaneemat nahi dekhi jismein aapne mujhe hissa na diya ho, siwaay Khaybar ke din ke, kyunki woh khaas tor par Hudaybiyyah walon ke liye thi, aur Abu Musa aur Abu Hurairah Hudaybiyyah aur Khaybar ke darmiyan aaye the."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ خَلِيلٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَفْصٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ عُمَيْرٍ   مَوْلَى آبِي اللَّحْمِ، قَالَ : شَهِدْتُ خَيْبَرَ وَأَنَا عَبْدٌ مَمْلُوكٌ فَأَعْطَانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنْ خُرْثِيِّ الْمَتَاعِ، وَأَعْطَانِي سَيْفًا، فَقَالَ :" تَقَلَّدْ بِهَذَا "
17.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Khalil, from Hafs, from Muhammad ibn Zayd, from Umayr, freed servant of Abi al-Lahm: He said: I witnessed Khaybar while I was an owned slave, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave me from the miscellaneous goods, and gave me a sword, and said: "Gird yourself with this."
17.hi: Isma'il ibn Khalil ne Hafs se bataya: Humein Muhammad ibn Zayd ne bataya, Umayr se (Abi al-Lahm ke azaad kiye hue ghulam): Unhone kaha, Main Khaybar mein maujood tha jabke main ghulam tha, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhe chhoti-mothi cheezon mein se diya, aur mujhe ek talwar di, aur farmaya: "Ise apni kamar mein baandh lo."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حُمْيَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ  ، وَمَكْحُولٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَنَّهُ نَهَى أَنْتُبَاعَ السِّهَامُ حَتَّى تُقْسَم "
17.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Humayd, from Abu Usamah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid ibn Jabir, from al-Qasim, and Makhul, from Abu Umamah, from the Prophet ﷺ: That he forbade that the arrows [i.e., the shares determined by lot] be sold before they were distributed.
17.hi: Ahmad ibn Humayd ne Abu Usamah se bataya: Humein Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid ibn Jabir ne bataya, al-Qasim aur Makhul se, Abu Umamah se, Nabi ﷺ se: ke aapne mana kiya ke qura ke teer (hisse) taqseem hone se pehle beche jaayein.

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَرْزُوقٍ  مَوْلًى لِتُجِيبٍ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي حَنَشٌ الصَّنْعَانِيُّ  ، قَالَ : غَزَوْنَا الْمَغْرِبَ وَعَلَيْنَا رُوَيْفِعُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ فَافْتَتَحْنَا قَرْيَةً يُقَالُ لَهَا : جَرْبَةَ ، فَقَامَ فِينَا رُوَيْفِعُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ   خَطِيبًا، فَقَالَ : إِنِّي لَا أَقُومُ فِيكُمْ إِلَّا بما سَمِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَامَ فِينَا يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ حِينَ افْتَتَحْنَاهَا، فَقَالَ :" مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ، فَلَا يَأْتِيَنَّ شَيْئًا مِنَ السَّبْيِ حَتَّى يَسْتَبْرِئَهَا "
17.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Abu Marzuq, freed servant of Tujib, from Hanash al-San'ani, about Ruwayfi' ibn Thabit al-Ansari: He said: We raided the Maghrib, with Ruwayfi' ibn Thabit al-Ansari over us, and we conquered a village called Jarbah, so Ruwayfi' ibn Thabit al-Ansari stood among us delivering a sermon, and said: I only stand among you with what I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he stood among us on the day of Khaybar when we conquered it, and said: "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him not put anything of the captive [women] until he has verified she is free of pregnancy."
17.hi: Ahmad ibn Khalid ne Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, Yazid ibn Abi Habib se, Abu Marzuq se (Tujib ke azaad kiye hue ghulam) bataya: Humein Hanash al-San'ani ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Humne Maghrib mein jihad kiya, Ruwayfi' ibn Thabit al-Ansari humare ameer the, so humne Jarbah naam ki ek basti fatah ki, to Ruwayfi' ibn Thabit al-Ansari humare darmiyan khade hokar khutba dene lage, aur kaha: Main tum mein sirf wahi khada hokar kehta hoon jo maine Rasulullah ﷺ se suna, aap humare darmiyan Khaybar ke din khade hue jab humne usay fatah kiya, aur farmaya: "Jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta ho, woh kisi qaidi [aurat] ke paas tab tak na jaaye jab tak uske haamila na hone ki tasdeeq na kar le."

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَسَدُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ خُمَيْرٍ أَبِي عُمَرَ الشَّامِيِّ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ   : أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَأَى امْرَأَةً مُجِحَّةً يَعْنِي : حُبْلَى عَلَى بَابِ فُسْطَاطٍ ، فَقَالَ : " لَعَلَّهُ قَدْ أَلَمَّ بِهَا؟ ".
قَالُوا : نَعَمْ.
قَالَ :" لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ أَلْعَنَهُ لَعْنَةً تَدْخُلُ مَعَهُ قَبْرَهُ، كَيْفَ يُوَرِّثُهُ وَهُوَ لَا يَحِلُّ لَهُ، وَكَيْفَ يَسْتَخْدِمُهُ وَهُوَ لَا يَحِلُّ لَهُ "
17.en: Narrated by Asad ibn Musa, from Shu'bah, from Yazid ibn Khumayr Abu Umar al-Shami al-Hamdani, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Jubayr ibn Nufayr, from his father, from Abu al-Darda: That the Prophet ﷺ saw a pregnant woman at the door of a tent, and said: "Perhaps he has had relations with her?" They said, "Yes." He said: "I had indeed intended to curse him with a curse that would enter the grave with him, how can he make her child his heir when it is not lawful for him, and how can he make use of her services when it is not lawful for him?"
17.hi: Asad ibn Musa ne Shu'bah se bataya: Humein Yazid ibn Khumayr Abu Umar al-Shami al-Hamdani ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abd al-Rahman ibn Jubayr ibn Nufayr ko suna, apne walid se, Abu al-Darda se: ke Nabi ﷺ ne ek khaymay ke darwaze par ek haamila aurat dekhi, aur farmaya: "Shayad usne iske saath sohbat ki hai?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Aapne farmaya: "Maine irada kiya tha ke main usay aisi lanat karun jo uske saath qabr mein bhi jaaye, woh iske bachche ko apna waaris kaise banaayega jabke yeh uske liye halal nahi, aur woh iski khidmat kaise le jabke yeh uske liye halal nahi?"

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، قِرَاءَةً، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جُنَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيِّ  : أَنَّ أَبَا أَيُّوبَ   كَانَ فِي جَيْشٍ فَفُرِّقَ بَيْنَ الصِّبْيَانِ وَبَيْنَ أُمَّهَاتِهِمْ، فَرَآهُمْ يَبْكُونَ، فَجَعَلَ يَرُدُّ الصَّبِيَّ إِلَى أُمِّهِ.
وَيَقُولُ : إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ فَرَّقَ بَيْنَ الْوَالِدَةِ وَوَلَدِهَا، فَرَّقَ اللَّهُ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْأَحِبَّاءِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ "
17.en: Narrated by al-Qasim ibn Kathir, from al-Layth ibn Sa'd, reading, from Abdullah ibn Junadah, from Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Hubuli: That Abu Ayyub was in an army, and the children were separated from their mothers, so he saw them crying, and he began returning each child to his mother, and saying: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever separates a mother from her child, Allah will separate him from his loved ones on the Day of Resurrection."
17.hi: Al-Qasim ibn Kathir ne al-Layth ibn Sa'd se bataya, unke saamne padha gaya: Abdullah ibn Junadah se, Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Hubuli se: ke Abu Ayyub ek lashkar mein the, to bacchon ko unki maaon se alag kar diya gaya, to unhone unhein rote hue dekha, aur woh har bachche ko uski maa ke paas wapas karne lage, aur kehte: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo kisi maa ko uske bachche se alag kare, Allah usay Qayamat ke din uske mehboobon se alag kar dega."

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَجَلِيُّ  ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ  ، عَنْ صَخْرِ بْنِ الْعَيْلَةِ  ، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ : الْغِيلَةِ .
قَالَ : أَخَذْتُ عَمَّةَ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، فَقَدِمْتُ بِهَا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَسَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَمَّتَهُ، فَقَالَ : " يَا صَخْرُ، إِنَّ الْقَوْمَ إِذَا أَسْلَمُوا، أَحْرَزُوا أَمْوَالَهُمْ وَدِمَاءَهُمْ، فَادْفَعْهَا إِلَيْهِ ".
وَكَانَ مَاءٌ لِبَنِي سُلَيْمٍ، فَأَسْلَمُوا فَأَتَوْهُ فَسَأَلُوهُ ذَلِكَ، فَدَعَانِي، فَقَالَ : " يَا صَخْرُ، إِنَّالْقَوْمَ إِذَا أَسْلَمُوا، أَحْرَزُوا أَمْوَالَهُمْ وَدِمَاءَهُمْ، فَادْفَعْهُ إِلَيْهِمْ "فَدَفَعْتُهُ
17.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Aban ibn Abdullah al-Bajali, from Uthman ibn Abi Hazim, from Sakhr ibn al-Aylah; with Abu Muhammad's note: Abu Muhammad said: Some of them say: al-Ghilah [alternate name form]. He said: I captured the paternal aunt of al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah, and brought her to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so the Prophet ﷺ asked about his aunt, so he said: "O Sakhr, indeed a people, when they become Muslim, they secure their properties and their blood, so give it back to him." And there was water [property] belonging to Banu Sulaym, and they became Muslim, so they came to him and asked him for that, so he called me, and said: "O Sakhr, indeed a people, when they become Muslim, they secure their properties and their blood, so give it back to them," so I gave it back.
17.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Aban ibn Abdullah al-Bajali se, Uthman ibn Abi Hazim se, Sakhr ibn al-Aylah se bataya: Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Kuch log kehte hain: al-Ghilah [ek doosra naam]. Unhone kaha, Maine al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah ki phuphi ko qaid kar liya, aur unhein Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas laaya, to Nabi ﷺ ne apni phuphi ke baare mein poocha, to aapne farmaya: "Ae Sakhr, jab log Musalman ho jaate hain, to unka maal aur unka khoon mehfooz ho jaata hai, so use unhein wapas kar do." Aur Banu Sulaym ka paani (jaayedaad) tha, aur woh Musalman ho gaye, so woh unke paas aaye aur yehi maanga, to aapne mujhe bulaaya, aur farmaya: "Ae Sakhr, jab log Musalman ho jaate hain, to unka maal aur unka khoon mehfooz ho jaata hai, so use unhein wapas kar do," so maine wapas kar diya.

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنِ ابِنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سَرِيَّةً فِيهَا ابْنُ عُمَر، فَغَنِمُوا إِبِلًا كَثِيرَةً، فَكَانَتْ سِهَامُهُمْ اثْنَيْ عَشَرَ بَعِيرًا أَوْ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ بَعِيرًا وَنُفِّلُوا بَعِيرًا بَعِيرًا "
17.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent an expeditionary force, Ibn Umar among them, and they took much camel spoil, and their shares were twelve camels or eleven camels, and they were also given an extra camel each."
17.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne ek dasta bheja jismein Ibn Umar bhi the, to unhone bahut se oont ghaneemat mein liye, to unke hisse baarah oont ya gyarah oont bane, aur unhein alag se ek-ek oont bhi diya gaya."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاق الْفَزَارِيُّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَيَّاشٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَّامٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ الْبَاهِلِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " إِذَاأَغَارَ فِي أَرْضِ الْعَدُوِّ، نَفَّلَ الرُّبُعَ، وَإِذَا أَقْبَلَ رَاجِعًا، وَكُلُّ النَّاسِ، نَفَّلَ الثُّلُثَ "
17.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Abu Ishaq al-Fazari, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Ayyash, from Sulayman ibn Musa, from Abu Sallam, from Abu Umamah al-Bahili, from Ubadah ibn al-Samit: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to "when he raided the enemy's land, give an extra quarter [share], and when he returned back, with all the people together, give an extra third."
17.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Abu Ishaq al-Fazari se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Ayyash se, Sulayman ibn Musa se, Abu Sallam se, Abu Umamah al-Bahili se, Ubadah ibn al-Samit se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ "jab dushman ki zameen mein hamla karte, to chauthaai alag se dete, aur jab wapas aate, aur sab log saath hote, to tihai alag se dete."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ  ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ  ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ جَارِيَةَ  ،  عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ مَسْلَمَةَ   : أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" نَفَّلَ الثُّلُثَ بَعْدَ الْخُمُسِ "
17.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Sufyan, from Yazid ibn Yazid ibn Jabir, from Makhul, from Ziyad ibn Jariyah, from Habib ibn Maslamah: That the Prophet ﷺ "gave a third as an extra share after the fifth [khums]."
17.hi: Abu Asim ne Sufyan se, Yazid ibn Yazid ibn Jabir se, Makhul se, Ziyad ibn Jariyah se, Habib ibn Maslamah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne "paanchwe hisse (khums) ke baad tihai alag se di."

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" مَنْ قَتَلَ كَافِرًا، فَلَهُ سَلَبُهُ ".
فَقَتَلَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ يَوْمَئِذٍ عِشْرِينَ، وَأَخَذَ أَسْلَابَهُمْ
17.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ishaq ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah, from Anas ibn Malik: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever kills a disbeliever, has his spoils." So Abu Talhah killed twenty on that day, and took their spoils.
17.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ishaq ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah se, Anas ibn Malik se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jo kisi kaafir ko qatal kare, uska saaman uska hai." To Abu Talhah ne us din bees log qatal kiye, aur unka saaman le liya.

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ كَثِيرِ بْنِ أَفْلَحَ هُوَ : عُمَرُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ  مَوْلَى أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ  ، قَالَ : " بَارَزْتُ رَجُلًا فَقَتَلْتُهُ،فَنَفَّلَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سَلَبَهُ "
17.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Kathir ibn Aflah (Umar ibn Kathir), from Abu Muhammad, freed servant of Abu Qatadah, from Abu Qatadah: He said: "I dueled with a man and killed him, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave me his spoils."
17.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Ibn Kathir ibn Aflah se (Umar ibn Kathir) bataya: Mujhse Abu Muhammad ne bataya (Abu Qatadah ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), Abu Qatadah se: Unhone kaha, "Maine ek aadmi se muqabla kiya aur usay maar diya, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhe uska saaman ina'am mein diya."

17.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاق الْفَزَارِيُّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَيَّاشٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَّامٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ الْبَاهِلِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَكْرَهُ الْأَنْفَالَ وَيَقُولُ :" لِيَرُدَّ قَوِيُّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ عَلَى ضَعِيفِهِمْ "
17.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Abu Ishaq al-Fazari, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Ayyash, from Sulayman ibn Musa, from Abu Sallam, from Abu Umamah al-Bahili, from Ubadah ibn al-Samit: That the Prophet ﷺ used to dislike extra shares [given to individuals beyond their due], and would say: "Let the strong among the Muslims give back to their weak."
17.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Abu Ishaq al-Fazari se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Ayyash se, Sulayman ibn Musa se, Abu Sallam se, Abu Umamah al-Bahili se, Ubadah ibn al-Samit se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ nafal (izafi hisse) ko na-pasand karte the, aur farmaate: "Musalmanon mein se mazboot log apne kamzoron ko wapas dein."

17.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيُّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَيَّاشٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلامٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ الْبَاهِلِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ   بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَقُولُ :" أَدُّوا الْخِيَاطَ وَالْمَخِيطَ، وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَالْغُلُولَ فَإِنَّهُ عَارٌ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ "
17.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Abu Ishaq al-Fazari, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Ayyash, from Sulayman ibn Musa, from Abu Sallam, from Abu Umamah al-Bahili, from Ubadah, with this chain: That the Prophet ﷺ used to say: "Give back the needle and thread, and beware of embezzlement, for it is a disgrace upon its people on the Day of Resurrection."
17.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Abu Ishaq al-Fazari se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Ayyash se, Sulayman ibn Musa se, Abu Sallam se, Abu Umamah al-Bahili se, Ubadah se isi sanad ke saath bataya ke Nabi ﷺ farmaate the: "Sui aur dhaaga bhi wapas kar do, aur khiyanat se bacho, kyunki yeh Qayamat ke din uske ehl ke liye ruswaai hai."

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ : ابْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ هُوَ : ابْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  عَنْ أَبِي مَرْزُوقٍ مَوْلًى لِتُجِيبَ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي حَنَشٌ الصَّنْعَانِيُّ  ، قَالَ : غَزَوْنَا الْمَغْرِبَ وَعَلَيْنَا رُوَيْفِعُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ، فَافْتَتَحْنَا قَرْيَةً يُقَالُ لَهَا : جَرْبَةَ فَقَامَ فِينَا رُوَيْفِعُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ   خَطِيبًا، فَقَالَ : إِنِّي لَا أَقُومُ فِيكُمْ إِلَّا مَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَامَ فِينَا يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ حِينَ افْتَتَحْنَاهَا :" مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلا يَرْكَبَنَّ دَابَّةً مِنْ فَيْءِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، حَتَّى إِذَا أَجْحَفَهَا أَوْ قَالَ : أَعْجَفَهَا، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : أَنَا أَشُكُّ فِيهِ رَدَّهَا ".
وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ، فَلَا يَلْبَسْ ثَوْبًا مِنْ فَيْءِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ حَتَّى إِذَا أَخْلَقَهُ، رَدَّهُ فِيهِ "
17.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Abu Marzuq, freed servant of Tujib, from Hanash al-San'ani, about Ruwayfi' ibn Thabit al-Ansari; with Abu Muhammad's note: He said: We raided the Maghrib, with Ruwayfi' ibn Thabit al-Ansari over us, and we conquered a village called Jarbah, so Ruwayfi' ibn Thabit al-Ansari stood among us delivering a sermon, and said: I only stand among you with what I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he stood among us on the day of Khaybar when we conquered it: "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him not ride an animal from the war-booty of the Muslims, until when he has worn it out, or he said: exhausted it," Abu Muhammad said: I am uncertain about it, [whether it said] "returns it." "And whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him not wear a garment from the war-booty of the Muslims until, when he has worn it out, he returns it in it."
17.hi: Ahmad ibn Khalid ne Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, Yazid ibn Abi Habib se, Abu Marzuq se (Tujib ke azaad kiye hue ghulam) bataya: Humein Hanash al-San'ani ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Humne Maghrib mein jihad kiya, Ruwayfi' ibn Thabit al-Ansari humare ameer the, so humne Jarbah naam ki ek basti fatah ki, to Ruwayfi' ibn Thabit al-Ansari humare darmiyan khade hokar khutba dene lage, aur kaha: Main tum mein sirf wahi khada hokar kehta hoon jo maine Rasulullah ﷺ se suna, aap humare darmiyan Khaybar ke din khade hue jab humne usay fatah kiya: "Jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta ho, woh Musalmanon ke maal-e-ghaneemat mein se koi jaanwar tab tak sawaari na kare jab tak woh usay ghis na de, ya farmaya: thaka na de," Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Mujhe shak hai [ke aapne kaha ho] "usay wapas kare." "Aur jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta ho, woh Musalmanon ke maal-e-ghaneemat mein se koi kapda tab tak na pehne jab tak woh usay purana na kar de, [fir] isi haalat mein usay wapas kare."

17.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو زُمَيْلٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ  ، قَالَ : قُتِلَ نَفَرٌ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ، فَقَالُوا : فُلَانٌ شَهِيدٌ، فُلانٌ.
..
..
..
حَتَّى ذَكَرُوا رَجُلًا، فَقَالُوا : فُلَانٌ شَهِيدٌ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" كَلا إِنِّي رَأَيْتُهُ فِي النَّارِ فِي عَبَاءَةٍ أَوْ فِي بُرْدَةٍ غَلَّهَا ".
ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي : " يَا ابْنَ الْخَطَّابِ قُمْ فَنَادِ فِي النَّاسِ أَنَّهُ لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ إِلا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ "فَقُمْتُ فَنَادَيْتُ فِي النَّاسِ
17.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Ikrimah ibn Ammar, from Abu Zumayl, from Ibn Abbas, from Umar ibn al-Khattab: He said: Some men were killed on the day of Khaybar, so they said: So-and-so is a martyr, so-and-so ... [continuing] ... until they mentioned a man, and said: So-and-so is a martyr, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "No indeed, I have seen him in the Fire, in a cloak or a mantle that he had embezzled." Then he said to me: "O Ibn al-Khattab, stand and announce among the people that none enters Paradise except the believers," so I stood and announced among the people.
17.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Ikrimah ibn Ammar se bataya: Mujhse Abu Zumayl ne bataya: Mujhse Ibn Abbas ne bataya: Mujhse Umar ibn al-Khattab ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Khaybar ke din kuch log qatal kiye gaye, to logon ne kaha: Fulaan shaheed hai, fulaan ... ... yahan tak ke unhone ek aadmi ka zikr kiya, aur kaha: Fulaan shaheed hai, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Nahi, maine usay Jahannam mein dekha hai, ek chaadar ya ek burd mein jise usne khiyanat mein liya tha." Fir aapne mujhse farmaya: "Ae Ibn al-Khattab, khade ho jao aur logon mein elaan karo ke sirf momin hi Jannat mein dakhil honge," to main khada hua aur logon mein elaan kiya.

17.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَائِدَةَ  ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ وَجَدْتُمُوهُ غَلَّ، فَاضْرِبُوهُ وَأَحْرِقُوا مَتَاعَهُ "
17.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Mansur, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Salih ibn Muhammad ibn Za'idah, from Salim ibn Abdullah, from his father, from his grandfather: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever you find has embezzled, then flog him, and burn his belongings."
17.hi: Sa'id ibn Mansur ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, Salih ibn Muhammad ibn Za'idah se, Salim ibn Abdullah se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jise tum khiyanat karte hue paao, use maaro aur uska saaman jala do."

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ الْمُكْتِبُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي كَثِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَوْفٍ الْمُزَنِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا نَهْبَ، وَلا إِغْلالَ، وَلا إِسْلَالَ، وَمَنْ يَغْلُلْ يَأْتِ بِمَا غَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : الْإِسْلالُ : السَّرِقَةُ
17.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Hatim al-Muktib, from al-Qasim ibn Malik, from Kathir ibn Abdullah ibn Amr ibn Awf al-Muzani, from his father, from his grandfather: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "No plunder, and no embezzlement, and no covert theft, and whoever embezzles will bring what he embezzled on the Day of Resurrection." Abu Muhammad said: al-Islal is: theft.
17.hi: Muhammad ibn Hatim al-Muktib ne al-Qasim ibn Malik se bataya: Mujhse Kathir ibn Abdullah ibn Amr ibn Awf al-Muzani ne bataya, apne walid se, apne dada se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Na loot-maar, na khiyanat, na chhupi hui chori, aur jo khiyanat kare woh Qayamat ke din apni khiyanat li hui cheez lekar aayega." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: 'Al-Islal' ka matlab hai: chori.

17.ar: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ هُوَ : ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَيَّاشُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنْ شِيَيْمِ بْنِ بَيْتَانَ  ، عَنْ جُنَادَةَ بْنِ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ  ، قَالَ : لَوْلَا أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَرْطَاةَ  ، يَقُولُ : قَدْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" لا تُقْطَعُ الْأَيْدِي فِي الْغَزْوِ لَقَطَعْتُهَا "
17.en: Narrated by Bishr ibn Umar al-Zahrani, from Abdullah ibn Lahi'ah, from Ayyash ibn Abbas, from Shuyaym ibn Baytan, from Junadah ibn Abi Umayyah: He said: Were it not that I heard Ibn Artah say: I have indeed heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Hands are not to be cut off during a military campaign," I would have cut them off.
17.hi: Bishr ibn Umar al-Zahrani ne Abdullah ibn Lahi'ah se, Ayyash ibn Abbas se, Shuyaym ibn Baytan se, Junadah ibn Abi Umayyah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Agar maine Ibn Artah ko yeh kehte na suna hota: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Jung mein haath nahi kaate jaate," to main unhein zaroor kaat deta.

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ   : أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ اسْتَعْمَلَ عَامِلًا عَلَى الصَّدَقَةِ فَجَاءَهُ الْعَامِلُ حِينَ فَرَغَ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَذَا الَّذِي لَكُمْ، وَهَذَا أُهْدِيَ لِي، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " فَهَلا قَعَدْتَ فِي بَيْتِ أَبِيكَ وَأَمِّكَ، فَنَظَرْتَ أَيُهْدَى لَكَ أَمْ لا "، ثُمَّ قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَشِيَّةً بَعْدَ الصَّلاةِ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ فَتَشَهَّدَ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ بِمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " أَمَّا بَعْدُ،فَمَا بَالُ الْعَامِلِ نَسْتَعْمِلُهُ فَيَأْتِينَا، فَيَقُولُ : هَذَا مِنْ عَمَلِكُمْ، وَهَذَا أُهْدِيَ لِي؟ فَهَلا قَعَدَ فِي بَيْتِ أَبِيهِ وَأُمِّهِ فَيَنْظُرَ أَيُهْدَى لَهُ أَمْ لا؟ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ، لَا يَغُلُّ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ مِنْهَا شَيْئًا إِلا جَاءَ بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَحْمِلُهُ عَلَى عُنُقِهِ، إِنْ كَانَ بَعِيرًا، جَاءَ بِهِ لَهُ رُغَاءٌ، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ بَقَرَةً، جَاءَ بِهَا لَهَا خُوَارٌ، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ شَاةً، جَاءَ بِهَا تَيْعِرُ، فَقَدْ بَلَّغْتُ؟ ".
قَالَ أَبُو حُمَيْدٍ : ثُمَّ رَفَعَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى إِنَّا لَنَنْظُرُ إِلَى عُفْرَةِ إِبِطَيْهِ.
قَالَ أَبُو حُمَيْدٍ : وَقَدْ سَمِعَ ذَلِكَ مَعِي مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ زَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، فَسَلُوهُ
17.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah ibn al-Zubayr, from Abu Humayd al-Sa'idi: That he informed him that the Prophet ﷺ employed a worker over charity [collection], so the worker came to him when he had finished his work, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, this is for you, and this was given to me as a gift." So the Prophet ﷺ said: "Then why did you not sit in the house of your father and your mother, and see whether it would be given to you [as a gift] or not?" Then the Prophet ﷺ stood one evening after the prayer on the pulpit, and testified [the shahadah], and praised Allah and lauded Him as He deserves, then said: "As for what follows - what is the matter with the worker whom we employ, so he comes to us and says: 'This is from your work, and this was given to me as a gift'? Then why did he not sit in the house of his father and his mother and see whether it would be given to him or not? By the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, none of you takes anything from it, except he will come on the Day of Resurrection carrying it on his neck: if it was a camel, he comes with it, it having a groaning sound, and if it was a cow, he comes with it, it having a lowing sound, and if it was a sheep, he comes with it, it bleating, so I have conveyed [the message]?" Abu Humayd said: Then the Prophet ﷺ raised his hands until we could indeed see the whiteness of his armpits. Abu Humayd said: And Zayd ibn Thabit heard that with me from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so ask him.
17.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Mujhse Urwah ibn al-Zubayr ne bataya, Abu Humayd al-Sa'idi se: ke unhone unhein bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne zakat ki wasooli par ek karyakartaa muqarrar kiya, so woh karyakartaa apna kaam khatam karne par aapke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, yeh aapka hai, aur yeh mujhe tohfe mein diya gaya." To Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "To tum apne baap aur maa ke ghar mein kyun nahi baithe, aur dekhte ke tumhein tohfa milta hai ya nahi?" Fir Nabi ﷺ ek shaam namaz ke baad mimbar par khade hue, aur shahaadat di aur Allah ki hamd aur tareef ki jaisi uski haqdaar hai, fir farmaya: "Amma ba'd - us karyakartaa ko kya hua hai jise hum kaam par lagaate hain, fir woh humare paas aakar kehta hai: 'Yeh tumhare kaam ka hai aur yeh mujhe tohfe mein diya gaya'? To woh apne baap aur maa ke ghar mein kyun nahi baitha aur dekhta ke usse tohfa milta hai ya nahi? Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, tum mein se koi bhi usmein se kuch nahi lega, magar woh Qayamat ke din use apni gardan par uthaaye laayega: agar woh oont hoga, to use is haal mein laayega ke woh boonk raha hoga, aur agar gaay hogi, to use is haal mein laayega ke woh awaaz kar rahi hogi, aur agar bhed hogi, to use is haal mein laayega ke woh mimya rahi hogi, so kya maine paighaam pahuncha diya?" Abu Humayd kehte hain: Fir Nabi ﷺ ne apne haath itna uthaaye ke hum aapki bagalon ki safedi dekhne lage. Abu Humayd kehte hain: Aur Zayd ibn Thabit ne bhi yeh mere saath Rasulullah ﷺ se suna, so unse poocho.

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُمَارَةُ بْنُ زَاذَانَ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ   " أَنَّ مَلِكَ ذِي يَزَنٍأَهْدَى إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حُلَّةً أَخَذَهَا بِثَلَاثَةٍ وَثَلَاثِينَ بَعِيرًا، أَوْ ثَلَاثٍ وَثَلَاثِينَ نَاقَةَ، فَقَبِلَهَا "
17.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Umarah ibn Zadhan, from Thabit, from Anas ibn Malik: That the king of Dhu Yazan gave the Prophet ﷺ a garment set as a gift, which he had bought for thirty-three camels, or thirty-three she-camels, so he accepted it.
17.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Umarah ibn Zadhan se, Thabit se, Anas ibn Malik se bataya ke Dhu Yazan ke baadshah ne Nabi ﷺ ko ek libaas tohfe mein diya jise usne teintees oont, ya teintees oontniyon ke badle khareeda tha, to aapne usay qabool kiya.

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ  ، قَالَ :" بَعَثَ صَاحِبُ أَيْلَةَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِكِتَابٍ، وَأَهْدَى لَهُ بَغْلَةً بَيْضَاءَ، فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَهْدَى لَهُ بُرْدًا "
17.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Maslamah, from Sulayman ibn Bilal, from Amr ibn Yahya, from Abbas ibn Sahl al-Sa'idi, from Abu Humayd al-Sa'idi: He said: "The ruler of Aylah sent a letter to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and gave him a white mule as a gift, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to him, and gave him a cloak as a gift."
17.hi: Abdullah ibn Maslamah ne Sulayman ibn Bilal se, Amr ibn Yahya se, Abbas ibn Sahl al-Sa'idi se, Abu Humayd al-Sa'idi se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Aylah ke hukmaraan ne Rasulullah ﷺ ko ek khat bheja, aur ek safed khachchar tohfe mein diya, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne unhein likha aur unhein ek chaadar tohfe mein di."

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ  ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نِيَار  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِنَّا لَا نَسْتَعِينُ بِمُشْرِكٍ ".
أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ رَوْحٍ  ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ  ، عَنْ فُضَيْلٍ هُوَ : ابْنُ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، هُوَ : الْخَطْمِي  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نِيَارٍ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   : أَطْوَلُ مِنْهُ
17.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Waki', from Malik ibn Anas, from Abdullah ibn Niyar, from Urwah, from Aisha; a similar chain also via Ishaq, from Rawh, from Malik, from Fudayl ibn Abi Abdullah al-Khatmi: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "We do not seek help from a polytheist." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Ishaq, from Rawh, from Malik, from Fudayl ibn Abi Abdullah, that is: al-Khatmi, from Abdullah ibn Niyar, from Urwah, from Aisha, longer than it.]
17.hi: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ne Waki' se, Malik ibn Anas se, Abdullah ibn Niyar se, Urwah se, Aisha se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Hum kisi mushrik se madad nahi maangte." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Ishaq se, Rawh se, Malik se, Fudayl ibn Abi Abdullah se (jo al-Khatmi hain), Abdullah ibn Niyar se, Urwah se, Aisha se bhi isse lambi aayi hai.]

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ  : رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكُوفَةِ ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعْدُ بْنُ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ سَمُرَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ الْجَرَّاحِ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ فِي آخِرِ مَا تَكَلَّمَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" أَخْرِجُوا يَهُودَ مِنَ الْحِجَازِ ، وَأَهْلَ نَجْرَانَ مِنْ جَزِيرَةِ الْعَرَبِ "
17.en: Narrated by Affan, from Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Qattan, from Ibrahim ibn Maymun, a man from the people of Kufah, from Sa'd ibn Samurah ibn Jundub, from his father Samurah, from Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah: He said: Among the last things the Messenger of Allah ﷺ spoke about, he said: "Expel the Jews from the Hijaz, and the people of Najran from the Arabian Peninsula."
17.hi: Affan ne Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Qattan se bataya: Humein Ibrahim ibn Maymun ne bataya (Kufah ke ek aadmi): Mujhse Sa'd ibn Samurah ibn Jundub ne bataya, apne walid Samurah se, Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ki aakhri baaton mein se ek yeh thi, aapne farmaya: "Yahoodiyon ko Hijaz se, aur Najran walon ko Jazeerat-ul-Arab se nikaal do."
