17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ حَيْوَةَ بْنِ شُرَيْحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي رَبِيعَةُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو إِدْرِيسَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو ثَعْلَبَةَ  ، قَالَ : أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّا بِأَرْضِ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ ، فَنَأْكُلُ فِي آنِيَتِهِمْ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنْ كُنْتَ بِأَرْضٍ كَمَا ذَكَرْتَ، فَلَا تَأْكُلُوا فِي آنِيَتِهِمْ إِلا أَنْ لَا تَجِدُوا مِنْهَا بُدًّا، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدُوا مِنْهَا بُدًّا، فَاغْسِلُوهَا، ثُمَّ كُلُوا فِيهَا "
17.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Haywah ibn Shurayh, from Rabi'ah ibn Yazid, from Abu Idris, from Abu Tha'labah: He said: I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, we are in the land of the People of the Book, so we eat from their vessels," so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If you are in a land as you have mentioned, then do not eat from their vessels unless you find no escape from it, but if you find no escape from it, then wash them, then eat from them."
17.hi: Abu Asim ne Haywah ibn Shurayh se bataya: Mujhse Rabi'ah ibn Yazid ne bataya: Mujhse Abu Idris ne bataya: Mujhse Abu Tha'labah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, hum Ahl-e-Kitaab ki zameen mein hain, to hum unke bartanon mein khaate hain," to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Agar tum aisi zameen mein ho jaisa tumne zikr kiya, to unke bartanon mein na khaao jab tak ke tumhein iska koi bachaao na mile, lekin agar tumhein bachaao na mile, to unhein dho lo, fir unmein khaao."

17.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ هُوَ : ابْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ  ، قَالَ : "دُلِّيَ جِرَابٌ مِنْ شَحْمٍ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ.
قَالَ : فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَالْتَزَمْتُهُ.
قَالَ : ثُمَّ قُلْتُ : لا أُعْطِي مِنْ هَذَا أَحَدًا الْيَوْمَ شَيْئًا، فَالْتَفَتُّ فَإِذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَبْتَسِمُ إِلَيَّ ".
 قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : أَرْجُو أَنْ يَكُونَ حُمَيْدٌ سَمِعَ مِنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
17.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Maslamah, from Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah, from Humayd, from Abdullah ibn Mughaffal; with Abdullah al-Darimi's note: He said: "A sack of fat was lowered on the day of Khaybar." He said: So I came to it and clung to it. He said: Then I said: "I will not give anyone anything from this today," then I turned around, and there was the Messenger of Allah ﷺ smiling at me. Abdullah said: I hope that Humayd heard from Abdullah.
17.hi: Abdullah ibn Maslamah ne Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah se, Humayd se, Abdullah ibn Mughaffal se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Khaybar ke din charbi ka ek bora [qile se] niche giraya gaya." Unhone bataya: To main uske paas aaya aur usay pakad liya. Unhone bataya: Fir maine kaha: "Aaj isme se kisi ko kuch nahi dunga," fir main muda, to Rasulullah ﷺ mujh par muskuraa rahe the. Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Mujhe ummeed hai ke Humayd ne Abdullah se suna hai.

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ بَجَالَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ : " لَمْ يَكُنْ عُمَرُ أَخَذَ الْجِزْيَةَ مِنَ الْمَجُوسِ حَتَّى شَهِدَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ   أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَأَخَذَهَا مِنْ مَجُوسِ هَجَرَ "
17.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Ibn Uyaynah, from Amr, from Bajalah: He said: I heard him say: "Umar did not take the jizyah from the Magians until Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf testified that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ took it from the Magians of Hajar."
17.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Ibn Uyaynah se, Amr se bataya: Mujhe Bajalah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine unhein kehte suna: "Umar ne Majoosiyon se jizya us waqt tak nahi liya jab tak Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf ne gawahi na di ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne Hajar ke Majoosiyon se jizya liya tha."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ  : أَنَّ أَبَا مُرَّةَ  مَوْلَى عَقِيلِ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أُمَّ هَانِئٍ بِنْتَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ   تُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهَا ذَهَبَتْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ، فَقَالَتْ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، زَعَمَ ابْنُ أُمِّي أَنَّهُ قَاتِلٌ رَجُلًا أَجَرْتُهُ فَلانَ بْنُ هُبَيْرَةَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" قَدْ أَجَرْنَا مَنْ أَجَرْتِ يَا أُمَّ هَانِئٍ "
17.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Malik, from Abu al-Nadr, from Abu Murrah, freed servant of Aqil ibn Abi Talib, from Umm Hani bint Abi Talib: That she went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the year of the Conquest, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, my mother's son [Ali] claims that he will kill a man I have granted protection to: so-and-so ibn Hubayrah." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "We have granted protection to whoever you have granted protection to, O Umm Hani."
17.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Malik se, Abu al-Nadr se bataya: Unhein Abu Murrah ne bataya (Aqil ibn Abi Talib ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), ke unhone Umm Hani bint Abi Talib ko yeh bayaan karte suna: ke woh Fateh ke saal Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas gayin, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, meri maa ke bete [Ali (Alayhis Salam)] ka dawa hai ke woh us aadmi ko qatal karega jise maine panah di hai: fulaan ibn Hubayrah." To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Humne bhi usay panah de di jise tumne panah di hai, ae Umm Hani."

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ مُعَيْزٍ السَّعْدِيِّ  ، قَالَ : خَرَجْتُ أُسْفِرُ فَرَسًا لِي مِنَ السَّحَرِ فَمَرَرْتُ عَلَى مَسْجِدٍ مِنْ مَسَاجِدِ بَنِي حَنِيفَةَ، فَسَمِعْتُهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ أَنَّ مُسَيْلَمَةَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ   فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ، فَبَعَثَ إِلَيْهِمْ الشُّرَطَ، فَأَخَذُوهُمْ، فَجِيءَ بِهِمْ، إِلَيْهِ فَتَابَ الْقَوْمُ وَرَجَعُوا عَنْ قَوْلِهِمْ، فَخَلَّى سَبِيلَهُمْ، وَقَدَّمَ رَجُلًا مِنْهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُ : عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ النَّوَاحَةِ، فَضَرَبَ عُنُقَهُ، فَقَالُوا لَهُ : تَرَكْتَ الْقَوْمَ وَقَتَلْتَ هَذَا؟، فَقَالَ : إِنِّي كُنْتُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ جَالِسًا إِذْ دَخَلَ هَذَا وَرَجُلٌ وَافِدَيْنِ مِنْ عِنْدِ مُسَيْلَمَةَ، فَقَالَ لَهُمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَتَشْهَدَانِ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ؟ "، فَقَالَا لَهُ : تَشْهَدُ أَنْتَ أَنَّ مُسَيْلَمَةَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ :" آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ، لَوْ كُنْتُ قَاتِلًا وَفْدًا، لَقَتَلْتُكُمَا ".
فَلِذَلِكَ قَتَلْتُهُ.
وَأَمَرَ بِمَسْجِدِهِمْ فَهُدِمَ
17.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Bakr ibn Ayyash, from Asim, from Abu Wa'il, from Ibn Mu'ayz al-Sa'di: He said: I went out at dawn taking my horse out, so I passed by a mosque of the mosques of Banu Hanifah, and I heard them testifying that Musaylamah was the messenger of Allah, so I returned to Abdullah ibn Mas'ud and informed him, so he sent the guards to them, and they seized them, and they were brought to him, so the people repented and recanted their statement, so he released them, and brought forward a man among them called Abdullah ibn al-Nawwahah, and struck his neck, so they said to him: "You left the people and killed this one?" So he said: "I was sitting with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when this one and another man entered as delegates from Musaylamah, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to them both: 'Do you both testify that I am the Messenger of Allah?' So they said to him: 'Do you testify that Musaylamah is the messenger of Allah?' So he said: 'I believe in Allah and His messengers, had I been one to kill delegates, I would have killed the two of you.'" So that is why I killed him. And he commanded regarding their mosque, and it was demolished.
17.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Bakr ibn Ayyash se, Asim se, Abu Wa'il se, Ibn Mu'ayz al-Sa'di se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main subah-e-sadiq mein apna ghoda taiyaar karne nikla, to main Banu Hanifah ki masjidon mein se ek masjid ke paas se guzra, to maine unhein gawahi dete suna ke Musaylamah Allah ka Rasool hai, to main Abdullah ibn Mas'ud ke paas wapas gaya aur unhein bataaya, to unhone pehredaar bheje, unhone unhein pakad liya, aur unhein unke paas laaya gaya, to un logon ne tauba ki aur apni baat se palat gaye, to unhone unhein chhod diya, aur unmein se ek aadmi ko, jise Abdullah ibn al-Nawwahah kaha jaata tha, aage badhaaya, aur uski gardan maar di, to logon ne unse kaha: "Aapne logon ko chhod diya aur isay maar diya?" To unhone kaha: "Main Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas baitha tha jab yeh aur ek doosra aadmi Musaylamah ki taraf se qaasid bankar dakhil hue, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne un dono se farmaya: 'Kya tum dono gawahi dete ho ke main Allah ka Rasool hoon?' To unhone aapse kaha: 'Kya aap gawahi dete hain ke Musaylamah Allah ka Rasool hai?' Aapne farmaya: 'Main Allah aur uske Rasoolon par imaan laata hoon, agar main qaasidon ko qatal karne wala hota, to tum dono ko qatal kar deta.'" So isi liye maine usay qatal kiya. Aur unhone unki masjid ke baare mein hukum diya, to woh gira di gayi.

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُيَيْنَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جَوْشَنٍ الْغَطَفَانِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ   : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" مَنْ قَتَلَ مُعَاهَدًا فِي غَيْرِ كُنْهِهِ، حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ الْجَنَّةَ "
17.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Uyaynah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Jawshan al-Ghatafani, from his father, from Abu Bakrah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever kills a person under treaty without proper cause, Allah forbids Paradise to him."
17.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid ne Uyaynah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Jawshan al-Ghatafani se, apne walid se, Abu Bakrah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jo kisi mu'aahid (ahad wale) ko bila wajah qatal kare, Allah uspar Jannat haraam kar deta hai."

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ  ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَتِ الْعَضْبَاءُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي عَقَيْلٍ فَأُسِرَ، وَأُخِذَتِ الْعَضْبَاءُ ، فَمَرَّ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُوَ فِي وَثَاقِهِ، فَقَالَ : يَا مُحَمَّدُ، عَلَى مَا تَأْخُذُونِي وَتَأْخُذُونَ سَابِقَةَ الْحَاجِّ، وَقَدْ أَسْلَمْتُ؟، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " لَوْ قُلْتَهَا وَأَنْتَ تَمْلِكُ أَمْرَكَ، أَفْلَحْتَ كُلَّ الْفَلَاحِ "، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " نَأْخُذُكَ بِجَرِيرَةِ حُلَفَائِكَ ".
وَكَانَتْ ثَقِيفٌ قَدْ أَسَرُوا رَجُلَيْنِ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
وَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَى حِمَارٍ عَلَيْهِ قَطِيفَةٌ، فَقَالَ : يَا مُحَمَّدُ إِنِّي جَائِعٌ فَأَطْعِمْنِي، وَإِنِّي وَظَمْآنُ فَاسْقِنِي، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " هَذِهِ حَاجَتُكَ ".
ثُمَّ إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ فُدِيَ بِرَجُلَيْنِ، فَحَبَسَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْعَضْبَاءَ لِرَحْلِهِ وَكَانَتْ مِنْ سَوَابِقِ الْحَاجِّ.
ثُمَّ إِنَّ الْمُشْرِكِينَ أَغَارُوا عَلَى سَرْحِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَذَهَبُوا بِهِ فِيهَا الْعَضْبَاءُ وَأَسَرُوا امْرَأَةً مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَكَانُوا إِذَا نَزَلُوا قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ كَلِمَةً إِبِلُهُمْ فِي أَفْنِيَتِهِمْ.
فَلَمَّا كَانَ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ قَامَتْ الْمَرْأَةُ وَقَدْ نُوِّمُوا، فَجَعَلَتْ لَا تَضَعُ يَدَيْهَا عَلَى بَعِيرٍ إِلا رَغَا، حَتَّى أَتَتْ الْعَضْبَاءَ ، فَأَتَتْ عَلَى نَاقَةٍ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ذَلُولٍ مُجَرَّسَةٍ، فَرَكِبَتْهَا ثُمَّ تَوَجَّهَتْ قِبَلَ الْمَدِينَةِ، وَنَذَرَتْ لَئِنِ اللَّهُ نَجَّاهَا، لَتَنْحَرَنَّهَا.
قَالَ : فَلَمَّا قَدِمَتِ عُرِفَتِ النَّاقَةُ، فَقِيلَ : نَاقَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَأَتَوْا بِهَا النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَأَخْبَرَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ بِنَذْرِهَا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" بِئْسَمَا جَزَيْتِهَا أَوْ بِئْسَمَا جَزَتْهَا إِنَّ اللَّهُ نَجَّاهَا لَتَنْحَرَنَّهَا؟ أَلا لا وَفَاءَ لِنَذْرٍ فِي مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ، وَلا فِيمَا لَا يَمْلِكُ ابْنُ آدَمَ "
17.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah, from Abu al-Muhallab, from Imran ibn Husayn: He said: Al-Adba' belonged to a man from Banu Aqil, so he was captured, and al-Adba' was taken, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by him while he was bound, so he said: "O Muhammad, why do you seize me and seize the pilgrims' racing camel, when I have become Muslim?" So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Had you said it while you had control of your own affair, you would have succeeded completely." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "We seize you for the crime of your allies." And Thaqif had captured two men from the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came on a donkey with a saddlecloth on it, so he said: "O Muhammad, I am hungry, so feed me, and I am thirsty, so give me drink." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "This is your need." Then the man was ransomed for two men, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ kept al-Adba' for his own mount, and it was among the pilgrims' racing camels. Then the polytheists raided the grazing area of Madinah and went off with it, al-Adba' among it, and they captured a woman from the Muslims, and when they would halt - Abu Muhammad said: then he mentioned a phrase - their camels [would be] in their courtyards. So when it was one night, the woman got up while they were asleep, and she did not place her hands on any camel except that it groaned, until she came to al-Adba', and she came upon the she-camel of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, docile and well-trained, so she rode it, then headed toward Madinah, and she vowed that if Allah saved her, she would surely sacrifice it. He said: So when she arrived, the she-camel was recognized, and it was said: the she-camel of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so they brought it to the Prophet ﷺ, and the woman informed [him] of her vow, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "What a bad reward you have given it, or what a bad reward it has been given - that Allah saved her and she would surely sacrifice it? Listen, there is no fulfilling a vow in disobedience to Allah, nor in what a son of Adam does not own."
17.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ayyub se, Abu Qilabah se, Abu al-Muhallab se, Imran ibn Husayn se bataya: Unhone kaha, Al-Adba' Banu Aqil ke ek aadmi ki thi, so woh qaid ho gaya, aur al-Adba' li gayi, to Rasulullah ﷺ uske paas se guzre jabke woh bandha hua tha, to usne kaha: "Ae Muhammad, tum mujhe aur Hajj ki daudne wali oontni ko kyun pakadte ho, jabke main Musalman ho chuka hoon?" To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Agar tum yeh baat tab kehte jab tumhare apne maamle par ikhtiyaar tha, to tum poori kaamyaabi paate." Fir Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Hum tumhein tumhare hulafa (mit'tehidon) ke jurm ki wajah se pakadte hain." Aur Thaqif ne Rasulullah ﷺ ke sahaba mein se do aadmiyon ko qaid kar liya tha. Aur Rasulullah ﷺ ek gadhe par aaye jispar ek chaadar thi, to usne kaha: "Ae Muhammad, main bhookha hoon, mujhe khilaao, aur main pyaasa hoon, mujhe pilaao." To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Yeh tumhari zaroorat hai." Fir us aadmi ko do aadmiyon ke badle chhudwaya gaya, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne al-Adba' ko apni sawaari ke liye rakh liya, aur woh Hajj ki daudne wali oontniyon mein se thi. Fir mushrikon ne Madinah ke charagaah par hamla kiya aur usay le gaye, al-Adba' bhi usmein thi, aur unhone Musalmanon mein se ek aurat ko qaid kar liya, aur jab woh pdaao karte - Abu Muhammad kehte hain: fir unhone ek jumla zikr kiya - unke oont unke aangan mein hote. So jab ek raat aayi, aurat uthi jabke woh so rahe the, to woh jis bhi oont par apne haath rakhti woh boonk deta, yahan tak ke woh al-Adba' tak pahunchi, to woh Rasulullah ﷺ ki oontni thi, narm aur tarbiyat-yaafta, so usne uspar sawaari ki, fir Madinah ki taraf rukh kiya, aur nazr maani ke agar Allah ne usay bacha liya, to woh zaroor usay zabah karegi. Unhone bataya: So jab woh pahunchi, oontni pehchaani gayi, aur kaha gaya: yeh Rasulullah ﷺ ki oontni hai, to woh isay Nabi ﷺ ke paas laaye, aur aurat ne apni nazr batayi, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Tumne kitna bura badla diya hai isay, ya kitna bura badla diya gaya hai isay - ke Allah ne usay bachaya to woh usay zaroor zabah karegi? Sun lo, Allah ki nafarmani mein koi nazr poori karna nahi, aur na hi us cheez mein jo Aadam ki aulaad ke ikhtiyaar mein na ho."

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ مُحَرَّرِ بْنِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قالَ : " كُنْتُ مَعَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ لَمَّا بَعَثَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَنَادَى بِأَرْبَعٍ حَتَّى صَهَلَ صَوْتُهُ :أَلا لا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ إِلا نَفْسٌ مُسْلِمَةٌ، وَلَا يَحُجَّنَّ بَعْدَ الْعَامِ مُشْرِكٌ، وَلَا يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ عُرْيَانُ.
وَمَنْ كَانَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَهْدٌ، فَإِنَّ أَجَلَهُ إِلَى أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْهُرٍ، فَإِذَا مَضَتِ الْأَرْبَعَةُ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بَرِيءٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ وَرَسُولُهُ "
17.en: Narrated by Bishr ibn Thabit, from Shu'bah, from al-Mughirah, from al-Sha'bi, from Muharrar ibn Abi Hurairah, from his father: He said: "I was with Ali ibn Abi Talib when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent him, and he called out four things until his voice grew hoarse: Listen, no soul enters Paradise except a Muslim soul, and let no polytheist perform Hajj after this year, and let no naked person circumambulate the House. And whoever has a treaty between him and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, his term is until four months, and when the four have passed, then Allah is free of the polytheists, and so is His Messenger."
17.hi: Bishr ibn Thabit ne Shu'bah se, al-Mughirah se, al-Sha'bi se, Muharrar ibn Abi Hurairah se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Main Ali ibn Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ke saath tha jab Rasulullah ﷺ ne unhein bheja, to unhone chaar baatein pukaarin yahan tak ke unki awaaz baithh gayi: Sun lo, koi rooh Jannat mein dakhil nahi hogi siwaay momin rooh ke, aur is saal ke baad koi mushrik Hajj na kare, aur koi barhna Baitullah ka tawaaf na kare. Aur jiska Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath koi ahad ho, uski muddat chaar mahine tak hai; fir jab chaar [mahine] guzar jaayein, to Allah aur uske Rasool mushrikon se bari-ul-zimma hain."

17.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاق  ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ  ، قَالَ : اعْتَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي ذِي الْقَعْدَةِ فَأَبَى أَهْلُ مَكَّةَ أَنْ يَدَعُوهُ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ مَكَّةَ حَتَّى قَاضَاهُمْ عَلَى أَنْ يُقِيمَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ، فَلَمَّا كَتَبُوا : هَذَا مَا قَاضَى عَلَيْهِ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالُوا : لأَنُقِرُّ بِهَذَا، لَوْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، مَا مَنَعْنَاكَ شَيْئًا، وَلَكِنْ أَنْتَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، فَقَالَ :" أَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ "، فَقَالَ لِعَلِيٍّ : " امْحُ : مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ "، فَقَالَ : لا وَاللَّهِ لا أَمْحُوهُ أَبَدًا.
فَأَخَذَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْكِتَابَ وَلَيْسَ يُحْسِنُ يَكْتُبُ، فَكَتَبَ مَكَانَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ هَذَا مَا قَاضَى عَلَيْهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ : أَنْ لَا يَدْخُلَ مَكَّةَ بِسِلَاحٍ إِلا السَّيْفَ فِي الْقِرَابِ، وَأَنْ لَا يُخْرِجَ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا أَحَدًا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَتْبَعَهُ، وَلا يَمْنَعَ أَحَدًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُقِيمَ بِهَا.
فَلَمَّا دَخَلَهَا وَمَضَى الأَجَلُ، أَتَوْا عَلِيًّا، فَقَالُوا : قُلْ لِصَاحِبِكَ فَلْيَخْرُجْ عَنَّا فَقَدْ مَضَى الْأَجَلُ
17.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Isra'il, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Bara' ibn Azib: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed Umrah in Dhu al-Qa'dah, but the people of Makkah refused to let him enter Makkah until he made a treaty with them that he would stay three days, so when they wrote: "This is what Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, has agreed to," they said: "We will not confirm this, if we knew you were the Messenger of Allah, we would not have prevented you from anything, but you are Muhammad ibn Abdullah," so he said: "I am the Messenger of Allah, and I am Muhammad ibn Abdullah," then he said to Ali: "Erase: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah," so he said: "No, by Allah, I will never erase it." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ took the document, and he was not skilled at writing, so he wrote in place of "Messenger of Allah": "This is what Muhammad ibn Abdullah has agreed to: that he will not enter Makkah with weapons except the sword in its sheath, and that he will not take out anyone of its people who wishes to follow him, and will not prevent any of his companions who wishes to stay there." So when he entered it, and the term passed, they came to Ali, and said: "Tell your companion to leave us, for the term has passed."
17.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Isra'il se bataya: Humein Abu Ishaq ne bataya, al-Bara' ibn Azib se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne Dhu al-Qa'dah mein Umrah kiya, lekin Makkah walon ne aapko Makkah mein dakhil hone se rok diya jab tak aapne unse ahad na kiya ke aap teen din thehrenge, so jab unhone likha: "Yeh woh cheez hai jispar Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool, ne razaamandi di," to unhone kaha: "Hum isay qabool nahi karenge, agar humein pata hota ke aap Allah ke Rasool hain, to hum aapko kuch bhi na rokte, lekin aap Muhammad ibn Abdullah hain," to aapne farmaya: "Main Allah ka Rasool hoon, aur main Muhammad ibn Abdullah bhi hoon," fir aapne Ali (Alayhis Salam) se farmaya: "Mita do: Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain," to unhone kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, main isay kabhi nahi mitaunga." To Rasulullah ﷺ ne khud dastavez le li, aur aap likhna acchi tarah nahi jaante the, to aapne 'Rasool-Allah' ki jagah likha: "Yeh woh cheez hai jispar Muhammad ibn Abdullah ne razaamandi di: ke woh Makkah mein hathiyaaron ke saath dakhil nahi honge siwaay talwar ke miyan mein, aur woh Makkah walon mein se kisi ko bhi nahi le jaayenge jo unki pairwi karna chahe, aur apne kisi bhi saathi ko na rokenge jo wahan thehrna chahe." So jab aap Makkah mein dakhil hue aur muddat guzar gayi, to woh Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke paas aaye, aur kaha: "Apne saathi se kaho ke woh humse nikal jaayein, kyunki muddat guzar chuki hai."

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَجَّاجِ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ :" خَرَجَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَبْدَانِ مِنَ الطَّائِفِ، فَأَعْتَقَهُمَا.
أَحَدُهُمَا أَبُو بَكْرَةَ "
17.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Khalid, from al-Hajjaj, from al-Hakam, from Miqsam, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "Two slaves came out to the Prophet ﷺ from al-Ta'if, and he freed them both. One of them was Abu Bakrah."
17.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Khalid se, al-Hajjaj se, al-Hakam se, Miqsam se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Do ghulam Ta'if se Nabi ﷺ ke paas aaye, to aapne un dono ko azaad kar diya. Unmein se ek Abu Bakrah the."

17.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : رُمِيَ يَوْمَ الْأَحْزَابِ سَعْدُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، فَقَطَعُوا أَبْجَلَهُ فَحَسَمَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالنَّارِ، فَانْتَفَخَتْ، يَدُهُ فَنَزَفَهُ فَحَسَمَهُ أُخْرَى، فَانْتَفَخَتْ يَدُهُ فَلَمَّا رَأَى ذَلِكَ قَالَ : اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُخْرِجْ نَفْسِي حَتَّى تُقِرَّ عَيْنِي مِنْ بَنِي قُرَيْظَةَ، فَاسْتَمْسَكَ عِرْقُهُ فَمَا قَطَرَ قَطْرَةً حَتَّى نَزَلُوا عَلَى حَكْمِ سَعْدٍ.
فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ، فَحَكَمَ أَنْ تُقْتَلَ رِجَالُهُمْ، وَتُسْتَحْيَا نِسَاؤُهُمْ وَذَرَارِيُّهُمْ لِيَسْتَعِينُ بِهِمُ الْمُسْلِمُونَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَصَبْتَ حُكْمَ اللَّهِ فِيهِمْ ".
وَكَانُوا أَرْبَعَ مِائَةٍ، فَلَمَّا فُرِغَ مِنْ قَتْلِهِمُ، انْفَتَقَ عِرْقُهُ فَمَاتَ
17.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Layth ibn Sa'd, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ibn Abdullah: That he said: Sa'd ibn Mu'adh was shot on the day of al-Ahzab, and they cut his vein, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cauterized it with fire, so his hand swelled, and it bled, so he cauterized it again, so his hand swelled, so when he saw that, he said: "O Allah, do not take my soul until You bring comfort to my eye from Banu Qurayzah," so his artery held and did not drip a single drop until they descended to Sa'd's judgment. So he sent for him, and he judged that their men be killed, and their women and children be enslaved for the Muslims to make use of, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "You have hit the judgment of Allah concerning them." And they were four hundred, so when the killing of them was finished, his artery burst open and he died.
17.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Layth ibn Sa'd se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir ibn Abdullah se bataya: ke unhone kaha, Sa'd ibn Mu'adh ko ghazwa-e-Ahzab ke din teer maara gaya, aur unhone unki rag kaat di, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne usay aag se daagh diya, to unka haath sooj gaya, aur woh khoon-rista raha, to aapne usay dobara daagh diya, to unka haath phir sooj gaya, to jab unhone yeh dekha, to kaha: Ae Allah, mujhe tab tak na le jaaiye jab tak meri aankh Banu Qurayzah ki wajah se thandi na ho jaaye, to unki rag rukk gayi aur ek qatra bhi na tapka yahan tak ke woh Sa'd ke faisle par utar aaye. To aapne unhein bulaaya, to unhone faisla diya ke unke mardon ko qatal kiya jaaye, aur unki auraton aur bacchon ko qaid kiya jaaye taake Musalman unse faida uthaayein, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Tumne unke baare mein Allah ke faisle ko theek pakda hai." Aur woh chaar sau the, so jab unka qatal khatam hua, unki rag phat gayi aur woh mar gaye.

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  : أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَدِيِّ بْنِ الْحَمْرَاءِ الزُّهْرِيَّ  ، قَالَ : رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُوَ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ وَاقِفًا بِالْحَزْوَرَةِ ، يَقُولُ :" وَاللَّهِ إِنَّكِ لَخَيْرُ أَرْضِ اللَّهِ، وَأَحَبُّ أَرْضِ اللَّهِ إِلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَوْلا أَنِّي أُخْرِجْتُ مِنْكِ مَا خَرَجْتُ "
17.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abdullah ibn Adi ibn al-Hamra al-Zuhri: He said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was standing on his mount at al-Hazwarah, saying: "By Allah, indeed you are the best land of Allah, and the most beloved land of Allah to Allah, and were it not that I was expelled from you, I would not have left."
17.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhse Uqayl ne bataya, Ibn Shihab se: Mujhe Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman ne bataya: ke Abdullah ibn Adi ibn al-Hamra al-Zuhri ne kaha: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko dekha jabke aap apni sawaari par al-Hazwarah mein khade the, farmaate hue: "Allah ki qasam, tu Allah ki zameen mein sabse behtar hai, aur Allah ki zameenon mein Allah ko sabse zyada aziz hai, aur agar mujhe tujhse na nikaala jaata, to main na jaata."

17.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ   : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا تَسُبُّوا الْأَمْوَاتَ، فَإِنَّهُمْ قَدْ أَفْضَوْا إِلَى مَا قَدَّمُوا "
17.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Rabi', from Shu'bah, from Sulayman, from Mujahid, about Aisha: He said: Aisha said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do not abuse the dead, for indeed they have arrived at what they sent forth."
17.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Rabi' ne Shu'bah se bataya: Humein Sulayman ne bataya, Mujahid se: unhone kaha, Aisha ne kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Murdon ko bura-bhala mat kaho, kyunki woh us cheez tak pahunch chuke hain jo unhone aage bheja tha."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ  ،  عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : لَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لا هِجْرَةَ بَعْدَ الْفَتْحِ، وَلَكِنْ جِهَادٌ وَنِيَّةٌ، وَإِذَا استُنْفِرْتُمْ، فَانْفِرُوا "
17.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Isra'il, from Mansur, from Mujahid, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas: He said: When it was the day of the Conquest of Makkah, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There is no [further] emigration after the Conquest, but [there is] jihad and intention, and when you are called to march forth, then march forth."
17.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Isra'il se, Mansur se, Mujahid se, Tawus se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Jab Fateh-e-Makkah ka din tha, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Fateh ke baad hijrat nahi hai, lekin jihad aur niyat hai, aur jab tumhein bulaaya jaaye [jang ke liye], to nikal pado."

17.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ حَرِيزِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي عَوْفٍ، وَهُو : عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هِنْدٍ الْبَجَلِيِّ  وَكَانَ مِنَ السَّلَفِ .
قَالَ : تَذَاكَرُوا الْهِجْرَةَ عِنْدَ مُعَاوِيَةَ   وَهُوَ عَلَى سَرِيرِهِ، فَقَالَ : سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" لا تَنْقَطِعُ الْهِجْرَةُ حَتَّى تَنْقَطِعَ التَّوْبَةُ ثَلَاثًا وَلا تَنْقَطِعُ التَّوْبَةُ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا "
17.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Hariz ibn Uthman, from Ibn Abi Awf (Abd al-Rahman), from Abu Hind al-Bajali, who was among the earlier generation: He said: They discussed emigration in the presence of Mu'awiyah while he was on his couch, so he said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: "Emigration does not cease until repentance ceases," three times, "and repentance does not cease until the sun rises from its place of setting."
17.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Hariz ibn Uthman se, Ibn Abi Awf se (Abd al-Rahman), Abu Hind al-Bajali se, jo pehli naslon mein se the, bataya: Unhone kaha, Woh Mu'awiyah ke paas hijrat ka zikr karne lage jabke woh apne takht par the, to unhone kaha: Maine Nabi ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Hijrat khatam nahi hoti jab tak tauba khatam na ho jaaye," teen martaba, "aur tauba khatam nahi hoti jab tak suraj apni dooba hui jagah se na nikal aaye."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَوْلا الْهِجْرَةُ، لَكُنْتُ امْرَءًا مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ "
17.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Were it not for emigration, I would have been a man from the Ansar."
17.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Agar hijrat na hoti, to main Ansar mein se ek aadmi hota."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   : أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَا مِنْ أَمِيرِ عَشَرَةٍ إِلَّا يُؤْتَى بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، مَغْلُولَةً يَدَاهُ إِلَى عُنُقِهِ، أَطْلَقَهُ الْحَقُّ أَوْ أَوْبَقَهُ "
17.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Sa'id ibn Yasar, from Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: "There is no commander of ten [people] except that he will be brought on the Day of Resurrection, his hands shackled to his neck, either the truth releases him or destroys him."
17.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Sa'id ibn Yasar se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Nabi Allah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Das logon ka koi bhi ameer nahi jise Qayamat ke din laaya na jaaye, uske haath uski gardan se bandhe hue, ya to haq usay azaad kare ya usay halaak kar de."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ  يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو   يُحَدِّثُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِيَّاكُمْ وَالظُّلْمَ، فَإِنَّ الظُّلْمَ ظُلُمَاتٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ "
17.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Amr, from Abdullah ibn al-Harith, from Abu Kathir, from Abdullah ibn Amr, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Beware of injustice, for indeed injustice is [multiple] darknesses on the Day of Resurrection."
17.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se bataya: Mujhe Amr ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abdullah ibn al-Harith ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Abu Kathir se: Unhone kaha, Maine Abdullah ibn Amr ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Zulm se bacho, kyunki zulm Qayamat ke din andheron ka anbaar hai."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ  : أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُؤَيِّدُ هَذَا الدِّينَ بِالرَّجُلِ الْفَاجِرِ "
17.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "Indeed Allah supports this religion even through a wicked man."
17.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Mujhe Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab ne bataya ke Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah is deen ki madad ek fasiq aadmi se bhi karwaata hai."

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَزْهَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْحَرَازِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عَامِرٍ هُوَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ لُحَيٍّ الْهَوْزَنِيِّ  ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَامَ فِينَا، فَقَالَ :" أَلا إِنَّ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ افْتَرَقُوا عَلَى ثِنْتَيْنِ وَسَبْعِينَ مِلَّةً، وَإِنَّ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةَ سَتَفْتَرِقُ عَلَى ثَلَاثٍ وَسَبْعِينَ : اثْنَتَانِ وَسَبْعُونَ فِي النَّارِ، وَوَاحِدَةٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ ".
قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : الْحَرَازُ قَبِيلَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ
17.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from Safwan, from Azhar ibn Abdullah al-Harazi, from Abu Amir (Abdullah ibn Luhayy al-Hawzani), from Mu'awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan; with Abdullah al-Darimi's note: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood among us, and said: "Indeed those before you from the People of the Book split into seventy-two sects, and this nation will split into seventy-three: seventy-two in the Fire, and one in Paradise." Abdullah said: al-Haraz is a tribe from the people of Yemen.
17.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne Safwan se bataya: Mujhse Azhar ibn Abdullah al-Harazi ne bataya, Abu Amir se (Abdullah ibn Luhayy al-Hawzani), Mu'awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ humare darmiyan khade hue, aur farmaya: "Sun lo, tumse pehle Ahl-e-Kitaab bahattar firqon mein bant gaye the, aur yeh ummat tehattar firqon mein bantegi: bahattar Jahannam mein, aur ek Jannat mein." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: 'Al-Haraz' Yemen walon ka ek qabeela hai.

17.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ الْجَعْدِ : أَبِي عُثْمَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو رَجَاءٍ الْعُطَارِدِيُّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ   يَرْوِيهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ رَأَى مِنْ أَمِيرِهِ شَيْئًا يَكْرَهُهُ، فَلْيَصْبِرْ، فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَحَدٍ يُفَارِقُ الْجَمَاعَةَ شِبْرًا، فَيَمُوتُ، إِلا مَاتَ مِيتَةً جَاهِلِيَّةً "
17.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from al-Ja'd Abu Uthman, from Abu Raja al-Utaridi, from Ibn Abbas, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whoever sees something from his commander that he dislikes, let him be patient, for indeed there is no one who separates from the community by a hand-span and dies, except that he dies a death of the Jahiliyyah."
17.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, al-Ja'd Abu Uthman se, Abu Raja al-Utaridi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibn Abbas ko Nabi ﷺ se yeh riwayat karte suna: Aapne farmaya, "Jo apne ameer mein koi aisi cheez dekhe jo usay na-pasand ho, to woh sabr kare, kyunki jo bhi jama'at se ek baalisht bhar bhi alag ho aur mar jaaye, to woh Jahiliyat ki maut marta hai."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِيَاسُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ سَلَّ عَلَيْنَا السِّلَاحَ، فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا "
17.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Ikrimah ibn Ammar, from Iyas ibn Salamah, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whoever draws a weapon against us, is not of us."
17.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Ikrimah ibn Ammar se bataya: Humein Iyas ibn Salamah ne bataya, apne walid se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Jo humpar hathiyaar chalaaye, woh humme se nahi."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ  يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ   أَنَّهُ قَالَ وَهُوَ عِنْدَهُ فِي وَفْدٍ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ : إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" إِنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ فِي قُرَيْشٍ، لَا يُعَادِيهِمْ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا كَبَّهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ، مَا أَقَامُوا الدِّينَ "
17.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb ibn Abi Hamzah, from al-Zuhri, about Muhammad ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im and Mu'awiyah: He said: Muhammad ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im used to narrate, from Mu'awiyah, that he said, while he was with him among a delegation from Quraysh: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Indeed this matter [of leadership] is in Quraysh, no one opposes them except that Allah topples him on his face, as long as they establish the religion."
17.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb ibn Abi Hamzah se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Unhone kaha, Muhammad ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im, Mu'awiyah se riwayat karte the ke unhone kaha, jabke woh Quraysh ke ek wafd mein unke paas the: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Yeh maamla (khilaafat) Quraysh mein hai, koi bhi unse dushmani nahi karta magar Allah usay uske muh ke bal gira deta hai, jab tak woh deen qaayam rakhein."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هُرْمُزَ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" قُرَيْشٌ، وَالْأَنْصَارُ، وَمُزَيْنَةُ وَجُهَيْنَةُ، وَأَسْلَمُ، وَغِفَارٌ، وَأَشْجَعُ، لَيْسَ لَهُمْ مَوْلًى دُونَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ "
17.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Sa'd ibn Ibrahim, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Hurmuz al-A'raj, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Quraysh, and the Ansar, and Muzaynah, and Juhaynah, and Aslam, and Ghifar, and Ashja', have no ally/patron besides Allah and His Messenger."
17.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Sa'd ibn Ibrahim se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Hurmuz al-A'raj se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Quraysh, aur Ansar, aur Muzaynah aur Juhaynah, aur Aslam, aur Ghifar, aur Ashja', inka Allah aur uske Rasool ke siwa koi sarparast nahi."

17.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ كَانَ أَسْلَمُ، وَغِفَارٌ خَيْرًا مِنَ الْحَلِيفَيْنِ أَسَدٍ وَغَطَفَانَ، أَتُرَوْنَهُمْ خَسِرُوا؟ ".
قَالُوا : نَعَمْ.
قَالَ : " فَإِنَّهُمْ خَيْرٌ مِنْهُمْ ".
قَالَ : " أَفَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ كَانَتْ مُزَيْنَةُ، وَجُهَيْنَةُ خَيْرًا مِنْ تَمِيمٍ وَعَامِرِ بْنِ صَعْصَعَةَ وَمَدَّ بِهَا صَوْتَهُ أَتُرَوْنَهُمْ خَسِرُوا؟ ".
قَالُوا : نَعَمْ.
قَالَ : " فَإِنَّهُمْ خَيْرٌ مِنْهُمْ "
17.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ali ibn Zayd, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakrah, from his father: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "What do you think, if Aslam and Ghifar were better than the two allied tribes Asad and Ghatafan, do you think they [Asad and Ghatafan] have lost out?" They said, "Yes." He said: "Then they [Aslam and Ghifar] are better than them." He said: "What do you think, if Muzaynah and Juhaynah were better than Tamim and Amir ibn Sa'sa'ah" - and he raised his voice with it - "do you think they have lost out?" They said, "Yes." He said: "Then they are better than them."
17.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ali ibn Zayd se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakrah se, apne walid se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Tumhara kya khayal hai, agar Aslam aur Ghifar do mit'tehid qabeelon Asad aur Ghatafan se behtar hon, to kya tumhein lagta hai unhone nuqsaan uthaaya?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Aapne farmaya: "To woh unse behtar hain." Aapne farmaya: "Tumhara kya khayal hai, agar Muzaynah aur Juhaynah Tamim aur Amir ibn Sa'sa'ah se behtar hon" - aur aapne apni awaaz isme bulund ki - "to kya tumhein lagta hai unhone nuqsaan uthaaya?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Aapne farmaya: "To woh unse behtar hain."

17.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ هُوَ : ابْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ  عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" غِفَارٌ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهَا، وَأَسْلَمُ سَالَمَهَا اللَّهُ "
17.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Maslamah, from Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah, from Humayd ibn Hilal, from Abdullah ibn al-Samit, from Abu Dharr: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Ghifar, may Allah forgive it, and Aslam, may Allah grant it peace."
17.hi: Abdullah ibn Maslamah ne Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah se, Humayd ibn Hilal se, Abdullah ibn al-Samit se, Abu Dharr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Ghifar, Allah usay bakhshe, aur Aslam, Allah usay salaamat rakhe."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ  ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" غِفَارٌ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهَا، وَأَسْلَمُ سَالَمَهَا اللَّهُ، وَعُصَيَّةُ عَصَتِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ "
17.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Abd al-Aziz, from Musa ibn Uqbah, from Abdullah ibn Dinar, from Ibn Umar: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Ghifar, may Allah forgive it, and Aslam, may Allah grant it peace, and Usayyah disobeyed Allah and His Messenger."
17.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Abd al-Aziz se, Musa ibn Uqbah se, Abdullah ibn Dinar se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Ghifar, Allah usay bakhshe, aur Aslam, Allah usay salaamat rakhe, aur Usayyah ne Allah aur uske Rasool ki nafarmani ki."

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   قِيلَ لِشَرِيكٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟.
قَالَ : نَعَمْ" لا حِلْفَ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ، وَالْحِلْفُ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ لَمْ يَزِدْهُ الْإِسْلَامُ إِلَّا شِدَّةً وَحِدَّةً "
17.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sharik, from Simak, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas; it was said to Sharik, about the Prophet ﷺ: It was said to Sharik: [Is this] from the Prophet ﷺ? He said: Yes, "There is no [new] alliance in Islam, and any alliance from the Jahiliyyah, Islam only increased it in strength and firmness."
17.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sharik se, Simak se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Sharik se poocha gaya: [Kya yeh] Nabi ﷺ se hai? Unhone kaha: Haan, "Islam mein [naya] muahida nahi hai, aur Jahiliyat mein jo muahida ho chuka tha, Islam ne usay sirf mazbooti aur sakhti mein badhaaya hai."

17.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِمُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ  : أَكَانَ أَنَسٌ   يَذْكُرُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ لِلنُّعْمَانِ بْنِ مُقَرِّنٍ :" ابْنُ أُخْتِ الْقَوْمِ مِنْهُمْ؟ ".
قَالَ : نَعَمْ
17.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Shu'bah: He said: I said to Mu'awiyah ibn Qurrah: Did Anas mention that the Prophet ﷺ said to al-Nu'man ibn Muqarrin: "The nephew of a people is one of them"? He said, "Yes."
17.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Mu'awiyah ibn Qurrah se poocha: Kya Anas zikr karte the ke Nabi ﷺ ne al-Nu'man ibn Muqarrin se farmaya: "Qaum ki behen ka beta unhi mein se hota hai"? Unhone kaha, "Haan."

17.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ  ، عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَوْلَى الْقَوْمِ مِنْهُمْ، وَحَلِيفُ الْقَوْمِ مِنْهُمْ، وَابْنُ أُخْتِ الْقَوْمِ مِنْهُمْ "
17.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah, from Isa ibn Yunus, from Kathir ibn Abdullah, from his father, from his grandfather: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The freed slave of a people is one of them, and the ally of a people is one of them, and the sister's son of a people is one of them."
17.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah ne Isa ibn Yunus se, Kathir ibn Abdullah se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Qaum ka azaad kiya hua ghulam unhi mein se hota hai, aur qaum ka mit'tehid unhi mein se hota hai, aur qaum ki behen ka beta unhi mein se hota hai."

17.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتَوَائِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ غَنْمٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ خَارِجَةَ  ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ تَحْتَ نَاقَةِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَسَمِعْتُهُ، يَقُولُ :" مَنِ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ، أَوِ انْتَمَى إِلَى غَيْرِ مَوَالِيهِ، رَغْبَةً عَنْهُمْ، فَعَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ، وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ، وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ، لَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ صَرْفٌ وَلَا عَدْلٌ "
17.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Hisham al-Dastawa'i, from Qatadah, from Shahr ibn Hawshab, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Ghanm, from Amr ibn Kharijah: He said: I was beneath the she-camel of the Prophet ﷺ, and I heard him say: "Whoever claims [descent] to other than his father, or attributes himself to other than his patrons, out of aversion to them, upon him is the curse of Allah, and the angels, and all the people, no compensation nor ransom will be accepted from him."
17.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Hisham al-Dastawa'i se, Qatadah se, Shahr ibn Hawshab se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Ghanm se, Amr ibn Kharijah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Nabi ﷺ ki oontni ke neeche tha, aur maine aapko farmaate suna, "Jo apne baap ke siwa kisi aur ka dawa kare, ya apne sarparaston ke siwa kisi aur se apni nisbat kare, unse bezaar hote hue, uspar Allah ki, aur farishton ki, aur tamaam logon ki lanat hai, na uski koi tabdeeli qabool ki jaayegi na fidya."

17.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ  ،  عَنْ سَعْدٍ   وَأَبِي بَكْرَةَ   أَنَّهُمَا حَدَّثَا : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنِ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ وَهُوَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ غَيْرُ أَبِيهِ، فَالْجَنَّةُ عَلَيْهِ حَرَامٌ "
17.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Asim, from Abu Uthman, from Sa'd and Abu Bakrah, that they both narrated: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever claims [descent] to other than his father, while knowing that he is not his father, Paradise is forbidden to him."
17.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Asim se, Abu Uthman se, Sa'd aur Abu Bakrah se bataya ke un dono ne riwayat ki: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo apne baap ke siwa kisi aur ka dawa kare jabke usay maloom ho ke woh uska baap nahi, uspar Jannat haraam hai."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرٍ  ، يَقُولُ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" الْحَلَالُ بَيِّنٌ وَالْحَرَامُ بَيِّنٌ، وَبَيْنَهُمَا مُتَشَابِهَاتٌ، لَا يَعْلَمُهَا كَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ فَمَنْ اتَّقَى الشُّبُهَاتِ، اسْتَبْرَأَ لِعِرْضِهِ وَدِينِهِ، وَمَنْ وَقَعَ فِي الشُّبُهَاتِ، وَقَعَ فِي الْحَرَامِ، كَالرَّاعِي يَرْعَى حَوْلَ الْحِمَى فَيُوشِكُ أَنْ يُوَاقِعَهُ، وَإِنَّ لِكُلِّ مَلِكٍ حِمًى، أَلَا وَإِنَّ حِمَى اللَّهِ مَحَارِمُهُ، أَلَا وَإِنَّ فِي الْجَسَدِ مُضْغَةً، إِذَا صَلَحَتْ ، صَلَحَ الْجَسَدُ كُلُّهُ، وَإِذَا فَسَدَتْ، فَسَدَ الْجَسَدُ كُلُّهُ، أَلَا وَهِيَ الْقَلْبُ "
18.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zakariya, from al-Sha'bi: He said: I heard al-Nu'man ibn Bashir say: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "The lawful is clear and the unlawful is clear, and between them are ambiguous matters which many people do not know; so whoever guards against the ambiguous matters, has cleared himself for his honor and his religion, and whoever falls into the ambiguous matters, falls into the unlawful, like a shepherd who grazes around a protected pasture, he is likely to graze within it; and indeed every king has a protected pasture, and indeed the protected pasture of Allah is His prohibitions; and indeed in the body there is a piece of flesh, if it is sound, the whole body is sound, and if it is corrupt, the whole body is corrupt; indeed it is the heart."
18.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zakariya se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Nu'man ibn Bashir ko kehte suna: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Halal saaf hai aur haraam saaf hai, aur in dono ke darmiyan shuba wali cheezein hain jinhein bahut se log nahi jaante; so jo shubhaat se bache, usne apni izzat aur apne deen ko bacha liya, aur jo shubhaat mein pad jaaye, woh haraam mein pad jaata hai, jaise woh charwaaha jo mahfooz charagaah ke aas-paas charaata hai to qareeb hota hai ke woh usmein dakhil ho jaaye; aur har baadshah ki ek mahfooz charagaah hoti hai, sun lo, Allah ki mahfooz charagaah uski haraam cheezein hain; sun lo, jism mein ek gosht ka tukda hai, agar woh theek ho, to poora jism theek hota hai, aur agar woh bigad jaaye, to poora jism bigad jaata hai; sun lo, woh dil hai."

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْحَوْرَاءِ السَّعْدِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ   : مَا تَحْفَظُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟.
قَالَ : سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ عَنْ مَسْأَلَةٍ لَا أَدْرِي مَا هِيَ، فَقَالَ :" دَعْ مَا يَرِيبُكَ إِلَى مَا لَا يَرِيبُكَ "
18.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Burayd ibn Abi Maryam, from Abu al-Hawra al-Sa'di: He said: I said to al-Hasan ibn Ali: "What do you remember from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" He said: A man asked him about a matter, I do not know what it was, so he said: "Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt."
18.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Burayd ibn Abi Maryam se, Abu al-Hawra al-Sa'di se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Hasan ibn Ali (Alayhis Salam) se poocha: "Aapko Rasulullah ﷺ se kya yaad hai?" Unhone kaha: Ek aadmi ne aapse ek maamle ke baare mein poocha, mujhe nahi maloom woh kya tha, to aapne farmaya: "Jo cheez tumhein shak mein daale usay chhod do us cheez ke liye jo tumhein shak mein na daale."

18.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّبَيْرِ أَبِي عَبْدِ السَّلَامِ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مِكْرَزٍ الْفِهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ وَابِصَةَ بْنِ مَعْبَدٍ الْأَسَدِيِّ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ لِوَابِصَةَ : " جِئْتَ تَسْأَلُ عَنِ الْبِرِّ وَالْإِثْمِ؟ ".
قَالَ : قُلْتُ : نَعَمْ.
قَالَ : فَجَمَعَ أَصَابِعَهُ فَضَرَبَ بِهَا صَدْرَهُ، وَقَالَ :" اسْتَفْتِ نَفْسَكَ.
اسْتَفْتِ قَلْبَكَ يَا وَابِصَةُ ثَلَاثًا الْبِرُّ مَا اطْمَأَنَّتْ إِلَيْهِ النَّفْسُ وَاطْمَأَنَّ إِلَيْهِ الْقَلْبُ، وَالْإِثْمُ مَا حَاكَ فِي النَّفْسِ وَتَرَدَّدَ فِي الصَّدْرِ، وَإِنْ أَفْتَاكَ النَّاسُ وَأَفْتَوْكَ "
18.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from al-Zubayr Abu Abd al-Salam, from Ayyub ibn Abdullah ibn Mikraz al-Fihri, from Wabisah ibn Ma'bad al-Asadi: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Wabisah: "Have you come to ask about righteousness and sin?" He said: I said, "Yes." He said: So he gathered his fingers and struck his chest with them, and said: "Ask your own self for a ruling. Ask your heart for a ruling, O Wabisah," three times, "righteousness is that which the soul is tranquil about and the heart is tranquil about, and sin is that which wavers in the soul and goes back and forth in the chest, even if people give you rulings and give you rulings."
18.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, al-Zubayr Abu Abd al-Salam se, Ayyub ibn Abdullah ibn Mikraz al-Fihri se, Wabisah ibn Ma'bad al-Asadi se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne Wabisah se farmaya: "Kya tum neki aur gunah ke baare mein poochne aaye ho?" Unhone kaha: Maine kaha, "Haan." Unhone bataya: To aapne apni ungliyan jama kin aur unse apni chhaati par maara, aur farmaya: "Apne dil se fatwa maango. Apne dil se fatwa maango, Ae Wabisah," teen martaba, "neki woh hai jispar dil ko sukoon mile aur jispar dil mutma-in ho, aur gunah woh hai jo dil mein khatka paida kare aur seene mein aage-peechhe hota rahe, chahe log tumhein fatwa dein aur tumhein fatwa dein."

18.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حُرَّةَ الرَّقَاشِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ  ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ آخِذًا بِزِمَامِ نَاقَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي أَوْسَطِ أَيَّامِ التَّشْرِيقِ أَذُودُ النَّاسَ عَنْهُ، فَقَالَ :" أَلَا إِنَّ كُلَّ رِبًا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ مَوْضُوعٌ، أَلَا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ قَضَى أَنَّ أَوَّلَ رِبًا يُوضَعُ رِبَا عَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، لَكُمْ رُءُوسُ أَمْوَالِكُمْ لَا تَظْلِمُونَ وَلَا تُظْلَمُونَ "
18.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ali ibn Zayd, from Abu Hurrah al-Raqashi, from his uncle: He said: I was holding the rein of the she-camel of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ during the middle days of Tashriq, keeping the people away from him, so he said: "Listen, every usury from the Jahiliyyah is abolished, listen, indeed Allah has decreed that the first usury to be abolished is the usury of al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib, you have the principal of your wealth, do not wrong nor be wronged."
18.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ali ibn Zayd se, Abu Hurrah al-Raqashi se, apne chacha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Rasulullah ﷺ ki oontni ki nakel pakde hue tha ayyaam-e-tashriq ke beech ke din, logon ko usse door rakhte hue, to aapne farmaya: "Sun lo, Jahiliyat ka har sood mauqoof hai, sun lo, Allah ne faisla kiya hai ke sabse pehla sood jo mauqoof kiya jaata hai woh Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib ka sood hai, tumhare liye tumhare maal ke asal (mool dhan) hain, na tum zulm karo na tumpar zulm kiya jaaye."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ هُزَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : " لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَآكِلَ الرِّبَا وَمُؤْكِلَهُ "
18.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from Abu Qays, from Huzayl, from Abdullah: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the one who consumes usury and the one who feeds it [to another]."
18.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se, Abu Qays se, Huzayl se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne sood khaane wale aur sood khilaane wale [dono] par lanat ki."

18.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَيَأْتِيَنَّ زَمَانٌ لَا يُبَالِي الْمَرْءُ بِمَا أَخَذَ الْمَالَ، بِحَلَالٍ أَمْ بِحَرَامٍ "
18.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Yunus, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from Sa'id al-Maqburi, from Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A time will surely come upon the people when a man will not care from where he takes wealth, whether lawful or unlawful."
18.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Yunus ne Ibn Abi Dhi'b se, Sa'id al-Maqburi se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Ek zamana zaroor aayega jab aadmi iski parwaah nahi karega ke usne maal halal se liya ya haraam se."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا قَبِيصَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ عَمَّتِهِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ أَحَقَّ مَا يَأْكُلُ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ أَطْيَبِ كَسْبِهِ، وَإِنَّ وَلَدَهُ مِنْ أَطْيَبِ كَسْبِهِ "
18.en: Narrated by Qabisah, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from Umarah ibn Umayr, from his paternal aunt, from Aisha: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed the most deserving of what a man eats is from his purest earning, and indeed his child is from his purest earning."
18.hi: Qabisah ne Sufyan se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se, Umarah ibn Umayr se, apni phuphi se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Aadmi jo sabse zyada haqdaar cheez khaata hai woh uski sabse paak kamaai hai, aur uska bachcha bhi uski sabse paak kamaai mein se hai."

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ هُوَ : ابْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ  عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ  ، قَالَ : خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَى الْبَقِيعِ ، فَقَالَ : " يَا مَعْشَرَ التُّجَّارِ ! " حَتَّى إِذَا اشْرَأَبُّوا.
قَالَ :" التُّجَّارُ يُحْشَرُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فُجَّارًا، إِلَّا مَنِ اتَّقَى اللَّهَ، وَبَرَّ، وَصَدَقَ ".
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : كَانَ أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، يَقُولُ : عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رِفَاعَةَ، وَإِنَّمَا هُوَ : إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ
18.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from Abdullah ibn Uthman ibn Khuthaym, from Isma'il ibn Rifa'ah, from his father, from his grandfather; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out to al-Baqi', and said: "O assembly of merchants!" until they stretched their necks [to listen]. He said: "The merchants will be gathered on the Day of Resurrection as wicked sinners, except whoever fears Allah, and is righteous, and is truthful." Abu Muhammad said: Abu Nu'aym used to say: Ubaydullah ibn Rifa'ah, but it is rather: Isma'il ibn Ubayd ibn Rifa'ah.
18.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se, Abdullah ibn Uthman ibn Khuthaym se, Isma'il ibn Rifa'ah se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ al-Baqi' ki taraf nikle, aur farmaya: "Ae taajiron ki jama'at!" yahan tak ke unhone apni gardanein utha lin. Aapne farmaya: "Taajir Qayamat ke din gunahgaaron ki tarah utaaye jaayenge, siwaay us shakhs ke jo Allah se dare, aur neik ho, aur sachcha ho." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Abu Nu'aym kaha karte the: Ubaydullah ibn Rifa'ah, lekin sahih naam hai: Isma'il ibn Ubayd ibn Rifa'ah.

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا قَبِيصَةُ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" التَّاجِرُ الصَّدُوقُ الْأَمِينُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ ".
 قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ : لَا عِلْمَ لِي بِهِ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَ سَمِعَ مِنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، وَقَالَ : أَبُو حَمْزَةَ هَذَا، هُوَ صَاحِبُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَهُوَ : مَيْمُونٌ الْأَعْوَرُ
18.en: Narrated by Qabisah, from Sufyan, from Abu Hamzah, from al-Hasan, from Abu Sa'id, from the Prophet ﷺ; with Abdullah al-Darimi's note: He said: "The truthful, trustworthy merchant is with the prophets, and the truthful ones, and the martyrs." Abdullah said: I do not have knowledge that al-Hasan heard from Abu Sa'id, and he said: this Abu Hamzah is the companion of Ibrahim, and he is: Maymun al-A'war.
18.hi: Qabisah ne Sufyan se, Abu Hamzah se, al-Hasan se, Abu Sa'id se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Sachcha, ameen taajir Anbiya, aur siddiqeen, aur shuhada ke saath hoga." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Mujhe iska ilm nahi ke al-Hasan ne Abu Sa'id se suna hai, aur unhone kaha: yeh Abu Hamzah, Ibrahim ke saathi hain, aur woh hain: Maymun al-A'war.

18.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل  ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : " بَايَعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَىإِقَامِ الصَّلَاةِ، وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ، وَالنُّصْحِ لِكُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ "
18.en: Narrated by Ya'la ibn Ubayd, from Isma'il, from Qays, from Jarir ibn Abdullah: He said: "I pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ upon establishing prayer, and giving zakah, and sincere advice to every Muslim."
18.hi: Ya'la ibn Ubayd ne Isma'il se, Qays se, Jarir ibn Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Maine Rasulullah ﷺ se namaz qaayam karne, zakat dene, aur har Musalman ke liye khair-khwaahi rakhne par bay'at ki."

18.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَقِيلٍ : يَحْيَى بْنُ الْمُتَوَكِّلِ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَرَّ بِطَعَامٍ بِسُوقِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَأَعْجَبَهُ حُسْنُهُ، فَأَدْخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَدَهُ فِي جَوْفِهِ، فَأَخْرَجَ شَيْئًا لَيْسَ كَالظَّاهِرِ فَأَفَّفَ بِصَاحِبِ الطَّعَامِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ :" لَا غِشَّ بَيْنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، مَنْ غَشَّنَا فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا "
18.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Salt, from Abu Aqil Yahya ibn al-Mutawakkil, from al-Qasim ibn Ubaydullah, from Salim, from Ibn Umar: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by food in the market of Madinah, and its good appearance impressed him, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ put his hand into its interior, and pulled out something not like what appeared on the surface, so he expressed his displeasure to the owner of the food, then said: "There is no deception between Muslims, whoever deceives us is not of us."
18.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Salt ne Abu Aqil Yahya ibn al-Mutawakkil se bataya: Mujhe al-Qasim ibn Ubaydullah ne bataya, Salim se, Ibn Umar se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ Madinah ke bazaar mein khaane ke paas se guzre to uski achhi shakl aapko pasand aayi, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne apna haath uske andar daala, to aapne aisi cheez nikaali jo baahar dikh rahi cheez jaisi nahi thi, to aapne khaane wale par na-razgi zaahir ki, fir farmaya: "Musalmanon ke darmiyan koi dhoka nahi, jo humein dhoka de woh humme se nahi."

18.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لِكُلِّ غَادِرٍ لِوَاءٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يُقَالُ : هَذِهِ غَدْرَةُ فُلَانٍ "
18.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Rabi', from Shu'bah, from Sulayman, from Abu Wa'il, from Abdullah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "For every betrayer there is a banner on the Day of Resurrection, it will be said: This is the betrayal of so-and-so."
18.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Rabi' ne Shu'bah se, Sulayman se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Wa'il ko suna, Abdullah se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Har dagha-baaz ke liye Qayamat ke din ek jhanda hoga, kaha jaayega: Yeh fulaan ki daghabaazi hai."

18.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ،  عَنْ مَعْمَرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نَافِعِ بْنِ نَضْلَةَ الْعَدَوِيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" لَا يَحْتَكِرُ إِلَّا خَاطِئٌ مَرَّتَيْنِ "
18.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Ma'mar ibn Abdullah ibn Nafi' ibn Nadlah al-Adawi: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "None hoards except a sinner," twice.
18.hi: Ahmad ibn Khalid ne Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, Muhammad ibn Ibrahim se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se, Ma'mar ibn Abdullah ibn Nafi' ibn Nadlah al-Adawi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Koi bhi zakheera-andozi nahi karta magar gunahgaar," do martaba.

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُدْعَانَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" الْجَالِبُ مَرْزُوقٌ، وَالْمُحْتَكِرُ مَلْعُونٌ "
18.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Isra'il, from Ali ibn Salim, from Ali ibn Zayd ibn Jud'an, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Umar, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "The one who brings goods to market is provided for, and the hoarder is cursed."
18.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Isra'il se, Ali ibn Salim se, Ali ibn Zayd ibn Jud'an se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se, Umar se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Maal laane wale ko rizq milta hai, aur zakheera karne wala mal'oon hai."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ  ، وَثَابِتٍ  ، وَقَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : غَلَا السِّعْرُ عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ النَّاسُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ غَلَا السِّعْرُ فَسَعِّرْ لَنَا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْخَالِقُ الْقَابِضُ الْبَاسِطُ الرَّازِقُ، الْمُسَعِّرُ، وَإِنِّي أَرْجُو أَنْ أَلْقَى رَبِّي وَلَيْسَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ يَطْلُبُنِي بِمَظْلَمَةٍ ظَلَمْتُهَا إِيَّاهُ بِدَمٍ وَلَا مَالٍ "
18.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Humayd, and Thabit, and Qatadah, from Anas: He said: Prices became high in the time of the Prophet ﷺ, so the people said: "O Messenger of Allah, prices have gone up, so set prices for us," so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed Allah is the Creator, the Withholder, the Extender, the Provider, the one who sets prices, and I hope to meet my Lord while none of you seeks a wrong from me that I wronged him in, whether of blood or wealth."
18.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Hammad ibn Salamah se bataya: Humein Humayd, aur Thabit, aur Qatadah ne bataya, Anas se: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ ke zamane mein qeematein bahut badh gayin, to logon ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, qeematein badh gayi hain, so humare liye narkh muqarrar kar dijiye," to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Allah hi Khaaliq hai, Rokne wala, Phailaane wala, Rizq dene wala, Narkh muqarrar karne wala, aur main ummeed rakhta hoon ke main apne Rab se milun jabke tum mein se koi bhi mujhse kisi zulm ka mutaaliba na kare jo maine uspar kiya ho, chahe woh khoon ka ho ya maal ka."

18.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ الْمُعْتَمِرِ  ،  عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ حِرَاشٍ  : أَنَّ حُذَيْفَةَ   حَدَّثَهُمْ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" تَلَقَّتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ رُوحَ رَجُلٍ مِمَّنْ قَبْلَكُمْ، فَقَالُوا : أَعَمِلْتَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ شَيْئًا؟، فَقَالَ : لَا، قَالُوا : تَذَكَّرْ.
قَالَ : كُنْتُ أُدَايِنُ النَّاسَ فَآمُرُ فِتْيَانِي أَنْ يُنْظِرُوا الْمُعْسِرَ، وَيَتَجَاوَزُوا عَنِ الْمُوسِرِ ".
قَالَ : " قَالَ اللَّهُ : تَجَاوَزُوا عَنْهُ "
18.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Yunus, from Zuhayr, from Mansur ibn al-Mu'tamir, from Rib'i ibn Hirash, about Hudhayfah: That Hudhayfah narrated to them: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The angels met the soul of a man from among those before you, and said: 'Did you do any good?' He said, 'No.' They said: 'Recall.'" He said: "I used to lend to people, so I would command my young men to give respite to the one in difficulty, and overlook the wealthy one." He said: "Allah said: 'Overlook him.'"
18.hi: Ahmad ibn Yunus ne Zuhayr se bataya: Humein Mansur ibn al-Mu'tamir ne bataya, Rib'i ibn Hirash se: ke Hudhayfah ne unhein bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Farishtay tumse pehle logon mein se ek aadmi ki rooh se mile, aur poocha: 'Kya tumne koi neki ki?' Usne kaha, 'Nahi.' Unhone kaha: 'Yaad karo.'" Unhone kaha: "Main logon ko qarz diya karta tha, to main apne jawaan ladkon ko hukum deta ke woh tang-daast ko mohlat dein, aur maal-daar ko mu'aaf kar dein." Aapne farmaya: "Allah ne farmaya: 'Isay mu'aaf kar do.'"

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ أَبِي الْخَلِيلِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" الْبَيِّعَانِ بِالْخِيَارِ مَا لَمْ يَتَفَرَّقَا فَإِنْ صَدَقَا وَبَيَّنَا، بُورِكَ لَهُمَا فِي بَيْعِهِمَا، وَإِنْ كَذَبَا وَكَتَمَا، مُحِقَ بَرَكَةُ بَيْعِهِمَا ".
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، بِإِسْنَادِهِ مِثْلَهُ
18.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Sa'id, from Qatadah, from Salih Abu al-Khalil, from Abdullah ibn al-Harith, from Hakim ibn Hizam; a similar chain also via Abu al-Walid: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The two parties to a sale have the option [to cancel] as long as they have not separated; so if they are truthful and clear, their sale is blessed, and if they lie and conceal, the blessing of their sale is erased." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, with his chain, the same.]
18.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Sa'id se, Qatadah se, Salih Abu al-Khalil se, Abdullah ibn al-Harith se, Hakim ibn Hizam se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Bechne aur khareedne wale ko [saude ko khatam karne ka] ikhtiyaar hai jab tak woh alag na hon; so agar dono sachche rahein aur saaf-saaf batayein, to unke saude mein barkat di jaayegi, aur agar dono jhoot bolein aur chhupaayein, to unke saude ki barkat mita di jaayegi." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Abu al-Walid se, Shu'bah se, Qatadah se, unki sanad ke saath bhi aayi hai.]

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" الْبَيِّعَانِ إِذَا اخْتَلَفَا وَالْمَبيعُ قَائِمٌ بِعَيْنِهِ، وَلَيْسَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَيِّنَةٌ، فَالْقَوْلُ مَا قَالَ الْبَائِعُ، أَوْ يَتَرَادَّانِ الْبَيْعَ "
18.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Hushaym, from Ibn Abi Layla, from al-Qasim ibn Abd al-Rahman, from his father, from Abdullah: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "When the two parties to a sale disagree, and the sold item still exists as it was, and there is no evidence between them, then the word is what the seller says, or they undo the sale."
18.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Hushaym se bataya: Humein Ibn Abi Layla ne bataya, al-Qasim ibn Abd al-Rahman se, apne walid se, Abdullah se: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Jab bechne aur khareedne wale ikhtilaaf karein, aur bechi hui cheez apni asal haalat mein maujood ho, aur unke darmiyan koi gawahi na ho, to baat woh hai jo bechne wala kahe, ya woh saude ko wapas kar dein."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ : ابْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ شِمَاسَةَ  ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" لَا يَحِلُّ لِامْرِئٍ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ أَنْ يَبِيعَ عَلَى بَيْعِ أَخِيهِ حَتَّى يَتْرُكَهُ "
18.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Shimasah, from Uqbah ibn Amir: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "It is not lawful for a man who believes in Allah and the Last Day to sell over the sale of his brother, until he leaves it."
18.hi: Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, Yazid ibn Abi Habib se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Shimasah se, Uqbah ibn Amir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Us aadmi ke liye halal nahi jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta ho ke woh apne bhai ke saude par apna saude de, jab tak woh usay chhod na de."

18.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ،  عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" عُهْدَةُ الرَّقِيقِ ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ "
18.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Aban ibn Yazid, from Qatadah, from al-Hasan, from Uqbah ibn Amir: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "The warranty period for a slave is three days."
18.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Aban ibn Yazid se, Qatadah se, al-Hasan se, Uqbah ibn Amir se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Ghulam ki zamaanat ki muddat teen din hai."

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ الْعَامِرِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" عُهْدَةُ الرَّقِيقِ ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ ".
فَفَسَّرَهُ قَتَادَةُ : إِنْ وَجَدَ فِي الثَّلَاثِ عَيْبًا رَدَّهُ بِغَيْرِ بَيِّنَةٍ، وَإِنْ وَجَدَهُ بَعْدَ ثَلاثَةٍ، لَمْ يَرُدَّهُ إِلَّا بِبَيِّنَةٍ
18.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hammam, from Qatadah, from al-Hasan, from Uqbah ibn al-Amir; with Qatadah's interpretation: He said: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The warranty period for a slave is three days." So Qatadah interpreted it: If a defect is found within the three, he returns him without evidence, and if he finds it after three, he does not return him except with evidence.
18.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hammam se, Qatadah se, al-Hasan se, Uqbah ibn al-Amir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, "Ghulam ki zamaanat ki muddat teen din hai." To Qatadah ne iski ta'weel yeh ki: Agar teen din ke andar aib mile, to woh usay bagair gawahi ke wapas kar de, aur agar teen din ke baad mile, to woh usay sirf gawahi ke saath wapas kare.

18.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمِنْهَالِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ هُوَ : ابْنُ حَسَّانَ  عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنِ اشْتَرَى شَاةً مُصَرَّاةً أَوْ لَقْحَةً مُصَرَّاةً، فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ، فَإِنْ رَدَّهَا، رَدَّ مَعَهَا صَاعًا مِنْ طَعَامٍ لَا سَمْرَاءَ "
18.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Minhal, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Hisham ibn Hassan, from Muhammad ibn Sirin, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever buys a sheep whose udder has been left un-milked to appear plentiful, or a she-camel similarly, he has the option for three days, so if he returns it, he returns with it a sa' of food, not of wheat."
18.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Minhal ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Hisham ibn Hassan se, Muhammad ibn Sirin se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo aisi bhed khareede jiska thann [dhoka dene ke liye] bharaa hua ho, ya aisi oontni, to usay teen din ka ikhtiyaar hai, so agar woh usay wapas kare, to uske saath khaane ka ek sa' bhi wapas kare, gehun ka nahi."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى الْقَطَّانُ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْبَيْعِ الْغَرَرِ "
18.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yahya al-Qattan, from Ubaydullah, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurairah: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of gharar [excessive uncertainty/risk]."
18.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Yahya al-Qattan se, Ubaydullah se, Abu al-Zinad se, al-A'raj se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne gharar (dhoke, ghair-yaqeeni) ki bikri se mana kiya."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْبَيْعِ الثِّمَارِ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلَاحُهَا، نَهَى الْبَائِعَ وَالْمُشْتَرِيَ "
18.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of fruits until their ripeness becomes apparent, he forbade both the seller and the buyer."
18.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne phalon ki bikri se, jab tak unka pakna zaahir na ho jaaye, mana kiya, aapne bechne wale aur khareedne wale dono ko mana kiya."

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنِ ابْتَاعَ ثَمَرَةً فَأَصَابَتْهُ جَائِحَةٌ، فَلَا يَأْخُذَنَّ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا.
بِمَ تَأْخُذُ مَالَ أَخِيكَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ؟ "
18.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever buys fruit and it is struck by a natural calamity, let him not take anything from it [i.e., the seller must bear the loss]. On what basis would you take your brother's wealth without right?"
18.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Ibn Jurayj se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jo phal khareede aur usay koi aafat (aasmani museebat) lag jaaye, to woh [bechne wala] usse kuch na le. Tum apne bhai ka maal bila haq kis buniyaad par lo ge?"

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ح وحَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنِالْمُحَاقَلَةِ وَالْمُزَابَنَةِ ".
قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : الْمُحَاقَلَةُ : بَيْعُ الزَّرْعِ بِالْبُرِّ.
وَقَالُوا : كَذَلِكَ يَقُولُ ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ
18.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Amr; a similar chain also via Musaddad, from Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Sa'id; with Abdullah al-Darimi's clarification: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade al-muhaqalah and al-muzabanah." Abdullah said: al-muhaqalah is: selling standing crops for wheat. And they said: Ibn al-Musayyab says the same.
18.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid ibn Abdullah se, Muhammad ibn Amr se bataya; aur Musaddad ne bhi bataya: Humein Yahya ne bataya, Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Sa'id se: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne al-muhaqalah aur al-muzabanah se mana kiya." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Al-muhaqalah yeh hai: khadi hui fasal ko gehun ke badle bechna. Aur log kehte hain: Ibn al-Musayyab bhi isi tarah kehte hain.

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ،  عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ  ، قَالَ :" رَخَّصَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي بَيْعِ الْعَرَايَا بِالتَّمْرِ وَالرُّطَبِ، وَلَمْ يُرَخِّصْ فِي غَيْرِ ذَلِكَ "
18.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from al-Awza'i, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim, from Ibn Umar, from Zayd ibn Thabit: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave a concession for selling al-araya [gifted date-palm produce] for dried and fresh dates, and did not give a concession for anything else besides that."
18.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne al-Awza'i se, Ibn Shihab se, Salim se, Ibn Umar se, Zayd ibn Thabit se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne al-araya (tohfe mein di khajoor) ko khajoor aur taazi khajoor ke badle bechne ki rukhsat di, aur iske siwa kisi aur cheez mein rukhsat nahi di."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنِ ابْتَاعَ طَعَامًا، فَلَا يَبِعْهُ حَتَّى يَقْبِضَهُ "
18.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whoever buys food, let him not sell it until he takes possession of it."
18.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jo khaana khareede, woh usay tab tak na beche jab tak usper qabza na kar le."
