18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ الْمُعَلِّمِ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْسَلَفٍ وَبَيْعٍ، وَعَنْ شَرْطَيْنِ فِي بَيْعٍ، وَعَنْ رِبْحِ مَا لَمْ يُضْمَنْ "
18.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Husayn al-Mu'allim, from Amr ibn Shu'ayb, from his father, from his grandfather: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade a loan combined with a sale, and two conditions in one sale, and profit from what has not been guaranteed [i.e., not in one's possession/risk]."
18.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Husayn al-Mu'allim se, Amr ibn Shu'ayb se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne saude ke saath qarz ko, aur ek saude mein do shartein rakhne ko, aur us cheez ke munaafe ko mana kiya jo abhi zimmedaari mein na aayi ho."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنِ اشْتَرَى عَبْدًا وَلَمْ يَشْتَرِطْ مَالَهُ، فَلَا شَيْءَ لَهُ "
18.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Maslamah, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim, from his father: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever buys a slave, and did not stipulate his wealth [with the sale], then he has nothing of it."
18.hi: Abdullah ibn Maslamah ne Ibn Abi Dhi'b se, Ibn Shihab se, Salim se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo ghulam khareede, aur uske maal ki shart na lagaaye, to uske liye usmein se kuch nahi."

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْبَيْعَتَيْنِ، وَعَنْ لِبْسَتَيْنِ : عَنْ بَيْعِ الْمُنَابَذَةِ وَالْمُلَامَسَةِ ".
قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : الْمُنَابَذَةُ : يَرْمِي هَذَا إِلَى ذَاكَ.
وَيَرْمِي ذَاكَ إِلَى هذَا.
قَالَ : كَانَ هَذَا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ
18.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Sufyan, from al-Zuhri, from Ata ibn Yazid, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri; with Abdullah al-Darimi's clarification: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade two [types of] sales, and two [types of] wearing: the sale of munabadhah and mulamasah [pre-Islamic haphazard forms of transaction based on throwing or touching, without proper inspection]." Abdullah said: al-munabadhah is: this one throws to that one, and that one throws to this one. He said: This was in the Jahiliyyah.
18.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Sufyan se, al-Zuhri se, Ata ibn Yazid se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne do tarah ki bikri se, aur do tarah ke pehnaawe se mana kiya: munabadhah aur mulamasah ki bikri se." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: 'Al-Munabadhah' yeh hai: yeh us par phenkta hai, aur woh is par phenkta hai. Unhone kaha: Yeh Jahiliyat mein hota tha.

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْبَيْعِ الْغَرَرِ، وَعَنْ بَيْعِ الْحَصَاةِ ".
قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : إِذَا رَمَى بِحَصًا، وَجَبَ الْبَيْعُ
18.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Uqbah ibn Khalid, from Ubaydullah, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurairah; with Abdullah al-Darimi's clarification: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of gharar, and the sale of pebble-throwing [a pre-Islamic method of concluding a sale by throwing a pebble]." Abdullah said: When he throws a pebble, the sale becomes binding.
18.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Uqbah ibn Khalid se, Ubaydullah se, Abu al-Zinad se, al-A'raj se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne gharar ki bikri se, aur kankari phenk kar bikri karne se mana kiya." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Jab woh kankari phenke, to saude wajib ho jaata hai.

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، وَجَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْبَيْعِ الْحَيَوَانِ بِالْحَيَوَانِ نَسِيئَةً ".
ثُمَّ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَ نَسِيَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ، وَلَمْ يَقُلْ جَعْفَرٌ : ثُمَّ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَ نَسِيَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ
18.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, and Ja'far ibn Awn, from Sa'id, from Qatadah, from al-Hasan, from Samurah ibn Jundub; with a note on al-Hasan forgetting: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of an animal for an animal on credit [deferred payment]." Then al-Hasan forgot this hadith, and Ja'far did not say: then al-Hasan forgot this hadith.
18.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir aur Ja'far ibn Awn ne Sa'id se, Qatadah se, al-Hasan se, Samurah ibn Jundub se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne ek jaanwar ko doosre jaanwar ke udhar badle bechne se mana kiya." Fir al-Hasan is hadith ko bhool gaye, aur Ja'far ne yeh nahi kaha: fir al-Hasan is hadith ko bhool gaye.

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ  ، قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ   : مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : اسْتَسْلَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَكْرًا، فَجَاءَتْ إِبِلٌ مِنْ إِبِلِ الصَّدَقَةِ.
قَالَ أَبُو رَافِعٍ : فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَقْضِيَ الرَّجُلَ بَكْرَهُ، فَقُلْتُ : لَمْ أَجِدْ فِي الْإِبِلِ إِلَّا جَمَلًا خِيَارًا رَبَاعِيًا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَعْطِهِ إِيَّاهُ، فَإِنَّ خَيْرَ النَّاسِ أَحْسَنُهُمْ قَضَاءً ".
قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : هَذَا يُقَوِّي قَوْلَ مَنْ يَقُولُ : الْحَيَوَانُ بِالْحَيَوَانِ
18.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Malik (read to him), from Zayd ibn Aslam, from Ata ibn Yasar, from Abu Rafi', freed servant of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; with Abdullah al-Darimi's note: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ borrowed a young camel, then camels of charity came. Abu Rafi' said: So he commanded me to repay the man his young camel, so I said: "I found among the camels only an excellent, mature four-year-old camel." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Give it to him, for the best of people is the one best in repayment." Abdullah said: This strengthens the saying of those who say: animal for animal [is permissible on credit].
18.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Malik se bataya, unke saamne padha gaya: Zayd ibn Aslam se, Ata ibn Yasar se, Abu Rafi' se (Rasulullah ﷺ ke azaad kiye hue ghulam): Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne ek jawaan oont udhaar liya, fir sadqe ke oont aaye. Abu Rafi' kehte hain: To aapne mujhe hukum diya ke main us aadmi ko uska jawaan oont ada karun, to maine kaha: "Mujhe oonton mein sirf ek behtareen chaar-saal ka oont mila." To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Usay wahi de do, kyunki logon mein sabse behtar woh hai jo ada karne mein sabse achha ho." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Yeh un logon ki baat ko taqwiyat deta hai jo kehte hain: jaanwar jaanwar ke badle [udhar par jaayez hai].

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمِنْهَالِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا تَلَقَّوُا الْجَلَبَ، مَنَ تَلَقَّاهُ فَاشْتَرَى مِنْهُ شَيْئًا، فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ إِذَا دَخَلَ السُّوقَ "
18.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Minhal, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Hisham ibn Hassan, from Muhammad, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do not intercept the incoming goods [before they reach the market]; whoever intercepts it and buys something from it, he has the option once he enters the market."
18.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Minhal ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Hisham ibn Hassan se, Muhammad se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Bazaar aane wale maal ko raaste mein na roko; jo usay roke aur usme se kuch khareed le, to jab woh bazaar mein pahunche to usay ikhtiyaar hai [saude ko radd karne ka]."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا يَبِيعُ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَى بَيْعِ بَعْضٍ، وَلَا تَلَقَّوُا السِّلَعَ حَتَّى يُهْبَطَ بِهَا الْأَسْوَاقَ، وَلَا تَنَاجَشُوا "
18.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "None of you should sell over the sale of another, and do not intercept goods until they are brought down to the markets, and do not artificially raise prices [najash]."
18.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tum mein se koi doosre ke saude par apna saude na de, aur maal ko bazaar mein utaarne se pehle mat roko, aur jhoothi bolion se bhaav mat badhaao."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنِ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْثَمَنِ الْكَلْبِ، وَمَهْرِ الْبَغِيِّ، وَحُلْوَانِ الْكَاهِنِ "، قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : حُلْوَانُ الْكَاهِنِ، مَا يُعْطَى عَلَى كَهَانَتِهِ
18.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Ibn Uyaynah, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Bakr ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Mas'ud; with Abdullah al-Darimi's clarification: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the price of a dog, and the earnings of a prostitute, and the fee of a soothsayer." Abdullah said: The fee of a soothsayer is what is given for his soothsaying.
18.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Ibn Uyaynah se bataya: Mujhse al-Zuhri ne bataya, Abu Bakr ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Abu Mas'ud se: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne kutte ki qeemat se, aur kasbi ki kamaai se, aur kaahin ki mazdoori se mana kiya." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Kaahin ki mazdoori woh hai jo uski kahaanat ke badle di jaaye.

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : لَمَّا نَزَلَتِ الْآيَةُ فِي آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ فِي الرِّبَا، " خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَتَلَاهُنَّ عَلَى النَّاسِ، ثُمَّحَرَّمَ التِّجَارَةَ فِي الْخَمْرِ "
18.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from al-A'mash, from Muslim, from Masruq, from Aisha: She said: When the verse at the end of Surah al-Baqarah about usury was revealed, "the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out and recited them to the people, then forbade trading in wine."
18.hi: Ya'la ne al-A'mash se, Muslim se, Masruq se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Jab Surah Al-Baqarah ke aakhir mein sood ki aayat naazil hui, "Rasulullah ﷺ nikle aur unhein logon ko padh kar sunaaya, fir sharaab ki tijaarat se mana kiya."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : لَمَّا نَزَلَتِ الْآيَاتُ مِنْ أَوَاخِرِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ ، " خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَاقْتَرَأَهُنَّ عَلَى النَّاسِ، ثُمَّ نَهَى عَنِالتِّجَارَةِ فِي الْخَمْرِ "
18.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Jarir, from Mansur, from Abu al-Duha, from Masruq, from Aisha: She said: When the verses from the end of Surah al-Baqarah were revealed, "the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out and recited them to the people, then forbade trading in wine."
18.hi: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ne Jarir se, Mansur se, Abu al-Duha se, Masruq se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Jab Surah Al-Baqarah ke aakhir ki aayaten naazil hui, "Rasulullah ﷺ nikle aur unhein logon ko padh kar sunaaya, fir sharaab ki tijaarat se mana kiya."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ : ابْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ الْقَعْقَاعِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ وَعْلَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ   عَنْ جُلُودِ الْمَيْتَةِ، فَقَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" دِبَاغُهَا طَهُورُهَا "
18.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Yazid, from al-Qa'qa' ibn Hakim, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Wa'lah: He said: I asked Ibn Abbas about the hides of dead animals, so he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Its tanning is its purification."
18.hi: Ahmad ibn Khalid ne Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Yazid se, al-Qa'qa' ibn Hakim se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Wa'lah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibn Abbas se murda jaanwaron ki khaal ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Uska daabgh hona hi uski taharat hai."

18.ar:
وَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْخَمْرِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ ، فَقُلْتُ لَهُ : إِنَّ لَنَا أَعْنَابًا، وَإِنَّا نَتَّخِذُ مِنْهَا هَذِهِ الْخُمُورَ فَنَبِيعُهَا مِنْ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ ؟.
قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ   : أَهْدَى رَجُلٌ مِنْ ثَقِيفٍ أَوْ دَوْسٍ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَاوِيَةً مِنْ خَمْرٍ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَمَا عَلِمْتَ يَا أَبَا فُلَانٍ أَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ حَرَّمَهَا؟ ".
قَالَ : لَا وَاللَّهِ.
قَالَ :" فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ حَرَّمَهَا ".
فَالْتَفَتَ إِلَى غُلَامِهِ، فَقَالَ : اخْرُجْ بِهَا إِلَى الْحَزْوَرَةِ فَبِعْهَا، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَوَ مَا عَلِمْتَ يَا أَبَا فُلَانٍ، أَنَّ الَّذِي حَرَّمَ شُرْبَهَا، حَرَّمَ بَيْعَهَا؟ ".
 قَالَ : فَأَمَرَ بِهَا فَأُفْرِغَتْ فِي الْبَطْحَاءِ
18.en: Continuing the same narration [Abd al-Rahman ibn Wa'lah, from Ibn Abbas]: And I asked him about selling wine to the People of the Covenant [dhimmis], and I said to him: "We have vineyards, and we make these wines from them, so shall we sell them to the People of the Covenant?" Ibn Abbas said: A man from Thaqif or Daws gave the Messenger of Allah ﷺ a large container of wine as a gift, during the Farewell Pilgrimage, so the Prophet ﷺ said to him: "Do you not know, O so-and-so, that Allah has forbidden it?" He said: "No, by Allah." He said: "Then Allah has indeed forbidden it." So he turned to his young servant, and said: Take it out to al-Hazwarah and sell it. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: "Do you not know, O so-and-so, that the One who forbade drinking it, forbade selling it?" He said: So he commanded regarding it, and it was poured out in al-Batha.
18.hi: Aur maine unse zimmiyon (Ahl-e-Zimma) ko sharaab bechne ke baare mein poocha, aur unse kaha: "Humare paas angoor ke baagh hain, aur hum inse yeh sharaabein banaate hain, to kya hum unhein zimmiyon ko bechein?" Ibn Abbas ne kaha: Thaqif ya Daws ke ek aadmi ne Rasulullah ﷺ ko sharaab ka ek baraataan tohfe mein diya, Hajjat-ul-Wida' mein, to Nabi ﷺ ne usse farmaya: "Kya tumhein maloom nahi, ae fulaan, ke Allah ne isay haraam kar diya hai?" Usne kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam." Aapne farmaya: "To Allah ne isay zaroor haraam kar diya hai." To woh apne ghulam ki taraf muda, aur kaha: Ise al-Hazwarah le jaao aur becho, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne usse farmaya: "Kya tumhein maloom nahi, ae fulaan, ke jisne iska peena haraam kiya usne iska bechna bhi haraam kiya?" Unhone bataya: To aapne iske baare mein hukum diya, aur ise al-Batha mein bahaa diya gaya.

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْبَيْعِ الْوَلَاءِ، وَعَنْ هِبَتِهِ ".
قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : الْأَمْرُ عَلَى هَذَا، لَا يُبَاعُ وَلَا يُوهَبُ
18.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Abdullah ibn Dinar, from Ibn Umar; with Abdullah al-Darimi's clarification: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade selling wala' [right of inheritance from manumission], and giving it as a gift." Abdullah said: The ruling is upon this, it is neither sold nor given as a gift.
18.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Abdullah ibn Dinar se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne wala' bechne se, aur usay tohfe mein dene se mana kiya." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Hukum isi par hai, na yeh becha jaata hai na tohfe mein diya jaata hai.

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ  ، قَالَ : أَعْتَقَ رَجُلٌ مِنَّا عَبْدًا لَهُ عَنْ دُبُرٍ.
قَالَ :" فَدَعَا بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَبَاعَهُ ".
قَالَ جَابِرٌ : وَإِنَّمَا مَاتَ عَامَ أَوَّلَ.
قِيلَ لعَبْدِ اللَّهِ : تَقُولُ بِهِ؟.
قَالَ : قَوْمُ يَقُولُونَ
18.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Amr ibn Dinar: He said: I heard Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari say: A man among us freed a slave of his to take effect after his death [mudabbar]. He said: "So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ called for him and sold him." Jabir said: And he died in the first year [after that]. It was said to Abdullah: "Do you hold this view?" He said: Some people say so.
18.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se, Amr ibn Dinar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari ko kehte suna: Humare mein se ek aadmi ne apne ghulam ko apni maut ke baad azaad karne ki shart lagaayi (mudabbar). Unhone bataya: "To Rasulullah ﷺ ne usay bulaaya aur usay bech diya." Jabir kehte hain: Aur woh pehle hi saal mar gaya. Abdullah (Imam Darimi) se poocha gaya: "Kya aap isi ke qaail hain?" Unhone kaha: Kuch log yeh kehte hain.

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِذَا وَلَدَتْ أَمَةُ الرَّجُلِ مِنْهُ، فَهِيَ مُعْتَقَةٌ عَنْ دُبُرٍ مِنْهُ أَوْ بَعْدَهُ "
18.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sharik, from Husayn ibn Abdullah ibn Ubaydullah ibn Abbas, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "When a man's slave-girl bears a child from him, she becomes freed to take effect after his death [mudabbarah] by that, or after that."
18.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sharik se, Husayn ibn Abdullah ibn Ubaydullah ibn Abbas se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jab aadmi ki laundi usse bachcha janam de, to woh isi wajah se ya iske baad uski maut ke baad azaad hone waali ban jaati hai."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ الْحَنَفِيُّ الْمَدَنِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ إِسْحَاق بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي مِكْيَالِهِمْ، وَبَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي صَاعِهِمْ وَمُدِّهِمْ "يَعْنِي : الْمَدِينَةَ
18.en: Narrated by Abu Muhammad al-Hanafi al-Madani, from Malik, from Ishaq ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah, from Anas ibn Malik: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O Allah, bless them in their measure, and bless them in their sa' and their mudd," meaning: Madinah.
18.hi: Abu Muhammad al-Hanafi al-Madani ne Malik se, Ishaq ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah se, Anas ibn Malik se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Allahumma baarik lahum fi mikyaalihim, wa baarik lahum fi saa'ihim wa muddihim" [Ae Allah, unhein unke naapne ke paimaane mein barkat de, aur unke sa' aur mudd mein barkat de] - yaani, Madinah [walon ke liye].

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  ، عَنْ بِلَالٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ عِنْدِي مُدُّ تَمْرٍ لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَوَجَدْتُ أَطْيَبَ مِنْهُ صَاعًا بِصَاعَيْنِ، فَاشْتَرَيْتُ مِنْهُ، فَأَتَيْتُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ :" مِنْ أَيْنَ لَكَ هَذَا يَا بِلَالُ؟ ".
قُلْتُ : اشْتَرَيْتُ صَاعًا بِصَاعَيْنِ.
قَالَ : " رُدَّهُ وَرُدَّ عَلَيْنَا تَمْرَنَا "
18.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Isra'il, from Abu Ishaq, from Masruq, from Bilal: He said: I had with me a mudd of dates for the Prophet ﷺ, so I found something better than it, a sa' for two sa', so I bought some of it, and brought it to the Prophet ﷺ, so he said: "Where did you get this from, O Bilal?" I said: I bought a sa' for two sa'. He said: "Return it, and return our dates to us."
18.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Isra'il se, Abu Ishaq se, Masruq se, Bilal se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mere paas Nabi ﷺ ke liye khajoor ka ek mudd tha, to maine usse behtar khajoor paayi, ek sa' do sa' ke badle, to maine usse kuch khareed liya, aur Nabi ﷺ ke paas laaya, to aapne poocha: "Tumhein yeh kahan se mila, Ae Bilal?" Maine kaha: Maine ek sa' do sa' ke badle khareeda. Aapne farmaya: "Isay wapas karo, aur humein humari khajoor wapas do."

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ هُوَ : ابْنُ بِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ بْنِ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيِّبِ  يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ   وَأَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ   حَدَّثَاهُ : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَعَثَ أَخَا بَنِي عَدِيٍّ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ فَاسْتَعْمَلَهُ عَلَى خَيْبَرَ ، فَقَدِمَ بِتَمْرٍ جَنِيبٍ.
 قَالَ ابْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ : يَعْنِي : جَيِّدًا ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَكُلُّ تَمْرِ خَيْبَرَ هَكَذَا؟ ".
قَالَ : لَا وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّا لَنَشْتَرِي الصَّاعَ بِالصَّاعَيْنِ مِنَ الْجَمْعِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا تَفْعَلُوا، وَلَكِنْ مِثْلًا بِمِثْلٍ، أَوْ بِيعُوا هَذَا، وَاشْتَرُوا بِثَمَنِهِ مِنْ هَذَا، وَكَذَلِكَ الْمِيزَانُ "
18.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Maslamah, from Sulayman ibn Bilal, from Abd al-Majid ibn Suhayl ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri and Abu Hurairah; with Ibn Maslamah's clarification: That they both narrated to him: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent the brother of Banu Adi al-Ansari, and employed him over Khaybar, so he brought good quality dates. Ibn Maslamah said: meaning: fine ones. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: "Are all the dates of Khaybar like this?" He said: "No, by Allah, O Messenger of Allah, we indeed buy a sa' for two sa' from the mixed [lower quality dates]." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do not do that, but like for like, or sell this and buy from its price from that," and likewise for weight.
18.hi: Abdullah ibn Maslamah ne Sulayman ibn Bilal se, Abd al-Majid ibn Suhayl ibn Abd al-Rahman se bataya: ke unhone Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab ko yeh bayaan karte suna ke Abu Sa'id al-Khudri aur Abu Hurairah ne unhein bataya: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne Banu Adi al-Ansari ke bhai ko bheja, aur unhein Khaybar par muqarrar kiya, to woh achhi qism ki khajoor laaye. Ibn Maslamah kehte hain: yaani, umda khajoor. To Rasulullah ﷺ ne unse poocha: "Kya Khaybar ki sab khajoor aisi hi hai?" Unhone kaha: "Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasulullah, hum to mili-julti [ghatiya qism] mein se ek sa' do sa' ke badle khareedte hain." To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Aisa mat karo, balke barabar ke badle barabar, ya isay becho, aur uski qeemat se usse khareedo," aur waziyaat (tolne) mein bhi isi tarah.

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَوْسِ بْنِ الْحَدَثَانِ النَّصْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ   رَضِي اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قالَ : سمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" الذَّهَبُ بِالذَّهَبِ هَاءَ وَهَاءَ، وَالْفِضَّةُ بِالْفِضَّةِ هَاءَ وَهَاءَ، وَالتَّمْرُ بِالتَّمْرِ هَاءَ وَهَاءَ، وَالْبُرُّ بِالْبُرِّ هَاءَ وَهَاءَ، وَالشَّعِيرُ بِالشَّعِيرِ هَاءَ وَهَاءَ، وَلَا فَضْلَ بَيْنَهُمَا "
18.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from al-Zuhri, from Malik ibn Aws ibn al-Hadathan al-Nasri, from Umar ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Gold for gold, hand to hand, and silver for silver, hand to hand, and dates for dates, hand to hand, and wheat for wheat, hand to hand, and barley for barley, hand to hand, with no excess between them."
18.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, al-Zuhri se, Malik ibn Aws ibn al-Hadathan al-Nasri se, Umar ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Sona sone ke badle, haath se haath, aur chandi chandi ke badle, haath se haath, aur khajoor khajoor ke badle, haath se haath, aur gehun gehun ke badle, haath se haath, aur jau jau ke badle, haath se haath, in ke darmiyan koi kami-beshi nahi."

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ  ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَشْعَثِ الصَّنْعَانِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَامَ أنَاسٌ فِي إِمَارَةِ مُعَاوِيَةَ يَبِيعُونَ آنِيَةَ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ إِلَى الْعَطَاءِ.
فَقَامَ عُبَادَةُ بْنُ الصَّامِتِ  ، فَقَالَ : إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " نَهَى عَنْبَيْعِ الذَّهَبِ بِالذَّهَبِ، وَالْفِضَّةِ بِالْفِضَّةِ، وَالْبُرِّ بِالْبُرِّ، وَالتَّمْرِ بِالتَّمْرِ، وَالشَّعِيرِ بِالشَّعِيرِ، وَالْمِلْحِ بِالْمِلْحِ إِلَّا مِثْلًا بِمِثْلٍ سَوَاءً بِسَوَاءٍ، فَمَنْ زَادَ أَوْ ازْدَادَ، فَقَدْ أَرْبَى "
18.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid, from Khalid al-Hadhdha, from Abu Qilabah, from Abu al-Ash'ath al-San'ani: He said: People stood during the governorship of Mu'awiyah selling vessels of gold and silver on credit against the [year's] stipend. So Ubadah ibn al-Samit stood, and said: Indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "forbade selling gold for gold, and silver for silver, and wheat for wheat, and dates for dates, and barley for barley, and salt for salt, except like for like, equal for equal, so whoever gives more or asks for more, has indeed engaged in usury."
18.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid se, Khalid al-Hadhdha se, Abu Qilabah se, Abu al-Ash'ath al-San'ani se bataya: Unhone kaha, Log Mu'awiyah ki hukumat mein sone aur chandi ke bartan saal ke wazife ke badle udhar bechne khade hue. To Ubadah ibn al-Samit khade hue, aur kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne "sona sone ke badle, aur chandi chandi ke badle, aur gehun gehun ke badle, aur khajoor khajoor ke badle, aur jau jau ke badle, aur namak namak ke badle bechne se mana kiya, siwaay barabar ke badle barabar, tulya ke badle tulya ke, so jo zyada de ya zyada maange, usne sood khaaya."

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْر  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِنَّمَا الرِّبَا فِي الدَّيْنِ ".
قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : مَعْنَاهُ : دِرْهَمٌ بِدِرْهَمَيْنِ
18.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ubaydullah ibn Abi Yazid, from Ibn Abbas; with Abdullah al-Darimi's clarification: He said: Usamah ibn Zayd informed me: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Usury is only in credit/deferred debt." Abdullah said: Its meaning is: one dirham for two dirhams [on credit].
18.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Ubaydullah ibn Abi Yazid se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Usamah ibn Zayd ne bataya: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Sood sirf udhar mein hota hai." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Iska matlab hai: ek dirham do dirham ke [udhar] badle.

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ أَبِيعُ الْإِبِلَ بِالْبَقِيعِ فَأَبِيعُ بِالدَّنَانِيرِ، وَآخُذُ الدَّرَاهِمَ، وَأَبِيعُ بِالدَّرَاهِمِ وَآخُذُ الدَّنَانِيرَ وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ : أَقْبِضُ فَأَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، رُوَيْدَكَ أَسْأَلُكَ : إِنِّي أَبِيعُ الْإِبِلَ بِالْبَقِيعِ فَأَبِيعُ بِالدَّنَانِيرِ، وَآخُذُ الدَّرَاهِمَ، وَأَبِيعُ بِالدَّرَاهِمِ وَآخُذُ الدَّنَانِيرَ.
قَالَ :" لَا بَأْسَ أَنْ تَأْخُذَ بِسِعْرِ يَوْمِكَ، مَا لَمْ تَفْتَرِقَا، وَبَيْنَكُمَا شَيْءٌ "
18.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Simak ibn Harb, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Umar: He said: I used to sell camels at al-Baqi', so I would sell for dinars, and take dirhams, and sell for dirhams and take dinars, and sometimes he said: take possession [right away], so I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, wait, let me ask you: I sell camels at al-Baqi', so I sell for dinars, and take dirhams, and sell for dirhams and take dinars." He said: "There is no harm that you take at the rate of your day, as long as you have not separated, and there is nothing [outstanding] between you two."
18.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Simak ibn Harb se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main al-Baqi' mein oont becha karta tha, to main dinar mein bechta aur dirham le leta, aur dirham mein bechta aur dinar le leta, aur kabhi-kabhi kaha: turant qabza kar leta, to main Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, thehriye, main aapse poochta hoon: Main al-Baqi' mein oont bechta hoon, to dinar mein bechta hoon aur dirham leta hoon, aur dirham mein bechta hoon aur dinar leta hoon." Aapne farmaya: "Koi harj nahi ke tum apne din ke bhaav par le lo, jab tak tum dono alag na ho, aur tum dono ke darmiyan [baaqi] kuch na ho."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ،  عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ :" تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَإِنَّ دِرْعَهُ لَمَرْهُونَةٌ عِنْدَ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ بِثَلَاثِينَ صَاعًا مِنْ شَعِيرٍ "
18.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hisham, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away while his coat of mail was pledged with a Jewish man for thirty sa' of barley."
18.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hisham se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ka wisaal us haal mein hua ke aapki zirah ek Yahoodi aadmi ke paas tees sa' jau ke badle giravi rakhi hui thi."

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمِنْهَالِ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْمَدِينَةَ وَهُمْ يُسْلِفُونَ فِي الثِّمَارِ فِي سَنَتَيْنِ وَثَلَاثٍ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أسْلِّفُوا فِي الثِّمَارِ : فِي كَيْلٍ مَعْلُومٍ وَوَزْنٍ مَعْلُومٍ ".
وَقَدْ كَانَ سُفْيَانُ يَذْكُرُهُ زَمَانًا إِلَى أَجَلٍ مَعْلُومٍ، ثُمَّ شَكَّكَهُ عَبَّادُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ
18.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Abdullah ibn Kathir, from Abu al-Minhal, from Ibn Abbas; with Sufyan's variant note: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ arrived at Madinah while they were making advance payments for fruit over two and three years, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Make advance payments for fruit: in a known measure and a known weight." And Sufyan used to mention it as "for a known term," then Abbad ibn Kathir made him uncertain about it.
18.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Ibn Abi Najih se, Abdullah ibn Kathir se, Abu al-Minhal se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ Madinah pahunche jabke woh do aur teen saalon ke liye phalon ki peshgi payment karte the, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Phalon mein peshgi karo: maloom naap aur maloom wazan mein." Aur Sufyan isay "maloom muddat tak" kehkar zikr karte the, fir Abbad ibn Kathir ne unhein shak mein daal diya.

18.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ مُحَارِبٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا   : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" وَزَنَ لَهُمْ دَرَاهِمَ فَأَرْجَحَهَا "
18.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Rabi', from Shu'bah, from Muharib: He said: I heard Jabir say: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "weighed out dirhams for them and gave more."
18.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Rabi' ne Shu'bah se, Muharib se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Jabir ko kehte suna: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "unke liye dirham tole aur zyada diya."

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ  ، عَنْ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ  ، قَالَ : جَلَبْتُ أَنَا وَمَخْرَمَةُ الْعَبْدِيُّ بَزًّا مِنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ إِلَى مَكَّةَ ، فَأَتَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَمْشِي، فَسَاوَمَنَا بِسَرَاوِيلَ أَوِ اشْتَرَى مِنَّا سَرَاوِيلَ وَثَمَّ وَزَّانٌ يَزِنُ بِالْأَجْرِ، فَقَالَ لِلْوَزَّانِ :" زِنْ وَأَرْجِحْ ".
فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ يَمْشِي، قَالُوا : هَذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
18.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Simak ibn Harb, from Suwayd ibn Qays: He said: I and Makhramah al-Abdi brought cloth from Bahrain to Makkah, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to us walking, and bargained with us for trousers, or bought trousers from us, and there was a weigher there who weighed for a fee, so he said to the weigher: "Weigh, and give extra." So when he went walking away, they said: This is the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
18.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Simak ibn Harb se, Suwayd ibn Qays se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main aur Makhramah al-Abdi Bahrain se Makkah kapda laaye, to Rasulullah ﷺ humare paas paidal aaye, aur humse paajaame ka bhaav lagaaya ya humse paajaama khareeda, aur wahan ek tolne wala tha jo mazdoori par tolta tha, to aapne tolne wale se farmaya: "Tolo, aur zyada do." So jab aap chal kar chale gaye, to logon ne kaha: Yeh Rasulullah ﷺ hain.

18.ar: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :مَطْلُ الْغَنِيِّ ظُلْمٌ، وَإِذَا أُتْبِعَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَلَى مَلِيءٍ فَلْيَتْبَعْ "
18.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Delaying [payment] by a wealthy person is injustice, and when one of you is referred to a solvent person [for payment], let him follow up [accept the transfer]."
18.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Abu al-Zinad se, al-A'raj se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Maal-daar ka [qarz mein] tehelaana zulm hai, aur jab tum mein se kisi ko kisi maal-daar ke paas hawaale kiya jaaye, to woh iski pairwi kare."

18.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ   أَنَّهُ تَقَاضَى مِنَ ابْنِ أَبِي حَدْرَدٍ دَيْنًا كَانَ لَهُ عَلَيْهِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَارْتَفَعَتْ أَصْوَاتُهُمَا حَتَّى سَمِعَهَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُوَ فِي بَيْتِهِ، فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِمَا، فَنَادَى : " يَا كَعْبُ ".
قَالَ : لَبَّيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ.
فَقَالَ :" ضَعْ مِنْ دَيْنِكَ فَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ أَيْ الشَّطْرَ ".
قَالَ : قَدْ فَعَلْتُ.
قَالَ : " قُمْ فَاقْضِهِ "
18.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Yunus, from al-Zuhri, from Abdullah ibn Ka'b, from his father: That he sought repayment of a debt owed to him by Ibn Abi Hadrad in the mosque, and their voices rose until the Prophet ﷺ heard it while he was in his house, so he came out to them, and called out: "O Ka'b." He said: "At your service, O Messenger of Allah." So he said: "Waive part of your debt," and he gestured to him, meaning: half. He said: "I have done so." He said: "Get up and repay it."
18.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Yunus se, al-Zuhri se, Abdullah ibn Ka'b se, apne walid se bataya ke unhone masjid mein Ibn Abi Hadrad se apna qarz maanga jo unpar tha, to un dono ki awaazein bulund hui yahan tak ke Nabi ﷺ ne unhein suna jabke aap apne ghar mein the, to aap unke paas nikle, aur pukaara: "Ae Ka'b." Unhone kaha: "Haazir hoon, Ya Rasulullah." To aapne farmaya: "Apna qarz kam kar do," aur unki taraf ishara kiya, yaani: aadha. Unhone kaha: "Maine kar diya." Aapne farmaya: "Uthkar isay ada kar do."

18.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ رِبْعِيٍّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْيَسَرِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" مَنْ أَنْظَرَ مُعْسِرًا، أَوْ وَضَعَ عَنْهُ، أَظَلَّهُ اللَّهُ فِي ظِلِّهِ يَوْمَ لَا ظِلَّ إِلَّا ظِلُّهُ ".
قَالَ : فَبَزَقَ فِي صَحِيفَتِهِ، فَقَالَ : اذْهَبْ فَهِيَ لَكَ لِغَرِيمِهِ وَذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ مُعْسِرًا
18.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Za'idah, from Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr, from Rib'i, from Abu al-Yasar: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Whoever gives respite to one in difficulty, or waives it for him, Allah will shade him in His shade on the day when there is no shade except His shade." He said: So he spat on his document, and said: Go, it is yours - to his debtor - and he mentioned that he was in difficulty.
18.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Za'idah se, Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr se, Rib'i se, Abu al-Yasar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Jo tang-daast ko mohlat de, ya uska qarz maaf kar de, Allah usay us din apne saaye mein saaya dega jab uske siwa koi saaya na hoga." Unhone bataya: To unhone apni dastavez par thooka, aur kaha: Jao, yeh tumhari hai - apne qarzdaar se - aur unhone zikr kiya ke woh tang-daast tha.

18.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ الْخَطْمِيُّ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ الْقُرَظِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" مَنْ نَفَّسَ عَنْ غَرِيمِهِ أَوْ مَحَا عَنْهُ، كَانَ فِي ظِلِّ الْعَرْشِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ "
18.en: Narrated by Affan ibn Muslim, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Abu Ja'far al-Khatmi, from Muhammad ibn Ka'b al-Qurazi, from Abu Qatadah: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Whoever gives relief to his debtor, or waives [the debt] for him, will be in the shade of the Throne on the Day of Resurrection."
18.hi: Affan ibn Muslim ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Abu Ja'far al-Khatmi se, Muhammad ibn Ka'b al-Qurazi se, Abu Qatadah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Jo apne qarzdaar ko raahat de, ya uska qarz mitaa de, woh Qayamat ke din Arsh ke saaye mein hoga."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى  : أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرِ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ  يُحَدِّثُ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا بَكْرِ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مَالَهُ بِعَيْنِهِ عِنْدَ إِنْسَانٍ قَدْ أَفْلَسَ أَوْ عِنْدَ رَجُلٍ قَدْ أَفْلَسَ فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِهِ مِنْ غَيْرِهِ "
18.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Yahya: that Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad informed him, that he heard Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz narrating, that he heard Abu Bakr ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Harith ibn Hisham, that he heard Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever finds his very own property with a person who has gone bankrupt, or with a man who has gone bankrupt, he has more right to it than anyone else."
18.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Yahya se bataya: ke Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ne unhein bataya ke unhone Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz ko yeh bayaan karte suna, ke unhone Abu Bakr ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Harith ibn Hisham ko suna, ke unhone Abu Hurairah ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo apna asal maal kisi aise insaan ke paas paaye jo dewaaliya ho gaya ho, ya kisi aise aadmi ke paas jo dewaaliya ho gaya ho, to woh iska sabse zyada haqdaar hai doosron se."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" نَفْسُ الْمُؤْمِنِ مُعَلَّقَةٌ مَا كَانَ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ "
18.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Sa'd ibn Ibrahim, from Umar ibn Abi Salamah, from his father, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The believer's soul is suspended as long as he has a debt."
18.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Sa'd ibn Ibrahim se, Umar ibn Abi Salamah se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Momin ki jaan latki rehti hai jab tak uspar qarz ho."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ  ، عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ  ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ   مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ فَارَقَ الرُّوحُ الْجَسَدَ وَهُوَ بَرِيءٌ مِنْ ثَلَاثٍ، دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ : مِنَ الْكِبْرِ، وَالْغُلُولِ، وَالدَّيْنِ "
18.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Sa'id, from Qatadah, from Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd, from Ma'dan ibn Abi Talhah, from Thawban, freed servant of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever the soul departs the body from while he is free of three things, enters Paradise: from pride, and embezzlement, and debt."
18.hi: Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Sa'id se, Qatadah se, Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd se, Ma'dan ibn Abi Talhah se, Thawban se, Rasulullah ﷺ ke azaad kiye hue ghulam, bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jiski rooh jism se is haal mein alag ho ke woh teen cheezon se paak ho, woh Jannat mein dakhil hoga: takabbur, khiyanat, aur qarz se."

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، وَأَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أُتِيَ بِرَجُلٍ لِيُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ :" صَلُّوا عَلَى صَاحِبِكُمْ فَإِنَّ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنًا ".
قَالَ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ : هُوَ عَلَيَّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ.
قَالَ : " بِالْوَفَاءِ؟ ".
قَالَ : " بِالْوَفَاءِ ".
قَالَ : فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ
18.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, and Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Uthman ibn Abdullah ibn Mawhab, from Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah, from his father: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was brought a man to pray over him, so he said: "Pray over your companion, for he has a debt upon him." Abu Qatadah said: "It is upon me, O Messenger of Allah." He said: "With full repayment?" He said: "With full repayment." He said: So he prayed over him.
18.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir aur Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se, Uthman ibn Abdullah ibn Mawhab se, Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah se, apne walid se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas ek aadmi laaya gaya taake aap uski namaz-e-janaza padhein, to aapne farmaya: "Apne saathi ki namaz padho, kyunki uspar qarz hai." Abu Qatadah ne kaha: "Woh mujhpar hai, Ya Rasulullah." Aapne poocha: "Poori ada karoge?" Unhone kaha: "Poori ada karunga." Unhone bataya: To aapne uski namaz padhi.

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِمَا عَلَى الْأَرْضِ مُؤْمِنٌ إِلا وأَنَا أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِهِ، فَمَنْ تَرَكَ دَيْنًا أَوْ ضَيَاعًا، فَلْأُدْعَ لَهُ، فَأَنَا مَوْلَاهُ، وَمَنْ تَرَكَ مَالًا، فَلِعَصَبَتِهِ مَنْ كَانَ ".
قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : ضَيَاعًا : يَعْنِي : عِيَالًا.
وَقَالَ : فَلْأُدْعَ لَهُ، يَعْنِي : ادْعُونِي لَهُ أَقْضِ عَنْهُ
18.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Sufyan, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurairah; with Abdullah al-Darimi's clarification: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "By the One in whose hand is my soul, there is no believer on earth except that I am more entitled to him than anyone; so whoever leaves a debt or dependents, let him be called to me [i.e., referred to me], for I am his patron, and whoever leaves wealth, it is for his relatives, whoever they are." Abdullah said: Dayaan means: dependents. And he said: "Let him be called to me," meaning: call me for him, I will settle it on his behalf.
18.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Sufyan se, Abu al-Zinad se, al-A'raj se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, zameen par koi momin nahi magar main uska logon se zyada haqdaar hoon; so jo qarz ya ashrit chhod jaaye, use mere paas bulaao, kyunki main uska sarparast hoon, aur jo maal chhod jaaye, woh uske rishtedaron ke liye hai, jo bhi hon." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: 'Dayaa' ka matlab hai: ashrit (bacche, gharwale). Aur aapne farmaya: "Mujhe uske liye bulaao," yaani: mujhe uske liye bulaao, main uski taraf se ada karunga.

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ الْحِزَامِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ  مَوْلَى الْأَسْلَمِيِّينَ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الدَّائِنِ حَتَّى يُقْضَى دَيْنُهُ مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيمَا يَكْرَهُ اللَّهُ ".
قَالَ : وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ يَقُولُ لِخَازِنِهِ : اذْهَبْ فَخُذْ لِي بِدَيْنٍ، فَإِنِّي أَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَبِيتَ لَيْلَةً إِلا وَاللَّهُ مَعِي بَعْدَمَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
18.en: Narrated by Ibrahim ibn al-Mundhir al-Hizami, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Abi Fudayk, from Sa'id ibn Sufyan, freed servant of the Aslamis, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Abdullah ibn Ja'far: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed Allah is with the debtor until his debt is repaid, as long as it is not in something that Allah dislikes." He said: And Abdullah ibn Ja'far used to say to his treasurer: Go and take a loan for me, for I dislike spending a night unless Allah is with me, after what I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
18.hi: Ibrahim ibn al-Mundhir al-Hizami ne Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Abi Fudayk se bataya: Humein Sa'id ibn Sufyan ne bataya (Aslami logon ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), Ja'far ibn Muhammad se, apne walid se, Abdullah ibn Ja'far se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah qarzdaar ke saath hota hai jab tak uska qarz ada na ho jaaye, jab tak woh us cheez mein na ho jo Allah na-pasand karta hai." Unhone bataya: Aur Abdullah ibn Ja'far apne khazaanchi se kehte the: Jao aur mere liye qarz le lo, kyunki mujhe na-pasand hai ke main koi raat aisi guzaarun jismein Allah mere saath na ho, jab se maine Rasulullah ﷺ se yeh suna hai.

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمِنْهَالِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" عَلَى الْيَدِ مَا أَخَذَتْ حَتَّى تُؤَدِّيَهُ "
18.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Minhal, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Sa'id ibn Abi Arubah, from Qatadah, from al-Hasan, from Samurah ibn Jundub: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Upon the hand is what it takes, until it repays it."
18.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Minhal ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Sa'id ibn Abi Arubah se, Qatadah se, al-Hasan se, Samurah ibn Jundub se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Haath par woh cheez zimmedaari hai jo usne li ho, jab tak woh usay ada na kar de."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا طَلْقُ بْنُ غَنَّامٍ  ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ  ، وَقَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" أَدِّ إِلَى مَنِ ائْتَمَنَكَ، وَلَا تَخُنْ مَنْ خَانَكَ "
18.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Ala, from Talq ibn Ghannam, from Sharik, and Qays, from Abu Hasin, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Give back to the one who trusted you, and do not betray the one who betrayed you."
18.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Ala ne Talq ibn Ghannam se, Sharik aur Qays se, Abu Hasin se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jisne tumpar bharosa kiya usay wapas do, aur jisne tumhare saath khiyanat ki usse khiyanat na karo."

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : أَهْدَى بَعْضُ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَيْهِ قَصْعَةً فِيهَا ثَرِيدٌ، وَهُوَ فِي بَيْتِ بَعْضِ أَزْوَاجِهِ، فَضَرَبَتْ الْقَصْعَةَ فَانْكَسَرَتْ، فَجَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَأْخُذُ الثَّرِيدَ فَيَرُدُّهُ فِي الصَّحْفَةِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ :" كُلُوا غَارَتْ أُمُّكُمْ ".
ثُمَّ انْتَظَرَ حَتَّى جَاءَتْ قَصْعَةٌ صَحِيحَةٌ.
فَأَخَذَهَا فَأَعْطَاهَا صَاحِبَةَ الْقَصْعَةِ الْمَكْسُورَةِ.
قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : نَقُولُ بِهَذَا
18.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Humayd, from Anas; with Abdullah al-Darimi's confirmation: He said: One of the Prophet's ﷺ wives gave him as a gift a bowl containing tharid, while he was in the house of another of his wives, so she struck the bowl and it broke, so the Prophet ﷺ began taking the tharid and returning it to the plate, while he was saying: "Eat, your mother has become jealous." Then he waited until an intact bowl came. So he took it, and gave it to the owner of the broken bowl. Abdullah said: We hold to this.
18.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Humayd se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ ki kisi biwi ne aapko ek tashtari tohfe mein bheji jismein tharid tha, jabke aap apni ek doosri biwi ke ghar mein the, to unhone tashtari ko maara aur woh toot gayi, to Nabi ﷺ tharid uthaakar tashtari mein wapas rakhne lage, jabke aap farma rahe the: "Khaao, tumhari maa ko ghairat aa gayi." Fir aap intezaar karte rahe yahan tak ke ek sahi-salaamat tashtari aayi. To aapne usay liya aur usay toote hue tashtari ki maalik ko de diya. Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Hum isi ke qaail hain.

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا.
أَبُو أُسَامَةَ  ، عَنْ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ شُعَيْبٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو   وَعَاصِمٍ ابْنَيْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ الثَّقَفِيِّ  : أَنَّ سُفْيَانَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَجَدَ عَيْبَةً فَأَتَى بِهَا عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ   رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ :" عَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً، فَإِنْ عُرِفَتْ، فَذَاكَ، وَإِلَّا فَهِيَ لَكَ، فَلَمْ تُعْرَفْ، فَلَقِيَهُ بِهَا فِي الْعَامِ الْمُقْبِلِ فِي الْمَوْسِمِ فَذَكَرَهَا لَهُ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ : هِيَ لَكَ، فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَمَرَنَا بِذَلِكَ ".
قَالَ : لَا حَاجَةَ لِي بِهَا.
فَقَبَضَهَا عُمَرُ، فَجَعَلَهَا فِي بَيْتِ الْمَالِ
18.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Ala, from Abu Usamah, from al-Walid ibn Kathir, from Amr ibn Shu'ayb, from Amr and Asim, sons of Sufyan ibn Abdullah ibn Rabi'ah al-Thaqafi: That Sufyan ibn Abdullah found a saddlebag, and brought it to Umar ibn al-Khattab رضوان الله عليه, so he said: "Announce it for a year, so if it is claimed, then that, and otherwise it is yours." So it was not claimed, so he met him with it the following year at the pilgrimage season and mentioned it to him, so Umar said: "It is yours, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us with that." He said: "I have no need of it." So Umar took possession of it, and placed it in the treasury.
18.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Ala ne Abu Usamah se bataya: Al-Walid ibn Kathir se: Mujhse Amr ibn Shu'ayb ne bataya, Amr aur Asim se (Sufyan ibn Abdullah ibn Rabi'ah al-Thaqafi ke bete): ke Sufyan ibn Abdullah ko ek thaila mila, to woh usay Umar ibn al-Khattab (رضوان الله عليه) ke paas laaye, to unhone kaha: "Isay ek saal tak elaan karo, so agar iska dawa kiya jaaye, to theek hai, warna yeh tumhari hai." To iska dawa nahi kiya gaya, to unhone agle saal Hajj ke mausam mein unse mulaqaat ki aur yeh unhein bataya, to Umar ne kaha: "Yeh tumhari hai, kyunki Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein isi ka hukum diya tha." Unhone kaha: "Mujhe iski zaroorat nahi." So Umar ne isay le liya, aur baitul-maal mein rakh diya.

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ  مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَصْرَةِ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرْبُ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ   أَنَّهُ عَامَ فُتِحَتْ مَكَّةُ ، قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ :" إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَبَسَ عَنْ مَكَّةَ الْفِيلَ، وَسَلَّطَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ، أَلَا وَإِنَّهَا لَمْ تَحِلَّ لِأَحَدٍ قَبْلِي وَلَا تَحِلُّ لِأَحَدٍ بَعْدِي، أَلَا وَإِنَّهَا سَاعَتِي هَذِهِ حَرَامٌ لَا يُخْتَلَى خَلَاهَا، وَلَا يُعْضَدُ شَجَرُهَا وَلَا تُلْتَقَطُ سَاقِطَتُهَا إِلَّا لِمُنْشِدٍ "
18.en: Narrated by Mu'adh ibn Hani', from the people of Basra, from Harb ibn Shaddad, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: That in the year Makkah was conquered, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood, and said: "Indeed Allah restrained the elephant from Makkah, and gave the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the believers dominance over them, listen, it was not lawful for anyone before me, nor is it lawful for anyone after me, listen, it is sacred [only] for this hour of mine, its plants are not to be uprooted, and its trees are not to be cut, and its lost items are not to be picked up except by one who will announce them."
18.hi: Mu'adh ibn Hani' ne Basra walon se bataya: Humein Harb ibn Shaddad ne bataya: Humein Yahya ibn Abi Kathir ne bataya: Humein Abu Salamah ne bataya: Humein Abu Hurairah ne bataya ke jis saal Makkah fatah hui, Rasulullah ﷺ khade hue, aur farmaya: "Allah ne Makkah se haathi ko roka, aur Rasulullah ﷺ aur momino ko unpar ghalba diya, sun lo, yeh na mujhse pehle kisi ke liye halal thi na mere baad kisi ke liye halal hai, sun lo, yeh sirf meri is ghadi ke liye halal ki gayi thi, iske paudhe na ukhaade jaayein, aur iske darakht na kaate jaayein, aur iski girii hui cheezein na uthaayi jaayein siwaay us shakhs ke jo unhein elaan karega."

18.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ  ، عَنِ الْجَارُودِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" ضَالَّةُ الْمُسْلِمِ حَرَقُ النَّارِ "
18.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Khalid al-Hadhdha, from Yazid ibn Abdullah ibn al-Shikhkhir, from Abu Muslim, from al-Jarud: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The lost item of a Muslim [if wrongly kept] is a burning of Fire."
18.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Khalid al-Hadhdha se, Yazid ibn Abdullah ibn al-Shikhkhir se, Abu Muslim se, al-Jarud se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Musalman ki gum hui cheez [galat tarike se rakhi jaaye to] Jahannam ki aag hai."

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْجُرَيْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَلَاءِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ الْجَرْمِيِّ  ، عَنِ الْجَارُودِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " ضَالَّةُ الْمُسْلِمِ حَرَقُ النَّارِ، ضَالَّةُ الْمُسْلِمِ حَرَقُ النَّارِ، ضَالَّةُ الْمُسْلِمِ حَرَقُ النَّارِ، لَا تَقْرَبَنَّهَا ".
قَالَ : فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، اللُّقَطَةُ نَجِدُهَا؟.
قَالَ :" أَنْشِدْهَا، وَلَا تَكْتُمْ، وَلَا تُغَيِّبْ، فَإِنْ جَاءَ رَبُّهَا، فَادْفَعْهَا إِلَيْهِ، وَإِلَّا، فَمَالُ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ "
18.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Jurayri, from Abu al-Ala, from Abu Muslim al-Jarmi, from al-Jarud: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The lost item of a Muslim is a burning of Fire, the lost item of a Muslim is a burning of Fire, the lost item of a Muslim is a burning of Fire, do not go near it." He said: So a man said: "O Messenger of Allah, a found item we come across?" He said: "Announce it, and do not conceal it, and do not hide it, so if its owner comes, hand it to him, and otherwise, it is the wealth of Allah, He gives it to whom He wills."
18.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Jurayri se, Abu al-Ala se, Abu Muslim al-Jarmi se, al-Jarud se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Musalman ki gum hui cheez Jahannam ki aag hai, Musalman ki gum hui cheez Jahannam ki aag hai, Musalman ki gum hui cheez Jahannam ki aag hai, iske paas na jao." Unhone bataya: To ek aadmi ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, jo laawaris cheez humein milti hai?" Aapne farmaya: "Isay elaan karo, aur isay na chhupaao, aur na isay ghaayeb karo, so agar iska maalik aaye, to usay de do, aur warna, yeh Allah ka maal hai, jise chahe woh deta hai."

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ الْكُوفِيُّ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ  ، عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ  ، عَنْ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ السَّلَمِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَخِيهِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ   : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنِ اقْتَطَعَ حَقَّ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ بِيَمِينِهِ، فَقَدْ أَوْجَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ النَّارَ، وَحَرَّمَ عَلَيْهِ الْجَنَّةَ "، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ : وَإِنْ كَانَ شَيْئًا يَسِيرًا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟.
قَالَ : " وَإِنْ قَضِيبًا مِنْ أَرَاكٍ ".
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ  ، عَنْ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَخَاهُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  يُحَدِّثُ : أَنَّ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ الْحَارِثِيَّ   حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
..

..
..
فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ
18.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Ya'qub al-Kufi, from Isma'il ibn Ja'far, from al-Ala, from Ma'bad ibn Ka'b al-Salami, from his brother Abdullah ibn Ka'b, from Abu Umamah; a similar chain also via Abdullah ibn Sa'id: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever seizes the right of a Muslim by his oath, Allah has made the Fire obligatory for him, and forbidden Paradise to him," so a man said to him: "Even if it was something small, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "Even if it was a twig of arak wood." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Usamah, from al-Walid ibn Kathir, from Muhammad ibn Ka'b ibn Malik: that he heard his brother Abdullah ibn Ka'b ibn Malik narrating: that Abu Umamah al-Harithi narrated to him that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ... and he mentioned the like of it.]
18.hi: Ahmad ibn Ya'qub al-Kufi ne Isma'il ibn Ja'far se, al-Ala se, Ma'bad ibn Ka'b al-Salami se, apne bhai Abdullah ibn Ka'b se, Abu Umamah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jo apni qasam se kisi Musalman ka haq chheen le, Allah ne uspar Jahannam wajib kar di hai, aur uspar Jannat haraam kar di hai," to ek aadmi ne poocha: "Chahe woh chhoti si cheez ho, Ya Rasulullah?" Aapne farmaya: "Chahe woh peelu ki lakdi ka ek tinka hi ho." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Abdullah ibn Sa'id se, Abu Usamah se, al-Walid ibn Kathir se, Muhammad ibn Ka'b ibn Malik se bhi aayi hai: ke unhone apne bhai Abdullah ibn Ka'b ibn Malik ko yeh bayaan karte suna: ke Abu Umamah al-Harithi ne unhein bataya ke unhone Rasulullah ﷺ ko suna ... aur unhone isi jaisa zikr kiya.]

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، وَحَجَّاجٌ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُدْرِكٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا زُرْعَةَ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ خَرَشَةَ بْنِ الْحُرِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" ثَلَاثَةٌ لَا يُكَلِّمُهُمْ اللَّهُ، وَلَا يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَلَا يُزَكِّيهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ "، فَقُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَنْ هُمْ خَابُوا وَخَسِرُوا؟ فَأَعَادَهَا، فَقُلْتُ : مَنْ هُمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟، فَقَالَ : " الْمُسْبِلُ، وَالْمَنَّانُ، وَالْمُنَفِّقُ سِلْعَتَهُ بِالْحَلِفِ كَاذِبًا "
18.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, and Hajjaj, from Shu'bah, from Ali ibn Mudrik, from Abu Zur'ah, from Kharashah ibn al-Hurr, from Abu Dharr: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Three, Allah will not speak to them, nor look at them on the Day of Resurrection, nor purify them, and for them is a painful punishment," so I said: "O Messenger of Allah, who are they, they have failed and lost?" So he repeated it, so I said: "Who are they, O Messenger of Allah?" So he said: "The one who lets his garment drag [out of arrogance], and the one who reminds others of his favors [to belittle them], and the one who markets his goods with a false oath."
18.hi: Abu al-Walid aur Hajjaj ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhse Ali ibn Mudrik ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Zur'ah ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Kharashah ibn al-Hurr se, Abu Dharr se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Teen [tarah ke log], Allah unse baat nahi karega, aur na Qayamat ke din unki taraf dekhega, aur na unhein paak karega, aur unke liye dardnaak azaab hai," to maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, kaun hain woh, woh to nakaam aur nuqsaan mein rahe?" To aapne isay dohraaya, to maine poocha: "Kaun hain woh, Ya Rasulullah?" To aapne farmaya: "Woh jo apna kapda ghaseette hue chale [ghuroor se], aur ehsaan jataane wala, aur jhoothi qasam khaakar apna saaman bechne wala."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي طَلْحَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ  : أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ سَهْلٍ  أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ سَعِيدَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" مَنْ ظَلَمَ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ شِبْرًا، فَإِنَّهُ يُطَوَّقُهُ مِنْ سَبْعِ أَرَضِينَ "
18.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri, from Talhah ibn Abdullah ibn Awf, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Sahl, from Sa'id ibn Zayd: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Whoever wrongfully takes a hand-span of land, will be encircled with it from seven earths [below]."
18.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Mujhse Talhah ibn Abdullah ibn Awf ne bataya: ke Abd al-Rahman ibn Sahl ne unhein bataya ke Sa'id ibn Zayd ne kaha: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Jo zameen ka ek baalisht bhi zulm se le, use saat zameenon [ke neeche] se ghera jaayega."

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ  : أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   أَخْبَرَهُ : أَنَّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ أَحْيَا أَرْضًا مَيْتَةً فَلَهُ فِيهَا أَجْرٌ وَمَا أَكَلَتِ الْعَافِيَةُ مِنْهَا، فَلَهُ فِيهَا صَدَقَةٌ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : الْعَافِيَةُ : الطَّيْرُ وَغَيْرُ ذَلِكَ
18.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Usamah, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Rafi', from Jabir ibn Abdullah; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever revives a dead land, has a reward for it, and whatever wild creatures eat from it, is charity for him." Abu Muhammad said: al-'afiyah is: birds and other than that.
18.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Usamah se, Hisham ibn Urwah se bataya: Mujhe Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Rafi' ne bataya: ke Jabir ibn Abdullah ne unhein bataya: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo murda zameen ko aabaad kare, uske liye usmein ajr hai, aur jo jaanwar (parinde waghera) usse khaayein, uske liye woh sadqa hai." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: 'Al-'Afiyah' ka matlab hai: parinde aur unke ilaawa.

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَرَجُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبْيَضَ بْنِ حَمَّالٍ السَّبَائِيُّ الْمَأْرِبِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عَمِّي ثَابِتُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبْيَضَ  : أَنَّ أَبَاهُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ أَبْيَضَ  حَدَّثَهُ، عَنْ أَبْيَضَ بْنِ حَمَّالٍ   حَدَّثَهُ : أَنَّهُ اسْتَقْطَعَ الْمِلْحَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الَّذِي يُقَالُ لَهُ مِلْحُ شَذَّا بِمَأْرِبَ فَأَقْطَعَهُ، ثُمَّ إِنَّ الْأَقْرَعَ بْنَ حَابِسٍ التَّمِيمِيَّ.
قَالَ : يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ إِنِّي قَدْ وَرَدْتُ الْمِلْحَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، وَهُوَ بِأَرْضٍ لَيْسَ بِهَا مَاءٌ، وَمَنْ وَرَدَهُ، أَخَذَهُ، وَهُوَ مِثْلُ مَاءِ الْعِدِّ.
فَاسْتَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْأَبْيَضَ فِي قَطِيعَتِهِ فِي الْمِلْحِ، فَقُلْتُ : قَدْ أَقَلْتُهُ عَلَى أَنْ تَجْعَلَهُ مِنِّي صَدَقَةً، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" هُوَ مِنْكَ صَدَقَةٌ، وَهُوَ مِثْلُ مَاءِ الْعِدِّ، مَنْ وَرَدَهُ، أَخَذَهُ ".
قَالَ : وَقَطَعَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَرْضًا وَنَخْلًا وَكَذَا بِالْجَوْفِ : جَوْفِ مُرَادٍ مَكَانَهُ حِينَ أَقَالَهُ مِنْهُ.
قَالَ الْفَرَجُ : فَهُوَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ : مَنْ وَرَدَهُ، أَخَذَهُ
18.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr al-Humaydi, from al-Faraj ibn Sa'id ibn Alqamah ibn Sa'id ibn Abyad ibn Hammal al-Saba'i al-Ma'ribi, from his uncle Thabit ibn Sa'id ibn Abyad, from his father Sa'id ibn Abyad, from Abyad ibn Hammal: That he requested a grant of the salt-flat from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, which is called the salt of Shadha at Ma'rib, and he granted it to him, then al-Aqra' ibn Habis al-Tamimi said: "O Prophet of Allah, I have indeed come to the salt-flat in the Jahiliyyah, and it is in a land without water, and whoever comes to it, takes from it, and it is like flowing spring water." So the Prophet ﷺ asked al-Abyad to withdraw his grant of the salt-flat, so I said: "I have withdrawn it on condition that you make it a charity from me," so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "It is a charity from you, and it is like flowing spring water, whoever comes to it, takes from it." He said: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ granted him land and palm-trees and the same at al-Jawf: the Jawf of Murad, in its place, when he had him withdraw from it. Al-Faraj said: So it remains upon that: whoever comes to it, takes from it.
18.hi: Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr al-Humaydi ne al-Faraj ibn Sa'id ibn Alqamah ibn Sa'id ibn Abyad ibn Hammal al-Saba'i al-Ma'ribi se bataya: Mujhse mere chacha Thabit ibn Sa'id ibn Abyad ne bataya: ke unke walid Sa'id ibn Abyad ne unhein bataya, Abyad ibn Hammal se: ke unhone Rasulullah ﷺ se woh namak-zameen maangi jise Ma'rib mein 'namak-e-Shadha' kaha jaata tha, to aapne unhein woh de di, fir al-Aqra' ibn Habis al-Tamimi ne kaha: "Ya Nabi Allah, main Jahiliyat mein is namak-zameen tak aata tha, aur yeh aisi zameen mein hai jahan paani nahi, aur jo isper aaye, woh usse le leta hai, aur yeh 'aab-e-idd' (behte chashme) jaisi hai." To Nabi ﷺ ne al-Abyad se unki namak-zameen wapas lene ki darkhwaast ki, to maine kaha: "Maine yeh wapas kar di is shart par ke aap ise mujhse sadqa bana dein," to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Yeh tumhari taraf se sadqa hai, aur yeh 'aab-e-idd' jaisi hai, jo isper aaye, woh usse le sakta hai." Unhone bataya: Aur Rasulullah ﷺ ne unhein al-Jawf mein zameen aur khajoorein bhi din: Jawf-e-Murad mein, uski jagah, jab aapne unse yeh wapas li thi. Al-Faraj kehte hain: So yeh isi tarah rahi: jo isper aaye, woh usse le sakta hai.

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ  ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ وَائِلٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ   " أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَأَقْطَعَهُ أَرْضًا ".
قَالَ : فَأَرْسَلَ مَعِي مُعَاوِيَةَ.
قَالَ : أَعْطِهَا إِيَّاهُ.
 قَالَ يَحْيَى : حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ  ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ
18.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Bashshar, from Ghundar, from Shu'bah, from Simak ibn Harb, from Alqamah ibn Wa'il, from his father: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "granted him land." He said: So he sent Mu'awiyah with me. He said: "Give it to him." Yahya said: Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us, Ghundar narrated to us, with this hadith.
18.hi: Muhammad ibn Bashshar ne Ghundar se, Shu'bah se, Simak ibn Harb se, Alqamah ibn Wa'il se, apne walid se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "unhein zameen ata ki." Unhone bataya: To aapne Mu'awiyah ko mere saath bheja. Aapne farmaya: "Ise unhein de do." Yahya kehte hain: Humein Muhammad ibn Bashshar ne bataya, humein Ghundar ne yeh hadith bataayi.

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ الْأَعْمَشُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سُفْيَانَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، يَقُولُ : حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمُّ مُبَشِّرٍ   امْرَأَةُ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ، قَالَتْ : دَخَلَ عَلَيَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي حَائِطٍ لِي، فَقَالَ : " يَا أُمَّ مُبَشِّرٍ، أَمُسْلِمٌ غَرَسَ هَذَا، أَمْ كَافِرٌ؟ ".
قُلْتُ : مُسْلِمٌ، فَقَالَ :" مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يَغْرِسُ غَرْسًا فَيَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ إِنْسَانٌ، أَوْ دَابَّةٌ، أَوْ طَيْرٌ، إِلَّا كَانَتْ لَهُ صَدَقَةٌ "
18.en: Narrated by al-Mu'alla ibn Asad, from Abd al-Wahid ibn Ziyad, from Sulayman al-A'mash, from Abu Sufyan, from Jabir ibn Abdullah, from Umm Mubashshir: Wife of Zayd ibn Harithah, she said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon me in a garden of mine, and said: "O Umm Mubashshir, did a Muslim plant this, or a disbeliever?" I said: A Muslim, so he said: "There is no Muslim who plants a planting and a person, or an animal, or a bird eats from it, except that it is charity for him."
18.hi: Al-Mu'alla ibn Asad ne Abd al-Wahid ibn Ziyad se bataya: Humein Sulayman al-A'mash ne bataya: Humein Abu Sufyan ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Jabir ibn Abdullah ko kehte suna: Mujhe Umm Mubashshir ne bataya, jo Zayd ibn Harithah ki biwi thin: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ mere paas mere ek baagh mein dakhil hue, aur farmaya: "Ae Umm Mubashshir, kya isay kisi Musalman ne lagaaya, ya kisi kaafir ne?" Maine kaha: Musalman ne, to aapne farmaya: "Koi Musalman nahi jo koi paudha lagaaye aur koi insaan, ya jaanwar, ya parinda usse khaaye, magar yeh uske liye sadqa hai."

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَرَجُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي عَمِّي ثَابِتُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ أَبْيَضَ بْنِ حَمَّالٍ   : أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ حِمَى الْأَرَاكِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا حِمَى فِي الْأَرَاكِ "، فَقَالَ : أَرَاكَةٌ فِي حِظَارِي؟، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " لَا حِمَى فِي الْأَرَاكِ ".
قَالَ فَرَجٌ : يَعْنِي ابْنُ أَبْيَضُ : بِحِظَارِي : الْأَرْضَ الَّتِي فِيهَا الزَّرْعُ الْمُحَاطُ عَلَيْهَا
18.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr, from al-Faraj ibn Sa'id, from his uncle Thabit ibn Sa'id, from his father Sa'id, from his grandfather Abyad ibn Hammal: That he asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about the protected pasture of arak trees, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There is no protected pasture in arak," so he said: "An arak tree in my enclosure?" So the Prophet ﷺ said: "There is no protected pasture in arak." Faraj said - meaning Ibn Abyad - "my enclosure" means: the land which has cultivated crops surrounded around it.
18.hi: Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr ne al-Faraj ibn Sa'id se bataya: Mujhe mere chacha Thabit ibn Sa'id ne bataya, apne walid Sa'id se, apne dada Abyad ibn Hammal se: ke unhone Rasulullah ﷺ se peelu (arak) darakhton ki mahfooz charagaah ke baare mein poocha, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Peelu mein koi mahfooz charagaah nahi." To unhone poocha: "Meri baad (baada, kheti ki gheri hui zameen) mein ek peelu ka darakht?" To Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Peelu mein koi mahfooz charagaah nahi." Faraj (yaani Ibn Abyad) kehte hain: 'Meri baad' se murad hai: woh zameen jismein kheti hoti hai jiske gird-o-nawaah ghera hua ho.

18.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمِنْهَالِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ إِيَاسَ بْنَ عَبْدٍ الْمُزَنِيَّ   وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : لَا تَبِيعُوا الْمَاءَ : فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " يَنْهَى عَنْبَيْعِ الْمَاءِ ".
وَقَالَ عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ : لَا نَدْرِي أَيَّ مَاءٍ.
قَالَ : يَقُولُ : لَا أَدْرِي مَاءً جَارِيًا أَوِ الْمَاءَ الْمُسْتَقَى؟
18.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Ibn Uyaynah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Abu al-Minhal: He said: I heard Iyas ibn Abd al-Muzani, who was among the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ, say: Do not sell water: for I heard the Prophet ﷺ "forbidding the sale of water." And Amr ibn Dinar said: We do not know which water. He said: meaning: I do not know, running water or drawn water?
18.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Ibn Uyaynah se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Abu al-Minhal se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Iyas ibn Abd al-Muzani ko kehte suna, jo Nabi ﷺ ke sahaba mein se the: Paani mat becho: kyunki maine Nabi ﷺ ko "paani ki bikri se mana karte suna." Aur Amr ibn Dinar ne kaha: Humein nahi maloom kaunsa paani. Unhone bataya: yaani: mujhe nahi maloom, behta hua paani ya kuen se kheencha hua paani?

18.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا كَهْمَسٌ  ، عَنْ سَيَّارٍ  رَجُلٍ مِنْ فَزَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ بُهَيْسَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهَا  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : أَنَّهُ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَاسْتَأْذَنَهُ فَدَخَلَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ قَمِيصِهِ وَقَدْ قَالَ عُثْمَانُ : فَالْتَزَمَهُ ، فَقَالَ : مَا الشَّيْءُ الَّذِي لَا يَحِلُّ مَنْعُهُ؟، فَقَالَ : " الْمِلْحُ وَالْمَاءُ "، فَقَالَ : مَا الشَّيْءُ الَّذِي لَا يَحِلُّ مَنْعُهُ؟.
قَالَ :" أَنْ تَفْعَلَ الْخَيْرَ خَيْرٌ لَكَ ".
قَالَ : مَا الشَّيْءُ الَّذِي لَا يَحِلُّ مَنْعُهُ؟.
قَالَ : " إِنْ تَفْعَلْ الْخَيْرَ خَيْرٌ لَكَ "وَانْتَهَى إِلَى الْمِلْحِ وَالْمَاءِ.
قِيلَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ : تَقُولُ بِهِ؟ فَأَوْمَأَ بِرَأْسِهِ
18.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Kahmas, from Sayyar (a man from Fazarah), from his father, from Buhaysah, from her father, from the Prophet ﷺ: That he came to the Prophet ﷺ and sought permission, so he entered between him and his shirt - and Uthman said: so he embraced him closely - so he asked: "What is the thing whose withholding is not lawful?" So he said: "Salt and water." So he asked: "What is the thing whose withholding is not lawful?" He said: "That you do good is good for you." He asked: "What is the thing whose withholding is not lawful?" He said: "If you do good it is good for you," and he ended at salt and water. It was said to Abdullah: "Do you hold to this?" So he nodded his head.
18.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Kahmas se, Sayyar se (Fazarah ke ek aadmi), apne walid se, Buhaysah se, apne walid se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya ke woh Nabi ﷺ ke paas aaye aur ijaazat maangi, to woh aapke aur aapki qamees ke darmiyan dakhil hue - aur Uthman ne kaha: to unhone aapko sakhti se lipat liya - to unhone poocha: "Woh kaunsi cheez hai jiska rokna halal nahi?" To aapne farmaya: "Namak aur paani." To unhone poocha: "Woh kaunsi cheez hai jiska rokna halal nahi?" Aapne farmaya: "Ke tum bhalaai karo, yeh tumhare liye achha hai." Unhone poocha: "Woh kaunsi cheez hai jiska rokna halal nahi?" Aapne farmaya: "Agar tum bhalaai karo to yeh tumhare liye achha hai," aur aap namak aur paani par khatm hue. Abdullah (Imam Darimi) se poocha gaya: "Kya aap isi ke qaail hain?" To unhone apne sar se ishara kiya [haan mein].

18.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" عَامَلَ خَيْبَرَ بِشَطْرِ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا مِنْ ثَمَرَةٍ أَوْ زَرْعٍ "
18.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Yahya, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Abdullah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "worked Khaybar's land on the basis of half of whatever came out of it, of fruit or crop."
18.hi: Musaddad ne Yahya se, Ubaydullah se bataya: Mujhse Nafi' ne bataya, Abdullah se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "Khaybar ki zameen se jo bhi phal ya fasal nikalti, uska aadha hisse ke tor par mu'aamla kiya."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ  : أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرًا   يَقُولُ : كُنَّا نُخَابِرُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَنْهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنِ الْخِبْرِ بَسَنَتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلَاثٍ، عَلَى الثُّلُثِ، وَالشَّطْرِ، وَشَيْءٍ مِنْ تِبْنٍ، فَقَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ أَرْضٌ فَلْيَحْرُثْهَا، فَإِنْ كَرِهَ أَنْ يَحْرُثَهَا، فَلْيَمْنَحْهَا أَخَاهُ، فَإِنْ كَرِهَ أَنْ يَمْنَحَهَا أَخَاهُ، فَلْيَدَعْهَا "
18.en: Narrated by Abu al-Hasan, from Zakariya ibn Ishaq, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir: That he heard Jabir say: We used to practice mukhabarah [share-cropping] before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us from mukhabarah, for two or three years, at a third, and a half, and something of straw, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to us: "Whoever has land, let him cultivate it, and if he dislikes cultivating it, let him give it to his brother [without charge], and if he dislikes giving it to his brother, let him leave it."
18.hi: Abu al-Hasan ne Zakariya ibn Ishaq se bataya: Humein Abu al-Zubayr ne bataya: ke unhone Jabir ko yeh kehte suna: Hum mukhabarah (share-cropping) kiya karte the do ya teen saal pehle jab tak Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein mukhabarah se mana nahi kiya, tihai par, aur aadhe par, aur bhoosay ki kisi maqdaar par, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne humse farmaya: "Jiske paas zameen ho, woh usay kaash kaare, aur agar usay kaashat karna na-pasand ho, to woh apne bhai ko de de, aur agar usay apne bhai ko dena na-pasand ho, to woh usay chhod de."

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق الشَّيْبَانِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَعْقِلٍ  عَنِ الْمُزَارَعَةِ، فَقَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي ثَابِتُ بْنُ الضَّحَّاكِ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "نَهَى عَنِ الْمُزَارَعَةِ ".
 قَالَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ : تَقُولُ بِهِ؟.
قَالَ : لَا أَقُولُ بِالْأَوَّلِ
18.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Abu Ishaq al-Shaybani, from Abdullah ibn al-Sa'ib: He said: I asked Abdullah ibn Ma'qil about muzara'ah [land-leasing for crop share], so he said: Thabit ibn al-Dahhak al-Ansari informed me: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "forbade muzara'ah." It was said to Abdullah: "Do you hold to this?" He said: I do not hold to the first [view].
18.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Abu Ishaq al-Shaybani se, Abdullah ibn al-Sa'ib se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abdullah ibn Ma'qil se muzara'ah ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: Mujhe Thabit ibn al-Dahhak al-Ansari ne bataya: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne "muzara'ah se mana kiya." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) se poocha gaya: "Kya aap isi ke qaail hain?" Unhone kaha: Main pehli baat ka qaail nahi.

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْبَيْعِ الْأَرْضِ الْبَيْضَاءِ سَنَتَيْنِ أَوُ ثَلَاثًا "
18.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zuhayr, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of bare uncultivated land for two or three years [i.e. renting land for produce shares over multiple years without proper contract]."
18.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zuhayr se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne khaali (bagair kheti wali) zameen ki do ya teen saal ke liye [share ke tor par] bikri se mana kiya."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِكْرِمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَبِيبَةَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ  ، قَالَ :كُنَّا نُكْرِي الْأَرْضَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِمَا عَلَى السَّوَاقِي مِنَ الزَّرْعِ، وَبِمَا سَعِدَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ مِنْهَا، " فَنَهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، وَأَذِنَ لَنَا أَوْ قَالَ رَخَّصَ لَنَا فِي أَنْ نُكْرِيَهَا بِالذَّهَبِ وَالْوَرِقِ "
