18.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Yazid ibn Harun, from Ibrahim ibn Sa'd, from Muhammad ibn Ikrimah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Harith ibn Hisham, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Labibah, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas: He said: We used to rent out land in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for whatever grew alongside the water channels, and whatever the water yielded from it, "so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us from that, and permitted us," or he said, "gave us a concession to rent it out for gold and silver."
18.hi: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ne Yazid ibn Harun se bataya: Humein Ibrahim ibn Sa'd ne bataya, Muhammad ibn Ikrimah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Harith ibn Hisham se, Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Labibah se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas se: Unhone kaha, Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke zamane mein zameen kiraye par dete the us fasal ke badle jo naalon ke kinaare ugti, aur jo paani usmein se paata, "to Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein isse mana kiya, aur humein ijaazat di," ya kaha, "humein rukhsat di ke hum usay sone aur chandi ke badle kiraye par dein."

18.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مَسْعُودِ بْنِ نِيَارٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ، قَالَ : جَاءَ سَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ   إِلَى مَجْلِسِنَا فَحَدَّثَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِذَا خَرَصْتُمْ، فَخُذُوا وَدَعُوا، دَعُوا الثُّلُثَ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَدَعُوا الثُّلُثَ، فَدَعُوا الرُّبُعَ "
18.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Khubayb ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Mas'ud ibn Niyar al-Ansari: He said: Sahl ibn Abi Hathmah came to our gathering and narrated that the Prophet ﷺ said: "When you estimate [the crop yield for zakah], take and leave, leave a third, and if you do not leave a third, leave a quarter."
18.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se, Khubayb ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Mas'ud ibn Niyar al-Ansari se bataya: Unhone kaha, Sahl ibn Abi Hathmah humari majlis mein aaye aur bataaya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jab tum andaaza lagaao [fasal ka], to lo aur chhodo bhi, tihai chhodo, aur agar tihai na chhod sako, to chauthaai chhodo."

18.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جُحَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْكَسْبِ الْإِمَاءِ "
18.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from Muhammad ibn Juhadah, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurairah: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the earnings of slave-girls [obtained through prostitution]."
18.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se, Muhammad ibn Juhadah se, Abu Hazim se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne laundiyon ki [zina se] kamaai se mana kiya."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَارِظٍ  : أَنَّ السَّائِبَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ  حَدَّثَهُ : أَنَّ رَافِعَ بْنَ خَدِيجٍ   حَدَّثَهُ : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" كَسْبُ الْحَجَّامِ خَبِيثٌ، وَمَهْرُ الْبَغِيِّ خَبِيثٌ، وَثَمَنُ الْكَلْبِ خَبِيثٌ "
18.en: Narrated by Wahb ibn Jarir, from Hisham, from Yahya, from Ibrahim ibn Abdullah ibn Qariz, from al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid, from Rafi' ibn Khadij: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The earnings of the cupper are impure, and the earnings of a prostitute are impure, and the price of a dog is impure."
18.hi: Wahb ibn Jarir ne Hisham se, Yahya se, Ibrahim ibn Abdullah ibn Qariz se bataya: ke al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid ne unhein bataya: ke Rafi' ibn Khadij ne unhein bataya: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Hijaama karne wale ki kamaai napaak hai, aur kasbi ki kamaai napaak hai, aur kutte ki qeemat napaak hai."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا حُمَيْدٌ الطَّوِيلُ  ،  عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" حَجَمَهُ أَبُو طَيْبَةَ وَأَمَرَ لَهُ بِصَاعَيْنِ مِنْ طَعَامٍ "
18.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Humayd al-Tawil, from Anas ibn Malik: That Abu Taybah cupped the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he commanded that he be given two sa' of food.
18.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Humayd al-Tawil se, Anas ibn Malik se bataya ke Abu Taybah ne Rasulullah ﷺ ka hijaama kiya, aur aapne hukum diya ke unhein khaane ke do sa' diye jaayein.

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْثَمَنِ عَسْبِ الْفَحْلِ "
18.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Fudayl, from al-A'mash, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurairah: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the price of a stud animal's mating fee."
18.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Ibn Fudayl se, al-A'mash se, Abu Hazim se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne nar jaanwar ke jofte ki qeemat lene se mana kiya."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي  ، عَنْ الْمَهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ   " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْعَسْبِ الْفَحْلِ، وَأَجْرِ الْمُومِسَةِ "
18.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from al-Qasim ibn al-Fadl, from his father, from al-Mahri: He said: Abu Hurairah said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the fee for a stud animal's mating, and the wage of a prostitute."
18.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne al-Qasim ibn al-Fadl se bataya: Humein unke walid ne bataya, al-Mahri se: Unhone kaha, Abu Hurairah ne kaha: "Rasulullah ﷺ ne nar jaanwar ke jofte ki fees se, aur kasbi ki mazdoori se mana kiya."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل هُوَ : ابْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُهَاجِرٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الْمَلِكِ بْنَ عُمَيْرٍ  ، يُحَدِّثُ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ حُرَيْثٍ  ، عَنْ أَخِيهِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ   وَكَانَتْ لَهُ صُحْبَةٌ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" مَنْ بَاعَ مِنْكُمْ دَارًا أَوْ عَقَارًا، فَإِنَّهُ قَمِنٌ أَنْ لَا يُبَارَكَ لَهُ إِلَّا أَنْ يَجْعَلَهُ فِي مِثْلِهِ "
18.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Isma'il ibn Ibrahim ibn Muhajir: He said: I heard Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr narrating: he said: I heard Amr ibn Hurayth say, from his brother Sa'id ibn Hurayth, who had companionship [with the Prophet]: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Whoever among you sells a house or a property, it is likely that it will not be blessed for him unless he puts it into the like of it."
18.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Isma'il ibn Ibrahim ibn Muhajir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr ko yeh bayaan karte suna: Unhone kaha, Maine Amr ibn Hurayth ko kehte suna, apne bhai Sa'id ibn Hurayth se, jinki thodi si sohbat thi: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Tum mein se jo koi ghar ya jaayedaad beche, to yeh mumkin hai ke usme barkat na ho jab tak woh usay usi jaisi cheez mein na lagaaye."

18.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَرْعَرَةُ بْنُ الْبِرِنْدِ السَّامِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ  ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنِ احْتَفَرَ بِئْرًا، فَلَيْسَ لِأَحَدٍ أَنْ يَحْفِرَ حَوْلَهُ أَرْبَعِينَ ذِرَاعًا عَطَنًا لِمَاشِيَتِهِ "
18.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Ar'arah ibn al-Birind al-Sami, from Isma'il ibn Muslim, from al-Hasan, from Abdullah ibn Mughaffal, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: He said: "Whoever digs a well, no one else may dig within forty cubits around it, as a resting-place for his livestock."
18.hi: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ne Ar'arah ibn al-Birind al-Sami se bataya: Humein Isma'il ibn Muslim ne bataya, al-Hasan se, Abdullah ibn Mughaffal se, Rasulullah ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Jo kuen khode, uske aas-paas chaalis haath tak koi aur kuen na khode, uske maweshiyon ke aaram karne ki jagah ke liye."

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي الشُّفْعَةِ إِذَا كَانَ طَرِيقُهُمَا وَاحِدًا؟.
قَالَ :" يُنْظَرُ بِهَا، وَإِنْ كَانَ صَاحِبُهَا غَائِبًا "
18.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Abd al-Malik, from Ata, from Jabir, from the Prophet ﷺ, about pre-emption when the shared party has one path: He was asked about pre-emption [shuf'ah] when their road was one? He said: "It is to be considered, even if its owner is absent."
18.hi: Ya'la ne Abd al-Malik se, Ata se, Jabir se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya ke aapse shuf'ah (pehle khareedne ke haq) ke baare mein poocha gaya jabke unka raasta ek hi ho? Aapne farmaya: "Isay maana jaayega, chahe uska maalik ghair-haazir ho."

18.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ :" قَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالشُّفْعَةِ فِي كُلِّ شِرْكٍ لَمْ يُقْسَمْ : رَبْعَةٍ أَوْ حَائِطٍ لَا يَحِلُّ لَهُ أَنْ يَبِيعَ حَتَّى يُؤْذِنَ شَرِيكَهُ، فَإِنْ شَاءَ، أَخَذَ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ، تَرَكَ، فَإِنْ بَاعَ وَلَمْ يُؤْذِنْهُ، فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِهِ ".
 قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ : تَقُولُ بِهَذَا؟.
قَالَ : نَعَمْ
18.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Ala, from Abdullah ibn Idris, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled with pre-emption in every partnership not [yet] divided: a house or a garden, [the partner] does not have the right to sell it until he informs his partner, so if he wishes, he may take it, and if he wishes, he may leave it, but if he sells without informing him, then he [the partner] has more right to it." It was said to Abu Muhammad: "Do you hold to this?" He said, "Yes."
18.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Ala ne Abdullah ibn Idris se, Ibn Jurayj se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne har us shirkat mein shuf'ah ka faisla diya jo abhi taqseem nahi hui: ghar ho ya baagh, use bechna halal nahi jab tak woh apne saathi ko na bataaye, so agar woh chahe to le le, aur agar chahe to chhod de, lekin agar woh bataaye bagair bech de, to woh [saathi] iska zyada haqdaar hai." Abu Muhammad se poocha gaya: "Kya aap isi ke qaail hain?" Unhone kaha, "Haan."

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  : أَنَّ أَبَا مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيَّ   اسْتَأْذَنَ عَلَى عُمَرَ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، فَلَمْ يُؤْذَنْ لَهُ، فَرَجَعَ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" إِذَا اسْتَأْذَنَ الْمُسْتَأْذِنُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ : فَإِنْ أُذِنَ لَهُ وَإِلَّا، فَلْيَرْجِعْ "، فَقَالَ : لَتَأْتِيَنَّ بِمَنْ يَشْهَدُ مَعَكَ، أَوْ لَأَفْعَلَنَّ، وَلَأَفْعَلَنَّ.
قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ : فَأَتَانَا وَأَنَا فِي قَوْمٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، وَهُوَ فَزِعٌ مِنْ وَعِيدِ عُمَرَ إِيَّاهُ، فَقَامَ عَلَيْنَا، فَقَالَ : أَنْشُدُ اللَّهَ مِنْكُمْ رَجُلًا سَمِعَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَّا شَهِدَ لِي بِهِ.
قَالَ : فَرَفَعْتُ رَأْسِي، فَقُلْتُ : أَخْبِرْهُ أَنِّي مَعَكَ عَلَى هَذَا.
وَقَالَ ذَاكَ آخَرُونَ، فَسُرِّيَ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى
19.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Da'ud, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: That Abu Musa al-Ash'ari sought permission to see Umar three times, but was not given permission, so he went back, he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "When the one seeking permission asks three times: either he is given permission or otherwise, let him go back," so he said: "You will indeed bring someone who witnesses with you, or I will surely do such-and-such." Abu Sa'id said: So he came to us while I was among a group of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the mosque, and he was afraid because of Umar's threat to him, so he stood over us, and said: I adjure by Allah any man among you who heard that from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, let him testify for me about it. He said: So I raised my head, and said: Tell him that I am with you on this. And others said the same, so it relieved Abu Musa.
19.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Da'ud se, Abu Nadrah se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se bataya ke Abu Musa al-Ash'ari ne Umar se milne ki teen martaba ijaazat maangi, lekin unhein ijaazat nahi mili, to woh wapas gaye, unhone kaha: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Jab koi ijaazat maangne wala teen martaba maange: to ya usay ijaazat di jaaye ya warna, woh wapas chala jaaye," to unhone kaha: "Tum zaroor koi gawah lekar aao, ya main zaroor fulaan-fulaan karunga." Abu Sa'id kehte hain: To woh humare paas aaye jabke main Rasulullah ﷺ ke sahaba ke kuch logon mein masjid mein tha, aur woh Umar ki dhamki se khaufzada the, to woh humare paas khade hue, aur kaha: Main tum mein se kisi bhi aadmi ko Allah ki qasam deta hoon jisne yeh Rasulullah ﷺ se suna ho, woh mere liye iski gawahi de. Unhone bataya: To maine apna sar utha kar kaha: Unhein bataao ke main aapke saath hoon is baat par. Aur doosron ne bhi yehi kaha, to Abu Musa ko sukoon mila.

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَضَرَبْتُ بَابَهُ، فَقَالَ :" مَنْ ذَا؟ ".
فَقُلْتُ : أَنَا.
قَالَ : " أَنَا؟ أَنَا؟ ! " فَكَرِهَ ذَاكَ
19.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Rabi', from Shu'bah, from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir: He said: I heard Jabir ibn Abdullah say: I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and knocked on his door, so he said: "Who is that?" So I said: "It is I." He said: "I? I?!" and he disliked that.
19.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Rabi' ne Shu'bah se, Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Jabir ibn Abdullah ko kehte suna: Main Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaya aur unka darwaza khatkhataaya, to aapne poocha: "Kaun hai?" To maine kaha: "Main hoon." Aapne farmaya: "Main? Main?!" aur aapne isay na-pasand kiya.

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ مُحَارِبَ بْنَ دِثَارٍ  يَذْكُرُ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْيَطْرُقَ الرَّجُلُ أَهْلَهُ لَيْلًا، أَوْ يُخَوِّنَهُمْ، أَوْ يَلْتَمِسَ عَثَرَاتِهِمْ ".
قَالَ سُفْيَانُ : قَوْلُهُ : أَوْ يُخَوِّنَهُمْ، أَوْ يَلْتَمِسَ عَثَرَاتِهِمْ، مَا أَدْرِي : شَيْءٌ.
قَالَهُ مُحَارِبٌ : أَوْ شَيْءٌ هُوَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ
19.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Muharib ibn Dithar, from Jabir ibn Abdullah; with Sufyan's note: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade a man from surprising his family at night, or suspecting them of betrayal, or seeking out their faults." Sufyan said: His saying: "or suspecting them of betrayal, or seeking out their faults," I do not know: whether it is something Muharib said, or something that is [actually] in the hadith.
19.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Muharib ibn Dithar ko yeh zikr karte suna, Jabir ibn Abdullah se: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne mana kiya ke aadmi raat ko achaanak apne ghar walon ke paas pahunche, ya unpar khiyanat ka shak kare, ya unki khaamiyaan talaash kare." Sufyan kehte hain: Unka farmaan: "ya unpar khiyanat ka shak kare, ya unki khaamiyaan talaash kare," mujhe nahi maloom: kya yeh Muharib ki apni baat hai, ya kuch aisa hai jo [waaqai] hadith mein hai.

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ عَوْفٍ  ، عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلَامٍ  ، قَالَ : لَمَّا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْمَدِينَةَ ، اسْتَشْرَفَهُ النَّاسُ، فَقَالُوا : قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
قَالَ : فَخَرَجْتُ فِيمَنْ خَرَجَ، فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتُ وَجْهَهُ، عَرَفْتُ أَنَّ وَجْهَهُ لَيْسَ بِوَجْهِ كَذَّابٍ.
فَكَانَ أَوَّلَ مَا سَمِعْتُهُ، يَقُولُ : " يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ،أَفْشُوا السَّلَامَ، وَأَطْعِمُوا الطَّعَامَ، وَصِلُوا الْأَرْحَامَ، وَصَلُّوا وَالنَّاسُ نِيَامٌ، تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِسَلَامٍ "
19.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Awf, from Zurarah ibn Awfa, from Abdullah ibn Salam: He said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ arrived at Madinah, the people came out looking for him, and said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has arrived." He said: So I went out among those who went out, and when I saw his face, I recognized that his face was not the face of a liar. And the first thing I heard him say was: "O people, spread the greeting of peace, and feed food, and maintain the ties of kinship, and pray while people sleep, you will enter Paradise with peace."
19.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Awf se, Zurarah ibn Awfa se, Abdullah ibn Salam se bataya: Unhone kaha, Jab Rasulullah ﷺ Madinah pahunche, log aapko dekhne nikle, aur kaha: "Rasulullah ﷺ pahunch gaye hain." Unhone bataya: To main un logon mein nikla jo nikle, aur jab maine aapka chehra dekha, mujhe pehchaan aaya ke yeh kisi jhoote ka chehra nahi ho sakta. Aur sabse pehli baat jo maine aapko kehte suna, woh yeh thi: "Ae logo, salaam phailaao, aur khaana khilaao, aur sila-e-rahmi karo, aur raat ko namaz padho jabke log so rahe hon, tum Jannat mein salaamati ke saath dakhil hoge."

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الْحَارِثِ  ،  عَنْ عَلِيٍّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لِلْمُسْلِمِ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِ سِتٌّ : يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيْهِ إِذَا لَقِيَهُ وَيُشَمِّتُهُ إِذَا عَطَسَ، وَيَعُودُهُ إِذَا مَرِضَ، وَيُجِيبُهُ إِذَا دَعَاهُ، وَيَشْهَدُهُ إِذَا تُوُفِّيَ، وَيُحِبُّ لَهُ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ، وَيَنْصَحُ لَهُ بِالْغَيْبِ "
19.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah, from Isra'il, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Harith, from Ali: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "For the Muslim, upon the Muslim, [there are] six [rights]: he greets him with salaam when he meets him, and says 'yarhamukallah' [may Allah have mercy on you] to him when he sneezes, and visits him when he is ill, and answers him when he invites him, and attends him when he dies, and loves for him what he loves for himself, and gives him sincere advice in his absence."
19.hi: Ubaydullah ne Isra'il se, Abu Ishaq se, al-Harith se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Musalman ka Musalman par chhe [haq] hain: jab woh usse mile to usay salaam kare, aur jab woh chheenke to usay dua de, aur jab woh bimaar ho to uski bimaar-pursi kare, aur jab woh usay bulaaye to uski dawat qabool kare, aur jab woh mar jaaye to uski janaza mein shareek ho, aur uske liye wahi pasand kare jo apne liye pasand kare, aur uski ghair-mojoodgi mein uske liye khair-khwaahi rakhe."

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو هَانِئٍ الْخَوْلَانِيُّ  : أَنَّ أَبَا عَلِيٍّ الْجَنْبِيَّ  حَدَّثَهُ، عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" يُسَلِّمُ الرَّاكِبُ عَلَى الْمَاشِي، وَالْقَائِمُ عَلَى الْقَاعِدِ، وَالْقَلِيلُ عَلَى الْكَثِيرِ "
19.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Haywah, from Abu Hani al-Khawlani, from Abu Ali al-Janbi, from Fadalah ibn Ubayd, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: He said: "The rider greets the one walking, and the one standing greets the one sitting, and the few greet the many."
19.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid ne Haywah se bataya: Humein Abu Hani al-Khawlani ne bataya: ke Abu Ali al-Janbi ne unhein bataya, Fadalah ibn Ubayd se, Rasulullah ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Sawaar chalne wale ko salaam kare, aur khada hua baithe hue ko salaam kare, aur thode log zyada logon ko salaam karein."

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ الْيَهُودَ إِذَا سَلَّمَ أَحَدُهُمْ، فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ : السَّامُ عَلَيْكَ.
قُلْ : عَلَيْكَ "
19.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Abdullah ibn Dinar, from Ibn Umar: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed the Jews, when one of them greets, he only says: 'al-saam 'alayk' [death be upon you]. Say [in return]: 'alayk' [upon you the same]."
19.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Abdullah ibn Dinar se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Yahoodi jab unmein se koi salaam kare, to woh sirf yeh kehta hai: 'As-saamu alayk' [tujhpar maut ho]. Tum [jawaab mein] kaho: 'Alayk' [tujhpar bhi wahi ho]."

19.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ سَيَّارٍ  ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ أَمْشِي مَعَ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، فَمَرَّ بِصِبْيَانٍ، فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَحَدَّثَ ثَابِتٌ  أَنَّهُ كَانَ مَعَ أَنَسٍ فَمَرَّ بِصِبْيَانٍ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَحَدَّثَ أَنَسٌ   : " أَنَّهُ كَانَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَفَمَرَّ بِصِبْيَانٍ، فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِمْ "
19.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from Sayyar: He said: I was walking with Thabit al-Bunani, and he passed by some children, and he greeted them, and Thabit narrated that he was with Anas and passed by some children and greeted them, and Anas narrated: "that he was with the Prophet ﷺ and he passed by some children, and greeted them."
19.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se, Sayyar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Thabit al-Bunani ke saath chal raha tha, to woh kuch bacchon ke paas se guzre, aur unhein salaam kiya, aur Thabit ne bataya ke woh Anas ke saath the aur kuch bacchon ke paas se guzre aur unhein salaam kiya, aur Anas ne bataya: "ke woh Nabi ﷺ ke saath the aur aap kuch bacchon ke paas se guzre, to aapne unhein salaam kiya."

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي شَهْرٌ  ،  عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ السَّكَنِ   إِحْدَى نِسَاءِ بَنِي عَبْدِ الْأَشْهَلِ " أَنَّهَا بَيْنَا هِيَ فِينِسْوَةٍ مَرَّ عَلَيْهِنَّ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِنَّ "
19.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb ibn Abi Hamzah, from Ibn Abi Husayn, from Shahr, from Asma bint Yazid ibn al-Sakan: One of the women of Banu Abd al-Ashhal, "that she was among a group of women whom the Prophet ﷺ passed by, and he greeted them."
19.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb ibn Abi Hamzah se, Ibn Abi Husayn se bataya: Mujhse Shahr ne bataya, Asma bint Yazid ibn al-Sakan se, jo Banu Abd al-Ashhal ki auraton mein se thin: ke woh kuch auraton ke saath thi jinke paas se Nabi ﷺ guzre, "to aapne unhein salaam kiya."

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  : أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ   زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَتْ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " يَا عَائِشُهَذَا جِبْرِيلُ يَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكِ السَّلَامَ ".
قَالَتْ : وَعَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكاتُهُ.
 قَالَتْ : وَهُوَ يَرَى مَا لَا أَرَى
19.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb ibn Abi Hamzah, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Aisha, wife of the Prophet ﷺ: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O Aisha, this is Jibril, he sends his greeting of peace to you." She said: "And upon him be peace, and the mercy of Allah, and His blessings." She said: "And he sees what I do not see."
19.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb ibn Abi Hamzah se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Mujhse Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman ne bataya: ke Aisha, Nabi ﷺ ki biwi, ne kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Ae Aisha, yeh Jibreel hain, woh tumhein salaam kehte hain." Unhone kaha: "Aur unpar bhi salaam ho, aur Allah ki rehmat, aur uski barkaten." Unhone kaha: "Aur woh dekhte hain jo main nahi dekhti."

19.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ هُوَ : ابْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ  ، قَالَ : صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَأَتَيْتُهُ حِينَ قَضَى صَلَاتَهُ، فَكُنْتُ أَوَّلَ مَنْ حَيَّا بِتَحِيَّةِ الْإِسْلَامِ.
قَالَ :" عَلَيْكَ السَّلَامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ، مِمَّنْ أَنْتَ؟ ".
قَالَ : قُلْتُ : مِنْ غِفَارٍ.
قَالَ : فَأَهْوَى بِيَدِهِ.
قُلْتُ فِي نَفْسِي : كَرِهَ أَنِّي انْتَمَيْتُ إِلَى غِفَارٍ
19.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Maslamah, from Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah, from Humayd ibn Hilal, from Abdullah ibn al-Samit, from Abu Dharr: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed, and I came to him when he had finished his prayer, and I was the first to greet him with the Islamic greeting. He said: "Alaykas salaam wa rahmatullah, who are you from?" He said: I said, "From Ghifar." He said: So he lowered his hand. I said to myself: He disliked that I attributed myself to Ghifar.
19.hi: Abdullah ibn Maslamah ne Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah se, Humayd ibn Hilal se, Abdullah ibn al-Samit se, Abu Dharr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne namaz padhi, to main aapke paas aaya jab aap namaz se faarigh hue, aur main pehla shakhs tha jisne aapko Islami salaam kiya. Aapne farmaya: "Alaykas-salaamu wa rahmatullah, tum kahan se ho?" Unhone bataya: Maine kaha, "Ghifar se." Unhone bataya: To aapne apna haath jhukaa liya. Maine apne dil mein socha: Aapko na-pasand hua ke maine apna nisbat Ghifar se ki.

19.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ عَوْفٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ  ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ  ، قَالَ : جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ، فَرَدَّ عَلَيْهِ وَقَالَ :" عَشْرٌ ".
ثُمَّ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ، فَرَدَّ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ : " عِشْرُونَ ".
ثُمَّ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، فَرَدَّ عَلَيْهِ وَقَالَ : " ثَلَاثُونَ "
19.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir, from Ja'far ibn Sulayman, from Awf, from Abu Raja, from Imran ibn Husayn: He said: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ, and said: "Al-salamu 'alaykum," so he replied, and said: "Ten." Then another man came and greeted, and said: "Al-salamu 'alaykum wa rahmatullah," so he replied, and said: "Twenty." Then another man came and greeted, and said: "Al-salamu 'alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh," so he replied, and said: "Thirty."
19.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir ne Ja'far ibn Sulayman se, Awf se, Abu Raja se, Imran ibn Husayn se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi Nabi ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha: "As-salaamu alaykum," to aapne jawaab diya, aur farmaya: "Das." Fir ek aur aadmi aaya aur salaam kiya, aur kaha: "As-salaamu alaykum wa rahmatullah," to aapne jawaab diya, aur farmaya: "Bees." Fir ek aur aadmi aaya aur salaam kiya, aur kaha: "As-salaamu alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh," to aapne jawaab diya, aur farmaya: "Tees."

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ الْحُضَيْنِ  ، عَنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ بْنِ قُنْفُذٍ   : أَنَّهُ سَلَّمَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُوَ يَبُولُ،" فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامَ حَتَّى تَوَضَّأَ، فَلَمَّا تَوَضَّأَ، رَدَّهُ عَلَيْهِ "
19.en: Narrated by Ishaq, from Mu'adh ibn Hisham, from his father, from Qatadah, from al-Hasan, from al-Hudayn, from al-Muhajir ibn Qunfudh: That he greeted the Prophet ﷺ while he was urinating, "so he did not return the greeting until he had performed ablution, and when he had performed ablution, he returned it to him."
19.hi: Ishaq ne Mu'adh ibn Hisham se bataya: Mujhse mere walid ne bataya, Qatadah se, al-Hasan se, al-Hudayn se, al-Muhajir ibn Qunfudh se: ke unhone Nabi ﷺ ko salaam kiya jabke aap peshaab kar rahe the, "to aapne wudu karne tak salaam ka jawaab nahi diya, aur jab wudu kar liya, to aapne unhein jawaab diya."

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بِسْطَامَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ  ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا تَدْخُلُوا عَلَى النِّسَاءِ ".
قِيلَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْحَمْوُ.
قَالَ : " الْحَمْوُ : الْمَوْتُ ".
 قَالَ يَحْيَى : الْحَمْوُ : يَعْنِي قَرَابَةَ الزَّوْجِ
19.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Bistam, from Layth ibn Sa'd, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Abu al-Khayr, from Uqbah ibn Amir; with Yahya's clarification: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do not enter upon women." It was said: "O Messenger of Allah, what about the husband's relative [al-hamw]?" He said: "The husband's relative is death." Yahya said: al-hamw means: the relatives of the husband.
19.hi: Yahya ibn Bistam ne Layth ibn Sa'd se, Yazid ibn Abi Habib se, Abu al-Khayr se, Uqbah ibn Amir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Auraton ke paas [akela] mat jao." Poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah, aur shohar ka rishtedaar [al-hamw]?" Aapne farmaya: "Shohar ka rishtedaar to maut hai." Yahya kehte hain: 'Al-Hamw' ka matlab hai: shohar ke rishtedaar.

19.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، وَأَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَرِيرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ نَظْرَةِ الْفَجْأَةِ، فَقَالَ :" اصْرِفْ بَصَرَكَ "
19.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, and Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from Yunus, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Abu Zur'ah ibn Amr ibn Jarir, from his father, from his grandfather: He said: I asked the Prophet ﷺ about a sudden [unintentional] glance, so he said: "Turn away your sight."
19.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf aur Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se, Yunus se, Amr ibn Sa'id se, Abu Zur'ah ibn Amr ibn Jarir se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Nabi ﷺ se achaanak nazar padne ke baare mein poocha, to aapne farmaya: "Apni nazar pher lo."

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ : ابْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ  ،  عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ   زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَتْ : سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ ذَيْلِ الْمَرْأَةِ، فَقَالَ : " شِبْرًا "، فَقُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِذَنْ تَبْدُوَ أَقْدَامُهُنَّ؟، قَالَ :" فَذِرَاعًا لَا يَزِدْنَ عَلَيْهِ ".
قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : النَّاسُ يَقُولُونَ : عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ
19.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Nafi', from Safiyyah bint Abi Ubayd, from Umm Salamah, wife of the Prophet ﷺ; with Abdullah al-Darimi's note: She said: The Prophet ﷺ was asked about the hem of a woman's garment, so he said: "A hand-span." I said: "O Messenger of Allah, then their feet would show?" He said: "Then a forearm's length, they should not exceed it." Abdullah said: People say: from Nafi', from Sulayman ibn Yasar.
19.hi: Ahmad ibn Khalid ne Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, Nafi' se, Safiyyah bint Abi Ubayd se, Umm Salamah, Nabi ﷺ ki biwi, se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ se aurat ke daaman ki lambaai ke baare mein poocha gaya, to aapne farmaya: "Ek baalisht." Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, tab to unke paaon nazar aayenge?" Aapne farmaya: "To ek haath, isse zyada na badhaayein." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Log kehte hain: Nafi' se, Sulayman ibn Yasar se.

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي رِبْعِيُّ بْنُ حِرَاشٍ  ، عَنِ امْرَأَتِهِ  ، عَنْ أُخْتٍ لِحُذَيْفَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : " يَا مَعْشَرَ النِّسَاءِ،أَمَا لَكُنَّ فِي الْفِضَّةِ مَا تَحَلَّيْنَ بِهِ؟ أَمَا إِنَّهُ لَيْسَتْ مِنْكُنَّ امْرَأَةٌ تَحَلَّى الذَّهَبَ فَتُظْهِرَهُ، إِلَّا عُذِّبَتْ بِهِ "
19.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Rib'i ibn Hirash, from his wife, from a sister of Hudhayfah: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a sermon to us, and said: "O assembly of women, do you not have silver to adorn yourselves with? Listen, there is not one of you who adorns herself with gold and displays it, except that she will be punished with it."
19.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Mansur se bataya: Mujhse Rib'i ibn Hirash ne bataya, apni biwi se, Hudhayfah ki ek behen se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein khutba diya, aur farmaya: "Ae auraton ki jama'at, kya tumhare paas chandi nahi jisse tum singaar karo? Sun lo, tum mein koi bhi aisi nahi jo sona pehne aur usay zaahir kare, magar usay usi se azaab diya jaayega."

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ عُمَارَةَ  ، عَنْ غُنَيْمِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى   :" أَيُّمَا امْرَأَةٍ اسْتَعْطَرَتْ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَتْ لِيُوجَدَ رِيحُهَا، فَهِيَ زَانِيَةٌ، وَكُلُّ عَيْنٍ زَانٍ ".
وَقَالَ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ : يَرْفَعُهُ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا
19.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Thabit ibn Umarah, from Ghunaym ibn Qays, from Abu Musa; with Abu Asim's note: "Whichever woman applies perfume, then goes out so that its fragrance is found, she is an adulteress, and every eye is an adulterer." Abu Asim said: Some of our companions raise it [to the Prophet ﷺ].
19.hi: Abu Asim ne Thabit ibn Umarah se, Ghunaym ibn Qays se, Abu Musa se bataya: "Jo bhi aurat khushbu lagaaye, fir isliye nikle ke uski khushbu paayi jaaye, woh zaaniya hai, aur har [buri niyat wali] aankh zaani hai." Abu Asim kehte hain: Humare kuch sathi ise marfu'an (Nabi tak) bayaan karte hain.

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ  ،  عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْوَاشِمَاتِ، ، وَالْمُتَنَمِّصَاتِ، وَالْمُتَفَلِّجَاتِ لِلْحُسْنِ الْمُغَيِّرَاتِ خَلْقَ اللَّهِ "، فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ امْرَأَةً مِنْ بَنِي أَسَدٍ يُقَالُ لَهَا : أُمُّ يَعْقُوبَ ، فَجَاءَتْ فَقَالَتْ : بَلَغَنِي أَنَّكَ لَعَنْتَ كَيْتَ وَكَيْتَ؟، فَقَالَ : وَمَا لِي لَا أَلْعَنُ مَنْ لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَهُوَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ؟، فَقَالَتْ : لَقَدْ قَرَأْتُ مَا بَيْنَ اللَّوْحَيْنِ، فَمَا وَجَدْتُ فِيهِ مَا تَقُولُ.
قَالَ : لَئِنْ كُنْتِ قَرَأْتِيهِ، لَقَدْ وَجَدْتِيهِ، أَمَا قَرَأْتِ # وَمَا آتَاكُمُ الرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُ وَمَا نَهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ فَانْتَهُوا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ سورة الحشر آية 7 #؟، فَقَالَتْ : بَلَى.
قَالَ : فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ نَهَى عَنْهُ، فَقَالَتْ : فَإِنِّي أَرَى أَهْلَكَ يَفْعَلُونَهُ؟.
قَالَ : فَادْخُلِي فَانْظُرِي.
فَدَخَلَتْ فَنَظَرَتْ، فَلَمْ تَرَ مِنْ حَاجَتِهَا شَيْئًا، فَقَالَ : لَوْ كَانَتْ كَذَلِكَ مَا جَامَعْتُهَا
19.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah, from Abdullah: He said: "Allah has cursed those who tattoo, and those who pluck eyebrow hairs, and those who create gaps between the teeth for beauty, altering the creation of Allah," so that reached a woman from Banu Asad called Umm Ya'qub, so she came, and said: "It has reached me that you cursed such-and-such and such-and-such?" So he said: "Why should I not curse whoever the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed, and it is in the Book of Allah?" So she said: "I have indeed read what is between the two covers [of the Qur'an], and I did not find in it what you say." He said: "If you had indeed read it, you would have found it. Have you not read: 'And whatever the Messenger has given you, take it, and whatever he has forbidden you, refrain from it, and fear Allah, indeed Allah is severe in punishment' [Surah al-Hashr, verse 7]?" So she said, "Indeed." He said: "So he has indeed forbidden it." So she said: "But I see your family doing it?" He said: "Then go in and look." So she went in and looked, and she did not see anything she was looking for, so he said: "Had it been so, I would not have had relations with her."
19.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se, Alqamah se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Allah ne godne wali auraton par, aur bhaven ukhaadne wali auraton par, aur husn ke liye daanton mein faasla banaane wali, Allah ki takhleeq badalne wali auraton par lanat ki hai," to yeh baat Banu Asad ki ek aurat tak pahunchi jise Umm Ya'qub kaha jaata tha, to woh aayi, aur kaha: "Mujhe khabar mili hai ke aapne fulaan aur fulaan par lanat ki?" To unhone kaha: "Mujhe kya hua hai ke main us par lanat na karun jispar Rasulullah ﷺ ne lanat ki, aur yeh Allah ki Kitaab mein hai?" To usne kaha: "Maine to donon takhton ke darmiyan [Quran] padha hai, mujhe usmein woh nahi mila jo aap kehte hain." Unhone kaha: "Agar tumne isay padha hota, to tumhein zaroor milta. Kya tumne yeh nahi padha: 'Aur jo Rasool tumhein dein use le lo, aur jisse mana karein usse ruk jao, aur Allah se daro, beshak Allah sakht saza dene wala hai' [Surah Al-Hashr, aayat 7]?" To usne kaha, "Kyun nahi." Unhone kaha: "To aapne isse mana kiya hai." To usne kaha: "Lekin main dekhti hoon ke aapke gharwale bhi yeh karte hain?" Unhone kaha: "To andar jaao aur dekho." So woh andar gayi aur dekha, to usay apni chaahi hui koi cheez nazar nahi aayi, to unhone kaha: "Agar aisa hota, to main uske saath sohbat na karta."

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ الْحَضْرَمِيُّ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَيَّاشُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ الْحِمْيَرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْحُصَيْنِ الْحَجْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عَامِرٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا رَيْحَانَةَ   صَاحِبَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " يَنْهَى عَنْعَشْرِ خِصَالٍ : مُكَامَعَةِ الرَّجُلِ الرَّجُلَ فِي شِعَارٍ وَاحِدٍ لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُمَا شَيْءٌ.
وَمُكَامَعَةِ الْمَرْأَةِ الْمَرْأَةَ فِي شِعَارٍ وَاحِدٍ لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُمَا شَيْءٌ.
وَالنَّتْفِ، وَالْوَشْمِ، وَالنُّهْبَةِ، وَرُكُوبِ النُّمُورِ، وَاتِّخَاذِ الدِّيبَاجِ هَاهُنَا عَلَى الْعَاتِقَيْنِ، وَفِي أَسْفَلِ الثِّيَابِ ".
 قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : أَبُو عَامِرٍ.
شَيْخٌ لَهُمْ، وَالْمُكَامَعَةُ : الْمُضَاجَعَةُ
19.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Zayd ibn al-Hubab, from Yahya ibn Ayyub al-Hadrami, from Ayyash ibn Abbas al-Himyari, from Abu al-Husayn al-Hajri, from Abu Amir; with Abdullah al-Darimi's note: He said: I heard Abu Rayhanah, a Companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to "forbid ten qualities: a man sharing a garment with another man in one covering with nothing between them; and a woman sharing a garment with another woman in one covering with nothing between them; and plucking hair, and tattooing, and looting, and riding on leopard-skins, and taking brocade, here on the two shoulders, and at the bottom of clothes." Abdullah said: Abu Amir is a shaykh of theirs, and al-mukama'ah is: lying together.
19.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Zayd ibn al-Hubab se bataya: Mujhse Yahya ibn Ayyub al-Hadrami ne bataya: Mujhe Ayyash ibn Abbas al-Himyari ne bataya, Abu al-Husayn al-Hajri se, Abu Amir se: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Rayhanah, Rasulullah ﷺ ke sathi, ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ "das cheezon se mana karte the: ek aadmi ka doosre aadmi ke saath ek chaadar mein lipatna jabke unke darmiyan kuch na ho; aur ek aurat ka doosri aurat ke saath ek chaadar mein lipatna jabke unke darmiyan kuch na ho; aur baal ukhaadna, aur godna, aur loot-maar, aur cheeton ki khaal par sawaari karna, aur diba (reshmi kapda) yahan kandhon par, aur kapdon ke niche pehnna." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Abu Amir unke ek buzurg hain, aur 'Al-Mukama'ah' ka matlab hai: saath lete rehna.

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، وَوَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ هُوَ الدَّسْتَوَائِيُّ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَعَنَالْمُخَنَّثِينَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ، وَالْمُتَرَجِّلَاتِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ، وَقَالَ : " أَخْرِجُوهُمْ مِنْ بُيُوتِكُمْ ".
قَالَ : فَأَخْرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فُلَانًا، وَأَخْرَجَ عُمَرُ فُلَانًا أَوْ فُلَانَةً.
 قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : فَأَشُكُّ
19.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, and Wahb ibn Jarir, from Hisham al-Dastawa'i, from Yahya, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas; with Abdullah al-Darimi's note: That the Prophet ﷺ cursed the effeminate men and masculine-behaving women, and said: "Expel them from your houses." He said: So the Prophet ﷺ expelled so-and-so, and Umar expelled so-and-so or so-and-so [a woman]. Abdullah said: I am uncertain [of the gender].
19.hi: Yazid ibn Harun aur Wahb ibn Jarir ne Hisham al-Dastawa'i se, Yahya se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne mardon mein se aurat-numa banne walon par, aur auraton mein se mard-numa banne wali auraton par lanat ki, aur farmaya: "Unhein apne gharon se nikaal do." Unhone bataya: To Nabi ﷺ ne fulaan ko nikaala, aur Umar ne fulaan ya fulaani ko nikaala. Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Mujhe shak hai.

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ  ، عَنْ زُرْعَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ   وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الصُّفَّةِ، قَالَ : جَلَسَ عِنْدَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَفَخِذِي مُنْكَشِفَةٌ، فَقَالَ :" خَمِّرْ عَلَيْكَ، أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ الْفَخِذَ عَوْرَةٌ؟ "
19.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Malik, from Abu al-Nadr, from Zur'ah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from his father: Who was among the Companions of the Suffah, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sat with us while my thigh was uncovered, so he said: "Cover it, do you not know that the thigh is [part of the] private area?"
19.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Malik se bataya: Humein Abu al-Nadr ne bataya, Zur'ah ibn Abd al-Rahman se, apne walid se, jo Ashaab-e-Suffah mein se the: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ humare paas baithe jabke meri raan khuli hui thi, to aapne farmaya: "Isay dhaak lo, kya tumhein nahi maloom ke raan [bhi] sharamgah hai?"

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ  ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ  ، قَالَ : دَخَلَ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ   نِسْوَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ حِمْصَ يَسْتَفْتِينَهَا، فَقَالَتْ : لَعَلَّكُنَّ مِنَ النِّسْوَةِ اللَّاتِي يَدْخُلْنَ الْحَمَّامَاتِ؟.
قُلْنَ : نَعَمْ.
قَالَتْ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" مَا مِنْ امْرَأَةٍ تَضَعُ ثِيَابَهَا فِي غَيْرِ بَيْتِ زَوْجِهَا، إِلَّا هَتَكَتْ مَا بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ اللَّهِ G ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمَلِيحِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ
19.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from al-A'mash, from Amr ibn Murrah, from Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd; with a similar chain also via Ubaydullah, from Isra'il, from Mansur, from Salim, from Abu al-Malih, from Aisha: He said: Some women from the people of Hims entered upon Aisha seeking a ruling from her, so she said: "Perhaps you are among the women who enter the bathhouses?" They said, "Yes." She said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "There is no woman who removes her clothes in other than her husband's house, except that she has torn apart what is between her and Allah, exalted is He." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Ubaydullah, from Isra'il, from Mansur, from Salim, from Abu al-Malih, from Aisha, with this hadith.]
19.hi: Ya'la ne al-A'mash se, Amr ibn Murrah se, Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd se bataya: Unhone kaha, Hims walon mein se kuch auratein Aisha ke paas fatwa poochne aayin, to unhone poocha: "Shayad tum un auraton mein se ho jo hammam (gusalkhaane) mein jaati hain?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Unhone kaha: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Koi aurat apne shohar ke ghar ke siwa kisi aur jagah apne kapde nahi utaarti, magar usne apne aur Allah, Ta'ala, ke darmiyan parda phaad diya." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Ubaydullah se, Isra'il se, Mansur se, Salim se, Abu al-Malih se, Aisha se bhi is hadith ke saath aayi hai.]

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا يُقِيمُ الرَّجُلُ يَعْنِي : أَخَاهُ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهِ، ثُمَّ يَقْعُدُ فِيهِ، وَلَكِنْ تَفَسَّحُوا وَتَوَسَّعُوا "
19.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A man should not make - meaning: his brother - stand up from his gathering, then sit in it, but make room and spread out."
19.hi: Musaddad ne Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Aadmi kisi ko - yaani: apne bhai ko - uski jagah se na uthaaye, fir khud waha baith jaaye, balke jagah do aur wusa't karo."

19.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُهَيْلٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا قَامَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَوِ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهِ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ، فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِهِ "
19.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Zuhayr, from Suhayl, from his father, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you, or a man, gets up from his gathering, then returns to it, he has more right to it."
19.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Zuhayr se bataya: Humein Suhayl ne bataya, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se koi, ya koi aadmi, apni jagah se uthe, fir wapas aaye, to woh usi ka zyada haqdaar hai."

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاق  ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَرَّ بِنَاسٍ جُلُوسٍ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ، فَقَالَ :" إِنْ كُنْتُمْ لَا بُدَّ فَاعِلِينَ، فَاهْدُوا السَّبِيلَ، وَأَفْشُوا السَّلَامَ، وَأَعِينُوا الْمَظْلُومَ ".
قَالَ شُعْبَةُ : لَمْ يَسْمَعْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ أَبُو إِسْحَاق مِنَ الْبَرَاءِ
19.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Bara'; with Shu'bah's note on the isnad: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by some people from the Ansar sitting, and said: "If you must do [something like this], then guide to the [right] path, and spread the greeting of peace, and help the oppressed." Shu'bah said: Abu Ishaq did not hear this hadith from al-Bara'.
19.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Shu'bah se bataya: Humein Abu Ishaq ne bataya, al-Bara' se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ Ansar ke kuch baithe hue logon ke paas se guzre, aur farmaya: "Agar tumhein zaroor karna hi hai, to seedhi raah dikhaao, aur salaam phailaao, aur mazloom ki madad karo." Shu'bah kehte hain: Abu Ishaq ne yeh hadith al-Bara' se nahi suni [yaani, yeh sanad munqata' hai].

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ  ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ  ، قَالَ : رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" مُسْتَلْقِيًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، وَاضِعًا إِحْدَى رِجْلَيْهِ عَلَى الْأُخْرَى "
19.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf, from Sufyan, from al-Zuhri, from Abbad ibn Tamim, from his uncle: He said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ "lying on his back in the mosque, placing one of his legs upon the other."
19.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf ne Sufyan se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Zuhri ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Abbad ibn Tamim se, apne chacha se: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko dekha "masjid mein cheet lete hue, apni ek taang doosri par rakhe hue."

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا كُنْتُمْ ثَلَاثَةً، فَلَا يَتَنَاجَى اثْنَانِ دُونَ صَاحِبِهِمَا، فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ يُحْزِنُهُ "
19.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from al-A'mash, from Abu Wa'il, from Abdullah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When you are three, let not two converse privately without their companion, for indeed that will grieve him."
19.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne al-A'mash se, Abu Wa'il se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum teen ho, to do log apne teesre saathi ko chhod kar aapas mein sargoshi na karein, kyunki isse usay ranj hoga."

19.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ،  حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ يَعْنِي : ابْنَ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هَاشِمٍ  ، عَنْ رُفَيْعٍ : أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَرْزَةَ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ  ، قَالَ : لَمَّا كَانَ بِأَخَرَةٍ، كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا جَلَسَ فِي الْمَجْلِسِ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَقُومَ، قَالَ :" سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ ".
فَقَالُوا : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّكَ لَتَقُولُ الْآنَ كَلَامًا، مَا كُنْتَ تَقُولُهُ فِيمَا خَلَا، فَقَالَ : " هَذَا كَفَّارَةٌ لِمَا يَكُونُ فِي الْمَجَالِسِ "
19.en: Narrated by Ya'la ibn Ubayd, from Hajjaj ibn Dinar, from Abu Hashim, from Rufay' Abu al-Aliyah, from Abu Barzah al-Aslami: He said: In later times, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he sat in a gathering and wanted to get up, would say: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk" [Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You, I bear witness that there is no god but You, I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance]. So they said: "O Messenger of Allah, you now say words which you did not use to say before," so he said: "This is an expiation for what occurs in gatherings."
19.hi: Ya'la ibn Ubayd ne Hajjaj ibn Dinar se, Abu Hashim se, Rufay' Abu al-Aliyah se, Abu Barzah al-Aslami se bataya: Unhone kaha, Baad ke zamane mein, Rasulullah ﷺ jab kisi majlis mein baithte aur uthna chahte, to farmaate: "Subhaanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illaa anta, astaghfiruka wa atoobu ilayk" [Ae Allah, tu paak hai aur teri hi tareef hai, main gawahi deta hoon ke tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi, main tujhse maghfirat maangta hoon aur teri taraf tauba karta hoon]. To sahaba ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, aap ab aisi baat kehte hain jo pehle nahi kehte the," to aapne farmaya: "Yeh majlison mein jo hota hai uska kaffara hai."

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، عَنْ أَخِيهِ عِيسَى  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" الْعَاطِسُ يَقُولُ : الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ.
وَيَقُولُ الَّذِي يُشَمِّتُهُ : يَرْحَمُكُمْ اللَّهُ، وَيَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ : يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ "
19.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla, from his brother Isa, from his father Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla, from Abu Ayyub al-Ansari, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "The sneezer says: Al-hamdu lillahi 'ala kulli hal [All praise to Allah in every state]. And the one who responds to him says: Yarhamukumullah [May Allah have mercy on you]. And he replies to him: Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu balakum [May Allah guide you and set right your affairs]."
19.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla se, apne bhai Isa se, apne walid Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla se, Abu Ayyub al-Ansari se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Chheenkne wala kahe: 'Al-hamdu lillahi 'alaa kulli haal' [Har haal mein Allah ki tareef]. Aur jo usay dua de woh kahe: 'Yarhamukumullah' [Allah tumpar reham kare]. Aur woh use jawaab de: 'Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu baalakum' [Allah tumhein hidayat de aur tumhare haalaat sudhaare]."

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ  ،  عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : عَطَسَ رَجُلَانِ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَشَمَّتَ أَوْ سَمَّتَ أَحَدَهُمَا وَلَمْ يُشَمِّتْ الْآخَرَ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، شَمَّتَّ هَذَا وَلَمْ تُشَمِّتْ الْآخَرَ؟، فَقَالَ :" إِنَّ هَذَا حَمِدَ اللَّهَ، وَإِنَّ هَذَا لَمْ يَحْمَدْ اللَّهَ ".
قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : سُلَيْمَانُ هُوَ : التَّيْمِيُّ
19.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Zuhayr, from Sulayman, from Anas; with Abdullah al-Darimi's clarification: He said: Two men sneezed in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ, so he responded to one of them and did not respond to the other, so it was said to him: "O Messenger of Allah, you responded to this one and did not respond to the other?" So he said: "This one praised Allah, and this one did not praise Allah." Abdullah said: Sulayman is: al-Taymi.
19.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Zuhayr se, Sulayman se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Do aadmi Nabi ﷺ ke saamne chheenke, to aapne unmein se ek ko dua di aur doosre ko nahi di, to aapse poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah, aapne isay dua di aur doosre ko nahi di?" To aapne farmaya: "Isne Allah ki hamd ki, aur isne Allah ki hamd nahi ki." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Sulayman se murad hai: al-Taymi.

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ هُوَ : ابْنُ عَمَّارٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي إِيَاسُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي  ، قَالَ : عَطَسَ رَجُلٌ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ :" يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ ".
ثُمَّ عَطَسَ أُخْرَى، فَقَالَ : " الرَّجُلُ مَزْكُومٌ "
19.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Ikrimah ibn Ammar, from Iyas ibn Salamah, from his father: He said: A man sneezed in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ, so he said: "Yarhamukallah." Then he sneezed again, so he said: "The man has a cold."
19.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Ikrimah ibn Ammar se bataya: Mujhse Iyas ibn Salamah ne bataya: Mujhse mere walid ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi Nabi ﷺ ke saamne chheenka, to aapne farmaya: "Yarhamukallah." Fir woh dobara chheenka, to aapne farmaya: "Isay zukaam hai."

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ   :" كَانَ لَنَا ثَوْبٌ فِيهِ تَصَاوِيرُ، فَجَعَلْتُهُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي، فَنَهَانِي أَوْ قَالَتْ : فَكَرِهَهُ ، قَالَتْ : فَجَعَلْتُهُ وَسَائِدَ "
19.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from his father: He said: Aisha said: "We had a cloth with pictures on it, so I placed it in front of the Prophet ﷺ while he was praying, so he forbade me, or she said: he disliked it," she said: "So I made it into cushions."
19.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Aisha ne kaha: "Humare paas ek kapda tha jispar tasweerein thin, to maine usay Nabi ﷺ ke saamne rakha jabke aap namaz padh rahe the, to aapne mujhe mana kiya, ya kaha: aapko yeh na-pasand hua," unhone kaha: "To maine usay takiye bana diye."

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَارَةُ بْنُ الْقَعْقَاعِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَارِثُ الْعُكْلِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَرِيرٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُجَيٍّ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ الْمَلَكَ لَا يَدْخُلُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ كَلْبٌ، وَلَا صُورَةٌ، وَلَا جُنُبٌ "
19.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Abd al-Wahid ibn Ziyad, from Umarah ibn al-Qa'qa', from al-Harith al-Ukli, from Abu Zur'ah ibn Amr ibn Jarir, from Abdullah ibn Nujayy, from Ali: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "Indeed the angel does not enter a house in which there is a dog, nor a picture, nor a person in a state of janabah."
19.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Abd al-Wahid ibn Ziyad se, Umarah ibn al-Qa'qa' se, al-Harith al-Ukli se, Abu Zur'ah ibn Amr ibn Jarir se, Abdullah ibn Nujayy se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Farishta us ghar mein dakhil nahi hota jismein kutta ho, na tasveer ho, na koi janabat ki haalat mein ho."

19.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، قَالَ : عَدِيُّ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ  أَخْبَرَنِي، قالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الْبَدْرِيِّ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" الْمُسْلِمُ إِذَا أَنَفْقَ نَفَقَةً عَلَى أَهْلِهِ وَهُوَ يَحْتَسِبُهَا، فَهِيَ لَهُ صَدَقَةٌ "
19.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Adi ibn Thabit, from Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Abu Mas'ud al-Badri, from the Prophet ﷺ: That he said: "When a Muslim spends an expense on his family, seeking its reward, it is charity for him."
19.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Adi ibn Thabit ne mujhe bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abdullah ibn Yazid ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Abu Mas'ud al-Badri se, Nabi ﷺ se: ke aapne farmaya, "Musalman jab apne gharwalon par kharcha kare aur uska sawaab chaahe, to yeh uske liye sadqa hai."

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ الْأَحْوَلُ  ، عَنْ مُوَرِّقٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ  ، قَالَ : " كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَاقَفَلَ، تُلُقِّيَ بِي وَبِالْحَسَنِ أَوْ بِالْحُسَيْنِ، قَالَ : وَأُرَاهُ قَالَ : الْحَسَنَ فَحَمَلَنِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، وَالْحَسَنَ وَرَاءَهُ، حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ وَنَحْنُ عَلَى الدَّابَّةِ الَّتِي عَلَيْهَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "
19.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Thabit ibn Yazid, from Asim al-Ahwal, from Muwarriq, from Abdullah ibn Ja'far: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he returned [from a journey], would be met by me and al-Hasan or al-Husayn," he said: and I think he said: al-Hasan, "so he carried me in front of him, and al-Hasan behind him, until we arrived at Madinah while we were on the mount that the Prophet ﷺ was on."
19.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Thabit ibn Yazid se bataya: Humein Asim al-Ahwal ne bataya, Muwarriq se, Abdullah ibn Ja'far se: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ jab [safar se] wapas aate, to mujhse aur al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) ya al-Husayn (Alayhis Salam) se mulaqaat hoti," unhone bataya: aur mera khayal hai unhone kaha: al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam), "to aap mujhe apne saamne bithaate, aur al-Hasan (Alayhis Salam) ko apne peechhe, yahan tak ke hum Madinah pahunchte jabke hum us sawaari par hote jispar Nabi ﷺ hote."

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ إِسْحَاق بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ  ، عَنْ الْمُسَيَّبِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ  ، وَمَعْبَدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الْخَطْمِيِّ  وَكَانَ أَمِيرًا عَلَى الْكُوفَةِ ، قَالَ : أَتَيْنَا قَيْسَ بْنَ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ فِي بَيْتِهِ، فَأَذَّنَ الْمُؤَذِّنِ لِلصَّلَاةِ، وَقُلْنَا لِقَيْسٍ : قُمْ فَصَلِّ لَنَا، فَقَالَ : لَمْ أَكُنْ لِأُصَلِّيَ بِقَوْمٍ لَسْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِأَمِيرٍ، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ لَيْسَ بِدُونِهِ.
يُقَالُ لَهُ : عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ حَنْظَلَةَ بْنِ الْغَسِيلِ   : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" الرَّجُلُ أَحَقُّ بِصَدْرِ دَابَّتِهِ، وَصَدْرِ فِرَاشِهِ، وَأَنْ يَؤُمَّ فِي رَحْلِهِ "، فَقَالَ قَيْسُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ : يَا فُلَانُ لِمَوْلًى لَهُ : قُمْ فَصَلِّ لَهُمْ
19.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Sulayman, from Ishaq ibn Yahya ibn Talhah, from al-Musayyab ibn Rafi', and Ma'bad ibn Khalid, from Abdullah ibn Yazid al-Khatmi: Who was governor over Kufah, he said: We came to Qays ibn Sa'd ibn Ubadah in his house, and the caller called the adhan for prayer, and we said to Qays: "Stand and pray for us," so he said: I would not lead a people over whom I am not a commander, so a man no less than him, called Abdullah ibn Hanzalah ibn al-Ghasil, said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The man has more right to the front of his mount, and the front of his bedding, and to lead the prayer in his own dwelling," so Qays ibn Sa'd said at that: "O so-and-so," to a client of his: "Stand and pray for them."
19.hi: Sa'id ibn Sulayman ne Ishaq ibn Yahya ibn Talhah se, al-Musayyab ibn Rafi' aur Ma'bad ibn Khalid se, Abdullah ibn Yazid al-Khatmi se bataya, jo Kufah ke ameer the: Unhone kaha, Hum Qays ibn Sa'd ibn Ubadah ke paas unke ghar aaye, to muezzin ne namaz ke liye azaan di, aur humne Qays se kaha: "Uthiye aur humein namaz padhaayiye," to unhone kaha: Main aisi qaum ki imaamat nahi karunga jispar main ameer nahi hoon, to ek aadmi jo unse kam nahi tha, jise Abdullah ibn Hanzalah ibn al-Ghasil kaha jaata tha, ne kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Aadmi apni sawaari ke aage, aur apne bistar ke aage, aur apne ghar mein imaamat karne ka zyada haqdaar hai," to Qays ibn Sa'd ne is par apne ek ghulam se kaha: "Ae fulaan, uthkar unhein namaz padhaao."

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو الْأَسْلَمِيِّ  ، قَالَ : وَقَدْ صَحِبَ أَبُوهُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبِي   يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" عَلَى ذِرْوَةِ كُلِّ بَعِيرٍ شَيْطَانٌ، فَإِذَا رَكِبْتُمُوهَا فَسَمُّوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُقَصِّرُوا عَنْ حَاجَاتِكُمْ "
19.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Usamah ibn Zayd, from Muhammad ibn Hamzah ibn Amr al-Aslami: He said: And his father had been a companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said: I heard my father say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Upon the hump of every camel is a devil, so when you mount it, mention the name of Allah, and do not fall short of your needs."
19.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Usamah ibn Zayd se bataya: Mujhse Muhammad ibn Hamzah ibn Amr al-Aslami ne bataya - aur unke walid Rasulullah ﷺ ke sahabi the: Unhone kaha, Maine apne walid ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Har oont ki kohaan par ek shaytan hota hai, so jab tum uspar sawaar ho, to Allah ka naam lo, aur apni zarooraton mein kami mat karo."

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ بْنُ سَوَّارٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ مُعَاذِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ   وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" ارْكَبُوا هَذِهِ الدَّوَابَّ سَالِمَةً، وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوهَا كَرَاسِيَّ ".
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ اللَّيْثِ  ، .
..
..
..
. إِلَّا أَنَّهُ مُخَالِفٌ شَبَابَةَ فِي شَيْءٍ
19.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Shababah ibn Sawwar, from Layth ibn Sa'd, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Sahl ibn Mu'adh ibn Anas, from his father: Who was among the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Ride these mounts safely, and do not take them as chairs [i.e. as a mere seat for idle talk]." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth ... but he differs with Shababah on something.]
19.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Shababah ibn Sawwar se, Layth ibn Sa'd se, Yazid ibn Abi Habib se, Sahl ibn Mu'adh ibn Anas se, apne walid se bataya, jo Nabi ﷺ ke sahaba mein se the: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "In sawaariyon par salaamat sawaari karo, aur inhein kursiyon ki tarah [bekaar baithne ke liye] mat banaao." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Abdullah ibn Salih se, al-Layth se bhi aayi hai ... lekin woh Shababah se kisi baat mein ikhtilaaf rakhte hain.]

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ سُمَيٍّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" السَّفَرُ قِطْعَةٌ مِنْ الْعَذَابِ يَمْنَعُ أَحَدَكُمْ نَوْمَهُ وَطَعَامَهُ وَشَرَابَهُ، فَإِذَا قَضَى أَحَدُكُمْ نَهْمَتَهُ مِنْ وَجْهِهِ فَلْيُعَجِّلْ الرَّجْعَةَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ "
19.en: Narrated by Khalid ibn Makhlad, from Malik, from Sumayy, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Travel is a portion of punishment, it prevents one of you from his sleep and his food and his drink, so when one of you fulfills his purpose on his journey, let him hasten his return to his family."
19.hi: Khalid ibn Makhlad ne Malik se, Sumayy se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Safar azaab ka ek hissa hai, yeh tum mein se kisi ko uski neend aur uske khaane aur uske peene se rokta hai, so jab tum mein se koi apna maqsad safar mein poora kar le, to woh jaldi apne gharwalon ke paas laut aaye."

19.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي كَعْبٍ : أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الْعَبْدِيُّ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ الْعَبْدِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، قَالَ : جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ : يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ السَّفَرَ.
فَقَالَ لَهُ : " مَتَى؟ ".
قَالَ : غَدًا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ.
قَالَ : فَأَتَاهُ، فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ :" فِي حِفْظِ اللَّهِ، وَفِي كَنَفِهِ، زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى، وَغَفَرَ لَكَ ذَنْبَكَ، وَوَجَّهَكَ لِلْخَيْرِ أَيْنَمَا تَوَخَّيْتَ أَوْ أَيْنَمَا تَوَجَّهْتَ ".
شَكَّ سَعِيدٌ فِي إِحْدَى الْكَلِمَتَيْنِ
19.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Sa'id ibn Abi Ka'b (Abu al-Hasan al-Abdi), from Musa ibn Maysarah al-Abdi, from Anas ibn Malik: He said: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ, and said to him: "O Prophet of Allah, I want to travel." So he said to him: "When?" He said: "Tomorrow, if Allah wills." He said: So he came to him, and took his hand, and said to him: "[Go] in the safekeeping of Allah, and in His care, may Allah provide you with taqwa, and forgive you your sins, and turn you toward good wherever you intend, or wherever you turn." Sa'id was uncertain about one of the two words.
19.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Sa'id ibn Abi Ka'b se bataya (Abu al-Hasan al-Abdi): Mujhse Musa ibn Maysarah al-Abdi ne bataya, Anas ibn Malik se: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi Nabi ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur aapse kaha: "Ya Nabi Allah, main safar karna chahta hoon." To aapne usse poocha: "Kab?" Usne kaha: "Kal, Inshaallah." Unhone bataya: To woh aapke paas aaya, to aapne uska haath pakda, aur usse farmaya: "Allah ki hifazat mein, aur uski panah mein, Allah tujhe taqwa ata kare, aur tere gunah maaf kare, aur tujhe bhalaai ki taraf le jaaye jahan bhi tu chaahe ya jahan bhi tu jaaye." Sa'id ko in do alfaaz mein se ek mein shak tha.

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمٌ هُوَ الْأَحْوَلُ  ، قَالَ : وَثَبَّتَنِي شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَرْجِسٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا سَافَرَ، قَالَ :" اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ، وَالْحَوْرِ بَعْدَ الْكَوْرِ، وَدَعْوَةِ الْمَظْلُومِ، وَسُوءِ الْمَنْظَرِ فِي الْأَهْلِ وَالْمَالِ "
19.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Asim al-Ahwal (Shu'bah confirmed it to me), from Abdullah ibn Sarjis: He said: The Prophet ﷺ, when he traveled, would say: "Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min wa'tha'is-safar, wa ka'abatil-munqalab, wal-hawri ba'dal-kawr, wa da'watil-mazlum, wa su'il-manzari fil-ahli wal-mal" [O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, and the sorrow of returning, and going back after having advanced, and the supplication of the oppressed, and a bad sight in family and wealth].
19.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Asim al-Ahwal se bataya - unhone kaha: aur Shu'bah ne mujhe [is sanad ki] pukhta tasdeeq di - Abdullah ibn Sarjis se: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ jab safar karte, to farmaate: "Allahumma inni a'oodhu bika min wa'thaa'is-safar, wa ka'aabatil-munqalab, wal-hawri ba'dal-kawr, wa da'watil-mazloom, wa soo'il-manzari fil-ahli wal-maal" [Ae Allah, main teri panah maangta hoon safar ki mushkilaat se, aur wapasi ke gham se, aage badhne ke baad peeche hatne se, mazloom ki dua se, aur ghar aur maal mein bure manzar se].

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَارِقِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا سَافَرَ فَرَكِبَ رَاحِلَتَهُ ،كَبَّرَ ثَلَاثًا وَيَقُولُ : " # سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ { 13 } وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ { 14 } سورة الزخرف آية 13-14 #.
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِي هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنْ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى.
اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا السَّفَرَ، وَاطْوِ لَنَا بُعْدَ الْأَرْضِ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ اصْحَبْنَا فِي سَفَرِنَا، وَاخْلُفْنَا فِي أَهْلِنَا بِخَيْرٍ "
19.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Ali ibn Abdullah al-Bariqi, from Abdullah ibn Umar: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he traveled and mounted his riding-animal, would say the takbir three times and say: "Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqalibun" [Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, while we could not have done it ourselves, and indeed to our Lord we will return] [Surah al-Zukhruf, verses 13-14]. "Allahumma inni as'aluka fi safari hadhal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tarda. Allahumma hawwin 'alaynas-safar, watwi lana bu'dal-ard, Allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safar, wal-khalifatu fil-ahl, Allahummas-habna fi safarina, wakhlufna fi ahlina bikhayr" [O Allah, I ask You in this journey of mine for righteousness and piety, and for deeds which please You. O Allah, ease this journey for us, and shorten for us its distance, O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey, and the Guardian of the family; O Allah, accompany us on our journey, and take care of our family in our absence with good].
19.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Ali ibn Abdullah al-Bariqi se, Abdullah ibn Umar se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ jab safar karte aur apni sawaari par baithte, to teen martaba takbir kehte aur farmaate: "Subhaanal-ladhi sakhkhara lanaa haadhaa wa maa kunnaa lahu muqrineen, wa innaa ilaa Rabbinaa la-munqaliboon" [Paak hai woh Zaat jisne humare liye ise musakhkhar kiya, warna hum khud ise vash mein nahi kar sakte the, aur beshak hum apne Rab ki taraf laut kar jaane wale hain] [Surah Az-Zukhruf, aayat 13-14]. "Allahumma inni as'aluka fi safari haadhal-birra wat-taqwaa, wa minal-'amali maa tardaa. Allahumma hawwin 'alaynas-safar, watwi lanaa bu'dal-ard, Allahumma antas-saahibu fis-safar, wal-khaleefatu fil-ahl, Allahummas-habnaa fi safarinaa, wakhlufnaa fi ahlinaa bikhayr" [Ae Allah, main is safar mein tujhse neki aur taqwa maangta hoon, aur aisa amal maangta hoon jissey tu razi ho. Ae Allah, humare liye yeh safar aasaan kar, aur zameen ki doori humare liye samet de, Ae Allah, tu hi safar mein saathi hai, aur ghar mein waali hai, Ae Allah, humare saath safar mein raha kar, aur humare peechhe humare ghar walon ki bhalaai se dekh-bhaal kar].

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُبَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ :" كُنَّا إِذَا صَعِدْنَا، كَبَّرْنَا، وَإِذَا هَبَطْنَا، سَبَّحْنَا "
19.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Zubayd, from Husayn, from Salim, from Jabir: He said: "We, when we went up [a slope], would say the takbir, and when we went down, we would glorify [Allah, saying tasbih]."
19.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Zubayd se, Husayn se, Salim se, Jabir se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Hum jab chadhte, to takbir kehte, aur jab utarte, to tasbih karte."

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْجَرَّاحِ  مَوْلَى أَمِّ حَبِيبَةَ ، عَنْ أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" الْعِيرُ الَّتِي فِيهَا الْجَرَسُ، لَا تَصْحَبُهَا الْمَلَائِكَة "
19.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Malik, from Nafi', from Salim, from Abu al-Jarrah, freed servant of Umm Habibah, from Umm Habibah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "The caravan with a bell in it, the angels do not accompany it."
19.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Malik se, Nafi' se, Salim se, Abu al-Jarrah se (Umm Habibah ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), Umm Habibah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Woh qaafila jismein ghanti ho, farishte uske saath nahi jaate."

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُهَيْلُ بْنُ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَا تَصْحَبُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ رِفْقَةً فِيهَا كَلْبٌ، أَوْ جَرَسٌ "
19.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Zuhayr, from Suhayl ibn Abi Salih, from his father, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "The angels do not accompany a traveling group with a dog, or a bell, in it."
19.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Zuhayr se, Suhayl ibn Abi Salih se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Farishte us qaafile ke saath nahi jaate jismein kutta, ya ghanti, ho."

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ  ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ فِي سَفَرٍ، فَسَمِعَ لَعْنَةً، فَقَالَ : " مَا هَذَا؟ ".
قَالُوا : فُلَانَةُ لَعَنَتْ رَاحِلَتَهَا.
فَقَالَ :" ضَعُوا عَنْهَا فَإِنَّهَا مَلْعُونَةٌ ".
قَالَ : فَوَضَعُوا عَنْهَا.
قَالَ عِمْرَانُ : كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهَا نَاقَةً وَرْقَاءَ
19.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah, from Abu al-Muhallab, from Imran ibn Husayn: That the Prophet ﷺ was on a journey, and heard a curse, so he said: "What is this?" They said: "So-and-so cursed her mount." So he said: "Take the load off it, for it is cursed." He said: So they took the load off it. Imran said: It is as if I am looking at it now, a dust-colored she-camel.
19.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ayyub se, Abu Qilabah se, Abu al-Muhallab se, Imran ibn Husayn se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ek safar mein the, to aapne ek lanat sunni, to aapne poocha: "Yeh kya hai?" Logon ne kaha: "Fulaanah ne apni sawaari par lanat ki." To aapne farmaya: "Uska bojh utaar do, kyunki woh mal'oon hai." Unhone bataya: To unhone uska bojh utaar diya. Imran kehte hain: Goya main use ab bhi dekh raha hoon, ek khaakastari rang ki oontni thi.

19.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا تُسَافِرِ الْمَرْأَةُ سَفَرًا ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَصَاعِدًا إِلَّا وَمَعَهَا أَبُوهَا، أَوْ أَخُوهَا، أَوْ زَوْجُهَا، أَوْ ذُو مَحْرَمٍ مِنْهُمَا "
19.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from al-A'mash, from Abu Salih, from Abu Sa'id: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A woman should not travel a journey of three days or more, unless her father, or her brother, or her husband, or a mahram [close relative] of theirs is with her."
19.hi: Ya'la ne al-A'mash se, Abu Salih se, Abu Sa'id se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Aurat teen din ya usse zyada ka safar na kare, siwaay iske ke uske saath uska baap, ya bhai, ya shohar, ya inmein se koi mahram ho."

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْهَيْثَمُ بْنُ جَمِيلٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ هُوَ : ابْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْعُمَرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَوْ يَعْلَمُ النَّاسُ مَا فِي الْوَحْدَةِ، لَمْ يَسْرِ رَاكِبٌ بِلَيْلٍ وَحْدَهُ أَبَدًا "
19.en: Narrated by al-Haytham ibn Jamil, from Asim ibn Muhammad al-Umari, from his father, from Ibn Umar: He said: The Prophet ﷺ said: "If people knew what is in solitude [when traveling alone], no rider would ever travel by night alone."
19.hi: Al-Haytham ibn Jamil ne Asim ibn Muhammad al-Umari se, apne walid se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, "Agar log jaante ke akele hone mein kya hai, to koi sawaar kabhi bhi raat ko akela safar na karta."

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، وَعَفَّانُ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَجْلانَ  ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، عَنْ خَوْلَةَ بِنْتِ حَكِيمٍ  ، قَالَتْ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" لَوْ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا نَزَلَ مَنْزِلًا، قَالَ : أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ فِي ذَلِكَ الْمَنْزِلِ شَيْءٌ حَتَّى يَرْتَحِلَ مِنْهُ "
19.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Ishaq, and Affan, from Wuhayb, from Muhammad ibn Ajlan, from Ya'qub ibn Abdullah ibn al-Ashajj, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Sa'd ibn Malik, from Khawlah bint Hakim: She said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "If one of you, when he stops at a stopping-place, says: 'A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq' [I seek refuge in the complete words of Allah from the evil of what He created], nothing will harm him at that stopping-place until he departs from it."
19.hi: Ahmad ibn Ishaq aur Affan ne Wuhayb se bataya: Humein Muhammad ibn Ajlan ne bataya, Ya'qub ibn Abdullah ibn al-Ashajj se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se, Sa'd ibn Malik se, Khawlah bint Hakim se: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Agar tum mein se koi, jab kisi jagah pdaao kare, kahe: 'A'oodhu bikalimaatillahit-taammaati min sharri maa khalaq' [Main Allah ke mukammal kalimaat ki panah maangta hoon uski har banaayi hui cheez ke sharr se], to us jagah usay tab tak koi nuqsaan nahi pahunchega jab tak woh wahan se kooch na kare."

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" إِذَا نَزَلَ مَنْزِلًا، لَمْ يَرْتَحِلْ مِنْهُ حَتَّى يُصَلِّيَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، أَوْ يُوَدِّعَ الْمَنْزِلَ بِرَكْعَتَيْنِ ".
قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : عُثْمَانُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ضَعِيفٌ
19.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Uthman ibn Sa'd, from Anas ibn Malik; with Abdullah al-Darimi's note: That the Prophet ﷺ used to "when he stopped at a place, not depart from it until he prayed two rak'ahs, or bid farewell to the place with two rak'ahs." Abdullah said: Uthman ibn Sa'd is weak.
19.hi: Abu Asim ne Uthman ibn Sa'd se, Anas ibn Malik se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ "jab kisi jagah pdaao karte, to wahan se tab tak nahi jaate jab tak do rakat namaz na padh lein, ya do rakat se us jagah se vida na lein." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Uthman ibn Sa'd zaeef (kamzor) hain.

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَارِقِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا رَجَعَ مِنْ سَفَرِهِ، قَالَ :" آيِبُونَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ "
19.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Ali ibn Abdullah al-Bariqi, from Abdullah ibn Umar: That the Prophet ﷺ, when he returned from his journey, would say: "Ayibuna in sha' Allah ta'ibuna 'abiduna, li Rabbina hamidun" [We are returning, if Allah wills, repenting, worshipping, to our Lord, giving praise].
19.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Ali ibn Abdullah al-Bariqi se, Abdullah ibn Umar se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ jab apne safar se wapas aate, to farmaate: "Aayiboona in shaa-Allahu taa'iboona 'aabidoona, li-Rabbinaa haamidoon" [Hum wapas aa rahe hain, Inshaallah, tauba karte hue, ibaadat karte hue, apne Rab ki hamd karte hue].

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاق  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ  ، يَقُولُ : إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَمَرَ رَجُلًا إِذَا أَخَذَ مَضْجَعَهُ أَنْ يَقُولَ :" اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَى مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ، فَإِنْ مَاتَ، مَاتَ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ "
