19.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Bara' ibn Azib: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded a man, when he took to his bed, to say: "Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk, wa alja'tu zahri ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, la malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilayk, amantu bikitabikal-ladhi anzalta, wa nabiyyikal-ladhi arsalta, fa'in mata, mata 'alal-fitrah" [O Allah, I have submitted myself to You, and turned my face toward You, and entrusted my affair to You, and taken refuge with my back to You, in hope and fear of You, there is no refuge nor escape from You except to You, I believe in Your Book which You revealed, and Your Prophet whom You sent, so if I die, I die upon the natural disposition (of Islam)].
19.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Humein Abu Ishaq ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Bara' ibn Azib ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne ek aadmi ko hukum diya ke jab woh apna bistar le, to woh kahe: "Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk, wa alja'tu zahri ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, laa malja'a wa laa manjaa minka illaa ilayk, aamantu bikitaabikal-ladhi anzalta, wa nabiyyikal-ladhi arsalta, fa-in mittu, mittu 'alal-fitrah" [Ae Allah, maine apni jaan tujhe saup di, aur apna chehra teri taraf pher liya, aur apna maamla tere supurd kar diya, aur apni peeth teri panah mein de di, teri taraf raghbat aur khauf se, tujhse koi panah aur bachaao nahi siwaay teri hi taraf, main teri us Kitaab par imaan laaya jo tune naazil ki, aur tere us Nabi par jise tune bheja, so agar main maru, to fitrat (Islam) par maru].

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا أَوَى أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ، فَلْيَنْفُضْ فِرَاشَهُ بِدَاخِلَةِ إِزَارِهِ، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَدْرِي مَا خَلَفَهُ فِيهِ، وَلْيَقُلْ : اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي، فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا، فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ "
19.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ubaydullah ibn Umar, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id al-Maqburi, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you retires to his bed, let him dust off his bed with the inner part of his izar, for he does not know what came upon it after he left it, and let him say: 'Allahumma bika wada'tu janbi, wa bika arfa'uh, Allahumma in amsakta nafsi, faghfir laha, wa in arsaltaha, fahfazha bima tahfazu bihi 'ibadakas-salihin' [O Allah, by You I lay down my side, and by You I raise it, O Allah if You take my soul, forgive it, and if You release it, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants]."
19.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ubaydullah ibn Umar se, Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id al-Maqburi se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se koi apne bistar par jaaye, to woh apna bistar apne izaar ke andar wale hisse se jhaad le, kyunki usay nahi maloom uski ghair-mojoodgi mein usmein kya aa gaya ho, aur woh kahe: 'Allahumma bika wada'tu janbi, wa bika arfa'uh, Allahumma in amsakta nafsi faghfir lahaa, wa in arsaltahaa fahfazhaa bimaa tahfazu bihi 'ibaadakas-saaliheen' [Ae Allah, tere hi sahaare maine apna pehlu rakha, aur tere hi sahaare main isay uthaunga, Ae Allah agar tu meri jaan rok le, to usay bakhsh de, aur agar tu isay chhod de, to isay isi tarah mehfooz rakh jaise tu apne neik bandon ko mehfooz rakhta hai]."

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْعَوَّامُ بْنُ حَوْشَبٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ  ، قَالَ : أَتَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَتَّى وَضَعَ قَدَمَهُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ فَاطِمَةَ ، فَعَلَّمَنَا مَا نَقُولُ إِذَا أَخَذْنَا مَضَاجِعَنَا :" ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ تَسْبِيحَةً، وَثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ تَحْمِيدَةً، وَأَرْبَعًا وَثَلَاثِينَ تَكْبِيرَةً ".
قَالَ عَلِيٌّ : فَمَا تَرَكْتُهَا بَعْدُ.
فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ : وَلَا لَيْلَةَ صِفِّينَ؟.
قَالَ : وَلَا لَيْلَةَ صِفِّينَ
19.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Awwam ibn Hawshab, from Amr ibn Murrah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla, from Ali: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to us until he placed his foot between me and Fatimah, and taught us what to say when we took to our beds: "Thirty-three glorifications, and thirty-three praises, and thirty-four magnifications." Ali said: I have not left it since. So a man said to him: "Not even the night of Siffin?" He said: "Not even the night of Siffin."
19.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Awwam ibn Hawshab se bataya: Mujhse Amr ibn Murrah ne bataya, Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ humare paas aaye yahan tak ke aapne apna paaon mere aur Fatimah (Alayhas Salam) ke darmiyan rakha, aur humein sikhaaya ke hum apne bistar par jaate waqt kya kahein: "Teintees tasbih, aur teintees tahmid, aur chauntees takbir." Ali (Alayhis Salam) kehte hain: Maine ise tab se kabhi nahi chhoda. To ek aadmi ne unse poocha: "Siffin ki raat bhi nahi?" Unhone kaha: "Siffin ki raat bhi nahi."

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ حِرَاشٍ  ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ.
قَالَ :" الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا، وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ "
19.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr, from Rib'i ibn Hirash, from Hudhayfah: He said: The Prophet ﷺ, when he woke up, would say: "Al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana, wa ilayhin-nushur" [Praise be to Allah who gave us life after having given us death, and to Him is the resurrection].
19.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr se, Rib'i ibn Hirash se, Hudhayfah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ jab jaagte, to farmaate: "Al-hamdu lillaahil-ladhi ahyaanaa ba'da maa amaatanaa, wa ilayhin-nushoor" [Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai jisne humein hamari maut ke baad zindagi di, aur usi ki taraf uthna hai].

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْحِزَامِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي عُمَيْرُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ الْعَنْسِيُّ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي جُنَادَةُ بْنُ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي عُبَادَةُ بْنُ الصَّامِتِ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ تَعَارَّ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ، فَقَالَ : لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ ".
ثُمَّ قَالَ : " رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي أَوْ قَالَ : ثُمَّ دَعَا اسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ فَإِنْ عَزَمَ فَتَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ صَلَّى قُبِلَتْ صَلَاتُهُ "
19.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Hizami, from al-Walid ibn Muslim, from al-Awza'i, from Umayr ibn Hani al-Ansi, from Junadah ibn Abi Umayyah, from Ubadah ibn al-Samit, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whoever wakes with a start in the night, and says: 'La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, subhanallah, wal-hamdu lillah, wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah' [There is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner, His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things capable, Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Allah, and Allah is greatest, and there is no power nor strength except with Allah]," then says: "'Rabbi ighfir li' [My Lord, forgive me]," or he said: "then supplicates, it will be answered for him, and if he resolves, then performs ablution, then prays, his prayer will be accepted."
19.hi: Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Hizami ne al-Walid ibn Muslim se bataya: Humein al-Awza'i ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Umayr ibn Hani al-Ansi ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Junadah ibn Abi Umayyah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Ubadah ibn al-Samit ne bataya, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Jo raat ko achaanak jaage, aur kahe: 'Laa ilaaha illallahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer, subhaanallah, wal-hamdu lillah, wallaahu akbar, wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billah' [Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, akela, uska koi shareek nahi, baadshahat aur tareef usi ki hai, aur woh har cheez par qaadir hai, Allah paak hai, aur tareef Allah ke liye hai, aur Allah sabse bada hai, aur koi taaqat aur qoowat nahi magar Allah ke saath]," fir kahe: "'Rabbi ighfir li' [Mere Rab, mujhe bakhsh de]," ya farmaya: "fir dua kare, to uski dua qabool ki jaayegi, aur agar woh irada kare, fir wudu kare, fir namaz padhe, to uski namaz qabool ki jaayegi."

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبْزَى  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَصْبَحَ.
قَالَ :" أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَكَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَدِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، وَمِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا "
19.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Salamah ibn Kuhayl, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Abza, from his father: He said: The Prophet ﷺ, when it became morning, would say: "Asbahna 'ala fitratil-Islam, wa kalimatil-ikhlas, wa dini nabiyyina Muhammad, wa millati abina Ibrahima hanifan musliman" [We have entered the morning upon the natural disposition of Islam, and the word of sincerity, and the religion of our Prophet Muhammad, and the way of our father Ibrahim, inclining toward truth, a Muslim].
19.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Salamah ibn Kuhayl se, Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Abza se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ jab subah hoti, to farmaate: "Asbahnaa 'alaa fitratil-Islaam, wa kalimatil-ikhlaas, wa deeni nabiyyinaa Muhammad, wa millati abeenaa Ibraaheema haneefan musliman" [Hum subah kar rahe hain Islam ki fitrat par, aur ikhlaas ke kalima par, aur humare Nabi Muhammad ke deen par, aur humare baap Ibrahim ke tareeqe par, jo seedhi raah wale aur Musalman the].

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مُرْنِي بِشَيْءٍ أَقُولُهُ إِذَا أَصْبَحْتُ وَإِذَا أَمْسَيْتُ.
قَالَ :" قُلْ : اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ ".
 قَالَ : " قُلْهُ إِذَا أَصْبَحْتَ وَإِذَا أَمْسَيْتَ، وَإِذَا أَخَذْتَ مَضْجَعَكَ "
19.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Ya'la ibn Ata, from Amr ibn Asim, from Abu Hurairah: He said: Abu Bakr said: "O Messenger of Allah, command me with something I should say when I wake up and when I retire in the evening." He said: "Say: 'Allahumma Fatiras-samawati wal-ard, 'Alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, Rabba kulli shay'in wa maleekah, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa anta, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi, wa min sharrish-shaytani wa shirkih' [O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Lord of everything and its Sovereign, I bear witness that there is no god but You, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own soul, and from the evil of the devil and his associating [others with You]]." He said: "Say it when you wake, and when you retire in the evening, and when you take to your bed."
19.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Ya'la ibn Ata se, Amr ibn Asim se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abu Bakr (رضي الله عنه) ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, mujhe koi aisi cheez bataayein jo main subah aur shaam kahun." Aapne farmaya: "Kaho: 'Allahumma Faatiras-samaawaati wal-ard, 'Aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahaadah, Rabba kulli shay'in wa maleekah, ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illaa anta, a'oodhu bika min sharri nafsi, wa min sharrish-shaytaani wa shirkih' [Ae Allah, aasmaanon aur zameen ke banaane wale, ghaib aur zaahir ke jaanne wale, har cheez ke Rab aur uske Maalik, main gawahi deta hoon ke tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi, main teri panah maangta hoon apne nafs ki buraai se, aur shaytan ki buraai aur uske shirk se]." Aapne farmaya: "Isay subah kaho, aur shaam kaho, aur jab apna bistar lo tab kaho."

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْمُقْرِئُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ هُوَ : ابْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَرْحُومٍ  ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ مُعَاذِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ لَبِسَ ثَوْبًا، فَقَالَ : الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ، غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ "
19.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid al-Muqri, from Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub, from Abu Marhum, from Sahl ibn Mu'adh ibn Anas, from his father: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever wears a garment, and says: 'Al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi kasani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah' [Praise be to Allah who has clothed me with this and provided it for me without any power or strength of my own], will be forgiven what preceded of his sins."
19.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid al-Muqri ne Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub se, Abu Marhum se, Sahl ibn Mu'adh ibn Anas se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo koi kapda pehne, aur kahe: 'Al-hamdu lillaahil-ladhi kasaani haadhaa wa razaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minni wa laa quwwah' [Sab tareef Allah ke liye hai jisne mujhe yeh pehnaya aur bagair meri kisi taaqat aur qoowat ke mujhe yeh diya], uske pichhle gunah maaf kar diye jaate hain."

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ يَعْنِي : ابْنَ بِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ  أَوْ أَبِي أُسَيْدٍ   قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا دَخَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ الْمَسْجِدَ، فَلْيَقُلْ : اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ، وَإِذَا خَرَجَ، فَلْيَقُلْ : اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ "
19.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Maslamah, from Sulayman ibn Bilal, from Rabi'ah, from Abd al-Malik ibn Sa'id, from Abu Humayd or Abu Usayd: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When one of you enters the mosque, let him say: 'Allahumma iftah li abwaba rahmatik' [O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy], and when he leaves, let him say: 'Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik' [O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty]."
19.hi: Abdullah ibn Maslamah ne Sulayman ibn Bilal se, Rabi'ah se, Abd al-Malik ibn Sa'id se, Abu Humayd ya Abu Usayd se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jab tum mein se koi masjid mein dakhil ho, to woh kahe: 'Allahumma iftah li abwaaba rahmatik' [Ae Allah, mere liye apni rehmat ke darwaze khol de], aur jab woh nikle, to woh kahe: 'Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik' [Ae Allah, main tujhse tera fazl maangta hoon]."

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَزْهَرُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ وَاسِعٍ  ، قَالَ : قَدِمْتُ مَكَّةَ فَلَقِيتُ بِهَا أَخِي سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  فَحَدَّثَنِي، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ دَخَلَ السُّوقَ، فَقَالَ : لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ أَلْفَ أَلْفِ حَسَنَةٍ، وَمَحَا عَنْهُ أَلْفَ أَلْفِ سَيِّئَةٍ، وَرَفَعَ لَهُ أَلْفَ أَلْفِ دَرَجَةٍ ".
قَالَ : فَقَدِمْتُ خُرَاسَانَ فَلَقِيتُ قُتَيْبَةَ بْنَ مُسْلِمٍ، فَقُلْتُ : إِنِّي أَتَيْتُكَ بِهَدِيَّةٍ، فَحَدَّثْتُهُ، فَكَانَ يَرْكَبُ فِي مَوْكِبِهِ فَيَأْتِي السُّوقَ، فَيَقُومُ، فَيَقُولُهَا ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ
19.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Azhar ibn Sinan, from Muhammad ibn Wasi': He said: I arrived at Makkah and met my brother Salim ibn Abdullah there, and he narrated to me, from his father, from his grandfather: that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever enters the market, and says: 'La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, yuhyi wa yumit, wa huwa hayyun la yamut, biyadihil-khayr, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir' [There is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner, His is the dominion and His is the praise, He gives life and causes death, and He is living, does not die, in His hand is all good, and He is over all things capable], Allah will write for him a thousand thousand good deeds, and erase from him a thousand thousand bad deeds, and raise him a thousand thousand levels." He said: So I arrived at Khurasan and met Qutaybah ibn Muslim, and I said: "I have come to you with a gift," and I narrated it to him, so he used to ride in his procession and come to the market, and stand, and say it, then return.
19.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Azhar ibn Sinan se bataya: Humein Muhammad ibn Wasi' ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Makkah pahuncha to wahan apne bhai Salim ibn Abdullah se mila, to unhone mujhe bataya, apne walid se, apne dada se: ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo bazaar mein dakhil ho, aur kahe: 'Laa ilaaha illallahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, yuhyi wa yumeet, wa huwa hayyun laa yamoot, biyadihil-khayr, wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer' [Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, akela, uska koi shareek nahi, baadshahat aur tareef usi ki hai, woh zindagi deta hai aur maut deta hai, aur woh zinda hai, kabhi nahi marega, uske haath mein bhalaai hai, aur woh har cheez par qaadir hai], Allah uske liye das lakh nekiyaan likhega, aur us par se das lakh gunah mita dega, aur usay das lakh darjay bulund karega." Unhone bataya: To main Khurasan pahuncha aur Qutaybah ibn Muslim se mila, to maine kaha: "Main aapke liye ek tohfa laaya hoon," to maine unhein yeh bataaya, so woh apne juloos mein sawaar hokar bazaar aate, aur khade hote, aur isay kehte fir wapas jaate.

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" تَسَمُّوا بِاسْمِي وَلَا تَكَنَّوْا بِكُنْيَتِي "
19.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Hisham, from Muhammad ibn Sirin, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Name yourselves with my name, but do not use my kunyah [Abu al-Qasim] for yourselves."
19.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Hisham se, Muhammad ibn Sirin se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Apna naam mere naam par rakho, lekin meri kunyat apne liye mat rakho."

19.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي زَكَرِيَّا الْخُزَاعِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّكُمْ تُدْعَوْنَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِأَسْمَائِكُمْ وَأَسْمَاءِ آبَائِكُمْ، فَأَحْسِنُوا أَسْمَاءَكُمْ "
19.en: Narrated by Affan ibn Muslim, from Hushaym, from Da'ud ibn Amr, from Abdullah ibn Abi Zakariya al-Khuza'i, from Abu al-Darda: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "You will be called on the Day of Resurrection by your names, and the names of your fathers, so make your names good."
19.hi: Affan ibn Muslim ne Hushaym se bataya: Humein Da'ud ibn Amr ne bataya, Abdullah ibn Abi Zakariya al-Khuza'i se, Abu al-Darda se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tumhein Qayamat ke din tumhare naamon se, aur tumhare baapon ke naamon se pukaara jaayega, so apne naam achhe rakho."

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَحَبُّ الْأَسْمَاءِ إِلَى اللَّهِ : عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ "
19.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir, from Ubaydullah ibn Umar, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The most beloved of names to Allah are: Abdullah, and Abd al-Rahman."
19.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir ne Ubaydullah ibn Umar se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah ko sabse aziz naam hain: Abdullah, aur Abd al-Rahman."

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ  ، عَنْ الرُّكَيْنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ،  عَنْ سَمُرَةَ   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " نَهَى أَنْنُسَمِّيَ أَرِقَّاءَنَا أَرْبَعَةَ أَسْمَاءٍ : أَفْلَحُ، وَنَافِعٌ، وَرَبَاحٌ، وَيَسَارٌ "
19.en: Narrated by Zakariya ibn Adi, from Mu'tamir, from al-Rukayn, from his father, from Samurah: That the Prophet ﷺ "forbade us from naming our slaves with four names: Aflah, and Nafi', and Rabah, and Yasar."
19.hi: Zakariya ibn Adi ne Mu'tamir se, al-Rukayn se, apne walid se, Samurah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne "humein apne ghulaamon ko chaar naamon se naamzad karne se mana kiya: Aflah, aur Nafi', aur Rabah, aur Yasar."

19.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ هُوَ : ابْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   : أَنَّ أُمَّ عَاصِمٍ كَانَ يُقَالُ لَهَا عَاصِيَةُ ،" فَسَمَّاهَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ جَمِيلَةَ "
19.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That Umm Asim used to be called Asiyah, "so the Prophet ﷺ named her Jamilah."
19.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ubaydullah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya ke Umm Asim ko 'Asiyah' (nafarmaan) kaha jaata tha, "to Nabi ﷺ ne unka naam Jameelah rakh diya."

19.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قالَ : كَانَ اسْمُ زَيْنَبَ ، بَرَّةَ ،" فَسَمَّاهَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ زَيْنَبَ "
19.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Shu'bah, from Ata ibn Abi Maymunah, from Abu Rafi', from Abu Hurairah: He said: Zaynab's name was Barrah, "so the Prophet ﷺ named her Zaynab."
19.hi: Musaddad ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Shu'bah se, Ata ibn Abi Maymunah se, Abu Rafi' se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Zaynab ka naam Barrah (neik) tha, "to Nabi ﷺ ne unka naam Zaynab rakh diya."

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ حِرَاشٍ  ، عَنِ الطُّفَيْلِ   أَخِي عَائِشَةَ ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ لِرَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ : نِعْمَ الْقَوْمُ أَنْتُمْ لَوْلَا أَنَّكُمْ تَقُولُونَ : مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ، وَشَاءَ مُحَمَّدٌ .
فَسَمِعَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ :" لَا تَقُولُوا : مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ وَشَاءَ مُحَمَّدٌ ، وَلَكِنْ، قُولُوا : مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ، ثُمَّ شَاءَ مُحَمَّدٌ "
19.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Shu'bah, from Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr, from Rib'i ibn Hirash, from al-Tufayl, brother of Aisha: He said: A man from the polytheists said to a man from the Muslims: "What a fine people you are, were it not that you say: 'What Allah wills and Muhammad wills.'" So the Prophet ﷺ heard, and said: "Do not say: 'What Allah wills and Muhammad wills,' but say: 'What Allah wills, then Muhammad wills.'"
19.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Shu'bah se, Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr se, Rib'i ibn Hirash se, al-Tufayl se, Aisha ke bhai, bataya: Unhone kaha, Mushrikon mein se ek aadmi ne Musalmanon mein se ek aadmi se kaha: "Tum kitne achhe log ho agar tum yeh na kaho: 'Jo Allah chahe aur Muhammad chaahein.'" To Nabi ﷺ ne yeh suna, aur farmaya: "Yeh mat kaho: 'Jo Allah chahe aur Muhammad chaahein,' balke kaho: 'Jo Allah chahe, fir Muhammad chaahein.'"

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ : ابْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا تَقُولُوا لِحَائِطِ الْعِنَبِ الْكَرْمُ، إِنَّمَا الْكَرْمُ الرَّجُلُ الْمُسْلِمُ "
19.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Salih ibn Ibrahim, from Abd al-Rahman al-A'raj, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do not say to a vineyard [garden]: 'al-karm', for indeed al-karm [true nobility] is the Muslim man."
19.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, Salih ibn Ibrahim se, Abd al-Rahman al-A'raj se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Angoor ke baagh ko 'al-karm' mat kaho, kyunki 'al-karm' (asli nobility) to Musalman aadmi hai."

19.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ L5403 ، عَنِ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ غُلَامٌ يَسُوقُ بِأَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ :" يَا أَنْجَشَةُ، رُوَيْدًا سَوْقَكَ بِالْقَوَارِيرِ "
19.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Abdullah ibn Ubayd, from Anas: He said: There was a young boy driving the mounts of the Prophet's ﷺ wives, so he said: "O Anjashah, gently with your driving, [as you carry] the fragile glass vessels [i.e., the women]."
19.hi: Abu Asim ne Abdullah ibn Ubayd se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek jawaan ladka Nabi ﷺ ki biwiyon ki sawaariyaan hank raha tha, to aapne farmaya: "Ae Anjashah, dheere hanko, [kyunki tum le ja rahe ho] naazuk shishe ke bartan [yaani, auratein]."

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا بَهْزُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" وَيْلٌ لِلَّذِي يُحَدِّثُ فَيَكْذِبُ لِيُضْحِكَ بِهِ الْقَوْمَ، وَيْلٌ لَهُ ! وَيْلٌ لَهُ ! "
19.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Bahz ibn Hakim, from his father, from his grandfather: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Woe to the one who narrates and lies to make people laugh with it, woe to him! Woe to him!"
19.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Bahz ibn Hakim se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Afsos us shakhs par jo baat kare aur jhoot bole taake usse logon ko hansaaye, afsos usper! Afsos usper!"

19.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ :صَدَّقَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أُمَيَّةَ بْنَ أَبِي الصَّلْتِ فِي بَيْتَيْنِ مِنْ الشِّعْرِ، فَقَالَ : رَجُلٌ وَثَوْرٌ تَحْتَ رِجْلِ يَمِينِهِ وَالنَّسْرُ لِلْأُخْرَى وَلَيْثٌ مُرْصَدُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " صَدَقَ ".
قَالَ : وَالشَّمْسُ تَطْلُعُ كُلَّ آخِرِ لَيْلَةٍ حَمْرَاءَ يُصْبِحُ لَوْنُهَا يَتَوَرَّدُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " صَدَقَ ".
فَقَالَ قَائِلٌ : تَأْبَى فَمَا تَطْلُعُ لَنَا فِي رِسْلِهَا إِلَّا مُعَذَّبَةً وَإِلَّا تُجْلَدُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " صَدَقَ "
19.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abdah ibn Sulayman, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Ya'qub ibn Utbah, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas: He said: The Prophet ﷺ confirmed Umayyah ibn Abi al-Salt as truthful in two lines of poetry, for he said: "A man and a bull beneath his right leg, and the eagle for the other, and a lion on watch," so the Prophet ﷺ said: "He spoke the truth." He said: And [also]: "And the sun rises each end of night, red, its color turning rosy at dawn," so the Prophet ﷺ said: "He spoke the truth." So a speaker said: "It refuses, and does not rise for us in its ease, except tormented, or else it is whipped," so the Prophet ﷺ said: "He spoke the truth."
19.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Abdah ibn Sulayman se bataya: Humein Muhammad ibn Ishaq ne bataya, Ya'qub ibn Utbah se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ ne Umayyah ibn Abi al-Salt ki shayari ke do misron ki tasdeeq ki, unhone kaha: "Ek aadmi aur ek bail uske daaye pair ke neeche, aur uqaab doosre ke neeche, aur ek sher taak mein," to Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Usne sach kaha." Unhone bataya: Aur [yeh bhi]: "Aur suraj har raat ke aakhir mein nikalta hai, laal, uska rang subah gulaabi ho jaata hai," to Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Usne sach kaha." To ek kehne wale ne kaha: "Woh inkaar karta hai, aur humare liye aasaani se nahi nikalta, magar sazaa-yaafta hokar, ya use kode maare jaate hain," to Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Usne sach kaha."

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ زِيَادٍ هُوَ : ابْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ  ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ يَغُوثَ  ، عَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ مِنَ الشِّعْرِ حِكْمَةً "
19.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ziyad ibn Sa'd, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Bakr ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Hisham, from Marwan ibn al-Hakam, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Aswad ibn Abd Yaghuth, from Ubayy ibn Ka'b, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Indeed there is wisdom in [some] poetry."
19.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se bataya: Mujhe Ziyad ibn Sa'd ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Ibn Shihab ne bataya, Abu Bakr ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Hisham se, Marwan ibn al-Hakam se, Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Aswad ibn Abd Yaghuth se, Ubayy ibn Ka'b se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Kuch shayari mein hikmat hoti hai."

19.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَنْظَلَةُ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :أَنْ يَمْتَلِئَ جَوْفُ أَحَدِكُمْ قَيْحًا أَوْ دَمًا خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ يَمْتَلِئَ شِعْرًا "
19.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Hanzalah, from Salim, from Ibn Umar: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "For the belly of one of you to be filled with pus or blood is better than it being filled with poetry."
19.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Hanzalah se, Salim se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tum mein se kisi ke pet mein peep ya khoon bhar jaana isse behtar hai ke woh shayari se bhar jaaye."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا، يُفَقِّهْهُ فِي الدِّينِ "
20.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Sulayman, from Isma'il ibn Ja'far, from Abdullah ibn Sa'id ibn Abi Hind, from his father, from Ibn Abbas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever Allah wishes good for, He gives him understanding of the religion."
20.hi: Sa'id ibn Sulayman ne Isma'il ibn Ja'far se, Abdullah ibn Sa'id ibn Abi Hind se, apne walid se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jiske saath Allah bhalaai chahe, usay woh deen ki samajh de deta hai."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ هُوَ : ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَاهُ  يُحَدِّثُ،  عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ الصِّحَّةَ وَالْفَرَاغَ نِعْمَتَانِ مِنْ نِعَمِ اللَّهِ، مَغْبُونٌ فِيهِمَا كَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ "
20.en: Narrated by al-Makki ibn Ibrahim, from Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from his father, from Ibn Abbas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Health and free time are two blessings from among the blessings of Allah, many people are deceived/deprived in regard to them."
20.hi: Al-Makki ibn Ibrahim ne Abdullah ibn Sa'id se bataya: ke unhone apne walid ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Ibn Abbas se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Sehat aur farāgat (khaali waqt) Allah ki ne'maton mein se do ne'matein hain, jinke baare mein bahut se log dhoke mein hain."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ يَعْنِي : ابْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنِ اسْتَمَعَ إِلَى حَدِيثِ قَوْمٍ وَهُمْ لَهُ كَارِهُونَ، صُبَّ فِي أُذُنِهِ الْآنُكُ "
20.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid ibn Abdullah, from Khalid al-Hadhdha, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whoever listens to the conversation of a people while they dislike it [being overheard], molten lead will be poured into his ear."
20.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid ibn Abdullah se, Khalid al-Hadhdha se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jo kisi qaum ki baatchit sune jabke woh isay na-pasand karte hon, uske kaan mein pighlaaya hua seesa daala jaayega."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا تُتْبِعِ النَّظْرَةَ النَّظْرَةَ، فَإِنَّ الْأُولَى لَكَ، وَالْآخِرَةَ عَلَيْكَ "
20.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim, from Salamah ibn Abi al-Tufayl, from Ali: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do not follow up a [first] glance with another glance, for the first is [permissible] for you, but the second is against you."
20.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, Muhammad ibn Ibrahim se, Salamah ibn Abi al-Tufayl se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Pehli nazar ke baad doosri nazar na daalo, kyunki pehli tumhare liye [mu'af] hai, aur doosri tumhare khilaaf hai."

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَخْبِرْنِي بِعَمَلٍ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ لَا أَسْأَلُ عَنْهُ أَحَدًا.
قَالَ :" اتَّقِ اللَّهَ، ثُمَّ اسْتَقِمْ ".
قَالَ : قُلْتُ : ثُمَّ أَيُّ شَيْءٍ؟.
قَالَ : فَأَشَارَ إِلَى لِسَانِهِ
20.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Rabi', from Shu'bah, from Ya'la ibn Ata, from Abdullah ibn Sufyan, from his father: He said: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, tell me of a deed in Islam that I will not ask anyone else about." He said: "Fear Allah, then remain steadfast." He said: I said: "Then what?" He said: So he pointed to his tongue.
20.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Rabi' ne Shu'bah se, Ya'la ibn Ata se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abdullah ibn Sufyan ko suna, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, mujhe Islam mein aisa amal bataayein ke main kisi aur se na poochun." Aapne farmaya: "Allah se daro, fir sabit-qadam raho." Unhone bataya: Maine poocha: "Fir kya?" Unhone bataya: To aapne apni zubaan ki taraf ishara kiya.

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ يَعْنِي : ابْنَ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ مُجَمِّعٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مُرْنِي بِأَمْرٍ أَعْتَصِمُ بِهِ.
قَالَ :" قُلْ رَبِّيَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقِمْ ".
قَالَ : قُلْتُ : يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ مَا أَكْثَرُ مَا تَخَوَّفُ عَلَيَّ؟.
قَالَ : فَأَخَذَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِلِسَانِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ : " هَذَا "
20.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Ibrahim ibn Isma'il ibn Mujammi', from Ibn Shihab, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Mu'adh, from Sufyan ibn Abdullah: He said: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, command me with something I can hold onto." He said: "Say: My Lord is Allah, then remain steadfast." He said: I said: "O Prophet of Allah, what is the thing you fear most for me?" He said: So the Prophet of Allah ﷺ took hold of his own tongue, then said: "This."
20.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Ibrahim ibn Isma'il ibn Mujammi' se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Ibn Shihab ne bataya, Abd al-Rahman ibn Mu'adh se, Sufyan ibn Abdullah se: Unhone kaha, Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, mujhe koi aisi baat bataayein jispar main qaayam rahun." Aapne farmaya: "Kaho: Mera Rab Allah hai, fir sabit-qadam raho." Unhone bataya: Maine poocha: "Ya Nabi Allah, aapko mere baare mein sabse zyada dar kis cheez ka hai?" Unhone bataya: To Nabi Allah ﷺ ne apni zubaan pakdi, fir farmaya: "Yeh."

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ مِغْوَلٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ : قِيلَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَيُّ الْإِسْلَامِ أَفْضَلُ؟.
قَالَ :" مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ "
20.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Malik ibn Mighwal, from al-A'mash, from Abu Sufyan, from Jabir: He said: It was said: "O Messenger of Allah, which Islam is best?" He said: "He from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe."
20.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Malik ibn Mighwal se, al-A'mash se, Abu Sufyan se, Jabir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah, kaunsa Islam sabse behtar hai?" Aapne farmaya: "Jiski zubaan aur haath se Musalman mehfooz rahein."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ عِيسَى  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ صَمَتَ، نَجَا "
20.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Isa, from Abdullah ibn Uqbah, from Yazid ibn Amr, from Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Hubuli, from Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever remains silent, is saved."
20.hi: Ishaq ibn Isa ne Abdullah ibn Uqbah se, Yazid ibn Amr se, Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Hubuli se, Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo khamosh raha, woh bach gaya."

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ قِيلَ لَهُ : مَا الْغِيبَةُ؟.
قَالَ : " ذِكْرُكَ أَخَاكَ بِمَا يَكْرَهُ ".
قِيلَ : وَإِنْ كَانَ فِي أَخِي مَا أَقُولُ؟.
قَالَ :" فَإِنْ كَانَ فِيهِ، فَقَدْ اغْتَبْتَهُ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ، فَقَدْ بَهَتَّهُ "
20.en: Narrated by Nu'aym ibn Hammad, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from al-Ala, from his father, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: That he was asked: What is backbiting? He said: "Your mentioning of your brother in a way he dislikes." It was said: "And what if what I say is [true] in my brother?" He said: "If it is in him, then you have indeed backbitten him, and if it is not in him, then you have indeed slandered him."
20.hi: Nu'aym ibn Hammad ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, al-Ala se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: ke aapse poocha gaya: Ghibat kya hai? Aapne farmaya: "Apne bhai ka zikr aise andaaz mein karna jo usay na-pasand ho." Poocha gaya: "Aur agar mera kaha hua mere bhai mein sach ho to?" Aapne farmaya: "Agar woh usmein hai, to tumne uski ghibat ki, aur agar woh usmein nahi hai, to tumne uspar tuhmat lagaayi."

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ  ، عَنْ إِدْرِيسَ الْأَوْدِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ  : أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ   يَرْفَعُ الْحَدِيثَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" إِنَّ شَرَّ الرَّوَايَا رَوَايَا الْكَذِبِ، وَلَا يَصْلُحُ مِنْ الْكَذِبِ جِدٌّ وَلَا هَزْلٌ.
وَلَا يَعِدُ الرَّجُلُ ابْنَهُ ثُمَّ لَا يُنْجِزُ لَهُ : إِنَّ الصِّدْقَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْبِرِّ، وَإِنَّ الْبِرَّ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ، وَإِنَّ الْكَذِبَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْفُجُورِ، وَإِنَّ الْفُجُورَ يَهْدِي إِلَى النَّارِ، وَإِنَّهُ يُقَالُ لِلصَّادِقِ : صَدَقَ وَبَرَّ، وَيُقَالُ لِلْكَاذِبِ : كَذَبَ وَفَجَرَ.
وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَصْدُقُ حَتَّى يُكْتَبَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ صِدِّيقًا، وَيَكْذِبُ حَتَّى يُكْتَبَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ كَذَّابًا ".
وَإِنَّهُ قَالَ : " لَنَا هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ مَا الْعَضْهُ؟ وَإِنَّ الْعَضْهَ : هِيَ النَّمِيمَةُ الَّتِي تُفْسِدُ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ "
20.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Jarir, from Idris al-Awdi, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu al-Ahwas, about Abdullah: That Abdullah raised the hadith to the Prophet ﷺ, he said: "Indeed the worst of narrations are false narrations, and lying is never proper, neither serious nor in jest. And a man should not promise his son something then not fulfill it for him: indeed truthfulness leads to righteousness, and indeed righteousness leads to Paradise, and indeed lying leads to wickedness, and indeed wickedness leads to the Fire, and indeed it is said of the truthful one: he spoke the truth and was righteous, and it is said of the liar: he lied and was wicked. And indeed a man continues to be truthful until he is written with Allah as extremely truthful, and continues to lie until he is written with Allah as a great liar." And he said: "Shall I not inform you of al-'adh [malicious slander]? Indeed al-'adh: it is the malicious talebearing that corrupts relations between people."
20.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Jarir se, Idris al-Awdi se, Abu Ishaq se, Abu al-Ahwas se bataya ke Abdullah ne hadith ko Nabi ﷺ tak marfu'an pahunchaya, unhone kaha: "Sabse buri riwaayat jhooti riwaayat hoti hai, aur jhoot na sanjeedgi mein theek hai na mazaak mein. Aur aadmi apne bete se koi wada na kare fir usay poora na kare: sachaai neki ki taraf le jaati hai, aur neki Jannat ki taraf le jaati hai, aur jhoot fisq ki taraf le jaata hai, aur fisq Jahannam ki taraf le jaata hai, aur sachche ke baare mein kaha jaata hai: usne sach kaha aur neik raha, aur jhoote ke baare mein kaha jaata hai: usne jhoot kaha aur fasiq hua. Aur aadmi sach bolta rehta hai yahan tak ke Allah ke paas usay 'siddeeq' likh diya jaata hai, aur jhoot bolta rehta hai yahan tak ke Allah ke paas usay bada jhoota likh diya jaata hai." Aur aapne farmaya: "Kya main tumhein 'al-adh' na bataun? Sun lo, 'al-adh' woh chughli hai jo logon ke darmiyan fasaad daalti hai."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو  ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ "
20.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zakariya, from al-Sha'bi: He said: I heard Abdullah ibn Amr say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The Muslim is he from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe."
20.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zakariya se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abdullah ibn Amr ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Musalman woh hai jiski zubaan aur haath se Musalman mehfooz rahein."

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفُضَيْلُ بْنُ مَرْزُوقٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَدِيُّ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ،إِنَّ اللَّهَ طَيِّبٌ لَا يَقْبَلُ إِلَّا الطَّيِّبَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَمَرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِمَا أَمَرَ بِهِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ، قَالَ : # يَأَيُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلُوا مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَاعْمَلُوا صَالِحًا إِنِّي بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ سورة المؤمنون آية 51 #، وَقَالَ : # يَأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُلُوا مِنْ طَيِّبَاتِ مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِلَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ سورة البقرة آية 172 #.
قَالَ : ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ الرَّجُلَ يُطِيلُ السَّفَرَ أَشْعَثَ أَغْبَرَ يَمُدُّ يَدَيْهِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ : يَا رَبِّ ! يَا رَبِّ ! وَمَطْعَمُهُ حَرَامٌ، وَمَلْبَسُهُ حَرَامٌ، وَمَشْرَبُهُ حَرَامٌ، وَغُذِّيَ بِالْحَرَامِ، فَأَنَّى يُسْتَجَابُ لِذَلِكَ؟ "
20.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from al-Fudayl ibn Marzuq, from Adi ibn Thabit, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O people, indeed Allah is good, He accepts only what is good. Indeed Allah commanded the believers with what He commanded the messengers, He said: 'O messengers, eat of the good things and act righteously, indeed I am aware of what you do' [Surah al-Mu'minun, verse 51], and He said: 'O you who believe, eat of the good things We have provided you, and be grateful to Allah, if it is Him that you worship' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 172]." He said: Then he mentioned the man who extends his journey, disheveled, dusty, raising his hands to the sky: "O Lord! O Lord!" while his food is unlawful, and his clothing is unlawful, and his drink is unlawful, and he was nourished with the unlawful, so how then could he be answered?
20.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne al-Fudayl ibn Marzuq se, Adi ibn Thabit se, Abu Hazim se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Ae logo, Allah paak hai, woh sirf paak cheez qabool karta hai. Allah ne momino ko wahi hukum diya hai jo usne rasoolon ko diya, usne farmaya: 'Ae rasoolon, paak cheezein khaao aur neik amal karo, main jo tum karte ho usse waaqif hoon' [Surah Al-Mu'minun, aayat 51], aur farmaya: 'Ae imaan walo, humne jo paak rizq tumhein diya hai usmein se khaao, aur Allah ka shukar karo, agar tum sirf usi ki ibaadat karte ho' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 172]." Unhone bataya: Fir aapne us aadmi ka zikr kiya jo lamba safar karta hai, bikhre baalon wala, gard-o-ghubaar mein sana hua, apne dono haath aasmaan ki taraf uthaata hai: "Ae Rab! Ae Rab!" jabke uska khaana haraam hai, aur uska pehnna haraam hai, aur uska peena haraam hai, aur usay haraam se parwarish diya gaya, to yeh kaise qabool kiya jaayega?

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَوَلَةَ  ، عَنْ بُرَيْدَةَ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" يَكْفِي أَحَدَكُمْ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا خَادِمٌ وَمَرْكَبٌ "
20.en: Narrated by Affan, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from al-Jurayri, from Abu Nadrah, from Abdullah ibn Mawlah, from Buraydah al-Aslami: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A servant and a mount suffice one of you from this world."
20.hi: Affan ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, al-Jurayri se, Abu Nadrah se, Abdullah ibn Mawlah se, Buraydah al-Aslami se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tum mein se kisi ke liye duniya se ek khidmatgar aur ek sawaari kaafi hai."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ بَيَانٍ هُوَ : ابْنُ بِشْرٍ الْأَحْمَسِيُّ  ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ مِرْدَاسٍ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" يَذْهَبُ الصَّالِحُونَ أَسْلَافًا وَيَبْقَى حُثَالَةٌ كَحُثَالَةِ الشَّعِيرِ "
20.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Mansur, from Abu Awanah, from Bayan ibn Bishr al-Ahmasi, from Qays, from Mirdas al-Aslami: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The righteous ones will pass away, one after another, and the dregs [of society] will remain, like the dregs of barley."
20.hi: Sa'id ibn Mansur ne Abu Awanah se, Bayan ibn Bishr al-Ahmasi se, Qays se, Mirdas al-Aslami se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Neik log ek-ek karke jaate rahenge, aur kachra reh jaayega, jau ke kachre ki tarah."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ عِيسَى  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" كَمْ مِنْ صَائِمٍ لَيْسَ لَهُ مِنْ صِيَامِهِ إِلَّا الظَّمَأُ، وَكَمْ مِنْ قَائِمٍ لَيْسَ لَهُ مِنْ قِيَامِهِ إِلَّا السَّهَرُ "
20.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Isa, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi al-Zinad, from Amr ibn Abi Amr, from Sa'id al-Maqburi, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "How many a fasting person has nothing from his fast except thirst, and how many a night-worshipper has nothing from his standing except sleeplessness."
20.hi: Ishaq ibn Isa ne Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi al-Zinad se, Amr ibn Abi Amr se, Sa'id al-Maqburi se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Kitne hi roze wale hain jinke roze mein pyaas ke siwa kuch nahi, aur kitne hi raat ko khade rehne wale hain jinke qayam mein bedaari ke siwa kuch nahi."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ هُوَ : ابْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي كَعْبُ بْنُ عَلْقَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ هِلَالٍ الصَّدَفِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ ذَكَرَ الصَّلَاةَ يَوْمًا، فَقَالَ :" مَنْ حَافَظَ عَلَيْهَا، كَانَتْ لَهُ نُورًا، وَبُرْهَانًا، وَنَجَاةً مِنَ النَّارِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يُحَافِظْ عَلَيْهَا، لَمْ تَكُنْ لَهُ نُورًا، وَلَا نَجَاةً، وَلَا بُرْهَانًا، وَكَانَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَعَ قَارُونَ، وَفِرْعَوْنَ، وَهَامَانَ، أُبَيِّ بْنِ خَلَفٍ "
20.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub, from Ka'b ibn Alqamah, from Isa ibn Hilal al-Sadafi, from Abdullah ibn Amr, from the Prophet ﷺ: That he mentioned prayer one day, and said: "Whoever guards it, it will be light, and proof, and salvation from the Fire for him on the Day of Resurrection, and whoever does not guard it, it will not be light, nor salvation, nor proof for him, and he will be on the Day of Resurrection with Qarun, and Fir'awn, and Haman, and Ubayy ibn Khalaf."
20.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid ne Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub se bataya: Mujhse Ka'b ibn Alqamah ne bataya, Isa ibn Hilal al-Sadafi se, Abdullah ibn Amr se, Nabi ﷺ se: ke aapne ek din namaz ka zikr kiya, aur farmaya, "Jo isse hifaazat rakhe, uske liye yeh Qayamat ke din noor, aur daleel, aur Jahannam se nijaat hogi, aur jo isse hifaazat na rakhe, uske liye yeh na noor hogi, na nijaat, na daleel, aur woh Qayamat ke din Qarun, aur Fir'awn, aur Haman, aur Ubayy ibn Khalaf ke saath hoga."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ عَجْلَانَ  ، عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ،  عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَيَرْغَبُ فِي قِيَامِ اللَّيْلِ حَتَّى قَالَ : " وَلَوْ رَكْعَةً "
20.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Ibn Ajlan, from Husayn ibn Abdullah ibn Ubaydullah ibn Abbas, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to encourage standing in prayer at night, until he said: "Even if it is [only] one rak'ah."
20.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhse Ibn Ajlan ne bataya, Husayn ibn Abdullah ibn Ubaydullah ibn Abbas se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ raat mein khade hokar namaz padhne ki ragheb dilaate the yahan tak ke farmaya: "Chahe ek hi rakat ho."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو أَبِي الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ فِي لِسَانِي ذَرَبٌ عَلَى أَهْلِي، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ يَعْدُهُمْ إِلَى غَيْرِهِمْ، فَسَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ :" أَيْنَ أَنْتَ مِنَ الِاسْتِغْفَارِ؟ إِنِّي لَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ "
20.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Isra'il, from Abu Ishaq, from Ubayd ibn Amr Abu al-Mughirah, from Hudhayfah: He said: There was sharpness in my tongue toward my family, and it did not go beyond them to others, so I asked the Prophet ﷺ, so he said: "Where are you regarding seeking forgiveness? I indeed seek Allah's forgiveness a hundred times every day."
20.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Isra'il se bataya: Humein Abu Ishaq ne bataya, Ubayd ibn Amr Abu al-Mughirah se, Hudhayfah se: Unhone kaha, Meri zubaan mein mere gharwalon ke saath sakhti thi, aur yeh unse aage doosron tak nahi jaati thi, to maine Nabi ﷺ se poocha, to aapne farmaya: "Tum istighfaar se kahan ho? Main Allah se har din sau martaba maghfirat maangta hoon."

20.ar: قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاق  : فَحَدَّثْتُ أَبَا بُرْدَةَ  ، وَأَبَا بَكْرٍ   ابْنَيْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَا : قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ "
20.en: Continuing from Abu Ishaq: to Abu Burdah and Abu Bakr, sons of Abu Musa: Abu Ishaq said: So I narrated it to Abu Burdah, and Abu Bakr, sons of Abu Musa, and they said: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Astaghfirullaha kulla yawmin mi'ata marratin, astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh" [I seek Allah's forgiveness a hundred times every day, I seek Allah's forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance].
20.hi: Abu Ishaq kehte hain: To maine yeh hadith Abu Burdah, aur Abu Bakr, jo Abu Musa ke bete hain, ko bataayi, to unhone kaha: Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, "Astaghfirullaha kulla yawmin mi'ata marratin, astaghfirullaha wa atoobu ilayh" [Main har din sau martaba Allah se maghfirat maangta hoon, main Allah se maghfirat maangta hoon aur uski taraf tauba karta hoon].

20.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، عَنْ سَلْمِ بْنِ قُتَيْبَةَ  ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ الْقُطَعِيِّ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ قَرَأَ : # هُوَ أَهْلُ التَّقْوَى وَأَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ سورة المدثر آية 56 #.
 قَالَ : " قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ :أَنَا أَهْلٌ أَنْ أُتَّقَى، فَمَنْ اتَّقَانِي فَأَنَا أَهْلٌ أَنْ أَغْفِرَ لَهُ "
20.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Salm ibn Qutaybah, from Suhayl al-Qutu'i, from Thabit, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ: That he recited: "He is worthy to be feared and He is worthy to forgive" [Surah al-Muddaththir, verse 56]. He said: "Your Lord said: I am worthy to be feared, so whoever fears Me, I am worthy to forgive him."
20.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Salm ibn Qutaybah se, Suhayl al-Qutu'i se, Thabit se, Anas se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya ke aapne padha: "Woh hi hai jo taqwa ke laayeq hai aur maghfirat ke laayeq hai" [Surah Al-Muddaththir, aayat 56]. Aapne farmaya: "Tumhare Rab ne farmaya: Main is laayeq hoon ke mujhse dara jaaye, so jo mujhse dare, main us laayeq hoon ke usay bakhsh dun."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ  ، عَنْ كَهْمَسِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي السَّلِيلِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنِّي لَأَعْلَمُ آيَةً لَوْ أَخَذَ بِهَا النَّاسُ بِهَا لَكَفَتْهُمْ : # فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَأَشْهِدُوا ذَوَيْ عَدْلٍ مِنْكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا الشَّهَادَةَ لِلَّهِ ذَلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِ مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَهُ مَخْرَجًا سورة الطلاق آية 2 # "
20.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Mu'tamir, from Kahmas ibn al-Hasan, from Abu al-Salil, from Abu Dharr: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I indeed know a verse which, if people took hold of it, would suffice them: 'So when they reach their term, retain them in a fair manner, or part with them in a fair manner, and take as witnesses two just persons among you, and establish testimony for Allah, that is by which is admonished whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, and whoever fears Allah, He will make for him a way out' [Surah al-Talaq, verse 2]."
20.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Mu'tamir se, Kahmas ibn al-Hasan se, Abu al-Salil se, Abu Dharr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Main ek aisi aayat jaanta hoon ke agar log usay pakad lein to unhein kaafi ho jaaye: 'Fir jab woh apni muddat ko pahunch jaayein, to unhein achhe tareeke se rakho ya achhe tareeke se alag ho jaao, aur apne mein se do adal wale gawah bana lo, aur Allah ke liye gawahi qaayam karo, isi se woh naseehat kiya jaata hai jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhta ho, aur jo Allah se dare, Allah uske liye [mushkil se] nikalne ki koi raah bana deta hai' [Surah At-Talaq, aayat 2]."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ هُوَ : ابْنُ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ بَانَكَ  ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ  ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ عَوْفِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ  ،  عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " يَا عَائِشُ،إِيَّاكِ وَمُحَقَّرَاتِ الذُّنُوبِ، فَإِنَّ لَهَا مِنَ اللَّهِ طَالِبًا "
20.en: Narrated by Mansur ibn Salamah, from Sa'id ibn Muslim ibn Banak, from Malik, from Amir ibn Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr, from Awf ibn al-Harith, from Aisha: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: "O Aisha, beware of trivial-seeming sins, for indeed they have a seeker from Allah."
20.hi: Mansur ibn Salamah ne Sa'id ibn Muslim ibn Banak se, Malik se, Amir ibn Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr se, Awf ibn al-Harith se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhse farmaya, "Ae Aisha, chhote samjhe jaane wale gunahon se bacho, kyunki unka bhi Allah ki taraf se ek talaash karne wala hai."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ الْبَاهِلِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" كُلُّ بَنِي آدَمَ خَطَّاءٌ، وَخَيْرُ الْخَطَّائِينَ التَّوَّابُونَ "
20.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Ali ibn Mas'adah al-Bahili, from Qatadah, from Anas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Every son of Adam is a sinner, and the best of sinners are those who repent often."
20.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Ali ibn Mas'adah al-Bahili se, Qatadah se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Aadam ki har aulaad khatakaar hai, aur khatakaaron mein sabse behtar woh hain jo baar-baar tauba karte hain."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ  ،  عَنْ النُّعْمَانِ هُوَ : ابْنُ بَشِيرٍ   أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" سَافَرَ رَجُلٌ فِي أَرْضٍ تَنُوفَةٍ فَقَالَ : تَحْتَ شَجَرَةٍ وَمَعَهُ رَاحِلَتُهُ، وعَلَيْهَا زَادُهُ وَطَعَامُهُ، فَاسْتَيْقَظَ وَقَدْ ذَهَبَتْ رَاحِلَتُهُ، فَعَلَا شَرَفًا، فَلَمْ يَرَ شَيْئًا، ثُمَّ عَلَا شَرَفًا، فَلَمْ يَرَ شَيْئًا، ثُمَّ عَلَا شَرَفًا فَلَمْ يَرَ شَيْئًا، قَالَ : فَالْتَفَتَ فَإِذَا هُوَ بِهَا تَجُرُّ خِطَامَهَا، فَمَا هُوَ بِأَشَدَّ فَرَحًا بِهَا مِنَ اللَّهِ بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ إِذَا تَابَ إِلَيْهِ "
20.en: Narrated by al-Nadr ibn Shumayl, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Simak ibn Harb, from al-Nu'man ibn Bashir, who heard him say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A man traveled in a desolate land, and he said [i.e. stopped] under a tree with his mount, upon which was his provision and his food, so he woke up and his mount had gone, so he climbed a hill, and did not see anything, then he climbed another hill, and did not see anything, then he climbed another hill, and did not see anything." He said: "So he turned around, and there it was, dragging its halter, so [Allah] is not more joyful with it than Allah is with the repentance of His servant when he turns to Him in repentance."
20.hi: Al-Nadr ibn Shumayl ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Simak ibn Harb se bataya: Unhone al-Nu'man ibn Bashir ko yeh kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Ek aadmi ne veeraan zameen mein safar kiya, to usne ek darakht ke neeche pdaao kiya apni sawaari ke saath, jispar uska zaad-e-raah aur khaana tha, to woh jaaga to uski sawaari chali gayi thi, to woh ek pahaad par chadha, kuch na dekha, fir doosre pahaad par chadha, kuch na dekha, fir teesre pahaad par chadha, kuch na dekha." Aapne farmaya: "To woh muda, to woh apni nakel ghaseette hui wahi thi, so Allah apne bande ki tauba se, jab woh uski taraf tauba karta hai, isse zyada khush hota hai jitna woh [aadmi apni sawaari se] hua."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي يَعْلَى  ، عَنْ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : خَطَّ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَطًّا مُرَبَّعًا، ثُمَّ خَطَّ وَسَطَهُ خَطًّا، ثُمَّ خَطَّ حَوْلَهُ خُطُوطًا، وَخَطَّ خَطًّا خَارِجًا مِنَ الْخَطِّ، فَقَالَ :" هَذَا الْإِنْسَانُ لِلْخَطِّ الْأَوْسَطِ وَهَذَا الْأَجَلُ مُحِيطٌ بِهِ، وَهَذِهِ الْأَعْرَاضُ لِلْخُطُوطِ فَإِذَا أَخْطَأَهُ وَاحِدٌ نَهَشَهُ الْآخَرُ، وَهَذَا الْأَمَلُ لِلْخَطِّ الْخَارِجِ "
20.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Yahya, from Sufyan, from his father, from Abu Ya'la, from al-Rabi' ibn Khuthaym, from Abdullah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ drew a square line for us, then drew a line in its middle, then drew lines around it, and drew a line outside the [main] line, and said: "This is man, and this middle line, and this term surrounding him, and these lines are misfortunes, so if one misses him, another catches him, and this is [his] hope, [represented] by the outside line."
20.hi: Musaddad ne Yahya se, Sufyan se, apne walid se, Abu Ya'la se, al-Rabi' ibn Khuthaym se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne humare liye ek chaukor lakeer khaincha, fir uske beech mein ek lakeer khainchi, fir uske gird kuch lakeerein khaincheen, aur us [beech ki] lakeer se bahar ek lakeer khaincha, aur farmaya: "Yeh insaan hai, yeh darmiyani lakeer, aur yeh muddat isay ghere hue hai, aur yeh lakeerein museebatein hain, so agar ek usse chook jaaye, to doosri usay pakad leti hai, aur yeh ummeed hai, [jo] bahar wali lakeer [se zaahir hoti hai]."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، عَنْ زَكَرِيَّا  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَا ذِئْبَانِ جَائِعَانِ أُرْسِلَا فِي غَنَمٍ بِأَفْسَدَ لَهَا مِنْ حِرْصِ الْمَرْءِ عَلَى الْمَالِ وَالشَّرَفِ لِدِينِهِ "
20.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Abdullah ibn al-Mubarak, from Zakariya, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Sa'd ibn Zurarah, from the son of Ka'b ibn Malik, from his father: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Two hungry wolves sent loose among sheep are not more destructive to it than a man's greed for wealth and status for his religion."
20.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Abdullah ibn al-Mubarak se, Zakariya se, Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Sa'd ibn Zurarah se, Ka'b ibn Malik ke bete se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Do bhookhe bhediye bhedon mein chhod diye jaayein to woh unhein utna barbaad nahi karte jitna aadmi ka apne deen ke haq mein maal aur martabe ka lalach usay barbaad karta hai."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ الْغَازِ  ، عَنْ حَيَّانَ أَبِي النَّضْرِ  ، عَنْ وَاثِلَةَ بْنِ الْأَسْقَعِ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : " قَالَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى :أَنَا عِنْدَ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي، فَلْيَظُنَّ بِي مَا شَاءَ "
20.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Abdullah ibn al-Mubarak, from Hisham ibn al-Ghaz, from Hayyan Abu al-Nadr, from Wathilah ibn al-Asqa, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Allah, blessed and exalted is He, said: 'I am as My servant thinks of Me, so let him think of Me whatever he wishes.'"
20.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Abdullah ibn al-Mubarak se, Hisham ibn al-Ghaz se, Hayyan Abu al-Nadr se, Wathilah ibn al-Asqa se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Allah, Tabaraka wa Ta'ala, ne farmaya: 'Main apne bande ke gumaan ke mutaabiq hoon, so woh mere baare mein jo chahe gumaan kare.'"

20.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حِينَ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى # وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الأَقْرَبِينَ سورة الشعراء آية 214 #، فَقَالَ :" يَا مَعْشَرَ قُرَيْشٍ، اشْتَرُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ، لَا أُغْنِي عَنْكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا، يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ مَنَافٍ، لَا أُغْنِي عَنْكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا.
يَا عَبَّاسُ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْمُطَلِّبِ، لَا أُغْنِي عَنْكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا، يَا صَفِيَّةُ عَمَّةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ لَا أُغْنِي عَنْكِ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا، يَا فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتَ مُحَمَّدٍ ، سَلِينِي مَا شِئْتِ، لَا أُغْنِي عَنْكِ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا "
20.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, and Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Prophet ﷺ stood up when Allah, exalted is He, revealed: "And warn your nearest kinsfolk" [Surah al-Shu'ara, verse 214], and said: "O assembly of Quraysh, buy yourselves free from Allah, I cannot avail you anything against Allah, O Banu Abd Manaf, I cannot avail you anything against Allah. O Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib, I cannot avail you anything against Allah, O Safiyyah, aunt of the Messenger of Allah, I cannot avail you anything against Allah, O Fatimah, daughter of Muhammad, ask of me whatever you wish, I cannot avail you anything against Allah."
20.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Mujhe Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, aur Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman ne bataya, ke Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Nabi ﷺ khade hue jab Allah Ta'ala ne naazil kiya: "Aur apne qareebi rishtedaron ko daraao" [Surah Ash-Shu'ara, aayat 214], aur farmaya: "Ae Quraysh ki jama'at, apne aap ko Allah se khareed lo, main tumhein Allah ke muqaable mein kuch faida nahi pahuncha sakta, Ae Banu Abd Manaf, main tumhein Allah ke muqaable mein kuch faida nahi pahuncha sakta. Ae Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib, main tumhein Allah ke muqaable mein kuch faida nahi pahuncha sakta, Ae Safiyyah, Rasulullah ki phuphi, main tumhein Allah ke muqaable mein kuch faida nahi pahuncha sakti, Ae Fatimah (Alayhas Salam), Muhammad ki beti, mujhse jo chaho maango, main tumhein Allah ke muqaable mein kuch faida nahi pahuncha sakta."

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" قَارِبُوا وَسَدِّدُوا، وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ أَحَدًا مِنْكُمْ لَنْ يُنْجِيَهُ عَمَلُهُ ".
قَالُوا : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، وَلَا أَنْتَ.
قَالَ : " وَلَا أَنَا إِلَّا أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِيَ اللَّهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنْهُ وَفَضْلٍ "
20.en: Narrated by al-Hasan ibn al-Rabi', from Abu al-Ahwas, from al-A'mash, from Abu Sufyan, from Jabir: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Come close [to perfection] and be precise, and know that none of you will be saved by his deed [alone]." They said: "O Messenger of Allah, not even you?" He said: "Not even me, unless Allah envelops me with mercy and grace from Himself."
20.hi: Al-Hasan ibn al-Rabi' ne Abu al-Ahwas se, al-A'mash se, Abu Sufyan se, Jabir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Qareeb raho aur durusti se karo, aur jaan lo ke tum mein se koi bhi apne amal se najaat nahi paayega." Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, kya aap bhi nahi?" Aapne farmaya: "Main bhi nahi, siwaay iske ke Allah mujhe apni rehmat aur fazl se dhaank le."

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا وَمَعَهُ قَرِينُهُ مِنَ الْجِنِّ، وَقَرِينُهُ مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ ".
قَالُوا : وَإِيَّاكَ؟.
قَالَ : " نَعَمْ وَإِيَّايَ، وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ أَعَانَنِي عَلَيْهِ فَأَسْلَمَ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : مِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَقُولُ : أَسْلَمَ : اسْتَسْلَمَ.
يَقُولُ : ذَلَّ
20.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd, from his father, from Abdullah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There is none of you except that with him is his companion from the jinn, and his companion from the angels." They said: "And you too?" He said: "Yes, me too, but Allah helped me against him, so he submitted [became Muslim]." Abu Muhammad said: Some people say: aslama means: he submitted [istaslama], meaning: he became humbled.
20.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Mansur se, Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd se, apne walid se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tum mein se koi bhi aisa nahi jiske saath uska ek saathi jinnaat mein se aur ek saathi farishton mein se na ho." Sahaba ne poocha: "Aur aapke saath bhi?" Aapne farmaya: "Haan, mere saath bhi, lekin Allah ne uske khilaaf meri madad ki to woh musalman ho gaya." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Kuch log kehte hain: 'Aslama' ka matlab hai: usne itaa'at qabool kar li, yaani: woh zaleel ho gaya.

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ مَا أَعْلَمُ، لَضَحِكْتُمْ قَلِيلًا، وَلَبَكَيْتُمْ كَثِيرًا "، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِمِثْلِ هَذَا
20.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Musa ibn Anas, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ; also narrated by Affan, from Hammam, from Qatadah, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "If you knew what I know, you would laugh little, and weep much."
20.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se, Musa ibn Anas se, Anas se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Agar tumhein wahi maloom ho jaata jo mujhe maloom hai, to tum kam hansde, aur zyada rote." Humein Affan ne bhi bataya: Humein Hammam ne bataya, Qatadah se, Anas se, Nabi ﷺ se, isi jaisi.

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَزِّمِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   : أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَرَّ بِسَخْلَةٍ جَرْبَاءَ قَدْ أَخْرَجَهَا أَهْلُهَا.
قَالَ : " تُرَوْنَ هَذِهِ هَيِّنَةً عَلَى أَهْلِهَا؟ ".
قَالُوا : نَعَمْ.
قَالَ :" وَاللَّهِ لَلدُّنْيَا أَهْوَنُ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ عَلَى أَهْلِهَا "
20.en: Narrated by Hajjaj, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Abu al-Muhazzim, from Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet ﷺ passed by a mangy young goat which its owners had thrown out. He said: "Do you see this as worthless to its owners?" They said, "Yes." He said: "By Allah, the world is more worthless to Allah than this is to its owners."
20.hi: Hajjaj ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Abu al-Muhazzim se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ek khaarish-zada bakri ke bachche ke paas se guzre jise uske maalikon ne phenk diya tha. Aapne poocha: "Kya tumhein yeh apne maalikon ki nazar mein bekaar lagta hai?" Unhone kaha, "Haan." Aapne farmaya: "Allah ki qasam, duniya Allah ke nazdeek isse zyada bekaar hai jitna yeh apne maalikon ke nazdeek hai."

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُرَاوِحِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : أَيُّ الْأَعْمَالِ أَفْضَلُ؟.
قَالَ :" إِيمَانٌ بِاللَّهِ، وَجِهَادٌ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ "
20.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Abu al-Murawwih, from Abu Dharr: He said: A man asked the Prophet ﷺ, and said: Which deeds are best? He said: "Belief in Allah, and jihad in the path of Allah."
20.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Hisham ibn Urwah se, apne walid se, Abu al-Murawwih se, Abu Dharr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi ne Nabi ﷺ se poocha, aur kaha: Kaunsa amal sabse behtar hai? Aapne farmaya: "Allah par imaan, aur Allah ki raah mein jihad."

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ  : أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَفْضَلُ الْأَعْمَالِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ إِيمَانٌ لَا شَكَّ فِيهِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ : رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ
20.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hisham, from Yahya, from Abu Ja'far, who heard Abu Hurairah; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The best deed with Allah is belief in which there is no doubt." Abu Muhammad said: Abu Ja'far: a man from the Ansar.
20.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hisham se, Yahya se bataya: ke Abu Ja'far ne Abu Hurairah ko yeh kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah ke nazdeek sabse behtar amal woh imaan hai jismein koi shak na ho." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Abu Ja'far: Ansar ke ek aadmi hain.

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ،  عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ "
20.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from Anas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself."
20.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Shu'bah se, Qatadah se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tum mein se koi haqeeqi momin nahi hota jab tak woh apne bhai ke liye wahi pasand na kare jo woh apne liye pasand karta hai."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، وَهَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى أَكُونَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ وَالِدِهِ، وَوَلَدِهِ، وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ "
20.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, and Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "None of you truly believes until I am more beloved to him than his father, and his child, and all the people."
20.hi: Yazid ibn Harun aur Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se, Qatadah se, Anas se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Tum mein se koi haqeeqi momin nahi hota jab tak main usay apne baap, apni aulaad, aur tamaam logon se zyada aziz na hoon."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُدْعَانَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ   : أَنَّ رَجُلًا، قَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَيُّ النَّاسِ خَيْرٌ؟، قَالَ :" مَنْ طَالَ عُمُرُهُ، وَحَسُنَ عَمَلُهُ "، قَالَ : فَأَيُّ النَّاسِ شَرٌّ؟، قَالَ : " مَنْ طَالَ عُمُرُهُ، وَسَاءَ عَمَلُهُ "، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدٍ   بِإِسْنَادِهِ، مِثْلَهُ
20.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zuhayr, from Ali ibn Zayd ibn Jud'an, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakrah, from Abu Bakrah; a similar chain also via Hajjaj: That a man said: "O Messenger of Allah, which of the people is best?" He said: "Whoever has a long life, and good deeds." He said: "Then which of the people is worst?" He said: "Whoever has a long life, and bad deeds." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Hajjaj, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ali ibn Zayd, with his chain, the same.]
20.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zuhayr se, Ali ibn Zayd ibn Jud'an se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakrah se, Abu Bakrah se bataya: ke ek aadmi ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, log mein sabse behtar kaun hai?" Aapne farmaya: "Jiski umar lambi ho, aur jiske amal achhe hon." Usne poocha: "To log mein sabse bura kaun hai?" Aapne farmaya: "Jiski umar lambi ho, aur jiske amal bure hon." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Hajjaj se, Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ali ibn Zayd se, unki sanad ke saath bhi aayi hai.]

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَسِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ دُرَيْكٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ مُحَيْرِيزٍ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جُمُعَةَ   رَجُلٍ مِنَ الصَّحَابَةِ حَدِّثْنَا : حَدِيثًا سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : نَعَمْ أُحَدِّثُكَ حَدِيثًا جَيِّدًا : تَغَدَّيْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَمَعَنَا أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَحَدٌ خَيْرٌ مِنَّا؟ أَسْلَمْنَا وَجَاهَدْنَا مَعَكَ؟، قَالَ : " نَعَمْ،قَوْمٌ يَكُونُونَ مِنْ بَعْدِكُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِي وَلَمْ يَرَوْنِي "
20.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from Asid ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Khalid ibn Durayk, from Ibn Muhayriz: He said: I said to Abu Jum'ah, a man from the Companions: "Narrate to us a hadith you heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." He said: "Yes, I will narrate to you a fine hadith: We had lunch with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah was with us, so he said: 'O Messenger of Allah, is anyone better than us? We accepted Islam and did jihad with you?' He said: 'Yes, a people who will come after you, believing in me without having seen me.'"
20.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Humein al-Awza'i ne bataya: Humein Asid ibn Abd al-Rahman ne bataya, Khalid ibn Durayk se, Ibn Muhayriz se: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Jum'ah se kaha, jo sahaba mein se ek aadmi the: "Humein koi hadith bataayein jo aapne Rasulullah ﷺ se suni ho." Unhone kaha: "Haan, main tumhein ek behtareen hadith bataata hoon: Humne Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath khaana khaya, aur Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah bhi humare saath the, to unhone poocha: 'Ya Rasulullah, kya koi humse behtar hai? Humne Islam qabool kiya aur aapke saath jihad kiya?' Aapne farmaya: 'Haan, woh log jo tumhare baad aayenge, mujhpar bina dekhe imaan laayenge.'"

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ  ،  عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" بِئْسَمَا لِأَحَدِكُمْ أَنْ يَقُولَ : نَسِيتُ آيَةَ كَيْتَ وَكَيْتَ، بَلْ هُوَ نُسِّيَ، فَاسْتَذْكِرُوا الْقُرْآنَ، فَإِنَّهُ أَسْرَعُ تَفَصِّيًا مِنْ صُدُورِ الرِّجَالِ مِنَ النَّعَمِ مِنْ عُقُلِهَا "
20.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Shu'bah, from Mansur, from Abu Wa'il, from Abdullah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "How bad it is for one of you to say: I forgot such-and-such verse; rather, he was made to forget it, so keep reviewing the Qur'an, for indeed it slips away from the chests of men faster than a grazing animal slips its hobbles."
20.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Shu'bah se, Mansur se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Wa'il ko suna, Abdullah se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Yeh tum mein se kisi ke liye kitni buri baat hai ke woh kahe: main fulaan aayat bhool gaya, balke woh bhulaayi gayi, so Quran ko yaad rakho, kyunki yeh aadmiyon ke seenon se jaanwaron ke apne bandhan se nikal jaane se zyada tez nikal jaata hai."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعْيَمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا يَقُولَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ : أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ مَتَّى "
20.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from al-A'mash, from Abu Wa'il, from Abdullah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Let none of you say: I am better than Yunus ibn Matta."
20.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se, al-A'mash se, Abu Wa'il se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tum mein se koi yeh na kahe: Main Yunus ibn Matta se behtar hoon."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الْمَدَائِنِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" عَلَى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ صَدَقَةٌ "، قَالُوا : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَوْ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ؟، قَالَ : " يَعْتَمِلُ بِيَدَيْهِ فَيَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ وَيَتَصَدَّقُ "، قَالُوا : أَفَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ؟، قَالَ : " يُعِينُ ذَا الْحَاجَةِ الْمَلْهُوفَ "، قَالُوا : أَفَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ؟، قَالَ : " يَأْمُرُ بِالْخَيْرِ "، قَالُوا : أَفَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ؟، قَالَ : " يُمْسِكُ عَنِ الشَّرِّ، فَإِنَّهَا لَهُ صَدَقَةٌ "
20.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Mada'ini, from Shu'bah, from Sa'id ibn Abi Burdah, from his father, from Abu Musa al-Ash'ari: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Upon every Muslim is charity." They said: "O Messenger of Allah, but if he is unable, or does not do it?" He said: "He works with his hands, benefiting himself, and gives charity." They said: "What if he does not do that?" He said: "He helps the person of need, the distressed one." They said: "What if he does not do that?" He said: "He enjoins good." They said: "What if he does not do that?" He said: "He refrains from evil, for indeed that is charity for him."
