20.hi: Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Mada'ini ne Shu'bah se, Sa'id ibn Abi Burdah se, apne walid se, Abu Musa al-Ash'ari se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Har Musalman par sadqa hai." Sahaba ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, agar woh na kar sake ya na kare?" Aapne farmaya: "Woh apne haathon se kaam kare, taake usse khud khaaye aur sadqa bhi de." Unhone poocha: "Aur agar woh yeh bhi na kare?" Aapne farmaya: "Woh zaroormand, mushkil mein pade shakhs ki madad kare." Unhone poocha: "Aur agar woh yeh bhi na kare?" Aapne farmaya: "Woh bhalaai ka hukum de." Unhone poocha: "Aur agar woh yeh bhi na kare?" Aapne farmaya: "Woh burai se ruk jaaye, kyunki yeh bhi uske liye sadqa hai."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو صَخْرٍ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مَكْحُولًا  يَقُولُ : حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو هِنْدٍ الدَّارِيُّ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" مَنْ قَامَ مَقَامَ رِيَاءٍ وَسُمْعَةٍ، رَاءَى اللَّهُ بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَسَمَّعَ "
20.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Haywah, from Abu Sakhr, from Makhul, from Abu Hind al-Dari: That he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Whoever stands in a position [of prayer or good deed] out of showing off and to be heard of, Allah will expose him on the Day of Resurrection and make him heard of."
20.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid ne Haywah se bataya: Mujhse Abu Sakhr ne bataya, ke unhone Makhul ko yeh kehte suna: Mujhse Abu Hind al-Dari ne bataya, ke unhone Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Jo koi riya aur dikhaawe ke liye khada ho, Allah use Qayamat ke din zaahir karega aur ruswa karega."

20.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ مَثَلُ الْخَامَةِ مِنَ الزَّرْعِ تُفَيِّئُهَا الرِّيَاحُ : تُعَدِّلُهَا مَرَّةً، وَتُضْجِعُهَا أُخْرَى حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُ الْمَوْتَ.
وَمَثَلُ الْكَافِرِ كَمَثَلِ الْأَرْزَةِ الْمُجْذِيَةِ عَلَى أَصْلِهَا لَا يُصِيبُهَا شَيْءٌ حَتَّى يَكُونَ انْجِعَافُهَا مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً ".
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : الْخَامَةُ : الضَّعِيفُ
20.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Sa'd ibn Ibrahim, from Abdullah ibn Ka'b, from his father Ka'b ibn Malik; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The example of the believer is like a young tender plant amid the crops, which the winds bend: they straighten it at one time, and lay it low at another, until death comes to it. And the example of the disbeliever is like the towering cedar, firmly fixed on its root, nothing befalls it, until it is uprooted all at once." Abu Muhammad said: al-khamah is: the weak plant.
20.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Sa'd ibn Ibrahim se, Abdullah ibn Ka'b se, apne walid Ka'b ibn Malik se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Momin ki misaal fasal ke ek naazuk paudhe jaisi hai jise hawaayein mode deti hain: kabhi seedha karti hain, kabhi zameen se laga deti hain, yahan tak ke usay maut aa jaaye. Aur kaafir ki misaal us bulund devdar jaisi hai jo apni jad par mazbooti se jamma ho, usay kuch nahi hota, yahan tak ke woh ek hi baar mein ukhad jaaye." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: 'Al-Khamah' ka matlab hai: kamzor paudha.

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، وَعُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ  ، أَنَّ حَكِيمَ بْنَ حِزَامٍ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَأَعْطَانِي، ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُهُ فَأَعْطَانِي، ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُهُ فَأَعْطَانِي، ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُهُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " يَا حَكِيمُ،إِنَّ هَذَا الْمَالَ خَضِرٌ حُلْوٌ، فَمَنْ أَخَذَهُ بِسَخَاوَةِ نَفْسٍ، بُورِكَ لَهُ فِيهِ، وَمَنْ أَخَذَهُ بِإِشْرَافِ نَفْسٍ، لَمْ يُبَارَكْ لَهُ فِيهِ، وَكَانَ كَالَّذِي يَأْكُلُ وَلَا يَشْبَعُ، وَالْيَدُ الْعُلْيَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْيَدِ السُّفْلَى "
20.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from al-Awza'i, from Ibn Shihab, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, and Urwah ibn al-Zubayr, about Hakim ibn Hizam: That Hakim ibn Hizam said: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he gave me, then I asked him and he gave me, then I asked him and he gave me, then I asked him, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O Hakim, indeed this wealth is green and sweet, so whoever takes it with a generous soul, it is blessed for him therein, and whoever takes it with a covetous soul, it is not blessed for him therein, and he is like one who eats but is not satisfied, and the upper hand is better than the lower hand."
20.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne al-Awza'i se, Ibn Shihab se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab aur Urwah ibn al-Zubayr se bataya ke Hakim ibn Hizam ne kaha: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ se maanga aur aapne mujhe diya, fir maine maanga aur aapne diya, fir maine maanga aur aapne diya, fir maine maanga, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Ae Hakim, yeh maal sabz aur meetha hai, so jo ise khule dil se le, uske liye ismein barkat hoti hai, aur jo ise lalach ki nazar se le, uske liye ismein barkat nahi hoti, aur woh us shakhs ki tarah ho jaata hai jo khaata hai lekin sair nahi hota, aur upar wala haath neeche wale haath se behtar hai."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الرَّقِّيُّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ وَرَّادٍ  مَوْلَى الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْوَأْدِ الْبَنَاتِ، وَعُقُوقِ الْأُمَّهَاتِ، وَعَنْ مَنْعٍ وَهَاتِ، وَعَنْ قِيلَ وَقَالَ، وَكَثْرَةِ السُّؤَالِ، وَإِضَاعَةِ الْمَالِ "
20.en: Narrated by Zakariya ibn Adi, from Ubaydullah ibn Amr al-Raqqi, from Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr, from Warrad, freed servant of al-Mughirah, from al-Mughirah: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the burying alive of daughters, and undutifulness to mothers, and withholding and demanding [selfishly], and idle talk and hearsay, and excessive questioning, and wasting wealth."
20.hi: Zakariya ibn Adi ne Ubaydullah ibn Amr al-Raqqi se, Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr se, Warrad se (al-Mughirah ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), al-Mughirah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne betiyon ko zinda dafan karne se, aur maaon ki na-farmaani se, aur rokna-aur-maangna [khudgarzi] se, aur bekaar baaton aur sun-gun se, aur zyada sawaal karne se, aur maal barbaad karne se mana kiya."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ  ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِنَّمَا أَخَافُ عَلَى أُمَّتِي الْأَئِمَّةَ الْمُضِلِّينَ "
20.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah, from Abu Asma, from Thawban: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "I only fear for my nation the misguiding leaders."
20.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ayyub se, Abu Qilabah se, Abu Asma se, Thawban se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Main apni ummat ke liye sirf gumraah karne wale peshwaon se darta hoon."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لِيَنْصُرِ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ ظَالِمًا أَوْ مَظْلُومًا، فَإِنْ كَانَ ظَالِمًا، فَلْيَنْهَهُ، فَإِنَّهُ لَهُ نُصْرَةٌ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مَظْلُومًا، فَلْيَنْصُرْهُ "
20.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zuhayr, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Let a man help his brother, whether he is oppressing or oppressed: if he is oppressing, let him restrain him, for that is helping him, and if he is oppressed, let him help him."
20.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zuhayr se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Aadmi apne bhai ki madad kare, chahe woh zaalim ho ya mazloom: agar woh zaalim ho, to usay roke, kyunki yehi uski madad hai, aur agar woh mazloom ho, to uski madad kare."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ  ، وَنَافِعٍ  ،  عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ "، قَالَ : قُلْنَا : لِمَنْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟، قَالَ : " لِلَّهِ، وَلِرَسُولِهِ، وَلِكِتَابِهِ، وَلِأَئِمَّةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَعَامَّتِهِمْ "
20.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Hisham ibn Sa'd, from Zayd ibn Aslam, and Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to us: "The religion is sincere advice." He said: We said: "To whom, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "To Allah, and His Messenger, and His Book, and to the leaders of the Muslims, and their common folk."
20.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Hisham ibn Sa'd se, Zayd ibn Aslam aur Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne humse farmaya, "Deen khair-khwaahi hai." Unhone bataya: Humne poocha: "Kiske liye, Ya Rasulullah?" Aapne farmaya: "Allah ke liye, aur uske Rasool ke liye, aur uski Kitaab ke liye, aur Musalmanon ke peshwaon aur unke aam logon ke liye."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ الْإِسْلَامَ بَدَأَ غَرِيبًا وَسَيَعُودُ غَرِيبًا أَظُنُّ حَفْصًا، قَالَ : فَطُوبَى لِلْغُرَبَاءِ "، قِيلَ : وَمَنِ الْغُرَبَاءُ؟، قَالَ : " النُّزَّاعُ مِنَ الْقَبَائِلِ "
20.en: Narrated by Zakariya ibn Adi, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from al-A'mash, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Abdullah; with Zakariya's note: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to us: "Indeed Islam began strange, and will return strange as it began" - I think it was Hafs who said: "so glad tidings for the strangers," - it was said: "And who are the strangers?" He said: "Those who withdraw from the tribes."
20.hi: Zakariya ibn Adi ne Hafs ibn Ghiyath se, al-A'mash se, Abu Ishaq se, Abu al-Ahwas se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne humse farmaya, "Beshak Islam ajnabi (ghair-maaloof) hokar shuru hua, aur ajnabi hokar hi wapas hoga jaise shuru hua tha" - mera khayal hai ke Hafs ne kaha: "so ajnabiyon ke liye khush-khabri hai," - poocha gaya: "Aur ajnabi kaun hain?" Aapne farmaya: "Woh log jo qabeelon se alag hokar nikal jaate hain."

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ،  عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ أَحَبَّ لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ أَحَبَّ اللَّهُ لِقَاءَهُ، وَمَنْ كَرِهَ لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ، كَرِهَ اللَّهُ لِقَاءَهُ ".
فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ أَوْ بَعْضُ أَزْوَاجِهِ : إِنَّا لَنَكْرَهُ الْمَوْتَ.
قَالَ : " لَيْسَ ذَلِكَ، وَلَكِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ إِذَا حَضَرَهُ الْمَوْتُ بُشِّرَ بِرِضْوَانِ اللَّهِ وَكَرَامَتِهِ، فَلَيْسَ شَيْءٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِمَّا أَمَامَهُ، فَأَحَبَّ لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ وَأَحَبَّ اللَّهُ لِقَاءَهُ، وَإِنَّ الْكَافِرَ إِذَا حَضَرَهُ الْمَوْتُ بُشِّرَ بِعَذَابِ اللَّهِ وَعُقُوبَتِهِ، فَلَيْسَ شَيْءٌ أَكْرَهَ إِلَيْهِ مِمَّا أَمَامَهُ، فَكَرِهَ لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ، وَكَرِهَ اللَّهُ لِقَاءَهُ "
20.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammam, from Qatadah, from Anas, from Ubadah ibn al-Samit: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever loves to meet Allah, Allah loves to meet him, and whoever dislikes to meet Allah, Allah dislikes to meet him." So Aisha, or one of his wives, said: "But we dislike death." He said: "That is not it, but rather when the believer is faced with death, he is given glad tidings of Allah's pleasure and honor, so nothing is more beloved to him than what is ahead of him, so he loves to meet Allah and Allah loves to meet him, and indeed when the disbeliever is faced with death, he is given tidings of Allah's punishment and His penalty, so nothing is more disliked to him than what is ahead of him, so he dislikes to meet Allah, and Allah dislikes to meet him."
20.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammam se, Qatadah se, Anas se bataya: Unhein Ubadah ibn al-Samit ne bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jo Allah se milna pasand kare, Allah bhi usse milna pasand karta hai, aur jo Allah se milna na-pasand kare, Allah bhi usse milna na-pasand karta hai." To Aisha, ya aapki kisi biwi ne kaha: "Lekin hum to maut ko na-pasand karte hain." Aapne farmaya: "Baat yeh nahi hai, balke jab momin ko maut ka saamna hota hai, to usay Allah ki khushnoodi aur uski izzat ki khush-khabri di jaati hai, so uske aage jo hai usse zyada usay koi cheez aziz nahi hoti, so woh Allah se milna pasand karta hai aur Allah bhi usse milna pasand karta hai, aur jab kaafir ko maut ka saamna hota hai, to usay Allah ke azaab aur uski saza ki khabar di jaati hai, so uske aage jo hai usse zyada usay koi cheez na-pasand nahi hoti, so woh Allah se milna na-pasand karta hai, aur Allah bhi usse milna na-pasand karta hai."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مَعْمَرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْحُبَابِ : سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى يَقُولُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ :أَيْنَ الْمُتَحَابُّونَ بِجَلَالِ؟ الْيَوْمَ أُظِلُّهُمْ فِي ظِلِّي يَوْمَ لَا ظِلَّ إِلَّا ظِلِّي "
20.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Malik, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Ma'mar, from Abu al-Hubab (Sa'id ibn Yasar), from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah, exalted is He, says on the Day of Resurrection: 'Where are those who loved one another for My majesty? Today I shall shade them in My shade, on a day when there is no shade except My shade.'"
20.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Malik se, Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Ma'mar se, Abu al-Hubab (Sa'id ibn Yasar) se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din farmaayega: 'Kahan hain woh log jinhone meri azmat ke liye ek-doosre se mohabbat ki? Aaj main unhein apne saaye mein saaya dunga, jis din mere saaye ke siwa koi saaya na hoga.'"

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي شُعَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ  مَوْلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" لَا يَتَمَنَّى أَحَدُكُمْ الْمَوْتَ : إِمَّا مُحْسِنًا، فَلَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يَزْدَادَ، إِحْسَانًا، وَإِمَّا مُسِيئًا، فَلَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يَسْتَعْتِبَ "
20.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Ubayd, freed servant of Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf, from Abu Hurairah: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Let none of you wish for death: whether he is a doer of good, then perhaps he may increase in good, or a doer of evil, then perhaps he may seek to make amends."
20.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb se bataya: Mujhe al-Zuhri ne bataya: Mujhe Abu Ubayd ne bataya (Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), ke Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Tum mein se koi maut ki tamanna na kare: chahe woh neik ho, to shayad woh apni neki mein aur izaafa kare, ya woh bura ho, to shayad woh tauba karne ki koshish kare."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" بُعِثْتُ أَنَا وَالسَّاعَةَ كَهَاتَيْنِ " وَأَشَارَ وَهْبٌ بِالسَّبَّاحَةِ وَالْوُسْطَى
20.en: Narrated by Wahb ibn Jarir, from Shu'bah, from Abu al-Tayyah, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ; with Wahb's gesture: He said: "I have been sent, and the Hour, like these two," and Wahb gestured with his index and middle fingers.
20.hi: Wahb ibn Jarir ne Shu'bah se, Abu al-Tayyah se, Anas se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Main aur Qayamat in dono jaisi hain," aur Wahb ne apni shahaadat wali aur beech wali ungliyon se ishara kiya.

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" إِنَّكُمْ وَفَّيْتُمْ سَبْعِينَ أُمَّةً أَنْتُمْ آخِرُهَا وَأَكْرَمُهَا عَلَى اللَّهِ "
20.en: Narrated by al-Nadr ibn Shumayl, from Bahz ibn Hakim, from his father, from his grandfather: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "You have completed seventy nations, you are the last of them and the most honored to Allah."
20.hi: Al-Nadr ibn Shumayl ne Bahz ibn Hakim se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Tumne sattar ummaton ko poora kiya hai, tum unmein aakhri aur Allah ke nazdeek sabse izzat wale ho."

20.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   : أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : " أَيْنَ فُلَانٌ؟ ".
فَغَمَزَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْهُمْ، فَقَالَ : إِنَّهُ، وَإِنَّهُ !، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَلَيْسَ قَدْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا؟ "، قَالُوا : بَلَى.
قَالَ :" فَلَعَلَّ اللَّهَ اطَّلَعَ عَلَى أَهْلِ بَدْرٍ، فَقَالَ : اعْمَلُوا مَا شِئْتُمْ، فَقَدْ غَفَرْتُ لَكُمْ "
20.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Asim, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Asim, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurairah: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "Where is so-and-so?" So a man among them nudged him, and said: "He is such-and-such, and such-and-such!" So the Prophet ﷺ said: "Did he not witness Badr?" They said, "Yes indeed." He said: "Then perhaps Allah looked upon the people of Badr, and said: 'Do whatever you wish, for I have forgiven you.'"
20.hi: Amr ibn Asim ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Asim se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Nabi ﷺ ne poocha: "Fulaan kahan hai?" To unmein se ek aadmi ne usay ishara karke bataaya, aur kaha: "Woh fulaan hai, aur fulaan!" To Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Kya woh Badr mein maujood nahi tha?" Unhone kaha, "Kyun nahi." Aapne farmaya: "To shayad Allah ne Badr walon par nazar daali, aur farmaya: Jo chaho karo, kyunki maine tumhein bakhsh diya hai."

20.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ عَتَّابِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ   : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَوْ حَبَسَ اللَّهُ الْقَطْرَ عَنْ أُمَّتِي عَشْرَ سِنِينَ، ثُمَّ أُنْزِلَ، لَأَصْبَحَتْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي بِهَا كَافِرِينَ يَقُولُونَ : هُوَ بِنَوْءِ مِجْدَحٍ ".
يقَالَ : الْمِجْدَحُ كَوْكَبٌ.
يُقَالُ لَهُ : الدَّبَرَانُ
20.en: Narrated by Affan, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Attab ibn Hunayn, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If Allah were to withhold the rain from my nation for ten years, then send it down, a group from my nation would become morning-time disbelievers, saying: 'It is due to the star al-Mijdah.'" It is said: al-Mijdah is a star, it is called: al-Dabaran.
20.hi: Affan ne Hammad ibn Salamah se bataya: Humein Amr ibn Dinar ne bataya, Attab ibn Hunayn se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Agar Allah meri ummat se das saal tak baarish rok le, fir isay bhej de, to meri ummat ka ek giroh subah kaafir ho jaayega, kahega: 'Yeh Mijdah sitaare ki wajah se hui hai.'" Kaha jaata hai: Al-Mijdah ek sitaara hai, jise al-Dabaran kaha jaata hai.

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ وَاصِلٍ  مَوْلَى أَبِي عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ بَشَّارِ بْنِ أَبِي سَيْفٍ  ، عَنْ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ غُطَيْفٍ  ، قَالَ : أَتَيْنَا أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ بْنَ الْجَرَّاحِ   نَعُودُهُ، فَقَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" الْحَسَنَةُ بِعَشْرِ أَمْثَالِهَا "
20.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid ibn Abdullah, from Wasil, freed servant of Abu Uyaynah, from Bashshar ibn Abi Sayf, from al-Walid ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Iyad ibn Ghutayf: He said: We came to Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah visiting him in illness, so he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "The good deed [is rewarded] by ten times its like."
20.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid ibn Abdullah se bataya: Humein Wasil ne bataya (Abu Uyaynah ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), Bashshar ibn Abi Sayf se, al-Walid ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Iyad ibn Ghutayf se: Unhone kaha, Hum Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah ki bimaar-pursi ke liye gaye, to unhone kaha: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Naiki das guna [ajr] ki hoti hai."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ الرُّكَيْنِ  ، عَنْ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ حَنْظَلَةَ  ، قَالَ شَرِيكٌ وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ : النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ حَنْظَلَةَ ، عَنْ عَمَّارٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ كَانَ ذَا وَجْهَيْنِ فِي الدُّنْيَا، كَانَ لَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ لِسَانَانِ مِنْ نَارٍ "
20.en: Narrated by al-Aswad ibn Amir, from Sharik, from al-Rukayn, from Nu'aym ibn Hanzalah (Sharik was uncertain, sometimes said: al-Nu'man ibn Hanzalah), from Ammar, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whoever has two faces in this world, will have two tongues of fire on the Day of Resurrection."
20.hi: Al-Aswad ibn Amir ne Sharik se, al-Rukayn se, Nu'aym ibn Hanzalah se bataya (Sharik ko kabhi-kabhi shak hota, kehte: al-Nu'man ibn Hanzalah), Ammar se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Jo duniya mein do chehron wala ho, uske Qayamat ke din aag ki do zubaanein hongi."

20.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ، فَأَيُّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ لَعَنْتُهُ، أَوْ شَتَمْتُهُ أَوْ جَلَدْتُهُ، فَاجْعَلْهَا لَهُ صَلَاةً وَرَحْمَةً وَقُرْبَةً تُقَرِّبُهُ بِهَا إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ "، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ   ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
..
..
..
..
. مِثْلَهُ، إِلَّا أَنَّ فِيهِ " زَكَاةً وَرَحْمَةً "
20.en: Narrated by al-Mu'alla ibn Asad, from Abd al-Wahid ibn Ziyad, from al-A'mash, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurairah; a similar chain also via Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Numayr: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O Allah, I am only human, so whichever Muslim I have cursed, or reviled, or flogged, make it for him a prayer, and mercy, and a means of nearness that draws him close to You on the Day of Resurrection." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Numayr, from his father, from al-A'mash, from Abu Sufyan, from Jabir, from the Prophet ﷺ, the same, except that in it is: "purification and mercy."]
20.hi: Al-Mu'alla ibn Asad ne Abd al-Wahid ibn Ziyad se, al-A'mash se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Ae Allah, main to sirf ek insaan hoon, so jis bhi Musalman par maine lanat ki, ya usay bura-bhala kaha, ya usay kode maare, to isay uske liye dua, aur rehmat, aur ek zariya bana de jo usay Qayamat ke din tere qareeb kare." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Numayr se, apne walid se, al-A'mash se, Abu Sufyan se, Jabir se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi aayi hai, isi tarah, siwaay iske ke usmein hai: "paakizgi aur rehmat."]

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ سُوَيْدَ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" مَا يَسُرُّنِي أَنَّ جَبَلَ أُحُدٍ لِي ذَهَبًا أَمُوتُ يَوْمَ أَمُوتُ عِنْدِي دِينَارٌ أَوْ نِصْفُ دِينَارٍ إِلَّا لِغَرِيمٍ "
20.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Shu'bah, from Amr ibn Murrah, from Suwayd ibn al-Harith, from Abu Dharr: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "It would not please me that Mount Uhud be gold for me, and I die on the day I die with a dinar or half a dinar left with me, except for a debt."
20.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Shu'bah se, Amr ibn Murrah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Suwayd ibn al-Harith ko suna, Abu Dharr se: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Mujhe yeh pasand nahi ke Uhud pahaad mera sona ban jaaye aur main jis din marun mere paas ek dinar ya aadha dinar bacha ho, siwaay qarz [ada karne] ke."

20.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ  ، وَسُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ هُوَ : ابْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ قُرْطٍ  ، قَالَ :" إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ أُمُورًا هِيَ أَدَقُّ فِي أَعْيُنِكُمْ مِنَ الشَّعْرِ، كُنَّا نَعُدُّهَا عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنْ الْمُوبِقَاتِ ".
فَذُكِرَ لِمُحَمَّدٍ يَعْنِي : ابْنَ سِيرِينَ، فَقَالَ : صَدَقَ، فَأَرَى جَرَّ الْإِزَارِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ
20.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Fadl, and Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Humayd ibn Hilal, from Ubadah ibn Qurt: He said: "You indeed commit matters that seem thinner in your eyes than a hair, which we used to count in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as among the destructive sins." So that was mentioned to Muhammad - meaning: Ibn Sirin - and he said: He spoke the truth, so I think dragging the izar [in arrogance] is among that.
20.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Fadl aur Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Ayyub ne bataya, Humayd ibn Hilal se, Ubadah ibn Qurt se: Unhone kaha, "Tum aisi baatein karte ho jo tumhari nazron mein baal se bhi patli hain, jinhein hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke zamane mein halaakat wale gunahon mein shumaar karte the." To yeh baat Muhammad ko - yaani: Ibn Sirin - bataayi gayi, to unhone kaha: Unhone sach kaha, so mera khayal hai izaar ghaseetna isi mein se hai.

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَبَايَةَ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ  ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ أَوْ مِنْ فَوْرِ جَهَنَّمَ فَأَبْرِدُوهَا بِالْمَاءِ "
20.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from his father, from Abayah ibn Rifa'ah, from Rafi' ibn Khadij: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Fever is from the intensity of Jahannam, or from the boiling of Jahannam, so cool it down with water."
20.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, apne walid se, Abayah ibn Rifa'ah se, Rafi' ibn Khadij se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Bukhaar Jahannam ki tapish se hai, ya Jahannam ke josh se, so isay paani se thanda karo."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُخَيْمِرَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَا أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ يُصَابُ بِبَلَاءٍ فِي جَسَدِهِ، إِلَّا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ الْحَفَظَةَ الَّذِينَ يَحْفَظُونَهُ، فَقَالَ : اكْتُبُوا لِعَبْدِي فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ مِثْلَ مَا كَانَ يَعْمَلُ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ، مَا كَانَ مَحْبُوسًا فِي وِثَاقِي "
20.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Sufyan, from Alqamah ibn Marthad, from al-Qasim ibn Mukhaymirah, from Abdullah ibn Amr: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There is no one from among the Muslims who is afflicted with an affliction in his body, except that Allah commands the recording angels who protect him, and says: 'Write for My servant, every day and night, the like of what he used to do of good, as long as he is confined in My bond.'"
20.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Sufyan se, Alqamah ibn Marthad se, al-Qasim ibn Mukhaymirah se, Abdullah ibn Amr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Koi Musalman apne jism mein kisi museebat mein mubtala nahi hota, magar Allah unhi hifaazat karne wale farishton ko hukum deta hai jo uski hifaazat karte hain, aur farmaata hai: 'Mere bande ke liye har din aur raat wahi likho jo woh naiki kiya karta tha, jab tak woh meri qaid mein hai.'"

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ  ، عَنْ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : دَخَلْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُوَ يُوعَكُ، فَوَضَعْتُ يَدِي عَلَيْهِ، فَقُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّكَ لَتُوعَكُ وَعْكًا شَدِيدًا، فَقَالَ :" إِنِّي أُوعَكُ كَمَا يُوعَكُ رَجُلَانِ مِنْكُمْ "، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : ذَلِكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ أَجْرَيْنِ؟، قَالَ : " أَجَلْ، وَمَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يُصِيبُهُ أَذًى، أَوْ مَرَضٌ فَمَا سِوَاهُ، إِلَّا حُطَّ عَنْهُ مِنْ سَيِّئَاتِهِ كَمَا تَحُطُّ الشَّجَرَةُ وَرَقَهَا "
20.en: Narrated by Ya'la ibn Ubayd, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim al-Taymi, from al-Harith ibn Suwayd, from Abdullah: He said: I entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was having a fever, so I placed my hand on him, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, indeed you have a severe fever," so he said: "Indeed I have as much fever as two men among you." He said: I said: "That is because you have two rewards?" He said: "Yes, and there is no Muslim who is afflicted with harm, or illness or anything besides that, except that his bad deeds are removed from him as a tree sheds its leaves."
20.hi: Ya'la ibn Ubayd ne al-A'mash se, Ibrahim al-Taymi se, al-Harith ibn Suwayd se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas gaya jabke aapko bukhaar tha, to maine apna haath aap par rakha, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, aapko to bahut tez bukhaar hai," to aapne farmaya: "Mujhe utna hi bukhaar hai jitna tum mein se do aadmiyon ko hota hai." Unhone bataya: Maine kaha: "Yeh isliye ke aapke liye do ajr hain?" Aapne farmaya: "Haan, aur koi Musalman aisa nahi jise koi takleef, ya bimari, ya aur kuch pahunche, magar uske gunah usse aise gir jaate hain jaise darakht apne pattay giraata hai."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الْمَدَنِيُّ  ، عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلَاةً وَاحِدَةً، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَشْرًا "
20.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Isma'il ibn Ja'far al-Madani, from al-Ala ibn Abd al-Rahman, from his father, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever sends one blessing upon me, Allah sends ten blessings upon him."
20.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Isma'il ibn Ja'far al-Madani se, al-Ala ibn Abd al-Rahman se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo mujhpar ek dua bheje, Allah usper das duaein bhejta hai."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ  مَوْلَى الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : جَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمًا وَهُوَ يُرَى الْبِشْرُ فِي وَجْهِهِ، فَقِيلَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّا نَرَى فِي وَجْهِكَ بِشْرًا لَمْ نَكُنْ نَرَاهُ؟، قَالَ : " أَجَلْ، إِنَّ مَلَكًا أَتَانِي، فَقَالَ لِي : يَا مُحَمَّدُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقُولُ لَكَ :أَمَا يُرْضِيكَ أَنْ لَا يُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْكَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِكَ، إِلَّا صَلَّيْتُ عَلَيْهِ عَشْرًا، وَلَا يُسَلِّمَ عَلَيْكَ، إِلَّا سَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ عَشْرًا؟، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : " بَلَى "
20.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Thabit, from Sulayman, freed servant of al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah, from his father: He said: The Prophet ﷺ came one day and joy could be seen on his face, so it was said: "O Messenger of Allah, we see joy on your face that we did not use to see?" He said: "Indeed, an angel came to me, and said to me: 'O Muhammad, indeed your Lord says to you: Would it not please you that none of your nation sends blessings upon you, except that I send ten blessings upon him, and none greets you with peace, except that I greet him with peace ten times?'" He said: I said: "Yes indeed."
20.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Thabit se bataya: Unhein Sulayman ne bataya, jo al-Hasan ibn Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke azaad kiye hue ghulam the, Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah se, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ ek din aaye jabke aapke chehre par khushi zaahir thi, to poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah, hum aapke chehre par woh khushi dekh rahe hain jo hum pehle nahi dekhte the?" Aapne farmaya: "Zaroor, ek farishta mere paas aaya, aur mujhse kaha: 'Ae Muhammad, aapka Rab aapse kehta hai: Kya tumhein yeh pasand nahi ke tumhari ummat mein se koi bhi tumpar dua bheje, magar main usper das duaein bhejun, aur koi tumhein salaam kare, magar main usay das martaba salaam karun?'" Unhone bataya: Maine kaha: "Kyun nahi."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ  ، عَنْ زَاذَانَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلَائِكَةً سَيَّاحِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يُبَلِّغُونِي عَنْ أُمَّتِي السَّلَامَ "
20.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Abdullah ibn al-Sa'ib, from Zadhan, from Abdullah ibn Mas'ud: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed Allah has traveling angels on the earth who convey to me the greetings of peace from my nation."
20.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Abdullah ibn al-Sa'ib se, Zadhan se, Abdullah ibn Mas'ud se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah ke kuch farishte zameen mein ghoomte rehte hain jo mujhe meri ummat ki taraf se salaam pahunchaate hain."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" إِنَّ لِي أَسْمَاءً : أَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ ، وَأَنَا أَحْمَدُ ، وَأَنَا الْمَاحِي الَّذِي يَمْحُو اللَّهُ بِيَ الْكُفْرَ، وَأَنَا الْحَاشِرُ الَّذِي يُحْشَرُ النَّاسُ عَلَى قَدَمِي، وَأَنَا الْعَاقِبُ ، وَالْعَاقِبُ الَّذِي لَيْسَ بَعْدَهُ أَحَدٌ "
20.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb ibn Abi Hamzah, from al-Zuhri, from Muhammad ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im, from his father: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Indeed I have [several] names: I am Muhammad, and I am Ahmad, and I am al-Mahi, by whom Allah erases disbelief, and I am al-Hashir, on whose feet the people will be gathered, and I am al-Aqib," and al-Aqib is: the one after whom there is no one else.
20.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb ibn Abi Hamzah se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Mujhe Muhammad ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im ne bataya, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Mere kuch naam hain: Main Muhammad hoon, aur main Ahmad hoon, aur main al-Maahi hoon jiske zariye Allah kufr mitaayega, aur main al-Haashir hoon jiske qadmon par log jama kiye jaayenge, aur main al-Aaqib hoon," aur al-Aaqib woh hai jiske baad koi aur nahi.

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَابِطٍ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : " يَا كَعْبُ بْنَ عُجْرَةَ،إِنَّهُ لَنْ يَدْخُلَ الْجَنَّةَ لَحْمٌ نَبَتَ مِنَ سُحْتٍ "
20.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Abdullah ibn Uthman ibn Khuthaym, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Sabit, from Jabir ibn Abdullah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O Ka'b ibn Ujrah, indeed flesh that grows from unlawful earnings will never enter Paradise."
20.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se bataya: Humein Abdullah ibn Uthman ibn Khuthaym ne bataya, Abd al-Rahman ibn Sabit se, Jabir ibn Abdullah se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Ae Ka'b ibn Ujrah, jo gosht haraam kamaai se ugta hai, woh kabhi Jannat mein dakhil nahi hoga."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ الْبَصْرِيُّ هُوَ رَوْحُ بِنُ أَسْلَمَ الْبَصْرِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا ثَابِتٌ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، عَنْ صُهَيْبٍ  ، قَالَ : بَيْنَمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ جَالِسٌ إِذْ ضَحِكَ، فَقَالَ : " أَلَا تَسْأَلُونِي مِمَّا أَضْحَكُ؟ "، فَقَالُوا : مِمَّ تَضْحَكُ؟، قَالَ :" عَجَبًا مِنْ أَمْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِ كُلُّهُ لَهُ خَيْرٌ : إِنْ أَصَابَهُ مَا يُحِبُّ، حَمِدَ اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ، فَكَانَ لَهُ خَيْرٌ، وَإِنْ أَصَابَهُ مَا يَكْرَهُ فَصَبَرَ، كَانَ لَهُ خَيْرٌ، وَلَيْسَ كُلُّ أَحَدٍ أَمْرُهُ لَهُ خَيْرٌ إِلَّا الْمُؤْمِنَ "
20.en: Narrated by Abu Hatim al-Basri (Rawh ibn Aslam al-Basri), from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Thabit, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla, from Suhayb: He said: While the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was sitting, he laughed, and said: "Will you not ask me why I laughed?" So they said: "Why do you laugh?" He said: "Amazement at the affair of the believer, all of it is good for him: if something he loves befalls him, he praises Allah for it, and it is good for him, and if something he dislikes befalls him and he is patient, it is good for him, and no one has everything good for him except the believer."
20.hi: Abu Hatim al-Basri (Rawh ibn Aslam al-Basri) ne Hammad ibn Salamah se bataya: Humein Thabit ne bataya, Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla se, Suhayb se: Unhone kaha, Jabke Rasulullah ﷺ baithe hue the, aap hanse, aur farmaya: "Kya tum mujhse nahi poochoge ke main kyun hansa?" To sahaba ne poocha: "Aap kyun hanse?" Aapne farmaya: "Momin ke maamle par tajjub, uska sab kuch uske liye achha hota hai: agar usay woh mile jo usay pasand ho, to woh Allah ki hamd karta hai, aur yeh uske liye achha hota hai, aur agar usay woh mile jo usay na-pasand ho aur woh sabr kare, to yeh bhi uske liye achha hota hai, aur kisi ke liye har cheez achhi nahi hoti siwaay momin ke."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ أَسْمَعُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَلَا أَدْرِي أَشَيْءٌ أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْ شَيْءٌ يَقُولُهُ، وَهُوَ يَقُولُ :" لَوْ كَانَ، لِابْنِ آدَمَ وَادِيَانِ مِنْ مَالٍ لَابْتَغَى إِلَيْهِمَا ثَالِثًا، وَلَا يَمْلَأُ جَوْفَ ابْنِ آدَمَ إِلَّا التُّرَابُ، وَيَتُوبُ اللَّهُ عَلَى مَنْ تَابَ "
20.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Shu'bah, from Qatadah, from Anas: He said: I used to hear the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I do not know if it was something revealed to him, or something he said himself, saying: "If the son of Adam had two valleys of wealth, he would seek a third, and nothing fills the belly of the son of Adam except dust, and Allah turns in forgiveness to whoever repents."
20.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Shu'bah se, Qatadah se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Rasulullah ﷺ ko sunta tha, aur mujhe nahi pata tha ke kya yeh aapko naazil kiya gaya tha ya khud farmaate the, aap farmaate: "Agar Aadam ki aulaad ke paas maal ki do wadiyaan hoti, to woh teesri talaash karti, aur Aadam ki aulaad ka pet sirf mitti se bharta hai, aur Allah us par tauba qabool karta hai jo tauba kare."

20.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا يَقُصُّ إِلَّا أَمِيرٌ، أَوْ مَأْمُورٌ، أَوْ مُرَاءٍ ".
قُلْتُ لِعَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ : إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ مُتَكَلِّفٌ.
فَقَالَ : هَذَا مَا سَمِعْتُ
20.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Abdullah ibn Amir, from Amr ibn Shu'ayb, from his father, from his grandfather: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "None should give sermons/storytelling except a commander, or one commanded, or a show-off." I said to Amr ibn Shu'ayb: "We used to hear it as: 'one who overburdens himself [without proper knowledge].'" So he said: This is what I heard.
20.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Abdullah ibn Amir se, Amr ibn Shu'ayb se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Sirf ameer, ya jise hukum diya gaya ho, ya dikhaawa karne wala hi wa'z-o-naseehat kare." Maine Amr ibn Shu'ayb se kaha: "Hum ise yun sunte the: 'mutakallif' (bagair ilm ke bojh uthaane wala)." To unhone kaha: Maine jo suna hai woh yeh hai.

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ  ، قالَ : سَمِعْتُ كُرْدُوسًا   وَكَانَ قَاصًّا ، يَقُولُ : أَخْبَرَنِي رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَدْرٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" لَأَنْ أَقْعُدَ فِي مِثْلِ هَذَا الْمَجْلِسِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُعْتِقَ أَرْبَعَ رِقَابٍ ".
قَالَ : قُلْتُ : أَنَا : أَيَّ مَجْلِسٍ يَعْنِي؟، قَالَ : كَانَ حِينَئِذٍ يَقُصُّ.
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : الرَّجُلُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ بَدْرٍ هُوَ : عَلِيٌّ
20.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Ala, from Yahya ibn Abi Bukayr, from Shu'bah, from Abd al-Malik ibn Maysarah, from Kurdus, a storyteller; with Abu Muhammad's identification: He said: I heard Kurdus, who was a storyteller, say: A man from the people of Badr informed me, that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "That I sit in a gathering like this is more beloved to me than that I free four slaves." He said: I said: "Which gathering does he mean?" He said: It was at that time a gathering of religious storytelling. Abu Muhammad said: The man from among the Companions of Badr is: Ali.
20.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Ala ne Yahya ibn Abi Bukayr se, Shu'bah se, Abd al-Malik ibn Maysarah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Kurdus ko, jo ek wa'iz the, yeh kehte suna: Mujhe Badr walon mein se ek aadmi ne bataya, ke unhone Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Aisi majlis mein baithna mujhe chaar ghulam azaad karne se zyada aziz hai." Unhone bataya: Maine poocha: "Kaunsi majlis ka matlab hai?" Unhone kaha: Us waqt yeh deeni wa'z ki majlis thi. Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Badr ke sahaba mein se woh aadmi Ali (Alayhis Salam) hain.

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا عُقَيْلٌ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ  : أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ   أَخْبَرَهُ : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَا يُلْدَغُ الْمُؤْمِنُ مِنْ جُحْرٍ وَاحِدٍ مَرَّتَيْنِ "
20.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The believer is not stung from the same hole twice."
20.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Humein Uqayl ne bataya, Ibn Shihab se: Mujhe Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab ne bataya: ke Abu Hurairah ne unhein bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Momin ek hi bill se do martaba nahi kaata jaata."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ  ، عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ : وَرُبَّمَا سَكَتَ عَنْ جَابِرٍ ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا تَدْخُلُوا عَلَى الْمُغِيبَاتِ، فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَجْرِي مِنَ ابْنِ آدَمَ كَمَجْرَى الدَّمِ "، قَالُوا : وَمِنْكَ؟، قَالَ : " نَعَمْ، وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ أَعَانَنِي عَلَيْهِ فَأَسْلَمَ "
20.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Ala, from Abu Usamah, from Mujalid, from Amir, from Jabir; with a note on doubtful transmission: He said: (and sometimes he was silent about it being from Jabir), he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do not enter upon women whose husbands are absent, for indeed the Shaytan flows in the son of Adam like the flow of blood." They said: "And in you too?" He said: "Yes, but Allah helped me against him, so he submitted [became Muslim]."
20.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Ala ne Abu Usamah se, Mujalid se, Amir se, Jabir se bataya: (aur kabhi-kabhi woh ise Jabir se manqool hona chhod dete) Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Un auraton ke paas mat jao jinke shohar ghair-haazir hon, kyunki shaytan Aadam ki aulaad mein khoon ki tarah daudta hai." Sahaba ne poocha: "Aur aapke andar bhi?" Aapne farmaya: "Haan, lekin Allah ne uske khilaaf meri madad ki to woh musalman ho gaya."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ  ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : أَيُّ النَّاسِ أَشَدُّ بَلَاءَ؟، قَالَ :" الْأَنْبِيَاءُ، ثُمَّ الْأَمْثَلُ فَالْأَمْثَلُ، يُبْتَلَى الرَّجُلُ عَلَى حَسَبِ دِينِهِ، فَإِنْ كَانَ فِي دِينِهِ صَلَابَةٌ زِيدَ صَلَابَةً، وَإِنْ كَانَ فِي دِينِهِ رِقَّةٌ، خُفِّفَ عَنْهُ، وَلَا يَزَالُ الْبَلَاءُ بِالْعَبْدِ حَتَّى يَمْشِيَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ مَا لَهُ خَطِيئَةٌ "
20.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from Asim, from Mus'ab ibn Sa'd, from Sa'd: He said: The Prophet ﷺ was asked: Which people are most severely tested? He said: "The prophets, then those most similar, then those most similar; a man is tested according to his religion: if there is firmness in his religion, his test is increased, and if there is weakness in his religion, it is lightened for him, and trial continues to befall the servant until it leaves him walking upon the earth without any sin."
20.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se, Asim se, Mus'ab ibn Sa'd se, Sa'd se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ se poocha gaya: Logon mein sabse zyada azmaaish kise hoti hai? Aapne farmaya: "Anbiya ko, fir unke qareeb walon ko, fir unke qareeb walon ko; aadmi ki azmaaish uske deen ke hisaab se hoti hai: agar uske deen mein mazbooti ho, to azmaaish badha di jaati hai, aur agar uske deen mein kamzori ho, to azmaaish halki kar di jaati hai, aur bande par azmaaish aati rehti hai yahan tak ke woh zameen par bagair kisi gunah ke chalta hai."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَا تُطْرُونِي كَمَا تُطْرِي النَّصَارَى عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ ، وَلَكِنْ قُولُوا : عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولُهُ "
20.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Malik, from al-Zuhri, from Ubaydullah, from Ibn Abbas, from Umar: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Do not exaggerate praise of me as the Christians exaggerated praise of Isa ibn Maryam, but say: the servant of Allah and His Messenger."
20.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Malik se, al-Zuhri se, Ubaydullah se, Ibn Abbas se, Umar se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Meri tareef mein waisi ghuluww (had se zyada) na karo jaise Isaiyon ne Isa ibn Maryam ki tareef mein ki, balke kaho: Allah ka banda aur uska Rasool."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" جَعَلَ اللَّهُ الرَّحْمَةَ مِائَةَ جُزْءٍ فَأَمْسَكَ عِنْدَهُ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ، وَأَنْزَلَ فِي الْأَرْضِ جُزْءًا وَاحِدًا، فَمِنْ ذَلِكَ الْجُزْءِ يَتَرَاحَمُ الْخَلْقُ، حَتَّى تَرْفَعَ الْفَرَسُ حَافِرَهَا عَنْ وَلَدِهَا خَشْيَةَ أَنْ تُصِيبَهُ "
20.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurairah: He said: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: "Allah made mercy in a hundred parts, and He kept ninety-nine with Him, and sent down one part on the earth, so from that one part creatures show mercy to each other, until the mare lifts her hoof away from her foal, fearing she may harm it."
20.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Mujhe Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab ne bataya, Abu Hurairah se: Unhone kaha, Maine Nabi ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Allah ne rehmat ke sau hisse banaaye, to unnisan (ninety-nine) apne paas rakh liye, aur ek hissa zameen mein utaara, so usi ek hisse se makhlooq ek-doosre par reham karti hai, yahan tak ke ghodi apna khur apne bachche se hataa leti hai is dar se ke kahin usay nuqsaan na pahunche."

20.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْجَعْدُ أَبُو عُثْمَانَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا رَجَاءٍ الْعُطَارِدِيَّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِيمَا يَرْوِيهِ عَنْ رَبِّهِ G قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ رَحِيمٌ : مَنْ هَمَّ بِحَسَنَةٍ فَلَمْ يَعْمَلْهَا، كُتِبَتْ لَهُ حَسَنَةً، فَإِنْ عَمِلَهَا، كُتِبَتْ عَشْرًا إِلَى سَبْعِ مِائَةٍ إِلَى أَضْعَافٍ كَثِيرَةٍ،  وَمَنْ هَمَّ بِسَيِّئَةٍ فَلَمْ يَعْمَلْهَا، كُتِبَتْ لَهُ حَسَنَةً، فَإِنْ عَمِلَهَا، كُتِبَتْ وَاحِدَةً، أَوْ يَمْحُوهَا.
وَلَا يَهْلِكُ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا هَالِكٌ "
20.en: Narrated by Affan, from Ja'far ibn Sulayman, from al-Ja'd Abu Uthman, from Abu Raja al-Utaridi, from Ibn Abbas, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, narrating from his Lord, Azza wa Jall: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed your Lord is Merciful: whoever intends a good deed but does not do it, one good deed is written for him, and if he does it, ten are written for it, up to seven hundred, up to many multiples, and whoever intends a bad deed but does not do it, one good deed is written for him, and if he does it, one is written, or it is erased. And none is destroyed before Allah except one who is [truly] destroyed."
20.hi: Affan ne Ja'far ibn Sulayman se, al-Ja'd Abu Uthman se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Raja al-Utaridi ko suna, Ibn Abbas se, Rasulullah ﷺ se, jise woh apne Rab, Azza wa Jall, se riwaayat karte hain: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tumhara Rab reham karne wala hai: jo neki ka irada kare fir use na kare, uske liye ek naiki likh di jaati hai, aur agar woh use kare, to das se sat sau tak, aur kai gunaa tak likhi jaati hai, aur jo bura kaam karne ka irada kare fir use na kare, uske liye ek naiki likh di jaati hai, aur agar woh use kare, to ek hi likhi jaati hai, ya woh mita di jaati hai. Aur Allah ke huzoor koi halaak nahi hota siwaay us shakhs ke jo [waaqai] halaak ho jaaye."

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ : الرَّجُلُ يُحِبُّ الْقَوْمَ وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَعْمَلَ مِثْلَ عَمَلِهِمْ؟، قَالَ : " أَنْتَ يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ مَعَ مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ ".
قُلْتُ : فَإِنِّي أُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ؟، قَالَ :" أَنْتَ مَعَ مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ "
20.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Sulayman, from Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah, from Humayd ibn Hilal, from Abdullah ibn al-Samit, from Abu Dharr: He said: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, [what about] the man who loves a people but is not able to do like their deeds?" He said: "You, O Abu Dharr, are with whoever you love." I said: "So indeed I love Allah and His Messenger?" He said: "You are with whoever you love."
20.hi: Sa'id ibn Sulayman ne Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah se, Humayd ibn Hilal se, Abdullah ibn al-Samit se, Abu Dharr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah: aisa aadmi jo ek qaum se mohabbat kare lekin unke jaisa amal na kar sake?" Aapne farmaya: "Tum, Ae Abu Dharr, us ke saath ho jisse tum mohabbat karte ho." Maine kaha: "To main Allah aur uske Rasool se mohabbat karta hoon?" Aapne farmaya: "Tum us ke saath ho jisse tum mohabbat karte ho."

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيٌّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا غَيْلَانُ  ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ  ، عَنْ مَعْدِي كَرِبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَرْوِيهِ عَنْ رَبِّهِ، قَالَ : " يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ ، إِنَّكَمَا دَعَوْتَنِي وَرَجَوْتَنِي، غَفَرْتُ لَكَ مَا كَانَ فِيكَ.
ابْنَ آدَمَ ، إِنَّكَ إِنْ تَلْقَانِي بِقُرَابِ الْأَرْضِ خَطَايَا، لَقِيتُكَ بِقُرَابِهَا مَغْفِرَةً بَعْدَ أَنْ لَا تُشْرِكَ بِي شَيْئًا، ابْنَ آدَمَ ، إِنَّكَ إِنْ تُذْنِبْ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ ذَنْبُكَ عَنَانَ السَّمَاءِ، ثُمَّ تَسْتَغْفِرُنِي أَغْفِرْ لَكَ وَلَا أُبَالِي "
20.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Mahdi, from Ghaylan, from Shahr ibn Hawshab, from Ma'dikarib, from Abu Dharr, from the Prophet ﷺ, narrating from his Lord: He said: "O son of Adam, as long as you call upon Me and hope in Me, I have forgiven you for what was in you. O son of Adam, if you were to come to Me with sins nearly filling the earth, I would come to you with forgiveness nearly filling it, as long as you do not associate anything with Me. O son of Adam, if you were to sin until your sin reached the clouds of the sky, then you sought My forgiveness, I would forgive you, and not care."
20.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Mahdi se, Ghaylan se, Shahr ibn Hawshab se, Ma'dikarib se, Abu Dharr se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya, jise woh apne Rab se riwaayat karte hain: Aapne farmaya, "Ae Aadam ki aulaad, jab tak tum mujhse dua maango aur mujhse ummeed rakho, main tumhein bakhsh dunga jo bhi tumme tha. Ae Aadam ki aulaad, agar tum mere paas zameen bhar ke gunah lekar aao, to main tumhare paas zameen bhar ki maghfirat lekar aaunga, bashart-e-ke tum mere saath kisi ko shareek na karo. Ae Aadam ki aulaad, agar tum itna gunah karo ke tumhara gunah aasmaan ke baadalon tak pahunch jaaye, fir tum mujhse maghfirat maango, to main tumhein bakhsh dunga, aur mujhe parwaah nahi."

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ هُوَ : ابْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ جَابِرٍ الْقَاضِي  ، عَنِ النَّوَّاسِ بْنِ سَمْعَانَ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنِ الْبِرِّ وَالْإِثْمِ، فَقَالَ :" الْبِرُّ حُسْنُ الْخُلُقِ، وَالْإِثْمُ مَا حَاكَ فِي نَفْسِكَ وَكَرِهْتَ أَنْ يَعْلَمَهُ النَّاسُ ".
 أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ عِيسَى  ، عَنْ مَعْنِ بْنِ عِيسَى  ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنِ النَّوَّاسِ بْنِ سَمْعَانَ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ.

فَذَكَرَ بِنَحْوِهِ
20.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from Safwan ibn Amr, from Yahya ibn Jabir al-Qadi, from al-Nawwas ibn Sam'an; a similar chain also via Ishaq ibn Isa: He said: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about righteousness and sin, so he said: "Righteousness is good character, and sin is what stirs in your soul and you dislike people to know of it." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Ishaq ibn Isa, from Ma'n ibn Isa, from Mu'awiyah ibn Salih, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Jubayr ibn Nufayr, from his father, from al-Nawwas ibn Sam'an: he said: I asked the Prophet ﷺ, then he mentioned the like of it.]
20.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne Safwan ibn Amr se bataya: Mujhse Yahya ibn Jabir al-Qadi ne bataya, al-Nawwas ibn Sam'an se: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ se neki aur gunah ke baare mein poocha, to aapne farmaya: "Neki achhe akhlaq ka naam hai, aur gunah woh hai jo tumhare dil mein khatke aur tum na-pasand karo ke log usay jaanein." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Ishaq ibn Isa se, Ma'n ibn Isa se, Mu'awiyah ibn Salih se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Jubayr ibn Nufayr se, apne walid se, al-Nawwas ibn Sam'an se bhi aayi hai: unhone kaha, Maine Nabi ﷺ se poocha, fir unhone isi jaisa zikr kiya.]

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ أَبِي شَبِيبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعْ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقْ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ "
20.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from Habib ibn Abi Thabit, from Maymun ibn Abi Shabib, from Abu Dharr: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Fear Allah wherever you are, and follow the bad deed with a good deed to erase it, and treat people with good character."
20.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se, Habib ibn Abi Thabit se, Maymun ibn Abi Shabib se, Abu Dharr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jahan bhi raho Allah se daro, aur bure amal ke baad achha amal karo taake woh usay mitaa de, aur logon ke saath achhe akhlaq se pesh aao."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ هُوَ : ابْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَجْلَانَ  ، عَنْ الْقَعْقَاعِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَكْمَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِيمَانًا أَحْسَنُهُمْ خُلُقًا "
20.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub, from Muhammad ibn Ajlan, from al-Qa'qa' ibn Hakim, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The most complete of believers in faith is the best of them in character."
20.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid ne Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub se bataya: Mujhse Muhammad ibn Ajlan ne bataya, al-Qa'qa' ibn Hakim se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Momino mein imaan ke lihaaz se sabse mukammal woh hai jinke akhlaq sabse behtar hon."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ هُوَ ابْنُ سَلَمَةَ  عَنْ يُونُسَ  ، وَحُمَيْدٍ  ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَفِيقٌ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ، وَيُعْطِي عَلَيْهِ مَا لَا يُعْطِي عَلَى الْعُنْفِ "
20.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Yunus, and Humayd, from al-Hasan, from Abdullah ibn Mughaffal: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed Allah is gentle, He loves gentleness, and gives for it what He does not give for harshness."
20.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se bataya: Humein Yunus aur Humayd ne bataya, al-Hasan se, Abdullah ibn Mughaffal se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah narm-khoo hai, woh narmi pasand karta hai, aur usper woh deta hai jo sakhti par nahi deta."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ فِي الْأَمْرِ كُلِّهِ "
20.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from al-Awza'i, from al-Zuhri, from Urwah, from Aisha: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed Allah loves gentleness in every matter."
20.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne al-Awza'i se, al-Zuhri se, Urwah se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah har maamle mein narmi pasand karta hai."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْكَرْمَانِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ أَذْهَبْتُ حَبِيبَتَيْهِ فَصَبَرَ وَاحْتَسَبَ، لَمْ أَرْضَ لَهُ بِثَوَابٍ دُونَ الْجَنَّةِ "
20.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Karmani, from Jarir, from al-A'mash, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever I take away his two beloved ones [eyes], and he is patient and seeks reward, I will not be satisfied for him with any reward less than Paradise."
20.hi: Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Karmani ne Jarir se, al-A'mash se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jiske do aziz [aankhen] main le lun, aur woh sabr kare aur sawaab chaahe, to main uske liye Jannat se kam kisi ajr par raazi nahi."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَشْهَبِ : جَعْفَرُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ  ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ  : أَنَّ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ زِيَادٍ عَادَ مَعْقِلَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ فِي مَرَضِهِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ مَعْقِلٌ   : إِنِّي مُحَدِّثُكَ بِحَدِيثٍ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَوْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّ بِي حَيَاةً مَا حَدَّثْتُكَ، إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يَسْتَرْعِيهِ اللَّهُ رَعِيَّةً، يَمُوتُ يَوْمَ يَمُوتُ، وَهُوَ غَاشٌّ لِرَعِيَّتِهِ، إِلَّا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ الْجَنَّةَ "
20.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Abu al-Ashhab (Ja'far ibn Hayyan), from al-Hasan: That Ubaydullah ibn Ziyad visited Ma'qil ibn Yasar in his illness of which he died, so Ma'qil said to him: "I will narrate to you a hadith I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, had I known I had [more] life, I would not have narrated it to you: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'There is no servant whom Allah puts in charge of a flock [of people], who dies on the day he dies while he is deceitful to his flock, except that Allah forbids him Paradise.'"
20.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Abu al-Ashhab (Ja'far ibn Hayyan) se, al-Hasan se bataya: ke Ubaydullah ibn Ziyad Ma'qil ibn Yasar ki us bimaari mein bimaar-pursi ke liye aaye jismein unki maut hui, to Ma'qil ne unse kaha: "Main aapko ek hadith bataata hoon jo maine Rasulullah ﷺ se suni thi, agar mujhe pata hota ke meri zindagi [aur] baaki hai, to main aapko na bataata: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, 'Koi bhi banda nahi jise Allah kisi ra'iyat par zimmedaar banaaye, aur woh jis din mare, apni ra'iyat ke saath dhoke mein ho, magar Allah uspar Jannat haraam kar deta hai.'"

20.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي زُرَيْقُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ  مَوْلَى بَنِي فَزَارَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُسْلِمَ بْنَ قَرَظَةَ الْأَشْجَعِيَّ  يَقُولُ : سَمِعْتُ عَوْفَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ الْأَشْجَعِيَّ   يَقُولُ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" خِيَارُ أَئِمَّتِكُمْ الَّذِينَ تُحِبُّونَهُمْ وَيُحِبُّونَكُمْ، وَتُصَلُّونَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَيُصَلُّونَ عَلَيْكُمْ، وَشِرَارُ أَئِمَّتِكُمْ، الَّذِينَ تُبْغِضُونَهُمْ وَيُبْغِضُونَكُمْ، وَتَلْعَنُونَهُمْ وَيَلْعَنُونَكُمْ ".
قُلْنَا : أَفَلَا نُنَابِذُهُمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ؟ قَالَ : " لَا، مَا أَقَامُوا فِيكُمْ الصَّلَاةَ، أَلَا مَنْ وُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَالٍ فَرَآهُ يَأْتِي شَيْئًا مِنْ مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ، فَلْيَكْرَهْ مَا يَأْتِي مِنْ مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ، وَلَا يَنْزِعَنَّ يَدًا مِنْ طَاعَةٍ ".
 قَالَ ابْنُ جَابِرٍ : فَقُلْتُ : آللَّهِ يَا أَبَا الْمِقْدَامِ ! آللَّهِ، أَسَمِعْتَ هَذَا مِنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ قَرَظَةَ؟ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ، وَجَثَا عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ، فَقَالَ : آللَّهِ لَسَمِعْتُ هَذَا مِنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ قَرَظَةَ، يَقُولُ : سَمِعْتُ عَمِّي عَوْفَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُهُ
20.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from al-Walid ibn Muslim, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid ibn Jabir, from Zurayq ibn Hayyan, freed servant of Banu Fazarah, from Muslim ibn Qarazah al-Ashja'i, from Awf ibn Malik al-Ashja'i: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "The best of your leaders are those you love and they love you, and you pray for them and they pray for you, and the worst of your leaders are those you hate and they hate you, and you curse them and they curse you." We said: "Shall we not oppose them then, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "No, as long as they establish prayer among you; listen, whoever has a ruler placed over him and sees him committing some disobedience to Allah, let him dislike what he does of disobedience to Allah, but let him not withdraw a hand from obedience." Ibn Jabir said: So I said: "By Allah, O Abu al-Miqdam! By Allah, did you hear this from Muslim ibn Qarazah?" So he faced the Qiblah, and knelt on his knees, and said: "By Allah, I indeed heard this from Muslim ibn Qarazah, saying: I heard my uncle Awf ibn Malik, saying: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say it."
20.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne al-Walid ibn Muslim se bataya: Humein Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid ibn Jabir ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Zurayq ibn Hayyan ne bataya (Banu Fazarah ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), ke unhone Muslim ibn Qarazah al-Ashja'i ko kehte suna: Maine Awf ibn Malik al-Ashja'i ko kehte suna: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Tumhare behtareen peshwa woh hain jinhein tum mohabbat karte ho aur woh tumhein mohabbat karte hain, aur tum unke liye dua karte ho aur woh tumhare liye dua karte hain, aur tumhare sabse bure peshwa woh hain jinse tum nafrat karte ho aur woh tumse nafrat karte hain, aur tum unpar lanat karte ho aur woh tumpar lanat karte hain." Humne poocha: "Kya hum unse tab ikhtilaaf na karein, Ya Rasulullah?" Aapne farmaya: "Nahi, jab tak woh tum mein namaz qaayam rakhein; sun lo, jispar koi waali muqarrar kiya jaaye aur woh usay Allah ki kisi nafarmani mein mubtala dekhe, to woh us nafarmani ko na-pasand kare, lekin itaa'at se haath na khainche." Ibn Jabir kehte hain: To maine poocha: "Allah ki qasam, Ae Abu al-Miqdam! Allah ki qasam, kya aapne yeh Muslim ibn Qarazah se suna?" To unhone Qibla ki taraf mudkar apne ghutnon par baith gaye, aur kaha: "Allah ki qasam, maine yeh Muslim ibn Qarazah se suna, unhone kaha: Maine apne chacha Awf ibn Malik ko kehte suna: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko yeh kehte suna."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَسْلَمَ الْعِجْلِيِّ  ، عَنْ بِشْرِ بْنِ شَغَافٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنِ الصُّورِ، فَقَالَ :" قَرْنٌ يُنْفَخُ فِيهِ "
20.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Sulayman al-Taymi, from Aslam al-Ijli, from Bishr ibn Shaghaf, from Abdullah ibn Amr: He said: The Prophet ﷺ was asked about the trumpet, so he said: "A horn which is blown into."
20.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Sulayman al-Taymi se, Aslam al-Ijli se, Bishr ibn Shaghaf se, Abdullah ibn Amr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ se soor (trumpet) ke baare mein poocha gaya, to aapne farmaya: "Ek seengh hai jismein phoonka jaayega."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ : " يَقْبِضُ اللَّهُ الْأَرْضَ وَيَطْوِي السَّمَوَاتِ بِيَمِينِهِ، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ :أَنَا الْمَلِكُ، أَيْنَ مُلُوكُ الْأَرْضِ؟ "
20.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Hurairah: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Allah will grasp the earth and fold the heavens in His right hand, then say: 'I am the King, where are the kings of the earth?'"
20.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Maine Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman ko suna: Maine Abu Hurairah ko kehte suna: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Allah zameen ko apni mutthi mein le lega aur aasmanon ko apne daaye haath mein lapetega, fir farmaayega: 'Main Baadshah hoon, zameen ke baadshah kahan hain?'"

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الصَّعْقُ بْنُ حَزْنٍ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : قِيلَ لَهُ : مَا الْمَقَامُ الْمَحْمُودُ؟، قَالَ : " ذَاكَ يَوْمٌ يَنْزِلُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَلَى كُرْسِيِّهِ يَئِطُّ كَمَا يَئِطُّ الرَّحْلُ الْجَدِيدُ مِنْ تَضَايُقِهِ بِهِ، وَهُوَ كَسَعَةِ مَا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ، وَيُجَاءُ بِكُمْ حُفَاةً، عُرَاةً، غُرْلًا، فَيَكُونُ أَوَّلَ مَنْ يُكْسَى إِبْرَاهِيمُ ، يَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى :اكْسُوا خَلِيلِي، فَيُؤْتَى بِرَيْطَتَيْنِ بَيْضَاوَيْنِ مِنْ رِيَاطِ الْجَنَّةِ، ثُمَّ أُكْسَى عَلَى إِثْرِهِ، ثُمَّ أَقُومُ عَنْ يَمِينِ اللَّهِ مَقَامًا يَغْبِطُنِي الْأَوَّلُونَ وَالْآخِرُونَ "
20.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Fadl, from al-Sa'q ibn Hazn, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Uthman ibn Umayr, from Abu Wa'il, from Ibn Mas'ud, from the Prophet ﷺ: He was asked: What is the Praiseworthy Station? He said: "That is a day when Allah, exalted is He, descends upon His Chair, it creaks as a new saddle creaks from its tightness, and it is as wide as the space between the sky and the earth, and you will be brought barefoot, naked, uncircumcised, and the first to be clothed will be Ibrahim, Allah, exalted is He, will say: 'Clothe My close friend,' so two white garments from the garments of Paradise will be brought, then I will be clothed after him, then I will stand at the right of Allah in a station that the first and the last will envy me for."
20.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Fadl ne al-Sa'q ibn Hazn se, Ali ibn al-Hakam se, Uthman ibn Umayr se, Abu Wa'il se, Ibn Mas'ud se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapse poocha gaya: Maqam-e-Mahmood kya hai? Aapne farmaya: "Yeh woh din hai jab Allah Ta'ala apni Kursi par utrega, woh aisi chatakhti hai jaisa naya kaathi apni tangi se chataakhti hai, aur woh aasmaan aur zameen ke darmiyan ki wus'at ke barabar hai, aur tum nange paaon, bilkul nange, bagair khatna wale laaye jaaoge, so sabse pehle Ibrahim ko kapda pehnaya jaayega, Allah Ta'ala farmaayega: 'Mere khaleel ko pehnaao,' so Jannat ke kapdon mein se do safed chaadar laayi jaayengi, fir mujhe unke baad pehnaaya jaayega, fir main Allah ke daaye taraf ek aise maqam par khada hounga jispar aage aur pichhle log mujhpar raashk karenge."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ : الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، وَعَطَاءُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيُّ  ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ   أَخْبَرَهُمَا : أَنَّ النَّاسَ، قَالُوا لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : هَلْ نَرَى رَبَّنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ؟ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" هَلْ تُمَارُونَ فِي رُؤْيَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ لَيْسَ دُونَهُ سَحَابٌ؟ "، قَالُوا : لَا، يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ : " فَهَلْ تُمَارُونَ فِي الشَّمْسِ لَيْسَ دُونَهَا سَحَابٌ؟ "، قَالُوا : لَا، قَالَ : " فَإِنَّكُمْ تَرَوْنَهُ كَذَلِكَ "
20.en: Narrated by Abu al-Yaman al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb ibn Abi Hamzah, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, and Ata ibn Yazid al-Laythi, from Abu Hurairah: That the people said to the Prophet ﷺ: Will we see our Lord on the Day of Resurrection? So the Prophet ﷺ said: "Do you dispute about seeing the moon on the night it is full, with no clouds obstructing it?" They said, "No, O Messenger of Allah." He said: "Then do you dispute about the sun, with no clouds obstructing it?" They said, "No." He said: "Then you will indeed see Him just as that."
20.hi: Abu al-Yaman al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb ibn Abi Hamzah se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Mujhe Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, aur Ata ibn Yazid al-Laythi ne bataya, ke Abu Hurairah ne unhein bataya: ke logon ne Nabi ﷺ se poocha: Kya hum Qayamat ke din apne Rab ko dekhenge? To Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Kya tum poornima ki raat mein chaand dekhne mein jhagda karte ho, jabke koi baadal usay rokta na ho?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi, Ya Rasulullah." Aapne farmaya: "To kya tum suraj [dekhne] mein jhagda karte ho, jabke koi baadal use rokta na ho?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi." Aapne farmaya: "To tum use isi tarah dekhoge."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : خَطَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : " يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ،إِنَّكُمْ مَحْشُورُونَ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى حُفَاةً عُرَاةً غُرْلًا، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ : # كَمَا بَدَأْنَا أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُعِيدُهُ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ سورة الأنبياء آية 104 # "
20.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from al-Mughirah ibn al-Nu'man, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave a sermon, and said: "O people, indeed you will be gathered to Allah, exalted is He, barefoot, naked, uncircumcised." Then he recited: "As We began the first creation, We will repeat it, a promise binding upon Us; indeed We were to do it" [Surah al-Anbiya, verse 104].
20.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Shu'bah se bataya: Humein al-Mughirah ibn al-Nu'man ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Sa'id ibn Jubayr ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Ibn Abbas se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne khutba diya, aur farmaya: "Ae logo, tum Allah Ta'ala ki taraf nange paaon, bilkul nange, bagair khatna wale, jama kiye jaaoge." Fir aapne padha: "Jis tarah humne pehli baar takhleeq shuru ki thi, hum usay dohraayenge, yeh humpar ek wajib wa'da hai; beshak hum aisa karne wale hain" [Surah Al-Anbiya, aayat 104].

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْبَزَّازُ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، يَقُولُ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" إِذَا جَمَعَ اللَّهُ الْعِبَادَ فِي صَعِيدٍ وَاحِدٍ، نَادَى مُنَادٍ : لِيَلْحَقْ كُلُّ قَوْمٍ بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ، فَيَلْحَقُ كُلُّ قَوْمٍ بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ، وَيَبْقَى النَّاسُ عَلَى حَالِهِمْ، فَيَأْتِيهِمْ، فَيَقُولُ : مَا بَالُ النَّاسِ ذَهَبُوا وَأَنْتُمْ هَاهُنَا؟، فَيَقُولُونَ : نَنْتَظِرُ إِلَهَنَا، فَيَقُولُ : هَلْ تَعْرِفُونَهُ؟ فَيَقُولُونَ : إِذَا تَعَرَّفَ إِلَيْنَا، عَرَفْنَاهُ، فَيَكْشِفُ لَهُمْ عَنْ سَاقِهِ فَيَقَعُونَ سُجُودًا، فَذَلِكَ قَوْلُ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى : # يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَنْ سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ فَلا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سورة القلم آية 42 # وَيَبْقَى كُلُّ مُنَافِقٍ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ، ثُمَّ يَقُودُهُمْ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ "
20.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Bazzaz, from Yunus ibn Bukayr, from Ibn Ishaq, from Sa'id ibn Yasar, from Abu Hurairah: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "When Allah gathers the servants on one plain, a caller will call out: 'Let every people follow what they used to worship,' so every people will follow what they used to worship, and the people [believers] will remain in their state, then He will come to them, and say: 'What is the matter with the people, they went away and you are here?' So they will say: 'We are waiting for our God,' so He will say: 'Do you know Him?' So they will say: 'When He identifies Himself to us, we will know Him,' so He will uncover His shin for them, so they will fall prostrate, and that is the saying of Allah, exalted is He: 'On the day when the shin will be uncovered and they will be called to prostrate, but they will not be able' [Surah al-Qalam, verse 42]. And every hypocrite will remain, unable to prostrate, then He will lead them to Paradise."
20.hi: Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Bazzaz ne Yunus ibn Bukayr se bataya: Mujhe Ibn Ishaq ne bataya: Mujhe Sa'id ibn Yasar ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Hurairah ko kehte suna: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Jab Allah bandon ko ek maidan mein jama kar dega, to ek pukaarne wala pukaarega: 'Har qaum apni ibaadat ki jaane wali cheez ke saath ho jaaye,' so har qaum jo ibaadat karti thi usi ke saath ho jaayegi, aur log [momin] apni haalat mein rahenge, fir woh unke paas aayega, aur poochega: 'Logon ko kya hua ke woh chale gaye aur tum yahaan ho?' To woh kahenge: 'Hum apne Ma'bood ka intezaar kar rahe hain,' to woh poochega: 'Kya tum usay pehchaante ho?' To woh kahenge: 'Jab woh humein apni pehchaan de, to hum usay pehchaan lenge,' to woh unke liye apni pindli khol dega, to woh sajde mein gir jaayenge, aur yehi Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai: 'Jis din pindli khol di jaayegi aur unhein sajde ki dawat di jaayegi to woh na kar sakenge' [Surah Al-Qalam, aayat 42]. Aur har munafiq baaqi reh jaayega, sajda karne ki taaqat na paayega, fir woh unhein Jannat ki taraf le jaayega."

20.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا دُخَيْنٌ الْحَجْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" إِذَا جَمَعَ اللَّهُ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْآخِرِينَ فَقَضَى بَيْنَهُمْ وَفَرَغَ مِنَ الْقَضَاءِ، قَالَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ : قَدْ قَضَى بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا، فَمَنْ يَشْفَعُ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّنَا؟ فَيَقُولُونَ : انْطَلِقُوا إِلَى آدَمَ ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَهُ بِيَدِهِ، وَكَلَّمَهُ، فَيَأْتُونَهُ، فَيَقُولُونَ : قُمْ فَاشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّنَا.
فَيَقُولُ آدَمُ : عَلَيْكُمْ بِنُوحٍ ، فَيَأْتُونَ نُوحًا ، فَيَدُلُّهُمْ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، فَيَأْتُونَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، فَيَدُلُّهُمْ عَلَى مُوسَى ، فَيَأْتُونَ مُوسَى ، فَيَدُلُّهُمْ عَلَى عِيسَى ، فَيَأْتُونَ عِيسَى ، فَيَقُولُ : أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ.
قَالَ : فَيَأْتُونِي فَيَأْذَنُ اللَّهُ G لِي أَنْ أَقُومَ إِلَيْهِ، فَيَثُورُ مَجْلِسِي أَطْيَبَ رِيحٍ شَمَّهَا أَحَدٌ قَطُّ، حَتَّى آتِيَ رَبِّي فَيُشَفِّعَنِي وَيَجْعَلَ لِي نُورًا مِنْ شَعْرِ رَأْسِي إِلَى ظُفْرِ قَدَمِي، فَيَقُولُ الْكَافِرُونَ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ لِإِبْلِيسَ : قَدْ وَجَدَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ مَنْ يَشْفَعُ لَهُمْ، فَقُمْ أَنْتَ فَاشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ، فَإِنَّكَ أَنْتَ أَضْلَلْتَنَا.
قَالَ : فَيَقُومُ، فَيَثُورُ مَجْلِسُهُ أَنْتَنَ رِيحٍ شَمَّهَا أَحَدٌ قَطُّ، ثُمَّ يَعْظُمُ لِجَهَنَّمَ، فَيَقُولُ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ : # وَقَالَ الشَّيْطَانُ لَمَّا قُضِيَ الأَمْرُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَعَدَكُمْ وَعْدَ الْحَقِّ وَوَعَدْتُكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُكُمْ سورة إبراهيم آية 22 # "إِلَى آخِرِ الْآيَةِ
20.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Ziyad, from Dukhayn al-Hajri, from Uqbah ibn Amir al-Juhani: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "When Allah gathers the first and the last, and judges between them and finishes the judgment, the believers will say: 'Our Lord has judged between us, so who will intercede for us to our Lord?' So they will say: 'Go to Adam, for Allah created him with His hand, and spoke to him,' so they will come to him, and say: 'Stand and intercede for us to our Lord.' So Adam will say: 'Go to Nuh,' so they will come to Nuh, and he will direct them to Ibrahim, so they will come to Ibrahim, and he will direct them to Musa, so they will come to Musa, and he will direct them to Isa, so they will come to Isa, so he will say: 'I will direct you to the unlettered Prophet.'" He said: "So they will come to me, and Allah, Azza wa Jall, will permit me to stand toward Him, and the fragrance of my gathering will rise, the most pleasant fragrance anyone ever smelled, until I come to my Lord and He accepts my intercession, and makes for me a light from the hair of my head to the nail of my foot, so the disbelievers will say at that, to Iblis: 'The believers have indeed found someone to intercede for them, so stand and intercede for us to your Lord, for indeed you are the one who led us astray.'" He said: "So he will stand, and the stench of his gathering will rise, the foulest smell anyone ever smelled, then he will be enlarged for Jahannam, and he will say at that: 'And Shaytan will say, when the matter has been decided: Indeed Allah promised you the true promise, and I promised you, but I failed you'" [Surah Ibrahim, verse 22], to the end of the verse.
20.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid ne Abd al-Rahman ibn Ziyad se bataya: Humein Dukhayn al-Hajri ne bataya, Uqbah ibn Amir al-Juhani se: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Jab Allah pehle aur pichhle sab logon ko jama karega aur unke darmiyan faisla kar chuka hoga aur faisle se faarigh ho jaayega, to momin kahenge: 'Humare Rab ne humare darmiyan faisla kar diya, to hamare liye humare Rab se kaun sifarish karega?' To woh kahenge: 'Aadam ke paas jao, kyunki Allah ne unhein apne haath se banaya, aur unse baat ki,' so woh unke paas jaayenge, aur kahenge: 'Khade hoiye aur humare liye humare Rab se sifarish keejiye.' To Aadam kahenge: 'Nuh ke paas jao,' to woh Nuh ke paas jaayenge, to woh unhein Ibrahim ki taraf bhejenge, so woh Ibrahim ke paas jaayenge, to woh unhein Musa ki taraf bhejenge, so woh Musa ke paas jaayenge, to woh unhein Isa ki taraf bhejenge, so woh Isa ke paas jaayenge, to woh kahenge: 'Main tumhein ummi Nabi ki taraf bhejta hoon.'" Aapne farmaya: "So woh mere paas aayenge, aur Allah, Azza wa Jall, mujhe unki taraf khade hone ki ijaazat dega, to meri majlis se aisi khushbu uthegi ke jaisi kisi ne kabhi na soongi ho, yahan tak ke main apne Rab ke paas aaunga aur woh meri sifarish qabool karega, aur mere liye ek noor banaayega mere sar ke baalon se mere pair ke naakhoon tak, to kaafir tab Iblees se kahenge: 'Momino ne apna sifarishi paa liya, to tum khade ho aur apne Rab se humare liye sifarish karo, kyunki tumne hi humein gumraah kiya tha.'"
