Aapne farmaya: "To woh khada hoga, aur uski majlis se aisi badbu uthegi ke jaisi kisi ne kabhi na soongi ho, fir woh Jahannam ke liye bada kar diya jaayega, aur tab woh kahega: 'Aur shaytan kahega jab maamla tay ho chuka hoga: Allah ne tumse sachcha wa'da kiya tha, aur maine tumse wa'da kiya to maine wa'da khilaafi ki'" [Surah Ibrahim, aayat 22], aayat ke aakhir tak.

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ دَعْوَةٌ، وَأُرِيدُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى أَنْ أَخْتَبِئَ دَعْوَتِي شَفَاعَةً لِأُمَّتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ "، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ بْنِ أَسِيدِ بْنِ جَارِيَةَ  مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
20.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Hurairah; a similar chain also via al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri, from Amr ibn Abi Sufyan ibn Asid ibn Jariyah: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "Every prophet has a supplication [that will surely be answered], and I wish, if Allah, exalted is He, wills, to save my supplication as intercession for my nation on the Day of Resurrection." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri: Amr ibn Abi Sufyan ibn Asid ibn Jariyah informed me the like of that, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ.]
20.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Mujhe Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman ne bataya, ke Abu Hurairah ne kaha: Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, "Har Nabi ki ek [qabool hone wali] dua hoti hai, aur main chahta hoon, agar Allah Ta'ala ne chaaha, ke main apni dua ko Qayamat ke din apni ummat ki shifa'at ke liye bacha kar rakhun." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se al-Hakam ibn Nafi' se, Shu'ayb se, al-Zuhri se bhi aayi hai: Mujhe Amr ibn Abi Sufyan ibn Asid ibn Jariyah ne isi jaisi baat bataayi, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se.]

20.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ   يُحَدِّثُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا مِنْ أُمَّتِي بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ ".
فَقَالَ عُكَّاشَةُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ، فَدَعَا، فَقَالَ آخَرُ : ادْعُ اللَّهَ لِي، فَقَالَ : " سَبَقَكَ بِهَا عُكَّاشَةُ "
20.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: That he said: "Seventy thousand of my nation will enter Paradise without accounting." So Ukkashah said: "O Messenger of Allah, pray to Allah to make me among them," so he prayed, then another said: "Pray to Allah for me," so he said: "Ukkashah has preceded you in it."
20.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se bataya: Mujhe Muhammad ibn Ziyad ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Hurairah ko Nabi ﷺ se yeh bayaan karte suna: ke aapne farmaya, "Meri ummat mein se sattar hazaar log bagair hisaab ke Jannat mein dakhil honge." To Ukkashah ne kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, Allah se dua kijiye ke woh mujhe unmein shaamil kare," to aapne dua ki, fir ek aur ne kaha: "Mere liye bhi dua keejiye," to aapne farmaya: "Ukkashah tumse pehle isme aage nikal gaya."

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَدْعَاءِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" لَيَدْخُلَنَّ الْجَنَّةَ بِشَفَاعَةِ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أُمَّتِي أَكْثَرُ مِنْ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ ".
قَالُوا : سِوَاكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟، قَالَ : " سِوَايَ "
20.en: Narrated by al-Mu'alla ibn Asad, from Wuhayb, from Khalid, from Abdullah ibn Shaqiq, from Abdullah ibn Abi al-Jad'a: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "More than Banu Tamim will indeed enter Paradise through the intercession of one man from my nation." They said: "Other than you, O Messenger of Allah?" He said: "Other than me."
20.hi: Al-Mu'alla ibn Asad ne Wuhayb se, Khalid se, Abdullah ibn Shaqiq se, Abdullah ibn Abi al-Jad'a se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Meri ummat mein se ek aadmi ki sifarish se Banu Tamim se zyada log Jannat mein dakhil honge." Sahaba ne poocha: "Aapke siwa, Ya Rasulullah?" Aapne farmaya: "Mere siwa."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ  ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِعَائِشَةَ   : يَا أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، أَرَأَيْتِ قَوْلَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى :# يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ الأَرْضُ غَيْرَ الأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَوَاتُ وَبَرَزُوا لِلَّهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ سورة إبراهيم آية 48 # أَيْنَ النَّاسُ يَوْمَئِذٍ؟ قَالَتْ : سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ : " عَلَى الصِّرَاطِ "
20.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid, from Da'ud, from al-Sha'bi, from Masruq: He said: I said to Aisha: "O Mother of the Believers, what do you think of Allah's saying, exalted is He: 'On the day when the earth will be replaced with another earth, and the heavens [likewise], and they will emerge before Allah, the One, the Overpowering' [Surah Ibrahim, verse 48], where will the people be on that day?" She said: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about that, so he said: "On the Bridge [al-Sirat]."
20.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid se, Da'ud se, al-Sha'bi se, Masruq se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Aisha se poocha: "Ae Ummul-Mumineen, Allah Ta'ala ke is farman ke baare mein aap kya kehti hain: 'Jis din zameen doosri zameen se badal di jaayegi, aur aasmaan bhi, aur woh Allah, Wahid, Qahhar, ke saamne pesh honge' [Surah Ibrahim, aayat 48], us din log kahan honge?" Unhone kaha: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ se isi ke baare mein poocha, to aapne farmaya: "Pul (Siraat) par."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، عَنْ السُّدِّيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ مُرَّةَ  عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ G : # وَإِنْ مِنْكُمْ إِلا وَارِدُهَا كَانَ عَلَى رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَقْضِيًّا سورة مريم آية 71 # فَحَدَّثَنِي : أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ   حَدَّثَهُمْ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" يَرِدُ النَّاسُ النَّارَ ثُمَّ يَصْدُرُونَ عَنْهَا بِأَعْمَالِهِمْ، فَأَوَّلُهُمْ كَلَمْحِ الْبَرْقِ، ثُمَّ كَالرِّيحِ، ثُمَّ كَحُضْرِ الْفَرَسِ، ثُمَّ كَالرَّاكِبِ فِي رَحْلِهِ، ثُمَّ كَشَدِّ الرَّجُلِ، ثُمَّ كَمَشْيِهِ "
20.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah, from Isra'il, from al-Suddi: He said: I asked Murrah about Allah's saying, Azza wa Jall: "And there is none of you except he will come to it, it is upon your Lord an inevitable decree" [Surah Maryam, verse 71], so he narrated to me: that Abdullah ibn Mas'ud told them, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The people will come to the Fire, then depart from it according to their deeds: the first of them like the flash of lightning, then like the wind, then like the running of a horse, then like a rider on his mount, then like the running of a man, then like his walking."
20.hi: Ubaydullah ne Isra'il se, al-Suddi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Murrah se Allah, Azza wa Jall, ke is farman ke baare mein poocha: "Aur tum mein se koi bhi nahi magar woh isme zaroor aayega, yeh tumhare Rab par ek fixed faisla hai" [Surah Maryam, aayat 71], to unhone mujhe bataaya: ke Abdullah ibn Mas'ud ne unhein bataya, unhone kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Log Jahannam par aayenge, fir apne amal ke hisaab se usse laut aayenge: unmein se pehla bijli ki chamak ki tarah, fir hawaa ki tarah, fir ghode ki daud ki tarah, fir apni sawaari par sawaar ki tarah, fir aadmi ki daud ki tarah, fir uski chaal ki tarah."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" يُؤْتَى بِالْمَوْتِ بِكَبْشٍ أَغْبَرَ، فَيُوقَفُ بَيْنَ الْجَنَّةِ وَالنَّارِ، فَيُقَالُ : يَا أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ، فَيَشْرَئِبُّونَ وَيَنْظُرُونَ، وَيُقَالُ : يَا أَهْلَ النَّارِ، فَيَشْرَئِبُّونَ وَيَنْظُرُونَ، وَيَرَوْنَ أَنْ قَدْ جَاءَ الْفَرَجُ، فَيُذْبَحُ وَيُقَالُ : خُلُودٌ لَا مَوْتَ "
20.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Asim, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Death will be brought in the form of a dust-colored ram, and it will be made to stand between Paradise and the Fire, and it will be said: 'O people of Paradise,' so they will crane their necks and look, and it will be said: 'O people of the Fire,' so they will crane their necks and look, and they will see that relief has come, so it will be slaughtered, and it will be said: 'Eternity, no death.'"
20.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Asim se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Maut ko ek khaakastari mendhe ki shakl mein laaya jaayega, aur usay Jannat aur Jahannam ke darmiyan khada kiya jaayega, aur kaha jaayega: 'Ae Jannat walo,' to woh gardanein utha kar dekhenge, aur kaha jaayega: 'Ae Jahannam walo,' to woh gardanein utha kar dekhenge, aur woh samajhenge ke raahat aa gayi hai, to usay zabah kiya jaayega aur kaha jaayega: 'Hamesha rehna hai, koi maut nahi.'"

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ  ، عَنْ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَخْطُبُ، فَقَالَ :" أَنْذَرْتُكُمْ النَّارَ، أَنْذَرْتُكُمْ النَّارَ، أَنْذَرْتُكُمْ النَّارَ " فَمَا زَالَ يَقُولُهَا حَتَّى لَوْ كَانَ فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا، لَسَمِعَهُ أَهْلُ السُّوقِ، حَتَّى سَقَطَتْ خَمِيصَةٌ كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ عِنْدَ رِجْلَيْهِ
20.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Shu'bah, from Simak, from al-Nu'man ibn Bashir: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ giving a sermon, and he said: "I have warned you of the Fire, I have warned you of the Fire, I have warned you of the Fire," and he kept saying it until, had he been in this position of mine, the people of the market would have heard him, until a shawl he was wearing fell down near his feet.
20.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Shu'bah se, Simak se, al-Nu'man ibn Bashir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko khutba dete suna, aapne farmaya, "Maine tumhein Jahannam se daraaya, maine tumhein Jahannam se daraaya, maine tumhein Jahannam se daraaya," aur aap yeh kehte rahe yahan tak ke agar aap meri is jagah par hote, to bazaar wale bhi sun lete, yahan tak ke ek chaadar jo aap par thi woh aapke paaon ke paas gir gayi.

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنَا بَهْزُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ : " كَانَ عَبْدٌ مِنْ عِبَادِ اللَّهِ، وَكَانَ لَا يَدِينُ لِلَّهِ دِينًا، وَإِنَّهُ لَبِثَ حَتَّى ذَهَبَ مِنْهُ عُمُرٌ وَبَقِيَ عُمُرٌ، فَعَلِمَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَبْتَئِرْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرًا، فَدَعَا بَنِيهِ، فَقَالَ : أَيُّ أَبٍ تَعْلَمُونِي؟ قَالُوا : خَيْرُهُ يَا أَبَانَا، قَالَ : فَإِنِّي لَا أَدَعُ عِنْدَ أَحَدٍ مِنْكُمْ مَالًا هُوَ مِنِّي إِلَّا أَخَذْتُهُ مِنْكُمْ، أَوْ لَتَفْعَلُنَّ مَا آمُرُكُمْ، قَالَ : فَأَخَذَ مِنْهُمْ مِيثَاقًا وَرَبِّي، قَالَ : أَمَّا أَنَا إِذَا مُتُّ فَخُذُونِي فَأَحْرِقُونِي بِالنَّارِ حَتَّى إِذَا كُنْتُ حُمَمًا فَدُقُّونِي ثُمَّ اذْرُونِي فِي الرِّيحِ، قَالَ : فَفَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ بِهِ وَرَبِّ مُحَمَّدٍ حِينَ مَاتَ، فَجِيءَ بِهِ أَحْسَنَ مَا كَانَ قَطُّ، فَعُرِضَ عَلَى رَبِّهِ، فَقَالَ :مَا حَمَلَكَ عَلَى النَّارِ؟ قَالَ : خَشْيَتُكَ يَا رَبِّ، قَالَ : إِنِّي أَسْمَعُكَ لَرَاهِبًا، قَالَ : فَتِيبَ عَلَيْهِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : يَبْتَئِرُ، يَدَّخِرُ
20.en: Narrated by al-Nadr ibn Shumayl, from Bahz ibn Hakim, from his father, from his grandfather; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "There was a servant among the servants of Allah, and he had no religion towards Allah, and he remained until part of his life had passed and part remained, and he knew he had not stored up any good with Allah, so he called his sons, and said: 'What kind of father do you know me to be?' They said: 'The best, O our father.' He said: 'I will not leave with any of you any wealth that is mine except that I take it from you, or you must do what I command you.'" He said: "So he took a pledge from them, by my Lord," he said: "'As for me, when I die, take me and burn me with fire, until when I am ashes, crush me, then scatter me in the wind.'" He said: "So they did that to him, by the Lord of Muhammad, when he died, and he was brought forth in the best state he had ever been, and he was presented to his Lord, so He said: 'What made you do that?' He said: 'Fear of You, O Lord.' He said: 'I indeed hear you as one who feared.'" He said: "So he was forgiven." Abu Muhammad said: yabtaʾiru: he stores up.
20.hi: Al-Nadr ibn Shumayl ne Bahz ibn Hakim se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Allah ke bandon mein se ek banda tha, aur uska Allah ke saamne koi deen nahi tha, aur woh rahtaa raha yahan tak ke uski umar ka ek hissa guzar gaya aur ek hissa baaki reh gaya, to usay maloom hua ke usne Allah ke paas koi bhalaai zakheera nahi ki, to usne apne beton ko bulaaya, aur poocha: 'Tum mujhe kaisa baap samajhte ho?' Unhone kaha: 'Behtareen, Ae humare baap.' Usne kaha: 'Main tum mein se kisi ke paas apna koi maal nahi chhodunga siwaay iske ke main use tumse le loon, ya tumhein zaroor woh karna hoga jo main tumhein hukum dun.'" Aapne farmaya: "To usne unse ahad liya, mere Rab ki qasam," aapne farmaya: "'Rahi baat meri, jab main mar jaaun, to mujhe le kar aag mein jala dena, yahan tak ke jab main raakh ho jaaun, to mujhe kuchal dena, fir mujhe hawaa mein bikhera dena.'" Aapne farmaya: "To unhone Muhammad ke Rab ki qasam usi tarah kiya jab woh mara, to usay uski behtareen haalat mein laaya gaya jaisa woh kabhi na tha, aur usay uske Rab ke saamne pesh kiya gaya, to usne poocha: 'Tumhein yeh karne par kis cheez ne uksaaya?' Usne kaha: 'Tera khauf, Ae Rab.' Usne farmaya: 'Main tumhein zaroor darne wala pa raha hoon.'" Aapne farmaya: "To usay bakhsh diya gaya." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: 'Yabtaʾiru' ka matlab hai: woh zakheera karta hai.

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" دَخَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ النَّارَ فِي هِرَّةٍ، فَقِيلَ : لَا أَنْتِ أَطْعَمْتِيهَا وَسَقَيْتِيهَا، وَلَا أَنْتِ أَرْسَلْتِيهَا فَتَأْكُلَ مِنْ خَشَاشِ الْأَرْضِ "
20.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A woman entered the Fire because of a cat, it was said: 'You neither fed it nor gave it water, nor did you release it to eat from the vermin of the earth.'"
20.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Malik se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Ek aurat ek billi ki wajah se Jahannam mein dakhil hui, usse kaha gaya: 'Na tumne isay khilaya na pilaya, aur na hi isay chhoda ke woh zameen ke keede-makode khaaye.'"

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مِقْلَاصٍ  مَوْلَى أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَكُنْيَتُهُ : أَبُو يَحْيَى ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ دَرَّاجًا : أَبَا السَّمْحِ  ، يَقُولُ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْهَيْثَمِ  ، يَقُولُ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ  ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ : رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَيُسَلَّطُ عَلَى الْكَافِرِ فِي قَبْرِهِ تِسْعَةٌ وَتِسْعُونَ تِنِّينًا تَنْهَشُهُ وَتَلْدَغُهُ حَتَّى تَقُومَ السَّاعَةُ، وَلَوْ أَنَّ تِنِّينًا مِنْهَا نَفَخَ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَا نَبَتَتْ خَضْرَاءُ "
20.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub ibn Miqlas, freed servant of Abu Hurairah (kunyah: Abu Yahya), from Darraj Abu al-Samh, from Abu al-Haytham, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Ninety-nine dragons will be set upon the disbeliever in his grave, biting and stinging him, until the Hour is established, and if one of these dragons breathed upon the earth, no green thing would grow."
20.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid ne Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub ibn Miqlas se bataya (Abu Hurairah ke azaad kiye hue ghulam, kunyat: Abu Yahya): Unhone kaha, Maine Darraj Abu al-Samh ko kehte suna: Maine Abu al-Haytham ko kehte suna: Maine Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Kaafir par uski qabr mein unnisan ajgar musallat kiye jaayenge jo usay kaatenge aur dansenge yahan tak ke Qayamat qaayam ho, aur agar unmein se ek ajgar zameen par phoonk maare, to koi hari cheez na ugegi."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَزْهَرُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ وَاسِعٍ  ، قَالَ : دَخَلْتُ عَلَى بِلَالِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، فَقُلْتُ : إِنَّ أَبَاكَ  حَدَّثَنِي، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : " إِنَّفِي جَهَنَّمَ وَادِيًا يُقَالُ لَهُ : هَبْهَبُ، يَسْكُنُهُ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ "فَإِيَّاكَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنْهُمْ
20.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Azhar ibn Sinan, from Muhammad ibn Wasi': He said: I entered upon Bilal ibn Abi Burdah, and said: "Your father narrated to me, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said: 'Indeed in Jahannam there is a valley called Habhab, every tyrant dwells in it,' so beware that you be among them."
20.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Azhar ibn Sinan se bataya: Humein Muhammad ibn Wasi' ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Bilal ibn Abi Burdah ke paas gaya, aur kaha: "Aapke walid ne mujhe bataya, apne walid se, Nabi ﷺ se, ke aapne farmaya: 'Jahannam mein ek waadi hai jise Habhab kaha jaata hai, har zaalim usmein rehta hai,' so isse bacho ke kahin tum unmein se na ho jao.

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ أَبِي مَسْلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَمَّا أَهْلُ النَّارِ الَّذِينَ هُمْ أَهْلُ النَّارِ، فَإِنَّهُمْ لَا يَمُوتُونَ فِي النَّارِ، وَأَمَّا نَاسٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ، فَإِنَّ النَّارَ تُصِيبُهُمْ عَلَى قَدْرِ ذُنُوبِهِمْ، فَيُحْرَقُونَ فِيهَا حَتَّى إِذَا صَارُوا فَحْمًا، أُذِنَ فِي الشَّفَاعَةِ فَيَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ النَّارِ ضَبَائِرَ ضَبَائِرَ، فَيُنْثَرُونَ عَلَى أَنْهَارِ الْجَنَّةِ.
فَيُقَالُ لِأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ : يُفِيضُوا عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ الْمَاءِ.
قَالَ : فَيُفِيضُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَتَنْبُتُ لُحُومُهُمْ كَمَا تَنْبُتُ الْحِبَّةُ فِي حَمِيلِ السَّيْلِ "
20.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid ibn Abdullah, from Sa'id ibn Yazid Abu Maslamah, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "As for the people of the Fire who are [permanently] the people of the Fire, they do not die in the Fire, but as for some people, the Fire touches them according to their sins, and they are burned in it until they become coal, then permission is given for intercession, and they come out of the Fire in bunches, and they are scattered over the rivers of Paradise." It will be said to the people of Paradise: "Pour water over them." He said: "So they will pour it over them, and their flesh will grow just as a seed grows in the silt carried by a flood."
20.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid ibn Abdullah se, Sa'id ibn Yazid Abu Maslamah se, Abu Nadrah se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jahannam ke woh log jo [hamesha ke liye] Jahannam wale hain, woh Jahannam mein nahi marenge, lekin kuch log aise honge, ke Jahannam unhein unke gunahon ke andaaze se lagti hai, to unhein usmein jalaaya jaayega yahan tak ke woh koila ban jaayein, fir shifa'at ki ijaazat di jaayegi to woh Jahannam se jhundon mein nikalenge, aur unhein Jannat ki nehron par bikher diya jaayega." Jannat walon se kaha jaayega: "Unpar paani daalo." Aapne farmaya: "To woh unpar daalenge, to unka gosht aise ugega jaise beej seelaab ke bahaaye hue keechad mein ugta hai."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ  ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ الثَّقَفِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَادِقٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لِلْجَنَّةِ ثَمَانِيَةُ أَبْوَابٍ "
20.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Humayd, from Mu'awiyah ibn Hisham, from Sharik, from Uthman al-Thaqafi, from Abu Sadiq, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid, from Abdullah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "For Paradise there are eight gates."
20.hi: Ahmad ibn Humayd ne Mu'awiyah ibn Hisham se, Sharik se, Uthman al-Thaqafi se, Abu Sadiq se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid se, Abdullah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jannat ke aath darwaze hain."

20.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ يَنْعَمُ لَا يَبْؤُسُ : لَا تَبْلَى ثِيَابُهُ، وَلَا يَفْنَى شَبَابُهُ، فِي الْجَنَّةِ مَا لَا عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ وَلَا أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ، وَلَا خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ "
20.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ayyub, from Abu Rafi', from Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever enters Paradise, lives in bliss, does not suffer misery: his clothes do not wear out, nor does his youth fade, in Paradise is what no eye has seen, nor ear heard, nor has occurred to the heart of any human being."
20.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ayyub se, Abu Rafi' se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jo Jannat mein dakhil hoga, woh naaz-o-ne'mat mein rahega, museebat na uthaayega: uske kapde purane nahi honge, aur uski jawaani khatam nahi hogi, Jannat mein woh cheez hai jise na kisi aankh ne dekha, na kisi kaan ne suna, aur na kisi insaan ke dil mein khayal aaya."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَمَوْضِعُ سَوْطٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا، وَاقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ : # كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ وَإِنَّمَا تُوَفَّوْنَ أُجُورَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَمَنْ زُحْزِحَ عَنِ النَّارِ وَأُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ فَقَدْ فَازَ وَمَا الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلا مَتَاعُ الْغُرُورِ سورة آل عمران آية 185 # "الْآيَةَ
20.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "A whip's length of space in Paradise is better than the world and all that is in it, and recite if you wish: 'Every soul will taste death, and you will only be given your full reward on the Day of Resurrection; so whoever is moved away from the Fire and admitted to Paradise has indeed succeeded, and the life of this world is nothing but the enjoyment of delusion' [Surah Ali Imran, verse 185]," the verse.
20.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jannat mein ek kode ki jagah duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai, aur agar chaho to padho: 'Har jaan ko maut ka mazaa chakhna hai, aur tumhein tumhara poora badla to Qayamat ke din hi diya jaayega; so jo Jahannam se hataaya jaaye aur Jannat mein dakhil kiya jaaye, woh kaamyaab ho gaya, aur duniya ki zindagi to sirf dhoke ka saaman hai' [Surah Aal-e-Imran, aayat 185]," aayat [ka baaki hissa].

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ سَعْدَانَ الْجُهَنِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُجَاهِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُدِلَّةَ  : أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، يَقُولُ : قُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ : الْجَنَّةُ مَا بِنَاؤُهَا؟، قَالَ :" لَبِنَةٌ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَلَبِنَةٌ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ، مِلَاطُهَا الْمِسْكُ الْأَذْفَرُ، وَحَصْبَاؤُهَا الْيَاقُوتُ وَاللُّؤْلُؤُ، وَتُرَابُهَا الزَّعْفَرَانُ، مَنْ يَدْخُلْهَا يَخْلُدْ فِيهَا يَنْعَمُ لَا يَبْؤُسُ، لَا يَفْنَى شَبَابُهُمْ، وَلَا تَبْلَى ثِيَابُهُمْ "
20.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Sa'dan al-Juhani, from Abu Mujahid, from Abu Mudillah: That he heard Abu Hurairah say: We said: "O Messenger of Allah, what is Paradise built from?" He said: "A brick of gold and a brick of silver, its mortar is fragrant musk, its pebbles are ruby and pearl, and its soil is saffron, whoever enters it lives in it forever, in bliss, without misery, their youth never fading, their clothes never wearing out."
20.hi: Abu Asim ne Sa'dan al-Juhani se, Abu Mujahid se bataya: Humein Abu Mudillah ne bataya: ke unhone Abu Hurairah ko kehte suna: Humne poocha Ya Rasulullah: Jannat kis cheez se banai gayi hai? Aapne farmaya: "Ek eent sone ki aur ek eent chandi ki, uska masala khushbudaar mushk hai, uski kankariyaan yaqoot aur moti hain, aur uski mitti za'faran hai, jo isme dakhil hoga woh hamesha usmein rahega, naaz-o-ne'mat mein, museebat ke bagair, unki jawaani kabhi khatam nahi hogi, aur unke kapde kabhi purane nahi honge."

20.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو قُدَامَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" جَنَّاتُ الْفِرْدَوْسِ أَرْبَعٌ : ثِنْتَانِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ : حِلْيَتُهُمَا وَآنِيَتُهُمَا، وَمَا فِيهِمَا، وَثِنْتَانِ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ : حِلْيَتُهُمَا وَآنِيَتُهُمَا وَمَا فِيهِمَا، وَلَيْسَ بَيْنَ الْقَوْمِ وَبَيْنَ أَنْ يَنْظُرُوا إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا رِدَاءُ الْكِبْرِيَاءِ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فِي جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ، وَهَذِهِ الْأَنْهَارُ تَشْخُبُ مِنْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ فِي جَوْبَةٍ ثُمَّ تَصْعَدُ بَعْدُ أَنْهَارًا ".
 قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : جَوْبَةٌ : مَا يُجَابُ عَنْهُ الْأَرْضُ
20.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Abu Qudamah, from Abu Imran al-Jawni, from Abu Bakr ibn Abdullah ibn Qays, from his father: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The gardens of al-Firdaws are four: two of gold, their adornments, their vessels, and what is in them; and two of silver, their adornments, their vessels, and what is in them; and there is nothing between the people and looking upon their Lord except the cloak of majesty upon His Face, in the gardens of Eden, and these rivers flow from the gardens of Eden in a hollow, then afterward ascend as rivers." Abdullah said: al-jawbah is: what is dug out from the ground.
20.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Abu Qudamah se, Abu Imran al-Jawni se, Abu Bakr ibn Abdullah ibn Qays se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Firdaws ke baagh chaar hain: do sone ke: unki saj-sajaawat aur unke bartan, aur jo unmein hai; aur do chandi ke: unki saj-sajaawat aur unke bartan aur jo unmein hai, aur logon aur apne Rab ko dekhne ke darmiyan uski chaadar-e-kibriya ke siwa kuch nahi hoga jo uske chehre par hai, Jannat-ul-Adan mein, aur yeh nehrein Jannat-ul-Adan se ek gaddhe mein bahti hain fir uske baad nadiyon ki soorat mein oopar chadhti hain." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: 'Jawbah' woh hai jo zameen se khoda gaya ho.

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ أَوَّلَ زُمْرَةٍ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ عَلَى أَحْسَنِ كَوْكَبٍ إِضَاءَةً فِي السَّمَاءِ ".
 فَقَامَ عُكَّاشَةُ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ، فَقَالَ : " اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ مِنْهُمْ ".
ثُمَّ قَامَ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ، فَقَالَ : " سَبَقَكَ بِهَا عُكَّاشَةُ "
20.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed the first group who will enter Paradise from my nation will be in the form of the moon on the night it is full, then those next after them in the brightest star of the sky." So Ukkashah stood, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, pray to Allah to make me among them," so he said: "O Allah, make him among them." Then another man stood, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, pray to Allah to make me among them," so he said: "Ukkashah has preceded you in it."
20.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Meri ummat mein se sabse pehla giroh jo Jannat mein dakhil hoga, poornima ki raat ke chaand ki shakl mein hoga, fir unke baad wale aasmaan mein sabse chamakdaar sitaare ki tarah honge." To Ukkashah khade hue, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, Allah se dua kijiye ke woh mujhe unmein shaamil kare," to aapne farmaya: "Allahumma-ja'alhu minhum" [Ae Allah, use unmein shaamil kar]. Fir ek aur aadmi khada hua, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, Allah se dua kijiye ke woh mujhe unmein shaamil kare," to aapne farmaya: "Ukkashah tumse pehle isme aage nikal gaya."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ يَعِيشَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ  ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الْأَغَرِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، وَأَبِي سَعِيدٍ   ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : # وَنُودُوا أَنْ تِلْكُمُ الْجَنَّةُ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ سورة الأعراف آية 43 #، قَالَ :" نُودُوا : صِحُّوا فَلَا تَسْقَمُوا، وَانْعَمُوا فَلَا تَبْؤُسُوا، وَشِبُّوا فَلَا تَهْرَمُوا، وَاخْلُدُوا فَلَا تَمُوتُوا "
20.en: Narrated by Ubayd ibn Ya'ish, from Yahya ibn Adam, from Hamzah ibn Habib, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Aghar, from Abu Hurairah, and Abu Sa'id, from the Prophet ﷺ: Regarding: "And it will be called out to them: This is Paradise, you have been given it as inheritance for what you used to do" [Surah al-A'raf, verse 43], he said: "It will be called out: Be healthy and never fall ill, live in bliss and never suffer misery, remain youthful and never grow old, and live forever and never die."
20.hi: Ubayd ibn Ya'ish ne Yahya ibn Adam se bataya: Humein Hamzah ibn Habib ne bataya, Abu Ishaq se, al-Aghar se, Abu Hurairah aur Abu Sa'id se, Nabi ﷺ se, is aayat ke baare mein: "Aur unhein pukaara jaayega: Yeh woh Jannat hai jiske tum waaris banaaye gaye ho, us cheez ke badle jo tum karte the" [Surah Al-A'raf, aayat 43], Aapne farmaya: "Unhein pukaara jaayega: Tandurust raho aur kabhi bimaar na pado, naaz-o-ne'mat mein raho aur kabhi museebat na uthaao, jawaan raho aur kabhi budhe na ho, aur hamesha raho aur kabhi na maro."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ ثُمَامَةَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ الْمُحَلِّمِيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ أَرْقَمَ  ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ لَيُعْطَى قُوَّةَ مِائَةِ رَجُلٍ فِي الْأَكْلِ وَالشُّرْبِ وَالْجِمَاعِ، وَالشَّهْوَةِ "، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ : إِنَّ الَّذِي يَأْكُلُ وَيَشْرَبُ تَكُونُ مِنْهُ الْحَاجَةُ؟، َفَقَالَ : " يَفِيضُ مِنْ جِلْدِهِ عَرَقٌ، فَإِذَا بَطْنُهُ قَدْ ضَمَرَ "
20.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from al-A'mash, from Thumamah ibn Uqbah al-Muhallimi: He said: I heard Zayd ibn Arqam say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A man from the people of Paradise will indeed be given the strength of a hundred men in eating, and drinking, and intercourse, and desire." So a man from the Jews said: "Would the one who eats and drinks have a need [to relieve himself]?" So he said: "Sweat will flow from his skin, and his stomach will become slender."
20.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne al-A'mash se, Thumamah ibn Uqbah al-Muhallimi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Zayd ibn Arqam ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jannat wale mein se ek aadmi ko sau aadmiyon ki taaqat di jaayegi khaane, peene, jima', aur khwaahish mein." To Yahoodiyon mein se ek aadmi ne poocha: "Jo khaayega aur piyega, usay zaroorat to hogi?" To aapne farmaya: "Uski jild se pasina bahega, to uska pet patla ho jaayega."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الرِّفَاعِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ يَعْنِي : ابْنَ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ الْأَحْوَلِ  ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ شَبَابٌ، جُرْدٌ، مُرْدٌ، كُحْلٌ، لَا تَبْلَى ثِيَابُهُمْ، وَلَا يَفْنَى شَبَابُهُمْ "
20.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Rifa'i, from Mu'adh ibn Hisham, from his father, from Amir al-Ahwal, from Shahr ibn Hawshab, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "The people of Paradise are youthful, hairless, beardless, with kohl-lined eyes, their clothes never wear out, and their youth never fades."
20.hi: Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Rifa'i ne Mu'adh ibn Hisham se, apne walid se, Amir al-Ahwal se, Shahr ibn Hawshab se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jannat wale jawaan honge, baalon se saaf, be-daadhi wale, aankhon mein surme wale, unke kapde purane nahi honge, aur unki jawaani khatam nahi hogi."

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ  : أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرًا   قِيلَ لِأَبِي عَاصِمٍ : عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟.
قَالَ : نَعَمْ" أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ لَا يَبُولُونَ، وَلَا يَمْتَخِطُونَ، وَلَا يَتَغَوَّطُونَ، وَيَكُونُ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُمْ جُشَاءً، يَأْكُلُونَ، وَيَشْرَبُونَ، وَيُلْهَمُونَ التَّسْبِيحَ وَالْحَمْدَ، كَمَا يُلْهَمُونَ النَّفَسَ "
20.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir; it was said to Abu Asim, about the Prophet ﷺ: It was said to Abu Asim: from the Prophet ﷺ? He said: Yes, "the people of Paradise do not urinate, nor blow their noses, nor defecate, and that [waste] from them becomes belching, they eat and drink, and are inspired to glorify and praise [Allah], just as they are inspired to breathe."
20.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Abu al-Zubayr ne bataya: ke unhone Jabir ko suna - Abu Asim se poocha gaya: Nabi ﷺ se? Unhone kaha: Haan, "Jannat wale na peshaab karte hain, na naak saaf karte hain, na qaza-e-hajat karte hain, aur unse yeh sab dakaar ki shakl mein hota hai, woh khaate aur peete hain, aur unhein tasbih aur hamd ki ilhaam di jaati hai, jaise unhein saans lene ki ilhaam di jaati hai."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " يَقُولُ اللَّهُ G :أَعْدَدْتُ لِعِبَادِي الصَّالِحِينَ مَا لَا عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ وَلَا أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ، وَلَا خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ، وَاقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ : # فَلا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ سورة السجدة آية 17 # "
20.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah, Azza wa Jall, says: I have prepared for My righteous servants what no eye has seen, nor ear heard, nor has occurred to the heart of any human being, and recite if you wish: 'And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for the eyes, as reward for what they used to do' [Surah al-Sajdah, verse 17]."
20.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah, Azza wa Jall, farmaata hai: Maine apne neik bandon ke liye woh cheez taiyaar ki hai jise na kisi aankh ne dekha, na kisi kaan ne suna, aur na kisi insaan ke dil mein khayal aaya, aur agar chaho to padho: 'To koi bhi jaan nahi jaanti unke liye kya-kya aankhon ki thandak chhupaayi gayi hai, unke amal ke badle mein' [Surah As-Sajdah, aayat 17]."

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ أَدْنَى أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ مَنْزِلًا مَنْ يَتَمَنَّى عَلَى اللَّهِ، فَيُقَالُ لَهُ : لَكَ ذَاكَ وَمِثْلُهُ مَعَهُ.
إِلَّا أَنَّهُ يُلَقَّى سِوَى كَذَا وَكَذَا، فَيُقَالُ لَهُ : ذَاكَ لَكَ وَمِثْلُهُ مَعَهُ ".
قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ   : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " فَيُقَالُ لَهُ : ذَاكَ وَعَشْرَةُ أَمْثَالِهِ "
20.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed the lowest in position among the people of Paradise is one who wishes something from Allah, so it is said to him: 'That is yours, and its like with it.' Except that he will be given besides such-and-such, and it will be said to him: 'That is yours, and its like with it.'" Abu Sa'id al-Khudri said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "So it will be said to him: 'That, and ten times its like.'"
20.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jannat walon mein sabse chhota darjaa uska hoga jo Allah se koi tamanna kare, to usse kaha jaayega: 'Yeh tumhara hai, aur uske saath usi jaisa aur.' Siwaay iske ke usay iske ilaawa fulaan-fulaan bhi milega, to usse kaha jaayega: 'Yeh tumhara hai, aur uske saath usi jaisa aur.'" Abu Sa'id al-Khudri kehte hain: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "To usse kaha jaayega: 'Yeh, aur iska das guna.'"

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَازِمٍ  ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ لَيَتَرَاءَوْنَ أَهْلَ الْغُرَفِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ كَمَا تَرَوْنَ الْكَوْكَبَ الدُّرِّيَّ فِي السَّمَاءِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو حَازِمٍ : فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ  ، فَحَدَّثَنِي، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ   : أَنَّهُ قَالَ : " الْكَوْكَبُ الدُّرِّيُّ فِي السَّمَاءِ الشَّرْقِيُّ وَالْغَرْبِيُّ "
20.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Wuhayb, from Abu Hazim, from Sahl ibn Sa'd: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed the people of Paradise will look at the dwellers of the upper chambers in Paradise, just as you see a brilliant star in the sky." Abu Hazim said: So I narrated this hadith to al-Nu'man ibn Abi Ayyash, so he narrated to me, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: that he said: "The brilliant star in the sky, east and west."
20.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Wuhayb se bataya: Humein Abu Hazim ne bataya, Sahl ibn Sa'd se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jannat wale Jannat ke bulund kamron ke rehne walon ko dekhenge jaise tum aasmaan mein chamakta hua sitaara dekhte ho." Abu Hazim kehte hain: To maine yeh hadith al-Nu'man ibn Abi Ayyash ko sunaayi, to unhone mujhe bataya, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se: ke unhone kaha: "Chamakta sitaara aasmaan mein, mashriq aur maghrib mein."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمِنْهَالِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الْقُرْدُوسِيُّ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَا فِي الْجَنَّةِ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا لَهُ زَوْجَتَانِ، إِنَّهُ لَيَرَى مُخَّ سَاقِهِمَا مِنْ وَرَاءِ سَبْعِينَ حُلَّةً، مَا فِيهَا مِنْ عَزَبٍ "
20.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Minhal, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Hisham al-Qurdusi, from Muhammad ibn Sirin, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There is no one in Paradise except that he has two wives, and he can indeed see the marrow of their shins through seventy garments, there is no unmarried person in it."
20.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Minhal ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Hisham al-Qurdusi se, Muhammad ibn Sirin se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jannat mein koi bhi aisa nahi jiski do biwiyaan na hon, woh unki pindliyon ki gudi ko sattar poshaakon ke peechhe se dekh sakega, usmein koi kunwara nahi hoga."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" الْخَيْمَةُ دُرَّةٌ مُجَوَّفَةٌ، طُولُهَا فِي السَّمَاءِ سِتُّونَ مِيلًا، فِي كُلِّ زَاوِيَةٍ مِنْهَا أَهْلٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ لَا يَرَاهُمْ الْآخَرُونَ "
20.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hammam, from Abu Imran al-Jawni, from Abu Bakr ibn Abdullah ibn Qays, from his father: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The tent is a hollow pearl, its height in the sky is sixty miles, in every corner of it are family members for the believer whom the others do not see."
20.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hammam se bataya: Humein Abu Imran al-Jawni ne bataya, Abu Bakr ibn Abdullah ibn Qays se, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Khaymah ek khokhla moti hai, uski oonchaai aasmaan mein sath meel hai, uske har kone mein momin ke gharwale hain jinhein doosre nahi dekh sakte."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، وَالْقَوَارِيرِيُّ  ، عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ الْأَحْوَلِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الصِّدِّيقِ النَّاجِيِّ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ إِذَا اشْتَهَى الْوَلَدَ فِي الْجَنَّةِ، كَانَ حَمْلُهُ وَوَضْعُهُ وَسِنُّهُ فِي سَاعَةٍ كَمَا اشْتَهَى "
20.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yazid, and al-Qawariri, from Mu'adh ibn Hisham, from his father, from Amir al-Ahwal, from Abu al-Siddiq al-Naji, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "When the believer desires a child in Paradise, its conception, and its delivery, and its age, will be in an hour, just as he desired."
20.hi: Muhammad ibn Yazid, aur al-Qawariri ne Mu'adh ibn Hisham se bataya: Humein unke walid ne bataya, Amir al-Ahwal se, Abu al-Siddiq al-Naji se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Jab momin Jannat mein bachcha chaahega, to uska hamal, uski paidaish, aur uski umar, sab ek hi ghante mein waise hi hoga jaisa usne chaha."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ  ، قَالَ : أُرَاهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ عِشْرُونَ وَمِائَةُ صَفٍّ : ثَمَانُونَ مِنْهَا أُمَّتِي، وَأَرْبَعُونَ سَائِرُ النَّاسِ "
20.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Ala, from Mu'awiyah ibn Hisham, from Sufyan, from Alqamah ibn Marthad, from Sulayman ibn Buraydah, from his father (as he believes): He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The people of Paradise are one hundred and twenty rows: eighty of them from my nation, and forty from the rest of mankind."
20.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Ala ne Mu'awiyah ibn Hisham se bataya: Humein Sufyan ne bataya, Alqamah ibn Marthad se, Sulayman ibn Buraydah se - unka khayal hai apne walid se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jannat wale ek sau bees safen honge: unmein se assi meri ummat se, aur chaalis baaki insaanon se."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنَا الْجُرَيْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ بَحْرَ اللَّبَنِ وَبَحْرَ الْعَسَلِ وَبَحْرَ الْخَمْرِ، ثُمَّ تَشَقَّقُ مِنْهُ الْأَنْهَارُ "
20.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Jurayri, from Hakim ibn Mu'awiyah, from his father: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed in Paradise there is a sea of milk, and a sea of honey, and a sea of wine, then rivers split out from it."
20.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Jurayri se bataya: Humein Hakim ibn Mu'awiyah ne bataya, apne walid se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jannat mein doodh ka ek samundar hai, aur shahad ka ek samundar hai, aur sharaab ka ek samundar hai, fir usse nadiyaan phoot nikalti hain."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ  ، عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ  ، قالَ : حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ : # إِنَّا أَعْطَيْنَاكَ الْكَوْثَرَ سورة الكوثر آية 1 #، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" هُوَ نَهْرٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ حَافَّتَاهُ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، يَجْرِي عَلَى الدُّرِّ وَالْيَاقُوتِ، تُرْبَتُهُ أَطْيَبُ مِنْ رِيحِ الْمِسْكِ، وَطَعْمُهُ أَحْلَى مِنَ الْعَسَلِ، وَمَاؤُهُ أَشَدُّ بَيَاضًا مِنَ الثَّلْجِ "
20.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Abu Awanah, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Muharib ibn Dithar, from Abdullah ibn Umar: He said: When "Indeed We have given you al-Kawthar" [Surah al-Kawthar, verse 1] was revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "It is a river in Paradise, its two banks are of gold, it flows over pearls and rubies, its soil is more fragrant than musk, and its taste is sweeter than honey, and its water is whiter than snow."
20.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Abu Awanah se, Ata ibn al-Sa'ib se, Muharib ibn Dithar se bataya: Humein Abdullah ibn Umar ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Jab "Beshak humne tumhein Kawthar diya" [Surah Al-Kawthar, aayat 1] naazil hui, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Yeh Jannat mein ek nadi hai, uske dono kinaare sone ke hain, yeh moti aur yaqoot par bahti hai, uski mitti mushk se zyada khushbudaar hai, aur uska mazaa shahad se zyada meetha hai, aur uska paani baraf se zyada safed hai."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ شَجَرَةً يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ فِي ظِلِّهَا مِائَةَ عَامٍ لَا يَقْطَعُهَا، وَاقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ : # وَظِلٍّ مَمْدُودٍ سورة الواقعة آية 30 # "
20.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed in Paradise there is a tree, a rider travels in its shade for a hundred years and does not cross it, and recite if you wish: 'And extended shade' [Surah al-Waqi'ah, verse 30]."
20.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jannat mein ek darakht hai, sawaar uske saaye mein sau saal chalta hai lekin usse paar nahi kar paata, aur agar chaho to padho: 'Aur pheli hui chhaanv' [Surah Al-Waqi'ah, aayat 30]."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الضَّحَّاكِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ شَجَرَةً يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ فِي ظِلِّهَا مِائَةَ عَامٍ لَا يَقْطَعُهَا، هِيَ شَجَرَةُ الْخُلْدِ "
20.en: Narrated by Abd al-Samad ibn Abd al-Warith, from Shu'bah, from Abu al-Dahhak, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Indeed in Paradise there is a tree, a rider travels in its shade for a hundred years and does not cross it, it is the tree of eternity."
20.hi: Abd al-Samad ibn Abd al-Warith ne Shu'bah se, Abu al-Dahhak se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Hurairah ko suna, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Jannat mein ek darakht hai, sawaar uske saaye mein sau saal chalta hai lekin usse paar nahi kar paata, yeh hamesha rehne ka darakht hai."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبَّادٌ هُوَ : ابْنُ مَنْصُورٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ شَهْرَ بْنَ حَوْشَبٍ  ، يَقُولُ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" الْعَجْوَةُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ، وَهِيَ شِفَاءٌ مِنَ السُّمِّ "
20.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Abbad ibn Mansur, from Shahr ibn Hawshab, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The ajwah date is from Paradise, and it is a cure from poison."
20.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Abbad ibn Mansur se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Shahr ibn Hawshab ko kehte suna: Maine Abu Hurairah ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Ajwah khajoor Jannat se hai, aur yeh zeher se shifa hai."

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا حُمَيْدٌ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : " إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ لَسُوقًا ".
قَالُوا : وَمَا هِيَ، قَالَ :" كُثْبَانٌ مِنْ مِسْكٍ يَخْرُجُونَ إِلَيْهَا فَيَجْتَمِعُونَ فِيهَا، فَيَبْعَثُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا فَتُدْخِلُهُمْ بُيُوتَهُمْ، فَيَقُولُ لَهُمْ أَهْلُوهُمْ : لَقَدْ ازْدَدْتُمْ بَعْدَنَا حُسْنًا، وَيَقُولُونَ لِأَهْلِيهِمْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ "، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْجَبَّارِ  ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِنَحْوِهِ
20.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Humayd, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ; a similar chain also via Sa'id ibn Abd al-Jabbar: He said: "Indeed in Paradise there is a market." They said: "What is it?" He said: "Mounds of musk which they go out to and gather in, so Allah sends a wind upon them which enters them into their homes, so their families say to them: 'You have increased in beauty since [you left] us,' and they say the like of that to their families." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Sa'id ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Thabit, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, near it.]
20.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Humayd se, Anas se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jannat mein ek bazaar hai." Unhone poocha: "Woh kya hai?" Aapne farmaya: "Mushk ke tille hain jinki taraf woh nikalte hain aur usmein jama hote hain, to Allah unpar ek hawaa bhejta hai jo unhein unke gharon mein daakhil kar deti hai, to unke gharwale unse kehte hain: 'Tum humse [judaai ke] baad aur khoobsurat ho gaye ho,' aur woh bhi apne gharwalon se aisi hi baat kehte hain." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Sa'id ibn Abd al-Jabbar se, Hammad ibn Salamah se, Thabit se, Anas se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi is ke qareeb aayi hai.]

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ  ،  عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" حُفَّتْ الْجَنَّةُ بِالْمَكَارِهِ، وَحُفَّتْ النَّارُ بِالشَّهَوَاتِ "
20.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Thabit, from Anas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Paradise is surrounded by hardships, and the Fire is surrounded by desires."
20.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Thabit se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jannat ko takleefon se ghera gaya hai, aur Jahannam ko khwaahishon se ghera gaya hai."

20.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ  : أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ  حَدَّثَهُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، قَالَ : بَيْنَا أَنَا قَاعِدٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَحَلْقَةٌ مِنْ فُقَرَاءِ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ قُعُودٌ إِذْ دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَعَدَ إِلَيْهِمْ، فَقُمْتُ إِلَيْهِمْ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَهُمْ :" لِيُبْشِرْ فُقَرَاءُ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ بِمَا يَسُرُّ وُجُوهَهُمْ، فَإِنَّهُمْ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ قَبْلَ الْأَغْنِيَاءِ بِأَرْبَعِينَ عَامًا ".
قَالَ : فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ أَلْوَانَهُمْ أَسْفَرَتْ، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو : حَتَّى تَمَنَّيْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مَعَهُمْ
20.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from Mu'awiyah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Jubayr, from his father Jubayr ibn Nufayr, from Abdullah ibn Amr: He said: While I was sitting in the mosque, and a circle of poor Emigrants was sitting, the Prophet ﷺ entered and sat with them, so I stood and joined them, and the Prophet ﷺ said to them: "Let the poor Emigrants receive glad tidings of what will delight their faces, for indeed they will enter Paradise forty years before the wealthy." He said: So I saw their complexions brighten. Abdullah ibn Amr said: Until I wished I could be with them.
20.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne bataya: Mujhse Mu'awiyah ne bataya: ke Abd al-Rahman ibn Jubayr ne unhein bataya, apne walid Jubayr ibn Nufayr se, Abdullah ibn Amr se: Unhone kaha, Main masjid mein baitha tha aur gareeb muhajireen ka ek halqa baitha tha, ke Nabi ﷺ dakhil hue aur unke saath baithe, to main bhi unke paas khada hua, to Nabi ﷺ ne unse farmaya: "Gareeb muhajireen ko us cheez ki khush-khabri sunao jo unke chehron ko khush karegi, kyunki woh Jannat mein maal-daaron se chaalis saal pehle dakhil honge." Unhone bataya: To maine dekha unke rang chamak uthe, Abdullah ibn Amr ne kaha: yahan tak ke maine tamanna ki ke kaash main bhi unke saath hota.

20.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   : أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ : قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" اشْتَكَتِ النَّارُ إِلَى رَبِّهَا، فَقَالَتْ : يَا رَبِّ أَكَلَ بَعْضِي بَعْضًا، فَأَذِنَ اللَّهُ لَهَا بِنَفَسَيْنِ : نَفَسٍ فِي الشِّتَاءِ، وَنَفَسٍ فِي الصَّيْفِ، فَهُوَ أَشَدُّ مَا تَجِدُونَ مِنَ الْحَرِّ، وَأَشَدُّ مَا تَجِدُونَ مِنَ الزَّمْهَرِيرِ ".
أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ بَهْدَلَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَحْوَهُ
20.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah; a similar chain also via Hajjaj, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Asim ibn Bahdalah, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurairah: That he heard him say: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The Fire complained to its Lord, and said: 'O Lord, part of me has eaten part of me [i.e., it consumed itself].' So Allah permitted it two exhalations: an exhalation in winter, and an exhalation in summer, so it is the most intense heat you find, and the most intense bitter cold you find." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Hajjaj, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Asim ibn Bahdalah, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ, near it.]
20.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Mujhe Abu Salamah ne bataya, Abu Hurairah se: ke unhone unhein kehte suna: Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jahannam ne apne Rab se shikaayat ki, aur kaha: 'Ae Rab, mera ek hissa doosre hisse ko khaa gaya.' To Allah ne isay do saansen lene ki ijaazat di: sardi mein ek saans, aur garmi mein ek saans, so yeh sabse zyada garmi hai jo tum paate ho, aur sabse zyada sakht sardi hai jo tum paate ho." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Hajjaj se, Hammad ibn Salamah se, Asim ibn Bahdalah se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bhi is ke qareeb aayi hai.]

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْهَجَرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عِيَاضٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ نَارَكُمْ هَذِهِ جُزْءٌ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ جُزْءًا مِنْ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ "
20.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from al-Hajari, from Abu Iyad, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed this fire of yours is one part of seventy parts of the fire of Jahannam."
20.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne al-Hajari se, Abu Iyad se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tumhari yeh aag Jahannam ki aag ke sattar hisson mein se ek hissa hai."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيه  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" أَهْوَنُ النَّاسِ عَذَابًا مَنْ لَهُ نَعْلَانِ يَغْلِي مِنْهُمَا دِمَاغُهُ "
20.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Ajlan, from his father, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "The lightest of people in punishment is one who has two sandals, from which his brain boils."
20.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Ajlan se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Logon mein sabse halki saza us shakhs ki hogi jiske paas do jootiyaan hongi jinse uska dimaag ubalega."

20.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" يُلْقَى فِي النَّارِ أَهْلُهَا، وَتَقُولُ : هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ ثَلَاثًا، حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهَا رَبُّهَا تَعَالَى فَيَضَعَ قَدَمَهُ عَلَيْهَا فَتُزْوَى وَتَقُولُ : قَطْ قَطْ قَطْ "
20.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ammar ibn Abi Ammar, from Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Its people will be thrown into the Fire, and it will say: 'Is there more? Is there more?' three times, until its Lord, exalted is He, comes to it and places His foot upon it, so it contracts, and says: 'Enough, enough, enough.'"
20.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ammar ibn Abi Ammar se, Abu Hurairah se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jahannam mein uske log daale jaayenge, aur woh kahegi: 'Kya aur bhi hai? Kya aur bhi hai?' teen martaba, yahan tak ke uska Rab, Ta'ala, uske paas aayega aur apna qadam usper rakhega, to woh sikad jaayegi aur kahegi: 'Bas, bas, bas.'"

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا عَاصِمٌ  ، عَنْ مُوَرِّقٍ الْعِجْلِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ   :" تَعَلَّمُوا الْفَرَائِضَ وَاللَّحْنَ وَالسُّنَنَ كَمَا تَعَلَّمُونَ الْقُرْآنَ "
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Asim, from Muwarriq al-Ijli: He said: Umar ibn al-Khattab said: "Learn the laws of inheritance, and correct pronunciation, and the sunan, just as you learn the Qur'an."
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Asim se, Muwarriq al-Ijli se bataya: Unhone kaha, Umar ibn al-Khattab ne kaha: "Miraath (wirasat) ke qawaneen, aur sahih uchcharan, aur sunnaten seekho, jaise tum Quran seekhte ho."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عُمَرُ   :" تَعَلَّمُوا الْفَرَائِضَ فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ دِينِكُمْ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim: He said: Umar said: "Learn the laws of inheritance, for indeed they are part of your religion."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Umar ne kaha: "Miraath ke qawaneen seekho, kyunki yeh tumhare deen ka hissa hain."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ الْمَاجِشُونُ ، قَالَ : قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ  :" لَوْ هَلَكَ عُثْمَانُ، وَزَيْدٌ فِي بَعْضِ الزَّمَانِ، لَهَلَكَ عِلْمُ الْفَرَائِضِ، لَقَدْ أَتَى عَلَى النَّاسِ زَمَانٌ، وَمَا يَعْلَمُهَا غَيْرُهُمَا "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yusuf al-Majishun: He said: Ibn Shihab said: "Had Uthman, and Zayd, died at some point in time, the knowledge of the laws of inheritance would have perished, indeed a time came upon the people when no one else but the two of them knew it."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Yusuf al-Majishun se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ibn Shihab ne kaha: "Agar Uthman, aur Zayd, kisi waqt mar jaate, to miraath ka ilm khatam ho jaata, waaqai logon par aisa waqt aaya jab in dono ke siwa koi aur isay nahi jaanta tha."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   :" تَعَلَّمُوا الْقُرْآنَ وَالْفَرَائِضَ، فَإِنَّهُ يُوشِكُ أَنْ يَفْتَقِرَ الرَّجُلُ إِلَى عِلْمٍ كَانَ يَعْلَمُهُ، أَوْ يَبْقَى فِي قَوْمٍ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from al-Mas'udi, from al-Qasim: He said: Abdullah said: "Learn the Qur'an, and the laws of inheritance, for indeed it may soon be that a man will need knowledge that he used to know, or remain among a people who do not know [it]."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne al-Mas'udi se, al-Qasim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ne kaha: "Quran aur miraath ke qawaneen seekho, kyunki jald hi aisa ho sakta hai ke aadmi ko us ilm ki zaroorat pade jo woh jaanta tha, ya woh aisi qaum mein reh jaaye jo isay na jaante hon."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زِيَادُ بْنُ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَلِيلِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى   :" مَنْ عَلِمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ الْفَرَائِضَ، فَإِنَّ مَثَلَهُ مَثَلُ الْبُرْنُسِ لَا وَجْهَ لَهُ، أَوْ : لَيْسَ لَهُ وَجْهٌ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Ziyad ibn Abi Muslim, from Abu al-Khalil: He said: Abu Musa said: "Whoever learns the Qur'an and does not learn the laws of inheritance, his example is like a hooded cloak with no face, or: it has no face."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Ziyad ibn Abi Muslim se, Abu al-Khalil se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abu Musa ne kaha: "Jo Quran seekhe aur miraath na seekhe, uski misaal us burnus (topi wale chogay) jaisi hai jiska koi chehra na ho, ya: jiska koi chehra nahi."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَال : قُلْتُ لِعَلْقَمَةَ  : مَا أَدْرِي مَا أَسْأَلُكَ عَنْهُ؟ قَالَ :" أَمِتْ جِيرَانَكَ "
21.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Shihab, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim: He said: I said to Alqamah: "I do not know what to ask you about," he said: "Ask about death for your neighbors [i.e., ask about matters of inheritance]."
21.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Shihab se, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Alqamah se kaha: "Mujhe nahi maloom main aapse kya poochun?" Unhone kaha: "Apne padosiyon ki maut [aur miraath] ke baare mein poocho."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ  ، قَالَ :" تَعَلَّمُوا الْفَرَائِضَ، وَالطَّلاقَ، وَالْحَجَّ، فَإِنَّهُ مِنْ دِينِكُمْ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Muhammad ibn Talhah, from al-Qasim ibn al-Walid al-Hamdani, from Abdullah ibn Mas'ud: He said: "Learn the laws of inheritance, and divorce, and Hajj, for indeed it is part of your religion."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Muhammad ibn Talhah se, al-Qasim ibn al-Walid al-Hamdani se, Abdullah ibn Mas'ud se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Miraath, aur talaq, aur Hajj [ke ahkaam] seekho, kyunki yeh tumhare deen ka hissa hain."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، قَالَ :" كَانُوا يُرَغِّبُونَ فِي تَعْلِيمِ الْقُرْآنِ وَالْفَرَائِضِ وَالْمَنَاسِكِ "
21.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Kathir, from al-Hasan: He said: "They used to encourage teaching the Qur'an, and the laws of inheritance, and the rites of Hajj."
21.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Kathir se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Woh Quran, aur miraath, aur Hajj ke manaasik sikhaane ki ragheb dilaate the."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ، فَلْيَتَعَلَّمْ الْفَرَائِضَ، فَإِنْ لَقِيَهُ أَعْرَابِيٌّ، قَالَ : يَا مُهَاجِرُ، أَتَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ؟ فَإِنْ قَالَ : نَعَمْ، قَالَ : تَفْرِضُ؟ فَإِنْ قَالَ : نَعَمْ، فَهُوَ زِيَادَةٌ وَخَيْر، وَإِنْ قَالَ : لَا، قَالَ : فَمَا فَضْلُكَ عَلَيَّ يَا مُهَاجِرُ؟ !
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu Ubaydah, from Abdullah: He said: "Whoever recites the Qur'an, let him learn the laws of inheritance, for if a Bedouin meets him, and says: 'O Emigrant, do you recite the Qur'an?' If he says, 'Yes,' he says: 'Do you know the laws of inheritance?' If he says, 'Yes,' then that is increase and good, but if he says, 'No,' he says: 'Then what advantage do you have over me, O Emigrant?!'"
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Abu Ishaq se, Abu Ubaydah se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo Quran padhe, woh miraath ke qawaneen bhi seekhe, kyunki agar koi Bedouin usse mile, aur kahe: 'Ae Muhajir, kya tum Quran padhte ho?' Agar woh kahe, 'Haan,' to woh poochega: 'Kya tumhein miraath ka ilm hai?' Agar woh kahe, 'Haan,' to yeh izaafa aur bhalaai hai, lekin agar woh kahe, 'Nahi,' to woh kahega: 'Fir mujhpar tumhari kya fazeelat hai, Ae Muhajir?!'"

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْنَا مَسْرُوقًا  : كَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ   تُحْسِنُ الْفَرَائِضَ؟ قَالَ :" وَالَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُهُ، لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ الْأَكَابِرَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ مُحَمَّدٍ يَسْأَلُونَهَا عَنْ الْفَرَائِضِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Uqbah ibn Khalid, from al-A'mash, from Muslim: He said: We asked Masruq: Was Aisha well-versed in the laws of inheritance? He said: "By the One besides whom there is no god, I have indeed seen the greatest of the Companions of Muhammad asking her about the laws of inheritance."
21.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Uqbah ibn Khalid se, al-A'mash se, Muslim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Humne Masruq se poocha: Kya Aisha miraath mein maahir thin? Unhone kaha: "Us Zaat ki qasam jiske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, maine Muhammad ke bade sahaba ko unse miraath ke masaail poochte dekha hai."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ  ،  عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ  ، وَعَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ   قَالَ شُعْبَةُ : هَذَا أَوَّلُ مَنْ رَمَى بِسَهْمٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، وَهَذَا تَدَلَّى مِنْ حِصْنِ الطَّائِفِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّم إِنَّهُمَا حَدَّثَا : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ وَهُوَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ غَيْرُ أَبِيهِ، فَالْجَنَّةُ عَلَيْهِ حَرَامٌ "
21.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Asim, from Abu Uthman, from Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas, and from Abu Bakrah; with Shu'bah's identification: Shu'bah said: This is the first to throw an arrow in the path of Allah, and this one climbed down from the fortress of al-Ta'if to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, they both narrated: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever claims [descent] to other than his father, while knowing that he is not his father, Paradise is forbidden to him."
21.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Asim se, Abu Uthman se, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas se, aur Abu Bakrah se bataya: Shu'bah kehte hain: Yeh (Sa'd) pehle shakhs hain jinhone Allah ki raah mein teer chalaaya, aur yeh (Abu Bakrah) Ta'if ke qile se utar kar Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaye the, in dono ne bataya: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jo apne baap ke siwa kisi aur ka dawa kare jabke usay maloom ho ke woh uska baap nahi, uspar Jannat haraam hai."

21.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ  ، قَالَ :" كُفْرٌ بِاللَّهِ ادِّعَاءٌ إِلَى نَسَبٍ لَا يُعْرَفُ، وَكُفْرٌ بِاللَّهِ تَبَرُّؤٌ مِنْ نَسَبٍ وَإِنْ دَقَّ.
 حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ زَكَرِيَّا أَبِي يَحْيَى  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ  ، نَحْوًا مِنْهُ
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from al-A'mash, from Abdullah ibn Murrah, from Abu Ma'mar, from Abu Bakr al-Siddiq; a similar chain also via Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Zakariya Abu Yahya: He said: "It is disbelief in Allah to claim a lineage that is not known, and it is disbelief in Allah to disown a lineage, even if distant." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Zakariya Abu Yahya: he said: I heard Abu Wa'il narrating, from Ibn Mas'ud, near it.]
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, al-A'mash se, Abdullah ibn Murrah se, Abu Ma'mar se, Abu Bakr al-Siddiq se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Aisi nasab ka dawa karna jo maloom na ho, Allah se kufr hai, aur nasab se bezaar hona, chahe woh doori wala hi ho, Allah se kufr hai." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Muhammad ibn Yusuf se, Sufyan se, Zakariya Abu Yahya se bhi aayi hai: unhone kaha, Maine Abu Wa'il ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Ibn Mas'ud se, is ke qareeb.]

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ السَّلُولِيُّ  ، عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ الْأَحْمَرِ  ، عَنْ السَّرِيِّ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ  ، قَالَ : أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِأُبَايِعَهُ، فَجِئْتُ وَقَدْ قُبِض، وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ   قَائِمٌ فِي مَقَامِهِ، فَأَطَالَ الثَّنَاءَ وَأَكْثَرَ الْبُكَاءَ، فَقَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" كُفْرٌ بِاللَّهِ انْتِفَاءٌ مِنْ نَسَبٍ وَإِنْ دَقَّ، وَادِّعَاءُ نَسَبٍ لَا يُعْرَفُ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Ala, from Ishaq ibn Mansur al-Saluli, from Ja'far al-Ahmar, from al-Sarri ibn Isma'il, from Qays ibn Abi Hazim: He said: I came to the Prophet ﷺ to pledge allegiance to him, so I came and he had already passed away, and Abu Bakr was standing in his place, so he prolonged the praise and increased the weeping, and said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "It is disbelief in Allah to disown a lineage, even if distant, and to claim a lineage that is not known."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Ala ne Ishaq ibn Mansur al-Saluli se, Ja'far al-Ahmar se, al-Sarri ibn Isma'il se, Qays ibn Abi Hazim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Nabi ﷺ ke paas bay'at karne aaya, to main aaya jab aapka wisaal ho chuka tha, aur Abu Bakr (رضي الله عنه) aapki jagah khade the, to unhone lambi tareef ki aur bahut roye, aur kaha: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Nasab se bezaar hona, chahe woh doori wala hi ho, Allah se kufr hai, aur aisi nasab ka dawa karna jo maloom na ho, [woh bhi kufr hai]."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ بَهْرَامَ  ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ  ،  عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ وَالِدِه، أَوْ تَوَلَّى غَيْرَ مَوَالِيهِ الَّذِينَ أَعْتَقُوهُ، فَإِنَّ عَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةَ اللَّه، وَالْمَلائِكَةِ، وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَة، لا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ صَرْفٌ وَلَا عَدْلٌ
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Abd al-Hamid ibn Bahram, from Shahr ibn Hawshab, from Ibn Abbas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whichever man claims [descent] to other than his father, or takes as patron someone other than those who freed him, upon him is the curse of Allah, and the angels, and all the people together until the Day of Resurrection, no exchange nor ransom will be accepted from him."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Abd al-Hamid ibn Bahram se, Shahr ibn Hawshab se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo bhi aadmi apne baap ke siwa kisi aur ka dawa kare, ya apne azaad karne walon ke siwa kisi aur ko apna sarparast banaaye, uspar Allah ki, aur farishton ki, aur tamaam logon ki Qayamat tak lanat hai, na uski koi tabdeeli qabool ki jaayegi na fidya."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ  : كَانَ عُمَرُ   إِذَا سَلَكَ بِنَا طَرِيقًا وَجَدْنَاهُ سَهْلًا، وَإِنَّهُ قَالَ فِي زَوْجٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ :" لِلزَّوْجِ النِّصْفُ، وَلِلْأُمِّ ثُلُثُ مَا بَقِيَ
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Sharik, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim: He said: Abdullah said: Umar, when he took us on a path, we found it easy, and he said concerning a husband and two parents: "For the husband, half, and for the mother, a third of what remains."
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Sharik se, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ne kaha: Umar, jab woh humein kisi raaste par le jaate, hum use aasaan paate, aur unhone shohar aur maa-baap ke maamle mein kaha: "Shohar ke liye aadha, aur maa ke liye jo baaki bache uska tihai."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ الرِّشْكُ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيِّبِ   عَنْ رَجُلٍ تَرَكَ امْرَأَتَهُ، وَأَبَوَيْهِ، فَقَالَ :" قَسَّمَهَا زَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ   مِنْ أَرْبَعَةٍ "
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hammam, from Yazid al-Rishk: He said: I asked Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab about a man who left his wife, and his parents [as heirs], so he said: "Zayd ibn Thabit divided it from four [parts]."
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hammam se, Yazid al-Rishk se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se ek aise aadmi ke baare mein poocha jisne apni biwi, aur apne maa-baap [waaris ke tor par] chhode, to unhone kaha: "Zayd ibn Thabit ne isay chaar hisson mein taqseem kiya."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ  : أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ   قَالَ فِي امْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ :" لِلْمَرْأَةِ الرُّبُعُ، وَلِلْأُمِّ ثُلُثُ مَا بَقِيَ "
21.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah, from Abu al-Muhallab: That Uthman ibn Affan said, concerning a wife and two parents: "For the wife, a quarter, and for the mother, a third of what remains."
21.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Ayyub se, Abu Qilabah se, Abu al-Muhallab se bataya ke Uthman ibn Affan ne biwi aur maa-baap ke maamle mein kaha: "Biwi ke liye chauthaai, aur maa ke liye jo baaqi bache uska tihai."

21.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ  ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ   أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" لِلْمَرْأَةِ الرُّبُعُ سَهْمٌ مِنْ أَرْبَعَةٍ، وَلِلْأُمِّ ثُلُثُ مَا بَقِيَ سَهْم، وَلِلأَبِّ سَهْمَانِ ".
أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ  ، عَنْ عُمَيْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  : أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ الْحَارِثَ الْأَعْوَرَ   عَنْ امْرَأَةٍ، وَأَبَوَيْنِ، فَقَالَ مِثْلَ قَوْلِ عُثْمَانَ
21.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah, from Abu al-Muhallab, from Uthman ibn Affan; a similar note also from Hajjaj, from Hammad, from Hajjaj, from Umayr ibn Sa'id: That he said: "For the wife, a quarter, one share out of four, and for the mother, a third of what remains, one share, and for the father, two shares." [It is narrated through another chain, from Hajjaj, from Hammad, from Hajjaj, from Umayr ibn Sa'id: that he asked al-Harith al-A'war about a wife and two parents, so he said the like of Uthman's saying.]
21.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ayyub se, Abu Qilabah se, Abu al-Muhallab se, Uthman ibn Affan se bataya: ke unhone kaha: "Biwi ke liye chauthaai, chaar mein se ek hissa, aur maa ke liye jo baaqi bache uska tihai, ek hissa, aur baap ke liye do hisse." [Isi jaisi ek riwayat Hajjaj se, Hammad se, Hajjaj se, Umayr ibn Sa'id se bhi aayi hai: ke unhone al-Harith al-A'war se biwi aur maa-baap ke baare mein poocha, to unhone Uthman jaisi hi baat kahi.]

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ  ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي امْرَأَةٍ تَرَكَتْ زَوْجَهَا وَأَبَوَيْهَا :" لِلزَّوْجِ النِّصْفُ، وَلِلْأُمِّ ثُلُثُ مَا بَقِيَ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Hisham, from Qatadah, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Zayd ibn Thabit: That he said, concerning a woman who left her husband and her two parents: "For the husband, half, and for the mother, a third of what remains."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Hisham se, Qatadah se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se, Zayd ibn Thabit se bataya: ke unhone us aurat ke baare mein kaha jisne apna shohar aur apne maa-baap chhode: "Shohar ke liye aadha, aur maa ke liye jo baaqi bache uska tihai."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ   : فِي امْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ، قَالَ :" مِنْ أَرْبَعَةٍ : لِلْمَرْأَةِ الرُّبُعُ، وَلِلْأُمِّ ثُلُثُ مَا بَقِي، وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِلْأَبِ "
21.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Ibn Abi Layla, from Amir al-Sha'bi, from Ali: Concerning a wife and two parents, he said: "From four [parts]: for the wife, a quarter, and for the mother, a third of what remains, and whatever remains is for the father."
21.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Ibn Abi Layla se, Amir al-Sha'bi se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bataya: biwi aur maa-baap ke maamle mein, unhone kaha: "Chaar hisson mein se: biwi ke liye chauthaai, aur maa ke liye jo baaqi bache uska tihai, aur jo baaqi bache woh baap ka."

21.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، وَمَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ عُمَرُ   إِذَا سَلَكَ بِنَا طَرِيقًا اتَّبَعْنَاهُ فِيهِ، وَجَدْنَاهُ سَهْلًا، وَإِنَّهُ" قَضَى فِي امْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ مِنْ أَرْبَعَةٍ : فَأَعْطَى الْمَرْأَةَ الرُّبُع، وَالأُمَّ ثُلُثَ مَا بَقِيَ، وَالْأَبَ سَهْمَيْنِ.
 حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  عَنْ عِيسَى  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ   مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from al-A'mash, and Mansur, from Ibrahim, from Abdullah; a similar chain also via Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Isa, from al-Sha'bi, from Zayd ibn Thabit: He said: When Umar took us on a path we followed him in it, we found it easy, and he ruled concerning a wife and two parents from four [parts]: he gave the wife a quarter, and the mother a third of what remained, and the father two shares. [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Isa, from al-Sha'bi, from Zayd ibn Thabit, the like of it.]
21.hi: Muhammad ne Sufyan se, al-A'mash aur Mansur se, Ibrahim se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Jab Umar humein kisi raaste par le jaate hum unki pairwi karte, hum use aasaan paate, aur unhone biwi aur maa-baap ke maamle mein chaar hisson se faisla diya: unhone biwi ko chauthaai diya, aur maa ko jo baaqi bache uska tihai, aur baap ko do hisse. [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Muhammad ibn Yusuf se, Sufyan se, Isa se, al-Sha'bi se, Zayd ibn Thabit se bhi aayi hai.]

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ الْمُسَيَّبِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ يَقُولُ :" مَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيَرَانِي أَنْ أُفَضِّلَ أُمًّا عَلَى أَبٍ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad, from Sufyan, from his father, from al-Musayyab ibn Rafi', from Abdullah: He said: He used to say: "Allah would not see me giving preference to a mother over a father."
21.hi: Muhammad ne Sufyan se, apne walid se, al-Musayyab ibn Rafi' se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Woh kaha karte the: "Allah mujhe aisa na dekhe ke main maa ko baap par tarjeeh dun."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، قَالَ :" أَرْسَلَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ إِلَى زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ   : أَتَجِدُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ لِلْأُمِّ ثُلُثُ مَا بَقِي؟ فَقَالَ زَيْدٌ : إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ رَجُلٌ تَقُولُ بِرَأْيِكَ، وَأَنَا رَجُلٌ أَقُولُ بِرَأْيِي "
21.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, from Ikrimah: He said: "Ibn Abbas sent to Zayd ibn Thabit: 'Do you find in the Book of Allah that the mother gets a third of what remains?' So Zayd said: 'You are only a man who speaks by his own opinion, and I am a man who speaks by my own opinion.'"
21.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, al-Hakam se, Ikrimah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Ibn Abbas ne Zayd ibn Thabit ke paas [poochne ke liye] bheja: 'Kya tumhein Allah ki Kitaab mein milta hai ke maa ko baaqi ka tihai milta hai?' To Zayd ne kaha: 'Tum bhi ek aadmi ho jo apni raay se kehte ho, aur main bhi ek aadmi hoon jo apni raay se kehta hoon.'"

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، وَحَجَّاجٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   : أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا فِي زَوْجٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ :" لِلزَّوْجِ النِّصْفُ، وَلِلْأُمِّ ثُلُثُ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ، وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِلْأَبِ "
21.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Hajjaj, from al-Sha'bi, and Hajjaj, from Ata, from Ibn Abbas: That they both said, concerning a husband and two parents: "For the husband, half, and for the mother, a third of the whole wealth, and whatever remains is for the father."
21.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Hajjaj se, al-Sha'bi se, aur Hajjaj se, Ata se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: ke un dono ne shohar aur maa-baap ke maamle mein kaha: "Shohar ke liye aadha, aur maa ke liye poore maal ka tihai, aur jo baaqi bache woh baap ka."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ  ، قَالَ :" لِلْأُمِّ ثُلُثُ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ فِي امْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ، وَفِي زَوْجٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ "
