21.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Abu Awanah, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from Ali: He said: "For the mother, a third of the whole wealth, in the case of a wife and two parents, and in the case of a husband and two parents."
21.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Abu Awanah se, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Maa ke liye poore maal ka tihai, chahe biwi aur maa-baap ka maamla ho, ya shohar aur maa-baap ka."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ الْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، قَالَ : خَالَفَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ   أَهْلَ الْقِبْلَةِ فِي امْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ :" جَعَلَ لِلْأُمِّ الثُّلُثَ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Idris, from his father, from al-Fudayl ibn Amr, from Ibrahim: He said: Ibn Abbas differed from the people of the Qiblah [the majority of Muslims], concerning a wife and two parents: "He made a third of the whole wealth for the mother."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Ibn Idris se bataya: Humein unke walid ne bataya, al-Fudayl ibn Amr se, Ibrahim se: Unhone kaha, Ibn Abbas ne ahl-e-qibla (aksariyat) se ikhtilaaf kiya, biwi aur maa-baap ke maamle mein: "Unhone maa ke liye poore maal ka tihai muqarrar kiya."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ  ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  ، قَالَ : " قَضَى مُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ   بِالْيَمَنِ فِي بِنْتٍ وَأُخْتٍ،فَأَعْطَى الْبِنْتَ النِّصْفَ، وَالْأُخْتَ النِّصْفَ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan al-Thawri, from Ash'ath ibn Abi al-Sha'tha, from al-Aswad ibn Yazid: He said: "Mu'adh ibn Jabal ruled in Yemen concerning a daughter and a sister: he gave the daughter half, and the sister half."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan al-Thawri se, Ash'ath ibn Abi al-Sha'tha se, al-Aswad ibn Yazid se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Mu'adh ibn Jabal ne Yemen mein ek beti aur ek behen ke maamle mein faisla diya: unhone beti ko aadha diya, aur behen ko aadha."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  : أَنَّ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ كَانَ لَا يُوَرِّثُ الْأُخْتَ مِنْ الْأَبِ، وَالْأُمِّ مَعَ الْبِنْتِ حَتَّى حَدَّثَهُ الْأَسْوَدُ أَنَّ مُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ  جَعَلَ لِلْبِنْتِ النِّصْفَ، وَلِلْأُخْتِ النِّصْفَ "، فَقَالَ : أَنْتَ رَسُولِي إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَة، فَأَخْبِرْهُ بِذَاكَ، وَكَانَ قَاضِيَهُ بِالْكُوفَةِ
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad ibn Yazid: That Ibn al-Zubayr used not to give inheritance to a paternal sister along with a daughter, until al-Aswad narrated to him that Mu'adh ibn Jabal gave the daughter half, and the sister half, so he said: "You are my messenger to Abdullah ibn Utbah, so inform him of that," and he was his judge at Kufah.
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se, al-Aswad ibn Yazid se bataya: ke Ibn al-Zubayr beti ke saath baap-sharek behen ko virasat nahi dete the yahan tak ke al-Aswad ne unhein bataya ke Mu'adh ibn Jabal ne beti ko aadha diya, aur behen ko aadha, to unhone kaha: "Tum mera qaasid Abdullah ibn Utbah ke paas ho, unhein yeh bataao," aur woh Kufah mein unke qaazi the.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ  ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ تَرَكَ بِنْتًا وَأُخْتًا؟ فَقَالَ : " لِابْنَتِهِ النِّصْف، وَلأُخْتِهِ مَا بَقِيَ " قَالَ : وَقَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي  ، عَنْ خَارِجَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ  : أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ   كَانَ" يَجْعَلُ الْأَخَوَاتِ مَعَ الْبَنَاتِ عَصَبَةً، لَا يَجْعَلُ لَهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا بَقِيَ "
21.en: Narrated by Bishr ibn Umar: He said: I asked Ibn Abi al-Zinad about a man who left a daughter and a sister? So he said: "For his daughter, half, and for his sister, what remains." He said: And he said: My father informed me, from Kharijah ibn Zayd: that Zayd ibn Thabit used to "make the sisters residuary heirs along with the daughters, not giving them anything except what remained."
21.hi: Bishr ibn Umar ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibn Abi al-Zinad se poocha, ek aise aadmi ke baare mein jisne ek beti aur ek behen chhodi? To unhone kaha: "Uski beti ke liye aadha, aur uski behen ke liye jo baaqi bache." Unhone bataya: Aur unhone kaha: Mujhe mere walid ne bataya, Kharijah ibn Zayd se: ke Zayd ibn Thabit "behanon ko betiyon ke saath asabah (baaqi maandaa waaris) banaate the, unhein sirf woh dete jo baaqi bachta."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، وَالْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ   : فِي زَوْجٍ، وَأُمٍّ، وَإِخْوَةٍ لِأَبٍ وَأُم، وَإِخْوَةٍ لِأُمٍّ، قَالَ :كَانَ عُمَر  ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّه  ، ِوَزَيْدٌ   يُشَرِّكُونَ، وَقَالَ عُمَرُ : " لَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ الْأَبُ إِلَّا قُرْبًا "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Mansur, and al-A'mash, from Ibrahim: Concerning a husband, a mother, siblings of full blood, and siblings from the mother's side, he said: Umar, and Abdullah, and Zayd used to make them share [equally in the third], and Umar said: "The father [i.e., paternal relation] only added nearness to them."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Mansur aur al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se bataya: shohar, maa, sage bhai-behan, aur maa-shareek bhai-behan ke maamle mein, unhone kaha: Umar, aur Abdullah, aur Zayd unhein baraabar hissa dete the, aur Umar ne kaha: "Baap [rishte] ne unhein sirf qurbat mein izaafa diya."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الْحَارِثِ  ،  عَنْ عَلِيٍّ   : أَنَّهُ كَانَ" لَا يُشَرِّكُ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad, from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Harith, from Ali: That he used not to make them share.
21.hi: Muhammad ne Sufyan se, Abu Ishaq se, al-Harith se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bataya: ke woh unhein baraabar hissa nahi dete the.

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ   :أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ  كَانَ يُشَرِّك، وَعَلِيٌّ   كَانَ لا يُشَرِّكُ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad, from Sufyan, from Sulayman al-Taymi, from Abu Mijlaz: That Uthman used to make them share, and Ali used not to make them share.
21.hi: Muhammad ne Sufyan se, Sulayman al-Taymi se, Abu Mijlaz se bataya: ke Uthman unhein baraabar hissa dete the, aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) unhein baraabar hissa nahi dete the.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ ذَكْوَانَ  : " أَنَّ زَيْدًا   كَانَيُشَرِّكُ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad, from Sufyan, from Ibn Dhakwan: That Zayd used to make them share.
21.hi: Muhammad ne Sufyan se, Ibn Dhakwan se bataya: ke Zayd unhein baraabar hissa dete the.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ ، عَنْ شُرَيْح  : " أَنَّهُ كَانَيُشَرِّكُ
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad, from Sufyan, from Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr, from Shurayh: That he used to make them share.
21.hi: Muhammad ne Sufyan se, Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr se, Shurayh se bataya: ke woh unhein baraabar hissa dete the.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَجَّاجِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ فَيْرُوزَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيه  : أَنَّ عُمَرَ   قَالَ فِي الْمُشَرَّكَة :" لَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ الْأَبُ إِلَّا قُرْبًا
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Salt, from Abu Shihab, from al-Hajjaj, from Abd al-Malik ibn al-Mughirah, from Sa'id ibn Fayruz, from his father: That Umar said, concerning the case of shared inheritance: "The father only added nearness to them."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Salt ne Abu Shihab se, al-Hajjaj se, Abd al-Malik ibn al-Mughirah se, Sa'id ibn Fayruz se, apne walid se bataya: ke Umar ne mushtarik (share ki gayi) virasat ke maamle mein kaha: "Baap [rishte] ne unhein sirf qurbat mein izaafa diya."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الْحَارِثِ الْأَعْوَرِ  ، قَالَ : أُتِيَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ  فِي فَرِيضَةِ بَنِي عَمٍّ، أَحَدُهُمْ أَخٌ لِأُمٍّ، فَقَالَ : الْمَالُ أَجْمَعُ لِأَخِيهِ لِأُمِّه، فَأَنْزَلَهُ بِحِسَابِ، أَوْ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْأَخِ مِنْ الْأَبِ وَالْأُمِّ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ عَلِيٌّ  ، سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْهَا، وَأَخْبَرْتُهُ بِقَوْلِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ : " يَرْحَمُهُ اللَّهُ، إِنْ كَانَ لَفَقِيهًا، أَمَّا أَنَافَلَمْ أَكُنْ لِأَزِيدَهُ عَلَى مَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَهُ : سَهْمٌ السُّدُسُ، ثُمَّ يُقَاسِمُهُمْ كَرَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zuhayr, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Harith al-A'war: He said: Abdullah was asked about the inheritance shares of paternal cousins, one of whom was also a maternal brother, so he said: The wealth all goes to his maternal brother, and he treated him according to the calculation, or status, of a brother from the same father and mother. So when Ali arrived, I asked him about it, and informed him of Abdullah's saying, so he said: "May Allah have mercy on him, he was indeed a jurist, but as for me, I would not give him more than what Allah has decreed for him: a sixth as his share, then he shares with them like one of them."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zuhayr se, Abu Ishaq se, al-Harith al-A'war se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah se chachazaad bhaiyon ke virasat ke hisson ke baare mein poocha gaya, jinmein se ek maa ka bhi bhai tha, to unhone kaha: Sara maal uske maa-shareek bhai ko milega, aur unhone usay usi hisaab se, ya usi darjay se maana jaise woh sage baap-maa ka bhai ho. To jab Ali (Alayhis Salam) aaye, maine unse iske baare mein poocha, aur unhein Abdullah ki baat batayi, to unhone kaha: "Allah unpar reham kare, woh waaqai faqih (fiqh ke jaankaar) the, lekin main to usay Allah ne jo muqarrar kiya usse zyada na deta: ek chhattha hissa uska, fir woh unke saath baraabar ka waaris bane jaise unmein se koi ek ho."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ عَلِي : أَنَّهُ أُتِيَ فِي ابْنَيْ عَمٍّ أَحَدُهُمَا أَخٌ لِأُمٍّ، فَقِيلَ لِعَلِيٍّ : إِنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ كَانَ يُعْطِيهِ الْمَالَ كُلَّهُ، فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ : إِنْ كَانَ لَفَقِيهًا، وَلَوْ كُنْتُ أَنَا" أَعْطَيْتُهُ السُّدُسَ، وَمَا بَقِيَ كَانَ بَيْنَهُمْ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Harith, about Ali: That he was asked about two paternal cousins, one of whom was also a maternal brother, so it was said to Ali: "Ibn Mas'ud used to give him all the wealth," so Ali رضي الله عنه said: "He was indeed a jurist, but had it been me, I would have given him a sixth, and what remained would have been between them."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Abu Ishaq se, al-Harith se bataya ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) se do chachazaad bhaiyon ke baare mein poocha gaya, jinmein se ek maa ka bhi bhai tha, to Ali (Alayhis Salam) se kaha gaya: "Ibn Mas'ud usay sara maal dete the," to Ali رضي الله عنه ne farmaya: "Woh waaqai faqih the, lekin agar main hota, to main usay chhattha hissa deta, aur jo baaqi bachta woh unke darmiyan hota."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قَيْسٍ الْأَوْدِيِّ  ، عَنْ هُزَيْلِ بْنِ شُرَحْبِيلَ  ، قَالَ : جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ، وَإِلَى سَلْمَانَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ فَسَأَلَهُمَا عَنْ بِنْتٍ، وَبِنْتِ ابْنٍ، وَأُخْتٍ لِأُمٍّ وَأَبٍ، فَقَالَا : لِلِابْنَةِ النِّصْفُ، وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِلْأُخْتِ، وَأْتِ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ فَإِنَّهُ سَيُتَابِعُنَا، فَجَاءَ الرَّجُلُ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ : لَقَدْ ضَلَلْتُ إِذًا، وَمَا أَنَا مِنْ الْمُهْتَدِينَ، وَإِنِّي أَقْضِي بِمَا " قَضَى بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :لِلِابْنَةِ النِّصْفُ، وَلِابْنَةِ الِابْنِ السُّدُسُ، وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِلْأُخْتِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan al-Thawri, from Abu Qays al-Awdi, from Huzayl ibn Shurahbil: He said: A man came to Abu Musa al-Ash'ari, and to Salman ibn Rabi'ah, and asked them about a daughter, a son's daughter, and a full sister, so they said: "For the daughter, half, and what remains is for the sister, and go to Ibn Mas'ud, for he will agree with us." So the man came to Abdullah, and asked him about that, so he said: "Then I would have gone astray, and I would not be among the rightly guided; and I rule according to what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled: for the daughter, half, and for the son's daughter, a sixth, and what remains is for the sister."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan al-Thawri se, Abu Qays al-Awdi se, Huzayl ibn Shurahbil se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi Abu Musa al-Ash'ari, aur Salman ibn Rabi'ah ke paas aaya, aur unse ek beti, ek bete ki beti, aur ek sagi behen ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: "Beti ke liye aadha, aur jo baaqi bache woh behen ka, aur Ibn Mas'ud ke paas jao, kyunki woh humse ittefaaq karenge." To woh aadmi Abdullah ke paas aaya, aur unse iske baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: "Tab to main gumraah ho jaaunga, aur main hidayat paane walon mein se nahi hounga; aur main isi ke mutaabiq faisla deta hoon jo Rasulullah ﷺ ne faisla diya: beti ke liye aadha, aur bete ki beti ke liye chhattha hissa, aur jo baaqi bache woh behen ka."

21.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  ،  عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   : أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي أَخَوَاتٍ لِأَبٍ وَأُمٍّ، وَإِخْوَةٍ وَأَخَوَاتٍ لِأَبٍ : قَالَ :" لِلْأَخَوَاتِ لِلْأَبِ وَالْأُمِّ الثُّلُثَانِ، وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِلذُّكُورِ دُونَ الْإِنَاثِ "، فَقَدِمَ مَسْرُوقٌ الْمَدِينَةَ ، فَسَمِعَ قَوْلَ زَيْدٍ   فِيهَا فَأَعْجَبَهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِهِ : أَتَتْرُكُ قَوْلَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ : إِنِّي أَتَيْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ فَوَجَدْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ مِنْ الرَّاسِخِينَ فِي الْعِلْمِ.
قَالَ أَحْمَدُ : فَقُلْتُ لِأَبِي شِهَاب : وَكَيْفَ قَالَ زَيْدٌ فِيهَا؟ قَالَ : شَرَّكَ بَيْنَهُمْ
21.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Shihab, from al-A'mash, from Muslim, from Masruq, from Abdullah: That he used to say, concerning full sisters, and paternal brothers and sisters: "For the full sisters, two-thirds, and what remains is for the males, not the females." So Masruq arrived at Madinah, and heard Zayd's saying about it, and it impressed him, so one of his companions said to him: "Would you leave Abdullah's saying?" He said: "I came to Madinah and found Zayd ibn Thabit to be among those firmly grounded in knowledge." Ahmad said: So I said to Abu Shihab: "And how did Zayd say about it?" He said: He made them share.
21.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Shihab se, al-A'mash se, Muslim se, Masruq se, Abdullah se bataya: ke woh sagi behanon, aur baap-shareek bhai-behanon ke baare mein kaha karte the: "Sagi behanon ke liye do-tihaai, aur jo baaqi bache woh mardon ke liye, auraton ke liye nahi." To Masruq Madinah aaye, aur unhone iske baare mein Zayd ki baat suni to unhein woh pasand aayi, to unke kisi sathi ne unse kaha: "Kya aap Abdullah ki baat chhod denge?" Unhone kaha: "Main Madinah aaya aur maine Zayd ibn Thabit ko ilm mein raasikheen (gehrai se jamme hue) mein se paaya." Ahmad kehte hain: To maine Abu Shihab se poocha: "Aur Zayd ne isme kya kaha?" Unhone kaha: Unhone unhein baraabar hissa diya.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ يُونُسَ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، قَالَ : ذَكَرْنَا عِنْدَ حَكِيمِ بْنِ جَابِر : أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ  قَالَ فِي أَخَوَاتٍ لِأَبٍ وَأُمٍّ وَإِخْوَةٍ وَأَخَوَاتٍ لِأَبٍ : أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُعْطِي لِلْأَخَوَاتِ مِنْ الْأَبِ وَالْأُمِّ الثُّلُثَيْنِ، وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِلذُّكُورِ دُونَ الْإِنَاثِ، فَقَالَ حَكِيمٌ  : قَالَ زَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ   :" هَذَا مِنْ عَمَلِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ أَنْ يَرِثَ الرِّجَالُ دُونَ النِّسَاءِ إِنَّ إِخْوَتَهُنَّ قَدْ رُدُّوا عَلَيْهِنَّ "
21.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah, from Isa ibn Yunus, from Isma'il: He said: We mentioned in the presence of Hakim ibn Jabir: that Ibn Mas'ud said, concerning full sisters, and paternal brothers and sisters: that he used to give the full sisters two-thirds, and what remained was for the males, not the females, so Hakim said: Zayd ibn Thabit said: "This is from the practice of the Jahiliyyah, that men inherit and not women; indeed their brothers have been given back to them [an equal portion, restoring balance]."
21.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah ne Isa ibn Yunus se, Isma'il se bataya: Unhone kaha, Humne Hakim ibn Jabir ke saamne zikr kiya: ke Ibn Mas'ud ne sagi behanon, aur baap-shareek bhai-behanon ke baare mein kaha: ke woh sagi behanon ko do-tihaai dete the, aur jo baaqi bachta woh mardon ke liye, auraton ke liye nahi, to Hakim ne kaha: Zayd ibn Thabit ne kaha: "Yeh Jahiliyat ka tareeqa hai ke mard virasat paayein aur auratein na paayein; unke bhaiyon ko unki taraf wapas kar diya gaya hai [barabar hissa dete hue]."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   : " أَنَّهَا كَانَتْتُشَرِّكُ بَيْنَ ابْنَتَيْنِ وَابْنَةِ ابْن، وَابْنِ ابْن : تُعْطِي الِابْنَتَيْنِ الثُّلُثَيْنِ، وَمَا بَقِيَ فَشَرِيكُهُمْ
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Ma'bad ibn Khalid, from Masruq, from Aisha: "That she used to make two daughters, and a son's daughter, and a son's son share together: giving the two daughters two-thirds, and whatever remained they shared with them."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Ma'bad ibn Khalid se, Masruq se, Aisha se bataya: "ke woh do betiyon, aur bete ki beti, aur bete ke bete ko baraabar hissa deti thin: do betiyon ko do-tihaai deti, aur jo baaqi bachta usme woh unke saath shareek hote."

21.ar: وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   لَا يُشَرِّكُ، يُعْطِي الذُّكُورَ دُونَ الْإِنَاثِ، وَقَالَ :" الْأَخَوَاتُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْبَنَاتِ "
21.en: Continuing the same discussion [about Abdullah ibn Mas'ud]: And Abdullah used not to make them share equally, he gave to the males and not the females, and said: "The sisters are in the position of daughters."
21.hi: Aur Abdullah unhein baraabar hissa nahi dete the, woh mardon ko dete the auraton ko nahi, aur kehte the: "Behnein betiyon ke darjay mein hain."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَهْلٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  : أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ   كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي بِنْتٍ وَبَنَاتِ ابْنٍ، وَابْنِ ابْنٍ :" إِنْ كَانَتِ الْمُقَاسَمَةُ بَيْنَهُمْ أَقَلَّ مِنْ السُّدُسِ، أَعْطَاهُمْ السُّدُسَ، وَإِنْ كَانَ أَكْثَرَ مِنَ السُّدُس، ِأَعْطَاهُمُ السُّدُسَ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Abu Sahl, from al-Sha'bi: That Ibn Mas'ud used to say, concerning a daughter and son's daughters, and a son's son: "If the shared division among them was less than a sixth, he gave them a sixth, and if it was more than a sixth, he [still] gave them a sixth."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Abu Sahl se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: ke Ibn Mas'ud ek beti, aur bete ki betiyon, aur bete ke bete ke baare mein kehte the: "Agar unke darmiyan taqseem chhattai hisse se kam hoti, to unhein chhattai hissa dete, aur agar chhattai hisse se zyada hoti, to bhi unhein chhattai hissa dete."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  : أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُشَرِّكُ فَقَالَ لَهُ عَلْقَمَةُ : هَلْ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَثْبَتُ مِنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ؟ فَقَالَ : لَا، وَلَكِنِّي رَأَيْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ  ، وَأَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ" يُشَرِّكُونَ فِي ابْنَتَيْنِ وَبِنْتِ ابْن، ٍوَابْنِ ابْن، وَأُخْتَيْنِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad, from Sufyan, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from Masruq: That he used to make them share, so Alqamah said to him: "Is anyone among them more well-established [in knowledge] than Abdullah?" So he said: "No, but I saw Zayd ibn Thabit, and the people of Madinah, making them share, in the case of two daughters and a son's daughter, and a son's son, and two sisters."
21.hi: Muhammad ne Sufyan se, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se, Masruq se bataya: ke woh unhein baraabar hissa dete the, to Alqamah ne unse poocha: "Kya unmein se koi Abdullah se zyada pukhta hai?" To unhone kaha: "Nahi, lekin maine Zayd ibn Thabit, aur Madinah walon ko unhein baraabar hissa dete dekha, do betiyon aur bete ki beti, aur bete ke bete, aur do behanon ke maamle mein."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ ، عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ  : " فِي امْرَأَةٍ تَرَكَتْ زَوْجَهَا، وَأُمَّهَا، وَأُخْتَهَا لِأَبِيهَا وَأُمِّهَا، وَأُخْتَهَا لِأَبِيهَا، وَإِخْوَتَهَا لِأُمِّهَا،جَعَلَهَا مِنْ سِتَّةٍ، ثُمَّ رَفَعَهَا فَبَلَغَتْ عَشْرَةً، لِلزَّوْجِ النِّصْفُ ثَلَاثَةُ أَسْهُمٍ، وَلِلْأُخْتِ مِنْ الْأَبِ وَالْأُمِّ النِّصْفُ ثَلَاثَةُ أَسْهُمٍ، وَلِلْأُمِّ السُّدُسُ سَهْمٌ، وَلِلْإِخْوَةِ مِنْ الْأُمِّ الثُّلُثُ سَهْمَانِ، وَلِلْأُخْتِ مِنْ الْأَبِ سَهْمٌ تَكْمِلَةُ الثُّلُثَيْنِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Hisham, from Muhammad ibn Sirin, from Shurayh: Concerning a woman who left her husband, and her mother, and her full sister, and her paternal sister, and her maternal brothers: he made it from six [parts], then he raised it, and it reached ten: for the husband, half, three shares, and for the full sister, half, three shares, and for the mother, a sixth, one share, and for the maternal siblings, a third, two shares, and for the paternal sister, one share, completing the two-thirds.
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Hisham se, Muhammad ibn Sirin se, Shurayh se bataya: ek aisi aurat ke baare mein jisne apna shohar, aur apni maa, aur apni sagi behen, aur apni baap-shareek behen, aur apne maa-shareek bhai chhode: unhone isay chhe hisson mein banaaya, fir isay badhaaya, to woh das tak pahuncha: shohar ke liye aadha, teen hisse, aur sagi behen ke liye aadha, teen hisse, aur maa ke liye chhattai hissa, ek hissa, aur maa-shareek bhai-behanon ke liye tihai, do hisse, aur baap-shareek behen ke liye ek hissa, do-tihaai poora karne ke liye.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  : أَنَّ عَلِيًّا  ، وَزَيْدًا   كَانَا" لَا يَحْجُبَانِ بِالْكُفَّار، وَلا بِالْمَمْلُوكِينَ، وَلَا يُوَرِّثَانِهِمْ شَيْئًا "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Ash'ath, from al-Sha'bi: That Ali, and Zayd, used not to exclude [heirs] because of disbelievers, nor because of enslaved persons, nor did they give them any inheritance.
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Ash'ath se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: ke Ali (Alayhis Salam), aur Zayd, kaafiron ki wajah se, aur na hi ghulaamon ki wajah se, [waaris ko virasat se] mehroom nahi karte the, aur na unhein koi virasat dete the.

21.ar: وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ  " يَحْجُبُ بِالْكُفَّارِ وَبِالْمَمْلُوكِينَ، وَلَا يُوَرِّثُهُمْ "
21.en: Continuing the same discussion [about Abdullah ibn Mas'ud]: And Abdullah used to exclude [heirs] because of disbelievers, and because of enslaved persons, but he did not give them any inheritance.
21.hi: Aur Abdullah kaafiron ki wajah se, aur ghulaamon ki wajah se, [waaris ko] mehroom karte the, lekin unhein koi virasat nahi dete the.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  : أَنَّ عَلِيًّا  ، وَزَيْدًا  ، قَالَا :" الْمَمْلُوكُونَ، وَأَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ لا يَحْجُبُونَ وَلا يَرِثُونَ
21.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, from Ibrahim: That Ali, and Zayd, said: "Enslaved persons, and the People of the Book, do not exclude [others from inheritance], nor do they inherit."
21.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Shu'bah se, al-Hakam se, Ibrahim se bataya: ke Ali (Alayhis Salam), aur Zayd, ne kaha: "Ghulaam, aur Ahl-e-Kitaab, na kisi ko [virasat se] mehroom karte hain, na virasat paate hain."

21.ar: وَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   :" يَحْجُبُونَ وَلَا يَرِثُونَ "
21.en: Continuing the same discussion [about Abdullah ibn Mas'ud]: And Abdullah said: "They exclude [others from inheritance], but do not inherit."
21.hi: Aur Abdullah ne kaha: "Woh [dusron ko virasat se] mehroom to karte hain, lekin khud virasat nahi paate."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ  : أَنَّ عُمَرَ   " كَانَكَتَبَ مِيرَاثَ الْجَدِّ، حَتَّى إِذَا طُعِنَ دَعَا بِهِ فَمَحَاهُ، ثُمّ قَالَ : سَتَرَوْنَ رَأْيَكُمْ فِيهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Yahya, from Sa'id: That Umar had written [the ruling on] the grandfather's inheritance, until when he was stabbed, he called for it and erased it, then said: "You will [each] see your own view about it."
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Yahya se, Sa'id se bataya: ke Umar ne dada ki virasat [ka faisla] likhwaya tha, yahan tak ke jab unhein zakhmi kiya gaya, unhone use mangwaaya aur mita diya, fir kaha: "Tum log iske baare mein apni apni raay dekh lena."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ ، أنبأنا أَشْعَثُ ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِعَبِيدَةَ  : حَدِّثْنِي عَنِ الْجَدِّ، فَقَالَ :" إِنِّي لَأَحْفَظُ فِي الْجَدِّ ثَمَانِينَ قَضِيَّةً مُخْتَلِفَةً "
21.en: Narrated by Yazid, from Ash'ath, from Ibn Sirin: He said: I said to Ubaydah: "Tell me about the grandfather." So he said: "I indeed remember eighty different rulings concerning the grandfather."
21.hi: Yazid ne Ash'ath se, Ibn Sirin se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ubaydah se kaha: "Mujhe dada [ki virasat] ke baare mein bataao." To unhone kaha: "Mujhe dada ke maamle mein assi mukhtalif faisle yaad hain."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ  ، قَالَ : أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ فَرِيضَة، فَقَالَ :" إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهَا جَدٌّ، فَهَاتِهَا "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Ghassan, from Isra'il, from Abu Ishaq, from Ubayd ibn Amr, from Ali: He said: A man came to him and asked him about an inheritance case, so he said: "If there is no grandfather in it, then give it to me [ask me about it]."
21.hi: Abu Ghassan ne Isra'il se, Abu Ishaq se, Ubayd ibn Amr se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi unke paas aaya aur unse ek virasat ke maamle ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: "Agar isme dada shaamil nahi, to bataao."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  قَالَ : جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى عَلِيٍّ   فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ فَرِيضَةٍ، فَقَالَ :" إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهَا جَدٌّ، فَهَاتِهَا "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from Ubayd ibn Amr: He said: A man came to Ali and asked him about an inheritance case, so he said: "If there is no grandfather in it, then give it to me."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Abu Ishaq se, Ubayd ibn Amr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke paas aaya aur unse ek virasat ke maamle ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: "Agar isme dada shaamil nahi, to bataao."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ السَّخْتِيَانِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ  مِنْ مُرَادٍ ، ٍسَمِعَ عَلِيًّا  ، يَقُولُ :" مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يَتَقَحَّمَ جَرَاثِيمَ جَهَنَّمَ، فَلْيَقْضِ بَيْنَ الْجَدِّ وَالْإِخْوَةِ
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Ayyub al-Sakhtiyani, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from a man from Murad: Who heard Ali say: "Whoever it would please to plunge into the depths of Jahannam, let him judge between the grandfather and the siblings [i.e., such a case is deeply contested and risky to judge]."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Ayyub al-Sakhtiyani se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Murad ke ek aadmi se bataya: jisne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko kehte suna: "Jise yeh pasand ho ke woh Jahannam ki tahon mein kood pade, to woh dada aur bhai-behanon ke darmiyan faisla kare."

21.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  .
ح وَعَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  : أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقَ  " جَعَلَ الْجَدَّ أَبًا ".
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ  ، عَنْ كُرْدُوسٍ  ، عَن أبِى بُرْدَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى  : أنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ   جَعَلَ الْجَدَّ أَبًا
21.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Wuhayb, from Khalid, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri; and from Ikrimah; a similar chain also via Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Sulayman al-Shaybani, from Kurdus, from Abu Burdah, from Abu Musa: That Abu Bakr al-Siddiq "made the grandfather like a father." [Muhammad ibn Yusuf narrated: from Sufyan, from Sulayman al-Shaybani, from Kurdus, from Abu Burdah, from Abu Musa: that Abu Bakr al-Siddiq made the grandfather like a father.]
21.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Wuhayb se, Khalid se, Abu Nadrah se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se; aur Ikrimah se bataya: ke Abu Bakr al-Siddiq ne "dada ko baap ka darja diya." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Muhammad ibn Yusuf se, Sufyan se, Sulayman al-Shaybani se, Kurdus se, Abu Burdah se, Abu Musa se bhi aayi hai: ke Abu Bakr al-Siddiq ne dada ko baap ka darja diya.]

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى  ، عَنْ كُرْدُوسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى  ، أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ  " جَعَلَ الْجَدَّ أَبًا "
21.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Shihab, from al-Shaybani, from Abu Burdah ibn Abi Musa, from Kurdus, from Abu Musa: That Abu Bakr "made the grandfather like a father."
21.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Shihab se, al-Shaybani se, Abu Burdah ibn Abi Musa se, Kurdus se, Abu Musa se bataya: ke Abu Bakr (رضي الله عنه) ne "dada ko baap ka darja diya."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ  ، عَنْ مَرْوَانَ  ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ  : أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ   كَانَ" يَجْعَلُ الْجَدَّ أَبًا "
21.en: Narrated by al-Aswad ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Amr ibn Murrah, from Abu Burdah, from Marwan, from Uthman: That Abu Bakr used to "make the grandfather like a father."
21.hi: Al-Aswad ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Amr ibn Murrah se, Abu Burdah se, Marwan se, Uthman se bataya: ke Abu Bakr "dada ko baap ka darja dete the."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ  ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ  : أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ   كَانَ" يَجْعَلُ الْجِدَّ أَبًا "
21.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah, and Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Isra'il, from Abu Ishaq, from Uthman: That Abu Bakr used to "make the grandfather like a father."
21.hi: Ubaydullah aur Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Isra'il se, Abu Ishaq se, Uthman se bataya: ke Abu Bakr "dada ko baap ka darja dete the."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ  ، قَالَ : لَقِيتُ مَرْوَانَ بْنَ الْحَكَمِ بِالْمَدِينَةِ ، فَقَالَ : يَا ابْنَ أَبِي مُوسَى، أَلَمْ أُخْبَرْ أَنَّ الْجَدَّ لَا يُنَزَّلُ فِيكُمْ مَنْزِلَةَ الْأَبِ، وَأَنْتَ لَا تُنْكِرُ؟ قَالَ : قُلْتُ : وَلَوْ كُنْتَ أَنْتَ لَمْ تُنْكِرْ، قَالَ مَرْوَانُ  : فَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ عَلَى عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ  أَنَّهُ شَهِدَ عَلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ   أَنَّهُ" جَعَلَ الْجَدَّ أَبًا، إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ دُونَهُ أَبٌ "
21.en: Narrated by al-Aswad ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Amr ibn Murrah, from Abu Burdah: He said: I met Marwan ibn al-Hakam at Madinah, so he said: "O son of Abu Musa, was I not informed that the grandfather is not given the status of the father among you, and you do not deny that?" He said: I said: "And had you also not denied it?" Marwan said: "So I bear witness against Uthman ibn Affan that he testified about Abu Bakr, that he made the grandfather like a father, when there was no father below him."
21.hi: Al-Aswad ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Amr ibn Murrah se, Abu Burdah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Marwan ibn al-Hakam se Madinah mein mila, to unhone kaha: "Ae Abu Musa ke bete, kya mujhe bataya nahi gaya ke dada ko tumhare yahan baap ka darja nahi diya jaata, aur tum inkaar nahi karte?" Unhone kaha: Maine kaha: "Aur agar aap bhi inkaar na karte to?" Marwan ne kaha: "To main Uthman ibn Affan par gawahi deta hoon ke unhone Abu Bakr ke baare mein gawahi di ke unhone dada ko baap ka darja diya, jab uske neeche koi baap na ho."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ  ، وَعَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  : أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ   كَانَ" يَجْعَلُ الْجَدَّ أَبًا "
21.en: Narrated by al-Aswad ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Khalid al-Hadhdha, from Abu Nadrah, and from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas: That Abu Bakr used to "make the grandfather like a father."
21.hi: Al-Aswad ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Khalid al-Hadhdha se, Abu Nadrah se, aur Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: ke Abu Bakr "dada ko baap ka darja dete the."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : جَعَلَهُ الَّذِي قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَوْ كُنْتُ مُتَّخِذًا أَحَدًا خَلِيلًا، لَاتَّخَذْتُهُ خَلِيلًا، وَلَكِنْ أُخُوَّةُ الْإِسْلَامِ أَفْضَلُ، يَعْنِي أَبَا بَكْرٍ   جَعَلَهُ أَبًا، يَعْنِي : الْجَدَّ "
21.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Wuhayb, from Ayyub, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas: He said: He gave him [that status] because of what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Had I taken any one as a close friend, I would have taken him as a close friend, but the brotherhood of Islam is superior," meaning: Abu Bakr; he gave him the status of a father, meaning: the grandfather.
21.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Wuhayb se, Ayyub se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Unhone usay [woh darja] diya us wajah se jo Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Agar main kisi ko khaleel (gehra dost) banaata, to main usay khaleel banaata, lekin Islam ki bhaichaari afzal hai," yaani: Abu Bakr; unhone usay baap ka darja diya, yaani: dada ko.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ الزُّبَيْر  : أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ  " جَعَلَ الْجَدَّ أَبًا "
21.en: Narrated by Muslim, from Wuhayb, from Ayyub, from Ibn Abi Mulaykah, from Ibn al-Zubayr: That Abu Bakr "made the grandfather like a father."
21.hi: Muslim ne Wuhayb se, Ayyub se, Ibn Abi Mulaykah se, Ibn al-Zubayr se bataya: ke Abu Bakr ne "dada ko baap ka darja diya."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، قَالَ : إِنَّ الْجَدَّ قَدْ مَضَتْ سُنَّتُهُ، وَإِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ  " جَعَلَ الْجَدَّ أَبًا "، وَلَكِنَّ النَّاسَ تَحَيَّرُوا
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Ash'ath, from al-Hasan: He said: Indeed the practice concerning the grandfather has already passed, and Abu Bakr "made the grandfather like a father," but the people became confused.
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Ash'ath se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, Dada ke maamle mein sunnat pehle hi guzar chuki hai, aur Abu Bakr ne "dada ko baap ka darja diya," lekin log hairaan ho gaye.

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ ،  عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ أَوَّلَ جَدٍّ وَرِثَ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ عُمَرُ
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Asim, from al-Sha'bi: He said: "The first grandfather who inherited in Islam was Umar."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Asim se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Islam mein virasat paane wale pehle dada Umar the."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، قَالَ :" أَوَّلُ جَدٍّ وَرِثَ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ عُمَر، فَأَخَذَ مَالَهُ، فَأَتَاهُ عَلِيٌّ  ، وَزَيْدٌ  ، فَقَالَا : لَيْسَ لَكَ ذَاكَ، إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ كَأَحَدِ الْأَخَوَيْنِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Hasan, from Asim, from al-Sha'bi: He said: "The first grandfather who inherited in Islam was Umar, so he took his wealth, but Ali, and Zayd, came to him, and said: 'That is not for you, you are only like one of the two brothers.'"
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Hasan se, Asim se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Islam mein virasat paane wale pehle dada Umar the, to unhone apna maal le liya, lekin Ali (Alayhis Salam), aur Zayd, unke paas aaye, aur kaha: 'Yeh aapke liye nahi hai, aap to sirf do bhaiyon mein se ek jaise hain.'"

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ عِيسَى الْخياط  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ عُمَرُ  " يُقَاسِمُ بِالْجَدِّ مَعَ الْأَخِ وَالْأَخَوَيْنِ، فَإِذَا زَادُوا أَعْطَاهُ الثُّلُثَ، وَكَانَ يُعْطِيهِ مَعَ الْوَلَدِ السُّدُسَ
21.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Isa al-Khayyat, from al-Sha'bi: He said: Umar used to "share the inheritance between the grandfather and one brother or two brothers, and if they increased [in number], he gave him a third, and he used to give him a sixth along with a child."
21.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Isa al-Khayyat se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Umar "dada ko ek bhai ya do bhaiyon ke saath baraabar hissa dete the, aur agar woh badh jaate, to unhein tihai dete, aur woh unhein aulaad ke saath chhattai hissa dete the."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ  : أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ   لَمَّا طُعِنَ، اسْتَشَارَهُمْ فِي الْجَدِّ، فَقَالَ :" إِنِّي كُنْتُ رَأَيْتُ فِي الْجَدِّ رَأْيًا، فَإِنْ رَأَيْتُمْ أَنْ تَتَّبِعُوهُ، فَاتَّبِعُوهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عُثْمَانُ   : إِنْ نَتَّبِعْ رَأْيَكَ فَإِنَّهُ رَشَدٌ، وَإِنْ نَتَّبِعْ رَأْيَ الشَّيْخِ، فَنِعْمَ ذُو الرَّأْيِ كَانَ
21.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Wuhayb, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Marwan ibn al-Hakam: That Umar ibn al-Khattab, when he was stabbed, consulted them about the grandfather, and said: "I had formed an opinion about the grandfather, so if you see fit to follow it, then follow it." So Uthman said to him: "If we follow your opinion, it is right guidance, and if we follow the shaykh's opinion [Abu Bakr's], then what a fine man of opinion he was."
21.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Wuhayb se bataya: Humein Hisham ibn Urwah ne bataya, apne walid se, Marwan ibn al-Hakam se: ke Umar ibn al-Khattab, jab unhein zakhmi kiya gaya, unhone dada ke baare mein unse mashwara kiya, aur kaha: "Maine dada ke baare mein ek raay banaayi thi, so agar tumhein munaasib lage isse maanna, to maano." To Uthman ne unse kaha: "Agar hum aapki raay maanein, to yeh hidayat hai, aur agar hum shaykh (Abu Bakr) ki raay maanein, to woh bhi kya khoob raay wale the."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، قَالَ : كَتَبَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ إِلَى عَلِيّ وَابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ بِالْبَصْرَةِ : إِنِّي أُتِيتُ بِجَدٍّ وَسِتَّةِ إِخْوَةٍ، فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ عَلِيٌّ   :" أَنْ أَعْطِ الْجَدَّ سُدسا، وَلَا تُعْطِهِ أَحَدًا بَعْدَهُ
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali ibn Mushir, from al-Shaybani, from al-Sha'bi: He said: Ibn Abbas wrote to Ali - and Ibn Abbas was in Basra: "I have been brought a case of a grandfather and six brothers," so Ali wrote to him: "Give the grandfather a sixth, and give it to no one else besides him."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali ibn Mushir se, al-Shaybani se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ibn Abbas ne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko likha - aur Ibn Abbas Basra mein the: "Mere paas ek dada aur chhe bhaiyon ka maamla laaya gaya hai," to Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unhein likha: "Dada ko chhattai hissa do, aur uske ilaawa kisi aur ko na do."

21.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  فِي سِتَّةِ إِخْوَةٍ وَجَدٍّ، قَالَ :" أَعْطِ الْجَدَّ السُّدُسَ.
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : كَأَنَّهُ يَعْنِي : عَلِيًّا رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ الشَّعْبِيُّ يَرْوِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Hasan, from Isma'il, from al-Sha'bi: Concerning six brothers and a grandfather, he said: "Give the grandfather a sixth." Abu Muhammad said: As if he means: Ali, may Allah's pleasure be upon him — al-Sha'bi narrates it from Ali, may Allah's pleasure be upon him.
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Hasan se, Isma'il se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: chhe bhaiyon aur ek dada ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Dada ko chhattai hissa do." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Goya unka matlab hai: Ali (Alayhis Salam), Allah ki raza unpar ho - al-Sha'bi yeh Ali (Alayhis Salam) se riwaayat karte hain, Allah ki raza unpar ho.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ  : أَنَّ عَلِيًّا   كَانَ" يَجْعَلُ الْجَدَّ أَخًا مَتَى يَكُونَ سَادِسًا
21.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Shu'bah, from Amr ibn Murrah, from Abdullah ibn Salamah: That Ali used to "treat the grandfather as a brother, whenever he became a sixth [i.e., one of six heirs]."
21.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Shu'bah se, Amr ibn Murrah se, Abdullah ibn Salamah se bataya: ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) "dada ko bhai ka darja dete the jab bhi woh chhatta [waaris] banta."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  : أَنَّ عَلِيًّا   كَانَ" يُشَرِّكُ الْجَدَّ مَعَ الْإِخْوَةِ إِلَى السُّدُسِ
21.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Wuhayb, from Yunus, from al-Hasan: That Ali used to "make the grandfather share with the brothers up to a sixth."
21.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Wuhayb se, Yunus se, al-Hasan se bataya: ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) "dada ko bhaiyon ke saath chhattai hisse tak baraabar hissa dete the."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ عَلِيٌّ  " يُشَرِّكُ بَيْنَ الْجَدِّ وَالْإِخْوَةِ حَتَّى يَكُونَ سَادِسًا
21.en: Narrated by Hashim ibn al-Qasim, from Shu'bah, from Amr ibn Murrah, from Abdullah ibn Salamah: He said: Ali used to "make the grandfather and the brothers share, until he became a sixth [heir]."
21.hi: Hashim ibn al-Qasim ne Shu'bah se, Amr ibn Murrah se, Abdullah ibn Salamah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ali (Alayhis Salam) "dada aur bhaiyon ko baraabar hissa dete the, yahan tak ke woh chhatta [waaris] ban jaata."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ عَلِيٌّ  " يُشَرِّكُ الْجَدَّ إِلَى سِتَّةٍ مَعَ الْإِخْوَةِ، يُعْطِي كُلَّ صَاحِبِ فَرِيضَةٍ فَرِيضَتَهُ، وَلَا يُوَرِّثُ أَخًا لِأُمٍّ مَعَ جَدٍّ، وَلَا أُخْتًا لِأُمٍّ، وَلَا يَزِيدُ الْجَدَّ مَعَ الْوَلَدِ عَلَى السُّدُسِ، إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ غَيْرُهُ، وَلَا يُقَاسِمُ بِأَخٍ لِأَبٍ مَعَ أَخٍ لِأَبٍ وَأُمٍّ، وَإِذَا كَانَتْ أُخْتٌ لِأَبٍ وَأُمٍّ، وَأَخٌ لِأَبٍ، أَعْطَى الْأُخْتَ النِّصْفَ، وَالنِّصْفَ الْآخَرَ بَيْنَ الْجَدِّ وَالْأَخِ نِصْفَيْنِ، وَإِذَا كَانُوا إِخْوَةً وَأَخَوَاتٍ، شَرَّكَهُمْ مَعَ الْجَدِّ إِلَى السُّدُسِ
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim: He said: Ali used to "make the grandfather share up to six with the brothers, giving each fixed-share heir his fixed share, and not giving inheritance to a maternal brother along with a grandfather, nor a maternal sister, and not increasing the grandfather beyond a sixth along with a child, unless there was another [heir], and not making a paternal brother share with a full brother, and when there was a full sister, and a paternal brother, he gave the sister half, and the other half between the grandfather and the brother, split in two, and when there were brothers and sisters, he made them share with the grandfather up to a sixth."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ali (Alayhis Salam) "dada ko bhaiyon ke saath chhe tak baraabar hissa dete, har muqarrar-hissa waale waaris ko uska muqarrar hissa dete, aur maa-shareek bhai ko dada ke saath virasat nahi dete, na maa-shareek behen ko, aur dada ko aulaad ke saath chhattai hisse se zyada nahi dete, siwaay iske ke koi aur [waaris] ho, aur baap-shareek bhai ko sage bhai ke saath baraabar hissa nahi dete, aur jab sagi behen, aur baap-shareek bhai hote, to behen ko aadha dete, aur baaki aadha dada aur bhai ke darmiyan do hisson mein baant dete, aur jab bhai aur behanein hote, to unhein dada ke saath chhattai hisse tak baraabar hissa dete."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ الْعَبْسِيِّ هُوَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مَعْقِلٍ  ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ   عَنْ الْجَد؟ فَقَالَ :" أَيُّ أَبٍ لَكَ أَكْبَر؟ فَقُلْتُ أَنَا : آدَمُ ، قَالَ : أَلَمْ تَسْمَعْ إِلَى قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى : # يَا بَنِي آدَمَ سورة الأعراف آية 26 #
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from al-Absi, that is Abdullah ibn Khalid, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Ma'qil: He said: Ibn Abbas was asked about the grandfather? So he said: "Which father of yours is the eldest?" So I said: "Adam." He said: "Have you not heard Allah's saying, exalted is He: 'O children of Adam' [Surah al-A'raf, verse 26]?"
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, al-Absi se, jo Abdullah ibn Khalid hain, Abd al-Rahman ibn Ma'qil se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ibn Abbas se dada ke baare mein poocha gaya? To unhone kaha: "Tumhare kaunse baap sabse bade hain?" To maine kaha: "Aadam." Unhone kaha: "Kya tumne Allah Ta'ala ka yeh farman nahi suna: 'Ae Aadam ki aulaad' [Surah Al-A'raf, aayat 26]?"

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ سُمَيْعٍ  ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ :" لَوَدِدْتُ أَنِّي وَالَّذِينَ يُخَالِفُونِي فِي الْجَدِّ تَلَاعَنَّا، أَيُّنَا أَسْوَأُ قَوْلًا
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Isma'il ibn Sumay', from a man, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "I wish that I and those who differ with me about the grandfather would engage in mutual imprecation [li'an], to see which of us has the worse view."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Isma'il ibn Sumay' se, ek aadmi se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Mujhe pasand hota ke main aur woh log jo dada ke baare mein mujhse ikhtilaaf karte hain, aapas mein la'an karein, dekhein humme se kiski raay zyada buri hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَاوُسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   : أَنَّهُ" جَعَلَ الْجَدَّ أَبًا "
21.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Wuhayb, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, from Ibn Abbas: That he "made the grandfather like a father."
21.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Wuhayb se, Ibn Tawus se, apne walid se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: ke unhone "dada ko baap ka darja diya."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  قَالَ : دَخَلْتُ عَلَى شُرَيْحٍ وَعِنْدَهُ عَامِرٌ، وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فِي فَرِيضَةِ امْرَأَةٍ مِنَّا : الْعَالِيَةِ ، تَرَكَتْ زَوْجَهَا، وَأُمَّهَا، وَأَخَاهَا لِأَبِيهَا، وَجَدَّهَا، فَقَالَ لِي : هَلْ مِنْ أُخْتٍ؟ قُلْتُ : لَا، قَالَ : لِلْبَعْلِ الشَّطْرُ وَلِلْأُمِّ الثُّلُثُ، قَالَ : فَجَهِدْتُ عَلَى أَنْ يُجِيبَنِي، فَلَمْ يُجِبْنِي إِلَّا بِذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ، وَعَامِرٌ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ : مَا جَاءَ أَحَدٌ بِفَرِيضَةٍ أَعْضَلَ مِنْ فَرِيضَةٍ جِئْتَ بِهَا، قَالَ : فَأَتَيْتُ عَبِيدَةَ السَّلْمَانِيَّ وَكَانَ يُقَال : لَيْسَ بِالْكُوفَةِ أَحَدٌ أَعْلَمَ بِفَرِيضَةٍ مِنْ عَبِيدَةَ، وَالْحَارِثِ الْأَعْوَرَ، وَكَانَ عَبِيدَةُ يَجْلِسُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَإِذَا وَرَدَتْ عَلَى شُرَيْحٍ فَرِيضَةٌ فِيهَا جَدٌّ، رَفَعَهُمْ إِلَى عَبِيدَةَ، فَفَرَضَ فَسَأَلْتُهُ، فَقَالَ : إِنْ شِئْتُمْ نَبَّأْتُكُمْ بِفَرِيضَةِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ   فِي هَذَا :" جَعَلَ لِلزَّوْجِ ثَلَاثَةَ أَسْهُمٍ النِّصْفَ، وَلِلْأُمِّ ثُلُثُ مَا بَقِيَ، وَهُوَ السُّدُسُ مِنْ رَأْسِ الْمَالِ، وَلِلْأَخِ سَهْمٌ، وَلِلْجَدِّ سَهْمٌ، قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ : الْجَدُّ أَبُو الْأَبِ
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zuhayr, from Abu Ishaq: He said: I entered upon Shurayh while Amir, and Ibrahim, and Abd al-Rahman ibn Abdullah were with him, concerning the inheritance case of a woman from among us, al-Aliyah, who left her husband, and her mother, and her paternal brother, and her grandfather, so he said to me: "Is there any sister?" I said, "No." He said: "For the husband, half, and for the mother, a third." He said: So I tried hard to get him to answer further, but he did not answer me except with that, so Ibrahim, and Amir, and Abd al-Rahman ibn Abdullah said: "No one has brought a more difficult inheritance case than the one you have brought." He said: So I went to Ubaydah al-Salmani, and it used to be said: There is no one in Kufah more knowledgeable in inheritance than Ubaydah, and al-Harith al-A'war, and Ubaydah used to sit in the mosque, so whenever an inheritance case involving a grandfather came to Shurayh, he referred them to Ubaydah, so he gave the ruling, and I asked him, so he said: "If you wish, I will inform you of Abdullah ibn Mas'ud's ruling on this: he gave the husband three shares, half, and the mother a third of what remained, which is a sixth of the total capital, and the brother one share, and the grandfather one share." Abu Ishaq said: The grandfather is the father's father.
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zuhayr se, Abu Ishaq se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Shurayh ke paas gaya jabke unke paas Amir, aur Ibrahim, aur Abd al-Rahman ibn Abdullah maujood the, humari ek aurat, al-Aliyah, ke virasat ke maamle mein jisne apna shohar, aur apni maa, aur apna baap-shareek bhai, aur apna dada chhoda, to unhone mujhse poocha: "Kya koi behen hai?" Maine kaha, "Nahi." Unhone kaha: "Shohar ke liye aadha, aur maa ke liye tihai." Unhone bataya: To maine bahut koshish ki ke woh mujhe aage jawaab dein, lekin unhone mujhe isse zyada jawaab nahi diya, to Ibrahim, aur Amir, aur Abd al-Rahman ibn Abdullah ne kaha: "Kisi ne bhi aapke laaye hue maamle se zyada mushkil virasat ka maamla nahi laaya." Unhone bataya: To main Ubaydah al-Salmani ke paas gaya, aur kaha jaata tha: Kufah mein Ubaydah, aur al-Harith al-A'war se zyada virasat ka jaankaar koi nahi, aur Ubaydah masjid mein baithte the, so jab bhi Shurayh ke paas koi aisa virasat ka maamla aata jismein dada shaamil hota, woh unhein Ubaydah ke paas bhej dete, to woh faisla dete, to maine unse poocha, to unhone kaha: "Agar tum chaho, to main tumhein Abdullah ibn Mas'ud ka is baare mein faisla bataata hoon: unhone shohar ko teen hisse diye, aadha, aur maa ko jo baaqi bacha uska tihai, jo poore maal ka chhattai hissa hai, aur bhai ko ek hissa, aur dada ko ek hissa." Abu Ishaq kehte hain: Dada baap ka baap hota hai.

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  : أَنَّ زَيْدًا   كَانَ" يُشَرِّكُ الْجَدَّ مَعَ الْإِخْوَةِ إِلَى الثُّلُثِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Wuhayb, from Yunus, from al-Hasan: That Zayd used to "make the grandfather share with the brothers up to a third."
21.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Wuhayb se, Yunus se, al-Hasan se bataya: ke Zayd "dada ko bhaiyon ke saath tihai hisse tak baraabar hissa dete the."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ   : أَنَّهُ كَانَ" يُقَاسِمُ بِالْجَدِّ مَعَ الْإِخْوَةِ إِلَى الثُّلُثِ، ثُمَّ لَا يُنْقِصُهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Umar ibn Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from his father, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from Zayd ibn Thabit: That he used to "share the inheritance between the grandfather and the brothers up to a third, then not reduce him beyond that."
21.hi: Umar ibn Hafs ibn Ghiyath ne apne walid se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya, Ibrahim se, Zayd ibn Thabit se: ke woh "dada ko bhaiyon ke saath tihai hisse tak baraabar hissa dete the, fir usse zyada kami nahi karte the."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ يُونُسَ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَامِرٌ   :" خُذْ مِنْ أَمْرِ الْجَدِّ مَا اجْتَمَعَ النَّاسُ عَلَيْهِ، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : يَعْنِي قَوْلَ زَيْدٍ
21.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah, from Isa ibn Yunus, from Isma'il: He said: Amir said: "Take from the matter of the grandfather what the people have agreed upon." Abu Muhammad said: He means: Zayd's saying.
21.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah ne Isa ibn Yunus se, Isma'il se bataya: Unhone kaha, Amir ne kaha: "Dada ke maamle mein woh baat maano jispar log muttafiq hain." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Unka matlab hai: Zayd ki baat.

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  : أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ   قَالَ فِي أُخْتٍ، وَأُمٍّ، ٍّوَزَوْجٍ، وَجَدٍّ، قَالَ :" جَعَلَهَا مِنْ سَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ : لِلْأُمِّ سِتَّةٌ، وَلِلزَّوْجِ تِسْعَةٌ، وَلِلْجَدِّ ثَمَانِيَةٌ، وَلِلْأُخْتِ أَرْبَعَةٌ
21.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Hammam, from Qatadah: That Zayd ibn Thabit said, concerning a sister, a mother, a husband, and a grandfather: he said: "He made it from twenty-seven [parts]: for the mother, six, and for the husband, nine, and for the grandfather, eight, and for the sister, four."
21.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Hammam se, Qatadah se bataya: ke Zayd ibn Thabit ne behen, maa, shohar, aur dada ke baare mein kaha: unhone kaha: "Unhone isay sattais hisson mein banaaya: maa ke liye chhe, aur shohar ke liye nau, aur dada ke liye aath, aur behen ke liye chaar."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ  ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ أَوَّلَ جَدَّةٍ أُطْعِمَتْ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ سَهْمًا أَمُّ أَبٍ، وَابْنُهَا حَيٌّ
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Ash'ath, from Ibn Sirin, from Ibn Mas'ud: He said: "Indeed the first grandmother who was given a share in Islam was a father's mother, while her son was alive."
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Ash'ath se, Ibn Sirin se, Ibn Mas'ud se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Islam mein hissa paane wali pehli dadi baap ki maa thi, jabke uska beta zinda tha."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ  ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   : " أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَأَطْعَمَ جَدَّةً سُدُسًا "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sharik, from Layth, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas: That the Prophet ﷺ "gave a grandmother a sixth."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sharik se, Layth se, Tawus se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: ke Nabi ﷺ ne "ek dadi ko chhattai hissa diya."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  : أَنَّ عُمَرَ  " وَرَّثَ جَدَّةً مَعَ ابْنِهَا "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ibrahim ibn Maysarah, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab: That Umar "gave inheritance to a grandmother while her son was alive."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se, Ibn Jurayj se, Ibrahim ibn Maysarah se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se bataya: ke Umar ne "ek dadi ko uske bete ke zinda hote hue virasat di."

21.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْصُورُ بْنُ الْمُعْتَمِرِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، قَالَ :" أَطْعَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ثَلَاثَ جَدَّاتٍ سُدُسًا.
قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ : مَنْ هُنَّهْ؟ قَالَ : جَدَّتَاكَ مِنْ قِبَلِ أَبِيكَ، وَجَدَّتُكَ مِنْ قِبَلِ أُمِّكَ "
21.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Shu'bah, from Mansur ibn al-Mu'tamir, from Ibrahim: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave three grandmothers a sixth." He said: I said to Ibrahim: "Who are they?" He said: "Your two grandmothers from your father's side, and your grandmother from your mother's side."
21.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Shu'bah se bataya: Mujhe Mansur ibn al-Mu'tamir ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibrahim ko kehte suna: "Rasulullah ﷺ ne teen dadiyon/naaniyon ko chhattai hissa diya." Unhone bataya: Maine Ibrahim se poocha: "Woh kaun hain?" Unhone kaha: "Tumhari do dadiyaan tumhare baap ki taraf se, aur tumhari naani tumhari maa ki taraf se."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، قَالَ : أَنْبَأَنِي الْحَسَنُ  ، قَالَ :" تَرِثُ الْجِدَّةُ وَابْنُهَا حَيٌّ "
21.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Yazid ibn Ibrahim: He said: Al-Hasan told me: "The grandmother inherits while her son is alive."
21.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Yazid ibn Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Al-Hasan ne mujhe bataya: "Dadi virasat paati hai jabke uska beta zinda ho."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، قَالَ :" لَا تَرِثُ أُمُّ أَبِ الْأُمِّ، ابْنُهَا الَّذِي تُدْلِي بِهِ لَا يَرِثُ، فَكَيْفَ تَرِثُ هِيَ؟ "
21.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Da'ud, from al-Sha'bi: He said: "The mother of the mother's father does not inherit, [because] her son, through whom she would claim connection, does not inherit, so how could she inherit?"
21.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Da'ud se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Maa ke baap ki maa virasat nahi paati, [kyunki] uska beta, jiske zariye woh rishta jodti hai, khud virasat nahi paata, to woh kaise paayegi?"

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ عُلَيَّةَ  ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَلْقَمَةَ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّهْمَاءِ  ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ  ، قَالَ :" تَرِثُ الْجِدَّةُ وَابْنُهَا حَيٌّ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Ma'mar, from Isma'il ibn Ulayyah, from Salamah ibn Alqamah, from Humayd ibn Hilal, from Abu al-Dahma, from Imran ibn Husayn: He said: "The grandmother inherits while her son is alive."
21.hi: Abu Ma'mar ne Isma'il ibn Ulayyah se, Salamah ibn Alqamah se, Humayd ibn Hilal se, Abu al-Dahma se, Imran ibn Husayn se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Dadi virasat paati hai jabke uska beta zinda ho."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : جَاءَتْ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ جَدَّةٌ أُمُّ أَبٍ، أَوْ أُمُّ أُمٍّ، فَقَالَتْ : إِنَّ ابْنَ ابْنِي أَوْ ابْنَ ابْنَتِي تُوُفِّيَ، وَبَلَغَنِي أَنَّ لِي نَصِيبًا، فَمَا لِي؟ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ : مَا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ فِيهَا شَيْئًا، وَسَأَسْأَلُ النَّاسَ، فَلَمَّا صَلَّى الظُّهْر، قَالَ : أَيُّكُمْ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ فِي الْجَدَّةِ شَيْئًا؟ فَقَالَ الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ   : أَنَا، قَالَ : مَاذَا؟ قَالَ :أَعْطَاهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سُدُسًا، قَالَ : أَيَعْلَمُ ذَاكَ أَحَدٌ غَيْرُكَ؟ فَقَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ   : صَدَقَ، فَأَعْطَاهَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ السُّدُسَ، فَجَاءَتْ إِلَى عُمَرَ مِثْلُهَا، فَقَال : مَا أَدْرِي، مَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِيهَا شَيْئًا، وَسَأَسْأَلُ النَّاسَ، فَحَدَّثُوهُ بِحَدِيثِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَسْلَمَةَ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ : أَيُّكُمَا خَلَتْ بِهِ فَلَهَا السُّدُسُ، فَإِنْ اجْتَمَعْتُمَا، فَهُوَ بَيْنَكُمَا
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Ash'ath, from al-Zuhri: He said: A grandmother came to Abu Bakr, a father's mother, or a mother's mother, and said: "My son's son, or my daughter's son, has passed away, and it has reached me that I have a share, so what do I get?" So Abu Bakr said: "I did not hear the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say anything about it, and I will ask the people," so when he had prayed Zuhr, he said: "Which of you heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say anything about the grandmother?" So al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah said: "I did." He said: "What?" He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave her a sixth. He said: "Does anyone besides you know that?" So Muhammad ibn Maslamah said: "He speaks the truth," so Abu Bakr gave her a sixth. Then a similar case came to Umar, so he said: "I do not know, I did not hear anything from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about it, and I will ask the people," so they told him the hadith of al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah, and Muhammad ibn Maslamah, so Umar said: "Whichever of you is alone with her, she gets a sixth, and if you both are together, it is between you both."
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Ash'ath se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abu Bakr ke paas ek dadi aayi, baap ki maa, ya maa ki maa, aur usne kaha: "Mera pote ka beta, ya meri beti ka beta, faut ho gaya hai, aur mujhe khabar mili hai ke mera koi hissa hai, to mujhe kya milta hai?" To Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko iske baare mein kuch farmaate nahi suna, aur main logon se poochunga," so jab unhone Zuhr padhi, unhone poocha: "Tum mein se kisne Rasulullah ﷺ ko dadi ke baare mein kuch farmaate suna hai?" To al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah ne kaha: "Maine." Unhone poocha: "Kya?" Unhone kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne unhein chhattai hissa diya. Unhone poocha: "Kya tumhare siwa koi aur bhi isse jaanta hai?" To Muhammad ibn Maslamah ne kaha: "Unhone sach kaha," to Abu Bakr ne unhein chhattai hissa diya. Fir Umar ke paas bhi aisa hi ek maamla aaya, to unhone kaha: "Mujhe nahi maloom, maine Rasulullah ﷺ se iske baare mein kuch nahi suna, aur main logon se poochunga," to unhone unhein al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah, aur Muhammad ibn Maslamah ki hadith bataayi, to Umar ne kaha: "Tum mein se jo bhi akeli ho, usay chhattai hissa milega, aur agar tum dono ekattha ho, to woh tum dono ke darmiyan hai."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ  ، وَزَيْدٍ   قَالَا :" إِذَا كَانَتْ الْجَدَّاتُ سَوَاءً، وَرِثَ ثَلَاثُ جَدَّاتٍ جَدَّتَا أَبِيهِ أُمُّ أُمِّهِ، وَأُمُّ أَبِيهِ، وَجَدَّةُ أُمِّهِ، فَإِنْ كَانَتْ إِحَدَاهُنَّ أَقْرَب، فَالسَّهْمُ لِذَوِي الْقُرْبَى
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Ash'ath, from al-Sha'bi, from Ali, and Zayd: They both said: "When the grandmothers are equal [in degree], three grandmothers inherit: the two grandmothers of his father [his father's mother and his father's father's mother], his mother's mother, and his mother's grandmother, but if one of them is closer, then the share goes to those who are closer."
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Ash'ath se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: Unhein Ali (Alayhis Salam), aur Zayd, ne bataya: dono ne kaha: "Jab dadiyaan baraabar darje ki hon, to teen dadiyaan virasat paati hain: uske baap ki do dadiyaan [baap ki maa aur baap ke baap ki maa], uski maa ki maa, aur uski maa ki dadi, lekin agar unmein se koi zyada qareeb ho, to hissa un qareeb walon ka hoga."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ  ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ  ، وَزَيْدٍ   : " أَنَّهُمَا كَانَالا يُوَرِّثَانِ الْجِدَّةَ أُمَّ الأَبِ مَعَ الأَبِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Hasan, from Ash'ath, from al-Sha'bi, from Ali, and Zayd: "That they both did not give inheritance to a grandmother, the father's mother, along with the father."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Hasan se, Ash'ath se, al-Sha'bi se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) aur Zayd se bataya: "ke un dono ne baap ki maa (dadi) ko baap ke saath virasat nahi di."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  : أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ   كَانَ" لَا يُوَرِّثُ الْجَدَّةَ وَابْنُهَا حَيٌّ "
21.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah, from Ibn al-Mubarak, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri: That Uthman used not to "give inheritance to a grandmother while her son is alive."
21.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah ne Ibn al-Mubarak se, Ma'mar se, al-Zuhri se bataya: ke Uthman "dadi ko uske bete ke zinda hote hue virasat nahi dete the."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ  ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ الْجَدَّاتِ لَيْسَ لَهُنَّ مِيرَاثٌ، إِنَّمَا هِيَ طُعْمَةٌ أُطْعِمْنَهَا، وَالْجَدَّاتُ أَقْرَبُهُنَّ وَأَبْعَدُهُنَّ سَوَاءٌ "
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Ash'ath, from Ibn Sirin, from Ibn Mas'ud: He said: "Grandmothers have no [fixed] inheritance, it is only a provision given to them, and grandmothers, whether closer or farther, are equal."
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Ash'ath se, Ibn Sirin se, Ibn Mas'ud se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Dadiyon ke liye koi [muqarrar] virasat nahi hai, yeh sirf ek riayat hai jo unhein di jaati hai, aur dadiyaan, chahe qareeb ho ya door, baraabar hain."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   :" تَرِثُ الْجَدَّةُ وَابْنُهَا حَيٌّ "
21.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Abu Awanah, from al-Mughirah, from Ibrahim: He said: Abdullah said: "The grandmother inherits while her son is alive."
21.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Abu Awanah se, al-Mughirah se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ne kaha: "Dadi virasat paati hai jabke uska beta zinda ho."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، قَالَ : " جِئْنَ أَرْبَعُ جَدَّاتٍ يَتَسَاوَقْنَ إِلَى مَسْرُوقٍ  ،فَأَلْغَى أَمَّ أَبِ الْأَبِ، وَوَرَّثَ ثَلَاثًا : جَدَّتَيْ أَبِيهِ : أُمَّ أُمِّهِ، وَأُمَّ أَبِيهِ، وَجَدَّةَ أُمِّهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Ash'ath, from al-Sha'bi: He said: "Four grandmothers came, all approaching together, to Masruq, so he disregarded the paternal grandfather's mother, and gave inheritance to three: the two grandmothers of his father: his father's mother, and his father's father's mother, and his mother's grandmother."
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Ash'ath se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Chaar dadiyaan ekathe Masruq ke paas aayin, to unhone baap ke dada ki maa ko nazar-andaaz kiya, aur teen ko virasat di: uske baap ki do dadiyaan: uski maa ki maa, aur uske baap ke baap ki maa, aur uski maa ki dadi."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   فِي ابْنَةٍ، وَابْنَةِ ابْنٍ، قَالَ :" النِّصْفُ وَالسُّدُسُ، وَمَا بَقِيَ، فَرَدٌّ عَلَى الْبِنْتِ "
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Sharik, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from Abdullah: Concerning a daughter, and a son's daughter, he said: "Half and a sixth, and whatever remains is returned to the daughter."
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Sharik se, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se, Abdullah se bataya: ek beti, aur bete ki beti ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Aadha aur chhattai hissa, aur jo baaqi bache, woh beti ko wapas kar diya jaaye."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّه   : " أَنَّهُ أُتِيَ فِي إِخْوَةٍ لِأُمٍّ، وَأُمٍّ،فَأَعْطَى الْإِخْوَةَ مِنَ الْأُمِّ الثُّلُثَ، وَالْأُمَّ سَائِرَ الْمَالِ، وَقَالَ : الْأُمُّ عَصَبَةُ مَنْ لَا عَصَبَةَ لَهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Jarir, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah, from Abdullah: That he was asked about a case of maternal siblings, and a mother: he gave the maternal siblings a third, and the mother the rest of the wealth, and said: "The mother is the residuary heir of one who has no residuary heir."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Jarir se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se, Alqamah se, Abdullah se bataya: ke unse maa-shareek bhai-behanon, aur maa ke maamle mein poocha gaya: unhone maa-shareek bhai-behanon ko tihai diya, aur maa ko baaqi sara maal, aur kaha: "Maa us shakhs ki asabah (baaqi-maandaa waaris) hai jiska koi aur asabah na ho."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ  عَنْ رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَتَرَكَ ابْنَتَهُ، لَا يُعْلَمُ لَهُ وَارِثٌ غَيْرُهَا، قَالَ :" لَهَا الْمَالُ كُلُّهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Hasan, from his father: He said: I asked al-Sha'bi about a man who died and left his daughter, no other heir known for him, so he said: "For her is the entire wealth."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Hasan se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Sha'bi se ek aise aadmi ke baare mein poocha jo mara aur apni beti chhod gaya, uska koi aur waaris maloom nahi, to unhone kaha: "Uske liye sara maal hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ   كَانَلَا يَرُدُّ عَلَى أَخٍ لِأُمٍّ مَعَ أُمٍّ، وَلا عَلَى جَدَّةٍ، إِذَا كَانَ مَعَهَا غَيْرُهَا مَنْ لَهُ فَرِيضَةٌ، وَلَا عَلَى ابْنَةِ ابْنٍ، مَعَ ابْنَةِ الصُّلْبِ، وَلَا عَلَى امْرَأَةٍ وَزَوْج
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Muhammad ibn Salim, from al-Sha'bi: That Ibn Mas'ud used not to give a return [radd] to a maternal brother along with a mother, nor to a grandmother, when there was another with her who had a fixed share, nor to a son's daughter along with a direct daughter, nor to a woman and a husband.
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Muhammad ibn Salim se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: ke Ibn Mas'ud maa-shareek bhai ko maa ke saath radd (bacha hua hissa wapas) nahi dete the, aur na dadi ko, jab uske saath koi aur muqarrar-hissa waala ho, aur na bete ki beti ko seedhi beti ke saath, aur na kisi aurat aur shohar ko.

21.ar: وَكَانَ عَلِيٌّ  " يَرُدُّ عَلَى كُلِّ ذِي سَهْمٍ، إِلَّا الْمَرْأَةَ وَالزَّوْجَ "
21.en: Continuing the same discussion [about Ali]: And Ali used to "give a return to every fixed-share heir, except the wife and the husband."
21.hi: Aur Ali (Alayhis Salam) "har muqarrar-hissa waale waaris ko radd dete the, siwaay biwi aur shohar ke."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ خَارِجَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِت   : " أَنَّهُأُتِيَ فِي ابْنَةٍ، أَوْ أُخْت، فَأَعْطَاهَا النِّصْفَ، وَجَعَلَ مَا بَقِيَ فِي بَيْتِ الْمَالِوقَالَ يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  : عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ خَارِجَةَ
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad, from Sufyan, from Muhammad ibn Salim, from Kharijah ibn Zayd, from Zayd ibn Thabit; with Yazid's alternate chain: That he was brought a case of a daughter, or a sister: he gave her half, and put whatever remained in the treasury. Yazid ibn Harun said: from Muhammad ibn Salim, from al-Sha'bi, from Kharijah.
21.hi: Muhammad ne Sufyan se bataya: Mujhe Muhammad ibn Salim ne bataya, Kharijah ibn Zayd se, Zayd ibn Thabit se: ke unke paas ek beti, ya behen, ka maamla laaya gaya: unhone usay aadha diya, aur jo baaqi bacha usay baitul-maal mein daal diya. Yazid ibn Harun kehte hain: Muhammad ibn Salim se, al-Sha'bi se, Kharijah se.

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ فِي ابْنِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ، قَالَ :" مِيرَاثُهُ لِأُمِّهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Sa'id, from Abu Ma'shar, from Ibrahim, from Abdullah: He said, concerning the child of li'an [mutual imprecation]: "His inheritance goes to his mother."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Sa'id se, Abu Ma'shar se, Ibrahim se, Abdullah se bataya: li'an ke bachche ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Uski virasat uski maa ko jaayegi."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَجُلًا  سَأَلَ عَطَاءَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ   عَنْ وَلَدِ الْمُتَلَاعِنَيْنِ لِمَنْ مِيرَاثُهُ؟ قَالَ :" لِأُمِّهِ وَأَهْلِهَا
21.en: Narrated by Mu'adh ibn Hani', from Ibrahim ibn Tahman: He said: I heard a man ask Ata ibn Abi Rabah about the child of the two who underwent li'an: whose inheritance does it go to? He said: "To his mother and her family."
21.hi: Mu'adh ibn Hani' ne Ibrahim ibn Tahman se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine ek aadmi ko Ata ibn Abi Rabah se poochte suna li'an karne walon ke bachche ke baare mein: uski virasat kise jaayegi? Unhone kaha: "Uski maa aur uske gharwalon ko."

21.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَهْلٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  قَالَ : قَالَ عَلِيٌّ   فِي ابْنِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ :" تَرَكَ أَخَاهُ لِأُمِّهِ، وَأُمَّهُ لِأَخِيهِ السُّدُسُ، وَلِأُمِّهِ الثُّلُثُ، ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَيَصِيرُ لِلْأَخِ الثُّلُثُ، وَلِلْأُمِّ الثُّلُثَانِ ".
وَقَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ   : لِأَخِيهِ السُّدُسُ، وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِلْأُمِّ
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Hasan, from Abu Sahl, from al-Sha'bi: He said: Ali said, concerning the child of li'an: "He left his maternal brother, and his mother: for his brother, a sixth, and for his mother, a third, then it is returned to them, so the brother gets a third, and the mother two-thirds." And Ibn Mas'ud said: "For his brother, a sixth, and whatever remains is for the mother."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Hasan se, Abu Sahl se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne li'an ke bachche ke baare mein kaha: "Usne apna maa-shareek bhai, aur apni maa chhodi: bhai ke liye chhattai hissa, aur maa ke liye tihai, fir yeh unhein wapas kar diya jaata hai, to bhai ko tihai milta hai, aur maa ko do-tihaai." Aur Ibn Mas'ud ne kaha: "Bhai ke liye chhattai hissa, aur jo baaqi bache woh maa ka."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَهْلٍ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  فِي ابْنِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ : تَرَكَ ابْنَ أَخٍ وَجَدًّا، قَالَ :" الْمَالُ لِابْنِ الْأَخِ "
21.en: Continuing the same discussion [al-Sha'bi]: Concerning the child of li'an: he left a brother's son and a grandfather, he said: "The wealth goes to the brother's son."
21.hi: Li'an ke bachche ke baare mein: usne bhai ka beta aur dada chhoda, unhone kaha: "Maal bhai ke bete ko jaayega."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَالِمُ بْنُ نُوحٍ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ   فِي مِيرَاثِ ابْنِ الْمُلَاعَنَة :" لِأُمِّهِ الثُّلُثُ، وَالثُّلُثَانِ لِبَيْتِ الْمَالِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Salim ibn Nuh, from Umar ibn Amir, from Qatadah, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Zayd ibn Thabit: Concerning the inheritance of the child of li'an: "For his mother, a third, and two-thirds to the treasury."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Salim ibn Nuh se, Umar ibn Amir se, Qatadah se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se, Zayd ibn Thabit se bataya: li'an ke bachche ki virasat ke baare mein: "Uski maa ke liye tihai, aur do-tihaai baitul-maal ke liye."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَالِمُ بْنُ نُوحٍ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" مِيرَاثُهُ لِأُمِّهِ تَعْقِلُ عَنْهُ عَصَبَةُ أُمِّهِ "، وَقَالَ قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ   : لِأُمِّهِ الثُّلُثُ، وَبَقِيَّةُ الْمَالِ لِعَصَبَةِ أُمِّهِ
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Salim ibn Nuh, from Umar ibn Amir, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Abdullah: He said: "His inheritance goes to his mother, his mother's residuary heirs pay [blood-money] on his behalf." And Qatadah said, from al-Hasan: "For his mother, a third, and the rest of the wealth to his mother's residuary heirs."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Salim ibn Nuh se, Umar ibn Amir se, Hammad se, Ibrahim se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Uski virasat uski maa ko jaayegi, uski maa ke asabah uski taraf se [khoon-baha] ada karenge." Aur Qatadah ne kaha, al-Hasan se: "Uski maa ke liye tihai, aur baaqi maal uski maa ke asabah ke liye."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا قَتَادَةُ  : أَنَّ عَلِيًّا  ، وَابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ   قَالَا فِي وَلَدِ المُلَاعَنَةٍ تَرْكُ جَدَّتِهِ وَإِخْوَتِهِ لأُمِّهِ، قَالَ :" لِلْجَدَّةِ الثُّلُثُ، وَلِلْإِخْوَةِ الثُّلُثَانِ "، وَقَالَ زَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ   : لِلْجَدَّةِ السُّدُسُ، وَلِلْإِخْوَةِ لِلْأُمِّ الثُّلُثُ، وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِبَيْتِ الْمَالِ
21.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Qatadah: That Ali, and Ibn Mas'ud, said, concerning the child of li'an leaving his grandmother and his maternal siblings, he said: "For the grandmother, a third, and for the siblings, two-thirds." And Zayd ibn Thabit said: "For the grandmother, a sixth, and for the maternal siblings, a third, and whatever remains is for the treasury."
21.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se bataya: Humein Qatadah ne bataya: ke Ali (Alayhis Salam), aur Ibn Mas'ud, ne li'an ke bachche ke baare mein kaha, jisne apni dadi aur apne maa-shareek bhai-behan chhode, unhone kaha: "Dadi ke liye tihai, aur bhai-behanon ke liye do-tihaai." Aur Zayd ibn Thabit ne kaha: "Dadi ke liye chhattai hissa, aur maa-shareek bhai-behanon ke liye tihai, aur jo baaqi bache woh baitul-maal ke liye."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا يُونُسُ  ، وَحُمَيدٌ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، قَالَ :" تَرِثُهُ أُمُّهُ يَعْنِي : ابْنَ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ "
21.en: Narrated by Hajjaj, from Hammad, from Yunus, and Humayd, from al-Hasan: He said: "His mother inherits from him," meaning: the child of li'an.
21.hi: Hajjaj ne Hammad se bataya: Humein Yunus, aur Humayd ne bataya, al-Hasan se: Unhone kaha, "Uski maa uski virasat paayegi," yaani: li'an ka bachcha.

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ : أَنَّ النَّخَعِيَّ ، وَالشَّعْبِيّ ، قَالَا :" تَرِثُهُ أُمُّهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Hajjaj, from Hammad, from Hajjaj: That al-Nakha'i, and al-Sha'bi, said: "His mother inherits from him."
21.hi: Hajjaj ne Hammad se bataya: Humein Hajjaj ne bataya: ke al-Nakha'i, aur al-Sha'bi, ne kaha: "Uski maa uski virasat paayegi."

21.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، قَالَ : كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَخٍ لِي   مِنْ بَنِي زُرَيْقٍ أَسْأَلُهُ : لِمَنْ قَضَى النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي ابْنِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ؟ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيَّ : " أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّم :قَضَى بِهِ لِأُمِّهِ هِيَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ أُمِّهِ وَأَبِيهِ.
وقَالَ سُفْيَانُ : الْمَالُ كُلُّهُ لِلْأُمِّ هِيَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ أَبِيهِ وَأُمِّهِ
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Da'ud ibn Abi Hind, from Abdullah ibn Ubayd ibn Umayr; with Sufyan's addition: He said: I wrote to a brother of mine from Banu Zurayq asking him: To whom did the Prophet ﷺ rule [inheritance] in the case of the child of li'an? So he wrote to me: "That the Prophet ﷺ ruled it for his mother, she is in the position of both his mother and his father." And Sufyan said: The entire wealth goes to the mother, she is in the position of his father and his mother.
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Da'ud ibn Abi Hind se, Abdullah ibn Ubayd ibn Umayr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Banu Zurayq ke apne ek bhai ko likha unse poochte hue: Nabi ﷺ ne li'an ke bachche ke maamle mein kise virasat ka faisla diya? To unhone mujhe likha: "ke Nabi ﷺ ne isay uski maa ke liye faisla diya, woh uski maa aur uske baap dono ka darja rakhti hai." Aur Sufyan ne kaha: Sara maal maa ko jaata hai, woh uske baap aur maa ka darja rakhti hai.

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ   فِي ابْنِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ تَرَكَ أُمَّهُ وَعَصَبَةَ أُمِّهِ، قَالَ :" الثُّلُثُ لِأُمِّهِ، وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِعَصَبَةِ أُمِّهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad, from Sufyan, from Hisham, from al-Hasan: Concerning the child of li'an leaving his mother and his mother's residuary heirs, he said: "A third for his mother, and whatever remains is for his mother's residuary heirs."
21.hi: Muhammad ne Sufyan se, Hisham se, al-Hasan se bataya: li'an ke bachche ke baare mein jisne apni maa aur apni maa ke asabah chhode, unhone kaha: "Uski maa ke liye tihai, aur jo baaqi bache woh uski maa ke asabah ke liye."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ  ، وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ   فِي ابْنِ الْمُلاعَنَةِ، قَالا :" عَصَبَتُهُ عَصَبَةُ أُمِّهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Ibn Abi Layla, from Amir, from Ali, and Abdullah: Concerning the child of li'an, they both said: "His residuary heirs are his mother's residuary heirs."
21.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Ibn Abi Layla se, Amir se, Ali (Alayhis Salam), aur Abdullah se bataya: li'an ke bachche ke baare mein, dono ne kaha: "Uske asabah uski maa ke asabah hain."
