21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الْحَلَبِيُّ مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا المُعْتَمِر ، عَنْ يُونُسَ ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُول :" مِيرَاثُ وَلَدِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ لِأُمِّه، قُلْتُ : فَإِنْ كَانَ لَهُ أَخٌ مِنْ أُمِّه؟ قَالَ : لَهُ السُّدُسُ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Halabi Musa ibn Khalid, from al-Mu'tamir, from Yunus, from al-Hasan: That he used to say: "The inheritance of the child of li'an goes to his mother." I said: "What if he has a maternal brother?" He said: "He gets a sixth."
21.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Halabi Musa ibn Khalid ne al-Mu'tamir se, Yunus se, al-Hasan se bataya: ke woh kehte the: "Li'an ke bachche ki virasat uski maa ko jaati hai." Maine poocha: "Agar uska koi maa-shareek bhai ho to?" Unhone kaha: "Usay chhattai hissa milega."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ ، قَالَ :" وَلَدُ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ لِأُمِّه، تَرِثُ فَرِيضَتَهَا مِنْهُ، وَسَائِرُ ذَلِكَ فِي بَيْتِ الْمَالِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from al-Zuhri: He said: "The child of li'an is [attributed] to his mother, she inherits her fixed share from him, and the rest of that goes to the treasury."
21.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Li'an ka bachcha uski maa ki taraf mansoob hota hai, woh usse apna muqarrar hissa paati hai, aur baaqi baitul-maal mein jaata hai."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" إِذَا تَلَاعَنَا، فُرِّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا وَلَمْ يَجْتَمِعَا، وَدُعِيَ الْوَلَدُ لِأُمِّهِ، يُقَالُ : ابْنُ فُلَانَةَ، هِيَ عَصَبَتُهُ يَرِثُهَا وَتَرِثُهُ، وَمَنْ دَعَاهُ لِزِنْيَةٍ، جُلِدَ "
21.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Musa ibn Ubaydah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: "When the two undergo li'an, they are separated and never reunited, and the child is called by his mother's name, it is said: son of so-and-so [woman], she is his residuary heir, she inherits from him and he inherits from her, and whoever calls him [a child] of adultery, is flogged."
21.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Musa ibn Ubaydah se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab dono li'an karte hain, to unhein alag kar diya jaata hai aur woh kabhi ekattha nahi hote, aur bachche ko uski maa ke naam se pukaara jaata hai, kaha jaata hai: fulaani ka beta, woh uski asabah hai, woh usse virasat paati hai aur woh usse virasat paata hai, aur jo usay zina ka bachcha kahe, usay kode maare jaayenge."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ ، حَدَّثَنَا الشَّيْبَانِيُّ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  فِي وَلَدِ الْمُتَلَاعِنَيْنِ : " أَنَّهُتَرِثُهُ عَصَبَةُ أُمِّهِ، وَهُمْ يَعْقِلُونَ عَنْهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Mu'adh ibn Hani', from Ibrahim ibn Tahman, from al-Shaybani, from al-Sha'bi: Concerning the child of the two who underwent li'an: "That his mother's residuary heirs inherit from him, and they pay [blood-money] on his behalf."
21.hi: Mu'adh ibn Hani' ne Ibrahim ibn Tahman se, al-Shaybani se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: li'an karne walon ke bachche ke baare mein: "ke uski maa ke asabah usse virasat paate hain, aur woh uski taraf se [khoon-baha] ada karte hain."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ عَزْرَةَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   فِي وَلَدِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ هُوَ الَّذِي لَا أَبَ لَهُ" تَرِثُهُ أُمُّهُ وَإِخْوَتُهُ مِنْ أُمِّهِ، ِوَعَصَبَةُُ أُمِّهِ، فَإِنْ قَذَفَهُ قَاذِف، جُلِدَ قَاذِفُهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Hammam, from Qatadah, from Azrah, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas: Concerning the child of li'an, who is one with no father: "His mother inherits from him, and his maternal siblings, and his mother's residuary heirs, and if anyone slanders him, the slanderer is flogged."
21.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Hammam se, Qatadah se, Azrah se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: li'an ke bachche ke baare mein, jiska koi baap nahi: "Uski maa, aur uske maa-shareek bhai-behan, aur uski maa ke asabah usse virasat paate hain, so agar koi usper tuhmat lagaaye, to tuhmat lagaane wale ko kode maare jaayenge."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ النُّعْمَانِ  ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ   : أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ مِيرَاثِ وَلَدِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ لِمَنْ هُوَ؟ قَالَ : جَعَلَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لِأُمِّهِ فِي سَبَبِهِ لِمَا لَقِيَتْ مِنْ الْبَلَاءِ، وَلِإِخْوَتِهِ مِنْ أُمِّهِ، وقَالَ مَكْحُول : فَإِنْ مَاتَتْ الْأُمُّ، وَتَرَكَتْ ابْنَهَا، ثُمَّ تُوُفِّيَ ابْنُهَا الَّذِي جُعِلَ لَهَا، كَانَ مِيرَاثُهُ لِإِخْوَتِهِ مِنْ أُمِّهِ كُلُّهُ، لِأَنَّهُ كَانَ لِأُمِّهِمْ وَجَدِّهِمْ، وَكَانَ لِأَبِيهَا السُّدُسُ مِنْ ابْنِ ابْنَتِهِ، وَلَيْسَ يَرِثُ الْجَدُّ إِلَّا فِي هَذِهِ الْمَنْزِلَةِ، لِأَنَّهُ إِنَّمَا هُوَ أَبُ الْأُمِّ، وَإِنَّمَا وَرِثَ الْإِخْوَةُ مِنْ الْأُمِّ أُمَّهُمْ، وَوَرِثَ الْجَدُّ ابْنَتَهُ لِأَنَّهُ جُعِلَ لَهَا، فَالْمَالُ الَّذِي لِلْوَلَدِ لِوَرَثَةِ الْأُمِّ وَهُوَ بِحَوْزَةِ الْجَدُّ وَحْدَهُ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ غَيْرُهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from al-Nu'man, from Makhul: That he was asked about the inheritance of the child of li'an, to whom does it go? He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ made it: "for his mother, on account of what befell her of trial, and for his maternal siblings." And Makhul said: So if the mother dies, leaving her son, then that son, who was assigned to her, also dies, his inheritance would go entirely to his maternal siblings, because it belonged to their mother and their grandfather, and the mother's father would get a sixth from his daughter's son, and the grandfather does not inherit except in this position, because he is only the mother's father, and the maternal siblings only inherited their mother, and the grandfather inherited his daughter because it was assigned to her, so the wealth that belonged to the child belongs to the heirs of the mother, and it is in the sole possession of the grandfather if there is no one else.
21.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se, al-Nu'man se, Makhul se bataya: ke unse li'an ke bachche ki virasat ke baare mein poocha gaya, woh kise jaati hai? Unhone kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne isay muqarrar kiya: "uski maa ke liye, usne jo museebat jhaili uski wajah se, aur uske maa-shareek bhai-behanon ke liye." Aur Makhul ne kaha: To agar maa mar jaaye, apna beta chhodkar, fir woh beta, jo usay diya gaya tha, bhi mar jaaye, to uski poori virasat uske maa-shareek bhai-behanon ko jaayegi, kyunki woh unki maa aur unke dada ki thi, aur maa ke baap ko apni beti ke bete se chhattai hissa milega, aur dada sirf isi soorat mein virasat paata hai, kyunki woh sirf maa ka baap hai, aur maa-shareek bhai-behanon ne sirf apni maa se virasat paayi, aur dada ne apni beti se virasat paayi kyunki yeh usay diya gaya tha, so jo maal bachche ka tha woh maa ke waarison ka hai, aur woh sirf dada ke qabze mein hoga agar koi aur na ho.

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ  ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  : أَنَّ قَوْمًا اخْتَصَمُوا إِلَى عَلِيٍّ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْه فِي وَلَدِ الْمُتَلَاعِنَيْنِ، فَجَاءَ عَصَبَةُ أَبِيهِ يَطْلُبُونَ مِيرَاثَه، فَقَالَ :" إِنَّ أَبَاهُ كَانَ تَبَرَّأَ مِنْهُ، فَلَيْسَ لَكُمْ مِنْ مِيرَاثِهِ شَيْءٌ، فَقَضَى بِمِيرَاثِهِ لِأُمِّهِ، وَجَعَلَهَا عَصَبَتَهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Ala, from Yahya ibn Abi Bukayr, from Ibrahim ibn Tahman, from Simak ibn Harb, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas: That some people disputed before Ali رضي الله تعالى عنه concerning the child of the two who underwent li'an, so the residuary heirs of his father came seeking his inheritance, so he said: "His father indeed disowned him, so you have no share of his inheritance," so he ruled his inheritance for his mother, and made her his residuary heir.
21.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Ala ne Yahya ibn Abi Bukayr se, Ibrahim ibn Tahman se, Simak ibn Harb se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: ke kuch log Ali (Alayhis Salam) رضي الله تعالى عنه ke saamne li'an karne walon ke bachche ke baare mein jhagdne aaye, to uske baap ke asabah uski virasat maangne aaye, to unhone farmaya: "Uske baap ne to usse inkaar kar diya tha, so uski virasat mein tumhara koi hissa nahi," so unhone uski virasat uski maa ke liye faisla di, aur usay uska asabah banaaya.

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْأَعْلَى  : أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ   : فِي الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ لَهُ مَا لِلرَّجُلِ وَمَا لِلْمَرْأَةِ مِنْ أَيِّهِمَا يُوَرَّثُ، فَقَالَ :" مِنْ أَيِّهِمَا بَالَ "
21.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Isra'il, from Abd al-A'la: That he heard Muhammad ibn Ali narrating, from Ali: concerning a man who has [physical characteristics] of both a man and a woman, from which of them does he inherit? So he said: "From whichever one he urinates."
21.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Isra'il se, Abd al-A'la se bataya: ke unhone Muhammad ibn Ali ko yeh bayaan karte suna, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se: us aadmi ke baare mein jiske paas mard aur aurat dono ki [alaamaat] hon, woh kisme se virasat paayega? To unhone farmaya: "Jisse woh peshaab kare."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ  ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ  ، عَنْ شِبَاكٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ   فِي الْخُنْثَى، قَالَ :" يُوَرَّثُ مِنْ قِبَلِ مَبَالِهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, from Hushaym, from Mughirah, from Shibak, from al-Sha'bi, from Ali: Concerning the khuntha [intersex person], he said: "He inherits based on where he urinates from."
21.hi: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah ne Hushaym se, Mughirah se, Shibak se, al-Sha'bi se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bataya: khuntha ke baare mein, unhone farmaya: "Woh isi hisaab se virasat paayega jahan se woh peshaab karta hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هَانِئٍ  ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ عَامِرٌ   عَنْ مَوْلُودٍ وُلِدَ، وَلَيْسَ بِذَكَرٍ، وَلَا أُنْثَى، لَيْسَ لَهُ مَا لِلذَّكَرِ، وَلَيْسَ لَهُ مَا لِلْأُنْثَى، يُخْرِجُ مِنْ سُرَّتِهِ كَهَيْئَةِ الْبَوْلِ وَالْغَائِطِ، سُئِلَ عَنْ مِيرَاثِهِ، فَقَالَ :" نِصْفُ حَظِّ الذَّكَرِ، وَنِصْفُ حَظِّ الْأُنْثَى "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Abu Hani': He said: Amir was asked about a newborn who is neither male nor female, has neither the male organ nor the female organ, and passes urine and stool from his navel, he was asked about his inheritance, so he said: "Half the share of a male, and half the share of a female."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Abu Hani' se bataya: Unhone kaha, Amir se poocha gaya us naumaulood ke baare mein jo na mard hai na aurat, jiske paas na mard ka aala hai na aurat ka, aur jo apni naabhi se peshaab aur qaza-e-hajat karta hai, unse uski virasat ke baare mein poocha gaya, to unhone kaha: "Mard ke hisse ka aadha, aur aurat ke hisse ka aadha."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ   عَنْ الْكَلَالَةِ، فَقَالَ : " إِنِّي سَأَقُولُ فِيهَا بِرَأْيِي، فَإِنْ كَانَ صَوَابًا فَمِنْ اللَّهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ خَطَأً فَمِنِّي، وَمِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ : أُرَاهُمَا خَلَا الْوَالِدَ وَالْوَلَدِ "، َفَلَمَّا اسْتُخْلِفَ عُمَرُ  ، قَالَ : إِنِّي لَأَسْتَحْيِي اللَّهَ أَنْ أَرُدَّ شَيْئًا قَالَهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Asim, from al-Sha'bi: He said: Abu Bakr was asked about kalalah [an heir with no ascendant or descendant], so he said: "I will speak about it with my own opinion, and if it is correct, then it is from Allah, and if it is wrong, then it is from me and from Shaytan: I consider it to mean besides parent and child," so when Umar became caliph, he said: I would be too shy before Allah to reject anything Abu Bakr said.
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Asim se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abu Bakr (رضي الله عنه) se kalalah ke baare mein poocha gaya, to unhone kaha: "Main iske baare mein apni raay se kahunga, so agar yeh sahi ho to Allah ki taraf se hai, aur agar ghalat ho to mujhse aur shaytan se hai: mera khayal hai in dono (kalalah) se murad hai baap-maa aur aulaad ke ilaawa," fir jab Umar khalifa bane, unhone kaha: Main Allah se sharmaata hoon ke koi baat radd karun jo Abu Bakr ne kahi ho.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  ، عَنْ مَرْثَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْيَزَنِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ  ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" مَا أَعْضَلَ بِأَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ شَيْءٌ مَا أَعْضَلَتْ بِهِمْ الْكَلَالَةُ "
21.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Marthad ibn Abdullah al-Yazani, from Uqbah ibn Amir al-Juhani: That he said: "Nothing has ever been more difficult for the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ than what kalalah made difficult for them."
21.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid ne Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub se bataya: Mujhse Yazid ibn Abi Habib ne bataya, Marthad ibn Abdullah al-Yazani se, Uqbah ibn Amir al-Juhani se: ke unhone kaha: "Rasulullah ﷺ ke sahaba ke liye kabhi koi cheez itni mushkil nahi hui jitni kalalah unke liye mushkil hui."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ :" الْكَلَالَةُ مَا خَلَا الْوَالِدَ وَالْوَلَدَ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Amr ibn Dinar, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "Kalalah is [an inheritance case that excludes] parent and child."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Amr ibn Dinar se, al-Hasan ibn Muhammad se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Kalalah woh hai jismein baap-maa aur aulaad shaamil na hon."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ L1584 ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ   : " أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقْرَأُ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ : # وَإِنْ كَانَ رَجُلٌ يُورَثُ كَلالَةً أَو امْرَأَةٌ وَلَهُ أَخٌ أَوْ أُخْتٌ سورة النساء آية 12 #لِأُمٍّ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad, from Sufyan, from Ya'la ibn Ata, from al-Qasim ibn Abdullah, from Sa'd: That he used to recite this verse: "And if a man leaves inheritance through kalalah, or a woman, and he has a brother or a sister" [Surah al-Nisa, verse 12]: "from the mother."
21.hi: Muhammad ne Sufyan se, Ya'la ibn Ata se, al-Qasim ibn Abdullah se, Sa'd se bataya: ke woh yeh aayat padha karte the: "Aur agar koi mard ya aurat kalalah ki soorat mein virasat chhode, aur uska ek bhai ya ek behen ho" [Surah An-Nisa, aayat 12]: "maa ki taraf se."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَسْوَدِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ  : أَنَّ عَاصِمَ بْنَ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ  أَخْبَرَهُ : أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ   " الْتَمَسَ مَنْ يَرِثُ ابْنَ الدَّحْدَاحَةِ، فَلَمْ يَجِدْ وَارِثًا،فَدَفَعَ مَالَ ابْنِ الدَّحْدَاحَةِ إِلَى أَخْوَالِ ابْنِ الدَّحْدَاحَةِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Haywah, from Abu al-Aswad Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Nawfal: That Asim ibn Umar ibn Qatadah al-Ansari informed him: that Umar ibn al-Khattab "searched for anyone who would inherit from Ibn al-Dahdahah, but did not find an heir, so he gave the wealth of Ibn al-Dahdahah to Ibn al-Dahdahah's maternal uncles."
21.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid ne Haywah se bataya: Humein Abu al-Aswad Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Nawfal ne bataya: ke Asim ibn Umar ibn Qatadah al-Ansari ne unhein bataya: ke Umar ibn al-Khattab ne "Ibn al-Dahdahah ke waaris ki talaash ki, lekin koi waaris nahi mila, to unhone Ibn al-Dahdahah ka maal uske mamu-zaad rishtedaron ko de diya."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ  ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ :" اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ مَوْلَى مَنْ لَا مَوْلَى لَهُ، وَالْخَالُ وَارِثُ مَنْ لَا وَارِثَ لَهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Amr ibn Muslim, from Tawus, from Aisha: She said: "Allah and His Messenger are the patron of whoever has no patron, and the maternal uncle is the heir of whoever has no heir."
21.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Amr ibn Muslim se, Tawus se, Aisha se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Allah aur uska Rasool us shakhs ka sarparast hai jiska koi sarparast na ho, aur mamu us shakhs ka waaris hai jiska koi waaris na ho."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ فِرَاسٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ زِيَادٍ  ، قَالَ : " أُتِيَ عُمَرُ   فِي عَمٍّ لِأُمٍّ، وَخَالَة،فَأَعْطَى الْعَمَّ لِلْأُمِّ الثُّلُثَيْنِ، وَأَعْطَى الْخَالَةَ الثُّلُثَ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Firas, from al-Sha'bi, from Ziyad: He said: "Umar was brought a case of a maternal uncle, and a maternal aunt, so he gave the maternal uncle two-thirds, and gave the maternal aunt a third."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Firas se, al-Sha'bi se, Ziyad se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Umar ke paas ek mamu, aur ek khaala ka maamla laaya gaya, to unhone mamu ko do-tihaai diya, aur khaala ko tihai diya."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ  ،  عَنِ الْحَسَنِ  : أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ  " أَعْطَى الْخَالَةَ الثُّلُثَ، وَالْعَمَّةَ الثُّلُثَيْنِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Yunus, from al-Hasan: That Umar ibn al-Khattab "gave the maternal aunt a third, and the paternal aunt two-thirds."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Yunus se, al-Hasan se bataya: ke Umar ibn al-Khattab ne "khaala ko tihai diya, aur phuphi ko do-tihaai."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ غَالِبِ بْنِ عَبَّادٍ  ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ حَبْتَرٍ النَّهْشَلِيِّ  ، قَالَ : أُتِيَ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ مَرْوَانَ فِي خَالَةٍ وَعَمَّةٍ، فَقَامَ شَيْخٌ  ، فَقَالَ : شَهِدْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ  " أَعْطَى الْخَالَةَ الثُّلُثَ، وَالْعَمَّةَ الثُّلُثَيْنِ "، قَالَ : فَهَمَّ أَنْ يَكْتُبَ بِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : أَيْنَ زَيْدٌ عَنْ هَذَا
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from al-Hasan ibn Amr, from Ghalib ibn Abbad, from Qays ibn Habtar al-Nahshali: He said: Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan was brought a case of a maternal aunt and a paternal aunt, so an old man stood, and said: "I witnessed Umar ibn al-Khattab give the maternal aunt a third, and the paternal aunt two-thirds." He said: So he intended to write it as a ruling, then said: "Where is Zayd on this matter?"
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, al-Hasan ibn Amr se, Ghalib ibn Abbad se, Qays ibn Habtar al-Nahshali se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan ke paas ek khaala aur ek phuphi ka maamla laaya gaya, to ek budhe aadmi khade hue, aur kaha: "Maine Umar ibn al-Khattab ko khaala ko tihai, aur phuphi ko do-tihaai dete dekha hai." Unhone bataya: To unhone isay faisle ke tor par likhne ka irada kiya, fir kaha: "Iss baare mein Zayd kahan hain?"

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   قَالَ :" الْخَالَةُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْأُمِّ، وَالْعَمَّةُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْأَبِ، وَبِنْتُ الْأَخِ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْأَخِ، وَكُلُّ ذِي رَحِمٍ بِمَنْزِلَةِ رَحِمِهِ الَّتِي يُدْلِي بِهَا إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ وَارِثٌ ذُو قَرَابَةٍ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Muhammad ibn Salim, from al-Sha'bi, from Masruq, from Abdullah: He said: "The maternal aunt is in the position of the mother, and the paternal aunt is in the position of the father, and the brother's daughter is in the position of the brother, and every blood relative is in the position of the relation through whom they claim connection, when there is no other closer heir."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Muhammad ibn Salim se, al-Sha'bi se, Masruq se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Khaala maa ke darjay mein hai, aur phuphi baap ke darjay mein hai, aur bhai ki beti bhai ke darjay mein hai, aur har khoon ka rishtedaar apne us rishte ke darjay mein hai jiske zariye woh rishta jodta hai, jab koi aur zyada qareeb waaris na ho."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ  : أَنَّ عُمَرَ   قَضَى فِي أَهْلِ طَاعُونِ عَمَوَاسَ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُواإِذَا كَانُوا مِنْ قِبَلِ الْأَبِ سَوَاءً، فَبَنُو الْأُمِّ أَحَقُّ، وَإِذَا كَانَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَقْرَبَ مِنْ بَعْضٍ بِأَبٍ، فَهُمْ أَحَقُّ بِالْمَالِ "
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hisham, from Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn Utbah: He said: Al-Dahhak ibn Qays narrated to me: that Umar ruled, concerning the victims of the plague of Amwas, that they used to say: "When they are equal on the father's side, then the mother's children have more right, and when some of them are closer than others through the father, then they have more right to the wealth."
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hisham se bataya: Humein Muhammad ne bataya, Abdullah ibn Utbah se: Unhone kaha, Mujhse al-Dahhak ibn Qays ne bataya: ke Umar ne Amwas ki mahaamaari ke shikaaron ke baare mein faisla diya ke: "Jab woh baap ki taraf se baraabar hon, to maa ki taraf ke bacchon ka zyada haq hota hai, aur jab unmein se koi baap ki taraf se zyada qareeb ho, to unka maal par zyada haq hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو إِسْحَاق الشَّيْبَانِيُّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَدَّادِ بْنِ الْهَادِ  ، قَالَ : أُصِيبَ سَالِمٌ مَوْلَى أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ يَوْمَ الْيَمَامَة، فَبَلَغَ مِيرَاثُهُ مِائَتَيْ دِرْهَمٍ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ   :" احْبِسُوهَا عَلَى أُمِّهِ حَتَّى تَأْتِيَ عَلَى آخِرِهَا "
21.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Shihab, from Abu Ishaq al-Shaybani, from Ubayd ibn Abi al-Ja'd, from Abdullah ibn Shaddad ibn al-Had: He said: Salim, freed servant of Abu Hudhayfah, was struck on the day of al-Yamamah, and his inheritance reached two hundred dirhams, so Umar said: "Withhold it for his mother until it reaches her in full [as a stipend, not lump sum]."
21.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Shihab se bataya: Mujhse Abu Ishaq al-Shaybani ne bataya, Ubayd ibn Abi al-Ja'd se, Abdullah ibn Shaddad ibn al-Had se: Unhone kaha, Salim, Abu Hudhayfah ke azaad kiye hue ghulam, al-Yamamah ke din maare gaye, aur unki virasat do sau dirham thi, to Umar ne kaha: "Isay unki maa ke liye rakh do yahan tak ke yeh unhein poori mile [wazife ki soorat mein, ek saath nahi]."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" الْإِخْوَةُ مِنْ الْأُمِّ يَتَوَارَثُونَ دُونَ بَنِي الْعَلَّاتِ، يَرِثُ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ لِأَبِيهِ وَأُمِّهِ، دُونَ أَخِيهِ لِأَبِيهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zuhayr, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Harith, from Ali, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Maternal siblings inherit from each other, but not the paternal half-siblings [from different mothers]: a man inherits from his full brother, but not his paternal-only brother."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zuhayr se, Abu Ishaq se, al-Harith se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Maa-shareek bhai-behan aapas mein virasat paate hain, lekin sirf baap-shareek bhai (jinki maa alag hon) nahi paate: aadmi apne sage baap-maa ke bhai se virasat paata hai, apne sirf-baap-shareek bhai se nahi."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِابْنِ عُمَرَ   : " أَرَأَيْتَرَجُلًا تَرَكَ ابْنَ ابْنَتِهِ، أَيَرِثُهُ؟ قَالَ : لا "
21.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from al-Nu'man ibn Salim: He said: I said to Ibn Umar: "What do you think about a man who leaves his daughter's son, does he inherit from him?" He said, "No."
21.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se, al-Nu'man ibn Salim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibn Umar se poocha: "Aap kya kehte hain us aadmi ke baare mein jo apni beti ka beta chhode, kya woh usse virasat paayega?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   :" الْأُمُّ عَصَبَةُ مَنْ لَا عَصَبَةَ لَهُ، وَالْأُخْتُ عَصَبَةُ مَنْ لَا عَصَبَةَ لَهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim: He said: Abdullah said: "The mother is the residuary heir of whoever has no residuary heir, and the sister is the residuary heir of whoever has no residuary heir."
21.hi: Ya'la ne al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ne kaha: "Maa us shakhs ki asabah hai jiska koi asabah na ho, aur behen us shakhs ki asabah hai jiska koi asabah na ho."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَاوُسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" أَلْحِقُوا الْفَرَائِضَ بِأَهْلِهَا، فَمَا بَقِي، فَهُوَ لِأَوْلَى رَجُلٍ ذَكَرٍ "
21.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Wuhayb, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, from Ibn Abbas, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Attach the fixed shares to their rightful people, and whatever remains, is for the nearest male relative."
21.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Wuhayb se, Ibn Tawus se, apne walid se, Ibn Abbas se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Muqarrar hisse unke haqdaaron ko do, aur jo baaqi bache, woh sabse qareebi mard rishtedaar ke liye hai."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى  : أَنَّ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ  أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْأَشْعَثِ  : أَنَّ عَمَّةً لَهُ تُوُفِّيَتْ يَهُودِيَّةً بِالْيَمَنِ ، فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ   فَقَالَ :" يَرِثُهَا أَقْرَبُ النَّاسِ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ أَهْلِ دِينِهَا "
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Yahya: that Sulayman ibn Yasar informed him, from Muhammad ibn al-Ash'ath: That a paternal aunt of his died as a Jew in Yemen, so that was mentioned to Umar ibn al-Khattab, so he said: "The person of her religion nearest to her inherits from her."
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Yahya se bataya: ke Sulayman ibn Yasar ne unhein bataya, Muhammad ibn al-Ash'ath se: ke unki ek phuphi Yemen mein Yahoodi ke tor par intiqaal kar gayin, to yeh baat Umar ibn al-Khattab se zikr ki gayi, to unhone kaha: "Uski virasat woh shakhs paayega jo uske deen ke logon mein se sabse qareeb ho."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ  ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، قَالَ : مَاتَتْ عَمَّةُ الْأَشْعَثِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ وَهِيَ يَهُودِيَّة، فَأَتَى عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّاب  ، فَقَالَ :" أَهْلُ دِينِهَا يَرِثُونَهَا "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Qays ibn Muslim, from Tariq ibn Shihab: He said: The paternal aunt of al-Ash'ath ibn Qays died, and she was a Jew, so he came to Umar ibn al-Khattab, so he said: "The people of her religion inherit from her."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Qays ibn Muslim se, Tariq ibn Shihab se bataya: Unhone kaha, Al-Ash'ath ibn Qays ki phuphi ka intiqaal hua, aur woh Yahoodi thi, to woh Umar ibn al-Khattab ke paas gaye, to unhone kaha: "Uske deen ke log usse virasat paayenge."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ   :" أَهْلُ الشِّرْكِ لَا نَرِثُهُمْ، وَلَا يَرِثُونَا "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Hammad, from Ibrahim: He said: Umar ibn al-Khattab said: "We do not inherit from the people of shirk, nor do they inherit from us."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Hammad se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Umar ibn al-Khattab ne kaha: "Hum mushrikon se virasat nahi paate, aur na woh humse paate hain."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ  ، عَنْ عِيسَى الْخياط  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ   : " أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَأَبَا بَكْرٍ، وَعُمَرَ، قَالُوا :لَا يَتَوَارَثُ أَهْلُ دِينَيْنِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Hasan, from Isa al-Khayyat, from al-Sha'bi: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and Abu Bakr, and Umar, said: The people of two different religions do not inherit from each other."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Hasan se, Isa al-Khayyat se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: "ke Rasulullah ﷺ, aur Abu Bakr, aur Umar, ne kaha: Do alag deen wale aapas mein virasat nahi paate."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" لَا يَتَوَارَثُ أَهْلُ مِلَّتَيْنِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zuhayr, from Mutarrif, from Amir, from Umar: He said: "The people of two different faiths do not inherit from each other."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zuhayr se, Mutarrif se, Amir se, Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Do alag deen wale aapas mein virasat nahi paate."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ الْأَشْعَثِ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ :" لَا نَرِثُ أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ وَلَا يَرِثُونَا، إِلَّا أَنْ يَمُوتَ لِلرَّجُلِ عَبْدُهُ أَوْ أَمَتُهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sharik, from al-Ash'ath, from al-Hasan, from Jabir: He said: "We do not inherit from the People of the Book, nor do they inherit from us, except when a man's male or female slave dies [and he inherits from that slave's estate]."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sharik se, al-Ash'ath se, al-Hasan se, Jabir se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Hum Ahl-e-Kitaab se virasat nahi paate, aur na woh humse paate hain, siwaay iske ke kisi aadmi ka ghulam ya laundi mar jaaye [to woh unse virasat paayega]."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ الْأَشْعَثِ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا نَرِثُ أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ وَلَا يَرِثُونَا، إِلَّا الرَّجُلُ يَرِثُ عَبْدَهُ، أَوْ أَمَتَهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Sharik, from al-Ash'ath, from al-Hasan, from Jabir: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "We do not inherit from the People of the Book, nor do they inherit from us, except the man who inherits from his male or female slave."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Sharik se, al-Ash'ath se, al-Hasan se, Jabir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Hum Ahl-e-Kitaab se virasat nahi paate, aur na woh humse paate hain, siwaay us aadmi ke jo apne ghulam ya laundi se virasat paaye."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  ، قَالَ : " كَانَ مُعَاوِيَةُ  يُوَرِّثُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ الْكَافِرِ، وَلَا يُوَرِّثُ الْكَافِرَ مِنْ الْمُسْلِمِ، قَالَ : قَالَ مَسْرُوقٌ : وَمَا حَدَثَ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ قَضَاءٌ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْهُ، قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ : تَقُولُ بِهَذَا؟ قَالَ : لا
21.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Da'ud, from al-Sha'bi, from Masruq; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: "Mu'awiyah used to give inheritance to the Muslim from the disbeliever, but not give inheritance to the disbeliever from the Muslim." Masruq said: "No ruling introduced in Islam is more beloved to me than this one." It was said to Abu Muhammad: "Do you hold this view?" He said, "No."
21.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Da'ud se, al-Sha'bi se, Masruq se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Mu'awiyah Musalman ko kaafir se virasat dete the, lekin kaafir ko Musalman se virasat nahi dete the." Masruq kehte hain: "Islam mein koi bhi naya faisla mujhe isse zyada pasand nahi." Abu Muhammad se poocha gaya: "Kya aap isi ke qaail hain?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  : أَنَّ الْمُعْزِلَةَ بِنْتَ الْحَارِثِ تُوُفِّيَتْ بِالْيَمَنِ وَهِيَ يَهُودِيَّةٌ، فَرَكِبَ الْأَشْعَثُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، وَكَانَتْ عَمَّتَهُ، إِلَى عُمَرَ فِي مِيرَاثِهَا، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ   : " لَيْسَ ذَاكَ لَكَ،يَرِثُهَا أَقْرَبُ النَّاسِ مِنْهَا مِنْ أَهْلِ دِينِهَا، لَا يَتَوَارَثُ مِلَّتَانِ "
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Da'ud ibn Abi Hind, from Amir: That al-Mu'zilah bint al-Harith died in Yemen as a Jew, so al-Ash'ath ibn Qays, who was her nephew, rode to Umar concerning her inheritance, so Umar said: "That is not for you, the nearest person to her from her own religion inherits from her; two faiths do not inherit from each other."
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Da'ud ibn Abi Hind se, Amir se bataya: ke al-Mu'zilah bint al-Harith ka Yemen mein Yahoodi ke tor par intiqaal hua, to al-Ash'ath ibn Qays, jo uske bhatije the, Umar ke paas uski virasat ke maamle mein gaye, to Umar ne kaha: "Yeh tumhare liye nahi hai, uski virasat woh shakhs paayega jo uske deen ke logon mein se sabse qareeb ho; do deen aapas mein virasat nahi paate."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ سِيرِينَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ   :" لَا يَتَوَارَثُ مِلَّتَانِ شَتَّى، وَلَا يَحْجُبُ مَنْ لَا يَرِثُ "
21.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Anas ibn Sirin: He said: Umar ibn al-Khattab said: "Two separate faiths do not inherit from each other, and whoever does not inherit does not exclude [others from inheritance]."
21.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Anas ibn Sirin se bataya: Unhone kaha, Umar ibn al-Khattab ne kaha: "Do alag deen aapas mein virasat nahi paate, aur jo khud virasat nahi paata, woh [dusron ko] mehroom bhi nahi karta."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْأَعْلَى  ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ  ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ   أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَا يَرِثُ الْمُسْلِمُ الْكَافِرَ، وَلَا الْكَافِرُ الْمُسْلِمَ "
21.en: Narrated by Nasr ibn Ali, from Abd al-A'la, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Ali ibn Husayn, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Usamah ibn Zayd: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The Muslim does not inherit from the disbeliever, nor does the disbeliever inherit from the Muslim."
21.hi: Nasr ibn Ali ne Abd al-A'la se, Ma'mar se, al-Zuhri se, Ali ibn Husayn se, Amr ibn Uthman se, Usamah ibn Zayd se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Musalman kaafir se virasat nahi paata, aur na kaafir Musalman se paata hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ ،  عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا مَاتَ الْمَيِّتُ وَجَبَتْ الْحُقُوقُ لِأَهْلِهَا، وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ لِمَنْ أَسْلَمَ أَوْ أُعْتِقَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْسَمَ الْمِيرَاثُ شَيْئًا "
21.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Sa'id, from Abu Ma'shar, from Ibrahim: He said: "When the deceased dies, the rights become due to their rightful heirs, and no share is given to whoever became Muslim or was freed [from slavery] before the inheritance was divided [if it happened after death but the estate is later distributed - referring to a specific timing rule]."
21.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Sa'id se, Abu Ma'shar se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab murda mar jaata hai, to haq unke haqdaaron ke liye wajib ho jaate hain, aur jo Musalman ho ya azaad ho virasat baantne se pehle, usay kuch nahi diya jaata."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عِيسَى  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ  ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا يَرِثُ الْمُسْلِمُ الْكَافِرَ، وَلَا الْكَافِرُ الْمُسْلِمَ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Abdullah ibn Isa, from al-Zuhri, from Ali ibn Husayn, from Usamah ibn Zayd: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The Muslim does not inherit from the disbeliever, nor does the disbeliever inherit from the Muslim."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Abdullah ibn Isa se, al-Zuhri se, Ali ibn Husayn se, Usamah ibn Zayd se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Musalman kaafir se virasat nahi paata, aur na kaafir Musalman se paata hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ  ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَا يَرِثُ الْمُسْلِمُ الْكَافِرَ، وَلَا الْكَافِرُ الْمُسْلِمَ "
21.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Sufyan, from al-Zuhri, from Ali ibn Husayn, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Usamah ibn Zayd, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "The Muslim does not inherit from the disbeliever, nor does the disbeliever inherit from the Muslim."
21.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Sufyan se, al-Zuhri se, Ali ibn Husayn se, Amr ibn Uthman se, Usamah ibn Zayd se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Musalman kaafir se virasat nahi paata, aur na kaafir Musalman se paata hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ،  عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" لَيْسَ لِلْمُكَاتَبِ مِيرَاثٌ، مَا بَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ مِنْ مُكَاتَبَتِهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Abu Awanah, from Mughirah, from Ibrahim: He said: "There is no inheritance for the mukatab [slave under a contract to purchase his own freedom], as long as anything remains upon him of his contract."
21.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Abu Awanah se, Mughirah se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Mukatab (azaadi ke muahide wala ghulam) ke liye koi virasat nahi hai, jab tak uska muahida baaqi ho."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ   : " فِي رَجُلٍ لَهُ بَنُونَ قَدْ أَعْتَقَ مِنْ بَعْضِهِمْ النِّصْفَ، وَمِنْ بَعْضٍ الثُّلُثَ، وَمِنْ بَعْضٍ الرُّبُعَ، قَالَ :لَا يَرِثُونَ حَتَّى يُعْتَقُوا "
21.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Abd al-Malik, from Ata: Concerning a man who has sons, and he has freed half of one, and a third of another, and a quarter of another: he said: "They do not inherit until they are [fully] freed."
21.hi: Ya'la ne Abd al-Malik se, Ata se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jiske bete hon, aur usne unmein se ek ko aadha azaad kiya ho, aur ek ko tihai, aur ek ko chauthaai: unhone kaha: "Woh virasat nahi paate jab tak woh [poori tarah] azaad na ho jaayein."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عبد الله بن جعفر الرقي ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  : " فِي رَجُلٍ اشْتَرَى ابْنَهُ فِي مَرَضِهِ، قَالَ :إِنْ خَرَجَ مِنْ الثُّلُثِ وَرِثَهُ، وَإِنْ وَقَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ السِّعَايَةُ لَمْ يَرِثْ "
21.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Raqqi, and Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah, from Ibn al-Mubarak, from Ma'mar, from Hammad, from Ibrahim: Concerning a man who bought his son during his illness, he said: "If it comes within a third [of the estate], he inherits from him, but if the [remaining amount owed as] earning-labor falls upon him, he does not inherit."
21.hi: Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Raqqi, aur Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah ne Ibn al-Mubarak se, Ma'mar se, Hammad se, Ibrahim se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jisne apni bimaari mein apna beta khareeda, unhone kaha: "Agar yeh tihai [maal] ke andar aaye, to woh usse virasat paayega, lekin agar mehnat ki kamaai [ki baaqi raqam] uspar aaye, to woh virasat nahi paayega."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، قَالَ :" حَدُّ الْمُكَاتَبِ حَدُّ الْمَمْلُوكِ، حَتَّى يُعْتَقَ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Hasan, from his father, from al-Sha'bi: He said: "The limit/status of the mukatab is the limit/status of a slave, until he is freed."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Hasan se, apne walid se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Mukatab ka darjaa ghulam ka darjaa hai, jab tak woh azaad na ho jaaye."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" الْمَوْلَى أَخٌ فِي الدِّينِ وَنِعْمَةٌ، أَحَقُّ النَّاسِ بِمِيرَاثِهِ أَقْرَبُهُمْ مِنْ الْمُعْتِقِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Sa'id ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Yunus, from al-Zuhri: He said: The Prophet ﷺ said: "The freed slave is a brother in religion and a blessing, the most deserving person of his inheritance is the nearest of them to the one who freed him."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Sa'id ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Yunus se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, "Azaad kiya hua ghulam deen mein bhai aur ek ne'mat hai, uski virasat ka sabse zyada haqdaar woh hai jo azaad karne wale se sabse qareeb ho."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، حدثنا مَنْصُورٌ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  فِي رَجُلٍ أَعْتَقَ مَمْلُوكًا، ثُمَّ مَاتَ الْمَوْلَى وَالْمَمْلُوكُ، وَتَرَكَ الْمُعْتِقُ أَبَاهُ وَابْنَهُ، قَالَا :" الْمَالُ لِلِابْنِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Hushaym, from Mansur, from al-Hasan, and Muhammad ibn Salim, from al-Sha'bi: Concerning a man who freed a slave, then the patron and the slave both died, and the one who freed him left his father and his son: they both said: "The wealth goes to the son."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Hushaym se bataya: Humein Mansur ne bataya, al-Hasan se, aur Muhammad ibn Salim se, al-Sha'bi se: us aadmi ke baare mein jisne ek ghulam azaad kiya, fir maalik aur ghulam dono mar gaye, aur azaad karne wale ne apna baap aur apna beta chhoda: dono ne kaha: "Maal bete ko jaayega."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادٌ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ   فِي رَجُلٍ تَرَكَ أَبَاهُ وَابْنَ ابْنِهِ، فَقَالَ :" الْوَلَاءُ لِابْنِ الِابْنِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abbad, from Umar ibn Amir, from Qatadah, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Zayd ibn Thabit: Concerning a man who left his father and his son's son, he said: "The wala' [right of patronage inheritance] goes to the son's son."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Abbad se, Umar ibn Amir se, Qatadah se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se, Zayd ibn Thabit se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jisne apna baap aur apne bete ka beta chhoda, unhone kaha: "Wala' bete ke bete ko jaayega."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَمَّرٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا خُصَيْفٌ  ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ   : أَنَّ امْرَأَةً أَعْتَقَتْ عَبْدًا لَهَا، ثُمَّ تُوُفِّيَتْ وَتَرَكَتْ ابْنَهَا وَأَخَاهَا، ثُمَّ تُوُفِّيَ مَوْلَاهَا، فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ابْنُ الْمَرْأَةِ وَأَخُوهَا فِي مِيرَاثِهِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مِيرَاثُهُ لِابْنِ الْمَرْأَةِ، فَقَالَ أَخُوهَا : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّه، ِلَوْ أَنَّهُ جَرَّ جَرِيرَةً، عَلَى مَنْ كَانَتْ؟ قَالَ : عَلَيْكَ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Mu'ammar, from Khusayf, from Ziyad ibn Abi Maryam: That a woman freed a slave of hers, then died, leaving her son and her brother, then her freed slave died, so the woman's son and her brother came to the Prophet ﷺ concerning his inheritance, so the Prophet ﷺ said: "His inheritance goes to the woman's son," so her brother said: "O Messenger of Allah, if he had committed a crime, upon whom would it fall?" He said: "Upon you."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Mu'ammar se, Khusayf se, Ziyad ibn Abi Maryam se bataya: ke ek aurat ne apna ek ghulam azaad kiya, fir woh mar gayi, apna beta aur apna bhai chhodkar, fir uska azaad kiya hua ghulam bhi mar gaya, to aurat ka beta aur uska bhai Nabi ﷺ ke paas uski virasat ke baare mein aaye, to Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Uski virasat aurat ke bete ko jaayegi," to uske bhai ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, agar usne koi jurm kiya hota, to woh kispar aata?" Aapne farmaya: "Tumpar."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُغِيرَةُ ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  " عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَعْتَقَ مَمْلُوكًا لَهُ، فَمَاتَ وَمَاتَ الْمَوْلَى، فَتَرَكَ الْمُعْتِقُ أَبَاهُ وَابْنَهُ، فَقَالَ لِأَبِيهِ :كَذَا، وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِابْنِهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Salt, from Hushaym, from Mughirah: He said: I asked Ibrahim about a man who freed a slave of his, then he died and the patron also died, and the one who freed him left his father and his son, so he said: "For his father, such-and-such, and whatever remains is for his son."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Salt ne Hushaym se bataya: Humein Mughirah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibrahim se poocha us aadmi ke baare mein jisne apna ghulam azaad kiya, fir woh mar gaya aur maalik bhi mar gaya, aur azaad karne wale ne apna baap aur apna beta chhoda, to unhone kaha: "Baap ke liye itna-itna, aur jo baaqi bache woh bete ka."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ الْحَكَمَ  ، وَحَمَّادًا   ، يَقُولَانِ :" هُوَ لِلِابْنِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Salt, from Hushaym, from Shu'bah: He said: I heard al-Hakam, and Hammad, saying: "It goes to the son."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Salt ne Hushaym se, Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Hakam, aur Hammad, ko kehte suna: "Yeh bete ko jaayega."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَن   " : أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " خَرَجَ إِلَى الْبَقِيعِ ، فَرَأَى رَجُلًا يُبَاعُ، فَأَتَاهُ فَسَاوَمَ بِهِ، ثُمَّ تَرَكَهُ فَرَآهُ رَجُلٌ فَاشْتَرَاهُ فَأَعْتَقَهُ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ بِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ : إِنِّي اشْتَرَيْتُ هَذَا فَأَعْتَقْتُهُ، فَمَا تَرَى فِيهِ؟ فَقَالَ :هُوَ أَخُوكَ وَمَوْلَاكَ، قَالَ : مَا تَرَى فِي صُحْبَتِهِ؟ قَالَ : إِنْ شَكَرَكَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَهُ وَشَرٌّ لَكَ، وَإِنْ كَفَرَكَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكَ وَشَرٌّ لَهُ، قَالَ : مَا تَرَى فِي مَالِهِ؟ قَالَ : إِنْ مَاتَ وَلَمْ يَتْرُكْ عَصَبَةً فَأَنْتَ وَارِثُهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Ash'ath, from al-Hasan: "That the Prophet ﷺ went out to al-Baqi', and saw a man being sold, so he came to him and bargained over him, then left him, so another man saw him and bought him and freed him, then brought him to the Prophet ﷺ, and said: I bought this one and freed him, what is your view about him? So he said: He is your brother and your freed slave. He asked: What is your view about accompanying him? He said: If he is grateful to you, that is good for him and bad for you, and if he is ungrateful to you, that is good for you and bad for him. He asked: What is your view about his wealth? He said: If he dies and leaves no residuary heir, then you are his heir."
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Ash'ath se, al-Hasan se bataya: "ke Nabi ﷺ al-Baqi' ki taraf nikle, to aapne ek aadmi ko bikte dekha, to aap uske paas gaye aur uska bhaav lagaaya, fir usay chhod diya, to ek aadmi ne usay dekha aur usay khareed liya aur azaad kar diya, fir usay Nabi ﷺ ke paas laaya aur kaha: Maine isay khareeda aur azaad kar diya, iske baare mein aapki kya raay hai? Aapne farmaya: Woh tumhara bhai aur tumhara azaad kiya hua ghulam hai. Usne poocha: Uski sohbat ke baare mein aapki kya raay hai? Aapne farmaya: Agar woh tumhara shukriya ada kare, to yeh uske liye achha aur tumhare liye bura hai, aur agar woh tumhara na-shukra ho, to yeh tumhare liye achha aur uske liye bura hai. Usne poocha: Uske maal ke baare mein aapki kya raay hai? Aapne farmaya: Agar woh mare aur koi asabah na chhode, to tum uske waaris ho."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا أَشْعَثُ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، وَسَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ   : أَنَّ ابْنَةَ حَمْزَةَ أَعْتَقَتْ عَبْدًا لَهَا، فَمَاتَ وَتَرَكَ ابْنَتَهُ وَمَوْلَاتَهُ بِنْتَ حَمْزَةَ ، "فَقَسَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِيرَاثَهُ بَيْنَ ابْنَتِهِ وَمَوْلَاتِهِ بِنْتِ حَمْزَةَ نِصْفَيْنِ "
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Ash'ath, from al-Hakam, and Salamah ibn Kuhayl, from Abdullah ibn Shaddad: That the daughter of Hamzah freed a slave of hers, and he died leaving his daughter and his patroness, the daughter of Hamzah, "so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ divided his inheritance between his daughter and his patroness, the daughter of Hamzah, in halves."
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Ash'ath se, al-Hakam se, aur Salamah ibn Kuhayl se, Abdullah ibn Shaddad se bataya: ke Hamzah ki beti ne apna ek ghulam azaad kiya, aur woh mar gaya apni beti aur apni maalkin, Hamzah ki beti, ko chhodkar, "to Rasulullah ﷺ ne uski virasat uski beti aur uski maalkin, Hamzah ki beti, ke darmiyan aadhe-aadhe taqseem ki."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ شَمُوسَ الْكِنْدِيَّةِ L1465 ، قَالَتْ : " قَاضَيْتُ إِلَى عَلِيٍّ   فِي أَبٍ مَاتَ فَلَمْ يَدَعْ أَحَدًا غَيْرِي، وَمَوْلَاهُ،فَأَعْطَانِي النِّصْفَ، َوَأَعْطَى مَوْلَاهُ النِّصْفَ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali ibn Mushir, from al-Shaybani, from al-Hakam, from Shamus al-Kindiyyah: She said: "I brought a case to Ali concerning a father who died and left no one besides me, and his freed slave, so he gave me half, and gave his freed slave half."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali ibn Mushir se, al-Shaybani se, al-Hakam se, Shamus al-Kindiyyah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Main Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke paas ek maamla le kar gayi, ek aise baap ke baare mein jo mar gaya aur mere aur uske azaad kiye hue ghulam ke siwa kisi ko na chhoda, to unhone mujhe aadha diya, aur uske azaad kiye hue ghulam ko aadha diya."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْكَنُودِ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ   : " أَنَّهُ أُتِيَ بِابْنَةٍ وَمَوْلًى،فَأَعْطَى الِابْنَةَ النِّصْفَ، وَالْمَوْلَى النِّصْفَ، قَالَ الْحَكَمُ : فَمَنْزِلِي هَذَا نَصِيبُ الْمَوْلَى الَّذِي وَرِثَهُ عَنْ مَوْلَاهُ
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Ibn Abi Layla, from al-Hakam, from Abu al-Kanud, from Ali: "That he was brought a case of a daughter and a freed slave, so he gave the daughter half, and the freed slave half." Al-Hakam said: This house of mine is the share of the freed slave that he inherited from his patron.
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Ibn Abi Layla se, al-Hakam se, Abu al-Kanud se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bataya: "ke unke paas ek beti aur ek azaad kiye hue ghulam ka maamla laaya gaya, to unhone beti ko aadha diya, aur azaad kiye hue ghulam ko aadha diya." Al-Hakam kehte hain: Mera yeh ghar us azaad kiye hue ghulam ke hisse mein se hai jo usne apne maalik se virasat mein paaya.

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ ابْنِ إِدْرِيسَ  ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مُدْلِجٍ : أَنَّهُ مَاتَ وَتَرَكَ ابْنَتَهُ وَمَوَالِيَهُ،فَأَعْطَى عَلِيٌّ   ابْنَتَهُ النِّصْفَ وَمَوَالِيَهُ النِّصْفَ "
21.en: Narrated by Ibrahim ibn Musa, from Ibn Idris, from Ash'ath, from al-Hakam, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Mudlij: That he died leaving his daughter and his freed slaves, "so Ali gave his daughter half, and his freed slaves half."
21.hi: Ibrahim ibn Musa ne Ibn Idris se, Ash'ath se, al-Hakam se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Mudlij se bataya: ke woh mar gaye apni beti aur apne azaad kiye hue ghulamon ko chhodkar, "to Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne unki beti ko aadha diya aur unke azaad kiye hue ghulamon ko aadha diya."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ إِدْرِيسَ  ، عَنْ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ الشَّمُّوسِ L1465  : " أَنَّ أَبَاهَا مَاتَ،فَجَعَلَ عَلِيٌّ   لَهَا النِّصْفَ وَلِمَوَالِيهِ النِّصْفَ "
21.en: Narrated by Ibrahim, from Ibn Idris, from al-Shaybani, from al-Hakam, from al-Shamus: "That her father died, so Ali gave her half, and to his freed slaves, half."
21.hi: Ibrahim ne Ibn Idris se, al-Shaybani se, al-Hakam se, al-Shamus se bataya: "ke uske walid ka intiqaal hua, to Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne usay aadha diya, aur uske azaad kiye hue ghulamon ko aadha."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَشْعَثُ ، عَنْ جَهْمِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  : أَنَّهُ " سُئِلَ عَنْ أُخْتَيْنِ اشْتَرَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا أَبَاهَا فَأَعْتَقَتْهُ، ثُمَّ مَاتَ، قَالَ لَهُمَا :الثُّلُثَانِ فَرِيضَتُهُمَا فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ، وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِلْمُعْتِقَةِ دُونَ الْأُخْرَى "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from Ash'ath, from Jahm ibn Dinar, from Ibrahim: That he "was asked about two sisters, one of whom bought her father and freed him, then he died, he said to them: 'Two-thirds is their fixed share in the Book of Allah, and whatever remains is for the one who freed him, not the other.'"
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Hafs ibn Ghiyath se, Ash'ath se, Jahm ibn Dinar se, Ibrahim se bataya: ke unse "do behanon ke baare mein poocha gaya, jinmein se ek ne apne baap ko khareeda aur azaad kar diya, fir woh mar gaya, unhone unse kaha: 'Do-tihaai unka muqarrar hissa hai Allah ki Kitaab mein, aur jo baaqi bache woh us behen ke liye hai jisne usay azaad kiya, doosri ke liye nahi.'"

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  : " فِي امْرَأَةٍ أَعْتَقَتْ أَبَاهَا، فَمَاتَ الْأَبُ وَتَرَكَ أَرْبَعَ بَنَاتٍ هِيَ إِحْدَاهُنَّ، قَالَ :لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَّةٌ، لَهُنَّ الثُّلُثَانِ، وَهِيَ مَعَهُنَّ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Isra'il, from al-Ash'ath, from al-Sha'bi: Concerning a woman who freed her father, then the father died leaving four daughters, she being one of them, he said: "There is no favor owed to him [for freeing them since it was obligatory], two-thirds is for them, and she is with them [sharing equally in the remaining share]."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Isra'il se, al-Ash'ath se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: us aurat ke baare mein jisne apne baap ko azaad kiya, fir baap mar gaya chaar betiyaan chhodkar, jinmein se woh khud bhi ek thi, unhone kaha: "Usper koi ehsaan nahi [azaad karna farz tha], do-tihaai unke liye hai, aur woh unke saath hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، عَنْ حَيَّانَ بْنِ سَلْمَانَ L2590 ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ عِنْدَ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ غَفَلَةَ  ، فَجَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ، فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ " فَرِيضَةِ رَجُلٍ تَرَكَ ابْنَتَهُ وَامْرَأَتَه، فَقَالَ : أَنَا أُنْبِئُكَ قَضَاءَ عَلِيٍّ  ، قَالَ : حَسْبِي قَضَاءُ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ : قَضَى عَلِيٌّلِامْرَأَتِهِ الثُّمُنَ، وَلِابْنَتِهِ النِّصْفَ، ثُمَّ رَدَّ الْبَقِيَّةَ عَلَى ابْنَتِهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zuhayr, from Hayyan ibn Salman: He said: I was with Suwayd ibn Ghafalah, so a man came to him, and asked him about "a case of a man who left his daughter and his wife, so he said: I will inform you of Ali's ruling, so he said: Ali's ruling is enough for me, he said: Ali ruled for his wife an eighth, and for his daughter half, then returned the remainder to his daughter."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zuhayr se, Hayyan ibn Salman se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Suwayd ibn Ghafalah ke paas tha, to unke paas ek aadmi aaya, aur unse poocha "ek aise aadmi ke maamle ke baare mein jisne apni beti aur apni biwi chhodi, to unhone kaha: Main tumhein Ali (Alayhis Salam) ka faisla bataata hoon, to usne kaha: Mujhe Ali (Alayhis Salam) ka faisla kaafi hai, unhone kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne biwi ko aathwan hissa faisla diya, aur beti ko aadha, fir baaqi beti ko wapas kar diya."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ ، عَنْ أَبِي الْهَيْثَمِ ،  عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  : أَنَّ مَوْلَاةً لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ تُوُفِّيَتْ وَتَرَكَتْ مَالًا، فَقُلْتُ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ، فَقَالَ :" إِنَّ لَهَا ذَا قَرَابَةٍ "
21.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah, from Isra'il, from Abu al-Haytham, from Ibrahim: That a freed slave woman of Ibrahim died leaving wealth, so I said to Ibrahim [about it], so he said: "She indeed has a blood relative."
21.hi: Ubaydullah ne Isra'il se, Abu al-Haytham se, Ibrahim se bataya: ke Ibrahim ki ek azaad ki hui laundi mar gayi maal chhodkar, to maine Ibrahim se poocha, to unhone kaha: "Uska ek khoon ka rishtedaar hai."

21.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَشْعَثُ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ  ، وَعَلِيٍّ  ، وَزَيْدٍ  ، قَالَ : وَأَحْسَبُهُ قَدْ ذَكَرَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ   أَيْضًا : أَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا :" الْوَلَاءُ لِلْكُبْرِ.
يَعْنُونَ بِالْكُبْرِ : مَا كَانَ أَقْرَبَ بِأَبٍ أَوْ أُمٍّ "
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Ash'ath, from al-Sha'bi, from Umar, and Ali, and Zayd; with al-Sha'bi's added clarification: He said: And I think he also mentioned Abdullah: that they said: "The wala' [right of patronage] goes to the eldest/nearest [heir]," meaning by 'eldest': whoever was nearest through father or mother.
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Ash'ath se, al-Sha'bi se, Umar, aur Ali (Alayhis Salam), aur Zayd se bataya: Unhone kaha, aur mera khayal hai unhone Abdullah ka bhi zikr kiya: ke unhone kaha: "Wala' sabse qareebi (bade) waaris ko jaayega," 'bade' se murad hai: jo baap ya maa ki taraf se sabse qareeb ho.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَشْعَثُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ  ، قَالَ : " كَتَبَ إِلَيَّ عُمَرُ فِي شَأْنِ فُكَيْهَةَ بِنْتِ سَمْعَانَ أَنَّهَا مَاتَتْ وَتَرَكَتْ ابْنَ أَخِيهَا لِأَبِيهَا وَأُمِّهَا، وَابْنَ أَخِيهَا لِأَبِيهَا، فَكَتَبَ عُمَرُ   :إِنَّ الْوَلَاءَ لِلْكُبْرِ "
21.en: Narrated by Yazid, from Ash'ath, from Ibn Sirin, from Abdullah ibn Utbah: He said: "Umar wrote to me concerning the matter of Fukayhah bint Sam'an: that she died leaving her full brother's son, and her paternal half-brother's son, so Umar wrote: 'Indeed the wala' goes to the nearest.'"
21.hi: Yazid ne Ash'ath se, Ibn Sirin se, Abdullah ibn Utbah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Umar ne mujhe Fukayhah bint Sam'an ke maamle mein likha: ke woh mar gayin apne sage bhai ke bete aur apne baap-shareek bhai ke bete ko chhodkar, to Umar ne likha: 'Wala' sabse qareebi ko jaayega.'"

21.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  : أَنَّ عَلِيًّا  ، وَزَيْدًا   قَالَا :" الْوَلَاءُ لِلْكُبْر ".
وَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ  ، وَشُرَيْحٌ   : لِلْوَرَثَةِ
21.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Shihab, from al-Shaybani, from al-Sha'bi: That Ali, and Zayd, said: "The wala' goes to the eldest/nearest." And Abdullah, and Shurayh, said: To the heirs [collectively].
21.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Shihab se, al-Shaybani se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: ke Ali (Alayhis Salam), aur Zayd, ne kaha: "Wala' sabse qareebi ko jaayega." Aur Abdullah, aur Shurayh, ne kaha: Sab waarison ko.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ  ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، قَالَ : " قَضَى عُمَر  ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ  ، وَعَلِيٌّ  ، وَزَيْدٌ  لِلْكُبْرِ بِالْوَلَاءِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Ash'ath, from al-Sha'bi: He said: "Umar, and Abdullah, and Ali, and Zayd ruled the wala' for the nearest [heir]."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Ash'ath se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Umar, aur Abdullah, aur Ali (Alayhis Salam), aur Zayd ne wala' ka faisla sabse qareebi ke liye diya."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، قَالَ : " تُوُفِّيَتْ فُكَيْهَةُ بِنْتُ سَمْعَانَ وَتَرَكَتْ ابْنَ أَخِيهَا لِأَبِيهَا، وَبَنِي بَنِي أَخِيهَا لِأَبِيهَا وَأُمِّهَا،فَوَرَّثَ عُمَرُ   بَنِي أَخِيهَا لِأَبِيهَا "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sharik, from Ash'ath, from Ibn Sirin: He said: "Fukayhah bint Sam'an died leaving her paternal half-brother's son, and her full brother's grandsons, so Umar gave inheritance to her paternal half-brother's son."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sharik se, Ash'ath se, Ibn Sirin se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Fukayhah bint Sam'an mar gayin apne baap-shareek bhai ke bete, aur apne sage bhai ke poton ko chhodkar, to Umar ne apne baap-shareek bhai ke bete ko virasat di."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ،  عَنْ عُمَرَ  ، وَعَلِيٍّ  ، وَزَيْدٍ   : أَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا :" الْوَلَاءُ لِلْكُبْرِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abd al-Salam ibn Harb, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from Umar, and Ali, and Zayd: That they said: "The wala' goes to the nearest."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Abd al-Salam ibn Harb se, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se, Umar, aur Ali (Alayhis Salam), aur Zayd se bataya: ke unhone kaha: "Wala' sabse qareebi ko jaayega."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  : " فِي أَخَوَيْنِ وَرِثَا مَوْلًى كَانَ أَعْتَقَهُ أَبُوهُمَا، فَمَاتَ أَحَدُهُمَا وَتَرَكَ وَلَدًا، قَالَ : كَانَ عَلِيٌّ  ، وَزَيْدٌ  ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ   ، يَقُولُونَ :" الْوَلاءُ لِلْكَبِر "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abu Awanah, from Mughirah, from Ibrahim: Concerning two brothers who inherited a freed slave whom their father had freed, then one of them died leaving a child, he said: Ali, and Zayd, and Abdullah, used to say: "The wala' goes to the nearest."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Abu Awanah se, Mughirah se, Ibrahim se bataya: do bhaiyon ke baare mein jinhone ek azaad kiye hue ghulam ki virasat paayi jise unke baap ne azaad kiya tha, fir unmein se ek mar gaya apni aulaad chhodkar, unhone kaha: Ali (Alayhis Salam), aur Zayd, aur Abdullah, kehte the: "Wala' sabse qareebi ko jaayega."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ مَطَرًا الْوَرَّاقَ  ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ عُمَرُ  ، وَعَلِيٌّ   :" الْوَلاءُ لِلْكِبَرِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Hammad ibn Zayd: He said: I heard Matar al-Warraq say: Umar, and Ali, said: "The wala' goes to the nearest."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Matar al-Warraq ko kehte suna: Umar, aur Ali (Alayhis Salam), ne kaha: "Wala' sabse qareebi ko jaayega."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، عَنْ رَوْحٍ ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، وَابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ ، عَنْ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ :" الْوَلَاءُ لِلْكُبْرِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Rawh, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ata, and Ibn Jurayj, from Ibn Tawus, from his father: He said: "The wala' goes to the nearest."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Rawh se, Ibn Jurayj se, Ata se, aur Ibn Jurayj se, Ibn Tawus se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Wala' sabse qareebi ko jaayega."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" الْوَلَاءُ لِلْكُبْرِ "
21.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Isra'il, from Mansur, from Ibrahim: He said: "The wala' goes to the nearest."
21.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Isra'il se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Wala' sabse qareebi ko jaayega."

21.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، وَسُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ   فِي الرَّجُلِ يُوَالِي الرَّجُلَ، قَالَا :" هُوَ بَيْنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ ".
قَالَ سُفْيَانُ : وَكَذَلِكَ نَقُولُ
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from Mutarrif, from al-Sha'bi, and Sufyan, from Yunus, from al-Hasan; with Sufyan's added note: Concerning a man who forms an alliance [wala'] with another man, they both said: "It is [held] among the Muslims [collectively]." Sufyan said: And that is what we say too.
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se, Mutarrif se, al-Sha'bi se, aur Sufyan se, Yunus se, al-Hasan se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo doosre aadmi se muahida (wala') karta hai, dono ne kaha: "Yeh Musalmanon ke darmiyan hai." Sufyan kehte hain: Aur hum bhi yehi kehte hain.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ تَمِيمًا الدَّارِيَّ  ، يَقُولُ : سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا السُّنَّةُ فِي الرَّجُلِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكُفْرِ يُسْلِمُ عَلَى يَدَيْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ الْمُسْلِمِينَ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" هُوَ أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِمَحْيَاهُ وَمَمَاتِهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz, from Abdullah ibn Mawhab: He said: I heard Tamim al-Dari say: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and said: "O Messenger of Allah, what is the sunnah concerning a man from the disbelievers who becomes Muslim at the hands of a Muslim man?" So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "He has the most right to his life and his death."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz se bataya: Humein Abdullah ibn Mawhab ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Tamim al-Dari ko kehte suna: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ se poocha, aur kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, kaafiron mein se ek aadmi ke baare mein sunnat kya hai jo ek Musalman aadmi ke haathon Musalman ho jaaye?" To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Woh uski zindagi aur uski maut ka logon mein sabse zyada haqdaar hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّوَادِ، أَسْلَمَ عَلَى يَدَيْ رَجُلٍ، قَالَ :" يَعْقِلُ عَنْهُ، وَيَرِثُهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah, from Isra'il, from Mansur, from Ibrahim: He said: He was asked about a man from the people of al-Sawad who became Muslim at the hands of a man, he said: "He pays [blood-money] on his behalf, and inherits from him."
21.hi: Ubaydullah ne Isra'il se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unse Sawad ke ek aadmi ke baare mein poocha gaya jo ek aadmi ke haathon Musalman ho gaya, unhone kaha: "Woh uski taraf se [khoon-baha] ada karega, aur usse virasat paayega."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ،  عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" تَرِثُ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ دِيَةِ زَوْجِهَا فِي الْعَمْدِ وَالْخَطَإِ "
21.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Shu'bah, from Mughirah, from Ibrahim: He said: "The wife inherits from her husband's blood-money, whether it was intentional or by mistake."
21.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Shu'bah se, Mughirah se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Biwi apne shohar ki diyat se virasat paati hai, chahe woh qatl-e-amd ho ya khata."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" الدِّيَةُ عَلَى فَرَائِضِ اللَّهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Abu Awanah, from Mughirah, from Ibrahim: He said: "The blood-money follows the fixed shares [of Allah's inheritance law]."
21.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Abu Awanah se, Mughirah se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Diyat Allah ke muqarrar hisson ke mutaabiq taqseem hoti hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، قَالَ :" الدِّيَةُ سَبِيلُهَا سَبِيلُ الْمِيرَاثِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Wuhayb, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah: He said: "The blood-money's way is the way of inheritance."
21.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Wuhayb se, Ayyub se, Abu Qilabah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Diyat ka tareeqa virasat ka hi tareeqa hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ ، وَدَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ : أن عمر بن عبد العزيز  كتب أن :" يورث الإخوة من الأم من الدية "
21.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Humayd, and Da'ud ibn Abi Hind: That Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz wrote that: "The maternal siblings are given inheritance from the blood-money."
21.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Humayd se, aur Da'ud ibn Abi Hind se bataya: ke Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz ne likha: "Maa-shareek bhai-behanon ko diyat se virasat di jaaye."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، قَالَ :" الْعَقْلُ مِيرَاثٌ بَيْنَ وَرَثَةِ الْقَتِيلِ عَلَى كِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَفَرَائِضِهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yunus, from Ibn Shihab: He said: "Blood-money is inheritance among the heirs of the slain, according to the Book of Allah and its fixed shares."
21.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhse Yunus ne bataya, Ibn Shihab se: Unhone kaha, "Khoon-baha maqtool ke waarison ke darmiyan virasat hai, Allah ki Kitaab aur uske muqarrar hisson ke mutaabiq."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ بَعْضِ  وَلَدِ ابْنِ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ  ، قَالَ :" لَقَدْ ظَلَمَ مَنْ لَمْ يُوَرِّثْ الْإِخْوَةَ مِنْ الْأُمِّ مِنْ الدِّيَةِ "
21.en: Narrated by Qabisah, from Sufyan, from Amr ibn Dinar, from one of the children of Ibn al-Hanafiyyah, from Ali: He said: "Whoever does not give inheritance to maternal siblings from the blood-money has indeed wronged."
21.hi: Qabisah ne Sufyan se, Amr ibn Dinar se, Ibn al-Hanafiyyah ki aulaad mein se ek se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jisne maa-shareek bhai-behanon ko khoon-baha se virasat na di, usne zaroor zulm kiya."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ  ، وَعَلِيٍّ  ، وَزَيْدٍ   ، قَالُوا :" الدِّيَةُ تُورَثُ كَمَا يُورَثُ الْمَالُ خَطَؤُهُ وَعَمْدُهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Khalid, from Ibn Salim, from al-Sha'bi, from Umar, and Ali, and Zayd: They said: "Blood-money is inherited just as wealth is inherited, whether it was by mistake or intentional."
21.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Khalid se, Ibn Salim se, al-Sha'bi se, Umar, aur Ali (Alayhis Salam), aur Zayd se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Khoon-baha usi tarah virasat mein aati hai jaise maal virasat mein aata hai, chahe woh khata ho ya amd (jaan-boojh kar)."

21.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ، قَالَ : " كَانَ عَلِيٌّ  لَا يُوَرِّثُ الْإِخْوَةَ مِنْ الْأُمِّ، وَلَا الزَّوْجَ، وَلَا الْمَرْأَةَ، مِنْ الدِّيَةِ شَيْئًا ".
قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ : بَعْضُهُمْ يُدْخِلُ بَيْنَ إِسْمَاعِيل، وَعَامِرٍ رَجُلًا
21.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Isma'il, from Amir; with Abdullah al-Darimi's note: He said: "Ali used not to give inheritance to maternal siblings, nor the husband, nor the wife, anything from the blood-money." Abdullah said: Some of them insert a man between Isma'il and Amir [in the chain].
21.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Isma'il se, Amir se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Ali (Alayhis Salam) maa-shareek bhai-behanon ko, na shohar ko, na biwi ko, khoon-baha se kuch virasat nahi dete the." Abdullah (Imam Darimi) kehte hain: Kuch log Isma'il aur Amir ke darmiyan ek aadmi shaamil karte hain.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ زِيَادٍ الْأَعْلَمِ ،  عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" لَا تُوَرَّثُ الْإِخْوَةُ مِنْ الْأُمِّ مِنْ الدِّيَةِ "
21.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ziyad al-A'lam, from al-Hasan: He said: "Maternal siblings are not given inheritance from the blood-money."
21.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ziyad al-A'lam se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Maa-shareek bhai-behanon ko khoon-baha se virasat nahi di jaati."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ خَارِجَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ  ، قَالَ :" كُلُّ قَوْمٍ مُتَوَارِثِينَ عَمِيَ مَوْتُهُمْ فِي هَدْمٍ، أَوْ غَرَقٍ، فَإِنَّهُمْ لَا يَتَوَارَثُونَ، يَرِثُهُمْ الْأَحْيَاءُ "
21.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Ibn Abi al-Zinad, from his father, from Kharijah ibn Zayd, from Zayd ibn Thabit: He said: "Every group of people who inherit from each other, whose deaths become unclear [as to order] in a collapse or drowning, they do not inherit from each other, the living inherit from them."
21.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Ibn Abi al-Zinad se, apne walid se, Kharijah ibn Zayd se, Zayd ibn Thabit se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Aapas mein virasat paane wale kisi bhi giroh ke log jinki maut ka waqt kisi imaarat ke girne, ya doobne mein maloom na ho, to woh aapas mein virasat nahi paate, unhein zinda log virasat mein paate hain."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَتِيقٍ ، قَالَ : قَرَأْتُ فِي بَعْضِ كُتُبِ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ  فِي الْقَوْمِ يَقَعُ عَلَيْهِمْ الْبَيْتُ، لَا يُدْرَى أَيُّهُمَا مَاتَ قَبْلُ؟ قَالَ :" لَا يُوَرَّثُ الْأَمْوَاتُ بَعْضُهُمْ مِنْ بَعْضٍ، وَيُوَرَّثُ الْأَحْيَاءُ مِنْ الْأَمْوَاتِ "
21.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Yahya ibn Atiq: He said: I read in one of the letters of Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz concerning people upon whom a house collapses, and it is not known which one died first? He said: "The dead do not inherit from each other, but the living inherit from the dead."
21.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Yahya ibn Atiq se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz ke kisi khat mein padha un logon ke baare mein jinpar ghar gir jaaye, aur maloom na ho kaun pehle mara? Unhone kaha: "Murda log aapas mein virasat nahi paate, lekin zinda log murdon se virasat paate hain."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ   : أَنَّ أُمَّ كُلْثُومٍ ، وَابْنَهَا زَيْدًا مَاتَا فِي يَوْمٍ وَاحِدٍ، فَالْتَقَتْ الصَّائِحَتَانِ فِي الطَّرِيقِ،فَلَمْ يَرِثْ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا مِنْ صَاحِبِهِ، وَأَنَّ أَهْلَ الْحَرَّةِ لَمْ يَتَوَارَثُوا، وَأَنَّ أَهْلَ صِفِّينَ لَمْ يَتَوَارَثُوا "
21.en: Narrated by Nu'aym ibn Hammad, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Ja'far, from his father: That Umm Kulthum, and her son Zayd, died on the same day, and the two funeral criers met on the way, so neither of them inherited from the other, and that the people of al-Harrah did not inherit from each other, and that the people of Siffin did not inherit from each other.
21.hi: Nu'aym ibn Hammad ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se bataya: Humein Ja'far ne bataya, apne walid se: ke Umm Kulthum, aur unke bete Zayd, ek hi din mar gaye, aur dono ka matam karne wale raaste mein mile, to unmein se kisi ne ek-doosre se virasat nahi paayi, aur ke al-Harrah walon ne aapas mein virasat nahi paayi, aur ke Siffin walon ne bhi aapas mein virasat nahi paayi.

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ   : " أَنَّ بَيْتًا بِالشَّامِ وَقَعَ عَلَى قَوْمٍ،فَوَرَّثَ عُمَرُ   بَعْضَهُمْ مِنْ بَعْضٍ "
21.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Ibn Abi Layla, from al-Sha'bi: "That a house in Syria collapsed upon a group of people, so Umar gave them inheritance from each other."
21.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Ibn Abi Layla se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: "ke Sham mein ek ghar kuch logon par gir gaya, to Umar ne unhein aapas mein virasat di."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ حُرَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ   : " أَنَّهُوَرَّثَ أَخَوَيْنِ قُتِلَا بِصِفِّينَ، أَحَدَهُمَا مِنْ الْآخَرِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from Hurays, from his father, from Ali: "That he gave inheritance to two brothers who were killed at Siffin, one from the other."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se, Hurays se, apne walid se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bataya: "ke unhone Siffin mein maare gaye do bhaiyon ko aapas mein virasat di, ek doosre se."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا حُمَيْدٌ  ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِيِّ   : " أَنَّ رَجُلًا هَلَكَ، وَتَرَكَ عَمَّتَهُ، وَخَالَتَهُ،فَأَعْطَى عُمَرُ الْعَمَّةَ نَصِيبَ الْأَخِ، وَأَعْطَى الْخَالَةَ نَصِيبَ الْأُخْتِ "
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Humayd, from Bakr ibn Abdullah al-Muzani: "That a man died, leaving his paternal aunt, and his maternal aunt, so Umar gave the paternal aunt the share of a brother, and gave the maternal aunt the share of a sister."
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Humayd se, Bakr ibn Abdullah al-Muzani se bataya: "ke ek aadmi mar gaya, apni phuphi, aur apni khaala chhodkar, to Umar ne phuphi ko bhai ka hissa diya, aur khaala ko behen ka hissa diya."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" مَنْ أَدْلَى بِرَحِمٍ، أُعْطِيَ بِرَحِمِهِ الَّتِي يُدْلِي بِهَا "
21.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Shihab, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim: He said: "Whoever claims connection through a blood relation, is given according to the relation through which he connects."
21.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Shihab se, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo khoon ke rishte se rishta jode, usay usi rishte ke mutaabiq diya jaayega jiske zariye woh jodta hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو إِسْحَاق الشَّيْبَانِيُّ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  : " فِي رَجُلٍ تَرَكَ عَمَّتَهُ، وَابْنَةَ أَخِيهِ، قَالَ :الْمَالُ لِابْنَةِ أَخِيهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Shihab, from Abu Ishaq al-Shaybani, from al-Sha'bi: Concerning a man who left his paternal aunt, and his brother's daughter, he said: "The wealth goes to his brother's daughter."
21.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Shihab se bataya: Mujhse Abu Ishaq al-Shaybani ne bataya, al-Sha'bi se: us aadmi ke baare mein jisne apni phuphi, aur apne bhai ki beti chhodi, unhone kaha: "Maal uske bhai ki beti ko jaayega."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" الْخَالُ وَارِثٌ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sharik, from Layth, from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "The maternal uncle is an heir."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sharik se, Layth se, Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir se, Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Mamu waaris hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدَةَ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  : أَنَّ عُمَرَ  ، وَعَبْدَ اللَّهِ   رَأَيَا أَنْيُوَرِّثَا خَالًا "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Hasan, from Ubaydah, from Ibrahim: That Umar, and Abdullah, held the view that a maternal uncle should be given inheritance.
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Hasan se, Ubaydah se, Ibrahim se bataya: ke Umar, aur Abdullah, is raay ke the ke mamu ko virasat di jaaye.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ أَبِي إِسْحَاق ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  : فِي عَمَّةٍ، وَبِنْتِ أَخٍ، قَالَ :" الْمَالُ لِابْنَةِ الْأَخِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Hasan, from Sulayman Abu Ishaq, from al-Sha'bi: Concerning a paternal aunt, and a brother's daughter, he said: "The wealth goes to the brother's daughter."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Hasan se, Sulayman Abu Ishaq se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: phuphi, aur bhai ki beti ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Maal bhai ki beti ko jaayega."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، أنبأنا حَسَنٌ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ ، عَنْ بَعْضِهِمْ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" لِلْعَمَّةِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Hasan, from Sulayman, from someone, from Ibrahim: He said: "For the paternal aunt."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Hasan se, Sulayman se, kisi se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Phuphi ke liye."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  : فِي بِنْتِ أَخٍ، وَعَمَّةٍ، قَالَ :" أَعْطِي الْمَالَ لِابْنَةِ الْأَخِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from al-Shaybani, from al-Sha'bi: Concerning a brother's daughter, and a paternal aunt, he said: "Give the wealth to the brother's daughter."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se, al-Shaybani se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: bhai ki beti, aur phuphi ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Maal bhai ki beti ko do."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ   : فِي رَجُلٍ تُوُفِّيَ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ وَارِثٌ إِلَّا ابْنَةُ أَخِيهِ وَخَالُهُ، قَالَ :" لِلْخَالِ نَصِيبُ أُخْتِهِ، وَلِابْنَةِ الْأَخِ نَصِيبُ أَبِيهَا "
