21.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Zakariya, from Amir, from Masruq: Concerning a man who died with no heir except his brother's daughter and his maternal uncle, he said: "For the maternal uncle, the share of his sister, and for the brother's daughter, the share of her father."
21.hi: Ya'la ne Zakariya se, Amir se, Masruq se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo mara aur uska koi waaris na tha siwaay uske bhai ki beti aur uske mamu ke, unhone kaha: "Mamu ke liye, uski behen ka hissa, aur bhai ki beti ke liye, uske baap ka hissa."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ، قَالَ : " كَانَ مَسْرُوقٌ  يُنَزِّلُ الْعَمَّةَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْأَبِ، إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ أَبٌ، وَالْخَالَةَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْأُمِّ، إِذَا لَمْ تَكُنْ أُمٌّ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Yunus, from Amir: He said: "Masruq used to place the paternal aunt in the position of the father, when there was no father, and the maternal aunt in the position of the mother, when there was no mother."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Yunus se, Amir se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Masruq phuphi ko baap ke darjay mein rakhte the, jab koi baap na ho, aur khaala ko maa ke darjay mein, jab koi maa na ho."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَبَّانَ  نَسَبَهُ إِلَى جَدِّهِ ، عَنْ عَمِّهْ وَاسِعِ بْنِ حَبَّانَ  ، قَالَ : تُوُفِّيَ ابْنُ الدَّحْدَاحَةِ، وَكَانَ أَتِيًّا، وَهُوَ الَّذِي لَا يُعْرَفُ لَهُ أَصْلٌ، فَكَانَ فِي بَنِي الْعَجْلَانِ، وَلَمْ يَتْرُكْ عَقِبًا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِعَاصِمِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ :" هَلْ تَعْلَمُونَ لَهُ فِيكُمْ نَسَبًا؟ قَالَ : مَا نَعْرِفُهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَدَعَا ابْنَ أُخْتِهِ، فَأَعْطَاهُ مِيرَاثَهُ
21.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Muhammad ibn Habban, tracing his lineage to his grandfather, from his uncle Wasi' ibn Habban: He said: Ibn al-Dahdahah died, and he was a newcomer, that is, one whose lineage was not known, and he was among Banu al-Ajlan, and left no offspring, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Asim ibn Adi: "Do you know any lineage for him among you?" He said: "We do not know it, O Messenger of Allah," so he called his sister's son, and gave him his inheritance.
21.hi: Ya'la ne Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, Muhammad ibn Habban se, jinka nasab unke dada tak jaata hai, apne chacha Wasi' ibn Habban se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ibn al-Dahdahah mar gaye, aur woh 'aati' the, yaani jinka koi maloom nasab na ho, aur woh Banu al-Ajlan mein the, aur unhone koi aulaad na chhodi, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne Asim ibn Adi se poocha: "Kya tumhein tum mein unka koi nasab maloom hai?" Unhone kaha: "Humein nahi maloom, Ya Rasulullah," to aapne unki behen ke bete ko bulaaya, aur unhein uski virasat de di.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي  ، عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ   : " أَنَّهُأَعْطَى خَالًا الْمَالَ "
21.en: Narrated by Umar ibn Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from his father, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from Umar: "That he gave a maternal uncle the wealth."
21.hi: Umar ibn Hafs ibn Ghiyath ne apne walid se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya, Ibrahim se, Umar se: "ke unhone ek mamu ko sara maal diya."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هَانِئٍ  ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ عَامِرٌ  عَنْ امْرَأَةٍ أَوْ رَجُلٍ، تُوُفِّيَ وَتَرَكَ خَالَةً وَعَمَّةً، قَالَ : " لَيْسَ لَهُ وَارِثٌ وَلَا رَحِمٌ غَيْرُهُمَا "، فَقَالَ : كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ  يُنَزِّلُ الْخَالَةَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ أُمِّهِ، وَيُنَزِّلُ الْعَمَّةَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ أَخِيهَا
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Abu Hani': He said: Amir was asked about a woman or a man who died leaving a maternal aunt and a paternal aunt, he said: "He has no heir and no blood relative besides these two," so he said: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud used to place the maternal aunt in the position of her mother, and place the paternal aunt in the position of her brother.
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Abu Hani' se bataya: Unhone kaha, Amir se poocha gaya ek aisi aurat ya aadmi ke baare mein jo mara ek khaala aur ek phuphi chhodkar, unhone kaha: "Uska koi aur waaris ya khoon ka rishtedaar in dono ke siwa nahi," to unhone kaha: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud khaala ko uski maa ke darjay mein rakhte the, aur phuphi ko uske bhai ke darjay mein.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ   : فِي رَجُلٍ اعْتَرَفَ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ بِأَلْفِ دِرْهَمٍ لِرَجُلٍ، وَأَقَامَ آخَرُ بَيِّنَةً بِأَلْفِ دِرْهَمٍ، وَتَرَكَ الْمَيِّتُ أَلْفَ دِرْهَمٍ، فَقَالَ :" الْمَالُ بَيْنَهُمَا نِصْفَيْنِ، إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ مُفْلِسًا، فَلَا يَجُوزُ إِقْرَارُهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Shihab, from Amr, from al-Hasan: Concerning a man who acknowledged, at the time of his death, a thousand dirhams owed to one man, and another man established evidence for a thousand dirhams, and the deceased left a thousand dirhams: he said: "The wealth is between the two of them in halves, unless he was bankrupt, in which case his acknowledgment is not valid."
21.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Shihab se, Amr se, al-Hasan se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jisne apni maut ke waqt ek hazaar dirham ek aadmi ke liye qabool kiya, aur doosre aadmi ne ek hazaar dirham ka saboot pesh kiya, aur murda ne ek hazaar dirham chhode: unhone kaha: "Maal dono ke darmiyan aadha-aadha hoga, siwaay iske ke woh dewaaliya ho, to uska iqraar jaayez nahi."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِشَرِيكٍ   : كَيْفَ ذَكَرْتَ فِي الْأَخَوَيْنِ يَدَّعِي أَحَدُهُمَا أَخًا؟ قَالَ :" يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهِ فِي نَصِيبِهِ "، قُلْتُ : مَنْ ذَكَرَهُ؟ قَالَ : جَابِرٌ  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym: He said: I said to Sharik: "How did you narrate concerning two brothers, one of whom claims [the existence of] a [third] brother?" He said: "He is included in his share." I said: "Who mentioned it?" He said: Jabir, from Amir, from Ali.
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Sharik se poocha: "Aapne do bhaiyon ke baare mein kya bayaan kiya jinmein se ek [teesre] bhai ka dawa kare?" Unhone kaha: "Woh uske hisse mein shaamil ho jaayega." Maine poocha: "Isay kisne bayaan kiya?" Unhone kaha: Jabir ne, Amir se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمُحَارِبِيُّ ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  : فِي الْإِخْوَةِ يَدَّعِي بَعْضُهُمْ الْأَخَ، وَيُنْكِرُ الْآخَرُونَ، قَالَ :" يَدْخُلُ مَعَهُمْ بِمَنْزِلَةِ عَبْدٍ يَكُونُ بَيْنَ الْإِخْوَةِ، فَيَعْتِقَ أَحَدُهُمْ نَصِيبَهُ، قَالَ : وَكَانَ عَامِرٌ ، وَالْحَكَمُ ، وَأَصْحَابُهُمَا يَقُولُونَ : لَا يَدْخُلُ إِلَّا فِي نَصِيبِ الَّذِي اعْتَرَفَ بِهِ
21.en: Narrated by Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad al-Muharibi, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim: Concerning brothers, some of whom claim [the existence of] a [further] brother, and the others deny it, he said: "He is included with them like the position of a slave shared between brothers, and one of them frees his own share." He said: And Amir, and al-Hakam, and their companions used to say: He is only included in the share of the one who acknowledged him.
21.hi: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah ne Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad al-Muharibi se, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se bataya: un bhaiyon ke baare mein jinmein se kuch [ek aur] bhai ka dawa karein, aur baaki inkaar karein, unhone kaha: "Woh unke saath is tarah shaamil hota hai jaise ek ghulam jo bhaiyon ke darmiyan sanjha ho, aur unmein se ek apna hissa azaad kar de." Unhone kaha: Aur Amir, aur al-Hakam, aur unke sathi kehte the: Woh sirf us shakhs ke hisse mein shaamil hota hai jisne uska iqraar kiya.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ ابْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ  ، عَنْ وَكِيعٍ  ، قَالَ : إِذَا كَانَا أَخَوَيْنِ، فَادَّعَى أَحَدُهُمَا أَخًا وَأَنْكَرَهُ الْآخَرُ؟ قَالَ : كَانَ ابْنُ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، يَقُولُ :" هِيَ مِنْ سِتَّةٍ : لِلَّذِي لَمْ يَدَّعِ ثَلَاثَةٌ، وَلِلْمُدَّعِي سَهْمَانِ، وَلِلْمُدَّعَى سَهْمٌ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, from Waki': He said: If there are two brothers, and one of them claims [a third] brother and the other denies him? He said: Ibn Abi Layla used to say: "It is from six: for the one who did not claim, three, and for the claimant, two shares, and for the claimed one, one share."
21.hi: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah ne Waki' se bataya: Unhone kaha, Agar do bhai hon, aur unmein se ek [teesre] bhai ka dawa kare aur doosra usse inkaar kare? Unhone kaha: Ibn Abi Layla kehte the: "Yeh chhe hisson mein se hoga: jisne dawa nahi kiya usay teen, aur dawa karne wale ko do hisse, aur jiska dawa kiya gaya usay ek hissa."

21.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ  ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ   : " فِي الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ لَهُ ثَلَاثَةُ بَنِينَ، فَقَالَ :ثُلُثِي لِأَصْغَرِ بَنِيَّ، فَقَالَ الْأَوْسَطُ : أَنَا أُجِيزُ، وَقَالَ الْأَكْبَرُ : أَنَا لَا أُجِيزُ، قَالَ : هِيَ مِنْ تِسْعَةٍ يُخْرِجُ ثَلاثَةً فَلَهُ سَهْمُهُ، وَسَهْمُ الَّذِي أَجَاز ".
وَقَالَ حَمَّادٌ : يَرُدُّ السَّهْمَ عَلَيْهِمْ جَمِيعًا، وَقَالَ عَامِرٌ   : الَّذِي رَدَّ إِنَّمَا رَدَّ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ
21.en: Narrated by Yunus ibn Muhammad, from Abu Awanah, from Mughirah, from Hammad: Concerning a man who has three sons, and he says: "Two-thirds is for my youngest son," so the middle one says: "I permit it," and the eldest says: "I do not permit it," he said: "It is from nine, he takes three out, so he has his own share, and the share of the one who permitted." And Hammad said: The share is returned to all of them together, and Amir said: The one who rejected only rejected [it as] against himself.
21.hi: Yunus ibn Muhammad ne Abu Awanah se, Mughirah se, Hammad se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jiske teen bete hon, aur woh kahe: "Do-tihaai mere sabse chhote bete ke liye hai," to beech wala kahe: "Main ijaazat deta hoon," aur sabse bada kahe: "Main ijaazat nahi deta," unhone kaha: "Yeh nau hisson mein se hoga, teen nikaale jaayenge, to usay uska apna hissa milega, aur us shakhs ka hissa jisne ijaazat di." Aur Hammad ne kaha: Hissa un sabko wapas kar diya jaayega, aur Amir ne kaha: Jisne radd kiya, usne sirf apne khilaaf radd kiya.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ ، عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ  : فِي رَجُلٍ أَقَرَّ بِأَخٍ، قَالَ :" بَيِّنَتُهُ أَنَّهُ أَخُوهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, from Yahya ibn Adam, from Sharik, from Khalid, from Ibn Sirin, from Shurayh: Concerning a man who acknowledged a brother, he said: "His evidence is that he is his brother."
21.hi: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah ne Yahya ibn Adam se, Sharik se, Khalid se, Ibn Sirin se, Shurayh se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jisne ek bhai ka iqraar kiya, unhone kaha: "Uska saboot yehi hai ke woh uska bhai hai."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ  ، عَنْ الْحَارِثِ الْعُكْلِيِّ   : فِي رَجُلٍ أَقَرَّ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ بِأَلْفِ دِرْهَمٍ مُضَارَبَةً، وَأَلْفٍ دَيْنًا، وَلَمْ يَدَعْ إِلَّا أَلْفَ دِرْهَمٍ، قَالَ :" يُبْدَأُ بِالدَّيْنِ، فَإِنْ فَضَلَ فَضْلٌ كَانَ لِصَاحِبِ الْمُضَارَبَةِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Abu Awanah, from Mughirah, from al-Harith al-Ukli: Concerning a man who acknowledged at the time of his death a thousand dirhams as a mudarabah [investment partnership] debt, and a thousand dirhams as an ordinary debt, and left only a thousand dirhams, he said: "The debt is started with first, so if there is any surplus, it belongs to the mudarabah partner."
21.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Abu Awanah se, Mughirah se, al-Harith al-Ukli se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jisne apni maut ke waqt ek hazaar dirham mudarabah (sarmaayakaari saajhedaari) ka qarz, aur ek hazaar dirham aam qarz qabool kiya, aur sirf ek hazaar dirham chhoda, unhone kaha: "Pehle qarz se shuru kiya jaayega, so agar kuch bacha, to woh mudarabah wale saathi ka hoga."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  : " فِي رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَتَرَكَ ثَلَاثَ مِئَةِ دِرْهَمٍ، وَثَلَاثَةَ بَنِينَ، فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ يَدَّعِي مِائَةَ دِرْهَمٍ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ، فَأَقَرَّ لَهُ أَحَدُهُمْ، قَالَ :يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهِ بِالْحِصَّةِ "، ثُمَّ قَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ : مَا أُرَى أَنْ يَكُونَ مِيرَاثًا، حَتَّى يُقْضَى الدَّيْنُ
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Hasan, from Mutarrif, from al-Sha'bi: Concerning a man who died leaving three hundred dirhams, and three sons, so a man came claiming a hundred dirhams owed to him by the deceased, and one of them [the sons] acknowledged it: he said: "He is included against him proportionally." Then al-Sha'bi said: I do not consider it to have become inheritance until the debt is settled.
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Hasan se, Mutarrif se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo mara teen sau dirham aur teen bete chhodkar, to ek aadmi aaya sau dirham ka dawa karte hue jo murda par tha, aur unmein se ek ne uska iqraar kiya: unhone kaha: "Woh usper hisse ke mutaabiq shaamil hoga." Fir al-Sha'bi ne kaha: Mera khayal nahi ke yeh virasat ban jaaye, jab tak qarz ada na ho jaaye.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ مُصْعَبُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْحَرَّانِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ الْأَشْعَثِ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ   : فِي رَجُلٍ هَلَكَ وَتَرَكَ ابْنَيْنِ، وَتَرَكَ أَلْفَيْ دِرْهَمٍ، فَاقْتَسَمَا الْأَلْفَيْ دِرْهَمٍ، وَغَابَ أَحَدُ الِابْنَيْنِ، فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ، فَاسْتَحَقَّ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ أَلْفَ دِرْهَمٍ، قَالَ :" يَأْخُذُ جَمِيعَ مَا فِي يَدِ هَذَا الشَّاهِدِ، وَيُقَالُ لَهُ : اتَّبِعْ أَخَاكَ الْغَائِبَ، وَخُذْ نِصْفَ مَا فِي يَدِهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Khaythamah Mus'ab ibn Sa'id al-Harrani, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from al-Ash'ath, from al-Hasan: Concerning a man who died leaving two sons, and left two thousand dirhams, so the two sons divided the two thousand dirhams, and one of the two sons was absent, then a man came and established a claim on the deceased for a thousand dirhams, he said: "He takes all of what is in the hand of this present witness, and it is said to him: 'Pursue your absent brother, and take half of what is in his possession.'"
21.hi: Abu Khaythamah Mus'ab ibn Sa'id al-Harrani ne Muhammad ibn Abdullah se, al-Ash'ath se, al-Hasan se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo mara do bete aur do hazaar dirham chhodkar, to dono beton ne do hazaar dirham taqseem kar liye, aur unmein se ek beta ghair-haazir tha, fir ek aadmi aaya, aur murda par hazaar dirham ka haq saabit kiya, unhone kaha: "Woh sab kuch le lega jo is haazir gawah ke haath mein hai, aur usse kaha jaayega: 'Apne ghair-haazir bhai ka peechha karo, aur uske paas jo hai uska aadha le lo.'"

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ زِيَادٍ الْأَعْلَمِ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، قَالَ :" إِذَا أَقَرَّ بَعْضُ الْوَرَثَةِ بِدَيْنٍ، فَهُوَ عَلَيْهِ بِحِصَّتِهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ziyad al-A'lam, from al-Hasan: He said: "When one of the heirs acknowledges a debt, it falls upon him in his proportional share."
21.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ziyad al-A'lam se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab waarison mein se koi ek qarz ka iqraar kare, to woh uspar uske hisse ke mutaabiq lagu hoga."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي هَاشِمٍ ،  عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا شَهِدَ اثْنَانِ مِنْ الْوَرَثَةِ بِدَيْنٍ، فَهُوَ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ إِذَا كَانُوا عُدُولًا "، وَقَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ  : عَلَيْهِمَا فِي بَاب فِي مِيرَاثِ الْمُرْتَدِّ
21.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Abu Hashim, from Ibrahim; with al-Sha'bi's differing view: He said: "When two of the heirs testify to a debt, it is taken from the entire wealth, if they are upright." And al-Sha'bi said: It falls upon the two of them [only, not the whole estate].
21.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Abu Hashim se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab waarison mein se do log qarz ki gawahi dein, to woh poore maal se liya jaayega, agar woh adal (theek) hon." Aur al-Sha'bi ne kaha: Yeh un dono par hi lagu hoga.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ جُمَيْعٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ  " يُوَرِّثُ أَهْلَ الْمُرْتَدِّ إِذَا قُتِلَ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Thabit ibn al-Walid ibn Jumay', from his father, from al-Qasim ibn Abd al-Rahman: He said: Ibn Mas'ud used to "give inheritance to the family of an apostate when he was killed."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Thabit ibn al-Walid ibn Jumay' se bataya: Mujhe unke walid ne bataya, al-Qasim ibn Abd al-Rahman se: Unhone kaha, Ibn Mas'ud "murtad (deen se phir jaane wale) ke gharwalon ko virasat dete the jab woh qatal kiya jaata."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ  : أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ  " جَعَلَ مِيرَاثَ الْمُرْتَدِّ لِوَرَثَتِهِ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ "
21.en: Narrated by al-Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Abu Awanah, from al-A'mash, from Abu Amr al-Shaybani: That Ali ibn Abi Talib "made the inheritance of the apostate for his Muslim heirs."
21.hi: Al-Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Abu Awanah se, al-A'mash se, Abu Amr al-Shaybani se bataya: ke Ali ibn Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne "murtad ki virasat uske Musalman waarison ke liye kar di."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ  ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ  : أَنَّ عَلِيًّا  " قَضَى فِي مِيرَاثِ الْمُرْتَدِّ لِأَهْلِهِ مِنْ الْمُسْلِمِينَ "
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Hajjaj, from al-Hakam: That Ali "ruled the inheritance of the apostate for his Muslim family."
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Hajjaj se, al-Hakam se bataya: ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne "murtad ki virasat uske Musalman gharwalon ke liye faisla di."

21.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ هُوَ ابْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، قَالَ :" إِذَا قَتَلَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ عَمْدًا، لَمْ يُوَرَّثْ مِنْ مِيرَاثِهِ، وَلَا مِنْ دِيَتِهِ، فَإِذَا قَتَلَهُ خَطَأً، وُرِّثَ مِنْ مِيرَاثِهِ، وَلَمْ يُوَرَّثْ مِنْ دِيَتِهِ.
 قَالَ : وَكَانَ عَطَاءٌ   يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ
21.en: Narrated by Zakariya ibn Adi, from Ubaydullah ibn Amr, from Abd al-Karim, from al-Hakam; with Ata's agreement: He said: "When a man kills his brother intentionally, he is not given inheritance from his inheritance nor from his blood-money, but if he kills him by mistake, he is given inheritance from his inheritance, but not from his blood-money." He said: And Ata used to say that.
21.hi: Zakariya ibn Adi ne Ubaydullah ibn Amr se, Abd al-Karim se, al-Hakam se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab aadmi apne bhai ko qatl-e-amd karta hai, to usay uski virasat se na uski diyat se kuch nahi milta, lekin agar woh usay khata mein qatal kare, to usay uski virasat milegi, lekin uski diyat nahi milegi." Unhone bataya: Aur Ata bhi yehi kehte the.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ خِلَاسٍ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ  ، قَالَ : رَمَى رَجُلٌ أُمَّهُ بِحَجَرٍ فَقَتَلَهَا، فَطَلَبَ مِيرَاثَهُ مِنْ إِخْوَتِهِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ إِخْوَتُهُ : لَا مِيرَاثَ لَكَ، فَارْتَفَعُوا إِلَى عَلِيٍّ،" فَجَعَلَ عَلَيْهِ الدِّيَةَ، وَأَخْرَجَهُ مِنْ الْمِيرَاثِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Sa'id, from Qatadah, from Khilas, from Ali: He said: A man threw a stone at his mother and killed her, then he sought his inheritance from his siblings, so his siblings said to him: "You have no inheritance," so they took it up with Ali, "so he imposed the blood-money upon him, and excluded him from the inheritance."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Sa'id se, Qatadah se, Khilas se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi ne apni maa par pathar phenka aur usay maar diya, fir usne apni virasat apne bhai-behanon se maangi, to uske bhai-behanon ne usse kaha: "Tumhare liye koi virasat nahi," to woh Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke paas gaye, "to unhone uspar diyat muqarrar ki, aur usay virasat se nikaal diya."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ الْحُرِّ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ   : أَنَّ الرَّجُلَ إِذَا قَتَلَ امْرَأَتَهُ خَطَأً، " أَنَّهُيُمْنَعُ مِيرَاثَهُ مِنْ الْعَقْلِ وَغَيْرِهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zuhayr, from al-Hasan ibn al-Hurr, from al-Hakam: That when a man kills his wife by mistake, "he is prevented from her inheritance, from the blood-money and other than it."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zuhayr se, al-Hasan ibn al-Hurr se, al-Hakam se bataya: ke jab aadmi apni biwi ko khata mein qatal kare, "to usay uski virasat se roka jaata hai, diyat se aur uske ilaawa se bhi."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ  ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ :" لَا يَرِثُ الْقَاتِلُ مِنْ الْمَقْتُولِ شَيْئًا "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from Layth, from Mujahid, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "The killer does not inherit anything from the slain."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se, Layth se, Mujahid se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Qaatil maqtool se kuch bhi virasat nahi paata."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  : " فِي رَجُلٍ قَذَفَ امْرَأَتَهُ، وَجَاءَ بِشُهُودٍ فَرُجِمَتْ؟ قَالَ :يَرِثُهَا "
21.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah, from Ibn al-Mubarak, from Ma'mar, from Qatadah: Concerning a man who accuses his wife [of adultery], and brings witnesses, so she is stoned? He said: "He inherits from her."
21.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah ne Ibn al-Mubarak se, Ma'mar se, Qatadah se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo apni biwi par tuhmat lagaaye, aur gawah laaye, to usay rajm kiya jaaye? Unhone kaha: "Woh usse virasat paayega."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ   : " فِي رَجُلٍ جُلِدَ الْحَدَّ أَرَاهُ مَاتَ، شَكَّ أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ؟ قَالَ :يَتَوَارَثَانِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Abu Awanah, from Hammad: Concerning a man who was flogged with a fixed punishment - I think he died, Abu al-Nu'man was uncertain? He said: "They inherit from each other."
21.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Abu Awanah se, Hammad se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jise hadd ki saza mein kode maare gaye - mera khayal hai woh mar gaya, Abu al-Nu'man ko shak tha? Unhone kaha: "Woh aapas mein virasat paayenge."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ  ، قَالَ :" الْقَاتِلُ لَا يَرِثُ، وَلَا يَحْجُبُ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Abu Awanah, from Muhammad ibn Salim, from Amir, from Ali: He said: "The killer does not inherit, nor does he exclude [others from inheritance]."
21.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Abu Awanah se, Muhammad ibn Salim se, Amir se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Qaatil na virasat paata hai, na kisi ko [virasat se] mehroom karta hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ  ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الْعَبْدِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ  ، قَالَ :" لَا يُوَرَّثُ الْقَاتِلُ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Hasan, from Layth, from Abu Amr al-Abdi, from Ali: He said: "The killer is not given inheritance."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Hasan se, Layth se, Abu Amr al-Abdi se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Qaatil ko virasat nahi di jaati."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عُمَرُ   :" لَا يَرِثُ قَاتِلٌ خَطَأً، وَلَا عَمْدًا "
21.en: Narrated by Zakariya ibn Adi, from Abu Bakr, from Mutarrif, from al-Sha'bi: He said: Umar said: "A killer, whether by mistake or intentional, does not inherit."
21.hi: Zakariya ibn Adi ne Abu Bakr se, Mutarrif se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Umar ne kaha: "Qaatil, chahe khata mein ho ya jaan-boojh kar, virasat nahi paata."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ  ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ :" لَا يَرِثُ الْقَاتِلُ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Layth, from Tawus, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "The killer does not inherit."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Layth se, Tawus se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Qaatil virasat nahi paata."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْأَعْلَى ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا اجْتَمَعَ نَسَبَانِ، وُرِّثَ بِأَكْبَرِهِمَا، يَعْنِي الْمَجُوسَ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abd al-A'la, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri: He said: "When two lineages come together, inheritance goes by the greater of the two," meaning: the Magians [who intermarried within family].
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Abd al-A'la se, Ma'mar se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab do nasab ekattha hon, to virasat unmein se bade ke mutaabiq hogi," yaani: Majoosi (jo apne khaandaan mein hi nikaah karte the).

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ  ، قَالَ :" يَرِثُ مِنْ الْجَانِبِ الَّذِي يَصْلُحُ، وَلَا يَرِثُ مِنْ الْجَانِبِ الَّذِي لَا يَصْلُحُ "
21.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Hammad ibn Abi Sulayman: He said: "He inherits from the side which is valid, and does not inherit from the side which is not valid."
21.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Hammad ibn Abi Sulayman se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Woh us taraf se virasat paata hai jo jaayez ho, aur us taraf se virasat nahi paata jo jaayez na ho."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  : أَنَّ عَلِيًّا  ، وَابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ  ، قَالَا فِي الْمَجُوسِ :" إِذَا أَسْلَمُوا، يَرِثُونَ مِنْ الْقَرَابَتَيْنِ جَمِيعًا "
21.en: Narrated by Hajjaj, from Hammad, from Sufyan al-Thawri, from a man, from al-Sha'bi: That Ali, and Ibn Mas'ud, said, concerning the Magians: "When they become Muslim, they inherit from both relations together."
21.hi: Hajjaj ne Hammad se, Sufyan al-Thawri se, ek aadmi se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: ke Ali (Alayhis Salam), aur Ibn Mas'ud, ne Majoosiyon ke baare mein kaha: "Jab woh Musalman ho jaayein, to woh dono rishton se ekattha virasat paate hain."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ  فِي امْرَأَةِ الْأَسِيرِ : " أَنَّهَاتَرِثُهُ وَيَرِثُهَا "
21.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Ibn Abi al-Zinad, from his father, from Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz: Concerning the wife of a captive: "That she inherits from him and he inherits from her."
21.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Ibn Abi al-Zinad se, apne walid se, Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz se bataya: ek qaidi ki biwi ke baare mein: "ke woh usse virasat paati hai aur woh usse virasat paata hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، حَدَّثَنِي مَعْمَرٌ ، عَنْ إِسْحَاق بْنِ رَاشِدٍ ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ  فِي الْأَسِيرِ يُوصِي، قَالَ :" أُجيزُ لَهُ وَصِيَّتَهُ مَا دَامَ عَلَى دِينِهِ لَمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ عَنْ دِينِهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Fadl, from Abdullah ibn al-Mubarak, from Ma'mar, from Ishaq ibn Rashid, from Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz: Concerning a captive who makes a will, he said: "I permit his will as long as he is upon his religion and has not changed from his religion."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Fadl ne Abdullah ibn al-Mubarak se bataya: Mujhse Ma'mar ne bataya, Ishaq ibn Rashid se, Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz se: us qaidi ke baare mein jo wasiyat kare, unhone kaha: "Main uski wasiyat ko jaayez maanta hoon jab tak woh apne deen par ho aur apne deen se badla na ho."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ ، قَالَ :" يُوَرَّثُ الْأَسِيرُ إِذَا كَانَ فِي أَيْدِي الْعَدُوِّ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Da'ud, from al-Sha'bi, from Shurayh: He said: "The captive is given inheritance even while in the hands of the enemy."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Da'ud se, al-Sha'bi se, Shurayh se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Qaidi ko virasat di jaati hai chahe woh dushman ke haath mein ho."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، حَدَّثَنِي مَنْ سَمِعَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، يَقُولُ :" يُوَرَّثُ الْأَسِيرُ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad, from Sufyan, from someone who heard Ibrahim: Saying: "The captive is given inheritance."
21.hi: Muhammad ne Sufyan se bataya: Mujhse us shakhs ne bataya jisne Ibrahim ko kehte suna: "Qaidi ko virasat di jaati hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  : أَنَّهُ كَانَ" لَا يُوَرِّثُ الْأَسِيرَ "
21.en: Narrated by al-Mu'alla ibn Asad, from Wuhayb, from Da'ud, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab: That he used not to "give inheritance to the captive."
21.hi: Al-Mu'alla ibn Asad ne Wuhayb se, Da'ud se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se bataya: ke woh "qaidi ko virasat nahi dete the."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، قَالَ : كَتَبَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ   إِلَى شُرَيْحٍ : أَنْ" لَا يُوَرِّثَ الْحَمِيلَ إِلَّا بِبَيِّنَةٍ، وَإِنْ جَاءَتْ بِهِ فِي خِرَقِهَا "
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Ash'ath, from al-Sha'bi: He said: Umar ibn al-Khattab wrote to Shurayh: "Do not give inheritance to a person of unknown lineage [brought as a child from elsewhere] except with clear evidence, even if she brought him wrapped in her own rags [as a claim of birth]."
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Ash'ath se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Umar ibn al-Khattab ne Shurayh ko likha: "Kisi anjaan nasab wale ko [jise kahin se bachche ki tarah laaya gaya ho] bagair saaf saboot ke virasat na do, chahe woh usay apne hi kapdon mein lipeta hua laaye."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" وَرِّثْ الْحَمِيلَ "
21.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah, from Isra'il, from Mansur, from Ibrahim: He said: "Give inheritance to the person of unknown lineage."
21.hi: Ubaydullah ne Isra'il se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Anjaan nasab wale ko virasat do."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ مِنْ بَنِي أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ ، عَنْ ضَمْرَةَ ، وَالْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ فَضَالَةَ ، وَابْنِ أَبِي عَوْفٍ ، وراشد ، وعطية ، قَالُوا :" لَا يُوَرَّثُ الْحُمَلَاءُ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Sa'id from Banu Umayyah, from Abu Bakr ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Maryam, from Damrah, and al-Fudayl ibn Fadalah, and Ibn Abi Awf, and Rashid, and Atiyyah: They said: "Those of unknown lineage are not given inheritance."
21.hi: Abu Sa'id, Banu Umayyah se, ne Abu Bakr ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Maryam se bataya, Damrah se, aur al-Fudayl ibn Fadalah se, aur Ibn Abi Awf se, aur Rashid se, aur Atiyyah se: Unhone kaha, "Anjaan nasab walon ko virasat nahi di jaati."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، قَالَ : قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ : حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ ، قَالَ : ذُكِرَ عِنْدَهُ قَوْلُ مَنْ يَقُولُ فِي الْحَمِيلِ، فَأَنْكَرَ ذَلِكَ، وَقَالَ :" قَدْ تَوَارَثَ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ، وَالْأَنْصَارُ بِنَسَبِهِمْ الَّذِي كَانَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ "
21.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah, from Ibn al-Mubarak, from Ibn Awn, from Muhammad: He said: The saying of those who spoke about the person of unknown lineage was mentioned in his presence, so he rejected that, and said: "The Emigrants, and the Ansar, indeed inherited from each other by their lineage which existed in the Jahiliyyah."
21.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah ne Ibn al-Mubarak se bataya: Ibn al-Mubarak ne kaha: Humein Ibn Awn ne bataya, Muhammad se: Unhone kaha, Unke saamne un logon ki baat zikr ki gayi jo anjaan nasab wale ke baare mein kehte the, to unhone isse inkaar kiya, aur kaha: "Muhajireen, aur Ansar, ne aapas mein apne us nasab ke zariye virasat paayi jo Jahiliyat mein tha."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ ، عَنْ ابْنِ إِدْرِيسَ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، وَابْنِ سِيرِينَ ، قَالَا :" لَا يُوَرَّثُ الْحَمِيلُ إِلَّا بِبَيِّنَةٍ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, from Ibn Idris, from Hisham, from al-Hasan, and Ibn Sirin: They both said: "The person of unknown lineage is not given inheritance except with clear evidence."
21.hi: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah ne Ibn Idris se, Hisham se, al-Hasan se, aur Ibn Sirin se bataya: Dono ne kaha, "Anjaan nasab wale ko bagair saaf saboot ke virasat nahi di jaati."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" لَمْ يَكُنْ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، وَعُمَرُ، وَعُثْمَانُ يُوَرِّثُونَ الْحَمِيلَ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Bakr, from Jarir, from Layth, from Hammad, from Ibrahim: He said: "Abu Bakr, and Umar, and Uthman did not give inheritance to the person of unknown lineage."
21.hi: Abu Bakr ne Jarir se, Layth se, Hammad se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Abu Bakr (رضي الله عنه), aur Umar, aur Uthman anjaan nasab wale ko virasat nahi dete the."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ الْمُحَارِبِيُّ ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ ، قَالَ :" أَقَرَّتْ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ مُحَارِبٍ جَلِيبَةٌ بِنَسَبٍ لَهَا جَلِيبٍ، فَوَرَّثَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُتْبَةَ  مِنْ أُخْتِهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Bakr, from Abd al-Rahim al-Muharibi, from Za'idah, from Ash'ath ibn Abi al-Sha'tha: He said: "A woman from [the tribe of] Muharib, an outsider brought there, acknowledged a lineage relation of hers, also brought there, so Abdullah ibn Utbah gave him inheritance from his sister."
21.hi: Abu Bakr ne Abd al-Rahim al-Muharibi se, Za'idah se, Ash'ath ibn Abi al-Sha'tha se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Muharib ki ek aurat, jo bahar se laayi gayi thi, ne apne ek nasab ke rishtedaar ka iqraar kiya, jo woh bhi bahar se laaya gaya tha, to Abdullah ibn Utbah ne usay uski behen se virasat de di."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ قَالَ عِنْدَ فِرَاقِ الدُّنْيَا : أَنَا مَوْلَى فُلَانٍ، قَالَ :" يُرَدُّ مِيرَاثَهُ لِمَنْ سَمَّى أَنَّهُ مَوْلَاهُ عِنْدَ فِرَاقِ الدُّنْيَا، إِلَّا أَنْ يَأْتُوا عَلَيْهِ بِبَيِّنَةٍ بِغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ يَرُدُّونَ بِهِ قَوْلَهُ، فَيُرَدُّ مِيرَاثُهُ إِلَى مَا قَامَتْ بِهِ الْبَيِّنَةُ "
21.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yunus, from Ibn Shihab: Concerning a man who said at the parting of this world: "I am the freed slave of so-and-so," he said: "His inheritance is given to whoever he named as his patron at the parting of this world, unless they bring clear evidence contrary to that, by which they reject his statement, so his inheritance is given according to what the evidence establishes."
21.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhse Yunus ne bataya, Ibn Shihab se: us aadmi ke baare mein jisne duniya se judaai ke waqt kaha: "Main fulaan ka azaad kiya hua ghulam hoon," unhone kaha: "Uski virasat usay di jaayegi jise usne apni duniya se judaai ke waqt apna maalik bataaya, illa yeh ke woh iske khilaaf saaf saboot laayein jisse woh uski baat ko radd karein, to uski virasat usi ke mutaabiq di jaayegi jo saboot se saabit ho."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ  ، وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ   ، قَالَا :" وَلَدُ الزِّنَا بِمَنْزِلَةِ ابْنِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sharik, from Muhammad ibn Salim, from al-Sha'bi, from Ali, and Abdullah: They both said: "The child of adultery is in the position of the child of li'an."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sharik se, Muhammad ibn Salim se, al-Sha'bi se, Ali (Alayhis Salam), aur Abdullah se bataya: Dono ne kaha, "Zina ka bachcha li'an ke bachche ke darjay mein hai."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ الْحُرِّ ، حَدَّثَنِي الْحَكَمُ  : أَنَّ" وَلَدَ الزِّنَا لَا يَرِثُهُ الَّذِي يَدَّعِيهِ، وَلَا يَرِثُهُ الْمَوْلُودُ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zuhayr, from al-Hasan ibn al-Hurr, from al-Hakam: That "the child of adultery, the one who claims him does not inherit from him, and the born child does not inherit from him."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zuhayr se, al-Hasan ibn al-Hurr se, al-Hakam se bataya: ke "zina ke bachche ko, jo shakhs uska dawa kare woh usse virasat nahi paata, aur na hi paida hua bachcha usse virasat paata hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَفْصَةَ ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ  أَنَّهُ كَانَ" لَا يُوَرِّثُ وَلَدَ الزِّنَا، وَإِنْ ادَّعَاهُ الرَّجُلُ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, from Rawh, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hafsah, from al-Zuhri, from Ali ibn Husayn: That he used not to "give inheritance to the child of adultery, even if the man claimed him."
21.hi: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah ne Rawh se, Muhammad ibn Abi Hafsah se, al-Zuhri se, Ali ibn Husayn se bataya: ke woh "zina ke bachche ko virasat nahi dete the, chahe aadmi uska dawa kare."

21.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي بَكْرُ بْنُ مُضَرَ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ بُكَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، قَالَ : " أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ أَتَى إِلَى غُلَامٍ يَزْعُمُ أَنَّهُ ابْنٌ لَهُ، وَأَنَّهُ زَنَى بِأُمِّهِ، وَلَمْ يَدَّعِ ذَلِكَ الْغُلَامَ أَحَدٌ، فَهُوَ يَرِثُهُ ".
قَالَ بُكَيْرٌ : وَسَأَلْتُ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ مِثْلَ قَوْلِ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ وَقَالَ عُرْوَةُ   : بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" الْوَلَدُ لِلْفِرَاشِ، وَلِلْعَاهِرِ الْحَجَرُ "
21.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from Bakr ibn Mudar, from Amr, that is Ibn al-Harith, from Bukayr, from Sulayman ibn Yasar; with Bukayr's added inquiry: He said: "Whichever man comes to a boy claiming he is his son, and that he committed adultery with his mother, and no one else has claimed that boy, he inherits from him." Bukayr said: And I asked Urwah about that, so he said the like of Sulayman ibn Yasar's saying, and Urwah said: It has reached us that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The child belongs to the [marriage] bed, and for the adulterer is the stone."
21.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne Bakr ibn Mudar se bataya: Mujhse Amr, yaani Ibn al-Harith, ne bataya, Bukayr se, Sulayman ibn Yasar se: Unhone kaha, "Jo bhi aadmi kisi ladke ke paas aakar dawa kare ke woh uska beta hai, aur ke usne uski maa se zina kiya, aur us ladke ka koi aur dawa na kare, to woh usse virasat paata hai." Bukayr kehte hain: Aur maine Urwah se bhi iske baare mein poocha, to unhone Sulayman ibn Yasar jaisi hi baat kahi, aur Urwah ne kaha: Humein khabar mili hai ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Bachcha [nikaah ke] bistar ka hota hai, aur zaani ke liye pathar hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، قَالَ :" ابْنُ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ مِثْلُ وَلَدِ الزِّنَا، تَرِثُهُ أُمُّهُ، وَوَرَثَتُهُ، وَرَثَةُ أُمِّهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Ibrahim ibn Musa, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from Amr, from al-Hasan: He said: "The child of li'an is like the child of adultery, his mother inherits from him, and his heirs are the heirs of his mother."
21.hi: Ibrahim ibn Musa ne Hafs ibn Ghiyath se, Amr se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Li'an ka bachcha zina ke bachche jaisa hai, uski maa usse virasat paati hai, aur uske waaris uski maa ke waaris hain."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" لَا يُوَرَّثُ وَلَدُ الزِّنَا "
21.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Abu Awanah, from Mughirah, from Ibrahim: He said: "The child of adultery is not given inheritance."
21.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Abu Awanah se, Mughirah se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Zina ke bachche ko virasat nahi di jaati."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ ، أَوْ يُونُسَ ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  : فِي أَوْلَادِ الزِّنَا، قَالَ :" يَتَوَارَثُونَ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْأُمَّهَاتِ، وَإِنْ وَلَدَتْ تَوْءَمًا فَمَاتَ، وَرِثَ السُّدُسَ "
21.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah, from Ibn al-Mubarak, from Ma'mar, or Yunus, from al-Zuhri: Concerning children of adultery, he said: "They inherit from each other through their mothers, and if she gave birth to twins and one died, he inherits a sixth."
21.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah ne Ibn al-Mubarak se bataya: Humein Ma'mar, ya Yunus, ne bataya, al-Zuhri se: zina ke bachchon ke baare mein, unhone kaha: "Woh apni maaon ke zariye aapas mein virasat paate hain, aur agar usne jurwaan bacche paida kiye aur ek mar gaya, to woh chhattai hissa paayega."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ شِبَاكٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" لَا يَرِثُ وَلَدُ الزِّنَا، إنما يرث من لم يقم على أبيه الحد، أو تملك أمه بنكاح 3، أو شراء "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, from Hushaym, from Mughirah, from Shibak, from Ibrahim: He said: "The child of adultery does not inherit; rather, only he inherits whose father did not have the punishment established against him [for adultery], or whose mother he came to possess through marriage or purchase, inherits."
21.hi: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah ne Hushaym se bataya: Humein Mughirah ne bataya, Shibak se, Ibrahim se: Unhone kaha, "Zina ka bachcha virasat nahi paata; balke sirf woh virasat paata hai jiske baap par hadd qaayam nahi ki gayi [zina ki], ya jiski maa ko usne nikaah ya khareed se apne qabze mein liya ho."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ  ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ   فِي الرَّجُلِ يَفْجُرُ بِالْمَرْأَةِ، ثُمَّ يَتَزَوَّجُهَا، قَالَ :" لَا بَأْسَ، إِلَّا أَنْ تَكُونَ حُبْلَى، فَإِنَّ الْوَلَدَ لَا يَلْحَقُهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Aban, from Musa ibn Muhammad al-Ansari, from Isma'il, from al-Hasan: Concerning a man who commits fornication with a woman, then marries her, he said: "There is no harm, unless she is pregnant, for then the child is not attributed to him."
21.hi: Isma'il ibn Aban ne Musa ibn Muhammad al-Ansari se, Isma'il se, al-Hasan se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo kisi aurat se zina kare, fir usse nikaah kar le, unhone kaha: "Koi harj nahi, siwaay iske ke woh haamila ho, kyunki tab bachcha uski taraf mansoob nahi kiya jaayega."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : قَضَى أَنَّ" كُلَّ مُسْتَلْحَقٍ اسْتُلْحِقَ بَعْدَ أَبِيهِ الَّذِي ادَّعَاهُ وَرَثَتُهُ بَعْدَهُ، فَقَضَى إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَمَةٍ يَمْلِكُهَا يَوْمَ يَطَؤُهَا، فَقَدْ لَحِقَ بِمَنْ اسْتَلْحَقَهُ، وَلَيْسَ لَهُ فِيمَا قُسِمَ قَبْلَهُ مِنْ الْمِيرَاثِ شَيْءٌ، وَمَا أَدْرَكَ مِنْ مِيرَاثٍ لَمْ يُقْسَمْ، فَلَهُ نَصِيبُهُ، وَلَا يَلْحَقُ إِذَا كَانَ الَّذِي يُدْعَى لَهُ أَنْكَرَهُ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَمَةٍ لَا يَمْلِكُهَا، أَوْ حُرَّةٍ عَاهَرَهَا، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَلْحَقُ وَلَا يَرِثُ، وَإِنْ كَانَ الَّذِي يُدْعَى لَهُ هُوَ ادَّعَاهُ، فَهُوَ وَلَدُ زِنَا لِأَهْلِ أُمِّهِ مَنْ كَانُوا : حُرَّةً، أَوْ أَمَةً "
21.en: Narrated by Zayd ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Rashid, from Sulayman ibn Musa, from Amr ibn Shu'ayb, from his father, from his grandfather: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled that: "Whoever is claimed [as a child] after his father who claimed him, and it is the heirs after him who claim him, then he ruled: if he was from a slave-girl he owned at the time he had relations with her, then he is attributed to whoever claimed him, but he has no share in whatever inheritance was distributed before that, and whatever inheritance he reaches that was not yet distributed, he has his share, but he is not attributed to him if the one being claimed for denied it, and if he was from a slave-girl he did not own, or a free woman he committed adultery with, then he is not attributed and does not inherit, and if the one being claimed for is himself the one who made the claim, then he is a child of adultery belonging to the people of his mother, whoever they were: free or slave."
21.hi: Zayd ibn Yahya ne Muhammad ibn Rashid se, Sulayman ibn Musa se, Amr ibn Shu'ayb se, apne walid se, apne dada se bataya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne faisla diya ke: "Jo apne baap ke jisne uska dawa kiya, uske baad dawa kiya jaaye, aur uske waaris hi uske baad dawa karein, to aapne faisla diya: agar woh aisi laundi se ho jise uske baap ne sohbat karte waqt maalik banaya ho, to woh usi ki taraf mansoob hoga jisne uska dawa kiya, lekin uska us virasat mein koi hissa nahi hoga jo uske pehle taqseem ho chuki, aur jo virasat abhi taqseem nahi hui usmein uska hissa hoga, lekin woh us shakhs ki taraf mansoob nahi hoga agar jiske liye dawa kiya jaa raha ho usne inkaar kiya, aur agar woh aisi laundi se ho jise usne maalik na banaya ho, ya aisi aazad aurat se ho jisse usne zina kiya ho, to woh mansoob nahi hoga aur virasat nahi paayega, aur agar jiske liye dawa kiya jaa raha hai woh khud hi dawa karne wala ho, to woh zina ka bachcha hai jo uski maa ke logon ka hoga, chahe woh aazad ho ya laundi."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، عَنْ عُمَيْرِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ  عَنْ مَمْلُوكٍ لِي وَلَدُ زِنًا، قَالَ :" لَا تَبِعْهُ، وَلَا تَأْكُلْ ثَمَنَهُ، وَاسْتَخْدِمْهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from al-Hasan, from Umayr ibn Yazid: He said: I asked al-Sha'bi about a slave of mine who was a child of adultery, he said: "Do not sell him, and do not eat his price, and employ him."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne al-Hasan se, Umayr ibn Yazid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Sha'bi se apne ek ghulam ke baare mein poocha jo zina ka bachcha tha, unhone kaha: "Isay mat becho, aur iski qeemat mat khaao, aur isse kaam lo."

21.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  : سُئِلَ عَنْ وَلَدِ زِنَا يَمُوتُ، قَالَ :" إِنْ كَانَ ابْنَ عَرَبِيَّةٍ، وَرِثَتْ أُمُّهُ الثُّلُثَ، وَجُعِلَ بَقِيَّةُ مَالِهِ فِي بَيْتِ الْمَالِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ ابْنَ مَوْلَاةٍ، وَرِثَتْ أُمُّهُ الثُّلُثَ، وَوَرِثَ مَوَالِيهَا الَّذِينَ أَعْتَقُوهَا مَا بَقِيَ.
قَالَ مَرْوَانُ : سَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا  يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ
21.en: Narrated by Marwan ibn Muhammad, from Sa'id, from al-Zuhri: He was asked about a child of adultery who dies, he said: "If he was the son of an Arab woman, his mother inherits a third, and the rest of his wealth is placed in the treasury, and if he was the son of a freed slave-woman, his mother inherits a third, and the patrons who freed her inherit whatever remains." Marwan said: I heard Malik say that.
21.hi: Marwan ibn Muhammad ne Sa'id se, al-Zuhri se bataya: unse zina ke bachche ke baare mein poocha gaya jo mar jaaye, unhone kaha: "Agar woh kisi Arab aurat ka beta ho, to uski maa tihai paati hai, aur uska baaqi maal baitul-maal mein rakh diya jaata hai, aur agar woh kisi azaad ki hui laundi ka beta ho, to uski maa tihai paati hai, aur jinhone usay azaad kiya woh maalik jo baaqi bache woh paate hain." Marwan kehte hain: Maine Malik ko yeh kehte suna.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْهَيْثَمُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ شُعَيْبٍ   : أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" قَضَى بِمِيرَاثِ ابْنِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ لِأُمِّهِ كُلِّهِ، لِمَا لَقِيَتْ فِيهِ مِنْ الْعَنَاءِ "
21.en: Narrated by Marwan ibn Muhammad, from al-Haytham ibn Humayd, from al-Ala ibn al-Harith, from Amr ibn Shu'ayb: That the Prophet ﷺ "ruled the entire inheritance of the child of li'an for his mother, because of the hardship she endured on account of him."
21.hi: Marwan ibn Muhammad ne al-Haytham ibn Humayd se, al-Ala ibn al-Harith se bataya: Mujhse Amr ibn Shu'ayb ne bataya: ke Nabi ﷺ ne "li'an ke bachche ki poori virasat uski maa ke liye faisla di, us takleef ki wajah se jo usne uski wajah se jhaili."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ  ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ حَصِيرَةَ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ   : أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي وَلَدِ الزِّنَا لِأَوْلِيَاءِ أُمِّهِ :" خُذُوا ابْنَكُمْ تَرِثُونَهُ وَتَعْقِلُونَهُ، وَلَا يَرِثُكُمْ "
21.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Aban, from Musa ibn Muhammad al-Ansari, from al-Harith ibn Hasirah, from Zayd ibn Wahb, from Ali: That he said, concerning the child of adultery, to the guardians of his mother: "Take your son, you inherit from him and pay [blood-money] on his behalf, but he does not inherit from you."
21.hi: Isma'il ibn Aban ne Musa ibn Muhammad al-Ansari se bataya: Mujhse al-Harith ibn Hasirah ne bataya, Zayd ibn Wahb se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se: ke unhone zina ke bachche ke baare mein, uski maa ke waalidon se kaha: "Apna beta le lo, tum usse virasat paoge aur uski taraf se [khoon-baha] ada karoge, lekin woh tumse virasat nahi paayega."

21.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ  ، قَالَ : َقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   :" السَّائِبَةُ يَضَعُ مَالَهُ حَيْثُ شَاءَ ".
قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ : قَالَ شُعْبَةُ : لَمْ يَسْمَعْ هَذَا مِنْ سَلَمَةَ أَحَدٌ غَيْرِي
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, and Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Shu'bah, from Salamah ibn Kuhayl, from Abu Amr al-Shaybani; with Shu'bah's note: He said: Abdullah said: "The sa'ibah [a slave freed unconditionally, with no wala' claimed] places his wealth wherever he wishes." Abdullah ibn Yazid said: Shu'bah said: No one heard this from Salamah except me.
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym, aur Abdullah ibn Yazid ne Shu'bah se bataya: Humein Salamah ibn Kuhayl ne bataya, Abu Amr al-Shaybani se: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ne kaha: "Sa'ibah (bagair kisi shart ke azaad kiya gaya ghulam) apna maal jahan chahe waha rakhta hai." Abdullah ibn Yazid kehte hain: Shu'bah ne kaha: Mere siwa kisi ne yeh Salamah se nahi suna.

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ وَرْدَانَ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ   : سُئِلَ عَنْ مِيرَاثِ السَّائِبَةِ، فَقَالَ :" كُلُّ عَتِيقٍ سَائِبَةٌ "
21.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Hatim ibn Wardan, from Yunus, from al-Hasan: He was asked about the inheritance of the sa'ibah, so he said: "Every freed slave is a sa'ibah [i.e., free of obligation in this sense]."
21.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Hatim ibn Wardan se, Yunus se, al-Hasan se bataya: unse sa'ibah ki virasat ke baare mein poocha gaya, to unhone kaha: "Har azaad kiya hua ghulam sa'ibah hai."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عُمَرُ   :" الصَّدَقَةُ وَالسَّائِبَةُ لِيَوْمِهِمَا، أَوْ لِوَقْتِهِمَا "
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Sulayman, from Abu Uthman: He said: Umar said: "Charity, and the sa'ibah, are for their own day [i.e., dealt with as they arise, without further complication]."
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Sulayman se, Abu Uthman se bataya: Unhone kaha, Umar ne kaha: "Sadqa, aur sa'ibah, apne hi waqt ke liye hote hain."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ عَامِرٍ  عَنْ الْمَمْلُوكِ يُعْتَقُ سَائِبَةً لِمَنْ وَلَاؤُهُ؟ قَالَ :" لِلَّذِي أَعْتَقَهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zakariya: He said: Amir was asked about the slave freed as a sa'ibah, to whom does his wala' belong? He said: "To the one who freed him."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zakariya se bataya: Unhone kaha, Amir se poocha gaya us ghulam ke baare mein jise sa'ibah bana kar azaad kiya jaaye, uska wala' kise milega? Unhone kaha: "Jisne usay azaad kiya usay."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ الْبَصْرِيُّ هُوَ رَوْحُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، قَالَ : " مَاتَ مَوْلًى عَلَى عَهْدِ عُثْمَانَ   وَلَيْسَ لَهُ وَالٍ،فَأَمَرَ بِمَالِهِ، فَأُدْخِلَ بَيْتَ الْمَالِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Hatim al-Basri (Rawh ibn Aslam), from Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Ishaq, from his father, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Amr: He said: "A freed slave died in the time of Uthman, and he had no guardian, so he commanded regarding his wealth, and it was put into the treasury."
21.hi: Abu Hatim al-Basri (Rawh ibn Aslam) ne Bishr ibn al-Mufaddal se bataya: Humein Abd al-Rahman ibn Ishaq ne bataya, apne walid se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Amr se: Unhone kaha, "Uthman ke zamane mein ek azaad kiya hua ghulam mara, aur uska koi sarparast nahi tha, to unhone uske maal ke baare mein hukum diya, aur usay baitul-maal mein daal diya gaya."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  : فِي رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَوْلَى عَتَاقَةٍ، قَالَ :" مَالُهُ حَيْثُ أَوْصَى بِهِ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ أَوْصَى، فَهُوَ فِي بَيْتِ الْمَالِ "
21.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Isma'il, from Amir, from Masruq: Concerning a man who died and had no patron from manumission, he said: "His wealth goes where he willed it, and if he had not made a will, it goes into the treasury."
21.hi: Ya'la ne Isma'il se, Amir se, Masruq se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo mara aur uska koi azaad karne wala maalik na tha, unhone kaha: "Uska maal wahan jaayega jahan usne wasiyat ki, aur agar usne wasiyat na ki ho, to woh baitul-maal mein jaayega."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ ، عَنْ ضَمْرَةَ ، وَرَاشِدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ، وَغَيْرِهِمَا، قَالُوا فِيمَنْ أُعْتِقَ سَائِبَةً :" إِنَّ وَلَاءَهُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَهُ، إِنَّمَا سَيَّبَهُ مِنْ الرِّقِّ، وَلَمْ يُسَيِّبْهُ مِنْ الْوَلَاءِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Sa'id ibn Amr, from Abu Bakr ibn Abi Maryam, from Damrah, and Rashid ibn Sa'd, and others: They said, concerning whoever was freed as a sa'ibah: "His wala' belongs to whoever freed him, he only released him from bondage, not from the wala'."
21.hi: Abu Sa'id ibn Amr ne Abu Bakr ibn Abi Maryam se, Damrah se, aur Rashid ibn Sa'd se, aur doosron se bataya: Unhone kaha, us shakhs ke baare mein jise sa'ibah bana kar azaad kiya jaaye: "Uska wala' usi ka hai jisne usay azaad kiya, usne sirf usay ghulaami se azaad kiya hai, wala' se nahi."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْصُورٌ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، وَالشَّعْبِيِّ ، قَالَا :" لَا بَأْسَ بِبَيْعِ وَلَاءِ السَّائِبَةِ وَهِبَتِهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, from Abu Da'ud, from Shu'bah: He said: Mansur told me: from Ibrahim, and al-Sha'bi, they said: "There is no harm in selling and gifting the wala' of a sa'ibah."
21.hi: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah ne Abu Da'ud se, Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhse Mansur ne bataya: Ibrahim, aur al-Sha'bi se, unhone kaha: "Sa'ibah ke wala' ko bechne aur tohfe mein dene mein koi harj nahi."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ  ، قَالَ : " أَعْتَقَ رَجُلٌ غُلَامًا سَائِبَةً، فَأَتَى عَبْدَ اللَّهِ  ، وَقَالَ : إِنِّي أَعْتَقْتُ غُلَامًا لِي سَائِبَةً، وَهَذِهِ تَرِكَتُهُ، قَالَ : هِيَ لَكَ، قَالَ :لَا حَاجَةَ لِي فِيهَا، قَالَ : فَضَعْهَا، فَإِنَّ هَهُنَا وَارِثًا كَثِيرًا "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from al-Mas'udi, from al-Qasim: He said: A man freed a slave-boy as a sa'ibah, so he came to Abdullah, and said: "I have freed a slave-boy of mine as a sa'ibah, and this is his estate," so he said: "It is yours," so he said: "I have no need of it," so he said: "Then put it down, for there are many heirs here."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne al-Mas'udi se, al-Qasim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi ne ek ghulam ladke ko sa'ibah bana kar azaad kiya, to woh Abdullah ke paas aaya, aur kaha: "Maine apne ek ghulam ladke ko sa'ibah bana kar azaad kiya, aur yeh uska tarikah hai," to unhone kaha: "Yeh tumhara hai," usne kaha: "Mujhe iski zaroorat nahi," to unhone kaha: "To isay rakh do, kyunki yahan bahut se waaris hain."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" إِذَا اسْتَهَلَّ الصَّبِيُّ، وُرِّثَ وَصُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Ash'ath, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ibn Abdullah: He said: "When the infant cries out [at birth], he is given inheritance and the funeral prayer is performed for him."
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Ash'ath se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir ibn Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab bachcha [paidaish par] cheekhe, to usay virasat di jaati hai aur uski namaz-e-janaza padhi jaati hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ :" إِذَا اسْتَهَلَّ الصَّبِيُّ، وَرِثَ وَوُرِثَ وَصُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sharik, from Abu Ishaq, from Ata, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "When the infant cries out, he inherits and is inherited from, and the funeral prayer is performed for him."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sharik se, Abu Ishaq se, Ata se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab bachcha cheekhe, to woh virasat paata hai aur usse virasat paayi jaati hai, aur uski namaz-e-janaza padhi jaati hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ  ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ :" لَيْسَ مِنْ مَوْلُودٍ إِلَّا يَسْتَهِلُّ، وَاسْتِهْلَالُهُ بِعَصْرِ الشَّيْطَانُ بَطْنَهُ، فَيَصِيحُ، إِلَّا عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ "
21.en: Narrated by Malik ibn Isma'il, from Isra'il, from Simak, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "There is no newborn except that he cries out, and his crying out is because the Shaytan squeezes his belly, so he screams, except Isa ibn Maryam."
21.hi: Malik ibn Isma'il ne Isra'il se, Simak se, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Koi bhi naumaulood aisa nahi jo cheekhe na, aur uska cheekhna is wajah se hai ke shaytan uske pet ko dabaata hai, to woh cheekhta hai, siwaay Isa ibn Maryam ke."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى هُوَ ابْنُ حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَاقِدٍ  ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا يَرِثُ الْمَوْلُودُ حَتَّى يَسْتَهِلَّ صَارِخًا، وَإِنْ وَقَعَ حَيًّا "
21.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Zayd ibn Waqid, from Makhul: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The newborn does not inherit until he cries out, even if he emerges alive."
21.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se, Zayd ibn Waqid se, Makhul se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Naumaulood virasat nahi paata jab tak woh cheekh na maare, chahe woh zinda hi kyun na nikle."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ :" إِذَا اسْتَهَلَّ الْمَوْلُودُ، صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَوُرِثَ "
21.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Ata, from Jabir: He said: "When the newborn cries out, the funeral prayer is performed for him and he is given inheritance."
21.hi: Ya'la ne Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, Ata se, Jabir se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab naumaulood cheekhe, to uski namaz-e-janaza padhi jaati hai aur usay virasat di jaati hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، قَالَ : أَرَى" الْعُطَاسَ اسْتِهْلَالًا "
21.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Ma'n, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from al-Zuhri: He said: I consider "sneezing to be [a valid sign of] crying out."
21.hi: Abdullah ibn Muhammad ne Ma'n se, Ibn Abi Dhi'b se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mera khayal hai "chheenkna bhi cheekhne [jaisa maana jaayega]."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" لَا يُوَرَّثُ الْمَوْلُودُ حَتَّى يَسْتَهِلَّ، وَلَا يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى يَسْتَهِلَّ، فَإِذَا اسْتَهَلَّ، صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَوُرِّثَ، وَكُمِّلَتْ الدِّيَةُ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Abu Awanah, from Mughirah, from Ibrahim: He said: "The newborn is not given inheritance until he cries out, and the funeral prayer is not performed for him until he cries out, so when he cries out, the funeral prayer is performed for him, and he is given inheritance, and the blood-money is paid in full."
21.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Abu Awanah se, Mughirah se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Naumaulood ko virasat nahi di jaati jab tak woh cheekh na maare, aur uski namaz nahi padhi jaati jab tak woh cheekh na maare, so jab woh cheekh maare, uski namaz padhi jaati hai aur usay virasat di jaati hai, aur diyat poori ada ki jaati hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  : وَسَأَلْنَاهُ عَنْ السِّقْطِ، فَقَالَ :" لَا يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ، وَلَا يُصَلَّى عَلَى مَوْلُودٍ حَتَّى يَسْتَهِلَّ صَارِخًا "
21.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yunus, from Ibn Shihab: And we asked him about the miscarried fetus, so he said: "The funeral prayer is not performed for it, and the funeral prayer is not performed for any newborn until he cries out."
21.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhse Yunus ne bataya, Ibn Shihab se: Aur humne unse giri hui bachche (miscarriage) ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: "Iski namaz nahi padhi jaati, aur kisi bhi naumaulood ki namaz nahi padhi jaati jab tak woh cheekh na maare."

21.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ ،  عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا ابْتَاعَ الْمُكَاتَبَانِ أَحَدُهُمَا الْآخَرَ : هَذَا هَذَا مِنْ سَيِّدِهِ، وَهَذَا هَذَا مِنْ سَيِّدِهِ، فَالْبَيْعُ لِلْأَوَّلِ.
وَيَقُولُ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ : الْوَلَاءُ لِسَيِّدِ الْبَائِعِ، وَيَقُولُونَ : إِنَّمَا ابْتَاعَ هَذَا مَا عَلَى الْمُكَاتَبِ، فَالْوَلَاءُ لِلسَّيِّدِ
21.en: Narrated by Harun ibn Mu'awiyah, from Abu Sufyan, from Ma'mar, from Qatadah: He said: "When two mukatabs [contracted slaves] buy each other: this one from his master, and this one from his master, the sale goes to the first one." And the people of Madinah say: The wala' belongs to the seller's master, and they say: He only bought what was owed by the mukatab, so the wala' belongs to the master.
21.hi: Harun ibn Mu'awiyah ne Abu Sufyan se, Ma'mar se, Qatadah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab do mukatab (azaadi ke muahide wale ghulam) ek-doosre ko khareedein: yeh isay apne maalik se, aur yeh usse apne maalik se, to saude ka haq pehle wale ka hai." Aur Madinah wale kehte hain: Wala' bechne wale ke maalik ka hoga, aur woh kehte hain: Isne to sirf woh khareeda jo mukatab par baaqi tha, so wala' maalik ka hi hoga.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ  ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" أَيُّمَا حُرٍّ تَزَوَّجَ أَمَةً، فَقَدْ أَرَقَّ نِصْفَهُ، وَأَيُّمَا عَبْدٍ تَزَوَّجَ حُرَّةً، فَقَدْ أَعْتَقَ نِصْفَهُ، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : يَعْنِي الْوَلَدَ
21.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Yahya, from Sa'id, that Umar; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: "Whichever free man marries a slave-girl, he has made half [of the offspring] enslaved, and whichever slave marries a free woman, he has freed half." Abu Muhammad said: meaning: the child.
21.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Yahya se, Sa'id se bataya: ke Umar ne kaha: "Jo bhi aazad aadmi laundi se nikaah kare, usne [aulaad ka] aadha hissa ghulaam bana diya, aur jo bhi ghulam aazad aurat se nikaah kare, usne [aulaad ka] aadha hissa azaad kar diya." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: yaani: bachche ko.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ ،  عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  : فِي الْعَبْدِ يَتَزَوَّجُ الْمَرْأَةَ، ثُمَّ يُطَلِّقُهَا وَلَهُ مِنْهَا وَلَدٌ؟ قَالَ :" إِنْ كَانَتْ حُرَّةً، فَالنَّفَقَةُ عَلَى أُمِّهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ عَبْدًا، يَعْنِي : الصَّبِيَّ، فَعَلَى مُوَالِيهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Shihab, from al-Shaybani, from al-Sha'bi: Concerning a slave who marries a woman, then divorces her, and he has a child from her: he said: "If she was free, then maintenance is upon his mother, and if he [the child] is a slave, then it is upon his masters."
21.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Shihab se, al-Shaybani se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: us ghulam ke baare mein jo kisi aurat se nikaah kare, fir usay talaq de de, aur uska usse ek bachcha ho: unhone kaha: "Agar woh aazad thi, to kharcha uski maa par hoga, aur agar woh [bachcha] ghulam ho, to uske maalikon par hoga."

21.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ .
ح وحَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  : أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا :" وَلَاؤُهُ لِمَنْ بَدَأَ بِالْعِتْقِ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Hushaym, from Zakariya, from Amir; and from Jarir, from Mughirah, from Ibrahim: That they both said: "His wala' belongs to whoever began the manumission first."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Hushaym se, Zakariya se, Amir se bataya; aur Jarir se, Mughirah se, Ibrahim se bataya: ke dono ne kaha: "Uska wala' usi ka hai jisne sabse pehle azaad karna shuru kiya."

21.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، أنبأنا يُونُسُ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ .
 ح وحَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ ، عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ تَغْلِبَ ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا :" إِنْ ضَمِنَ، كَانَ الْوَلَاءُ لَهُ، وَإِنْ اسْتَسْعَى الْعَبْدُ، كَانَ الْوَلَاءُ بَيْنَهُمْ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Hushaym, from Yunus, from al-Hasan; and from Jarir, from Aban ibn Taghlib, from al-Hakam, from Ibrahim: That they both said: "If he guaranteed [payment for the remaining share], the wala' belongs to him, but if the slave works [to earn his freedom by his own labor], the wala' is shared between them."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Hushaym se, Yunus se, al-Hasan se bataya; aur Jarir se, Aban ibn Taghlib se, al-Hakam se, Ibrahim se bataya: ke dono ne kaha: "Agar usne [baaqi hisse ki] zamaanat li, to wala' usi ka hai, lekin agar ghulam ne khud mehnat karke [azaadi kamaayi], to wala' unke darmiyan sanjha hoga."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى ، وَأَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  : فِي عَبْدٍ بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ أَعْتَقَ أَحَدُهُمَا نَصِيبَهُ، فَقَالَ :" يُتَمَّمُ عِتْقُهُ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَالٌ، اسْتُسْعِيَ الْعَبْدُ فِي النِّصْفِ بِقِيمَةِ عَدْلٍ، وَالْوَلَاءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ "
21.en: Narrated by Ya'la, and Abu Nu'aym, from Zakariya, from Amir: Concerning a slave shared between two men, one of whom freed his own share, he said: "His manumission is completed, so if he has no wealth [to buy the other half], the slave is made to work to earn the other half at a fair valuation, and the wala' belongs to whoever freed him."
21.hi: Ya'la, aur Abu Nu'aym ne Zakariya se, Amir se bataya: do aadmiyon ke darmiyan sanjhe ghulam ke baare mein jisme se ek ne apna hissa azaad kar diya, unhone kaha: "Uski azaadi poori ki jaayegi, so agar uske paas maal na ho, to ghulam se aadhe hisse ki mehnat munaasib qeemat par karwaayi jaayegi, aur wala' usi ka hoga jisne azaad kiya."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ الْمَعْمَرِيِّ ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ ، عَنْ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  : فِي عَبْدٍ بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ، أَعْتَقَ أَحَدَهُمَا نَصِيبَهُ وَأَمْسَكَهُ الْآخَرُ، قَالَ :" مِيرَاثُهُ بَيْنَهُمَا "
21.en: Narrated by Harun ibn Mu'awiyah, from Abu Sufyan al-Ma'mari, from Ma'mar, from Ibn Tawus, from his father: Concerning a slave shared between two men, one of whom freed his own share and the other kept his: he said: "His inheritance is between the two of them."
21.hi: Harun ibn Mu'awiyah ne Abu Sufyan al-Ma'mari se, Ma'mar se, Ibn Tawus se, apne walid se bataya: do aadmiyon ke darmiyan sanjhe ghulam ke baare mein jisme se ek ne apna hissa azaad kar diya aur doosre ne apna rakh liya: unhone kaha: "Uski virasat un dono ke darmiyan hai."

21.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، قَالَ :" مِيرَاثُهُ لِلَّذِي أَمْسَكَهُ.
وقال قَتَادَةُ  : هُوَ لِلْمُعْتِقِ كُلُّهُ، وَثَمَنُهُ عَلَيْهِ، وَيَقُولُهُ أَهْلُ الْكُوفَةِ
21.en: Narrated by Harun, from Abu Sufyan, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri; with Qatadah's differing view: He said: "His inheritance goes to the one who kept his share." And Qatadah said: All of it goes to the one who freed him, and his price is upon him, and this is said by the people of Kufah.
21.hi: Harun ne Abu Sufyan se, Ma'mar se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Uski virasat us shakhs ko jaayegi jisne apna hissa rakha." Aur Qatadah ne kaha: Sara maal us shakhs ko jaayega jisne usay azaad kiya, aur uski qeemat uspar hogi, aur yehi Kufah wale kehte hain.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  : فِي الرَّجُلِ يَمُوتُ وَيَتْرُكُ مُكَاتَبًا، وَلَهُ بَنُونَ وَبَنَاتٌ، أَيَكُونُ لِلنِّسَاءِ مِنْ الْوَلَاءِ شَيْءٌ؟ قَالَ :" تَرِثُ النِّسَاءُ مِمَّا عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ مِنْ مُكَاتَبَتِهِ، وَيَكُونُ الْوَلَاءُ لِلرِّجَالِ دُونَ النِّسَاءِ، إِلَّا مَا كَاتَبْنَ، أَوْ أَعْتَقْنَ "
21.en: Narrated by Ya'la ibn Ubayd, from Abd al-Malik, from Ata: Concerning a man who dies leaving a mukatab, and he has sons and daughters, do the women get any share of the wala'? He said: "The women inherit from what remains owed on his [the mukatab's] contract, but the wala' belongs to the men, not the women, except what they themselves contracted or freed."
21.hi: Ya'la ibn Ubayd ne Abd al-Malik se, Ata se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo mara ek mukatab chhodkar, aur uske bete aur betiyaan hon, kya auraton ko wala' mein se kuch milega? Unhone kaha: "Auratein us [mukatab] par baaqi qarz se virasat paayengi, lekin wala' mardon ka hoga, auraton ka nahi, siwaay iske ke unhone khud koi muahida kiya ho, ya azaad kiya ho."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ ، قَالَ :" لَا تَرِثُ النِّسَاءُ مِنْ الْوَلَاءِ إِلَّا مَا أَعْتَقْنَ، أَوْ أَعْتَقَ مَنْ أَعْتَقْنَ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sharik, from Layth, from Tawus: He said: "Women do not inherit from the wala' except what they themselves freed, or what those they freed then freed."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sharik se, Layth se, Tawus se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Auratein wala' se virasat nahi paatin siwaay iske ke unhone khud azaad kiya ho, ya jise unhone azaad kiya usne aage kisi ko azaad kiya ho."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ ، قَالَ :" تُوُفِّيَ رَجُلٌ وَتَرَكَ مُكَاتَبًا، ثُمَّ مَاتَ الْمُكَاتَبُ وَتَرَكَ مَالًا، فَجَعَلَ ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ ، وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  مَا بَقِيَ مِنْ مُكَاتَبَتِهِ بَيْنَ بَنِي مَوْلَاهُ الرِّجَالُ وَالنِّسَاءُ عَلَى مِيرَاثِهِمْ، وَمَا فَضَلَ مِنْ الْمَالِ بَعْدَ كِتَابَتِهِ، فَلِلرِّجَالِ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ بَنِي مَوْلَاهُ، دُونَ النِّسَاءِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abu Sufyan, from Ma'mar, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir: He said: "A man died leaving a mukatab, then the mukatab died leaving wealth, so Ibn al-Musayyab, and Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman made what remained of his contract shared between the sons of his patron, men and women, according to their inheritance shares, but whatever was surplus wealth after his contract was fulfilled, that went to the men among the sons of his patron, not the women."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Abu Sufyan se, Ma'mar se, Yahya ibn Abi Kathir se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Ek aadmi mara ek mukatab chhodkar, fir mukatab bhi mara maal chhodkar, to Ibn al-Musayyab, aur Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman ne uske muahide par jo baaqi tha usay uske maalik ke beton, mard aur aurat, ke darmiyan unke virasat ke hisson ke mutaabiq sanjha kiya, lekin muahida poora hone ke baad jo maal bacha, woh maalik ke beton mein se sirf mardon ko milega, auraton ko nahi."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ  ، وَعَلِيٍّ  ، وَزَيْدٍ   ، أَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا :" الْوَلَاءُ لِلْكُبْرِ، وَلَا يَرِثُونَ النِّسَاءَ مِنْ الْوَلَاءِ إِلَّا مَا أَعْتَقْنَ، أَوْ كَاتَبْنَ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abd al-Salam ibn Harb, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from Umar, and Ali, and Zayd: That they said: "The wala' goes to the nearest, and women do not inherit from the wala' except what they themselves freed, or made a manumission contract for."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Abd al-Salam ibn Harb se, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se, Umar, aur Ali (Alayhis Salam), aur Zayd se bataya: ke unhone kaha: "Wala' sabse qareebi ko jaayega, aur auratein wala' se virasat nahi paatin siwaay iske ke unhone khud azaad kiya ho, ya azaadi ka muahida kiya ho."

21.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ .
ح وحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ ، عَنْ يُونُسَ ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ .
 ح وحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  : أَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا :" لَا يَرِثُ النِّسَاءُ مِنْ الْوَلَاءِ إِلَّا مَا أَعْتَقْنَ، أَوْ كَاتَبْنَ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Isma'il ibn Ibrahim, from Khalid, from Abu Qilabah; and from Ibn Wahb, from Yunus, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab; and from Ibn Abi al-Zinad, from his father, from Sulayman ibn Yasar: That they said: "Women do not inherit from the wala' except what they themselves freed, or made a manumission contract for."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Isma'il ibn Ibrahim se, Khalid se, Abu Qilabah se; aur Ibn Wahb se, Yunus se, al-Zuhri se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se; aur Ibn Abi al-Zinad se, apne walid se, Sulayman ibn Yasar se bataya: ke sabne kaha: "Auratein wala' se virasat nahi paatin siwaay iske ke unhone khud azaad kiya ho, ya azaadi ka muahida kiya ho."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، عن مُعَاذٌ ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" لَا تَرِثُ النِّسَاءُ مِنْ الْوَلَاءِ إِلَّا مَا أَعْتَقْنَ، أَوْ أَعْتَقَ مَنْ أَعْتَقْنَ، إِلَّا الْمُلَاعَنَةُ، فَإِنَّهَا تَرِثُ مَنْ أَعْتَقَ ابْنُهَا، وَالَّذِي انْتَفَى مِنْهُ أَبُوهُ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Mu'adh, from Ash'ath, from al-Hasan: He said: "Women do not inherit from the wala' except what they themselves freed, or what those they freed then freed, except the woman who underwent li'an, for she inherits from whoever her son freed, and from the one whose father disowned him."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Mu'adh se, Ash'ath se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Auratein wala' se virasat nahi paatin siwaay iske ke unhone khud azaad kiya ho, ya jise unhone azaad kiya usne aage kisi ko azaad kiya ho, siwaay li'an karne wali aurat ke, kyunki woh us shakhs se virasat paati hai jise uske bete ne azaad kiya, aur us shakhs se jiska baap usse inkaar kar de."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ   : أَنَّهُ كَانَ" يَرِثُ مَوَالِيَ عُمَرَ دُونَ بَنَاتِ عُمَرَ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Wahb, from Yunus, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from his father: That he used to "inherit from Umar's freed slaves, not from Umar's daughters."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Ibn Wahb se, Yunus se, al-Zuhri se, Salim se, apne walid se bataya: ke woh "Umar ke azaad kiye hue ghulaamon se virasat paate the, Umar ki betiyon se nahi."

21.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  فِي امْرَأَةٍ مَاتَتْ، وَتَرَكَتْ بَنِيهَا، فَوَرِثُوهَا مَالًا وَمَوَالِيَ، قَالَ :" يَرْجِعُ الْوَلَاءُ إِلَى عَصَبَةِ الْمَرْأَةِ "
21.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid ibn Abdullah, from Khalid al-Hadhdha, from Abu Qilabah: Concerning a woman who died leaving her sons, and they inherited wealth and freed slaves from her, he said: "The wala' returns to the woman's residuary heirs."
21.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid ibn Abdullah se, Khalid al-Hadhdha se, Abu Qilabah se bataya: us aurat ke baare mein jo mari apne beton ko chhodkar, aur unhone usse maal aur azaad kiye hue ghulaam paaye, unhone kaha: "Wala' aurat ke asabah ki taraf laut jaata hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  عَنْ رَجُلٍ كَاتَبَ عَبْدًا لَهُ، ثُمَّ مَاتَ وَتَرَكَ وَلَدًا رِجَالًا وَنِسَاءً، قَالَ :" لِلذُّكُورِ دُونَ الْإِنَاثِ "
21.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah, from Isra'il, from Mansur: He said: I asked Ibrahim about a man who made a manumission contract with a slave of his, then died leaving male and female children, he said: "For the males, not the females."
21.hi: Ubaydullah ne Isra'il se, Mansur se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibrahim se poocha us aadmi ke baare mein jisne apne ek ghulam se azaadi ka muahida kiya, fir mard aur aurat aulaad chhodkar mar gaya, unhone kaha: "Mardon ke liye, auraton ke liye nahi."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي امْرَأَةٍ مَاتَتْ وَتَرَكَتْ مَوْلًى، قَالَ :" الْوَلَاءُ لِبَنِيهَا، فَإِذَا مَاتُوا، رَجَعَ إِلَى عَصَبَتِهَا "
21.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Wuhayb, from Yunus, from al-Hasan: That he used to say, concerning a woman who died leaving a freed slave: "The wala' belongs to her sons, and when they die, it returns to her residuary heirs."
21.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Wuhayb se, Yunus se, al-Hasan se bataya: ke woh us aurat ke baare mein kehte the jo mari apna azaad kiya hua ghulam chhodkar: "Wala' uske beton ka hai, aur jab woh mar jaayein, to yeh uske asabah ki taraf laut jaayega."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  قَالَ :" لَيْسَ لِلنِّسَاءِ مِنْ الْوَلَاءِ شَيْءٌ، إِلَّا مَا أَعْتَقَتْ هِيَ فيَ نَفْسِهَا "
21.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Mughirah, from Ibrahim: He said: "There is nothing of the wala' for women, except what they themselves freed personally."
21.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Mughirah se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Auraton ke liye wala' mein se kuch nahi, siwaay iske ke unhone khud apne aap azaad kiya ho."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، قَالَ : مَاتَ مَوْلًى لِعُمَرَ، فَسَأَلَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ  ، فَقَالَ : هَلْ لِبَنَاتِ عُمَرَ مِنْ مِيرَاثِهِ شَيْءٌ؟ قَالَ :" مَا أَرَى لَهُنَّ شَيْئًا، وَإِنْ شِئْتَ أَنْ تُعْطِيَهُنَّ، أَعْطَيْتَهُنَّ "
21.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Ibn Awn, from Muhammad: He said: A freed slave of Umar died, so Ibn Umar asked Zayd ibn Thabit, and said: "Do Umar's daughters have any share of his inheritance?" He said: "I do not see anything for them, but if you wish to give them, you may give them."
21.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Ibn Awn se, Muhammad se bataya: Unhone kaha, Umar ka ek azaad kiya hua ghulam mara, to Ibn Umar ne Zayd ibn Thabit se poocha, aur kaha: "Kya Umar ki betiyon ke liye uski virasat mein kuch hissa hai?" Unhone kaha: "Mujhe unke liye kuch nazar nahi aata, lekin agar tum unhein dena chaho, to de sakte ho."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ :" يُحْرِزُ الْوَلَاءَ مَنْ يُحْرِزُ الْمِيرَاثَ "
21.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Usamah, from Hisham, from his father: He said: "Whoever secures the inheritance, secures the wala'."
21.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Usamah se, Hisham se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo virasat mehfooz kare, woh wala' bhi mehfooz karta hai."

21.ar:
