حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ   :" أَنَّ امْرَأَةً مِنْ مُحَارِبٍ وَهَبَتْ وَلَاءَ عَبْدِهَا لِنَفْسِهِ، فَأَعْتَقَتْهُ، فَوَهَبَ وَلاءَ نَفْسِهِ لِعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، وَمَاتَتْ، فَخَاصَمَتِ الْمَوَالِيَ إِلَى عُثْمَانَ، فَدَعَا عُثْمَانُ الْبَيِّنَةَ عَلَى مَا قَالَ، قَالَ : فَأَتَى الْبَيِّنَةُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عُثْمَانُ   : اذْهَبْ، فَوَالِ مَنْ شِئْتَ ".
قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ : فَوَالَى عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ
21.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Khalid, from Yahya, from Abu Bakr ibn Amr ibn Hazm; with Abu Bakr's added note: "That a woman from Muharib gifted the wala' of her slave to himself, and freed him, so he gifted his own wala' to Abd al-Rahman ibn Amr ibn Hazm, then she died, so the freed slaves disputed with Uthman, so Uthman asked for evidence for what he said," he said: "So he brought evidence, so Uthman said to him: 'Go, and ally yourself with whoever you wish.'" Abu Bakr said: So he allied with Abd al-Rahman ibn Amr ibn Hazm.
21.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Khalid se, Yahya se, Abu Bakr ibn Amr ibn Hazm se bataya: "ke Muharib qabeele ki ek aurat ne apne ghulam ke wala' ko usi ko tohfe mein de diya, aur usay azaad kiya, to usne apna wala' Abd al-Rahman ibn Amr ibn Hazm ko tohfe mein de diya, fir woh aurat mar gayi, to azaad kiye hue ghulaamon ne Uthman se jhagda kiya, to Uthman ne unse jo kaha uska saboot maanga," unhone bataya: "To saboot pesh kiya gaya, to Uthman ne usse kaha: 'Jao, aur jise chaaho muahida kar lo.'" Abu Bakr kehte hain: To usne Abd al-Rahman ibn Amr ibn Hazm se muahida kiya.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْبَيْعِ الْوَلَاءِ، وَعَنْ هِبَتِهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from Abdullah ibn Dinar, from Ibn Umar: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade selling the wala', and gifting it."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se, Abdullah ibn Dinar se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne wala' bechne se, aur usay tohfe mein dene se mana kiya."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   : " أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَنَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الْوَلَاءِ، وَعَنْ هِبَتِهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muslim, from Shu'bah, from Abdullah ibn Dinar, from Ibn Umar: "That the Prophet ﷺ forbade selling the wala', and gifting it."
21.hi: Muslim ne Shu'bah se bataya: Humein Abdullah ibn Dinar ne bataya, Ibn Umar se: "ke Nabi ﷺ ne wala' bechne se, aur usay tohfe mein dene se mana kiya."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ  ، يَقُولُ :" لَا يُبَاعُ الْوَلَاءُ وَلَا يُوهَبُ، وَالْوَلَاءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ "
21.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Abd al-Malik, from Ata: He said: I heard Ibn Abbas say: "The wala' is not sold and not gifted, the wala' belongs to whoever freed."
21.hi: Ya'la ne Abd al-Malik se, Ata se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibn Abbas ko kehte suna: "Wala' na becha jaata hai na tohfe mein diya jaata hai, wala' usi ka hai jisne azaad kiya."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   :" الْوَلَاءُ لُحْمَةٌ كَلُحْمَةِ النَّسَبِ، لَا يُبَاعُ وَلَا يُوهَبُ "
21.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Sa'id, from Abu Ma'shar, from Ibrahim: He said: Abdullah said: "The wala' is a bond like the bond of lineage, it is not sold and not gifted."
21.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Sa'id se, Abu Ma'shar se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ne kaha: "Wala' ek rishta hai jaisa nasab ka rishta, yeh na becha jaata hai na tohfe mein diya jaata hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِم ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  : " أنهماكرها بيع الولاء "
21.en: Narrated by Muslim, from Hammam, from Qatadah, from al-Hasan, and Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab: "That they both disliked selling the wala'."
21.hi: Muslim ne Hammam se, Qatadah se, al-Hasan se, aur Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se bataya: "ke dono wala' bechne ko na-pasand karte the."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ   :" لَا يُبَاعُ الْوَلَاءُ، أَيُؤْكَلُ بِرَقَبَةِ رَجُلٍ مَرَّتَيْنِ؟ "
21.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Idris, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ata: He said: Ibn Abbas said: "The wala' is not sold, is a man's neck [his freedom] to be consumed twice?"
21.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Ibn Idris se, Ibn Jurayj se, Ata se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Wala' nahi becha jaata, kya kisi aadmi ki gardan (uski azaadi) do martaba khaayi jaayegi?"

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ :" الْفَرَائِضُ مِنْ سِتَّةٍ، لَا نُعِيلُهَا "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ata, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "The fixed shares are from six, we do not proportionally reduce them."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Ibn Jurayj se, Ata se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Muqarrar hisse chhe se hote hain, hum unhein munaasib tor par kam nahi karte."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ بْنِ شُرَيْحٍ ، عَنْ شريح بْنِ الْحَارِثِ ، قَالَ : " اخْتُصِمَ إِلَى شُرَيْحٍ فِي بِنْتَيْنِ، وَأَبَوَيْنِ، وَزَوْجٍ، فَقَضَى فِيهَا، فَأَقْبَلَ الزَّوْجُ يَشْكُوهُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ رَبَاحٍ فَأَخَذَهُ، وَبَعَثَ إِلَى شُرَيْحٍ، فَقَالَ : مَا يَقُولُ هَذَا؟ قَالَ : هَذَا يَخَالُنِي امْرَأً جَائِرًا، وَأَنَا إِخَالُهُ امْرَأً فَاجِرًا، يُظْهِرُ الشَّكْوَى وَيَكْتُمُ قَضَاءً سَائِرًا، فَقَالَ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ : مَا تَقُولُ فِي بِنْتَيْنِ، وَأَبَوَيْنِ، وَزَوْجٍ؟ فَقَالَ :لِلزَّوْجِ الرُّبُعُ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ، وَلِلْأَبَوَيْنِ السُّدُسَانِ، وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِلِابْنَتَيْنِ، قَالَ : فَلِأَيِّ شَيْءٍ نَقَصْتَنِي؟ قَالَ : لَيْسَ أَنَا نَقَصْتُكَ، اللَّهُ نَقَصَكَ، لِلِابْنَتَيْنِ الثُّلُثَانِ، وَلِلْأَبَوَيْنِ السُّدُسَانِ، وَلِلزَّوْجِ الرُّبُعُ، فَهِيَ مِنْ سَبْعَةٍ وَنِصْفٍ فَرِيضَةً، فَرِيضَتُكَ عَائِلَةٌ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Imran, from Mu'awiyah ibn Maysarah ibn Shurayh, from Shurayh ibn al-Harith: He said: A dispute was brought to Shurayh concerning two daughters, two parents, and a husband, so he ruled in it, so the husband came complaining about him in the mosque, so Abdullah ibn Rabah sent for him and took hold of him, and sent to Shurayh, so he said: "What does this one say?" He said: "This one thinks I am an unjust man, and I think he is a wicked man, showing complaint but hiding an established ruling." So the man said to him: "What do you say about two daughters, two parents, and a husband?" So he said: "For the husband, a quarter of the whole wealth, and for the two parents, two-sixths, and whatever remains is for the two daughters." He said: "So why did you reduce mine?" He said: "It is not I who reduced you, Allah reduced you: for the two daughters, two-thirds, and for the two parents, two-sixths, and for the husband, a quarter, so it becomes from seven and a half as its fixed calculation, your fixed share is [thus] proportionally reduced [awl]."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Imran ne Mu'awiyah ibn Maysarah ibn Shurayh se, Shurayh ibn al-Harith se bataya: Unhone kaha, Shurayh ke saamne do betiyon, do maa-baap, aur ek shohar ka maamla laaya gaya, to unhone iska faisla diya, to shohar unke khilaaf masjid mein shikaayat karne aaya, to Abdullah ibn Rabah ne usay bulaakar pakad liya, aur Shurayh ke paas bheja, to unhone poocha: "Yeh kya kehta hai?" Unhone kaha: "Yeh mujhe zaalim aadmi samajhta hai, aur main isay fasiq aadmi samajhta hoon, jo shikaayat zaahir karta hai lekin ek qaayam faisla chhupaata hai." To aadmi ne unse kaha: "Aap do betiyon, do maa-baap, aur ek shohar ke baare mein kya kehte hain?" To unhone kaha: "Shohar ke liye poore maal ka chauthaai, aur maa-baap ke liye do-chhattai, aur jo baaqi bache woh do betiyon ka." Usne poocha: "To aapne mera hissa kyun kam kiya?" Unhone kaha: "Maine nahi, Allah ne tumhein kam kiya: do betiyon ke liye do-tihaai, aur maa-baap ke liye do-chhattai, aur shohar ke liye chauthaai, so yeh saade saat se banta hai apne muqarrar hisaab mein, tumhara hissa munaasib tor par kam kiya gaya hai [awl]."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ  ، وَعُمَرَ  ، وَزَيْدٍ   ، قَالُوا :" الْوَالِدُ يَجُرُّ وَلَاءَ وَلَدِهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Ash'ath, from al-Sha'bi, from Ali, and Umar, and Zayd: They said: "The father claims [i.e., transfers] the wala' of his child [when it originates from the mother's side]."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Ash'ath se, al-Sha'bi se, Ali (Alayhis Salam), aur Umar, aur Zayd se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Baap apne bachche ke wala' ko [jab woh maa ki taraf se ho to] apni taraf khaincha hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، قَالَ :" الْجَدُّ يَجُرُّ الْوَلَاءَ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Ash'ath, from al-Sha'bi: He said: "The grandfather claims [transfers] the wala'."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Ash'ath se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Dada wala' apni taraf khaincha hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ ، عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ ، قَالَ :" الْوَالِدُ يَجُرُّ وَلَاءَ وَلَدِهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Ash'ath, from Ibn Sirin, from Shurayh: He said: "The father claims [transfers] the wala' of his child."
21.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Ash'ath se, Ibn Sirin se, Shurayh se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Baap apne bachche ke wala' ko apni taraf khaincha hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  : " فِي مَمْلُوكٍ تُوُفِّيَ وَلَهُ أَبٌ حُرٌّ، وَلَهُ بَنُونَ مِنْ امْرَأَةٍ حُرَّةٍ، لِمَنْ وَلَاءُ وَلَدِهِ؟ قَالَ :لِمَوَالِي الْجَدِّ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zakariya, from Amir: Concerning a slave who died and had a free father, and had sons from a free woman, to whom does his child's wala' belong? He said: "To the grandfather's patrons."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zakariya se, Amir se bataya: us ghulam ke baare mein jo mara aur uska baap aazad tha, aur uske aazad aurat se bete the, uske bachche ka wala' kise milega? Unhone kaha: "Dada ke maalikon ko."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  : " فِي مُكَاتَبٍ مَاتَ وَقَدْ أَدَّى نِصْفَ مُكَاتَبَتِهِ، وَلَهُ وَلَدٌ مِنْ امْرَأَةٍ حُرَةٍ، قَالَ :مَا أُرَاهُ إِلَّا قَدْ جَرَّ وَلَاءَ وَلَدِهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Isra'il, from Mughirah, from Ibrahim: Concerning a mukatab who died having paid half of his contract, and he had a child from a free woman, he said: "I do not see it as anything other than that he has claimed the wala' of his child."
21.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Isra'il se, Mughirah se, Ibrahim se bataya: us mukatab ke baare mein jo mara apni azaadi ke muahide ka aadha ada karke, aur uska ek aazad aurat se bachcha tha, unhone kaha: "Mera khayal hai ke usne apne bachche ka wala' apni taraf khainch liya hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ،  عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، قَالَ : " كَانَ شُرَيْحٌ لَا يَرْجِعُ عَنْ قَضَاءٍ يَقْضِي بِهِ، فَحَدَّثَهُ الْأَسْوَدُ  : أَنَّ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ الْمَمْلُوكُ الْحُرَّةَ، فَوَلَدَتْ أَوْلَادًا أَحْرَارًا، ثُمَّ عُتِقَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ، رَجَعَ الْوَلَاءُ لِمَوَالِي أَبِيهِمْ "، فَأَخَذَ بِهِ شُرَيْحٌ
21.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, from Ibrahim: He said: Shurayh used not to reverse a ruling he had given, so al-Aswad told him: that Umar said: "When a slave marries a free woman, and she bears free children, then he is freed after that, the wala' returns to his father's patrons," so Shurayh adopted that view.
21.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Shu'bah se, al-Hakam se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Shurayh apne diye hue faisle se peechhe nahi hatte the, to al-Aswad ne unhein bataya: ke Umar ne kaha: "Jab ghulam aazad aurat se nikaah kare, aur woh aazad bacche paida hue, fir woh us baad azaad ho jaaye, to wala' unke baap ke maalikon ki taraf laut jaayega," to Shurayh ne isi ko apnaaya.

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عُمَر   : " الْمَمْلُوكِ يَكُونُ تَحْتَهُ الْحُرَّةُ،يُعْتَقُ الْوَلَدُ بِعِتْقِ أُمِّهِ، فَإِذَا عُتِقَ الْأَبُ، جَرَّ الْوَلَاءَ "
21.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim: He said: Umar said: "The slave who has a free woman under him [as wife]: the child is freed by his mother's freedom, so when the father is freed, he claims [transfers] the wala'."
21.hi: Ya'la ne al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Umar ne kaha: "Ghulam jiske nikaah mein aazad aurat ho: bachcha uski maa ki aazadi se aazad hota hai, so jab baap azaad ho, to woh wala' apni taraf khaincha hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ ، عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ شِنْظِيرٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  : " فِي الْحُرَّةِ تَحْتَ الْعَبْدِ، قَالَ :أَمَّا مَا وَلَدَتْ مِنْهُ وَهُوَ عَبْدٌ، فَوَلَاؤُهُمْ لِأَهْلِ نِعْمَتِهَا، وَمَا وَلَدَتْ مِنْهُ وَهُوَ حُرٌّ، فَوَلَاؤُهُمْ لِأَهْلِ نِعْمَتِهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Muslim, from Abd al-Warith, from Kathir ibn Shinzir, from Ata: Concerning a free woman married to a slave, he said: "As for whatever children she bore while he was a slave, their wala' belongs to her benefactor's family, and whatever children she bore while he was free, their wala' belongs to his benefactor's family."
21.hi: Muslim ne Abd al-Warith se, Kathir ibn Shinzir se, Ata se bataya: aazad aurat ke baare mein jo ghulam se nikaah mein ho, unhone kaha: "Jo bachche usne unki paidaish ke waqt paida hue jab woh ghulam tha, unka wala' uski ne'mat wale (jinhone usay azaad kiya) ka hoga, aur jo bachche usne paida kiye jab woh azaad tha, unka wala' uski ne'mat wale ka hoga."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عُمَرُ   :" إِذَا كَانَتْ الْحُرَّةُ تَحْتَ الْمَمْلُوكِ، فَوَلَدَتْ لَهُ غُلَامًا، فَإِنَّهُ يُعْتَقُ بِعِتْقِ أُمِّهِ، وَوَلَاؤُهُ لِمَوَالِي أُمِّهِ، فَإِذَا أُعْتِقَ الْأَبُ، جَرَّ الْوَلَاءَ إِلَى مَوَالِي أَبِيهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim: He said: Umar said: "When a free woman is under a slave [as wife], and she bears him a boy, he is freed by his mother's freedom, and his wala' belongs to his mother's patrons, so when the father is freed, he claims [transfers] the wala' to his father's patrons."
21.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Umar ne kaha: "Jab aazad aurat ghulam ke nikaah mein ho, aur usse ek ladka paida ho, to woh apni maa ki azaadi se azaad hota hai, aur uska wala' uski maa ke maalikon ka hoga, so jab baap azaad ho, to woh wala' apne baap ke maalikon ki taraf khaincha hai."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ :" كَانَتْ أُمِّي مَوْلَاةً لِلْحُرَقَةِ، وَكَانَ أَبِي يَعْقُوبُ مُكَاتَبًا لِمَالِكِ بْنِ أَوْسِ بْنِ الْحَدَثَانِ النَّصْرِيِّ، ثُمَّ إِنَّ أَبِي أَدَّى كِتَابَتَهُ، فَدَخَلَ الْحُرَقِيُّ عَلَى عُثْمَانَ، يَسْأَلُ الْحَقَّ يَعْنِي : الْعَطَاءَ ، وَعِنْدَهُ مَالِكُ بْنُ أَوْسٍ، فَقَالَ : ذَاكَ مَوْلَايَ، فَاخْتَصَمَا إِلَى عُثْمَانَ  ، فَقَضَى بِهِ لِلْحُرَقِيِّ "
21.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Muhammad ibn Salamah, from Ibn Ishaq, from al-Ala ibn Abd al-Rahman, from his father: He said: "My mother was a freed slave-woman of al-Huraqah, and my father Ya'qub was a mukatab of Malik ibn Aws ibn al-Hadathan al-Nasri, then my father fulfilled his contract, so al-Huraqi came to Uthman, asking for his due, that is: the stipend, and Malik ibn Aws was with him, so he said: 'That is my freed slave,' so they disputed before Uthman, so he ruled it for al-Huraqi."
21.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Muhammad ibn Salamah se bataya: Humein Ibn Ishaq ne bataya, al-Ala ibn Abd al-Rahman se, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, "Meri maa al-Huraqah ki azaad ki hui laundi thi, aur mere walid Ya'qub Malik ibn Aws ibn al-Hadathan al-Nasri ke mukatab the, fir mere walid ne apna muahida poora kiya, to al-Huraqi Uthman ke paas aaye, apna haq maangte hue, yaani: wazifa, aur unke paas Malik ibn Aws bhi the, to unhone kaha: 'Yeh mera azaad kiya hua ghulam hai,' to dono ne Uthman ke saamne jhagda kiya, to unhone al-Huraqi ke liye faisla diya."

21.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَهْمُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْحَمْرَاوِيُّ : " أَنَّ رَجُلًا تُوُفِّيَ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ وَارِثٌ، فَكُتِبَ فِيهِ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ  وَهُوَ خَلِيفَةٌ، فَكَتَبَ : أَنْاقْتَسِمُوا مِيرَاثَهُ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ يَأْخُذُ مَعَهُمْ الْعَطَاءَ، فَقُسِمَ مِيرَاثُهُ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ يَأْخُذُ مَعَهُمْ الْعَطَاءَ فِي عِرَافَتِهِ "
21.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Haywah, from Sahm ibn Yazid al-Hamrawi: "That a man died with no heir, so it was written to Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz, who was caliph, so he wrote: 'Divide his inheritance among those who received the stipend with him,' so his inheritance was divided among those who received the stipend with him in his registered unit."
21.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid ne Haywah se bataya: Mujhe Sahm ibn Yazid al-Hamrawi ne bataya: "ke ek aadmi mara aur uska koi waaris na tha, to iske baare mein Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz ko likha gaya, jo us waqt khalifa the, to unhone likha: 'Uski virasat un logon mein taqseem karo jo unke saath wazifa lete the,' to uski virasat un logon mein taqseem ki gayi jo uski unit mein unke saath wazifa lete the."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَاحَقُّ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ يَبِيتُ لَيْلَتَيْنِ وَلَهُ شَيْءٌ يُوصِي فِيهِ، إِلَّا وَوَصِيَّتُهُ مَكْتُوبَةٌ عِنْدَهُ "
22.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ubayd, from Ubaydullah, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "It is not right for a Muslim man who has anything to make a will about, to spend two nights, except that his will is written down with him."
22.hi: Muhammad ibn Ubayd ne Ubaydullah se bataya: Humein Nafi' ne bataya, Ibn Umar se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Kisi Musalman aadmi ke liye jaayez nahi ke uske paas koi aisi cheez ho jiski wasiyat karni ho, aur woh do raatein guzaare bagair iske ke uski wasiyat uske paas likhi hui ho."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَشْهَبِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ  ، قَالَ :" الْمُؤْمِنُ لَا يَأْكُلُ فِي كُلِّ بَطْنِهِ، وَلَا تَزَالُ وَصِيَّتُهُ تَحْتَ جَنْبِهِ "
22.en: Narrated by Affan, from Abu al-Ashhab, from al-Hasan: He said: "The believer does not eat with his whole stomach, and his will remains under his side [ready at all times]."
22.hi: Affan ne Abu al-Ashhab se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Momin apna pura pet bhar kar nahi khaata, aur uski wasiyat hamesha uske pehlu ke neeche [taiyaar] rehti hai."

22.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ، قَالَ : " قَالَ لِي ثُمَامَةُ بْنُ حَزْنٍ  : مَا فَعَلَ أَبُوكَ؟ قُلْتُ : مَاتَ، قَالَ : فَهَلْ أَوْصَى؟ فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يُقَالُ :إِذَا أَوْصَى الرَّجُلُ، كَانَتْ وَصِيَّتُهُ تَمَامًا لِمَا ضَيَّعَ مِنْ زَكَاتِهِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد ، وقال غَيْرُهُ : الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو
22.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Da'ud ibn Abi Hind, from al-Qasim ibn Umar; with Abu Muhammad's note: He said: Thumamah ibn Hazn said to me: 'What became of your father?' I said: 'He died.' He said: 'Did he make a will? For it used to be said: When a man makes a will, his will is a completion for whatever he neglected of his zakah.' Abu Muhammad said: And others say: al-Qasim ibn Amr.
22.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Da'ud ibn Abi Hind se, al-Qasim ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhse Thumamah ibn Hazn ne kaha: "Tumhare walid ka kya hua?" Maine kaha: "Woh guzar gaye." Unhone poocha: "Kya unhone wasiyat ki thi? Kyunki yeh kaha jaata tha: Jab aadmi wasiyat kare, to uski wasiyat uski zakat mein jo kami reh gayi ho uski takmeel hoti hai." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Aur doosre kehte hain: al-Qasim ibn Amr.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِنْدٍ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، قَالَ : كَانَ يُقَالُ :" مَنْ أَوْصَى بِوَصِيَّةٍ فَلَمْ يَجُرْ، وَلَمْ يَحِفْ، كَانَ لَهُ مِنْ الْأَجْرِ مِثْلُ مَا أَنْ لَوْ تَصَدَّقَ بِهِ فِي حَيَاتِهِ "
22.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Da'ud ibn Abi Hind, from al-Sha'bi: He said: It used to be said: "Whoever makes a will, and it is not unjust, and does not deprive the heirs, has a reward like that of one who gave the equivalent in charity during his lifetime."
22.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Da'ud ibn Abi Hind se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Yeh kaha jaata tha: "Jo koi wasiyat kare, aur na zulm kare na kisi ko mehroom kare, to usay itna hi ajr milega jitna agar usne apni zindagi mein sadqa diya hota."

22.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ أَبِي يُونُسَ ، عَنْ قَزَعَةَ ، قَالَ : قِيلَ لِهَرِمِ بْنِ حَيَّانَ  : أَوْصِهْ، قَالَ :" أُوصِيكُمْ بِالْآيَاتِ الْأَوَاخِرِ مِنْ سُورَةِ النَّحْلِ ، وَقَرَأَ ابْنُ حَيَّانَ : # ادْعُ إِلَى سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِالْحِكْمَةِ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ : وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ مُحْسِنُونَ سورة النحل آية 125 - 128 # "
22.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from Abu Yunus, from Qaza'ah: He said: It was said to Harim ibn Hayyan: "Make your will." He said: "I make my will to you with the last verses of Surah al-Nahl," and Ibn Hayyan recited: "Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom" until His saying: "and those who are doers of good" [Surah al-Nahl, verses 125-128].
22.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se, Abu Yunus se, Qaza'ah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Harim ibn Hayyan se kaha gaya: "Wasiyat karo." Unhone kaha: "Main tumhein Surah An-Nahl ki aakhri aayaton ki wasiyat karta hoon," aur Ibn Hayyan ne padha: "Apne Rab ki raah ki taraf hikmat se bulaao," yahan tak ke uska farman: "aur woh jo nekokaar hain" [Surah An-Nahl, aayat 125-128].

22.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ  ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ مُصَرِّفٍ الْيَامِيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى   : أَوْصَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟ قَالَ : لَا، قُلْت : فَكَيْفَ كُتِبَ عَلَى النَّاسِ الْوَصِيَّةُ أَوْ : أُمِرُوا بِالْوَصِيَّةِ؟ فَقَالَ :أَوْصَى بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ.
وقَالَ هُزَيْلُ بْنُ شُرَحْبِيلَ : أَبُو بَكْرٍ كَانَ يَتَأَمَّرُ عَلَى وَصِيِّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَدَّ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَنَّهُ وَجَدَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَهْدًا، فَخَزَمَ أَنْفَهُ بِخِزَامَةٍ ذلِكَ
22.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Malik ibn Mighwal, from Talhah ibn Musarrif al-Yami: He said: I asked Abdullah ibn Abi Awfa: Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ make a will? He said, "No." I said: "Then how was the will prescribed upon people, or: were they commanded with the will?" So he said: He willed the Book of Allah. And Huzayl ibn Shurahbil said: Abu Bakr was appointed over the will of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; Abu Bakr wished he had found a covenant from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he would have pierced his nose with a ring for it [i.e., submitted completely to it].
22.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Malik ibn Mighwal se, Talhah ibn Musarrif al-Yami se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abdullah ibn Abi Awfa se poocha: Kya Rasulullah ﷺ ne wasiyat ki thi? Unhone kaha, "Nahi." Maine poocha: "To phir logon par wasiyat kaise farz ki gayi, ya: unhein wasiyat ka hukum kyun diya gaya?" To unhone kaha: Aapne Allah ki Kitaab ki wasiyat ki. Aur Huzayl ibn Shurahbil ne kaha: Abu Bakr (رضي الله عنه) Rasulullah ﷺ ki wasiyat par ameer bane; Abu Bakr chaahte the ke unhein Rasulullah ﷺ ka koi ahad mil jaata, to woh iske liye apni naak mein nakel daal lete.

22.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ ، أنبأنا هَمَّامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  : " # كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ إِنْ تَرَكَ خَيْرًا الْوَصِيَّةُ لِلْوَالِدَيْنِ وَالأَقْرَبِينَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ حَقًّا عَلَى الْمُتَّقِينَ سورة البقرة آية 180 #، قَالَ :" الْخَيْرُ : الْمَالُ، كَانَ يُقَالُ : أَلْفًا فَمَا فَوْقَ ذَلِكَ "
22.en: Narrated by Yazid, from Hammam, from Qatadah: Concerning: "It has been prescribed for you, when death approaches one of you, if he leaves wealth, that he make a bequest for parents and near relatives in a fair manner, an obligation upon the righteous" [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 180]: he said: "'Khayr' means: wealth, it used to be said: a thousand and above that."
22.hi: Yazid ne Hammam se, Qatadah se bataya: is aayat ke baare mein: "Tumpar likh diya gaya hai, jab tum mein se kisi ko maut aaye, agar woh maal chhode, to woh maa-baap aur qareebi rishtedaron ke liye achhe tareeke se wasiyat kare, yeh muttaqiyon par ek haq hai" [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 180]: unhone kaha: "'Khayr' ka matlab hai: maal, kaha jaata tha: hazaar aur isse zyada."

22.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ  : " أَنَّهُأَوْصَى ذِكْرُ مَا أَوْصَى بِهِ، أَوْ هَذَا ذِكْرُ مَا أَوْصَى بِهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ بَنِيهِ وَأَهْلَ بَيْتِهِ : # فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَصْلِحُوا ذَاتَ بَيْنِكُمْ وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ سورة الأنفال آية 1 #، وَأَوْصَاهُمْ بِمَا أَوْصَى بِهِ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بَنِيهِ، وَيَعْقُوبُ : # يَا بَنِيَّ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَى لَكُمُ الدِّينَ فَلا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلا وَأَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ سورة البقرة آية 132 #، وَأَوْصَاهُمْ أَنْ لَا يَرْغَبُوا أَنْ يَكُونُوا مَوَالِيَ الْأَنْصَارِ وَإِخْوَانَهُمْ فِي الدِّينِ، وَأَنَّ الْعِفَّةَ وَالصِّدْقَ خَيْرٌ وَأَتْقَى مِنْ الزِّنَا وَالْكَذِبِ، إِنْ حَدَثَ بِهِ حَدَثٌ فِي مَرَضِي هَذَا قَبْلَ أَنْ أُغَيِّرَ وَصِيَّتِي هَذِهِ، ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ حَاجَتَهُ "
22.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Ibn Awn, from Muhammad ibn Sirin: That he made a will - a record of what he willed, or this is a record of what Muhammad ibn Abi Amrah willed to his sons and family: "So fear Allah, and reconcile between yourselves, and obey Allah and His Messenger, if you are believers" [Surah al-Anfal, verse 1], and he willed them what Ibrahim willed his sons, and Ya'qub: "O my sons, indeed Allah has chosen the religion for you, so do not die except while you are Muslims" [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 132], and he willed them not to be reluctant to be the allies of the Ansar and their brothers in religion, and that chastity and truthfulness are better and more righteous than adultery and lying, if anything happens to him in this illness of his before he changes this will of his, then he mentioned his need.
22.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Ibn Awn se bataya: Humein Muhammad ibn Sirin ne bataya: "ke unhone wasiyat ki - jo unhone wasiyat ki uska zikr, ya yeh Muhammad ibn Abi Amrah ki apne beton aur ghar walon ke liye ki gayi wasiyat ka zikr hai: 'So Allah se daro aur apne aapas ke maamlaat theek karo, aur Allah aur uske Rasool ki itaa'at karo agar tum momin ho' [Surah Al-Anfal, aayat 1], aur unhein wahi wasiyat ki jo Ibrahim ne apne beton ko, aur Ya'qub ne ki: 'Ae mere beto, Allah ne tumhare liye yeh deen chun liya hai, so na marna magar Musalman hokar' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 132], aur unhein wasiyat ki ke woh Ansar ka mit'tehid aur deen mein bhai hone se na-pasand na karein, aur ke pakizgi aur sachaai zina aur jhoot se behtar aur zyada taqwa wali hain, agar unhein is bimaari mein kuch ho jaaye is se pehle ke woh apni yeh wasiyat badlein, fir unhone apni zaroorat ka zikr kiya."

22.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : " هَكَذَا كَانُوا يُوصُونَ : هَذَا مَا أَوْصَى بِهِ فُلَانُ بْنُ فُلَانٍ، أَنَّهُيَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، وَأَنَّ السَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا، وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُورِ، وَأَوْصَى مَنْ تَرَكَ بَعْدَهُ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ أَنْ يَتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَيُصْلِحُوا ذَاتَ بَيْنِهِمْ، وَأَنْ يُطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ إِنْ كَانُوا مُؤْمِنِينَ، وَأَوْصَاهُمْ بِمَا أَوْصَى بِهِ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بَنِيهِ وَيَعْقُوبُ : # يَا بَنِيَّ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَى لَكُمُ الدِّينَ فَلا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلا وَأَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ سورة البقرة آية 132 #، وَأَوْصَى إِنْ حَدَثَ بِهِ حَدَثٌ مِنْ وَجَعِهِ هَذَا، أَنَّ حَاجَتَهُ كَذَا وَكَذَا "
22.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Bakr, from Hisham ibn Hassan, from Ibn Sirin, from Anas: He said: "This is how they used to make wills: 'This is what so-and-so ibn so-and-so willed, that he testifies that there is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger, and that the Hour is coming, no doubt about it, and that Allah will resurrect whoever is in the graves,' and he willed whoever he leaves behind of his family to fear Allah and reconcile between themselves, and to obey Allah and His Messenger if they are believers, and he willed them what Ibrahim willed his sons, and Ya'qub: 'O my sons, indeed Allah has chosen the religion for you, so do not die except while you are Muslims' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 132], and he willed that if anything happens to him from this ailment of his, that his need is such-and-such."
22.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Bakr se, Hisham ibn Hassan se, Ibn Sirin se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Isi tarah woh wasiyat kiya karte the: 'Yeh woh hai jo fulaan ibn fulaan ne wasiyat ki, ke woh gawahi deta hai ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, akela, uska koi shareek nahi, aur ke Muhammad uske banda aur Rasool hain, aur ke Qayamat aane wali hai, ismein koi shak nahi, aur ke Allah qabron mein jo hain unhein utha khada karega,' aur unhone apne peechhe rehne wale gharwalon ko wasiyat ki ke woh Allah se darein aur aapas mein sudhaar karein, aur ke Allah aur uske Rasool ki itaa'at karein agar woh momin hon, aur unhein wahi wasiyat ki jo Ibrahim ne apne beton ko, aur Ya'qub ne ki: 'Ae mere beto, Allah ne tumhare liye yeh deen chun liya hai, so na marna magar Musalman hokar' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 132], aur unhone wasiyat ki ke agar unhein is bimaari mein kuch ho jaaye, to unki zaroorat fulaan-fulaan hai."

22.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غَيْلَانَ ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ  حِينَ أَوْصَى، قَالَ : " نَشَهُّدُ هَذَا فَاشْهَدْ بِهِ :نَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، وَيُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ، وَيَكْفُرُ بِالطَّاغُوتِ عَلَى ذَلِكَ يَحْيَا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ، وَيَمُوتُ، وَيُبْعَثُ، وَأَوْصَى فِيمَا رَزَقَهُ اللَّهُ فِيمَا تَرَكَ إِنْ حَدَثَ بِهِ حَدَثٌ وَهُوَ كَذَا وَكَذَا، إِنْ لَمْ يُغَيِّرْ شَيْئًا مِمَّا فِي هَذِهِ الْوَصِيَّةِ ".
حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ ثَوْبَانَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ ، قَالَ : هَذِهِ وَصِيَّةُ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ
22.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from al-Walid, from Hafs ibn Ghaylan, from Makhul, when he made his will; with a note on the transmission: He said: "We testify this, so bear witness to it: We testify that there is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger, and he believes in Allah, and disbelieves in false deities; upon this he lives, Allah willing, and dies, and is resurrected," and he made a will regarding what Allah had provided him of what he left, if anything happens to him, that it is such-and-such, unless he changes anything of what is in this will. Al-Hakam narrated to us: al-Walid told us: Ibn Thawban informed me, from his father, from Makhul, who said: This is the will of Abu al-Darda.
22.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne al-Walid se bataya: Humein Hafs ibn Ghaylan ne bataya, Makhul se, jab unhone wasiyat ki: Unhone kaha, "Hum yeh gawahi dete hain, so tum bhi gawahi do: Hum gawahi dete hain ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, akela, uska koi shareek nahi, aur ke Muhammad uske banda aur Rasool hain, aur woh Allah par imaan laata hai, aur taaghoot ka inkaar karta hai; isi par woh jeeta hai, Inshaallah, aur marta hai, aur uthaya jaayega," aur unhone Allah ne unhein jo diya usme se jo woh chhod jaayein uski wasiyat ki, agar unhein kuch ho jaaye, ke woh fulaan-fulaan hai, jab tak woh is wasiyat mein se kuch na badlein. Al-Hakam kehte hain: Humein al-Walid ne bataya: Mujhe Ibn Thawban ne bataya, apne walid se, Makhul se, unhone kaha: Yeh Abu al-Darda ki wasiyat hai.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَيَّانَ التَّيْمِيُّ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ : كَتَبَ الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ خُثَيْمٍ وَصِيَّتَهُ : بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ : " هَذَا مَا أَوْصَى بِهِ الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ خُثَيْمٍ  وَأَشْهَدَ اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ، وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا، وَجَازِيًا لِعِبَادِهِ الصَّالِحِينَ وَمُثِيبًابِأَنِّي رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا، وَإِنِّي آمُرُ نَفْسِي وَمَنْ أَطَاعَنِي أَنْ نَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ فِي الْعَابِدِينَ، وَنَحْمَدَهُ فِي الْحَامِدِينَ، وَأَنْ نَنْصَحَ لِجَمَاعَةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ "
22.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Abu Hayyan al-Taymi, from his father: He said: Al-Rabi' ibn Khuthaym wrote his will: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful: "This is what al-Rabi' ibn Khuthaym has willed, and he calls Allah to witness upon it, and Allah is sufficient as a Witness, and a Rewarder of His righteous servants and a Recompenser: that I am content with Allah as Lord, and Islam as religion, and Muhammad as Prophet, and I command myself and whoever obeys me that we worship Allah among the worshippers, and praise Him among those who praise, and give sincere advice to the community of Muslims."
22.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Abu Hayyan al-Taymi se bataya: Mujhse unke walid ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Al-Rabi' ibn Khuthaym ne apni wasiyat likhi: Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Raheem: "Yeh woh hai jo al-Rabi' ibn Khuthaym ne wasiyat ki, aur usne Allah ko iska gawaah banaaya, aur Allah gawaah ke tor par kaafi hai, aur apne neik bandon ka jazaa dene wala aur inaam dene wala: ke main Allah ko Rab ke tor par, aur Islam ko deen ke tor par, aur Muhammad ko Nabi ke tor par razi hoon, aur main apne aap ko aur jo mera kehna maane usay hukum deta hoon ke hum ibaadat karne walon mein Allah ki ibaadat karein, aur tareef karne walon mein uski tareef karein, aur Musalmanon ki jama'at ke liye khair-khwaahi rakhein."

22.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  : " أَنَّ عَلِيًّا دَخَلَ عَلَى مَرِيضٍ، فَذَكَرُوا لَهُ الْوَصِيَّةَ، فَقال عَلِيٌّ   :قَالَ اللَّهُ : # إِنْ تَرَكَ خَيْرًا سورة البقرة آية 180 #، وَلَا أُرَاهُ تَرَكَ خَيْرًا ".
قَالَ حَمَّادٌ : فَحَفِظْتُ أَنَّهُ تَرَكَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِ مِائَةٍ
22.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Hisham, from his father: "That Ali entered upon a sick man, and they mentioned the will to him, so Ali said: 'Allah said: "if he leaves wealth" [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 180], and I do not think he has left wealth.'" Hammad said: But I remember that he left more than seven hundred.
22.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Hisham se, apne walid se bataya: "ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) ek bimaar ke paas gaye, to unhone unse wasiyat ka zikr kiya, to Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: 'Allah ne farmaya: "agar woh maal chhode" [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 180], aur mera khayal nahi ke usne maal chhoda hai.'" Hammad kehte hain: Lekin mujhe yaad hai ke usne sat sau se zyada chhoda tha.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كُنَاسَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : "دَخَلَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ   عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ يَعُودُهُ، فَقَالَ : أُوصِي؟ قَالَ : لا، لَمْ تَدَعْ مَالًا، فَدَعْ مَالَكَ لِوَلَدِكَ "
22.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kunasah, from Hisham, from his father: He said: "Ali ibn Abi Talib entered upon a man from his tribe visiting him in illness, so he said: 'Shall I make a will?' He said: 'No, you have left no wealth, so leave your wealth for your children.'"
22.hi: Muhammad ibn Kunasah ne Hisham se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Ali ibn Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) apni qaum ke ek aadmi ki bimaar-pursi ke liye gaye, to usne poocha: 'Kya main wasiyat karun?' Aapne farmaya: 'Nahi, tumne koi maal nahi chhoda, so apna maal apni aulaad ke liye chhod do.'"

22.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زَيْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  : " فِي رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى وَالْوَرَثَةُ شُهُودٌ مُقِرُّونَ، فَقَالَ :لَا يَجُوزُ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : يَعْنِي : إِذَا أَنْكَرُوا بَعْدُ
22.en: Narrated by Abu Zayd, from Shu'bah, from Mansur, from Ibrahim; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: Concerning a man who makes a will while the heirs are present and acknowledging it, he said: "It is not valid." Abu Muhammad said: meaning: if they deny it afterward.
22.hi: Abu Zayd ne Shu'bah se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo wasiyat kare jabke waaris maujood ho aur uska iqraar kar rahe hon, unhone kaha: "Yeh jaayez nahi." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: yaani: agar woh baad mein inkaar karein.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ الحَكَمَ ، وَحَمَّادًا  : " عَنِ الْأَوْلِيَاءِ يُجِيزُونَ الْوَصِيَّةَ، فَإِذَا مَاتَ لَمْ يُجِيزُوا؟ قَالَا :لَا يَجُوزُ "
22.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Shu'bah: He said: I asked al-Hakam, and Hammad, about the heirs who approve a will, but when he dies they do not approve it? They both said: "It is not valid."
22.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Hakam, aur Hammad, se poocha waarison ke baare mein jo wasiyat ko manzoor karte hain, lekin jab woh mar jaaye to manzoor na karein? Dono ne kaha: "Yeh jaayez nahi."

22.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ ،  عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ  : " فِي الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي بِأَكْثَرَ مِنْ ثُلُثِهِ، قَالَ :إِنْ أَجَازَتْهُ الْوَرَثَةُ، أَجَزْنَاهُ، وَإِنْ قَالَتِ الْوَرَثَةُ : أَجَزْنَاهُ، فَهُمْ بِالْخِيَارِ إِذَا نَفَضُوا أَيْدِيَهُمْ مِنْ الْقَبْرِ "
22.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Da'ud ibn Abi Hind, from Amir, from Shurayh: Concerning a man who wills more than a third, he said: "If the heirs approve it, we permit it, and if the heirs say: 'We approve it,' they still have the choice once they have dusted off their hands from the grave."
22.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Da'ud ibn Abi Hind se, Amir se, Shurayh se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo apni tihai se zyada ki wasiyat kare, unhone kaha: "Agar waaris ise jaayez qaraar dein, to hum ise jaayez maanenge, aur agar waaris kahein: 'Humne ise jaayez qaraar diya,' to unhein ab bhi ikhtiyaar hai jab tak woh qabr se apne haath jhaad na lein."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ  : " أَنَّ رَجُلًا اسْتَأْذَنَ وَرَثَتَهُ أَنْ يُوصِيَ بِأَكْثَرَ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ، فَأَذِنُوا لَهُ، ثُمَّ رَجَعُوا فِيهِ بَعْدَ مَا مَاتَ، فَسُئِلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ :هَذَا التَّكَرُّهُ لَا يَجُوزُ "
22.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from al-Mas'udi, from Abu Awn, from al-Qasim: "That a man asked his heirs' permission to will more than a third, and they permitted him, then they went back on it after he died, so Abdullah was asked about that, so he said: 'This reluctance is not valid.'"
22.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne al-Mas'udi se, Abu Awn se, al-Qasim se bataya: "ke ek aadmi ne apne waarison se tihai se zyada ki wasiyat karne ki ijaazat maangi, to unhone use ijaazat di, fir uske marne ke baad unhone isse mukar liya, to Abdullah se iske baare mein poocha gaya, to unhone kaha: 'Yeh na-pasandeedgi jaayez nahi.'"

22.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ   : " فِي الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي بِأَكْثَرَ مِنْ الثُّلُثِ فَرَضِيَ الْوَرَثَةُ، قَالَ :هُوَ جَائِزٌ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : أَجَزْنَاهُ يَعْنِي فِي الْحَيَاةِ
22.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Hisham, from al-Hasan; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: Concerning a man who wills more than a third, and the heirs approve it, he said: "It is valid." Abu Muhammad said: "We approved it" means: while alive.
22.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Hisham se, al-Hasan se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo tihai se zyada ki wasiyat kare aur waaris ise razi ho jaayein, unhone kaha: "Yeh jaayez hai." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: "Humne ise jaayez qaraar diya" ka matlab hai: zindagi mein.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ بِمَكَّةَ ، وَلَيْسَ لَهُ إِلَّا ابْنَةٌ، فَقُلْتُ لَهُ : " إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لِي إِلَّا ابْنَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ، فَأُوصِي بِمَالِي كُلِّهِ؟ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : لَا، قُلْتُ : فَأُوصِي بِالنِّصْفِ؟ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : لَا، قَالَ : فَأُوصِي بِالثُّلُثِ؟ قَالَ : فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :الثُّلُثُ، وَالثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ "
22.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Hammam, from Qatadah, from Yunus ibn Jubayr, from Muhammad ibn Sa'd, from his father: That the Prophet ﷺ came to him while he was in Makkah, and he had only one daughter, so I said to him: "I have only one daughter, shall I will my entire wealth?" So the Prophet ﷺ said: "No." I said: "Then shall I will half?" So the Prophet ﷺ said to him: "No." He said: "Then shall I will a third?" He said: So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A third, and a third is much."
22.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Hammam se, Qatadah se, Yunus ibn Jubayr se, Muhammad ibn Sa'd se, apne walid se bataya: ke Nabi ﷺ unke paas aaye jabke woh Makkah mein the, aur unki sirf ek beti thi, to maine aapse kaha: "Meri sirf ek beti hai, kya main apna sara maal wasiyat kar dun?" To Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: "Nahi." Maine kaha: "To kya main aadha wasiyat karun?" To Nabi ﷺ ne unse farmaya: "Nahi." Unhone kaha: "To kya main tihai wasiyat karun?" Unhone bataya: To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Tihai, aur tihai bhi bahut hai."

22.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : " اشْتَكَيْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ حَتَّى أُدْنِفْتُ، فَدَخَلَ عَلَيَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَعُودُنِي، فَقُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا أُرَانِي إِلَّا أَلَمَّ بِي وَأَنَا ذُو مَالٍ كَثِيرٍ، وَإِنَّمَا يَرِثُنِي ابْنَةٌ لِي، أَفَأَتَصَدَّقُ بِمَالِي كُلِّهِ؟ قَالَ : لَا، قُلْتُ : فَبِنِصْفِهِ؟ قَال : لَا، قُلْتُ : فَالثُّلُثِ؟ قَالَ :الثُّلُثُ، وَالثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ، إِنَّكَ إِنْ تَتْرُكْ وَرَثَتَكَ أَغْنِيَاءَ، خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ تَتْرُكَهُمْ فُقَرَاءَ يَتَكَفَّفُونَ النَّاسَ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ، وَإِنَّكَ لَا تُنْفِقُ نَفَقَةً إِلَّا آجَرَكَ اللَّهُ فِيهَا، حَتَّى مَا تَجْعَلُ فِي فِي امْرَأَتِكَ "
22.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from al-Zuhri, from Amir ibn Sa'd, from his father: He said: "I fell ill with the Prophet ﷺ during the Farewell Pilgrimage until I was near death, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon me to visit me, so I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, I see nothing but that this illness has struck me severely, and I am a man of much wealth, and only a daughter of mine inherits from me, shall I give all my wealth in charity?' He said: 'No.' I said: 'Then half of it?' He said: 'No.' I said: 'Then a third?' He said: 'A third, and a third is much, indeed if you leave your heirs wealthy, that is better than leaving them poor, begging from people with their hands, and indeed you never spend an expense, except that Allah rewards you for it, even what you put into your wife's mouth.'"
22.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Ishaq se, al-Zuhri se, Amir ibn Sa'd se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Main Hajjat-ul-Wida' mein Nabi ﷺ ke saath bimaar pad gaya yahan tak ke main maut ke qareeb pahunch gaya, to Rasulullah ﷺ meri bimaar-pursi ke liye tashreef laaye, to maine kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah, mujhe lagta hai ke yeh bimaari mujhpar sakhti se aayi hai, aur main bahut maal wala aadmi hoon, aur sirf meri ek beti hi mera waaris hogi, kya main apna sara maal sadqe mein de dun?' Aapne farmaya: 'Nahi.' Maine kaha: 'To iska aadha?' Aapne farmaya: 'Nahi.' Maine kaha: 'To tihai?' Aapne farmaya: 'Tihai, aur tihai bhi bahut hai, agar tum apne waarison ko maal-daar chhodo, to yeh isse behtar hai ke tum unhein gareeb chhodo, jo logon se apne haathon phaila kar maangte phirein, aur beshak tum jo bhi kharcha karo, Allah tumhein iska ajr dega, chahe woh woh cheez ho jo tum apni biwi ke muh mein rakhte ho.'"

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ إِسْحَاق بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ ،  عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ : " أَنَّ أَبَاهُ زِيَادَ بْنَ مَطَرٍ  أَوْصَى، فَقَالَ :وَصِيَّتِي مَا اتَّفَقَ عَلَيْهِ فُقَهَاءُ أَهْلِ الْبَصْرَةِ ، فَسَأَلْتُ، فَاتَّفَقُوا عَلَى الْخُمُسِ "
22.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ishaq ibn Suwayd, from al-Ala ibn Ziyad: That his father Ziyad ibn Matar made a will, and said: "My will is whatever the jurists of the people of Basra agree upon," so I asked, and they agreed upon a fifth.
22.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ishaq ibn Suwayd se, al-Ala ibn Ziyad se bataya: ke unke walid Ziyad ibn Matar ne wasiyat ki, aur kaha: "Meri wasiyat wahi hai jispar Basra ke fuqaha muttafiq hon," to maine poocha, to unhone paanchwe hisse par ittefaaq kiya.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ إِسْحَاق بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ  : أَنَّ رَجُلًا سَأَلَ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ  ، فَقَالَ : " إِنَّ وَارِثِي كَلَالَةٌ، فَأُوصِي بِالنِّصْفِ؟ قَالَ : لَا، قَالَ : فَالثُّلُثِ؟ قَالَ : لَا، قَالَ : فَالرُّبُع؟ قَالَ : لَا، قَالَ : فَالْخُمُس؟ قَالَ : لَا، حَتَّى صَارَ إِلَى الْعُشْرِ، فَقَالَ :أَوْصِ بِالْعُشْرِ "
22.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ishaq ibn Suwayd, from al-Ala ibn Ziyad: That a man asked Umar ibn al-Khattab, and said: "My heir is kalalah, shall I will half?" He said, "No." He said: "Then a third?" He said, "No." He said: "Then a quarter?" He said, "No." He said: "Then a fifth?" He said, "No," until it came down to a tenth, so he said: "Will a tenth."
22.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ishaq ibn Suwayd se, al-Ala ibn Ziyad se bataya: ke ek aadmi ne Umar ibn al-Khattab se poocha, aur kaha: "Mera waaris kalalah hai, kya main aadha wasiyat karun?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi." Usne poocha: "To tihai?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi." Usne poocha: "To chauthaai?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi." Usne poocha: "To paanchwan hissa?" Unhone kaha, "Nahi," yahan tak ke woh das ke hisse tak aaya, to unhone kaha: "Daswan hissa wasiyat karo."

22.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ ، قَالَ :" إِنَّمَا كَانُوا يُوصُونَ بِالْخُمُسِ وَالرُّبُعِ، وَكَانَ الثُّلُثُ مُنْتَهَى الْجَامِحِ.
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : يَعْنِي بِالْجَامِحِ : الْفَرَسَ الْجَمُوحَ
22.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Isma'il, from Amir; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: "They only used to will a fifth or a quarter, and a third was the limit for the unruly [i.e., an extreme]." Abu Muhammad said: By 'unruly' he means: a headstrong horse.
22.hi: Ya'la ne Isma'il se, Amir se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Woh sirf paanchwan ya chauthaai hissa wasiyat karte the, aur tihai to zyaadti karne wale ki hadd thi." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: 'Zyaadti karne wale' se murad hai: bad-lagaam ghoda.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ ، عَنْ بَكْرٍ ، قَالَ : " أَوْصَيْتُ إِلَى حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، فَقَالَ :مَا كُنْتُ لِأَقْبَلَ وَصِيَّةَ رَجُلٍ لَهُ وَلَدٌ يُوصِي بِالثُّلُثِ "
22.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Humayd, from Bakr: He said: "I made a will to Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman, so he said: 'I would not accept the will of a man who has children, willing a third.'"
22.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Humayd se, Bakr se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Maine Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman ko wasiyat ki, to unhone kaha: 'Main us aadmi ki wasiyat qabool na karta jiski aulaad ho, tihai ki wasiyat karte hue.'"

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ ، عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ ، قَالَ :" الثُّلُثُ جَهْدٌ وَهُوَ جَائِزٌ "
22.en: Narrated by Qabisah, from Sufyan, from Hisham, from Muhammad ibn Sirin, from Shurayh: He said: "A third is a strain, but it is valid."
22.hi: Qabisah ne Sufyan se, Hisham se, Muhammad ibn Sirin se, Shurayh se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Tihai ek bojh hai, lekin yeh jaayez hai."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" كَانَ السُّدُسُ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِمْ مِنْ الثُّلُثِ "
22.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah, from Isra'il, from Mansur, from Ibrahim: He said: "A sixth was more beloved to them than a third."
22.hi: Ubaydullah ne Isra'il se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Chhattai hissa unhein tihai se zyada aziz tha."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" الْوَصِيُّ أَمِينٌ فِيمَا أُوصِيَ إِلَيْهِ بِهِ "
22.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Sharik, from Mughirah, from Ibrahim: He said: "The executor is trusted with whatever he was made an executor over."
22.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Sharik se, Mughirah se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Wasi (wasiyat karne wala/executor) ameen hota hai us cheez mein jispar usay wasi banaaya gaya hai."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ ، عَنْ أبي وَهْبٍ ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ ، قَالَ :" أَمْرُ الْوَصِيِّ جَائِزٌ فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، إِلَّا فِي الِابْتِيَاعِ، وَإِذَا بَاعَ بَيْعًا لَمْ يُقِلْ "، وَهُوَ رَأْيُ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَمْزَةَ
22.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Abu Wahb, from Makhul; with a note on this being Yahya's view: He said: "The executor's affairs are valid in everything, except in purchasing [property from the estate], and if he makes a sale, it cannot be undone." And this is Yahya ibn Hamzah's opinion.
22.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se, Abu Wahb se, Makhul se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Wasi ke kaam har cheez mein jaayez hain, siwaay khareedne [tarikay se maal khud khareedne] ke, aur agar woh koi saude bikri kare, to woh wapas nahi hoti." Aur yeh Yahya ibn Hamzah ki raay hai.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ ،  عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ ، قَالَ :" الْوَصِيُّ أَمِينٌ فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، إِلَّا فِي الْعِتْقِ، فَإِنَّ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُقِيمَ الْوَلَاءَ "
22.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak, from al-Walid, from al-Awza'i, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir: He said: "The executor is trusted in everything, except in manumission, for he must establish the wala' [claim it for the deceased's estate correctly]."
22.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak ne al-Walid se, al-Awza'i se, Yahya ibn Abi Kathir se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Wasi har cheez mein ameen hota hai, siwaay azaadi (ghulam ko azaad karne) ke, kyunki usper wala' ko sahi tor par qaayam karna zaroori hai."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  : " فِي مَالِ الْيَتِيمِيَعْمَلُ بِهِ الْوَصِيُّ إِذَا أَوْصَى إِلَى الرَّجُلِ "
22.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah, from Isra'il, from Mansur, from Ibrahim: Concerning the wealth of an orphan, that the executor acts upon it, when he is made an executor by the man.
22.hi: Ubaydullah ne Isra'il se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se bataya: yateem ke maal ke baare mein, ke wasi usmein amal karta hai, jab aadmi ne usay wasi banaaya ho.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، قَالَ :" وَصِيُّ الْيَتِيمِ يَأْخُذُ لَهُ بِالشُّفْعَةِ، وَالْغَائِبُ عَلَى شُفْعَتِهِ "
22.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Salt, from Musa ibn Muhammad, from Isma'il, from al-Hasan: He said: "The orphan's executor takes pre-emption on his behalf, and the absent party retains his right of pre-emption."
22.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Salt ne Musa ibn Muhammad se, Isma'il se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Yateem ka wasi uske liye shuf'ah (pehle khareedne ka haq) lega, aur ghair-haazir shakhs apna shuf'ah ka haq barqaraar rakhta hai."

22.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ شَيْخٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ دِمَشْقَ ، قَالَ : " كُنْتُ عِنْدَ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، وَعِنْدَهُ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، وَأَبُو قِلَابَةَ ، إِذْ دَخَلَ غُلَامٌ، فَقَالَ :أَرْضُنَا بِمَكَانِ كَذَا وَكَذَا، بَاعَكُمْ الْوَصِيُّ وَنَحْنُ أَطْفَالٌ، فَالْتَفَتَ إِلَى سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ، فَقَالَ : مَا تَقُولُ؟ قَالَ : فَأَضْجَعَ فِي الْقَوْلِ، فَالْتَفَتَ إِلَى أَبِي قِلَابَةَ، فَقَالَ : مَا تَقُولُ؟ قَالَ : رُدَّ عَلَى الْغُلَامِ أَرْضَهُ، قَالَ : إِذًا يَهْلِكُ مَالُنَا؟ قَالَ : أَنْتَ أَهْلَكْتَهُ "
22.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Ikrimah, an elder from the people of Damascus: He said: "I was with Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz, and Sulayman ibn Habib, and Abu Qilabah were with him, when a young man entered, and said: 'Our land at such-and-such place, the executor sold to you while we were children,' so he turned to Sulayman ibn Habib, and said: 'What do you say?'" He said: So he gave a vague answer, so he turned to Abu Qilabah, and said: "What do you say?" He said: "Return the land to the young man." He said: "Then our wealth will be lost?" He said: "You destroyed it yourself."
22.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se bataya: Mujhe Ikrimah ne bataya, jo Damascus ke ek buzurg the: Unhone kaha, "Main Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz ke paas tha, aur unke paas Sulayman ibn Habib, aur Abu Qilabah maujood the, ke ek jawaan aadmi aaya, aur kaha: 'Humari zameen fulaan jagah par, wasi ne aapko becha thi jabke hum bacche the,' to unhone Sulayman ibn Habib ki taraf mudkar poocha: 'Aap kya kehte hain?'" Unhone bataya: To unhone ghol-mol jawaab diya, to unhone Abu Qilabah ki taraf mudkar poocha: "Aap kya kehte hain?" Unhone kaha: "Jawaan aadmi ko uski zameen wapas kar do." Unhone poocha: "To phir hamara maal barbaad ho jaayega?" Unhone kaha: "Tumne khud isay barbaad kiya hai."

22.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ   : " فِي رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى لِرَجُلٍ بِنِصْفِ مَالِهِ، وَلِآخَرَ بِثُلُثِ مَالِهِ، قَالَ :يَضْرِبَانِ بِذَلِكَ فِي الثُّلُثِ : هَذَا بِالنِّصْفِ، وَهَذَا بِالثُّلُث "
22.en: Narrated by Ibrahim ibn Musa, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Ash'ath, from al-Hasan: Concerning a man who wills half his wealth to one man, and a third of his wealth to another, he said: "They both draw proportionally from the third: this one for the half [share he was willed], and this one for the third [share he was willed]."
22.hi: Ibrahim ibn Musa ne Muhammad ibn Abdullah se, Ash'ath se, al-Hasan se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo apna aadha maal ek aadmi ko, aur apna tihai maal doosre ko wasiyat kare, unhone kaha: "Dono is tihai [jaayez hisse] se munaasib tor par hissa lenge: yeh aadhe ke liye, aur yeh tihai ke liye."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ ، عَنْ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، قَالَ :" يُغَيِّرُ صَاحِبُ الْوَصِيَّةِ مِنْهَا مَا شَاءَ، غَيْرَ الْعَتَاقَةِ "
22.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Za'idah, from al-Shaybani, from al-Sha'bi: He said: "The person making a will can change from it whatever he wishes, except manumission."
22.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Za'idah se, al-Shaybani se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Wasiyat karne wala usme se jo chaahe badal sakta hai, siwaay azaadi (ghulam ko azaad karne) ke."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ  : " أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ  ، قَالَ :" يُحْدِثُ الرَّجُلُ فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ مَا شَاءَ، وَمِلَاكُ الْوَصِيَّةِ آخِرُهَا "
22.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Hammam, from Qatadah, from Amr ibn Shu'ayb, from Abdullah ibn Abi Rabi'ah: That Umar ibn al-Khattab said: "A man may change whatever he wishes in his will, and the deciding factor in a will is its last version."
22.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Hammam se, Qatadah se, Amr ibn Shu'ayb se, Abdullah ibn Abi Rabi'ah se bataya: ke Umar ibn al-Khattab ne kaha: "Aadmi apni wasiyat mein jo chaahe badal sakta hai, aur wasiyat ka faisla-kun hissa uska aakhri version hota hai."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي قَتَادَةُ ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ : " أَنَّ أَبَاهُ أَعْتَقَ رَقِيقًا لَهُ فِي مَرَضِهِ، ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُ أَنْ يَرُدَّهُمْ وَيُعْتِقَ غَيْرَهُمْ، قَالَ : فَخَاصَمُونِي إِلَى عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ ،فَأَجَازَ عِتْقَ الْآخِرِينَ، وَأَبْطَلَ عِتْقَ الْأَوَّلِينَ "
22.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Hammam, from Qatadah, from Amr ibn Dinar: That his father freed some of his slaves during his illness, then it occurred to him to reverse it and free others instead, he said: So they disputed with me before Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan, so he permitted the manumission of the later ones, and invalidated the manumission of the first ones.
22.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Hammam se bataya: Mujhse Qatadah ne bataya: Mujhse Amr ibn Dinar ne bataya: ke unke walid ne apni bimaari mein apne kuch ghulaam azaad kiye, fir unhein khayal aaya ke woh unhein wapas lein aur unki jagah doosron ko azaad karein, unhone bataya: To unhone mujhse Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan ke saamne jhagda kiya, to unhone baad walon ki azaadi ko jaayez qaraar diya, aur pehlon ki azaadi ko baatil kar diya.

22.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ  ، عَنْ الشَّرِيدِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عُمَرُ   :" يُحْدِثُ الرَّجُلُ فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ مَا شَاءَ، وَمِلَاكُ الْوَصِيَّةِ آخِرُهَا ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : هَمَّامٌ لَمْ يَسْمَعْ مِنْ عَمْرٍو، وَبَيْنَهُمَا قَتَادَةُ
22.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Hammam, from Amr ibn Shu'ayb, from Abdullah ibn Abi Rabi'ah, from al-Sharid ibn Suwayd; with Abu Muhammad's note: He said: Umar said: 'A man may change whatever he wishes in his will, and the deciding factor in a will is its last version.' Abu Muhammad said: Hammam did not hear from Amr, and between them is Qatadah.
22.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Hammam se, Amr ibn Shu'ayb se, Abdullah ibn Abi Rabi'ah se, al-Sharid ibn Suwayd se bataya: Unhone kaha, Umar ne kaha: "Aadmi apni wasiyat mein jo chaahe badal sakta hai, aur wasiyat ka faisla-kun hissa uska aakhri version hota hai." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Hammam ne Amr se nahi suna, aur dono ke darmiyan Qatadah hain.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، قَالَ : ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ  : " فِي الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي بِوَصِيَّةٍ ثُمَّ يُوصِي بِأُخْرَى، قَالَ :هُمَا جَائِزَتَانِ فِي مَالِهِ "
22.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah, from Ibn al-Mubarak, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri: Concerning a man who makes one will, then makes another, he said: "Both are valid regarding his wealth."
22.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah ne Ibn al-Mubarak se bataya: Ibn al-Mubarak ne kaha: Humein Ma'mar ne bataya, al-Zuhri se: us aadmi ke baare mein jo ek wasiyat kare, fir doosri kare, unhone kaha: "Dono uske maal mein jaayez hain."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ   :" مِلَاكُ الْوَصِيَّةِ آخِرُهَا "
22.en: Narrated by Sa'id, from Ibn al-Mubarak, from Ma'mar, from Qatadah: He said: Umar ibn al-Khattab said: "The deciding factor in a will is its last version."
22.hi: Sa'id ne Ibn al-Mubarak se bataya: Humein Ma'mar ne bataya, Qatadah se: Unhone kaha, Umar ibn al-Khattab ne kaha: "Wasiyat ka faisla-kun hissa uska aakhri version hota hai."

22.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ ،  عَنْ يَحْيَى ، قَالَ :" إِذَا اتَّهَمَ الْقَاضِي الْوَصِيَّ لَمْ يَعْزِلْهُ، وَلَكِنْ يُوَكِّلُ مَعَهُ غَيْرَهُ "وَهُوَ رَأْيُ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ
22.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak, from al-Walid, from al-Awza'i, from Yahya; with a note on this being al-Awza'i's view: He said: "When the judge suspects the executor, he does not remove him, but appoints another to act with him." And this is al-Awza'i's opinion.
22.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak ne al-Walid se, al-Awza'i se, Yahya se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab qaazi ko wasi par shak ho, to woh usay hataata nahi, balke uske saath kisi aur ko bhi zimmedaar banaata hai." Aur yeh al-Awza'i ki raay hai.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ ، عَنْ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ ، قَالَ :" يَجُوزُ بَيْعُ الْمَرِيضِ وَشِرَاؤُهُ وَنِكَاحُهُ، وَلَا يَكُونُ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ "
22.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Sharik, from al-Shaybani, from Amir: He said: "The sale, purchase, and marriage of a sick person are valid, and are not counted from the third."
22.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Sharik se, al-Shaybani se, Amir se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Bimaar shakhs ki bikri, khareed, aur nikaah jaayez hain, aur woh tihai mein se shumaar nahi kiye jaate."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ ، عَنْ الْحَارِثِ الْعُكْلِيِّ ، قَالَ :" مَا حَابَى بِهِ الْمَرِيضُ فِي مَرَضِهِ مِنْ بَيْعٍ أَوْ شِرَاءٍ، فَهُوَ فِي ثُلُثِهِ قِيمَةُ عَدْلٍ "
22.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Abu Awanah, from Mutarrif, from al-Harith al-Ukli: He said: "Whatever favoritism a sick person shows in his illness through a sale or purchase, it is counted against his third at a fair valuation."
22.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Abu Awanah se, Mutarrif se, al-Harith al-Ukli se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Bimaar shakhs apni bimaari mein bikri ya khareed mein jo bhi rukhsat (fayda) de, woh uski tihai mein se munaasib qeemat ke hisaab se shumaar hoga."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى هُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، قَالَ : أَعْطَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِنَا وَهِيَ حَامِلٌ، فَسُئِلَ الْقَاسِمُ ، فَقَالَ : " هُوَ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ، قَالَ يَحْيَى : وَنَحْنُ نَقُولُ :إِذَا ضَرَبَهَا الْمَخَاضُ فَمَا أَعْطَتْ، فَمِنْ الثُّلُثِ "
22.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Yahya ibn Sa'id: He said: A woman from our family gave [charity] while she was pregnant, so al-Qasim was asked, and he said: "It is from the entire wealth." Yahya said: "And we say: When labor pains strike her, then whatever she gives is from the third."
22.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se bataya: Unhone kaha, Humare khaandaan ki ek aurat ne [sadqa] diya jabke woh haamila thi, to al-Qasim se poocha gaya, to unhone kaha: "Yeh poore maal mein se hai." Yahya kehte hain: "Aur hum kehte hain: Jab usay prasav-peeda shuru ho, to jo woh de, woh tihai mein se hoga."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ   : " فِي رَجُلٍ قَالَ لِغُلَامِهِ : إِنْ دَخَلْتُ دَارَ فُلَانٍ، فَغُلَامِي حُرٌّ، ثُمَّ دَخَلَهَا وَهُوَ مَرِيضٌ، قَالَ :يُعْتَقُ مِنْ الثُّلُثِ، وَإِنْ دَخَلَ فِي صِحَّتِهِ، عُتِقَ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ "
22.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Shihab, from Amr, from al-Hasan: Concerning a man who says to his slave-boy: "If I enter so-and-so's house, my slave is free," then he enters it while sick, he said: "He is freed from the third, but if he entered while healthy, he is freed from the entire wealth."
22.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Shihab se, Amr se, al-Hasan se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo apne ghulam ladke se kahe: "Agar main fulaan ke ghar dakhil hua, to mera ghulam aazad hai," fir woh usmein bimaari ki haalat mein dakhil ho, unhone kaha: "Woh tihai se aazad hoga, aur agar woh sehat ki haalat mein dakhil hua, to woh poore maal se aazad hoga."

22.ar: أخبرنا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا النُّعْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا كَانَ الْوَرَثَةُ مَحَاوِيجَ، فَلَا أَرَى بَأْسًا أَنْ يُرَدَّ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ الثُّلُثِ "، قَالَ يَحْيَى : فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِلْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  فَأَعْجَبَهُ
22.en: Narrated by Marwan ibn Muhammad, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from al-Nu'man ibn al-Mundhir, from Makhul: He said: "When the heirs are needy, I do not see any harm in giving them back from the third." Yahya said: So I mentioned that to al-Awza'i, and it pleased him.
22.hi: Marwan ibn Muhammad ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se, al-Nu'man ibn al-Mundhir se, Makhul se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab waaris zaroormand hon, to mujhe koi harj nazar nahi aata ke unhein tihai se wapas diya jaaye." Yahya kehte hain: To maine yeh baat al-Awza'i se zikr ki to unhein pasand aayi.

22.ar:
أخبرنا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ .
ح وأَخْبَرَنَا مُغِيرَةُ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَا :" إِذَا شَهِدَ شَاهِدَانِ مِنْ الْوَرَثَةِ، جَازَ عَلَى جَمِيعِهِمْ، وَإِذَا شَهِدَ وَاحِدٌ، فَفِي نَصِيبِهِ بِحِصَّتِهِ "
22.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hushaym, from Yunus, from al-Hasan; and from Mughirah, from Ibrahim: They both said: "When two witnesses from among the heirs testify, it is valid against all of them, and when one testifies, it is against his own share proportionally."
22.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hushaym se, Yunus se, al-Hasan se bataya; aur Mughirah se, Ibrahim se bataya: dono ne kaha, "Jab waarison mein se do gawah gawahi dein, to yeh sab par lagu hota hai, aur jab ek gawahi de, to yeh sirf uske apne hisse ke mutaabiq hota hai."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا مُطَرِّفٌ : أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الشَّعْبِيَّ ، يَقُولُ :" إِذَا شَهِدَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ الْوَرَثَةِ، فَفِي نَصِيبِهِ بِحِصَّتِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فِي جَمِيعِ حِصَّتِهِ "
22.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hushaym, from Mutarrif: That he heard al-Sha'bi say: "When a man from the heirs testifies, it is against his own share proportionally," then he said: after that, it applies to his whole share.
22.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hushaym se, Mutarrif se bataya: ke unhone al-Sha'bi ko kehte suna: "Jab waarison mein se ek aadmi gawahi de, to yeh sirf uske apne hisse ke mutaabiq hota hai," fir unhone kaha: uske baad, yeh uske poore hisse par lagu hota hai.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ عَبْدُ رَبِّهِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا أَوْصَى الرَّجُلُ بِالثُّلُثِ، وَالرُّبُعِ، فَفِي الْعَيْنِ وَالدَّيْنِ، وَإِذَا أَوْصَى بِخَمْسِينَ أَوْ سِتِّينَ إِلَى الْمِائَةِ، فَفِي الْعَيْنِ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ الثُّلُثَ "
22.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Abu Shihab Abd Rabbih ibn Nafi', from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim: He said: "When a man wills a third, or a quarter, it is [calculated] from the coin and the debt [i.e., the entire liquid estate], and when he wills fifty or sixty up to a hundred, it is [calculated] from the coin [only] until it reaches a third."
22.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Abu Shihab Abd Rabbih ibn Nafi' se, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab aadmi tihai, ya chauthaai, wasiyat kare, to yeh nakad aur qarz [poori mulkiyat] se hisaab hota hai, aur jab woh pachaas ya saath se sau tak wasiyat kare, to yeh sirf nakad se hisaab hota hai jab tak woh tihai tak na pahunche."

22.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قُسَيْطٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" الْمَرْءُ أَحَقُّ بِثُلُثِ مَالِهِ، يَضَعُهُ فِي أَيِّ مَالِهِ شَاءَ "
22.en: Narrated by Marwan ibn Muhammad, from Sulayman ibn Bilal, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from Yazid ibn Abdullah ibn Qusayt: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A man has more right to a third of his wealth, to place it in whatever part of his wealth he wishes."
22.hi: Marwan ibn Muhammad ne Sulayman ibn Bilal se, Ja'far ibn Muhammad se, Yazid ibn Abdullah ibn Qusayt se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Aadmi apne maal ke tihai hisse ka sabse zyada haqdaar hai, isay apne maal ke jis bhi hisse mein rakhna chaahe."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ أَبِي حَبِيبَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ عَنْ رَجُلٍ جَعَلَ دَرَاهِمَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ   : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَتَصَدَّقُ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ أَوْ يُعْتِقُ، كَالَّذِي يُهْدِي بَعْدَ مَا شَبِعَ "
22.en: Narrated by Abd al-Samad ibn Abd al-Warith, from Shu'bah, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu Habibah: He said: I asked Abu al-Darda about a man who set aside dirhams for the path of Allah, so Abu al-Darda said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The example of one who gives charity or frees a slave at the time of his death is like one who gives a gift after he is already full."
22.hi: Abd al-Samad ibn Abd al-Warith ne Shu'bah se, Abu Ishaq se, Abu Habibah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu al-Darda se us aadmi ke baare mein poocha jisne Allah ki raah mein dirham rakhe, to Abu al-Darda ne kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo apni maut ke waqt sadqa kare ya ghulam azaad kare, uski misaal us shakhs jaisi hai jo pet bhar jaane ke baad tohfa de."

22.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ  ،  عَنْ الْحَسَنِ   : " فِي الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي بِأَشْيَاءَ وَمِنْهَا الْعِتْقُ، فَيُجَاوِزُ الثُّلُثَ، قَالَ :يُبْدَأُ بِالْعِتْقِ ".
حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، قَالَ : بِالْحِصَصِ
22.en: Narrated by al-Mu'alla ibn Asad, from Wuhayb, from Yunus, from al-Hasan; and separately from Ayyub, from Muhammad: Concerning a man who wills several things, including manumission, and it exceeds the third, he said: "Start with the manumission." Al-Mu'alla ibn Asad narrated to us: from Wuhayb, from Ayyub, from Muhammad, he said: [Distribute] proportionally.
22.hi: Al-Mu'alla ibn Asad ne Wuhayb se, Yunus se, al-Hasan se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo kai cheezon ki wasiyat kare, jinmein azaadi bhi ho, aur woh tihai se zyada ho jaaye, unhone kaha: "Azaadi se shuru karo." Al-Mu'alla ibn Asad ne bataya: Wuhayb se, Ayyub se, Muhammad se: Unhone kaha: Munaasib hisson mein.

22.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعَافَى ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ :" مَنْ أَوْصَى أَوْ أَعْتَقَ، فَكَانَ فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ عَوْلٌ، دَخَلَ الْعَوْلُ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْعَتَاقَةِ، وَأَهْلِ الْوَصِيَّةِ ".
قَالَ عَطَاءٌ : إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ غَلَبُونَا، يَبْدَءُونَ بِالْعَتَاقَةِ قَبْلُ
22.en: Narrated by al-Hasan ibn Bishr, from al-Mu'afa, from Uthman ibn al-Aswad, from Ata; with Ata's added note: He said: "Whoever makes a will or frees a slave, and his will has proportional reduction [awl], the reduction affects both the people of manumission and the people of the will [equally]." Ata said: The people of Madinah overruled us, they start with manumission first.
22.hi: Al-Hasan ibn Bishr ne al-Mu'afa se, Uthman ibn al-Aswad se, Ata se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo wasiyat kare ya azaad kare, aur uski wasiyat mein kami (awl) ho, to woh kami azaadi wale aur wasiyat wale, dono par lagu hoti hai." Ata kehte hain: Madinah walon ne humein zyada mana, woh pehle azaadi se shuru karte hain.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ " فِي الَّذِي يُوصِي بِعِتْقٍ، وَغَيْرِهِ فَيَزِيدُ عَلَى الثُّلُثِ، قَالَ : بِالْحِصَصِ "
22.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd: He said: Amr ibn Dinar said, concerning the one who wills manumission and other things, and it exceeds the third, he said: "Proportionally."
22.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Unhone kaha, Amr ibn Dinar ne kaha us shakhs ke baare mein jo azaadi aur doosri cheezon ki wasiyat kare, aur woh tihai se zyada ho jaaye, unhone kaha: "Munaasib hisson mein."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ شِنْظِيرٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ   : " فِي رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى بِأَكْثَرَ مِنْ الثُّلُثِ وَفِيهِ عِتْقٌ؟ قَالَ :يُبْدَأُ بِالْعِتْقِ "
22.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Kathir ibn Shinzir, from al-Hasan: Concerning a man who wills more than a third, and it includes manumission? He said: "Start with the manumission."
22.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Kathir ibn Shinzir se, al-Hasan se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo tihai se zyada wasiyat kare aur usmein azaadi bhi ho? Unhone kaha: "Azaadi se shuru karo."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" يُبْدَأُ بِالْعَتَاقَةِ قَبْلَ الْوَصِيَّةِ "
22.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah, from Isra'il, from Mansur, from Ibrahim: He said: "Start with manumission before the [general] will."
22.hi: Ubaydullah ne Isra'il se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Azaadi se shuru karo, [aam] wasiyat se pehle."

22.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ   : " فِي الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي لِبَنِي فُلَانٍ، قَالَ :غَنِيُّهُمْ وَفَقِيرُهُمْ وَذَكَرُهُمْ وَأُنْثَاهُمْ سَوَاءٌ "
22.en: Narrated by al-Mu'alla ibn Asad, from Wuhayb, from Yunus, from al-Hasan: Concerning a man who wills to the sons of so-and-so, he said: "Their rich and their poor, and their males and their females, are all equal."
22.hi: Al-Mu'alla ibn Asad ne Wuhayb se, Yunus se, al-Hasan se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo fulaan ke beton ke liye wasiyat kare, unhone kaha: "Unke maal-daar aur unke gareeb, aur unke mard aur unki auratein, sab baraabar hain."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، قَالَ :" إِذَا أَوْصَى لِبَنِي فُلَانٍ، فَالذَّكَرُ وَالْأُنْثَى فِيهِ سَوَاءٌ "
22.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Shihab, from Amr, from al-Hasan: He said: "When one wills to the sons of so-and-so, the male and the female are equal in it."
22.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Shihab se, Amr se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab koi fulaan ke beton ke liye wasiyat kare, to mard aur aurat usmein baraabar hain."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ بْنُ مُوسَى الْهَمْدَانِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنِي سَيَّارُ بْنُ أَبِي كَرِبٍ : " أَنَّ آتِيًا أَتَى شُرَيْحًا ، فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى بِسَهْمٍ مِنْ مَالِهِ، قَالَ :تُحْسَبُ الْفَرِيضَةُ، فَمَا بَلَغَ سِهَامَهَا، أُعْطِيَ الْمُوصَى لَهُ سَهْمًا كَأَحَدِهَا "
22.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Za'idah ibn Musa al-Hamdani, from Sayyar ibn Abi Karib: That a visitor came to Shurayh, and asked him about a man who willed a share of his wealth, he said: "The fixed shares are calculated, and however many shares it comes to, the one bequeathed to is given a share like one of them."
22.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Za'idah ibn Musa al-Hamdani se bataya: Mujhe Sayyar ibn Abi Karib ne bataya: ke ek shakhs Shurayh ke paas aaya, aur unse ek aadmi ke baare mein poocha jisne apne maal ka ek hissa wasiyat mein diya, unhone kaha: "Muqarrar hisson ka hisaab lagaaya jaayega, aur jitne bhi hisse bante hon, wasiyat paane wale ko unmein se ek jaisa hissa diya jaayega."

22.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا تَصَدَّقَ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى بَعْضِ وَرَثَتِهِ وَهُوَ صَحِيحٌ بِأَكْثَرَ مِنْ النِّصْفِ، رُدَّ إِلَى الثُّلُثِ، وَإِذَا أَعْطَى النِّصْفَ، جَازَ لَهُ ذَلِكَ ".
قَالَ سَعِيدٌ : وَكَانَ قُضَاةُ أَهْلِ دِمَشْقَ يَقْضُونَ بِذَلِكَ
22.en: Narrated by Marwan ibn Muhammad, from Sa'id, from Makhul; with a note on Damascus's judges: He said: "When a man gives charity to some of his heirs while healthy, more than half, it is reduced to a third, but when he gives half, that is valid for him." Sa'id said: And the judges of the people of Damascus used to rule by that.
22.hi: Marwan ibn Muhammad ne Sa'id se, Makhul se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab aadmi apne kisi waaris ko sehat ki haalat mein sadqa de, aadhe se zyada, to usay tihai tak ghatta diya jaayega, lekin jab woh aadha de, to yeh uske liye jaayez hai." Sa'id kehte hain: Aur Damascus ke qaazi isi ka faisla dete the.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" الْكَفَنُ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ "
22.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Shaybah, from Hafs, from Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid, from al-Hakam, from Ibrahim: He said: "The shroud is from the entire wealth."
22.hi: Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Shaybah ne Hafs se, Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid se, al-Hakam se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Kafan poore maal se [ada kiya jaata] hai."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ مُعَاذٍ  ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ   : " فِي رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَتَرَكَ قِيمَةَ أَلْفَيْ دِرْهَمٍ، وَعَلَيْهِ مِثْلُهَا أَوْ أَكْثَرُ، قَالَ :يُكَفَّنُ مِنْهَا، وَلَا يُعْطَى دَيْنُهُ "
22.en: Narrated by Ibrahim ibn Musa, from Mu'adh, from Ash'ath, from al-Hasan: Concerning a man who died and left the value of two thousand dirhams, and owed the same or more, he said: "He is shrouded from it, and his debt is not paid."
22.hi: Ibrahim ibn Musa ne Mu'adh se, Ash'ath se, al-Hasan se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo mara aur do hazaar dirham ki qeemat chhod gaya, aur uspar utna hi ya zyada qarz tha, unhone kaha: "Usay usi se kafanaya jaayega, aur uska qarz ada nahi kiya jaayega."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَمَّنْ سَمِعَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" يُبْدَأُ بِالْكَفَنِ، ثُمَّ الدَّيْنِ، ثُمَّ الْوَصِيَّةِ "
22.en: Narrated by Qabisah, from Sufyan, from someone who heard Ibrahim: He said: "Start with the shroud, then the debt, then the will."
22.hi: Qabisah ne Sufyan se, us shakhs se jisne Ibrahim ko suna, bataya: Unhone kaha, "Kafan se shuru karo, fir qarz se, fir wasiyat se."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ ، أنبأنا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ فِرَاسٍ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  : " فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَمُوتُ، قَالَ :" تُكَفَّنُ مِنْ مَالِهَا، لَيْسَ عَلَى الزَّوْجِ شَيْءٌ "
22.en: Narrated by Qabisah, from Sufyan, from Firas, from al-Sha'bi: Concerning a woman who dies, he said: "She is shrouded from her own wealth, nothing is upon the husband."
22.hi: Qabisah ne Sufyan se, Firas se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: us aurat ke baare mein jo mar jaaye, unhone kaha: "Usay apne hi maal se kafanaya jaayega, shohar par kuch nahi."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ ، عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ ،  عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ :" الْحَنُوطُ، وَالْكَفَنُ مِنْ رَأْسِ الْمَالِ "
22.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah, from Ibn al-Mubarak, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ata: He said: "The embalming perfume and the shroud are from the principal wealth."
22.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah ne Ibn al-Mubarak se, Ibn Jurayj se, Ata se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Khushbu (hunoot) aur kafan mool maal se hote hain."
