22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" الْكَفَنُ مِنْ وَسَطِ الْمَالِ، يكفن على قدر ما كان يلبس في حياته، ثم يخرج الدين، ثم الثلث "
22.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Isma'il, from al-Hasan: He said: "The shroud is from the middle of the wealth, he is shrouded according to what he used to wear in his life, then the debt is taken out, then the third."
22.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Isma'il se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Kafan maal ke darmiyaani hisse se hota hai, usay usi tarah kafanaya jaata hai jaisa woh apni zindagi mein pehnta tha, fir qarz nikaala jaata hai, fir tihai."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا مَنْصُورٌ  ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ  ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ :" إِذَا أَوْصَى الرَّجُلُ إِلَى الرَّجُلِ وَهُوَ غَائِبٌ، فَلْيَقْبَلْ وَصِيَّتَهُ، وَإِنْ كَانَ حَاضِرًا، فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ : إِنْ شَاءَ، قَبِلَ، وَإِنْ شَاء، َتَرَكَ "
22.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hushaym, from Mansur, from al-Hasan: That he used to say: "When a man appoints another man as executor while he is absent, let him accept his executorship, but if he is present, he has the choice: if he wishes, he accepts, and if he wishes, he leaves it."
22.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hushaym se, Mansur se, al-Hasan se bataya: ke woh kehte the: "Jab aadmi kisi doosre aadmi ko wasi banaaye jabke woh ghair-haazir ho, to usay uski wasi-giri qabool karni chaahiye, lekin agar woh haazir ho, to usay ikhtiyaar hai: agar chaahe to qabool kare, aur agar chaahe to chhod de."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا صَالِحُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ،  عَنْ أَيُّوبَ ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ الْحَسَنَ ، وَمُحَمَّدًا  عَنِ " الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي إِلَى الرَّجُلِ، قَالَا :نَخْتَارُ أَنْ يَقْبَلَ "
22.en: Narrated by Salih ibn Abdullah, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub: He said: I asked al-Hasan, and Muhammad, about a man who appoints another man as executor, they both said: "We prefer that he accept."
22.hi: Salih ibn Abdullah ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ayyub se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Hasan, aur Muhammad, se poocha us aadmi ke baare mein jo doosre aadmi ko wasi banaaye, dono ne kaha: "Hum pasand karte hain ke woh qabool kare."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَسْعَدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ  ، قَالَ :" إِذَا أَوْصَى الرَّجُلُ إِلَى الرَّجُلِ وَهُوَ غَائِبٌ، فَإِذَا قَدِمَ فَإِنْ شَاءَ، قَبِلَ ، فَإِذَا قَبِلَ، لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ أَنْ يَرُدَّ "
22.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn As'ad, from Abu Bakr, from Hisham, from al-Hasan: He said: "When a man appoints another man as executor while he is absent, then when he arrives, if he wishes, he accepts, but once he accepts, he cannot reject it."
22.hi: Muhammad ibn As'ad ne Abu Bakr se, Hisham se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab aadmi kisi doosre aadmi ko wasi banaaye jabke woh ghair-haazir ho, fir jab woh aaye, agar woh chaahe to qabool kare, lekin ek baar qabool karne ke baad, usay isse radd karne ka haq nahi."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَضَّاحُ بْنُ يَحْيَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، قَالَ :" إِذَا أَوْصَى الرَّجُلُ إِلَى الرَّجُلِ، فَعُرِضَتْ عَلَيْهِ الْوَصِيَّةُ، وَكَانَ غَائِبًا فَقَبِلَ، لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ أَنْ يَرْجِعَ "
22.en: Narrated by al-Waddah ibn Yahya, from Abu Bakr, from Hisham, from al-Hasan: He said: "When a man appoints another man as executor, and the executorship is presented to him, and he was absent, but he accepts, he cannot go back on it."
22.hi: Al-Waddah ibn Yahya ne Abu Bakr se, Hisham se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab aadmi kisi doosre aadmi ko wasi banaaye, aur wasiyat uske saamne pesh ki jaaye, aur woh ghair-haazir tha lekin usne qabool kar liya, to usay isse peechhe hatne ka haq nahi."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ شعبة ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا أَوْصَى الرَّجُلُ لِإِنْسَانٍ، وَهُوَ غَائِبٌ، وَكَانَ مَيِّتًا، وَهُوَ لَا يَدْرِي، فَهِيَ رَاجِعَةٌ "
22.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Shu'bah, from Abu Ma'shar, from Ibrahim: He said: "When a man wills [something] for a person while he is absent, and he was [already] dead, and he [the willer] did not know, then it reverts back."
22.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Shu'bah se, Abu Ma'shar se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab aadmi kisi shakhs ke liye wasiyat kare jabke woh ghair-haazir ho, aur woh [pehle se] mar chuka ho, aur wasiyat karne wale ko iska ilm na ho, to yeh [wasiyat] wapas lauta di jaayegi."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، قَالَ :" إِذَا أَوْصَى لِعَبْدِهِ ثُلُثَ مَالِهِ، رُبُعَ مَالِهِ، خُمُسَ مَالِهِ، فَهُوَ مِنْ مَالِهِ دَخَلَتْهُ عَتَاقَةٌ "
22.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Yunus, from al-Hasan: He said: "When he wills a third of his wealth, a quarter of his wealth, or a fifth of his wealth to his slave, it is from his wealth, manumission is included in it."
22.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Yunus se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab woh apne ghulam ko apne maal ka tihai, chauthaai, ya paanchwan hissa wasiyat kare, to yeh uske maal se hoga, azaadi bhi isme shaamil hai."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل ،  عَنْ قَيْسٍ ، قَالَ : كَانَ يُقَالُ :" إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيُحْرَمُ بَرَكَةَ مَالِهِ فِي حَيَاتِهِ، فَإِذَا كَانَ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ، تَزَوَّدَ بِفَجْرَةٍ "
22.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Isma'il, from Qays: He said: It used to be said: "The man is indeed deprived of the blessing of his wealth in his life, so when it is at the time of death, he provides himself with wickedness [i.e., last-minute unjust dealings]."
22.hi: Ya'la ne Isma'il se, Qays se bataya: Unhone kaha, Yeh kaha jaata tha: "Aadmi apni zindagi mein apne maal ki barkat se mehroom kar diya jaata hai, so jab maut ka waqt aata hai, to woh apne aap ko badkaari se zaad-e-raah dega leta hai."

22.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُبَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنٌ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   :" الْمُرَّانِ : الْإِمْسَاكُ فِي الْحَيَاةِ، وَالتَّبْذِيرُ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : يُقَالُ : مُرٌّ فِي الْحَيَاةِ، وَمُرٌّ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ
22.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Zubayd, from Husayn, from Ibrahim al-Taymi, from his father; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: Abdullah said: 'al-murran: is withholding during life, and squandering at the time of death.' Abu Muhammad said: It is said: bitter in life, and bitter at death.
22.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Zubayd se, Husayn se, Ibrahim al-Taymi se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ne kaha: "'Al-Murran' ka matlab hai: zindagi mein rokna, aur maut ke waqt fizool-kharchi karna." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Kaha jaata hai: zindagi mein kadwa, aur maut ke waqt kadwa.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ،  عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا أَوْصَى الرَّجُلُ لِآخَرَ بِمِثْلِ نَصِيبِ ابْنِهِ، فَلَا يَتِمُّ لَهُ مِثْلُ نَصِيبِهِ، حَتَّى يَنْقُصَ مِنْهُ "
22.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah, from Isra'il, from Mansur, from Ibrahim: He said: "When a man wills to another the equivalent of his son's share, then it is not made complete equal to his share, until it is reduced from it [slightly]."
22.hi: Ubaydullah ne Isra'il se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab aadmi doosre ko apne bete ke hisse jitna wasiyat kare, to woh uske hisse ke barabar poora nahi kiya jaata, jab tak usmein se [thodi] kami na ki jaaye."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  : " فِي رَجُلٍ كَانَ لَهُ ثَلَاثَةُ بَنِينَ، فَأَوْصَى لِرَجُلٍ مِثْلَ نَصِيبِ أَحَدِهِمْ لَوْ كَانُوا أَرْبَعَةً، قَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ :يُعْطَى الْخُمُسَ "
22.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Da'ud ibn Abi Hind, from al-Sha'bi: Concerning a man who had three sons, and willed to a man the equivalent of one of their shares as if they were four, al-Sha'bi said: "He is given a fifth."
22.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Da'ud ibn Abi Hind se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jiske teen bete the, aur usne ek aadmi ko unmein se ek ke hisse jitna wasiyat kiya, agar woh chaar hote, al-Sha'bi ne kaha: "Usay paanchwan hissa diya jaayega."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِنْدٍ ، قَالَ : " سَأَلْنَا عَامِرًا  عَنْ رَجُلٍ تَرَكَ ابْنَيْنِ، وَأَوْصَى بِمِثْلِ نَصِيبِ أَحَدِهِمْ لَوْ كَانُوا ثَلَاثَةً، قَالَ :أَوْصَى بِالرُّبُعِ "
22.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Da'ud ibn Abi Hind: He said: We asked Amir about a man who left two sons, and willed the equivalent of one of their shares as if they were three, he said: "He willed a quarter."
22.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Da'ud ibn Abi Hind se bataya: Unhone kaha, Humne Amir se poocha us aadmi ke baare mein jo do bete chhod gaya, aur usne unmein se ek ke hisse jitna wasiyat kiya, agar woh teen hote, unhone kaha: "Usne chauthaai wasiyat ki."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ : " فِي رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى بِمِثْلِ نَصِيبِ بَعْضِ الْوَرَثَةِ، قَالَ :لَا يَجُوزُ، وَإِنْ كَانَ أَقَلَّ مِنْ الثُّلُثِ "، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : هُوَ حَسَنٌ
22.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Abu Awanah, from Mughirah, from Ibrahim; with Abu Muhammad's approval: Concerning a man who wills the equivalent of the share of one of the heirs, he said: "It is not valid, even if it is less than a third." Abu Muhammad said: This is good [reasoning].
22.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Abu Awanah se, Mughirah se, Ibrahim se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo waarison mein se kisi ek ke hisse jitna wasiyat kare, unhone kaha: "Yeh jaayez nahi, chahe woh tihai se kam hi ho." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Yeh theek hai.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ ، أنبأنا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي السَّفَرِ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  : " فِي رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى فِي غَلَّةِ عَبْدِهِ بِدِرْهَمٍ، وَغَلَّتُهُ سِتَّةٌ، قَالَ :لَهُ سُدُسُهُ "
22.en: Narrated by Qabisah, from Sufyan, from Ibn Abi al-Safar, from al-Sha'bi: Concerning a man who wills a dirham from the produce of his slave, and his produce is six [dirhams], he said: "He gets a sixth of it."
22.hi: Qabisah ne Sufyan se, Ibn Abi al-Safar se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo apne ghulam ki paidaawar mein se ek dirham wasiyat kare, aur uski paidaawar chhe [dirham] ho, unhone kaha: "Usay iska chhattai hissa milega."

22.ar: أخبرنا قَبِيصَةُ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ ، يَقُولُ :" إِذَا أَقَرَّ لِوَارِثٍ وَلِغَيْرِ وَارِثٍ بِمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ، قَالَ : أَرَى أَنْ أُبْطِلَهُمَا جَمِيعًا "
22.en: Narrated by Qabisah: He said: I heard Sufyan say: "When he acknowledges a hundred dirhams owed to an heir and to a non-heir together, I consider that I would invalidate both of them."
22.hi: Qabisah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Sufyan ko kehte suna: "Jab woh ek waaris aur ek ghair-waaris ke liye ekattha sau dirham ka iqraar kare, mera khayal hai ke main dono ko baatil kar dunga."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ ، عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ ، قَالَ :" لَا يَجُوزُ إِقْرَارٌ لِوَارِثٍ، قَالَ : وقال الْحَسَنُ  : أَحَقُّ مَا جَازَ عَلَيْهِ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ : أَوَّلَ يَوْمٍ مِنْ أَيَّامِ الْآخِرَةِ، وَآخِرَ يَوْمٍ مِنْ أَيَّامِ الدُّنْيَا "
22.en: Narrated by Muslim, from Hammam, from Qatadah, from Ibn Sirin, from Shurayh; with al-Hasan's added note: He said: "An acknowledgment for an heir is not valid." He said: And al-Hasan said: "The most deserving [time to make an acknowledgment] that is valid upon him, is at the time of his death: the first day of the days of the Hereafter, and the last day of the days of this world."
22.hi: Muslim ne Hammam se, Qatadah se, Ibn Sirin se, Shurayh se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Waaris ke liye kiya gaya iqraar jaayez nahi." Unhone bataya: Aur al-Hasan ne kaha: "Sabse zyada haqdaar waqt jab uspar [iqraar] jaayez hota hai, uski maut ke waqt hai: Aakhirat ke dinon ka pehla din, aur duniya ke dinon ka aakhri din."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، أنبأنا خَالِدٌ ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ ، قَالَ :" لَا يَجُوزُ لِوَارِثٍ وَصِيَّةٌ "
22.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid, from Khalid, from Abu Qilabah: He said: "A will for an heir is not valid."
22.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid se, Khalid se, Abu Qilabah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Waaris ke liye wasiyat jaayez nahi."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ  : " أَنَّ رَجُلًا يُكْنَى أَبَا ثَابِتٍأَقَرَّ لِامْرَأَتِهِ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ أَنَّ لَهَا عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعَ مِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ مِنْ صَدَاقِهَا، فَأَجَازَهُ الْحَسَنُ  "
22.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Humayd: "That a man with the kunyah Abu Thabit acknowledged to his wife, at the time of his death, that she was owed four hundred dirhams from her dowry, so al-Hasan permitted it."
22.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Humayd se bataya: "ke Abu Thabit kunyat wale ek aadmi ne apni biwi se, apni maut ke waqt, iqraar kiya ke usper uske mahar ke chaar sau dirham baaqi hain, to al-Hasan ne isay jaayez qaraar diya."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتَوَائِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ غَنْمٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ خَارِجَةَ  ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ تَحْتَ نَاقَةِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهِيَ تَقْصَعُ بِجِرَّتِهَا، وَلُعَابُهَا يَنُوصُ بَيْنَ كَتِفَيَّ، سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ :" أَلَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَعْطَى كُلَّ ذِي حَقٍّ حَقَّهُ، فَلَا يَجُوزُ وَصِيَّةٌ لِوَارِثٍ "
22.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Hisham al-Dastawa'i, from Qatadah, from Shahr ibn Hawshab, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Ghanm, from Amr ibn Kharijah: He said: I was under the she-camel of the Prophet ﷺ while it chewed its cud, and its saliva flowed between my shoulders, I heard him say: "Listen, Allah has indeed given every rightful owner his right, so a will for an heir is not valid."
22.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Hisham al-Dastawa'i se, Qatadah se, Shahr ibn Hawshab se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Ghanm se, Amr ibn Kharijah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Nabi ﷺ ki oontni ke neeche tha jabke woh apni jugaali kar rahi thi, aur uska laar mere kandhon ke darmiyan beh raha tha, maine aapko farmaate suna, "Sun lo, Allah ne har haqdaar ko uska haq de diya hai, so waaris ke liye koi wasiyat jaayez nahi."

22.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ ، أنبأنا هَمَّامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، قَال : # إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ إِنْ تَرَكَ خَيْرًا الْوَصِيَّةُ لِلْوَالِدَيْنِ وَالأَقْرَبِينَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ حَقًّا عَلَى الْمُتَّقِينَ سورة البقرة آية 180 #،فَأَمَرَ أَنْ يُوصِيَ لِوَالِدَيْهِ وَأَقَارِبِهِ، ثُمَّ نُسِخَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فِي سُورَةِ النِّسَاءِ ، فَجَعَلَ لِلْوَالِدَيْنِ نَصِيبًا مَعْلُومًا، وَأَلْحَقَ لِكُلِّ ذِي مِيرَاثٍ نَصِيبَهُ مِنْهُ، وَلَيْسَتْ لَهُمْ وَصِيَّةٌ، فَصَارَتْ الْوَصِيَّةُ لِمَنْ لَا يَرِثُ مِنْ قَرِيبٍ وَغَيْرِهِ "
22.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hammam, from Qatadah: He said, concerning: "When death approaches one of you, if he leaves wealth, that he make a bequest for parents and near relatives in a fair manner, an obligation upon the righteous" [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 180]: He commanded that a will be made for parents and relatives, then it was later abrogated in Surah al-Nisa, where He made a known share for parents, and attached to every heir his share of it, and they no longer had a will [entitlement], so the will became for whoever does not inherit, whether relative or otherwise.
22.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hammam se, Qatadah se bataya: aayat ke baare mein: "Jab tum mein se kisi ko maut aaye, agar woh maal chhode, to woh maa-baap aur qareebi rishtedaron ke liye achhe tareeke se wasiyat kare, yeh muttaqiyon par ek haq hai" [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 180]: Allah ne hukum diya ke maa-baap aur rishtedaron ke liye wasiyat ki jaaye, fir yeh baad mein Surah An-Nisa mein mansookh kar diya gaya, jahan usne maa-baap ke liye ek maloom hissa muqarrar kiya, aur har waaris ko usme se uska hissa joda, aur unke liye ab koi wasiyat [haqdaari] nahi rahi, so wasiyat sirf uske liye reh gayi jo virasat na paata ho, chahe rishtedaar ho ya kuch aur.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وَرْقَاءُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ،  عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ :" كَانَ الْمَالُ لِلْوَلَدِ، وَكَانَتْ الْوَصِيَّةُ لِلْوَالِدَيْنِ وَالْأَقْرَبِينَ، فَنَسَخَ اللَّهُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ مَا أَحَبَّ، فَجَعَلَ لِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلَ حَظِّ الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ، وَجَعَلَ لِلْأَبَوَيْنِ لِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا السُّدُسَ وَالثُّلُثَ، وَجَعَلَ لِلْمَرْأَةِ الثُّمُنَ وَالرُّبُعَ، وَلِلزَّوْجِ الشَّطْرَ وَالرُّبُعَ "
22.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Warqa, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Ata, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "The wealth used to be for the child, and the will used to be for the parents and near relatives, so Allah abrogated whatever of that He willed, and made for the male the equivalent of the share of two females, and gave to each of the parents a sixth and a third, and gave the wife an eighth and a quarter, and the husband half and a quarter."
22.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Warqa se, Ibn Abi Najih se, Ata se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Maal aulaad ke liye tha, aur wasiyat maa-baap aur qareebi rishtedaron ke liye thi, to Allah ne usmein se jo chaaha mansookh kiya, aur mard ke liye do auraton ke barabar hissa muqarrar kiya, aur maa-baap mein se har ek ko chhattai hissa aur tihai diya, aur biwi ko aathwan aur chauthaai diya, aur shohar ko aadha aur chauthaai diya."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو تُمَيْلَةَ ، عَنْ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ وَاقِدٍ ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ ، وَالْحَسَنِ  :# إِنْ تَرَكَ خَيْرًا الْوَصِيَّةُ لِلْوَالِدَيْنِ وَالأَقْرَبِينَ سورة البقرة آية 180 #، فكانت الوصية كذلك، حتى نسختها آية الميراث "
22.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Isma'il, from Abu Tumaylah, from al-Husayn ibn Waqid, from Yazid, from Ikrimah, and al-Hasan: Concerning: "If he leaves wealth, that he make a bequest for parents and near relatives" [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 180]: the will was thus, until the verse of inheritance abrogated it.
22.hi: Ahmad ibn Isma'il ne Abu Tumaylah se, al-Husayn ibn Waqid se, Yazid se, Ikrimah aur al-Hasan se bataya: aayat ke baare mein: "Agar woh maal chhode, to woh maa-baap aur qareebi rishtedaron ke liye wasiyat kare" [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 180]: wasiyat isi tarah thi, yahan tak ke virasat ki aayat ne isay mansookh kar diya.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، " سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى وَلَهُ أَخٌ مُوسِرٌ، أَيُوصِ لَهُ؟ قَالَ :نَعَمْ، وَإِنْ كَانَ رَبَّ عِشْرِينَ أَلْفًا، ثُمَّ قَالَ : وَإِنْ كَانَ رَبَّ مِائَةِ أَلْفٍ، فَإِنَّ غِنَاهُ لَا يَمْنَعُهُ الْحَقَّ "
22.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Humayd, from al-Hasan: He was asked about a man who makes a will, and has a well-off brother, does he will to him? He said: "Yes, even if he is the owner of twenty thousand," then he said: "And even if he is the owner of a hundred thousand, for his wealth does not prevent him from his right."
22.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Humayd se, al-Hasan se bataya: unse ek aise aadmi ke baare mein poocha gaya jo wasiyat kare, aur uska ek maal-daar bhai ho, kya woh usay wasiyat de sakta hai? Unhone kaha: "Haan, chahe woh bees hazaar ka maalik ho," fir unhone kaha: "Aur chahe woh ek lakh ka maalik ho, kyunki uski amiri usay uske haq se nahi rokti."

22.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ  : " في رجل قَالَ : سَيْفِي لِفُلَانٍ، فَإِنْ مَاتَ فُلَانٌ، فَلِفُلَانٍ، فَإِنْ مَاتَ فُلَانٌ، فَمَرْجِعُهُ إِلَيَّ، قَالَا :هُوَ لِلْأَوَّلِ ".
قَالَ : وَقَالَ حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  : يُمْضَى كَمَا قَالَ
22.en: Narrated by Affan, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Qatadah, from al-Hasan, and Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab; with Humayd's addition: Concerning a man who says: "My sword is for so-and-so, but if so-and-so dies, then it is for so-and-so, but if so-and-so dies, then it reverts to me," they both said: "It belongs to the first one." He said: And Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman said: It is carried out as he said.
22.hi: Affan ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Qatadah se, al-Hasan aur Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo kahe: "Meri talwar fulaan ke liye hai, lekin agar fulaan mar jaaye, to woh fulaan ke liye hai, lekin agar fulaan mar jaaye, to woh mujhe wapas lauta di jaaye," dono ne kaha: "Yeh pehle wale ki hai." Unhone bataya: Aur Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman ne kaha: Isay usi tarah amal mein laaya jaayega jaisa usne kaha.

22.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ : أَنَّ عُرْوَةَ ، قَالَ : " فِي الرَّجُلِ يُعْطِي الرَّجُلَ الْعَطَاءَ، فَيَقُولُ : هُوَ لَكَ، فَإِذَا مُتَّ، فَلِفُلَانٍ، فَإِذَا مَاتَ فُلَانٌ، فَلِفُلَانٍ، وَإِذَا مَاتَ فُلَانٌ، فَمَرْجِعُهُ إِلَيَّ.
قَالَ :يُمْضَى كَمَا قَالَ، وَإِنْ كَانُوا مِائَةً "
22.en: Narrated by Affan, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Hisham ibn Urwah: That Urwah said, concerning a man who gives a gift to another man, and says: "It is yours, but when you die, it is for so-and-so, and when so-and-so dies, it is for so-and-so, and when so-and-so dies, it reverts to me," he said: "It is carried out as he said, even if there were a hundred of them."
22.hi: Affan ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Hisham ibn Urwah se bataya: ke Urwah ne kaha, us aadmi ke baare mein jo doosre aadmi ko tohfa de, aur kahe: "Yeh tumhara hai, lekin jab tum maro, to yeh fulaan ke liye hai, aur jab fulaan mare, to yeh fulaan ke liye hai, aur jab fulaan mare, to yeh mujhe wapas lauta diya jaaye," unhone kaha: "Isay usi tarah amal mein laaya jaayega jaisa usne kaha, chahe unki tadaad sau bhi ho."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَةُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ الرَّاسِبِيُّ ، وَكَثِيرُ بْنُ مَعْدَانَ ، قَالَا : سَأَلْنَا سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ " الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي فِي غَيْرِ قَرَابَتِهِ، فَقَالَ سَالِمٌ  :هِيَ حَيْثُ جَعَلَهَا، قَالَ : فَقُلْنَا : إِنَّ الْحَسَنَ  يَقُولُ : يُرَدُّ عَلَى الْأَقْرَبِينَ، فَأَنْكَرَ ذَلِكَ، وَقَالَ قَوْلًا شَدِيدًا "
22.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Shaybah ibn Hisham al-Rasibi, and Kathir ibn Ma'dan: They said: We asked Salim ibn Abdullah about a man who wills to someone who is not his relative, so Salim said: "It is where he placed it," they said: So we said: "al-Hasan says: It is returned to the near relatives," so he rejected that, and spoke sharply.
22.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Shaybah ibn Hisham al-Rasibi, aur Kathir ibn Ma'dan ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Humne Salim ibn Abdullah se poocha us aadmi ke baare mein jo apne rishtedaar ke ilaawa kisi aur ko wasiyat kare, to Salim ne kaha: "Yeh wahin jaayega jahan usne rakha," unhone bataya: To humne kaha: "Al-Hasan kehte hain: Yeh qareebi rishtedaron ko wapas kar diya jaata hai," to unhone isse inkaar kiya, aur sakhti se baat ki.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، قَالَ :" إِذَا أَوْصَى الرَّجُلُ فِي قَرَابَتِهِ، فَهُوَ لِأَقْرَبِهِمْ بِبَطْنٍ : الذَّكَرُ وَالْأُنْثَى فِيهِ سَوَاءٌ "
22.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Shihab, from Amr, from al-Hasan: He said: "When a man wills [something] for his relatives, it goes to the nearest of them by lineage: the male and the female are equal in it."
22.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Shihab se, Amr se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab aadmi apne rishtedaron ke liye wasiyat kare, to yeh unmein se nasab mein sabse qareebi ko jaayega: mard aur aurat usmein baraabar hain."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  : " فِي رَجُلٍ قَالَ : أَحَدُ غُلَامَيَّ حُرٌّ ثُمَّ مَاتَ، وَلَمْ يُبَيِّنْ، قَالَ :الْوَرَثَةُ بِمَنْزِلَتِهِ يُعْتِقُونَ أَيَّهُمَا أَحَبُّوا "
22.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Bakr, from Mutarrif, from al-Sha'bi: Concerning a man who says: "One of my two slave-boys is free," then dies without clarifying [which one], he said: "The heirs are in his position, they free whichever of them they wish."
22.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Bakr se, Mutarrif se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo kahe: "Mere do ghulaam ladkon mein se ek aazad hai," fir wazeh kiye bagair mar jaaye [kaunsa], unhone kaha: "Waaris uski jagah hain, woh unmein se jise chaahein azaad karein."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ  ،  عَنْ الْحَسَنِ   : " أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ فِي مَرَضِهِ : لِفُلَانٍ كَذَا وَلِفُلَانٍ كَذَا، وَعَبْدِي فُلَانٌ حُرٌّ، وَلَمْ يَقُلْ : إِنْ حَدَثَ بِي حَدَثٌ، فَبَرَأَ، قَالَ :هُوَ مَمْلُوكٌ "
22.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Yunus, from al-Hasan: "That a man said during his illness: 'Such-and-such for so-and-so, and such-and-such for so-and-so, and my slave so-and-so is free,' and did not say: 'If anything happens to me,' then he recovered, he said: "He remains a slave."
22.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Yunus se, al-Hasan se bataya: "ke aadmi ne apni bimaari mein kaha: 'Fulaan-fulaan cheez fulaan ke liye, aur fulaan-fulaan cheez fulaan ke liye, aur mera ghulam fulaan aazad hai,' aur usne yeh nahi kaha: 'Agar mujhe kuch ho jaaye,' fir woh theek ho gaya, unhone kaha: "Woh ghulam hi rahega."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  : " فِي رَجُلٍ أَعْتَقَ غُلَامَهُ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ، وَلَيْسَ لَهُ غَيْرُهُ، وَعَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ، قَالَ :يَسْعَى لِلْغُرَمَاءِ فِي ثَمَنِهِ "
22.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Bakr, from Mutarrif, from al-Sha'bi: Concerning a man who frees his slave-boy at the time of death, and has no one else besides him, and he owes a debt, he said: "He works to earn his price for the creditors."
22.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Bakr se, Mutarrif se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo apni maut ke waqt apna ghulam ladka azaad kare, aur uske paas uske siwa aur kuch na ho, aur uspar qarz ho, unhone kaha: "Woh apni qeemat qarzdaaron ke liye mehnat karke kamaayega."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  : " أَنَّ رَجُلًا اشْتَرَى عَبْدًا بِتِسْعِ مِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ، فَأَعْتَقَهُ وَلَمْ يَقْضِ ثَمَنَ الْعَبْدِ، وَلَمْ يَتْرُكْ شَيْئًا، فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ   :يَسْعَى الْعَبْدُ فِي ثَمَنِهِ "
22.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Hammam, from Qatadah, from al-Hasan: "That a man bought a slave for nine hundred dirhams, then freed him but did not pay the price of the slave, and left nothing, so Ali said: 'The slave works to earn his own price.'"
22.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Hammam se, Qatadah se, al-Hasan se bataya: "ke ek aadmi ne ek ghulam sau dirham mein khareeda, fir usay azaad kar diya lekin ghulam ki qeemat ada nahi ki, aur kuch nahi chhoda, to Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: 'Ghulam apni qeemat khud mehnat karke kamaayega.'"

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَشْعَثِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" الْمُدَبَّرُ مِنْ الثُّلُثِ "
22.en: Narrated by Mansur ibn Salamah, from Sharik, from al-Ash'ath, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: He said: "The mudabbar [slave freed to take effect after master's death] is from the third."
22.hi: Mansur ibn Salamah ne Sharik se, al-Ash'ath se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Mudabbar (maut ke baad azaad hone wala ghulam) tihai mein se hota hai."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" الْمُدَبَّرُ مِنْ الثُّلُثِ "
22.en: Narrated by Mansur ibn Salamah, from Sharik, from Mansur, from Ibrahim: He said: "The mudabbar is from the third."
22.hi: Mansur ibn Salamah ne Sharik se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Mudabbar tihai mein se hota hai."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، قَالَ :" الْمُعْتَقُ عَنْ دُبُرٍ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ "
22.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Kathir, from al-Hasan: He said: "The one freed to take effect after death is from the third."
22.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Kathir se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Maut ke baad azaad hone wala tihai mein se hota hai."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، قَالَ :" الْمُعْتَقَةُ عَنْ دُبُرٍ وَوَلَدُهَا مِنْ الثُّلُثِ "
22.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Humayd, from al-Hasan: He said: "The woman freed to take effect after death, and her child, are from the third."
22.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Humayd se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Maut ke baad azaad hone wali aurat, aur uska bachcha, tihai mein se hote hain."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، قَالَ : مَنْصُورٌ أَخْبَرَنِي، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" الْمُعْتَقُ عَنْ دُبُرٍ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ "
22.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Shu'bah: He said: Mansur told me: from Ibrahim, he said: "The one freed to take effect after death is from the third."
22.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Shu'bah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhse Mansur ne bataya, Ibrahim se: Unhone kaha, "Maut ke baad azaad hone wala tihai mein se hota hai."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الشَّقَرِيِّ ، وَأَبِي هَاشِمٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" الْمُدَبَّرُ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ "
22.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Abu Abdullah al-Shaqari, and Abu Hashim, from Ibrahim: He said: "The mudabbar is from the entire wealth."
22.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Abu Abdullah al-Shaqari, aur Abu Hashim se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Mudabbar poore maal mein se hota hai."

22.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، قَالَ :" الْمُعْتَقُ عَنْ دُبُرٍ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ ".
سُئِلَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : بِأَيِّهِمَا تَقُولُ؟ قَالَ : مِنَ الثُّلُثِ
22.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Abu Awanah, from Abu Bishr, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: "The one freed to take effect after death is from the entire wealth." Abu Muhammad was asked: "Which of the two [views] do you hold?" He said: From the third.
22.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Abu Awanah se, Abu Bishr se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Maut ke baad azaad hone wala poore maal mein se hota hai." Abu Muhammad se poocha gaya: "Aap in dono mein se kya kehte hain?" Unhone kaha: Tihai mein se.

22.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَخْلَدٌ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، قَالَ :" لَا تَشْهَدْ عَلَى وَصِيَّةٍ حَتَّى تُقْرَأَ عَلَيْكَ، وَلَا تَشْهَدْ عَلَى مَنْ لَا تَعْرِفُ "
22.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah, from Makhlad, from Hisham, from al-Hasan: He said: "Do not witness a will until it is read to you, and do not witness for someone you do not know."
22.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah ne Makhlad se, Hisham se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Kisi wasiyat par gawah mat bano jab tak woh tumhein padh kar na sunaayi jaaye, aur kisi aise shakhs par gawah mat bano jise tum nahi jaante."

22.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  : أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ  " أَوْصَى لِأُمَّهَاتِ أَوْلَادِهِ بِأَرْبَعَةِ آلَافٍ، أَرْبَعَةِ آلَافٍ، لِكُلِّ امْرَأَةٍ مِنْهُنَّ "
22.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Humayd, from al-Hasan: That Umar ibn al-Khattab "willed to the mothers of his children four thousand each, for every woman among them."
22.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Humayd se, al-Hasan se bataya: ke Umar ibn al-Khattab ne "apne bacchon ki maaon ke liye char-char hazaar wasiyat ki, unmein se har aurat ke liye."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ ، أنبأنا ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ  : أَنَّهُ" أَجَازَ وَصِيَّةَ ابْنِ ثَلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً "
22.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Ibn Abi al-Zinad, from his father, from Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz: That he "permitted the will of a thirteen-year-old boy."
22.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Ibn Abi al-Zinad se, apne walid se, Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz se bataya: ke unhone "terah saal ke ladke ki wasiyat ko jaayez qaraar diya."

22.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق ، قَالَ : " أَوْصَى غُلَامٌ مِنْ الْحَيِّ ابْنُ سَبْعِ سِنِينَ، فَقَالَ شُرَيْحٌ  :إِذَا أَصَابَ الْغُلَامُ فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ، جَازَتْ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : يُعْجِبُنِي، وَالْقُضَاةُ لَا يُجِيزُونَ
22.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zuhayr, from Abu Ishaq; with Abu Muhammad's approval: He said: "A boy from the tribe, seven years old, made a will, so Shurayh said: 'When the boy hits the mark in his will, it is valid.'" Abu Muhammad said: This pleases me, but the judges do not permit it.
22.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zuhayr se, Abu Ishaq se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Qabeele ke ek ladke ne, jo saat saal ka tha, wasiyat ki, to Shurayh ne kaha: 'Jab ladka apni wasiyat mein sahi nishaana lagaaye, to yeh jaayez hai.'" Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Yeh mujhe pasand hai, lekin qaazi ise jaayez nahi maante.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاق أَنَّهُ " شَهِدَ شُرَيْحًا أَجَازَ وَصِيَّةَ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ لِظِئْرِهِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْحِيرَةِ "، وَعَبَّاسٌ صَبِيٌّ
22.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Yunus, from Abu Ishaq: That he "witnessed Shurayh permitting the will of Abbas ibn Isma'il ibn Marthad for his wet-nurse, from the people of al-Hirah," and Abbas was a young boy.
22.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Yunus se bataya: Humein Abu Ishaq ne bataya: ke unhone "Shurayh ko Abbas ibn Isma'il ibn Marthad ki wasiyat jaayez qaraar dete dekha, unki doodh-maa ke liye, jo al-Hirah walon mein se thin," aur Abbas ek chhota bachcha the.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، أنبأنا يُونُسُ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاق ، قَالَ : قَالَ شُرَيْحٌ  :" إِذَا اتَّقَى الصَّبِيُّ الرَّكِيَّةَ، جَازَتْ وَصِيَّتُهُ "
22.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Yunus, from Abu Ishaq: He said: Shurayh said: "When the boy is aware [and cautious] of a well, his will is valid."
22.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Yunus se bataya: Humein Abu Ishaq ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Shurayh ne kaha: "Jab ladka kuen se hoshiyaar rehne laage, to uski wasiyat jaayez hoti hai."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  : " أَنَّ غُلَامًا مِنْهُمْ حِينَ ثُغِرَ يُقَالُ لَهُ مَرْثَدٌ :أَوْصَى لِظِئْرٍ لَهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْحِيرَةِ بِأَرْبَعِينَ دِرْهَمًا، فأجازه شريح ، وَقَالَ : مَنْ أَصَابَ الْحَقَّ، أَجَزْنَاهُ "
22.en: Narrated by Qabisah, from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq: That a boy among them, when his baby teeth had fallen out, called Marthad: "willed forty dirhams to a wet-nurse of his, from the people of al-Hirah," so Shurayh permitted it, and said: "Whoever hits the mark of what is right, we permit it."
22.hi: Qabisah ne Sufyan se, Abu Ishaq se bataya: ke unke mein se ek ladka, jise Marthad kaha jaata tha, jab uske doodh ke daant tootne lage, "usne apni doodh-maa ke liye chaalis dirham wasiyat kiye, jo al-Hirah walon mein se thin," to Shurayh ne isay jaayez qaraar diya, aur kaha: "Jo bhi sahi baat par pahunche, hum use jaayez maanenge."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى  : أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرِ بْنَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ  أَخْبَرَهُ : " أَنَّ غُلَامًا بِالْمَدِينَةِ حَضَرَهُ الْمَوْتُ وَوَرَثَتُهُ بِالشَّامِ ، وَأَنَّهُمْ ذَكَرُوا لِعُمَرَ أَنَّهُ يَمُوتُ، فَسَأَلُوهُ أَنْ يُوصِيَ، فَأَمَرَهُ عُمَرُ   أَنْ يُوصِيَ،فَأَوْصَى بِبِئْرٍ يُقَالُ لَهَا : بِئْرُ جُشَمَ، وَإِنَّ أَهْلَهَا بَاعُوهَا بِثَلَاثِينَ أَلْفًا، ذَكَرَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَنَّ الْغُلَامَ كَانَ ابْنَ عَشْرِ سِنِينَ، أَوْ ثِنْتَيْ عَشْرَةَ "
22.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Yahya: That Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm informed him: "That a young man in Madinah was dying, and his heirs were in Syria, and they mentioned to Umar that he was dying, so they asked him to make a will, so Umar commanded him to make a will, so he willed a well called Bi'r Jusham, and its owners sold it for thirty thousand," Abu Bakr mentioned that the young man was ten or twelve years old.
22.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Yahya se bataya: ke unhein Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm ne bataya: "ke Madinah mein ek jawaan aadmi marne wala tha, aur uske waaris Sham mein the, aur unhone Umar se zikr kiya ke woh marne wala hai, to unhone unse wasiyat karne ki darkhwaast ki, to Umar ne unhein wasiyat karne ka hukum diya, to unhone ek kuen ki wasiyat ki jise Bi'r Jusham kaha jaata tha, aur uske maalikon ne isay tees hazaar mein becha," Abu Bakr ne zikr kiya ke jawaan aadmi das ya baarah saal ka tha.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" يَجُوزُ وَصِيَّةُ الصَّبِيِّ في ماله في الثلث، فما دونه، وإنما يمنعه وليه ذلك في الصحة رهبة الفاقة عليه، فأما عند الموت، فليس له أن يمنعه "
22.en: Narrated by Yazid, from Hisham al-Dastawa'i, from Hammad, from Ibrahim: He said: "The will of a young boy regarding his own wealth is valid up to a third, or less than that, and his guardian only prevents that during his health out of fear of poverty for him, but at the time of death, his guardian has no right to prevent it."
22.hi: Yazid ne Hisham al-Dastawa'i se, Hammad se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Chhote ladke ki wasiyat apne maal mein tihai tak, ya isse kam, jaayez hai, aur uska sarparast usse sirf sehat ki haalat mein rokta hai gareebi ke khauf se, lekin maut ke waqt, uske sarparast ko usay rokne ka koi haq nahi."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ خالد الحذاء ، وَأَيُّوبَ ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ  : " أَنَّهُ أُتِيَ فِي جَارِيَةٍ أَوْصَتْ، فَجَعَلُوا يُصَغِّرُونَهَا، فَقَالَ :مَنْ أَصَابَ الْحَقَّ، أَجَزْنَاهُ "
22.en: Narrated by Qabisah, from Sufyan, from Khalid al-Hadhdha, and Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin, from Abdullah ibn Utbah: "That he was brought a case of a slave-girl who made a will, so they began belittling her [age], so he said: 'Whoever hits the mark of what is right, we permit it.'"
22.hi: Qabisah ne Sufyan se, Khalid al-Hadhdha aur Ayyub se, Ibn Sirin se, Abdullah ibn Utbah se bataya: "ke unke paas ek laundi ka maamla laaya gaya jisne wasiyat ki, to log uski [umar ki] chhoti hone ki baat karne lage, to unhone kaha: 'Jo bhi sahi baat par pahunche, hum use jaayez maanenge.'"

22.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ   : " أَنَّ سُلَيْمًا الْغَسَّانِيَّ مَاتَ وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَشْرٍ، أَوْ ثِنْتَيْ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً،فَأَوْصَى بِبِئْرٍ لَهُ قِيمَتُهَا ثَلاثُونَ أَلْفًا "، فَأَجَازَهَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ  ، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : النَّاسُ يَقُولُونَ : عَمْرُو بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ ابْنَيْهِ : عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، وَمُحَمَّدٍ  ابْنَيْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا   مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، غَيْرَ أَنَّ أَحَدَهُمَا قَالَ : ابْنُ ثَلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ، وَقَالَ الْآخَرُ : قَبْلَ أَنْ يَحْتَلِمَ.
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : عَنْ ابْنَيْهِ، يَعْنِي : ابْنَيْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ
22.en: Narrated by Qabisah, from Sufyan, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Abu Bakr; with Abu Muhammad's note: "That Sulaym al-Ghassani died at ten, or twelve years old, and he had willed a well of his worth thirty thousand," so Umar ibn al-Khattab permitted it. Abu Muhammad said: People say: Amr ibn Sulaym. [Narrated by Qabisah, from Sufyan, from his two sons: Abdullah, and Muhammad, sons of Abu Bakr, from their father, the like of it, except that one of them said: "thirteen years old," and the other said: "before puberty."] Abu Muhammad said: "from his two sons" means: the two sons of Abu Bakr.
22.hi: Qabisah ne Sufyan se, Yahya ibn Sa'id se, Abu Bakr se bataya: "ke Sulaym al-Ghassani das, ya baarah saal ki umar mein mar gaye, aur unhone apne ek kuen ki wasiyat ki thi jiski qeemat tees hazaar thi," to Umar ibn al-Khattab ne isay jaayez qaraar diya. Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Log kehte hain: Amr ibn Sulaym. [Isi jaisi riwayat Qabisah se, Sufyan se, unke do beton se: Abdullah, aur Muhammad, jo Abu Bakr ke bete hain, apne walid se bhi aayi hai, siwaay iske ke unmein se ek ne kaha: "terah saal ka," aur doosre ne kaha: "baalighi se pehle."] Abu Muhammad kehte hain: "unke do beton se" ka matlab hai: Abu Bakr ke do bete.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْأَعْلَى ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ :" وَصِيَّتُهُ لَيْسَتْ بِجَائِزَةٍ إِلَّا مَا لَيْسَ بِذِي بَالٍ، يَعْنِي : الْغُلَامَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَحْتَلِمَ "
22.en: Narrated by Nasr ibn Ali, from Abd al-A'la, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri: That he used to say: "His will is not valid except for something insignificant, meaning: a boy before puberty."
22.hi: Nasr ibn Ali ne Abd al-A'la se, Ma'mar se, al-Zuhri se bataya: ke woh kehte the: "Uski wasiyat jaayez nahi siwaay kisi mamooli cheez ke, yaani: baaligh hone se pehle ka ladka."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا هُشَيْمٌ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ  ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ  ، قَالَ :" لَا يَجُوزُ طَلَاقُ الْغُلَامِ وَلَا وَصِيَّتُهُ، وَلَا هِبَتُهُ، وَلَا صَدَقَتُهُ، وَلَا عَتَاقَتُهُ، حَتَّى يَحْتَلِمَ "
22.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Hushaym, from Yunus, from al-Hasan: He said: "The divorce of a young boy is not valid, nor his will, nor his gift, nor his charity, nor his manumission, until he reaches puberty."
22.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Hushaym se, Yunus se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Chhote ladke ki talaq jaayez nahi, na uski wasiyat, na uska tohfa, na uska sadqa, na uska ghulaam azaad karna, jab tak woh baaligh na ho jaaye."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ  ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ :" لَا يَجُوزُ طَلَاقُ الصَّبِيِّ، وَلَا عِتْقُهُ، وَلَا وَصِيَّتُهُ، وَلَا شِرَاؤُهُ، وَلَا بَيْعُهُ، وَلَا شَيْءٌ "
22.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from Hajjaj, from Ata, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "The divorce of a young boy is not valid, nor his manumission, nor his will, nor his purchase, nor his sale, nor anything."
22.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah ne Hafs ibn Ghiyath se, Hajjaj se, Ata se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Chhote ladke ki talaq jaayez nahi, na uska ghulaam azaad karna, na uski wasiyat, na uski khareed, na uski bikri, na kuch aur."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِمْيَرِيِّ ، قَالَ :" لَا يَجُوزُ طَلَاقٌ، وَلَا وَصِيَّةٌ، إِلَّا فِي عَقْلٍ، إِلَّا النَّشْوَانَ، يَعْنِي : السَّكْرَانَ، فَإِنَّهُ يَجُوزُ طَلَاقُهُ، وَيُضْرَبُ ظَهْرُهُ "
22.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid, from Hammam, from Qatadah, from Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Himyari: He said: "Divorce and will are not valid except with sound mind, except the intoxicated, meaning: the drunk, for his divorce is valid, and his back is flogged."
22.hi: Abu al-Walid ne Hammam se, Qatadah se, Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Himyari se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Talaq aur wasiyat jaayez nahi siwaay hosh mein hote hue, siwaay nashe wale ke, yaani: sharaabi, kyunki uski talaq jaayez hai, aur uski peeth par kode maare jaate hain."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي إِسْحَاق ، قَالَ : " سَأَلْتُ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، وَمُعَاوِيَةَ بْنَ قُرَّةَ  عَنْ رَجُلٍ قَالَ فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ : " كُلُّ لِي حُرٌّ، وَلَهُ مَمْلُوكٌ آبِقٌ، فَقَالَا :هُوَ حُرٌّ "، قَالَ الْحَسَنُ ، وَإِيَاسٌ ، وَبَكْرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  : ليس بحر
22.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid ibn Abdullah, from Yahya ibn Abi Ishaq; with al-Hasan's differing view: He said: I asked al-Qasim ibn Abd al-Rahman, and Mu'awiyah ibn Qurrah about a man who says in his will: "Everything of mine is free," and he has a runaway slave, so they both said: "He is free." Al-Hasan, and Iyas, and Bakr ibn Abdullah said: He is not free.
22.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid ibn Abdullah se, Yahya ibn Abi Ishaq se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Qasim ibn Abd al-Rahman, aur Mu'awiyah ibn Qurrah se ek aadmi ke baare mein poocha jo apni wasiyat mein kahe: "Mera sab kuch aazad hai," aur uska ek bhaaga hua ghulam bhi ho, to dono ne kaha: "Woh aazad hai." Al-Hasan, aur Iyas, aur Bakr ibn Abdullah ne kaha: Woh aazad nahi.

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ الْعُمَرِيُّ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  : " أَنَّ عُمَرَ  أَوْصَى إِلَى حَفْصَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ "
22.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Maslamah, from Abdullah al-Umari, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: "That Umar appointed Hafsah, Mother of the Believers, as executor."
22.hi: Abdullah ibn Maslamah ne Abdullah al-Umari se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: "ke Umar ne Hafsah, Ummul-Mumineen, ko wasi banaaya."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   : " أَنَّ صَفِيَّةَأَوْصَتْ لِنَسِيبٍ لَهَا يَهُودِيٍّ "
22.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from Layth, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: "That Safiyyah willed for a Jewish relative of hers."
22.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se, Layth se, Nafi' se, Ibn Umar se bataya: "ke Safiyyah ne apne ek Yahoodi rishtedaar ke liye wasiyat ki."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق ، قَالَ : " أَوْصَى غُلَامٌ مِنَ الْحَيِّ، يُقَالُ لَهُ : عَبَّاسُ بْنُ مَرْثَدٍ ابْنُ سَبْعِ سِنِينَ لِظِئْرٍ لَهُ يَهُودِيَّةٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْحِيرَةِ بِأَرْبَعِينَ دِرْهَمًا، فَقَالَ شُرَيْحٌ  :إِذَا أَصَابَ الْغُلَامُ فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ، جَازَتْ وَإِنَّمَا أَوْصَى لِذِي حَقٍّ "، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : أَنَا أَقُولُ بِهِ
22.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zuhayr, from Abu Ishaq; with Abu Muhammad's agreement: He said: "A boy from the tribe, called Abbas ibn Marthad, seven years old, willed forty dirhams to a Jewish wet-nurse of his, from the people of al-Hirah, so Shurayh said: 'When the boy hits the mark in his will, it is valid, and he only willed to someone deserving of it.'" Abu Muhammad said: I hold this view.
22.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zuhayr se, Abu Ishaq se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Qabeele ke ek ladke ne, jise Abbas ibn Marthad kaha jaata tha, jo saat saal ka tha, apni Yahoodi doodh-maa ke liye chaalis dirham wasiyat kiye, jo al-Hirah walon mein se thin, to Shurayh ne kaha: 'Jab ladka apni wasiyat mein sahi nishaana lagaaye, to yeh jaayez hai, aur usne sirf haqdaar shakhs ke liye wasiyat ki hai.'" Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Main isi ka qaail hoon.

22.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ : " أَنَّ الزُّبَيْرَ جَعَلَ دُورَهُ صَدَقَةً عَلَى بَنِيهِ، لَا تُبَاعُ وَلَا تُوَرَّثُ، وَأَنَّ لِلْمَرْدُودَةِ مِنْ بَنَاتِهِ أَنْ تَسْكُنَ غَيْرَ مُضِرَّةٍ وَلَا مُضَارٍّ بِهَا، فَإِنْ هِيَ اسْتَغْنَتْ بِزَوْجٍ، فَلَا حَقَّ لَهَا "
22.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Usamah, from Hisham, from his father: "That al-Zubayr made his houses a charity for his sons, not to be sold nor inherited, and that whichever of his daughters was divorced could reside there without causing harm and without harm being caused to her, but if she became independent through a husband, she had no right to it."
22.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Usamah se, Hisham se, apne walid se bataya: "ke al-Zubayr ne apne ghar apne beton ke liye sadqa (waqf) bana diye, na bikenge na virasat mein aayenge, aur ke unki jo beti talaq-yaafta ho woh usmein bina nuqsaan pahunchaaye aur bina nuqsaan uthaaye reh sakti hai, lekin agar woh kisi shohar se aazad (behtar) ho jaaye, to uska usmein koi haq nahi."

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، أنبأنا الْوَلِيدُ ، عَنْ حَفْصٍ ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ  : " فِي الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي لِلرَّجُلِ بِدَنَانِيرَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، فَيَمُوتُ الْمُوصَى لَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ بِهَا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، قَالَ :هِيَ إِلَى أَوْلِيَاءِ الْمُتَوَفَّى الْمُوصِي، يُنْفِذُونَهَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ "
22.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from al-Walid, from Hafs, from Makhul: Concerning a man who wills dinars to another man for the path of Allah, but the one bequeathed to dies before taking it out from his family: he said: "It goes to the guardians of the deceased who made the will, they carry it out in the path of Allah."
22.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne al-Walid se, Hafs se, Makhul se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo doosre aadmi ke liye Allah ki raah mein dinar wasiyat kare, lekin jise wasiyat mili ho woh apne gharwalon se isay nikaalne se pehle mar jaaye: unhone kaha: "Yeh wasiyat karne wale murda ke sarparaston ko jaayega, woh isay Allah ki raah mein amal mein laayenge."

22.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ   : " فِي الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي لِلرَّجُلِ بِالْوَصِيَّةِ، فَيَمُوتُ الْمُوصَى لَهُ قَبْلَ الْمُوصِي، قَالَ :هِيَ جَائِزَةٌ لِوَرَثَةِ الْمُوصَى لَهُ.
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق السَّبِيعِيِّ  ، قَالَ : حُدِّثْتُ  أَنَّ عَلِيًّا   كَانَ يُجِيزُهَا مِثْلَ قَوْلِ الْحَسَنِ
22.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Ash'ath, from al-Hasan; with a note from Abu Ishaq al-Sabi'i: Concerning a man who wills a bequest to another man, but the one bequeathed to dies before the one making the will, he said: "It is valid for the heirs of the one bequeathed to." [Muhammad ibn Uyaynah narrated: from Ali ibn Mushir, from Ash'ath, from Abu Ishaq al-Sabi'i: he said: I was told that Ali used to permit it, like al-Hasan's saying.]
22.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali ibn Mushir se, Ash'ath se, al-Hasan se bataya: us aadmi ke baare mein jo doosre aadmi ke liye wasiyat kare, lekin jise wasiyat mili ho woh wasiyat karne wale se pehle mar jaaye, unhone kaha: "Yeh wasiyat paane wale ke waarison ke liye jaayez hai." [Isi jaisi riwayat Muhammad ibn Uyaynah se, Ali ibn Mushir se, Ash'ath se, Abu Ishaq al-Sabi'i se bhi aayi hai: unhone kaha, Mujhe bataya gaya ke Ali (Alayhis Salam) ise jaayez qaraar dete the, al-Hasan ki baat jaisi hi.]

22.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ هُوَ ابْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ مُوسَى هُوَ ابْنُ عُقْبَةَ  ،  عَنْ نَافِعٍ  : " أَنَّ رَجُلًا جَاءَ إِلَى ابْنِ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ : إِنَّ رَجُلًا أَوْصَى إِلَيَّ وَجَعَلَ نَاقَةً فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، وَلَيْسَ هَذَا زَمَانًا يُخْرَجُ إِلَى الْغَزْوِ، فَأَحْمِلُ عَلَيْهَا فِي الْحَجِّ؟ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ   :الْحَجُّ وَالْعُمْرَةُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ "
22.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Musa ibn Uqbah, from Nafi': "That a man came to Ibn Umar, and said: 'A man appointed me as executor, and set aside a she-camel for the path of Allah, but this is not a time when [military] expeditions go out, shall I use it to carry people for Hajj?' So Ibn Umar said: 'Hajj and Umrah are [both] in the path of Allah.'"
22.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, Musa ibn Uqbah se, Nafi' se bataya: "ke ek aadmi Ibn Umar ke paas aaya, aur kaha: 'Ek aadmi ne mujhe wasi banaaya, aur Allah ki raah mein ek oontni rakhi, lekin abhi jang ke liye lashkar nahi nikalte, kya main isay Hajj mein log le jaane ke liye istemaal karun?' To Ibn Umar ne kaha: 'Hajj aur Umrah [dono] Allah ki raah mein hain.'"

22.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ  ، عَنْ وَاقِدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ  : " أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَوْصَى بِمَالِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، فَسَأَلَ الْوَصِيُّ عَنْ ذَلِكَ عُمَرَ  ، فَقَالَ :أَعْطِهِ عُمَّالَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ : وَمَنْ عُمَّالُ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ : حَاجُّ بَيْتِ اللَّهِ "
22.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Musa ibn Ubaydah, from Waqid ibn Muhammad ibn Zayd ibn Abdullah ibn Umar: "That a man willed his wealth for the path of Allah, so the executor asked Umar about that, so he said: 'Give it to the workers of Allah.' He asked: 'And who are the workers of Allah?' He said: 'The pilgrims of the House of Allah.'"
22.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Musa ibn Ubaydah se, Waqid ibn Muhammad ibn Zayd ibn Abdullah ibn Umar se bataya: "ke ek aadmi ne apna maal Allah ki raah mein wasiyat kiya, to wasi ne iske baare mein Umar se poocha, to unhone kaha: 'Ise Allah ke amilo (kaam karne walon) ko do.' Usne poocha: 'Aur Allah ke amil kaun hain?' Unhone kaha: 'Baitullah ke Hajj karne wale.'"

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ  ، عَنْ قَابُوسَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ الَّذِي لَيْسَ فِي جَوْفِهِ مِنْ الْقُرْآنِ شَيْءٌ كَالْبَيْتِ الْخَرِبِ "
23.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Zurarah, from Jarir, from Qabus, from his father, from Ibn Abbas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed the man who has nothing of the Qur'an in his heart is like a ruined house."
23.hi: Amr ibn Zurarah ne Jarir se, Qabus se, apne walid se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Woh aadmi jiske seene mein Quran mein se kuch bhi na ho, woh khandhar ghar ki tarah hai."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ خَالِدِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مسْلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سِنَانٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ  ،  عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ مَأْدُبَةُ اللَّهِ، فَخُذُوا مِنْهُ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ، فَإِنِّي لَا أَعْلَمُ شَيْئًا أَصْفَرَ مِنْ خَيْرٍ، مِنْ بَيْتٍ لَيْسَ فِيهِ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ شَيْءٌ، وَإِنَّ الْقَلْبَ الَّذِي لَيْسَ فِيهِ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ شَيْءٌ، خَرِبٌ كَخَرَابِ الْبَيْتِ الَّذِي لَا سَاكِنَ لَهُ "
23.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Khalid ibn Hazim, from Muhammad ibn Maslamah, from Abu Sinan, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Abdullah: He said: "This Qur'an is Allah's banquet, so take from it whatever you can, for I know of nothing more devoid of good than a house in which there is nothing of the Book of Allah, and indeed the heart in which there is nothing of the Book of Allah is ruined, like the ruin of a house that has no dweller."
23.hi: Abdullah ibn Khalid ibn Hazim ne Muhammad ibn Maslamah se, Abu Sinan se, Abu Ishaq se, Abu al-Ahwas se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Yeh Quran Allah ki dawat hai, so isse jo tum ho sake le lo, kyunki main bhalaai se zyada khaali kisi cheez ko nahi jaanta jitna woh ghar jismein Allah ki Kitaab mein se kuch na ho, aur woh dil jismein Allah ki Kitaab mein se kuch na ho, woh viraan hai jaise us ghar ki tabaahi jiska koi rehne wala na ho."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ قَبِيصَةُ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" تَعَلَّمُوا هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ، فَإِنَّكُمْ تُؤْجَرُونَ بِتِلَاوَتِهِ بِكُلِّ حَرْفٍ عَشْرَ حَسَنَاتٍ، أَمَا إِنِّي لَا أَقُولُ بِ ( الم )، وَلَكِنْ بِأَلِفٍ، وَلَامٍ، وَمِيمٍ، بِكُلِّ حَرْفٍ عَشْرُ حَسَنَاتٍ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu Amir Qabisah, from Sufyan, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Abdullah: He said: "Learn this Qur'an, for you are rewarded for reciting it with ten good deeds for every letter, listen, I do not say: 'Alif Lam Meem' is [one letter], but rather Alif, and Lam, and Meem, for every letter is ten good deeds."
23.hi: Abu Amir Qabisah ne Sufyan se, Ata ibn al-Sa'ib se, Abu al-Ahwas se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Yeh Quran seekho, kyunki tumhein iski tilaawat par har harf ke badle das naikiyon ka ajr milta hai, sun lo, main yeh nahi kehta ke 'Alif Laam Meem' [ek harf hai], balke Alif, aur Laam, aur Meem, [har alag harf hai], har harf par das naikiyaan hain."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرْبُ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي حَفْصُ بْنُ عِنَانٍ الْحَنَفِيُّ  : أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ   كَانَ يَقُولُ :" إِنَّ الْبَيْتَ لَيَتَّسِعُ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ وَتَحْضُرُهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَتَهْجُرُهُ الشَّيَاطِينُ، وَيَكْثُرُ خَيْرُهُ أَنْ يُقْرَأَ فِيهِ الْقُرْآنُ، وَإِنَّ الْبَيْتَ لَيَضِيقُ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ وَتَهْجُرُهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ، وَتَحْضُرُهُ الشَّيَاطِينُ، وَيَقِلُّ خَيْرُهُ، أَنْ لَا يُقْرَأَ فِيهِ الْقُرْآنُ "
23.en: Narrated by Mu'adh ibn Hani', from Harb ibn Shaddad, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Hafs ibn Inan al-Hanafi: That Abu Hurairah used to say: "Indeed the house becomes spacious for its people, and the angels visit it, and the devils avoid it, and its good increases, when the Qur'an is recited in it, and indeed the house becomes narrow for its people, and the angels avoid it, and the devils visit it, and its good decreases, when the Qur'an is not recited in it."
23.hi: Mu'adh ibn Hani' ne Harb ibn Shaddad se, Yahya ibn Abi Kathir se, Hafs ibn Inan al-Hanafi se bataya: ke Abu Hurairah kehte the: "Ghar apne rehne walon ke liye khula ho jaata hai aur farishtay usmein aate hain aur shaytan usse door rehte hain aur uski bhalaai badh jaati hai, jab usmein Quran padha jaaye, aur ghar apne rehne walon ke liye tang ho jaata hai aur farishtay usse door rehte hain aur shaytan usmein aate hain aur uski bhalaai kam ho jaati hai, jab usmein Quran na padha jaaye."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ  ، عَنْ مِشْرَحِ بْنِ هَاعَانَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ  ، يَقُولُ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" لَوْ جُعِلَ الْقُرْآنُ فِي إِهَابٍ، ثُمَّ أُلْقِيَ فِي النَّارِ، مَا احْتَرَقَ "
23.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Ibn Lahi'ah, from Mishrah ibn Ha'an: He said: I heard Uqbah ibn Amir say: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "If the Qur'an were placed in a hide, then thrown into the fire, it would not burn."
23.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid ne Ibn Lahi'ah se, Mishrah ibn Ha'an se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Uqbah ibn Amir ko kehte suna: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, "Agar Quran ko kisi khaal mein rakh diya jaaye, fir usay aag mein daala jaaye, to woh nahi jalega."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الرَّقِّيُّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، يَقُولُ :" اقْرَءُوا الْقُرْآنَ، فَإِنَّهُ نِعْمَ الشَّفِيعُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ "، إِنَّهُ يَقُولُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ : يَا رَبِّ، حَلِّهِ حِلْيَةَ الْكَرَامَةِ، فَيُحَلَّى حِلْيَةَ الْكَرَامَةِ، يَا رَبِّ، اكْسُهُ كِسْوَةَ الْكَرَامَةِ، فَيُكْسَى كِسْوَةَ الْكَرَامَةِ، يَا رَبِّ، أَلْبِسْهُ تَاجَ الْكَرَامَةِ، يَا رَبِّ، ارْضَ عَنْهُ، فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَ رِضَاكَ شَيْءٌ "
23.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Raqqi, from Ubaydullah ibn Amr, from Zayd ibn Abi Unaysah, from Asim, from Abu Salih: He said: I heard Abu Hurairah say: "Recite the Qur'an, for it is a fine intercessor on the Day of Resurrection," it says on the Day of Resurrection: 'O Lord, adorn him with the adornment of honor,' so he is adorned with the adornment of honor, 'O Lord, clothe him with the garment of honor,' so he is clothed with the garment of honor, 'O Lord, crown him with the crown of honor,' 'O Lord, be pleased with him, for there is nothing beyond Your pleasure.'
23.hi: Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Raqqi ne Ubaydullah ibn Amr se, Zayd ibn Abi Unaysah se, Asim se, Abu Salih se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Hurairah ko kehte suna: "Quran padho, kyunki yeh Qayamat ke din behtareen sifarishi hai," yeh Qayamat ke din kehta hai: 'Ae Rab, isay izzat ke zewar se sajaa de,' to usay izzat ke zewar se sajaaya jaata hai, 'Ae Rab, isay izzat ka libaas pehnaa de,' to usay izzat ka libaas pehnaaya jaata hai, 'Ae Rab, isay izzat ka taaj pehnaa de,' 'Ae Rab, isse razi ho ja, kyunki teri raza ke baad kuch nahi.'

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْفَزَارِيُّ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" يَجِيءُ الْقُرْآنُ يَشْفَعُ لِصَاحِبِهِ، يَقُولُ : يَا رَبِّ لِكُلِّ عَامِلٍ عُمَالَةٌ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ، وَإِنِّي كُنْتُ أَمْنَعُهُ اللَّذَّةَ وَالنَّوْمَ، فَأَكْرِمْهُ، فَيُقَالُ : ابْسُطْ يَمِينَكَ، فَتُمْلَأُ مِنْ رِضْوَانِ اللَّهِ، ثُمَّ يُقَالُ : ابْسُطْ شِمَالَكَ، فَتُمْلَأُ مِنْ رِضْوَانِ اللَّهِ، وَيُكْسَى كِسْوَةَ الْكَرَامَةِ، وَيُحَلَّى بِحِلْيَةِ الْكَرَامَةِ، وَيُلْبَسُ تَاجَ الْكَرَامَةِ "
23.en: Narrated by Musa ibn Khalid, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Fazari, from Sufyan, from Asim, from Mujahid, from Ibn Umar: He said: "The Qur'an comes intercedes for its companion, saying: 'O Lord, every worker gets a wage for his work, and I used to deprive him of pleasure and sleep, so honor him,' so it is said: 'Extend your right hand,' so it is filled from the pleasure of Allah, then it is said: 'Extend your left,' so it is filled from the pleasure of Allah, and he is clothed with the garment of honor, and adorned with the adornment of honor, and crowned with the crown of honor."
23.hi: Musa ibn Khalid ne Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Fazari se, Sufyan se, Asim se, Mujahid se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Quran apne saathi ke liye sifarish karne aayega, kahega: 'Ae Rab, har kaam karne wale ko uske kaam ki mazdoori milti hai, aur main usay lutf aur neend se rokta tha, so isay izzat de,' to kaha jaayega: 'Apna daaya haath phailaao,' to woh Allah ki khushnoodi se bhar diya jaayega, fir kaha jaayega: 'Apna baaya phailaao,' to woh Allah ki khushnoodi se bhar diya jaayega, aur usay izzat ka libaas pehnaaya jaayega, aur izzat ke zewar se sajaaya jaayega, aur izzat ka taaj pehnaaya jaayega."

23.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْفَزَارِيُّ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ الْمُسَيَّبِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، قَالَ :" الْقُرْآنُ يَشْفَعُ لِصَاحِبِهِ، فَيُكْسَى حُلَّةَ الْكَرَامَةِ، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ : رَبِّ زِدْهُ، فَيُكْسَى تَاجَ الْكَرَامَةِ، قَالَ : فَيَقُولُ : رَبِّ زِدْهُ، فَآتِهِ، وَآتِهِ.
..
قَالَ : يَقُولُ : رِضَائِي ".
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : قَالَ وُهَيْبُ بْنُ الْوَرْدِ : اجْعَلْ قِرَاءَتَكَ الْقُرْآنَ عِلْمًا، وَلَا تَجْعَلْهُ عَمَلًا
23.en: Narrated by Musa ibn Khalid, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Fazari, from al-Hasan ibn Ubaydullah, from al-Musayyab ibn Rafi', from Abu Salih; with Abu Muhammad's added note: He said: "The Qur'an intercedes for its companion, so he is clothed with the garment of honor, then it says: 'My Lord, increase him,' so he is clothed with the crown of honor," he said: "then it says: 'My Lord, increase him,' so give him, and give him... it says: 'My pleasure.'" Abu Muhammad said: Wuhayb ibn al-Ward said: Make your recitation of the Qur'an knowledge, and do not make it [merely] an action.
23.hi: Musa ibn Khalid ne Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Fazari se, al-Hasan ibn Ubaydullah se, al-Musayyab ibn Rafi' se, Abu Salih se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Quran apne saathi ke liye sifarish karta hai, to usay izzat ka libaas pehnaaya jaata hai, fir woh kehta hai: 'Mere Rab, isay aur badha,' to usay izzat ka taaj pehnaaya jaata hai," unhone kaha: "fir woh kehta hai: 'Mere Rab, isay aur badha,' to usay de, aur de... yeh kehta hai: 'Meri raza.'" Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Wuhayb ibn al-Ward ne kaha: Apni Quran ki tilaawat ko ilm banaao, isse [sirf] amal mat banaao.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ الْفَزَارِيُّ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ إِذَا أَتَى أَهْلَهُ أَنْ يَجِدَ ثَلَاثَ خَلِفَاتٍ سِمَانٍ، قَالُوا : نَعَمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ : " فَثَلَاثُ آيَاتٍ يَقْرَؤُهُنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ، خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْهُنَّ "
23.en: Narrated by Musa ibn Khalid, from Ibrahim al-Fazari, from al-A'mash, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Would any of you love, when he comes to his family, to find three fat pregnant she-camels?" They said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." He said: "Then three verses which one of you recites are better for him than them."
23.hi: Musa ibn Khalid ne Ibrahim al-Fazari se, al-A'mash se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Kya tum mein se koi pasand karega ke jab woh apne gharwalon ke paas jaaye, to teen mote-taaze haamila oontniyaan paaye?" Unhone kaha, "Haan, Ya Rasulullah." Aapne farmaya: "To teen aayaten jo tum mein se koi padhe, unse behtar hain."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ هُوَ الْهَجَرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ مَأْدُبَةُ اللَّهِ، فَتَعَلَّمُوا مِنْ مَأْدُبَتِهِ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ، إِنَّ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ حَبْلُ اللَّهِ، وَالنُّورُ الْمُبِينُ، وَالشِّفَاءُ النَّافِعُ، عِصْمَةٌ لِمَنْ تَمَسَّكَ بِهِ، وَنَجَاةٌ لِمَنْ اتَّبَعَهُ، لَا يَزِيغُ فَيَسْتَعْتِبُ، وَلَا يَعْوَجُّ فَيُقَوَّمُ، وَلَا تَنْقَضِي عَجَائِبُهُ، وَلَا يَخْلَقُ عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الرَّدِّ، فَاتْلُوهُ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْجُرُكُمْ عَلَى تِلَاوَتِهِ بِكُلِّ حَرْفٍ عَشْرَ حَسَنَاتٍ، أَمَا إِنِّي لَا أَقُولُ ( الم ) وَلَكِنْ بِأَلِفٍ، وَلَامٍ، وَمِيمٍ "
23.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Ibrahim al-Hajari, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Abdullah: He said: "This Qur'an is Allah's banquet, so learn from His banquet whatever you can, this Qur'an is the rope of Allah, and the clear light, and the beneficial cure, protection for whoever holds fast to it, and salvation for whoever follows it, it does not deviate needing correction, nor does it bend needing straightening, its wonders never cease, and it does not wear out with much repetition, so recite it, for Allah rewards you for its recitation with ten good deeds for every letter, listen, I do not say: 'Alif Lam Meem' [is one letter], but rather Alif, and Lam, and Meem."
23.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Ibrahim al-Hajari se, Abu al-Ahwas se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Yeh Quran Allah ki dawat hai, so uski dawat se jo tum ho sake seekho, yeh Quran Allah ki rassi hai, aur roshan noor hai, aur faayde-mand shifa hai, jo isay pakde uske liye hifaazat, aur jo isse pairwi kare uske liye nijaat, yeh na bhatakta hai ke islaah ki zaroorat pade, aur na tedha hota hai ke seedha kiya jaaye, iske ajaaib kabhi khatam nahi hote, aur yeh baar-baar dohraane se purana nahi padta, so isay padho, kyunki Allah tumhein iski tilaawat par har harf ke badle das naikiyaan deta hai, sun lo, main yeh nahi kehta ke 'Alif Laam Meem' [ek harf hai], balke Alif, aur Laam, aur Meem."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَيَّانَ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ حَيَّانَ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ  ، قَالَ : قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمًا خَطِيبًا فَحَمِدَ، اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ،إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ يُوشِكُ أَنْ يَأْتِيَنِي رَسُولُ رَبِّي، فَأُجِيبَهُ، وَإِنِّي تَارِكٌ فِيكُمْ الثَّقَلَيْنِ : أَوَّلُهُمَا كِتَابُ اللَّهِ فِيهِ الْهُدَى وَالنُّورُ، فَتَمَسَّكُوا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ، وَخُذُوا بِهِ " فَحَثَّ عَلَيْهِ وَرَغَّبَ فِيهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " وَأَهْلَ بَيْتِي، أُذَكِّرُكُمْ اللَّهَ فِي أَهْلِ بَيْتِي، ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ "
23.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Abu Hayyan, from Yazid ibn Hayyan, from Zayd ibn Arqam: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood one day delivering a sermon, and praised Allah and lauded Him, then said: "O people, I am only a human being, it is about time that a messenger from my Lord will come to me, and I will answer him, and I am leaving among you two weighty things: the first of them is the Book of Allah, in which is guidance and light, so hold fast to the Book of Allah, and take it," so he urged and encouraged it, then said: "And my family [Ahl al-Bayt], I remind you of Allah regarding my family," three times.
23.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Abu Hayyan se, Yazid ibn Hayyan se, Zayd ibn Arqam se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ek din khutba dete hue khade hue, aur Allah ki hamd ki aur uski tareef ki, fir farmaya: "Ae logo, main to sirf ek insaan hoon, jald hi mere Rab ka qaasid mere paas aayega, aur main usay jawaab dunga, aur main tum mein do bhaari cheezein chhod raha hoon: unmein se pehli Allah ki Kitaab hai, jismein hidayat aur noor hai, so Allah ki Kitaab ko mazbooti se pakdo, aur usay le lo," to aapne isper ubhaara aur ragheb dilaayi, fir farmaya: "Aur mera Ahl-e-Bayt [gharwale], main tumhein Allah ki yaad dilaata hoon mere Ahl-e-Bayt ke baare mein," teen martaba.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   :" إِنَّ هَذَا الصِّرَاطَ مُحْتَضَرٌ، تَحْضُرُهُ الشَّيَاطِينُ يُنَادُونَ : يَا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ، هَذَا الطَّرِيقُ، فَاعْتَصِمُوا بِحَبْلِ اللَّهِ، فَإِنَّ حَبْلَ اللَّهِ الْقُرْآنُ "
23.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from al-A'mash, from Abu Wa'il: He said: Abdullah said: "This path is inhabited, the devils inhabit it, calling out: 'O servants of Allah, this is the way,' so hold fast to the rope of Allah, for indeed the rope of Allah is the Qur'an."
23.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne al-A'mash se, Abu Wa'il se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ne kaha: "Yeh raasta aabaad hai, shaytan isme rehte hain, pukaarte hue: 'Ae Allah ke bando, yehi raasta hai,' so Allah ki rassi ko mazbooti se pakdo, kyunki Allah ki rassi Quran hai."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَتْنَا عَبْدَةُ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ  ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ قَارِئَ الْقُرْآنِ وَالْمُتَعَلِّمَ تُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِمْ الْمَلَائِكَةُ حَتَّى يَخْتِمُوا السُّورَةَ، فَإِذَا أَقْرَأَ أَحَدُكُمْ السُّورَةَ، فَلْيُؤَخِّرْ مِنْهَا آيَتَيْنِ حَتَّى يَخْتِمَهَا مِنْ آخِرِ النَّهَارِ كَيْ مَا تُصَلِّي الْمَلَائِكَةُ عَلَى الْقَارِئِ وَالْمُقْرِئِ مِنْ أَوَّلِ النَّهَارِ إِلَى آخِرِهِ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from Abdah, from Khalid ibn Ma'dan: He said: "The angels send blessings upon the reciter and the learner of the Qur'an until they finish the surah, so when one of you recites a surah, let him leave two verses of it until he finishes it at the end of the day, so that the angels may send blessings upon the reciter and the teacher from the beginning of the day to its end."
23.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne Abdah se, Khalid ibn Ma'dan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Farishtay Quran padhne wale aur seekhne wale par dua bhejte hain jab tak woh surah khatam na karein, so jab tum mein se koi surah padhe, to usme se do aayaten baaqi chhod de yahan tak ke woh unhein din ke aakhir mein khatam kare, taake farishtay padhne wale aur padhaane wale par din ki shuru se aakhir tak dua bhejte rahein."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا حَرِيزٌ  ، عَنْ شُرَحْبِيلَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ الْخَوْلَانِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ   : أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ :" اقْرَءُوا الْقُرْآنَ، وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُمْ هَذِهِ الْمَصَاحِفُ الْمُعَلَّقَةُ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَنْ يُعَذِّبَ قَلْبًا وَعَى الْقُرْآنَ "
23.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Hariz, from Shurahbil ibn Muslim al-Khawlani, from Abu Umamah: That he used to say: "Recite the Qur'an, and do not be deceived by these hung-up copies of the Qur'an [unread on the wall], for Allah will never punish a heart that has memorized/comprehended the Qur'an."
23.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Hariz se, Shurahbil ibn Muslim al-Khawlani se, Abu Umamah se bataya: ke woh kehte the: "Quran padho, aur in latki hui Mus'haf [na-padhi hui] kitabon se dhoka mat khaao, kyunki Allah kabhi us dil ko azaab nahi dega jisne Quran ko samajh liya ho."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ الْبَاهِلِيِّ  ، قَالَ :" : اقْرَءُوا الْقُرْآنَ، وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُمْ هَذِهِ الْمَصَاحِفُ الْمُعَلَّقَةُ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُعَذِّبُ قَلْبًا وَعَى الْقُرْآنَ "
23.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from Mu'awiyah ibn Salih, from Sulaym ibn Amir, from Abu Umamah al-Bahili: He said: "Recite the Qur'an, and do not be deceived by these hung-up copies of the Qur'an, for Allah does not punish a heart that has memorized/comprehended the Qur'an."
23.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne Mu'awiyah ibn Salih se bataya: Mujhse Sulaym ibn Amir ne bataya, Abu Umamah al-Bahili se: Unhone kaha, "Quran padho, aur in latki hui Mus'haf kitaabon se dhoka mat khaao, kyunki Allah us dil ko azaab nahi deta jisne Quran ko samajh liya ho."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ  ، عَنْ مَعْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ  ، قَالَ :" لَيْسَ مِنْ مُؤَدِّبٍ إِلَّا وَهُوَ يُحِبُّ أَنْ يُؤْتَى أَدَبُهُ، وَإِنَّ أَدَبَ اللَّهِ الْقُرْآنُ "
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Mis'ar, from Ma'n ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Ibn Mas'ud: He said: "There is no teacher of manners except that he loves his teaching to be followed, and indeed Allah's teaching is the Qur'an."
23.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Mis'ar se, Ma'n ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Ibn Mas'ud se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Koi bhi adab sikhaane wala aisa nahi jo yeh na chahe ke uske adab ki pairwi ki jaaye, aur Allah ka adab Quran hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ  ، يَقُولُ :" إِنَّ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ مَأْدُبَةُ اللَّهِ، فَمَنْ دَخَلَ فِيهِ، فَهُوَ آمِنٌ "
23.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from Abd al-Malik ibn Maysarah, from Abu al-Ahwas: He said: Abdullah used to say: "This Qur'an is Allah's banquet, so whoever enters into it, is secure."
23.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se, Abd al-Malik ibn Maysarah se, Abu al-Ahwas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah kehte the: "Yeh Quran Allah ki dawat hai, so jo isme dakhil ho, woh mehfooz hai."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  ،  عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ أَحَبَّ الْقُرْآنَ، فَلْيُبْشِرْ "
23.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hammad, from Abu Awanah, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid, from Abdullah: He said: "Whoever loves the Qur'an, let him rejoice."
23.hi: Yahya ibn Hammad ne Abu Awanah se, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo Quran se mohabbat kare, use khush ho jaana chaahiye."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ أَحَبَّ الْقُرْآنَ، فَلْيُبْشِرْ "
23.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid, from Abdullah: He said: "Whoever loves the Qur'an, let him rejoice."
23.hi: Ya'la ne al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo Quran se mohabbat kare, use khush ho jaana chaahiye."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ أَبِي النُّجُودِ  ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ  : أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ   كَانَ يَقُولُ :" يَجِيءُ الْقُرْآنُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيَشْفَعُ لِصَاحِبِهِ، فَيَكُونُ لَهُ قَائِدًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ، وَيَشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِ، وَيَكُونُ لَهُ سَائِقًا إِلَى النَّارِ "
23.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hammam, from Asim ibn Abi al-Nujud, from al-Sha'bi: That Ibn Mas'ud used to say: "The Qur'an comes on the Day of Resurrection and intercedes for its companion, and becomes a guide for him to Paradise, and testifies against him, and becomes a driver for him to the Fire."
23.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hammam se, Asim ibn Abi al-Nujud se, al-Sha'bi se bataya: ke Ibn Mas'ud kehte the: "Quran Qayamat ke din aata hai aur apne saathi ke liye sifarish karta hai, aur uske liye Jannat ki taraf rahnuma banta hai, aur uske khilaaf gawahi bhi deta hai, aur uske liye Jahannam ki taraf hankne wala banta hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا بُدَيْلٌ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ لِلَّهِ أَهْلِينَ مِنَ النَّاسِ، قِيلَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَنْ هُمْ؟ قَالَ : أَهْلُ الْقُرْآنِ "
23.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from al-Hasan ibn Abi Ja'far, from Budayl, from Anas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah has people among mankind," it was said: "O Messenger of Allah, who are they?" He said: "The people of the Qur'an."
23.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne al-Hasan ibn Abi Ja'far se, Budayl se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah ke insaanon mein se kuch khaas log hain," poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah, woh kaun hain?" Aapne farmaya: "Quran wale."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ بَهْدَلَةَ  ، عَنْ مُغِيثٍ  ، عَنْ كَعْبٍ  ، قَالَ :" عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْقُرْآنِ، فَإِنَّهُ فَهْمُ الْعَقْلِ، وَنُورُ الْحِكْمَةِ، وَيَنَابِيعُ الْعِلْمِ، وَأَحْدَثُ الْكُتُبِ بِالرَّحْمَنِ عَهْدًا، وَقَالَ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ : يَا مُحَمَّدُ ، إِنِّي مُنَزِّلٌ عَلَيْكَ تَوْرَاةً حَدِيثَةً، تَفْتَحُ فِيهَا أَعْيُنًا عُمْيًا، وَآذَانًا صُمًّا، وَقُلُوبًا غُلْفًا "
23.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Asim, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Asim ibn Bahdalah, from Mughith, from Ka'b: He said: "Adhere to the Qur'an, for it is the understanding of the intellect, and the light of wisdom, and the springs of knowledge, and the most recently revealed of the Books by the Most Gracious, and He said in the Torah: 'O Muhammad, I am going to send down to you a new Torah, which opens with it blind eyes, and deaf ears, and veiled hearts.'"
23.hi: Amr ibn Asim ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Asim ibn Bahdalah se, Mughith se, Ka'b se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Quran ko mazbooti se pakdo, kyunki yeh aqal ki samajh hai, aur hikmat ka noor hai, aur ilm ke chashme hain, aur Rahman ki taraf se sabse recent kitaab hai, aur usne Taurat mein farmaya: 'Ae Muhammad, main tumpar ek nayi Taurat nazil karne wala hoon, jisse main andhi aankhein, aur bahre kaan, aur parde wale dil khol dunga.'"

23.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زِيَادُ بْنُ مِخْرَاقٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي كِنَانَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى  ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" إِنَّ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ كَائِنٌ لَكُمْ أَجْرًا، وَكَائِنٌ لَكُمْ ذِكْرًا، وَكَائِنٌ بِكُمْ نُورًا، وَكَائِنٌ عَلَيْكُمْ وِزْرًا، اتَّبِعُوا الْقُرْآنَ، وَلَا يَتَّبِعْكُمْ الْقُرْآنُ، فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ يَتَّبِعْ الْقُرْآنَ، يَهْبِطْ بِهِ فِي رِيَاضِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَمَنْ اتَّبَعَهُ الْقُرْآنُ يَزُخُّ فِي قَفَاهُ، فَيَقْذِفُهُ فِي جَهَنَّمَ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : يَزُخُّ : يَدْفَعُ
23.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from Ziyad ibn Mikhraq, from Abu Iyas, from Abu Kinanah, from Abu Musa; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: That he said: 'This Qur'an will indeed be a reward for you, and will be a remembrance for you, and will be a light for you, and will be a burden upon you, so follow the Qur'an, and let the Qur'an not follow you, for whoever follows the Qur'an, it takes him down into the gardens of Paradise, and whoever the Qur'an follows [instead], it pushes at the back of his neck, and casts him into Jahannam.' Abu Muhammad said: yazukhkhu means: it pushes.
