23.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se bataya: Humein Ziyad ibn Mikhraq ne bataya, Abu Iyas se, Abu Kinanah se, Abu Musa se: ke unhone kaha, "Yeh Quran zaroor tumhare liye ajr hoga, aur zaroor tumhare liye zikr hoga, aur zaroor tumhare liye noor hoga, aur zaroor tumpar bojh hoga, Quran ki pairwi karo, aur Quran ko apni pairwi na karne do, kyunki jo Quran ki pairwi kare, woh usay Jannat ke baaghon mein le jaayega, aur jise Quran [ulta] pairwi kare, woh uski gardan ke peechhe dhakka mare, aur usay Jahannam mein daal de." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: 'Yazukhkhu' ka matlab hai: woh dhakka maarta hai.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ  ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَمِّي إِيَاسَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ  ، يَقُولُ : أَخَذَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ   بِيَدِي، ثُمَّ قَالَ :" إِنَّكَ إِنْ بَقِيتَ، سَيَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ ثَلَاثَةُ أَصْنَافٍ : فَصِنْفٌ لِلَّهِ، وَصِنْفٌ لِلْجِدَالِ، وَصِنْفٌ لِلدُّنْيَا، وَمَنْ طَلَبَ بِهِ أَدْرَكَ "
23.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Musa ibn Ayyub: He said: I heard my uncle Iyas ibn Amir say: Ali ibn Abi Talib took my hand, then said: "Indeed if you remain, three types will recite the Qur'an: a type for Allah, a type for argument, and a type for the world, and whoever seeks it [worldly gain] through it, will attain it."
23.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid ne Musa ibn Ayyub se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine apne chacha Iyas ibn Amir ko kehte suna: Ali ibn Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) ne mera haath pakda, fir farmaya: "Agar tum baaqi raho, to teen tarah ke log Quran padhenge: ek Allah ke liye, ek jhagde ke liye, aur ek duniya ke liye, aur jo isse [duniya] talaash kare, use paayega."

23.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  : أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ لِأَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ   : " إِنَّ إِخْوَانَكَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكُوفَةِ ، مِنْ أَهْلِ الذِّكْرِ، يُقْرِئُونَكَ السَّلَامَ.
فَقَالَ : وَعَلَيْهِمْ السَّلَامُ، وَمُرْهُمْفَلْيُعْطُوا الْقُرْآنَ بِخَزَائِمِهِمْ، فَإِنَّهُ يَحْمِلُهُمْ عَلَى الْقَصْدِ وَالسُّهُولَةِ، وَيُجَنِّبُهُمْ الْجَوْرَ وَالْحُزُونَةَ "
23.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah: That a man said to Abu al-Darda: "Your brothers from the people of Kufah, from the people of remembrance, send you their greeting of peace." So he said: "And upon them be peace, and command them to give the Qur'an its full rights [reciting it correctly], for it carries them upon what is right and easy, and keeps them away from injustice and hardship."
23.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ayyub se, Abu Qilabah se bataya: ke ek aadmi ne Abu al-Darda se kaha: "Kufah ke aapke bhai, jo zikr karne walon mein se hain, aapko salaam bhejte hain." To unhone kaha: "Aur unpar bhi salaam ho, aur unhein hukum do ke woh Quran ko uski poori haqiqat ke saath ada karein, kyunki yeh unhein seedhi aur aasaan raah par le jaata hai, aur unhein zulm aur sakhti se door rakhta hai."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الرِّفَاعِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ الْجُعْفِيُّ  ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ الزَّيَّاتِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُخْتَارِ الطَّائِيِّ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَخِي الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ الْحَارِثِ  ، قَالَ : دَخَلْتُ الْمَسْجِدَ، فَإِذَا أُنَاسٌ يَخُوضُونَ فِي أَحَادِيثَ، فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَلِيٍّ  ، فَقُلْتُ : أَلَا تَرَى أَنَّ أُنَاسًا يَخُوضُونَ فِي الْأَحَادِيثِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ؟ فَقَالَ : قَدْ فَعَلُوهَا؟ قُلْتُ : نَعَمْ، قَالَ : أَمَا إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" سَتَكُونُ فِتَنٌ "، قُلْتُ : وَمَا الْمَخْرَجُ مِنْهَا؟ قَالَ : كِتَابُ اللَّهِ، كِتَابُ اللَّهِ فِيهِ نَبَأُ مَا قَبْلَكُمْ، وَخَبَرُ مَا بَعْدَكُمْ، وَحُكْمُ مَا بَيْنَكُمْ، هُوَ الْفَصْلُ لَيْسَ بِالْهَزْلِ، هُوَ الَّذِي مَنْ تَرَكَهُ مِنْ جَبَّارٍ، قَصَمَهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ ابْتَغَى الْهُدَى فِي غَيْرِهِ، أَضَلَّهُ اللَّهُ، فَهُوَ حَبْلُ اللَّهِ الْمَتِينُ، وَهُوَ الذِّكْرُ الْحَكِيمُ، وَهُوَ الصِّرَاطُ الْمُسْتَقِيمُ، وَهُوَ الَّذِي لَا تَزِيغُ بِهِ الْأَهْوَاءُ، وَلَا تَلْتَبِسُ بِهِ الْأَلْسِنَةُ، وَلَا يَشْبَعُ مِنْهُ الْعُلَمَاءُ، وَلَا يَخْلَقُ عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الرَّدِّ، وَلَا تَنْقَضِي عَجَائِبُهُ، وَهُوَ الَّذِي لَمْ يَنْتَهِ الْجِنُّ إِذْ سَمِعَتْهُ أَنْ قَالُوا : # إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا سورة الجن آية 1 #، هُوَ الَّذِي مَنْ قَالَ بِهِ صَدَقَ، وَمَنْ حَكَمَ بِهِ عَدَلَ، وَمَنْ عَمِلَ بِهِ أُجِرَ، وَمَنْ دَعَا إِلَيْهِ هُدِيَ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ "خُذْهَا إِلَيْكَ يَا أَعْوَرُ
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Rifa'i, from al-Husayn al-Ju'fi, from Hamzah al-Zayyat, from Abu al-Mukhtar al-Ta'i, from the nephew of al-Harith, from al-Harith: He said: I entered the mosque, and there were people engrossed in [idle] narrations, so I went to Ali, and said: "Do you not see people engrossed in narrations in the mosque?" So he said: "Have they done that?" I said, "Yes." He said: "Listen, I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'There will be trials.'" I said: "And what is the way out of them?" He said: "The Book of Allah, the Book of Allah contains the news of what came before you, and the report of what comes after you, and the judgment of what is between you, it is the decisive word, not a joke, it is such that whoever among the tyrants abandons it, Allah breaks him, and whoever seeks guidance in other than it, Allah misguides him, it is the firm rope of Allah, and it is the wise reminder, and it is the straight path, it is that whose desires do not cause it to deviate, nor do tongues confuse it, nor do the scholars ever get their fill of it, nor does it wear out with much repetition, nor do its wonders ever cease, and it is that which the jinn, when they heard it, could not help but say: 'Indeed we have heard a wondrous recitation' [Surah al-Jinn, verse 1], it is that of which whoever speaks by it, speaks truly, and whoever judges by it, judges justly, and whoever acts by it, is rewarded, and whoever calls to it, is guided to a straight path," [he said] "Take it, O one-eyed man."
23.hi: Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Rifa'i ne al-Husayn al-Ju'fi se, Hamzah al-Zayyat se, Abu al-Mukhtar al-Ta'i se, al-Harith ke bhatije se, al-Harith se bataya: Unhone kaha, Main masjid mein gaya, to log baaton mein uljhe hue the, to main Ali (Alayhis Salam) ke paas gaya, aur kaha: "Kya aap dekh nahi rahe log masjid mein baaton mein uljhe hain?" To unhone kaha: "Kya unhone aisa kiya hai?" Maine kaha, "Haan." Unhone kaha: "Sun lo, maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna: 'Fitne aayenge.'" Maine poocha: "Aur unse nikalne ka raasta kya hai?" Unhone farmaya: "Allah ki Kitaab, Allah ki Kitaab mein tumse pehle ki khabar hai, aur tumhare baad ki khabar hai, aur tumhare darmiyan ka faisla hai, yeh faisla-kun baat hai, mazaak nahi, yeh woh hai ke jo zaalim ise chhode, Allah usay tod deta hai, aur jo iske siwa kisi aur mein hidayat talaash kare, Allah usay gumraah kar deta hai, yeh Allah ki mazboot rassi hai, aur yeh hikmat wali yaad-dahaani hai, aur yeh seedha raasta hai, yeh woh hai jisse khwaahishein bhataka nahi sakti, aur zubaanein isay uljha nahi sakti, aur ulama isse kabhi seer nahi hote, aur yeh baar-baar dohraane se purana nahi padta, aur iske ajaaib kabhi khatam nahi hote, aur yeh woh hai jise sunkar jinnaat bhi keh uthe: 'Humne ek ajeeb Quran suna hai' [Surah Al-Jinn, aayat 1], yeh woh hai ke jo iske mutaabiq kahe, sach kahe, aur jo iske mutaabiq faisla kare, insaaf kare, aur jo iske mutaabiq amal kare, use ajr mile, aur jo iski taraf bulaaye, use seedhi raah dikhaayi jaaye," [aapne farmaya] "Ise le lo, ae kaane aadmi."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِنَانٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْبَخْتَرِيِّ  ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ  ، قَالَ : قِيلَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ أُمَّتَكَ سَتُفْتَتَنُ مِنْ بَعْدِكَ، قَالَ : فَسَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَوْ سُئِلَ : مَا الْمَخْرَجُ مِنْهَا؟ قَالَ :" الْكِتَابُ الْعَزِيزُ الَّذِي # لا يَأْتِيهِ الْبَاطِلُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَلا مِنْ خَلْفِهِ تَنْزِيلٌ مِنْ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٍ سورة فصلت آية 42 # مَنِ ابْتَغَى الْهُدَى فِي غَيْرِهِ، فَقَدْ أَضَلَّهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ وَلِيَ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ مِنْ جَبَّارٍ فَحَكَمَ بِغَيْرِهِ، قَصَمَهُ اللَّهُ، هُوَ الذِّكْرُ الْحَكِيمُ، وَالنُّورُ الْمُبِينُ، وَالصِّرَاطُ الْمُسْتَقِيمُ، فِيهِ خَبَرُ مَنْ قَبْلَكُمْ، وَنَبَأُ مَا بَعْدَكُمْ، وَحُكْمُ مَا بَيْنَكُمْ، وَهُوَ الْفَصْلُ لَيْسَ بِالْهَزْلِ، وَهُوَ الَّذِي سَمِعَتْهُ الْجِنُّ فَلَمْ تَتَنَاهَ أَنْ قَالُوا : # إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا سورة الجن آية 1 #، وَلَا يَخْلَقُ عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الرَّدِّ، وَلَا تَنْقَضِي عِبَرُهُ، وَلَا تَفْنَى عَجَائِبُهُ "، ثُمَّ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ لِلْحَارِثِ : خُذْهَا إِلَيْكَ يَا أَعْوَرُ
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Ala, from Zakariya ibn Adi, from Muhammad ibn Salamah, from Ibn Sinan, from Amr ibn Murrah, from Abu al-Bakhtari, from al-Harith, from Ali: He said: It was said: "O Messenger of Allah, your nation will indeed be tried after you," he said: So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked, or was asked: What is the way out of it? He said: "The Mighty Book, of which: 'Falsehood cannot approach it from before it or from behind it, a revelation from a Wise, Praiseworthy [God]' [Surah Fussilat, verse 42], whoever seeks guidance in other than it, Allah has indeed misguided him, and whoever among the tyrants governs this matter and judges by other than it, Allah breaks him, it is the wise reminder, and the clear light, and the straight path, in it is the news of what is before you, and the report of what is after you, and the judgment of what is between you, it is the decisive word, not a joke, and it is that which the jinn heard and could not help but say: 'Indeed we have heard a wondrous recitation' [Surah al-Jinn, verse 1], and it does not wear out with much repetition, and its lessons never end, and its wonders never perish," then Ali said to al-Harith: "Take it, O one-eyed man."
23.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Ala ne Zakariya ibn Adi se, Muhammad ibn Salamah se, Ibn Sinan se, Amr ibn Murrah se, Abu al-Bakhtari se, al-Harith se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bataya: Unhone kaha, Poocha gaya: "Ya Rasulullah, aapki ummat aapke baad zaroor aazmaayi jaayegi," unhone bataya: To Rasulullah ﷺ ne poocha, ya poocha gaya: Isse nikalne ka raasta kya hai? Aapne farmaya: "Woh zabardast Kitaab, jismein: 'Baatil na iske aage se aa sakta hai na iske peechhe se, yeh Hakeem, Hameed ki taraf se nazil hai' [Surah Fussilat, aayat 42], jo iske siwa kisi aur mein hidayat talaash kare, Allah ne usay gumraah kar diya, aur jo zaalim is maamle ka waali bane aur iske siwa kisi aur se faisla kare, Allah usay tod deta hai, yeh hikmat wali yaad-dahaani hai, aur roshan noor hai, aur seedha raasta hai, isme tumse pehle ki khabar hai, aur tumhare baad ki khabar hai, aur tumhare darmiyan ka faisla hai, yeh faisla-kun baat hai, mazaak nahi, aur yeh woh hai jise jinnaat ne suna aur keh uthe: 'Humne ek ajeeb Quran suna hai' [Surah Al-Jinn, aayat 1], aur yeh baar-baar dohraane se purana nahi padta, aur iske sabak kabhi khatam nahi hote, aur iske ajaaib kabhi zaya nahi hote," fir Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne al-Harith se farmaya: "Ise le lo, ae kaane aadmi."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ أَبِي حمزة ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  : # وَمَنْ يُؤْتَ الْحِكْمَةَ فَقَدْ أُوتِيَ خَيْرًا كَثِيرًا سورة البقرة آية 269 #، قَالَ :" الْفَهْمَ بِالْقُرْآنِ "
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Abu Hamzah, from Ibrahim: Concerning: "And whoever is given wisdom has indeed been given much good" [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 269], he said: "[It means] understanding through the Qur'an."
23.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, Abu Hamzah se, Ibrahim se bataya: is aayat ke baare mein: "Aur jise hikmat di jaaye, use zaroor bahut bhalaai di gayi" [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 269], unhone kaha: "[Iska matlab hai] Quran ke zariye samajh."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، عَنْ وَرْقَاءَ ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  : # يُؤْتِي الْحِكْمَةَ مَنْ يَشَاءُ سورة البقرة آية 269 #، قَالَ :" الْكِتَابَ يُؤْتِي إِصَابَتَهُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ "
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Warqa, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid: Concerning: "He gives wisdom to whom He wills" [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 269], he said: "He gives the Book's correct understanding to whom He wills."
23.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Warqa se, Ibn Abi Najih se, Mujahid se bataya: is aayat ke baare mein: "Woh jise chaahe hikmat deta hai" [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 269], unhone kaha: "Woh jise chaahe Kitaab ki sahi samajh deta hai."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ خَيْثَمَةَ ، قَالَ : قَالَ لِامْرَأَتِهِ :" إِيَّاكِ أَنْ تُدْخِلِي بَيْتِي مَنْ يَشْرَبُ الْخَمْرَ، بَعْدَ أَنْ كَانَ يُقْرَأُ فِيهِ الْقُرْآنُ كُلَّ ثَلَاثٍ "
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yazid, from Abu Bakr, from al-A'mash, from Khaythamah: He said: He said to his wife: "Beware of letting into my house whoever drinks wine, after there being a place where the Qur'an was recited every three [days/nights]."
23.hi: Muhammad ibn Yazid ne Abu Bakr se, al-A'mash se, Khaythamah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Unhone apni biwi se kaha: "Khabardaar, mere ghar mein aise kisi ko mat aane dena jo sharaab piye, jabke yahan har teen din mein Quran padha jaata tha."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا فِطْرٌ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ :" مَا يَمْنَعُ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا رَجَعَ مِنْ سُوقِهِ، أَوْ مِنْ حَاجَتِهِ، فَاتَّكَأَ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ، أَنْ يَقْرَأَ ثَلَاثَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ الْقُرْآنِ؟ ! "
23.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Fitr, from al-Hakam, from Miqsam, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "What prevents one of you, when he returns from his market, or from his errand, and reclines on his bed, from reciting three verses from the Qur'an?!"
23.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Fitr se, al-Hakam se, Miqsam se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Tum mein se kisi ko kya rokta hai ke jab woh apne bazaar se, ya apni zaroorat se wapas aaye, aur apne bistar par tekaan lagaaye, to woh Quran ki teen aayaten padh le?!"

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنَا النُّعْمَانُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ "
23.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Abd al-Wahid, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Ishaq, from al-Nu'man ibn Sa'd, from Ali: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The best of you is whoever learns the Qur'an and teaches it."
23.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Abd al-Wahid se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Ishaq se, al-Nu'man ibn Sa'd se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tum mein behtareen woh hai jo Quran seekhe aur usay sikhaaye."

23.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَلْقَمَةُ بْنُ مَرْثَدٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَيْدَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيِّ  ،  عَنْ عُثْمَانَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ خَيْرَكُمْ مَنْ عَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ، أَوْ تَعَلَّمَهُ ".
قَالَ : أَقْرَأَ أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ فِي إِمْرَةِ عُثْمَانَ حَتَّى كَانَ الْحَجَّاجُ، قَالَ : ذَاكَ أَقْعَدَنِي مَقْعَدِي هَذَا
23.en: Narrated by al-Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Shu'bah, from Alqamah ibn Marthad, from Sa'd ibn Ubaydah, from Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Sulami, from Uthman, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: 'Indeed the best of you is whoever teaches the Qur'an, or learns it.' He said: Abu Abd al-Rahman taught recitation during Uthman's rule until al-Hajjaj's time, he said: That is what seated me in this seat of mine.
23.hi: Al-Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Shu'bah se bataya: Mujhe Alqamah ibn Marthad ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Sa'd ibn Ubaydah ko suna, Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Sulami se, Uthman se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Tum mein sabse behtar woh hai jo Quran sikhaaye, ya usay seekhe." Unhone bataya: Abu Abd al-Rahman ne Uthman ki hukumat mein al-Hajjaj ke waqt tak qiraat sikhaayi, unhone kaha: Isi ne mujhe meri is jagah par bithaya.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَارِثُ بْنُ نَبْهَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ بَهْدَلَةَ  ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" خِيَارُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ، وَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ "، قَالَ : فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِي، فَأَقْعَدَنِي هَذَا الْمَقْعَدَ أُقْرِئُ
23.en: Narrated by al-Mu'alla ibn Asad, from al-Harith ibn Nabhan, from Asim ibn Bahdalah, from Mus'ab ibn Sa'd, from his father: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The best of you is whoever learns the Qur'an, and teaches the Qur'an," he said: So he took my hand, and seated me in this seat, teaching recitation.
23.hi: Al-Mu'alla ibn Asad ne al-Harith ibn Nabhan se, Asim ibn Bahdalah se, Mus'ab ibn Sa'd se, apne walid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tum mein behtareen woh hai jo Quran seekhe, aur Quran sikhaaye," unhone bataya: To unhone mera haath pakda, aur mujhe isi jagah bithaya, taalim dete hue.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ  ، عَنْ عِيسَى  ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ  ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ يَتَعَلَّمُ الْقُرْآنَ ثُمَّ يَنْسَاهُ، إِلَّا لَقِيَ اللَّهَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَهُوَ أَجْذَمُ "، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : عِيسَى وهُوَ ابْنُ فَائِدٍ
23.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Yazid ibn Abi Ziyad, from Isa, from a man, from Sa'd ibn Ubadah; with Abu Muhammad's identification: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'There is no man who learns the Qur'an then forgets it, except that he meets Allah on the Day of Resurrection with his hand cut off [i.e., leprous/maimed].' Abu Muhammad said: Isa is: the son of Fa'id.
23.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Yazid ibn Abi Ziyad se, Isa se, ek aadmi se, Sa'd ibn Ubadah se bataya: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Koi bhi aadmi Quran seekhe fir usay bhool jaaye, magar woh Qayamat ke din Allah se is haal mein milega ke woh kodhi (haath kata hua) hoga." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Isa: Fa'id ke bete hain.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُبَيْدَةَ  ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ نَاجِيَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ L7835 ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" أَكْثِرُوا تِلَاوَةَ الْقُرْآنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُرْفَعَ، قَالُوا : هَذِهِ الْمَصَاحِفُ تُرْفَعُ، فَكَيْفَ بِمَا فِي صُدُورِ الرِّجَالِ؟ قَالَ : يُسْرَى عَلَيْهِ لَيْلًا فَيُصْبِحُونَ مِنْهُ فُقَرَاءَ، وَيَنْسَوْنَ قَوْلَ : لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَيَقَعُونَ فِي قَوْلِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ وَأَشْعَارِهِمْ، وَذَلِكَ حِينَ يَقَعُ عَلَيْهِمْ الْقَوْلُ "
23.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Musa ibn Ubaydah, from Safwan ibn Sulaym, from Najiyah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah, from his father, from Abdullah: He said: "Recite the Qur'an much before it is lifted away," they said: "These are the copies of the Qur'an that are lifted away, but what about what is in the hearts of men?" He said: "It is taken away by night, so they wake up destitute of it, and forget the saying: 'There is no god but Allah,' and fall into the sayings of the Jahiliyyah and their poetry, and that is when the [final] word befalls them."
23.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Musa ibn Ubaydah se, Safwan ibn Sulaym se, Najiyah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah se, apne walid se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Quran ki tilaawat zyada karo isse pehle ke yeh utha liya jaaye," logon ne kaha: "Yeh Mus'haf jo utha liye jaayenge, lekin uska kya jo logon ke seenon mein hai?" Unhone kaha: "Woh raat ko utha liya jaayega, to log subah usse mehroom paayenge, aur 'Laa ilaaha illallah' kehna bhool jaayenge, aur Jahiliyat ki baaton aur unki shayari mein pad jaayenge, aur yehi waqt hoga jab unpar [aakhri] baat aa padegi."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلَّامٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي مُطِيعٍ ، قَالَ : كَانَ قَتَادَةُ ، يَقُولُ :" اعْمُرُوا بِهِ قُلُوبَكُمْ، وَاعْمُرُوا بِهِ بُيُوتَكُمْ "، قَالَ : أُرَاهُ يَعْنِي : الْقُرْآنَ
23.en: Narrated by al-Mu'alla ibn Asad, from Sallam ibn Abi Muti': He said: Qatadah used to say: "Populate your hearts with it, and populate your houses with it," he said: I think he meant: the Qur'an.
23.hi: Al-Mu'alla ibn Asad ne Sallam ibn Abi Muti' se bataya: Unhone kaha, Qatadah kehte the: "Isse apne dilon ko aabaad karo, aur isse apne gharon ko aabaad karo," unhone bataya: Mera khayal hai unka matlab tha: Quran.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ زِرٍّ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ  ، قَالَ :" لَيُسْرَيَنَّ عَلَى الْقُرْآنِ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ، فَلَا يُتْرَكُ آيَةٌ فِي مُصْحَفٍ، وَلَا فِي قَلْبِ أَحَدٍ، إِلَّا رُفِعَتْ "
23.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Asim, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Asim, from Zirr, from Ibn Mas'ud: He said: "The Qur'an will indeed be taken away one night, so no verse will be left in any copy, nor in anyone's heart, except that it will be lifted away."
23.hi: Amr ibn Asim ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Asim se, Zirr se, Ibn Mas'ud se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Quran ek raat zaroor utha liya jaayega, to koi aayat kisi Mus'haf mein, ya kisi ke dil mein baaqi nahi bachegi, magar woh utha li jaayegi."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ وَاقِدٍ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، قَالَ :" مَا جَالَسَ الْقُرْآنَ أَحَدٌ فَقَامَ عَنْهُ، إِلَّا بِزِيَادَةٍ أَوْ نُقْصَانٍ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ : # وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلا يَزِيدُ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلا خَسَارًا سورة الإسراء آية 82 #
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir, from Abdullah ibn Waqid, from Qatadah: He said: "No one sits with the Qur'an and gets up from it, except with an increase or a decrease," then he recited: "And We send down of the Qur'an that which is a cure and a mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss" [Surah al-Isra, verse 82].
23.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir ne Abdullah ibn Waqid se, Qatadah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Koi bhi Quran ke saath baithkar uska sanga chhodta nahi, magar kuch izaafe ya kami ke saath," fir unhone padha: "Aur hum Quran mein se woh naazil karte hain jo momino ke liye shifa aur rehmat hai, lekin yeh zaalimon ko sirf nuqsaan mein hi badhaata hai" [Surah Al-Isra, aayat 82].

23.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا رِفْدَةُ الْغَسَّانِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ عَجْلَانَ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ ، قَالَ : كَانَ يُقَالُ :" إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيُرِيدُ الْعَذَابَ بِأَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ، فَإِذَا سَمِعَ تَعْلِيمَ الصِّبْيَانِ الْحِكْمَةَ، صَرَفَ ذَلِكَ عَنْهُمْ ".
قَالَ مَرْوَانُ : يَعْنِي بِالْحِكْمَةِ : الْقُرْآنَ
23.en: Narrated by Marwan ibn Muhammad, from Rifdah al-Ghassani, from Thabit ibn Ajlan al-Ansari; with Marwan's clarification: He said: It used to be said: 'Indeed Allah intends punishment for the people of the earth, but when He hears the teaching of children in wisdom, He turns it away from them.' Marwan said: By 'wisdom' he means: the Qur'an.
23.hi: Marwan ibn Muhammad ne Rifdah al-Ghassani se bataya: Humein Thabit ibn Ajlan al-Ansari ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Yeh kaha jaata tha: "Allah zameen walon ke liye azaab ka irada karta hai, lekin jab woh bacchon ko hikmat sikhaate hue sunta hai, to isse unse hataa deta hai." Marwan kehte hain: 'Hikmat' se murad hai: Quran.

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جَابِرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْخٌ يُكَنَّى أَبَا عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ  ، قَالَ :" سَيَبْلَى الْقُرْآنُ فِي صُدُورِ أَقْوَامٍ كَمَا يَبْلَى الثَّوْبُ، فَيَتَهَافَتُ، يَقْرَءُونَهُ لَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُ شَهْوَةً وَلَا لَذَّةً، يَلْبَسُونَ جُلُودَ الضَّأْنِ عَلَى قُلُوبِ الذِّئَابِ، أَعْمَالُهُمْ طَمَعٌ لَا يُخَالِطُهُ خَوْفٌ، إِنْ قَصَّرُوا، قَالُوا : سَنَبْلُغُ، وَإِنْ أَسَاءُوا، قَالُوا : سَيُغْفَرُ لَنَا، إِنَّا لَا نُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا "
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak, from Sadaqah ibn Khalid, from Ibn Jabir, from a shaykh known as Abu Amr, from Mu'adh ibn Jabal: He said: "The Qur'an will indeed wear out in the chests of some people just as a garment wears out and falls apart, they recite it and find no desire or pleasure in it, they wear the skins of sheep over the hearts of wolves, their deeds are greed unmixed with fear, if they fall short, they say: 'We will still reach [Paradise],' and if they do wrong, they say: 'We will be forgiven, indeed we do not associate anything with Allah.'"
23.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak ne Sadaqah ibn Khalid se, Ibn Jabir se bataya: Humein ek buzurg ne bataya jinhein Abu Amr kaha jaata tha, Mu'adh ibn Jabal se: Unhone kaha, "Quran kuch logon ke seenon mein zaroor purana ho jaayega jaise kapda purana hokar bikhar jaata hai, woh isay padhenge lekin unhein iski koi chaahat ya lutf mehsoos na hoga, woh bhediyon ke dilon par bhed ki khaal pehnte hain, unke amal lalach hote hain jisme khauf nahi milta, agar woh kami karein, to kehte hain: 'Hum phir bhi pahunch jaayenge,' aur agar burai karein, to kehte hain: 'Humein maaf kar diya jaayega, hum to Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi karte.'"

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ  ،  عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" قَالَ بِئْسَمَا لِأَحَدِكُمْ أَنْ يَقُولَ : نَسِيتُ آيَةَ كَيْتَ وَكَيْتَ، بَلْ هُوَ نُسِّيَ، وَاسْتَذْكِرُوا الْقُرْآنَ، فَإِنَّهُ أَسْرَعُ تَفَصِّيًا مِنْ صُدُورِ الرِّجَالِ مِنْ النَّعَمِ مِنْ عُقُلِهَا "
23.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Shu'bah, from Mansur: He said: I heard Abu Wa'il, from Abdullah, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "How bad it is for one of you to say: I forgot such-and-such verse; rather, he was made to forget it, so keep reviewing the Qur'an, for it slips away faster from the chests of men than camels escape their hobbles."
23.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Shu'bah se, Mansur se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Wa'il ko suna, Abdullah se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Yeh tum mein se kisi ke liye kitni buri baat hai ke woh kahe: main fulaan aayat bhool gaya, balke woh bhulaayi gayi, so Quran ko yaad rakho, kyunki yeh aadmiyon ke seenon se oonton ke apne bandhan se nikal jaane se zyada tez nikal jaata hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيٍّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبِي  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ  ، يَقُول : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" تَعَلَّمُوا كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَتَعَاهَدُوهُ، وَتَغَنَّوْا بِهِ وَاقْتَنُوهُ، فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ أَوْ : فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ لَهُوَ أَشَدُّ تَفَلُّتًا مِن الْمَخَاضِ فِي الْعُقُلِ "
23.en: Narrated by Wahb ibn Jarir, from Musa ibn Ali: He said: I heard my father say: I heard Uqbah ibn Amir say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Learn the Book of Allah, and take care of it, and recite it beautifully, and cherish it, for by the One in whose hand is my soul, or: by the One in whose hand is Muhammad's soul, it is more likely to escape than a she-camel from its hobbles."
23.hi: Wahb ibn Jarir ne Musa ibn Ali se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine apne walid ko kehte suna: Maine Uqbah ibn Amir ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah ki Kitaab seekho aur uski dekh-bhaal karo, aur isay khoobsurati se padho aur isay sanjho, kyunki us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, ya: jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, yeh oontni ke apne bandhan se nikalne se bhi zyada nikal jaane wali hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى  عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" تَعَلَّمُوا كِتَابَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَتَعَاهَدُوهُ، وَاقْتَنُوهُ وَتَغَنَّوْا بِهِ، فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، لَهُوَ أَشَدُّ تَفَلُّتًا مِنْ الْمَخَاضِ فِي الْعُقُلِ "
23.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from Musa, from his father, from Uqbah ibn Amir: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Learn the Book of Allah, exalted is He, and take care of it, and cherish it and recite it beautifully, for by the One in whose hand is my soul, it is more likely to escape than a she-camel from its hobbles."
23.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne Musa se bataya: Mujhse unke walid ne bataya, Uqbah ibn Amir se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah Ta'ala ki Kitaab seekho aur uski dekh-bhaal karo, aur isay sanjho aur khoobsurati se padho, kyunki us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, yeh oontni ke apne bandhan se nikalne se bhi zyada nikal jaane wali hai."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ  : " أَنَّ عِكْرِمَةَ بْنَ أَبِي جَهْلٍ   كَانَيَضَعُ الْمُصْحَفَ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ، وَيَقُولُ : كِتَابُ رَبِّي، كِتَابُ رَبِّي "
23.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Ibn Abi Mulaykah: "That Ikrimah ibn Abi Jahl used to place the copy of the Qur'an on his face, and say: 'The Book of my Lord, the Book of my Lord.'"
23.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ayyub se, Ibn Abi Mulaykah se bataya: "ke Ikrimah ibn Abi Jahl Mus'haf ko apne chehre par rakhte, aur kehte: 'Mere Rab ki Kitaab, mere Rab ki Kitaab.'"

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ  ، قَالَ : " كَانَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي لَيْلَى  إِذَا صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ، قَرَأَ الْمُصْحَفَ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ "، قَالَ : وَكَانَ ثَابِتٌ يَفْعَلُهُ
23.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Hammam, from Thabit: He said: "Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla, when he prayed Fajr, would recite the Mus'haf until the sun rose," he said: And Thabit used to do it too.
23.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Hammam se, Thabit se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla, jab woh Fajr padhte, to suraj tulu hone tak Mus'haf padhte," unhone bataya: Aur Thabit bhi aisa hi karte the.

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ زُرَيْعٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ ،  عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، قَالَ : # إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يَسْتَحْيِي أَنْ يَضْرِبَ مَثَلا مَا بَعُوضَةً فَمَا فَوْقَهَا فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا فَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَيَقُولُونَ مَاذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِهَذَا مَثَلا يُضِلُّ بِهِ كَثِيرًا وَيَهْدِي بِهِ كَثِيرًا وَمَا يُضِلُّ بِهِ إِلا الْفَاسِقِينَ سورة البقرة آية 26 #، قَالَ :" أَيْ يَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ كَلَامُ الرَّحْمَنِ "
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi, from Yazid ibn Zurayi, from Sa'id, from Qatadah: Concerning: "Indeed Allah is not shy to strike a parable, that of a mosquito or what is above it, so as for those who believe, they know it is the truth from their Lord, and as for those who disbelieve, they say: What did Allah intend by this as an example? He misguides many thereby and guides many thereby, and He does not misguide thereby except the defiantly disobedient" [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 26], he said: "That is, they know it is the speech of the Most Gracious."
23.hi: Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi ne Yazid ibn Zurayi se, Sa'id se, Qatadah se bataya: is aayat ke baare mein: "Allah kisi bhi misaal dene mein sharm mehsoos nahi karta, chahe woh macchar ki ho ya usse bhi choti, so jo momin hain woh jaante hain ke yeh unke Rab ki taraf se haq hai, aur jo kaafir hain woh kehte hain: Allah ne is misaal se kya irada kiya? Isse woh bahut logon ko gumraah karta hai aur bahut logon ko hidayat deta hai, aur woh isse sirf fasiqon ko gumraah karta hai" [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 26], unhone kaha: "Yaani, woh jaante hain ke yeh Rahman ka kalaam hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ  ، عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَا مِنْ كَلَامٍ أَعْظَمُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنْ كَلَامِهِ، وَمَا رَدَّ الْعِبَادُ إِلَى اللَّهِ كَلَامًا أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ كَلَامِهِ "
23.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from Mu'awiyah ibn Salih, from Abu Bakr ibn Abi Maryam, from Atiyyah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There is no speech greater with Allah than His speech, and the servants never return any speech to Allah more beloved to Him than His own speech."
23.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne Mu'awiyah ibn Salih se, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Maryam se, Atiyyah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Koi bhi kalaam Allah ke nazdeek uske apne kalaam se bada nahi, aur bande Allah ki taraf koi bhi kalaam nahi lautaate jo usay uske apne kalaam se zyada pasand ho."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ الثَّقَفِيُّ  ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَعْرِضُ نَفْسَهُ فِي الْمَوْسِمِ عَلَى النَّاسِ فِي الْمَوْقِفِ، فَيَقُولُ :" هَلْ مِنْ رَجُلٍ يَحْمِلُنِي إِلَى قَوْمِهِ؟ فَإِنَّ قُرَيْشًا مَنَعُونِي أَنْ أُبَلِّغَ كَلَامَ رَبِّي؟ "
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Isra'il, from Uthman ibn al-Mughirah al-Thaqafi, from Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd, from Jabir ibn Abdullah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to present himself to the people at the standing place during the pilgrimage season, and would say: "Is there any man who will carry me to his people? For Quraysh has prevented me from conveying my Lord's speech."
23.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Isra'il se bataya: Humein Uthman ibn al-Mughirah al-Thaqafi ne bataya, Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd se, Jabir ibn Abdullah se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ Hajj ke mausam mein logon ke saamne khade ho kar apne aap ko pesh karte, aur farmaate: "Kya koi aisa aadmi hai jo mujhe apni qaum tak le jaaye? Kyunki Quraysh ne mujhe mere Rab ka kalaam pahunchaane se roka hai?"

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ  ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ  ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزَّعْرَاءِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ   :" إِنَّ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ كَلَامُ اللَّهِ، فَلَا أَعْرِفَنَّكُمْ فِيمَا عَطَفْتُمُوهُ عَلَى أَهْوَائِكُمْ "
23.en: Narrated by Ishaq, from Jarir, from Layth, from Salamah ibn Kuhayl, from Abu al-Za'ra: He said: Umar ibn al-Khattab said: "This Qur'an is the speech of Allah, so let me not find you turning it toward your own desires."
23.hi: Ishaq ne Jarir se, Layth se, Salamah ibn Kuhayl se, Abu al-Za'ra se bataya: Unhone kaha, Umar ibn al-Khattab ne kaha: "Yeh Quran Allah ka kalaam hai, so mujhe tumhein aisa na paayein ke tum ise apni khwaahishon ke mutaabiq mod rahe ho."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّرْجُمَانِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ قَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ شَغَلَهُ قِرَاءَةُ الْقُرْآنِ عَنْ مَسْأَلَتِي وَذِكْرِي، أَعْطَيْتُهُ أَفْضَلَ ثَوَابِ السَّائِلِينَ، وَفَضْلُ كَلَامِ اللَّهِ عَلَى سَائِرِ الْكَلَامِ، كَفَضْلِ اللَّهِ عَلَى خَلْقِهِ "
23.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Ibrahim al-Turjumani, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Hamdani, from Amr ibn Qays, from Atiyyah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever is kept busy by reciting the Qur'an from asking Me and remembering Me, I give him the best reward of those who ask, and the excellence of Allah's speech over all other speech is like the excellence of Allah over His creation."
23.hi: Isma'il ibn Ibrahim al-Turjumani ne Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Hamdani se bataya: Humein Amr ibn Qays ne bataya, Atiyyah se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jise Quran ki tilaawat mujhse maangne aur mera zikr karne se mashghool kar de, main usay maangne walon ka behtareen sawaab dunga, aur Allah ke kalaam ki fazeelat baaki tamaam kalaam par aisi hai jaisi Allah ki fazeelat uski makhlooq par hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ الْحُدَّانِيِّ  ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" فَضْلُ كَلَامِ اللَّهِ عَلَى كَلَامِ خَلْقِهِ، كَفَضْلِ اللَّهِ عَلَى خَلْقِهِ "
23.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ash'ath al-Huddani, from Shahr ibn Hawshab: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The excellence of Allah's speech over the speech of His creation is like the excellence of Allah over His creation."
23.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Ash'ath al-Huddani se, Shahr ibn Hawshab se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah ke kalaam ki fazeelat uski makhlooq ke kalaam par aisi hai jaisi Allah ki fazeelat uski makhlooq par hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ  ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ  مِنْ شُيُوخِ مِصْرَ ، أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" الْقُرْآنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ "
23.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from Yahya ibn Ayyub, from Ubaydullah ibn Abi Ja'far, from a man among the elders of Egypt, from Abdullah ibn Amr, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: That he said: "The Qur'an is more beloved to Allah than the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them."
23.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne Yahya ibn Ayyub se bataya: Mujhe Ubaydullah ibn Abi Ja'far ne bataya, Misr ke buzurgon mein se ek aadmi se, ke unhone unhein bataya, Abdullah ibn Amr se, Rasulullah ﷺ se: ke aapne farmaya, "Quran Allah ko aasmanon aur zameen aur unmein jo hai usse zyada aziz hai."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ الْأَعْوَرُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ  ، عَنْ جُنْدُبٍ   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" اقْرَءُوا الْقُرْآنَ مَا ائْتَلَفْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ، فَإِذَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيهِ، فَقُومُوا "
23.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Harun al-A'war, from Abu Imran al-Jawni, from Jundub: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "Recite the Qur'an as long as you agree upon it, but when you differ about it, then stand up [and stop]."
23.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Harun al-A'war se, Abu Imran al-Jawni se, Jundub se bataya: ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, "Quran padho jab tak tum ismein ittefaaq karo, lekin jab tum ismein ikhtilaaf karo, to uth jao."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيُّ  ، عَنْ جُنْدُبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" اقْرَءُوا الْقُرْآنَ مَا ائْتَلَفَتْ عَلَيْهِ قُلُوبُكُمْ، فَإِذَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيهِ، فَقُومُوا "
23.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hammam, from Abu Imran al-Jawni, from Jundub ibn Abdullah: He said: "Recite the Qur'an as long as your hearts agree upon it, but when you differ about it, then stand up [and stop]."
23.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hammam se, Abu Imran al-Jawni se, Jundub ibn Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Quran padho jab tak tumhare dil ismein ittefaaq karein, lekin jab tum ismein ikhtilaaf karo, to uth jao."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو قُدَامَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيُّ  ، عَنْ جُنْدُبٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" اقْرَءُوا الْقُرْآنَ مَا ائْتَلَفَتْ عَلَيْهِ قُلُوبُكُمْ، فَإِذَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ، فِيهِ فَقُومُوا "
23.en: Narrated by Abu Ghassan Malik ibn Isma'il, from Abu Qudamah, from Abu Imran al-Jawni, from Jundub: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Recite the Qur'an as long as your hearts agree upon it, but when you differ, then stand up [and stop]."
23.hi: Abu Ghassan Malik ibn Isma'il ne Abu Qudamah se, Abu Imran al-Jawni se, Jundub se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Quran padho jab tak tumhare dil ismein ittefaaq karein, lekin jab tum ikhtilaaf karo, to uth jao."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا فِطْرٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" مِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُؤْتَى الْإِيمَانَ وَلَا يُؤْتَى الْقُرْآنَ، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يُؤْتَى الْقُرْآنَ وَلَا يُؤْتَى الْإِيمَانَ، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يُؤْتَى الْقُرْآنَ وَالْإِيمَانَ، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ لَا يُؤْتَى الْقُرْآنَ وَلَا الْإِيمَانَ، ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ لَهُمْ مَثَلًا، قَالَ : فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ الْإِيمَانَ وَلَمْ يُؤْتَ الْقُرْآنَ، فَمَثَلُهُ مَثَلُ التَّمْرَةِ حُلْوَةُ الطَّعْمِ، لَا رِيحَ لَهَا، وَأَمَّا مَثَلُ الَّذِي أُوتِيَ الْقُرْآنَ، وَلَمْ يُؤْتَ الْإِيمَانَ، فَمَثَلُ الْآسَةِ طَيِّبَةُ الرِّيحِ، مُرَّةُ الطَّعْمِ، وَأَمَّا الَّذِي أُوتِيَ الْقُرْآنَ وَالْإِيمَانَ، فَمَثَلُ الْأُتْرُجَّةِ، طَيِّبَةُ الرِّيحِ، حُلْوَةُ الطَّعْمِ، وَأَمَّا الَّذِي لَمْ يُؤْتَ الْقُرْآنَ وَلَا الْإِيمَانَ، فَمَثَلُهُ مَثَلُ الْحَنْظَلَةِ، مُرَّةُ الطَّعْمِ، لَا رِيحَ لَهَا "
23.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Fitr, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Harith, from Ali رضي الله عنه: He said: "Among people is one who is given faith but not given the Qur'an, and among them is one who is given the Qur'an but not given faith, and among them is one who is given both the Qur'an and faith, and among them is one who is given neither the Qur'an nor faith," then he gave them an example, he said: "As for the one given faith but not given the Qur'an, his example is like a date, sweet in taste, with no fragrance, and as for the example of the one given the Qur'an but not given faith, it is like sweet basil, pleasant in fragrance, bitter in taste, and as for the one given both the Qur'an and faith, his example is like a citron, pleasant in fragrance, sweet in taste, and as for the one given neither the Qur'an nor faith, his example is like a colocynth, bitter in taste, with no fragrance."
23.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Fitr se, Abu Ishaq se, al-Harith se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se, رضي الله عنه bataya: Unhone kaha, "Logon mein se kuch aise hain jinhein imaan diya jaata hai lekin Quran nahi diya jaata, aur kuch aise hain jinhein Quran diya jaata hai lekin imaan nahi diya jaata, aur kuch aise hain jinhein Quran aur imaan dono diye jaate hain, aur kuch aise hain jinhein na Quran diya jaata hai na imaan," fir aapne unke liye misaal di, unhone kaha: "Jise imaan diya jaaye lekin Quran na diya jaaye, uski misaal khajoor jaisi hai, jiska zaayka meetha hai, lekin jiski koi khushbu nahi, aur jise Quran diya jaaye lekin imaan na diya jaaye, uski misaal khushbudaar rehaan (mehndi/tulsi) jaisi hai, jiski khushbu achhi hai lekin zaayka kadwa hai, aur jise Quran aur imaan dono diye jaayein, uski misaal santra (utrujja) jaisi hai, jiski khushbu achhi hai aur zaayka meetha hai, aur jise na Quran diya jaaye na imaan, uski misaal indrayan (hanzalah) jaisi hai, jiska zaayka kadwa hai aur jiski koi khushbu nahi."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ، مَثَلُ الْأُتْرُجَّةِ، طَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ، وَرِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ، وَمَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ الَّذِي لَا يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ، مَثَلُ التَّمْرَةِ، طَعْمُهَا حُلْوٌ، وَلَيْسَ لَهَا رِيحٌ، وَمَثَلُ الْمُنَافِقِ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ، مَثَلُ الرَّيْحَانَةِ، رِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ، وَطَعْمُهَا مُرٌّ، وَمَثَلُ الْمُنَافِقِ الَّذِي لَا يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ، مَثَلُ الْحَنْظَلَةِ، لَيْسَ لَهَا رِيحٌ، وَطَعْمُهَا مُرٌّ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Abu Awanah, from Qatadah, from Anas ibn Malik, from Abu Musa al-Ash'ari, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "The example of the believer who recites the Qur'an is like the citron, its taste is pleasant, and its fragrance is pleasant, and the example of the believer who does not recite the Qur'an is like the date, its taste is sweet, but it has no fragrance, and the example of the hypocrite who recites the Qur'an is like sweet basil, its fragrance is pleasant, but its taste is bitter, and the example of the hypocrite who does not recite the Qur'an is like the colocynth, it has no fragrance, and its taste is bitter."
23.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Abu Awanah se, Qatadah se, Anas ibn Malik se, Abu Musa al-Ash'ari se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Us momin ki misaal jo Quran padhe, santra jaisi hai, jiska zaayka achha hai, aur jiski khushbu achhi hai, aur us momin ki misaal jo Quran na padhe, khajoor jaisi hai, jiska zaayka meetha hai, lekin jiski koi khushbu nahi, aur us munafiq ki misaal jo Quran padhe, rehaan jaisi hai, jiski khushbu achhi hai, lekin jiska zaayka kadwa hai, aur us munafiq ki misaal jo Quran na padhe, indrayan jaisi hai, jiski koi khushbu nahi, aur jiska zaayka kadwa hai."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ  ، قَالَ :" مَثَلُ الَّذِي أُوتِيَ الْإِيمَانَ وَلَمْ يُؤْتَ الْقُرْآنَ مَثَلُ التَّمْرَةِ، طَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ، وَلَا رِيحَ لَهَا، وَمَثَلُ الَّذِي أُوتِيَ الْقُرْآنَ وَلَمْ يُؤْتَ الْإِيمَانَ مَثَلُ الرَّيْحَانَةِ الْآسَةِ، رِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ، وَطَعْمُهَا مُرٌّ، وَمَثَلُ الَّذِي أُوتِيَ الْقُرْآنَ وَالْإِيمَانَ مَثَلُ الْأُتْرُجَّةِ، رِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ، وَطَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ، وَمَثَلُ الَّذِي لَمْ يُؤْتَ الْإِيمَانَ وَلَا الْقُرْآنَ مَثَلُ الْحَنْظَلَةِ، رِيحُهَا خَبِيثٌ، وَطَعْمُهَا خَبِيثٌ "
23.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah, from Isra'il, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Harith, from Ali: He said: "The example of the one given faith but not given the Qur'an is like the date, its taste is pleasant, but it has no fragrance, and the example of the one given the Qur'an but not given faith is like sweet basil, its fragrance is pleasant, but its taste is bitter, and the example of the one given both the Qur'an and faith is like the citron, its fragrance is pleasant, and its taste is pleasant, and the example of the one given neither faith nor the Qur'an is like the colocynth, its fragrance is foul, and its taste is foul."
23.hi: Ubaydullah ne Isra'il se, Abu Ishaq se, al-Harith se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jise imaan diya jaaye lekin Quran na diya jaaye uski misaal khajoor jaisi hai, jiska zaayka achha hai, lekin jiski koi khushbu nahi, aur jise Quran diya jaaye lekin imaan na diya jaaye uski misaal rehaan jaisi hai, jiski khushbu achhi hai, lekin jiska zaayka kadwa hai, aur jise Quran aur imaan dono diye jaayein uski misaal santra jaisi hai, jiski khushbu achhi hai, aur jiska zaayka bhi achha hai, aur jise na imaan diya jaaye na Quran uski misaal indrayan jaisi hai, jiski khushbu badbudaar hai, aur jiska zaayka bhi bura hai."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عَامِرُ بْنُ وَاثِلَةَ  : أَنَّ نَافِعَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْحَارِثِ لَقِيَ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ بِعُسْفَانَ ، وَكَانَ عُمَرُ اسْتَعْمَلَهُ عَلَى أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ ، فَسَلَّمَ عَلَى عُمَرَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ : مَنْ اسْتَخْلَفْتَ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْوَادِي؟ فَقَالَ نَافِعٌ : اسْتَخْلَفْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ ابْنَ أَبْزَى، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ : وَمَنْ ابْنُ أَبْزَى؟ فَقَالَ : مَوْلًى مِنْ مَوَالِينَا، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ : فَاسْتَخْلَفْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ مَوْلًى؟ فَقَالَ : يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، إِنَّهُ قَارِئٌ لِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ، عَالِمٌ بِالْفَرَائِضِ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ   : أَمَا إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَرْفَعُ بِهَذَا الْكِتَابِ أَقْوَامًا، وَيَضَعُ بِهِ آخَرِينَ "
23.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb ibn Abi Hamzah, from al-Zuhri, from Amir ibn Wathilah: That Nafi' ibn Abd al-Harith met Umar ibn al-Khattab at Usfan, and Umar had appointed him over the people of Makkah, so he greeted Umar, and Umar said to him: "Whom have you appointed as deputy over the people of the valley?" So Nafi' said: "I appointed Ibn Abza as deputy over them." So Umar said: "And who is Ibn Abza?" He said: "A freed slave from among our freed slaves." So Umar said: "So you appointed a freed slave as deputy over them?" So he said: "O Commander of the Believers, he is a reciter of the Book of Allah, knowledgeable in the fixed [inheritance] shares." So Umar said: "Listen, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ indeed said: 'Allah raises some people by this Book, and lowers others by it.'"
23.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb ibn Abi Hamzah se, al-Zuhri se bataya: Mujhe Amir ibn Wathilah ne bataya: ke Nafi' ibn Abd al-Harith Usfan mein Umar ibn al-Khattab se mile, aur Umar ne unhein Makkah walon par muqarrar kiya tha, to unhone Umar ko salaam kiya, to Umar ne unse poocha: "Waadi walon par tumne kise apna naa'ib banaaya?" To Nafi' ne kaha: "Maine Ibn Abza ko unpar naa'ib banaaya." To Umar ne poocha: "Aur Ibn Abza kaun hai?" Unhone kaha: "Humare azaad kiye hue ghulaamon mein se ek azaad ghulam." To Umar ne poocha: "To tumne un par ek azaad ghulam ko naa'ib banaaya?" To unhone kaha: "Ae Ameer-ul-Mumineen, woh Allah ki Kitaab ka qaari hai, muqarrar hisson ka jaankaar hai." To Umar ne kaha: "Sun lo, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya tha: 'Allah is Kitaab se kuch logon ko bulund karta hai, aur isi se doosron ko neecha dikhaata hai.'"

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ  ،  عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ  ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ لَهُ أَجْرٌ، وَإِنَّ الَّذِي يَسْتَمِعُ لَهُ أَجْرَانِ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from Abdah, from Khalid ibn Ma'dan: He said: "Indeed the one who recites the Qur'an has one reward, and the one who listens to it has two rewards."
23.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne Abdah se, Khalid ibn Ma'dan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo Quran padhe usay ek ajr hai, aur jo isay sune usay do ajr hain."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا رَزِينُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ اسْتَمَعَ إِلَى آيَةٍ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ، كَانَتْ لَهُ نُورًا "
23.en: Narrated by Razin ibn Abdullah ibn Humayd, from Abd al-Razzaq, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ata, from Ibn Abbas: He said: "Whoever listens to a verse from the Book of Allah, it becomes a light for him."
23.hi: Razin ibn Abdullah ibn Humayd ne Abd al-Razzaq se, Ibn Jurayj se, Ata se, Ibn Abbas se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo Allah ki Kitaab ki ek aayat sune, woh uske liye noor ban jaati hai."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ  ، وَهَمَّامٌ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى  ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ وَهُوَ مَاهِرٌ بِهِ، فَهُوَ مَعَ السَّفَرَةِ الْكِرَامِ الْبَرَرَةِ، وَالَّذِي يَقْرَؤُهُ وَهُوَ يَشْتَدُّ عَلَيْهِ، فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ "
23.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Hisham, and Hammam, from Qatadah, from Zurarah ibn Awfa, from Sa'd ibn Hisham, from Aisha, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "The one who recites the Qur'an while being skilled at it, is with the noble, righteous scribes, and the one who recites it while it is difficult for him, has two rewards."
23.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Hisham aur Hammam se bataya: Humein Qatadah ne bataya, Zurarah ibn Awfa se, Sa'd ibn Hisham se, Aisha se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Jo Quran padhe aur usmein maahir ho, woh izzat waale, neik farishton (safarah) ke saath hai, aur jo isay padhe jabke yeh uspar mushkil ho, uske liye do ajr hain."

23.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ وَهْبٍ الذِّمَارِيِّ ، قَالَ :" مَنْ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ الْقُرْآنَ، فَقَامَ بِهِ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ، وَآنَاءَ النَّهَارِ، وَعَمِلَ بِمَا فِيهِ، وَمَاتَ عَلَى الطَّاعَةِ، بَعَثَهُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَعَ السَّفَرَةِ وَالْأَحْكَامِ.
قَالَ سَعِيدٌ : السَّفَرَةُ : الْمَلَائِكَةُ، وَالْأَحْكَامُ : الْأَنْبِيَاءُ ، قَالَ : وَمَنْ كَانَ حَرِيصًا وَهُوَ يَتَفَلَّتُ مِنْهُ، وَهُوَ لَا يَدَعُهُ، أُوتِيَ أَجْرَهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ، وَمَنْ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ حَرِيصًا وَهُوَ يَتَفَلَّتُ مِنْهُ وَمَاتَ عَلَى الطَّاعَةِ، فَهُوَ مِنْ أَشْرَافِهِمْ، وَفُضِّلُوا عَلَى النَّاسِ، كَمَا فُضِّلَتْ النُّسُورُ عَلَى سَائِرِ الطَّيْرِ، وَكَمَا فُضِّلَتْ مَرْجَةٌ خَضْرَاءُ عَلَى مَا حَوْلَهَا مِنْ الْبِقَاعِ، فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ، قِيلَ : أَيْنَ الَّذِينَ كَانُوا يَتْلُونَ كِتَابِي لَمْ يُلْهِهِمْ اتِّبَاعُ الْأَنْعَامِ؟ فَيُعْطَى الْخُلْدَ وَالنَّعِيمَ، فَإِنْ كَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مَاتَا عَلَى الطَّاعَةِ، جُعِلَ عَلَى رُءُوسِهِمَا تَاجُ الْمُلْكِ، فَيَقُولَانِ : رَبَّنَا مَا بَلَغَتْ هَذَا أَعْمَالُنَا؟ فَيَقُولان : بَلَى، إِنَّ ابْنَكُمَا كَانَ يَتْلُو كِتَابِي "
23.en: Narrated by Marwan ibn Muhammad, from Sa'id ibn Abd al-Aziz, from Isma'il ibn Ubaydullah, from Wahb al-Dhimari; with Sa'id's clarification: He said: "Whoever Allah gives the Qur'an, and he stands with it in the hours of the night, and the hours of the day, and acts by what is in it, and dies in obedience, Allah will raise him on the Day of Resurrection with the scribes and the judges [prophets]." Sa'id said: al-safarah is: the angels, and al-ahkam is: the prophets. He said: And whoever is eager for it though it keeps slipping from him, yet he does not abandon it, is given his reward twice, and whoever is eager for it though it keeps slipping from him, and dies in obedience, is among their nobles, and they are preferred over people, just as eagles are preferred over other birds, and just as a green meadow is preferred over the surrounding lands, so when it is the Day of Resurrection, it will be said: "Where are those who used to recite My Book, not distracted by chasing after cattle?" So he will be given eternity and bliss, but if his two parents died in obedience, a crown of dominion will be placed on their heads, so they will say: "Our Lord, from where did our deeds reach this?" So it will be said: "Rather, your son used to recite My Book."
23.hi: Marwan ibn Muhammad ne Sa'id ibn Abd al-Aziz se bataya: Humein Isma'il ibn Ubaydullah ne bataya, Wahb al-Dhimari se: Unhone kaha, "Jise Allah Quran de, aur woh raat ke ghanton mein, aur din ke ghanton mein isse khada rahe, aur jo isme hai uspar amal kare, aur itaa'at ki haalat mein mare, Allah usay Qayamat ke din safarah (farishton) aur ahkaam (Ambiya) ke saath uthaayega." Sa'id kehte hain: 'Safarah': farishte, aur 'Ahkaam': Ambiya. Unhone kaha: Aur jo ismein shauqeen ho jabke yeh usse phisalta rehta ho, lekin woh isay chhode nahi, usay uska ajr do martaba diya jaayega, aur jo ismein shauqeen ho jabke yeh usse phisalta rahe, aur woh itaa'at ki haalat mein mare, to woh unke sharafa mein se hai, aur unhein logon par tarjeeh di jaayegi, jaise uqaab ko baaki parindon par tarjeeh di jaati hai, aur jaise hari charagaah ko uske aas-paas ki zameeno par tarjeeh di jaati hai, so jab Qayamat ka din hoga, kaha jaayega: "Kahan hain woh log jo meri Kitaab padha karte the, jinhein maweshiyon ke peechhe bhaagna mashghool nahi karta tha?" To usay hamesha rehna aur ne'mat di jaayegi, so agar uske maa-baap itaa'at ki haalat mein mare hon, to unke saron par baadshahat ka taaj rakh diya jaayega, to woh kahenge: "Humare Rab, humare amal to isse kahin kam the?" To kaha jaayega: "Balke, tumhara beta meri Kitaab padha karta tha."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا قَبِيصَةُ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" فِي فَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ، شِفَاءٌ مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ "
23.en: Narrated by Qabisah, from Sufyan, from Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "In the Opening of the Book, there is a cure for every disease."
23.hi: Qabisah ne Sufyan se, Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Fatihat-ul-Kitaab mein har bimaari ki shifa hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُعَلَّى الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ، قَالَ : " مَرَّ بِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ :" أَلَمْ يَقُلْ اللَّهُ G : # يَأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَجِيبُوا لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ لِمَا يُحْيِيكُمْ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهِ وَأَنَّهُ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ سورة الأنفال آية 24 #، قَالَ : أَلَا أُعَلِّمُكَ أَعْظَمَ سُورَةٍ فِي الْقُرْآنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَخْرُجَ مِنْ الْمَسْجِدِ؟، فَلَمَّا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ، قَالَ : # الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ سورة الفاتحة آية 2 # وَهِيَ السَّبْعُ الْمَثَانِي، وَالْقُرْآنُ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِي أُوتِيتُمْ "
23.en: Narrated by Bishr ibn Umar al-Zahrani, from Shu'bah, from Khubayb ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Hafs ibn Asim, from Abu Sa'id ibn al-Mu'alla al-Ansari: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by me, and said: 'Did Allah not say: 'O you who believe, respond to Allah and to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life, and know that Allah intervenes between a man and his heart, and that to Him you will be gathered' [Surah al-Anfal, verse 24]?' He said: 'Shall I not teach you the greatest surah in the Qur'an before I leave the mosque?' Then when he intended to leave, he said: 'Al-hamdu lillahi Rabbil-Alameen' [Surah al-Fatihah, verse 2], and it is the seven often-repeated verses, and the Magnificent Qur'an which you have been given."
23.hi: Bishr ibn Umar al-Zahrani ne Shu'bah se, Khubayb ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Hafs ibn Asim se, Abu Sa'id ibn al-Mu'alla al-Ansari se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ mere paas se guzre, aur farmaya: 'Kya Allah ne farmaya nahi: 'Ae imaan walo, Allah aur Rasool ki baat maano jab woh tumhein us cheez ki taraf bulaayein jo tumhein zindagi de, aur jaan lo ke Allah aadmi aur uske dil ke darmiyan hail hota hai, aur ke tum usi ki taraf jama kiye jaaoge' [Surah Al-Anfal, aayat 24]?' Aapne farmaya: 'Kya main tumhein masjid se nikalne se pehle Quran ki sabse azeem surah na sikhaaun?' Fir jab aap nikalne lage, to farmaya: '"Alhamdulillahi Rabbil Aalameen"' [Surah Al-Fatihah, aayat 2], aur yeh saat baar-baar dohraayi jaane wali aayaten hain, aur woh azeem Quran jo tumhein diya gaya hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ  ، عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" فَاتِحَةُ الْكِتَابِ هِيَ السَّبْعُ الْمَثَانِي "
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Abu Usamah, from Abd al-Hamid ibn Ja'far, from al-Ala ibn Abd al-Rahman, from his father, from Abu Hurairah, from Ubayy ibn Ka'b: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The Opening of the Book is the seven often-repeated verses."
23.hi: Muhammad ibn Sa'id ne Abu Usamah se, Abd al-Hamid ibn Ja'far se, al-Ala ibn Abd al-Rahman se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se, Ubayy ibn Ka'b se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Fatihat-ul-Kitaab hi saat baar-baar dohraayi jaane wali aayaten hain."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَا أُنْزِلَتْ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ وَلَا فِي الْإِنْجِيلِ وَالزَّبُورِ وَالْقُرْآنِ مِثْلُهَا يَعْنِي : أُمَّ الْقُرْآنِ وَإِنَّهَا لَسَبْعٌ مِنْ الْمَثَانِي، وَالْقُرْآنُ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِي أُعْطِيتُ "
23.en: Narrated by Nu'aym ibn Hammad, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from al-Ala ibn Abd al-Rahman, from his father, from Abu Hurairah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Nothing like it was revealed in the Torah, nor in the Gospel, nor the Psalms, nor the Qur'an," meaning: the Mother of the Qur'an, "and it is indeed seven of the often-repeated verses, and the Magnificent Qur'an which I was given."
23.hi: Nu'aym ibn Hammad ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se, al-Ala ibn Abd al-Rahman se, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Isi jaisi koi cheez na Taurat mein, na Injeel mein, na Zaboor mein, aur na hi Quran mein nazil hui," yaani: Umm-ul-Quran (Quran ki maa), "aur yeh zaroor saat baar-baar dohraayi jaane wali aayaton mein se hai, aur woh azeem Quran jo mujhe diya gaya."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَلِيٍّ الْحَنَفِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ  ، عَنْ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ أُمُّ الْقُرْآنِ ، وَأُمُّ الْكِتَابِ ، وَالسَّبْعُ الْمَثَانِي "
23.en: Narrated by Abu Ali al-Hanafi, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from al-Maqburi, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "'Al-hamdu lillah' is the Mother of the Qur'an, and the Mother of the Book, and the seven often-repeated verses."
23.hi: Abu Ali al-Hanafi ne Ibn Abi Dhi'b se bataya: Mujhse al-Maqburi ne bataya, Abu Hurairah se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "'Alhamdulillah' Quran ki maa hai, aur Kitaab ki maa hai, aur saat baar-baar dohraayi jaane wali aayaten hain."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا فِطْرٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" مَا مِنْ بَيْتٍ يُقْرَأُ فِيهِ سُورَةُ الْبَقَرَةِ ، إِلَّا خَرَجَ مِنْهُ الشَّيْطَانُ وَلَهُ ضَرِيطٌ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Fitr, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Abdullah: He said: "There is no house in which Surah al-Baqarah is recited, except that the Shaytan leaves it with a fart."
23.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Fitr se, Abu Ishaq se, Abu al-Ahwas se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Koi ghar aisa nahi jismein Surah Al-Baqarah padhi jaaye, magar shaytan usse paad marte hue nikal jaata hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَتْنَا عَبْدَةُ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ  ، قَالَ :" سُورَةُ الْبَقَرَةِ تَعْلِيمُهَا بَرَكَةٌ، وَتَرْكُهَا حَسْرَةٌ، وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُهَا الْبَطَلَةُ، وَهِيَ فُسْطَاطُ الْقُرْآنِ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from Abdah, from Khalid ibn Ma'dan: He said: "Learning Surah al-Baqarah is a blessing, and abandoning it is a regret, and the falsifiers [magicians] cannot manage it, and it is the tent of the Qur'an."
23.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne Abdah se, Khalid ibn Ma'dan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Surah Al-Baqarah seekhna barkat hai, aur isay chhodna afsos hai, aur jadugar isse nahi sambhal sakte, aur yeh Quran ka khaymah hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" إِنَّ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ سَنَامًا، وَإِنَّ سَنَامَ الْقُرْآنِ سُورَةُ الْبَقَرَةِ ، وَإِنَّ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ لُبَابًا، وَإِنَّ لُبَابَ الْقُرْآنِ الْمُفَصَّلُ "" قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : اللُّبَابُ : الْخَالِصُ
23.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Asim, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Asim, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Abdullah; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: That he said: 'Indeed everything has a hump [highest point], and indeed the hump of the Qur'an is Surah al-Baqarah, and indeed everything has a core, and indeed the core of the Qur'an is al-Mufassal [the shorter, later surahs].' Abu Muhammad said: al-lubab is: the pure essence.
23.hi: Amr ibn Asim ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Asim se, Abu al-Ahwas se, Abdullah se bataya: ke unhone kaha, "Har cheez ka ek kohaan (sabse bulund hissa) hota hai, aur Quran ka kohaan Surah Al-Baqarah hai, aur har cheez ka ek maghz hota hai, aur Quran ka maghz al-Mufassal (chhoti baad ki surahen) hain." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: 'Al-Lubab' ka matlab hai: khaalis jauhar.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ طَلْحَةَ ، عَنْ زُبَيْدٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ سُورَةَ الْبَقَرَةِ، تُوِّجَ بِهَا تَاجًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ "
23.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Aban, from Muhammad ibn Talhah, from Zubayd, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Aswad: He said: "Whoever recites Surah al-Baqarah, will be crowned with a crown in Paradise because of it."
23.hi: Isma'il ibn Aban ne Muhammad ibn Talhah se, Zubayd se, Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Aswad se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo Surah Al-Baqarah padhe, usay iski wajah se Jannat mein ek taaj pehnaaya jaayega."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   :" إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ إِذَا سَمِعَ سُورَةَ الْبَقَرَةِ تُقْرَأُ فِي بَيْتٍ، خَرَجَ مِنْهُ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Shu'bah, from Salamah ibn Kuhayl, from Abu al-Ahwas: He said: Abdullah said: "Indeed the Shaytan, when he hears Surah al-Baqarah being recited in a house, leaves it."
23.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Shu'bah se, Salamah ibn Kuhayl se, Abu al-Ahwas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ne kaha: "Shaytan, jab woh kisi ghar mein Surah Al-Baqarah padhi jaate suna, to woh usse nikal jaata hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَيْفَعُ بْنُ عَبْدٍ الْكَلَاعِيُّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَجُلٌ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَيُّ سُورَةِ الْقُرْآنِ أَعْظَمُ؟ قَالَ :" قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ "، قَالَ : فَأَيُّ آيَةٍ فِي الْقُرْآنِ أَعْظَمُ؟ قَالَ : " آيَةُ الْكُرْسِيِّ : # اللَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ سورة البقرة آية 255 #، قَالَ : فَأَيُّ آيَةٍ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ تُحِبُّ أَنْ تُصِيبَكَ وَأُمَّتَكَ؟ قَالَ : خَاتِمَةُ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ ، فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ خَزَائِنِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ، مِنْ تَحْتِ عَرْشِهِ، أَعْطَاهَا هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةَ، لَمْ تَتْرُكْ خَيْرًا مِنْ خَيْرِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ إِلَّا اشْتَمَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from Safwan, from Ayfa ibn Abd al-Kala'i: He said: A man asked: "O Messenger of Allah, which surah of the Qur'an is greatest?" He said: "'Say, He is Allah, One.'" He asked: "Then which verse in the Qur'an is greatest?" He said: "Ayat al-Kursi: 'Allah, there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 255]." He asked: "Then which verse, O Prophet of Allah, do you love to befall you and your nation?" He said: "The closing of Surah al-Baqarah, for it is from the treasures of Allah's mercy, from beneath His Throne, He gave it to this nation, it has not left out any good of the good of this world and the Hereafter except that it includes it."
23.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne Safwan se bataya: Mujhse Ayfa ibn Abd al-Kala'i ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi ne poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, Quran ki kaunsi surah sabse azeem hai?" Aapne farmaya: "'Qul huwa Allahu Ahad.'" Usne poocha: "To Quran mein kaunsi aayat sabse azeem hai?" Aapne farmaya: "Aayat-ul-Kursi: 'Allah, uske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, woh zinda hai, sab kuch sambhaale hue hai' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 255]." Usne poocha: "To Ae Allah ke Nabi, kaunsi aayat aap chaahte hain ke aapko aur aapki ummat ko naseeb ho?" Aapne farmaya: "Surah Al-Baqarah ka khaatma, kyunki yeh Allah ki rehmat ke khazaanon mein se hai, uske Arsh ke neeche se, usne yeh is ummat ko diya, isne duniya aur Aakhirat ki bhalaai mein se koi bhalaai nahi chhodi jo isme shaamil na ho."

23.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ الثَّقَفِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الشَّعْبِيُّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ   :" لَقِيَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ مُحَمَّدٍ رَجُلًا مِنْ الْجِنِّ، فَصَارَعَهُ فَصَرَعَهُ الْإِنْسِيُّ، فَقَالَ لَهُ الْإِنْسِيُّ : إِنِّي لَأَرَاكَ ضَئِيلًا شَخِيتًا، كَأَنَّ ذُرَيِّعَتَيْكَ ذُرَيِّعَتَا كَلْبٍ، فَكَذَلِكَ أَنْتُمْ مَعْشَرَ الْجِنِّ، أَمْ أَنْتَ مِنْ بَيْنِهِمْ كَذَلِكَ؟ قَالَ : لَا وَاللَّهِ، إِنِّي مِنْهُمْ لَضَلِيعٌ؟ وَلَكِنْ عَاوِدْنِي الثَّانِيَةَ، فَإِنْ صَرَعْتَنِي، عَلَّمْتُكَ شَيْئًا يَنْفَعُكَ، فَعَاوَدَهُ، فَصَرَعَهُ، قَالَ : هاتِ عَلِّمْنِي، قَالَ : نَعَمْ، قَالَ : تَقْرَأُ # اللَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ سورة البقرة آية 255 #؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ، قَالَ : فَإِنَّكَ لَا تَقْرَؤُهَا فِي بَيْتٍ، إِلَّا خَرَجَ مِنْهُ الشَّيْطَانُ، لَهُ خَبَجٌ كَخَبَجِ الْحِمَارِ، ثُمَّ لَا يَدْخُلُهُ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : الضَّئِيلُ : الدَّقِيقُ، وَالشَّخِيتُ : الْمَهْزُولُ، وَالضَّلِيعُ : جَيِّدُ الْأَضْلَاع، وَالْخَبَجُ : الرِّيحُ
23.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Abu Asim al-Thaqafi, from al-Sha'bi: He said: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud said: A man from the Companions of Muhammad met a man from the jinn, and wrestled him, and the human threw him down, so the human said to him: I see you as slight and thin, as if your two shins were the shins of a dog, are you all like that, O company of jinn, or are you like that among them alone? He said: No, by Allah, I am indeed one of the strong ones among them, but wrestle with me a second time, and if you throw me down, I will teach you something that will benefit you, so he wrestled him again, and threw him down, so he said: Come, teach me. He said: Yes. He said: Do you recite: Allah, there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 255]? He said, Yes. He said: Then you will never recite it in a house, except that the Shaytan leaves it, with a fart like the fart of a donkey, then he will not enter it until morning. Abu Muhammad said: al-da'il: the thin one, and al-shakhit: the emaciated one, and al-dali': strong-ribbed, and al-khabaj: the wind (i.e., flatulence).
23.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Abu Asim al-Thaqafi se bataya: Humein al-Sha'bi ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ibn Mas'ud ne kaha: "Muhammad ke sahaba mein se ek aadmi ek jinn se mila, to woh usse kushti ladne laga aur insaan ne usay giraa diya, to insaan ne usse kaha: 'Mujhe tum patle aur kamzor lagte ho, goya tumhari donon pindliyaan kutte ki pindliyon jaisi hain, kya tum jinnaat aisi hi hote ho, ya tum hi unmein aise ho?' Usne kaha: 'Nahi, Allah ki qasam, main unmein taakatwar hoon, lekin mujhse doosri baar kushti karo, aur agar tumne mujhe giraa diya, to main tumhein aisi cheez sikhaunga jo tumhein faida degi,' to usne dobara kushti ki, aur usay giraa diya, to usne kaha: 'Le aao, mujhe sikhaao.' Usne kaha: 'Theek hai.' Usne poocha: 'Kya tum padhte ho: 'Allah, uske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, woh zinda hai, sab kuch sambhaale hue hai' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 255]?' Usne kaha, 'Haan.' Usne kaha: 'To tum ise kisi ghar mein kabhi nahi padhoge, magar shaytan usse nikal jaayega, gadhe ke paad jaisi awaaz karte hue, fir woh subah tak usme dakhil nahi hoga.'" Abu Muhammad kehte hain: 'Al-Da'il': patla, aur 'Al-Shakhit': kamzor, aur 'Al-Dali'': mazboot palliyon wala, aur 'Al-Khabaj': hawa (yaani, paad).

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو الْعُمَيْسِ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   :" مَنْ قَرَأَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ، لَمْ يَدْخُلْ ذَلِكَ الْبَيْتَ شَيْطَانٌ تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةَ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ : أَرْبَعًا مِنْ أَوَّلِهَا، وَآيَةُ الْكُرْسِيِّ، وَآيَتَانِ بَعْدَهَا، وَثَلَاثٌ خَوَاتِيمُهَا، أَوَّلُهَا : # لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ وَإِنْ تُبْدُوا مَا فِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ يُحَاسِبْكُمْ بِهِ اللَّهُ فَيَغْفِرُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ سورة البقرة آية 284 # "
23.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Abu al-Umays, from al-Sha'bi: He said: Abdullah said: "Whoever recites ten verses from Surah al-Baqarah in one night, no Shaytan will enter that house that night until morning: four from its beginning, and the Ayat al-Kursi, and two verses after it, and three of its closing verses, its beginning: 'To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. Whether you show what is within yourselves or conceal it, Allah will bring you to account for it. Then He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills, and Allah is over all things competent' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 284]."
23.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Abu al-Umays se bataya: Humein al-Sha'bi ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ne kaha: "Jo ek raat mein Surah Al-Baqarah ki das aayaten padhe, us raat us ghar mein subah tak koi shaytan dakhil nahi hoga: chaar iski shuru se, aur Aayat-ul-Kursi, aur uske baad ki do aayaten, aur teen iski aakhri aayaten, iski shuru: 'Aasmanon aur zameen mein jo kuch hai, sab Allah ka hai. Chahe tum apne dilon mein jo hai zaahir karo ya chhupaao, Allah tumse iska hisaab lega. Fir woh jise chaahe maaf kar deta hai aur jise chaahe azaab deta hai, aur Allah har cheez par qaadir hai' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 284]."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ أَرْبَعَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ ، وَآيَةَ الْكُرْسِيِّ، وَآيَتَانِ بَعْدَ آيَةِ الْكُرْسِيِّ، وَثَلَاثًا مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ ، لَمْ يَقْرَبْهُ وَلَا أَهْلَهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَيْطَانٌ، وَلَا شَيْءٌ يَكْرَهُهُ، وَلَا يُقْرَأْنَ عَلَى مَجْنُونٍ إِلَّا أَفَاقَ "
23.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Asim, from Hammad, from Asim, from al-Sha'bi, from Ibn Mas'ud: He said: "Whoever recites four verses from the beginning of Surah al-Baqarah, and Ayat al-Kursi, and the two verses after Ayat al-Kursi, and three from the end of Surah al-Baqarah, neither he nor his household will be approached that day by any Shaytan, nor anything he dislikes, and they are not recited over an insane person except that he recovers."
23.hi: Amr ibn Asim ne Hammad se, Asim se, al-Sha'bi se, Ibn Mas'ud se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo Surah Al-Baqarah ki shuru ki chaar aayaten, aur Aayat-ul-Kursi, aur Aayat-ul-Kursi ke baad ki do aayaten, aur Surah Al-Baqarah ki aakhri teen aayaten padhe, us din na usay na uske gharwalon ko koi shaytan chhuu sakega, aur na koi na-pasandeeda cheez, aur yeh kisi pagal par padhi jaayein to woh hosh mein aa jaata hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَمَّنْ  سَمِعَ عَلِيًّا  ، يَقُولُ :" مَا كُنْتُ أَرَى أَنَّ أَحَدًا يَعْقِلُ يَنَامُ، حَتَّى يَقْرَأَ هَؤُلَاءِ الْآيَاتِ مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ ، وَإِنَّهُنَّ لَمِنْ كَنْزٍ تَحْتَ الْعَرْشِ "
23.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Abu Ishaq, from someone who heard Ali say: "I never used to think that anyone with any sense could sleep until he recited these verses from the end of Surah al-Baqarah, for they are indeed from a treasure beneath the Throne."
23.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Abu Ishaq se bataya: Us shakhs se jisne Ali (Alayhis Salam) ko kehte suna: "Main kabhi nahi samajhta tha ke koi aqal wala shakhs so sakta hai jab tak woh Surah Al-Baqarah ki in aakhri aayaton ko na padh le, aur yeh Arsh ke neeche ek khazaane mein se hain."

23.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ عِيسَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سِنَانٍ  ، عَنْ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ سُبَيْعٍ  ، وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ الْبَقَرَةِ عِنْدَ مَنَامِهِ، لَمْ يَنْسَ الْقُرْآنَ : أَرْبَعُ آيَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِهَا، وَآيَةُ الْكُرْسِيِّ، وَآيَتَانِ بَعْدَهَا، وَثَلَاثٌ مِنْ آخِرِهَا ".
 قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ : لَمْ يَنْسَ مَا قَدْ حَفِظَ، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : مِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ : الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ سُمَيْعٍ
23.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Isa, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Abu Sinan, from al-Mughirah ibn Subay', who was among the companions of Abdullah; with Ishaq's clarification and Abu Muhammad's note: He said: 'Whoever recites ten verses from al-Baqarah at his sleep, will not forget the Qur'an: four verses from its beginning, and Ayat al-Kursi, and the two verses after it, and three from its end.' Ishaq said: he will not forget what he has memorized. Abu Muhammad said: some of them say: al-Mughirah ibn Sumay'.
23.hi: Ishaq ibn Isa ne Abu al-Ahwas se, Abu Sinan se, al-Mughirah ibn Subay' se bataya, jo Abdullah ke sathiyon mein se the: Unhone kaha, "Jo apne sone se pehle Al-Baqarah ki das aayaten padhe, Quran nahi bhoolega: chaar aayaten iski shuru se, aur Aayat-ul-Kursi, aur uske baad ki do aayaten, aur teen iske aakhir se." Ishaq kehte hain: woh jo yaad kar chuka hai use nahi bhoolega. Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Kuch log kehte hain: al-Mughirah ibn Sumay'.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ عِيسَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ هُوَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَازِمٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُلَيْكِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ آيَةَ الْكُرْسِيِّ، وَفَاتِحَةَ حم الْمُؤْمِنِ إِلَى قَوْلِه # غَافِرِ الذَّنْبِ وَقَابِلِ التَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ الْعِقَابِ ذِي الطَّوْلِ لا إِلَهَ إِلا هُوَ إِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ سورة غافر آية 3 #، لَمْ يَرَ شَيْئًا يَكْرَهُهُ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، وَمَنْ قَرَأَهَا حِينَ يُمْسِي، لَمْ يَرَ شَيْئًا يَكْرَهُهُ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ "
23.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Isa, from Abu Mu'awiyah (Muhammad ibn Khazim), from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakr al-Mulayki, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever recites Ayat al-Kursi, and the opening of Surah Ha-Mim al-Mu'min up to His saying: 'Forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in punishment, extender in favor. There is no deity except Him; to Him is the destination' [Surah Ghafir, verse 3], will not see anything he dislikes until evening, and whoever recites it when evening comes, will not see anything he dislikes until morning."
23.hi: Ishaq ibn Isa ne Abu Mu'awiyah se bataya (Muhammad ibn Khazim): Mujhse Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakr al-Mulayki ne bataya, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo Aayat-ul-Kursi, aur Surah Ha-Mim Al-Mu'min ki shuruaat, uske farman tak: 'Gunah bakhshne wala, tauba qabool karne wala, saza mein sakht, fazl wala. Uske siwa koi ma'bood nahi; usi ki taraf lautna hai' [Surah Ghafir, aayat 3], padhe, woh shaam tak koi na-pasandeeda cheez nahi dekhega, aur jo isay shaam ko padhe, woh subah tak koi na-pasandeeda cheez nahi dekhega."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا أَشْعَثُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْجَرْمِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَشْعَثِ الصَّنْعَانِيِّ  ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ كِتَابًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَخْلُقَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِأَلْفَيْ عَامٍ، فَأَنْزَلَ مِنْهُ آيَتَيْنِ خَتَمَ بِهِمَا سُورَةَ الْبَقَرَةِ ، وَلَا تُقْرَآنِ فِي دَارٍ ثَلَاثَ لَيَالٍ فَيَقْرَبُهَا شَيْطَانٌ "
23.en: Narrated by Affan, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ash'ath ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Jarmi, from Abu Qilabah, from Abu al-Ash'ath al-San'ani, from al-Nu'man ibn Bashir: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed Allah wrote a book two thousand years before He created the heavens and the earth, and He sent down two verses from it, with which He closed Surah al-Baqarah, and they will not be recited in a house for three nights before any Shaytan comes near it."
23.hi: Affan ne Hammad ibn Salamah se bataya: Humein Ash'ath ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Jarmi ne bataya, Abu Qilabah se, Abu al-Ash'ath al-San'ani se, al-Nu'man ibn Bashir se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah ne aasmaanon aur zameen ko banaane se do hazaar saal pehle ek Kitaab likhi, aur usme se do aayaten nazil kin, jinse usne Surah Al-Baqarah khatam ki, aur woh teen raaton tak kisi ghar mein padhi jaayein to koi shaytan uske paas nahi aa sakta."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ الْآيَتَيْنِ الْآخِرَتَيْنِ مِنْ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ، كَفَتَاهُ "
23.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Shu'bah, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid, from Abu Mas'ud, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whoever recites the last two verses of Surah al-Baqarah in one night, they will suffice him."
23.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Shu'bah se, Mansur se, Ibrahim se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid se, Abu Mas'ud se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, "Jo Surah Al-Baqarah ki aakhri do aayaten ek raat mein padhe, yeh usay kaafi ho jaayengi."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي زِيَادٍ  ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ  ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ يَزِيدَ  ، قَالَتْ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" اسْمُ اللَّهِ الْأَعْظَمُ فِي هَاتَيْنِ الْآيَتَيْنِ : # اللَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ سورة البقرة آية 255 #، # وَإِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ سورة البقرة آية 163 # "
