23.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ubaydullah ibn Abi Ziyad, from Shahr ibn Hawshab, from Asma bint Yazid: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah's Greatest Name is in these two verses: 'Allah, there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 255], and 'And your god is one God' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 163]."
23.hi: Abu Asim ne Ubaydullah ibn Abi Ziyad se, Shahr ibn Hawshab se, Asma bint Yazid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah ka sabse azeem naam in do aayaton mein hai: 'Allah, uske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, woh zinda hai, sab kuch sambhaale hue hai' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 255], aur 'Aur tumhara ma'bood ek hi ma'bood hai' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 163]."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُجَاهِدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزَّاهِرِيَّةِ  ، عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَتَمَ سُورَةَ الْبَقَرَةِ بِآيَتَيْنِ أُعْطِيتُهُمَا مِنْ كَنْزِهِ الَّذِي تَحْتَ الْعَرْشِ، فَتَعَلَّمُوهُنَّ وَعَلِّمُوهُنَّ نِسَاءَكُمْ، فَإِنَّهُمَا صَلَاةٌ، وَقُرْآنٌ، وَدُعَاءٌ "
23.en: Narrated by Mujahid ibn Musa, from Ma'n, from Mu'awiyah ibn Salih, from Abu al-Zahiriyyah, from Jubayr ibn Nufayr: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed Allah closed Surah al-Baqarah with two verses, given to me from His treasure that is beneath the Throne, so learn them, and teach them to your women, for they are prayer, and Qur'an, and supplication."
23.hi: Mujahid ibn Musa ne Ma'n se bataya: Humein Mu'awiyah ibn Salih ne bataya, Abu al-Zahiriyyah se, Jubayr ibn Nufayr se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah ne Surah Al-Baqarah ko do aayaton se khatam kiya, jo mujhe uske Arsh ke neeche wale khazaane se di gayi hain, so unhein seekho aur apni auraton ko sikhaao, kyunki yeh namaz hain, aur Quran hain, aur dua hain."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا بَشِيرٌ هُوَ ابْنُ الْمُهَاجِرِ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ جَالِسًا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ :" تَعَلَّمُوا سُورَةَ الْبَقَرَةِ ، فَإِنَّ أَخْذَهَا بَرَكَةٌ، وَتَرْكَهَا حَسْرَةٌ، وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُهَا الْبَطَلَةُ، ثُمَّ سَكَتَ سَاعَةً، ثُمَّ قَالَ : تَعَلَّمُوا سُورَةَ الْبَقَرَةِ ، وَآلِ عِمْرَانَ ، فَإِنَّهُمَا الزَّهْرَاوَانِ، وَإِنَّهُمَا تُظِلَّانِ صَاحِبَهُمَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ كَأَنَّهُمَا غَمَامَتَانِ أَوْ : غَيَايَتَانِ، أَوْ : فِرْقَانِ مِنْ طَيْرٍ صَوَافَّ ، وَإِنَّ الْقُرْآنَ يَلْقَى صَاحِبَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حِينَ يَنْشَقُّ عَنْهُ الْقَبْرُ كَالرَّجُلِ الشَّاحِبِ، فَيَقُولُ لَهُ : هَلْ تَعْرِفُنِي؟ فَيَقُولُ : مَا أَعْرِفُكَ، فَيَقُولُ : أَنَا صَاحِبُكَ الْقُرْآنُ الَّذِي أَظْمَأْتُكَ فِي الْهَوَاجِرِ، وَأَسْهَرْتُ لَيْلَكَ، وَإِنَّ كُلَّ تَاجِرٍ مِنْ وَرَاءِ تِجَارَتِهِ، وَإِنَّكَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ وَرَاءِ كُلِّ تِجَارَةٍ، فَيُعْطَى الْمُلْكَ بِيَمِينِهِ، وَالْخُلْدَ بِشِمَالِهِ، وَيُوضَعُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ تَاجُ الْوَقَارِ، وَيُكْسَى وَالِدَاهُ حُلَّتَيْنِ لَا يُقَوَّمُ لَهُمَا الدُّنْيَا، فَيَقُولَانِ : بِمَ كُسِينَا هَذَا؟ وَيُقَالُ لَهُمَا : بِأَخْذِ وَلَدِكُمَا الْقُرْآنَ، ثُمَّ يُقَالُ لَهُ : اقْرَأْ وَاصْعَدْ فِي دَرَجِ الْجَنَّةِ وَغُرَفِهَا، فَهُوَ فِي صُعُودٍ مَا دَامَ يَقْرَأُ هَذًّا كَانَ، أَوْ تَرْتِيلًا "
23.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Bashir ibn al-Muhajir, from Abdullah ibn Buraydah, from his father: He said: I was sitting with the Prophet ﷺ and I heard him say: "Learn Surah al-Baqarah, for taking it up is a blessing, and abandoning it is a regret, and the falsifiers cannot manage it," then he was silent for a while, then he said: "Learn Surah al-Baqarah, and Aal Imran, for they are the two radiant ones, they will shade their companion on the Day of Resurrection like two clouds, or: two shades, or two flocks of birds in ranks, and indeed the Qur'an meets its companion on the Day of Resurrection, when the grave splits open for him, like a pale man, and it says to him: 'Do you recognize me?' So he says: 'I do not recognize you.' So it says: 'I am your companion, the Qur'an, who made you thirsty in the hot afternoons, and kept you awake at night, and indeed every merchant is behind his trade, and indeed you today are ahead of every trade,' so he is given dominion in his right hand, and eternity in his left, and the crown of dignity is placed on his head, and his two parents are clothed with two garments that the world cannot equal in value, so they say: 'With what were we clothed this?' And it is said to them: 'By your child's taking up the Qur'an,' then it is said to him: 'Recite and ascend through the levels of Paradise and its chambers,' so he keeps ascending as long as he recites, whether reciting fast or with measured recitation."
23.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Bashir ibn al-Muhajir se bataya: Mujhse Abdullah ibn Buraydah ne bataya, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, Main Nabi ﷺ ke paas baitha tha aur maine aapko farmaate suna, "Surah Al-Baqarah seekho, kyunki isay lena barkat hai, aur isay chhodna afsos hai, aur jadugar isse nahi sambhal sakte," fir aap kuch der khamosh rahe, fir farmaya: "Surah Al-Baqarah, aur Aal-e-Imran seekho, kyunki yeh dono roshan surahen hain, yeh Qayamat ke din apne saathi ko chhaanv deti hain jaise woh do baadal hon, ya: do saaye, ya safon mein udte parindon ke do jhund, aur Quran Qayamat ke din apne saathi se milta hai, jab uski qabr uske liye phat jaati hai, jaise ek pila hua aadmi, aur woh usse kehta hai: 'Kya tum mujhe pehchaante ho?' To woh kehta hai: 'Main tumhein nahi pehchaanta.' To woh kehta hai: 'Main tumhaara saathi hoon, Quran, jisne tumhein garmi ki dophar mein pyaasa rakha, aur tumhari raat jagaayi, aur har taajir apni tijaarat ke peechhe hota hai, aur tum aaj har tijaarat se aage ho,' to usay uske daaye haath mein baadshahat, aur baaye mein hamesha rehna diya jaata hai, aur uske sar par waqar ka taaj rakha jaata hai, aur uske maa-baap ko do libaas pehnaaye jaate hain jinki qeemat duniya barabar nahi kar sakti, to woh kehte hain: 'Yeh humein kyun pehnaaya gaya?' Aur unse kaha jaata hai: 'Tumhare bete ke Quran lene ki wajah se,' fir usse kaha jaata hai: 'Padho aur Jannat ke darjon aur uske kamron mein chadho,' to woh chadhta rehta hai jab tak woh padhta rahe, chahe woh tez padhe, ya thehar-thehar kar."

23.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي يَحْيَى سُلَيْمِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ  : أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ  ، يَقُولُ :" إِنَّ أَخًا لَكُمْ أُرِيَ فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنَّ النَّاسَ يَسْلُكُونَ فِي صَدْعِ جَبَلٍ وَعْرٍ طَوِيلٍ، وَعَلَى رَأْسِ الْجَبَلِ شَجَرَتَانِ خَضْرَاوَانِ تَهْتِفَانِ : هَلْ فِيكُمْ مَنْ يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْبَقَرَةِ ؟ هَلْ فِيكُمْ مَنْ يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ آلِ عِمْرَانَ ؟ فَإِذَا قَالَ الرَّجُلُ : نَعَمْ، دَنَتَا بِأَعْذَاقِهِمَا حَتَّى يَتَعَلَّقَ بِهِمَا، فَتَخْطِرَانِ بِهِ الْجَبَلَ ".
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : الْأَعْذَاقُ : الْأَغْصَانُ
23.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from Mu'awiyah, from Abu Yahya Sulaym ibn Amir: That he heard Abu Umamah say: Indeed a brother of yours was shown in a dream that people were passing through a crack in a long, rugged mountain, and at the top of the mountain were two green trees calling out: Is there among you anyone who recites Surah al-Baqarah? Is there among you anyone who recites Surah Aal Imran? So when a man said: Yes, the two trees would bring their branches close until he could hold onto them, and they would swing him over the mountain. Abu Muhammad said: al-a'dhaq: the branches.
23.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne Mu'awiyah se bataya: Mujhse Abu Yahya Sulaym ibn Amir ne bataya: ke unhone Abu Umamah ko kehte suna: "Tumhare ek bhai ko khwaab mein dikhaaya gaya ke log ek lambi, uncha-neecha pahaad ki dara-daraar se guzar rahe hain, aur pahaad ki chotii par do hari daraakhtein hain jo pukaar rahi hain: 'Kya tum mein koi hai jo Surah Al-Baqarah padhta ho? Kya tum mein koi hai jo Surah Aal-e-Imran padhta ho?' To jab koi aadmi kehta: 'Haan,' to woh dono darakht apni shaakhein qareeb kar dete yahan tak ke woh unse chipak jaata, to woh use pahaad se pass karva dete." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: 'Al-A'dhaq' ka matlab hai: shaakhein.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الرَّقِّيُّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : " قَرَأَ رَجُلٌ عِنْدَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَقَرَةَ ، وَآلَ عِمْرَانَ ، فَقَالَ :قَرَأْتَ سُورَتَيْنِ فِيهِمَا اسْمُ اللَّهِ الْأَعْظَمُ الَّذِي إِذَا دُعِيَ بِهِ، أَجَابَ، وَإِذَا سُئِلَ بِهِ أَعْطَى "
23.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Raqqi, from Ubaydullah ibn Amr, from Zayd, from Jabir, from Abu al-Duha, from Masruq, from Abdullah: He said: "A man recited al-Baqarah, and Aal Imran, in the presence of Abdullah, so he said: 'You have recited two surahs which contain Allah's Greatest Name, which, when called upon by it, He answers, and when asked by it, He gives.'"
23.hi: Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Raqqi ne Ubaydullah ibn Amr se, Zayd se, Jabir se, Abu al-Duha se, Masruq se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Ek aadmi ne Abdullah ke saamne Al-Baqarah, aur Aal-e-Imran padhi, to unhone kaha: 'Tumne do surahen padhi hain jinmein Allah ka sabse azeem naam hai, jise pukaara jaaye to woh jawaab deta hai, aur jise maanga jaaye to woh deta hai.'"

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، عَنْ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عَطَّافٍ L275 ،  عَنْ كَعْبٍ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ الْبَقَرَةَ ، وَآلَ عِمْرَانَ ، جَاءَتَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تَقُولَانِ : رَبَّنَا لَا سَبِيلَ عَلَيْهِ "
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Abd al-Salam ibn Harb, from al-Jurayri, from Abu Attaf, from Ka'b: He said: "Whoever recites al-Baqarah, and Aal Imran, they will come on the Day of Resurrection saying: 'Our Lord, no way against him.'"
23.hi: Muhammad ibn Sa'id ne Abd al-Salam ibn Harb se, al-Jurayri se, Abu Attaf se, Ka'b se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo Al-Baqarah, aur Aal-e-Imran padhe, yeh dono Qayamat ke din aakar kahengi: 'Humare Rab, iske khilaaf koi raasta nahi.'"

23.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمِ بْنِ حَنْظَلَةَ الْبَكْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ   :" مَنْ قَرَأَ آلَ عِمْرَانَ ، فَهُوَ غَنِيٌّ، وَالنِّسَاءُ مُحَبِّرَةٌ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : مُحَبِّرَةٌ : مُزَيِّنَةٌ
23.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Isra'il, from Abu Ishaq, from Sulaym ibn Hanzalah al-Bakri; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud said: 'Whoever recites Aal Imran, is wealthy, and the women are adorned.' Abu Muhammad said: muhabbirah means: adorned.
23.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Isra'il se, Abu Ishaq se, Sulaym ibn Hanzalah al-Bakri se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ibn Mas'ud ne kaha: 'Jo Aal-e-Imran padhe, woh maal-daar hai, aur auratein sajii-savari hain.' Abu Muhammad kehte hain: 'Muhabbirah' ka matlab hai: sajii hui.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ عِيسَى  ، عَنْ ابْنِ لَهِيعَةَ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ  ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ آخِرَ آلِ عِمْرَانَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ، كُتِبَ لَهُ قِيَامُ لَيْلَةٍ "
23.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Isa, from Ibn Lahi'ah, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Abu al-Khayr, from Uthman ibn Affan: He said: "Whoever recites the end of Aal Imran in one night, will have the standing of the night [in prayer] written for him."
23.hi: Ishaq ibn Isa ne Ibn Lahi'ah se, Yazid ibn Abi Habib se, Abu al-Khayr se, Uthman ibn Affan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo Aal-e-Imran ka aakhri hissa ek raat mein padhe, uske liye raat ke qayam (namaz) ka sawaab likha jaayega."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ سُورَةَ آلِ عِمْرَانَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ، صَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ "
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak, from Sadaqah ibn Khalid, from Yahya ibn al-Harith, from Makhul: He said: "Whoever recites Surah Aal Imran on Friday, the angels send blessings upon him until night."
23.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak ne Sadaqah ibn Khalid se, Yahya ibn al-Harith se, Makhul se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo Jumee ke din Surah Aal-e-Imran padhe, farishtay raat tak uspar dua bhejte rehte hain."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ سَلَّامٍ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ الْأَشْجَعِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي مِسْعَرٌ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي جَابِرٌ  ، قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقَعَ فِيمَا وَقَعَ فِيهِ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   :" نِعْمَ كَنْزُ الصُّعْلُوكِ سُورَةُ آلِ عِمْرَانَ ، يَقُومُ بِهَا فِي آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ "
23.en: Narrated by al-Qasim ibn Sallam Abu Ubayd, from Ubaydullah al-Ashja'i, from Mis'ar, from Jabir (before he fell into what he fell into), from al-Sha'bi: He said: Abdullah said: "What a fine treasure for the destitute is Surah Aal Imran, he stands with it at the end of the night."
23.hi: Al-Qasim ibn Sallam Abu Ubayd ne Ubaydullah al-Ashja'i se bataya: Mujhse Mis'ar ne bataya: Mujhse Jabir ne bataya - us waqt se pehle jab woh us cheez mein pade jisme woh pade - al-Sha'bi se: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ne kaha: "Gareeb ke liye kya khoob khazaana hai Surah Aal-e-Imran, woh isse raat ke aakhir mein khada rehta hai."

23.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ ،  عَنْ أَبِي السَّلِيلِ ، قَالَ : أَصَابَ رَجُلٌ دَمًا، قَالَ : فَأَوَى إِلَى وَادِي مَجَنَّةٍ : وَادٍ لَا يُمْسِي فِيهِ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا أَصَابَتْهُ حَيَّةٌ : وَعَلَى شَفِيرِ الْوَادِي رَاهِبَانِ، قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا لِصَاحِبِهِ : هَلَكَ وَاللَّهِ الرَّجُلُ، قَالَ :فَافْتَتَحَ سُورَةَ آلِ عِمْرَانَ ، قَالَا : فَقَرَأَ سُورَةً طَيِّبَةً لَعَلَّهُ سَيَنْجُو، قَالَ : فَأَصْبَحَ سَلِيمًا ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : أَبُو السَّلِيلِ : ضُرَيْبُ بْنُ نُقَيْرٍ، ويقال : ابن نفير
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Abd al-Salam, from al-Jurayri, from Abu al-Salil; with Abu Muhammad's identification: He said: A man committed bloodshed [killing], he said: So he took refuge in the valley of Majannah: a valley in which no one spent the night except that a snake bit him: and on the edge of the valley were two monks, one of them said to his companion: By Allah, the man is doomed, he said: So he began Surah Aal Imran, they both said: He recited a fine surah, perhaps he will be saved, he said: So he woke up unharmed. Abu Muhammad said: Abu al-Salil is: Durayb ibn Nuqayr, and it is also said: Ibn Nufayr.
23.hi: Muhammad ibn Sa'id ne Abd al-Salam se, al-Jurayri se, Abu al-Salil se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi ne khoon kar diya, unhone bataya: To woh Majannah waadi mein panaah lene gaya: ek aisi waadi jismein koi bhi raat guzaare to usay saanp kaat leta: aur waadi ke kinare do sannyaasi the, unmein se ek ne apne saathi se kaha: "Allah ki qasam, aadmi barbaad ho gaya," unhone bataya: To usne Surah Aal-e-Imran shuru ki, dono ne kaha: Usne ek achhi surah padhi, shaayad woh bach jaaye, unhone bataya: To woh subah salaamat uthaa. Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Abu al-Salil: Durayb ibn Nuqayr hain, aur unhein Ibn Nufayr bhi kaha jaata hai.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ  ، عَنْ الْمُسَيَّبِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   :" السَّبْعُ الطُّوَلُ مِثْلُ التَّوْرَاةِ، وَالْمِئِينَ مِثْلُ الْإِنْجِيلِ، وَالْمَثَانِي مِثْلُ الزَّبُورِ، وَسَائِرُ الْقُرْآنِ بَعْدُ فَضْلٌ "
23.en: Narrated by Mu'adh ibn Hani', from Ibrahim ibn Tahman, from Asim, from al-Musayyab ibn Rafi': He said: Abdullah said: "The seven long surahs are like the Torah, and the hundreds [surahs] are like the Gospel, and the often-repeated ones are like the Psalms, and the rest of the Qur'an after that is extra virtue."
23.hi: Mu'adh ibn Hani' ne Ibrahim ibn Tahman se, Asim se, al-Musayyab ibn Rafi' se bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ne kaha: "Saat lambi surahen Taurat jaisi hain, aur sau-sau aayat wali (surahen) Injeel jaisi hain, aur baar-baar dohraayi jaane wali surahen Zaboor jaisi hain, aur baaki Quran uske baad izaafi fazeelat hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ خَلِيفَةَ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" الْأَنْعَامُ مِنْ نَوَاجِبِ الْقُرْآنِ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zuhayr, from Abu Ishaq, from Abdullah ibn Khalifah, from Umar: He said: "Surah al-An'am is among the obligatory-quality surahs of the Qur'an."
23.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zuhayr se, Abu Ishaq se, Abdullah ibn Khalifah se, Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Surah Al-An'am Quran ki zaroori (khaas) surahon mein se hai."

23.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  .
عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ كَعْبًا  ، قَالَ :" فَاتِحَةُ التَّوْرَاةِ الْأَنْعَامُ ، وَخَاتِمَتُهَا هُودٌ "
23.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Hammam, from Abu Imran al-Jawni, from Abdullah ibn Rabah: He said: I heard Ka'b say: "The opening of the Torah is [like] al-An'am, and its closing is [like] Hud."
23.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Hammam se bataya: Abu Imran al-Jawni se, Abdullah ibn Rabah se: Unhone kaha, Maine Ka'b ko kehte suna: "Taurat ki shuruaat Al-An'am [jaisi] hai, aur uski khatam Hud [jaisi] hai."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ  ، عَنْ كَعْبٍ   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" اقْرَءُوا سُورَةَ هُودٍ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ "
23.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hammam, from Abu Imran al-Jawni, from Abdullah ibn Rabah, from Ka'b: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "Recite Surah Hud on Friday."
23.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hammam se, Abu Imran al-Jawni se, Abdullah ibn Rabah se, Ka'b se bataya: ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jumee ke din Surah Hud padho."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيُّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ  ، عَنْ كَعْبٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" اقْرَءُوا سُورَةَ هُودٍ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ "
23.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Hammam, from Abu Imran al-Jawni, from Abdullah ibn Rabah, from Ka'b: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Recite Surah Hud on Friday."
23.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Hammam se, Abu Imran al-Jawni se, Abdullah ibn Rabah se, Ka'b se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jumee ke din Surah Hud padho."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَتْنَا عَبْدَةُ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ الْكَهْفِ ، لَمْ يَخَفْ الدَّجَّالَ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from Abdah, from Khalid ibn Ma'dan: He said: "Whoever recites ten verses from al-Kahf, will not fear the Dajjal [Antichrist]."
23.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne Abdah se, Khalid ibn Ma'dan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo Al-Kahf ki das aayaten padhe, Dajjal se nahi darega."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدَةَ  ، عَنْ زِرِّ بْنِ حُبَيْشٍ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ آخِرَ سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ لِسَاعَةٍ، يُرِيدُ يَقُومُ مِنْ اللَّيْلِ، قَامَهَا "، قَالَ عَبْدَةُ : فَجَرَّبْنَاهُ، فَوَجَدْنَاهُ كَذَلِكَ
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir, from al-Awza'i, from Abdah, from Zirr ibn Hubaysh: He said: Whoever recites the end of Surah al-Kahf at a specific hour, intending to stand in prayer at night, will stand it. Abdah said: So we tried it, and found it to be so.
23.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir ne al-Awza'i se, Abdah se, Zirr ibn Hubaysh se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo Surah Al-Kahf ka aakhri hissa ek khaas ghante mein padhe, raat ko namaz padhne ke irade se, to woh usay pooraa kar paayega." Abdah kehte hain: To humne isay aazmaaya, aur isay waisa hi paaya.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هَاشِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ  ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ عُبَادٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ سُورَةَ الْكَهْفِ لَيْلَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ، أَضَاءَ لَهُ مِنْ النُّورِ فِيمَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْبَيْتِ الْعَتِيقِ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hushaym, from Abu Hashim, from Abu Mijlaz, from Qays ibn Ubad, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: He said: "Whoever recites Surah al-Kahf on the night of Friday, light will shine for him between him and the Ancient House."
23.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hushaym se, Abu Hashim se, Abu Mijlaz se, Qays ibn Ubad se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo Jumee ki raat Surah Al-Kahf padhe, uske liye uske aur Baitullah al-Atiq ke darmiyan noor chamkega."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَتْنَا عَبْدَةُ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ  ، قَالَ :" اقْرَءُوا الْمُنَجِّيَةَ، وَهِيَ : ( الم تَنْزِيلُ )، فَإِنَّهُ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ رَجُلًا كَانَ يَقْرَؤُهَا مَا يَقْرَأُ شَيْئًا غَيْرَهَا، وَكَانَ كَثِيرَ الْخَطَايَا، فَنَشَرَتْ جَنَاحَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَقَالَتْ : رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يُكْثِرُ قِرَاءَتِي، فَشَفَّعَهَا الرَّبُّ فِيهِ، وَقَالَ : اكْتُبُوا لَهُ بِكُلِّ خَطِيئَةٍ حَسَنَةً، وَارْفَعُوا لَهُ دَرَجَةً "
23.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from Abdah, from Khalid ibn Ma'dan: He said: "Recite the savior [surah], and it is: 'Alif Lam Meem. Tanzil' [Surah al-Sajdah], for it has reached me that a man used to recite it and nothing else, and he had many sins, so it spread its wing over him, and said: 'My Lord, forgive him, for he used to recite me often,' so the Lord accepted its intercession for him, and said: 'Write for him a good deed for every sin, and raise him a level.'"
23.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne Abdah se, Khalid ibn Ma'dan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Bacha lene wali (surah) padho, aur woh hai: 'Alif Laam Meem. Tanzeel' [Surah Al-Sajdah], kyunki mujhe khabar mili hai ke ek aadmi isay padhta tha aur kuch aur nahi padhta tha, aur uske kaafi gunah the, to usne apna par uspar phaila diya, aur kaha: 'Mere Rab, isay bakhsh de, kyunki yeh mujhe bahut padhta tha,' to Rab ne uski sifarish uske liye qabool ki, aur farmaya: 'Uske liye har gunah ke badle ek naiki likho, aur usay ek darjaa bulund karo.'"

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، أنبأنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ضَمْرَةَ  ، عَنْ كَعْبٍ   قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ ( ألم تَنْزِيلُ ) السَّجْدَةَ ، وَتَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ، كُتِبَ لَهُ سَبْعُونَ حَسَنَةً، وَحُطَّ عَنْهُ بِهَا سَبْعُونَ سَيِّئَةً، وَرُفِعَ لَهُ بِهَا سَبْعُونَ دَرَجَةً "
23.en: Narrated by Affan, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Abdullah ibn Damrah, from Ka'b: He said: "Whoever recites 'Alif Lam Meem Tanzil' [Surah] al-Sajdah, and 'Tabarak alladhi biyadihil-mulk' [Surah al-Mulk], seventy good deeds will be written for him, and seventy bad deeds will be removed from him because of it, and he will be raised seventy levels because of it."
23.hi: Affan ne Hammad ibn Salamah se bataya: Humein Abu al-Zubayr ne bataya, Abdullah ibn Damrah se, Ka'b se: Unhone kaha, "Jo 'Alif Laam Meem Tanzeel' [Surah] Al-Sajdah, aur 'Tabaraka-alladhi biyadihil-mulk' [Surah Al-Mulk] padhe, uske liye sattar naikiyaan likhi jaayengi, aur usme sattar gunah mitaaye jaayenge, aur usay isse sattar darje bulund kiye jaayenge."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  : أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا خَالِدٍ عَامِرَ بْنَ جَشِيبٍ  ، وَبَحِيرَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ  ، يُحَدِّثَانِ : أَنَّ خَالِدَ بْنَ مَعْدَانَ  ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ # الم { 1 } تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ لا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ { 2 } سورة السجدة آية 1-2 # تُجَادِلُ عَنْ صَاحِبِهَا فِي الْقَبْرِ، تَقُولُ : اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتُ مِنْ كِتَابِكَ، فَشَفِّعْنِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ لَمْ أَكُنْ مِنْ كِتَابِكَ، فَامْحُنِي عَنْهُ، وَإِنَّهَا تَكُونُ كَالطَّيْرِ تَجْعَلُ جَنَاحَهَا عَلَيْهِ، فَيُشْفَعُ لَهُ، فَتَمْنَعُهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَفِي ( تَبَارَكَ ) مِثْلَهُ"، فَكَانَ خَالِدٌ لَا يَبِيتُ حَتَّى يَقْرَأَ بِهِمَا
23.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from Mu'awiyah ibn Salih: That he heard Abu Khalid Amir ibn Jashib, and Bahir ibn Sa'd, narrating: that Khalid ibn Ma'dan said: "Indeed 'Alif Lam Meem, the revelation of the Book, about which there is no doubt, is from the Lord of the worlds' [Surah al-Sajdah, verses 1-2] argues on behalf of its companion in the grave, saying: 'O Allah, if I am from Your Book, then let me intercede for him, and if I am not from Your Book, then erase me from him,' and it becomes like a bird placing its wing over him, so it is allowed to intercede for him, and it protects him from the punishment of the grave, and in [Surah] Tabarak is the like of it," so Khalid never spent a night without reciting them both.
23.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne Mu'awiyah ibn Salih se bataya: ke unhone Abu Khalid Amir ibn Jashib, aur Bahir ibn Sa'd ko bayaan karte suna: ke Khalid ibn Ma'dan ne kaha: "Sun lo, 'Alif Laam Meem, is Kitaab ka nazil hona, jismein koi shak nahi, jahaanon ke Rab ki taraf se hai' [Surah Al-Sajdah, aayat 1-2] apne saathi ki taraf se qabr mein bahas karti hai, kehti hai: 'Ae Allah, agar main teri Kitaab mein se hoon, to mujhe iske liye sifarish karne de, aur agar main teri Kitaab mein se nahi hoon, to mujhe isse mita de,' aur yeh ek parinde ki tarah ho jaati hai jo apna par usper daal deti hai, to usay iski sifarish karne ki ijaazat di jaati hai, aur yeh usay qabr ke azaab se bachaati hai, aur (Surah) Tabarak mein bhi aisi hi baat hai," so Khalid kabhi raat nahi guzaarte the bagair in dono ko padhe hue.

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" لَا يَنَامُ حَتَّى يَقْرَأَ : ( تَنْزِيلُ ) السَّجْدَةَ ، ( وَتَبَارَكَ ) "
23.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from Layth, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir: He said: The Prophet ﷺ "never slept until he recited: 'Tanzil' al-Sajdah, [and] 'Tabarak'."
23.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se, Layth se, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ "kabhi tab tak nahi sote the jab tak: 'Tanzeel' Al-Sajdah, [aur] 'Tabarak' na padh lein."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ ، قَالَ :" فُضِّلَتَا عَلَى كُلِّ سُورَةٍ فِي الْقُرْآنِ بِسِتِّينَ حَسَنَةً "
23.en: Narrated by Musa ibn Khalid, from Mu'tamir, from Layth, from Tawus: He said: "These two [surahs] are preferred over every surah in the Qur'an by sixty good deeds."
23.hi: Musa ibn Khalid ne Mu'tamir se, Layth se, Tawus se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Yeh dono (surahen) Quran ki har surah par sath naikiyon se afzal hain."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ مُرَّةَ ، يَقُولُ :" أُتِيَ رَجُلٌ فِي قَبْرِهِ، فَأُتِيَ جَانِبُ قَبْرِهِ، فَجَعَلَتْ سُورَةٌ مِنْ الْقُرْآنِ ثَلَاثُونَ آيَةً تُجَادِلُ عَنْهُ، حَتَّى قَالَ : فَنَظَرْنَا أَنَا وَمَسْرُوقٌ، فَلَمْ نَجِدْ فِي الْقُرْآنِ سُورَةً ثَلَاثِينَ آيَةً إِلَّا تَبَارَكَ "
23.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Shu'bah, from Amr ibn Murrah: He said: I heard Murrah say: "A man was approached in his grave, and the side of his grave was approached, so a surah from the Qur'an with thirty verses began arguing on his behalf," until he said: So Masruq and I looked, and we did not find in the Qur'an a surah of thirty verses except [Surah] Tabarak.
23.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Shu'bah se bataya: Mujhse Amr ibn Murrah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Murrah ko kehte suna: "Ek aadmi ke paas uski qabr mein aaya gaya, aur uski qabr ke pehlu mein aaya gaya, to Quran ki teen tees aayaton wali ek surah uski taraf se bahas karne lagi," yahan tak ke unhone kaha: To maine aur Masruq ne dekha, aur humein Quran mein teen tees aayaton wali koi surah na mili siwaay (Surah) Tabarak ke.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُهَاجِرِ بْنِ الْمِسْمَارِ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ حَفْصِ بْنِ ذَكْوَانَ  ، عَنْ مَوْلَى الْحُرَقَةِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى قَرَأَ طه ، وَيس قَبْلَ أَنْ يَخْلُقَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِأَلْفِ عَامٍ، فَلَمَّا سَمِعَتْ الْمَلَائِكَةُ الْقُرْآنَ، قَالَتْ : طُوبَى لِأُمَّةٍ يَنْزِلُ هَذَا عَلَيْهَا، وَطُوبَى لِأَجْوَافٍ تَحْمِلُ هَذَا، وَطُوبَى لِأَلْسِنَةٍ تَتَكَلَّمُ بِهَذَا "
23.en: Narrated by Ibrahim ibn al-Mundhir, from Ibrahim ibn al-Muhajir ibn al-Mismar, from Umar ibn Hafs ibn Dhakwan, from the freed slave of al-Huraqah, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah, blessed and exalted is He, recited Ta-Ha, and Ya-Sin, a thousand years before He created the heavens and the earth, so when the angels heard the Qur'an, they said: 'Blessed is the nation upon whom this will be revealed, and blessed are the bellies that carry this, and blessed are the tongues that speak this.'"
23.hi: Ibrahim ibn al-Mundhir ne Ibrahim ibn al-Muhajir ibn al-Mismar se bataya: Humein Umar ibn Hafs ibn Dhakwan ne bataya, al-Huraqah ke azaad kiye hue ghulam se, Abu Hurairah se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah, Tabaraka wa Ta'ala, ne aasmaanon aur zameen ko banaane se ek hazaar saal pehle Ta-Ha, aur Ya-Seen padhi, to jab farishton ne Quran suna, unhone kaha: 'Mubaarak hai woh ummat jispar yeh nazil hoga, aur mubaarak hain woh pet jo isay uthaate hain, aur mubaarak hain woh zubaanein jo isay kehti hain.'"

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : بَلَغَنِي عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ ( يس ) فِي لَيْلَةٍ، ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ اللَّهِ أَوْ مَرْضَاةِ اللَّهِ، غُفِرَ لَهُ، وَقَالَ : بَلَغَنِي أَنَّهَا تَعْدِلُ الْقُرْآنَ كُلَّهُ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid Musa ibn Khalid, from Mu'tamir, from his father: He said: It reached me, from al-Hasan, he said: "Whoever recites [Surah] Ya-Sin in a night, seeking Allah's face or Allah's pleasure, will be forgiven," and he said: It has reached me that it is equivalent to the entire Qur'an.
23.hi: Abu al-Walid Musa ibn Khalid ne Mu'tamir se bataya: Mujhse unke walid ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe al-Hasan se khabar mili, unhone kaha: "Jo (Surah) Ya-Seen ek raat mein Allah ka chehra ya Allah ki khushnoodi talaash karte hue padhe, usay bakhsh diya jaayega," aur unhone kaha: Mujhe khabar mili hai ke yeh poore Quran ke barabar hai.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ هَارُونَ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ مُقَاتِلِ بْنِ حَيَّانَ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَلْبًا، وَإِنَّ قَلْبَ الْقُرْآنِ يس، مَنْ قَرَأَهَا فَكَأَنَّمَا قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ عَشْرَ مِرارٍ "
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman, from al-Hasan ibn Salih, from Harun Abu Muhammad, from Muqatil ibn Hayyan, from Qatadah, from Anas: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed everything has a heart, and the heart of the Qur'an is Ya-Sin, whoever recites it, it is as if he recited the Qur'an ten times."
23.hi: Muhammad ibn Sa'id ne Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman se, al-Hasan ibn Salih se, Harun Abu Muhammad se, Muqatil ibn Hayyan se, Qatadah se, Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Har cheez ka ek dil hota hai, aur Quran ka dil Ya-Seen hai, jo isay padhe, goya usne Quran das martaba padha."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي  ، حَدَّثَنِي زِيَادُ بْنُ خَيْثَمَةَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُحَادَةَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ يس فِي لَيْلَةٍ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ اللَّهِ، غُفِرَ لَهُ فِي تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةِ "
23.en: Narrated by al-Walid ibn Shuja', from his father, from Ziyad ibn Khaythamah, from Muhammad ibn Juhadah, from al-Hasan, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever recites Ya-Sin in a night seeking Allah's face, will be forgiven that night."
23.hi: Al-Walid ibn Shuja' ne apne walid se bataya: Mujhe Ziyad ibn Khaythamah ne bataya, Muhammad ibn Juhadah se, al-Hasan se, Abu Hurairah se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo raat mein Allah ka chehra chaahte hue Ya-Seen padhe, us raat usay bakhsh diya jaayega."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي  ، حَدَّثَنِي زِيَادُ بْنُ خَيْثَمَةَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُحَادَةَ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ  ، قَالَ : بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ يس فِي صَدْرِ النَّهَارِ، قُضِيَتْ حَوَائِجُهُ "
23.en: Narrated by al-Walid ibn Shuja', from his father, from Ziyad ibn Khaythamah, from Muhammad ibn Juhadah, from Ata ibn Abi Rabah: He said: It reached me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever recites Ya-Sin at the start of the day, his needs will be fulfilled."
23.hi: Al-Walid ibn Shuja' ne apne walid se bataya: Mujhe Ziyad ibn Khaythamah ne bataya, Muhammad ibn Juhadah se, Ata ibn Abi Rabah se: Unhone kaha, Mujhe khabar mili hai ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo din ke shuru mein Ya-Seen padhe, uski zarooratein poori ki jaayengi."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا رَاشِدٌ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ الْحِمَّانِيُّ  ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ   :" مَنْ قَرَأَ ( يس ) حِينَ يُصْبِحُ، أُعْطِيَ يُسْرَ يَوْمِهِ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، وَمَنْ قَرَأَهَا فِي صَدْرِ لَيْلِهِ، أُعْطِيَ يُسْرَ لَيْلَتِهِ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ "
23.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Zurarah, from Abd al-Wahhab, from Rashid Abu Muhammad al-Himmani, from Shahr ibn Hawshab: He said: Ibn Abbas said: "Whoever recites [Surah] Ya-Sin at dawn, will be given the ease of his day until evening, and whoever recites it at the start of his night, will be given the ease of his night until morning."
23.hi: Amr ibn Zurarah ne Abd al-Wahhab se, Rashid Abu Muhammad al-Himmani se, Shahr ibn Hawshab se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ibn Abbas ne kaha: "Jo subah (Surah) Ya-Seen padhe, usay shaam tak apne din ki aasaani di jaayegi, aur jo apni raat ke shuru mein isay padhe, usay subah tak apni raat ki aasaani di jaayegi."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل ،  عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عِيسَى ، قَالَ : أُخْبِرْتُ أَنَّهُ" مَنْ قَرَأَ ( حم ) الدُّخَانَ لَيْلَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِيمَانًا وَتَصْدِيقًا بِهَا، أَصْبَحَ مَغْفُورًا لَهُ "
23.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Isma'il, from Abdullah ibn Isa: He said: I was informed that: "Whoever recites [Surah] Ha-Mim al-Dukhan on the night of Friday with faith and belief in it, will wake up forgiven."
23.hi: Ya'la ne Isma'il se, Abdullah ibn Isa se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe bataaya gaya ke: "Jo Jumee ki raat (Surah) Ha-Mim Ad-Dukhan imaan aur uski tasdeeq ke saath padhe, woh subah bakhsha hua uthega."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ ( حم ) الدُّخَانَ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ، أَصْبَحَ مَغْفُورًا لَهُ، وَزُوِّجَ مِنْ الْحُورِ الْعِينِ "
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak, from Sadaqah ibn Khalid, from Yahya ibn al-Harith, from Abu Rafi': He said: "Whoever recites [Surah] Ha-Mim al-Dukhan on the night of Friday, will wake up forgiven, and will be married to the wide-eyed maidens."
23.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak ne Sadaqah ibn Khalid se, Yahya ibn al-Harith se, Abu Rafi' se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo Jumee ki raat (Surah) Ha-Mim Ad-Dukhan padhe, woh subah bakhsha hua uthega, aur uska nikaah huron se kiya jaayega."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" كُنَّ ! الْحَوَامِيمُ يُسَمَّيْنَ الْعَرَائِسَ "
23.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Mis'ar, from Sa'd ibn Ibrahim: He said: "The Ha-Mim [surahs] used to be called al-'Ara'is [the brides]."
23.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Mis'ar se, Sa'd ibn Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Ha-Mim (surahon) ko 'Al-Araa'is' (dulhanein) kaha jaata tha."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ ثَلَاثَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْحَشْرِ إِذَا أَصْبَحَ، فَمَاتَ مِنْ يَوْمِهِ ذَلِكَ، طُبِعَ بِطَابَعِ الشُّهَدَاءِ، وَإِنْ قَرَأَ إِذَا أَمْسَى، فَمَاتَ مِنْ لَيْلَتِهِ، طُبِعَ بِطَابَعِ الشُّهَدَاءِ "
23.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Hisham, from al-Hasan: He said: "Whoever recites three verses from the end of Surah al-Hashr when he wakes up, and dies that day, is stamped with the seal of the martyrs, and if he recites them when evening comes, and dies that night, he is stamped with the seal of the martyrs."
23.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Hisham se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo Surah Al-Hashr ki aakhri teen aayaten subah padhe, aur usi din mar jaaye, to usay shuhada ki mohar lagaayi jaayegi, aur agar woh unhein shaam ko padhe, aur usi raat mar jaaye, to usay shuhada ki mohar lagaayi jaayegi."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ عِيسَى  ، عَنْ مَعْنٍ  ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ بَحِيرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : أَنَّهُ كَانَ " يَقْرَأُ الْمُسَبِّحَاتِ عِنْدَ النَّوْمِ، وَيَقُولُ :" إِنَّ فِيهِنَّ آيَةً تَعْدِلُ أَلْفَ آيَةٍ "
23.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Isa, from Ma'n, from Mu'awiyah ibn Salih, from Bahir ibn Sa'd, from Khalid ibn Ma'dan, from the Prophet ﷺ: That he used to "recite the glorifying [Musabbihat] surahs before sleep, and would say: 'In them there is a verse equivalent to a thousand verses.'"
23.hi: Ishaq ibn Isa ne Ma'n se, Mu'awiyah ibn Salih se, Bahir ibn Sa'd se, Khalid ibn Ma'dan se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: ke aap "sone se pehle Musabbihat (tasbih wali) surahen padhte, aur farmaate: 'Inmein ek aayat hai jo hazaar aayaton ke barabar hai.'"

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَرَجِ الْبَغْدَادِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ أَبُو الْعَلَاءِ الْخَفَّافُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعُ بْنُ أَبِي نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ مَعْقِلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يُصْبِحُ : أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنْ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ، وَثَلَاثَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْحَشْرِ، وَكَّلَ اللَّهُ بِهِ سَبْعِينَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، وَإِنْ قَالَهَا مَسَاءً، فَمِثْلُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ "
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Faraj al-Baghdadi, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr, from Khalid ibn Tahman Abu al-Ala al-Khaffaf, from Nafi' ibn Abi Nafi', from Ma'qil ibn Yasar, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whoever says when he wakes up: 'A'udhu billahis-sami'il-'alimi minash-shaytanir-rajim' [I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from the accursed Shaytan], and three verses from the end of Surah al-Hashr, Allah appoints for him seventy thousand angels who send blessings upon him until evening, and if he says it in the evening, likewise until morning."
23.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Faraj al-Baghdadi ne Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr se bataya: Humein Khalid ibn Tahman Abu al-Ala al-Khaffaf ne bataya: Mujhe Nafi' ibn Abi Nafi' ne bataya, Ma'qil ibn Yasar se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Jo subah kahe: 'A'oodhu billahis-samee'il-'aleemi minash-shaytaanir-rajeem' [Main Allah ki panah maangta hoon, jo sabse zyada sunne wala, sabse zyada jaanne wala hai, mardood shaytan se], aur Surah Al-Hashr ki aakhri teen aayaten padhe, Allah usper sattar hazaar farishtay muqarrar karta hai jo shaam tak uspar dua bhejte hain, aur agar woh isay shaam ko kahe, to isi tarah subah tak."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زَيْدٍ سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ  مُهَاجِرٍ، قَالَ : " جَاءَ رَجُل   زَمَنَ زِيَادٍ إِلَى الْكُوفَةِ ، فَسَمِعْتُهُ يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهُ كَانَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي مَسِيرٍ لَهُ، قَالَ : وَرُكْبَتِي تُصِيبُ أَوْ تَمَسُّ رُكْبَتَهُ، فَسَمِعَ رَجُلًا يَقْرَأُ : قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ ، قَالَ :" بَرِئَ مِنَ الشِّرْكِ "، وَسَمِعَ رَجُلًا يَقْرَأُ : قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ، قَالَ : غُفِرَ لَهُ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu Zayd Sa'id ibn al-Rabi', from Shu'bah, from Abu al-Hasan Muhajir: He said: "A man came to Kufah in the time of Ziyad, and I heard him narrate that he was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on a journey of his," he said: "And my knee was touching or brushing his knee, so he heard a man reciting: 'Say, O disbelievers,' he said: 'He is free of shirk,' and he heard a man reciting: 'Say, He is Allah, One,' he said: 'He is forgiven.'"
23.hi: Abu Zayd Sa'id ibn al-Rabi' ne Shu'bah se bataya: Mujhe Abu al-Hasan Muhajir ne bataya: Unhone kaha, "Ziyad ke zamane mein Kufah mein ek aadmi aaya, aur maine unhein yeh bayaan karte suna ke woh Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath ek safar mein the," unhone bataya: "Aur meri ghutna aapke ghutne se lagta ya chhuta tha, to aapne ek aadmi ko 'Qul yaa ayyuhal-kaafiroon' padhte suna, to aapne farmaya: 'Woh shirk se bari ho gaya,' aur aapne ek aadmi ko 'Qul huwallahu ahad' padhte suna, to aapne farmaya: 'Usay bakhsh diya gaya.'"

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ فَرْوَةَ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : " مَجِيءٌ مَا جَاءَ بِكَ "، قَالَ : جِئْتُ لِتُعَلِّمَنِي شَيْئًا أَقُولُهُ عِنْدَ مَنَامِي، قَالَ :" فَإِذَا أَخَذْتَ مَضْجَعَكَ، فَاقْرَأْ : قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ ، ثُمَّ نَمْ عَلَى خَاتِمَتِهَا، فَإِنَّهَا بَرَاءَةٌ مِنْ الشِّرْكِ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zuhayr, from Abu Ishaq, from Farwah ibn Nawfal, from his father: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "What has brought you?" He said: "I came for you to teach me something to say at my sleep." He said: "When you take your place to sleep, recite: 'Say, O disbelievers,' then sleep upon its closing, for it is a declaration of freedom from shirk."
23.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zuhayr se, Abu Ishaq se, Farwah ibn Nawfal se, apne walid se bataya: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Tumhein kya laaya hai?" Unhone kaha: "Main aaya hoon ke aap mujhe kuch sikhaayein jo main apne sone ke waqt kahun." Aapne farmaya: "Jab tum apni sone ki jagah lo, to 'Qul yaa ayyuhal-kaafiroon' padho, fir uski aakhri par so jao, kyunki yeh shirk se bari hone ka elaan hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ ، حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ ، حَدَّثَنَا إِيَاسٌ الْبِكَالِيُّ ، عَنْ نَوْفٍ الْبِكَالِيِّ ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَزَّأَ الْقُرْآنَ عَلَى ثَلَاثَةِ أَجْزَاءٍ، فَجَعَلَ ( قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ) ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from Safwan, from Iyas al-Bikali, from Nawf al-Bikali: He said: "Allah divided the Qur'an into three parts, and made 'Say, He is Allah, One' a third of the Qur'an."
23.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne Safwan se, Iyas al-Bikali se, Nawf al-Bikali se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Allah ne Quran ko teen hisson mein banta, aur 'Qul huwallahu ahad' ko Quran ka tihai banaaya."

23.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو عَقِيلٍ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، يَقُولُ : إِنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَال :" مَنْ قَرَأَ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ عَشْرَ مَرَّاتٍ، بُنِيَ لَهُ بِهَا قَصْرٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ، وَمَنْ قَرَأَ عِشْرِينَ مَرَّةً، بُنِيَ لَهُ بِهَا قَصْرَانِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ، وَمَنْ قَرَأَهَا ثَلَاثِينَ مَرَّةً، بُنِيَ لَهُ بِهَا ثَلَاثَةُ قُصُورٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ "، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ : وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِذَنْ لَتَكَّثُرَنَّ قُصُورُنَا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " اللَّهُ أَوْسَعُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : أَبُو عَقِيلٍ زُهْرَةُ بْنُ مَعْبَدٍ، وَزَعَمُوا أَنَّهُ كَانَ مِنْ الْأَبْدَالِ
23.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Haywah, from Abu Aqil, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab; with Abu Muhammad's identification: He said: The Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: Whoever recites 'Say, He is Allah, One' ten times, a palace will be built for him in Paradise, and whoever recites it twenty times, two palaces will be built for him in Paradise, and whoever recites it thirty times, three palaces will be built for him in Paradise, so Umar ibn al-Khattab said: By Allah, O Messenger of Allah, our palaces will then be many, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Allah is more spacious than that. Abu Muhammad said: Abu Aqil is Zuhrah ibn Ma'bad, and they claimed he was among the Abdal [pious substitutes/saints].
23.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid ne Haywah se bataya: Mujhe Abu Aqil ne bataya: ke unhone Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab ko kehte suna: Nabi Allah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo 'Qul huwallahu ahad' das martaba padhe, uske liye Jannat mein ek mahal banaaya jaayega, aur jo isay bees martaba padhe, uske liye Jannat mein do mahal banaaye jaayenge, aur jo isay tees martaba padhe, uske liye Jannat mein teen mahal banaaye jaayenge," to Umar ibn al-Khattab ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, Ya Rasulullah, to phir humare mahal bahut ho jaayenge," to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Allah isse zyada wasee hai." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Abu Aqil Zuhrah ibn Ma'bad hain, aur log kehte the ke woh Abdal (neik badal-yaafta) mein se the.

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ ، عَنْ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ ضَمْرَةَ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  : أَنَّهُ كَانَ" إِذَا قَرَأَ سُورَةً فَخَتَمَهَا، أَتْبَعَهَا بِ : قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from Utbah ibn Damrah ibn Habib, from his father: That he used to "whenever he recited a surah and finished it, follow it with 'Say, He is Allah, One'."
23.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne Utbah ibn Damrah ibn Habib se, apne walid se bataya: ke woh "jab bhi koi surah padhte aur khatam karte, uske baad 'Qul huwallahu ahad' padhte."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الْعَطَّارِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ  ، عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَيَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ؟ قَالُوا : نَحْنُ أَعْجَزُ وَأَضْعَفُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ : إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَزَّأَ الْقُرْآنَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَجْزَاءٍ، فَجَعَلَ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ "
23.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Aban ibn Yazid al-Attar, from Qatadah, from Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd, from Ma'dan ibn Abi Talhah, from Abu al-Darda: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Is one of you unable to recite a third of the Qur'an in one night?" They said: "We are more unable and weaker than that," so he said: "Indeed Allah divided the Qur'an into three parts, and made 'Say, He is Allah, One' a third of the Qur'an."
23.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Aban ibn Yazid al-Attar se bataya: Humein Qatadah ne bataya, Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd se, Ma'dan ibn Abi Talhah se, Abu al-Darda se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Kya tum mein se koi ek raat mein Quran ka tihai padhne se qaasir hai?" Unhone kaha: "Hum isse bhi zyada qaasir aur kamzor hain," to aapne farmaya: "Allah ne Quran ko teen hisson mein banta, aur 'Qul huwallahu ahad' ko Quran ka tihai banaaya."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ مُجَمِّعٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ  : أَنَّ حُمَيْدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  حَدَّثَهُ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ   كَانَ يَقُولُ :( قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ) تَعْدِلُ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Ibrahim ibn Isma'il ibn Mujammi': He said: Ibn Shihab told me: that Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman narrated to him, that Abu Hurairah used to say: "'Say, He is Allah, One' equals a third of the Qur'an."
23.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Ibrahim ibn Isma'il ibn Mujammi' se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Ibn Shihab ne bataya: ke Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman ne unhein bataya, ke Abu Hurairah kehte the: "'Qul huwallahu ahad' Quran ke tihai ke barabar hai."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ  ، عَنْ سَلَّامِ بْنِ أَبِي مُطِيعٍ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ زِرٍّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" ( قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ) تَعْدِلُ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ :، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ زِرٍّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، مِثْلَهُ
23.en: Narrated by al-Mu'alla ibn Asad, from Sallam ibn Abi Muti', from Asim, from Zirr, from Abdullah; a similar chain also via Amr ibn Asim, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Asim, from Zirr, from Abdullah: He said: "'Say, He is Allah, One' equals a third of the Qur'an." [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Amr ibn Asim, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Asim, from Zirr, from Abdullah, the same.]
23.hi: Al-Mu'alla ibn Asad ne Sallam ibn Abi Muti' se, Asim se, Zirr se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "'Qul huwallahu ahad' Quran ke tihai ke barabar hai." [Isi jaisi riwayat ek aur sanad se Amr ibn Asim se, Hammad ibn Salamah se, Asim se, Zirr se, Abdullah se bhi aayi hai.]

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا مُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ   : أَنَّ رَجُلًا، قَالَ : وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لَأُحِبُّ هَذِهِ السُّورَةَ : ( قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ) ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" حُبُّكَ إِيَّاهَا أَدْخَلَكَ الْجَنَّةَ "
23.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Mubarak ibn Fadalah, from Thabit, from Anas: That a man said: "By Allah, I love this surah: 'Say, He is Allah, One'," so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Your love for it will admit you into Paradise."
23.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Mubarak ibn Fadalah se, Thabit se, Anas se bataya: ke ek aadmi ne kaha: "Allah ki qasam, mujhe yeh surah bahut pasand hai: 'Qul huwallahu ahad'," to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Isse tumhari mohabbat tumhein Jannat mein dakhil karaayegi."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ   : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سُئِلَ عَنْ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ، فَقَالَ :" ثُلُثُ الْقُرْآنِ، أَوْ تَعْدِلُهُ "
23.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Maslamah, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Muslim, from Muhammad ibn Shihab, from Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman, from his mother: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about 'Say, He is Allah, One', so he said: "A third of the Qur'an, or its equivalent."
23.hi: Abdullah ibn Maslamah ne Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Muslim se, Muhammad ibn Shihab se, Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman se, apni maa se bataya: ke Rasulullah ﷺ se 'Qul huwallahu ahad' ke baare mein poocha gaya, to aapne farmaya: "Quran ka tihai, ya iske barabar."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ هِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، عَنْ امْرَأَةٍ  مِنْ الْأَنْصَارِ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ  ، قَالَ : أَتَاهَا فَقَالَ : أَلَا تَرَيْنَ إِلَى مَا جَاءَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَتْ : رُبَّ خَيْرٍ قَدْ أَتَانَا بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَمَا هُوَ؟ قَالَ : قَالَ لَنَا :" أَيَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ "؟ قَالَ : فَأَشْفَقْنَا أَنْ يُرِيدَنَا عَلَى أَمْرٍ نَعْجِزُ عَنْهُ، فَلَمْ نَرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِ شَيْئًا حَتَّى قَالَهَا ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " أَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ ( قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَد، اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ )؟ "
23.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Isra'il, from Mansur, from Hilal, from al-Rabi' ibn Khuthaym, from Amr ibn Maymun, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla, from a woman from the Ansar, from Abu Ayyub: He said: He came to her, and said: "Do you not see what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has brought?" She said: "Much good has the Messenger of Allah ﷺ brought us, so what is it?" He said: He said to us: "Is one of you unable to recite a third of the Qur'an in one night?" He said: So we became afraid that he wanted from us something we would be unable to do, so we did not respond to him at all, until he said it three times, then he said: "Is one of you not able to recite: 'Say, He is Allah, One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge'?"
23.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Isra'il se, Mansur se, Hilal se, al-Rabi' ibn Khuthaym se, Amr ibn Maymun se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla se, Ansar ki ek aurat se, Abu Ayyub se bataya: Unhone kaha, Woh unke paas aaye aur kaha: "Kya tum nahi dekhtin ke Rasulullah ﷺ kya le kar aaye hain?" Unhone kaha: "Rasulullah ﷺ humare liye bahut bhalaai laaye hain, to woh kya hai?" Unhone kaha: Aapne humse farmaya: "Kya tum mein se koi ek raat mein Quran ka tihai padhne se qaasir hai?" Unhone bataya: To humein dar hua ke aap humse aisi cheez chaahte hain jo hum na kar sakein, so humne aapko kuch jawaab nahi diya yahan tak ke aapne yeh teen martaba farmaya, fir aapne farmaya: "Kya tum mein se koi 'Qul huwallahu ahad, Allahus-Samad' padhne mein qaasir hai?"

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ  ، عَنْ نُوحِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ  ، عَنْ أُمِّ كَثِيرٍ الْأَنْصَارِيَّةِ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ خَمْسِينَ مَرَّةً، غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ ذُنُوبَ خَمْسِينَ سَنَةً "
23.en: Narrated by Nasr ibn Ali, from Nuh ibn Qays, from Muhammad Abu Raja, from Umm Kathir al-Ansariyyah, from Anas ibn Malik: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever recites 'Say, He is Allah, One' fifty times, Allah forgives him fifty years of sins."
23.hi: Nasr ibn Ali ne Nuh ibn Qays se bataya: Humein Muhammad Abu Raja ne bataya, Umm Kathir al-Ansariyyah se, Anas ibn Malik se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo 'Qul huwallahu ahad' pachaas martaba padhe, Allah usay pachaas saal ke gunah bakhsh deta hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ  ، وَابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ  ، قَالا : سَمِعْنَا يَزِيدَ بْنَ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  ، يَقُولُ : حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عِمْرَانَ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ  ، يَقُولُ : تَعَلَّقْتُ بِقَدَمِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقُلْتُ لَهُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَقْرِئْنِي سُورَةَ هُود ، وَسُورَةَ يُوسُفَ ، فَقَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " يَا عُقْبَةُ،إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَقْرَأَ مِنْ الْقُرْآنِ سُورَةً أَحَبَّ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا أَبْلَغَ عِنْدَهُ مِن قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ "، قَالَ يَزِيدُ : فَلَمْ يَكُنْ أَبُو عِمْرَانَ يَدَعُهَا، كَانَ لَا يَزَالُ يَقْرَؤُهَا فِي صَلَاةِ الْمَغْرِبِ
23.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Haywah, and Ibn Lahi'ah: They both said: We heard Yazid ibn Abi Habib say: Abu Imran told me, that he heard Uqbah ibn Amir say: I clung to the foot of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and said to him: O Messenger of Allah, teach me Surah Hud, and Surah Yusuf, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: O Uqbah, you will never recite a surah from the Qur'an more beloved to Allah or more effective with Him than 'Say, I seek refuge with the Lord of daybreak'. Yazid said: So Abu Imran would never leave it, he would always recite it in the Maghrib prayer.
23.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid ne Haywah, aur Ibn Lahi'ah se bataya: Dono ne kaha, Humne Yazid ibn Abi Habib ko kehte suna: Mujhe Abu Imran ne bataya, ke unhone Uqbah ibn Amir ko kehte suna: Main Rasulullah ﷺ ke paaon se lipat gaya, aur aapse kaha: Ya Rasulullah, mujhe Surah Hud, aur Surah Yusuf sikhaaiye, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhse farmaya: Ae Uqbah, tum kabhi bhi Quran mein se koi aisi surah nahi padhoge jo Allah ko isse zyada aziz ho ya usse zyada asar-daar ho: 'Qul a'oodhu bi-Rabbil-Falaq' se. Yazid kehte hain: To Abu Imran ise kabhi nahi chhodte the, woh hamesha ise Maghrib ki namaz mein padha karte the.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ  ، أَنَّ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ  ، قَالَ : " مَشَيْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ لِي : " قُلْ يَا عُقْبَةُ "، فَقُلْتُ : أَيَّ شَيْءٍ أَقُولُ؟ قَالَ : فَسَكَتَ عَنِّي، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " يَا عُقْبَةُ : قُلْ، فَقُلْتُ : أَيَّ شَيْءٍ أَقُولُ؟ قَالَ :" قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ، فَقَرَأْتُهَا حَتَّى جِئْتُ عَلَى آخِرِهَا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ : " مَا سَأَلَ سَائِلٌ، وَلَا اسْتَعَاذَ مُسْتَعِيذٌ بِمِثْلِهَا "
23.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Layth, from Ibn Ajlan, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id al-Maqburi, from Uqbah ibn Amir: He said: "I walked with the Prophet ﷺ, and he said to me: 'Say, O Uqbah,' so I said: 'What thing should I say?' He said: So he was silent to me, then he said: 'O Uqbah, say,' so I said: 'What thing should I say?' He said: 'Say, I seek refuge with the Lord of daybreak,' so I recited it until I reached its end, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said at that: 'No one who asks has asked, and no one who seeks refuge has sought refuge, with anything like it.'"
23.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Layth se bataya: Humein Ibn Ajlan ne bataya, Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id al-Maqburi se: ke Uqbah ibn Amir ne kaha: "Main Nabi ﷺ ke saath chal raha tha, to aapne mujhse farmaya: 'Kaho, Ae Uqbah,' to maine poocha: 'Main kya kahun?' Unhone bataya: To aap mujhse khamosh rahe, fir farmaya: 'Ae Uqbah: kaho,' to maine poocha: 'Main kya kahun?' Aapne farmaya: "Qul a'oodhu bi-Rabbil-Falaq," to maine ise aakhir tak padha, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne is par farmaya: "Kisi maangne wale ne kabhi isi jaisi cheez nahi maangi, aur kisi panah maangne wale ne kabhi isi jaisi cheez se panah nahi maangi.""

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَقَدْ أُنْزِلَ عَلَيَّ آيَاتٌ لَمْ أَرَ أَوْ لَمْ يُرَ مِثْلَهُنَّ، يَعْنِي : الْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ "
23.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid, from Qays, from Uqbah ibn Amir: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Verses have indeed been revealed to me the like of which has never been seen, or has never been seen," meaning: the two protective surahs [al-Falaq and al-Nas].
23.hi: Ya'la ne Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid se, Qays se, Uqbah ibn Amir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Mujhpar aisi aayaten nazil ki gayi hain jinke jaisi maine nahi dekhin, ya kabhi nahi dekhi gayin," yaani: do panah wali surahen (Al-Falaq aur An-Nas).

23.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بِسْطَامَ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَمْزَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ  .
ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ  ، عَنْ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ  ، عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ فِي لَيْلَةٍ، لَمْ يُكْتَبْ مِنْ الْغَافِلِينَ "
23.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Bistam, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Yahya ibn al-Harith, from al-Qasim Abu Abd al-Rahman, from Tamim al-Dari; and from Uthman ibn Muslim, from al-Abbas ibn Maymun, from Tamim al-Dari: He said: "Whoever recites ten verses in one night, is not recorded among the heedless."
23.hi: Yahya ibn Bistam ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se bataya: Mujhse Yahya ibn al-Harith ne bataya, al-Qasim Abu Abd al-Rahman se, Tamim al-Dari se; aur Uthman ibn Muslim se bhi bataya, al-Abbas ibn Maymun se, Tamim al-Dari se: Unhone kaha, "Jo ek raat mein das aayaten padhe, woh ghaafilon mein nahi likha jaata."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بِسْطَامَ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَمْزَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ  ، وَفَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ   ، قَالَا :" مَنْ قَرَأَ بِعَشْرِ آيَاتٍ فِي لَيْلَةٍ، كُتِبَ مِنْ الْمُصَلِّينَ "
23.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Bistam, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Yahya ibn al-Harith, from al-Qasim Abu Abd al-Rahman, from Tamim al-Dari, and Fadalah ibn Ubayd: They both said: "Whoever recites ten verses in one night, is recorded among those who pray."
23.hi: Yahya ibn Bistam ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se bataya: Mujhse Yahya ibn al-Harith ne bataya, al-Qasim Abu Abd al-Rahman se, Tamim al-Dari se, aur Fadalah ibn Ubayd se: Dono ne kaha, "Jo ek raat mein das aayaten padhe, woh namazi logon mein likha jaata hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُوَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ الْقُرَظِيِّ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ بِعَشْرِ آيَاتٍ، لَمْ يُكْتَبْ مِنْ الْغَافِلِينَ "
23.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Aban, from Abu Uways, from Musa ibn Uqbah, from Muhammad ibn Ka'b al-Qurazi, from Ibn Umar: He said: "Whoever recites ten verses in a night, is not recorded among the heedless."
23.hi: Isma'il ibn Aban ne Abu Uways se bataya: Humein Musa ibn Uqbah ne bataya, Muhammad ibn Ka'b al-Qurazi se, Ibn Umar se: Unhone kaha, "Jo ek raat mein das aayaten padhe, woh ghaafilon mein nahi likha jaata."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجَدَلِيِّ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ بِعَشْرِ آيَاتٍ، لَمْ يُكْتَبْ مِنْ الْغَافِلِينَ "
23.en: Narrated by Malik ibn Isma'il, from Isra'il, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Mughirah ibn Abdullah al-Jadali, from Ibn Umar: He said: "Whoever recites ten verses in a night, is not recorded among the heedless."
23.hi: Malik ibn Isma'il ne Isra'il se, Abu Ishaq se, al-Mughirah ibn Abdullah al-Jadali se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo ek raat mein das aayaten padhe, woh ghaafilon mein nahi likha jaata."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا فِطْرٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ  ،  عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ بِخَمْسِينَ آيَةً، لَمْ يُكْتَبْ مِنْ الْغَافِلِينَ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Fitr, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Abdullah: He said: "Whoever recites fifty verses in a night, is not recorded among the heedless."
23.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Fitr se, Abu Ishaq se, Abu al-Ahwas se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo raat mein pachaas aayaten padhe, woh ghaafilon mein nahi likha jaata."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بِسْطَامَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ  ، وَفَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ   ، قَالَا :" مَنْ قَرَأَ بِخَمْسِينَ آيَةً فِي لَيْلَةٍ، كُتِبَ مِنْ الْحَافِظِينَ "
23.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Bistam, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Yahya ibn al-Harith, from al-Qasim Abu Abd al-Rahman, from Tamim al-Dari, and Fadalah ibn Ubayd: They both said: "Whoever recites fifty verses in a night, is recorded among the preservers [of the Qur'an]."
23.hi: Yahya ibn Bistam ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se bataya: Mujhse Yahya ibn al-Harith ne bataya, al-Qasim Abu Abd al-Rahman se, Tamim al-Dari se, aur Fadalah ibn Ubayd se: Dono ne kaha, "Jo raat mein pachaas aayaten padhe, woh hifaazat karne walon mein likha jaata hai."

23.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُبَيْدَةَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ يُحَنَّسَ  مَوْلَى الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  أَخِي أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ فِي اللَّهِ، عَنْ أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ بِمِائَةِ آيَةٍ فِي لَيْلَةٍ، لَمْ يُكْتَبْ مِنْ الْغَافِلِينَ ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : مِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ مَكَانَ سَالِمٍ : رَاشِدُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Qasim, from Musa ibn Ubaydah, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim, from Yuhannas, freed slave of al-Zubayr, from Salim, brother of Umm al-Darda in Allah, from Umm al-Darda, from Abu al-Darda, from the Prophet ﷺ; with Abu Muhammad's note: He said: 'Whoever recites a hundred verses in a night, is not recorded among the heedless.' Abu Muhammad said: Some of them say instead of Salim: Rashid ibn Sa'd.
23.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Qasim ne Musa ibn Ubaydah se bataya: Humein Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ne bataya, Yuhannas se (al-Zubayr ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), Salim se (Umm al-Darda ke deeni bhai), Umm al-Darda se, Abu al-Darda se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Jo raat mein sau aayaten padhe, woh ghaafilon mein nahi likha jaata." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Kuch log Salim ki jagah kehte hain: Rashid ibn Sa'd.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُوَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ الْقُرَظِيِّ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ بِمِائَةِ آيَةٍ، كُتِبَ مِنْ الْقَانِتِينَ "
23.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Aban, from Abu Uways, from Musa ibn Uqbah, from Muhammad ibn Ka'b al-Qurazi, from Ibn Umar: He said: "Whoever recites a hundred verses in a night, is recorded among the devoutly obedient."
23.hi: Isma'il ibn Aban ne Abu Uways se bataya: Humein Musa ibn Uqbah ne bataya, Muhammad ibn Ka'b al-Qurazi se, Ibn Umar se: Unhone kaha, "Jo raat mein sau aayaten padhe, woh itaa'atguzaaron mein likha jaata hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بِسْطَامَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ وَاقِدٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ  ، عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ   : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ بِمِائَةِ آيَةٍ فِي لَيْلَةٍ، كُتِبَ لَهُ قُنُوتُ لَيْلَةٍ "
23.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Bistam, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Zayd ibn Waqid, from Sulayman ibn Musa, from Kathir ibn Murrah, from Tamim al-Dari: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever recites a hundred verses in a night, has the standing of a night [in prayer] written for him."
23.hi: Yahya ibn Bistam ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se bataya: Mujhe Zayd ibn Waqid ne bataya, Sulayman ibn Musa se, Kathir ibn Murrah se, Tamim al-Dari se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo raat mein sau aayaten padhe, uske liye raat ke qayam ka sawaab likha jaata hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ ، قَالَ : قَالَ كَعْبٌ  :" مَنْ قَرَأَ مِائَةَ آيَةٍ، كُتِبَ مِنْ الْقَانِتِينَ "
23.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from al-A'mash, from Abu Salih: He said: Ka'b said: "Whoever recites a hundred verses, is recorded among the devoutly obedient."
23.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne al-A'mash se, Abu Salih se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ka'b ne kaha: "Jo sau aayaten padhe, woh itaa'atguzaaron mein likha jaata hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بِسْطَامَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ  ، وَفَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ   ، قَالَا :" مَنْ قَرَأَ بِمِائَةِ آيَةٍ فِي لَيْلَةٍ، كُتِبَ مِنْ الْقَانِتِينَ "
23.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Bistam, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Yahya ibn al-Harith, from al-Qasim Abu Abd al-Rahman, from Tamim al-Dari, and Fadalah ibn Ubayd: They both said: "Whoever recites a hundred verses in a night, is recorded among the devoutly obedient."
23.hi: Yahya ibn Bistam ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se bataya: Mujhe Yahya ibn al-Harith ne bataya, al-Qasim Abu Abd al-Rahman se, Tamim al-Dari se, aur Fadalah ibn Ubayd se: Dono ne kaha, "Jo raat mein sau aayaten padhe, woh itaa'atguzaaron mein likha jaata hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا فِطْرٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ بِمِائَةِ آيَةٍ، كُتِبَ مِنْ الْقَانِتِينَ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Fitr, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Abdullah: He said: "Whoever recites a hundred verses in a night, is recorded among the devoutly obedient."
23.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Fitr se, Abu Ishaq se, Abu al-Ahwas se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo raat mein sau aayaten padhe, woh itaa'atguzaaron mein likha jaata hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا حَرِيزُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ  ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ  ، يَقُولُ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ بِمِائَةِ آيَةٍ، لَمْ يُكْتَبْ مِنْ الْغَافِلِينَ "
23.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Hariz ibn Uthman, from Habib ibn Ubayd: He said: I heard Abu Umamah say: "Whoever recites a hundred verses, is not recorded among the heedless."
23.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Hariz ibn Uthman se, Habib ibn Ubayd se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Umamah ko kehte suna: "Jo sau aayaten padhe, woh ghaafilon mein nahi likha jaata."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَرِيزٌ  ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ  ، يَقُولُ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ مِائَتَيْ آيَةٍ، كُتِبَ مِنْ الْقَانِتِينَ "
23.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Hariz, from Habib ibn Ubayd: He said: I heard Abu Umamah say: "Whoever recites two hundred verses, is recorded among the devoutly obedient."
23.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Hariz se, Habib ibn Ubayd se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Umamah ko kehte suna: "Jo do sau aayaten padhe, woh itaa'atguzaaron mein likha jaata hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُبَيْدَةَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ يُحَنَّسَ  مَوْلَى الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  أَخِي أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ فِي اللَّهِ، عَنْ أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ مِائَتَيْ آيَةٍ فِي لَيْلَةٍ، كُتِبَ مِنْ الْقَانِتِينَ "
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Qasim, from Musa ibn Ubaydah, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim, from Yuhannas, freed slave of al-Zubayr, from Salim, brother of Umm al-Darda in Allah, from Umm al-Darda, from Abu al-Darda, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whoever recites two hundred verses in a night, is recorded among the devoutly obedient."
23.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Qasim ne Musa ibn Ubaydah se bataya: Humein Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ne bataya, Yuhannas se (al-Zubayr ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), Salim se (Umm al-Darda ke deeni bhai), Umm al-Darda se, Abu al-Darda se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Jo raat mein do sau aayaten padhe, woh itaa'atguzaaron mein likha jaata hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجَدَلِيِّ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ، لَمْ يُكْتَبْ مِنْ الْغَافِلِينَ، وَمَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ بِمِائَةِ آيَةٍ، كُتِبَ مِنْ الْقَانِتِينَ، وَمَنْ قَرَأَ بِمِائَتَيْ آيَةٍ، كُتِبَ مِنْ الْفَائِزِينَ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu Ghassan, from Isra'il, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Mughirah ibn Abdullah al-Jadali, from Ibn Umar: He said: "Whoever recites ten verses in a night, is not recorded among the heedless, and whoever recites a hundred verses in a night, is recorded among the devoutly obedient, and whoever recites two hundred verses, is recorded among the successful."
23.hi: Abu Ghassan ne Isra'il se, Abu Ishaq se, al-Mughirah ibn Abdullah al-Jadali se, Ibn Umar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo raat mein das aayaten padhe, woh ghaafilon mein nahi likha jaata, aur jo raat mein sau aayaten padhe, woh itaa'atguzaaron mein likha jaata hai, aur jo do sau aayaten padhe, woh kaamyaab logon mein likha jaata hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ، كُتِبَ مِنْ الذَّاكِرِينَ، وَمَنْ قَرَأَ بِمِائَةِ آيَةٍ، كُتِبَ مِنْ الْقَانِتِينَ، وَمَنْ قَرَأَ بِخَمْسِ مِائَةِ آيَةٍ إِلَى الْأَلْفِ، أَصْبَحَ وَلَهُ قِنْطَارٌ مِنْ الْأَجْرِ، قِيلَ : وَمَا الْقِنْطَارُ؟ قَالَ : مِلْءُ مَسْكِ الثَّوْرِ ذَهَبًا "
23.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Sa'id al-Jurayri, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: He said: "Whoever recites ten verses in a night, is recorded among those who remember [Allah], and whoever recites a hundred verses, is recorded among the devoutly obedient, and whoever recites from five hundred verses to a thousand, wakes up with a qintar [large measure] of reward," it was said: "And what is a qintar?" He said: The fill of a bull's hide with gold.
23.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Sa'id al-Jurayri se, Abu Nadrah se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo raat mein das aayaten padhe, woh zikr karne walon mein likha jaata hai, aur jo sau aayaten padhe, woh itaa'atguzaaron mein likha jaata hai, aur jo paanch sau se hazaar tak aayaten padhe, woh subah karta hai aur uske paas ek qintar (bada paimana) ajr ka hota hai," poocha gaya: "Aur qintar kya hai?" Unhone kaha: Ek bail ki khaal jitni jagah sone se bhar di jaaye.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ   : أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ مِائَةَ آيَةٍ، لَمْ يُحَاجَّهُ الْقُرْآنُ تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةَ، وَمَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ مِائَتَيْ آيَةٍ، كُتِبَ لَهُ قُنُوتُ لَيْلَةٍ، وَمَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ خَمْسَ مِائَةِ آيَةٍ إِلَى الْأَلْفِ، أَصْبَحَ وَلَهُ قِنْطَارٌ فِي الْآخِرَةِ "، قَالُوا : وَمَا الْقِنْطَارُ؟ قَالَ : اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفًا "
23.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Wuhayb, from Yunus, from al-Hasan: That the Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever recites a hundred verses in a night, the Qur'an will not argue against him that night, and whoever recites two hundred verses in a night, has the standing of a night [in prayer] written for him, and whoever recites five hundred to a thousand verses in a night, wakes up with a qintar in the Hereafter," they said: "And what is a qintar?" He said: Twelve thousand [dinars/ounces].
23.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Wuhayb se, Yunus se, al-Hasan se bataya: ke Nabi Allah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Jo raat mein sau aayaten padhe, Quran us raat uske khilaaf hujjat nahi banayega, aur jo raat mein do sau aayaten padhe, uske liye raat ke qayam ka sawaab likha jaayega, aur jo raat mein paanch sau se hazaar tak aayaten padhe, woh subah karta hai aur uske paas Aakhirat mein ek qintar hota hai," unhone poocha: "Aur qintar kya hai?" Unhone kaha: Baarah hazaar.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا فِطْرٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ  ،  عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ ثَلَاثَ مِائَةِ آيَةٍ، كُتِبَ لَهُ قِنْطَارٌ، وَمَنْ قَرَأَ سَبْعَ مِائَةِ آيَةٍ "، لَا أَدْرِي أَيَّ شَيْءٍ قَالَ فِيهَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ بِقَوْلِهِ
23.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Fitr, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Abdullah: He said: "Whoever recites three hundred verses in a night, has a qintar written for him, and whoever recites seven hundred verses," I do not know what Abu Nu'aym said in his statement about it.
23.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Fitr se, Abu Ishaq se, Abu al-Ahwas se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo raat mein teen sau aayaten padhe, uske liye ek qintar likha jaata hai, aur jo saat sau aayaten padhe," mujhe nahi maloom Abu Nu'aym ne isme kya farmaya.

23.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا حَرِيزٌ  ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ  ، يَقُولُ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ أَلْفَ آيَةٍ، كُتِبَ لَهُ قِنْطَارٌ مِنْ الْأَجْرِ.
وَالْقِيرَاطُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ الْقِنْطَارِ لَا تَفِي بِهِ دُنْيَاكُمْ، يَقُولُ : لَا يَعْدِلُهُ دُنْيَاكُمْ "
23.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Hariz, from Habib ibn Ubayd: He said: I heard Abu Umamah say: "Whoever recites a thousand verses, has a qintar of reward written for him. And a qirat [smaller measure] of that qintar, your world cannot equal it," meaning: your world does not equal it.
23.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Hariz se, Habib ibn Ubayd se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Umamah ko kehte suna: "Jo hazaar aayaten padhe, uske liye ek qintar ajr likha jaata hai. Aur us qintar ka ek qirat (chhota hissa) bhi, tumhari duniya isse barabar nahi ho sakti," yaani: tumhari duniya isse barabar nahi."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بِسْطَامَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ  ، وَفَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ   ، قَالَا :" مَنْ قَرَأَ أَلْفَ آيَةٍ فِي لَيْلَةٍ، كُتِبَ لَهُ قِنْطَارٌ، وَالْقِيرَاطُ مِنْ الْقِنْطَارِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا، وَاكْتَنَزَ مِنْ الْأَجْرِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ "
23.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Bistam, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Yahya ibn al-Harith, from al-Qasim Abu Abd al-Rahman, from Tamim al-Dari, and Fadalah ibn Ubayd: They both said: "Whoever recites a thousand verses in a night, has a qintar written for him, and a qirat of the qintar is better than the world and everything in it, and he has stored up whatever reward Allah wills."
23.hi: Yahya ibn Bistam ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se bataya: Mujhe Yahya ibn al-Harith ne bataya, al-Qasim Abu Abd al-Rahman se, Tamim al-Dari se, aur Fadalah ibn Ubayd se: Dono ne kaha, "Jo raat mein hazaar aayaten padhe, uske liye ek qintar likha jaata hai, aur qintar ka qirat duniya aur usmein jo kuch hai usse behtar hai, aur usne jitna ajr Allah chaahe utna jama kar liya."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُبَيْدَةَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ يُحَنَّسَ  مَوْلَى الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  أَخِي أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ ، عَنْ أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ أَلْفَ آيَةٍ، إِلَى خَمْسِ مِائَةٍ كُتِبَ لَهُ قِنْطَارٌ مِنْ الْأَجْرِ، الْقِيرَاطُ مِنْهُ مِثْلُ التَّلِّ الْعَظِيمِ "
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Qasim, from Musa ibn Ubaydah, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim, from Yuhannas, freed slave of al-Zubayr, from Salim, brother of Umm al-Darda, from Umm al-Darda, from Abu al-Darda, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: "Whoever recites a thousand verses, up to five hundred [more], has a qintar of reward written for him, the qirat of it is like a great hill."
23.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Qasim ne Musa ibn Ubaydah se bataya: Humein Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ne bataya, Yuhannas se (al-Zubayr ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), Salim se (Umm al-Darda ke bhai), Umm al-Darda se, Abu al-Darda se, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, "Jo hazaar aayaten padhe, paanch sau tak [aur], uske liye ek qintar ajr likha jaata hai, jiska qirat ek bade pahaad jitna hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا، أَبَانُ الْعَطَّارُ  ، وَحَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ :" الْقِنْطَارُ : اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفًا "
23.en: Narrated by Abd al-Samad ibn Abd al-Warith, from Aban al-Attar, and Hammad ibn Salamah, from Asim, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurairah: He said: "The qintar is: twelve thousand."
23.hi: Abd al-Samad ibn Abd al-Warith ne Aban al-Attar, aur Hammad ibn Salamah se bataya, Asim se, Abu Salih se, Abu Hurairah se: Unhone kaha, "Qintar: baarah hazaar hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ عِيسَى ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَشْهَبِ ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ الْعَبْدِيِّ ، قَالَ :" الْقِنْطَارُ : مِلْءُ مَسْكِ ثَوْرٍ ذَهَبًا "
23.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Isa, from Abu al-Ashhab, from Abu Nadrah al-Abdi: He said: "The qintar is: the fill of a bull's hide with gold."
23.hi: Ishaq ibn Isa ne Abu al-Ashhab se, Abu Nadrah al-Abdi se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Qintar: ek bail ki khaal jitni jagah sone se bharna hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق ، عَنْ هُشَيْمٍ ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ ، قَالَ :" الْقِنْطَارُ : أَرْبَعُونَ أَلْفًا "
23.en: Narrated by Ishaq, from Hushaym, from Ali ibn Zayd, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab: He said: "The qintar is: forty thousand."
23.hi: Ishaq ne Hushaym se, Ali ibn Zayd se, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Qintar: chaalis hazaar hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ مُبَارَكٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، قَالَ :" الْقِنْطَارُ دِيَةُ أَحَدِكُمْ اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفًا "
23.en: Narrated by Ishaq, from Mubarak, from al-Hasan: He said: "The qintar is the blood-money of one of you: twelve thousand."
23.hi: Ishaq ne Mubarak se, al-Hasan se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Qintar tum mein se kisi ki diyat hai: baarah hazaar."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ هُوَ الزَّنْجِيُّ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ  ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  ، قَالَ :" الْقِنْطَارُ : سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ دِينَارٍ "
23.en: Narrated by Ishaq, from Muslim (al-Zinji), from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid: He said: "The qintar is: seventy thousand dinars."
