23.hi: Ishaq ne Muslim se bataya (al-Zinji), Ibn Abi Najih se, Mujahid se: Unhone kaha, "Qintar: sattar hazaar dinar hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ  ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ  ، عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ  ، قَالَ :" الْقِنْطَارُ : أَلْفُ أُوقِيَّةٍ وَمِائَتَا أُوقِيَّةٍ "
23.en: Narrated by Ishaq, from Abu Bakr, from Abu Hasin, from Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd, from Mu'adh ibn Jabal: He said: "The qintar is: one thousand two hundred ounces."
23.hi: Ishaq ne Abu Bakr se, Abu Hasin se, Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd se, Mu'adh ibn Jabal se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Qintar: ek hazaar do sau uqiyah hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ ، قَالَ :" الْقِنْطَارُ : سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مِثْقَالٍ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sharik, from Layth, from Mujahid: He said: "The qintar is: seventy thousand mithqals."
23.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sharik se, Layth se, Mujahid se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Qintar: sattar hazaar misqaal hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا صَالِحٌ الْمُرِّيُّ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، رَفَعَهُ قَالَ :" مَنْ شَهِدَ الْقُرْآنَ حِينَ يُفْتَحُ، فَكَأَنَّمَا شَهِدَ فَتْحًا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، وَمَنْ شَهِدَ خَتْمَهُ حِينَ يُخْتَمُ، فَكَأَنَّمَا شَهِدَ الْغَنَائِمَ حِينَ تُقْسَمُ "
23.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Salih al-Murri, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah, raising it to the Prophet: He said: "Whoever witnesses the Qur'an when it opens, it is as if he witnessed a conquest in the path of Allah, and whoever witnesses its closing when it is closed, it is as if he witnessed the spoils of war when they are distributed."
23.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Salih al-Murri se bataya: Humein Ayyub ne bataya, Abu Qilabah se, isay Nabi tak marfu'an pahunchaate hue: Unhone kaha, "Jo Quran ki shuruaat mein maujood ho, goya woh Allah ki raah mein ek fatah mein maujood tha, aur jo iski khatam ke waqt maujood ho, goya woh ghaneemat ke bantay jaane ke waqt maujood tha."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا صَالِحٌ الْمُرِّيُّ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، قَالَ :" كَانَ رَجُلٌ يَقْرَأُ فِي مَسْجِدِ الْمَدِينَةِ ، وَكَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ   قَدْ وَضَعَ عَلَيْهِ الرَّصَدَ، فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ خَتْمِهِ، قَامَ فَتَحَوَّلَ إِلَيْهِ "
23.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Salih al-Murri, from Qatadah: He said: "A man used to recite in the mosque of Madinah, and Ibn Abbas had someone watching for him, so when it was the day of his completion, he would get up and go over to him."
23.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Salih al-Murri se, Qatadah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Ek aadmi Madinah ki masjid mein padha karta tha, aur Ibn Abbas ne uspar nazar rakhne wala rakha tha, so jab uske khatam karne ka din hota, woh khade hokar uski taraf jaate."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا صَالِحٌ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ  إِذَا أَشْفَى عَلَى خَتْمِ الْقُرْآنِ، بِاللَّيْلِ بَقَّى مِنْهُ شَيْئًا حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ فَيَجْمَعَ أَهْلَهُ، فَيَخْتِمَهُ مَعَهُمْ "
23.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Salih, from Thabit al-Bunani: He said: Anas ibn Malik, when he was close to completing the Qur'an at night, would leave a small part of it until morning, then gather his family, and complete it with them.
23.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Salih se, Thabit al-Bunani se bataya: Unhone kaha, Anas ibn Malik, jab woh raat ko Quran khatam karne ke qareeb hote, to isme se thoda hissa subah tak baaqi rakhte, fir apne gharwalon ko jama karte, aur unke saath usay khatam karte.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ  ، قَالَ :" كَانَ أَنَسٌ   إِذَا خَتَمَ الْقُرْآنَ، جَمَعَ وَلَدَهُ وَأَهْلَ بَيْتِهِ، فَدَعَا لَهُمْ "
23.en: Narrated by Affan, from Ja'far ibn Sulayman, from Thabit: He said: "Anas, when he completed the Qur'an, would gather his children and his household, and pray for them."
23.hi: Affan ne Ja'far ibn Sulayman se, Thabit se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Anas, jab woh Quran khatam karte, to apni aulaad aur apne gharwalon ko jama karte, aur unke liye dua karte."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ ، عَنْ عَبْدَةَ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا خَتَمَ الرَّجُلُ الْقُرْآنَ بِنَهَارٍ، صَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، وَإِنْ فَرَغَ مِنْهُ لَيْلًا، صَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from Abdah: He said: "When a man completes the Qur'an during the day, the angels send blessings upon him until evening, and if he finishes it at night, the angels send blessings upon him until morning."
23.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se, Abdah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab aadmi din mein Quran khatam kare, farishtay shaam tak uspar dua bhejte hain, aur agar woh isse raat ko faarigh ho, to farishtay subah tak uspar dua bhejte hain."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ عِيسَى  ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ الْمُرِّيِّ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ،  عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى   : أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سُئِلَ : أَيُّ الْعَمَلِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ :الْحَالُّ الْمُرْتَحِلُ "، قِيلَ : وَمَا الْحَالُّ الْمُرْتَحِلُ؟ قَالَ : صَاحِبُ الْقُرْآنِ يَضْرِبُ مِنْ أَوَّلِ الْقُرْآنِ إِلَى آخِرِهِ، وَمِنْ آخِرِهِ إِلَى أَوَّلِهِ، كُلَّمَا حَلَّ، ارْتَحَلَ "
23.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Isa, from Salih al-Murri, from Qatadah, from Zurarah ibn Awfa: That the Prophet ﷺ was asked: Which deed is best? He said: "The one who alights and journeys on," it was said: "And what is the one who alights and journeys on?" He said: "The companion of the Qur'an, who moves from the beginning of the Qur'an to its end, and from its end to its beginning, every time he alights, he journeys on again."
23.hi: Ishaq ibn Isa ne Salih al-Murri se, Qatadah se, Zurarah ibn Awfa se bataya: ke Nabi ﷺ se poocha gaya: Kaunsa amal sabse behtar hai? Aapne farmaya: "Woh jo utarta hai aur phir chalta hai," poocha gaya: "Aur 'utarne aur chalne wala' kya hai?" Aapne farmaya: "Quran ka saathi, jo Quran ki shuruaat se uske aakhir tak, aur uske aakhir se uski shuruaat tak jaata rehta hai, jab bhi woh utarta hai, woh phir chal padta hai."

23.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" إِذَا قَرَأَ الرَّجُلُ الْقُرْآنَ نَهَارًا، صَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، وَإِنْ قَرَأَهُ لَيْلًا، صَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ ".
قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ : فَرَأَيْتُ أَصْحَابَنَا يُعْجِبُهُمْ أَنْ يَخْتِمُوهُ أَوَّلَ النَّهَارِ، وَأَوَّلَ اللَّيْلِ.
 حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ الْفِرْيَابِيُّ ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، مِثْلَهُ، إِلَّا أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِيهِ قَوْلُ سُلَيْمَانَ
23.en: Narrated by Ibrahim ibn Musa, from Jarir, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim; with Sulayman's addition and a parallel chain: He said: When a man recites the Qur'an during the day, the angels send blessings upon him until evening, and if he recites it at night, the angels send blessings upon him until morning. Sulayman said: So I saw our companions liked to complete it at the start of the day, and the start of the night. [Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf al-Firyabi, from Sufyan, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, the same, except Sulayman's saying is not in it.]
23.hi: Ibrahim ibn Musa ne Jarir se, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab aadmi din mein Quran padhe, farishtay shaam tak uspar dua bhejte hain, aur agar woh isse raat ko padhe, to farishtay subah tak uspar dua bhejte hain." Sulayman kehte hain: To maine dekha humare saathiyon ko yeh pasand tha ke woh isay din ke shuru aur raat ke shuru mein khatam karein. [Isi jaisi riwayat Muhammad ibn Yusuf al-Firyabi se, Sufyan se, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se bhi aayi hai, siwaay iske ke usmein Sulayman ki baat nahi hai.]

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا فَرْوَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَغْرَاءِ ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ الْمُزَنِيِّ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق ، عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ عَنْ ظَهْرِ قَلْبِهِ، كَانَتْ لَهُ دَعْوَةٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا، أَوْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ "
23.en: Narrated by Farwah ibn Abi al-Maghra, from al-Qasim ibn Malik al-Muzani, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Ishaq, from Muharib ibn Dithar: He said: "Whoever recites the Qur'an by heart, has a supplication in this world, or in the Hereafter."
23.hi: Farwah ibn Abi al-Maghra ne al-Qasim ibn Malik al-Muzani se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Ishaq se, Muharib ibn Dithar se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo Quran ko zabaani (yaad karke) padhe, uske liye duniya mein, ya Aakhirat mein, ek dua hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ  ، وَعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ   ، قَالَا :" مَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ لَيْلًا أَوْ نَهَارًا، صَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ "، وَقَالَ الْآخَرُ : " غُفِرَ لَهُ "
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Abd al-Salam, from Yazid ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Talhah, and Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Aswad: They both said: "Whoever recites the Qur'an at night or during the day, the angels send blessings upon him until night," and the other said: "He is forgiven."
23.hi: Muhammad ibn Sa'id ne Abd al-Salam se bataya: Humein Yazid ibn Abd al-Rahman ne bataya, Talhah se, aur Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Aswad se: Dono ne kaha, "Jo raat ya din mein Quran padhe, farishtay raat tak uspar dua bhejte hain," aur doosre ne kaha: "Usay bakhsh diya jaata hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ حَمَّادٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا قَزَعَةُ بْنُ سُوَيْدٍ ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الْأَعْرَجِ ، قَالَ :" مَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ ثُمَّ دَعَا، أَمَّنَ عَلَى دُعَائِهِ أَرْبَعَةُ آلَافِ مَلَكٍ "
23.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Hammad, from Qaza'ah ibn Suwayd, from Humayd al-A'raj: He said: "Whoever recites the Qur'an then supplicates, four thousand angels say 'Ameen' to his supplication."
23.hi: Amr ibn Hammad ne Qaza'ah ibn Suwayd se, Humayd al-A'raj se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jo Quran padhe fir dua kare, chaar hazaar farishtay uski dua par 'Aameen' kehte hain."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ ، قَالَ : بَعَثَ إِلَيَّ مجاهدٌ، قَالَ :إِنَّمَا دَعَوْنَاكَ أَنَّا أَرَدْنَا أَنْ نَخْتِمَ الْقُرْآنَ، وَإِنَّهُ بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ الدُّعَاءَ يُسْتَجَابُ عِنْدَ خَتْمِ الْقُرْآنِ، قَالَ : فَدَعَوْا بِدَعَوَاتٍ "
23.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Rabi', from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, from Mujahid: He said: Mujahid sent for me, he said: "We have only called you because we wanted to complete the Qur'an, and it has reached us that supplication is answered at the completion of the Qur'an," he said: So they made supplications.
23.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Rabi' ne Shu'bah se, al-Hakam se, Mujahid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujahid ne mujhe bulwaaya, unhone kaha: "Humne tumhein sirf isliye bulaaya ke hum Quran khatam karna chaahte the, aur humein khabar mili hai ke Quran ki khatam par dua qabool hoti hai," unhone bataya: To unhone kuch duaen kin.

23.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ  ، عَنْ عَنْبسة  ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ  ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ مُصَرِّفٍ  ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ  ، قَالَ :" إِذَا وَافَقَ خَتْمُ الْقُرْآنِ أَوَّلَ اللَّيْلِ، صَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ، وَإِنْ وَافَقَ خَتْمُهُ آخِرَ اللَّيْلِ، صَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، فَرُبَّمَا بَقِيَ عَلَى أَحَدِنَا الشَّيْءُ، فَيُؤَخِّرَهُ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ أَوْ يُصْبِحَ ".
 قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : هَذَا حَسَنٌ عَنْ سَعْدٍ
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Humayd, from Harun, from Anbasah, from Layth, from Talhah ibn Musarrif, from Mus'ab ibn Sa'd, from Sa'd; with Abu Muhammad's note: He said: When the completion of the Qur'an coincides with the start of the night, the angels send blessings upon him until morning, and if its completion coincides with the end of the night, the angels send blessings upon him until evening, so sometimes something remains for one of us, and he delays it until evening or morning. Abu Muhammad said: This is fine [narrated] from Sa'd.
23.hi: Muhammad ibn Humayd ne Harun se, Anbasah se, Layth se, Talhah ibn Musarrif se, Mus'ab ibn Sa'd se, Sa'd se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Jab Quran ki khatam raat ke shuru mein hoti hai, to farishtay subah tak uspar dua bhejte hain, aur agar iski khatam raat ke aakhir mein ho, to farishtay shaam tak uspar dua bhejte hain, so kabhi-kabhi humme se kisi ke paas kuch baaqi bach jaata hai, to woh isay shaam ya subah tak taal deta hai." Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Yeh Sa'd se achhi riwayat hai.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُجَاهِدُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُهَاجِرِ بْنِ مِسْمَارٍ  ابْنِ أَخِي بُكَيْرِ بْنِ مِسْمَارٍ، حَدَّثَنِي صَفْوَانُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، قَالَ :" حَمَلَةُ الْقُرْآنِ عُرَفَاءُ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ "
23.en: Narrated by Mujahid ibn Musa, from Ma'n, from Ibrahim ibn Muhajir ibn Mismar, nephew of Bukayr ibn Mismar, from Safwan ibn Sulaym, from Ata ibn Yasar: He said: "The bearers of the Qur'an are the leaders of the people of Paradise."
23.hi: Mujahid ibn Musa ne Ma'n se bataya: Humein Ibrahim ibn Muhajir ibn Mismar ne bataya, jo Bukayr ibn Mismar ke bhatije the: Mujhe Safwan ibn Sulaym ne bataya, Ata ibn Yasar se: Unhone kaha, "Quran uthaane wale Jannat walon ke sardaar hain."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ ، أنبأنا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  : أَنَّهُ كَانَ" يَخْتِمُ الْقُرْآنَ كُلَّ لَيْلَتَيْنِ "
23.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Abd al-Malik, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr: That he used to "complete the Qur'an every two nights."
23.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Abd al-Malik se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se bataya: ke woh "har do raaton mein Quran khatam karte the."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ  ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فِي كَمْ أَخْتِمُ الْقُرْآنَ؟ قَالَ :" اخْتِمْهُ فِي شَهْرٍ "، قُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أنا أُطِيقُ، قَالَ : " اخْتِمْهُ فِي خَمْسة وَعِشْرِينَ "، قُلْتُ : إِنِّي أُطِيقُ، قَالَ : " اخْتِمْهُ فِي عِشْرِينَ "، قُلْتُ : إِنِّي أُطِيقُ، قَالَ : " اخْتِمْهُ فِي خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ "، قُلْتُ : إِنِّي أُطِيقُ، قَالَ : " اخْتِمْهُ فِي عَشْرٍ "، قُلْتُ : إِنِّي أُطِيقُ، قَالَ : " اخْتِمْهُ فِي خَمْسٍ "، قُلْتُ : إِنِّي أُطِيقُ، قَالَ : " لَا "
23.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Jarir, from Mutarrif, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu Burdah, from Abdullah ibn Amr: He said: I said: "O Messenger of Allah, in how many [days] should I complete the Qur'an?" He said: "Complete it in a month." I said: "O Messenger of Allah, I am capable [of more]," he said: "Complete it in twenty-five." I said: "I am capable," he said: "Complete it in twenty." I said: "I am capable," he said: "Complete it in fifteen." I said: "I am capable," he said: "Complete it in ten." I said: "I am capable," he said: "Complete it in five." I said: "I am capable," he said: "No."
23.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Jarir se, Mutarrif se, Abu Ishaq se, Abu Burdah se, Abdullah ibn Amr se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine poocha: "Ya Rasulullah, main Quran kitne [dinon] mein khatam karun?" Aapne farmaya: "Ek mahine mein khatam karo." Maine kaha: "Ya Rasulullah, main taaqat rakhta hoon," aapne farmaya: "Pachees mein khatam karo." Maine kaha: "Main taaqat rakhta hoon," aapne farmaya: "Bees mein khatam karo." Maine kaha: "Main taaqat rakhta hoon," aapne farmaya: "Pandrah mein khatam karo." Maine kaha: "Main taaqat rakhta hoon," aapne farmaya: "Das mein khatam karo." Maine kaha: "Main taaqat rakhta hoon," aapne farmaya: "Paanch mein khatam karo." Maine kaha: "Main taaqat rakhta hoon," aapne farmaya: "Nahi."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ رَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، قَالَ : " أَمَرَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْلَا أَقْرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ ثَلَاثٍ "
23.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Uqbah ibn Khalid, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Ziyad, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Rafi', from Abdullah ibn Amr: He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded me not to recite the Qur'an in less than three [days]."
23.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Uqbah ibn Khalid se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Ziyad se bataya: Mujhe Abd al-Rahman ibn Rafi' ne bataya, Abdullah ibn Amr se: Unhone kaha, "Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhe hukum diya ke main Quran teen [dinon] se kam mein na padhun."

23.ar:
حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَهِيكٍ  ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ   : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ لَمْ يَتَغَنَّ بِالْقُرْآنِ ".
قَالَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ : يَسْتَغْنِي، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : النَّاسُ يَقُولُونَ : عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي نَهِيكٍ
23.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Layth ibn Sa'd, from Ibn Abi Mulaykah, from Ibn Abi Nahik, from Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas; with Ibn Uyaynah's and Abu Muhammad's clarifications: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: He is not of us, who does not chant the Qur'an [i.e., recite it melodiously]. Ibn Uyaynah said: [It means] one who is content/dispenses with it. Abu Muhammad said: People say: Ubaydullah ibn Abi Nahik.
23.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Layth ibn Sa'd se bataya: Humein Ibn Abi Mulaykah ne bataya, Ibn Abi Nahik se, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Woh humme se nahi jo Quran khoobsurat awaaz mein na padhe." Ibn Uyaynah kehte hain: [Iska matlab hai] jo isse mustaghni ho jaaye. Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Log kehte hain: Ubaydullah ibn Abi Nahik.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا مِسْعَرٌ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ  ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ  ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : أَيُّ النَّاسِ أَحْسَنُ صَوْتًا لِلْقُرْآنِ، وَأَحْسَنُ قِرَاءَةً؟ قَالَ :" مَنْ إِذَا سَمِعْتَهُ يَقْرَأُ، أُرِيتَ أَنَّهُ يَخْشَى اللَّهَ "، قَالَ طَاوُسٌ : وَكَانَ طَلْقٌ كَذَلِكَ
23.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Mis'ar, from Abd al-Karim, from Tawus: He said: The Prophet ﷺ was asked: Who among people has the best voice for the Qur'an, and the best recitation? He said: He whom, when you hear him recite, you see that he fears Allah. Tawus said: And Talq was like that.
23.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Mis'ar se bataya: Humein Abd al-Karim ne bataya, Tawus se: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ se poocha gaya: Logon mein sabse achhi awaaz Quran ke liye kiski hai, aur sabse achhi qiraat kiski hai? Aapne farmaya: "Woh jise jab tum padhte suno, to tumhein lage ke woh Allah se darta hai." Tawus kehte hain: Aur Talq aisa hi tha.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَمْ يَأْذَنْ اللَّهُ لِشَيْءٍ، مَا أَذِنَ لِنَبِيٍّ يَتَغَنَّى بِالْقُرْآنِ "، قَالَ صَاحِبٌ لَهُ : أَرَادَ : يَجْهَرُ بِهِ
23.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: That he used to say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Allah has never given permission for anything as He has given permission for a prophet to chant the Qur'an. A companion of his said: He meant: recite it aloud.
23.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhse Uqayl ne bataya, Ibn Shihab se: Mujhse Abu Salamah ne bataya, Abu Hurairah se: ke woh kehte the: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, "Allah ne kisi cheez ko utni ijaazat nahi di jitni usne kisi Nabi ko Quran ko khoobsurati se padhne ki di hai." Unke ek saathi ne kaha: Unka matlab tha: use bulund awaaz mein padhna.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ  ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ :" مَا أَذِنَ اللَّهُ لِشَيْءٍ، كَمَا أَذِنَ لِنَبِيٍّ يَتَغَنَّى بِالْقُرْآنِ "
23.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yunus, from Ibn Shihab: He said: Abu Salamah informed me, that Abu Hurairah said: "Allah has never given permission for anything as He has given permission for a prophet to chant the Qur'an."
23.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhe Yunus ne bataya, Ibn Shihab se: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Abu Salamah ne bataya, ke Abu Hurairah ne kaha: "Allah ne kisi cheez ko utni ijaazat nahi di jitni usne kisi Nabi ko Quran ko khoobsurati se padhne ki di hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ   : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَقُولُ لِأَبِي مُوسَى وَكَانَ حَسَنَ الصَّوْتِ بِالْقُرْآنِ :" لَقَدْ أُوتِيَ هَذَا مِنْ مَزَامِيرِ آلِ دَاوُدَ "
23.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yunus, from Ibn Shihab: He said: Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman informed me: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say to Abu Musa, and he had a beautiful voice for the Qur'an: "You have indeed been given one of the flutes of the family of Dawud."
23.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhe Yunus ne bataya, Ibn Shihab se: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman ne bataya: ke Rasulullah ﷺ Abu Musa se farmaate the, jinki awaaz Quran ke liye khoobsurat thi: "Tumhein Dawud ke khaandaan ki baansuriyon mein se ek di gayi hai."

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ  أَيْضًا : أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ   كَانَ إِذَا رَأَى أَبَا مُوسَى، قَالَ :" ذَكِّرْنَا رَبَّنَا يَا أَبَا مُوسَى، فَيَقْرَأُ عِنْدَهُ "
23.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yunus, from Ibn Shihab: He said: Abu Salamah also told me: that Umar ibn al-Khattab, when he saw Abu Musa, would say: "Remind us of our Lord, O Abu Musa," so he would recite in his presence.
23.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhe Yunus ne bataya, Ibn Shihab se: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Abu Salamah ne bhi bataya: ke Umar ibn al-Khattab, jab woh Abu Musa ko dekhte, kehte: "Humein humare Rab ki yaad dilaao, Ae Abu Musa," to woh unke saamne padhte.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ الْهَجَرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" لَا أُلْفِيَنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ يَضَعُ إِحْدَى رِجْلَيْهِ عَلَى الْأُخْرَى يَتَغَنَّى وَيَدَعُ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ سُورَةَ الْبَقَرَةِ ، فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَفِرُّ مِنْ الْبَيْتِ يُقْرَأُ فِيهِ سُورَةُ الْبَقَرَةِ ، وَإِنَّ أَصْفَرَ الْبُيُوتِ الْجَوْفُ، يَصْفَرُ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ "
23.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Ibrahim al-Hajari, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Abdullah: He said: "I would never find one of you placing one leg over the other, chanting, and abandoning reciting Surah al-Baqarah, for indeed the Shaytan flees from a house in which Surah al-Baqarah is recited, and indeed the most desolate of houses is the empty one, becoming desolate of the Book of Allah."
23.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Ibrahim al-Hajari se, Abu al-Ahwas se, Abdullah se bataya: Unhone kaha, "Main tum mein se kisi ko na paaun ke woh apni ek taang doosri par rakhkar gaana gaaye aur Surah Al-Baqarah padhna chhod de, kyunki shaytan us ghar se bhaagta hai jismein Surah Al-Baqarah padhi jaaye, aur sabse viraan ghar woh khaali hota hai, jo Allah ki Kitaab se viraan ho."

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي بَعْضُ  آلِ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ :" قَدِمَ سَلَمَةُ الْبَيْذَقُ الْمَدِينَةَ ، فَقَامَ يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ، فَقِيلَ لِسَالِمٍ  : لَوْ جِئْتَ فَسَمِعْتَ قِرَاءَتَهُ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ بِبَابِ الْمَسْجِدِ، سَمِعَ قِرَاءَتَهُ، رَجَعَ فَقَالَ : غِنَاءٌ غِنَاءٌ "
23.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub: He said: Someone from the family of Salim ibn Abdullah told me: "Salamah al-Baydaq came to Madinah, and stood to lead them in prayer, so it was said to Salim: 'If only you would come and hear his recitation,' so when he was at the door of the mosque, he heard his recitation, and turned back, and said: 'Song, song.'"
23.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se, Ayyub se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Salim ibn Abdullah ke khaandaan mein se kisi ne bataya: "Salamah al-Baydaq Madinah aaye, aur unhein namaz padhaane khade hue, to Salim se kaha gaya: 'Kaash aap aakar unki qiraat suntay,' to jab woh masjid ke darwaze par pahunche, unhone unki qiraat suni, aur wapas laut aaye, aur kaha: 'Gaana, gaana.'"

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  : " أَنَّ أَبَا مُوسَى كَانَ يَأْتِي عُمَرَ  ، فَيَقُولُ لَهُ عُمَرُ :ذَكِّرْنَا رَبَّنَا، فَيَقْرَأُ عِنْدَهُ "
23.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Salamah: That Abu Musa would come to Umar, and Umar would say to him: "Remind us of our Lord," so he would recite in his presence.
23.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se, Ibn Shihab se, Abu Salamah se bataya: ke Abu Musa Umar ke paas aate, to Umar unse kehte: "Humein humare Rab ki yaad dilaao," to woh unke saamne padhte.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَا أَذِنَ اللَّهُ لِشَيْءٍ، كَأَذَنِهِ لِنَبِيٍّ يَتَغَنَّى بِالْقُرْآنِ يَجْهَرُ بِهِ "
23.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad (Ibn Amr), from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Allah has never given permission for anything as He has given permission for a prophet to chant the Qur'an, reciting it aloud.'
23.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad se bataya (Ibn Amr), Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, 'Allah ne kisi cheez ko utni ijaazat nahi di jitni usne kisi Nabi ko Quran ko khoobsurati se, bulund awaaz mein padhne ki di hai.'

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" لَقَدْ أُوتِيَ أَبُو مُوسَى مِزْمَارًا مِنْ مَزَامِيرِ آلِ دَاوُدَ "
23.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Malik ibn Mighwal, from Ibn Buraydah, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: 'Abu Musa has indeed been given a flute from the flutes of the family of Dawud.'
23.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Malik ibn Mighwal se, Ibn Buraydah se, apne walid se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, 'Abu Musa ko Dawud ke khaandaan ki baansuriyon mein se ek baansuri di gayi hai.'

23.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : " دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَسَمِعَ قِرَاءَةَ رَجُلٍ، فَقَالَ : " مَنْ هَذَا "؟ قِيلَ : عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ :" لَقَدْ أُوتِيَ هَذَا مِزْمَارًا مِنْ مَزَامِيرِ آلِ دَاوُدَ "
23.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurairah: He said: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered, and heard a man's recitation, so he said: 'Who is this?' It was said: Abdullah ibn Qays, he said: 'This one has indeed been given a flute from the flutes of the family of Dawud.''
23.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Muhammad ibn Amr se, Abu Salamah se, Abu Hurairah se bataya: Unhone kaha, 'Rasulullah ﷺ dakhil hue, to aapne ek aadmi ki qiraat suni, to aapne farmaya: 'Yeh kaun hai?' Kaha gaya: Abdullah ibn Qays, aapne farmaya: 'Isay Dawud ke khaandaan ki baansuriyon mein se ek baansuri di gayi hai.''

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْسَجَةَ  ، عَنْ الْبَرَاءِ  ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" زَيِّنُوا الْقُرْآنَ بِأَصْوَاتِكُمْ "
23.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Talhah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Awsajah, from al-Bara', from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: 'Adorn the Qur'an with your voices.'
23.hi: Ubaydullah ne Sufyan se, Mansur se, Talhah se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Awsajah se, al-Bara' se, Nabi ﷺ se bataya: Aapne farmaya, 'Quran ko apni awaazon se sajaao.'

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ  ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ  ، عَنْ زَاذَانَ أَبِي عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ :" حَسِّنُوا الْقُرْآنَ بِأَصْوَاتِكُمْ، فَإِنَّ الصَّوْتَ الْحَسَنَ يَزِيدُ الْقُرْآنَ حُسْنًا "
23.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Bakr, from Sadaqah ibn Abi Imran, from Alqamah ibn Marthad, from Zadhan Abu Umar, from al-Bara' ibn Azib: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Beautify the Qur'an with your voices, for indeed a beautiful voice adds beauty to the Qur'an.'
23.hi: Muhammad ibn Bakr ne Sadaqah ibn Abi Imran se, Alqamah ibn Marthad se, Zadhan Abu Umar se, al-Bara' ibn Azib se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, 'Quran ko apni khoobsurat awaazon se sajaao, kyunki khoobsurat awaaz Quran mein khoobsurati badhaati hai.'

23.ar:
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، قَالَ :" قَرَأَ رَجُلٌ عِنْدَ أَنَسٍ بِلَحْنٍ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْأَلْحَانِ، فَكَرِهَ ذَلِكَ أَنَسٌ   ".
قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد ، وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ : قَرَأَ غُورَكُ بْنُ أَبِي الْخِضْرِمِ
23.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abdullah ibn Idris, from al-A'mash; with Abu Muhammad's identification: He said: A man recited in Anas's presence with one of these melodies, so Anas disliked that. Abu Muhammad said, and others said: The one who recited was Ghurak ibn Abi al-Khidrim.
23.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abdullah ibn Idris se, al-A'mash se bataya: Unhone kaha, 'Ek aadmi ne Anas ke saamne in dhunon mein se ek se qiraat ki, to Anas ne isay na-pasand kiya.' Abu Muhammad kehte hain, aur doosron ne kaha: Padhne wala Ghurak ibn Abi al-Khidrim tha.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ ،  عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ ، قَالَ :" كَانُوا يَرَوْنَ هَذِهِ الْأَلْحَانَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ مُحْدَثَةً "
23.en: Narrated by al-Abbas ibn Sufyan, from Ibn Ulayyah, from Ibn Awn, from Muhammad: He said: 'They used to consider these melodies in the Qur'an as an innovation.'
23.hi: Al-Abbas ibn Sufyan ne Ibn Ulayyah se, Ibn Awn se, Muhammad se bataya: Unhone kaha, 'Woh Quran mein in dhunon ko bidat samajhte the.'

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَجُلٌ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ K : أَيُؤَاخَذُ الرَّجُلُ بِمَا عَمِلَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ؟، قَالَ :" مَنْ أَحْسَنَ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ لَمْ يُؤَاخَذْ بِمَا كَانَ عَمِلَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، وَمَنْ أَسَاءَ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ، أُخِذَ بِالْأَوَّلِ وَالْآخِرِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from al-A'mash, from Abu Wa'il, from Abdullah رضي الله عنه: He said: A man said: 'O Messenger of Allah, is a man held accountable for what he did in the Jahiliyyah?' He said: 'Whoever does good in Islam, is not held accountable for what he did in the Jahiliyyah, and whoever does evil in Islam, is held accountable for the first and the last.'
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se, al-A'mash se, Abu Wa'il se, Abdullah رضي الله عنه se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi ne poocha: 'Ya Rasulullah, kya aadmi Jahiliyat mein kiye gaye amal ke liye pakda jaayega?' Aapne farmaya: 'Jo Islam mein bhalaai kare, use Jahiliyat ke amal ke liye nahi pakda jaayega, aur jo Islam mein burai kare, use pehle aur baad dono ke liye pakda jaayega.'

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ النَّضْرِ الرَّمْلِيُّ  ، عَنْ مَسَرَّةَ بْنِ مَعْبَدٍ مِنْ بَنِي الْحَارِثِ بْنِ أَبِي الْحَرَامِ مِنْ لَخْمٍ  ،  عَنْ الْوَضِينِ  ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّا كُنَّا أَهْلَ جَاهِلِيَّةٍ وَعِبَادَةِ أَوْثَانٍ، فَكُنَّا نَقْتُلُ الْأَوْلَادَ، وَكَانَتْ عِنْدِي ابْنَةُ لِي فَلَمَّا أَجَابَتْ، وَكَانَتْ مَسْرُورَةً بِدُعَائِي إِذَا دَعَوْتُهَا، فَدَعَوْتُهَا يَوْمًا، فَاتَّبَعَتْنِي فَمَرَرْتُ حَتَّى أَتَيْتُ بِئْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِي غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ، فَأَخَذْتُ بِيَدِهَا فَرَدَّيْتُ بِهَا فِي الْبِئْرِ، وَكَانَ آخِرَ عَهْدِي بِهَا أَنْ تَقُولَ : يَا أَبَتَاهُ ! يَا أَبَتَاهُ ! فَبَكَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَتَّى وَكَفَ دَمْعُ عَيْنَيْهِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ جُلَسَاءِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : أَحْزَنْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ : " كُفَّ فَإِنَّهُ يَسْأَلُ عَمَّا أَهَمَّهُ "، ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ : " أَعِدْ عَلَيَّ حَدِيثَكَ " فَأَعَادَهُ، فَبَكَى حَتَّى وَكَفَ الدَّمْعُ مِنْ عَيْنَيْهِ عَلَى لِحْيَتِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ :" إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ وَضَعَ عَنْ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ مَا عَمِلُوا، فَاسْتَأْنِفْ عَمَلَكَ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Walid ibn al-Nadr al-Ramli, from Masarrah ibn Ma'bad from Banu al-Harith ibn Abi al-Haram of Lakhm, from al-Wadin: That a man came to the Prophet ﷺ, and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, we were people of Jahiliyyah and idol worship, and we used to kill our children, and I had a daughter, and when she could respond, and she was pleased with my calling her whenever I called her, so I called her one day, and she followed me, and I walked until I came to a well of my people not far away, and I took her hand and threw her into the well, and the last thing I knew of her was that she said: 'O my father! O my father!'' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wept until his tears flowed, so a man among the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: 'You have grieved the Messenger of Allah ﷺ,' so he said to him: 'Stop, for he is asking about what concerns him,' then he said to him: 'Repeat your story to me,' so he repeated it, and he wept until the tears flowed from his eyes onto his beard, then he said to him: 'Allah has indeed lifted from the Jahiliyyah what they did, so start your deeds anew.'
24.hi: Al-Walid ibn al-Nadr al-Ramli ne Masarrah ibn Ma'bad se bataya, jo Banu al-Harith ibn Abi al-Haram (Lakhm) mein se the: Mujhe al-Wadin ne bataya: ke ek aadmi Nabi ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah, hum Jahiliyat aur but-parasti wale log the, aur hum apni aulaad ko qatal karte the, aur meri ek beti thi, jab woh jawaab dene lagi, aur meri pukaar par khush hoti thi jab main usay bulaata, to ek din maine usay bulaaya, to woh mere peechhe chal padi, aur main chalta rehta yahan tak ke main apne khaandaan ke ek kuen tak pahuncha jo door nahi tha, to maine uska haath pakda aur usay kuen mein daal diya, aur uske baare mein aakhri baat jo mujhe pata hai woh yeh thi ke woh kehti thi: 'Ae mere abba! Ae mere abba!'' To Rasulullah ﷺ ro pade yahan tak ke aapke aansu bahne lage, to Rasulullah ﷺ ke sahaba mein se ek aadmi ne unse kaha: 'Aapne Rasulullah ﷺ ko ranjeeda kar diya,' to aapne usse farmaya: 'Chup raho, kyunki woh apne dil ki baat poochh raha hai,' fir aapne usse farmaya: 'Mujhe apni baat dohraao,' to usne dohraayi, aur aap ro pade yahan tak ke aapki daadhi par aansu bahne lage, fir aapne usse farmaya: 'Allah ne Jahiliyat walon ne jo kiya usay maaf kar diya hai, so ab apna amal naye sire se shuru karo.'

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ الْمُؤَدِّبِ ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي مَوْلَايَ  :" أَنَّ أَهْلَهُ بَعَثُوا مَعَهُ بِقَدَحٍ فِيهِ زُبْدٌ وَلَبَنٌ إِلَى آلِهَتِهِمْ، قَالَ : فَمَنَعَنِي أَنْ آكُلَ الزُّبْدَ لِمَخَافَتِهَا، قَالَ : فَجَاءَ كَلْبٌ فَأَكَلَ الزُّبْدَ وَشَرِبَ اللَّبَنَ، ثُمَّ بَالَ عَلَى الصَّنَمِ وَهُوَ : أُسَافٌ وَنَائِلَةُ، قَالَ هَارُونُ : كَانَ الرَّجُلُ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ إِذَا سَافَرَ، حَمَلَ مَعَهُ أَرْبَعَةَ أَحْجَارٍ : ثَلَاثَةً لِقِدْرِهِ وَالرَّابِعَ يَعْبُدُهُ وَيُرَبِّي كَلْبَهُ، وَيَقْتُلُ وَلَدَهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Harun ibn Mu'awiyah, from Ibrahim ibn Sulayman al-Mu'addib, from al-A'mash, from Mujahid: He said: My patron told me: 'That his family sent with him a bowl containing butter and milk to their idols, he said: So it prevented me from eating the butter out of fear of it, he said: So a dog came and ate the butter and drank the milk, then urinated on the idol, which was: Isaf and Na'ilah.' Harun said: A man in the Jahiliyyah, when he traveled, would carry with him four stones: three for his cooking-pot, and the fourth he worshipped, and he would raise his dog, but kill his child.
24.hi: Harun ibn Mu'awiyah ne Ibrahim ibn Sulayman al-Mu'addib se, al-A'mash se, Mujahid se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe mere maalik ne bataya: 'ke unke gharwalon ne unke saath ek pyaala bheja jismein makkhan aur doodh tha unke khudaaon ke liye, unhone kaha: To usne mujhe makkhan khaane se roka uske khauf ki wajah se, unhone kaha: To ek kutta aaya aur makkhan khaa gaya aur doodh pi gaya, fir but par peshaab kar diya, jo tha: Isaf aur Na'ilah.' Harun kehte hain: Jahiliyat mein aadmi jab safar karta, to apne saath chaar patthar le jaata: teen apne haandi ke liye, aur chautha jiski woh puja karta, aur woh apne kutte ko paalta, lekin apne bachche ko qatal karta.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُجَاهِدُ بْنُ مُوسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا رَيْحَانُ هُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ السَّامِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادٌ هُوَ ابْنُ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ ، قَالَ :" كُنَّا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ إِذَا أَصَبْنَا حَجَرًا حَسَنًا، عَبَدْنَاهُ، وَإِنْ لَمْ نُصِبْ حَجَرًا، جَمَعْنَا كُثْبَةً مِنْ رَمْلٍ، ثُمَّ جِئْنَا بِالنَّاقَةِ الصَّفِيِّ فَتَفَاجَّ عَلَيْهَا، فَنَحْلُبُهَا عَلَى الْكُثْبَةِ حَتَّى نَرْوِيَهَا، ثُمَّ نَعْبُدُ تِلْكَ الْكُثْبَةَ مَا أَقَمْنَا بِذَلِكَ الْمَكَانِ "، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد الصَّفِيُّ : الْكَثِيرَةُ الْأَلْبَانِ
24.en: Narrated by Mujahid ibn Musa, from Rayhan ibn Sa'id al-Sami, from Abbad ibn Mansur, from Abu Raja; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: 'We used to, in the Jahiliyyah, when we found a fine stone, worship it, and if we did not find a stone, we would gather a mound of sand, then bring the milch-camel and make her straddle it, and we would milk her onto the mound until we quenched it, then we would worship that mound as long as we stayed in that place.' Abu Muhammad said: al-safiyy is: the one with abundant milk.
24.hi: Mujahid ibn Musa ne Rayhan ibn Sa'id al-Sami se bataya: Humein Abbad ibn Mansur ne bataya, Abu Raja se: Unhone kaha, 'Hum Jahiliyat mein, jab humein koi achha patthar milta, to hum uski puja karte, aur agar humein koi patthar na milta, to hum ret ka ek tila jama karte, fir ek doodh dene wali oontni laate aur usay uspar phailaate, to hum usay us tile par dooha karte yahan tak ke woh seer ho jaata, fir hum us tile ki puja karte jab tak hum wahan rehte.' Abu Muhammad kehte hain: 'Al-Safiyy' ka matlab hai: bahut doodh wali (jaanwar).

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ كَعْبٌ   : نَجِدُهُ مَكْتُوبًا :" مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَا فَظٌّ، وَلَا غَلِيظٌ، وَلَا صَخَّابٌ بِالْأَسْوَاقِ، وَلَا يَجْزِي بِالسَّيِّئَةِ السَّيِّئَةَ، وَلَكِنْ يَعْفُو وَيَغْفِرُ، وَأُمَّتُهُ الْحَمَّادُونَ يُكَبِّرُونَ اللَّهَ G عَلَى كُلِّ نَجْدٍ، وَيَحْمَدُونَهُ فِي كُلِّ مَنْزِلَةٍ، وَيَتَأَزَّرُونَ عَلَى أَنْصَافِهِمْ، وَيَتَوَضَّئُونَ عَلَى أَطْرَافِهِمْ، مُنَادِيهِمْ يُنَادِي فِي جَوِّ السَّمَاءِ صَفُّهُمْ فِي الْقِتَالِ، وَصَفُّهُمْ فِي الصَّلَاةِ سَوَاءٌ، لَهُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ دَوِيٌّ كَدَوِيِّ النَّحْلِ، مَوْلِدُهُ بِمَكَّةَ ، وَمُهَاجِرُهُ بِطَيْبَةَ ، وَمُلْكُهُ بِالشَّامِ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Hasan ibn al-Rabi', from Abu al-Ahwas, from al-A'mash, from Abu Salih: He said: Ka'b said: We find it written: 'Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, neither harsh, nor coarse, nor loud in the markets, and does not repay evil with evil, but rather pardons and forgives, and his nation are the praisers, they magnify Allah upon every high ground, and praise Him in every situation, they wear their lower garments to their mid-shins, and perform ablution to the extent of their limbs, their caller calls in the sky, their rows in battle and their rows in prayer are equal, they have at night a hum like the hum of bees, his birthplace is in Makkah, his place of emigration is in Tayba, and his kingdom is in Syria.'
24.hi: Al-Hasan ibn al-Rabi' ne Abu al-Ahwas se, al-A'mash se, Abu Salih se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ka'b ne kaha: Hum ise likha hua paate hain: 'Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool ﷺ, na sakht, na rukhkha, na bazaaron mein shor machaane wale, aur burai ka badla burai se nahi dete, balke maaf kar dete hain aur bakhsh dete hain, aur unki ummat tareef karne wale hain, woh har oonchai par Allah ki takbeer kehte hain, aur har halat mein uski hamd karte hain, apne kapde apne pindliyon tak baandhte hain, aur apne azaon ki hadd tak wudu karte hain, unka pukaarne wala aasmaan mein pukaarta hai, unki jang mein saf aur unki namaz mein saf barabar hoti hai, unke paas raat ko shehad ki makkhiyon ki gunjaan jaisi awaaz hoti hai, unki paidaish Makkah mein hai, unki hijrat Tayba mein hai, aur unki hukumat Sham mein hai.'

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي هِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ أُسَامَةَ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ سَلَامٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ :" إِنَّا لَنَجِدُ صِفَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ شَاهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا، وَحِرْزًا، لِلْأُمِّيِّينَ، أَنْتَ عَبْدِي وَرَسُولِي، سَمَّيْتُهُ الْمُتَوَكِّلَ، لَيْسَ بِفَظٍّ، وَلَا غَلِيظٍ، وَلَا صَخَّابٍ بِالْأَسْوَاقِ، وَلَا يَجْزِي بِالسَّيِّئَةِ مِثْلَهَا، وَلَكِنْ يَعْفُو وَيَتَجَاوَزُ، وَلَنْ أَقْبِضَهُ حَتَّى يُقِيمَ الْمِلَّةَ الْمُتَعَوِّجَةَ بِأَنْ يَشْهَدَ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، نَفْتَحُ بِهِ أَعْيُنًا عُمْيًا وَآذَانًا صُمًا، وَقُلُوبًا غُلْفًا "، قَالَ عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ : وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو وَاقِدٍ اللَّيْثِيُّ : أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ كَعْبًا يَقُولُ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ ابْنُ سَلَامٍ
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Khalid ibn Yazid, from Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal, from Hilal ibn Usamah, from Ata ibn Yasar, from Ibn Salam رضي الله عنه: That he used to say: 'We indeed find the description of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ [in earlier scripture]: 'Indeed We have sent you as a witness, and a bringer of good tidings, and a warner, and a safeguard for the unlettered ones, you are My servant and My messenger, I named him al-Mutawakkil [the one who relies on Allah], he is not harsh, nor coarse, nor loud in the markets, and does not repay evil with the like of it, but rather pardons and overlooks, and I will not take him until he establishes the crooked religion straight, by making them testify there is no god but Allah, opening thereby blind eyes, and deaf ears, and covered hearts.'' Ata ibn Yasar said: And Abu Waqid al-Laythi informed me: that he heard Ka'b saying the like of what Ibn Salam said.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhe Khalid ibn Yazid ne bataya, Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal se, Hilal ibn Usamah se, Ata ibn Yasar se, Ibn Salam se رضي الله عنه: ke woh kehte the: 'Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ka wasf paate hain: 'Humne tumhein gawaah, aur khush-khabri dene wala, aur daraane wala banaakar bheja hai, aur ummiyon ke liye ek panah, tum mera banda aur mera Rasool ho, maine unka naam Al-Mutawakkil rakha, na sakht, na rukhkha, na bazaaron mein shor machaane wale, aur burai ka badla usi jaisi burai se nahi dete, balke maaf karte aur nazar-andaaz karte hain, aur main unhein tab tak nahi uthaunga jab tak woh tedhi millat ko seedha na kar dein, is tarah ke woh gawahi dilaayein ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, hum isse andhi aankhein, bahre kaan, aur dhake hue dilon ko kholte hain.'' Ata ibn Yasar kehte hain: Aur mujhe Abu Waqid al-Laythi ne bataya: ke unhone Ka'b ko Ibn Salam jaisi hi baat kehte suna.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ عَوْفٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ذَكْوَانَ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ كَعْبٍ   :" فِي السَّطْرِ الْأَوَّلِ : مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، عَبْدِي الْمُخْتَارُ، لَا فَظٌّ، وَلَا غَلِيظٌ، وَلَا صَخَّابٌ فِي الْأَسْوَاقِ، وَلَا يَجْزِي بِالسَّيِّئَةِ السَّيِّئَةَ، وَلَكِنْ يَعْفُو وَيَغْفِرُ، مَوْلِدُهُ بِمَكَّةَ ، وَهِجْرَتُهُ بِطَيْبَةَ ، وَمُلْكُهُ بِالشَّامِ ، وَفِي السَّطْرِ الثَّانِي : مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، أُمَّتُهُ الْحَمَّادُونَ يَحْمَدُونَ اللَّهَ فِي السَّرَّاءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ، يَحْمَدُونَ اللَّهَ فِي كُلِّ مَنْزِلَةٍ، وَيُكَبِّرُونَه عَلَى كُلِّ شَرَفٍ، رُعَاةُ الشَّمْسِ يُصَلُّونَ الصَّلَاةَ إِذَا جَاءَ وَقْتُهَا وَلَوْ كَانُوا عَلَى رَأْسِ كُنَاسَةٍ، وَيَأْتَزِرُونَ عَلَى أَوْسَاطِهِمْ، وَيُوَضِّئُونَ أَطْرَافَهُمْ، وَأَصْوَاتُهُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ فِي جَوِّ السَّمَاءِ كَأَصْوَاتِ النَّحْلِ "
24.en: Narrated by Zayd ibn Awf, from Abu Awanah, from Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr, from Dhakwan Abu Salih, from Ka'b: 'In the first line: Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, My chosen servant, neither harsh, nor coarse, nor loud in the markets, and does not repay evil with evil, but rather pardons and forgives, his birthplace is in Makkah, his migration is in Tayba, and his kingdom is in Syria, and in the second line: Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, his nation are the praisers, they praise Allah in ease and hardship, they praise Allah in every situation, and magnify Him upon every honorable place, sun-watchers, they pray the prayer when its time comes even if they are atop a rubbish heap, they wrap their lower garments around their waists, and wash their limbs, and their voices at night in the sky are like the sounds of bees.'
24.hi: Zayd ibn Awf ne Abu Awanah se bataya: Humein Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr ne bataya, Dhakwan Abu Salih se, Ka'b se: 'Pehli line mein: Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool, mere chune hue banda, na sakht, na rukhkha, na bazaaron mein shor machaane wale, aur burai ka badla burai se nahi dete, balke maaf karte aur bakhsh dete hain, unki paidaish Makkah mein hai, unki hijrat Tayba mein hai, aur unki hukumat Sham mein hai, aur doosri line mein: Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool, unki ummat tareef karne wale hain, woh khushi aur takleef mein Allah ki hamd karte hain, har halat mein Allah ki hamd karte hain, aur har izzat wali jagah par uski takbeer kehte hain, dhoop ke rakhwaale, woh namaz uske waqt par padhte hain chahe woh kachre ke dher par hi kyun na hon, apne kapde apni kamar par baandhte hain, aur apne aazon ko dhote hain, aur unki raat ki awaazein aasmaan mein shehad ki makkhiyon ki awaazon jaisi hoti hain.'

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُجَاهِدُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي فَرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ كَعْبَ الْأَحْبَارِ : كَيْفَ تَجِدُ نَعْتَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ؟، فَقَالَ كَعْبٌ   :" نَجِدْهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يُولَدُ بِمَكَّةَ ، وَيُهَاجِرُ إِلَى طَابَةَ ، وَيَكُونُ مُلْكُهُ بِالشَّامِ ، وَلَيْسَ بِفَحَّاشٍ، وَلَا صَخَّابٍ فِي الْأَسْوَاقِ، وَلَا يُكَافِئُ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ السَّيِّئَةَ، وَلَكِنْ يَعْفُو وَيَغْفِرُ، أُمَّتُهُ الْحَمَّادُونَ، يَحْمَدُونَ اللَّهَ فِي كُلِّ سَرَّاءَ، وَضَرَّاءَ وَيُكَبِّرُونَ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ نَجْدٍ، يُوَضِّئُونَ أَطْرَافَهُمْ، وَيَأْتَزِرُونَ فِي أَوْسَاطِهِمْ، يُصَفُّونَ فِي صَلاتِهِمْ كَمَا يُصَفُّونَ فِي قِتَالِهِمْ، دَوِيُّهُمْ فِي مَسَاجِدِهِمْ كَدَوِيِّ النَّحْلِ، يُسْمَعُ مُنَادِيهِمْ فِي جَوِّ السَّمَاءِ "
24.en: Narrated by Mujahid ibn Musa, from Ma'n ibn Isa, from Mu'awiyah ibn Salih, from Abu Farwah, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: That he asked Ka'b al-Ahbar: How do you find the description of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the Torah? So Ka'b said: 'We find him: Muhammad ibn Abdullah, born in Makkah, and emigrating to Taba, and his kingdom being in Syria, and he is neither foul-mouthed nor loud in the markets, and does not repay evil with evil, but rather pardons and forgives, his nation are the praisers, they praise Allah in every ease and hardship, and magnify Allah upon every high ground, they wash their limbs, and wrap their garments around their waists, they line up in their prayer as they line up in their battle, their hum in their mosques is like the hum of bees, their caller is heard in the sky.'
24.hi: Mujahid ibn Musa ne Ma'n ibn Isa se bataya: Humein Mu'awiyah ibn Salih ne bataya, Abu Farwah se, Ibn Abbas se رضي الله عنهما: ke unhone Ka'b al-Ahbar se poocha: Aap Taurat mein Rasulullah ﷺ ka wasf kaise paate hain? To Ka'b ne kaha: 'Hum unhein paate hain: Muhammad ibn Abdullah, Makkah mein paida hone wale, aur Taba ki taraf hijrat karne wale, aur unki hukumat Sham mein hone wali, aur woh na bad-zubaan hain na bazaaron mein shor machaane wale, aur burai ka badla burai se nahi dete, balke maaf karte aur bakhshte hain, unki ummat tareef karne wale hain, woh har khushi aur takleef mein Allah ki hamd karte hain, aur har oonchai par Allah ki takbeer kehte hain, woh apne aazon ko dhote hain, aur apne kapde apni kamar par baandhte hain, woh apni namaz mein utni hi saf-bandi karte hain jitni apni jang mein karte hain, unki masjidon mein unki gunjaan shehad ki makkhiyon ki gunjaan jaisi hoti hai, unka pukaarne wala aasmaan mein suna jaata hai.'

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَيْوَةُ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ التَّمِيمِيِّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا بَحِيرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ  ، عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" لَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ إِلَيْكُمْ لَيْسَ بِوَهِنٍ، وَلَا كَسِلٍ، لِيُحْيِيَ قُلُوبًا غُلْفًا، وَيَفْتَحَ أَعْيُنًا عُمْيًا، وَيُسْمِعَ آذَانًا صُمًّا، وَيُقِيمَ السُّنَّةَ العَوْجَاءَ، حَتَّى يُقَالَ : لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Haywah ibn Shurayh, from Baqiyyah ibn al-Walid al-Tamimi, from Bahir ibn Sa'd, from Khalid ibn Ma'dan, from Jubayr ibn Nufayr al-Hadrami: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'A messenger has indeed come to you who is not weak nor lazy, to bring life to covered hearts, and open blind eyes, and make deaf ears hear, and set straight the crooked sunnah, until it is said: There is no god but Allah, alone.'
24.hi: Haywah ibn Shurayh ne Baqiyyah ibn al-Walid al-Tamimi se bataya: Humein Bahir ibn Sa'd ne bataya, Khalid ibn Ma'dan se, Jubayr ibn Nufayr al-Hadrami se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, 'Tumhare paas ek Rasool aaya hai jo na kamzor hai na susta, taake woh dhake hue dilon ko zinda kare, aur andhi aankhon ko khole, aur bahre kaanon ko sunaaye, aur tedhi sunnat ko seedha kare, yahan tak ke kaha jaaye: Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, akela.'

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْحِزَامِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي قَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَهُ إِلَيْهِ حَاجَةٌ، فَمَشَى مَعَهُ حَتَّى دَخَلَ، قَالَ : فَإِحْدَى رِجْلَيْهِ فِي الْبَيْتِ وَالْأُخْرَى خَارِجَة كَأَنَّهُ يُنَاجِي، فَالْتَفَتَ، فَقَالَ :" أَتَدْرِي مَنْ كُنْتُ أُكَلِّمُ؟ إِنَّ هَذَا مَلَكٌ لَمْ أَرَهُ قَطُّ قَبْلَ يَوْمِي هَذَا، اسْتَأْذَنَ رَبَّهُ أَنْ يُسَلِّمَ عَلَيَّ، قَالَ : إِنَّا آتَيْنَاكَ أَوْ أَنْزَلْنَا الْقُرْآنَ فَصْلًا، وَالسَّكِينَةَ صَبْرًا، وَالْفُرْقَانَ وَصْلًا "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Hizami, from Ishaq ibn Sulayman, from Amr ibn Abi Qays, from Ata, from Amir: He said: A man among the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ had a need with him, so he walked with him until he entered, he said: So one of his legs was in the house and the other outside, as if he was conversing privately, then he turned, and said: 'Do you know who I was speaking with? This was an angel I had never seen before this day of mine, he sought permission from his Lord to greet me with peace, he said: We have brought you, or We have sent down the Qur'an distinctly, and tranquility as patience, and the Criterion as a connection.'
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Hizami ne Ishaq ibn Sulayman se bataya: Humein Amr ibn Abi Qays ne bataya, Ata se, Amir se: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ ke sahaba mein se ek aadmi ki aapse zaroorat thi, to woh unke saath chala yahan tak ke woh dakhil hue, unhone bataya: To aapki ek taang ghar mein thi aur doosri baahar, goya aap kisi se guftagu kar rahe hon, fir aap mude, aur farmaya: 'Kya tumhein maloom hai main kis se baat kar raha tha? Yeh ek farishta tha jise maine apne is din se pehle kabhi nahi dekha, usne apne Rab se ijaazat maangi ke woh mujhe salaam kare, usne kaha: Humne tumhein diya hai, ya humne Quran wazeh tor par nazil kiya, aur sukoon sabr ke tor par, aur Furqan ittehad ke tor par.'

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُجَاهِدُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا رَيْحَانُ هُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادٌ هُوَ ابْنُ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَبِيعَةَ الْجُرَشِيَّ  ، يَقُولُ : أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ : لِتَنَمْ عَيْنُكَ، وَلْتَسْمَعْ أُذُنُكَ، وَلْيَعْقِلْ قَلْبُكَ، قَالَ :" فَنَامَتْ عَيْنَايَ، وَسَمِعَتْ أُذُنَايَ، وَعَقَلَ قَلْبِي "، قَالَ : فَقِيلَ لِي : سَيِّدٌ بَنَى دَارًا فَصَنَعَ مَأْدُبَةً، وَأَرْسَلَ دَاعِيًا، فَمَنْ أَجَابَ الدَّاعِيَ، دَخَلَ الدَّارَ، وَأَكَلَ مِنْ الْمَأْدُبَةِ، وَرَضِيَ عَنْهُ السَّيِّدُ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يُجِبْ الدَّاعِيَ، لَمْ يَدْخُلْ الدَّارَ، وَلَمْ يَطْعَمْ مِنْ الْمَأْدُبَةِ، وَسَخِطَ عَلَيْهِ السَّيِّدُ، قَالَ : " فَاللَّهُ : السَّيِّدُ، وَمُحَمَّدٌ : الدَّاعِي، وَالدَّارُ : الْإِسْلَامُ، وَالْمَأْدُبَةُ : الْجَنَّةُ "
24.en: Narrated by Mujahid ibn Musa, from Rayhan (Ibn Sa'id), from Abbad (Ibn Mansur), from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah, from Atiyyah: That he heard Rabi'ah al-Jurashi say: The Prophet ﷺ was approached, and it was said to him: 'Let your eye sleep, and let your ear listen, and let your heart understand,' he said: 'So my eyes slept, and my ears listened, and my heart understood,' he said: So it was said to me: A master built a house and prepared a banquet, and sent out a caller, so whoever responds to the caller, enters the house, and eats from the banquet, and the master is pleased with him, and whoever does not respond to the caller, does not enter the house, nor taste from the banquet, and the master is angry with him, he said: 'So Allah: is the master, and Muhammad: is the caller, and the house: is Islam, and the banquet: is Paradise.'
24.hi: Mujahid ibn Musa ne Rayhan se bataya (Ibn Sa'id), Abbad se (Ibn Mansur), Ayyub se, Abu Qilabah se, Atiyyah se: ke unhone Rabi'ah al-Jurashi ko kehte suna: Nabi ﷺ ke paas [koi] aaya, aur unse kaha gaya: 'Aapki aankh soye, aur aapka kaan sune, aur aapka dil samjhe,' aapne farmaya: 'To meri aankhein so gayin, aur mere kaan sunne lage, aur mera dil samajhne laga,' aapne bataya: To mujhse kaha gaya: Ek sardaar ne ghar banaaya aur ek dawat taiyaar ki, aur ek bulaane wala bheja, so jo bulaane wale ki baat maane, woh ghar mein dakhil ho, aur dawat se khaaye, aur sardaar usse razi ho, aur jo bulaane wale ki baat na maane, woh na ghar mein dakhil ho, na dawat chakhe, aur sardaar usse naaraz ho, aapne farmaya: 'To Allah: sardaar hai, aur Muhammad: bulaane wala hai, aur ghar: Islam hai, aur dawat: Jannat hai.'

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ  ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ التَّمِيمِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَرَجَ إِلَى الْبَطْحَاءِ ، وَمَعَهُ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ، فَأَقْعَدَهُ وَخَطَّ عَلَيْهِ خَطًّا، ثُمَّ قَالَ :" لَا تَبْرَحَنَّ فَإِنَّهُ سَيَنْتَهِي إِلَيْكَ رِجَالٌ فَلَا تُكَلِّمْهُمْ، فَإِنَّهُمْ لَنْ يُكَلِّمُوكَ "، فَمَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَيْثُ أَرَادَ، ثُمَّ جَعَلُوا يَنْتَهُونَ إِلَى الْخَطِّ لَا يُجَاوِزُونَهُ، ثُمَّ يَصْدُرُونَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ، جَاءَ إِلَيَّ فَتَوَسَّدَ فَخِذِي، وَكَانَ إِذَا نَامَ، نَفَخَ فِي النَّوْمِ، نَفْخًا فَبَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مُتَوَسِّدٌ فَخِذِي، رَاقِدٌ، إِذْ أَتَانِي رِجَالٌ كَأَنَّهُمْ الْجِمَالُ عَلَيْهِمْ ثِيَابٌ بِيضٌ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ مَا بِهِمْ مِنْ الْجَمَالِ حَتَّى قَعَدَ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ عِنْدَ رَأْسِهِ، وَطَائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ عِنْدَ رِجْلَيْهِ، فَقَالُوا بَيْنَهُمْ : مَا رَأَيْنَا عَبْدًا أُوتِيَ مِثْلَ مَا أُوتِيَ هَذَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : إِنَّ عَيْنَيْهِ لَتَنَامَانِ، وَإِنَّ قَلْبَهُ لَيَقْظَانُ، اضْرِبُوا لَهُ مَثَلًا : سَيِّدٌ بَنَى قَصْرًا ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مَأْدُبَةً فَدَعَا النَّاسَ إِلَى طَعَامِهِ وَشَرَابِهِ، ثُمَّ ارْتَفَعُوا، وَاسْتَيْقَظَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ : " أَتَدْرِي مَنْ هَؤُلَاءِ؟ "، قُلْتُ : اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ، قَالَ : " هُمْ الْمَلَائِكَةُ "، قَالَ : " وَهَلْ تَدْرِي مَا الْمَثَلُ الَّذِي ضَرَبُوهُ؟ "، قُلْتُ : اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ، قَالَ : " الرَّحْمَنُ بَنَى الْجَنَّةَ فَدَعَا إِلَيْهَا عِبَادَهُ، فَمَنْ أَجَابَهُ، دَخَلَ جَنَّتَهُ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يُجِبْهُ، عَاقَبَهُ وَعَذَّبَهُ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Abu Usamah, from Ja'far ibn Maymun al-Tamimi, from Abu Uthman al-Nahdi: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out to al-Batha, and Ibn Mas'ud was with him, so he seated him and drew a line around him, then said: 'Do not leave this at all, for indeed men will come near you, but do not speak to them, for they will never speak to you,' so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went where he intended, then they began coming close to the line without crossing it, then returning toward the Prophet ﷺ, until when it was the latter part of the night, he came to me and rested his head on my thigh, and when he slept, he would breathe [snore] in his sleep, so while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was resting his head on my thigh, asleep, some men came to me who looked like camels, wearing white garments, Allah knows how beautiful they were, until a group of them sat near his head, and a group near his feet, and they said among themselves: We have never seen a servant given what this Prophet ﷺ has been given: his eyes indeed sleep, but his heart is awake, strike an example for him: A master built a palace, then prepared a banquet, and called the people to his food and drink, then they rose, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ awoke at that, and said: 'Do you know who these were?' I said: 'Allah and His Messenger know best.' He said: 'They are the angels.' He said: 'And do you know what the example was that they struck?' I said: 'Allah and His Messenger know best.' He said: 'The Most Gracious built Paradise, and called His servants to it, so whoever responds to Him, enters His Paradise, and whoever does not respond to Him, He punishes him and torments him.'
24.hi: Al-Hasan ibn Ali ne Abu Usamah se bataya: Humein Ja'far ibn Maymun al-Tamimi ne bataya, Abu Uthman al-Nahdi se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ al-Batha ki taraf nikle, aur Ibn Mas'ud aapke saath the, to aapne unhein bithaya aur unke gird ek lakeer khaincha, fir farmaya: 'Ise bilkul na chhodna, kyunki kuch log tumhare qareeb aayenge, lekin unse baat mat karna, kyunki woh kabhi tumse baat nahi karenge,' to Rasulullah ﷺ jahan chaahte the wahan gaye, fir woh log lakeer tak aane lage bagair usse aage badhe, fir Nabi ﷺ ki taraf laut jaate, yahan tak ke jab raat ka aakhri hissa hua, aap mere paas aaye aur mere raan par sar rakh diya, aur jab aap sote, to neend mein saans lete, to jabke Rasulullah ﷺ mere raan par sar rakhe soye hue the, mere paas kuch aadmi aaye jo oont jaise dikhte the, safed kapde pehne hue, Allah jaanta hai woh kitne khoobsurat the, yahan tak ke unmein se ek giroh aapke sar ke paas baitha, aur ek giroh aapke paaon ke paas, aur unhone aapas mein kaha: Humne kabhi kisi bande ko woh nahi diya jaate dekha jo is Nabi ﷺ ko diya gaya hai: unki aankhein sote hain, lekin unka dil jaagta hai, inke liye ek misaal do: Ek sardaar ne mahal banaaya, fir dawat taiyaar ki, aur logon ko apne khaane-peene ki dawat di, fir woh uth gaye, aur Rasulullah ﷺ isi waqt jaage, aur farmaya: 'Kya tumhein maloom hai yeh kaun the?' Maine kaha: 'Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain.' Aapne farmaya: 'Yeh farishtay the.' Aapne farmaya: 'Aur kya tumhein maloom hai unhone kya misaal di?' Maine kaha: 'Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain.' Aapne farmaya: 'Rahman ne Jannat banaayi, aur apne bandon ko uski taraf bulaaya, so jo uski baat maane, woh uski Jannat mein dakhil hota hai, aur jo uski baat na maane, woh usay saza deta hai aur azaab deta hai.'

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ  ، عَنْ بَحِيرٍ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو السُّلَمِيُّ  ، عَنْ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ عَبْدٍ السُّلَمِيِّ  ، أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُمْ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ : كَيْفَ كَانَ أَوَّلُ شَأْنِكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟، قَالَ :" كَانَتْ حَاضِنَتِي مِنْ بَنِي سَعْدِ بْنِ بَكْرٍ، فَانْطَلَقْتُ أَنَا، وَابْنٌ لَهَا فِي بَهْمٍ لَنَا وَلَمْ نَأْخُذْ مَعَنَا زَادًا، فَقُلْتُ : يَا أَخِي، اذْهَبْ فَأْتِنَا بِزَادٍ مِنْ عِنْدِ أُمِّنَا، فَانْطَلَقَ أَخِي وَمَكَثْتُ عِنْدَ الْبَهْمِ، فَأَقْبَلَ طَائِرَانِ أَبْيَضَانِ كَأَنَّهُمَا نَسْرَانِ، فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا لِصَاحِبِهِ : أَهُوَ هُوَ؟، قَالَ الْآخَرُ : نَعَمْ، فَأَقْبَلَا يَبْتَدِرَانِي فَأَخَذَانِي فَبَطَحَانِي لِلْقَفَا فَشَقَّا بَطْنِي ثُمَّ اسْتَخْرَجَا قَلْبِي فَشَقَّاهُ، فَأَخْرَجَا مِنْهُ عَلَقَتَيْنِ سَوْدَاوَيْنِ، فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا لِصَاحِبِهِ : ائْتِنِي بِمَاءِ ثَلْجٍ، فَغَسَلَ بِهِ جَوْفِي، ثُمَّ قَالَ : ائْتِنِي بِمَاءِ بَرَدٍ، فَغَسَلَ بِهِ قَلْبِي، ثُمَّ قَالَ : ائْتِنِي بِالسَّكِينَةِ فَذَرَّهُ فِي قَلْبِي، ثُمَّ قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا لِصَاحِبِهِ : حُصْهُ، فَحَاصَهُ وَخَتَمَ عَلَيْهِ بِخَاتَمِ النُّبُوَّةِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا لِصَاحِبِهِ : اجْعَلْهُ فِي كِفَّةٍ وَاجْعَلْ أَلْفًا مِنْ أُمَّتِهِ فِي كِفَّةٍ "، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " فَإِذَا أَنَا أَنْظُرُ إِلَى الْأَلْفِ فَوْقِي أُشْفِقُ أَنْ يَخِرَّ عَلَيَّ بَعْضُهُمْ، فَقَالَ : لَوْ أَنَّ أُمَّتَهُ وُزِنَتْ بِهِ لَمَالَ بِهِمْ، ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَا وَتَرَكَانِي "، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " وَفَرِقْتُ فَرَقًا شَدِيدًا، ثُمَّ انْطَلَقْتُ إِلَى أُمِّي فَأَخْبَرْتُهَا بِالَّذِي لَقِيتُ، فَأَشْفَقَتْ أَنْ يَكُونَ قَدْ الْتَبَسَ بِي، فَقَالَتْ : أُعِيذُكَ بِاللَّهِ، فَرَحَلَتْ بَعِيرًا لَهَا، فَجَعَلَتْنِي عَلَى الرَّحْلِ وَرَكِبَتْ خَلْفِي حَتَّى بُلَغْنَا إِلَى أُمِّي، فَقَالَتْ : أَدَّيْتُ أَمَانَتِي وَذِمَّتِي، وَحَدَّثَتْهَا بِالَّذِي لَقِيتُ، فَلَمْ يَرُعْهَا ذَلِكَ، وَقَالَتْ : إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ حِينَ خَرَجَ مِنِّي شَيْئًا، يَعْنِي : نُورًا أَضَاءَتْ مِنْهُ قُصُورُ الشَّامِ "
24.en: Narrated by Nu'aym ibn Hammad, from Baqiyyah, from Bahir, from Khalid ibn Ma'dan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Amr al-Sulami, from Utbah ibn Abd al-Sulami: Who was among the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: that a man said to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: How was the beginning of your affair, O Messenger of Allah? He said: 'My wet-nurse was from Banu Sa'd ibn Bakr, so I went out, I and a son of hers, among our young livestock, and we did not take provisions with us, so I said: 'O my brother, go and bring us provisions from our mother,' so my brother went and I remained with the livestock, then two white birds approached, as if they were two eagles, so one of them said to his companion: 'Is it him?' The other said: 'Yes,' so they came racing toward me and took me and laid me flat on my back and split open my belly, then they took out my heart and split it open, and extracted from it two black clots, then one of them said to his companion: 'Bring me water of snow,' so he washed my insides with it, then he said: 'Bring me water of hail,' so he washed my heart with it, then he said: 'Bring me tranquility,' so he sprinkled it in my heart, then one of them said to his companion: 'Stitch it,' so he stitched it and sealed it with the seal of prophethood, then one of them said to his companion: 'Put him in one pan of the scale and put a thousand of his nation in the other pan.'' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'So I looked at the thousand above me, worried that some of them would fall upon me, so he said: If his nation were weighed against him, he would outweigh them, then they left and departed, leaving me.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'And I became greatly frightened, then I went to my mother and told her what I had encountered, so she feared that something had happened to me, so she said: 'I seek Allah's protection for you,' so she saddled a camel of hers, and put me on the saddle and rode behind me, until we reached my mother, and she said: 'I have fulfilled my trust and my duty,' and she told her what I had encountered, but that did not frighten her, and she said: 'I indeed saw, when he came out from me, something,' meaning: a light that lit up the palaces of Syria.'
24.hi: Nu'aym ibn Hammad ne Baqiyyah se bataya: Humein Bahir ne bataya, Khalid ibn Ma'dan se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Amr al-Sulami se, Utbah ibn Abd al-Sulami se, jo Rasulullah ﷺ ke sahaba mein se the: ke ek aadmi ne Rasulullah ﷺ se poocha: Aapke maamle ki shuruaat kaise thi, Ya Rasulullah? Aapne farmaya: 'Meri doodh-maa Banu Sa'd ibn Bakr mein se thi, so main nikla, main aur unka ek beta, humare kuch chhote maweshiyon mein, aur humne apne saath koi zaad-e-raah nahi liya, to maine kaha: 'Ae mere bhai, jao aur humare liye humari maa se zaad-e-raah le aao,' to mera bhai gaya aur main maweshiyon ke paas thehra, fir do safed parinde aaye, jaise ke woh do uqaab hon, to unmein se ek ne apne saathi se kaha: 'Kya yehi hai?' Doosre ne kaha: 'Haan,' to woh mujh par daudte hue aaye aur mujhe pakda aur mujhe peeth ke bal lita diya aur mera pet chaak kiya, fir unhone mera dil nikaala aur usay chaak kiya, aur usme se do kaale lothde nikaale, fir unmein se ek ne apne saathi se kaha: 'Baraf ka paani laao,' to usne isse mera andar dhoya, fir usne kaha: 'Ole ka paani laao,' to usne isse mera dil dhoya, fir usne kaha: 'Sukoon laao,' to usne mere dil mein bhar diya, fir unmein se ek ne apne saathi se kaha: 'Isay silo,' to usne isse silaa aur isper nabuwwat ki mohar lagaayi, fir unmein se ek ne apne saathi se kaha: 'Isay ek pallay mein rakho aur iski ummat mein se hazaar ko doosre pallay mein rakho.'' Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: 'To main hazaar ko apne oopar dekh raha tha, khauf tha ke unmein se koi mujhpar gir na jaaye, to usne kaha: Agar uski ummat usse taul di jaaye, to woh unhein bhaari padega, fir woh chale gaye aur mujhe chhod diya.' Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: 'Aur mujhe bahut zyada dar laga, fir main apni maa ke paas gaya aur unhein bataaya jo mere saath hua, to unhein khauf hua ke mujhpar kuch aa gaya ho, to unhone kaha: 'Main tujhe Allah ki panah mein deti hoon,' to unhone apna oont kasa, aur mujhe kaathi par bithaaya aur mere peechhe sawaar hui, yahan tak ke hum apni maa tak pahunche, aur unhone kaha: 'Maine apni amaanat aur zimmedaari poori kar di,' aur unhein bataaya jo mere saath hua, lekin isse unhein dar nahi laga, aur unhone kaha: 'Maine dekha tha, jab woh mujhse nikla, kuch,' yaani: ek noor jisse Sham ke mahal roshan ho gaye.'

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ الْقُرَشِيُّ  ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ الْغِفَارِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، كَيْفَ عَلِمْتَ أَنَّكَ نَبِيٌّ حَتَّى اسْتَيْقَنْتَ؟، فَقَالَ : " يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ،أَتَانِي مَلَكَانِ وَأَنَا بِبَعْضِ بَطْحَاءِ مَكَّةَ فَوَقَعَ أَحَدُهُمَا عَلَي الْأَرْضِ، وَكَانَ الْآخَرُ بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ، فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا لِصَاحِبِهِ : أَهُوَ هُوَ؟، قَالَ : نَعَمْ، قَالَ : فَزِنْهُ بِرَجُلٍ، فَوُزِنْتُ بِهِ فَوَزَنْتُهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : فَزِنْهُ بِعَشَرَةٍ، فَوُزِنْتُ بِهِمْ فَرَجَحْتُهُمْ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : زِنْهُ بِمِئَةٍ، فَوُزِنْتُ بِهِمْ فَرَجَحْتُهُمْ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : زِنْهُ بِأَلْفٍ، فَوُزِنْتُ بِهِمْ فَرَجَحْتُهُمْ كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ يَنْتَثِرُونَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ خِفَّةِ الْمِيزَانِ، قَالَ : فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا لِصَاحِبِهِ : لَوْ وَزَنْتَهُ بِأُمَّتِهِ لَرَجَحَهَا "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Imran, from Abu Da'ud, from Ja'far ibn Uthman al-Qurashi, from Uthman ibn Urwah ibn al-Zubayr, from his father, from Abu Dharr al-Ghifari: He said: I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, how did you know that you were a prophet, until you became certain?' So he said: 'O Abu Dharr, two angels came to me while I was in some part of the open plain of Makkah, and one of them settled on the ground, while the other was between the sky and the earth, so one of them said to his companion: 'Is it him?' He said: 'Yes,' he said: 'Weigh him against a man,' so I was weighed against him and I outweighed him, then he said: 'Weigh him against ten,' so I was weighed against them and I outweighed them, then he said: 'Weigh him against a hundred,' so I was weighed against them and I outweighed them, then he said: 'Weigh him against a thousand,' so I was weighed against them and I outweighed them, as if I am looking at them scattering off me from the lightness of the scale,' he said: 'So one of them said to his companion: 'If you had weighed him against his whole nation, he would have outweighed them.''
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Imran ne Abu Da'ud se bataya: Humein Ja'far ibn Uthman al-Qurashi ne bataya, Uthman ibn Urwah ibn al-Zubayr se, apne walid se, Abu Dharr al-Ghifari se: Unhone kaha, Maine poocha: 'Ya Rasulullah, aapko kaise pata chala ke aap Nabi hain, yahan tak ke aapko yaqeen ho gaya?' To aapne farmaya: 'Ae Abu Dharr, mere paas do farishtay aaye jabke main Makkah ke maidaan ke kisi hisse mein tha, aur unmein se ek zameen par utar aaya, jabke doosra aasmaan aur zameen ke darmiyan tha, to unmein se ek ne apne saathi se kaha: 'Kya yehi hai?' Usne kaha: 'Haan,' usne kaha: 'Isay ek aadmi ke saath toolo,' to mujhe uske saath toola gaya aur main usse bhaari nikla, fir usne kaha: 'Isay das ke saath toolo,' to mujhe unke saath toola gaya aur main unse bhaari nikla, fir usne kaha: 'Isay sau ke saath toolo,' to mujhe unke saath toola gaya aur main unse bhaari nikla, fir usne kaha: 'Isay hazaar ke saath toolo,' to mujhe unke saath toola gaya aur main unse bhaari nikla, goya main unhein dekh raha hoon ke woh mujhse tarazu ki halki-pan ki wajah se bikher rahe hain,' aapne farmaya: 'To unmein se ek ne apne saathi se kaha: 'Agar tum isay iski poori ummat ke saath toolte, to yeh unse bhaari padta.''

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ خَلِيلٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ : " يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ،إِنَّمَا أَنَا رَحْمَةٌ مُهْدَاةٌ "
24.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Khalil, from Ali ibn Mushir, from al-A'mash, from Abu Salih: He said: The Prophet ﷺ used to call out to them: 'O people, I am only a mercy sent as a gift.'
24.hi: Isma'il ibn Khalil ne Ali ibn Mushir se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya, Abu Salih se: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ unhein pukaarte the: 'Ae logo, main to sirf tohfe mein bheji gayi ek rehmat hoon.'

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَرِيفٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَيَّانَ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ،  عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ : كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فِي سَفَرٍ فَأَقْبَلَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَلَمَّا دَنَا مِنْهُ، قَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَيْنَ تُرِيدُ؟ "، قَالَ : إِلَى أَهْلِي، قَالَ : " هَلْ لَكَ فِي خَيْرٍ؟ "، قَالَ : وَمَا هُوَ؟، قَالَ : " تَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ "، فَقَالَ : وَمَنْ يَشْهَدُ عَلَى مَا تَقُولُ؟، قَالَ : " هَذِهِ السَّلَمَةُ "، فَدَعَاهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهِيَ بِشَاطِئِ الْوَادِي فَأَقْبَلَتْ تَخُدُّ الْأَرْضَ خَدًّا حَتَّى قَامَتْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، فَاسْتَشْهَدَهَا ثَلَاثًا، فَشَهِدَتْ ثَلَاثًا أَنَّهُ كَمَا قَالَ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَتْ إِلَى مَنْبَتِهَا، وَرَجَعَ الْأَعْرَابِيُّ إِلَى قَوْمِهِ، وَقَالَ : إِنْ اتَّبَعُونِي أَتَيْتُكَ بِهِمْ، وَإِلَّا رَجَعْتُ، فَكُنْتُ مَعَكَ
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Tarif, from Muhammad ibn Fudayl, from Abu Hayyan, from Ata, from Ibn Umar رضي الله عنهما: He said: We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on a journey, and a Bedouin approached, and when he came near him, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: 'Where do you intend to go?' He said: 'To my family.' He said: 'Is there something good for you?' He said: 'And what is it?' He said: 'You testify that there is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger.' So he said: 'And who testifies to what you say?' He said: 'This tree.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ called it, and it was at the edge of the valley, so it came forward, cutting through the ground, until it stood before him, so he asked it to testify three times, and it testified three times that he was as he said, then it returned to where it grew, and the Bedouin returned to his people, and said: 'If they follow me, I will bring them to you, and if not, I will return, and I will be with you.'
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Tarif ne Muhammad ibn Fudayl se bataya: Humein Abu Hayyan ne bataya, Ata se, Ibn Umar se رضي الله عنهما: Unhone kaha, Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath ek safar mein the, to ek Bedouin aaya, aur jab woh aapke qareeb aaya, Rasulullah ﷺ ne usse farmaya: 'Tum kahan jaana chaahte ho?' Usne kaha: 'Apne gharwalon ke paas.' Aapne farmaya: 'Kya tumhare liye koi bhalaai hai?' Usne poocha: 'Aur woh kya hai?' Aapne farmaya: 'Tum gawahi do ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, akela, uska koi shareek nahi, aur ke Muhammad uske banda aur Rasool hain.' To usne poocha: 'Aur iski gawahi kaun deta hai jo aap kehte hain?' Aapne farmaya: 'Yeh darakht.' To Rasulullah ﷺ ne isay bulaaya, aur woh waadi ke kinare tha, to woh zameen ko chaak karte hue aage badha, yahan tak ke aapke saamne khada ho gaya, to aapne isse teen martaba gawahi maangi, aur usne teen martaba gawahi di ke aap waisi hi hain jaisa aapne farmaya, fir woh apni jagah wapas chala gaya, aur Bedouin apni qaum ke paas laut gaya, aur kaha: 'Agar unhone meri baat maani, to main unhein aapke paas laaunga, aur agar nahi, to main wapas aa jaaunga, aur main aapke saath rahunga.'

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : خَرَجْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي سَفَرٍ، وَكَانَ لَا يَأْتِي الْبَرَازَ حَتَّى يَتَغَيَّبَ فَلَا يُرَى، فَنَزَلْنَا بِفَلَاةٍ مِنْ الْأَرْضِ لَيْسَ فِيهَا شَجَرةٌ، وَلَا عَلَمٌ، فَقَالَ : " يَا جَابِرُ،اجْعَلْ فِي إِدَاوَتِكَ مَاءً ثُمَّ انْطَلِقْ بِنَا "، قَالَ : فَانْطَلَقْنَا حَتَّى لَا نُرَى، فَإِذَا هُوَ بِشَجَرَتَيْنِ بَيْنَهُمَا أَرْبَعُ أَذْرُعٍ ، فَقَالَ : " يَا جَابِرُ، انْطَلِقْ إِلَى هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ، فَقُلْ : يُقُولُ لَكِ رَسولُ اللَّهِ K : الْحَقِي بِصَاحِبَتِكِ حَتَّى أَجْلِسَ خَلْفَكُمَا "، فَرَجَعَتْ إِلَيْهَا، فَجَلَسَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَلْفَهُمَ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَتَا إِلَى مَكَانِهِمَا، فَرَكِبْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ بَيْنَنَا كَأَنَّمَا عَلَيْنَا الطَّيْرُ تُظِلُّنَا، فَعَرَضَتْ لَهُ امْرَأَةٌ مَعَهَا صَبِيٌّ لَهَا، فَقَالَتْ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ ابْنِي هَذَا يَأْخُذُهُ الشَّيْطَانُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ ثَلَاثَ مِرَارٍ، قَالَ : فَتَنَاوَلَ الصَّبِيَّ فَجَعَلَهُ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ مُقَدَّمِ الرَّحْلِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " اخْسَأْ عَدُوَّ اللَّهِ، أَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، اخْسَأْ عَدُوَّ اللَّهِ أَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ثَلَاثًا "، ثُمَّ دَفَعَهُ إِلَيْهَا، فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا، مَرَرْنَا بِذَلِكَ الْمَكَانِ فَعَرَضَتْ لَنَا الْمَرْأَةُ مَعَهَا صَبِيُّهَا، وَمَعَهَا كَبْشَانِ تَسُوقُهُمَا، فَقَالَتْ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ اقْبَلْ مِنِّي هَدِيَّتِي، فَوَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ مَا عَادَ إِلَيْهِ بَعْدُ، فَقَالَ : " خُذُوا مِنْهَا وَاحِدًا وَرُدُّوا عَلَيْهَا الْآخَرَ "، قَالَ : ثُمَّ سِرْنَا وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَيْنَنَا كَأَنَّمَا عَلَيْنَا الطَّيْرُ تُظِلُّنَا، فَإِذَا جَمَلٌ نَادٌّ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ بَيْنَ سِمَاطَيْنِ خَرَّ سَاجِدًا، فَجَلَسَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَقَالَ عَلَيَّ النَّاسَ : " مَنْ صَاحِبُ الْجَمَلِ؟ " فَإِذَا فِتْيَةٌ مِنْ الْأَنْصَارِ، قَالُوا : هُوَ لَنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ : " فَمَا شَأْنُهُ "؟، قَالُوا : اسْتَنَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ مُنْذُ عِشْرِينَ سَنَةً وَكَانَتْ بِهِ شُحَيْمَةٌ فَأَرَدْنَا أَنْ نَنْحَرَهُ فَنَقْسِمَهُ بَيْنَ غِلْمَانِنَا، فَانْفَلَتَ مِنَّا، قَالَ : " بِيعُونِيهِ "، قَالُوا : لَا، بَلْ هُوَ لَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ : " أَمَّا لا، فَأَحْسِنُوا إِلَيْهِ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُ أَجَلُهُ "، قَالَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، نَحْنُ أَحَقُّ بِالسُّجُودِ لَكَ مِنْ الْبَهَائِمِ، قَالَ : " لَا يَنْبَغِي لِشَيْءٍ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ لِشَيْءٍ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَلِكَ، كَانَ النِّسَاءُ لِأَزْوَاجِهِنَّ "
24.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Isma'il ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir رضي الله عنه: He said: I went out with the Prophet ﷺ on a journey, and he would not go to relieve himself until he was concealed and could not be seen, so we stopped at an open piece of land with no tree and no landmark, so he said: 'O Jabir, put water in your water-skin, then let us go,' he said: So we went until we could not be seen, and there he was near two trees, four cubits apart, so he said: 'O Jabir, go to this tree, and say: The Messenger of Allah says to you: Join your companion, until I sit behind you both,' so it returned to it, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sat behind them, then the two returned to their place, and we rode with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and the Messenger of Allah was between us as if birds were shading us, and a woman with a child of hers presented herself to him, and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, this son of mine, the Shaytan seizes him three times every day,' he said: So he took the boy and put him between himself and the front of the saddle, then said: 'Be off, enemy of Allah, I am the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, be off, enemy of Allah, I am the Messenger of Allah ﷺ,' three times, then he handed him back to her, so when we had finished our journey, we passed by that place, and the woman presented herself to us with her son, and with her two rams that she was driving, and she said: 'O Messenger of Allah, accept my gift, for by the One who sent you with truth, it has not returned to him since,' so he said: 'Take one from her, and return the other to her.' He said: Then we traveled on, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was between us as if birds were shading us, and there was a runaway camel, until when it was between two rows, it fell down prostrating, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sat, and said to the people: 'Who is the owner of this camel?' So there were some young men from the Ansar, they said: 'It is ours, O Messenger of Allah,' he said: 'What is the matter with it?' They said: 'We have been using it for plowing for twenty years, and it had some fat on it, so we wanted to slaughter it and divide it among our boys, but it escaped from us.' He said: 'Sell it to me.' They said: 'No, rather it is yours, O Messenger of Allah,' he said: 'As you wish then, but treat it well until its term comes to it.' The Muslims said at that: 'O Messenger of Allah, we have more right to prostrate to you than the animals,' he said: 'It is not fitting for anything to prostrate to anything, and were that so, it would be for wives to their husbands.'
