24.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Isma'il ibn Abd al-Malik se bataya: Humein Abu al-Zubayr ne bataya, Jabir se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Main Nabi ﷺ ke saath ek safar mein nikla, aur aap qaza-e-hajat ke liye tab tak nahi jaate the jab tak chhup na jaate aur dikhaayi na dete, to hum ek khaali zameen par utre jismein na koi darakht tha na koi nishaani, to aapne farmaya: 'Ae Jabir, apne mashkeeze mein paani daalo, fir humein le chalo,' unhone bataya: To hum chale yahan tak ke hum dikhaayi nahi dete the, wahan aap do darakhton ke paas the, jinke darmiyan chaar haath ki doori thi, to aapne farmaya: 'Ae Jabir, is darakht ke paas jao, aur kaho: Rasulullah tumse kehte hain: Apni saathi darakht se mil jao, yahan tak ke main tum dono ke peechhe baithun,' to woh usse jaa mili, aur Rasulullah ﷺ unke peechhe baithe, fir dono apni jagah laut aayin, aur hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath sawaar hue, aur Rasulullah humare darmiyan the goya humpar parinde chhaanv kar rahe hon, aur ek aurat apne bachche ke saath aapke saamne aayi, aur kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah, mera yeh beta, shaytan usay har din teen martaba pakad leta hai,' unhone bataya: To aapne bachche ko liya aur usay apne aur kaathi ke aage wale hisse ke darmiyan rakha, fir farmaya: 'Duur ho ja, Allah ke dushman, main Allah ka Rasool ﷺ hoon, duur ho ja, Allah ke dushman, main Allah ka Rasool ﷺ hoon,' teen martaba, fir usay wapas usse de diya, to jab humne apna safar poora kiya, hum us jagah se guzre to aurat humare saamne apne bachche ke saath aayi, aur uske saath do mendhe the jinhein woh hank rahi thi, aur usne kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah, mera tohfa qabool keejiye, us Zaat ki qasam jisne aapko haq ke saath bheja, woh uske baad se kabhi nahi laut kar aaya,' to aapne farmaya: 'Ek unse le lo aur doosra usay wapas kar do.' Unhone bataya: Fir hum chale aur Rasulullah ﷺ humare darmiyan the goya humpar parinde chhaanv kar rahe hon, to ek bhaaga hua oont tha, yahan tak ke jab woh do safon ke darmiyan tha, woh sajde mein gir gaya, to Rasulullah ﷺ baithe, aur logon se farmaya: 'Is oont ka maalik kaun hai?' To Ansar ke kuch jawaan the, unhone kaha: 'Yeh humara hai, Ya Rasulullah,' aapne poocha: 'Ismein kya baat hai?' Unhone kaha: 'Hum ise bees saal se hal jotne ke liye istemaal kar rahe hain, aur usmein kuch charbi thi, to humne isay zabah karke apne ladkon mein baantne ka irada kiya, lekin yeh humse bhaag gaya.' Aapne farmaya: 'Ise mujhe becho.' Unhone kaha: 'Nahi, balke yeh aapka hai, Ya Rasulullah,' aapne farmaya: 'Agar aisa hai, to iske saath achha sulook karo yahan tak ke iski ajal aa jaaye.' Musalmanon ne is par kaha: 'Ya Rasulullah, hum jaanwaron se zyada aapko sajda karne ke haqdaar hain,' aapne farmaya: 'Kisi cheez ke liye jaayez nahi ke woh kisi cheez ko sajda kare, aur agar aisa hota, to biwiyaan apne shohar ko karti.'

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَجْلَحُ  ، عَنْ الذَّيَّالِ بْنِ حَرْمَلَةَ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : أَقْبَلْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَتَّى دُفِعْنَا إِلَى حَائِطٍ فِي بَنِي النَّجَّارِ، فَإِذَا فِيهِ جَمَلٌ لَا يَدْخُلُ الْحَائِطَ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا شَدَّ عَلَيْهِ، فَذَكَرُوا ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَأَتَاهُ، فَدَعَاهُ فَجَاءَ وَاضِعًا مِشْفَرَهُ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ حَتَّى بَرَكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، فَقَالَ :" هَاتُوا خِطَامًا "، فَخَطَمَهُ وَدَفَعَهُ إِلَى صَاحِبِهِ، ثُمَّ الْتَفَتَ، فَقَالَ : " مَا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا يَعْلَمُ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، إِلَّا عَاصِيَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ "
24.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from al-Ajlah, from al-Dhayyal ibn Harmalah, from Jabir ibn Abdullah رضي الله عنه: He said: We came with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ until we were driven to an orchard in Banu al-Najjar, and there was a camel in it that no one entered the orchard except that it charged at him, so they mentioned that to the Prophet ﷺ, so he came to it, and called it, and it came placing its lower lip on the ground until it knelt before him, so he said: 'Bring a nose-rein,' so he put the rein on it and handed it to its owner, then he turned, and said: 'There is no one between the sky and the earth except that he knows I am the Messenger of Allah, except the disobedient among the jinn and mankind.'
24.hi: Ya'la ne al-Ajlah se bataya: Humein al-Dhayyal ibn Harmalah ne bataya, Jabir ibn Abdullah se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath aaye yahan tak ke hum Banu al-Najjar ke ek baagh tak pahunche, to usmein ek oont tha jo kisi ko baagh mein dakhil nahi hone deta tha magar uspar chad daudta, to unhone yeh baat Nabi ﷺ se zikr ki to aap uske paas aaye, to aapne usay bulaaya, to woh apna hoant zameen par rakhte hue aaya yahan tak ke aapke saamne baith gaya, to aapne farmaya: 'Nakel laao,' to aapne isay nakel pehnaayi aur uske maalik ke supurd kar diya, fir aap mude, aur farmaya: 'Aasmaan aur zameen ke darmiyan koi bhi aisa nahi jo yeh na jaanta ho ke main Allah ka Rasool hoon, siwaay jinnaat aur insaanon mein se nafarmaanon ke.'

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ فَرْقَدٍ السَّبَخِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، إِنَّ امْرَأَةً جَاءَتْ بِابْنٍ لَهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَتْ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ ابْنِي بِهِ جُنُونٌ، وَإِنَّهُ يَأْخُذُهُ عِنْدَ غَدَائِنَا وَعَشَائِنَا فَيُخَبَّثُ عَلَيْنَا، "فَمَسَحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ صَدْرَهُ، وَدَعَا فَثَعَّ ثَعَّةً، وَخَرَجَ مِنْ جَوْفِهِ مِثْلُ الْجِرْوِ الْأَسْوَدِ، فَسَعَى "
24.en: Narrated by al-Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Farqad al-Sabakhi, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: That a woman brought her son to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and said: O Messenger of Allah, my son has madness, and it seizes him at our lunch and our dinner and he behaves badly toward us, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wiped his chest, and prayed, so he vomited, and something like a black puppy came out of his belly, and it ran off.
24.hi: Al-Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se, Farqad al-Sabakhi se, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas se رضي الله عنهما bataya: Ek aurat apne bete ko Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas laayi, aur kaha: Ya Rasulullah, mere bete ko junoon hai, aur yeh humare naashte aur khaane ke waqt usay pakadta hai aur woh humare saamne badtameezi karta hai, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne uske seene par haath phera, aur dua ki, to usne ulti ki, aur uske pet se ek kaale kutte ke bachche jaisi cheez nikli, aur woh daud gayi.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ طَهْمَانَ  ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنِّي لَأَعْرِفُ حَجَرًا بِمَكَّةَ كَانَ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيَّ قَبْلَ أَنْ أُبْعَثَ إِنِّي لَأَعْرِفُهُ الْآنَ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Yahya ibn Abi Bukayr al-Abdi, from Ibrahim ibn Tahman, from Simak, from Jabir ibn Samurah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: I indeed recognize a stone in Makkah that used to greet me before I was sent as a prophet, I indeed recognize it now.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Sa'id ne Yahya ibn Abi Bukayr al-Abdi se bataya: Humein Ibrahim ibn Tahman ne bataya, Simak se, Jabir ibn Samurah se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Main Makkah mein ek patthar ko pehchaanta hoon jo mujhe Nabuwwat milne se pehle salaam kiya karta tha, main abhi bhi usay pehchaanta hoon.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا فَرْوَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي ثَوْرٍ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل السُّدِّيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبَّادٍ أَبِي يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ   رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ، قَالَ :" كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِمَكَّةَ فَخَرَجْنَا مَعَهُ فِي بَعْضِ نَوَاحِيهَا، فَمَرَرْنَا بَيْنَ الْجِبَالِ وَالشَّجَرِ، فَلَمْ نَمُرَّ بِشَجَرَةٍ وَلَا جَبَلٍ إِلَّا قَالَ : السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Farwah, from al-Walid ibn Abi Thawr al-Hamdani, from Isma'il al-Suddi, from Abbad Abu Yazid, from Ali ibn Abi Talib رضوان الله عليه: He said: We were with the Prophet ﷺ in Makkah, so we went out with him to some of its outskirts, so we passed among mountains and trees, and we never passed by any tree or mountain except that it said: Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah.
24.hi: Farwah ne al-Walid ibn Abi Thawr al-Hamdani se bataya: Humein Isma'il al-Suddi ne bataya, Abbad Abu Yazid se, Ali ibn Abi Talib رضوان الله عليه se: Unhone kaha, Hum Nabi ﷺ ke saath Makkah mein the to hum aapke saath uske kisi hisse mein nikle, to hum pahaadon aur darakhton ke darmiyan se guzre, aur hum kisi bhi darakht ya pahaad se nahi guzre magar usne kaha: Ae Allah ke Rasool, aap par salaam ho.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ شِمْرِ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ  ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ   مِنْ مُزَيْنَةَ، أَوْ جُهَيْنَةَ، قَالَ : صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْفَجْرَ فَإِذَا هُوَ بِقَرِيبٍ مِنْ مِئَةِ ذِئْبٍ قَدْ أَقْعَيْنَ وُفُودُ الذِّئَابِ، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" تَرْضَخُونَ لَهُمْ شَيْئًا مِنْ طَعَامِكُمْ وَتَأْمَنُونَ عَلَى مَا سِوَى ذَلِكَ؟ "، فَشَكَوْا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْحَاجَةَ، قَالَ : " فَآذِنُوهُنَّ "، قَالَ : فَآذَنُوهُنَّ فَخَرَجْنَ وَلَهُنَّ عُوَاءٌ
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from al-A'mash, from Shimr ibn Atiyyah, from a man from Muzaynah or Juhaynah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed Fajr, and there was he, near a hundred wolves who had crouched, delegations of wolves, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to them: You should give them something of your food and be safe otherwise? So they complained to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ of need, he said: So allow them, he said: So they allowed them, and they went out howling.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya, Shimr ibn Atiyyah se, Muzaynah ya Juhaynah ke ek aadmi se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne Fajr padhi to wahan bhediyon ke qareeb sau ka jhund tha jo baithe hue the, bhediyon ke wafd, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne unse farmaya: Tum unhein apne khaane mein se kuch dete ho aur baaqi ke liye mehfooz rehte ho? To unhone Rasulullah ﷺ se zaroorat ki shikaayat ki, aapne farmaya: To unhein ijaazat do, unhone bataya: To unhone unhein ijaazat di, to woh cheekhte hue nikal gaye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : جَاءَ جِبْرِيلُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ حَزِينٌ، وَقَدْ تَخَضَّبَ بِالدَّمِ مِنْ فِعْلِ أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ، فَقَالَ جِبْرِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَلْ تُحِبُّ أَنْ أُرِيَكَ آيَةً؟، قَالَ :" نَعَمْ، فَنَظَرَ إِلَى شَجَرَةٍ مِنْ وَرَائِهِ "، فَقَالَ : ادْعُ بِهَا، فَدَعَا بِهَا، فَجَاءَتْ وَقَامَتْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، فَقَالَ : مُرْهَا فَلْتَرْجِعْ، فَأَمَرَهَا فَرَجَعَتْ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " حَسْبِي حَسْبِي "
24.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Mu'awiyah, from al-A'mash, from Abu Sufyan, from Anas ibn Malik رضي الله عنه: He said: Jibril came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was sitting sad, having been stained with blood from what the people of Makkah of Quraysh had done, so Jibril, upon him be peace, said: O Messenger of Allah, would you like me to show you a sign? He said: Yes, and he looked at a tree behind him, so he said: Call it, so he called it, and it came and stood before him, so he said: Command it to return, so he commanded it and it returned, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Enough for me, enough for me.
24.hi: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ne Abu Mu'awiyah se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya, Abu Sufyan se, Anas ibn Malik se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Jibreel Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaye jabke aap gham mein baithe hue the, aur Makkah ke Quraysh logon ki karastaani se khoon lag chuka tha, to Jibreel, alayhis-salaam, ne kaha: Ya Rasulullah, kya aap chaahte hain ke main aapko ek nishaani dikhaaun? Aapne farmaya: Haan, to aapne apne peechhe ek darakht dekha, to unhone kaha: Isay bulaao, to aapne isay bulaaya, to woh aayi aur aapke saamne khadi ho gayi, unhone kaha: Isay wapas jaane ka hukum do, to aapne hukum diya to woh wapas chali gayi, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: Bas mere liye, bas mere liye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ  ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي ظَبْيَانَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : أَتَى رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي عَامِرٍ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَلَا أُرِيكَ آيَةً "، قَالَ : بَلَى، قَالَ : " فَاذْهَبْ فَادْعُ تِلْكَ النَّخْلَةَ "، فَدَعَاهَا فَجَاءَتْ تَنْقُزُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، قَالَ : قُلْ لَهَا تَرْجِعْ، قَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " ارْجِعِي "، فَرَجَعَتْ حَتَّى عَادَتْ إِلَى مَكَانِهَا، فَقَالَ : يَا بَنِي عَامِرٍ، مَا رَأَيْتُ رَجُلًا كَالْيَوْمِ أَسْحَرَ مِنْهُ !
24.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Jarir, and Abu Mu'awiyah, from al-A'mash, from Abu Zabyan, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه: He said: A man from Banu Amir came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Shall I not show you a sign? He said: Yes indeed, he said: Go and call that palm-tree, so he called it, and it came leaping before him, he said: Tell it to return, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to it: Return, so it returned until it went back to its place, so he said: O Banu Amir, I have never seen a man more magical than him today!
24.hi: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ne Jarir se, aur Abu Mu'awiyah se bataya, al-A'mash se, Abu Zabyan se, Ibn Abbas se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Banu Amir ka ek aadmi Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaya, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: Kya main tumhein ek nishaani na dikhaaun? Usne kaha: Kyun nahi, aapne farmaya: Jao aur us khajoor ke darakht ko bulaao, to usne bulaaya, to woh uske saamne kudte hue aayi, usne kaha: Isse kaho wapas jaaye, Rasulullah ﷺ ne usse farmaya: Wapas jaao, to woh wapas gayi yahan tak ke apni jagah laut aayi, to usne kaha: Ae Banu Amir, maine aaj jaisa jaadugar kabhi kisi aadmi ko nahi dekha!

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ صَفْوَانَ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى  ،  عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ : دَعَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِلَالًا، فَطَلَبَ بِلَالٌ الْمَاءَ ثُمَّ جَاءَ، فَقَالَ : لَا وَاللَّهِ مَا وَجَدْتُ الْمَاءَ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" فَهَلْ مِنْ شَنٍّ؟ " فَأَتَاهُ بِشَنٍّ، فَبَسَطَ كَفَّيْهِ فِيهِ فَانْبَعَثَتْ تَحْتَ يَدَيْهِ عَيْنٌ، قَالَ : فَكَانَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ يَشْرَبُ، وَغَيْرُهُ يَتَوَضَّأُ
24.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Ibrahim, from Shu'ayb ibn Safwan, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Abu al-Duha, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: He said: The Prophet ﷺ called Bilal, so Bilal sought water then came, and said: No, by Allah, I did not find water, so the Prophet ﷺ said: Is there any water-skin? So he brought him a water-skin, and he spread his two palms into it, and a spring gushed forth beneath his hands, he said: So Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه would drink, and others would perform ablution.
24.hi: Isma'il ibn Ibrahim ne Shu'ayb ibn Safwan se bataya: Humein Ata ibn al-Sa'ib ne bataya, Abu al-Duha se, Ibn Abbas se رضي الله عنهما: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ ne Bilal ko bulaaya, to Bilal ne paani dhoondha fir aaye, aur kaha: Nahi, Allah ki qasam, mujhe paani nahi mila, to Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: To kya koi mashk hai? To woh aapke paas ek mashk laaye, to aapne apni donon hatheliyaan usmein phailaayin, to aapke haathon ke neeche se ek chashma phoot padaa, unhone bataya: To Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه peete the, aur doosre wudu karte the.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ  ، عَنْ نُبَيْحٍ الْعَنَزِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا : غَزَوْنَا أَوْ سَافَرْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَنَحْنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِضْعَةَ عَشَرَ وَمِائَتَانِ فَحَضَرَتْ الصَّلَاةُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" هَلْ فِي الْقَوْمِ مِنْ طَهُورٍ؟ "، فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ يَسْعَى، بِإِدَاوَةٍ فِيهَا شَيْءٌ مِنْ مَاءٍ، لَيْسَ فِي الْقَوْمِ مَاءٌ غَيْرُهُ، " فَصَبَّهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي قَدَحٍ، ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ فَأَحْسَنَ الْوُضُوءَ، ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ وَتَرَكَ الْقَدَحَ "، فَرَكِبَ النَّاسُ ذَلِكَ الْقَدَحَ، وَقَالُوا : تَمَسَّحُوا تَمَسَّحُوا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " عَلَى رِسْلِكُمْ " حِينَ سَمِعَهُمْ يَقُولُونَ ذَلِكَ، " فَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَفَّهُ فِي الْمَاءِ وَالْقَدَحِ "، وَقَالَ : " بِسْمِ اللَّهِ "، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " أَسْبِغُوا الطُّهُورَ "، فَوَالَّذِي هُوَ ابْتَلَانِي بِبَصَرِي لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ الْعُيُونَ، عُيُونَ الْمَاءِ تَخْرُجُ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ فَلَمْ يَرْفَعْهَا حَتَّى تَوَضَّئُوا أَجْمَعُونَ
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Abu Awanah, from al-Aswad ibn Qays, from Nubayh al-Anazi: He said: Jabir ibn Abdullah رضي الله عنهما said: We fought, or we traveled, with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and we were that day some twelve hundred, and prayer time came, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Is there anyone among the people with purifying water? So a man came running with a water-skin containing a little water, there was no water among the people besides it, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ poured it into a bowl, then performed ablution beautifully, then left and left the bowl, so the people rushed to that bowl, and said: Wipe yourselves, wipe yourselves, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Take it easy, when he heard them saying that, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ placed his palm into the water and the bowl, and said: In the name of Allah, then said: Perform ablution completely, so by the One who gave me my sight, I indeed saw the springs, springs of water coming out from between his fingers, and he did not lift it until they had all performed ablution.
24.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Abu Awanah se bataya: Humein al-Aswad ibn Qays ne bataya, Nubayh al-Anazi se: Unhone kaha, Jabir ibn Abdullah رضي الله عنهما ne kaha: Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath jung ya safar mein gaye aur hum us din baarah sau ke qareeb the, aur namaz ka waqt aaya, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne poocha: Kya logon mein se kisi ke paas paak paani hai? To ek aadmi daudte hue ek mashk laaya jismein thoda paani tha, logon mein iske siwa koi paani nahi tha, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne usay ek pyaale mein daala, fir wudu kiya achhi tarah, fir chale gaye aur pyaala chhod diya, to log us pyaale par toot pade, aur kaha: Chhoo lo, chhoo lo, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: Aaraam se, jab unhone yeh sunaa, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne apni hatheli paani aur pyaale mein rakhi, aur farmaya: Bismillah, fir farmaya: Poora wudu karo, to us Zaat ki qasam jisne mujhe nazar di, maine chashmay, paani ke chashmay dekhe jo aapki ungliyon ke darmiyan se nikal rahe the, aur aapne usay nahi utha jab tak sab logon ne wudu na kar liya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ  ، وَحُصَيْنٍ  ، سَمِعَا سَالِمَ بْنَ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ  ، يَقُولُ : سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ : أَصَابَنَا عَطَشٌ فَجَهَشْنَا، فَانْتَهَيْنَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، " فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ فِي تَوْرٍ، فَجَعَلَ يَفُورُ كَأَنَّهُ عُيُونٌ، مِنْ خَلَلِ أَصَابِعِهِ "، وَقَالَ :" اذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ "، فَشَرِبْنَا حَتَّى وَسِعَنَا وَكَفَانَا، وَفِي حَدِيثِ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ : فَقُلْنَا لِجَابِرٍ : كَمْ كُنْتُمْ؟، قَالَ : كُنَّا أَلْفًا وَخَمْسَ مِئَةٍ وَلَوْ كُنَّا مِئَةَ أَلْفٍ لَكَفَانَا
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, and Sa'id ibn al-Rabi', from Shu'bah, from Amr ibn Murrah, and Husayn, both heard Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd say: I heard Jabir ibn Abdullah رضي الله عنهما say: We suffered thirst, so we panicked, and we came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he put his hand in a vessel, and water began gushing as if it were springs, from between his fingers, and he said: Remember the name of Allah, so we drank until it was enough and sufficient for us, and in the hadith of Amr ibn Murrah: We said to Jabir: How many were you? He said: We were one thousand five hundred, and had we been a hundred thousand, it would have sufficed us.
24.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, aur Sa'id ibn al-Rabi' ne Shu'bah se bataya: Humein Amr ibn Murrah, aur Husayn ne bataya, dono ne Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd ko kehte suna: Maine Jabir ibn Abdullah رضي الله عنهما ko kehte suna: Humein pyaas lagi to hum ghabraaye, to hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas gaye, to aapne apna haath ek bartan mein rakha, to paani chashmon ki tarah phootne laga, aapki ungliyon ke darmiyan se, aur aapne farmaya: Allah ka naam lo, to hum piye yahan tak ke hum sab ke liye kaafi ho gaya, aur Amr ibn Murrah ki hadith mein: Humne Jabir se poocha: Tum kitne the? Unhone kaha: Hum ek hazaar paanch sau the, aur agar hum ek lakh bhi hote to yeh humein kaafi ho jaata.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْجَعْدُ أَبُو عُثْمَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ  رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : شَكَى أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْعَطَشَ،" فَدَعَا بِعُسٍّ، فَصُبَّ فِيهِ مَاءٌ، وَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَدَهُ فِيهِ "، قَالَ : فَجَعَلْتُ أَنْظُرُ إِلَى الْمَاءِ يَنْبُعُ عُيُونًا مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَالنَّاسُ يَسْتَقُونَ حَتَّى اسْتَقَى النَّاسُ كُلُّهُمْ
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi, from Ja'far ibn Sulayman, from al-Ja'd Abu Uthman, from Anas ibn Malik رضي الله عنه, from Jabir ibn Abdullah: He said: The Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ complained of thirst to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he called for a large bowl, and water was poured into it, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ put his hand in it, he said: So I began looking at the water gushing as springs from between the Messenger of Allah's ﷺ fingers, and the people drawing water, until all the people had drawn water.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Raqashi ne Ja'far ibn Sulayman se bataya: Humein al-Ja'd Abu Uthman ne bataya: Humein Anas ibn Malik رضي الله عنه ne bataya: Humein Jabir ibn Abdullah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ke sahaba ne Rasulullah ﷺ se pyaas ki shikaayat ki, to aapne ek bada pyaala mangwaaya, aur usmein paani daala gaya, aur Rasulullah ﷺ ne apna haath usmein rakha, unhone bataya: To main dekhne laga paani chashmon ki tarah Rasulullah ﷺ ki ungliyon ke darmiyan se phoot raha tha aur log paani nikaal rahe the, yahan tak ke sab logon ne paani le liya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ بِخَسْفٍ ، فَقَالَ : كُنَّا أَصْحَابَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَعُدُّ الْآيَاتِ بَرَكَةً، وَأَنْتُمْ تَعُدُّونَهَا تَخْوِيفًا، إِنَّا بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ولَيْسَ مَعَنَا مَاءٌ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" اطْلُبُوا مَنْ مَعَهُ فَضْلُ مَاءٍ "، " فَأُتِيَ بِمَاءٍ، فَصَبَّهُ فِي الْإِنَاءِ، ثُمَّ وَضَعَ كَفَّهُ فِيهِ، فَجَعَلَ الْمَاءُ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ "، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " حَيَّ عَلَى الطَّهُورِ الْمُبَارَكِ، وَالْبَرَكَةُ مِنْ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى "، فَشَرِبْنَا، وقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ : كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ تَسْبِيحَ الطَّعَامِ وَهُوَ يُؤْكَلُ
24.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Isra'il, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah, from Abdullah: He said: Abdullah رضي الله عنه heard of an earthquake, and said: We, the Companions of Muhammad ﷺ, counted signs as a blessing, but you count them as a fright, we were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with no water with us, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Seek whoever has extra water, so water was brought, and he poured it into a vessel, then put his palm in it, and the water began coming out from between his fingers, then he said: Come to the blessed purifying water, and blessing is from Allah, exalted is He, so we drank, and Abdullah said: We used to hear the food glorifying [Allah] while it was being eaten.
24.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Musa ne Isra'il se bataya: Humein Mansur ne bataya, Ibrahim se, Alqamah se, Abdullah se: Unhone kaha, Abdullah رضي الله عنه ne ek zalzalay ke baare mein suna, aur kaha: Hum, Muhammad ﷺ ke sahaba, nishaaniyon ko barkat samajhte the, lekin tum unhein khauf samajhte ho, hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath the aur humare paas paani nahi tha, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: Talaash karo kiske paas izaafi paani hai, to paani laaya gaya, to aapne usay ek bartan mein daala, fir apni hatheli usmein rakhi, to paani aapki ungliyon ke darmiyan se nikalne laga, fir aapne farmaya: Aao mubaarak wudu ke paani ki taraf, aur barkat Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se hai, to hum piye, aur Abdullah ne kaha: Hum khaane ki tasbih sunte the jabke woh khaaya jaa raha hota tha.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْجَوَّابِ  ، عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ رُزَيْقٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : زُلْزِلَتْ الْأَرْضُ عَلَى عَهْدِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، فَأُخْبِرَ بِذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ : إِنَّا كُنَّا أَصْحَابَ مُحَمَّدٍ K نَرَى الْآيَاتِ بَرَكَاتٍ، وَأَنْتُمْ تَرَوْنَهَا تَخْوِيفًا، بَيْنَا نَحْنُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي سَفَرٍ إِذْ حَضَرَتْ الصَّلَاةُ وَلَيْسَ مَعَنَا مَاءٌ إِلَّا يَسِيرٌ، " فَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِمَاءٍ فِي صَحْفَةٍ، وَوَضَعَ كَفَّهُ فِيهِ، فَجَعَلَ الْمَاءُ يَتْبَجِّسُ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ "، ثُمَّ نَادَى :" حَيَّ عَلَى الْوَضُوءِ، وَالْبَرَكَةُ مِنْ اللَّهِ "، قالَ : فَأَقْبَلَ النَّاسُ فَتَوَضَّئُوا، وَجَعَلْتُ لَا هَمَّ لِي إِلَّا مَا أُدْخِلُهُ بَطْنِي لِقَوْلِهِ : " وَالْبَرَكَةُ مِنْ اللَّهِ "، فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ سَالِمَ بْنَ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، فَقَالَ : كَانُوا خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ مِئَةٍ
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Numayr, from Abu al-Jawwab, from Ammar ibn Ruzayq, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah, from Abdullah رضي الله عنه: He said: The earth trembled in the time of Abdullah, and he was informed of that, so he said: We, the Companions of Muhammad ﷺ, saw signs as blessings, but you see them as a fright, while we were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on a journey when prayer time came and we had no water except a little, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ called for water in a bowl, and put his palm in it, and the water began to gush out from between his fingers, then he called out: Come to ablution, and blessing is from Allah, he said: So the people came and performed ablution, and I had no concern except what I could put into my stomach, because of his saying: And blessing is from Allah, so I told this to Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd, and he said: They were fifteen hundred.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Numayr ne Abu al-Jawwab se bataya: Humein Ammar ibn Ruzayq ne bataya, al-A'mash se, Ibrahim se, Alqamah se, Abdullah se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ke zamane mein zameen kaanpi, to unhein iski khabar di gayi, to unhone kaha: Hum, Muhammad ﷺ ke sahaba, nishaaniyon ko barkatein samajhte the, lekin tum unhein khauf samajhte ho, hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath ek safar mein the jab namaz ka waqt aaya aur humare paas thode ke siwa koi paani nahi tha, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne ek tashtari mein paani mangwaaya, aur apni hatheli usmein rakhi, to paani aapki ungliyon ke darmiyan se phootne laga, fir aapne pukaara: Wudu ki taraf aao, aur barkat Allah ki taraf se hai, unhone bataya: To log aaye aur wudu kiya, aur mujhe koi fikr nahi thi siwaay iske ke main apne pet mein kya daalun, unke farman ki wajah se: Aur barkat Allah ki taraf se hai, to maine yeh baat Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd ko bataayi, to unhone kaha: Woh pandrah sau the.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ" يَخْطُبُ إِلَى جِذْعٍ، فَلَمَّا اتَّخَذَ الْمِنْبَرَ حَنَّ الْجِذْعُ حَتَّى أَتَاهُ، فَمَسَحَهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Mu'adh ibn al-Ala, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar رضي الله عنهما: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to deliver sermons at a palm-trunk, so when he took up the pulpit, the trunk moaned until he came to it, and wiped it.
24.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Mu'adh ibn al-Ala se bataya: Humein Nafi' ne bataya, Ibn Umar se رضي الله عنهما: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ek khajoor ke tane ke paas khutba diya karte the, to jab aapne mimbar banaaya, tana rota rahaa yahan tak ke aap uske paas aaye, aur usay chhua.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا تَمِيمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُؤْمِنِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا صَالِحُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا خَطَبَ قَامَ فَأَطَالَ الْقِيامَ، فَكَانَ يَشُقُّ عَلَيْهِ قِيَامُهُ، فَأُتِيَ بِجِذْعِ نَخْلَةٍ فَحُفِرَ لَهُ وَأُقِيمَ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ قَائِمًا لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا خَطَبَ فَطَالَ الْقِيَامُ عَلَيْهِ، اسْتَنَدَ إِلَيْهِ فَاتَّكَأَ عَلَيْهِ فَبَصُرَ بِهِ رَجُلٌ كَانَ وَرَدَ الْمَدِينَةَ ، فَرَآهُ قَائِمًا إِلَى جَنْبِ ذَلِكَ الْجِذْعِ، فَقَالَ : لِمَنْ يَلِيهِ مِنْ النَّاسِ : لَوْ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا يَحْمَدُنِي فِي شَيْءٍ يَرْفُقُ بِهِ، لَصَنَعْتُ لَهُ مَجْلِسًا يَقُومُ عَلَيْهِ، فَإِنْ شَاءَ، جَلَسَ مَا شَاءَ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ، قَامَ، فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ :" ائْتُونِي بِهِ "، فَأَتَوْهُ بِهِ، فَأُمِرَهُ أَنْ يَصْنَعَ لَهُ هَذِهِ الْمَرَاقِيَ الثَّلَاثَ، أَوْ الْأَرْبَعَ هِيَ الْآنَ فِي مِنْبَرِ الْمَدِينَةِ ، فَوَجَدَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي ذَلِكَ رَاحَةً، فَلَمَّا فَارَقَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْجِذْعَ وَعَمَدَ إِلَى هَذِهِ الَّتِي صُنِعَتْ لَهُ، جَزِعَ الْجِذْعُ فَحَنَّ كَمَا تَحِنُّ النَّاقَةُ حِينَ فَارَقَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَزَعَمَ ابْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حِينَ سَمِعَ حَنِينَ الْجِذْعِ، رَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَقَالَ : " اخْتَرْ أَنْ أَغْرِسَكَ فِي الْمَكَانِ الَّذِي كُنْتَ فِيهِ، فَتَكُونَ كَمَا كُنْتَ، وَإِنْ شِئْتَ أَنْ أَغْرِسَكَ فِي الْجَنَّةِ فَتَشْرَبَ مِنْ أَنْهَارِهَا وَعُيُونِهَا فَيَحْسُنُ نَبْتُكَ، وَتُثْمِرُ فَيَأْكُلَ أَوْلِيَاءُ اللَّهِ مِنْ ثَمَرَتِكَ وَنَخْلِكَ فَعَلْتُ " فَزَعَمَ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مِنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ لَهُ : " نَعَمْ قَدْ فَعَلْتُ مَرَّتَيْنِ "، فَسُأَلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ : " اخْتَارَ أَنْ أَغْرِسَهُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Humayd, from Tamim ibn Abd al-Mu'min, from Salih ibn Hayyan, from Ibn Buraydah, from his father: He said: The Prophet ﷺ, when he delivered a sermon, would stand and prolong the standing, and standing became difficult for him, so a palm-trunk was brought and dug into the ground and set up beside him standing for the Prophet ﷺ, so the Prophet ﷺ, when he delivered a sermon and the standing was prolonged, would lean on it and rest against it, then a man who had come to Madinah saw him standing beside that trunk, and said to those near him among the people: If I knew that Muhammad would praise me for something that eases things for him, I would make him a seat he could stand on, so if he wished, he could sit as long as he wished, and if he wished, he could stand, so that reached the Prophet ﷺ, and he said: Bring him to me, so they brought him to him, and he was commanded to make him these three, or four, steps that are now in the pulpit of Madinah, so the Prophet ﷺ found comfort in that, so when the Prophet ﷺ parted from the trunk and went to this that was made for him, the trunk was distressed and moaned as the she-camel moans when the Prophet ﷺ parted from her, so Ibn Buraydah claimed, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ, when he heard the moaning of the trunk, returned to it and put his hand on it, and said: Choose whether I plant you back in the place you were, so you would be as you were, or if you wish that I plant you in Paradise so that you may drink from its rivers and its springs so that your growth may be beautiful, and you may bear fruit so that the close friends of Allah may eat from your fruit and your dates, I will do it, so he claimed that he heard from the Prophet ﷺ saying to it: Yes, I have indeed done it twice, so the Prophet ﷺ was asked, and he said: It chose that I plant it in Paradise.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Humayd ne Tamim ibn Abd al-Mu'min se bataya: Humein Salih ibn Hayyan ne bataya: Mujhe Ibn Buraydah ne bataya, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ, jab khutba dete, to khade hokar lamba khade rehte, to aapko khade hona mushkil hone laga, to ek khajoor ka tana laaya gaya aur uske liye zameen mein khoda gaya aur Nabi ﷺ ke liye uske paas khada karwaaya gaya, to Nabi ﷺ, jab khutba dete aur khada hona lamba ho jaata, isper tekaan lagaate, to ek aadmi ne, jo Madinah aaya tha, aapko us tane ke paas khada dekha, to usne apne paas ke logon se kaha: Agar mujhe pata hota ke Muhammad meri tareef karenge kisi cheez ke liye jo unhein aasaani de, to main unke liye ek majlis banaata jispar woh khade ho sakte, so agar chaahen to jitna chaahein baithein, aur agar chaahen to khade hon, to yeh baat Nabi ﷺ tak pahunchi, to aapne farmaya: Isay mere paas lao, to woh usay aapke paas laaye, aur usse in teen, ya chaar, seediyon ko banaane ka hukum diya jo abhi Madinah ke mimbar mein hain, to Nabi ﷺ ko isme aaraam mila, to jab Nabi ﷺ tane se alag hue aur is [naye] ki taraf gaye jo unke liye banaayi gayi thi, tana pareshaan hua aur usi tarah rota rahaa jaise oontni rota hai jab Nabi ﷺ usse alag hote, to Ibn Buraydah ne apne walid se dawa kiya ke Nabi ﷺ jab tane ka ronaa suna, aap uski taraf laute aur apna haath uspar rakha aur farmaya: Chuno ke main tumhein wahi jagah wapas lagaa dun jahan tum the, to tum waisi hi rahogi jaisi thi, ya agar tum chaaho ke main tumhein Jannat mein lagaa dun taake tum uski nehron aur chashmon se pi sako aur tumhara ugna khoobsurat ho, aur tum phal do taake Allah ke dost tumhare phal aur tumhari khajoorein khaayein, main aisa karunga, to unhone dawa kiya ke unhone Nabi ﷺ se sunaa aapne usse kaha: Haan, maine yeh do martaba kiya hai, to Nabi ﷺ se poocha gaya, to aapne farmaya: Usne chuna ke main isay Jannat mein lagaa dun.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" يَقُومُ إِلَى جِذْعٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُجْعَلَ الْمِنْبَرُ، فَلَمَّا جُعِلَ الْمِنْبَرُ حَنَّ ذَلِكَ الْجِذْعُ حَتَّى سَمِعْنَا حَنِينَهُ، فَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَدَهُ عَلَيْهِ فَسَكَنَ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir, from Sulayman ibn Kathir, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to stand at a trunk before the pulpit was made, so when the pulpit was made, that trunk moaned until we heard its moaning, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ put his hand on it and it calmed down.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir ne Sulayman ibn Kathir se bataya: Humein al-Zuhri ne bataya, Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab se, Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ mimbar banaaye jaane se pehle ek tane ke paas khade hote the, to jab mimbar banaaya gaya, woh tana rota rahaa yahan tak ke humne uska rona suna, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne apna haath uspar rakha to woh shaant ho gaya.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَخْطُبُ إِلَى خَشَبَةٍ، فَلَمَّا صُنِعَ الْمِنْبَرُ فَجَلَسَ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، حَنَّتْ حَنِينَ الْعِشَارِ حَتَّى وَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا فَسَكَنَتْ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir, from Sulayman ibn Kathir, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Hafs ibn Ubaydullah, from Jabir ibn Abdullah رضي الله عنه: He said: The Prophet ﷺ used to deliver sermons at a piece of wood, so when the pulpit was made, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sat on it, it moaned like the moaning of a pregnant she-camel until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ put his hand on it and it calmed down.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir ne Sulayman ibn Kathir se bataya: Humein Yahya ibn Sa'id ne bataya, Hafs ibn Ubaydullah se, Jabir ibn Abdullah se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ ek lakdi ke paas khutba dete the, to jab mimbar banaaya gaya aur Rasulullah ﷺ uspar baithe, woh haamila oontni ki tarah rone lagi yahan tak ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne apna haath usper rakha to woh shaant ho gayi.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا فَرْوَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّا  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي كَرِيبٍ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" حَنَّتْ الْخَشَبَةُ حَنِينَ النَّاقَةِ الْخَلُوجِ "
24.en: Narrated by Farwah, from Yahya ibn Zakariya, from his father, from Abu Ishaq, from Sa'id ibn Abi Karib, from Jabir ibn Abdullah رضي الله عنه: He said: The wood moaned like the moaning of a pregnant she-camel [that has just given birth].
24.hi: Farwah ne Yahya ibn Zakariya se bataya: Mujhse unke walid ne bataya, Abu Ishaq se, Sa'id ibn Abi Karib se, Jabir ibn Abdullah se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Lakdi haamila oontni (jisne abhi bachcha diya ho) ki tarah rone lagi.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ  ، عَنْ الطُّفَيْلِ بْنِ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : يُصَلِّي إِلَى جِذْعٍ وَيَخْطُبُ إِلَيْهِ إِذْ كَانَ الْمَسْجِدُ عَرِيشًا، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ : أَلَا نَجْعَلُ لَكَ عَرِيشًا تَقُومُ عَلَيْهِ يَرَاكَ النَّاسُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ، وَتُسْمِعُ مِنْ خُطْبَتِكَ؟، قَالَ :" نَعَمْ "، فَصُنِعَ لَهُ الثَّلَاثَ دَرَجَاتٍ، هُنَّ اللَّوَاتِي عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ، فَلَمَّا صُنِعَ الْمِنْبَرُ وَوُضِعَ فِي مَوْضِعِهِ الَّذِي وَضَعَهُ فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : فَلَمَّا جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُرِيدُ الْمِنْبَرَ مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ، فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُ، خَارَ الْجِذْعُ حَتَّى تَصَدَّعَ وَانْشَقَّ، فَرَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَمَسَحَهُ بِيَدِهِ حَتَّى سَكَنَ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَى الْمِنْبَرِ، قَالَ : فَكَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى، صَلَّى إِلَيْهِ فَلَمَّا هُدِمَ الْمَسْجِدُ أَخَذَ ذَلِكَ الْجِذْعَ أُبَيُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ عِنْدَهُ حَتَّى بَلِيَ فَأَكَلَتْهُ الْأَرَضَةُ وَعَادَ رُفَاتًا
24.en: Narrated by Zakariya ibn Adi, from Ubaydullah ibn Amr, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Aqil, from al-Tufayl ibn Ubayy ibn Ka'b, from his father: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray facing a trunk and deliver sermons at it when the mosque was a shelter, so a man among his Companions said to him: Shall we not make you a shelter you can stand on, so the people can see you on Friday, and hear your sermon? He said: Yes, so three steps were made for him, they are those which are on the pulpit, so when the pulpit was made and set up in the place where the Messenger of Allah ﷺ set it, he said: So when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came intending the pulpit, he passed by it, and when he passed it, the trunk moaned until it cracked and split, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ returned to it and wiped it with his hand until it calmed down, then returned to the pulpit, he said: So when he prayed, he prayed facing it, so when the mosque was demolished, Ubayy ibn Ka'b took that trunk, and it remained with him until it wore out and termites ate it and it turned to dust.
24.hi: Zakariya ibn Adi ne Ubaydullah ibn Amr se bataya: Humein Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Aqil ne bataya, al-Tufayl ibn Ubayy ibn Ka'b se, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ek tane ki taraf munh karke namaz padhte aur usi ke paas khutba dete the jab masjid ek chappar thi, to aapke sahaba mein se ek aadmi ne aapse kaha: Kya hum aapke liye ek chappar na banaayein jispar aap khade hon, log aapko Jumee ke din dekhein, aur aapka khutba sunein? Aapne farmaya: Haan, to unke liye teen seediyaan banaayi gayin, yeh wahi hain jo mimbar par hain, to jab mimbar banaaya gaya aur usi jagah rakha gaya jahan Rasulullah ﷺ ne isay rakha tha, unhone bataya: To jab Rasulullah ﷺ mimbar ka irada karte hue aaye, aap uske paas se guzre, to jab aap usse aage badhe, tana rota rahaa yahan tak ke woh chatakh gaya aur phat gaya, to Rasulullah ﷺ uski taraf laute aur apne haath se usay chhua yahan tak ke woh shaant ho gaya, fir mimbar ki taraf laute, unhone bataya: To jab aap namaz padhte, us taraf munh karke padhte, to jab masjid gira di gayi, Ubayy ibn Ka'b ne woh tana le liya, aur woh unke paas rahaa yahan tak ke woh purana ho gaya aur deemak ne usay khaa liya aur woh mitti ban gaya.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ  ، عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْوَدَّاكِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" يَخْطُبُ إِلَى لِزْقِ جِذْعٍ فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ رُومِيٌّ، فَقَالَ : أَصْنَعُ لَكَ مِنْبَرًا تَخْطُبُ عَلَيْهِ، فَصَنَعَ لَهُ مِنْبَرًا هَذَا الَّذِي تَرَوْنَ، قَالَ : فَلَمَّا قَامَ عَلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَخْطُبُ، حَنَّ الْجِذْعُ حَنِينَ النَّاقَةِ إِلَى وَلَدِهَا، فَنَزَلَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَضَمَّهُ إِلَيْهِ فَسَكَنَ، فَأَمَرَ بِهِ أَنْ يُحْفَرَ لَهُ وَيُدْفَنَ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Usamah, from Mujalid, from Abu al-Waddak, from Abu Sa'id رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to deliver sermons close beside a trunk, so a Roman man came to him, and said: Shall I make you a pulpit to deliver sermons on? So he made him a pulpit, this one that you see, he said: So when the Prophet ﷺ stood on it to deliver a sermon, the trunk moaned as a she-camel moans for her offspring, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ descended to it, and embraced it and it calmed down, so he commanded that a hole be dug for it and it be buried.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Usamah se bataya: Humein Mujalid ne bataya, Abu al-Waddak se, Abu Sa'id se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ek tane ke bilkul paas khutba dete the, to aapke paas ek Rumi aadmi aaya, aur kaha: Main aapke liye ek mimbar banaaun jispar aap khutba dein? To usne aapke liye ek mimbar banaaya, yehi jise tum dekhte ho, unhone bataya: To jab Nabi ﷺ khutba dene isper khade hue, tana usi tarah rota rahaa jaise oontni apne bachche ke liye rota hai, to Rasulullah ﷺ uski taraf utre, aur usay apne seene se lagaaya to woh shaant ho gaya, to aapne hukum diya ke uske liye gadhda khoda jaaye aur usay dafna diya jaaye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الصَّعْقُ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ  ، يَقُولُ : لَمَّا أَنْ قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْمَدِينَةَ جَعَلَ" يُسْنِدُ ظَهْرَهُ إِلَى خَشَبَةٍ وَيُحَدِّثُ النَّاسَ "، فَكَثُرُوا حَوْلَهُ، فَأَرَادَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْ يُسْمِعَهُمْ، فَقَالَ : " ابْنُوا لِي شَيْئًا أَرْتَفِعُ عَلَيْهِ "، قَالُوا : كَيْفَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ؟، قَالَ : " عَرِيشٌ كَعَرِيشِ مُوسَى "، فَلَمَّا أَنْ بَنَوْا لَهُ، قَالَ الْحَسَنُ : حَنَّتْ وَاللَّهِ الْخَشَبَةُ، قَالَ الْحَسَنُ : سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ ! هَلْ تُبْتَغَى قُلُوبُ قَوْمٍ سَمِعُوا؟ قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : يَعْنِي هَذَا
24.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from al-Sa'q, who heard al-Hasan say; with Abu Muhammad's note: When the Prophet ﷺ arrived at Madinah, he would rest his back against a piece of wood and address the people, so the people around him became numerous, so the Prophet ﷺ wanted to make them hear, so he said: Build me something I can raise myself upon, they said: How, O Prophet of Allah? He said: A shelter like the shelter of Musa, so when they built it for him, al-Hasan said: The wood moaned, by Allah, al-Hasan said: Glory be to Allah! Are the hearts of a people who heard sought after? Abu Muhammad said: He means this.
24.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne al-Sa'q se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Hasan ko kehte suna: Jab Nabi ﷺ Madinah pahunche, aap apni peeth ek lakdi par tekte aur logon se baat karte, to aapke aas-paas log badh gaye, to Nabi ﷺ ne chaaha ke unhein sunaayein, to aapne farmaya: Mere liye kuch banaao jispar main unche ho sakun, unhone kaha: Kaise, Ae Allah ke Nabi? Aapne farmaya: Musa ke chappar jaisa ek chappar, to jab unhone aapke liye woh banaaya, al-Hasan ne kaha: Lakdi royi, Allah ki qasam, al-Hasan ne kaha: Subhanallah! Kya un logon ke dil talaash kiye jaate hain jinhone suna? Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Unka matlab yehi hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ : يَخْطُبُ إِلَى جِذْعٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ الْمِنْبَرَ، فَلَمَّا اتَّخَذَ الْمِنْبَرَ وَتَحَوَّلَ إِلَيْهِ، حَنَّ الْجِذْعُ، فَاحْتَضَنَهُ، فَسَكَنَ "، وَقَالَ :" لَوْ لَمْ أَحْتَضِنْهُ، لَحَنَّ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ "، أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، بِمِثْلِهِ
24.en: Narrated by al-Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ammar ibn Abi Ammar, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما; a similar chain also via al-Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad, from Thabit, from Anas رضي الله عنه: That the Prophet ﷺ used to deliver sermons at a trunk before he took up the pulpit, so when he took up the pulpit and moved to it, the trunk moaned, so he embraced it, and it calmed down, and he said: Had I not embraced it, it would have moaned until the Day of Resurrection. [Narrated by al-Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad, from Thabit, from Anas رضي الله عنه, the same.]
24.hi: Al-Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se bataya: Humein Ammar ibn Abi Ammar ne bataya, Ibn Abbas se رضي الله عنهما: ke Nabi ﷺ mimbar banaane se pehle ek tane ke paas khutba dete the, to jab aapne mimbar banaaya aur usi ki taraf gaye, tana rota rahaa, to aapne usay seene se lagaaya, aur woh shaant ho gaya, aur farmaya: Agar main isse seene se na lagaata, to yeh Qayamat tak rota rehta. [Isi jaisi riwayat al-Hajjaj ibn Minhal se, Hammad se, Thabit se, Anas se رضي الله عنه bhi aayi hai.]

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ  ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : حَنَّتِ الْخَشَبَةُ الَّتِي كَانَ يَقُومُ عِنْدَهَا، " فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَيْهَا،وَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا "، فَسَكَنَتْ
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid, from al-Mas'udi, from Abu Hazim, from Sahl ibn Sa'd رضي الله عنه: He said: The wood at which he used to stand moaned, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood by it, and placed his hand on it, and it calmed down.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid ne al-Mas'udi se bataya: Humein Abu Hazim ne bataya, Sahl ibn Sa'd se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Woh lakdi jiske paas aap khade hote the royi, to Rasulullah ﷺ uski taraf khade hue, aur apna haath usper rakha, to woh shaant ho gayi.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ : يَقُومُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ، فَيُسْنِدُ ظَهْرَهُ إِلَى جِذْعٍ مَنْصُوبٍ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَيَخْطُبُ النَّاسَ، فَجَاءَهُ رُومِيٌّ، فَقَالَ : أَلَا أَصْنَعُ لَكَ شَيْئًا تَقْعُدُ عَلَيْهِ وَكَأَنَّكَ قَائِمٌ؟ فَصَنَعَ لَهُ مِنْبَرًا لَهُ دَرَجَتَانِ، وَيَقْعُدُ عَلَى الثَّالِثَةِ، فَلَمَّا قَعَدَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ الْمِنْبَرِ، خَارَ الْجِذْعُ كَخُوَارِ الثَّوْرِ حَتَّى ارْتَجَّ الْمَسْجِدُ حُزْنًا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَنَزَلَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنْ الْمِنْبَرِ، فَالْتَزَمَهُ وَهُوَ يَخُورُ، فَلَمَّا الْتَزَمَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، سَكَنَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " أَمَا وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِلَوْ لَمْ أَلْتَزِمْهُ، لَمَا زَالَ هَكَذَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ حُزْنًا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "، فَأَمَرَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَدُفِنَ
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf, from Umar ibn Yunus, from Ikrimah ibn Ammar, from Ishaq ibn Abi Talhah, from Anas ibn Malik رضي الله عنه: That the Prophet ﷺ used to stand on Friday, resting his back against a trunk fixed in the mosque, and deliver sermons to the people, so a Roman man came to him, and said: Shall I not make you something you can sit upon while appearing as if you are standing? So he made him a pulpit with two steps, and he would sit on the third, so when the Prophet of Allah ﷺ sat on that pulpit, the trunk bellowed like the bellowing of a bull until the mosque shook with grief for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ descended from the pulpit to it, and clung to it while it was bellowing, so when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ clung to it, it calmed down, then he said: By the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, had I not clung to it, it would not have ceased doing so until the Day of Resurrection, out of grief for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded regarding it, and it was buried.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf ne Umar ibn Yunus se bataya: Humein Ikrimah ibn Ammar ne bataya: Humein Ishaq ibn Abi Talhah ne bataya: Humein Anas ibn Malik ne bataya رضي الله عنه: ke Nabi ﷺ Jumee ke din khade hote, apni peeth masjid mein gaade hue tane par tekte hue, aur logon ko khutba dete, to aapke paas ek Rumi aadmi aaya, aur kaha: Kya main aapke liye aisi cheez na banaaun jispar aap baith sakein jabke lage ke aap khade hain? To usne aapke liye do seediyon wala ek mimbar banaaya, aur aap teesri par baithte, to jab Nabi Allah ﷺ us mimbar par baithe, tana bail ki tarah cheekha yahan tak ke masjid Rasulullah ﷺ ke gham mein hil gayi, to Rasulullah ﷺ mimbar se uski taraf utre, aur usse lipat gaye jabke woh cheekh raha tha, to jab Rasulullah ﷺ usse lipat gaye, woh shaant ho gaya, fir farmaya: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, agar main isse na lipat jaata, to yeh Qayamat tak aisa hi karta rehta, Rasulullah ﷺ ke gham mein, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne iske baare mein hukum diya to isay dafna diya gaya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمُحَارِبِيُّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ بْنِ أَيْمَنَ الْمَكِّيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِجَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ حَدِّثْنِي بِحَدِيثٍ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْهُ أَرْوِيهِ عَنْكَ، فَقَالَ جَابِرٌ : كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ نَحْفُرُهُ، فَلَبِثْنَا ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ لَا نَطْعَمُ طَعَامًا، وَلَا نَقْدِرُ عَلَيْهِ، فَعَرَضَتْ فِي الْخَنْدَقِ كُدْيَةٌ فَجِئْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَذِهِ كُدْيَةٌ قَدْ عَرَضَتْ، فِي الْخَنْدَقِ فَرَشَشْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ، فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَبَطْنُهُ مَعْصُوبٌ بِحَجَرٍ، فَأَخَذَ الْمِعْوَلَ، أَوْ الْمِسْحَاةَ، ثُمَّ سَمَّى ثَلَاثًا، ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ فَعَادَتْ كَثِيبًا أَهْيَلَ، فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتُ ذَلِكَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، ائْذَنْ لِي، قَالَ : فَأَذِنَ لِي، فَجِئْتُ امْرَأَتِي، فَقُلْتُ : ثَكِلَتْكِ أُمُّكِ قَدْ رَأَيْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ شَيْئًا لَا صَبْرَ لِي عَلَيْهِ، فَهَلْ عِنْدَكِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ؟، فَقَالَتْ : عِنْدِي صَاعٌ مِنْ شَعِيرٍ، وَعَنَاقٌ، قَالَ : فَطَحَنَّا الشَّعِيرَ، وَذَبَحْنَا الْعَنَاقَ، وَسَلَخْتُهَا، وَجَعَلْتُهَا، فِي الْبُرْمَةِ وَعَجَنْتُ الشَّعِيرَ، قَالَ : ثُمَّ قَالَ : رَجَعْتُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَلَبِثْتُ سَاعَةً، ثُمَّ اسْتَأْذَنْتُهُ الثَّانِيَةَ فَأَذِنَ لِي، فَجِئْتُ، فَإِذَا الْعَجِينُ قَدْ أَمْكَنَ، فَأَمَرْتُهَا بِالْخَبْزِ وَجَعَلْتُ الْقِدْرَ عَلَى الْأَثَاثِي، قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ : إِنَّمَا هِيَ الْأَثَافِيُّ وَلَكِنْ هَكَذَا، قَالَ : ثُمَّ جِئْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقُلْتُ : إِنَّ عِنْدَنَا طُعَيِّمًا لَنَا، فَإِنْ رَأَيْتَ أَنْ تَقُومَ مَعِي أَنْتَ وَرَجُلٌ أَوْ رَجُلَانِ مَعَكَ، فَقَالَ :" وَكَمْ هُوَ؟ "، قُلْتُ : صَاعٌ مِنْ شَعِيرٍ، وَعَنَاقٌ، فَقَالَ : " ارْجِعْ إِلَى أَهْلِكَ وَقُلْ لَهَا لَا تَنْزِعْ الْقِدْرَ مِنْ الْأَثَافِيِّ، وَلَا تُخْرِجْ الْخُبْزَ مِنْ التَّنُّورِ حَتَّى آتِيَ "، ثُمَّ قَالَ لِلنَّاسِ : " قُومُوا إِلَى بَيْتِ جَابِرٍ "، قَالَ : فَاسْتَحْيَيْتُ حَيَاءً لَا يَعْلَمُهُ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، فَقُلْتُ لِامْرَأَتِي : ثَكِلَتْكِ أُمُّكِ، قَدْ جَاءَكِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِأَصْحَابِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ، فَقَالَتْ : أَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سَأَلَكَ : كَمْ الطَّعَامُ؟، فَقُلْتُ : نَعَمْ، فَقَالَتْ : اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ، قَدْ أَخْبَرْتَهُ بِمَا كَانَ عِنْدَنَا، قَالَ : فَذَهَبَ عَنِّي بَعْضُ مَا كُنْتُ أَجِدُ، وَقُلْتُ : لَقَدْ صَدَقْتِ، فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَدَخَلَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ لِأَصْحَابِهِ : " لَا تَضَاغَطُوا "، " ثُمَّ بَرَّكَ عَلَى التَّنُّورِ وَعَلَى الْبُرْمَةِ "، قَالَ : فَجَعَلْنَا نَأْخُذُ مِنْ التَّنُّورِ الْخُبْزَ، وَنَأْخُذُ اللَّحْمَ مِنْ الْبُرْمَةِ، فَنُثَرِّدُ وَنَغْرِفُ لَهُمْ، وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " لِيَجْلِسْ عَلَى الصَّحْفَةِ سَبْعَةٌ أَوْ ثَمَانِيَةٌ "، فَإِذَا أَكَلُوا كَشَفْنَا عَنْ التَّنُّورِ، وَكَشَفْنَا عَنْ الْبُرْمَةِ، فَإِذَا هُمَا أَمْلَأُ مِمَّا كَانَا، فَلَمْ نَزَلْ نَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ كُلَّمَا فَتَحْنَا التَّنُّورَ وَكَشَفْنَا عَنْ الْبُرْمَةِ، وَجَدْنَاهُمَا أَمْلَأَ مَا كَانَا حَتَّى شَبِعَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ كُلُّهُمْ، وَبَقِيَ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ الطَّعَامِ، فَقَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ أَصَابَتْهُمْ مَخْمَصَةٌ، فَكُلُوا وَأَطْعِمُوا "، فَلَمْ نَزَلْ يَوْمَنَا ذَلِكَ نَأْكُلُ وَنُطْعِمُ، قَالَ : وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا ثَمَانَ مِئَةٍ، أَوْ قَالَ : ثَلَاثَ مِئَةٍ، قَالَ أَيْمَنُ : لَا أَدْرِي أَيُّهُمَا قَالَ
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Umar ibn Aban, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad al-Muharibi, from Abd al-Wahid ibn Ayman al-Makki, from his father: He said: I said to Jabir ibn Abdullah رضي الله عنه: Narrate to me a hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that you heard from him, that I may narrate it from you, so Jabir said: We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the day of the Trench, digging it, and we stayed three days not tasting food, and unable to get any, so a rocky patch appeared in the trench, so I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and said: O Messenger of Allah, this is a rocky patch that has appeared in the trench, so we sprinkled water on it, so the Prophet ﷺ stood, his belly bound with a stone, and took the pick, or the spade, then invoked Allah's name three times, then struck, and it turned into loose sand, so when I saw that from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I said: O Messenger of Allah, permit me, he said: So he permitted me, so I came to my wife, and said: May your mother be bereaved of you, I have seen something from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that I cannot bear, do you have anything? So she said: I have a sa' of barley, and a young goat, he said: So we ground the barley, and slaughtered the young goat, and I skinned it, and put it in the pot, and kneaded the barley, he said: Then I said: I returned to the Prophet ﷺ and stayed a while, then I asked his permission a second time and he permitted me, so I came, and the dough had risen, so I ordered her to bake, and I put the pot on the tripod-stones, Abu Abd al-Rahman said: They are the athafi [tripod-stones] but this is how [he said it], he said: Then I came to the Prophet ﷺ, and said: We have a little food for us, so if you see fit to come with me, you and a man or two men with you, so he said: And how much is it? I said: A sa' of barley, and a young goat, so he said: Return to your family, and tell her not to remove the pot from the stones, nor take the bread out of the oven until I come, then he said to the people: Get up to Jabir's house, he said: So I felt a shyness that only Allah knows, so I said to my wife: May your mother be bereaved of you, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has come to you with all his companions, so she said: Did the Prophet ﷺ ask you: how much is the food? So I said: Yes, so she said: Allah and His Messenger know best, you have told him what we had, he said: So some of what I was feeling left me, and I said: You spoke the truth, so the Prophet ﷺ came and entered, then said to his companions: Do not crowd, then he invoked a blessing over the oven and over the pot, he said: So we began taking the bread from the oven, and taking the meat from the pot, so we made tharid and ladled it out for them, and the Prophet ﷺ said: Let seven or eight sit around each dish, so when they had eaten we uncovered the oven, and uncovered the pot, and found them fuller than they had been, so we kept doing that every time we opened the oven and uncovered the pot, we found them fuller than they had been until all the Muslims were satisfied, and some food remained, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to us: The people have indeed been struck by hunger, so eat and feed others, so we kept eating and feeding others that whole day of ours, he said: And he informed me that they were eight hundred, or he said: three hundred, Ayman said: I do not know which of the two he said.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Umar ibn Aban ne Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad al-Muharibi se bataya: Humein Abd al-Wahid ibn Ayman al-Makki ne bataya, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, Maine Jabir ibn Abdullah se رضي الله عنه kaha: Mujhe Rasulullah ﷺ se koi hadith bataao jo aapne unse suni ho, taake main isse aapse riwaayat karun, to Jabir ne kaha: Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath Khandaq ke din the, ise khod rahe the, to hum teen din tak rahe khaana na chakh sake, aur na kuch paa sake, to Khandaq mein ek patheeli patti nazar aayi, to main Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha: Ya Rasulullah, yeh patheeli patti nazar aayi hai, to humne uspar paani chhida, to Nabi ﷺ khade hue, aapka pet ek patthar se bandha hua tha, to aapne kudaal, ya belcha, liya, fir teen martaba Allah ka naam liya, fir maara, to woh dhili reet mein badal gayi, to jab maine yeh Rasulullah ﷺ se dekha, maine kaha: Ya Rasulullah, mujhe ijaazat dijiye, unhone bataya: To aapne mujhe ijaazat di, to main apni biwi ke paas gaya, aur kaha: Teri maa tujhe roye, maine Rasulullah ﷺ se aisi cheez dekhi hai jispar mujhe sabr nahi, kya tumhare paas kuch hai? To usne kaha: Mere paas ek sa' jau hai, aur ek bakri ka bachcha, unhone bataya: To humne jau pisa, aur bakri ka bachcha zabah kiya, aur maine usay chheela, aur haandi mein daala, aur jau gaunda, unhone bataya: Fir maine kaha: Main Nabi ﷺ ke paas wapas gaya aur kuch der thehra, fir maine doosri baar ijaazat maangi to aapne mujhe ijaazat di, to main aaya, to aata taiyaar ho chuka tha, to maine usay roti banaane ka hukum diya, aur maine haandi teen pattharon par rakhi, Abu Abd al-Rahman kehte hain: Yeh 'athafi' hain lekin yeh [aisa kaha] unhone bataya: Fir main Nabi ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha: Humare paas humare liye thoda khaana hai, so agar aap munaasib samjhein ke aap mere saath aayein, aap aur ek ya do aadmi aapke saath, to aapne poocha: Aur yeh kitna hai? Maine kaha: Ek sa' jau, aur ek bakri ka bachcha, to aapne farmaya: Apne gharwalon ke paas jao, aur unhein kehna ke haandi ko pattharon se na hataayein, aur na roti tandoor se nikaalein jab tak main na aaun, fir aapne logon se farmaya: Jabir ke ghar chalo, unhone bataya: To mujhe aisi sharm hui jise sirf Allah jaanta hai, to maine apni biwi se kaha: Teri maa tujhe roye, Rasulullah ﷺ apne tamaam sahaba ke saath tumhare paas aa gaye hain, to usne poocha: Kya Nabi ﷺ ne tumse poocha tha: khaana kitna hai? To maine kaha: Haan, to usne kaha: Allah aur uska Rasool zyada jaante hain, tumne unhein bataa diya jo humare paas tha, unhone bataya: To jo main mehsoos kar raha tha usme se kuch kam hua, aur maine kaha: Tumne sach kaha, to Nabi ﷺ aaye aur dakhil hue, fir apne sahaba se farmaya: Bheed mat karo, fir aapne tandoor aur haandi par dua ki, unhone bataya: To hum tandoor se roti nikaalne lage, aur haandi se gosht nikaalne lage, to hum tharid banaate aur unhein parosne lage, aur Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: Har thaali par saat ya aath log baithein, to jab woh khaa chuke hum tandoor kholte, aur haandi kholte, to woh pehle se bhi zyada bhare hote, to hum aisa karte rahe har baar jab hum tandoor kholte aur haandi kholte, humein woh pehle se zyada bhare milte, yahan tak ke sab Musalman seer ho gaye, aur kuch khaana bacha, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne humse farmaya: Logon par bhookh aa padi hai, so khaao aur khilaao, to hum us saare din khaate aur khilaate rahe, unhone bataya: Aur unhone mujhe bataaya ke woh aath sau the, ya kaha: teen sau, Ayman kehte hain: Mujhe nahi maloom unhone in dono mein se kaunsa kaha.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ هُوَ ابْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : أَمَرَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ طَعَامًا يَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ، قَالَ : ثُمَّ بَعَثَنِي أَبُو طَلْحَةَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَأَتَيْتُهُ، فَقُلْتُ : بَعَثَنِي إِلَيْكَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ، فَقَالَ لِلْقَوْمِ :" قُومُوا "، فَانْطَلَقَ وَانْطَلَقَ الْقَوْمُ مَعَهُ، فَقَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّمَا صَنَعْتُ طَعَامًا لِنَفْسِكَ خَاصَّةً؟، فَقَالَ : " لَا عَلَيْكَ انْطَلِقْ "، قَالَ : فَانْطَلَقَ وَانْطَلَقَ الْقَوْمُ، قَالَ : فَجِيءَ بِالطَّعَامِ، " فَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَدَهُ وَسَمَّى عَلَيْهِ "، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " ائْذَنْ لِعَشَرَةٍ "، قَالَ : فَأَذِنَ لَهُمْ، فَقَالَ : " كُلُوا بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ "، فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا، ثُمَّ قَامُوا، " ثُمَّ وَضَعَ يَدَهُ كَمَا صَنَعَ فِي الْمَرَّةِ الْأُولَى وَسَمَّى عَلَيْهِ "، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " ائْذَنْ لِعَشَرَةٍ "، فَأَذِنَ لَهُمْ، فَقَالَ : " كُلُوا، بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ " فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا، ثُمَّ قَامُوا حَتَّى فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ بِثَمَانِينَ رَجُلًا، قَالَ : " وَأَكَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ وَتَرَكُوا سُؤْرًا "
24.en: Narrated by Zakariya ibn Adi, from Ubaydullah (Ibn Amr), from Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla, from Anas ibn Malik رضي الله عنه: He said: Abu Talhah commanded Umm Sulaym رضي الله عنها to prepare food for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to eat from, he said: Then Abu Talhah sent me to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so I came to him, and said: Abu Talhah has sent me to you, so he said to the people: Get up, so he went and the people went with him, so Abu Talhah said: O Messenger of Allah, I only prepared food for yourself specifically? So he said: Never mind, go on, he said: So he went and the people went, he said: So the food was brought, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ placed his hand and invoked Allah's name over it, then said: Let ten in, he said: So he let them in, and said: Eat, in the name of Allah, so they ate until they were satisfied, then they stood up, then he placed his hand as he had done the first time and invoked Allah's name over it, then said: Let ten in, so he let them in, and said: Eat, in the name of Allah, so they ate until they were satisfied, then they stood up, until he did that with eighty men, he said: And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the household ate and left leftovers.
24.hi: Zakariya ibn Adi ne Ubaydullah se bataya (Ibn Amr): Humein Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr ne bataya, Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla se, Anas ibn Malik se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Abu Talhah ne Umm Sulaym رضي الله عنها ko hukum diya ke woh Rasulullah ﷺ ke liye khaana taiyaar karein jissey aap khaayein, unhone bataya: Fir Abu Talhah ne mujhe Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas bheja, to main aapke paas aaya, aur kaha: Abu Talhah ne mujhe aapke paas bheja hai, to aapne logon se farmaya: Uth jao, to aap chale aur log aapke saath chale, to Abu Talhah ne kaha: Ya Rasulullah, maine to khaana sirf aapke khud ke liye taiyaar kiya tha? To aapne farmaya: Koi baat nahi, chalo, unhone bataya: To aap chale aur log chale, unhone bataya: To khaana laaya gaya, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne apna haath rakha aur uspar Allah ka naam liya, fir farmaya: Das ko andar aane do, unhone bataya: To unhone unhein andar aane diya, aur farmaya: Khaao, Allah ke naam se, to woh khaate rahe yahan tak ke seer ho gaye, fir woh khade hue, fir aapne apna haath waise hi rakha jaise pehli baar rakha tha aur uspar Allah ka naam liya, fir farmaya: Das ko andar aane do, to unhone unhein andar aane diya, aur farmaya: Khaao, Allah ke naam se, to woh khaate rahe yahan tak ke seer ho gaye, fir woh khade hue, yahan tak ke aapne assi aadmiyon ke saath aisa kiya, unhone bataya: Aur Rasulullah ﷺ aur ghar walon ne khaaya aur kuch bacha diya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ هُوَ الْعَطَّارُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ  ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّهُ طَبَخَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قِدْرًا، فَقَالَ لَهُ :" نَاوِلْنِي الْذِّرَاعَ "، وَكَانَ يُعْجِبُهُ الذِّرَاعُ، فَنَاوَلَهُ الذِّرَاعَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " نَاوِلْنِي الذِّرَاعَ "، فَنَاوَلَهُ ذِرَاعًا، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " نَاوِلْنِي الذِّرَاعَ "، فَقُلْتُ : يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ، وَكَمْ لِلشَّاةِ مِنْ ذِرَاعٍ؟ فَقَالَ : " وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ أَنْ لَوْ سَكَتَّ لَأُعْطَيْتَ أَذْرُعًا مَا دَعَوْتُ بِهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Aban al-Attar, from Qatadah, from Shahr ibn Hawshab, from Abu Ubayd رضي الله عنه: That he cooked a pot for the Prophet ﷺ, so he said to him: Hand me the foreleg, and he was fond of the foreleg, so he handed him the foreleg, then he said: Hand me the foreleg, so he handed him a foreleg, then he said: Hand me the foreleg, so I said: O Prophet of Allah, how many forelegs does a sheep have? So he said: By the One in whose hand is my soul, had you stayed silent, you would have been given forelegs as many times as I asked for it.
24.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Aban al-Attar se bataya: Humein Qatadah ne bataya, Shahr ibn Hawshab se, Abu Ubayd se رضي الله عنه: ke unhone Nabi ﷺ ke liye ek haandi pakaayi, to aapne unse farmaya: Mujhe agla paaya do, aur aapko agla paaya bahut pasand tha, to unhone aapko agla paaya diya, fir aapne farmaya: Mujhe agla paaya do, to unhone aapko ek aur agla paaya diya, fir aapne farmaya: Mujhe agla paaya do, to maine kaha: Ya Nabi Allah, ek bhed ke kitne agle paaye hote hain? To aapne farmaya: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, agar tum khamosh rehte to tumhein utne agle paaye diye jaate jitni baar main isse maangta.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَان  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ  ، عَنْ نُبَيْحٍ الْعَنَزِيِّ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ لِيُقَاتِلَهُمْ، فَقَالَ أَبِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ : يَا جَابِرُ، لَا عَلَيْكَ أَنْ تَكُونَ، فِي نَظَّارِي أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ حَتَّى تَعْلَمَ إِلَى مَا يَصِيرُ أَمْرُنَا، فَإِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لَوْلَا أَنِّي أَتْرُكُ بَنَاتٍ لِي بَعْدِي، لَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ تُقْتَلَ بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ، قَالَ : فَبَيْنَمَا أَنَا فِي النَّظَّارِينَ إِذْ جَاءَتْ عَمَّتِي بِأَبِي وَخَالِي لِتَدْفُنَهُمَا فِي مَقَابِرِنَا، فَلَحِقَ رَجُلٌ يُنَادِي، إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَنْ تَرُدُّوا الْقَتْلَى فَتَدْفُنُوهَا فِي مَضَاجِعَهَا حَيْثُ قُتِلَتْ، فَرَدَدْنَاهُمَا، فَدَفَنَّاهُمَا فِي مَضْجَعِهِمَا حَيْثُ قُتِلَا : فَبَيْنَا أَنَا فِي خِلَافَةِ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، إِذْ جَاءَنِي رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ : يَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، لَقَدْ أَثَارَ أَبَاكَ عُمَّالُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، فَبَدَا، فَخَرَجَ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ، فَانْطَلَقْتُ إِلَيْهِ فَوَجَدْتُهُ عَلَى النَّحْوِ الَّذِي دَفَنْتُهُ لَمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ إِلَّا مَا لَمْ يَدَعِ الْقَتِيلَ، قَالَ : فَوَارَيْتُهُ، وَتَرَكَ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ دَيْنًا مِنْ التَّمْرِ فَاشْتَدَّ عَلَيَّ بَعْضُ غُرَمَائِهِ، فِي التَّقَاضِي، فَأَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ أَبِي أُصِيبَ يَوْمَ كَذَا وَكَذَا، وَإِنَّهُ تَرَكَ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنًا مِنَ التَّمْرِ، وَإِنَّهُ قَدْ اشْتَدَّ عَلَيَّ بَعْضُ غُرَمَائِهِ فِي الطَّلَبِ، فَأُحِبُّ أَنْ تُعِينَنِي عَلَيْهِ لَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يُنْظِرَنِي طَائِفَةً مِنْ تَمْرِهِ إِلَى هَذَا الصِّرَامِ الْمُقْبِلِ، قَالَ :" نَعَمْ آتِيكَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ قَرِيبًا مِنْ وَسَطِ النَّهَارِ "، قَالَ : فَجَاءَ وَمَعَهُ حَوَارِيُّوهُ، قَالَ : فَجَلَسُوا فِي الظِّلِّ وَسَلَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَاسْتَأْذَنَ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا، قَالَ : وَقَدْ قُلْتُ لِامْرَأَتِي : إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ جَاءَنِي الْيَوْمَ وَسَطَ النَّهَارِ، فَلَا يَرَيَنَّكِ وَلَا تُؤْذِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي بَيْتِي بِشَيْءٍ وَلَا تُكَلِّمِيهِ، فَفَرَشَتْ فِرَاشًا وَوِسَادَةً فَوَضَعَ رَأْسَهُ، فَنَامَ، فَقُلْتُ لِمَوْلًى لِي : اذْبَحْ هَذِهِ الْعَنَاقَ، وَهِيَ دَاجِنٌ سَمِينَة، فَالْوَحَا وَالْعَجْلَ افْرَغْ مِنْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَسْتَيْقِظَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَنَا مَعَكَ، فَلَمْ نَزَلْ فِيهَا حَتَّى فَرَغْنَا مِنْهَا، وَهُوَ نَائِمٌ، فَقُلْتُ : إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حِينَ يَسْتَيْقِظُ يَدْعُو بِطَهُورِ، وَأَنَا أَخَافُ إِذَا فَرَغَ أَنْ يَقُومَ، فَلَا يَفْرَغْ مِنْ طُهُورِهِ حَتَّى يُوضَعَ الْعَنَاقُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْقَظَ، قَالَ : " يَا جَابِرُ ائْتِنِي بِطَهُورٍ "، قَالَ : نَعَمْ، فَلَمْ يَفْرَغْ مِنْ وُضُوئِهِ حَتَّى وُضِعَتِ الْعَنَاقُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، قَالَ : فَنَظَرَ إِلَيَّ، فَقَالَ : " كَأَنَّكَ قَدْ عَلِمْتَ حُبَّنَا اللَّحْمَ، ادْعُ أَبَا بَكْر "، ثُمَّ دَعَا حَوَارِيِّيهِ، قَالَ : فَجِيءَ بِالطَّعَامِ فَوُضِعَ، قَالَ : فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ، وَقَالَ : " بِسْمِ اللَّهِ كُلُوا "، فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا وَفَضَلَ مِنْهَا لَحْمٌ كَثِيرٌ، وَقَالَ : وَاللَّهِ إِنَّ مَجْلِسَ بَنِي سَلِمَةَ لَيَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْهِمْ، هُوَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِمْ مِنْ أَعْيُنِهِمْ، مَا يَقْرَبُونَهُ مَخَافَةَ أَنْ يُؤْذُوهُ، ثُمَّ قَامَ، وَقَامَ أَصْحَابُهُ، فَخَرَجُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، وَكَانَ يَقُولُ : " خَلُّوا ظَهْرِي لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ "، قَالَ : فَاتَّبَعْتُهُمْ حَتَّى بَلَغْتُ سَقُفَّةَ الْبَابِ، فَأَخْرَجَتِ امْرَأَتِي صَدْرَهَا وَكَانَتْ سَتِّيرَةً، فَقَالَتْ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، صَلِّ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى زَوْجِي، قَالَ : " صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْكِ وَعَلَى زَوْجِكِ "، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " ادْعُوا لِي فُلَانًا لِلْغَرِيمِ الَّذِي اشْتَدَّ عَلَيَّ فِي الطَّلَبِ، فَقَالَ : " أَنْسِ جَابِرًا طَائِفَةً مِنْ دَيْنِكَ الَّذِي عَلَى أَبِيهِ إِلَى هَذَا الصِّرَامِ الْمُقْبِلِ "، قَالَ : مَا أَنَا بِفَاعِلٍ، قَالَ : وَاعْتَلَّ وَقَالَ : إِنَّمَا هُوَ مَالُ يَتَامَى، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَيْنَ جَابِرٌ؟ " قَالَ : قُلْتُ : أَنَا ذَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ : " كِلْ لَهُ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى سَوْفَ يُوَفِّيهِ "، فَرَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ، فَإِذَا الشَّمْسُ قَدْ دَلَكَتْ، قَالَ : " الصَّلَاةُ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ "، فَانْدَفَعُوا إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ، فَقُلْتُ لِغَرِيمِي : قَرِّبْ أَوْعِيَتَكَ، فَكِلْتُ لَهُ مِنْ الْعَجْوَةِ فَوَفَّاهُ اللَّهُ وَفَضُلَ لَنَا مِنْ التَّمْرِ كَذَا وَكَذَا، قَالَ : فَجِئْتُ أَسْعَى إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي مَسْجِدِهِ كَأَنِّي شَرَارَةٌ، فَوَجَدْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَدْ صَلَّى، فَقُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي قَدْ كِلْتُ لِغَرِيمِي تَمْرَهُ فَوَفَّاهُ اللَّهُ وَفَضُلَ لَنَا مِنْ التَّمْرِ كَذَا وَكَذَا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَيْنَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ؟ "، قَالَ : فَجَاءَ يُهَرْوِلُ، قَالَ : " سَلْ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ غَرِيمِهِ وَتَمْرِهِ "، قَالَ : مَا أَنَا بِسَائِلِهِ، قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ سَوْفَ يُوَفِّيهِ إِذْ أَخْبَرْتَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ سَوْفَ يُوَفِّيهِ فَرَدَّدَ عَلَيْهِ، وَرَدَّدَ عَلَيْهِ هَذِهِ الْكَلِمَةَ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، كُلُّ ذَلِكَ يَقُولُ : مَا أَنَا بِسَائِلِهِ، وَكَانَ لَا يُرَاجَعُ بَعْدَ الْمَرَّةِ الثَّالِثَةِ، فَقَالَ : مَا فَعَلَ غَرِيمُكَ وَتَمْرُكَ؟، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : وَفَّاهُ اللَّهُ وَفَضُلَ لَنَا مِنْ التَّمْرِ كَذَا وَكَذَا، قالَ : فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَى امْرَأَتِي، فَقُلْتُ : أَلَمْ أَكُنْ نَهَيْتُكِ أَنْ تُكَلِّمِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي بَيْتِي؟، فَقَالَتْ : تَظُنُّ أَنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى يُورِدُ نَبِيَّهُ فِي بَيْتِي ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ وَلَا أَسْأَلُهُ الصَّلَاةَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى زَوْجِي
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Abu Awanah, from al-Aswad, from Nubayh al-Anazi, from Jabir ibn Abdullah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out to the polytheists to fight them, so my father Abdullah said: O Jabir, there is no harm on you to be among the watchers of the people of Madinah until you know how our affair turns out, for by Allah, were it not that I leave behind daughters of mine after me, I would have loved for you to be killed before me. He said: So while I was among the watchers, my aunt came with my father and my maternal uncle to bury them in our graveyard, so a man reached [us] calling out: The Prophet ﷺ commands you to bring back the slain and bury them where they fell, so we brought them back, and buried them where they fell: Then while I was in the caliphate of Mu'awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan رضي الله عنه, a man came to me, and said: O Jabir ibn Abdullah, Mu'awiyah's workers have exposed your father, so a group of them went out, so I went to him and found him in the same state I had buried him, unchanged except that a foot had not been left of the slain. He said: So I re-buried him, and my father had left a debt of dates upon him, and some of his creditors pressed me hard in demanding payment, so I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and said: O Messenger of Allah, my father was struck down on such-and-such a day, and he left a debt of dates upon him, and some of his creditors have pressed me hard in demanding, so I would like you to help me with him, perhaps he would give me respite for part of his dates until this coming harvest. He said: Yes, I will come to you, Allah willing, near midday. He said: So he came with his disciples with him. He said: So they sat in the shade, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ greeted and sought permission then entered upon us. He said: And I had said to my wife: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ is coming to me today at midday, so do not let him see you and do not disturb the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in my house with anything and do not speak to him. So she spread a mat and a cushion and he laid his head down and slept, so I said to a freed slave of mine: Slaughter this young goat, it being a fattened domestic one, and be quick, hurry, and finish it before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wakes up, and I am with you, so we kept at it until we finished with it, while he was asleep. So I said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when he wakes up, calls for purifying water, and I fear when he finishes he will get up, so let the goat be placed before him before he finishes his purification, so when he woke, he said: O Jabir, bring me purifying water, he said: Yes, so he had not finished his ablution before the young goat was placed before him. He said: So he looked at me, and said: It is as if you knew our love of meat, call Abu Bakr, then he called his disciples. He said: So the food was brought and set down. He said: So he placed his hand, and said: In the name of Allah, eat, so they ate until they were full and much meat remained from it, and he said: By Allah, the gathering of Banu Salimah looking at them, it was dearer to them than their own eyes, they would not go near it out of fear of disturbing him, then he stood, and his companions stood, and they went out before him, and he used to say: Leave my back for the angels. He said: So I followed them until I reached the shelter of the door, and my wife stuck her chest out, and she was very modest, and said: O Messenger of Allah, pray for blessings upon me and my husband, he said: May Allah's blessings be upon you and your husband, then he said: Call so-and-so for me for the creditor who has pressed hard on me in demanding, so he said: Let Jabir have respite for part of the debt that is upon his father until this coming harvest, he said: I will not do it. He said: And he made excuses and said: It is only orphans' wealth, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Where is Jabir? He said: I said: Here I am, O Messenger of Allah, he said: Measure out for him, for Allah, exalted is He, will indeed repay him in full, so he raised his head to the sky, and there was the sun having passed its zenith, he said: The prayer, O Abu Bakr, so they hurried to the mosque, so I said to my creditor: Bring your containers near, so I measured out ajwah dates for him, and Allah repaid him in full and there remained for us so-and-so much of dates. He said: So I came running to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in his mosque as if I were a spark, and I found the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had already prayed, so I said: O Messenger of Allah, I have measured out for my creditor his dates and Allah has repaid him in full and there remains for us so-and-so much of dates, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Where is Umar ibn al-Khattab? He said: So he came running, he said: Ask Jabir ibn Abdullah about his creditor and his dates, he said: I will not ask him, I already knew that Allah would repay him in full since you informed me that Allah would repay him in full, so he repeated it to him, and repeated this statement to him three times, each time saying: I will not ask him, and he was not one to be argued with after the third time, so he said: What happened with your creditor and your dates? He said: I said: Allah repaid him in full and there remained for us so-and-so much of dates. He said: So I returned to my wife, and said: Did I not forbid you from speaking to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in my house? So she said: Do you think that Allah, exalted is He, brings His Prophet into my house then he leaves without me asking him for blessings upon me and my husband?
24.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Abu Awanah se bataya: Humein al-Aswad ne bataya, Nubayh al-Anazi se, Jabir ibn Abdullah se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ mushrikon se ladne nikle, to mere walid Abdullah ne kaha: Ae Jabir, tumpar koi harj nahi ke tum Madinah ke logon mein dekhne walon mein raho yahan tak ke tumhein pata chale humara maamla kya banta hai, kyunki Allah ki qasam, agar main apne peechhe apni betiyon ko na chhodta, to main chaahta ke tum mere saamne qatal ho jao.
