Unhone bataya: To jab main dekhne walon mein tha, meri phuphi mere walid aur mere mamu ko lekar aayin taake unhein humaari qabaron mein dafan karein, to ek aadmi pukaarte hue pahuncha: Nabi ﷺ tumhein hukum dete hain ke tum maqtoolon ko wapas le jao aur unhein wahin dafan karo jahan woh qatal hue, to humne unhein wapas kiya, aur unhein waha dafan kiya jahan woh qatal hue: Fir jab main Mu'awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan رضي الله عنه ki khilaafat mein tha, ek aadmi mere paas aaya, aur kaha: Ae Jabir ibn Abdullah, Mu'awiyah ke karyakartaaon ne tumhare walid ko kholaa hai, to unmein se ek giroh nikla, to main unke paas gaya aur unhein usi haalat mein paaya jismein maine unhein dafan kiya tha, koi tabdeeli nahi thi siwaay iske ke ek paaon maqtool ka nahi bacha tha. Unhone bataya: To maine unhein dobara dafan kiya, aur mere walid par khajoor ka qarz tha, aur unke kuch qarzdaaron ne mujhpar maang mein sakhti ki, to main Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaya, aur kaha: Ya Rasulullah, mere walid fulaan-fulaan din maare gaye, aur unpar khajoor ka qarz tha, aur unke kuch qarzdaaron ne mujhpar maang mein sakhti ki hai, to main chaahta hoon ke aap mujhe unke saath madad karein, shayad woh mujhe kuch khajoor ki mohlat is aane wale toray tak de dein. Aapne farmaya: Haan, main tumhare paas aaunga, Inshaallah, dophar ke qareeb. Unhone bataya: To aap apne saathiyon ke saath aaye. Unhone bataya: To woh saaye mein baithe aur Rasulullah ﷺ ne salaam kiya aur ijaazat maangi fir humare paas dakhil hue. Unhone bataya: Aur maine apni biwi se kaha tha: Rasulullah ﷺ aaj dophar mein mere paas aa rahe hain, to woh tumhein na dekhein aur mere ghar mein Rasulullah ﷺ ko kisi cheez se pareshaan na karo aur unse baat na karo. To usne ek bistar aur takiya bichhaaya aur aapne apna sar rakha, aur so gaye, to maine apne ek azaad kiye hue ghulam se kaha: Isse bakri ke bachche ko zabah karo, jo palay hua motaa-taaza tha, aur jaldi karo, phurti se karo, isse Rasulullah ﷺ ke jaagne se pehle nipta do, aur main tumhare saath hoon, to hum ismein lage rahe yahan tak ke humne isse nipta diya, jabke aap so rahe the. To maine kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ, jab aap jaagte hain, wudu ka paani maangte hain, aur mujhe dar hai ke jab aap faarigh ho jaayein to khade ho jaayein, so bakri ka bachcha aapke saamne rakh diya jaaye isse pehle ke aap apna wudu poora karein, to jab aap jaage, farmaya: Ae Jabir mere liye wudu ka paani lao, unhone kaha: Haan, to aapne apna wudu poora nahi kiya tha ke bakri ka bachcha aapke saamne rakh diya gaya. Unhone bataya: To aapne mujhe dekha, aur farmaya: Goya tumhein humaari gosht ki pasand ka pata tha, Abu Bakr ko bulaao, fir aapne apne saathiyon ko bulaaya. Unhone bataya: To khaana laaya gaya aur rakha gaya. Unhone bataya: To aapne apna haath rakha, aur farmaya: Bismillah, khaao, to woh khaate rahe yahan tak ke seer ho gaye aur bahut sa gosht bach gaya, aur aapne farmaya: Allah ki qasam, Banu Salimah ki majlis unhein dekhti rahi, yeh unhein unki apni aankhon se zyada aziz tha, woh iske paas na jaate is khauf se ke kahin aapko takleef na ho, fir aap khade hue, aur aapke sahaba khade hue, aur woh aapke aage-aage nikle, aur aap farmaate: Meri peeth farishton ke liye chhod do. Unhone bataya: To main unke peechhe gaya yahan tak ke main darwaze ke chappar tak pahuncha, to meri biwi ne apna seena baahar nikaala aur woh bahut ba-pardah thi, aur kaha: Ya Rasulullah, mujhpar aur mere shohar par dua kijiye, aapne farmaya: Allah ki barkat tumpar aur tumhare shohar par ho, fir aapne farmaya: Mere liye fulaan ko bulaao us qarzdaar ke liye jisne mujhpar maang mein sakhti ki, to aapne farmaya: Jabir ko unke walid par baaqi qarz ka kuch hissa is aane wale toray tak mohlat de do, unhone kaha: Main aisa nahi karunga. Unhone bataya: Aur usne bahaana banaaya aur kaha: Yeh to yateemon ka maal hai, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: Jabir kahan hai? Unhone kaha: Maine kaha: Main yahan hoon, Ya Rasulullah, aapne farmaya: Unke liye naapo, kyunki Allah Ta'ala usay zaroor poora ada karega, to aapne apna sar aasmaan ki taraf uthaaya, to suraj dhal chuka tha, aapne farmaya: Namaz, Ae Abu Bakr, to woh masjid ki taraf jaldi gaye, to maine apne qarzdaar se kaha: Apne bartan qareeb lao, to maine ajwah khajoor unhein naap kar di aur Allah ne usay poora ada kar diya aur humare paas fulaan-fulaan miqdaar khajoor bach gayi. Unhone bataya: To main Rasulullah ﷺ ki taraf daudte hue aaya unki masjid mein goya main ek chingaari hoon, to maine paaya ke Rasulullah ﷺ namaz padh chuke hain, to maine kaha: Ya Rasulullah, maine apne qarzdaar ko uski khajoor naap kar de di aur Allah ne usay poora ada kar diya aur humare paas fulaan-fulaan miqdaar khajoor bach gayi hai, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: Umar ibn al-Khattab kahan hain? Unhone bataya: To woh daudte hue aaye, aapne farmaya: Jabir ibn Abdullah se unke qarzdaar aur unki khajoor ke baare mein poocho, unhone kaha: Main unse nahi poochunga, mujhe pehle hi maloom tha ke Allah usay poora ada karega jab aapne bataaya tha ke Allah usay poora ada karega, to aapne unse yeh dohraaya, aur yeh baat unse teen martaba dohraayi, har baar woh kehte: Main unse nahi poochunga, aur teesri martaba ke baad unse dobara baat nahi ki jaati thi, to aapne poocha: Tumhare qarzdaar aur tumhaari khajoor ka kya hua? Unhone kaha: Maine kaha: Allah ne usay poora ada kar diya aur humare paas fulaan-fulaan miqdaar khajoor bach gayi. Unhone bataya: To main apni biwi ke paas laut aaya, aur maine kaha: Kya maine tumhein Rasulullah ﷺ se mere ghar mein baat karne se mana nahi kiya tha? To usne kaha: Kya tum samajhte ho ke Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi ko mere ghar laata hai fir woh nikal jaate hain aur main unse mere aur mere shohar par dua na maangun.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَكِيمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي الْحَكَمُ بْنُ أَبَانَ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ اللَّهَ فَضَّلَ مُحَمَّدًا K عَلَى الْأَنْبِيَاءِ عَلَيْهِمْ السَّلامُ وَعَلَى أَهْلِ السَّمَاءِ، فَقَالُوا : يَا ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، بِمَ فَضَّلَهُ عَلَى أَهْلِ السَّمَاءِ؟، قَالَ : إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَالَ لِأَهْلِ السَّمَاءِ # وَمَنْ يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّي إِلَهٌ مِنْ دُونِهِ فَذَلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي الظَّالِمِينَ سورة الأنبياء آية 29 #، وَقَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى لِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : # إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا { 1 } لِيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ سورة الفتح آية 1-2 #، قَالُوا : فَمَا فَضْلُهُ عَلَى الْأَنْبِيَاءِ عَلَيْهِمْ السَّلامُ؟ قَالَ : قَالَ اللَّهُ G : # وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ رَسُولٍ إِلا بِلِسَانِ قَوْمِهِ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمْ سورة إبراهيم آية 4 #، وَقَالَ اللَّهُ G لِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : # وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلا كَافَّةً لِلنَّاسِ سورة سبأ آية 28 #، فَأَرْسَلَهُ إِلَى الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ "
24.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Yazid ibn Abi Hakim, from al-Hakam ibn Aban, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه: He said: Indeed Allah preferred Muhammad ﷺ over the prophets, upon them be peace, and over the people of the sky, so they said: O Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما, in what did He prefer him over the people of the sky? He said: Indeed Allah said to the people of the sky: 'And whoever among them says: Indeed I am a god besides Him, We will recompense him with Jahannam, thus do We recompense the wrongdoers' [Surah al-Anbiya, verse 29], and Allah exalted is He said to Muhammad ﷺ: 'Indeed We have given you a clear conquest, that Allah may forgive you what preceded of your sin and what will follow' [Surah al-Fath, verses 1-2]. They said: Then what is his excellence over the prophets, upon them be peace? He said: Allah said: 'And We did not send any messenger except with the language of his people, so that he might make clear to them' [Surah Ibrahim, verse 4], and Allah said to Muhammad ﷺ: 'And We have not sent you except comprehensively to mankind' [Surah Saba, verse 28], so He sent him to the jinn and mankind.
24.hi: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ne Yazid ibn Abi Hakim se bataya: Mujhe al-Hakam ibn Aban ne bataya, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Beshak Allah ne Muhammad ﷺ ko Anbiya, alayhimus-salaam, aur aasmaan walon par fazeelat di, to logon ne poocha: Ae Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما, unhein aasmaan walon par kis baat mein fazeelat di? Unhone kaha: Allah ne aasmaan walon se farmaya: 'Aur unmein se jo bhi kahe ke main uske siwa ek ma'bood hoon, to hum usay Jahannam ki saza denge, isi tarah hum zaalimon ko saza dete hain' [Surah Al-Anbiya, aayat 29], aur Allah Ta'ala ne Muhammad ﷺ se farmaya: 'Beshak humne tumhein khuli fatah di hai, taake Allah tumhare pehle aur baad ke gunah bakhsh de' [Surah Al-Fath, aayat 1-2]. Unhone poocha: To Anbiya, alayhimus-salaam, par unki kya fazeelat hai? Unhone kaha: Allah ne farmaya: 'Aur humne koi Rasool sirf uski qaum ki zubaan mein bheja taake woh unhein wazeh kar sake' [Surah Ibrahim, aayat 4], aur Allah ne Muhammad ﷺ se farmaya: 'Aur humne tumhein sirf tamaam insaanon ke liye [Rasool] bheja hai' [Surah Saba, aayat 28], to usne aapko jinnaat aur insaano ki taraf bheja.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زَمْعَةُ  ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ،  عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : جَلَسَ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَنْتَظِرُونَهُ فَخَرَجَ حَتَّى إِذَا دَنَا مِنْهُمْ، سَمِعَهُمْ يَتَذَاكَرُونَ، فَتَسَمَّعَ حَدِيثَهُمْ، فَإِذَا بَعْضُهُمْ، يَقُولُ : عَجَبًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ اتَّخَذَ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ خَلِيلًا، فَإِبْرَاهِيمُ خَلِيلُهُ، وَقَالَ آخَرُ : مَاذَا بِأَعْجَبَ مِنْ : # وَكَلَّمَ اللَّهُ مُوسَى تَكْلِيمًا سورة النساء آية 164 #، وَقَالَ آخَرُ : فَعِيسَى كَلِمَةُ اللَّهِ وَرُوحُهُ، وَقَالَ آخَرُ : وَآدَمُ اصْطَفَاهُ اللَّه، فَخَرَجَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَسَلَّمَ، وَقَالَ :" قَدْ سَمِعْتُ كَلَامَكُمْ وَعَجَبَكُمْ، إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلُ اللَّهِ، وَهُوَ كَذَلِكَ، وَمُوسَى نَجِيُّهُ، وَهُوَ كَذَلِكَ، وَعِيسَى رُوحُهُ وَكَلِمَتُهُ، وَهُوَ كَذَلِكَ، وَآدَمُ اصْطَفَاهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى، وَهُوَ كَذَلِكَ، أَلَا وَأَنَا حَبِيبُ اللَّهِ، وَلَا فَخْرَ، وَأَنَا حَامِلُ لِوَاءِ الْحَمْدِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَلَا فَخْرُ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ شَافِعٍ، وَأَوَّلُ مُشَفَّعٍ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلَا فَخْرُ، وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ مَنْ يُحَرِّكُ بِحَلَقِ الْجَنَّةِ وَلَا فَخْرُ، فَيَفْتَحُ اللَّهُ فَيُدْخِلُنِيهَا وَمَعِي فُقَرَاءُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَا فَخْرُ، وَأَنَا أَكْرَمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْآخِرِينَ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا فَخْرُ "
24.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Zam'ah, from Salamah, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه: He said: Some people from the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ sat waiting for him, so he came out until when he came near them, he heard them discussing, so he listened to their conversation, and there was one of them saying: Amazing, Allah indeed took a close friend from among His creation, Ibrahim is His close friend, and another said: What is more amazing than: 'And Allah spoke to Musa directly' [Surah al-Nisa, verse 164], and another said: But Isa is the word of Allah and His spirit, and another said: And Adam, Allah chose him, so he came out to them and greeted them, and said: I have indeed heard your talk and your amazement, Ibrahim is the close friend of Allah, and he is so, and Musa is His confidant, and he is so, and Isa is His spirit and His word, and he is so, and Adam, Allah exalted is He chose him, and he is so, listen, and I am the beloved of Allah, without boasting, and I am the bearer of the banner of praise on the Day of Resurrection, without boasting, and I am the first intercessor, and the first whose intercession is accepted on the Day of Resurrection, without boasting, and I am the first to shake the rings of Paradise, without boasting, and Allah will open it and admit me into it, and with me the poor believers, without boasting, and I am the most honored of the first and the last to Allah, without boasting.
24.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Zam'ah se bataya: Humein Salamah ne bataya, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ ke sahaba mein se kuch log baithe aapka intezaar kar rahe the, to aap nikle yahan tak ke jab aap unke qareeb aaye, aapne unhein aapas mein baat karte suna, to aapne unki baat sunna shuru ki, to unmein se ek keh raha tha: Ajeeb hai, Allah ne apni makhlooq mein se ek dost banaya, to Ibrahim uske dost hain, aur doosre ne kaha: Isse zyada ajeeb kya hai: 'Aur Allah ne Musa se seedhe taur par baat ki' [Surah An-Nisa, aayat 164], aur doosre ne kaha: Lekin Isa Allah ka kalima aur uski rooh hain, aur doosre ne kaha: Aur Aadam, Allah ne unhein chun liya, to aap unke paas nikle aur salaam kiya, aur farmaya: Maine tumhaari baat aur tumhaara ajeebpan sun liya hai, Ibrahim Allah ke khaleel hain, aur woh waisi hi hain, aur Musa uske raazdaar hain, aur woh waise hi hain, aur Isa uski rooh aur uska kalima hain, aur woh waise hi hain, aur Aadam, Allah Ta'ala ne unhein chuna, aur woh waise hi hain, sun lo, aur main Allah ka mehboob hoon, bila fakhr ke, aur main Qayamat ke din hamd ke jhande ka uthhaane wala hoon, bila fakhr ke, aur main pehla sifarish karne wala hoon, aur pehla jiski sifarish qabool ki jaayegi Qayamat ke din, bila fakhr ke, aur main pehla hoon jo Jannat ke halqon ko hilaayega, bila fakhr ke, to Allah ise kholega aur mujhe ismein dakhil karega, aur mere saath gareeb momin, bila fakhr ke, aur main Allah ke nazdeek pehlon aur pichhlon mein sabse izzat wala hoon, bila fakhr ke.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ أَبِي الْأَسْوَدِ  ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ  ، عَنْ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَنَا أَوَّلُهُمْ خُرُوجًا، وَأَنَا قَائِدُهُمْ إِذَا وَفَدُوا، وَأَنَا خَطِيبُهُمْ إِذَا أَنْصَتُوا، وَأَنَا مُسْتَشْفِعُهُمْ إِذَا حُبِسُوا، وَأَنَا مُبَشِّرُهُمْ إِذَا أَيِسُوا، الْكَرَامَةُ وَالْمَفَاتِيحُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِيَدِي، وَأَنَا أَكْرَمُ وَلَدِ آدَمَ عَلَى رَبِّي، يَطُوفُ عَلَيَّ أَلْفُ خَادِمٍ كَأَنَّهُمْ بَيْضٌ مَكْنُونٌ، أَوْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَنْثُورٌ "
24.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Sulayman, from Mansur ibn Abi al-Aswad, from Layth, from al-Rabi' ibn Anas, from Anas رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: I am the first of them to come out, and I am their leader when they arrive as delegations, and I am their orator when they listen attentively, and I am their intercessor when they are detained, and I am their bringer of glad tidings when they despair, honor and the keys are that day in my hand, and I am the most honored child of Adam to my Lord, a thousand servants circle around me, as if they are hidden pearls, or scattered pearls.
24.hi: Sa'id ibn Sulayman ne Mansur ibn Abi al-Aswad se bataya: Humein Layth ne bataya, al-Rabi' ibn Anas se, Anas se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Main unmein sabse pehle nikalne wala hoon, aur main unka rahnuma hoon jab woh wafd banakar aayenge, aur main unka khateeb hoon jab woh khamosh sunenge, aur main unka sifarish karne wala hoon jab woh rok liye jaayein, aur main unhein khush-khabri dene wala hoon jab woh na-ummeed ho jaayein, izzat aur chaabiyaan us din mere haath mein hongi, aur main Aadam ki aulaad mein apne Rab ke nazdeek sabse izzat wala hoon, hazaar khidmatgaar mere gird ghoomte hain, goya woh chhupe hue moti, ya bikhre hue moti hain.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْحَكَمِ الْمِصْرِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرُ بْنُ مُضَرَ  ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ  ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ هُوَ ابْنُ عَطَاءِ بْنِ خَبَّابٍ  مَوْلَى بَنِي الدُّئِلِ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" أَنَا قَائِدُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَلَا فَخْرُ، وَأَنَا خَاتَمُ النَّبِيِّينَ وَلَا فَخْرُ، وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ شَافِعٍ وَأَوَّلُ مُشَفَّعٍ وَلَا فَخْرُ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Abd al-Hakam al-Misri, from Bakr ibn Mudar, from Ja'far ibn Rabi'ah, from Salih ibn Ata ibn Khabbab, freed slave of Banu al-Du'il, from Ata ibn Abi Rabah, from Jabir ibn Abdullah رضي الله عنهما: That the Prophet ﷺ said: I am the leader of the messengers, without boasting, and I am the seal of the prophets, without boasting, and I am the first intercessor and the first whose intercession is accepted, without boasting.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Abd al-Hakam al-Misri ne Bakr ibn Mudar se bataya: Humein Ja'far ibn Rabi'ah ne bataya, Salih ibn Ata ibn Khabbab se (Banu al-Du'il ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), Ata ibn Abi Rabah se, Jabir ibn Abdullah se رضي الله عنهما: ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, Main Rasoolon ka rahnuma hoon, bila fakhr ke, aur main Nabiyon ki mohar hoon, bila fakhr ke, aur main pehla sifarish karne wala aur pehla jiski sifarish qabool ki jaayegi, bila fakhr ke.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ هُوَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ جُدْعَانَ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ بْنِ مَالِكٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" أَنَا أَوَّلُ مَنْ يَأْخُذُ بِحَلْقَةِ بَابِ الْجَنَّةِ فَأُقَعْقِعُهَا "، قَالَ أَنَسٌ : كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى يَدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُحَرِّكُهَا، وَصَفَ لَنَا سُفْيَانُ كَذَا، وَجَمَعَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَصَابِعَهُ وَحَرَّكَهَا، قَالَ : وَقَالَ لَهُ ثَابِتٌ : مَسَسْتَ يَدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِيَدِكَ؟، قَالَ : نَعَمْ، قَالَ : فَأَعْطِنِيهَا أُقَبِّلْهَا
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Abbad, from Sufyan (Ibn Uyaynah), from Ibn Jud'an, from Anas ibn Malik رضي الله عنه: That the Prophet ﷺ said: I am the first to take hold of the ring of the door of Paradise and rattle it. Anas said: It is as if I am looking at the hand of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ moving it, Sufyan described it to us like this, and Abu Abdullah gathered his fingers and moved them. He said: And Thabit said to him: Did you touch the hand of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with your hand? He said: Yes. He said: Then give it to me, that I may kiss it.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Abbad ne Sufyan se bataya (Ibn Uyaynah), Ibn Jud'an se, Anas ibn Malik se رضي الله عنه: ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, Main sabse pehle Jannat ke darwaze ka halqa pakadne wala hoon aur usay khadkhadaunga, Anas kehte hain: Goya main Rasulullah ﷺ ka haath dekh raha hoon usay hilaate hue, Sufyan ne humein isi tarah wasf kiya, aur Abu Abdullah ne apni ungliyaan jama kin aur unhein hilaaya. Unhone bataya: Aur Thabit ne unse kaha: Kya tumne apne haath se Rasulullah ﷺ ka haath chhua tha? Unhone kaha: Haan. Unhone kaha: To woh mujhe do, main usay chumun.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ  ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ  ، عَنْ الْمُخْتَارِ بْنِ فُلْفُلٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَنَا أَوَّلُ شَافِعٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ "
24.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Husayn ibn Ali, from Za'idah, from al-Mukhtar ibn Fulful, from Anas رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: I am the first intercessor in Paradise.
24.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Husayn ibn Ali se bataya: Humein Za'idah ne bataya, al-Mukhtar ibn Fulful se, Anas se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Main Jannat mein pehla sifarish karne wala hoon.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ هُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْهَادِ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ :" إِنِّي لَأَوَّلُ النَّاسِ تَنْشَقُّ الْأَرْضُ عَنْ جُمْجُمَتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلَا فَخْرُ، وَأُعْطَى لِوَاءَ الْحَمْدِ وَلَا فَخْرُ، وَأَنَا سَيِّدُ النَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلَا فَخْرُ، وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ مَنْ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلَا فَخْرُ، وَآتِي بَابَ الْجَنَّةِ فَآخُذُ بِحَلْقَتِهَا فَيَقُولُونَ : مَنْ هَذَا؟، فَأَقُولُ أَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ ، فَيَفْتَحُونَ لِي فَأَدْخُلُ فَأَجِدُ الْجَبَّارَ مُسْتَقْبِلِي، فَأَسْجُدُ لَهُ، فَيَقُولُ : ارْفَعْ رَأْسَكَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ وَتَكَلَّمْ، يُسْمَعْ مِنْكَ، وَقُلْ، يُقْبَلْ مِنْكَ، وَاشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ، فَأَرْفَعُ رَأْسِي، فَأَقُولُ : أُمَّتِي أُمَّتِي يَا رَبّ، فَيَقُولُ : اذْهَبْ إِلَى أُمَّتِكَ، فَمَنْ وَجَدْتَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِنْ شَعِيرٍ مِنْ الْإِيمَانِ، فَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ، فَأَذْهَبُ، فَمَنْ وَجَدْتُ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالَ ذَلِكَ أَدْخَلْتُهُمْ الْجَنَّةَ، فَأَجِدُ الْجَبَّارَ مُسْتَقْبِلِي فَأَسْجُدُ لَهُ، فَيَقُولُ : ارْفَعْ رَأْسَكَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ وَتَكَلَّمْ، يُسْمَعْ مِنْكَ، وَقُلْ : يُقْبَلْ مِنْكَ، وَاشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ، فَأَرْفَعُ رَأْسِي فَأَقُولُ : أُمَّتِي أُمَّتِي يَا رَبِّ، فَيَقُولُ : اذْهَبْ إِلَى أُمَّتِكَ، فَمَنْ وَجَدْتَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِنْ خَرْدَلٍ مِنْ الْإِيمَانِ فَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ، فَأَذْهَبُ، فَمَنْ وَجَدْتُ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالَ ذَلِكَ أَدْخَلْتُهُمْ الْجَنَّةَ، وَفُرِغَ مِنْ حِسَابِ النَّاسِ وَأُدْخِلَ مَنْ بَقِيَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي فِي النَّارِ مَعَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ، فَيَقُولُ أَهْلُ النَّارِ : مَا أَغْنَى عَنْكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ اللَّهَ وَلَا تُشْرِكُونَ بِهِ شَيْئًا، فَيَقُولُ الْجَبَّارُ : فَبِعِزَّتِي لَأَعْتِقَنَّهُمْ مِنْ النَّارِ، فَيُرْسِلُ إِلَيْهِمْ، فَيَخْرُجُونَ مِنْ النَّارِ وَقَدْ امْتُحِشُوا، فَيُدْخَلُونَ فِي نَهَرِ الْحَيَاةِ، فَيَنْبُتُونَ فِيهِ كَمَا تَنْبُتُ الْحِبَّةُ فِي غُثَاءِ السَّيْلِ وَيُكْتَبُ بَيْنَ أَعْيُنِهِمْ هَؤُلَاءِ عُتَقَاءُ اللَّهِ، فَيُذْهَبُ بِهِمْ فَيَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ، فَيَقُولُ لَهُمْ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ : هَؤُلَاءِ الْجَهَنَّمِيُّونَ، فَيَقُولُ الْجَبَّار : بَلْ هَؤُلَاءِ عُتَقَاءُ الْجَبَّارِ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yazid ibn Abdullah ibn al-Had, from Amr ibn Abi Amr, from Anas ibn Malik: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: I am indeed the first of people for whom the earth will split from over my skull on the Day of Resurrection, without boasting, and I will be given the banner of praise, without boasting, and I am the master of people on the Day of Resurrection, without boasting, and I am the first to enter Paradise on the Day of Resurrection, without boasting, and I will come to the gate of Paradise and take hold of its ring, so they will say: Who is this? So I will say: I am Muhammad, so they will open for me, and I will enter and find the Almighty facing me, so I will prostrate to Him, so He will say: Raise your head, O Muhammad, and speak, you will be heard, and say, it will be accepted from you, and intercede, your intercession will be accepted, so I will raise my head, and say: My nation, my nation, O Lord, so He will say: Go to your nation, whoever you find in his heart the weight of a barley grain of faith, admit him into Paradise, so I will go, and whoever I find in his heart that weight, I will admit them into Paradise, so I will find the Almighty facing me and I will prostrate to Him, so He will say: Raise your head, O Muhammad, and speak, you will be heard, and say: it will be accepted from you, and intercede, your intercession will be accepted, so I will raise my head and say: My nation, my nation, O Lord, so He will say: Go to your nation, whoever you find in his heart the weight of a mustard seed of faith, admit him into Paradise, so I will go, and whoever I find in his heart that weight, I will admit them into Paradise, and when the accounting of the people is finished, whoever remains from my nation will be admitted into the Fire with the people of the Fire, so the people of the Fire will say: What benefit was it to you that you used to worship Allah and not associate anything with Him? So the Almighty will say: By My might, I will indeed free them from the Fire, so He will send to them, and they will come out of the Fire having been scorched, so they will be admitted into the river of life, and they will sprout in it as a seed sprouts in the silt carried by a flood, and it will be written between their eyes: These are the freed of Allah, so they will be taken and enter Paradise, so the people of Paradise will say to them: These are the people of Jahannam, so the Almighty will say: Rather, these are the freed of the Almighty.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhse Yazid ibn Abdullah ibn al-Had ne bataya, Amr ibn Abi Amr se, Anas ibn Malik se: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, Main log logon mein pehla hoon jinke sar se zameen Qayamat ke din phatega, bila fakhr ke, aur mujhe hamd ka jhanda diya jaayega, bila fakhr ke, aur main Qayamat ke din logon ka sardaar hoon, bila fakhr ke, aur main Qayamat ke din Jannat mein sabse pehle dakhil hone wala hoon, bila fakhr ke, aur main Jannat ke darwaze par aaunga aur uska halqa pakdunga, to woh kahenge: Yeh kaun hai? To main kahunga: Main Muhammad hoon, to woh mere liye kholenge aur main dakhil hokar dekhunga Jabbar mera saamna kar rahe hain, to main unhein sajda karunga, to woh farmaayenge: Apna sar utha, Ae Muhammad, aur baat karo, tumhaari sunee jaayegi, aur kaho, tumse qabool kiya jaayega, aur sifarish karo, tumhaari sifarish qabool ki jaayegi, to main apna sar uthaaunga, aur kahunga: Meri ummat, meri ummat, Ae Rab, to woh farmaayenge: Apni ummat ki taraf jao, jise tum unke dil mein jau ke daane ke barabar imaan paao, unhein Jannat mein dakhil karo, to main jaaunga, aur jise main unke dil mein utna paaun, main unhein Jannat mein dakhil karunga, to main Jabbar ko apna saamna karte paaunga aur main unhein sajda karunga, to woh farmaayenge: Apna sar utha, Ae Muhammad, aur baat karo, tumhaari sunee jaayegi, aur kaho: tumse qabool kiya jaayega, aur sifarish karo, tumhaari sifarish qabool ki jaayegi, to main apna sar uthaaunga aur kahunga: Meri ummat, meri ummat, Ae Rab, to woh farmaayenge: Apni ummat ki taraf jao, jise tum unke dil mein raai ke daane ke barabar imaan paao usay Jannat mein dakhil karo, to main jaaunga, aur jise main unke dil mein utna paaun, main unhein Jannat mein dakhil karunga, aur jab logon ka hisaab khatam hoga to meri ummat mein se jo baaqi rahega usay Jahannam mein Jahannam walon ke saath dakhil kiya jaayega, to Jahannam wale kahenge: Tumhein iska kya faida hua ke tum Allah ki ibaadat karte the aur uske saath kisi ko shareek nahi karte the? To Jabbar farmaayenge: Meri izzat ki qasam, main unhein zaroor Jahannam se azaad karunga, to woh unki taraf bheje jaayenge, to woh Jahannam se jhulse hue nikalenge, to unhein zindagi ki nehr mein dakhil kiya jaayega, to woh usmein isi tarah ugenge jaise beej seelaab ke bahaaye hue keechad mein ugta hai, aur unki aankhon ke darmiyan likha jaayega: Yeh Allah ke azaad kiye hue log hain, to unhein le jaaya jaayega aur woh Jannat mein dakhil honge, to Jannat wale unse kahenge: Yeh Jahannam wale hain, to Jabbar farmaayenge: Nahi, yeh Jabbar ke azaad kiye hue hain.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلَانِيِّ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ غَنْمٍ  ، قَالَ :" نَزَلَ جِبْرِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَشَقَّ بَطْنَهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ جِبْرِيلُ : قَلْبٌ وَكِيعٌ فِيهِ أُذُنَانِ سَمِيعَتَانِ وَعَيْنَانِ بَصِيرَتَانِ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ الْمُقَفِّي، الْحَاشِرُ ، خُلُقُكَ قَيِّمٌ، وَلِسَانُكَ صَادِقٌ، وَنَفْسُكَ مُطْمَئِنَّةٌ "، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : وَكِيعٌ يَعْنِي : شَدِيدًا
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from Mu'awiyah, from Yunus ibn Maysarah, from Abu Idris al-Khawlani, from Ibn Ghanm: He said: Jibril, upon him be peace, descended upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and split open his belly, then Jibril said: A firm heart, in it two hearing ears and two seeing eyes, Muhammad, Messenger of Allah, the last of the prophets, the gatherer, your character is upright, and your tongue is truthful, and your soul is tranquil.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne Mu'awiyah se bataya: Mujhse Yunus ibn Maysarah ne bataya, Abu Idris al-Khawlani se, Ibn Ghanm se: Unhone kaha, Jibreel, alayhis-salaam, Rasulullah ﷺ par utre aur aapka pet chaak kiya, fir Jibreel ne kaha: Ek mazboot dil, ismein do sunne wale kaan aur do dekhne wali aankhein, Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool, Nabiyon ke aakhri, jama karne wale, tumhara akhlaq durust hai, aur tumhaari zubaan sachchi hai, aur tumhaari rooh mutma-in hai. Abu Muhammad kehte hain: 'Wakee' ka matlab hai: mazboot.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ رُوَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ قَيْسٍ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَدْرَكَ بِيَ الْأَجَلَ الْمَرْحُومَ وَاخْتَصَرَ لِيَ اخْتِصَارًا فَنَحْنُ الْآخِرُونَ، وَنَحْنُ السَّابِقُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَإِنِّي قَائِلٌ قَوْلًا غَيْرَ فَخْرٍ : إِبْرَاهِيمُ خَلِيلُ اللَّهِ، وَمُوسَى صَفِيُّ اللَّهِ، وَأَنَا حَبِيبُ اللَّهِ، وَمَعِي لِوَاءُ الْحَمْدِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ G وَعَدَنِي فِي أُمَّتِي وَأَجَارَهُمْ مِنْ ثَلَاثٍ : لَا يَعُمُّهُمْ بِسَنَةٍ، وَلَا يَسْتَأْصِلُهُمْ عَدُوٌّ، وَلَا يَجْمَعُهُمْ عَلَى ضَلَالَةٍ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from Mu'awiyah, from Urwah ibn Ruwaym, from Amr ibn Qays: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Allah caused me to reach the blessed term, and He shortened it for me a shortening, so we are the last, and we are the foremost on the Day of Resurrection, and I am saying a statement not out of boasting: Ibrahim is the close friend of Allah, and Musa is the chosen one of Allah, and I am the beloved of Allah, and with me is the banner of praise on the Day of Resurrection, and Allah, exalted is He, promised me regarding my nation and protected them from three things: A [general] famine will not encompass them, and an enemy will not exterminate them entirely, and they will not be gathered upon misguidance.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne Mu'awiyah se bataya: Mujhse Urwah ibn Ruwaym ne bataya, Amr ibn Qays se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Allah ne mujhe rehmat wali muddat tak pahunchaaya aur mere liye isay chhota kar diya, so hum aakhri hain, aur hum Qayamat ke din pehle hain, aur main ek baat kehta hoon bila fakhr ke: Ibrahim Allah ke khaleel hain, aur Musa Allah ke chune hue hain, aur main Allah ka mehboob hoon, aur mere saath hamd ka jhanda hai Qayamat ke din, aur Allah Ta'ala ne mujhse mere ummat ke baare mein wada kiya hai aur unhein teen cheezon se panah di hai: Unhein qehat pura ghere mein nahi lega, aur unhein koi dushman jad se khatam nahi karega, aur unhein gumraahi par jama nahi karega.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَرْطَاةُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ  ، عَنْ ضَمْرَةَ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ مَسْلَمَةَ السَّكُونِيَّ  ، وَقَالَ غَيْرُ مُحَمَّدٍ : سَلَمَةَ السَّكُونِيَّ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذْ قَالَ قَائِلٌ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَلْ أُتِيتَ بِطَعَامٍ مِنْ السَّمَاءِ؟، قَالَ :" نَعَمْ أُتِيتُ بِطَعَامٍ "، قَالَ : يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ، هَلْ كَانَ فِيهِ مِنْ فَضْلٍ؟، قَالَ : " نَعَمْ "، قَالَ : فَمَا فُعِلَ بِهِ؟، قَالِ : " رُفِعَ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ، وَقَدْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنِّي غَيْرُ لَابِثٍ فِيكُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا، ثُمَّ تَلْبَثُونَ، حَتَّى تَقُولُوا : مَتَى مَتَى؟ ثُمَّ تَأْتُونِي أَفْنَادًا يُفْنِي بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا، بَيْنَ يَدَيْ السَّاعَةِ مُوتَانٌ شَدِيدٌ، وَبَعْدَهُ سَنَوَاتُ الزَّلَازِلِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak, from Mu'awiyah ibn Yahya, from Artah ibn al-Mundhir, from Damrah ibn Habib: He said: I heard Maslamah al-Sakuni say - and others besides Muhammad said: Salamah al-Sakuni رضي الله عنه: While we were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, someone said: O Messenger of Allah, were you brought food from the sky? He said: Yes, I was brought food. He said: O Prophet of Allah, was there any surplus of it? He said: Yes. He said: So what was done with it? He said: It was raised to the sky, and it has been revealed to me that I will not remain among you except a little, then you will remain, until you say: When? When? Then you will come to me in groups, some of you destroying others, before the Hour there is a severe mortality, and after it years of earthquakes.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak ne Mu'awiyah ibn Yahya se bataya: Humein Artah ibn al-Mundhir ne bataya, Damrah ibn Habib se: Unhone kaha, Maine Maslamah al-Sakuni ko kehte suna - aur Muhammad ke ilaawa doosron ne kaha: Salamah al-Sakuni رضي الله عنه: Jabke hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas the, kisi ne kaha: Ya Rasulullah, kya aapko aasmaan se khaana laaya gaya tha? Aapne farmaya: Haan, mujhe khaana laaya gaya tha. Usne poocha: Ya Nabi Allah, kya usmein kuch bacha tha? Aapne farmaya: Haan. Usne poocha: To uska kya kiya gaya? Aapne farmaya: Usay aasmaan ki taraf utha liya gaya, aur mujhpar wahi ki gayi hai ke main tum mein thoda hi rahunga, fir tum rahoge, yahan tak ke tum kahoge: Kab? Kab? Fir tum mere paas girohon mein aaoge, tum mein se kuch doosron ko khatam karenge, Qayamat se pehle sakht maut hogi, aur uske baad zalzalon ke saal hongay.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرنَا سُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَلَاءِ  ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أُتِيَ بِقَصْعَةٍ مِنْ ثَرِيدٍ "، فَوُضِعَتْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ الْقَوْمِ، فَتَعَاقَبُوهَا إِلَى الظُّهْرِ مِنْ غُدْوَةٍ، يَقُومُ قَوْمٌ وَيَجْلِسُ آخَرُونَ، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ لِسَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ : أَمَا كَانَتْ تُمَدُّ؟، فَقَالَ سَمُرَةُ : مِنْ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ تَعْجَبُ؟ مَا كَانَتْ تُمَدُّ إِلَّا مِنْ هَا هُنَا، وَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ
24.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Yazid ibn Harun, from Sulayman al-Taymi, from Abu al-Ala, from Samurah ibn Jundub رضي الله عنه: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was brought a bowl of tharid, so it was placed before the people, and they took turns eating from it until noon from morning, some people getting up and others sitting down, so a man said to Samurah ibn Jundub: Was it not being extended [refilled]? So Samurah said: What are you amazed at? It was only being extended from up there, and he pointed with his hand to the sky.
24.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Yazid ibn Harun se bataya: Humein Sulayman al-Taymi ne bataya, Abu al-Ala se, Samurah ibn Jundub se رضي الله عنه: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ko tharid ka ek pyaala laaya gaya, to woh logon ke saamne rakha gaya, to woh subah se dophar tak baari-baari khaate rahe, kuch log uthte aur doosre baithte, to ek aadmi ne Samurah ibn Jundub se poocha: Kya yeh badhta nahi raha [bhara jaata raha]? To Samurah ne kaha: Tum kis baat par hairaan ho? Yeh sirf wahaan se badhta tha, aur unhone apne haath se aasmaan ki taraf ishara kiya.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ سَوَّارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ إِضْحِيَانٍ، وَعَلَيْهِ حُلَّةٌ حَمْرَاءُ، فَجَعَلْتُ أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ وَإِلَى الْقَمَرِ، قَالَ : فَلَهُوَ كَانَ أَحْسَنَ فِي عَيْنِي مِنْ الْقَمَرِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad, from Ash'ath ibn Sawwar, from Abu Ishaq, from Jabir ibn Samurah رضي الله عنه: He said: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on a bright moonlit night, wearing a red garment set, so I began looking at him and at the moon, he said: So he was more beautiful in my eyes than the moon.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Sa'id ne Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad se bataya: Humein Ash'ath ibn Sawwar ne bataya, Abu Ishaq se, Jabir ibn Samurah se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko ek chaandni raat mein dekha, aap laal libaas mein the, to main aapko aur chaand ko dekhne laga, unhone bataya: To aap mere nazar mein chaand se zyada khoobsurat lage.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي الثَابِتٍ الزُّهْرِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنُ أَخِي مُوسَى  ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ  ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَفْلَجَ الثَّنِيَّتَيْنِ، إِذَا تَكَلَّمَ رُئِيَ كَالنُّورِ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ بَيْنِ ثَنَايَاهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Ibrahim ibn al-Mundhir, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi al-Thabit al-Zuhri, from Isma'il ibn Ibrahim, nephew of Musa, from his uncle Musa ibn Uqbah, from Kurayb, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had a slight gap between his two front teeth, when he spoke it was seen like light coming out from between his front teeth.
24.hi: Ibrahim ibn al-Mundhir ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi al-Thabit al-Zuhri se bataya: Mujhse Isma'il ibn Ibrahim ne bataya, Musa ke bhatije: apne chacha Musa ibn Uqbah se, Kurayb se, Ibn Abbas se رضي الله عنهما: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ke aage ke do daanton mein halka sa faasla tha, jab aap baat karte to lagta ke noor aapke daanton ke darmiyan se nikal raha ho.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مِسْعَرٌ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ :" مَا رَأَيْتُ أَحَدًا أَنْجَدَ، وَلَا أَجْوَدَ، وَلَا أَشْجَعَ، وَلَا أَضْوَأَ أَوْ أَوْضَأَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "
24.en: Narrated by Mahmud ibn Ghaylan, from Yazid ibn Harun, from Mis'ar, from Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr: He said: Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه said: I have never seen anyone more courageous, nor more generous, nor braver, nor more radiant or handsome than the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
24.hi: Mahmud ibn Ghaylan ne Yazid ibn Harun se bataya: Humein Mis'ar ne bataya, Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr se: Unhone kaha, Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه ne kaha: Maine kabhi kisi ko Rasulullah ﷺ se zyada bahaadur, na zyada sakhi, na zyada bahaadur (dilaawar), na zyada roshan ya khoobsurat nahi dekha.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ الْحِزَامِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمَّارِ بْنِ يَاسِرٍ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : لِلرُّبَيِّعِ بِنْتِ مُعَوِّذِ ابْنِ عَفْرَاءَ   : صِفِي لَنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَتْ : يَا بُنَيَّ" لَوْ رَأَيْتَهُ، رَأَيْتَ الشَّمْسَ طَالِعَةً "
24.en: Narrated by Ibrahim ibn al-Mundhir al-Hizami, from Ubaydullah ibn Musa, from Usamah ibn Zayd, from Abu Ubaydah ibn Muhammad ibn Ammar ibn Yasir: He said: I said to al-Rubayyi bint Mu'awwidh ibn Afra: Describe the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for us, so she said: O my son, had you seen him, you would have seen the sun rising.
24.hi: Ibrahim ibn al-Mundhir al-Hizami ne Ubaydullah ibn Musa se bataya: Humein Usamah ibn Zayd ne bataya, Abu Ubaydah ibn Muhammad ibn Ammar ibn Yasir se: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Rubayyi bint Mu'awwidh ibn Afra se kaha: Humein Rasulullah ﷺ ka wasf bataao, to unhone kaha: Ae mere bete, agar tum unhein dekhte, to tum suraj ko chadhta hua dekhte.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا ثَابِتٌ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ" أَزْهَرَ اللَّوْنِ كَأَنَّ عَرَقَهُ اللُّؤْلُؤُ، إِذَا مَشَى تَكَفَّأَ، وَمَا مَسِسْتُ حَرِيرَةً وَلَا دِيبَاجَةً أَلْيَنَ مِنْ كَفِّهِ، وَلَا شَمِمْتُ رَائِحَةً قَطُّ أَطْيَبُ مِنْ رَائِحَتِهِ : مِسْكَةً وَلَا غَيْرَهَا "
24.en: Narrated by Hajjaj ibn Minhal, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Thabit, from Anas رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was radiant in complexion, as if his sweat were pearls, when he walked he leaned forward, and I never touched silk or brocade softer than his palm, nor did I ever smell a scent more pleasant than his scent: musk or anything else.
24.hi: Hajjaj ibn Minhal ne Hammad ibn Salamah se bataya: Humein Thabit ne bataya, Anas se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ chamakti rang wale the, goya aapka pasina moti tha, jab aap chalte to aage ki taraf jhukte, aur maine kabhi koi resham ya diba nahi chhua jo aapki hatheli se zyada narm ho, aur maine kabhi koi khushbu nahi soongi jo aapki khushbu se zyada achhi ho: mushk ho ya koi aur cheez.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" خَدَمْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَمَا قَالَ لِي : أُفٍّ قَطُّ، وَلَا قَالَ لِي لِشَيْءٍ صَنَعْتُهُ : لِمَ صَنَعْتَ كَذَا وَكَذَا أَوْ هَلَّا صَنَعْتَ كَذَا وَكَذَا، وَقَالَ : لَا وَاللَّهِ مَا مَسِسْتُ بِيَدِي دِيبَاجًا، وَلَا حَرِيرًا أَلْيَنَ مِنْ يَدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَلَا وَجَدْتُ رِيحًا قَطُّ أَوْ عَرْفًا كَانَ أَطْيَبَ مِنْ عَرْفِ أَوْ رِيحِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Thabit, from Anas ibn Malik رضي الله عنه: He said: I served the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he never said 'uff' to me at all, nor did he ever say to me about anything I had done: Why did you do such-and-such, or why did you not do such-and-such, and he said: No, by Allah, I never touched with my hand a brocade or silk softer than the hand of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, nor did I ever find a scent or fragrance more pleasant than the fragrance or scent of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
24.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Thabit ne bataya, Anas ibn Malik se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ki khidmat ki, to aapne mujhse kabhi 'uff' nahi kaha, aur na hi kabhi kisi kaam ke baare mein jo maine kiya kaha: Tumne fulaan-fulaan kyun kiya, ya fulaan-fulaan kyun nahi kiya, aur unhone kaha: Nahi, Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi apne haath se koi diba ya resham nahi chhua jo Rasulullah ﷺ ke haath se zyada narm ho, aur maine kabhi koi khushbu ya khushboo nahi paayi jo Rasulullah ﷺ ki khushboo ya khushbu se zyada achhi ho.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الرِّفَاعِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ خُدْرَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي رَجُلٌ   مِنْ بَنِي حُرَيْشٍ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ مَعَ أَبِي حِينَ رَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَاعِزَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، فَلَمَّا أَخَذَتْهُ الْحِجَارَةُ أُرْعِبْتُ،" فَضَمَّنِي إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَسَالَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ عَرَقِ إِبْطِهِ مِثْلُ رِيحِ الْمِسْكِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Rifa'i, from Abu Bakr, from Habib ibn Khudrah, from a man from Banu Hurayth: He said: I was with my father when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stoned Ma'iz ibn Malik رضي الله عنه, so when the stones took hold of him, I was frightened, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ held me close to him, and the sweat from his armpit flowed onto me like the scent of musk.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Yazid al-Rifa'i ne Abu Bakr se bataya: Humein Habib ibn Khudrah ne bataya: Mujhe Banu Hurayth ke ek aadmi ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Main apne walid ke saath tha jab Rasulullah ﷺ ne Ma'iz ibn Malik رضي الله عنه ko rajm kiya, to jab pathhar unhein lage, mujhe dar laga, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhe apne paas gale laga liya, to unki bagal ka pasina mujhpar behne laga mushk ki khushbu jaisa.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الْبَرَاءِ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ : أَرَأَيْتَ كَانَ وَجْهُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِثْلَ السَّيْفِ؟، قَالَ :" لَا، مِثْلَ الْقَمَرِ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zuhayr, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Bara': He said: A man asked him: Tell me, was the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ like the sword? He said: No, like the moon.
24.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zuhayr se bataya: Humein Abu Ishaq ne bataya, al-Bara' se: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi ne unse poocha: Bataao, kya Rasulullah ﷺ ka chehra talwar jaisa tha? Unhone kaha: Nahi, chaand jaisa.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" يُعْرَفُ بِاللَّيْلِ بِطيبِ الرِّيحِ "
24.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Sharik, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was recognized at night by the pleasantness of his scent.
24.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Sharik se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya, Ibrahim se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ raat ko apni khushbu ki khoobi se pehchaane jaate the.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْهَاشِمِيُّ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ عَطِيَّةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَمْ يَسْلُكْ طَرِيقًا أَوْ لَا يَسْلُكُ طَرِيقًا، فَيَتْبَعُهُ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا عَرَفَ أَنَّهُ قَدْ سَلَكَهُ مِنْ طِيبِ عَرْفِهِ "، أَوْ قَالَ : مِنْ رِيحِ عَرَقِهِ
24.en: Narrated by Malik ibn Isma'il, from Ishaq ibn al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Hashimi, from al-Mughirah ibn Atiyyah, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir رضي الله عنه: That the Prophet ﷺ did not walk a path, or does not walk a path, that anyone follows him upon, except that he knows he walked it from the pleasantness of his scent, or he said: from the scent of his sweat.
24.hi: Malik ibn Isma'il ne Ishaq ibn al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Hashimi se bataya: Humein al-Mughirah ibn Atiyyah ne bataya, Abu al-Zubayr se, Jabir se رضي الله عنه: ke Nabi ﷺ kisi raaste se nahi chalte, ya nahi chalte, ke koi usper unki pairwi kare magar usay maloom ho jaaye ke aap isse guzre hain aapki khushbu ki khoobi se, ya kaha: aapke pasine ki khushbu se.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو اللَّيْثِيُّ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : يَأْكُلُ الْهَدِيَّةَ، وَلَا يَقْبَلُ الصَّدَقَةَ، فَأَهْدَتْ لَهُ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ يَهُودِ خَيْبَرَ شَاةً مَصْلِيَّةً، فَتَنَاوَلَ مِنْهَا، وَتَنَاوَلَ مِنْهَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْبَرَاءِ، ثُمَّ رَفَعَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَدَهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ :" إِنَّ هَذِهِ تُخْبِرُنِي أَنَّهَا مَسْمُومَةٌ "، فَمَاتَ بِشْرُ بْنُ الْبَرَاءِ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " مَا حَمَلَكِ عَلَى مَا صَنَعْتِ؟ "، فَقَالَتْ : إِنْ كُنْتَ نَبِيًّا لَمْ يَضُرَّكَ شَيْءٌ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ مَلِكًا، أَرَحْتُ النَّاسَ مِنْكَ، فَقَالَ : فِي مَرَضِهِ : " مَا زِلْتُ مِنْ الْأَكْلَةِ الَّتِي أَكَلْتُ بِخَيْبَرَ، فَهَذَا أَوَانُ انْقِطَاعِ أَبْهَرِي "
24.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Muhammad ibn Amr al-Laythi, from Abu Salamah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to eat gifts, but not accept charity, so a woman from the Jews of Khaybar gave him a roasted sheep as a gift, so he took some of it, and Bishr ibn al-Bara' took some of it too, then the Prophet ﷺ raised his hand, then said: This indeed tells me that it is poisoned, so Bishr ibn al-Bara' died, so the Prophet ﷺ sent to her: What led you to do what you did? So she said: If you were a prophet, nothing would harm you, and if you were a king, I would have relieved the people of you. So he said in his illness: I have not ceased, since the meal I ate at Khaybar, [suffering], and this is the time of the severing of my aorta.
24.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Muhammad ibn Amr al-Laythi se bataya: Humein Abu Salamah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ tohfa khaate the, lekin sadqa qabool nahi karte the, to Khaybar ke Yahoodiyon mein se ek aurat ne aapko ek bhuni hui bhed tohfe mein di, to aapne usmein se kuch liya, aur Bishr ibn al-Bara' ne bhi usmein se kuch liya, fir Nabi ﷺ ne apna haath uthaaya, fir farmaya: Yeh mujhe bata rahi hai ke yeh zeher-yukta hai, to Bishr ibn al-Bara' mar gaye, to Nabi ﷺ ne uski taraf bheja: Tumhein woh karne par kis cheez ne uksaaya? To usne kaha: Agar aap Nabi hain to aapko kuch nuqsaan nahi hoga, aur agar aap baadshah hain, to maine logon ko aapse aaraam de diya. To aapne apni bimaari mein farmaya: Jab se maine Khaybar mein woh khaana khaaya hai, main [takleef mein] rahaa hoon, aur yeh mere aortic rag ke katne ka waqt hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ يُحَدِّثُ، أَنَّ يَهُودِيَّةً مِنْ أَهْلِ خَيْبَرَ سَمَّتْ شَاةً مَصْلِيَّةً، ثُمَّ أَهْدَتْهَا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَأَخَذَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنْهَا الذِّرَاعَ فَأَكَلَ مِنْهَا، وَأَكَلَ الرَّهْطُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ مَعَهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُمْ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" ارْفَعُوا أَيْدِيَكُمْ "، وَأَرْسَلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَى الْيَهُودِيَّةِ فَدَعَاهَا، فَقَالَ لَهَا : " أَسَمَمْتِ هَذِهِ الشَّاةَ؟ "، فَقَالَتْ : نَعَمْ، وَمَنْ أَخْبَرَكَ؟، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَخْبَرَتْنِي هَذِهِ فِي يَدِيَ : لِلذِّرَاعِ "، قَالَتْ : نَعَمْ، قَالَ : " فَمَاذَا أَرَدْتِ إِلَى ذَلِكَ؟ "، قَالَتْ : قُلْتُ : إِنْ كَانَ نَبِيًّا لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ نَبِيًّا، اسْتَرَحْنَا مِنْهُ، " فَعَفَا عَنْهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَلَمْ يُعَاقِبْهَا "، وَتُوُفِّيَ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِهِ الَّذِينَ أَكَلُوا مِنْ الشَّاةِ، " وَاحْتَجَمَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَى كَاهِلِهِ مِنْ أَجْلِ الَّذِي أَكَلَ مِنْ الشَّاةِ "، حَجَمَهُ أَبُو هِنْدٍ مَوْلَى بَنِي بَيَاضَةَ، بِالْقَرْنِ وَالشَّفْرَةِ، وَهُوَ مِنْ بَنِي ثُمَامَةَ، وَهُمْ حَيٌّ مِنْ الْأَنْصَارِ
24.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb ibn Abi Hamzah, from al-Zuhri: That Jabir ibn Abdullah رضي الله عنه used to narrate: that a Jewish woman from the people of Khaybar poisoned a roasted sheep, then gave it as a gift to the Prophet ﷺ, so the Prophet ﷺ took the foreleg from it and ate from it, and the group of his Companions ate with him, then the Prophet ﷺ said to them: Lift up your hands, and the Prophet ﷺ sent for the Jewish woman and called her, and said to her: Did you poison this sheep? So she said: Yes, and who told you? So the Prophet ﷺ said: This one in my hand told me: about the foreleg, she said: Yes, he said: Then what did you intend by that? She said: I said: If he is a prophet, it will not harm him, and if he is not a prophet, we will be relieved of him. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pardoned her and did not punish her, and some of his Companions who had eaten from the sheep passed away, and the Prophet ﷺ was cupped on his shoulder because of what he had eaten from the sheep, Abu Hind, freed slave of Banu Bayadah, cupped him with the horn and the blade, and he was from Banu Thumamah, and they were a tribe from the Ansar.
24.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb ibn Abi Hamzah se bataya: Humein al-Zuhri ne bataya: ke Jabir ibn Abdullah رضي الله عنه bayaan karte the: ke Khaybar ki ek Yahoodi aurat ne ek bhuni hui bhed mein zeher milaaya, fir usay Nabi ﷺ ko tohfe mein diya, to Nabi ﷺ ne usmein se agla paaya liya aur usmein se khaaya, aur aapke sahaba ke ek giroh ne aapke saath khaaya, fir Nabi ﷺ ne unse farmaya: Apne haath utha lo, aur Nabi ﷺ ne Yahoodi aurat ko bulaaya aur usse farmaya: Kya tumne is bhed mein zeher milaaya? To usne kaha: Haan, aur aapko kisne bataaya? To Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: Isne mujhe mere haath mein bataaya: agle paaye ke baare mein, usne kaha: Haan, aapne poocha: To tumne isse kya irada kiya? Usne kaha: Maine kaha: Agar woh Nabi hain to unhein nuqsaan nahi hoga, aur agar woh Nabi nahi hain, to hum unse aaraam paa jaayenge. To Rasulullah ﷺ ne usay maaf kar diya aur usay saza nahi di, aur aapke kuch sahaba jinhone bhed se khaaya tha intiqaal kar gaye, aur Nabi ﷺ ne apne kandhe par hijaama lagwaaya us cheez ki wajah se jo aapne bhed se khaayi thi, Abu Hind, Banu Bayadah ke azaad kiye hue ghulam, ne aapko seengh aur chhuri se hijaama diya, aur woh Banu Thumamah mein se the, aur woh Ansar ka ek qabeela the.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : لَمَّا فُتِحَتْ خَيْبَرَ، أُهْدِيَتْ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ شَاةٌ فِيهَا سُمٌّ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" اجْمَعُوا لِي مَنْ كَانَ هَا هُنَا مِنْ الْيَهُودِ "، فَجُمِعُوا لَهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " إِنِّي سَائِلُكُمْ عَنْ شَيْءٍ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ صَادِقِيَّ عَنْهُ؟ "، قَالُوا : نَعَمْ، يَا أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ ، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " مَنْ أَبُوكُمْ؟ "، قَالُوا : أَبُونَا فُلَانٌ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " كَذَبْتُمْ، بَلْ أَبُوكُمْ فُلَانٌ "، قَالُوا : صَدَقْتَ وَبَرَرْتَ، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ : " هَلْ أَنْتُمْ صَادِقِيَّ عَنْ شَيْءٍ إِنْ سَأَلْتُكُمْ عَنْهُ؟ "، فَقَالُوا : نَعَمْ، وَإِنْ كَذَبْنَاكَ، عَرَفْتَ كَذِبَنَا كَمَا عَرَفْتَهُ فِي آبَائِنَا، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " فَمَنْ أَهْلُ النَّارِ؟ "، فَقَالُوا : نَكُونُ فِيهَا يَسِيرًا ثُمَّ تَخْلِفُونَنا فِيهَا، قَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " اخْسَئُوا فِيهَا، وَاللَّهِ لَا نَخْلِفُكُمْ فِيهَا أَبَدًا "، ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُمْ : " هَلْ أَنْتُمْ صَادِقِيَّ عَنْ شَيْءٍ إِنْ سَأَلْتُكُمْ عَنْهُ؟ "، قَالُوا : نَعَمْ، قَالَ : " هَلْ جَعَلْتُمْ فِي هَذِهِ الشَّاةِ سُمًّا؟ "، قَالُوا : نَعَمْ، قَالَ : " مَا حَمَلَكُمْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ؟ "، قَالُوا : أَرَدْنَا إِنْ كُنْتَ كَاذِبًا أَنْ نَسْتَرِيحَ مِنْكَ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ نَبِيًّا لَمْ يَضُرَّكَ
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id al-Maqburi, from Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه: He said: When Khaybar was conquered, a sheep containing poison was given as a gift to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Gather for me whoever of the Jews is here, so they were gathered for him, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to them: I am going to ask you about something, will you be truthful with me about it? They said: Yes, O Abu al-Qasim. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to them: Who is your father? They said: Our father is so-and-so. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: You have lied, rather your father is so-and-so. They said: You have spoken the truth and been righteous. So he said to them: Will you be truthful with me about something if I ask you about it? So they said: Yes, and if we lie to you, you would recognize our lie as you recognized it in our fathers. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to them: Then who are the people of the Fire? So they said: We will be in it briefly, then you will succeed us in it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to them: Be disgraced in it, by Allah, we will never succeed you in it. Then he said to them: Will you be truthful with me about something if I ask you about it? They said: Yes. He said: Did you put poison in this sheep? They said: Yes. He said: What led you to that? They said: We wanted, if you were a liar, to be relieved of you, and if you were a prophet, it would not harm you.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhse Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id al-Maqburi ne bataya, Abu Hurairah se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Jab Khaybar fatah hua, Rasulullah ﷺ ko ek bhed tohfe mein di gayi jismein zeher tha, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: Mere liye yahan jo bhi Yahoodi hain unhein jama karo, to unhein aapke liye jama kiya gaya, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne unse farmaya: Main tumse ek cheez poochta hoon, kya tum mujhse ismein sachche hoge? Unhone kaha: Haan, Ae Abu al-Qasim. To Rasulullah ﷺ ne unse poocha: Tumhaara baap kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Humara baap fulaan hai. To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: Tumne jhoot kaha, balke tumhaara baap fulaan hai. Unhone kaha: Aapne sach kaha aur theek kaha. To aapne unse farmaya: Kya tum mujhse ek cheez mein sachche hoge agar main tumse poochun? To unhone kaha: Haan, aur agar hum aapse jhoot bolein, to aap humaara jhoot pehchaan lenge jaise aapne humare baapon mein pehchaana. To Rasulullah ﷺ ne unse poocha: To Jahannam wale kaun hain? To unhone kaha: Hum usme thodi der rahenge fir aap humaari jagah lenge usme. Rasulullah ﷺ ne unse farmaya: Usme zaleel raho, Allah ki qasam, hum tumhaari jagah kabhi nahi lenge usme. Fir aapne unse farmaya: Kya tum mujhse ek cheez mein sachche hoge agar main tumse poochun? Unhone kaha: Haan. Aapne poocha: Kya tumne is bhed mein zeher daala? Unhone kaha: Haan. Aapne poocha: Tumhein iske liye kis cheez ne uksaaya? Unhone kaha: Hum chaahte the, agar aap jhoote hain, to hum aapse aaraam paayein, aur agar aap Nabi hain, to isse aapko nuqsaan nahi hoga.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" مَا سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ شَيْئًا قَطُّ، فَقَالَ : لَا "، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : قَالَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ : إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ عِنْدَهُ وَعَدَ
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Ibn al-Munkadir, from Jabir رضي الله عنه; with Abu Muhammad's clarification: He said: The Prophet ﷺ was never asked for anything, and said: No. Abu Muhammad said: Ibn Uyaynah said: When it was not with him, he would promise it.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein Ibn al-Munkadir ne bataya, Jabir se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ se kabhi kisi cheez ke liye poocha nahi gaya ke aapne 'Nahi' kaha ho. Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Ibn Uyaynah ne kaha: Jab woh unke paas na hoti, to aap wada karte.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، عَنْ زَمْعَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ  ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، قَالَ :" كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَيِيًّا، لَا يُسْأَلُ شَيْئًا إِلَّا أَعْطَاهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Imran, from Abu Da'ud al-Tayalisi, from Zam'ah, from Abu Hazim, from Sahl ibn Sa'd: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was modest, he was never asked for anything except that he gave it.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Imran ne Abu Da'ud al-Tayalisi se bataya: Humein Zam'ah ne bataya, Abu Hazim se, Sahl ibn Sa'd se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ sharmeele the, aapse kabhi kisi cheez ke liye maanga nahi gaya magar aapne woh de di.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، قالَ : حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ  ،  عَنْ رَجُلٍ   مِنْ الْعَرَبِ، قَالَ : زَحَمْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ وَفِي رِجْلِي نَعْلٌ كَثِيفَةٌ، فَوَطِئْتُ بِهَا عَلَى رِجْلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَنَفَحَنِي نَفْحَةً بِسَوْطٍ فِي يَدِهِ، وَقَالَ : " بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوْجَعْتَنِي "، قَالَ : فَبِتُّ لِنَفْسِي لَائِمًا، أَقُولُ : أَوْجَعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : فَبِتُّ بِلَيْلَةٍ كَمَا يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ، فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحْنَا، إِذَا رَجُلٌ يَقُولُ : أَيْنَ فُلَانٌ؟، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : هَذَا وَاللَّهِ الَّذِي كَانَ مِنِّي بِالْأَمْسِ، قَالَ : فَانْطَلَقْتُ وَأَنَا مُتَخَوِّفٌ، فَقَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّكَ وَطِئْتَ بِنَعْلِكَ عَلَى رِجْلِي بِالْأَمْسِ فَأَوْجَعْتَنِي، فَنَفَحْتُكَ نَفْحَةً بِالسَّوْطِ، فَهَذِهِ ثَمَانُونَ نَعْجَةً، فَخُذْهَا بِهَا "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr, from a man from the Arabs: He said: I pressed against the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the day of Hunayn, and I had a thick sandal on my foot, so I trod with it on the foot of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he struck me a light blow with a whip in his hand, and said: In the name of Allah, you hurt me. He said: So I spent the night blaming myself, saying: I hurt the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said: So I spent that night as Allah knows, then when we reached morning, there was a man saying: Where is so-and-so? He said: I said: This is, by Allah, what happened to me yesterday. He said: So I went, fearful, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: You trod with your sandal on my foot yesterday and hurt me, so I struck you a light blow with the whip, so here are eighty ewes, take them for it.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf ne Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad se bataya: Humein Muhammad ibn Ishaq ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Abdullah ibn Abi Bakr ne bataya, ek Arab aadmi se: Unhone kaha, Main Hunayn ke din Rasulullah ﷺ se bheed mein dab gaya, aur mere paaon mein mota joota tha, to maine usse Rasulullah ﷺ ke paaon par pair rakh diya, to aapne apne haath ke kode se mujhe halka sa maara, aur farmaya: Bismillah, tumne mujhe takleef di. Unhone bataya: To main apne aap ko ilzaam dete hue raat guzaari, kehta hua: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko takleef di. Unhone bataya: To maine raat guzaari jaise Allah jaanta hai, fir jab humaari subah hui, ek aadmi keh raha tha: Fulaan kahan hai? Unhone bataya: Maine kaha: Yeh, Allah ki qasam, jo kal mere saath hua tha. Unhone bataya: To main khauf ke saath gaya, to Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhse farmaya: Tumne kal apne joote se mere paaon par pair rakha aur mujhe takleef di, to maine tumhein kode se halka sa maara, so yeh assi bakriyaan hain, isliye inhein le lo.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَخِي الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : إِنَّ جِبْرِيلَ ، قَالَ :" مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَهْلُ عَشَرَةِ أَبْيَاتٍ إِلَّا قَلَّبْتُهُمْ، فَمَا وَجَدْتُ أَحَدًا أَشَدَّ إِنْفَاقًا لِهَذَا الْمَالِ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "
24.en: Narrated by Ya'qub ibn Humayd, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from the nephew of al-Zuhri, from al-Zuhri: That Jibril said: There is no household of ten houses on the earth except that I have gone through them all, and I did not find anyone more intense in spending this wealth than the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
24.hi: Ya'qub ibn Humayd ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se bataya: Humein al-Zuhri ke bhatije ne bataya, al-Zuhri se: ke Jibreel ne kaha: Zameen par das gharon ka koi khaandaan aisa nahi jo maine na palte hon, aur mujhe koi bhi is maal ko Rasulullah ﷺ se zyada kharch karne wala nahi mila.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ وَاقِدٍ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عُقَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُكْثِرُ الذِّكْرَ، وَيُقِلُّ اللَّغْوَ، وَيُطِيلُ الصَّلَاةَ، وَيُقْصِرُ الْخُطْبَةَ، وَلَا يَأْنَفُ وَلَا يَسْتَنْكِفُ أَنْ يَمْشِيَ مَعَ الْأَرْمَلَةِ وَالْمِسْكِينِ فَيَقْضِيَ لَهُمَا حَاجَتَهُمَا "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Humayd, from al-Fadl ibn Musa, from al-Husayn ibn Waqid, from Yahya ibn Uqayl, from Abdullah ibn Abi Awfa رضي الله عنه: He said: The Prophet ﷺ used to engage much in remembrance, and speak little idle talk, and prolong the prayer, and shorten the sermon, and did not disdain nor consider it beneath him to walk with the widow and the poor, to fulfill their needs.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Humayd ne al-Fadl ibn Musa se bataya: Humein al-Husayn ibn Waqid ne bataya, Yahya ibn Uqayl se, Abdullah ibn Abi Awfa se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ zyada zikr karte, aur kam bekaar baat karte, aur namaz lamba karte, aur khutba chhota karte, aur na apni izzat kam samajhte na hichkichaate ke woh bewa aur miskeen ke saath chalein taake unki zaroorat poori karein.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ الْعَبَّاسُ   رِضْوَانُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ : لَأَعْلَمَنَّ مَا بَقَاءُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِينَا؟، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي أَرَاهُمْ قَدْ آذَوْكَ وَآذَاكَ غُبَارُهُمْ، فَلَوِ اتَّخَذْتَ عَرِيشًا تُكَلِّمُهُمْ مِنْهُ؟، فَقَالَ :" لَا أَزَالُ بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِهِمْ يَطَئُونَ عَقِبِي، وَيُنَازِعُونِي رِدَائِي حَتَّى يَكُونَ اللَّهُ هُوَ الَّذِي يُرِيحُنِي مِنْهُمْ "، قَالَ : فَعَلِمْتُ أَنَّ بَقَاءَهُ فِينَا قَلِيلٌ
24.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Ikrimah: He said: al-Abbas رضوان الله عليه said: I will indeed find out how long the Messenger of Allah ﷺ will remain among us? So he said: O Messenger of Allah, I see that they have caused you harm and their dust has caused you harm, so what if you took up a shelter to speak to them from? So he said: I will not cease being among them, they treading on my heel, and pulling at my cloak, until it is Allah who relieves me of them. He said: So I knew that his remaining among us was little.
24.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Ayyub ne bataya, Ikrimah se: Unhone kaha, Al-Abbas رضوان الله عليه ne kaha: Main zaroor jaanunga Rasulullah ﷺ humare beech kitne din rahenge? To unhone kaha: Ya Rasulullah, main dekhta hoon ke unhone aapko takleef di hai aur unki dhool ne aapko takleef di hai, to agar aap ek chappar banaayein jahan se aap unse baat karein? To aapne farmaya: Main unke beech se hatunga nahi, woh mere aediyon par chalein, aur mere chaadar ko khainchein, yahan tak ke Allah hi mujhe unse aaraam de. Unhone bataya: To mujhe pata chal gaya ke aapka humare beech rehna thoda hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ،  عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ  ، قَالَ : قِيلَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَلَا نَحْجُبُكَ؟، فَقَالَ :" لَا، دَعُوهُمْ يَطَئُونَ عَقِبِي وَأَطَأُ أَعْقَابَهُمْ حَتَّى يُرِيحَنِيَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Musa, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from al-Awza'i, from Da'ud ibn Ali: He said: It was said: O Messenger of Allah, shall we not screen you off? So he said: No, let them tread on my heel and I will tread on their heels until Allah relieves me of them.
24.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Musa ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se bataya: Humein al-Awza'i ne bataya, Da'ud ibn Ali se: Unhone kaha, Poocha gaya: Ya Rasulullah, kya hum aapko parda na kar dein? To aapne farmaya: Nahi, unhein mere aediyon par chalne do aur main unki aediyon par chalunga yahan tak ke Allah mujhe unse aaraam de.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، عَنْ أُنَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي مَرَضِهِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ، وَنَحْنُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ عَاصِبًا رَأْسَهُ بِخِرْقَةٍ حَتَّى أَهْوَى نَحْوَ الْمِنْبَرِ، فَاسْتَوَى عَلَيْهِ وَاتَّبَعْنَاهُ، قَالَ : " وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِإِنِّي لَأَنْظُرُ إِلَى الْحَوْضِ مِنْ مَقَامِي هَذَا "، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " إِنَّ عَبْدًا عُرِضَتْ عَلَيْهِ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتُهَا، فَاخْتَارَ الْآخِرَةَ "، قَالَ : فَلَمْ يَفْطِنْ لَهَا أَحَدٌ غَيْرُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ فَذَرَفَتْ عَيْنَاهُ، فَبَكَى، ثُمَّ قَالَ : بَلْ نَفْدِيكَ بِآبَائِنَا وَأُمَّهَاتِنَا وَأَنْفُسِنَا وَأَمْوَالِنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ : ثُمَّ هَبَطَ فَمَا قَامَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى السَّاعَةِ
24.en: Narrated by Zakariya ibn Adi, from Hatim ibn Isma'il, from Unays ibn Abi Yahya, from his father, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to us in his illness in which he died, while we were in the mosque, with his head bound with a cloth, until he leaned toward the pulpit, and stood on it and we followed him, he said: By the One in whose hand is my soul, I indeed see the [heavenly] pool from this position of mine, then he said: Indeed a servant was presented with the world and its adornment, and he chose the Hereafter. He said: So no one understood it except Abu Bakr, رضوان الله عليه, so his eyes flowed with tears, and he wept, then he said: Rather, we would ransom you with our fathers and our mothers and ourselves and our wealth, O Messenger of Allah. He said: Then he came down, and did not stand on it until this hour.
24.hi: Zakariya ibn Adi ne Hatim ibn Isma'il se bataya: Humein Unays ibn Abi Yahya ne bataya, apne walid se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ apni bimaari mein humare paas nikle jismein aapka wisaal hua, jabke hum masjid mein the, aapka sar ek kapde se bandha hua tha, yahan tak ke aap mimbar ki taraf jhuke, aur usper khade hue aur hum aapke peechhe chale, aapne farmaya: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, main is jagah se hauz (kausar) ko dekh raha hoon, fir farmaya: Ek banda ko duniya aur uska singaar pesh kiya gaya, to usne Aakhirat ko chuna. Unhone bataya: To isay Abu Bakr, رضوان الله عليه, ke siwa kisi ne nahi samjha, to unki aankhon se aansu bahne lage, aur woh ro pade, fir kaha: Balke, hum aapko apne maa-baap aur apne aap aur apne maal se fidiya karte hain, Ya Rasulullah. Unhone bataya: Fir aap utre, aur is ghadi tak dobara isper khade nahi hue.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا خَلِيفَةُ بْنُ خَيَّاطٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدٍ  مَوْلَى الْحَكَمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَاصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ،  عَنْ أَبِي مُوَيْهِبَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنِّي قَدْ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَسْتَغْفِرَ لِأَهْلِ الْبَقِيعِ، فَانْطَلِقْ مَعِي " فَانْطَلَقْتُ مَعَهُ فِي جَوْفِ اللَّيْلِ فَلَمَّا وَقَفَ عَلَيْهِمْ، قَالَ : " السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا أَهْلَ الْمَقَابِرِ، لِيُهْنِكُمْ مَا أَصْبَحْتُمْ فِيهِ مِمَّا أَصْبَحَ فِيهِ النَّاسُ، أَقْبَلَتْ الْفِتَنُ كَقِطْعِ اللَّيْلِ الْمُظْلِمِ يَتْبَعُ آخِرُهَا أَوَّلَهَا : الْآخِرَةُ أَشَرُّ مِنْ الْأُولَى "، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيَّ، فَقَالَ : " يَا أَبَا مُوَيْهِبَةَ إِنِّي قَدْ أُوتِيتُ بِمَفَاتِيحِ خَزَائِنِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْخُلْدَ فِيهَا، ثُمَّ الْجَنَّةُ، فَخُيِّرْتُ بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ وَبَيْنَ لِقَاءِ رَبِّي "، قُلْتُ : بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي، خُذْ مَفَاتِيحَ خَزَائِنِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْخُلْدَ فِيهَا، ثُمَّ الْجَنَّةَ، قَالَ : " لَا وَاللَّهِ يَا أَبَا مُوَيْهِبَةَ لَقَدْ اخْتَرْتُ لِقَاءَ رَبِّي "، ثُمَّ اسْتَغْفَرَ لِأَهْلِ الْبَقِيعِ، ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ، فَبُدِئَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِوَجَعِهِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ
24.en: Narrated by Khalifah ibn Khayyat, from Bakr ibn Sulayman, from Ibn Ishaq, from Abdullah ibn Umar ibn Ali ibn Adi, from Ubayd, freed slave of al-Hakam ibn Abi al-As, from Abdullah ibn Amr, from Abu Muwayhibah رضي الله عنه, freed slave of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: I have indeed been commanded to seek forgiveness for the people of al-Baqi', so come with me. So I went with him in the depths of the night, and when he stood over them, he said: Peace be upon you, O people of the graves, may what you have reached this morning be a blessing for you compared to what the people have reached this morning, trials have come like pieces of dark night, one following the other, the last worse than the first. Then he turned to me, and said: O Abu Muwayhibah, I have indeed been given the keys of the treasures of this world and eternity in it, then Paradise, and I was given a choice between that and meeting my Lord. I said: May my father and mother be sacrificed for you, take the keys of the treasures of this world and eternity in it, then Paradise. He said: No, by Allah, O Abu Muwayhibah, I have indeed chosen meeting my Lord. Then he sought forgiveness for the people of al-Baqi', then departed, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was struck by the illness of which he died.
24.hi: Khalifah ibn Khayyat ne Bakr ibn Sulayman se bataya: Humein Ibn Ishaq ne bataya: Mujhe Abdullah ibn Umar ibn Ali ibn Adi ne bataya, Ubayd se (al-Hakam ibn Abi al-As ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), Abdullah ibn Amr se, Abu Muwayhibah se رضي الله عنه, Rasulullah ﷺ ke azaad kiye hue ghulam: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhse farmaya: Mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke main al-Baqi' walon ke liye maghfirat maangun, so mere saath chalo. To main aapke saath raat ke gehre hisse mein gaya, aur jab aap unpar khade hue, farmaya: As-salaamu alaikum, ae qabron walo, tumhein mubaarak ho jo tum is subah paa chuke ho, us cheez ke muqaable mein jo log is subah paa chuke hain, fitne aa gaye hain andheri raat ke tukdon ki tarah, ek doosre ke peechhe aate hue, aakhri pehle se bura. Fir aap mujhse mude, aur farmaya: Ae Abu Muwayhibah, mujhe duniya ke khazaanon ki chaabiyaan aur usmein hamesha rehna diya gaya hai, fir Jannat, aur mujhe iske aur apne Rab se milne ke darmiyan ikhtiyaar diya gaya. Maine kaha: Mere maa-baap aap par qurbaan hon, duniya ke khazaanon ki chaabiyaan aur usmein hamesha rehna le lein, fir Jannat. Aapne farmaya: Nahi, Allah ki qasam, Ae Abu Muwayhibah, maine apne Rab se milna chuna hai. Fir aapne al-Baqi' walon ke liye maghfirat maangi, fir wapas laute, aur Rasulullah ﷺ us bimaari mein mubtala hue jismein aapka wisaal hua.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ الْعَوَّامِ  ، عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ خَبَّابٍ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ  ، قَالَ : لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ( إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ ) دَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَاطِمَةَ ، فَقَالَ :" قَدْ نُعِيَتْ إِلَيَّ نَفْسِي "، فَبَكَتْ، فَقَالَ : " لَا تَبْكِي، فَإِنَّكِ أَوَّلُ أَهْلِي لِحَاقًا بِي "، فَضَحِكَتْ، فَرَآهَا بَعْضُ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقُلْنَ : يَا فَاطِمَةُ ، رَأَيْنَاكِ بَكَيْتِ ثُمَّ ضَحِكْتِ؟، قَالَتْ : إِنَّهُ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَّهُ قَدْ نُعِيَتْ إِلَيْهِ نَفْسُهُ فَبَكَيْتُ، فَقَالَ لِي : " لَا تَبْكِي فَإِنَّكِ أَوَّلُ أَهْلِي لَاحِقٌ بِي "، فَضَحِكْتُ، وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ، وَجَاءَ أَهْلُ الْيَمَنِ : هُمْ أَرَقُّ أَفْئِدَةً، وَالْإِيمَانُ يَمَانٍ، وَالْحِكْمَةُ يَمَانِيَةٌ "
24.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Sulayman, from Abbad ibn al-Awwam, from Hilal ibn Khabbab, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas: He said: When "When the victory of Allah has come, and the conquest" was revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ called Fatimah, and said: My death has indeed been announced to me. So she wept. So he said: Do not weep, for you are the first of my family to join me. So she laughed. So some of the Prophet's ﷺ wives saw her, and said: O Fatimah, we saw you weep then laugh? She said: He informed me that his death had been announced to him, so I wept, then he said to me: Do not weep, for you are the first of my family to join me, so I laughed. And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: The victory of Allah and the conquest has come, and the people of Yemen have come: they are the most tender of hearts, and faith is Yemeni, and wisdom is Yemeni.
24.hi: Sa'id ibn Sulayman ne Abbad ibn al-Awwam se bataya: Humein Hilal ibn Khabbab ne bataya, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se: Unhone kaha, Jab "Jab Allah ki madad aur fatah aa jaaye" nazil hui, Rasulullah ﷺ ne Fatimah (Alayhas Salam) ko bulaaya, aur farmaya: Meri maut ka elaan mujhe kar diya gaya hai. To woh ro padi. To aapne farmaya: Mat ro, kyunki tum mere gharwalon mein sabse pehle mujhse milogi. To woh muskuraayi. To Nabi ﷺ ki kuch biwiyon ne unhein dekha, aur kaha: Ae Fatimah, humne aapko rote fir hanste dekha? Unhone kaha: Unhone mujhe bataaya ke unki maut ka elaan unhein kar diya gaya hai, to main royi, fir unhone mujhse farmaya: Mat ro, kyunki tum mere gharwalon mein sabse pehle mujhse milogi, to main hansi. Aur Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: Allah ki madad aur fatah aa gayi hai, aur Yemen wale aa gaye hain: woh sabse narm dil hain, aur imaan Yemeni hai, aur hikmat Yemeni hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : رَجَعَ إِلَيَّ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ مِنْ جَنَازَةٍ مِنْ الْبَقِيعِ ، فَوَجَدَنِي وَأَنَا أَجِدُ صُدَاعًا وَأَنَا أَقُولُ : وَا رَأْسَاهُ !، قَالَ :" بَلْ أَنَا يَا عَائِشَةُ وَا رَأْسَاهُ "، قَالَ : " وَمَا ضَرَّكِ لَوْ مِتِّ قَبْلِي فَغَسَّلْتُكِ وَكَفَّنْتُكِ وَصَلَّيْتُ عَلَيْكِ وَدَفَنْتُكِ؟ "، فَقُلْتُ : لَكَأَنّنِي بِكَ وَاللَّهِ لَوْ فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ لَرَجَعْتَ إِلَى بَيْتِي فَأَعْرَسْتَ فِيهِ بِبَعْضِ نِسَائِكَ، قَالَتْ : " فَتَبَسَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، ثُمَّ بُدِئَ فِي وَجَعِهِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Muhammad ibn Salamah, from Ibn Ishaq, from Ya'qub ibn Utbah, from Ibn Shihab, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah, from Aisha: She said: The Prophet ﷺ returned to me one day from a funeral at al-Baqi', and he found me while I was having a headache and I was saying: Oh my head! He said: Rather, it is I, O Aisha, oh my head! He said: And what harm would it do you if you died before me and I washed you and shrouded you and prayed over you and buried you? So I said: It is as if I can see you, by Allah, had you done that, you would have returned to my house and consummated a marriage there with one of your wives. She said: So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ smiled, then the illness began in which he died.
24.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Muhammad ibn Salamah se bataya: Humein Ibn Ishaq ne bataya, Ya'qub ibn Utbah se, Ibn Shihab se, Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah se, Aisha se: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ ek din al-Baqi' se ek janaza se mere paas wapas aaye, to aapne mujhe paaya jabke mujhe sar dard tha aur main keh rahi thi: Haaye mera sar! Aapne farmaya: Balke, main, Ae Aisha, haaye mera sar! Aapne farmaya: Aur tumhein kya nuqsaan hota agar tum mujhse pehle mar jaati aur main tumhein ghusal deta aur kafnaataa aur tumhaari namaz padhta aur tumhein dafnaata? To maine kaha: Goya main tumhein dekh rahi hoon, Allah ki qasam, agar aap aisa karte, to aap mere ghar wapas jaate aur apni kisi doosri biwi ke saath waha shaadi ki raat manaate. Unhone kaha: To Rasulullah ﷺ muskuraaye, fir woh bimaari shuru hui jismein aapka wisaal hua.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا فَرْوَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَغْرَاءِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُخْتَارٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي مَرَضِهِ :" صُبُّوا عَلَيَّ سَبْعَ قِرَبٍ مِنْ سَبْعِ آبَارٍ شَتَّى حَتَّى أَخْرُجَ إِلَى النَّاسِ فَأَعْهَدَ إِلَيْهِمْ "، قَالَ : فَأَقْعَدْنَاهُ فِي مِخْضَبٍ لِحَفْصَةَ فَصَبَبْنَا عَلَيْهِ الْمَاءَ صَبًّا أَوْ شَنَنَّا عَلَيْهِ شَنًّا، الشَّكُّ مِنْ قِبَلِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق، فَوَجَدَ رَاحَةً، فَخَرَجَ فَصَعِدَ الْمِنْبَرَ، فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ وَاسْتَغْفَرَ لِلشُّهَدَاءِ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ أُحُدٍ، وَدَعَا لَهُمْ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " أَمَّا بَعْدُ، فَإِنَّ الْأَنْصَارَ عَيْبَتِي الَّتِي أَوَيْتُ إِلَيْهَا، فَأَكْرِمُوا كَرِيمَهُمْ، وَتَجَاوَزُوا عَنْ مُسِيئِهِمْ إِلَّا فِي حَدٍّ، أَلَا إِنَّ عَبْدًا مِنْ عِبَادِ اللَّهِ قَدْ خُيِّرَ بَيْنَ الدُّنْيَا وَبَيْنَ مَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ، فَاخْتَارَ مَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ "، فَبَكَى أَبُو بَكْرٍ، وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ يَعْنِي نَفْسَهُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " عَلَى رِسْلِكَ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ، سُدُّوا هَذِهِ الْأَبْوَابَ الشَّوَارِعَ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ إِلَّا بَابَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، فَإِنِّي لَا أَعْلَمُ امْرَءًا أَفْضَلَ عِنْدِي يَدًا فِي الصُّحْبَةِ مِنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ "
24.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Mansur, from Fulayh ibn Sulayman, from Abd al-Rahman, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Aisha: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was informed of the prayer during his illness, so he said: Command Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer. Then he fainted, so when he recovered, he said: Did you command Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer? So I said: Abu Bakr is a tender man, so if you commanded Umar? So he said: You are the female companions of Yusuf, command Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer, for how many a speaker wishes for something, but Allah and the believers refuse.
24.hi: Sa'id ibn Mansur ne Fulayh ibn Sulayman se bataya: Humein Abd al-Rahman ne bataya, al-Qasim ibn Muhammad se, Aisha se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ko apni bimaari mein namaz ki khabar di gayi, to aapne farmaya: Abu Bakr ko hukum do ke woh logon ko namaz padhaayein. Fir aap behosh ho gaye, to jab aap hosh mein aaye, farmaya: Kya tumne Abu Bakr ko hukum diya ke woh logon ko namaz padhaayein?
