To maine kaha: Abu Bakr narm-dil aadmi hain, agar aap Umar ko hukum dete? To aapne farmaya: Tum Yusuf ki saathaniyon jaisi ho, Abu Bakr ko hukum do ke woh logon ko namaz padhaayein, kyunki kitne hi kehne wale kuch chaahte hain, lekin Allah aur momin inkaar karte hain.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : أُوذِنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالصَّلَاةِ فِي مَرَضِهِ، فَقَالَ :" مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ "، ثُمَّ أُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ، فَلَمَّا سُرِّيَ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : " هَلْ أَمَرْتُنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ؟ "، فَقُلْتُ : إِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ رَجُلٌ رَقِيقٌ، فَلَوْ أَمَرْتَ عُمَرَ، فَقَالَ : " أَنْتُنَّ صَوَاحِبُ يُوسُفَ مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ، فَرُبَّ قَائِلٍ مُتَمَنٍّ وَيَأْبَى اللَّهُ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ "
24.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Ikrimah: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away on Monday, so he was kept the rest of his day and his night and the next day until he was buried on the night of Wednesday, and they said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has not died, but his soul was taken up as Musa's soul was taken up. So Umar stood, and said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has not died, but his soul was taken up as Musa's soul was taken up, by Allah, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ will not die until he cuts off the hands and tongues of some people. So Umar kept speaking until foam came to the corners of his mouth from what he was threatening and saying, so al-Abbas stood, and said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has indeed died, and he is indeed a human being, and he decays as humans decay, O people, so bury your companion, for he is too honored by Allah to be given two deaths, would He give one of you one death and give him two deaths while he is more honored to Allah than that? O people, bury your companion, for if it is as you say, it is not difficult for Allah to have the dust dug up from him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, by Allah, did not die until he left the path clear and evident, he made lawful the lawful, and forbade the unlawful, and he married and divorced, and he waged war and made peace, no shepherd of sheep, whom their owner follows to the tops of mountains, striking down thorny trees for them with his stick and plastering their trough with his hand, was more diligent nor more industrious than the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was among you, O people, so bury your companion. He said: And Umm Ayman began weeping, so it was said to her: O Umm Ayman, are you weeping for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? So she said: By Allah, I am not weeping for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from not knowing that he has gone to what is better for him than the world, but I weep that the news from the sky has been cut off. Hammad said: Weeping choked Ayyub when he reached this point.
24.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Ayyub ne bataya, Ikrimah se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ Somwaar ke din faut hue, to unhein us din ke baaqi hisse aur raat aur agle din tak rakha gaya yahan tak ke unhein Budhwaar ki raat dafnaaya gaya, aur logon ne kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ nahi mare, balke unki rooh utha li gayi jaise Musa ki rooh utha li gayi thi. To Umar khade hue, aur kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ nahi mare, balke unki rooh utha li gayi jaise Musa ki rooh utha li gayi thi, Allah ki qasam, Rasulullah ﷺ tab tak nahi marenge jab tak kuch logon ke haath aur zubaanein na kaat dein. To Umar baat karte rahe yahan tak ke unke munh ke kinaron mein jhaag aa gayi jo woh dhamki de rahe the aur keh rahe the, to al-Abbas khade hue, aur kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ waaqai faut ho chuke hain, aur woh ek insaan the aur woh ghis-pit jaate hain jaise insaan ghis-pit jaate hain, Ae qaum, apne saathi ko dafnaao, kyunki woh Allah ke nazdeek isse zyada izzat wale hain ke unhein do martaba maut di jaaye, kya woh tum mein se kisi ko ek martaba maut de aur usay do martaba maut de jabke woh Allah ke nazdeek isse zyada izzat wale hain? Ae qaum, apne saathi ko dafnaao, so agar jaisa tum kehte ho waisa hai, to Allah ke liye mushkil nahi ke woh mitti khodwaa de. Rasulullah ﷺ, Allah ki qasam, tab tak nahi mare jab tak unhone raasta saaf aur wazeh nahi chhoda, unhone halal ko halal kiya, aur haraam ko haraam kiya, aur unhone nikaah kiya aur talaq di, aur jung ki aur sulah ki, koi bakri chaate wala jise uska maalik pahaadon ki chotiyon tak le jaata ho, uske liye apni chaddi se kaante-daar peda todta ho aur apne haath se uska hauz mitti se banata ho, itna mehnati aur itna zyada koshish karne wala nahi hota jitna Rasulullah ﷺ tum mein the, Ae qaum, apne saathi ko dafnaao. Unhone bataya: Aur Umm Ayman rone lagin, to unse poocha gaya: Ae Umm Ayman, kya aap Rasulullah ﷺ par ro rahi hain? To unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, main Rasulullah ﷺ par isliye nahi ro rahi ke mujhe nahi pata ke woh aisi cheez ki taraf gaye hain jo unke liye duniya se behtar hai, lekin main is baat par ro rahi hoon ke aasmaan ki khabar ruk gayi. Hammad kehte hain: Yahan tak pahunchte hi Ayyub ko rulaayi ne gam kar diya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، قَالَ :" تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ، فَحُبِسَ بَقِيَّةَ يَوْمِهِ وَلَيْلَتَهُ وَالْغَدَ حَتَّى دُفِنَ لَيْلَةَ الْأَرْبِعَاءِ، وَقَالُوا : إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَمْ يَمُتْ، وَلَكِنْ عُرِجَ بِرُوحِهِ كَمَا عُرِجَ بِرُوحِ مُوسَى ، فَقَامَ عُمَرُ، فَقَالَ : إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَمْ يَمُتْ، وَلَكِنْ عُرِجَ بِرُوحِهِ كَمَا عُرِجَ بِرُوحِ مُوسَى ، وَاللَّهِ لَا يَمُوتُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَتَّى يَقْطَعَ أَيْدِيَ أَقْوَامٍ وَأَلْسِنَتَهُمْ، فَلَمْ يَزَلْ عُمَرُ يَتَكَلَّمُ حَتَّى أَزْبَدَ شِدْقَاهُ مِمَّا يُوعِدُ وَيَقُولُ، فَقَامَ الْعَبَّاسُ، فَقَالَ : إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَدْ مَاتَ، وَإِنَّهُ لَبَشَرٌ وَإِنَّهُ يَأْسَنُ كَمَا يَأْسَنُ الْبَشَرُ، أَيْ قَوْمِ فَادْفِنُوا صَاحِبَكُمْ، فَإِنَّهُ أَكْرَمُ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ أَنْ يُمِيتَهُ إِمَاتَتَيْنِ، أَيُمِيتُ أَحَدَكُمْ إِمَاتَةً وَيُمِيتُهُ إِمَاتَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ أَكْرَمُ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ؟، أَيْ قَوْمِ، فَادْفِنُوا صَاحِبَكُمْ، فَإِنْ يَكُ كَمَا تَقُولُونَ فَلَيْسَ بِعَزِيزٍ عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يَبْحَثَ عَنْهُ التُّرَابَ، إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَاللَّهِ مَا مَاتَ حَتَّى تَرَكَ السَّبِيلَ نَهْجًا وَاضِحًا، فَأَحَلَّ الْحَلَالَ، وَحَرَّمَ الْحَرَامَ، وَنَكَحَ وَطَلَّقَ، وَحَارَبَ وَسَالَمَ، مَا كَانَ رَاعِي غَنَمٍ يَتَّبِعُ بِهَا صَاحِبُهَا رُءُوسَ الْجِبَالِ يَخْبِطُ عَلَيْهَا الْعِضَاهَ بِمِخْبَطِهِ وَيَمْدُرُ حَوْضَهَا بِيَدِهِ بِأَنْصَبَ وَلَا أَدْأَبَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، كَانَ فِيكُمْ، أَيْ قَوْمِ فَادْفِنُوا صَاحِبَكُمْ، قَالَ : وَجَعَلَتْ أُمُّ أَيْمَنَ تَبْكِي، فَقِيلَ لَهَا : يَا أُمَّ أَيْمَنَ تَبْكِينَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟، قَالَتْ : إِنِّي وَاللَّهِ مَا أَبْكِي عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْ لا أَكُونَ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ قَدْ ذَهَبَ إِلَى مَا هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ الدُّنْيَا، وَلَكِنِّي أَبْكِي عَلَى خَبَرِ السَّمَاءِ انْقَطَعَ، قَالَ حَمَّادٌ : خَنَقَتِ الْعَبْرَةُ أَيُّوبَ حِينَ بَلَغَ هَا هُنَا "
24.en: Narrated by Abd al-Wahhab ibn Sa'id al-Dimashqi, from Shu'ayb ibn Ishaq, from al-Awza'i, from Ya'ish ibn al-Walid, from Makhul: That the Prophet ﷺ said: When a calamity befalls one of you, let him remember the calamity of my [death], for indeed it is among the greatest of calamities.
24.hi: Abd al-Wahhab ibn Sa'id al-Dimashqi ne Shu'ayb ibn Ishaq se bataya: Humein al-Awza'i ne bataya: Mujhe Ya'ish ibn al-Walid ne bataya: Mujhe Makhul ne bataya: ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, Jab tum mein se kisi par koi museebat aaye, to woh mujhpar aayi museebat ko yaad kare, kyunki yeh sabse badi museebaton mein se hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يَعِيشُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ  ، حَدَّثَنِي مَكْحُولٌ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" إِذَا أَصَابَ أَحَدَكُمْ مُصِيبَةٌ فَلْيَذْكُرْ مُصِيبَتَهُ بِي فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ أَعْظَمِ الْمَصَائِبِ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Fitr, from Ata: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: When a calamity befalls one of you, let him remember his affliction of me, for indeed it is among the greatest of calamities.
24.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Fitr se bataya: Humein Ata ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Jab tum mein se kisi par koi museebat aaye, to woh mujhpar aayi museebat ko yaad kare, kyunki yeh sabse badi museebaton mein se hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا فِطْرٌ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا أَصَابَ أَحَدَكُمْ مُصِيبَةٌ، فَلْيَذْكُرْ مُصَابَهُ بِي، فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ أَعْظَمِ الْمَصَائِبِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf, from Sufyan, from Umar ibn Muhammad, from his father: He said: I never heard Ibn Umar mention the Prophet ﷺ at all except that he wept.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein Umar ibn Muhammad ne bataya, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, Maine kabhi Ibn Umar ko Nabi ﷺ ka zikr karte nahi suna magar woh rote.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ :" مَا سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ يَذْكُرُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَطُّ إِلَّا بَكَى "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Thabit, from Anas ibn Malik: That Fatimah said: O Anas, how did your souls agree to throw dust upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? And she said: O my father, how near you are to your Lord! O my father, the Garden of Firdaws is your abode! O my father, to Jibril we announce his death! O my father, he answered a Lord who called him! Hammad said: When Thabit narrated it, he wept, and Thabit said: When Anas narrated it, he wept.
24.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Thabit ne bataya, Anas ibn Malik se: ke Fatimah (Alayhas Salam) ne kaha: Ae Anas, tumhaari jaanein kaise razi ho gayi ke tum Rasulullah ﷺ par mitti daalo? Aur unhone kaha: Ae mere abba, aap apne Rab se kitne qareeb hain! Ae mere abba, Firdaws ki Jannat aapka thikaana hai! Ae mere abba, hum unki maut ki khabar Jibreel ko dete hain! Ae mere abba, unhone us Rab ko jawaab diya jisne unhein bulaaya! Hammad kehte hain: Jab Thabit ne yeh riwaayat sunaayi, woh ro pade, aur Thabit kehte hain: Jab Anas ne yeh riwaayat sunaayi, woh ro pade.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ  ، أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ  ، قَالَتْ : يَا أَنَسُ" كَيْفَ طَابَتْ أَنْفُسُكُمْ أَنْ تَحْثُوا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ التُّرَابَ؟، وَقَالَتْ : يَا أَبَتَاهْ، مِنْ رَبِّهِ مَا أَدْنَاهْ، وَا أَبَتَاهْ جَنَّةُ الْفِرْدَوْسِ مَأْوَاهْ، وَا أَبَتَاهْ إِلَى جِبْرِيلَ نَنْعَاهْ، وَا أَبَتَاهْ أَجَابَ رَبًّا دَعَاهْ، قَالَ حَمَّادٌ : حِينَ حَدَّثَ ثَابِتٌ بَكَى، وقَالَ ثَابِتٌ : حِينَ حَدَّثَ أَنَسٌ بَكَى "
24.en: Narrated by Affan, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Thabit, from Anas, and he mentioned the Prophet ﷺ: He said: I witnessed him on the day he entered Madinah, and I never saw a day that was more beautiful and more radiant than the day the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered upon us in it, and I witnessed him on the day of his death, and I never saw a day that was uglier or darker than the day the Messenger of Allah ﷺ died in it.
24.hi: Affan ne Hammad ibn Salamah se bataya: Humein Thabit ne bataya, Anas se, aur unhone Nabi ﷺ ka zikr kiya: Unhone kaha, Main us din maujood tha jab aap Madinah mein dakhil hue aur maine kabhi koi din us din se zyada khoobsurat aur roshan nahi dekha jab Rasulullah ﷺ humare paas dakhil hue, aur main unki maut ke din maujood tha, to maine kabhi koi din us din se zyada badsurat ya andhera nahi dekha jismein Rasulullah ﷺ ka wisaal hua.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ  ، وَذَكَرَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" شَهِدْتُهُ يَوْمَ دَخَلَ الْمَدِينَةَ فَمَا رَأَيْتُ يَوْمًا قَطُّ، كَانَ أَحْسَنَ وَلَا أَضْوَأَ مِنْ يَوْمٍ دَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَشَهِدْتُهُ يَوْمَ مَوْتِهِ، فَمَا رَأَيْتُ يَوْمًا كَانَ أَقْبَحَ، وَلَا أَظْلَمَ مِنْ يَوْمٍ مَاتَ فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Muti', from Hushaym, from Abu Abd al-Jalil, from Abu Hariz al-Azdi: He said: Abdullah ibn Salam said to the Prophet ﷺ: O Messenger of Allah, we find you standing before your Lord on the Day of Resurrection, your cheeks red, ashamed before your Lord because of what your nation innovated after you.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Muti' ne Hushaym se bataya: Humein Abu Abd al-Jalil ne bataya, Abu Hariz al-Azdi se: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ibn Salam ne Nabi ﷺ se kaha: Ya Rasulullah, hum aapko Qayamat ke din apne Rab ke saamne khada paate hain, aapke gaal laal hain, apne Rab ke saamne sharminda hain us cheez ki wajah se jo aapki ummat ne aapke baad naye tareeke nikaale.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُطِيعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الْجَلِيلِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حَرِيزٍ الْأَزْدِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلَامٍ   لِلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّا نَجِدُكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ قَائِمًا عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ وَأَنْتَ مُحْمَارَّةٌ وَجْنَتَاكَ مُسْتَحْيٍ مِنْ رَبِّكَ مِمَّا أَحْدَثَتْ أُمَّتُكَ مِنْ بَعْدِكَ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Qasim ibn Kathir, who heard Abd al-Rahman ibn Shurayh narrating, from Abu al-Aswad al-Qurashi, from Abu Qurrah, freed slave of Abu Jahl, from Abu Hurairah, from the Prophet ﷺ: That when this surah was revealed to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: "When the victory of Allah has come, and the conquest, and you see the people entering the religion of Allah in multitudes" [Surah al-Nasr, verses 1-2], the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: They will surely leave it in multitudes just as they entered it in multitudes.
24.hi: Al-Qasim ibn Kathir ne bataya: Unhone Abd al-Rahman ibn Shurayh ko riwaayat karte suna, Abu al-Aswad al-Qurashi se, Abu Qurrah se (Abu Jahl ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), Abu Hurairah se, Nabi ﷺ se: ke jab yeh surah Rasulullah ﷺ par nazil hui: "Jab Allah ki madad aur fatah aa jaaye, aur tum logon ko fauj dar fauj Allah ke deen mein dakhil hote dekho" [Surah An-Nasr, aayat 1-2], Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: Woh zaroor isse fauj dar fauj nikalenge jaise woh usmein fauj dar fauj dakhil hue.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ شُرَيْحٍ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَسْوَدِ الْقُرَشِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قُرَّةَ  مَوْلَى أَبِي جَهْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : أَنَّ هَذِهِ السُّورَةَ لَمَّا أُنْزِلَتْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ # إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ { 1 } وَرَأَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا { 2 } سورة النصر آية 1 #، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَيَخْرُجُنَّ مِنْهُ أَفْوَاجًا كَمَا دَخَلُوهُ أَفْوَاجًا "
24.en: Narrated by Abu Bakr al-Misri, from Sulayman Abu Ayyub al-Khuza'i, from Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Umawi, from Ma'ruf ibn Kharrabudh al-Makki, from Khalid ibn Ma'dan: He said: Abdullah ibn al-Ahtam entered upon Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz with the general public, and Umar was not surprised except to find him before him speaking, so he praised Allah and lauded Him, then said: As for what follows, Allah created creation independent of their obedience, secure against their disobedience, and people at that time were of different classes and opinions, and the Arabs were in the worst of those classes: the people of the stony land, and the people of camel-hair tents, and the people of mange, the good things of this world and the ease of its life bypassed them, they did not ask Allah collectively, nor recite a book for Him, their dead in the Fire, and their living blind, impure, along with countless things disliked and considered worthless. So when Allah wanted to spread His mercy upon them, He sent to them a messenger from among themselves, [for whom] "grievous to him is what you suffer, [he is] concerned over you, to the believers is kind and merciful" [paraphrase of Surah al-Tawbah, verse 128], blessings of Allah be upon him, and peace and the mercy of Allah and His blessings, but that did not stop them from wounding him in his body and giving him nicknames in his name, and with him was a speaking book from Allah, he would not rise except by His command, nor depart except by His permission, so when he was commanded with resolve, and burdened with jihad, his determination expanded for Allah's command, so Allah made clear his proof, and made his word prevail, and made his call manifest, and he parted from this world pious and pure. Then Abu Bakr stood after him and followed his sunnah, and took his path, and the Arabs apostatized, or those of them who did that, so he refused to accept from them, after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, anything except what had been acceptable [before], he drew the swords from their sheaths, and lit fires in their torches, then he inclined the people of falsehood toward the people of truth, and did not cease cutting off their limbs, and watering the earth with their blood, until he brought them back into that from which they had emerged, and settled them upon what they had fled from, and he had taken from the wealth of Allah a young camel to ride, and an Abyssinian woman who nursed a child of his, so he saw that at his death as a lump in his throat, so he handed that over to the caliph after him, and he parted from this world pious and pure, upon the path of his companion. Then Umar ibn al-Khattab stood after him, and he built up the cities, and mixed harshness with gentleness, and bared his forearms, and rolled up his shins, and provided for matters their counterparts, and for war its equipment, so when the young man of al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah struck him, he ordered Ibn Abbas to ask the people: Do they confirm his killer? So when it was said: the young man of al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah, he began praising his Lord that it was not someone with a claim in the war-spoils, who would argue against him that he had only made his blood lawful by what he had made lawful of his right, and he had taken from the wealth of Allah eighty-some thousand, so he broke up his properties for it, and disliked burdening his children with it, so he handed it over to the caliph after him, and he parted from this world pious and pure, upon the path of his two companions. Then indeed you, O Umar, son of the world, its kings raised you, and fed you from its breasts, and you grew up in it seeking its favorable positions, but when you were given authority over it, you cast it aside where Allah had cast it, you abandoned it and shunned it, and considered it filthy except for what you took as provision from it, so praise be to Allah who through you cleared our sin and through you removed our distress, so proceed, and do not look back, for nothing is dear against the truth, and nothing is base against falsehood, I say this saying of mine, and I seek Allah's forgiveness for myself and for the believing men and women. Abu Ayyub said: So Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz used to say about something: Ibn al-Ahtam said to me: Proceed, and do not look back.
24.hi: Abu Bakr al-Misri ne Sulayman Abu Ayyub al-Khuza'i se bataya: Humein Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Umawi ne bataya, Ma'ruf ibn Kharrabudh al-Makki se, Khalid ibn Ma'dan se: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ibn al-Ahtam Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz ke paas aam logon ke saath dakhil hue to Umar ko unhein apne saamne baat karte hue paakar hairaan hona pada, to unhone Allah ki hamd ki aur uski tareef ki, fir kaha: Amma ba'd, Allah ne makhlooq ko unki itaa'at se bay-niyaaz aur unki nafarmani se mehfooz banaaya, aur us waqt log darjaat aur raay mein mukhtalif the, aur Arab un darjon mein sabse bure the: patharili zameen wale, oont ke baalon ke khaymon wale, aur khaarish wale, duniya ki achhi cheezein aur uski zindagi ki aasaani unse door thi, woh Allah se milkar dua nahi maangte the, na uske liye koi kitaab padhte the, unke murda Jahannam mein, aur unke zinda andhe, napaak, be-shumaar na-pasandeeda aur bekaar samjhi jaane wali cheezon ke saath. To jab Allah ne unpar apni rehmat phailaana chaaha, usne unki taraf ek Rasool bheja unhi mein se, jinke liye "tumhaari takleef unpar giraan hai, tumhaari fikar unhein hai, momino par narm-dil, meherbaan hain" [Surah At-Tawbah, aayat 128 ka mafhoom], unpar Allah ki dua, aur salaam aur Allah ki rehmat aur uski barkatein, lekin isse woh nahi ruke ke unhone unhein unke jism mein zakhmi kiya aur unke naam mein laqab diye, aur unke saath Allah ki taraf se ek bolta hua kitaab thi, woh uske hukum ke bagair na uthte the, na uski ijaazat ke bagair chalte the, so jab unhein azm ka hukum diya gaya, aur jihad ka bojh diya gaya, to unka irada Allah ke hukum ke liye phaila, to Allah ne unki hujjat wazeh ki, aur unki baat ko jaari kiya, aur unki dawat ko zaahir kiya, aur woh duniya se muttaqi, paak hokar juda hue. Fir unke baad Abu Bakr khade hue aur unki sunnat par chale, aur unka raasta liya, aur Arab murtad ho gaye, ya unmein se jinhone aisa kiya, to unhone Rasulullah ﷺ ke baad unse woh cheez ke siwa kuch qabool karne se inkaar kiya jo pehle qabool ki jaati thi, unhone talwaarein apne miyaanon se nikaal lin, aur aag apni mash'alon mein jalayi, fir unhone haq walon ko baatil walon ke khilaaf kar diya, to woh unke azaon ko kaatte rahe, aur zameen ko unke khoon se seenchte rahe, yahan tak ke unhein wapas usmein le aaye jahan se woh nikle the, aur unhein us par jamaaya jisse woh bhaage the, aur unhone Allah ke maal se ek jawaan oont liya sawaari ke liye, aur ek Habashi aurat li jisne unke bachche ko doodh pilaaya, to unhone apni maut ke waqt isay apne gale mein phaans samjha, to unhone yeh apne baad khalifa ko de diya, aur woh duniya se muttaqi, paak hokar juda hue. Fir unke baad Umar ibn al-Khattab khade hue, to unhone shehron ko aabaad kiya, aur sakhti ko narmi se mila diya, aur apni baazuein khol dein, aur apni pindliyon ko upar chadhaaya, aur maamlaat ke liye unke barabar wale, aur jung ke liye uske saaz-o-samaan ka intezaam kiya, so jab unhein al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah ke jawaan ne zakhmi kiya, unhone Ibn Abbas ko hukum diya ke woh logon se poochein: Kya woh uske qaatil ki tasdeeq karte hain: To jab kaha gaya: al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah ka jawaan, unhone apne Rab ki hamd karna shuru ki ke unhein koi maal-e-ghaneemat mein haq waala shakhs nahi mila jo unke khilaaf yeh dalil de ke usne unka khoon isliye halal kiya kyunki unhone uska haq halal kiya tha, aur unhone Allah ke maal se assi-taak hazaar liye the, to unhone apni jaayedaadein iske liye tod din aur apni aulaad par iska bojh daalna na-pasand kiya, to unhone yeh apne baad khalifa ko de diya, aur woh duniya se muttaqi, paak hokar apne dono saathiyon ke raaste par juda hue. Fir tum, Ae Umar, duniya ke bete, uske baadshaahon ne tumhein paala, aur tumhein apne seene pilaaye, aur tum usmein badhe uski behtareen jagahein talaash karte hue, to jab tumhein isper wilaayat di gayi, tumne isay wahin daala jahan Allah ne isay daala, tumne isay chhoda aur isse mooh moda, aur isay napaak samjha siwaay us cheez ke jo tumne isse zaad-e-raah liya, so tareef hai us Allah ki jisne tumhaare zariye humaara gunah saaf kiya aur tumhaare zariye humaari museebat hataayi, so aage badho aur peechhe mat dekho, kyunki haq ke muqaable mein koi cheez izzat wali nahi hoti, aur baatil ke muqaable mein koi cheez zaleel nahi hoti, main apni yeh baat kehta hoon, aur Allah se apni aur momin mardon aur auraton ki maghfirat maangta hoon. Abu Ayyub kehte hain: To Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz kisi cheez ke baare mein kehte the: Ibn al-Ahtam ne mujhse kaha: Aage badho aur peechhe mat dekho.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ الْمِصْرِيُّ L108 ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الْخُزَاعِيِّ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الْأُمَوِيِّ  ، عَنْ مَعْرُوفِ بْنِ خَرَّبُوذَ الْمَكِّيِّ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ  ، قَالَ :" دَخَلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْأَهْتَمِ L4678  عَلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ مَعَ الْعَامَّةِ فَلَمْ يُفْجَأْ عُمَرُ إِلَّا وَهُوَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَتَكَلَّمُ، فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : أَمَّا بَعْدُ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ الْخَلْقَ غَنِيًّا عَنْ طَاعَتِهِمْ، آمِنًا لِمَعْصِيَتِهِمْ، وَالنَّاسُ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِي الْمَنَازِلِ وَالرَّأْيِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ، فَالْعَرَبُ بِشَرِّ تِلْكَ الْمَنَازِلِ : أَهْلُ الْحَجَرِ، وَأَهْلُ الْوَبَرِ، وَأَهْلُ الدَّبَرِ، تُجْتَازُ دُونَهُمْ طَيِّبَاتُ الدُّنْيَا وَرَخَاءُ عَيْشِهَا، لَا يَسْأَلُونَ اللَّهَ جَمَاعَةً، وَلَا يَتْلُونَ لَهُ كِتَابًا، مَيِّتُهُمْ فِي النَّارِ، وَحَيُّهُمْ أَعْمَى نَجِسٌ مَعَ مَا لَا يُحْصَى مِنْ الْمَرْغُوبِ عَنْهُ، وَالْمَزْهُودِ فِيهِ، فَلَمَّا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَنْشُرَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَحْمَتَهُ، بَعَثَ إِلَيْهِمْ رَسُولًا مِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ حَرِيصٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ، وَعَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، فَلَمْ يَمْنَعْهُمْ ذَلِكَ أَنْ جَرَحُوهُ فِي جِسْمِهِ وَلَقَّبُوهُ فِي اسْمِهِ، وَمَعَهُ كِتَابٌ مِنْ اللَّهِ نَاطِقٌ، لَا يُقُومُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِهِ، وَلَا يُرْحَلُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ، فَلَمَّا أُمِرَ بِالْعَزْمَةِ، وَحُمِلَ عَلَى الْجِهَادِ، انْبَسَطَ لِأَمْرِ اللَّهِ لَوْثُهُ، فَأَفْلَجَ اللَّهُ حُجَّتَهُ، وَأَجَازَ كَلِمَتَهُ، وَأَظْهَرَ دَعْوَتَهُ، وَفَارَقَ الدُّنْيَا تَقِيًّا نَقِيًّا، ثُمَّ قَامَ بَعْدَهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَسَلَكَ سُنَّتَهُ، وَأَخَذَ سَبِيلَهُ، وَارْتَدَّتْ الْعَرَبُ أَوْ مَنْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُمْ، فَأَبَى أَنْ يَقْبَلَ مِنْهُمْ بَعْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَّا الَّذِي كَانَ قَابِلًا، انْتَزَعَ السُّيُوفَ مِنْ أَغْمَادِهَا، وَأَوْقَدَ النِّيرَانَ فِي شُعُلِهَا، ثُمَّ نَكِبَ بِأَهْلِ الْحَقِّ أَهْلَ الْبَاطِلِ، فَلَمْ يَبْرَحْ يُقَطِّعُ أَوْصَالَهُمْ، وَيَسْقِي الْأَرْضَ دِمَاءَهُمْ، حَتَّى أَدْخَلَهُمْ فِي الَّذِي خَرَجُوا مِنْهُ، وَقَرَّرَهُمْ بِالَّذِي نَفَرُوا عَنْهُ، وَقَدْ كَانَ أَصَابَ مِنْ مَالِ اللَّهِ بَكْرًا ، يَرْتَوِي عَلَيْهِ، وَحَبَشِيَّةً أَرْضَعَتْ وَلَدًا لَهُ، فَرَأَى ذَلِكَ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ غُصَّةً فِي حَلْقِهِ، فَأَدَّى ذَلِكَ إِلَى الْخَلِيفَةِ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ، وَفَارَقَ الدُّنْيَا تَقِيًّا نَقِيًّا عَلَى مِنْهَاجِ صَاحِبِهِ، ثُمَّ قَامَ بَعْدَهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ، فَمَصَّرَ الْأَمْصَارَ، وَخَلَطَ الشِّدَّةَ بِاللِّينِ، وَحَسَرَ عَنْ ذِرَاعَيْهِ، وَشَمَّرَ عَنْ سَاقَيْهِ وَعَدَّ لِلْأُمُورِ أَقْرَانَهَا، وَلِلْحَرْبِ آلَتَهَا، فَلَمَّا أَصَابَهُ فَتَي الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، أَمَرَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ يَسْأَلُ النَّاسَ : هَلْ يُثْبِتُونَ قَاتِلَهُ : فَلَمَّا قِيلَ : فَتَي الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، اسْتَهَلَّ يَحْمَدُ رَبَّهُ أَنْ لَا يَكُونَ أَصَابَهُ ذُو حَقٍّ فِي الْفَيْءِ فَيَحْتَجَّ عَلَيْهِ بِأَنَّهُ إِنَّمَا اسْتَحَلَّ دَمَهُ بِمَا اسْتَحَلَّ مِنْ حَقِّهِ، وَقَدْ كَانَ أَصَابَ مِنْ مَالِ اللَّهِ بِضْعَةً وَثَمَانِينَ أَلْفًا، فَكَسَرَ لَهَا رِبَاعَهُ وَكَرِهَ بِهَا كَفَالَةَ أَوْلَادِهِ، فَأَدَّاهَا إِلَى الْخَلِيفَةِ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ، وَفَارَقَ الدُّنْيَا تَقِيًّا نَقِيًّا عَلَى مِنْهَاجِ صَاحِبَيْهِ، ثُمَّ إِنَّكَ يَا عُمَرُ بُنَيُّ الدُّنْيَا وَلَّدَتْكَ مُلُوكُهَا، وَأَلْقَمَتْكَ ثَدْيَيْهَا، وَنَبَتَّ فِيهَا تَلْتَمِسُهَا مَظَانَّهَا، فَلَمَّا وُلِيتَهَا أَلْقَيْتَهَا حَيْثُ أَلْقَاهَا اللَّهُ، هَجَرْتَهَا وَجَفَوْتَهَا، وَقَذِرْتَهَا إِلَّا مَا تَزَوَّدْتَ مِنْهَا، فَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي جَلَا بِكَ حَوْبَتَنَا وَكَشَفَ بِكَ كُرْبَتَنَا، فَامْضِ وَلَا تَلْتَفِتْ، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَعِزُّ عَلَى الْحَقِّ شَيْءٌ، وَلَا يَذِلُّ عَلَى الْبَاطِلِ شَيْءٌ، أَقُولُ قَوْلِي هَذَا، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ لِي وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ "، قَالَ أَبُو أَيُّوبَ : فَكَانَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، يَقُولُ فِي الشَّيْءِ : قَالَ لِيَ ابْنُ الْأَهْتَمِ : امْضِ وَلَا تَلْتَفِتْ
24.en: Narrated by Abu Bakr al-Misri, from Sulayman Abu Ayyub al-Khuza'i, from Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Umawi, from Ma'ruf ibn Kharraboudh al-Makki, from Khalid ibn Ma'dan: He said: Abdullah ibn al-Ahtam entered upon Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz with the common people, and Umar was not taken by surprise until he found him before him speaking, so he praised Allah and lauded Him, then said: As for what follows, Allah created creation being free of need for their obedience, and secure from their disobedience, and people at that time were divided in status and opinion, and the Arabs were in the worst of those positions: the people of stone, and the people of wool-tents, and the people of hardship, the good things of the world and the ease of its life passed by them, they did not ask Allah collectively, nor did they recite for Him a book, their dead were in the Fire, and their living were blind and impure, along with countless things unwanted and disdained, so when Allah wished to spread His mercy over them, He sent to them a messenger from among themselves, dear to him is your suffering, eager for you, to the believers, kind, merciful, may Allah's blessings be upon him, and upon him be peace and the mercy of Allah and His blessings, but that did not prevent them from wounding him in his body and mocking him in his name, and with him was a speaking book from Allah, he would not stand except by His command, nor travel except by His permission, so when he was commanded with resolve, and burdened with jihad, his zeal expanded for the command of Allah, so Allah made his proof triumphant, and passed his word, and manifested his call, and he parted from this world pious and pure, then Abu Bakr stood after him and followed his practice, and took his path, and the Arabs apostatized or those of them who did that, so he refused to accept from them after the Messenger of Allah ﷺ except what was acceptable, he drew the swords from their sheaths, and lit the fires in their torches, then he struck the people of falsehood with the people of truth, and did not cease cutting their limbs, and watering the ground with their blood, until he brought them back into what they had come out of, and confirmed them in what they had fled from, and he had taken from Allah's wealth a young camel to ride upon, and an Abyssinian woman who nursed a child of his, so he saw that at his death as a lump in his throat, so he handed that over to the caliph after him, and parted from this world pious and pure, upon the path of his companion, then Umar ibn al-Khattab stood after him, and built up the garrison towns, and mixed strictness with gentleness, and rolled up his sleeves, and tucked up his lower garments, and prepared for matters their equals, and for war its equipment, so when the young man of al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah struck him, he commanded Ibn Abbas to ask the people: Do they confirm his killer? So when it was said: The young man of al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah, he cried out praising his Lord that no one entitled to a share in the spoils had struck him so that he could argue against him that he had only made his blood lawful because of what he had made lawful of his right, and he had taken from Allah's wealth some eighty-odd thousand, so he broke up his estates for it, and disliked burdening his children with it, so he handed it over to the caliph after him, and parted from this world pious and pure, upon the path of his two companions, then indeed you, O Umar, are the son of this world, its kings gave birth to you, and fed you its two breasts, and you grew up in it seeking its occasions, so when you were given authority over it, you cast it aside where Allah casts it, you abandoned it and treated it harshly, and considered it filthy except what you took as provision from it, so praise be to Allah who through you has cleared away our sin and through you has removed our distress, so go forward and do not turn back, for nothing is too dear to preserve the truth, and nothing is too humble to abandon for falsehood, I say this saying of mine, and I seek Allah's forgiveness for myself and for the believing men and believing women. Abu Ayyub said: So Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz used to say, about a matter: Ibn al-Ahtam said to me: Go forward and do not turn back.
24.hi: Abu Bakr al-Misri ne Sulayman Abu Ayyub al-Khuza'i se bataya: Humein Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Umawi ne bataya, Ma'ruf ibn Kharraboudh al-Makki se, Khalid ibn Ma'dan se: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ibn al-Ahtam Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz ke paas aam logon ke saath dakhil hue, to Umar ko koi hairaani nahi hui jab tak unhone use apne saamne baat karte na paaya, to usne Allah ki hamd ki aur uski tareef ki, fir kaha: Amma ba'd, Allah ne makhlooq ko banaaya jabke woh unki itaa'at se be-niyaaz tha, aur unki nafarmaani se mehfooz tha, aur us waqt log darjay aur raay mein mukhtalif the, aur Arab un darjaon mein sabse bure the: pattharon ke log, oon ke khaymon ke log, aur mushkil ke log, duniya ki achhi cheezein aur uski zindagi ki aasaani unse guzar jaati thi, woh ekattha hokar Allah se nahi maangte the, aur na uske liye koi kitaab padhte the, unke murda Jahannam mein the, aur unke zinda andhe aur napaak the, na-shumaar aisi cheezon ke saath jo na-pasandeeda aur haqeer theen, so jab Allah ne unpar apni rehmat phailaane ka irada kiya, usne unki taraf unmein se ek Rasool bheja, tumhari takleef unpar bhaari hai, tumhare liye betaab, momino ke liye narm-dil, mehrbaan, Allah ki dua unpar ho, aur unpar salaam aur Allah ki rehmat aur uski barkatein ho, lekin isse unhein na roka ke unhone unke jism ko zakhmi kiya aur unke naam mein mazaak udaaya, aur unke saath Allah ki taraf se ek bolti hui Kitaab thi, woh uske hukum ke bagair na khade hote na uski ijaazat ke bagair safar karte, so jab unhein irade ka hukum diya gaya, aur jihad ka bojh diya gaya, unka josh Allah ke hukum ke liye phail gaya, so Allah ne unki hujjat ko ghaalib kiya, aur unke kalimay ko jaari kiya, aur unki dawat ko zaahir kiya, aur woh is duniya se taqwa aur pakizgi ke saath rukhsat hue, fir unke baad Abu Bakr khade hue aur unki sunnat par chale, aur unka raasta liya, aur Arab murtad ho gaye ya unmein se kuch ne aisa kiya, to unhone Rasulullah ﷺ ke baad unse siwaay us cheez ke jo maqbool thi kuch qabool karne se inkaar kiya, unhone talwaarein apni miyaanon se nikaali, aur unke chhoolon mein aag lagaayi, fir haqq walon ko baatil walon se bhidaaya, aur unke ang kaatte rahe, aur zameen ko unke khoon se sinchate rahe, yahan tak ke unhein wahin wapas le aaye jahan se woh nikle the, aur unhein usi par sthir kiya jisse woh bhaage the, aur unhone Allah ke maal mein se ek jawaan oont liya sawaari ke liye, aur ek Habashi aurat li jisne unke ek bachche ko doodh pilaaya, to unhone apni maut ke waqt isay apne gale mein ek ganth dekhi, so unhone yeh apne baad khalifa ko de diya, aur woh is duniya se taqwa aur pakizgi ke saath rukhsat hue, apne saathi ke raaste par, fir unke baad Umar ibn al-Khattab khade hue, to unhone shehar aabaad kiye, aur sakhti ko narmi se milaaya, aur apni aasteen upar chadhaayi, aur apni pindliyaan khol dee, aur maamlaton ke liye unke barabar taiyaari ki, aur jung ke liye uska saaman, to jab unhein al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah ke jawaan ne maara, unhone Ibn Abbas ko hukum diya ke woh logon se poochein: Kya woh uske qaatil ko saabit karte hain? To jab kaha gaya: Al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah ka jawaan, unhone khushi se apne Rab ki hamd ki ke unhein maal-e-ghaneemat mein koi haqdaar shakhs nahi mila, jisse woh unke khilaaf yeh dalil de sake ke unhone sirf uska khoon uske haq ko halaal karne ki wajah se halaal kiya, aur unhone Allah ke maal mein se assi hazaar ke qareeb liya, to unhone iske liye apni jaayedaadein todin aur isse apni aulaad ki zimmedaari lena na-pasand kiya, to unhone yeh apne baad khalifa ko de diya, aur woh is duniya se taqwa aur pakizgi ke saath rukhsat hue, apne dono sathiyon ke raaste par, fir Ae Umar, tum duniya ke bete ho, iske baadshahon ne tumhein paala, aur iske dono seene tumhein pilaaye, aur tum ismein isse dhundte hue paal-poste gaye, so jab tumhein isper hukumat di gayi, tumne isay wahan phenk diya jahan Allah isay phenkta hai, tumne isay chhod diya aur isse sakhti se pesh aaye, aur isay napaak samjha siwaay usko chhodkar jo tumne isse zaad-e-raah liya, so hamd hai us Allah ki jisne tumhare zariye humaari khataa saaf ki aur tumhare zariye humaari museebat dur ki, so aage badho aur peechhe mat mudo, kyunki haqq ko bachaane ke liye koi cheez itni aziz nahi ke usay chhoda na jaaye, aur baatil ke liye koi cheez itni haqeer nahi ke usay chhoda na jaaye, main yeh apni baat kehta hoon, aur main Allah se apne liye aur momin mardon aur momin auraton ke liye maghfirat maangta hoon. Abu Ayyub kehte hain: To Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz kisi maamle mein kehte the: Ibn al-Ahtam ne mujhse kaha: Aage badho aur peechhe mat mudo.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مَالِكٍ النُّكْرِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْجَوْزَاءِ أَوْسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" قَحَطَ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ قَحْطًا شَدِيدًا، فَشَكَوْا إِلَى عَائِشَةَ  ، فَقَالَتْ : انْظُرُوا قَبْرَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَاجْعَلُوا مِنْهُ كُوَوًا إِلَى السَّمَاءِ حَتَّى لَا يَكُونَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ سَقْفٌ، قَالَ : فَفَعَلُوا، فَمُطِرْنَا مَطَرًا حَتَّى نَبَتَ الْعُشْبُ، وَسَمِنَتِ الْإِبِلُ حَتَّى تَفَتَّقَتْ مِنْ الشَّحْمِ، فَسُمِّيَ عَامَ الْفَتْقِ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Sa'id ibn Zayd, from Amr ibn Malik al-Nukri, from Abu al-Jawza Aws ibn Abdullah: He said: The people of Madinah suffered a severe drought, so they complained to Aisha, so she said: Look at the grave of the Prophet ﷺ, and make from it an opening to the sky, such that there is no ceiling between it and the sky. He said: So they did that, and we were given such rain that vegetation grew, and the camels became so fat that they split open from the fat, so it was named the Year of the Splitting.
24.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Sa'id ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Amr ibn Malik al-Nukri ne bataya: Humein Abu al-Jawza Aws ibn Abdullah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Madinah walon par sakht qehat aaya, to unhone Aisha se shikaayat ki, to unhone kaha: Nabi ﷺ ki qabr dekho, aur usse aasmaan ki taraf ek roshandaan bana do yahan tak ke uske aur aasmaan ke darmiyan koi chhat na ho. Unhone bataya: To unhone aisa kiya, to humpar itni baarish hui ke ghaas ug aayi, aur oont itne motay ho gaye ke charbi se phat gaye, to usay 'Aam-ul-Fatq' (phatne ka saal) kaha gaya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ  ، قَالَ :" لَمَّا كَانَ أَيَّامُ الْحَرَّةِ لَمْ يُؤَذَّنْ فِي مَسْجِدِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ثَلَاثًا، وَلَمْ يُقَمْ وَلَمْ يَبْرَحْ سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ الْمَسْجِدِ، وَكَانَ لَا يَعْرِفُ وَقْتَ الصَّلَاةِ إِلَّا بِهَمْهَمَةٍ يَسْمَعُهَا مِنْ قَبْرِ النَّبِيِّ "، فَذَكَرَ مَعْنَاهُ
24.en: Narrated by Marwan ibn Muhammad, from Sa'id ibn Abd al-Aziz: He said: When it was the days of al-Harrah, the adhan was not called in the mosque of the Prophet ﷺ for three [days], nor was the iqamah given, and Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab did not leave the mosque, and he could not tell the time of prayer except by a murmur he heard from the grave of the Prophet. So he mentioned its meaning.
24.hi: Marwan ibn Muhammad ne Sa'id ibn Abd al-Aziz se bataya: Unhone kaha, Jab al-Harrah ke din aaye, Nabi ﷺ ki masjid mein teen [dinon] tak azaan nahi di gayi, aur na iqaamat di gayi, aur Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab masjid se nahi nikle, aur woh namaz ka waqt sirf ek gunjaan se pehchaante the jo woh Nabi ki qabr se sunte the. So unhone iska matlab zikr kiya.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي هِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ نُبَيْهِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ  ، أَنَّ كَعْبًا   دَخَلَ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ ، فَذَكَرُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ كَعْبٌ :" مَا مِنْ يَوْمٍ يَطْلُعُ إِلَّا نَزَلَ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا مِنْ الْمَلَائِكَةِ، حَتَّى يَحُفُّوا بِقَبْرِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَضْرِبُونَ بِأَجْنِحَتِهِمْ، وَيُصَلُّونَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَتَّى إِذَا أَمْسَوْا، عَرَجُوا وَهَبَطَ مِثْلُهُمْ، فَصَنَعُوا مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى إِذَا انْشَقَّتْ عَنْهُ الْأَرْضُ، خَرَجَ فِي سَبْعِينَ أَلْفًا مِنْ الْمَلَائِكَةِ يَزِفُّونَهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Khalid (Ibn Yazid), from Sa'id (Ibn Abi Hilal), from Nubayh ibn Wahb: That Ka'b entered upon Aisha, and they mentioned the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so Ka'b said: There is no day that dawns except that seventy thousand angels descend, until they surround the grave of the Prophet ﷺ, beating with their wings, and sending blessings upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, until when evening comes, they ascend and an equal number descend, and do the like of that, until when the earth splits open for him, he comes out among seventy thousand angels escorting him.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhe Khalid ne bataya (Ibn Yazid), Sa'id se (Ibn Abi Hilal), Nubayh ibn Wahb se: ke Ka'b Aisha ke paas gaye, to unhone Rasulullah ﷺ ka zikr kiya, to Ka'b ne kaha: Koi din aisa nahi jo tulu ho magar sattar hazaar farishtay utarte hain, yahan tak ke woh Nabi ﷺ ki qabr ko ghere lete hain, apne par phadphadaate hue, aur Rasulullah ﷺ par dua bhejte hue, yahan tak ke jab shaam hoti hai, woh chadh jaate hain aur unke barabar dusre utarte hain, aur isi tarah karte hain, yahan tak ke jab zameen unke liye phat jaayegi, woh sattar hazaar farishton ke darmiyan nikalenge jo unhein le kar chalenge.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا ثَوْرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدُ بْنُ مَعْدَانَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ،  عَنْ عِرْبَاضِ بْنِ سَارِيَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : صَلَّى لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ صَلَاةَ الْفَجْرِ، ثُمَّ وَعَظَنَا مَوْعِظَةً بَلِيغَةً ذَرَفَتْ مِنْهَا الْعُيُونُ، وَوَجِلَتْ مِنْهَا الْقُلُوبُ، فَقَالَ قَائِلٌ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، كَأَنَّهَا مَوْعِظَةُ مُوَدِّعٍ؟ فَأَوْصِنَا، فَقَالَ :" أُوصِيكُمْ بِتَقْوَى اللَّهِ وَالسَّمْعِ وَالطَّاعَةِ وَإِنْ كَانَ عَبْدًا حَبَشِيًّا، فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ يَعِشْ مِنْكُمْ بَعْدِي فَسَيَرَى اخْتِلَافًا كَثِيرًا، فَعَلَيْكُمْ بِسُنَّتِي وَسَنَّةِ الْخُلَفَاءِ الرَّاشِدِينَ الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، عَضُّوا عَلَيْهَا بِالنَّوَاجِذِ وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَالْمُحْدَثَاتِ، فَإِنَّ كُلَّ مُحْدَثَةٍ بِدْعَةٌ "، وقَالَ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ مَرَّةً : " وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَمُحْدَثَاتِ الْأُمُورِ، فَإِنَّ كُلَّ بِدْعَةٍ ضَلَالَةٌ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Thawr ibn Yazid, from Khalid ibn Ma'dan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Amr, from al-Irbad ibn Sariyah رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ led us in Fajr prayer, then admonished us with an eloquent admonition that made eyes shed tears, and made hearts fearful, so a speaker said: O Messenger of Allah, it is as if this is a farewell admonition, so advise us, so he said: I advise you to fear Allah, and to hear and obey, even if it is an Abyssinian slave, for whoever among you lives after me will see much dispute, so hold fast to my sunnah and the sunnah of the rightly-guided caliphs, bite onto it with your molars, and beware of newly-invented matters, for every newly-invented matter is an innovation. And Abu Asim said once: And beware of newly-invented matters, for every innovation is misguidance.
24.hi: Abu Asim ne Thawr ibn Yazid se bataya: Mujhe Khalid ibn Ma'dan ne bataya, Abd al-Rahman ibn Amr se, al-Irbad ibn Sariyah se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein Fajr ki namaz padhaayi, fir humein ek asar-daar naseehat ki jisse aankhon se aansu bahne lage, aur dil dar gaye, to ek shakhs ne kaha: Ya Rasulullah, goya yeh vida'i naseehat hai? So humein wasiyat dijiye, to aapne farmaya: Main tumhein Allah se darne ki, aur sunne aur maanne ki wasiyat karta hoon, chahe woh ek Habashi ghulam hi ho, kyunki jo bhi tum mein se mere baad zinda rahega woh bahut ikhtilaaf dekhega, so tum mere sunnat, aur khulafa-e-rashideen ki sunnat ko pakdo, unhein apni daadhon se kaso, aur naye niklay maamlon se bacho, kyunki har naya maamla bidat hai. Aur Abu Asim ne ek baar kaha: aur naye niklay maamlon se bacho, kyunki har bidat gumraahi hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ مَنْ مَضَى مِنْ عُلَمَائِنَا يَقُولُونَ :" الِاعْتِصَامُ بِالسُّنَّةِ نَجَاةٌ، وَالْعِلْمُ يُقْبَضُ قَبْضًا سَرِيعًا، فَنَعْشُ الْعِلْمِ ثَبَاتُ الدِّينِ وَالدُّنْيَا، وَفِي ذَهَابِ الْعِلْمِ ذَهَابُ ذَلِكَ كُلِّهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from Yunus ibn Yazid, from al-Zuhri: He said: Those of our scholars who have passed used to say: Adherence to the sunnah is salvation, and knowledge is taken away swiftly, for the survival of knowledge is the stability of religion and this world, and in the passing away of knowledge is the passing away of all of that.
24.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se bataya: Humein Yunus ibn Yazid ne bataya, al-Zuhri se: Unhone kaha, Humare ulama jo guzar chuke hain woh kehte the: Sunnat ko pakdna hi najaat hai, aur ilm bahut tezi se utha liya jaata hai, so ilm ka baaqi rehna hi deen aur duniya ki mazbooti hai, aur ilm ke jaane mein yeh sab kuch jaana hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرٍو السَّيْبَانِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الدَّيْلَمِيِّ  ، قَالَ :" بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ أَوَّلَ ذَهَابِ الدِّينِ تَرْكُ السُّنَّةُ، يَذْهَبُ الدِّينُ سُنَّةً سُنَّةً، كَمَا يَذْهَبُ الْحَبْلُ قُوَّةً قُوَّةً "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from Yahya ibn Abi Amr al-Saybani, from Abdullah al-Daylami: He said: It has reached me that the first sign of the loss of religion is the abandonment of the sunnah, religion goes away sunnah by sunnah, just as a rope goes away strand by strand.
24.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se bataya: Humein Yahya ibn Abi Amr al-Saybani ne bataya, Abdullah al-Daylami se: Unhone kaha, Mujhe khabar mili hai ke deen ke khone ki pehli nishaani sunnat ko chhod dena hai, deen sunnat-dar-sunnat khatam hota jaata hai, jaise rassi taakat-dar-taakat khatam hoti jaati hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، عَنْ حَسَّانَ  ، قَالَ :" مَا ابْتَدَعَ قَوْمٌ بِدْعَةً فِي دِينِهِمْ إِلَّا نَزَعَ اللَّهُ مِنْ سُنَّتِهِمْ مِثْلَهَا، ثُمَّ لَا يُعِيدُهَا إِلَيْهِمْ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from Hassan: He said: No people invented an innovation in their religion, except that Allah removed from their sunnah something equivalent to it, then never restored it to them until the Day of Resurrection.
24.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se bataya: Humein Hassan ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Kisi bhi qaum ne apne deen mein bidat nahi nikaali, magar Allah ne unki sunnat mein se usi jaisi cheez cheen li, fir Qayamat tak unhein woh kabhi wapas nahi ki.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ ، قَالَ :" مَا ابْتَدَعَ رَجُلٌ بِدْعَةً إِلَّا اسْتَحَلَّ السَّيْفَ "
24.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Wuhayb, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah: He said: No man invented an innovation except that he made the sword lawful [i.e., justified violence].
24.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Wuhayb se bataya: Humein Ayyub ne bataya, Abu Qilabah se: Unhone kaha, Kisi aadmi ne koi bidat nahi nikaali magar usne talwar ko halal kar diya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْأَهْوَاءِ أَهْلُ الضَّلَالَةِ، وَلَا أَرَى مَصِيرَهُمْ إِلَّا إِلَي النَّارَ، فَجَرِّبْهُمْ فَلَيْسَ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ يَنْتَحِلُ قَوْلًا أَوْ قَالَ : حَدِيثًا فَيَتَنَاهَى بِهِ الْأَمْرُ دُونَ السَّيْفِ، وَإِنَّ النِّفَاقَ كَانَ ضُرُوبًا، ثُمَّ تَلَا : # وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ عَاهَدَ اللَّهَ لَئِنْ آتَانَا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ لَنَصَّدَّقَنَّ وَلَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ سورة التوبة آية 75 #، # وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَلْمِزُكَ فِي الصَّدَقَاتِ فَإِنْ أُعْطُوا مِنْهَا رَضُوا وَإِنْ لَمْ يُعْطَوْا مِنْهَا إِذَا هُمْ يَسْخَطُونَ سورة التوبة آية 58 #، # وَمِنْهُمُ الَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ النَّبِيَّ وَيِقُولُونَ هُوَ أُذُنٌ قُلْ أُذُنُ خَيْرٍ لَكُمْ سورة التوبة آية 61 # فَاخْتَلَفَ قَوْلُهُمْ وَاجْتَمَعُوا، فِي الشَّكِّ وَالتَّكْذِيبِ، وَإِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ اخْتَلَفَ قَوْلُهُمْ وَاجْتَمَعُوا فِي السَّيْفِ، وَلَا أَرَى مَصِيرَهُمْ إِلَّا إِلَي النَّارَ "، قَالَ حَمَّادٌ : ثُمَّ قَالَ أَيُّوبُ عِنْدَ ذَا الْحَدِيثِ أَوْ عِنْدَ الْأَوَّلِ : وَكَانَ وَاللَّهِ مِنْ الْفُقَهَاءِ ذَوِي الْأَلْبَابِ : يَعْنِي أَبَا قِلَابَةَ
24.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah: He said: The people of desires are the people of misguidance, and I see nothing for their fate except the Fire, so test them, for none of them holds to a saying, or he said: a hadith, and stops at that short of the sword, and hypocrisy indeed had various forms, then he recited: 'And among them are those who made a covenant with Allah, saying, If He gives us from His bounty, we will surely spend in charity, and we will surely be among the righteous' [Surah al-Tawbah, verse 75], 'And among them are those who criticize you concerning the [distribution of] charities. If they are given from them, they approve; but if they are not given from them, at once they become angry' [Surah al-Tawbah, verse 58], 'And among them are those who abuse the Prophet and say, He is an ear. Say, He is an ear of goodness for you' [Surah al-Tawbah, verse 61], so their sayings differed, but they came together in doubt and denial, and these too, their sayings differ, but they come together over the sword, and I see nothing for their fate except the Fire. Hammad said: Then Ayyub said, at this hadith or at the first: And by Allah, he was among the jurists possessing understanding, meaning: Abu Qilabah.
24.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Ayyub ne bataya, Abu Qilabah se: Unhone kaha, Khwaahishaat ke log gumraahi ke log hain, aur mujhe unke anjaam mein Jahannam ke siwa kuch nazar nahi aata, so unhein aazmaao, kyunki unmein se koi bhi ek baat, ya kaha: ek hadith, ko apnaakar talwar se kam par nahi rukta, aur munaafiqat kai tarah ki hoti thi, fir unhone padha: 'Aur unmein se kuch hain jinhone Allah se ahad kiya ke agar usne apna fazl diya to woh zaroor sadqa denge aur nekokaaron mein se honge' [Surah At-Tawbah, aayat 75], 'Aur unmein se kuch hain jo aapki sadqaat ke baare mein tanz karte hain, agar unhein usmein se diya jaaye to woh razi hote hain aur agar na diya jaaye to naaraz ho jaate hain' [Surah At-Tawbah, aayat 58], 'Aur unmein se woh hain jo Nabi ko takleef dete hain aur kehte hain: Yeh kaan hai. Kaho: Yeh tumhare liye ek behtar kaan hai' [Surah At-Tawbah, aayat 61], to unki baaten mukhtalif hui lekin woh shak aur jhutlaane mein ekattha hue, aur yeh log bhi, unki baaten mukhtalif hain lekin woh talwar par ekattha hote hain, aur mujhe unke anjaam mein Jahannam ke siwa kuch nazar nahi aata. Hammad kehte hain: Fir Ayyub ne is hadith par ya pehli par kaha: Aur Allah ki qasam, woh un fuqaha mein se the jo hikmat rakhte the: yaani, Abu Qilabah.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ،  عَنْ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ  ، وَحُذَيْفَةَ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّهُمَا كَانَا جَالِسَيْنِ فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَسَأَلَهُمَا عَنْ شَيْءٍ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ لِحُذَيْفَةَ :" لِأَيِّ شَيْءٍ تَرَى يَسْأَلُونِي عَنْ هَذَا؟، قَالَ : يَعْلَمُونَهُ ثُمَّ يَتْرُكُونَهُ، فَأَقْبَلَ إِلَيْهِ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ، فَقَالَ : مَا سَأَلْتُمُونَا عَنْ شَيْءٍ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى نَعْلَمُهُ، أَخْبَرْنَاكُمْ بِهِ، أَوْ سُنَّةٍ مِنْ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَخْبَرْنَاكُمْ بِهِ، وَلَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِمَا أَحْدَثْتُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid ibn Abdullah, from Ata, from Amir, from Ibn Mas'ud, and Hudhayfah رضي الله عنهما: That they were sitting, so a man came and asked them about something, so Ibn Mas'ud said to Hudhayfah: Why do you think they ask me about this? He said: They know it, then they abandon it, so Ibn Mas'ud turned to him, and said: You have not asked us about anything from the Book of Allah, exalted is He, that we know, except that we have informed you of it, or a sunnah from the Prophet of Allah ﷺ that we informed you of, but we have no capacity for what you have newly invented.
24.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid ibn Abdullah se bataya: Humein Ata ne bataya, Amir se, Ibn Mas'ud, aur Hudhayfah se رضي الله عنهما: ke woh dono baithe the ke ek aadmi aaya aur unse kisi cheez ke baare mein poocha, to Ibn Mas'ud ne Hudhayfah se kaha: Aapko kya lagta hai woh mujhse isi baare mein kyun poochte hain? Unhone kaha: Woh jaante hain, fir isse chhod dete hain, to Ibn Mas'ud unki taraf mude, aur kaha: Tumne humse Allah Ta'ala ki Kitaab se koi bhi aisi cheez nahi poochi jo hum jaante hon, magar humne tumhein iski khabar di, ya Allah ke Nabi ﷺ ki koi sunnat jiski khabar humne tumhein di, lekin jo tumne naya nikaala hai uski humme taaqat nahi.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ  ، عَنْ النَّزَّالِ بْنِ سَبْرَةَ  ، قَالَ :" مَا خَطَبَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   خُطْبَةً بِالْكُوفَةِ إِلَّا شَهِدْتُهَا، فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَوْمًا، وَسُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يُطَلِّقُ امْرَأَتَهُ ثَمَانِيَةً وَأَشْبَاهِ ذَلِكَ، قَالَ : هُوَ كَمَا، قَالَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَنْزَلَ كِتَابَهُ وَبَيَّنَ بَيَانَهُ، فَمَنْ أَتَى الْأَمْرَ مِنْ قِبَلِ وَجْهِهِ فَقَدْ بُيِّنَ لَهُ، وَمَنْ خَالَفَ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا نُطِيقُ خِلَافَكُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from al-Mas'udi, from Abd al-Malik ibn Maysarah, from al-Nazzal ibn Sabrah: He said: Abdullah did not deliver any sermon in Kufah except that I witnessed it, so I heard him one day, and he was asked about a man who divorces his wife eight times and the like of that, he said: It is as he said, then he said: Allah indeed sent down His Book and made clear His explanation, so whoever approaches the matter from its right direction, it has indeed been made clear to him, and whoever opposes, then by Allah, we cannot bear your opposition.
24.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne al-Mas'udi se bataya: Humein Abd al-Malik ibn Maysarah ne bataya, al-Nazzal ibn Sabrah se: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ne Kufah mein koi bhi khutba nahi diya magar main usmein maujood tha, to maine unhein ek din suna, aur unse ek aadmi ke baare mein poocha gaya jo apni biwi ko aath martaba talaq de aur isi jaisi cheezein, unhone kaha: Yeh waisa hi hai jaisa unhone kaha, fir unhone kaha: Allah ne apni Kitaab nazil ki aur apna bayaan wazeh kiya, so jo bhi maamle ko uski sahi disha se apnaaye, usay wazeh kar diya gaya hai, aur jo mukhaalifat kare, to Allah ki qasam, hum tumhari mukhaalifat sehne ki taaqat nahi rakhte.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ النَّزَّالَ بْنَ سَبْرَةَ  ، قَالَ :" شَهِدْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ   وَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ وَامْرَأَةٌ فِي تَحْرِيمٍ، فَقَالَ : إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ بَيَّنَ، فَمَنْ أَتَى الْأَمْرَ مِنْ قِبَلِ وَجْهِهِ، فَقَدْ بُيِّنَ، وَمَنْ خَالَفَ، فَوَاللَّهِ مَا نُطِيقُ خِلَافَكُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from Abd al-Malik ibn Maysarah, from al-Nazzal ibn Sabrah: He said: I witnessed Abdullah, and a man and a woman came to him about a prohibition matter, so he said: Allah has indeed made it clear, so whoever approaches the matter from its right direction, it has been made clear, and whoever opposes, then by Allah, we cannot bear your opposition.
24.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Shu'bah se bataya: Mujhe Abd al-Malik ibn Maysarah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Nazzal ibn Sabrah ko kehte suna: Unhone kaha, Main Abdullah ke paas maujood tha, to unke paas ek aadmi aur ek aurat ek haraam qarar diye jaane wale maamle mein aaye, to unhone kaha: Allah ne isse wazeh kar diya hai, so jo maamle ko uski sahi disha se apnaaye, usay wazeh kar diya gaya hai, aur jo mukhaalifat kare, to Allah ki qasam, hum tumhari mukhaalifat sehne ki taaqat nahi rakhte.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ  ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ   :" أَنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يَقُولُ بِرَأْيِهِ إِلَّا شَيْئًا سَمِعَهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Hafs, from Ash'ath, from Ibn Sirin: That he would never speak by his own opinion, except something he had heard.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Hafs se bataya: Humein Ash'ath ne bataya, Ibn Sirin se: ke woh kabhi apni raay se baat nahi karte the, siwaay kisi cheez ke jo unhone suni ho.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَثَّامٌ  وَالِدُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَثَّامٍ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، قَالَ :" مَا سَمِعْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ يَقُولُ بِرَأْيِهِ فِي شَيْءٍ قَطُّ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Attham, father of Ali ibn Attham, from al-A'mash: He said: I never heard Ibrahim say anything by his own opinion, ever.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Attham se bataya, jo Ali ibn Attham ke walid the, al-A'mash se: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibrahim ko kabhi apni raay se kuch kehte nahi suna.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ  ، قَالَ :" مَا قُلْتُ بِرَأْيِي مُنْذُ ثَلَاثُونَ سَنَةً "، قَالَ أَبُو هِلَالٍ : " مُنْذُ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Abu Awanah, from Qatadah; with Abu Hilal's note: He said: I have not spoken by my own opinion for thirty years. Abu Hilal said: For forty years.
24.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Abu Awanah se bataya: Humein Qatadah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine teen dahaayi (tees saal) se apni raay se kuch nahi kaha. Abu Hilal kehte hain: Chaalis saal se.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَكَّامُ بْنُ سَلْمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي خَيْثَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ  ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ عَطَاءٌ   عَنْ شَيْءٍ، قَالَ : لَا أَدْرِي، قَالَ : قِيلَ لَهُ : أَلَا تَقُولُ فِيهَا بِرَأْيِكَ؟، قَالَ :" إِنِّي أَسْتَحْيِي مِنْ اللَّهِ G أَنْ يُدَانَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِرَأْيِي "
24.en: Narrated by Makhlad ibn Malik, from Hakkam ibn Salm, from Abu Khaythamah, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Rufay': He said: Ata was asked about something, he said: I do not know, he said: It was said to him: Will you not give your opinion about it? He said: I am ashamed before Allah, exalted is He, that judgment be given on earth by my opinion.
24.hi: Makhlad ibn Malik ne Hakkam ibn Salm se bataya: Humein Abu Khaythamah ne bataya, Abd al-Aziz ibn Rufay' se: Unhone kaha, Ata se kisi cheez ke baare mein poocha gaya, unhone kaha: Mujhe nahi maloom, unhone kaha: Unse kaha gaya: Kya aap apni raay nahi denge isme? Unhone kaha: Main Allah Ta'ala se sharmaata hoon ke zameen par mere raay se faisla diya jaaye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي حَاتِمٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، عَنْ عِيسَى  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، قَالَ : جَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ يَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ شَيْءٍ، فَقَالَ :" كَانَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ   يَقُولُ فِيهِ كَذَا وَكَذَا، قَالَ : أَخْبِرْنِي أَنْتَ بِرَأْيِكَ، فَقَالَ : أَلَا تَعْجَبُونَ مِنْ هَذَا؟ أَخْبَرْتُهُ عَنْ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، وَيَسْأَلُنِي عَنْ رَأْيِي، وَدِينِي عِنْدِي آثَرُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ، وَاللَّهِ لَأَنْ أَتَغَنَّى أُغْنِيَّةً أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُخْبِرَكَ بِرَأْيِي "
24.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Aban, from Hatim (Ibn Isma'il), from Isa, from al-Sha'bi: He said: A man came to him asking about something, so he said: Ibn Mas'ud used to say such-and-such about it, he said: Tell me your own opinion, so he said: Do you not wonder at this? I told him about Ibn Mas'ud, and he asks me for my opinion, and my religion is more precious to me than that, by Allah, for me to sing a song is more beloved to me than to tell you my opinion.
24.hi: Isma'il ibn Aban ne Hatim se bataya (Ibn Isma'il), Isa se, al-Sha'bi se: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi unke paas aaya kisi cheez ke baare mein poochte hue, to unhone kaha: Ibn Mas'ud isme aisa-aisa kehte the, usne kaha: Mujhe apni raay bataao, to unhone kaha: Kya tumhein isper tajjub nahi hota? Maine tumhein Ibn Mas'ud ke baare mein bataaya, aur woh mujhse meri raay maangta hai, aur mera deen mere nazdeek isse zyada aziz hai, Allah ki qasam, mera gaana gaana mujhe isse zyada aziz hai ke main tumhein apni raay bataaun.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل ، عَنْ عِيسَى ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، قَالَ :" إِيَّاكُمْ وَالْمُقَايَسَةَ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَئِنْ أَخَذْتُمْ بِالْمُقَايَسَةِ لَتُحِلُّنَّ الْحَرَامَ وَلَتُحَرِّمُنَّ الْحَلَالَ، وَلَكِنْ مَا بَلَغَكُمْ عَمَّنْ حَفِظَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَاعْمَلُوا بِهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Aban, from Hatim (Ibn Isma'il), from Isa, from al-Sha'bi: He said: Beware of analogical reasoning, by the One in whose hand is my soul, if you take to analogy, you will surely make the unlawful lawful and the lawful unlawful, but rather act by what has reached you from those who preserved [knowledge] among the Companions of Muhammad ﷺ.
24.hi: Isma'il ibn Aban ne Hatim se bataya (Ibn Isma'il), Isa se, al-Sha'bi se: Unhone kaha, Qiyaas (analogical reasoning) se bacho, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, agar tum qiyaas apnaao, to tum zaroor haraam ko halal kar doge aur halal ko haraam kar doge, lekin jo tum tak Muhammad ﷺ ke sahaba mein se hifaazat karne walon se pahunche, usi par amal karo.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ  ، قَالَ : جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ : إِنَّهُ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ الْبَارِحَةَ ثَمَانِيًا، قَالَ : بِكَلَامٍ وَاحِدٍ؟، قَالَ : بِكَلَامٍ وَاحِدٍ، قَالَ : فَيُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبِينُوا مِنْكَ امْرَأَتَكَ؟ قَالَ : نَعَمْ، قَالَ : وَجَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ : إِنَّهُ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ مِائَةَ طَلْقَةٍ قَالَ : بِكَلَامٍ وَاحِدٍ؟، قَالَ : بِكَلَامٍ وَاحِدٍ، قَالَ : فَيُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبِينُوا مِنْكَ امْرَأَتَكَ؟، قَالَ : نَعَمْ، فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   :" مَنْ طَلَّقَ كَمَا أَمَرَهُ اللَّهُ، فَقَدْ بَيَّنَ اللَّهُ الطَّلَاقَ وَمَنْ لَبَّسَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ، وَكَّلْنَا بِهِ لَبْسَهُ وَاللَّهِ لَا تُلَبِّسُونَ عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ وَنَتَحَمَّلُهُ نَحْنُ، هُوَ كَمَا تَقُولُونَ "
24.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Ibn Awn, from Muhammad ibn Sirin, from Alqamah: He said: A man came to Abdullah, and said: He divorced his wife eight times last night, he said: With one statement? He said: With one statement, he said: So do they want to make your wife separated from you [entirely]? He said: Yes, he said: And a man came to him, and said: He divorced his wife a hundred divorces, he said: With one statement? He said: With one statement, he said: So do they want to make your wife separated from you? He said: Yes, so Abdullah said: Whoever divorces as Allah commanded him, Allah has indeed made divorce clear, and whoever confused things for himself, we hold him responsible for his confusion, by Allah, you will not confuse things for yourselves and have us bear it, it is as you say.
24.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Ibn Awn se bataya: Humein Muhammad ibn Sirin ne bataya, Alqamah se: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi Abdullah ke paas aaya, aur kaha: Usne pichhli raat apni biwi ko aath martaba talaq di, unhone poocha: Ek hi baat mein? Usne kaha: Ek hi baat mein, unhone poocha: To kya woh chaahte hain ke tumhari biwi tumse hamesha ke liye alag ho jaaye? Usne kaha: Haan, unhone bataya: Aur ek aadmi unke paas aaya, aur kaha: Usne apni biwi ko sau talaqein di, unhone poocha: Ek hi baat mein? Usne kaha: Ek hi baat mein, unhone poocha: To kya woh chaahte hain ke tumhari biwi tumse alag ho jaaye? Usne kaha: Haan, to Abdullah ne kaha: Jo Allah ke hukum ke mutaabiq talaq de, Allah ne talaq ko wazeh kar diya hai, aur jo apne aap ke liye maamla uljhaa de, hum usi ko uski uljhan ka zimmedaar maante hain, Allah ki qasam, tum apne liye maamla uljhaao aur hum isse uthaayein, aisa nahi hoga, yeh waisa hi hai jaisa tum kehte ho.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ،  عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ  ، قَالَ :" لَأَنْ يَعِيشَ الرَّجُلُ جَاهِلًا بَعْدَ أَنْ يَعْلَمَ حَقَّ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَقُولَ مَا لَا يَعْلَمُ "
24.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from al-Qasim: He said: For a man to live ignorant after knowing Allah's right upon him is better for him than saying what he does not know.
24.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Yahya ibn Sa'id ne bataya, al-Qasim se: Unhone kaha, Aadmi ke liye jahaal reh kar jeena, Allah ka haq apne oopar jaanne ke baad, isse behtar hai ke woh woh baat kahe jo woh nahi jaanta.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ الْقَاسِمَ   سُئْلُ، قَالَ :" إِنَّا وَاللَّهِ مَا نَعْلَمُ كُلَّ مَا تَسْأَلُونَ عَنْهُ، وَلَوْ عَلِمْنَا مَا كَتَمْنَاكُمْ، وَلَا حَلَّ لَنَا أَنْ نَكْتُمَكُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub: He said: I heard al-Qasim, when asked, say: We, by Allah, do not know everything you ask about, and had we known, we would not have hidden it from you, and it is not lawful for us to hide it from you.
24.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Ayyub ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Qasim ko, jab unse poocha gaya, kehte suna: Hum, Allah ki qasam, woh sab kuch nahi jaante jo tum poochte ho, aur agar hum jaante, to hum tumse chhupaate nahi, aur humare liye tumse chhupaana jaayez nahi.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ الْقَاسِمُ  عَنْ شَيْءٍ قَدْ سَمَّاهُ، فَقَالَ :" مَا أَضْطَرُّ إِلَى مَشُورَةٍ، وَمَا أَنَا مِنْ ذَي فِي شَيْءٍ "
24.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Ibn Awn: He said: Al-Qasim was asked about something he had named, so he said: I do not have need for consultation, and I have nothing to do with it in any matter.
24.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Ibn Awn se bataya: Unhone kaha, Al-Qasim se ek aisi cheez ke baare mein poocha gaya jise unhone naam liya tha, to unhone kaha: Mujhe mashware ki zaroorat nahi, aur mera isme koi lena-dena nahi.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ  ،  عَنْ يَحْيَى  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِلْقَاسِمِ   : مَا أَشَدَّ عَلَيَّ أَنْ تُسْأَلَ عَنْ الشَّيْءِ لَا يَكُونُ عِنْدَكَ وَقَدْ كَانَ أَبُوكَ إِمَامًا، قَالَ :" إِنَّ أَشَدَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَعِنْدَ مَنِ عَقَلَ عَنْ اللَّهِ أَنْ أُفْتِيَ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ، أَوْ أَرْوِيَ عَنْ غَيْرِ ثِقَةٍ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Yahya: He said: I said to al-Qasim: How difficult it is for me that you are asked about something you do not have [an answer for], though your father was an imam? He said: What is more difficult than that before Allah and before whoever has understanding from Allah, is that I give a ruling without knowledge, or narrate from someone untrustworthy.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se bataya: Humein Yahya ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Qasim se kaha: Mujhe kitna mushkil lagta hai ke aapse kisi cheez ke baare mein poocha jaaye jo aapke paas nahi hai, jabke aapke walid imam the? Unhone kaha: Allah ke nazdeek aur jo Allah se samajh rakhta hai uske nazdeek isse zyada mushkil yeh hai ke main bagair ilm ke fatwa dun, ya kisi ghair-bharosemand se riwaayat karun.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ ، عَنْ الْعَوَّامِ ، عَنْ الْمُسَيَّبِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ ، قَالَ :" كَانُوا إِذَا نَزَلَتْ بِهِمْ قَضِيَّةٌ لَيْسَ فِيهَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَثَرٌ، اجْتَمَعُوا لَهَا وَأَجْمَعُوا، فَالْحَقُّ فِيمَا رَأَوْا، فَالْحَقُّ فِيمَا رَأَوْا "، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ ، عَنْ الْعَوَّامِ بِهَذَا
24.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Hushaym, from al-Awwam, from al-Musayyab ibn Rafi': He said: When a case arose for which there was no precedent from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, they would gather for it and reach a consensus, so the truth is in what they saw, the truth is in what they saw. Narrated by Abdullah, from Yazid, from al-Awwam, with this.
24.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Hushaym se bataya: Humein al-Awwam ne bataya, al-Musayyab ibn Rafi' se: Unhone kaha, Jab unke saamne koi maamla aata jismein Rasulullah ﷺ se koi nishaani na hoti, woh iske liye ekattha hote aur ittefaaq karte, so haqq wahi hai jo unhone dekha, haqq wahi hai jo unhone dekha. Abdullah ne Yazid se bataya, al-Awwam se isi tarah.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ الْحِمْصِيُّ  ، أَنَّ وَهْبَ بْنَ عَمْرٍو الْجُمَحِيَّ   حَدَّثَهُ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" لَا تَعْجَلُوا بِالْبَلِيَّةِ قَبْلَ نُزُولِهَا، فَإِنَّكُمْ إِنْ لَا تَعْجَلُوهَا قَبْلَ نُزُولِهَا، لَا يَنْفَكُّ الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَفِيهِمْ إِذَا هِيَ نَزَلَتْ مَنْ إِذَا قَالَ، وُفِّقَ وَسُدِّدَ، وَإِنَّكُمْ إِنْ تَعْجَلُوهَا، تَخْتَلِفْ بِكُمْ الْأَهْوَاءُ، فَتَأْخُذُوا هَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا، وَأَشَارَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَعَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَعَنْ شِمَالِهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, and Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Abu Salamah al-Himsi, from Wahb ibn Amr al-Jumahi: That the Prophet ﷺ said: Do not hasten to bring trial before it descends, for if you do not hasten it before it descends, the Muslims will not be without someone among them who, when he speaks, is granted success and correctness, and if you hasten it, desires will differ among you, and you will take this way and that, and he gestured before him and to his right and to his left.
24.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan, aur Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se bataya: Humein Abu Salamah al-Himsi ne bataya: ke Wahb ibn Amr al-Jumahi ne unhein bataya, ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, "Museebat ko uske aane se pehle jaldi mat lao, kyunki agar tum isse iske aane se pehle jaldi na lao, Musalmanon mein hamesha koi na koi hoga jo jab bole, use kaamyaabi aur seedhi raah di jaayegi, aur agar tum isse jaldi lao, to khwaahishaat tumhare darmiyan alag ho jaayengi, to tum yeh aur woh raasta apnaaoge," aur unhone apne saamne, apni daayi aur apni baayi taraf ishara kiya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ سُئِلَ عَنْ الْأَمْرِ يَحْدُثُ لَيْسَ فِي كِتَابٍ وَلَا سُنَّةٍ، فَقَالَ :" يَنْظُرُ فِيهِ الْعَابِدُونَ مِنْ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak, from Yahya ibn Hamzah, from Abu Salamah: That the Prophet ﷺ was asked about a matter that arises, not being in a Book nor a sunnah, so he said: The worshippers among the believers will look into it.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak ne Yahya ibn Hamzah se bataya: Mujhse Abu Salamah ne bataya: ke Nabi ﷺ se ek aise maamle ke baare mein poocha gaya jo naya paida ho, na kisi Kitaab mein ho na Sunnat mein, to aapne farmaya: Momino mein se ibaadat karne wale isme gaur karenge.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ ، قَالَ : قَالَ الْقَاسِمُ  :" إِنَّكُمْ لَتَسْأَلُونَ عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ مَا كُنَّا نَسْأَلُ عَنْهَا، وَتُنَقِّرُونَ عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ مَا كُنَّا نُنَقِّرُ عَنْهَا، وَتَسْأَلُونَ عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ مَا أَدْرِي مَا هِيَ، وَلَوْ عَلِمْنَاهَا مَا حَلَّ لَنَا أَنْ نَكْتُمُكُمُوهَا "
24.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Mu'adh ibn Mu'adh, from Ibn Awn: He said: al-Qasim said: You indeed ask about things we never used to ask about, and you scrutinize things we never used to scrutinize, and you ask about things I do not know what they are, and had we known them, it would not have been lawful for us to hide them from you.
24.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Mu'adh ibn Mu'adh se bataya: Humein Ibn Awn ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Al-Qasim ne kaha: Tum aisi cheezon ke baare mein poochte ho jinke baare mein hum kabhi nahi poochte the, aur tum aisi cheezon ki khoj karte ho jinki khoj hum kabhi nahi karte the, aur tum aisi cheezon ke baare mein poochte ho jinke baare mein mujhe nahi maloom kya hain, aur agar hum unhein jaante, to humare liye tumse unhein chhupaana jaayez na hota.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ ابْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ  ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" إِنَّهُ سَيَأْتِي نَاسٌ يُجَادِلُونَكُمْ بِشُبُهَاتِ الْقُرْآنِ، فَخُذُوهُمْ بِالسُّنَنِ، فَإِنَّ أَصْحَابَ السُّنَنِ أَعْلَمُ بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ G "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Umar ibn al-Ashajj, from Umar ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه: He said: People will indeed come who will argue with you using ambiguities of the Qur'an, so take them by [means of] the sunnahs, for the people of the sunnahs are more knowledgeable of the Book of Allah, exalted is He.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhe Yazid ibn Abi Habib ne bataya, Umar ibn al-Ashajj se: ke Umar ibn al-Khattab ne رضي الله عنه kaha: Aage aisa log aayenge jo tumse Quran ki mutashaabih aayaton se jhagda karenge, so unhein sunnaton se pakdo, kyunki sunnaton ke maahir Allah Ta'ala ki Kitaab ko zyada jaante hain.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ هُوَ ابْنُ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ هُوَ ابْنُ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ  ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ  ، قَالَ :" مَا زَالَ أَمْرُ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مُعْتَدِلًا لَيْسَ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ حَتَّى نَشَأَ فِيهِمْ الْمُوَلَّدُونَ، أَبْنَاءُ سَبَايَا الْأُمَمِ، أَبْنَاءُ النِّسَاءِ الَّتِي سَبَتْ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنْ غَيْرِهِمْ، فَقَالُوا فِيهِمْ : بِالرَّأْيِ فَأَضَلُّوهُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali (Ibn Mushir), from Hisham (Ibn Urwah), from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Nawfal, from Urwah ibn al-Zubayr: He said: The affair of Banu Isra'il remained upright with nothing wrong in it, until the mixed-lineage ones grew up among them, sons of captive women from other nations, sons of women whom Banu Isra'il had captured from other than themselves, so they spoke about matters by opinion, and thus led them astray.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali se bataya (Ibn Mushir), Hisham se (Ibn Urwah), Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Nawfal se, Urwah ibn al-Zubayr se: Unhone kaha, Banu Isra'il ka maamla seedha rehta tha isme kuch bhi ghalat nahi tha, yahan tak ke unmein mili-julti nasab wale badhe, doosri qaumon ki qaidi auraton ke bete, unhone jinhein Banu Isra'il ne apne siwa doosron se qaid kiya tha, to unhone maamlon mein apni raay se baat ki, aur unhein gumraah kar diya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْمِنْقَرِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي  ، قَالَ : جَاءَ رَجُلٌ يَوْمًا إِلَى ابْنِ عُمَرَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ شَيْءٍ لَا أَدْرِي مَا هُوَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ ابْنُ عُمَرَ :" لَا تَسْأَلْ عَمَّا لَمْ يَكُنْ، فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ يَلْعَنُ مَنْ سَأَلَ عَمَّا لَمْ يَكُنْ "
24.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Hammad ibn Yazid al-Minqari, from his father: He said: A man came one day to Ibn Umar رضي الله عنهما, and asked him about something I do not know what it was, so Ibn Umar said to him: Do not ask about what has not occurred, for I heard Umar ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه curse whoever asks about what has not occurred.
24.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Hammad ibn Yazid al-Minqari se bataya: Mujhse unke walid ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek din ek aadmi Ibn Umar رضي الله عنهما ke paas aaya, aur unse ek aisi cheez ke baare mein poocha jo mujhe nahi maloom kya thi, to Ibn Umar ne usse kaha: Us cheez ke baare mein na poochho jo abhi hui nahi, kyunki maine Umar ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه ko us shakhs par lanat karte suna jo abhi na hui cheez ke baare mein poochta hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، قَالَ : بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ   رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ كَانَ يَقُولُ إِذَا سُئِلَ عَنْ الْأَمْرِ :" أَكَانَ هَذَا؟ فَإِنْ قَالُوا : نَعَمْ، قَدْ كَانَ، حَدَّثَ فِيهِ بِالَّذِي يَعْلَمُ وَالَّذِي يَرَى، وَإِنْ قَالُوا : لَمْ يَكُنْ، قَالَ : فَذَرُوهُ حَتَّى يَكُونَ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn Nafi', from Shu'ayb, from al-Zuhri: He said: It has reached us that Zayd ibn Thabit al-Ansari رضوان الله عليه used to say, when asked about a matter: Has this happened? So if they said: Yes, it has happened, he would speak about it with what he knew and what he saw fit, and if they said: It has not happened, he would say: Then leave it until it happens.
24.hi: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi' ne Shu'ayb se bataya: Humein al-Zuhri ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Humein khabar mili hai ke Zayd ibn Thabit al-Ansari رضوان الله عليه kaha karte the, jab unse kisi maamle ke baare mein poocha jaata: Kya yeh hua hai? So agar woh kehte: Haan, ho chuka hai, to woh isme apni jaankaari aur apni raay ke mutaabiq baat karte, aur agar woh kehte: Nahi hua, to woh kehte: To ise chhod do jab tak yeh ho na jaaye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو هِشَامٍ الْمَخْزُومِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ عَمَّارُ بْنُ يَاسِرٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْ مَسْأَلَةٍ، فَقَالَ :" هَلْ كَانَ هَذَا بَعْدُ؟، قَالُوا : لَا، قَالَ : دَعُونَا حَتَّى تَكُونَ، فَإِذَا كَانَ، تَجَشَّمْنَاهَا لَكُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Hisham al-Makhzumi, from Wuhayb, from Da'ud, from Amir: He said: Ammar ibn Yasir رضي الله عنه was asked about a matter, so he said: Has this occurred yet? They said, No, he said: Leave us until it happens, and when it happens, we will take it upon ourselves for you.
24.hi: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ne Abu Hisham al-Makhzumi se bataya: Humein Wuhayb ne bataya: Humein Da'ud ne bataya, Amir se: Unhone kaha, Ammar ibn Yasir رضي الله عنه se ek maamle ke baare mein poocha gaya, to unhone kaha: Kya yeh abhi hua hai? Unhone kaha, Nahi, unhone kaha: Humein chhod do jab tak yeh ho jaaye, aur jab yeh ho jaaye, to hum ise tumhare liye uthaayenge.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عُمَرُ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ :" أُحَرِّجُ بِاللَّهِ عَلَى رَجُلٍ سَأَلَ عَمَّا لَمْ يَكُنْ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ بَيَّنَ مَا هُوَ كَائِنٌ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Sufyan, from Amr, from Tawus: He said: Umar رضي الله عنه said on the pulpit: I adjure by Allah any man who asks about what has not occurred, for Allah has indeed made clear what is to occur.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein Amr ne bataya, Tawus se: Unhone kaha, Umar رضي الله عنه ne mimbar par kaha: Main Allah ki qasam deta hoon us aadmi ko jo un cheezon ke baare mein poochta hai jo abhi hui nahi, kyunki Allah ne wazeh kar diya hai jo hoga.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ،  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ :" مَا رَأَيْتُ قَوْمًا كَانُوا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، مَا سَأَلُوهُ إِلَّا عَنْ ثَلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ مَسْأَلَةً حَتَّى قُبِضَ، كُلُّهُنَّ، فِي الْقُرْآنِ مِنْهُنَّ، # يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الشَّهْرِ الْحَرَامِ سورة البقرة آية 217 #، وَ # وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ سورة البقرة آية 222 #، قَالَ : مَا كَانُوا يَسْأَلُونَ إِلَّا عَمَّا يَنْفَعُهُمْ "
