24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Shaybah, from Ibn Fudayl, from Ata, from Sa'id, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: He said: I never saw people better than the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, they did not ask him except thirteen questions until he passed away, all of them in the Qur'an, among them: 'They ask you about the sacred month' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 217], and 'And they ask you about menstruation' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 222], he said: They only used to ask about what benefited them.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Shaybah ne Ibn Fudayl se bataya: Humein Ata ne bataya, Sa'id se, Ibn Abbas se رضي الله عنهما: Unhone kaha, Maine kabhi Rasulullah ﷺ ke sahaba se behtar log nahi dekhe, unhone aapse sirf terah sawaal poochhe yahan tak ke aapka wisaal hua, sab Quran mein hain, unmein se: 'Woh aapse haram mahine ke baare mein poochte hain' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 217], aur 'Aur woh aapse haiz ke baare mein poochte hain' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 222], unhone kaha: Woh sirf usi ke baare mein poochte the jo unhein faida deta.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ عُمَيْرِ بْنِ إِسْحَاق  ، قَالَ :" لَمَنْ أَدْرَكْتُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَكْثَرُ مِمَّنْ سَبَقَنِي مِنْهُمْ، فَمَا رَأَيْتُ قَوْمًا أَيْسَرَ سِيرَةً، وَلَا أَقَلَّ تَشْدِيدًا مِنْهُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Ibn Awn, from Umayr ibn Ishaq: He said: Of those Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ whom I met, more of them came after me than before me, and I never saw any people whose way of life was easier, nor with less strictness, than them.
24.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Ibn Awn se bataya: Humein Umayr ibn Ishaq ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Jin Rasulullah ﷺ ke sahaba se maine mulaqaat ki, unmein se zyada tar mere baad aaye the mere pehle aane walon se, aur maine kabhi koi log nahi dekhe jinka tareeqa-e-zindagi itna aasaan ho, aur jinmein sakhti itni kam ho jitni unmein thi.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنِي الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ L1504 ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ حُبَابٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي رَجَاءُ بْنُ حَيْوَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عُبَادَةَ بْنَ نُسَيٍّ الْكِنْدِيَّ  ، وَسُئِلَ عَنْ امْرَأَةٍ مَاتَتْ مَعَ قَوْمٍ لَيْسَ لَهَا وَلِيٌّ، فَقَالَ :" أَدْرَكْتُ أَقْوَامًا مَا كَانُوا يُشَدِّدُونَ تَشْدِيدَكُمْ، وَلَا يَسْأَلُونَ مَسَائِلَكُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Abbas ibn Sufyan, from Zayd ibn Hubab, from Raja ibn Haywah: He said: I heard Ubadah ibn Nusayy al-Kindi, when he was asked about a woman who died among people who had no guardian for her, say: I met people who did not exercise the strictness you exercise, nor ask the questions you ask.
24.hi: Al-Abbas ibn Sufyan ne Zayd ibn Hubab se bataya: Mujhe Raja ibn Haywah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ubadah ibn Nusayy al-Kindi ko suna, jab unse ek aisi aurat ke baare mein poocha gaya jo aise logon ke darmiyan mari jiska koi waali na tha, unhone kaha: Maine aise log paaye jo woh sakhti nahi karte the jo sakhti tum karte ho, aur na woh sawaal poochte the jo sawaal tum poochte ho.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ ، أَخْبَرَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ حُبَابٍ ، أَخْبَرَنِي رَجَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ الْقُرَشِيِّ ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ مَعَ ابْنِ مُحَيْرِيزٍ، بِمَرْجِ الدِّيبَاجِ فَرَأَيْتُ مِنْهُ خَلْوَةً، فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ مَسْأَلَةٍ، فَقَالَ لِي : مَا تَصْنَعُ بِالْمَسَائِلِ؟، قُلْتُ : " لَوْلَا الْمَسَائِلُ، لَذَهَبَ الْعِلْمُ، قَالَ :" لَا تَقُلْ ذَهَبَ الْعِلْمُ، إِنَّهُ لَا يَذْهَبُ الْعِلْمُ مَا قُرِئَ الْقُرْآنُ، وَلَكِنْ لَوْ قُلْتَ : يَذْهَبُ الْفِقْهُ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Abbas ibn Sufyan, from Zayd ibn Hubab, from Raja ibn Abi Salamah, from Khalid ibn Hazim, from Hisham ibn Muslim al-Qurashi: He said: I was with Ibn Muhayriz at Marj al-Dibaj, and I saw an opportunity when he was alone, so I asked him a question, so he said to me: What do you do with questions? I said: Were it not for questions, knowledge would be gone, he said: Do not say knowledge is gone, indeed knowledge does not go away as long as the Qur'an is recited, but had you said: understanding [fiqh] is going away [that would be right].
24.hi: Al-Abbas ibn Sufyan ne Zayd ibn Hubab se bataya: Mujhe Raja ibn Abi Salamah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhse Khalid ibn Hazim ne bataya, Hisham ibn Muslim al-Qurashi se: Unhone kaha, Main Ibn Muhayriz ke saath Marj al-Dibaj mein tha, to maine dekha ke woh akela hain, to maine unse ek sawaal poocha, to unhone mujhse kaha: Tum sawaalon se kya karte ho? Maine kaha: Agar sawaal na hote, to ilm chala jaata, unhone kaha: Yeh mat kaho ke ilm chala gaya, ilm tab tak nahi jaata jab tak Quran padha jaata hai, lekin agar tum kehte: Fiqh chala jaata hai, [to yeh sahi hota].

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ، إِنَّا لَا نَدْرِي،" لَعَلَّنَا نَأْمُرُكُمْ بِأَشْيَاءَ لَا تَحِلُّ لَكُمْ، وَلَعَلَّنَا نُحَرِّمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَشْيَاءَ هِيَ لَكُمْ حَلَالٌ، إِنَّ آخِرَ مَا نَزَلَ مِنْ الْقُرْآنِ آيَةُ الرِّبَا، وَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَمْ يُبَيِّنْهَا لَنَا حَتَّى مَاتَ، فَدَعُوا مَا يَرِيبُكُمْ إِلَى مَا لَا يَرِيبُكُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Da'ud, from al-Sha'bi, that Umar رضي الله عنه: He said: O people, we do not know, perhaps we may command you with things that are not lawful for you, and perhaps we may forbid you things that are lawful for you, the last thing revealed of the Qur'an was the verse of usury, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not explain it to us before he died, so leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt.
24.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se bataya: Humein Da'ud ne bataya, al-Sha'bi se: ke Umar رضي الله عنه ne kaha: Ae logo, hum nahi jaante, shaayad hum tumhein aisi cheezon ka hukum dein jo tumhare liye jaayez na hon, aur shaayad hum tumpar aisi cheezein haraam kar dein jo tumhare liye halal hon, Quran mein sabse aakhri jo nazil hui woh sood ki aayat thi, aur Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein isay wazeh nahi kiya apni maut se pehle, so jo tumhein shak mein daale usay chhod do us cheez ke liye jo tumhein shak mein na daale.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَلْمُ بْنُ جُنَادَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ  ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ  ، قَالَ :" خَرَجْتُ مِنْ عِنْدِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، فَاسْتَقْبَلَنِي حَمَّادٌ، فَحَمَّلَنِي ثَمَانِيَةَ أَبْوَابٍ، مَسَائِلَ، فَسَأَلْتُهُ، فَأَجَابَنِي عَنْ أَرْبَعٍ وَتَرَكَ أَرْبَعًا "
24.en: Narrated by Salm ibn Junadah, from Ibn Idris, from his uncle: He said: I left Ibrahim's presence, so Hammad met me, and burdened me with eight matters, questions, so I asked him about them, and he answered me about four and left four.
24.hi: Salm ibn Junadah ne Ibn Idris se bataya: Humein unke chacha ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Ibrahim ke paas se nikla, to Hammad mujhse mila, to unhone mujhpar aath maamlon, sawaalon, ka bojh daala, to maine unse poocha, to unhone chaar ka jawaab diya aur chaar chhod diye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا قَبِيصَةُ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبْجَرَ  ، عَنْ زُبَيْدٍ  ، قَالَ :" مَا سَأَلْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ شَيْءٍ إِلَّا عَرَفْتُ الْكَرَاهِيَةَ فِي وَجْهِهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Qabisah, from Sufyan, from Abd al-Malik ibn Abjar, from Zubayd: He said: I never asked Ibrahim about anything except that I recognized dislike on his face.
24.hi: Qabisah ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein Abd al-Malik ibn Abjar ne bataya, Zubayd se: Unhone kaha, Maine kabhi Ibrahim se kuch nahi poocha magar maine unke chehre par na-pasandeedgi pehchaani.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ  ، قَالَ :" مَا رَأَيْتُ أَحَدًا أَكْثَرَ أَنْ يَقُولَ إِذَا سُئِلَ عَنْ شَيْءٍ : لَا عِلْمَ لِي بِهِ مِنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ   "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ishaq ibn Mansur, from Umar ibn Abi Za'idah: He said: I never saw anyone who said more often, when asked about something: I have no knowledge of it, than al-Sha'bi.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ne Ishaq ibn Mansur se bataya: Humein Umar ibn Abi Za'idah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine kabhi kisi ko itni zyada baar yeh kehte nahi dekha, jab unse kisi cheez ke baare mein poocha jaata: Mujhe iska ilm nahi, jitna al-Sha'bi kehte the.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُهُ يَذْكُرُ ، قَالَ : كَانَ الشَّعْبِيُّ  إِذَا جَاءَهُ شَيْءٌ اتَّقَى، وَكَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ   يَقُولُ، وَيَقُولُ، وَيَقُولُ، قَالَ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ :" كَانَ الشَّعْبِيُّ فِي هَذَا أَحْسَنَ حَالًا عِنْدَ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ مِنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Awn: He said: I heard him mention: He said: al-Sha'bi, when something came to him, was cautious, and Ibrahim would say, and say, and say. Abu Asim said: al-Sha'bi was, in this, in a better state to Ibn Awn than Ibrahim.
24.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Awn se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine unhein zikr karte suna: Unhone kaha, Al-Sha'bi, jab unke paas koi cheez aati, woh ehtiyaat karte, aur Ibrahim kehte, aur kehte, aur kehte. Abu Asim kehte hain: Al-Sha'bi, isme, Ibn Awn ke nazdeek Ibrahim se behtar haalat mein the.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ إِيَاسٍ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِسَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ   : مَا لَكَ لَا تَقُولُ فِي الطَّلَاقِ شَيْئًا؟، قَالَ :" مَا مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ إِلَّا قَدْ سَأَلْتُ عَنْهُ، وَلَكِنِّي أَكْرَهُ أَنْ أُحِلَّ حَرَامًا، أَوْ أُحَرِّمَ حَلَالًا "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Ahmad ibn Bashir, from Shu'bah, from Ja'far ibn Iyas: He said: I said to Sa'id ibn Jubayr: Why do you not say anything about divorce? He said: There is nothing about it that I have not been asked about, but I dislike making the unlawful lawful, or making the lawful unlawful.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Ahmad ibn Bashir se bataya: Humein Shu'bah ne bataya, Ja'far ibn Iyas se: Unhone kaha, Maine Sa'id ibn Jubayr se kaha: Aap talaq ke baare mein kuch kyun nahi kehte? Unhone kaha: Isme aisa kuch nahi jo mujhse na poocha gaya ho, lekin mujhe na-pasand hai ke main haraam ko halal karun, ya halal ko haraam karun.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى  ، يَقُولُ :" لَقَدْ أَدْرَكْتُ فِي هَذَا الْمَسْجِدِ عِشْرِينَ وَمِائَةً مِنْ الْأَنْصَارِ، وَمَا مِنْهُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ يُحَدِّثُ بِحَدِيثٍ إِلَّا وَدَّ أَنَّ أَخَاهُ كَفَاهُ الْحَدِيثَ، وَلَا يُسْأَلُ عَنْ فُتْيَا إِلَّا وَدَّ أَنَّ أَخَاهُ كَفَاهُ الْفُتْيَا "
24.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib: He said: I heard Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla say: I met one hundred and twenty of the Ansar in this mosque, and there was not one of them who narrated a hadith except that he wished his brother would suffice him from narrating it, nor was any of them asked for a religious ruling except that he wished his brother would suffice him from giving the ruling.
24.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein Ata ibn al-Sa'ib ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla ko kehte suna: Maine is masjid mein Ansar mein se ek sau bees se mulaqaat ki, aur unmein se koi bhi aisa nahi tha jo koi hadith bayaan kare magar woh chaahta ke uska bhai use hadith bayaan karne se kaafi kar de, aur unmein se koi bhi aisa nahi tha jise koi fatwa ke liye poocha jaata magar woh chaahta ke uska bhai use fatwa dene se kaafi kar de.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ الصَّفَّارُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ  ، كَيْفَ كُنْتُمْ تَصْنَعُونَ إِذَا سُئِلْتُمْ؟، قَالَ :" عَلَى الْخَبِيرِ وَقَعْتَ، كَانَ إِذَا سُئِلَ الرَّجُلُ، قَالَ لِصَاحِبِهِ : أَفْتِهِمْ، فَلَا يَزَالُ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ إِلَى الْأَوَّلِ "
24.en: Narrated by Yusuf ibn Ya'qub al-Saffar, from Abu Bakr, from Da'ud: He said: I asked al-Sha'bi: How did you all used to do when you were asked? He said: You have come upon the expert, when a man was asked, he would say to his companion: Give them a ruling, and it would keep going until it returned to the first one.
24.hi: Yusuf ibn Ya'qub al-Saffar ne Abu Bakr se bataya: Humein Da'ud ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Sha'bi se poocha: Aap log jab poochha jaata to kya karte the? Unhone kaha: Aap maahir se milen hain, jab aadmi se poocha jaata, woh apne saathi se kehta: Unhein fatwa do, aur yeh chalta rehta yahan tak ke pehle wale ke paas laut aata.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَجَّاجِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ  ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ الْعَالِمَ يَدْخُلُ فِيمَا بَيْنَ اللَّهِ وَبَيْنَ عِبَادِهِ، فَلْيَطْلُبْ لِنَفْسِهِ الْمَخْرَجَ "
24.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn al-Hajjaj: He said: I heard Sufyan, from Ibn al-Munkadir, say: The scholar enters between Allah and His servants, so let him seek a way out for himself.
24.hi: Ahmad ibn al-Hajjaj ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Sufyan ko suna, Ibn al-Munkadir se: Aalim Allah aur uske bandon ke darmiyan dakhil hota hai, so use apne liye raasta talaash karna chaahiye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ قُدَامَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ  ،  عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْرَجَ إِلَيَّ مَعْنُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  كِتَابًا، فَحَلَفَ لِي بِاللَّهِ أَنَّهُ خَطُّ أَبِيه  ، فَإِذَا فِيهِ : قَال عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   :" وَالَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ مَا رَأَيْتُ أَحَدًا كَانَ أَشَدَّ عَلَى الْمُتَنَطِّعِينَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَمَا رَأَيْتُ أَحَدًا كَانَ أَشَدَّ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، وَإِنِّي لَأَرَى عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ كَانَ أَشَدَّ خَوْفًا عَلَيْهِمْ أَوْ لَهُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Qudamah, from Abu Usamah, from Mis'ar: He said: Ma'n ibn Abd al-Rahman brought out a letter to me, and swore to me by Allah that it was in his father's handwriting, so in it: Abdullah said: By the One besides whom there is no god, I never saw anyone more severe against the excessively meticulous ones than the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I never saw anyone more severe against them than Abu Bakr رضي الله عنه, and I indeed see Umar رضي الله عنه as more fearful for them or on their behalf.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Qudamah ne Abu Usamah se bataya: Humein Mis'ar ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Ma'n ibn Abd al-Rahman ne mere saamne ek khat nikaala, aur mujhse Allah ki qasam khaayi ke yeh unke walid ki likhaai hai, to usme tha: Abdullah ne kaha: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, maine kabhi kisi ko had se zyada baareek-bini karne walon par Rasulullah ﷺ se zyada sakht nahi dekha, aur maine kabhi kisi ko unpar Abu Bakr رضي الله عنه se zyada sakht nahi dekha, aur main dekhta hoon ke Umar رضي الله عنه unke liye ya unke baare mein zyada khaufzada the.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زَمْعَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ حَاضِرٍ الْأَزْدِيِّ  ، قَالَ : دَخَلْتُ عَلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، فَقُلْتُ : أَوْصِنِي، فَقَالَ : نَعَمْ،" عَلَيْكَ بِتَقْوَى اللَّهِ، وَالِاسْتِقَامَةِ، اتَّبِعْ وَلَا تَبْتَدِعْ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Zam'ah ibn Salih, from Uthman ibn Hadir al-Azdi: He said: I entered upon Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه, and said: Advise me, so he said: Yes, hold to fear of Allah, and steadfastness, follow and do not innovate.
24.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Zam'ah ibn Salih se bataya: Humein Uthman ibn Hadir al-Azdi ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه ke paas gaya, aur kaha: Mujhe naseehat dijiye, to unhone kaha: Haan, Allah ke khauf ko, aur sthirta ko pakdo, pairwi karo aur bidat mat nikalo.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ بن جابر ، أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ ، قَالَ :" كَانُوا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّهُ عَلَى الطَّرِيقِ مَا كَانَ عَلَى الْأَثَرِ "
24.en: Narrated by Makhlad ibn Malik ibn Jabir, from al-Nadr ibn Shumayl, from Ibn Awn, from Ibn Sirin: He said: They used to hold that whoever stayed on the trace, was on the path.
24.hi: Makhlad ibn Malik ibn Jabir ne al-Nadr ibn Shumayl se bataya: Humein Ibn Awn ne bataya, Ibn Sirin se: Unhone kaha, Woh maanate the ke jo bhi nishaan par rahaa, woh raaste par hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا أَزْهَرُ ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ ، قَالَ :" مَا دَامَ عَلَى الْأَثَرِ، فَهُوَ عَلَى الطَّرِيقِ "
24.en: Narrated by Yusuf ibn Musa, from Azhar, from Ibn Awn, from Ibn Sirin: He said: As long as he is on the trace, he is on the path.
24.hi: Yusuf ibn Musa ne Azhar se bataya: Humein Ibn Awn ne bataya, Ibn Sirin se: Unhone kaha, Jab tak woh nishaan par hai, woh raaste par hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ :" تَعَلَّمُوا الْعِلْمَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْبَضَ، وَقَبْضُهُ أَنْ يَذْهَبَ أَهْلُهُ، أَلَا وَإِيَّاكُمْ، وَالتَّنَطُّعَ، وَالتَّعَمُّقَ، وَالْبِدَعَ، وَعَلَيْكُمْ بِالْعَتِيقِ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Abu Qilabah: He said: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه said: Learn knowledge before it is taken away, and its being taken away is that its people go away, listen, and beware of excessive meticulousness, and delving too deep, and innovations, and hold to what is ancient/established.
24.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se bataya: Humein Yahya ibn Abi Kathir ne bataya, Abu Qilabah se: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه ne kaha: Ilm seekho isse pehle ke yeh utha liya jaaye, aur iska utha liya jaana yeh hai ke iske log chale jaayein, sun lo, aur had se zyada baareek-bini se, aur zyada gehraai mein jaane se, aur bidaton se bacho, aur us par qaayam raho jo purana aur qaayam-shuda hai.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، وَأَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ :" عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْعِلْمِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْبَضَ، وَقَبْضُهُ أَنْ يُذْهَبَ بِأَصْحَابِهِ، عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْعِلْمِ، فَإِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ لَا يَدْرِي مَتَى يُفْتَقَرُ إِلَيْهِ أَوْ يُفْتَقَرُ إِلَى مَا عِنْدَهُ، إِنَّكُمْ سَتَجِدُونَ أَقْوَامًا يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يَدْعُونَكُمْ إِلَى كِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَقَدْ نَبَذُوهُ وَرَاءَ ظُهُورِهِمْ، فَعَلَيْكُمْ بِالْعِلْمِ، وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَالتَّبَدُّعَ، وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَالتَّنَطُّعَ، وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَالتَّعَمُّقَ، وَعَلَيْكُمْ بِالْعَتِيقِ "
24.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, and Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah: He said: Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه said: Hold to knowledge before it is taken away, and its being taken away is that its people are taken away, hold to knowledge, for indeed one of you does not know when he will need it or need what he has, you will indeed find people who claim they call you to the Book of Allah while they have discarded it behind their backs, so hold to knowledge, and beware of innovation, and beware of excessive meticulousness, and beware of delving too deep, and hold to what is ancient/established.
24.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb, aur Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Ayyub ne bataya, Abu Qilabah se: Unhone kaha, Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه ne kaha: Ilm ko pakdo isse pehle ke yeh utha liya jaaye, aur iska utha liya jaana yeh hai ke iske log utha liye jaayein, ilm ko pakdo, kyunki tum mein se koi nahi jaanta kab usse zaroorat pade, ya jo uske paas hai usse zaroorat pade, tum aise log paaoge jo dawa karenge ke woh tumhein Allah ki Kitaab ki taraf bulaate hain jabke unhone isse apni peeth ke peechhe phenk diya hai, so ilm ko pakdo, aur bidat se bacho, aur had se zyada baareek-bini se bacho, aur zyada gehraai mein jaane se bacho, aur us par qaayam raho jo purana aur qaayam-shuda hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا يُقَالُ لَهُ : صَبِيغٌ قَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ فَجَعَلَ يَسْأَلُ عَنْ مُتَشَابِهِ الْقُرْآنِ، فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ عُمَرُ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ وَقَدْ أَعَدَّ لَهُ عَرَاجِينَ النَّخْلِ، فَقَالَ :" مَنْ أَنْتَ؟، قَالَ : أَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ صَبِيغٌ، فَأَخَذَ عُمَرُ عُرْجُونًا مِنْ تِلْكَ الْعَرَاجِينِ، فَضَرَبَهُ وَقَالَ : أَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عُمَرُ فَجَعَلَ لَهُ ضَرْبًا حَتَّى دَمِيَ رَأْسُهُ، فَقَالَ : يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، حَسْبُكَ، قَدْ ذَهَبَ الَّذِي كُنْتُ أَجِدُ فِي رَأْسِي "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Yazid ibn Hazim, from Sulayman ibn Yasar: That a man called Sabigh came to Madinah and began asking about the ambiguous parts of the Qur'an, so Umar رضي الله عنه sent for him, having prepared palm-branch stalks for him, and said: Who are you? He said: I am the servant of Allah, Sabigh, so Umar took a stalk from those stalks, and struck him, and said: I am the servant of Allah, Umar, and he struck him repeatedly until his head bled, so he said: O Commander of the Believers, enough for you, what I used to feel in my head has indeed gone.
24.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Yazid ibn Hazim ne bataya, Sulayman ibn Yasar se: ke ek aadmi jise Sabigh kaha jaata tha Madinah aaya aur Quran ke mutashaabih hisson ke baare mein poochne laga, to Umar رضي الله عنه ne uske paas bheja, aur uske liye khajoor ki daaliyaan taiyaar rakhi thi, aur poocha: Tum kaun ho? Usne kaha: Main Allah ka banda, Sabigh, hoon, to Umar ne un daaliyon mein se ek li, aur usay maara, aur kaha: Main Allah ka banda, Umar, hoon, aur unhone usay itna maara ke uska sar khoon se lath-path ho gaya, to usne kaha: Ae Ameer-ul-Mumineen, aapke liye kaafi hai, jo mujhe apne sar mein mehsoos ho raha tha woh chala gaya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، وَيَزِيدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ  ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا، قَالَتْ : تَلَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : # هُوَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ مِنْهُ آيَاتٌ مُحْكَمَاتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ الْكِتَابِ وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَابِهَاتٌ سورة آل عمران آية 7 # فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ الَّذِينَ يَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَابَهَ مِنْهُ، فَاحْذَرُوهُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi, from Hammad ibn Salamah, and Yazid ibn Ibrahim, from Abdullah ibn Abi Mulaykah, from al-Qasim, from Aisha رضي الله عنها: She said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited: 'It is He who has sent down to you the Book; in it are verses that are precise, they are the foundation of the Book, and others that are ambiguous' [Surah Ali Imran, verse 7], so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: When you see those who follow what is ambiguous of it, then beware of them.
24.hi: Abu al-Walid al-Tayalisi ne Hammad ibn Salamah, aur Yazid ibn Ibrahim se bataya: Humein Abdullah ibn Abi Mulaykah ne bataya, al-Qasim se, Aisha se رضي الله عنها: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne padha: 'Woh hi hai jisne tumpar Kitaab nazil ki, isme kuch aayaten mohkam (saaf) hain, woh Kitaab ki buniyaad hain, aur baaki mutashaabih' [Surah Aal-e-Imran, aayat 7], to Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: Jab tum unhein dekho jo isme se mutashaabih ki pairwi karte hain, to unse bacho.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ  ، قَالَ : سُئِلَ عَبْدُ اللَّه   عَنْ شَيْءٍ، فَقَالَ :" إِنِّي لَأَكْرَهُ أَنْ أُحِلَّ لَكَ شَيْئًا حَرَّمَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ، أَوْ أُحَرِّمَ مَا أَحَلَّهُ اللَّهُ لَكَ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Hafs, from al-A'mash, from Shaqiq: He said: Abdullah was asked about something, so he said: I dislike making lawful for you something Allah has forbidden you, or making unlawful what Allah has made lawful for you.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Muhammad ne Hafs se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya, Shaqiq se: Unhone kaha, Abdullah se ek cheez ke baare mein poocha gaya, to unhone kaha: Mujhe na-pasand hai ke main tumhare liye woh cheez halal karun jo Allah ne tumpar haraam ki ho, ya woh haraam karun jo Allah ne tumhare liye halal ki ho.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق الْفَزَارِيِّ ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ ،  عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، قَالَ :" لَأَنْ أَرُدَّهُ بِعِيِّهِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أَتَكَلَّفَ لَهُ مَا لَا أَعْلَمُ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Abu Ishaq al-Fazari, from Ibn Awn, from Ibn Sirin, from Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman: He said: For me to reject it with my own inability [to answer] is more beloved to me than that I put myself through what I do not know.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Abu Ishaq al-Fazari se bataya: Humein Ibn Awn ne bataya, Ibn Sirin se, Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman se: Unhone kaha, Mujhe isse inkaar karna apni na-taaqti ke saath, isse zyada pasand hai ke main apne aap ko us cheez ki taklif dun jo mujhe nahi maloom.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ عَجْلَانَ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  مَوْلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ صَبِيغًا الْعِرَاقِيَّ، جَعَلَ يَسْأَلُ عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ مِنْ الْقُرْآنِ فِي أَجْنَادِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ حَتَّى قَدِمَ مِصْرَ ، فَبَعَثَ بِهِ عَمْرُو بْنُ الْعَاصِ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، فَلَمَّا أَتَاهُ الرَّسُولُ بِالْكِتَابِ فَقَرَأَهُ، فَقَالَ : أَيْنَ الرَّجُلُ؟، قَالَ : فِي الرَّحْلِ، قَالَ عُمَرُ :" أَبْصِرْ أَنْ يَكُونُ ذَهَبَ فَتُصِيبَكَ مِنِّي بِهِ الْعُقُوبَةُ الْمُوجِعَةُ، فَأَتَاهُ بِهِ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ : تَسْأَلُ مُحْدَثَةً، فَأَرْسَلَ عُمَرُ إِلَى رَطَائِبَ مِنْ جَرِيدٍ، فَضَرَبَهُ بِهَا حَتَّى تَرَكَ ظَهْرَهُ دَبِرَةً، ثُمَّ تَرَكَهُ حَتَّى بَرَأَ، ثُمَّ عَادَ لَهُ، ثُمَّ تَرَكَهُ حَتَّى بَرَأَ، فَدَعَا بِهِ لِيَعُودَ لَهُ، قَالَ : فَقَالَ صَبِيغٌ : إِنْ كُنْتَ تُرِيدُ قَتْلِي، فَاقْتُلْنِي قَتْلًا جَمِيلًا، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُدَاوِيَنِي، فَقَدْ وَاللَّهِ بَرِئْتُ، فَأَذِنَ لَهُ إِلَى أَرْضِهِ، وَكَتَبَ إِلَى أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، أَنْ لَا يُجَالِسَهُ أَحَدٌ مِنْ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، فَاشْتَدَّ ذَلِكَ عَلَى الرَّجُلِ، فَكَتَبَ أَبُو مُوسَى إِلَى عُمَرَ : أَنْ قَدْ حَسُنَتْ تَوْبَتُهُ، فَكَتَبَ عُمَرُ : أَنْ ائْذَنْ لِلنَّاسِ بِمُجَالَسَتِهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Ibn Ajlan, from Nafi', freed servant of Abdullah: That Sabigh al-Iraqi began asking about things from the Qur'an among the Muslim army camps, until he reached Egypt, so Amr ibn al-As رضي الله عنه sent him to Umar ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه, so when the messenger brought him the letter and he read it, he said: Where is the man? He said: In the caravan luggage, Umar said: Watch out, lest he has gone off, and you will receive from me a painful punishment for it, so he brought him to him, so Umar said: You ask about a newly-invented thing, and Umar sent for some fresh palm branches, and struck him with them until his back was left wounded, then left him until he healed, then returned to him, then left him until he healed, so he called for him to return to him, he said: So Sabigh said: If you intend to kill me, then kill me in a decent manner, and if you intend to treat me, then by Allah, I have indeed recovered, so he permitted him to go to his land, and wrote to Abu Musa al-Ash'ari رضي الله عنه that no Muslim should sit with him, so that became severe on the man, so Abu Musa wrote to Umar: That his repentance had become good, so Umar wrote: Permit the people to sit with him.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhe Ibn Ajlan ne bataya, Nafi' se (Abdullah ke azaad kiye hue ghulam): ke Sabigh al-Iraqi Musalman lashkaron mein Quran se cheezon ke baare mein poochne laga, yahan tak ke woh Misr pahuncha, to Amr ibn al-As رضي الله عنه ne usay Umar ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه ke paas bheja, to jab qaasid unke paas khat laaya aur unhone usay padha, unhone poocha: Aadmi kahan hai? Usne kaha: Saaman mein, Umar ne kaha: Dekho kahin woh chala na gaya ho, warna tumhein mujhse iski takleef-deh saza milegi, to woh usay unke paas laaya, to Umar ne kaha: Tum naye niklay maamle ke baare mein poochte ho, aur Umar ne kuch taazi khajoor ki daaliyon ke liye bheja, aur unse usay maara yahan tak ke uski peeth zakhmi ho gayi, fir usay chhod diya jab tak woh theek ho gaya, fir dobara aisa kiya, fir usay chhod diya jab tak woh theek ho gaya, to unhone usay bulaaya taake dobara aisa karein, unhone bataya: To Sabigh ne kaha: Agar aap mujhe qatal karna chaahte hain, to mujhe achhe tareeke se qatal karein, aur agar aap mera ilaaj karna chaahte hain, to Allah ki qasam, main theek ho chuka hoon, to unhone usay apni zameen jaane ki ijaazat di, aur Abu Musa al-Ash'ari رضي الله عنه ko likha ke koi Musalman uske saath na baithe, to yeh us aadmi ke liye sakht ho gaya, to Abu Musa ne Umar ko likha: ke uski tauba achhi ho gayi hai, to Umar ne likha: Logon ko uske saath baithne ki ijaazat do.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَامِرًا  ، يَقُولُ : اسْتَفْتَى رَجُلٌ أُبَيَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ  ، فَقَالَ : يَا أَبَا الْمُنْذِرِ، مَا تَقُولُ فِي كَذَا وَكَذَا؟، قَالَ : يَا بُنَيَّ، أَكَانَ الَّذِي سَأَلْتَنِي عَنْهُ؟، قَالَ : لَا، قَالَ :" أَمَّا لَا، فَأَجِّلْنِي حَتَّى يَكُونَ، فَنُعَالِجَ أَنْفُسَنَا حَتَّى نُخْبِرَكَ "
24.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Yunus, from Zuhayr, from Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid: He said: I heard Amir say: A man sought a ruling from Ubayy ibn Ka'b, and said: O Abu al-Mundhir, what do you say about such-and-such? He said: My son, has that which you asked me about occurred? He said, No, he said: If not, then give me time until it occurs, so we may work on ourselves until we can inform you.
24.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Yunus ne Zuhayr se bataya: Humein Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Amir ko kehte suna: Ek aadmi ne Ubayy ibn Ka'b se fatwa maanga, aur kaha: Ae Abu al-Mundhir, aap fulaan-fulaan ke baare mein kya kehte hain? Unhone kaha: Mere bete, kya jiske baare mein tumne mujhse poocha woh hua hai? Usne kaha, Nahi, unhone kaha: Agar nahi, to mujhe muhlat do jab tak yeh ho jaaye, taake hum apne aap par mehnat karein jab tak hum tumhein bataa sakein.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنَا عَنْ فِرَاسٍ  ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ أَمْشِي مَعَ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، فَقَالَ فَتًى : مَا تَقُولُ يَا عَمَّاهُ فِي كَذَا وَكَذَا؟، قَالَ : يَا ابْنَ أَخِي، أَكَانَ هَذَا؟، قَالَ : لَا، قَالَ :" فَأَعْفِنَا حَتَّى يَكُونَ "
24.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hammad, from Abu Awanah, from Firas, from Amir, from Masruq: He said: I was walking with Ubayy ibn Ka'b رضي الله عنه, so a young man said: What do you say, O my uncle, about such-and-such? He said: O son of my brother, has this happened? He said, No, he said: Then excuse us until it happens.
24.hi: Yahya ibn Hammad ne Abu Awanah se bataya: Humein Firas ne bataya, Amir se, Masruq se: Unhone kaha, Main Ubayy ibn Ka'b رضي الله عنه ke saath chal raha tha, to ek jawaan ladke ne poocha: Aap fulaan-fulaan ke baare mein kya kehte hain, Ae mere chacha? Unhone kaha: Ae mere bhai ke bete, kya yeh hua hai? Usne kaha, Nahi, unhone kaha: To humein muaaf karo jab tak yeh ho jaaye.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ ، قَالَ :" كَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ  إِذَا سُئِلَ عَنْ شَيْءٍ لَمْ يُجِبْ فِيهِ إِلَّا جَوَابَ الَّذِي سُئِلَ عَنْهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Usamah, from al-A'mash: He said: Ibrahim, when asked about something, would only answer the exact question he was asked about.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Usamah se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Ibrahim, jab unse kisi cheez ke baare mein poocha jaata, sirf usi sawaal ka jawaab dete the jo poocha gaya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ ، عَنْ وُهَيْبٍ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ  " أَنَّهُ كَانَلَا يُفْتِي فِي الْفَرْجِ بِشَيْءٍ فِيهِ اخْتِلَافٌ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Husayn ibn Mansur, from al-Husayn ibn al-Walid, from Wuhayb, from Hisham, from Muhammad ibn Sirin: That he would not give a ruling about the private parts on anything on which there was dispute.
24.hi: Al-Husayn ibn Mansur ne al-Husayn ibn al-Walid se bataya: Humein Wuhayb ne bataya, Hisham se, Muhammad ibn Sirin se: ke woh sharamgah ke maamlon mein kisi bhi aisi cheez ka fatwa nahi dete the jismein ikhtilaaf ho.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الصَّلْتُ بْنُ رَاشِدٍ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ طَاوُسًا  عَنْ مَسْأَلَةٍ، فَقَالَ لِي : كَانَ هَذَا؟، قُلْتُ : نَعَمْ، قَالَ : آللَّهِ، قُلْتُ : آللَّهِ، ثُمّ قَالَ : إِنَّ أَصْحَابَنَا  أَخْبَرُونَا عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : " يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ،لَا تَعْجَلُوا بِالْبَلَاءِ قَبْلَ نُزُولِهِ، فَيُذْهَبُ بِكُمْ هَهُنَا وَهَهُنَا، فَإِنَّكُمْ إِنْ لَمْ تَعْجَلُوا بِالْبَلَاءِ قَبْلَ نُزُولِهِ، لَمْ يَنْفَكَّ الْمُسْلِمُونَ أَنْ يَكُونَ فِيهِمْ مَنْ إِذَا سُئِلَ، سُدَّدَ، وَإِذَا قَالَ، وُفِّقَ "
24.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from al-Salt ibn Rashid: He said: I asked Tawus about a matter, so he said to me: Has this happened? I said: Yes, he said: By Allah? I said: By Allah, then he said: Our companions informed us, from Mu'adh ibn Jabal رضي الله عنه, that he said: O people, do not hasten trial before it descends, so it takes you here and there, for if you do not hasten trial before it descends, the Muslims will not lack someone among them who, when asked, is guided rightly, and when he speaks, is granted success.
24.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein al-Salt ibn Rashid ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Tawus se ek maamle ke baare mein poocha, to unhone mujhse kaha: Kya yeh hua hai? Maine kaha: Haan, unhone poocha: Allah ki qasam? Maine kaha: Allah ki qasam, fir unhone kaha: Humare sathiyon ne humein bataaya, Mu'adh ibn Jabal رضي الله عنه se, ke unhone kaha: Ae logo, museebat ko uske aane se pehle jaldi mat lao, so yeh tumhein yahan aur wahan le jaayega, kyunki agar tum museebat ko uske aane se pehle jaldi na lao, Musalmanon mein hamesha koi na koi hoga jo jab poocha jaaye, seedhi raah dikhaaya jaaye, aur jab bole, kaamyaabi paaye.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَدْرَكَهُ رَمَضَانَانِ، فَقَالَ : أَكَانَ أَوْ لَمْ يَكُنْ؟، قَالَ : لَمْ يَكُنْ بَعْدُ، فَقَالَ : اتْرُكْ بَلِيَّتَهُ حَتَّى تَنْزِلَ، قَالَ : فَدَلَسْنَا لَهُ رَجُلًا، فَقَالَ : قَدْ كَانَ، فَقَالَ" يُطْعِمُ عَنْ الْأَوَّلِ مِنْهُمَا ثَلَاثِينَ مِسْكِينًا، لِكُلِّ يَوْمٍ مِسْكِينٌ "
24.en: Narrated by Bishr ibn al-Hakam, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Amr ibn Maymun, from his father, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: He said: I asked him about a man overtaken by two Ramadans [without making up a missed fast], so he said: Has this happened or not? He said: Not yet, so he said: Leave your affliction until it descends, he said: So we tricked him with a man [claiming it had happened], so he said: It has indeed happened, so he said: He feeds thirty poor people for the first of the two, one poor person for each day.
24.hi: Bishr ibn al-Hakam ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se bataya: Humein Amr ibn Maymun ne bataya, apne walid se, Ibn Abbas se رضي الله عنهما: Unhone kaha, Maine unse ek aise aadmi ke baare mein poocha jispar do Ramzaan aa gaye [chhoota rozah poora kiye bagair], to unhone kaha: Kya yeh hua hai ya nahi? Unhone kaha: Abhi nahi, to unhone kaha: Apni museebat ko chhod do jab tak yeh utar jaaye, unhone bataya: To humne ek aadmi ke zariye unhein dhoka diya [ke yeh ho chuka], to unhone kaha: Yeh ho chuka hai, to unhone kaha: Woh do mein se pehle ke liye tees miskeeno ko khilaaye, har din ek miskeen.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْعُمَرِيُّ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ أَجْلِسُ بِمَكَّةَ إِلَى ابْنِ عُمَرَ   يَوْمًا، وَإِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاس رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا يَوْمًا، فَمَا يَقُولُ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فِيمَا يُسْأَلُ" لَا عِلْمَ لِي، أَكْثَرُ مِمَّا يُفْتِي بِهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Imran, from Ishaq ibn Sulayman, from al-Umari, from Ubayd ibn Jurayj: He said: I used to sit in Makkah with Ibn Umar one day, and with Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما another day, and Ibn Umar, when asked, said more often: I have no knowledge, than he gave rulings.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Imran ne Ishaq ibn Sulayman se bataya: Humein al-Umari ne bataya, Ubayd ibn Jurayj se: Unhone kaha, Main Makkah mein ek din Ibn Umar ke saath baithta tha, aur ek din Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما ke saath, aur Ibn Umar, jab unse poocha jaata, zyada kehte: Mujhe ilm nahi, is se zyada ke woh fatwa dete.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   :" تَعَلَّمُوا، فَإِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ لَا يَدْرِي مَتَى يُخْتَلفُ إِلَيْهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from al-A'mash, from Abu Wa'il: He said: Abdullah said: Learn, for none of you knows when he will be needed [and sought out for knowledge].
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya, Abu Wa'il se: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ne kaha: Seekho, kyunki tum mein se koi nahi jaanta kab uski zaroorat padegi [aur uske paas ilm ke liye aaya jaayega].

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ  ،  عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" أَجْرَؤُكُمْ عَلَى الْفُتْيَا، أَجْرَؤُكُمْ عَلَى النَّارِ "
24.en: Narrated by Ibrahim ibn Musa, from Ibn al-Mubarak, from Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub, from Ubaydullah ibn Abi Ja'far: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: The most daring of you in giving religious rulings, is the most daring of you toward the Fire.
24.hi: Ibrahim ibn Musa ne Ibn al-Mubarak se bataya: Humein Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub ne bataya, Ubaydullah ibn Abi Ja'far se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Tum mein sabse zyada betaab jo fatwa dene mein hai, woh tum mein Jahannam ki taraf sabse zyada betaab hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدَةَ بْنِ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" مَنْ أَحْدَثَ رَأْيًا لَيْسَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ، وَلَمْ تَمْضِ بِهِ سُنَّةٌ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، لَمْ يَدْرِ عَلَى مَا هُوَ مِنْهُ إِذَا لَقِيَ اللَّهَ G "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from Abdah ibn Abi Lubabah, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه: He said: Whoever introduces an opinion that is not in the Book of Allah, and no sunnah from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has passed with it, does not know what state he is in when he meets Allah, exalted is He.
24.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se bataya: Humein Abdah ibn Abi Lubabah ne bataya, Ibn Abbas se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Jo koi aisi raay nikaale jo Allah ki Kitaab mein na ho, aur na hi usse Rasulullah ﷺ ki koi sunnat guzri ho, woh nahi jaanta ke jab woh Allah Ta'ala se milega to woh kis haal mein hoga.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي بَكْرُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الْمَعَافِرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" مَنْ أُفْتِيَ بِفُتْيَا مِنْ غَيْرِ ثَبْتٍ فَإِنَّمَا إِثْمُهُ عَلَى مَنْ أَفْتَاهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Yazid, from Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub, from Bakr ibn Amr al-Ma'afiri, from Abu Uthman Muslim ibn Yasar, from Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: Whoever is given a religious ruling without a firm basis, its sin is only upon the one who gave the ruling.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Yazid ne Sa'id ibn Abi Ayyub se bataya: Mujhse Bakr ibn Amr al-Ma'afiri ne bataya, Abu Uthman Muslim ibn Yasar se, Abu Hurairah se رضي الله عنه, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, Jise bagair pukhta buniyaad ke fatwa diya jaaye, uska gunah sirf fatwa dene wale par hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سِنَانٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" مَنْ أَفْتَى بِفُتْيَا يُعَمَّى عَلَيْهَا، فَإِثْمُهَا عَلَيْه "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Abu Sinan, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه: He said: Whoever gives a religious ruling that is made to appear vague to him, its sin is upon him.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se bataya: Humein Abu Sinan ne bataya, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Jo aisa fatwa de jo usko baawajood shubha ke diya jaaye, uska gunah usi par hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ  ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بُرْقَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَيْمُونُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، إِذَا وَرَدَ عَلَيْهِ الْخَصْمُ نَظَرَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ وَجَدَ فِيهِ مَا يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ، قَضَى بِهِ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِي الْكِتَابِ، وَعَلِمَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي ذَلِكَ الْأَمْرِ سُنَّةً، قَضَى بِهِ، فَإِنْ أَعْيَاهُ، خَرَجَ فَسَأَلَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، فَقَالَ : أَتَانِي كَذَا وَكَذَا، فَهَلْ عَلِمْتُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَضَى فِي ذَلِكَ بِقَضَاءٍ؟ فَرُبَّمَا اجْتَمَعَ إِلَيْهِ النَّفَرُ كُلُّهُمْ يَذْكُرُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِيهِ قَضَاءً، فَيَقُولُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ :" الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي جَعَلَ فِينَا مَنْ يَحْفَظُ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا K فَإِنْ أَعْيَاهُ أَنْ يَجِدَ فِيهِ سُنَّةً مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، جَمَعَ رُؤُوسَ النَّاسِ وَخِيَارَهُمْ فَاسْتَشَارَهُمْ، فَإِذَا اجْتَمَعَ رَأْيُهُمْ عَلَى أَمْرٍ، قَضَى بِهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Salt, from Zuhayr, from Ja'far ibn Burqan, from Maymun ibn Mihran: He said: Abu Bakr رضي الله عنه, when a dispute came to him, would look into the Book of Allah, and if he found in it what settled the matter between them, he would judge by it, and if it was not in the Book, and he knew of a sunnah from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ regarding that matter, he would judge by it, but if that failed him, he would go out and ask the Muslims, and say: Such-and-such has come to me, so do any of you know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ made a ruling about it? So sometimes a group would gather to him, all mentioning a ruling of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about it, so Abu Bakr would say: Praise be to Allah who has placed among us someone who preserves the knowledge of our Prophet, but if he failed to find a sunnah from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in it, he would gather the leaders of the people and their best ones and consult them, so when their opinion agreed upon a matter, he would judge by it.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Salt ne Zuhayr se bataya: Humein Ja'far ibn Burqan ne bataya: Humein Maymun ibn Mihran ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Abu Bakr رضي الله عنه, jab unke paas koi jhagda aata, Allah ki Kitaab mein dekhte, aur agar unhein isme woh milta jisse unke darmiyan faisla ho jaaye, to woh isi se faisla dete, aur agar Kitaab mein na hota, aur unhein us maamle mein Rasulullah ﷺ ki koi sunnat maloom hoti, to woh isi se faisla dete, lekin agar yeh unse chook jaata, to woh nikalte aur Musalmanon se poochte, aur kehte: Mere paas fulaan-fulaan cheez aayi hai, to kya tum mein se kisi ko maloom hai ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne isme koi faisla diya ho? To kabhi-kabhi unke paas ek giroh jama ho jaata, sab Rasulullah ﷺ ka isme koi faisla zikr karte, to Abu Bakr kehte: Hamd hai us Allah ki jisne humme aisa koi rakha jo humare Nabi ka ilm mehfooz rakhta hai, lekin agar isme unhein Rasulullah ﷺ ki koi sunnat na milti, to woh logon ke sardaaron aur unke behtareen logon ko jama karte aur unse mashwara karte, so jab unki raay kisi maamle par ekattha ho jaati, woh isi se faisla dete.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارة  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سُهَيْلٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ عَلَى امْرَأَتِي اعْتِكَافُ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ ، فَسَأَلْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، وَعِنْدَهُ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ عَلَيْهَا صِيَامٌ، قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ : لَا يَكُونُ اعْتِكَافٌ إِلَّا بِصِيَامٍ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ : أَعَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟، قَالَ : لَا، قَالَ : فَعَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ؟، قَالَ : لَا، قَالَ : فَعَنْ عُمَرَ؟، قَالَ : لَا، قَالَ : فَعَنْ عُثْمَانَ؟، قَالَ : لَا، قَالَ عُمَرُ : مَا أَرَى عَلَيْهَا صِيَامًا، فَخَرَجْتُ فَوَجَدْتُ طَاوُسًا، وَعَطَاءَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، فَسَأَلْتُهُمَا، فَقَالَ طَاوُسٌ  : كَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ،" لَا يَرَى عَلَيْهَا صِيَامًا إِلَّا أَنْ تَجْعَلَهُ عَلَى نَفْسِهَا "، قَالَ : وَقَالَ عَطَاءٌ : ذَلِكَ رَأْيِي
24.en: Narrated by Ibrahim ibn Musa, and Amr ibn Zurarah, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Abu Suhayl: He said: My wife had an itikaf [seclusion] of three days upon her at al-Masjid al-Haram, so I asked Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz, with Ibn Shihab present with him, he said: I said: Is there fasting upon her? Ibn Shihab said: There is no itikaf without fasting, so Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz said to him: From the Prophet ﷺ? He said, No, he said: Then from Abu Bakr? He said, No, he said: Then from Umar? He said, No, he said: Then from Uthman? He said, No, so Umar said: I do not see that fasting is upon her, so I went out and found Tawus, and Ata ibn Abi Rabah, and I asked them both, so Tawus said: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه did not see that fasting was upon her unless she made it obligatory upon herself, he said: And Ata said: That is my opinion too.
24.hi: Ibrahim ibn Musa, aur Amr ibn Zurarah ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se bataya: Humein Abu Suhayl ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Meri biwi par al-Masjid al-Haram mein teen din ka i'tikaaf tha, to maine Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz se poocha, aur unke paas Ibn Shihab maujood the, unhone kaha: Maine poocha: Kya uspar roza hai? Ibn Shihab ne kaha: Roze ke bagair koi i'tikaaf nahi hota, to Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz ne unse poocha: Kya yeh Nabi ﷺ se hai? Unhone kaha, Nahi, unhone poocha: To Abu Bakr se? Unhone kaha, Nahi, unhone poocha: To Umar se? Unhone kaha, Nahi, unhone poocha: To Uthman se? Unhone kaha, Nahi, to Umar ne kaha: Mujhe nazar nahi aata ke uspar roza hai, to main nikla aur Tawus, aur Ata ibn Abi Rabah se mila, aur maine dono se poocha, to Tawus ne kaha: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه ke nazdeek uspar roza nahi tha jab tak woh khud apne oopar farz na kare, unhone bataya: Aur Ata ne kaha: Meri bhi yehi raay hai.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَقِيلٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ الْجُرَيْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : لَمَّا قَدِمَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ   الْبَصْرَةَ ، أَتَيْتُهُ أَنَا، وَالْحَسَنُ،" فَقَالَ لِلْحَسَنِ : أَنْتَ الْحَسَنُ؟ مَا كَانَ أَحَدٌ بِالْبَصْرَةِ أَحَبَّ إِلَيَّ لِقَاءً مِنْكَ، وَذَلِكَ أَنَّهُ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّكَ تُفْتِي بِرَأْيِكَ، فَلَا تُفْتِ بِرَأْيِكَ إِلَّا أَنْ تَكُونَ سُنَّةٌ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَوْ كِتَابٌ مُنْزَلٌ "
24.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Aqil, from Sa'id al-Jurayri, from Abu Nadrah: He said: When Abu Salamah came to Basrah, I and al-Hasan came to him, so he said to al-Hasan: Are you al-Hasan? No one in Basrah was more beloved to me to meet than you, and that is because it has reached me that you give religious rulings by your own opinion, so do not give rulings by your own opinion, unless there is a sunnah from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, or a revealed Book.
24.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Abu Aqil se bataya: Humein Sa'id al-Jurayri ne bataya, Abu Nadrah se: Unhone kaha, Jab Abu Salamah Basra aaye, main aur al-Hasan unke paas gaye, to unhone al-Hasan se kaha: Kya aap al-Hasan hain? Basra mein mujhe aapse zyada mulaqaat ki koi khwaahish nahi thi, aur yeh isliye ke mujhe khabar mili hai ke aap apni raay se fatwe dete hain, so apni raay se fatwe mat do, jab tak Rasulullah ﷺ se koi sunnat na ho, ya koi nazil ki gayi Kitaab.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عِصْمَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ  ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ   لَقِيَهُ فِي الطَّوَافِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ : " يَا أَبَا الشَّعْثَاءِإِنَّكَ مِنْ فُقَهَاءِ الْبَصْرَةِ فَلَا تُفْتِ إِلَّا بِقُرْآنٍ نَاطِقٍ، أَوْ سُنَّةٍ مَاضِيَةٍ، فَإِنَّكَ إِنْ فَعَلْتَ غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ، هَلَكْتَ وَأَهْلَكْتَ "
24.en: Narrated by Ismah ibn al-Fadl, from Zayd ibn al-Hubab, from Yazid ibn Uqbah, from al-Dahhak, from Jabir ibn Zayd: That Ibn Umar met him during the circumambulation, and said to him: O Abu al-Sha'tha, you are indeed among the jurists of Basra, so do not give religious rulings except by a clear Qur'an, or an established sunnah, for if you do otherwise, you will perish and cause others to perish.
24.hi: Ismah ibn al-Fadl ne Zayd ibn al-Hubab se bataya: Humein Yazid ibn Uqbah ne bataya: Humein al-Dahhak ne bataya, Jabir ibn Zayd se: ke Ibn Umar unse tawaf ke waqt mile, aur unse kaha: Ae Abu al-Sha'tha, tum Basra ke fuqaha mein se ho, so fatwa sirf wazeh Quran se, ya qaayam sunnat se do, kyunki agar tum aisa nahi karoge, to tum khud bhi halaak hoge aur doosron ko bhi halaak karoge.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ حُرَيْثِ بْنِ ظُهَيْرٍ L2353 ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" أَتَى عَلَيْنَا زَمَانٌ لَسْنَا نَقْضِي وَلَسْنَا هُنَالِكَ، وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ قَدَّرَ مِنْ الْأَمْرِ أَنْ قَدْ بَلَغْنَا مَا تَرَوْنَ، فَمَنْ عَرَضَ لَهُ قَضَاءٌ بَعْدَ الْيَوْمِ، فَلْيَقْضِ فِيهِ بِمَا فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ G فَإِنْ جَاءَهُ مَا لَيْسَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ، فَلْيَقْضِ بِمَا قَضَى بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَإِنْ جَاءَهُ مَا لَيْسَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ، وَلَمْ يَقْضِ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَلْيَقْضِ بِمَا قَضَى بِهِ الصَّالِحُونَ، وَلَا يَقُلْ إِنِّي أَخَافُ، وَإِنِّي أُرَى، فَإِنَّ الْحَرَامَ بَيِّنٌ، وَالْحَلَالَ بَيِّنٌ، وَبَيْنَ ذَلِكَ أُمُورٌ مُشْتَبِهَةٌ، فَدَعْ مَا يَرِيبُكَ إِلَى مَا لَا يَرِيبُكَ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from al-A'mash, from Umarah ibn Umayr, from Hurayth ibn Zuhayr, from Abdullah ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه: He said: A time has come upon us where we do not judge and we are not qualified for it, and Allah has indeed decreed that we have reached what you see, so whoever a judgment presents itself to after today, let him judge by what is in the Book of Allah, exalted is He, and if something comes to him that is not in the Book of Allah, let him judge by what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ judged, and if something comes to him that is not in the Book of Allah, nor did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ judge it, let him judge by what the righteous judged, and let him not say: I fear, and I see, for the unlawful is clear, and the lawful is clear, and between them are ambiguous matters, so leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya, Umarah ibn Umayr se, Hurayth ibn Zuhayr se, Abdullah ibn Mas'ud se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Humpar aisa waqt aaya hai jab hum faisla nahi karte aur hum uske ahle nahi rahe, aur Allah ne muqarrar kar diya hai ke hum wahan pahunch gaye jo tum dekhte ho, so jise aaj ke baad koi faisla pesh ho, to woh usme Allah Ta'ala ki Kitaab ke mutaabiq faisla kare, aur agar usme koi aisi cheez aaye jo Allah ki Kitaab mein na ho, to woh usi tarah faisla kare jaisa Rasulullah ﷺ ne faisla diya, aur agar usme koi aisi cheez aaye jo na Allah ki Kitaab mein ho na Rasulullah ﷺ ne isme faisla diya ho, to woh usi tarah faisla kare jaisa neik logon ne faisla diya, aur woh yeh na kahe: Mujhe dar hai, aur mera khayal hai, kyunki haraam saaf hai, aur halal saaf hai, aur in dono ke darmiyan shuba wali cheezein hain, so jo tumhein shak mein daale usay chhod do us cheez ke liye jo tumhein shak mein na daale.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ" إِذَا سُئِلَ عَنْ الْأَمْرِ فَكَانَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ، أَخْبَرَ بِهِ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِي الْقُرْآنِ وَكَانَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَخْبَرَ بِهِ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ، فَعَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، وَعُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ، قَالَ فِيهِ بِرَأْيِهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Uyaynah, from Ubaydullah ibn Abi Yazid: He said: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه, when asked about a matter, if it was in the Qur'an, he informed of it, and if it was not in the Qur'an but was from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he informed of it, and if it was not, then from Abu Bakr, and Umar رضي الله عنهما, and if it was not, he spoke about it with his own opinion.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Muhammad ne Ibn Uyaynah se bataya: Humein Ubaydullah ibn Abi Yazid ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه, jab unse kisi maamle ke baare mein poocha jaata, agar woh Quran mein hota, to woh isse bataate, aur agar Quran mein na hota lekin Rasulullah ﷺ se hota, to woh isse bataate, aur agar na hota, to Abu Bakr, aur Umar رضي الله عنهما se, aur agar na hota, to woh isme apni raay se baat karte.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ  : أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ   كَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ :" إِنْ جَاءَكَ شَيْءٌ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ، فَاقْضِ بِهِ وَلَا تَلْفِتْكَ عَنْهُ الرِّجَالُ، فَإِنْ جَاءَكَ مَا لَيْسَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَانْظُرْ سُنَّةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَاقْضِ بِهَا، فَإِنْ جَاءَكَ مَا لَيْسَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ سُنَّةٌ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَانْظُرْ مَا اجْتَمَعَ عَلَيْهِ النَّاسُ فَخُذْ بِهِ، فَإِنْ جَاءَكَ مَا لَيْسَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ فِي سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَلَمْ يَتَكَلَّمْ فِيهِ أَحَدٌ قَبْلَكَ، فَاخْتَرْ أَيَّ الْأَمْرَيْنِ شِئْتَ : إِنْ شِئْتَ أَنْ تَجْتَهِدَ بِرَأْيَكَ ثُمَّ تُقَدَّمَ فَتَقَدَّمْ، وَإِنْ شِئْتَ أَنْ تَتَأَخَّرَ، فَتَأَخَّرْ، وَلَا أَرَى التَّأَخُّرَ إِلَّا خَيْرًا لَكَ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Sha'bi, from Shurayh: That Umar ibn al-Khattab wrote to him: If something comes to you in the Book of Allah, then judge by it, and let not men turn you away from it, and if something comes to you that is not in the Book of Allah, then look to the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and judge by it, and if something comes to you that is not in the Book of Allah and there is no sunnah from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ regarding it, then look at what people have agreed upon and take it, and if something comes to you that is not in the Book of Allah, nor in the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and no one before you has spoken about it, then choose whichever of two matters you wish: if you wish to exert your own judgment then proceed forward, then go forward, and if you wish to hold back, then hold back, and I see holding back as nothing but better for you.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali ibn Mushir se bataya: Humein Abu Ishaq ne bataya, al-Sha'bi se, Shurayh se: ke Umar ibn al-Khattab ne unhein likha: Agar tumhare paas Allah ki Kitaab mein koi cheez aaye, to usi se faisla karo, aur log tumhein isse na hataayein, aur agar tumhare paas koi aisi cheez aaye jo Allah ki Kitaab mein na ho, to Rasulullah ﷺ ki sunnat dekho, aur usi se faisla karo, aur agar tumhare paas koi aisi cheez aaye jo Allah ki Kitaab mein na ho aur usme Rasulullah ﷺ ki koi sunnat na ho, to dekho jispar logon ne ittefaaq kiya hai aur usay le lo, aur agar tumhare paas koi aisi cheez aaye jo na Allah ki Kitaab mein ho, na Rasulullah ﷺ ki sunnat mein, aur na hi tumse pehle kisi ne isme baat ki ho, to do maamlon mein se jo chaaho chuno: agar tum apni raay se koshish karke aage badhna chaaho, to aage badho, aur agar tum ruk jaana chaaho, to ruk jaao, aur mujhe ruk jaana tumhare liye behtar hi lagta hai.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الثَّقَفِيِّ  ، عَنْ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَمْرِو  ابْنِ أَخِي الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ نَاسٍ  مِنْ أَهْلِ حِمْصٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ مُعَاذٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، عَنْ مُعَاذٍ  ، أَنّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَمَّا بَعَثَهُ إِلَى الْيَمَنِ ، قَالَ :" أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ عَرَضَ لَكَ قَضَاءٌ كَيْفَ تَقْضِي؟ "، قَالَ : أَقْضِي بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ : " فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ؟ "، قَالَ : فَبِسُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : " فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِي سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ؟ "، قَالَ : أَجْتَهِدُ رَأْيِي وَلَا آلُو، قَالَ : فَضَرَبَ صَدْرَهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي وَفَّقَ رَسُولَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ لِمَا يُرْضِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from Muhammad ibn Ubaydullah al-Thaqafi, from al-Harith ibn Amr, nephew of al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah, from some people from Hims among the companions of Mu'adh رضي الله عنه, from Mu'adh: That the Prophet ﷺ, when he sent him to Yemen, said: What will you do if a judgment presents itself to you, how will you judge? He said: I will judge by the Book of Allah, he said: And if it is not in the Book of Allah? He said: Then by the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said: And if it is not in the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah? He said: I will exert my own judgment and not fall short, he said: So he struck his chest, then said: Praise be to Allah who has guided the messenger of the Messenger of Allah to what pleases the Messenger of Allah.
24.hi: Yahya ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se bataya: Humein Muhammad ibn Ubaydullah al-Thaqafi ne bataya, al-Harith ibn Amr se (al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah ke bhatije), Hims ke kuch logon se jo Mu'adh رضي الله عنه ke sathiyon mein se the, Mu'adh se: ke Nabi ﷺ ne, jab unhein Yemen bheja, poocha: Agar tumhare paas koi faisla pesh ho to tum kya karoge, kaise faisla doge? Unhone kaha: Main Allah ki Kitaab se faisla dunga, aapne poocha: Aur agar yeh Allah ki Kitaab mein na ho? Unhone kaha: To Rasulullah ﷺ ki sunnat se, aapne poocha: Aur agar yeh Rasulullah ﷺ ki sunnat mein na ho? Unhone kaha: Main apni raay se koshish karunga aur kami nahi karunga, unhone bataya: To aapne unke seene par haath maara, fir farmaya: Hamd hai us Allah ki jisne Rasulullah ke qaasid ko usi cheez ki hidayat di jo Rasulullah ko razi kare.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ حُرَيْثِ بْنِ ظُهَيْرٍ L2353 ، قَالَ : أَحْسَبُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" قَدْ أَتَى عَلَيْنَا زَمَانٌ وَمَا نُسْأَلُ، وَمَا نَحْنُ هُنَاكَ، وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدَّرَ أَنْ بَلَغْتُ مَا تَرَوْنَ، فَإِذَا سُئِلْتُمْ عَنْ شَيْءٍ، فَانْظُرُوا فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ G فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدُوهُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَفِي سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدُوهُ فِي سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، فَمَا أَجْمَعَ عَلَيْهِ الْمُسْلِمُونَ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيمَا أَجْمَعَ عَلَيْهِ الْمُسْلِمُونَ، فَاجْتَهِدْ رَأْيَكَ، وَلَا تَقُلْ : إِنِّي أَخَافُ وَأَخْشَى، فَإِنَّ الْحَلَالَ بَيِّنٌ، وَالْحَرَامَ بَيِّنٌ، وَبَيْنَ ذَلِكَ أُمُورٌ مُشْتَبِهَةٌ، فَدَعْ مَا يَرِيبُكَ إِلَى مَا لَا يَرِيبُكَ "، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  ، عَن عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، نَحْوَهُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَن عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، بِنَحْوِهِ
24.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from Sulayman, from Umarah ibn Umayr, from Hurayth ibn Zuhayr; parallel chains also given: He said: I think that Abdullah رضي الله عنه said: A time has come upon us when we were not asked, and we were not qualified for it, and Allah has decreed that I have reached what you see, so when you are asked about something, look in the Book of Allah, exalted is He, and if you do not find it in the Book of Allah, then in the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah, and if you do not find it in the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah, then what the Muslims have agreed upon, and if it is not in what the Muslims have agreed upon, then exert your own judgment, and do not say: I fear and I am wary, for the lawful is clear, and the unlawful is clear, and between them are ambiguous matters, so leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt. [Narrated by Yahya ibn Hammad, from Abu Awanah, from Sulayman, from Umarah ibn Umayr, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid, from Abdullah, similarly. Narrated by Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Jarir, from al-A'mash, from al-Qasim ibn Abd al-Rahman, from his father, from Abdullah, similarly.]
24.hi: Yahya ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se bataya: Humein Sulayman ne bataya, Umarah ibn Umayr se, Hurayth ibn Zuhayr se: Unhone kaha, Mera khayal hai Abdullah رضي الله عنه ne kaha: Humpar aisa waqt aaya jab humse poocha nahi jaata tha, aur hum uske ahle nahi the, aur Allah ne muqarrar kiya hai ke main wahan pahunch gaya jo tum dekhte ho, so jab tumse kisi cheez ke baare mein poocha jaaye, Allah Ta'ala ki Kitaab mein dekho, aur agar tumhein yeh Allah ki Kitaab mein na mile, to Rasulullah ki sunnat mein, aur agar tumhein yeh Rasulullah ki sunnat mein na mile, to jispar Musalman ittefaaq karte hon, aur agar yeh jispar Musalman ittefaaq karte hon usme na ho, to apni raay se koshish karo, aur yeh mat kaho: Mujhe dar hai aur mujhe khauf hai, kyunki halal saaf hai, aur haraam saaf hai, aur in dono ke darmiyan shuba wali cheezein hain, so jo tumhein shak mein daale usay chhod do us cheez ke liye jo tumhein shak mein na daale. [Isi jaisi riwayat Yahya ibn Hammad se, Abu Awanah se, Sulayman se, Umarah ibn Umayr se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid se, Abdullah se bhi aayi hai. Abdullah ibn Muhammad ne Jarir se bataya, al-A'mash se, al-Qasim ibn Abd al-Rahman se, apne walid se, Abdullah se bhi isi jaisi.]

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ  ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   : " أَيُّهَا النَّاسُإِنَّكُمْ سَتُحْدِثُونَ وَيُحْدَثُ لَكُمْ، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ مُحْدَثَةً فَعَلَيْكُمْ بِالْأَمْرِ الْأَوَّلِ "، قَالَ حَفْصٌ : كُنْتُ أُسْنِدُ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثُمَّ دَخَلَنِي مِنْهُ شَكٌّ
24.en: Narrated by Harun ibn Mu'awiyah, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from al-A'mash; with Hafs's note: He said: Abdullah said: O people, you will indeed introduce new things and new things will be introduced for you, so when you see something newly introduced, hold to the first matter. Hafs said: I used to attribute this to Habib, from Abu Abd al-Rahman, then I became uncertain about it.
24.hi: Harun ibn Mu'awiyah ne Hafs ibn Ghiyath se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ne kaha: Ae logo, tum zaroor nayi cheezein nikaaloge aur tumhare liye nayi cheezein nikaali jaayengi, so jab tum koi nayi nikaali hui cheez dekho, to pehle maamle ko pakdo. Hafs kehte hain: Main isay Habib se, Abu Abd al-Rahman se mansoob karta tha, fir mujhe isme shak ho gaya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عُمَرُ   لِابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ :" أَلَمْ أُنْبَأْ أَوْ أُنْبِئْتُ أَنَّكَ تُفْتِي وَلَسْتَ بِأَمِيرٍ؟ وَلِّ حَارَّهَا مَنْ تَوَلَّى قَارَّهَا "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Salt, from Ibn al-Mubarak, from Ibn Awn, from Muhammad: He said: Umar said to Ibn Mas'ud: Was I not informed, or have I been informed, that you give religious rulings while you are not a commander? Give the hot part [responsibility] to whoever takes on the cool part [i.e., stay in your place].
24.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Salt ne Ibn al-Mubarak se bataya: Humein Ibn Awn ne bataya, Muhammad se: Unhone kaha, Umar ne Ibn Mas'ud se kaha: Kya mujhe bataaya nahi gaya, ya mujhe bataaya gaya hai, ke tum fatwe dete ho jabke tum ameer nahi ho? Garmi wala hissa usko do jo thanda hissa sambhaale [yaani, apni jagah par raho].

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ  ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ الَّذِي يُفْتِي النَّاسَ فِي كُلِّ مَا يُسْتَفْتَى لَمَجْنُونٌ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from al-A'mash, from Abu Wa'il, from Ibn Mas'ud: He said: The one who gives religious rulings to people about everything he is asked for a ruling on is indeed mad.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya, Abu Wa'il se, Ibn Mas'ud se: Unhone kaha, Jo logon ko har us cheez ka fatwa deta hai jispar usse fatwa maanga jaaye, woh zaroor pagal hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" إِنَّمَا يُفْتِي النَّاسَ ثَلَاثَةٌ : رَجُلٌ إِمَامٌ أَوْ وَالٍ، وَرَجُلٌ يَعْلَمُ نَاسِخَ الْقُرْآنِ مِنْ الْمَنْسُوخِ "، قَالُوا : يَا حُذَيْفَةُ، وَمَنْ ذَاكَ؟، قَالَ : " عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ، أَوْ أَحْمَقُ مُتَكَلِّفٌ "
24.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Hisham, from Muhammad, from Hudhayfah رضي الله عنه: He said: Only three people give religious rulings to the people: a man who is an imam or a governor, and a man who knows the abrogating from the abrogated of the Qur'an, they said: O Hudhayfah, and who is that? He said: Umar ibn al-Khattab, or a foolish person who overreaches himself.
24.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Hisham se bataya: Humein Muhammad ne bataya, Hudhayfah se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Sirf teen log logon ko fatwa dete hain: ek aadmi jo imam ya waali ho, aur ek aadmi jo Quran ke naasikh aur mansookh ko jaanta ho, unhone poocha: Ae Hudhayfah, aur woh kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Umar ibn al-Khattab, ya ek bewaqoof jo apne aap se zyada bharta hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ حُذَيْفَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ :" إِنَّمَا يُفْتِي النَّاسَ أَحَدُ ثَلَاثَةٍ : رَجُلٌ عَلِمَ نَاسِخَ الْقُرْآنِ مِنْ مَنْسُوخِهِ "، قَالُوا : وَمَنْ ذَاكَ؟، قَالَ : " عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ، قَالَ : وَأَمِيرٌ لَا يَجِدُ بُدًّا، أَوْ أَحْمَقُ مُتَكَلِّفٌ "، ثُمَّ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ : فَلَسْتُ بِوَاحِدٍ مِنْ هَذَيْنِ، وَأَرْجُو أَنْ لَا أَكُونَ الثَّالِثَ
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Abu Usamah, from Hisham ibn Hassan, from Muhammad, from Abu Ubaydah ibn Hudhayfah: He said: Hudhayfah رضي الله عنه said: Only one of three gives religious rulings to the people: a man who knows the abrogating from the abrogated of the Qur'an, they said: And who is that? He said: Umar ibn al-Khattab, he said: And a governor who finds no way around it, or a foolish person who overreaches himself, then Muhammad said: I am not one of these two, and I hope I am not the third.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Abu Usamah se bataya: Humein Hisham ibn Hassan ne bataya, Muhammad se, Abu Ubaydah ibn Hudhayfah se: Unhone kaha, Hudhayfah رضي الله عنه ne kaha: Sirf teen mein se ek hi logon ko fatwa deta hai: ek aadmi jo Quran ke naasikh aur mansookh ko jaanta ho, unhone poocha: Aur woh kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Umar ibn al-Khattab, unhone kaha: Aur ek waali jo isse bachne ka koi raasta na paaye, ya ek bewaqoof jo apne aap se zyada bharta hai, fir Muhammad ne kaha: Main in dono mein se koi nahi hoon, aur main ummeed karta hoon ke main teesra na hoon.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ عَلِمَ مِنْكُمْ عِلْمًا، فَلْيَقُلْ بِهِ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَعْلَمْ، فَلْيَقُلْ لِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ : اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ، فَإِنَّ : الْعَالِمَ إِذَا سُئِلَ عَمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ، قَالَ : اللَّهُ G أَعْلَمُ، وَقَدْ قَالَ اللَّهُ لِرَسُولِهِ : # قُلْ مَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ سورة ص آية 86 # "
24.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from al-A'mash, from Muslim, from Masruq, from Abdullah: He said: Whoever among you knows any knowledge, let him speak it, and whoever does not know, let him say for what he does not know: Allah knows best, for indeed the knowledgeable one, when asked about what he does not know, says: Allah, exalted is He, knows best, and Allah, exalted is He, said to His Messenger: Say, I do not ask you for it any reward, and I am not of the pretentious [Surah Sad, verse 86].
24.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne al-A'mash se bataya: Humein Muslim ne bataya, Masruq se, Abdullah se: Unhone kaha, Tum mein se jo koi ilm jaante ho, isse kaho, aur jo na jaanta ho, woh jo na jaane use kahe: Allah zyada jaanta hai, kyunki aalim, jab usse woh poocha jaaye jo woh nahi jaanta, kehta hai: Allah Ta'ala zyada jaanta hai, aur Allah Ta'ala ne apne Rasool se farmaya: Kaho, main tumse iske liye koi ajr nahi maangta aur main dikhaawa karne walon mein se nahi hoon [Surah Sad, aayat 86].

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ  ، أَنَّ أَبَا مُوسَى   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ فِي خُطْبَتِهِ :" مَنْ عَلِمَ عِلْمًا، فَلْيُعَلِّمْهُ النَّاسَ، وَإِيَّاهُ أَنْ يَقُولَ مَا لَا عِلْمَ لَهُ بِهِ فَيَمْرُقَ مِنْ الدِّينِ وَيَكُونَ مِنْ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ "
24.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Humayd, from Abu Raja, from Abu al-Muhallab: That Abu Musa رضي الله عنه said in his sermon: Whoever knows some knowledge, let him teach it to the people, and let him beware of saying what he has no knowledge of, so that he strays from the religion and becomes one of the pretentious.
24.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Humayd se bataya: Humein Abu Raja ne bataya, Abu al-Muhallab se: ke Abu Musa رضي الله عنه ne apne khutba mein kaha: Jo koi ilm jaanta ho, use logon ko sikhaaye, aur usse bachein ke woh woh baat kahe jiska use ilm nahi, taake woh deen se nikal jaaye aur dikhaawa karne walon mein ho jaaye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْبَخْتَرِيِّ  ، وَزَاذَانَ  ، قَالَا : قَالَ عَلِيٌّ   رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ :" وَا بَرْدَهَا عَلَى الْكَبِدِ إِذَا سُئِلْتُ عَمَّا لَا أَعْلَمُ، أَنْ أَقُولَ : اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ "
24.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid ibn Abdullah, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Abu al-Bakhtari, and Zadhan: They both said: Ali رضوان الله عليه said: How cooling to the liver, when I am asked about what I do not know, that I say: Allah knows best.
24.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid ibn Abdullah se bataya: Humein Ata ibn al-Sa'ib ne bataya, Abu al-Bakhtari se, aur Zadhan se: Dono ne kaha, Ali (Alayhis Salam) رضوان الله عليه ne kaha: Jigar ko kitni thandak milti hai, jab mujhse woh poocha jaaye jo mujhe nahi maloom, ke main kahun: Allah zyada jaanta hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْبَخْتَرِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ   رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ، قَالَ :" يَا بَرْدَهَا عَلَى الْكَبِدِ أَنْ تَقُولَ لِمَا لَا تَعْلَمُ : اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sharik, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Abu al-Bakhtari, from Ali رضوان الله عليه: He said: How cooling to the liver, that you say for what you do not know: Allah knows best.
24.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sharik se bataya: Humein Ata ibn al-Sa'ib ne bataya, Abu al-Bakhtari se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se رضوان الله عليه: Unhone kaha, Jigar ko kitni thandak milti hai, jab tum woh kaho jo tum nahi jaante: Allah zyada jaanta hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَيْرُ بْنُ عَرْفَجَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا رَزِينٌ أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، قَالَ :" إِذَا سُئِلْتُمْ عَمَّا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ، فَاهْرُبُوا "، قَالُوا : وَكَيْفَ الْهَرَبُ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ؟، قَالَ : " تَقُولُونَ : اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Umayr ibn Arfajah, from Razin Abu al-Nu'man, from Ali ibn Abi Talib رضي الله عنه: He said: When you are asked about what you do not know, then flee, they said: And how does one flee, O Commander of the Believers? He said: You say: Allah knows best.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Umayr ibn Arfajah se bataya: Humein Razin Abu al-Nu'man ne bataya, Ali ibn Abi Talib se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Jab tumse woh poocha jaaye jo tum nahi jaante, to bhaago, unhone poocha: Aur bhaagne ka tareeqa kya hai, Ae Ameer-ul-Mumineen? Unhone kaha: Tum kaho: Allah zyada jaanta hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ  ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ الْبَطِينِ  ، عَنْ عَزْرَةَ التَّمِيمِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَلِيٌّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ :" وَا بَرْدَهَا عَلَى الْكَبِدِ، ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ "، قَالُوا : وَمَا ذَلِكَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ؟، قَالَ : " أَنْ يُسْأَلَ الرَّجُلُ عَمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ، فَيَقُولُ : اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Humayd, from Jarir, from Mansur, from Muslim al-Batin, from Azrah al-Tamimi: He said: Ali رضي الله عنه said: How cooling to the liver, three times, they said: And what is that, O Commander of the Believers? He said: That a man is asked about what he does not know, and he says: Allah knows best.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Humayd ne Jarir se bataya: Humein Mansur ne bataya, Muslim al-Batin se, Azrah al-Tamimi se: Unhone kaha, Ali رضي الله عنه ne kaha: Jigar ko kitni thandak milti hai, teen martaba, unhone poocha: Aur woh kya hai, Ae Ameer-ul-Mumineen? Unhone kaha: Ke aadmi se woh poocha jaaye jo woh nahi jaanta, aur woh kahe: Allah zyada jaanta hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا فَرْوَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَغْرَاءِ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّ رَجُلًا سَأَلَهُ عَنْ مَسْأَلَةٍ فَقَالَ : لَا عِلْمَ لِي بِهَا، فَلَمَّا أَدْبَرَ الرَّجُلُ، قَالَ بْنُ عُمَرَ :" نِعْمَ مَا قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ، سُئِلَ عَمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ، فَقَالَ : لَا عِلْمَ لِي بِهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Farwah ibn Abi al-Maghra, from Ali ibn Mushir, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Ibn Umar رضي الله عنهما: That a man asked him about a matter, so he said: I have no knowledge of it, so when the man turned away, Ibn Umar said: How fine is what Ibn Umar said, he was asked about what he did not know, and he said: I have no knowledge of it.
24.hi: Farwah ibn Abi al-Maghra ne Ali ibn Mushir se bataya: Humein Hisham ibn Urwah ne bataya, apne walid se, Ibn Umar se رضي الله عنهما: ke ek aadmi ne unse ek maamle ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: Mujhe iska ilm nahi, to jab aadmi peechhe muda, Ibn Umar ne kaha: Kya khoob hai jo Ibn Umar ne kaha, unse woh poocha gaya jo woh nahi jaante the, aur unhone kaha: Mujhe iska ilm nahi.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، قَالَ :" لَا أَدْرِي نِصْفُ الْعِلْمِ "
24.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hammad, from Abu Awanah, from Mughirah, from al-Sha'bi: He said: I do not know is half of knowledge.
24.hi: Yahya ibn Hammad ne Abu Awanah se bataya: Humein Mughirah ne bataya, al-Sha'bi se: Unhone kaha, 'Mujhe nahi maloom' ilm ka aadha hissa hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ الْعُمَرِيُّ  ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ  ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَتَى ابْنَ عُمَرَ   يَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ شَيْءٍ، فَقَالَ :" لَا عِلْمَ لِي، ثُمَّ الْتَفَتَ بَعْدَ أَنْ قَفَّي الرَّجُلُ، فَقَالَ : نِعْمَ مَا قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ ! يُسْأَلُ عَمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ، فَقَالَ : لَا عِلْمَ لِي "، يَعْنِي : ابْنُ عُمَرَ نَفْسَهُ
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Maslamah, from Abdullah al-Umari, from Nafi': That a man came to Ibn Umar asking him about something, so he said: I have no knowledge, then he turned around after the man had left, and said: How fine is what Ibn Umar said! He is asked about what he does not know, and he says: I have no knowledge, meaning: Ibn Umar himself.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Maslamah ne Abdullah al-Umari se bataya: Humein Nafi' ne bataya: ke ek aadmi Ibn Umar ke paas aaya unse kisi cheez ke baare mein poochte hue, to unhone kaha: Mujhe ilm nahi, fir woh mudkar dekhne lage jab aadmi chala gaya, aur kaha: Kya khoob hai jo Ibn Umar ne kaha! Unse woh poocha jaata hai jo woh nahi jaante, aur woh kehte hain: Mujhe ilm nahi, yaani: Ibn Umar khud.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، قَالَ :" كَانَ عَامِرٌ  إِذَا سُئِلَ عَنْ شَيْءٍ، يَقُولُ : لَا أَدْرِي، فَإِنْ رُدُّوا عَلَيْهِ، قَالَ : إِنْ شِئْتَ كُنْتُ حَلَفْتُ لَكَ بِاللَّهِ إِنْ كَانَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Humayd, from Jarir, from Mughirah: He said: When Amir was asked about something, he would say: I do not know, and if they pressed him, he would say: If you wish, I would swear to you by Allah that I have no knowledge of it.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Humayd ne Jarir se bataya: Humein Mughirah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Amir jab unse kisi cheez ke baare mein poocha jaata, woh kehte: Mujhe nahi maloom, aur agar woh unpar zor dete, woh kehte: Agar tum chaaho, to main tumse Allah ki qasam khaata hoon ke mujhe iska ilm nahi.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ ، عَنْ حَفْصٍ ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ ، قَالَ :" مَا أُبَالِي سُئِلْتُ عَمَّا أَعْلَمُ أَوْ مَا لَا أَعْلَمُ، لِأَنِّي إِذَا سُئِلْتُ عَمَّا أَعْلَمُ، قُلْتُ مَا أَعْلَمُ، وَإِذَا سُئِلْتُ عَمَّا لَا أَعْلَمُ قُلْتُ : لَا أَعْلَمُ "
24.en: Narrated by Harun ibn Mu'awiyah, from Hafs, from Ash'ath, from Ibn Sirin: He said: I do not care whether I am asked about what I know or what I do not know, because when I am asked about what I know, I say what I know, and when I am asked about what I do not know, I say: I do not know.
24.hi: Harun ibn Mu'awiyah ne Hafs se bataya: Humein Ash'ath ne bataya, Ibn Sirin se: Unhone kaha, Mujhe parwaah nahi ke mujhse woh poocha jaaye jo main jaanta hoon ya jo main nahi jaanta, kyunki jab mujhse woh poocha jaata hai jo main jaanta hoon, main woh kehta hoon jo main jaanta hoon, aur jab mujhse woh poocha jaata hai jo main nahi jaanta, main kehta hoon: Mujhe nahi maloom.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ ، عَنْ حَفْصٍ ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ ، قَالَ :" مَا سَمِعْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  يَقُولُ قَطُّ : حَلَالٌ وَلَا حَرَامٌ، إِنَّمَا كَانَ يَقُولُ : كَانُوا يَتَكْرَهُونَ، وَكَانُوا يَسْتَحِبُّونَ "
24.en: Narrated by Harun, from Hafs, from al-A'mash: He said: I never heard Ibrahim ever say: Lawful, or unlawful, he would only say: They used to dislike it, and they used to prefer it.
24.hi: Harun ne Hafs se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibrahim ko kabhi nahi suna kehte: Halal, ya haraam, woh sirf kehte the: Woh na-pasand karte the, aur woh pasand karte the.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   :" كَيْفَ أَنْتُمْ إِذَا لَبِسَتْكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ يَهْرَمُ فِيهَا الْكَبِيرُ وَيَرْبُو فِيهَا الصَّغِيرُ، وَيَتَّخِذُهَا النَّاسُ سُنَّةً، فَإِذَا غُيِّرَتْ، قَالُوا : غُيِّرَتْ السُّنَّةُ "، قَالُوا : وَمَتَى ذَلِكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ؟، قَالَ : " إِذَا كَثُرَتْ قُرَّاؤُكُمْ، وَقَلَّتْ فُقَهَاؤُكُمْ، وَكَثُرَتْ أُمَرَاؤُكُمْ، وَقَلَّتْ أُمَنَاؤُكُمْ، وَالْتُمِسَتِ الدُّنْيَا بِعَمَلِ الْآخِرَةِ "
24.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from al-A'mash, from Shaqiq: He said: Abdullah said: How will you be when a trial dresses you, in which the old grow old and the young grow up in it, and people take it as a sunnah, so when it is changed, they say: The sunnah has been changed, they said: And when is that, O Abu Abd al-Rahman?
