He said: When your Qur'an-reciters increase, and your jurists decrease, and your commanders increase, and your trustworthy ones decrease, and this world is sought through the deeds of the Hereafter.
24.hi: Ya'la ne al-A'mash se bataya: Humein Shaqiq ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ne kaha: Tum kaise ho jaaoge jab tumhein ek fitna pehnaaya jaayega, jismein bada budha ho jaayega aur chhota badha hoga, aur log isay sunnat samajh lenge, so jab isse badla jaayega, woh kahenge: Sunnat badal di gayi, unhone poocha: Aur woh kab hoga, Ae Abu Abd al-Rahman? Unhone kaha: Jab tumhare Quran padhne wale badh jaayein, aur tumhare fuqaha kam ho jaayein, aur tumhare ameer badh jaayein, aur tumhare bharosemand log kam ho jaayein, aur duniya Aakhirat ke amal se talaash ki jaaye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" كَيْفَ أَنْتُمْ إِذَا لَبِسَتْكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ يَهْرَمُ فِيهَا الْكَبِيرُ وَيَرْبُو فِيهَا الصَّغِيرُ، إِذَا تُرِكَ مِنْهَا شَيْءٌ، قِيلَ : تُرِكَتْ السُّنَّةُ "، قَالُوا : وَمَتَى ذَاكَ؟، قَالَ : " إِذَا ذَهَبَتْ عُلَمَاؤُكُمْ، وَكَثُرَتْ جُهَلَاؤُكُمْ، وَكَثُرَتْ قُرَّاؤُكُمْ، وَقَلَّتْ فُقَهَاؤُكُمْ، وَكَثُرَتْ أُمَرَاؤُكُمْ، وَقَلَّتْ أُمَنَاؤُكُمْ، وَالْتُمِسَتْ الدُّنْيَا بِعَمَلِ الْآخِرَةِ، وَتُفُقِّهَ لِغَيْرِ الدِّينِ "
24.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid ibn Abdullah, from Yazid ibn Abi Ziyad, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah, from Abdullah: He said: How will you be when a trial dresses you, in which the old grow old and the young grow up, when something of it is left, it is said: The sunnah has been left, they said: And when is that? He said: When your scholars pass away, and your ignorant increase, and your Qur'an-reciters increase, and your jurists decrease, and your commanders increase, and your trustworthy ones decrease, and this world is sought through the deeds of the Hereafter, and understanding is sought for other than the religion.
24.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid ibn Abdullah se bataya: Humein Yazid ibn Abi Ziyad ne bataya, Ibrahim se, Alqamah se, Abdullah se: Unhone kaha, Tum kaise ho jaaoge jab tumhein ek fitna pehnaaya jaayega, jismein bada budha ho jaayega aur chhota badha hoga, jab isme se kuch chhod diya jaayega, kaha jaayega: Sunnat chhod di gayi, unhone poocha: Aur woh kab hoga? Unhone kaha: Jab tumhare ulama chale jaayein, aur tumhare jahaal badh jaayein, aur tumhare Quran padhne wale badh jaayein, aur tumhare fuqaha kam ho jaayein, aur tumhare ameer badh jaayein, aur tumhare bharosemand log kam ho jaayein, aur duniya Aakhirat ke amal se talaash ki jaaye, aur samajh deen ke ilaawa kisi aur cheez ke liye haasil ki jaaye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ ، قَالَ : أُنْبِئْتُ  أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُقَالُ :" وَيْلٌ لِلْمُتَفَقِّهِينَ لِغَيْرِ الْعِبَادَةِ، وَالْمُسْتَحِلِّينَ لِلْحُرُمَاتِ بِالشُّبُهَاتِ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i: He said: I was told that it used to be said: Woe to those who seek understanding for other than worship, and those who make forbidden things lawful through ambiguities.
24.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe bataaya gaya ke yeh kaha jaata tha: Afsos un logon par jo ibaadat ke ilaawa kisi aur cheez ke liye fiqh talaash karte hain, aur un logon par jo shubhaat ke zariye haraam cheezon ko halal karte hain.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا صَالِحُ بْنُ سُهَيْلٍ  مَوْلَى يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" لَا يَأْتِي عَلَيْكُمْ عَامٌ إِلَّا وَهُوَ شَرٌّ مِنْ الَّذِي كَانَ قَبْلَهُ، أَمَا إِنِّي لَسْتُ أَعْنِي عَامًا أَخْصَبَ مِنْ عَامٍ، وَلَا أَمِيرًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَمِيرٍ، وَلَكِنْ عُلَمَاؤُكُمْ وَخِيَارُكُمْ وَفُقَهَاؤُكُمْ يَذْهَبُونَ، ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُونَ مِنْهُمْ خَلَفًا، وَيَجِيءُ قَوْمٌ يَقِيسُونَ الْأُمُورَ بِرَأْيِهِمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Salih ibn Suhayl, freed servant of Yahya ibn Abi Za'idah, from Yahya, from Mujalid, from al-Sha'bi, from Masruq, from Abdullah رضي الله عنه: He said: No year comes upon you except that it is worse than the one before it, listen, I do not mean a year more fertile than another year, nor a commander better than another commander, but rather your scholars and your best ones and your jurists pass away, then you do not find a successor for them, and a people come who measure matters by their own opinion.
24.hi: Salih ibn Suhayl ne, jo Yahya ibn Abi Za'idah ke azaad kiye hue ghulam the, Yahya se bataya: Humein Mujalid ne bataya, al-Sha'bi se, Masruq se, Abdullah se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Koi saal tumpar aisa nahi aata magar woh usse pehle wale se bura hota hai, sun lo, mera matlab yeh nahi ke koi saal doosre saal se zyada zarkhez ho, na yeh ke koi ameer doosre ameer se behtar ho, lekin tumhare ulama aur tumhare behtareen log aur tumhare fuqaha chale jaate hain, fir tumhein unka koi jaanashee nahi milta, aur aise log aate hain jo maamlon ko apni raay se naapte hain.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ دَاوُدَ بْنَ أَبِي هِنْدٍ ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ ، قَالَ :" أَوَّلُ مَنْ قَاسَ إِبْلِيسُ، وَمَا عُبِدَتْ الشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ إِلَّا بِالْمَقَايِيسِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf, from Yahya ibn Sulaym: He said: I heard Da'ud ibn Abi Hind, from Ibn Sirin, say: The first to use analogy was Iblis, and the sun and the moon were not worshipped except through analogies.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf ne Yahya ibn Sulaym se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Da'ud ibn Abi Hind ko suna, Ibn Sirin se: Sabse pehle qiyaas karne wala Iblees tha, aur suraj aur chaand ki puja qiyaas ke zariye hi hui.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ ، عَنْ ابْنِ شَوْذَبٍ ، عَنْ مَطَرٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  أَنَّهُ تَلَا هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ : # خَلَقْتَنِي مِنْ نَارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ طِينٍ سورة الأعراف آية 12 # قَالَ :" قَاسَ إِبْلِيسُ وَهُوَ أَوَّلُ مَنْ قَاسَ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir, from Ibn Shawdhab, from Matar, from al-Hasan: That he recited this verse: 'You created me from fire and created him from clay' [Surah al-A'raf, verse 12], he said: Iblis used analogy, and he is the first to use analogy.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir ne Ibn Shawdhab se bataya: Humein Matar ne bataya, al-Hasan se: ke unhone yeh aayat padhi: 'Tu ne mujhe aag se banaaya aur usay mitti se banaaya' [Surah Al-A'raf, aayat 12], unhone kaha: Iblees ne qiyaas kiya aur woh pehla shakhs hai jisne qiyaas kiya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" إِنِّي أَخَافُ، أَوْ أَخْشَى أَنْ أَقِيسَ، فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمِي "
24.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Abu Awanah, from Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid, from al-Sha'bi, from Masruq: That he said: I fear, or I am wary, that I might use analogy, and my foot slip.
24.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Abu Awanah se bataya: Humein Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid ne bataya, al-Sha'bi se, Masruq se: ke unhone kaha: Mujhe dar hai, ya mujhe khauf hai, ke main qiyaas karun, aur mera pair phisal jaaye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الْأَحْمَرُ ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، قَالَ :" وَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ أَخَذْتُمْ بِالْمَقَايِيسِ، لَتُحَرِّمُنَّ الْحَلَالَ، وَلَتُحِلُّنَّ الْحَرَامَ "
24.en: Narrated by Sadaqah ibn al-Fadl, from Abu Khalid al-Ahmar, from Isma'il, from al-Sha'bi: He said: By Allah, if you take to analogies, you will surely make the lawful unlawful, and make the unlawful lawful.
24.hi: Sadaqah ibn al-Fadl ne Abu Khalid al-Ahmar se bataya: Humein Isma'il ne bataya, al-Sha'bi se: Unhone kaha, Allah ki qasam, agar tum qiyaas apnaao, to tum zaroor halal ko haraam kar doge, aur haraam ko halal kar doge.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : كَانَ يَقُولُ :" مَا أَبْغَضَ إِلَيَّ أَرَأَيْتَ، أَرَأَيْتَ يَسْأَلُ الرَّجُلُ صَاحِبَهُ فَيَقُولُ : أَرَأَيْتَ وَكَانَ لَا يُقَايِسُ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Hasan ibn Bishr, from his father, from Isma'il, from Amir: That he used to say: There is nothing more hateful to me than: What do you think, what do you think, when a man asks his companion and says: What do you think, and he was not one to use analogy.
24.hi: Al-Hasan ibn Bishr ne apne walid se bataya: Humein Isma'il ne bataya, Amir se: ke woh kehte the: Mujhe kisi cheez se itni nafrat nahi jitni: Tumhara kya khayal hai, tumhara kya khayal hai se, jab aadmi apne saathi se poochta hai aur kehta hai: Tumhara kya khayal hai, aur woh khud qiyaas nahi karte the.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ الزِّبْرِقَانِ ، قَالَ :" نَهَانِي أَبُو وَائِلٍ  أَنْ أُجَالِسَ أَصْحَابَ أَرَأَيْتَ "
24.en: Narrated by Sadaqah ibn al-Fadl, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from al-Zibriqan: He said: Abu Wa'il forbade me from sitting with the companions of what do you think.
24.hi: Sadaqah ibn al-Fadl ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se bataya: Humein al-Zibriqan ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Abu Wa'il ne mujhe 'tumhara kya khayal hai' wale sathiyon ke saath baithne se mana kiya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، قَالَ :" لَوْ أَنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ كَانُوا عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَنَزَلَتْ عَامَّةُ الْقُرْآنِ يَسْأَلُونَكَ، يَسْأَلُونَكَ "
24.en: Narrated by Sadaqah ibn al-Fadl, from Ibn Uyaynah, from Isma'il, from al-Sha'bi: He said: Had these people existed in the time of the Prophet ﷺ, most of the Qur'an would have been revealed as: They ask you, they ask you.
24.hi: Sadaqah ibn al-Fadl ne Ibn Uyaynah se bataya: Humein Isma'il ne bataya, al-Sha'bi se: Unhone kaha, Agar yeh log Nabi ﷺ ke zamane mein hote, to Quran ka zyada hissa isi tarah nazil hota: Woh aapse poochte hain, woh aapse poochte hain.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ طَلْحَةَ ، عَنْ مَيْمُونٍ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ ، قَالَ : قَالَ لِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ  : " يَا أَبَا حَمْزَةَ،وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ تَكَلَّمْتُ، وَلَوْ وَجَدْتُ بُدًّا مَا تَكَلَّمْتُ، وَإِنَّ زَمَانًا أَكُونُ فِيهِ فَقِيهَ أَهْلِ الْكُوفَةِ زَمَانُ سُوءٍ "
24.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Aban, from Muhammad (Ibn Talhah), from Maymun Abu Hamzah: He said: Ibrahim said to me: O Abu Hamzah, by Allah, I have indeed spoken, though had I found a way around it, I would not have spoken, and indeed a time in which I am the jurist of the people of Kufah is a bad time.
24.hi: Isma'il ibn Aban ne Muhammad se bataya (Ibn Talhah): Mujhe Maymun Abu Hamzah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Ibrahim ne mujhse kaha: Ae Abu Hamzah, Allah ki qasam, maine baat ki hai, aur agar mujhe isse bachne ka koi raasta milta, to main na bolta, aur woh zamana jismein main Kufah walon ka faqih hoon, bura zamana hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ  ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عُمَرُ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ :" إِيَّاكَ وَالْمُكَايَلَةَ "، يَعْنِي : فِي الْكَلَامِ
24.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Sufyan, from Layth, from Mujahid: He said: Umar رضي الله عنه said: Beware of excessive measuring, meaning: in speech.
24.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein Layth ne bataya, Mujahid se: Unhone kaha, Umar رضي الله عنه ne kaha: Zyada naapne (baaton mein) se bacho, yaani: baatchit mein.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ الْبَصْرِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ الْهُذَلِيُّ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، قَالَ : " شَهِدْتُ شُرَيْحًا ، وَجَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ مُرَادٍ، فَقَالَ : يَا أَبَا أُمَيَّةَ، مَا دِيَةُ الْأَصَابِعِ؟، قَالَ :عَشْرٌ عَشْرٌ، قَالَ : يَا سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، أَسَوَاءٌ هَاتَانِ؟ جَمَعَ بَيْنَ الْخِنْصِرِ وَالْإِبْهَامِ، فَقَالَ شُرَيْحٌ : يَا سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، أَسَوَاءٌ أُذُنُكَ وَيَدُكَ؟ فَإِنَّ الْأُذُنَ يُوَارِيهَا الشَّعْرُ، وَالْكُمَّةُ وَالْعِمَامَةُ فِيهَا نِصْفُ الدِّيَةِ، وَفِي الْيَدِ نِصْفُ الدِّيَةِ، وَيْحَكَ : إِنَّ السُّنَّةَ سَبَقَتْ قِيَاسَكُمْ فَاتَّبِعْ وَلَا تَبْتَدِعْ، فَإِنَّكَ لَنْ تَضِلَّ مَا أَخَذْتَ بِالْأَثَرِ، قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ : فَقَالَ لِي الشَّعْبِيُّ  : يَا هُذَلِيُّ، لَوْ أَنَّ أَحْنَفَكُمْ قُتِلَ وَهَذَا الصَّبِيُّ فِي مَهْدِهِ أَكَانَ دِيَتُهُمَا سَوَاءً؟، قُلْتُ : نَعَمْ، قَالَ : فَأَيْنَ الْقِيَاسُ؟ "
24.en: Narrated by Hajjaj al-Basri, from Abu Bakr al-Hudhali, from al-Sha'bi: He said: I witnessed Shurayh, and a man from Murad came to him, and said: O Abu Umayyah, what is the blood-money for the fingers? He said: Ten each, he said: Glory be to Allah, are these two equal? Bringing together the little finger and the thumb, so Shurayh said: Glory be to Allah, are your ear and your hand equal? For the ear is covered by hair, and a cap, and a turban, and it has half the blood-money, and the hand has half the blood-money, woe to you: the sunnah preceded your analogy, so follow and do not innovate, for you will not go astray as long as you take to the [prophetic] precedent. Abu Bakr said: So al-Sha'bi said to me: O Hudhali, if the most sensible of you were killed, and this infant in its cradle [were killed], would their blood-money be equal? I said: Yes, he said: Then where is the analogy?
24.hi: Hajjaj al-Basri ne Abu Bakr al-Hudhali se bataya: Humein al-Sha'bi ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Shurayh ke saath maujood tha, to Murad ka ek aadmi unke paas aaya, aur poocha: Ae Abu Umayyah, ungliyon ka khoon-baha kya hai? Unhone kaha: Har ek ke liye das, usne poocha: Subhaanallah, kya yeh dono barabar hain? Chhoti ungli aur angoothe ko milaate hue, to Shurayh ne kaha: Subhaanallah, kya tumhaara kaan aur tumhara haath barabar hain? Kyunki kaan baalon se dhaka hota hai, aur topi, aur pagdi, aur usme aadhi diyat hai, aur haath mein aadhi diyat, afsos tumpar: Sunnat tumhare qiyaas se pehle hai, so pairwi karo aur bidat mat nikaalo, kyunki tum kabhi gumraah nahi hoge jab tak tum riwaayat ko pakde rahoge. Abu Bakr kehte hain: To al-Sha'bi ne mujhse kaha: Ae Hudhali, agar tumhare mein sabse aqalmand shakhs qatal kiya jaaye, aur yeh bachcha apne palane mein [qatal kiya jaaye], to kya unki diyat barabar hogi? Maine kaha: Haan, unhone poocha: To qiyaas kahan hai?

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ  ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ مُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ :" يُفْتَحُ الْقُرْآنُ عَلَى النَّاسِ حَتَّى يَقْرَأَهُ الْمَرْأَةُ وَالصَّبِيُّ وَالرَّجُلُ، فَيَقُولُ الرَّجُلُ : قَدْ قَرَأْتُ الْقُرْآنَ فَلَمْ أُتَّبَعُ، وَاللَّهِ لَأَقُومَنَّ بِهِ فِيهِمْ لَعَلِّي أُتَّبَعُ، فَيَقُومُ بِهِ فِيهِمْ فَلَا يُتَّبَعُ، فَيَقُولُ : قَدْ قَرَأْتُ الْقُرْآنَ فَلَمْ أُتَّبَعْ، وَقَدْ قُمْتُ بِهِ فِيهِمْ، فَلَمْ أُتَّبَعْ، لأَحْتَظِرْنَّ فِي بَيْتِي مَسْجِدًا لَعَلِّي أُتَّبَعْ، فَيَحْتَظِرُ فِي بَيْتِهِ مَسْجِدًا فَلَا يُتَّبَعُ، فَيَقُولُ : قَدْ قَرَأْتُ الْقُرْآنَ فَلَمْ أُتَّبَعْ، وَقُمْتُ بِهِ فِيهِمْ فَلَمْ أُتَّبَعْ، وَقَدْ احْتَظَرْتُ فِي بَيْتِي مَسْجِدًا، فَلَمْ أُتَّبَعْ، وَاللَّهِ لَآتِيَنَّهُمْ بِحَدِيثٍ لَا يَجِدُونَهُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ G وَلَمْ يَسْمَعُوهُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ لَعَلِّي أُتَّبَعُ، قَالَ مُعَاذٌ : فَإِيَّاكُمْ وَمَا جَاءَ بِهِ فَإِنَّ مَا جَاءَ بِهِ ضَلَالَةٌ "
24.en: Narrated by Marwan ibn Muhammad, from Sa'id, from Rabi'ah ibn Yazid: He said: Mu'adh ibn Jabal رضي الله عنه said: The Qur'an will be opened up to the people until the woman and the child and the man recite it, so the man says: I have recited the Qur'an but am not followed, by Allah, I will surely stand with it among them, perhaps I will be followed, so he stands with it among them but is not followed, so he says: I have recited the Qur'an but am not followed, and I have stood with it among them but am not followed, I will surely make an enclosure in my house as a mosque, perhaps I will be followed, so he makes an enclosure in his house as a mosque but is not followed, so he says: I have recited the Qur'an but am not followed, and I stood with it among them but am not followed, and I have made an enclosure in my house as a mosque but am not followed, by Allah, I will surely bring them a hadith that they will not find in the Book of Allah, exalted is He, and have not heard from the Messenger of Allah, perhaps I will be followed, Mu'adh said: So beware of what he brings, for what he brings is misguidance.
24.hi: Marwan ibn Muhammad ne Sa'id se bataya: Humein Rabi'ah ibn Yazid ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Mu'adh ibn Jabal رضي الله عنه ne kaha: Quran logon ke liye khol diya jaayega yahan tak ke aurat aur bachcha aur mard isay padhein, to aadmi kahega: Maine Quran padha lekin meri pairwi nahi hui, Allah ki qasam, main zaroor isse unke darmiyan khada hounga, shaayad meri pairwi ho, to woh unke darmiyan isse khada hota hai lekin uski pairwi nahi hoti, to woh kehta hai: Maine Quran padha lekin meri pairwi nahi hui, aur maine isse unke darmiyan khada kiya lekin meri pairwi nahi hui, main zaroor apne ghar mein ek masjid ka gherav banaaunga, shaayad meri pairwi ho, to woh apne ghar mein ek masjid ka gherav banaata hai lekin uski pairwi nahi hoti, to woh kehta hai: Maine Quran padha lekin meri pairwi nahi hui, aur maine isse unke darmiyan khada kiya lekin meri pairwi nahi hui, aur maine apne ghar mein ek masjid ka gherav banaaya lekin meri pairwi nahi hui, Allah ki qasam, main zaroor unke paas aisi hadith laaunga jo unhein Allah Ta'ala ki Kitaab mein nahi milegi aur jo unhone Rasulullah se nahi suni hogi, shaayad meri pairwi ho, Mu'adh kehte hain: To jo woh laaye usse bacho, kyunki jo woh laaye woh gumraahi hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ هُوَ ابْنُ مِغْوَلٍ قَالَ : قَالَ لِي الشَّعْبِيُّ  :" مَا حَدَّثُوكَ هَؤُلَاءِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَخُذْ بِهِ، وَمَا قَالُوهُ بِرَأْيِهِمْ، فَأَلْقِهِ فِي الْحُشِّ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Malik (Ibn Mighwal): He said: Al-Sha'bi said to me: Whatever these people narrate to you from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, take it, and whatever they say by their own opinion, throw it in the toilet.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Malik se bataya (Ibn Mighwal): Unhone kaha, Al-Sha'bi ne mujhse kaha: Yeh log tumhein Rasulullah ﷺ se jo bhi riwaayat karein, isay le lo, aur jo woh apni raay se kahein, isay bakhaar mein phenk do.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنِي الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ حُبَابٍ ، أَخْبَرَنِي رَجَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَةَ بْنَ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ ، يَقُولُ :" قَدْ رَضِيتُ مِنْ أَهْلِ زَمَانِي هَؤُلَاءِ أَنْ لَا يَسْأَلُونِي وَلَا أَسْأَلُهُمْ، إِنَّمَا يَقُولُ أَحَدُهُمْ أَرَأَيْتَ، أَرَأَيْتَ؟ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Abbas ibn Sufyan, from Zayd ibn Hubab, from Raja ibn Abi Salamah: He said: I heard Abdah ibn Abi Lubabah say: I have become content with the people of my time that they do not ask me, and I do not ask them, one of them only says: What do you think, what do you think?
24.hi: Al-Abbas ibn Sufyan ne Zayd ibn Hubab se bataya: Mujhe Raja ibn Abi Salamah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abdah ibn Abi Lubabah ko kehte suna: Main apne zamane ke logon se isi baat par razi ho gaya hoon ke woh mujhse na poochein aur main unse na poochun, unmein se koi sirf yeh kehta hai: Tumhara kya khayal hai, tumhara kya khayal hai?

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ بَهْدَلَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ  ، قَالَ : خَطَّ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمًا خَطًّا، ثُمَّ قَالَ :" هَذَا سَبِيلُ اللَّهِ "، ثُمَّ خَطَّ خُطُوطًا عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، وَعَنْ شِمَالِهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " هَذِهِ سُبُلٌ عَلَى كُلِّ سَبِيلٍ مِنْهَا شَيْطَانٌ يَدْعُو إِلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ تَلَا : # وَأَنَّ هَذَا صِرَاطِي مُسْتَقِيمًا فَاتَّبِعُوهُ وَلا تَتَّبِعُوا السُّبُلَ فَتَفَرَّقَ بِكُمْ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ سورة الأنعام آية 153 # "
24.en: Narrated by Affan, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Asim ibn Bahdalah, from Abu Wa'il, from Abdullah ibn Mas'ud: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ drew a line for us one day, then said: This is the path of Allah, then he drew lines to his right, and to his left, then said: These are paths, on every path of them is a devil calling to it, then he recited: 'And that this is My path, being straight, so follow it, and do not follow the [other] ways, for they will separate you from His way' [Surah al-An'am, verse 153].
24.hi: Affan ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Asim ibn Bahdalah ne bataya, Abu Wa'il se, Abdullah ibn Mas'ud se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne humare liye ek din ek lakeer khaincha, fir farmaya: Yeh Allah ka raasta hai, fir aapne apni daayi taraf, aur apni baayi taraf lakeerein khaincheen, fir farmaya: Yeh raaste hain, in mein se har raaste par ek shaytan hai jo uski taraf bulaata hai, fir aapne padha: 'Aur yeh ke yeh mera raasta hai, seedha, so isi ki pairwi karo, aur doosre raastay mat apnaao, kyunki woh tumhein uske raaste se alag kar denge' [Surah Al-An'am, aayat 153].

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا وَرْقَاءُ ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  : # وَلا تَتَّبِعُوا السُّبُلَ سورة الأنعام آية 153 #، قَالَ :" الْبِدَعَ وَالشُّبُهَاتِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Warqa, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid: Concerning 'and do not follow the [other] ways' [Surah al-An'am, verse 153], he said: Innovations and ambiguities.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Warqa se bataya: Humein Ibn Abi Najih ne bataya, Mujahid se: is aayat ke baare mein 'aur doosre raastay mat apnaao' [Surah Al-An'am, aayat 153]: unhone kaha: Bidaten aur shubhaat.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبِي  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : كُنَّا نَجْلِسُ عَلَى بَابِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَبْلَ صَلَاةِ الْغَدَاةِ، فَإِذَا خَرَجَ، مَشَيْنَا مَعَهُ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ، فَجَاءَنَا أَبُو مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيُّ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، فَقَالَ :أَخَرَجَ إِلَيْكُمْ أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بَعْدُ؟، قُلْنَا : لَا، فَجَلَسَ مَعَنَا حَتَّى خَرَجَ، فَلَمَّا خَرَجَ، قُمْنَا إِلَيْهِ جَمِيعًا، فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُو مُوسَى : يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ آنِفًا أَمْرًا أَنْكَرْتُهُ وَلَمْ أَرَ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ إِلَّا خَيْرًا، قَالَ : فَمَا هُوَ؟، فَقَالَ : إِنْ عِشْتَ فَسَتَرَاهُ، قَالَ : رَأَيْتُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ قَوْمًا حِلَقًا جُلُوسًا يَنْتَظِرُونَ الصَّلَاةَ فِي كُلِّ حَلْقَةٍ رَجُلٌ، وَفِي أَيْدِيهِمْ حَصَا، فَيَقُولُ : كَبِّرُوا مِائَةً، فَيُكَبِّرُونَ مِائَةً، فَيَقُولُ : هَلِّلُوا مِائَةً، فَيُهَلِّلُونَ مِائَةً، وَيَقُولُ : سَبِّحُوا مِائَةً، فَيُسَبِّحُونَ مِائَةً، قَالَ : فَمَاذَا قُلْتَ لَهُمْ؟، قَالَ : مَا قُلْتُ لَهُمْ شَيْئًا انْتِظَارَ رَأْيِكَ أَوِ انْتِظَارَ أَمْرِكَ، قَالَ : أَفَلَا أَمَرْتَهُمْ أَنْ يَعُدُّوا سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ، وَضَمِنْتَ لَهُمْ أَنْ لَا يَضِيعَ مِنْ حَسَنَاتِهِمْ؟ ثُمَّ مَضَى وَمَضَيْنَا مَعَهُ حَتَّى أَتَى حَلْقَةً مِنْ تِلْكَ الْحِلَقِ، فَوَقَفَ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَقَالَ : مَا هَذَا الَّذِي أَرَاكُمْ تَصْنَعُونَ؟، قَالُوا : يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ حَصًا نَعُدُّ بِهِ التَّكْبِيرَ، وَالتَّهْلِيلَ، وَالتَّسْبِيحَ، قَالَ : " فَعُدُّوا سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ، فَأَنَا ضَامِنٌ أَنْ لَا يَضِيعَ مِنْ حَسَنَاتِكُمْ شَيْءٌ، وَيْحَكُمْ يَا أُمَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ ، مَا أَسْرَعَ هَلَكَتَكُمْ ! هَؤُلَاءِ صَحَابَةُ نَبِيِّكُمْ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مُتَوَافِرُونَ، وَهَذِهِ ثِيَابُهُ لَمْ تَبْلَ، وَآنِيَتُهُ لَمْ تُكْسَرْ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، إِنَّكُمْ لَعَلَى مِلَّةٍ هِيَ أَهْدَى مِنْ مِلَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، أَوْ مُفْتَتِحُو بَابِ ضَلَالَةٍ "، قَالُوا : وَاللَّهِ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، مَا أَرَدْنَا إِلَّا الْخَيْرَ، قَالَ : " وَكَمْ مِنْ مُرِيدٍ لِلْخَيْرِ لَنْ يُصِيبَهُ، إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَّ قَوْمًا يَقْرَؤُونَ الْقُرْآنَ لَا يُجَاوِزُ تَرَاقِيَهُمْ، وَايْمُ اللَّهِ مَا أَدْرِي لَعَلَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ مِنْكُمْ "، ثُمَّ تَوَلَّى عَنْهُمْ، فَقَالَ عَمْرُو بْنُ سَلَمَةَ : رَأَيْنَا عَامَّةَ أُولَئِكَ الْحِلَقِ يُطَاعِنُونَا يَوْمَ النَّهْرَوَانِ مَعَ الْخَوَارِجِ
24.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Amr ibn Yahya: He said: I heard my father narrating, from his father, he said: We used to sit at the door of Abdullah ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه before the morning prayer, so when he came out, we would walk with him to the mosque, so Abu Musa al-Ash'ari رضي الله عنه came to us, and said: Has Abu Abd al-Rahman come out to you yet? We said, No, so he sat with us until he came out, so when he came out, we all stood to him, so Abu Musa said to him: O Abu Abd al-Rahman, I saw a moment ago in the mosque something I disapproved of, and I did not see, praise be to Allah, other than good, he said: What was it? So he said: If you live, you will see it, he said: I saw in the mosque groups sitting in circles waiting for the prayer, in each circle a man, and in their hands were pebbles, so he says: Say Allahu Akbar a hundred times, so they say Allahu Akbar a hundred times, so he says: Say La ilaha illa Allah a hundred times, so they say it a hundred times, and he says: Glorify Allah a hundred times, so they glorify Allah a hundred times, he said: So what did you say to them? He said: I did not say anything to them, waiting for your opinion or waiting for your command, he said: Why did you not command them to count their bad deeds instead, and guarantee them that none of their good deeds would be lost? Then he proceeded and we proceeded with him until he came to one of those circles, and stood over them, and said: What is this that I see you doing? They said: O Abu Abd al-Rahman, pebbles with which we count the takbir, and the tahlil, and the tasbih, he said: Then count your sins, for I guarantee that none of your good deeds will be lost, woe to you, O nation of Muhammad, how quickly is your ruin! These are the Companions of your Prophet ﷺ, abundant among you, and these are his garments not yet worn out, and his vessels not yet broken, by the One in whose hand is my soul, you are either upon a way more guided than the way of Muhammad, or you are opening the door of misguidance, they said: By Allah, O Abu Abd al-Rahman, we intended only good, he said: How many who intend good never attain it, indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ told us that a people will recite the Qur'an that does not go beyond their collarbones, and by Allah, I do not know, perhaps most of them are among you, then he turned away from them, so Amr ibn Salamah said: We saw most of those circles fighting against us on the day of al-Nahrawan with the Khawarij.
24.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Amr ibn Yahya se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine apne walid ko riwaayat karte suna, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, Hum Abdullah ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه ke darwaze par subah ki namaz se pehle baithte the, to jab woh nikalte, hum unke saath masjid tak chalte, to Abu Musa al-Ash'ari رضي الله عنه humare paas aaye, aur poocha: Kya Abu Abd al-Rahman abhi tak aapke paas nikle hain? Humne kaha, Nahi, to woh humare saath baithe yahan tak ke woh nikle, to jab woh nikle, hum sab unki taraf khade hue, to Abu Musa ne unse kaha: Ae Abu Abd al-Rahman, maine abhi masjid mein ek aisi cheez dekhi jise maine na-pasand kiya, aur maine, Hamdulillah, isse pehle sirf bhalaai dekhi hai, unhone poocha: Woh kya tha? To unhone kaha: Agar aap zinda rahe, to aap ise khud dekhenge, unhone kaha: Maine masjid mein kuch log dekhe jo halqe bana kar baithe namaz ka intezaar kar rahe the, har halqe mein ek aadmi, aur unke haathon mein kankariyaan thi, to woh kehte: Sau martaba takbir kaho, to woh sau martaba takbir kehte, to woh kehte: Sau martaba tahlil kaho, to woh sau martaba tahlil kehte, aur woh kehte: Sau martaba tasbih kaho, to woh sau martaba tasbih karte, unhone poocha: To tumne unse kya kaha? Unhone kaha: Maine unse kuch nahi kaha, aapki raay ka, ya aapke hukum ka, intezaar karte hue, unhone kaha: Kya aapne unhein hukum nahi diya ke woh apne gunah gine, aur unhein zamaanat di ke unki koi bhi naiki zaya nahi hogi? Fir woh aage badhe aur hum unke saath aage badhe yahan tak ke woh un halqon mein se ek tak pahunche, aur unpar khade hue, aur poocha: Yeh kya hai jo main tumhein karte dekh raha hoon? Unhone kaha: Ae Abu Abd al-Rahman, kankariyaan jinse hum takbir, tahlil, aur tasbih ginte hain, unhone kaha: To apne gunah gino, main zamaanat deta hoon ke tumhari koi bhi naiki zaya nahi hogi, afsos tumpar, Ae Muhammad ki ummat, tumhari halaakat kitni tezi se aayi hai! Yeh tumhare Nabi ﷺ ke sahaba hain, tum mein bahut zyada hain, aur yeh unke kapde abhi purane nahi hue, aur unke bartan abhi toote nahi, us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, tum ya to Muhammad ke tareeqe se zyada hidayat wale tareeqe par ho, ya tum gumraahi ka darwaza khol rahe ho, unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, Ae Abu Abd al-Rahman, humara irada sirf bhalaai tha, unhone kaha: Kitne aise log hain jo bhalaai chaahte hain lekin usay kabhi nahi paate, Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein bataaya ke aisa giroh hoga jo Quran padhega lekin yeh unke halq se aage nahi jaayega, aur Allah ki qasam, mujhe nahi maloom, shaayad unmein se zyada tar tum mein se hi hon, fir woh unse mud gaye, to Amr ibn Salamah ne kaha: Humne un halqon ke zyada tar logon ko al-Nahrawan ke din Khawarij ke saath humse ladte dekha.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ :" اتَّبِعُوا، وَلَا تَبْتَدِعُوا، فَقَدْ كُفِيتُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from al-A'mash, from Habib, from Abu Abd al-Rahman: He said: Abdullah رضي الله عنه said: Follow, and do not innovate, for you have indeed been sufficed.
24.hi: Ya'la ne al-A'mash se bataya: Humein Habib ne bataya, Abu Abd al-Rahman se: Unhone kaha, Abdullah رضي الله عنه ne kaha: Pairwi karo, aur bidat mat nikaalo, kyunki tumhein kaafi kar diya gaya hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ، وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ :" إِنَّ أَفْضَلَ الْهَدْيِ هَدْيُ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَشَرَّ الْأُمُورِ مُحْدَثَاتُهَا، وَكُلَّ بِدْعَةٍ ضَلَالَةٌ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf, from Yahya ibn Sulaym, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a sermon to us, and praised Allah, and lauded Him, then said: Indeed the best guidance is the guidance of Muhammad ﷺ, and the worst of matters are those newly invented, and every innovation is misguidance.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf ne Yahya ibn Sulaym se bataya: Mujhse Ja'far ibn Muhammad ne bataya, apne walid se, Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein khutba diya aur Allah ki hamd ki, aur uski tareef ki, fir farmaya: Sabse behtar hidayat Muhammad ﷺ ki hidayat hai, aur sabse bure maamle woh hain jo naye niklein, aur har bidat gumraahi hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق الْفَزَارِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَسْلَمَ الْمِنْقَرِيِّ  ، عَنْ بِلَادِ بْنِ عِصْمَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، يَقُولُ : وَكَانَ إِذَا كَانَ عَشِيَّةَ الْخَمِيسِ لَيْلَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ، قَامَ فَقَالَ :" إِنَّ أَصْدَقَ الْقَوْلِ قَوْلُ اللَّهِ G وَإِنَّ أَحْسَنَ الْهَدْيِ هَدْيُ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَالشَّقِيُّ مَنْ شَقِيَ فِي بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ، وَإِنَّ شَرَّ الرَّوَايَا رَوَايَا الْكَذِبِ، وَشَرَّ الْأُمُورِ مُحْدَثَاتُهَا، وَكُلَّ مَا هُوَ آتٍ قَرِيبٌ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Abu Ishaq al-Fazari, from Aslam al-Minqari, from Bilad ibn Ismah: He said: I heard Abdullah ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه say, and when it was Thursday evening, the night of Friday, he would stand and say: Indeed the truest speech is the speech of Allah, exalted is He, and indeed the best guidance is the guidance of Muhammad ﷺ, and the wretched one is he who is wretched in his mother's womb, and indeed the worst narrations are the narrations of lies, and the worst of matters are those newly invented, and everything that is coming is near.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Abu Ishaq al-Fazari se bataya: Humein Aslam al-Minqari ne bataya, Bilad ibn Ismah se: Unhone kaha, Maine Abdullah ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه ko kehte suna, aur jab Jumee ki raat, Jumee ki shaam hoti, woh khade hote aur kehte: Sabse sachi baat Allah Ta'ala ki baat hai, aur sabse behtar hidayat Muhammad ﷺ ki hidayat hai, aur badnaseeb woh hai jo apni maa ke pet mein hi badnaseeb ho jaaye, aur sabse buri riwaayaten jhoot ki riwaayaten hain, aur sabse bure maamle woh hain jo naye niklein, aur jo bhi aane wala hai woh qareeb hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق الْفَزَارِيِّ ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ ، عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ ، قَالَ :" مَا أَخَذَ رَجُلٌ بِبِدْعَةٍ فَرَاجَعَ سُنَّةً "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Abu Ishaq al-Fazari, from Layth, from Ayyub, from Ibn Sirin: He said: No man took to an innovation but that he returned to a sunnah.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Abu Ishaq al-Fazari se bataya: Humein Layth ne bataya, Ayyub se, Ibn Sirin se: Unhone kaha, Koi aadmi kisi bidat ko nahi apnaata magar woh kisi sunnat ki taraf laut aata hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ  ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" إِنَّمَا أَخَافُ عَلَى أُمَّتِي الْأَئِمَّةَ الْمُضِلِّينَ "
24.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah, from Abu Asma, from Thawban رضي الله عنه, from the Prophet ﷺ: That he said: I only fear for my nation the misguiding leaders.
24.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Ayyub ne bataya, Abu Qilabah se, Abu Asma se, Thawban se رضي الله عنه, Nabi ﷺ se: ke aapne farmaya, Main apni ummat ke liye sirf gumraah karne wale peshwaon se darta hoon.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الْهَرَوِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَرِيرٍ ، عَنْ حَيَّةَ بِنْتِ أَبِي حَيَّةَ ، قَالَتْ : دَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا رَجُلٌ بِالظَّهِيرَةِ، فَقُلْتُ : يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، مِنْ أَيْنَ أَقْبَلْتَ؟، قَالَ : أَقْبَلْتُ أَنَا وَصَاحِبٌ لِي فِي بُغَاءٍ لَنَا، فَانْطَلَقَ صَاحِبِي يَبْغِي، وَدَخَلْتُ أَنَا أَسْتَظِلُّ بِالظِّلِّ، وَأَشْرَبُ مِنْ الشَّرَابِ، فَقُمْتُ إِلَى لُبَيْنَةٍ حَامِضَةٍ، ورُبَّمَا قَالَتْ : فَقُمْتُ إِلَى ضَيْحَةٍ حَامِضَةٍ، فَسَقَيْتُهُ مِنْهَا، فَشَرِبَ، وَشَرِبْتُ، قَالَتْ : وَتَوَسَّمْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ : يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ مَنْ أَنْتَ؟، فَقَالَ أَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ ، قُلْتُ : أَنْتَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ صَاحِبُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الَّذِي سَمِعْتُ بِهِ؟، قَالَ : نَعَمْ، قَالَتْ : فَذَكَرْتُ غَزْوَنَا خَثْعَمًا، وَغَزْوَةَ بَعْضِنَا بَعْضًا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، وَمَا جَاءَ اللَّهُ بِهِ مِنْ الْأُلْفَةِ وَأَطْنَابِ الْفَسَاطِيطِ وَشَبَّكَ ابْنُ عَوْنٍ أَصَابِعَهُ، وَوَصَفَهُ لَنَا مُعَاذٌ، وَشَبَّكَ أَحْمَدُ، فَقُلْتُ : يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ،حَتَّى مَتَى تَرَى أَمْرَ النَّاسِ هَذَا؟ ، قَالَ : " مَا اسْتَقَامَتْ الْأَئِمَّةُ "، قُلْتُ : مَا الْأَئِمَّةُ؟، قَالَ : " أَمَا رَأَيْتِ السَّيِّدَ يَكُونُ فِي الْحِوَاءِ فَيَتَّبِعُونَهُ، وَيُطِيعُونَهُ؟ فَمَا اسْتَقَامَ أُولَئِكَ "
24.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah Abu al-Walid al-Harawi, from Mu'adh ibn Mu'adh, from Ibn Awn, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Abu Zur'ah ibn Amr ibn Jarir, from Hayyah bint Abi Hayyah: She said: A man entered upon us at midday, so I said: O servant of Allah, from where have you come? He said: I and a companion of mine came seeking [game/livestock] for us, so my companion went off seeking, and I entered to shade myself in the shade, and drink from the drink, so I got up to some sour milk, and perhaps she said: so I got up to some sour whey, and gave him some to drink from it, so he drank, and I drank, she said: And I studied him and said: O servant of Allah, who are you? So he said: I am Abu Bakr, I said: Are you Abu Bakr, the companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, whom I have heard of? He said, Yes, she said: So I mentioned our raid against Khath'am, and the raids of some of us against others in the Jahiliyyah, and what Allah brought of unity and the ropes of the tent-poles - and Ibn Awn interlaced his fingers, and Mu'adh described it for us, and Ahmad interlaced them - so I said: O servant of Allah, until when do you see this matter of the people continuing? He said: As long as the leaders remain upright, I said: What are the leaders? He said: Have you not seen the chief who is in the encampment, so they follow him, and obey him? So those [leaders] are not upright.
24.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah Abu al-Walid al-Harawi ne Mu'adh ibn Mu'adh se bataya: Humein Ibn Awn ne bataya, Amr ibn Sa'id se, Abu Zur'ah ibn Amr ibn Jarir se, Hayyah bint Abi Hayyah se: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi dophar ke waqt humare paas dakhil hua, to maine kaha: Ae Allah ke banda, aap kahan se aaye? Unhone kaha: Main aur mera ek saathi apne liye kuch talaash karne aaye, to mera saathi talaash karte hue chala gaya, aur main saaye mein baithne aur peene ke liye dakhil hua, to main ek khatti chhachh ki taraf gaya, aur shaayad unhone kaha: to main ek khatte peene ki cheez ki taraf gaya, to maine unhein isse pilaaya, to unhone piya, aur maine piya, unhone kaha: Aur maine unhein gaur se dekha aur kaha: Ae Allah ke banda, aap kaun hain? To unhone kaha: Main Abu Bakr hoon, maine poocha: Kya aap Abu Bakr hain, Rasulullah ﷺ ke saathi, jinke baare mein maine suna hai? Unhone kaha, Haan, unhone kaha: To maine Khath'am ke khilaaf humaari jung, aur Jahiliyat mein humme se kuch ki doosron ke khilaaf jung ka zikr kiya, aur jo Allah unity aur khaymon ki rassiyaan laaya - aur Ibn Awn ne apni ungliyaan ekattha kiya, aur Mu'adh ne yeh humein bataaya, aur Ahmad ne ekattha kiya - to maine poocha: Ae Allah ke banda, kab tak aap logon ke is maamle ko yun hi chalte dekhenge? Unhone kaha: Jab tak peshwaain seedhi rahenge, maine poocha: Peshwaain kya hain? Unhone kaha: Kya aapne sardaar ko basti mein rehte hue nahi dekha, to woh uski pairwi karte hain, aur uski itaa'at karte hain? To woh [peshwaain] seedhi nahi rahin.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَخٍ لِعَدِيِّ بْنِ أَرْطَاةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ أَخْوَفُ مَا أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ الْأَئِمَّةَ الْمُضِلِّينَ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Salt, from Ibrahim ibn Sa'd, from his father, from a brother of Adi ibn Artat, from Abu al-Darda: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: The most fearful thing I fear for you is the misguiding leaders.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Salt ne Ibrahim ibn Sa'd se bataya: Humein unke walid ne bataya, Adi ibn Artat ke ek bhai se, Abu al-Darda se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Jis cheez ka mujhe tumhare liye sabse zyada khauf hai woh gumraah karne wale peshwaain hain.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ بَيَانٍ بْنِ بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ  ، قَالَ : دَخَلَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ   رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ عَلَى امْرَأَةٍ مِنْ أَحْمَسَ يُقَالُ لَهَا زَيْنَبُ ، قَالَ : فَرَآهَا لَا تَتَكَلَّمُ، فَقَالَ :" مَا لَهَا لَا تَتَكَلَّمُ؟ "، قَالُوا : نَوَتْ حَجَّةً مُصْمِتَةً، فَقَالَ لَهَا : " تَكَلَّمِي، فَإِنَّ هَذَا لَا يَحِلُّ، هَذَا مِنْ عَمَلِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ "، قَالَ : فَتَكَلَّمَتْ، فَقَالَتْ : مَنْ أَنْتَ، قَالَ : أَنَا امْرُؤٌ مِنْ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ، قَالَتْ : مِنْ أَيِّ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ؟، قَالَ : مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ، قَالَتْ : فَمِنْ أَيِّ قُرَيْشٍ أَنْتَ؟، قَالَ : إِنَّكِ لَسَئُولٌ، أَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، قَالَتْ : مَا بَقَاؤُنَا عَلَى هَذَا الْأَمْرِ الصَّالِحِ الَّذِي جَاءَ اللَّهُ بِهِ بَعْدَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ؟، فَقَالَ : بَقَاؤُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مَا اسْتَقَامَتْ بِكُمْ أَئِمَّتُكُمْ، قَالَتْ : وَمَا الْأَئِمَّةُ؟، قَالَ : أَمَا كَانَ لِقَوْمِكِ رُؤَسَاءُ وَأَشْرَافٌ، يَأْمُرُونَهُمْ فَيُطِيعُونَهُمْ؟، قَالَتْ : بَلَى، قَالَ : فَهُمْ مِثْلُ أُولَئِكَ عَلَى النَّاسِ
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Abu Awanah, from Bayan ibn Bishr, from Qays ibn Abi Hazim: He said: Abu Bakr رضوان الله عليه entered upon a woman from Ahmas called Zaynab, he said: So he saw her not speaking, so he said: What is wrong with her that she does not speak? They said: She intended a silent pilgrimage, so he said to her: Speak, for this is not lawful, this is from the deeds of the Jahiliyyah, he said: So she spoke, and she said: Who are you? He said: I am a man of the Emigrants, she said: From which of the Emigrants? He said: From Quraysh, she said: And from which of Quraysh are you? He said: You are indeed inquisitive, I am Abu Bakr, she said: What is our continuance upon this good matter which Allah brought after the Jahiliyyah? So he said: Your continuance upon it is as long as your leaders remain upright with you, she said: And what are the leaders? He said: Did your people not have chiefs and nobles, who commanded them and they obeyed them? She said, Yes, he said: They are like those over the people.
24.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Abu Awanah se bataya: Humein Bayan ibn Bishr ne bataya, Qays ibn Abi Hazim se: Unhone kaha, Abu Bakr رضوان الله عليه Ahmas ki ek aurat ke paas gaye jise Zaynab kaha jaata tha, unhone kaha: To unhone dekha ke woh baat nahi kar rahi, to unhone poocha: Isay kya hua hai ke yeh baat nahi karti? Logon ne kaha: Usne khamosh rehne wala Hajj karne ka irada kiya hai, to unhone usse kaha: Baat karo, kyunki yeh jaayez nahi, yeh Jahiliyat ke amal mein se hai, unhone kaha: To usne baat ki, aur usne poocha: Aap kaun hain? Unhone kaha: Main Muhajireen mein se ek aadmi hoon, usne poocha: Kaunse Muhajireen mein se? Unhone kaha: Quraysh mein se, usne poocha: To aap Quraysh mein se kaunse hain? Unhone kaha: Tum bahut poochtaachh karti ho, main Abu Bakr hoon, usne poocha: Is achhe maamle par jo Allah Jahiliyat ke baad laaya, humara baaqi rehna kya hai? To unhone kaha: Tumhara isper baaqi rehna tab tak hai jab tak tumhari peshwaain tumhare saath seedhi rahein, usne poocha: Aur peshwaain kya hain? Unhone kaha: Kya tumhari qaum ke koi sardaar aur izzat waale log nahi the, jo unhein hukum dete aur woh unki itaa'at karte? Usne kaha, Haan, unhone kaha: Woh log logon par unhi jaise hain.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ وَاصِلٍ  ، عَنْ امْرَأَةٍ يُقَالُ لَهَا عَائِذَةُ L4047 ، قَالَتْ : رَأَيْتُ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ يُوصِي الرِّجَالَ وَالنِّسَاءَ، وَيَقُولُ :" مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنْكُمْ مِنْ امْرَأَةٍ، أَوْ رَجُلٍ، فَالسَّمْتَ الْأَوَّلَ، فَإِنَّكُمْ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ "، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ : السَّمْتُ الطَّرِيقُ
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi, from Sufyan, from Wasil, from a woman called A'idhah: She said: I saw Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه advising the men and the women, and saying: Whoever among you meets a woman, or a man, [holding to] the earlier way, then you are upon the natural disposition. Abdullah said: al-samt is: the path.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Muhammad ne Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi se bataya: Humein Sufyan ne bataya, Wasil se, ek aurat se jise A'idhah kaha jaata tha: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه ko mardon aur auraton ko naseehat karte dekha, aur kehte the: Jo tum mein se kisi aurat, ya aadmi, ko [pehle wale] purane tareeqe par paaye, to tum fitrat par ho. Abdullah kehte hain: 'Al-Samt' ka matlab hai: raasta.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيٌّ هُوَ ابْنُ مُسْهِرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ حُدَيْرٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ لِي عُمَرُ   : هَلْ تَعْرِفُ مَا يَهْدِمُ الْإِسْلَامَ؟، قُلْتُ : لَا، قَالَ :" يَهْدِمُهُ زَلَّةُ الْعَالِمِ، وَجِدَالُ الْمُنَافِقِ بِالْكِتَابِ، وَحُكْمُ الْأَئِمَّةِ الْمُضِلِّينَ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Ali (Ibn Mushir), from Abu Ishaq, from al-Sha'bi, from Ziyad ibn Hudayr: He said: Umar said to me: Do you know what destroys Islam? I said, No, he said: It is destroyed by the slip of the scholar, and the argument of the hypocrite using the Book, and the ruling of the misguiding leaders.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Ali se bataya (Ibn Mushir), Abu Ishaq se, al-Sha'bi se, Ziyad ibn Hudayr se: Unhone kaha, Umar ne mujhse kaha: Kya tumhein maloom hai Islam ko kya barbaad karta hai? Maine kaha, Nahi, unhone kaha: Isay aalim ki lagzish, aur munafiq ka Kitaab se jhagda, aur gumraah karne wale peshwaon ka hukum barbaad karta hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا هَارُونُ ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ، قَالَ :" لَا تُجَالِسُوا أَصْحَابَ الْخُصُومَاتِ، فَإِنَّهُمْ يَخُوضُونَ فِي آيَاتِ اللَّهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Harun, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from Layth, from al-Hakam, from Muhammad ibn Ali: He said: Do not sit with the people of arguments, for they delve into the verses of Allah.
24.hi: Harun ne Hafs ibn Ghiyath se bataya: Humein Layth ne bataya, al-Hakam se, Muhammad ibn Ali se: Unhone kaha, Jhagda karne walon ke saath mat baitho, kyunki woh Allah ki aayaton mein uljhte hain.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ ، عَنْ شريك ، عَنْ مُبَارَكٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" سُنَّتُكُمْ وَاللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ بَيْنَهُمَا : بَيْنَ الْغَالِي وَالْجَافِي، فَاصْبِرُوا عَلَيْهَا رَحِمَكُمْ اللَّهُ، فَإِنَّ أَهْلَ السُّنَّةِ كَانُوا أَقَلَّ النَّاسِ فِيمَا مَضَى، وَهُمْ أَقَلُّ النَّاسِ فِيمَا بَقِيَ : الَّذِينَ لَمْ يَذْهَبُوا مَعَ أَهْلِ الْإِتْرَافِ فِي إِتْرَافِهِمْ، وَلَا مَعَ أَهْلِ الْبِدَعِ فِي بِدَعِهِمْ، وَصَبَرُوا عَلَى سُنَّتِهِمْ حَتَّى لَقُوا رَبَّهُمْ، فَكَذَلِكُمْ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ فَكُونُوا "
24.en: Narrated by al-Husayn ibn Mansur, from Abu Usamah, from Sharik, from Mubarak, from al-Hasan: He said: Your sunnah, by the One besides whom there is no god, is between the two of them: between the excessive and the negligent, so be patient upon it, may Allah have mercy on you, for the people of the sunnah have always been the fewest of people in what has passed, and they are the fewest of people in what remains: those who did not go along with the people of extravagance in their extravagance, nor with the people of innovations in their innovations, and were patient upon their sunnah until they met their Lord, so be like that, Allah willing.
24.hi: Al-Husayn ibn Mansur ne Abu Usamah se bataya: Humein Sharik ne bataya, Mubarak se, al-Hasan se: Unhone kaha, Tumhari sunnat, us Zaat ki qasam jiske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, in dono ke darmiyan hai: had se zyada aur laapervaahi ke darmiyan, so isper sabr karo, Allah tumpar reham kare, kyunki sunnat wale hamesha logon mein sabse kam rahe hain jo guzar chuka hai, aur woh baaqi mein bhi logon mein sabse kam hain: jo na fizool-kharchi karne walon ke saath unki fizool-kharchi mein gaye, na hi bidaton ke logon ke saath unki bidaton mein, aur apni sunnat par sabr karte rahe yahan tak ke woh apne Rab se milen, so Inshaallah aise hi bano.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ  ، وَمَالِكِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" الْقَصْدُ فِي السُّنَّةِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ الِاجْتِهَادِ فِي الْبِدْعَةِ "
24.en: Narrated by Musa ibn Khalid, from Isa ibn Yunus, from al-A'mash, from Umarah, and Malik ibn al-Harith, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid, from Abdullah رضي الله عنه: He said: Moderation in the sunnah is better than striving in innovation.
24.hi: Musa ibn Khalid ne Isa ibn Yunus se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya, Umarah, aur Malik ibn al-Harith se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid se, Abdullah se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Sunnat mein miyaana-ravi bidat mein koshish karne se behtar hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْخُزَاعِيُّ ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" لَقَدْ أَدْرَكْتُ أَقْوَامًا لَوْ لَمْ يُجَاوِزْ أَحَدُهُمْ ظِفْرًا، لَمَا جَاوَزْتُهُ، كَفَى إِزْرَاءً عَلَى قَوْمٍ أَنْ تُخَالَفَ أَفْعَالُهُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Mansur ibn Salamah al-Khuza'i, from Sharik, from Abu Hamzah, from Ibrahim: He said: I have met people that had one of them not exceeded a fingernail's width, I would not have exceeded it, it is disgrace enough for a people that their actions be opposed.
24.hi: Mansur ibn Salamah al-Khuza'i ne Sharik se bataya: Humein Abu Hamzah ne bataya, Ibrahim se: Unhone kaha, Maine aise log paaye ke agar unmein se koi bhi ek naakhun ki chaudaai se bhi aage na badhta, to main bhi na badhta, kisi qaum ke liye itni ruswaai kaafi hai ke unke amal ki mukhaalifat ki jaaye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ  : # أَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ وَأُولِي الأَمْرِ مِنْكُمْ سورة النساء آية 59 #، قَالَ :" أُولُو الْعِلْمِ وَالْفِقْهِ، وَطَاعَةُ الرَّسُولِ : اتِّبَاعُ الْكِتَابِ وَالسُّنَّةِ "
24.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Abd al-Malik, from Ata: Concerning: 'Obey Allah and obey the Messenger and those in authority among you' [Surah al-Nisa, verse 59], he said: Those of knowledge and understanding, and obedience to the Messenger is: following the Book and the sunnah.
24.hi: Ya'la ne Abd al-Malik se bataya: Humein Ata ne bataya: is aayat ke baare mein: 'Allah ki itaa'at karo aur Rasool ki itaa'at karo aur apne mein se ikhtiyaar walon ki' [Surah An-Nisa, aayat 59], unhone kaha: Ilm aur fiqh wale, aur Rasool ki itaa'at hai: Kitaab aur sunnat ki pairwi karna.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ أَدْهَمَ ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ شُبْرُمَةَ  عَنْ شَيْءٍ، وَكَانَتْ عِنْدِي مَسْأَلَةٌ شَدِيدَةٌ، فَقُلْتُ : رَحِمَكَ اللَّهُ، انْظُرْ فِيهَا، قَالَ :" إِذَا وَضَحَ لِيَ الطَّرِيقُ، وَوَجَدْتُ الْأَثَرَ، لَمْ أَحْبَسْ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Ibrahim ibn Adham: He said: I asked Ibn Shubrumah about something, and I had a difficult matter, so I said: May Allah have mercy on you, look into it, he said: When the path becomes clear to me, and I find the precedent, I do not hold back.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Ibrahim ibn Adham se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibn Shubrumah se ek cheez ke baare mein poocha, aur mere paas ek mushkil maamla tha, to maine kaha: Allah aap par reham kare, isme dekhiye, unhone kaha: Jab mujhe raasta saaf ho jaata hai, aur mujhe nishaan mil jaata hai, main nahi rukta.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ الْهَيْثَمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَوْفٌ  ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ جَابِرٍ  مِنْ أَهْلِ هَجَرَ، قَالَ : قَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ  ، قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" تَعَلَّمُوا الْعِلْمَ وَعَلِّمُوهُ النَّاسَ، تَعَلَّمُوا الْفَرَائِضَ وَعَلِّمُوهُ النَّاسَ، تَعَلَّمُوا الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلِّمُوهُ النَّاسَ، فَإِنِّي امْرُؤٌ مَقْبُوضٌ، وَالْعِلْمُ سَيُنْقَصُ وَتَظْهَرُ الْفِتَنُ حَتَّى يَخْتَلِفَ اثْنَانِ فِي فَرِيضَةٍ لَا يَجِدَانِ أَحَدًا يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمَا "
24.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn al-Haytham, from Awf, from a man called Sulayman ibn Jabir from the people of Hajar: He said: Ibn Mas'ud said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: Learn knowledge and teach it to the people, learn the fixed [inheritance] shares and teach them to the people, learn the Qur'an and teach it to the people, for I am one who will be taken away, and knowledge will decrease, and trials will appear, until two people will differ about a fixed share and not find anyone to settle it between them.
24.hi: Uthman ibn al-Haytham ne Awf se bataya: Humein ek aadmi ne bataya jise Sulayman ibn Jabir kaha jaata tha, Hajar ke logon mein se: Unhone kaha, Ibn Mas'ud ne kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne mujhse farmaya: Ilm seekho aur logon ko sikhaao, muqarrar hisse seekho aur logon ko sikhaao, Quran seekho aur logon ko sikhaao, kyunki main ek aisa aadmi hoon jo utha liya jaayega, aur ilm kam hota jaayega aur fitne zaahir honge yahan tak ke do log ek muqarrar hisse ke baare mein ikhtilaaf karenge aur unhein koi nahi milega jo unke darmiyan faisla kare.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ أَبِي خَلِيفَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ زِيَادَ بْنَ مِخْرَاقٍ  ذَكَرَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : أَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ، وَأَبَا مُوسَى إِلَى الْيَمَنِ ، قَالَ :" تَسَانَدَا وَتَطَاوَعَا، وَبَشِّرَا وَلَا تُنَفِّرَا "، فَقَدِمَا الْيَمَنَ ، فَخَطَبَ النَّاسَ مُعَاذٌ فَحَضَّهُمْ عَلَى الْإِسْلَامِ، وَأَمَرَهُمْ بِالتَّفَقُّهِ فِي الْقُرْآنِ، وَقَالَ : إِذَا فَعَلْتُمْ ذَلِكَ، فَاسْأَلُونِي أُخْبِرْكُمْ عَنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ، فَمَكَثُوا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَمْكُثُوا، فَقَالُوا لِمُعَاذٍ : قَدْ كُنْتَ أَمَرْتَنَا إِذَا نَحْنُ تَفَقَّهْنَا وَقَرَأْنَا أَنْ نَسْأَلَكَ فَتُخْبِرَنَا بِأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ مُعَاذٌ : إِذَا ذُكِرَ الرَّجُلُ بِخَيْرٍ، فَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ بِشَرٍّ فَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ
24.en: Narrated by Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim, from Umar ibn Abi Khalifah: He said: I heard Ziyad ibn Mikhraq mention, from Abdullah ibn Umar رضي الله عنه: he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent Mu'adh ibn Jabal, and Abu Musa to Yemen, he said: Support one another and be obedient to one another, and give good news and do not repel, so they arrived in Yemen, so Mu'adh delivered a sermon to the people and urged them upon Islam, and commanded them with understanding of the Qur'an, and said: When you do that, ask me and I will inform you of the people of Paradise from the people of the Fire, so they remained as long as Allah willed them to remain, so they said to Mu'adh: You had commanded us that when we understood and recited, we should ask you and you would inform us of the people of Paradise from the people of the Fire, so Mu'adh said to them: When a man is mentioned with good, he is of the people of Paradise, and when he is mentioned with evil, he is of the people of the Fire.
24.hi: Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim ne Umar ibn Abi Khalifah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ziyad ibn Mikhraq ko zikr karte suna, Abdullah ibn Umar se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne Mu'adh ibn Jabal, aur Abu Musa ko Yemen bheja, unhone kaha: Ek doosre ka saath do aur ek doosre ki itaa'at karo, aur khush-khabri do aur log ko na bhagaao, to woh dono Yemen pahunche, to Mu'adh ne logon ko khutba diya aur unhein Islam par ubhaara, aur unhein Quran samajhne ka hukum diya, aur kaha: Jab tum aisa karo, to mujhse poochho aur main tumhein Jahannam walon mein se Jannat walon ke baare mein bataaunga, so woh rahe jab tak Allah ne chaaha ke woh rahein, to unhone Mu'adh se kaha: Aapne humein hukum diya tha ke jab hum samajh jaayein aur padh lein, to hum aapse poochein aur aap humein Jahannam walon mein se Jannat walon ke baare mein bataayein, to Mu'adh ne unse kaha: Jab aadmi ka zikr achhaai se hota hai, to woh Jannat walon mein se hai, aur jab uska zikr burai se hota hai, to woh Jahannam walon mein se hai.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ  يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : قِيلَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَيُّ النَّاسِ أَكْرَمُ؟، قَالَ :" أَتْقَاهُمْ "، قَالُوا : لَيْسَ عَنْ هَذَا نَسْأَلُكَ، قَالَ : " فَيُوسُفُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ بْنُ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ بْنِ خَلِيلِ اللَّهِ "، قَالُوا : لَيْسَ عَنْ هَذَا نَسْأَلُكَ، قَالَ : " فَعَنْ مَعَادِنِ الْعَرَبِ تَسْأَلُونِي؟ خِيَارُهُمْ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ خِيَارُهُمْ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ إِذَا فَقُهُوا "
24.en: Narrated by Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim, from Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Qattan, from Ubaydullah, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id, from his father, from Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه: He said: It was said: O Messenger of Allah, who among people is most noble? He said: The most God-fearing of them, they said: We do not ask you about this, he said: Then Yusuf ibn Ya'qub, the prophet of Allah, son of the prophet of Allah, son of the close friend of Allah, they said: We do not ask you about this, he said: Then you are asking me about the origins/lineages of the Arabs? Their best in the Jahiliyyah are their best in Islam, when they gain understanding.
24.hi: Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim ne Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Qattan se bataya: Humein Ubaydullah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id ko riwaayat karte suna, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Poocha gaya: Ya Rasulullah, log mein sabse izzat wala kaun hai? Aapne farmaya: Unmein sabse zyada taqwa wala, unhone kaha: Hum aapse yeh nahi poochte, aapne farmaya: To Yusuf ibn Ya'qub, Allah ke Nabi, Allah ke Nabi ke bete, Allah ke khaleel ke bete, unhone kaha: Hum aapse yeh nahi poochte, aapne farmaya: To tum mujhse Arab ke nasab ke baare mein poochte ho? Unke behtareen Jahiliyat mein unke behtareen Islam mein hain, jab woh samajh paayein.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ هُوَ ابْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ الْهَاديِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ  ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ :" مَنْ يُرِدْ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا، يُفَقِّهْهُ فِي الدِّينِ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yazid ibn Abdullah ibn Usamah ibn al-Hadi, from Abd al-Wahhab, from Ibn Shihab, from Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Mu'awiyah رضي الله عنه: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: Whoever Allah wishes good for, He gives him understanding in the religion.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhe Yazid ibn Abdullah ibn Usamah ibn al-Hadi ne bataya, Abd al-Wahhab se, Ibn Shihab se, Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Mu'awiyah se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, Jiske saath Allah bhalaai chaahe, usay woh deen mein samajh de deta hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ يُرِدْ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا، يُفَقِّهْهُ فِي الدِّينِ "
24.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Sulayman, from Isma'il ibn Ja'far, from Abdullah ibn Sa'id ibn Abi Hind, from his father, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Whoever Allah wishes good for, He gives him understanding in the religion.
24.hi: Sa'id ibn Sulayman ne Isma'il ibn Ja'far se bataya: Humein Abdullah ibn Sa'id ibn Abi Hind ne bataya, apne walid se, Ibn Abbas se رضي الله عنهما: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Jiske saath Allah bhalaai chaahe, usay woh deen mein samajh de deta hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ جَبَلَةَ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ مُحَيْرِيزٍ  ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ :" مَنْ يُرِدْ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا، يُفَقِّهْهُ فِي الدِّينِ "
24.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Jabalah ibn Atiyyah, from Ibn Muhayriz, from Mu'awiyah: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: Whoever Allah wishes good for, He gives him understanding in the religion.
24.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hammad ibn Salamah se bataya: Humein Jabalah ibn Atiyyah ne bataya, Ibn Muhayriz se, Mu'awiyah se: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, Jiske saath Allah bhalaai chaahe, usay woh deen mein samajh de deta hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل هُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ أَبِي عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّهُ شَهِدَ خُطْبَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ : " أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ،إِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لَا أَدْرِي لَعَلِّي لَا أَلْقَاكُمْ بَعْدَ يَوْمِي هَذَا بِمَكَانِي هَذَا، فَرَحِمَ اللَّهُ مَنْ سَمِعَ مَقَالَتِي الْيَوْمَ فَوَعَاهَا، فَرُبَّ حَامِلِ فِقْهٍ وَلَا فِقْهَ لَهُ، وَرُبَّ حَامِلِ فِقْهٍ إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ أَفْقَهُ مِنْهُ، وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ أَمْوَالَكُمْ وَدِمَاءَكُمْ حَرَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ كَحُرْمَةِ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ، فِي هَذَا الشَّهْرِ، فِي هَذَا الْبَلَدِ، وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ الْقُلُوبَ لَا تُغِلُّ عَلَى ثَلَاثٍ : إِخْلَاصِ الْعَمَلِ لِلَّهِ، وَمُنَاصَحَةِ أُولِي الْأَمْرِ، وَعَلَى لُزُومِ جَمَاعَةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، فَإِنَّ دَعْوَتَهُمْ تُحِيطُ مِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Da'ud al-Zahrani, from Isma'il (Ibn Ja'far), from Amr ibn Abi Amr, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Huwayrith, from Muhammad ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im, from his father رضي الله عنه: That he witnessed the sermon of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the Day of Arafah during the Farewell Pilgrimage: O people, I, by Allah, do not know, perhaps I will not meet you after this day of mine at this place of mine, so may Allah have mercy on whoever hears my speech today and preserves it, for how many a bearer of understanding has no understanding, and how many a bearer of understanding conveys it to one who understands more than he does, and know that your wealth and your blood are unlawful to you like the sanctity of this day, in this month, in this land, and know that hearts do not harbor resentment over three things: sincerity of deed for Allah, and sincere advice to those in authority, and holding to the community of Muslims, for their call surrounds them from behind.
24.hi: Sulayman ibn Da'ud al-Zahrani ne Isma'il se bataya (Ibn Ja'far): Humein Amr ibn Abi Amr ne bataya, Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Huwayrith se, Muhammad ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im se, apne walid رضي الله عنه se: ke unhone Hajjat-ul-Wida' mein Arafah ke din Rasulullah ﷺ ka khutba dekha: Ae logo, main, Allah ki qasam, nahi jaanta, shaayad main tumse is din ke baad is jagah par phir kabhi na milun, so Allah reham kare us par jo aaj meri baat sune aur usay yaad rakhe, kyunki kitne hi samajh dene wale khud samajh nahi rakhte, aur kitne hi samajh dene wale isse aisi shakhs tak pahunchaate hain jo unse zyada aqal-mand hai, aur jaan lo ke tumhara maal aur tumhara khoon tumpar utna hi haraam hai jitna is din ki hurmat hai, is mahine mein, is shehar mein, aur jaan lo ke dil teen cheezon ke khilaaf koi kudurat nahi rakhte: Allah ke liye amal ka ikhlaas, aur ikhtiyaar walon ke liye khair-khwaahi, aur Musalmanon ki jama'at ko pakde rehna, kyunki unki pukaar unhein cheher se ghere rehti hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالْخَيْفِ مِنْ مِنًى ، فَقَالَ :" نَضَّرَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا سَمِعَ مَقَالَتِي فَوَعَاهَا، ثُمَّ أَدَّاهَا إِلَى مَنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْهَا، فَرُبَّ حَامِلِ فِقْهٍ لَا فِقْهَ لَهُ، وَرُبَّ حَامِلِ فِقْهٍ إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ أَفْقَهُ مِنْهُ ثَلَاثٌ لَا يُغِلُّ عَلَيْهِنَّ قَلْبُ الْمُؤْمِنِ : إِخْلَاصُ الْعَمَلِ لِلَّهِ، وَطَاعَةُ ذَوِي الْأَمْرِ، وَلُزُومُ الْجَمَاعَةِ، فَإِنَّ دَعْوَتَهُمْ تَكُونُ مِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad (Ibn Ishaq), from al-Zuhri, from Muhammad ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im, from his father: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood at al-Khayf in Mina, and said: May Allah brighten the face of a servant who hears my speech, and preserves it, then conveys it to whoever has not heard it, for how many a bearer of understanding has no understanding, and how many a bearer of understanding conveys it to one who understands more than he does, three things over which the heart of a believer harbors no resentment: sincerity of deed for Allah, and obedience to those in authority, and holding to the community, for their call is from behind them.
24.hi: Ahmad ibn Khalid ne Muhammad se bataya (Ibn Ishaq), al-Zuhri se, Muhammad ibn Jubayr ibn Mut'im se, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ Mina mein al-Khayf mein khade hue, aur farmaya: Allah us banda ka chehra roshan kare jo meri baat sune, aur isse yaad rakhe, fir isse pahunchaaye jisne isse na suna ho, kyunki kitne hi samajh dene wale khud samajh nahi rakhte, aur kitne hi samajh dene wale isse aisi shakhs tak pahunchaate hain jo unse zyada aqal-mand hai, teen cheezein aisi hain jinke khilaaf momin ka dil koi kudurat nahi rakhta: Allah ke liye amal ka ikhlaas, aur ikhtiyaar walon ki itaa'at, aur jama'at ko pakde rehna, kyunki unki pukaar unke peechhe se aati hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عِصْمَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرَمِيُّ بْنُ عُمَارَةَ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبَانَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : خَرَجَ زَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ   مِنْ عِنْدِ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، بِنِصْفِ النَّهَارِ، قَالَ : فَقُلْتُ مَا خَرَجَ هَذِهِ السَّاعَةَ مِنْ عِنْدِ مَرْوَانَ إِلَّا وَقَدْ سَأَلَهُ عَنْ شَيْءٍ، فَأَتَيْتُهُ، فَسَأَلْتُهُ، فَقَالَ : نَعَمْ، سَأَلَنِي عَنْ حَدِيثٍ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" نَضَّرَ اللَّهُ امْرَأً سَمِعَ مِنَّا حَدِيثًا فَحَفِظَهُ، فَأَدَّاهُ إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ أَحْفَظُ مِنْهُ، فَرُبَّ حَامِلِ فِقْهٍ لَيْسَ بِفَقِيهٍ، وَرُبَّ حَامِلِ فِقْهٍ إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ أَفْقَهُ مِنْهُ، لَا يَعْتَقِدُ قَلْبُ مُسْلِمٍ عَلَى ثَلَاثِ خِصَالٍ إِلَّا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ "، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : مَا هُنَّ؟، قَالَ : إِخْلَاصُ الْعَمَلِ لِلَّهِ، وَالنَّصِيحَةُ لِوُلَاةِ الْأَمْرِ، وَلُزُومُ الْجَمَاعَةِ، فَإِنَّ دَعْوَتَهُمْ تُحِيطُ مِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ، وَمَنْ كَانَتْ الْآخِرَةُ نِيَّتَهُ، جَعَلَ اللَّهُ غِنَاهُ فِي قَلْبِهِ، وَجَمَعَ لَهُ شَمْلَهُ، وَأَتَتْهُ الدُّنْيَا وَهِيَ رَاغِمَةٌ، وَمَنْ كَانَتْ الدُّنْيَا نِيَّتَهُ، فَرَّقَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ شَمْلَهُ، وَجَعَلَ فَقْرَهُ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ، وَلَمْ يَأْتِهِ مِنْ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا مَا قُدِّرَ لَهُ "، قَالَ : وَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلَاةِ الْوُسْطَى، قَالَ : هِيَ الظُّهْرُ
24.en: Narrated by Ismah ibn al-Fadl, from Harami ibn Umarah, from Shu'bah, from Umar ibn Sulayman, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Aban ibn Uthman, from his father: He said: Zayd ibn Thabit came out from Marwan ibn al-Hakam's presence at midday, he said: So I said: He has only come out at this hour from Marwan's presence because he asked him about something, so I came to him, and asked him, so he said: Yes, he asked me about a hadith I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said: May Allah brighten the face of a man who heard a hadith from us and preserved it, and conveyed it to one who is more preserving of it than him, for how many a bearer of understanding is not a jurist, and how many a bearer of understanding conveys it to one who understands more than he does; the heart of a Muslim never holds fast to three qualities except that he enters Paradise, he said: I said: What are they? He said: Sincerity of deed for Allah, and sincere advice to those in authority, and holding to the community, for their call surrounds them from behind, and whoever has the Hereafter as his intention, Allah places contentment in his heart, and gathers his affairs together, and this world comes to him though it is reluctant, and whoever has this world as his intention, Allah scatters his affairs, and places his poverty before his eyes, and nothing comes to him from this world except what was decreed for him, he said: And I asked him about the middle prayer, he said: It is Zuhr.
24.hi: Ismah ibn al-Fadl ne Harami ibn Umarah se bataya: Humein Shu'bah ne bataya, Umar ibn Sulayman se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Aban ibn Uthman se, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, Zayd ibn Thabit dophar ke waqt Marwan ibn al-Hakam ke paas se nikle, unhone kaha: To maine kaha: Woh is waqt Marwan ke paas se sirf isliye nikle hain kyunki unhone unse kuch poocha hai, to main unke paas gaya, aur unse poocha, to unhone kaha: Haan, unhone mujhse ek hadith ke baare mein poocha jo maine Rasulullah ﷺ se suni thi, unhone farmaya: Allah us aadmi ka chehra roshan kare jo humse koi hadith sune aur isse yaad rakhe, aur isse aisi shakhs tak pahunchaaye jo usse zyada isay yaad rakhne wala ho, kyunki kitne hi samajh dene wale khud faqih nahi hote, aur kitne hi samajh dene wale isse aisi shakhs tak pahunchaate hain jo unse zyada aqal-mand hai; Musalman ka dil kabhi teen khaslaton par mazbooti se qaayam nahi hota magar woh Jannat mein dakhil hota hai, unhone kaha: Maine poocha: Woh kya hain? Unhone kaha: Allah ke liye amal ka ikhlaas, aur ikhtiyaar walon ke liye khair-khwaahi, aur jama'at ko pakde rehna, kyunki unki pukaar unhein cheher se ghere rehti hai, aur jiski niyat Aakhirat ho, Allah uske dil mein qanaat rakh deta hai, aur uske maamlon ko ekattha kar deta hai, aur duniya uske paas aati hai jabke woh na-chaahte hue aati hai, aur jiski niyat duniya ho, Allah uske maamlon ko bikher deta hai, aur uski gareebi uski aankhon ke saamne rakh deta hai, aur usse duniya mein se sirf wahi milta hai jo uske liye muqarrar hai, unhone kaha: Aur maine unse namaz-e-wusta ke baare mein poocha, unhone kaha: Woh Zuhr hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْقُرَشِيُّ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ زُبَيْدٍ الْيَامِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَجْلَانِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ :" نَضَّرَ اللَّهُ امْرَءًا سَمِعَ مِنَّا حَدِيثًا فَبَلَّغَهُ كَمَا سَمِعَهُ، فَرُبَّ مُبَلَّغٍ أَوْعَى مِنْ سَامِعٍ، ثَلَاثٌ لَا يَغِلُّ عَلَيْهِنَّ قَلْبُ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ : إِخْلَاصُ الْعَمَلِ لِلَّهِ، وَالنَّصِيحَةُ لِكُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ، وَلُزُومُ جَمَاعَةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، فَإِنَّ دُعَاءَهُمْ يُحِيطُ مِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Musa, from Amr ibn Muhammad al-Qurashi, from Isra'il, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Zubayd al-Yami, from Abu al-Ajlan, from Abu al-Darda رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a sermon to us, and said: May Allah brighten the face of a man who heard a hadith from us and conveyed it as he heard it, for how many a conveyor understands better than the hearer, three things over which the heart of a Muslim man harbors no resentment: sincerity of deed for Allah, and sincere advice to every Muslim, and holding to the community of Muslims, for their supplication surrounds them from behind.
24.hi: Yahya ibn Musa ne Amr ibn Muhammad al-Qurashi se bataya: Humein Isra'il ne bataya, Abd al-Rahman ibn Zubayd al-Yami se, Abu al-Ajlan se, Abu al-Darda se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein khutba diya aur farmaya: Allah us aadmi ka chehra roshan kare jo humse koi hadith sune aur isse waise hi pahunchaaye jaise usne suna, kyunki kitne hi pahunchaane wale sunne wale se zyada aqal-mand hote hain, teen cheezein aisi hain jinke khilaaf Musalman aadmi ka dil koi kudurat nahi rakhta: Allah ke liye amal ka ikhlaas, aur har Musalman ke liye khair-khwaahi, aur Musalmanon ki jama'at ko pakde rehna, kyunki unki dua unhein cheher se ghere rehti hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ  ،  عَنْ جَابِرٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ كَذَبَ عَلَيَّ مُتَعَمِّدًا، فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنْ النَّارِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Hushaym, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Whoever lies about me deliberately, let him take his seat in the Fire.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Hushaym se bataya: Humein Abu al-Zubayr ne bataya, Jabir se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Jo mujhpar jaan-boojh kar jhoot bole, woh apni jagah Jahannam mein banaa le.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْأَعْلَى  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" مَنْ كَذَبَ عَلَيَّ مُتَعَمِّدًا، فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنْ النَّارِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abu Awanah, from Abd al-A'la, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: Whoever lies about me deliberately, let him take his seat in the Fire.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Abu Awanah se bataya: Humein Abd al-A'la ne bataya, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas se رضي الله عنه, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, Jo mujhpar jaan-boojh kar jhoot bole, woh apni jagah Jahannam mein banaa le.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ  ، عَنْ الزُّبَيْرِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ :" مَنْ حَدَّثَ عَنِّي كَذِبًا، فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنْ النَّارِ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Yazid ibn Abdullah, from Amr ibn Abdullah ibn Urwah, from Abdullah ibn Urwah, from Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr, from al-Zubayr رضي الله عنه: That he heard the Prophet ﷺ say: Whoever narrates from me a lie, let him take his seat in the Fire.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhe Yazid ibn Abdullah ne bataya, Amr ibn Abdullah ibn Urwah se, Abdullah ibn Urwah se, Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr se, al-Zubayr se رضي الله عنه: ke unhone Nabi ﷺ ko farmaate suna, Jo mujhse jhoot riwaayat kare, woh apni jagah Jahannam mein banaa le.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي الصَّبَّاحُ بْنُ مُحَارِبٍ  ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَعْلَى بْنِ مُرَّةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" مَنْ كَذَبَ عَلَيَّ مُتَعَمِّدًا، فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنْ النَّارِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Humayd, from al-Sabbah ibn Muharib, from Umar ibn Abdullah ibn Ya'la ibn Murrah, from his father, from his grandfather: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Whoever lies about me deliberately, let him take his seat in the Fire.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Humayd ne al-Sabbah ibn Muharib se bataya: Mujhe Umar ibn Abdullah ibn Ya'la ibn Murrah ne bataya, apne walid se, apne dada se: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Jo mujhpar jaan-boojh kar jhoot bole, woh apni jagah Jahannam mein banaa le.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَسَدُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ عَتَّابٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، يَقُولُ : لَوْلَا أَنِّي أَخْشَى أَنْ أُخْطِئَ لَحَدَّثْتُكُمْ بِأَشْيَاءَ سَمِعْتُهَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَوْ قَالَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَذَاكَ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُهُ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ :" مَنْ كَذَبَ عَلَيَّ مُتَعَمِّدًا، فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنْ النَّارِ "
24.en: Narrated by Asad ibn Musa, from Shu'bah, from Attab: He said: I heard Anas ibn Malik رضي الله عنه say: Were it not that I fear I might err, I would have narrated to you things I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ or that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, and that is because I heard him ﷺ say: Whoever lies about me deliberately, let him take his seat in the Fire.
24.hi: Asad ibn Musa ne Shu'bah se bataya: Humein Attab ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Anas ibn Malik رضي الله عنه ko kehte suna: Agar mujhe khauf na hota ke main galti karunga to main tumhein aisi cheezein bataata jo maine Rasulullah ﷺ se suni ya jo Rasulullah ﷺ ne kahi, aur yeh isliye ke maine aapko ﷺ farmaate suna, Jo mujhpar jaan-boojh kar jhoot bole, woh apni jagah Jahannam mein banaa le.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ  ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ  ، وَعَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ  ، وَعَنْ التَّيْمِيِّ  ، وَعَنْ عَتَّابٍ  مَوْلَى ابْنِ هُرْمُزَ، سَمِعُوا أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" مَنْ كَذَبَ عَلَيَّ مُتَعَمِّدًا، فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنْ النَّارِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Da'ud, from Shu'bah, from Abd al-Aziz, and from Hammad ibn Abi Sulayman, and from al-Taymi, and from Attab, freed servant of Ibn Hurmuz, who all heard Anas ibn Malik رضي الله عنه, from the Prophet ﷺ: That he said: Whoever lies about me deliberately, let him take his seat in the Fire.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Da'ud se bataya: Humein Shu'bah ne bataya, Abd al-Aziz se, aur Hammad ibn Abi Sulayman se, aur al-Taymi se, aur Attab se (Ibn Hurmuz ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), jinhone sabne Anas ibn Malik رضي الله عنه ko suna, Nabi ﷺ se: ke aapne farmaya, Jo mujhpar jaan-boojh kar jhoot bole, woh apni jagah Jahannam mein banaa le.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ : " يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ،إِيَّاكُمْ وَكَثْرَةَ الْحَدِيثِ عَنِّي، فَمَنْ قَالَ عَلَيَّ، فَلَا يَقُلْ إِلَّا حَقًّا أَوْ إِلَّا صِدْقًا، وَمَنْ قَالَ عَلَيَّ مَا لَمْ أَقُلْ، فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنْ النَّارِ "
24.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad (Ibn Ishaq), from Ma'bad ibn Ka'b, from Abu Qatadah رضي الله عنه: He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say on the pulpit: O people, beware of narrating much from me, so whoever says something on my authority, let him not say anything except the truth, or except what is correct, and whoever says on my authority what I did not say, let him take his seat in the Fire.
24.hi: Ahmad ibn Khalid ne Muhammad se bataya (Ibn Ishaq), Ma'bad ibn Ka'b se, Abu Qatadah se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko mimbar par farmaate suna, Ae logo, mujhse zyada riwaayat karne se bacho, so jo mere naam par kuch kahe, woh sirf sach kahe, ya sirf sahi baat kahe, aur jo mere naam par woh kahe jo maine nahi kaha, woh apni jagah Jahannam mein banaa le.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الْأَحْوَلِ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ كَذَبَ عَلَيَّ مُتَعَمِّدًا، فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنْ النَّارِ "
24.en: Narrated by Harun ibn Mu'awiyah, from Ibrahim ibn Sulayman, from Asim al-Ahwal, from Muhammad ibn Bishr, from Anas رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Whoever lies about me deliberately, let him take his seat in the Fire.
24.hi: Harun ibn Mu'awiyah ne Ibrahim ibn Sulayman se bataya: Humein Asim al-Ahwal ne bataya, Muhammad ibn Bishr se, Anas se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Jo mujhpar jaan-boojh kar jhoot bole, woh apni jagah Jahannam mein banaa le.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرنَا هِشَامٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَقْبِضُ الْعِلْمَ انْتِزَاعًا يَنْتَزِعُهُ مِنْ النَّاسِ، وَلَكِنْ : قَبْضُ الْعِلْمِ قَبْضُ الْعُلَمَاءِ، فَإِذَا لَمْ يُبْقِ عَالِمًا، اتَّخَذَ النَّاسُ رُؤَسَاءً جُهَّالًا، فَسُئِلُوا، فَأَفْتَوْا بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ، فَضَلُّوا وَأَضَلُّوا "
24.en: Narrated by Ja'far ibn Awn, from Hisham, from his father, from Abdullah ibn Amr رضي الله عنهما: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Indeed Allah does not take away knowledge by extracting it from the people, but rather: the taking away of knowledge is the taking away of the scholars, so when He leaves no scholar, the people take ignorant leaders, so they are asked, and they give rulings without knowledge, so they go astray and lead astray.
