24.hi: Ja'far ibn Awn ne Hisham se bataya: Humein unke walid ne bataya, Abdullah ibn Amr se رضي الله عنهما: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Allah ilm ko logon se cheenkar nahi uthaata, balke: ilm ka uthna ulama ka uthna hai, so jab woh koi aalim baaqi nahi chhodta, log jaahil sardaar bana lete hain, to unse poocha jaata hai, aur woh bagair ilm ke fatwa dete hain, to woh khud gumraah hote hain aur doosron ko gumraah karte hain.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ  ، عَنْ الْحَجَّاجِ  ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي مَالِكٍ  ، عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  مَوْلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ  ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ :" خُذُوا الْعِلْمَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَذْهَبَ "، قَالُوا : وَكَيْفَ يَذْهَبُ الْعِلْمُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ، وَفِينَا كِتَابُ اللَّهِ؟، قَالَ : فَغَضِبَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : " ثَكِلَتْكُمْ أُمَّهَاتُكُمْ، أَوَلَمْ تَكُنِ التَّوْرَاةُ وَالْإِنْجِيلُ فِي بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمْ شَيْئًا؟ إِنَّ ذَهَابَ الْعِلْمِ أَنْ يَذْهَبَ حَمَلَتُهُ، إِنَّ ذَهَابَ الْعِلْمِ أَنْ يَذْهَبَ حَمَلَتُهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Musa ibn Khalid, from Mu'tamir ibn Sulayman, from al-Hajjaj, from al-Walid ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Malik, from al-Qasim Abu Abd al-Rahman, freed servant of Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid, from Abu Umamah, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: That he said: Take knowledge before it goes away, they said: And how does knowledge go away, O Prophet of Allah, when the Book of Allah is among us? He said: So he became angry, then said: May your mothers be bereaved of you, was the Torah and the Gospel not among Banu Isra'il, yet they did not benefit them anything? Indeed the going away of knowledge is that its bearers go away, indeed the going away of knowledge is that its bearers go away.
24.hi: Musa ibn Khalid ne Mu'tamir ibn Sulayman se bataya: Humein al-Hajjaj ne bataya, al-Walid ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Malik se, al-Qasim Abu Abd al-Rahman se (Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), Abu Umamah se, Rasulullah ﷺ se: ke aapne farmaya, Ilm jaane se pehle isay le lo, unhone poocha: Aur ilm kaise jaayega, Ae Allah ke Nabi, jabke Allah ki Kitaab humare paas hai? Unhone bataya: To aapko gussa aaya, fir farmaya: Tumhari maaein tumhein roein, kya Taurat aur Injeel Banu Isra'il ke paas nahi thi, lekin unhein iska koi faida nahi hua? Ilm ka jaana yehi hai ke iske le jaane wale chale jaayein, ilm ka jaana yehi hai ke iske le jaane wale chale jaayein.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ ، حَدَّثَنَا هِلَالٌ هُوَ ابْنُ خَبَّابٍ ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ ، قُلْتُ : يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، مَا عَلَامَةُ هَلَاكِ النَّاسِ؟، قَالَ :" إِذَا هَلَكَ عُلَمَاؤُهُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Thabit ibn Yazid, from Hilal (Ibn Khabbab): He said: I asked Sa'id ibn Jubayr, I said: O Abu Abdullah, what is the sign of the ruin of the people? He said: When their scholars are ruined.
24.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Thabit ibn Yazid se bataya: Humein Hilal ne bataya (Ibn Khabbab): Unhone kaha, Maine Sa'id ibn Jubayr se poocha, maine kaha: Ae Abu Abdullah, logon ki barbaadi ki nishaani kya hai? Unhone kaha: Jab unke ulama barbaad ho jaayein.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَسْعُودُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ الْجُعْفِيُّ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رُبَيِّعَةَ  ، عَنْ سَلْمَانَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" لَا يَزَالُ النَّاسُ بِخَيْرٍ مَا بَقِيَ الْأَوَّلُ حَتَّى يَتَعَلَّمَ أَوْ يُعَلِّمَ الْآخِرَ، فَإِنْ هَلَكَ الْأَوَّلُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُعَلِّمَ أَوْ يَتَعَلَّمَ الْآخِرُ، هَلَكَ النَّاسُ "
24.en: Narrated by Malik ibn Isma'il, from Mas'ud ibn Sa'd al-Ju'fi, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Abdullah ibn Rubay'ah, from Salman رضي الله عنه: He said: The people will remain in good as long as the first generation remains until it teaches or the last generation learns, but if the first generation perishes before it teaches or the last learns, the people perish.
24.hi: Malik ibn Isma'il ne Mas'ud ibn Sa'd al-Ju'fi se bataya: Humein Ata ibn al-Sa'ib ne bataya, Abdullah ibn Rubay'ah se, Salman se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Log bhalaai mein rahenge jab tak pehli nasal baaqi rahe yahan tak ke woh sikhaaye ya aakhri nasal seekhe, lekin agar pehli nasal khatam ho jaaye isse pehle ke woh sikhaaye ya aakhri seekhe, to log khatam ho jaayenge.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُدَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ قَابُوسَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" هَلْ تَدْرُونَ مَا ذَهَابُ الْعِلْمِ؟، قُلْنَا : لَا، قَالَ : ذَهَابُ الْعُلَمَاءِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Salt, from Abu Kudaynah, from Qabus, from his father, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه: He said: Do you know what the going away of knowledge is? We said, No, he said: The going away of the scholars.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Salt ne Abu Kudaynah se bataya: Humein Qabus ne bataya, apne walid se, Ibn Abbas se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Kya tumhein maloom hai ilm ka jaana kya hai? Humne kaha, Nahi, unhone kaha: Ulama ka jaana.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَسْعَدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ : أَتَدْرِي كَيْفَ يُنْقَصُ الْعِلْمُ؟، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : كَمَا يُنْفَضُ الثَّوْبُ، وَكَمَا يَقْسُو الدِّرْهَمُ، قَالَ :" لَا، وَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ لَمِنْهُ، قَبْضُ الْعِلْمِ : قَبْضُ الْعُلَمَاءِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn As'ad, from Abu Bakr, from Asim, from Abu Wa'il: He said: Hudhayfah رضي الله عنه said: Do you know how knowledge decreases? He said: I said: As a garment wears thin, and as a dirham loses its worth, he said: No, though that is indeed part of it, the taking away of knowledge is: the taking away of the scholars.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn As'ad ne Abu Bakr se bataya: Humein Asim ne bataya, Abu Wa'il se: Unhone kaha, Hudhayfah رضي الله عنه ne kaha: Kya tumhein pata hai ilm kaise kam hota hai? Unhone kaha: Maine kaha: Jaise kapda ghis jaata hai, aur jaise dirham apni qadr khota hai, unhone kaha: Nahi, aur woh iska hissa hai, ilm ka uthna hai: Ulama ka uthna.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ  ، عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ أَبِي الْأَسْوَدِ  ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ  ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" مَا لِي أَرَى عُلَمَاءَكُمْ يَذْهَبُونَ وَجُهَّالَكُمْ لَا يَتَعَلَّمُونَ؟ ! فَتَعَلَّمُوا قَبْلَ أَنْ يُرْفَعَ الْعِلْمُ، فَإِنَّ رَفْعَ الْعِلْمِ ذَهَابُ الْعُلَمَاءِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Salt, from Mansur ibn Abi al-Aswad, from Husayn, from Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd, from Abu al-Darda رضي الله عنه: He said: What is with me that I see your scholars going away and your ignorant ones not learning?! So learn before knowledge is raised away, for the raising away of knowledge is the going away of the scholars.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Salt ne Mansur ibn Abi al-Aswad se bataya: Humein Husayn ne bataya, Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd se, Abu al-Darda se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Mujhe kya hua hai ke main dekhta hoon tumhare ulama ja rahe hain aur tumhare jaahil nahi sikhte?! So ilm ko utha liye jaane se pehle seekho, kyunki ilm ka utha liya jaana ulama ka jaana hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْثَرٌ  ، عَنْ بُرْد  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى  ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" النَّاسُ عَالِمٌ وَمُتَعَلِّمٌ، وَلَا خَيْرَ فِيمَا بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ "
24.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Asad Abu Asim, from Abthar, from Burd, from Sulayman ibn Musa, from Abu al-Darda رضي الله عنه: He said: People are a scholar and a learner, there is no good in what is beyond that.
24.hi: Ahmad ibn Asad Abu Asim ne Abthar se bataya: Humein Burd ne bataya, Sulayman ibn Musa se, Abu al-Darda se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Log ya to aalim hain ya seekhne wale, iske baad kuch bhalaai nahi.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْثَرٌ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" مُعَلِّمُ الْخَيْرِ، وَالْمُتَعَلِّمُ فِي الْأَجْرِ سَوَاءٌ، وَلَيْسَ لِسَائِرِ النَّاسِ بَعْدُ خَيْرٌ "
24.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Asad Abu Asim, from Abthar, from al-A'mash, from Salim, from Abu al-Darda رضي الله عنه: He said: The teacher of good and the learner are equal in reward, and there is no good for the rest of the people after that.
24.hi: Ahmad ibn Asad Abu Asim ne Abthar se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya, Salim se, Abu al-Darda se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Bhalaai sikhaane wala, aur seekhne wala ajr mein barabar hain, aur baaki logon ke liye iske baad koi bhalaai nahi.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا قَبِيصَةُ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" اغْدُ عَالِمًا أَوْ مُتَعَلِّمًا أَوْ مُسْتَمِعًا، وَلَا تَكُنِ الرَّابِعَ فَتَهْلِكَ "
24.en: Narrated by Qabisah, from Sufyan, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from al-Hasan, from Abdullah ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه: He said: Rise each morning as a scholar, or a learner, or a listener, and do not be the fourth [i.e., a disinterested one], or you will perish.
24.hi: Qabisah ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein Ata ibn al-Sa'ib ne bataya, al-Hasan se, Abdullah ibn Mas'ud se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Subah aalim, ya seekhne wale, ya sunne wale ban kar uthho, aur chautha mat bano, warna barbaad ho jaaoge.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رُبَيِّعَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ سَلْمَانُ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ :" لَا يَزَالُ النَّاسُ بِخَيْرٍ مَا بَقِيَ الْأَوَّلُ حَتَّى يَتَعَلَّمَ الْآخِرُ، فَإِذَا هَلَكَ الْأَوَّلُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَعَلَّمَ الْآخِرُ، هَلَكَ النَّاسُ "
24.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Khalid, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Abdullah ibn Rubay'ah: He said: Salman رضي الله عنه said: The people will remain in good as long as the first generation remains until the last learns, but if the first generation perishes before the last learns, the people perish.
24.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Khalid se bataya: Humein Ata ibn al-Sa'ib ne bataya, Abdullah ibn Rubay'ah se: Unhone kaha, Salman رضي الله عنه ne kaha: Log bhalaai mein rahenge jab tak pehli nasal baaqi rahe yahan tak ke aakhri nasal seekhe, lekin agar pehli nasal khatam ho jaaye isse pehle ke aakhri seekhe, to log khatam ho jaayenge.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ  ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، قَالَا : أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَحْنَفِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عُمَرُ   :" تَفَقَّهُوا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُسَوَّدُوا "
24.en: Narrated by Wahb ibn Jarir, and Uthman ibn Umar, from Ibn Awn, from Muhammad, from al-Ahnaf: He said: Umar said: Gain understanding before you are made leaders.
24.hi: Wahb ibn Jarir, aur Uthman ibn Umar ne Ibn Awn se bataya: Humein Muhammad ne bataya, al-Ahnaf se: Unhone kaha, Umar ne kaha: Sardaar banaaye jaane se pehle deen ki samajh haasil karo.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا بَقِيَّةُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي صَفْوَانُ بْنُ رُسْتُمَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ  ، عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ  ، رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : تَطَاوَلَ النَّاسُ فِي الْبِنَاءِ فِي زَمَنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ   : " يَا مَعْشَرَ الْعُرَيْبِ،الْأَرْضَ الْأَرْضَ، إِنَّهُ لَا إِسْلَامَ إِلَّا بِجَمَاعَةٍ، وَلَا جَمَاعَةَ إِلَّا بِإِمَارَةٍ، وَلَا إِمَارَةَ إِلَّا بِطَاعَةٍ، فَمَنْ سَوَّدَهُ قَوْمُهُ عَلَى الْفِقْهِ، كَانَ حَيَاةً لَهُ وَلَهُمْ، وَمَنْ سَوَّدَهُ قَوْمُهُ عَلَى غَيْرِ فِقْهٍ، كَانَ هَلَاكًا لَهُ وَلَهُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Baqiyyah, from Safwan ibn Rustum, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Maysarah, from Tamim al-Dari رضي الله عنه: He said: People began building excessively tall in the time of Umar رضي الله عنه, so Umar said: O company of the Arabs, [stay close to] the earth, the earth, indeed there is no Islam without a community, and no community without leadership, and no leadership without obedience, so whoever his people place as leader upon understanding, it is a life for him and for them, and whoever his people place as leader without understanding, it is destruction for him and for them.
24.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Baqiyyah se bataya: Mujhe Safwan ibn Rustum ne bataya, Abd al-Rahman ibn Maysarah se, Tamim al-Dari se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Umar رضي الله عنه ke zamane mein log oonchi imaaraten banaane lage, to Umar ne kaha: Ae Arab ki jama'at, zameen [se qareeb raho], zameen, kyunki jama'at ke bagair koi Islam nahi, aur qiyaadat ke bagair koi jama'at nahi, aur itaa'at ke bagair koi qiyaadat nahi, so jise uski qaum samajh par sardaar banaaye, yeh uske aur unke liye zindagi hai, aur jise uski qaum bagair samajh ke sardaar banaaye, yeh uske aur unke liye halaakat hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا بَقِيَّةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ  ، أَنَّ الْمُهَاصِرَ بْنَ حَبِيبٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى :" إِنِّي لَسْتُ كُلَّ كَلَامِ الْحَكِيمِ أَتَقَبَّلُ، وَلَكِنِّي أَتَقَبَّلُ هَمَّهُ وَهَوَاهُ، فَإِنْ كَانَ هَمُّهُ وَهَوَاهُ فِي طَاعَتِي، جَعَلْتُ صَمْتَهُ حَمْدًا لِي وَوَقَارًا، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَتَكَلَّمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak, from Baqiyyah, from Sadaqah ibn Abdullah ibn Suhayb, from al-Muhasir ibn Habib: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Allah, exalted is He, said: I do not accept all of the wise person's speech, but I accept his concern and his desire, so if his concern and his desire are in obedience to Me, I make his silence praise of Me and dignity, even if he does not speak.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Mubarak ne Baqiyyah se bataya: Humein Sadaqah ibn Abdullah ibn Suhayb ne bataya: ke al-Muhasir ibn Habib ne kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: Main hikmat waale ka har kalaam qabool nahi karta, lekin main uski fikr aur uski khwaahish qabool karta hoon, so agar uski fikr aur uski khwaahish meri itaa'at mein hon, main uski khamoshi ko meri hamd aur waqar bana deta hoon, chahe woh baat na kare.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ  ، عَنْ حَجَّاجِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ لَيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ  ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الزَّاهِرِيَّةِ  ، يَرْفَعُ الْحَدِيثَ، أَنَّ اللَّهَ قَالَ :" أَبُثُّ الْعِلْمَ فِي آخِرِ الزَّمَانِ حَتَّى يَعْلَمَهُ الرَّجُلُ وَالْمَرْأَةُ، وَالْعَبْدُ وَالْحُرُّ، وَالصَّغِيرُ وَالْكَبِيرُ، فَإِذَا فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ بِهِمْ، أَخَذْتُهُمْ بِحَقِّي عَلَيْهِمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Makhlad ibn Malik, from Hajjaj ibn Muhammad, from Layth ibn Sa'd, from Mu'awiyah ibn Salih, from Abu al-Zahiriyyah, raising the hadith: That Allah said: I will spread knowledge in the last of times until the man and the woman, and the slave and the free, and the young and the old know it, so when I do that with them, I will hold them to My right upon them.
24.hi: Makhlad ibn Malik ne Hajjaj ibn Muhammad se bataya: Humein Layth ibn Sa'd ne bataya, Mu'awiyah ibn Salih se, Abu al-Zahiriyyah se, hadith ko marfu'an pahunchaate hue: ke Allah ne farmaya: Main aakhri zamane mein ilm phailaunga yahan tak ke aadmi aur aurat, aur ghulam aur aazad, aur chhota aur bada, isay jaan lein, so jab main unke saath aisa karunga, main unhein apne haq se pakadunga jo unpar hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ  ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ طَلَبَ شَيْئًا مِنْ هَذَا الْعِلْمِ، فَأَرَادَ بِهِ مَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ، يُدْرِكْ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ أَرَادَ بِهِ الدُّنْيَا، فَذَاكَ وَاللَّهِ حَظُّهُ مِنْهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Makhlad ibn Malik, from Makhlad ibn Husayn, from Hisham, from al-Hasan: He said: Whoever seeks something of this knowledge, and intends by it what is with Allah, will attain it, Allah willing, and whoever intends by it this world, that, by Allah, is his share of it.
24.hi: Makhlad ibn Malik ne Makhlad ibn Husayn se bataya: Humein Hisham ne bataya, al-Hasan se: Unhone kaha, Jo is ilm mein se kuch talaash kare, aur isse Allah ke paas jo hai woh chaahe, Inshaallah woh usay paayega, aur jo isse duniya chaahe, to Allah ki qasam, yehi uska hissa hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عِيسَى  ، قَالَ : قَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ   :" لَا تَعَلَّمُوا الْعِلْمَ لِثَلَاثٍ : لِتُمَارُوا بِهِ السُّفَهَاءَ، وَتُجَادِلُوا بِهِ الْعُلَمَاءَ، وَلِتَصْرِفُوا بِهِ وُجُوهَ النَّاسِ إِلَيْكُمْ، وَابْتَغُوا بِقَوْلِكُمْ مَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ، فَإِنَّهُ يَدُومُ وَيَبْقَى، وَيَنْفَدُ مَا سِوَاهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Muhammad ibn Awn, from Ibrahim ibn Isa: He said: Ibn Mas'ud said: Do not learn knowledge for three reasons: to argue with it against the foolish, and to dispute with it against the scholars, and to turn the faces of people toward you with it, and seek with your speech what is with Allah, for it endures and remains, while everything else perishes.
24.hi: Ya'la ne Muhammad ibn Awn se bataya: Humein Ibrahim ibn Isa ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Ibn Mas'ud ne kaha: Ilm teen wajahon se mat seekho: bewaqoofon se isse jhagda karne ke liye, aur ulama se isse behas karne ke liye, aur logon ke chehron ko apni taraf modne ke liye, aur apni baaton se woh talaash karo jo Allah ke paas hai, kyunki woh baaqi rehta hai, aur baaki sab khatam ho jaata hai.

24.ar: وَبِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ، قَالَ :" كُونُوا يَنَابِيعَ الْعِلْمِ، مَصَابِيحَ الْهُدَى، أَحْلَاسَ الْبُيُوتِ، سُرُجَ اللَّيْلِ، جُدُدَ الْقُلُوبِ، خُلْقَانَ الثِّيَابِ، تُعْرَفُونَ فِي أَهْلِ السَّمَاءِ، وَتَخْفَوْنَ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ "
24.en: With the same chain: He said: Be springs of knowledge, lamps of guidance, well-worn to your homes, lights of the night, renewed in heart, worn-out in clothing, known among the people of the sky, unknown to the people of the earth.
24.hi: Isi sanad ke saath, unhone kaha: Ilm ke chashme bano, hidayat ke chiraag, apne gharon se lipte hue, raat ke deeye, dilon mein naye, kapdon mein purane, aasmaan walon mein pehchaane jaao, aur zameen walon se chhupe raho.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ حَزْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا يَطْلُبُ هَذَا الْعِلْمَ أَحَدٌ لَا يُرِيدُ بِهِ إِلَّا الدُّنْيَا، إِلَّا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرْفَ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Muhammad ibn Umarah ibn Hazm, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: No one seeks this knowledge intending by it only this world, except that Allah forbids him the fragrance of Paradise on the Day of Resurrection.
24.hi: Abu Asim ne Muhammad ibn Umarah ibn Hazm se bataya: Mujhe Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Koi bhi is ilm ko talaash nahi karta sirf duniya chaahte hue, magar Allah usse Qayamat ke din Jannat ki khushbu haraam kar deta hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُجَاهِدُ بْنُ مُوسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَجُلٌ لِلشَّعْبِيِّ  : أَفْتِنِي أَيُّهَا الْعَالِمُ، فَقَالَ :" الْعَالِمُ مَنْ يَخَافُ اللَّهَ G "
24.en: Narrated by Mujahid ibn Musa, from Abdullah ibn Numayr, from Malik ibn Mighwal: He said: A man said to al-Sha'bi: Give me a ruling, O scholar, so he said: The scholar is one who fears Allah, exalted is He.
24.hi: Mujahid ibn Musa ne Abdullah ibn Numayr se bataya: Humein Malik ibn Mighwal ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi ne al-Sha'bi se kaha: Mujhe fatwa dijiye, Ae aalim, to unhone kaha: Aalim woh hai jo Allah Ta'ala se dare.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ مَزْيَدٍ L6008 ، عَنْ أَوْفَى بْنِ دَلْهَمٍ  أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ،  عَنْ عَلِيٍّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" تَعَلَّمُوا الْعِلْمَ، تُعْرَفُوا بِهِ، وَاعْمَلُوا بِهِ، تَكُونُوا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، فَإِنَّهُ سَيَأْتِي بَعْدَ هَذَا زَمَانٌ لَا يَعْرِفُ فِيهِ تِسْعَةُ عُشَرَائِهِمْ الْمَعْرُوفَ، وَلَا يَنْجُو مِنْهُ إِلَّا كُلُّ نُؤْمَةٍ، فَأُولَئِكَ أَئِمَّةُ الْهُدَى وَمَصَابِيحُ الْعِلْمِ، لَيْسُوا بِالْمَسَايِيحِ، وَلَا الْمَذَايِيعِ الْبُذُرِ "، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : نُؤَمَةٌ : غَافِلٌ عَنْ الشَّرِّ، الْمَذَايِيعُ : كَثِيرُ الْكَلَامِ، وَالْبُذْرِ : النَّمَّامُونَ
24.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Umar ibn Mazyad, from Awfa ibn Dalham that it reached him, from Ali رضي الله عنه: He said: Learn knowledge, be known by it, and act by it, be among its people, for indeed a time will come after this in which nine out of ten of their companions do not know what is proper, and none will be saved from it except every quiet, unassuming person, for those are the leaders of guidance and the lamps of knowledge, they are not the notorious, nor the loud gossiping spreaders. Abu Muhammad said: nu'amah is: one heedless of evil, al-madhayi' is: much talk, and al-budhur is: the gossipers.
24.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Umar ibn Mazyad se bataya: Humein Awfa ibn Dalham ne bataya, ke unhein khabar mili, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Ilm seekho, isse pehchaane jaao, aur isper amal karo, iske ehle bano, kyunki iske baad ek aisa zamana aayega jismein unke das sathiyon mein se nau maroof cheez ko nahi jaanenge, aur isse sirf har khaamosh, be-shohrat shakhs hi bachega, so woh log hidayat ke peshwaain aur ilm ke chiraag hain, woh mash-hoor nahi hain, na hi shor machaane wale gossip failaane wale hain. Abu Muhammad kehte hain: 'Nu'amah': burai se ghaafil, 'Al-Madhayi'': zyada baatein karne wala, aur 'Al-Budhur': chughli karne wale.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ  ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ مُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ :" اعْمَلُوا مَا شِئْتُمْ بَعْدَ أَنْ تَعْلَمُوا، فَلَنْ يَأْجُرَكُمْ اللَّهُ تَعَاليَ بِالْعِلْمِ حَتَّى تَعْمَلُوا "
24.en: Narrated by Marwan ibn Muhammad, from Sa'id ibn Abd al-Aziz, from Yazid ibn Jabir: He said: Mu'adh ibn Jabal رضي الله عنه said: Do whatever you wish after you have learned, for Allah, exalted is He, will never reward you for knowledge until you act.
24.hi: Marwan ibn Muhammad ne Sa'id ibn Abd al-Aziz se bataya: Humein Yazid ibn Jabir ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Mu'adh ibn Jabal رضي الله عنه ne kaha: Jo chaho karo seekhne ke baad, kyunki Allah Ta'ala tumhein ilm par tab tak ajr nahi dega jab tak tum amal na karo.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ خَالِدِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مَزْيَدٍ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ ، أَنَّهُ أَتَى ابْنَ مُنَبِّهٍ  فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ، وَقَالَ لَهُ : كَيْفَ عَقْلُهُ؟ فَأَخْبَرَهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : إِنَّا لَنَتَحَدَّثُ، أَوْ نَجِدُ فِي الْكُتُبِ أَنَّهُ :" مَا آتَى اللَّهُ سًبْحَانَه عَبْدًا عِلْمًا فَعَمِلَ بِهِ عَلَى سَبِيلِ الْهُدَى، فَيَسْلُبَهُ عَقْلَهُ حَتَّى يَقْبِضَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Khalid ibn Hazim, from al-Walid ibn Mazyad: He said: I heard Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid ibn Jabir narrating, from Sa'd: that he came to Ibn Munabbih and asked him about al-Hasan, and said to him: How is his mind? So he informed him, then said: We indeed narrate, or find in the books, that: Allah, glory be to Him, never gives a servant knowledge that he acts upon along the way of guidance, but that He strips him of his mind until Allah takes him to Himself [i.e., grants him a good, gentle death].
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Khalid ibn Hazim ne al-Walid ibn Mazyad se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid ibn Jabir ko riwaayat karte suna, Sa'd se: ke woh Ibn Munabbih ke paas gaye aur unse al-Hasan ke baare mein poocha, aur unse kaha: Unka dimaag kaisa hai? To unhone unhein bataaya, fir kaha: Hum riwaayat karte hain, ya kitaabon mein paate hain, ke: Allah, subhaanahu, kisi banda ko aisa ilm nahi deta jispar woh hidayat ki raah par amal kare, magar woh usse uski aqal cheen leta hai yahan tak ke Allah usay apni taraf le le [yaani, usay achhi, narm maut deta hai].

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ سَيْفٍ الْحِمْصِيُّ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَبْشَةَ السَّلُولِيُّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، يَقُولُ :" إِنَّ مِنْ أَشَرِّ النَّاسِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مَنْزِلَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، عَالِمًا لَا يَنْتَفِعُ بِعِلْمِهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Aban, from Ibn al-Qasim ibn Qays: He said: Yunus ibn Sayf al-Himsi told me: he said: Abu Kabshah al-Saluli told me: he said: I heard Abu al-Darda رضي الله عنه say: Among the worst of people in status before Allah on the Day of Resurrection is a scholar who does not benefit from his knowledge.
24.hi: Isma'il ibn Aban ne Ibn al-Qasim ibn Qays se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhse Yunus ibn Sayf al-Himsi ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhse Abu Kabshah al-Saluli ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu al-Darda رضي الله عنه ko kehte suna: Allah ke nazdeek Qayamat ke din darjay mein sabse bure logon mein woh aalim hai jo apne ilm se faida na uthaaye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو قُدَامَةَ  ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ   : " مَنْ يَزْدَدْ عِلْمًا، يَزْدَدْ وَجَعًا "، أخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ :" مَا أَخَافُ عَلَى نَفْسِي أَنْ يُقَالَ لِي : مَا عَلِمْتَ، وَلَكِنْ أَخَافُ أَنْ يُقَالَ لِي : مَاذَا عَمِلْتَ "
24.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Abu Qudamah, from Malik ibn Dinar: He said: Abu al-Darda said: Whoever increases in knowledge, increases in pain. And Abu al-Darda said: I do not fear for myself that it be said to me: What did you know, but I fear that it be said to me: What did you do?
24.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Abu Qudamah se bataya: Humein Malik ibn Dinar ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Abu al-Darda ne kaha: Jo ilm mein badhta hai, dard mein badhta hai. Aur Abu al-Darda ne kaha: Mujhe apne aap se dar nahi ke mujhse kaha jaaye: Tumne kya jaana, lekin mujhe dar hai ke mujhse kaha jaaye: Tumne kya kiya?

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ  ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ  يَذْكُرُ عَمَّنْ  حَدَّثَهُ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" تَدَارُسُ الْعِلْمِ سَاعَةً مِنْ اللَّيْلِ، خَيْرٌ مِنْ إِحْيَائِهَا "
24.en: Narrated by Harun ibn Mu'awiyah, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath: He said: I heard Ibn Jurayj mention, from someone who narrated to him, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه: he said: Studying knowledge together for an hour of the night is better than spending it in [voluntary] night-vigil.
24.hi: Harun ibn Mu'awiyah ne Hafs ibn Ghiyath se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibn Jurayj ko zikr karte suna, kisi se jisne unhein bataya, Ibn Abbas se رضي الله عنه: unhone kaha, Raat ke ek ghante mein milkar ilm padhna, isse behtar hai ke usay ibaadat mein zinda rakha jaaye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا وقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ :" إِنِّي لَأُجَزِّئُ اللَّيْلَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَجْزَاءٍ : فَثُلُثٌ أَنَامُ، وَثُلُثٌ أَقُومُ، وَثُلُثٌ أَتَذَكَّرُ أَحَادِيثَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "
24.en: Narrated by [chain implied continuous]: And Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه said: I divide the night into three parts: a third I sleep, and a third I stand [in prayer], and a third I recall the hadiths of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
24.hi: Aur Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه ne kaha: Main raat ko teen hisson mein baantta hoon: tihai sota hoon, aur tihai [namaz mein] khada rehta hoon, aur tihai Rasulullah ﷺ ki hadithon ko yaad karta hoon.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَرَفَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" مَنْ ابْتَغَى شَيْئًا مِنْ الْعِلْمِ يَبْتَغِي بِهِ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ سُبْحَانَهُ، آتَاهُ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ مَا يَكْفِيهِ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Hasan ibn Arafah, from Jarir, from al-Hasan ibn Amr, from Ibrahim: He said: Whoever seeks something of knowledge, seeking with it the face of Allah, glory be to Him, Allah gives him from it what suffices him.
24.hi: Al-Hasan ibn Arafah ne Jarir se bataya: Humein al-Hasan ibn Amr ne bataya, Ibrahim se: Unhone kaha, Jo ilm mein se kuch talaash kare, isse Allah ka chehra chaahte hue, Allah usay isme se utna deta hai jo usay kaafi ho.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ   عَنْ حَدِيثٍ، فَحَدَّثَنِيهِ، فَقُلْتُ : إِنَّهُ يُرْفَعُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ :" لَا، عَلَى مَنْ دُونَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْنَا، فَإِنْ كَانَ فِيهِ زِيَادَةٌ أَوْ نُقْصَانٌ، كَانَ عَلَى مَنْ دُونَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Thabit ibn Yazid, from Asim: He said: I asked al-Sha'bi about a hadith, and he narrated it to me, so I said: It is raised to the Prophet ﷺ? So he said: No, [attributing it] to someone below the Prophet ﷺ is more beloved to us, for if there is any addition or omission in it, it will be upon someone below the Prophet ﷺ.
24.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Thabit ibn Yazid se bataya: Humein Asim ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Sha'bi se ek hadith ke baare mein poocha, to unhone mujhe bataayi, to maine kaha: Kya yeh Nabi ﷺ tak marfu'an pahunchti hai? To unhone kaha: Nahi, Nabi ﷺ se neeche kisi ki taraf [mansoob karna] humein zyada pasand hai, kyunki agar isme koi izaafa ya kami ho, to woh Nabi ﷺ se neeche kisi par hogi.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاق بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هَاشِمٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، قَالَ : " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَعَنْ الْمُحَاقَلَةِ وَالْمُزَابَنَةِ "، فَقِيلَ لَهُ : أَمَا تَحْفَظُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَدِيثًا غَيْرَ هَذَا؟، قَالَ : بَلَى، وَلَكِنْ أَقُولُ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ : قَالَ عَلْقَمَةُ، أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ
24.en: Narrated by Ishaq ibn Isa, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Abu Hashim, from Ibrahim: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade al-muhaqalah and al-muzabanah, so it was said to him: Do you not preserve any other hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ besides this one? He said: Of course, but I would rather say: Abdullah said, Alqamah said - that is more beloved to me.
24.hi: Ishaq ibn Isa ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Abu Hashim ne bataya, Ibrahim se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne al-muhaqalah aur al-muzabanah se mana kiya, to unse poocha gaya: Kya aap Rasulullah ﷺ se iske siwa koi aur hadith yaad nahi rakhte? Unhone kaha: Kyun nahi, lekin main kehna zyada pasand karta hoon: Abdullah ne kaha, Alqamah ne kaha - yeh mujhe zyada pasand hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، إِذَا حَدَّثَ بِحَدِيثٍ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" هَذَا أَوْ نَحْوَهُ، أَوْ شِبْهَهُ، أَوْ شَكْلَهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir, from al-Awza'i, from Isma'il ibn Ubaydullah: He said: Abu al-Darda رضي الله عنه, when he narrated a hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, would say: This or something like it, or similar to it, or in that shape.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir ne al-Awza'i se bataya: Humein Isma'il ibn Ubaydullah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Abu al-Darda رضي الله عنه, jab woh Rasulullah ﷺ se koi hadith bayaan karte, kehte: Yeh ya isi jaisi, ya isse milti-julti, ya isi soorat mein.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَسَدُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ  ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، إِذَا حَدَّثَ حَدِيثًا، قَالَ :" اللَّهُمَّ إِلَّا هَكَذَا، أَوْ كَشَكْلِهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Asad ibn Musa, from Mu'awiyah, from Rabi'ah ibn Yazid: He said: Abu al-Darda رضي الله عنه, when he narrated a hadith, would say: O Allah, unless it was exactly like this, or in its shape.
24.hi: Asad ibn Musa ne Mu'awiyah se bataya: Humein Rabi'ah ibn Yazid ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Abu al-Darda رضي الله عنه, jab woh koi hadith bayaan karte, kehte: Ae Allah, siwaay iske ke yeh bilkul aisi hi ho, ya isi soorat mein.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ  ، قَالَ : " كُنْتُ لَا تَفُوتُنِي عَشِيَّةُ خَمِيسٍ إِلَّا وَآتِي فِيهَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ،فَمَا سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ لِشَيْءٍ، قَطُّ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، حَتَّى كَانَتْ ذَاتَ عَشِيَّةٍ، فَقَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ : فَاغْرَوْرَقَتَا عَيْنَاهُ وَانْتَفَخَتْ أَوْدَاجُه، فَأَنَا رَأَيْتُهُ مَحْلُولَةً أَزْرَارُهُ، وَقَالَ : أَوْ مِثْلُهُ، أَوْ نَحْوُهُ، أَوْ شَبِيهٌ بِهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Ibn Awn, from Muslim Abu Abdullah, from Ibrahim al-Taymi, from his father, from Amr ibn Maymun: He said: I never missed a Thursday evening without coming to Abdullah ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه, so I never heard him say for anything: The Messenger of Allah said, until one particular evening, when he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, he said: So his eyes filled with tears and the veins of his neck swelled, so I saw him with his shirt-buttons undone, and he said: Or something like it, or similar to it, or resembling it.
24.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Ibn Awn se bataya: Humein Muslim Abu Abdullah ne bataya, Ibrahim al-Taymi se, apne walid se, Amr ibn Maymun se: Unhone kaha, Main kabhi Jumaeraat ki shaam nahi chhoo do jab tak main Abdullah ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه ke paas na jaaun, to maine unhein kabhi kisi cheez ke baare mein kehte nahi suna: Rasulullah ne farmaya, yahan tak ke ek shaam aisi thi, jab unhone kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, unhone bataya: To unki aankhon mein aansu bhar aaye aur unki gardan ki rag phool gayi, to maine unhein apne kurte ke button khule dekha, aur unhone kaha: Ya isi jaisi, ya usi ke qareeb, ya isse milti-julti.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَشْعَثُ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، وَابْنِ سِيرِينَ  ، أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، كَانَ إِذَا حَدَّثَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي الْأَيَّامِ، تَرَبَّدَ وَجْهُهُ، وَقَالَ :" هَكَذَا أَوْ نَحْوَهُ، هَكَذَا أَوْ نَحْوَهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Ash'ath, from al-Sha'bi, and Ibn Sirin: That Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه, when he narrated from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ during the days, his face would change color, and he would say: Like this or something like it, like this or something like it.
24.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Ash'ath se bataya: Humein al-Sha'bi, aur Ibn Sirin ne bataya: ke Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه, jab woh Rasulullah ﷺ se un dinon riwaayat karte, unka chehra badal jaata, aur woh kehte: Isi tarah ya isi jaisa, isi tarah ya isi jaisa.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا تَوْبَةُ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ لِي الشَّعْبِيُّ   :" أَرَأَيْتَ فُلَانًا الَّذِي يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ؟ قَعَدْتُ مَعَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   سَنَتَيْنِ، أَوْ سَنَةً وَنِصْفًا، فَمَا سَمِعْتُهُ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ شَيْئًا، إِلَّا هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ "
24.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from Tawbah al-Anbari: He said: Al-Sha'bi said to me: Have you seen so-and-so who says: The Messenger of Allah said, The Messenger of Allah said? I sat with Ibn Umar for two years, or a year and a half, and I never heard him narrate anything from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, except this one hadith.
24.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se bataya: Humein Tawbah al-Anbari ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Al-Sha'bi ne mujhse kaha: Kya aapne fulaan ko dekha jo kehta hai: Rasulullah ne farmaya, Rasulullah ne farmaya? Main Ibn Umar ke saath do saal, ya dedh saal, baitha, aur maine unhein Rasulullah ﷺ se kuch bhi bayaan karte nahi suna, siwaay is ek hadith ke.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَسَدُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي السَّفَرِ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، قَالَ :" جَالَسْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ   سَنَةً، فَلَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ يَذْكُرُ حَدِيثًا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "
24.en: Narrated by Asad ibn Musa, from Shu'bah, from Abdullah ibn Abi al-Safar, from al-Sha'bi: He said: I sat with Ibn Umar for a year, and I never heard him mention a hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
24.hi: Asad ibn Musa ne Shu'bah se bataya: Humein Abdullah ibn Abi al-Safar ne bataya, al-Sha'bi se: Unhone kaha, Main Ibn Umar ke saath ek saal baitha, aur maine unhein Rasulullah ﷺ se koi hadith zikr karte nahi suna.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ قُطْبَةَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ،" يُحَدِّثُنَا فِي الشَّهْرِ بِالْحَدِيثَيْنِ، أَوْ الثَّلَاثَةِ "
24.en: Narrated by Asim ibn Yusuf, from Abu Bakr, from Abu Hasin, from al-Sha'bi, from Thabit ibn Qutbah al-Ansari: He said: Abdullah رضي الله عنه used to narrate to us two or three hadiths in a month.
24.hi: Asim ibn Yusuf ne Abu Bakr se bataya: Humein Abu Hasin ne bataya, al-Sha'bi se, Thabit ibn Qutbah al-Ansari se: Unhone kaha, Abdullah رضي الله عنه humein mahine mein do ya teen hadithein bayaan karte the.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ  ، قَالَ : مَرَّ بِنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ  ، فَقُلْنَا حَدِّثْنَا بِبَعْضِ مَا سَمِعْتَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ؟، فَقَالَ :" وَأَتَحَلَّلُ "
24.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Umar, from Yunus, from Abd al-Malik ibn Ubayd: He said: Anas ibn Malik passed by us, so we said: Narrate to us some of what you heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? So he said: And I make an effort/exert myself.
24.hi: Uthman ibn Umar ne Yunus se bataya: Humein Abd al-Malik ibn Ubayd ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Anas ibn Malik humare paas se guzre, to humne kaha: Humein woh bataao jo aapne Rasulullah ﷺ se suna? To unhone kaha: Aur main koshish karta hoon.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ أَنَسٌ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَكَانَ إِذَا حَدَّثَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قَالَ :" أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "
24.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ibn Awn, from Muhammad: He said: Anas رضي الله عنه [narrated] from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and when he narrated from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he would say: Or as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said.
24.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Ibn Awn ne bataya, Muhammad se: Unhone kaha, Anas رضي الله عنه [riwaayat karte the] Rasulullah ﷺ se, aur jab woh Rasulullah ﷺ se bayaan karte, woh kehte: Ya jaisa Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل  ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ أَنَسٌ   رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَدِيثًا، قَالَ :" أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "
24.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Isma'il, from Ayyub, from Muhammad: He said: Anas رضي الله عنه [narrated] a hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he would say: Or as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said.
24.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Isma'il se bataya: Humein Ayyub ne bataya, Muhammad se: Unhone kaha, Anas رضي الله عنه Rasulullah ﷺ se ek hadith [riwaayat karte], woh kehte: Ya jaisa Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي السَّائِبُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، قَالَ : خَرَجْتُ مَعَ سَعْدٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، إِلَى مَكَّةَ ،" فَمَا سَمِعْتُهُ يُحَدِّثُ حَدِيثًا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، حَتَّى رَجَعْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ "
24.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid: He said: I went out with Sa'd رضي الله عنه to Makkah, and I never heard him narrate any hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, until we returned to Madinah.
24.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Yahya ibn Sa'id ne bataya: Mujhe al-Sa'ib ibn Yazid ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Sa'd رضي الله عنه ke saath Makkah nikla, aur maine unhein koi bhi hadith Rasulullah ﷺ se bayaan karte nahi suna, yahan tak ke hum Madinah wapas aaye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا بَيَانٌ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ قَرَظَةَ بْنِ كَعْبٍ  : أَنَّ عُمَرَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، شَيَّعَ الْأَنْصَارَ حِينَ خَرَجُوا مِنْ الْمَدِينَةِ ، فَقَالَ :" أَتَدْرُونَ لِمَ شَيَّعْتُكُمْ؟ قُلْنَا : لِحَقِّ الْأَنْصَارِ، قَالَ : إِنَّكُمْ تَأْتُونَ قَوْمًا تَهْتَزُّ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ بِالْقُرْآنِ اهْتِزَازَ النَّخْلِ، فَلَا تَصُدُّوهُمْ بِالْحَدِيثِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَأَنَا شَرِيكُكُمْ "، قَالَ : فَمَا حَدَّثْتُ بِشَيْءٍ، وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ كَمَا سَمِعَ أَصْحَابِي
24.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from Bayan, from al-Sha'bi, from Qarazah ibn Ka'b: That Umar رضي الله عنه saw off the Ansar when they left Madinah, and said: Do you know why I have seen you off? We said: Because of the right of the Ansar, he said: You are going to a people whose tongues quiver with the Qur'an as the palm-tree quivers, so do not turn them away by narrating hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I am your partner in it, he said: So I did not narrate anything, though I had heard just as my companions heard.
24.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se bataya: Humein Bayan ne bataya, al-Sha'bi se, Qarazah ibn Ka'b se: ke Umar رضي الله عنه ne Ansar ko vida'i di jab woh Madinah se nikle, aur kaha: Kya tumhein maloom hai maine tumhein kyun vida'i di hai? Humne kaha: Ansar ke haq ki wajah se, unhone kaha: Tum aise log ke paas ja rahe ho jinki zubaanein Quran se aisi kaanpti hain jaise khajoor ka darakht kaanpta hai, so unhein Rasulullah ﷺ se hadith bayaan karke unse door mat karo, aur main tumhara isme saathi hoon, unhone kaha: To maine kuch bayaan nahi kiya, jabke maine bhi utna hi suna tha jitna mere sathiyon ne suna.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَشْعَثُ بْنُ سَوَّارٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ قُرَظَةَ بْنِ كَعْبٍ  ، قَالَ : بَعَثَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، رَهْطًا مِنْ الْأَنْصَارِ إِلَى الْكُوفَةِ ، فَبَعَثَنِي مَعَهُمْ، فَجَعَلَ يَمْشِي مَعَنَا حَتَّى أَتَى صِرَارًا وَصِرَارٌ : مَاءٌ فِي طَرِيقِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَجَعَلَ يَنْفُضُ الْغُبَارَ عَنْ رِجْلَيْهِ، ثُمّ قَالَ :" إِنَّكُمْ تَأْتُونَ الْكُوفَةَ ، فَتَأْتُونَ قَوْمًا لَهُمْ أَزِيزٌ بِالْقُرْآنِ فَيَأْتُونَكُمْ، فَيَقُولُونَ : قَدِمَ أَصْحَابُ مُحَمَّدٍ ! قَدِمَ أَصْحَابُ مُحَمَّدٍ ! فَيَأْتُونَكُمْ فَيَسْأَلُونَكُمْ عَنْ الْحَدِيثِ، فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ أَسْبَغَ الْوُضُوءِ ثَلَاثٌ، وَثِنْتَانِ تُجْزِيَانِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : إِنَّكُمْ تَأْتُونَ الْكُوفَةَ ، فَتَأْتُونَ قَوْمًا لَهُمْ أَزِيزٌ بِالْقُرْآنِ، فَيَقُولُونَ : قَدِمَ أَصْحَابُ مُحَمَّدٍ ! قَدِمَ أَصْحَابُ مُحَمَّدٍ ! فَيَأْتُونَكُمْ فَيَسْأَلُونَكُمْ عَنْ الْحَدِيثِ، فَأَقِلُّوا الرِّوَايَةَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَأَنَا شَرِيكُكُمْ فِيهِ "، قَالَ قَرَظَةُ : وَإِنْ كُنْتُ لَأَجْلِسُ فِي الْقَوْمِ، فَيَذْكُرُونَ الْحَدِيثَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَإِنِّي لَمِنْ أَحْفَظِهِمْ لَهُ، فَإِذَا ذَكَرْتُ وَصِيَّةَ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، سَكَتُّ، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد : مَعْنَاهُ عِنْدِي : الْحَدِيثُ عَنْ أَيَّامِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، لَيْسَ السُّنَنَ وَالْفَرَائِضَ
24.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Ash'ath ibn Sawwar, from al-Sha'bi, from Qurazah ibn Ka'b: He said: Umar ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه sent a group from the Ansar to Kufah, and sent me with them, so he began walking with us until he came to Sirar - and Sirar is water on the road to Madinah - so he began shaking the dust off his legs, then said: You are going to Kufah, so you will come to a people who have a humming with the Qur'an, and they will come to you, and say: The Companions of Muhammad have arrived! The Companions of Muhammad have arrived! And they will come to you and ask you about hadith, so know that the most complete ablution is three, and two suffice, then he said: You are going to Kufah, so you will come to a people who have a humming with the Qur'an, and they will say: The Companions of Muhammad have arrived! The Companions of Muhammad have arrived! And they will come to you and ask you about hadith, so narrate little from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I am your partner in it. Qarazah said: And I would sit among people, and they would mention a hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I was indeed among the most preserving of it, but when I remembered Umar's رضي الله عنه instruction, I fell silent. Abu Muhammad said: Its meaning to me is: hadith about the days of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, not the sunnahs and the fixed [inheritance] shares.
24.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Ash'ath ibn Sawwar se bataya: Humein al-Sha'bi ne bataya, Qurazah ibn Ka'b se: Unhone kaha, Umar ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه ne Ansar mein se ek giroh Kufah bheja, aur mujhe unke saath bheja, to woh humare saath chalne lage yahan tak ke woh Sirar tak pahunche - aur Sirar Madinah ke raaste mein ek paani ki jagah hai - to woh apne paaon se dhool jhaadne lage, fir kaha: Tum Kufah ja rahe ho, to tumhein aise log milenge jinki Quran ke saath ek gunjaan hoti hai to woh tumhare paas aayenge, aur kahenge: Muhammad ke sahaba aa gaye! Muhammad ke sahaba aa gaye! Aur woh tumhare paas aayenge aur tumse hadith poochenge, so jaan lo ke sabse mukammal wudu teen martaba hai, aur do martaba kaafi hai, fir unhone kaha: Tum Kufah ja rahe ho, to tumhein aise log milenge jinki Quran ke saath ek gunjaan hoti hai, aur woh kahenge: Muhammad ke sahaba aa gaye! Muhammad ke sahaba aa gaye! Aur woh tumhare paas aayenge aur tumse hadith poochenge, so Rasulullah ﷺ se riwaayat kam karo, aur main isme tumhara saathi hoon. Qarazah kehte hain: Aur main logon mein baitha karta, aur woh Rasulullah ﷺ se hadith zikr karte, aur main unmein se isay sabse zyada yaad rakhne wala tha, lekin jab mujhe Umar رضي الله عنه ki hidayat yaad aati, main khamosh ho jaata. Abu Muhammad kehte hain: Mere nazdeek iska matlab hai: Rasulullah ﷺ ke zamaane ki hadithein, sunnaten aur muqarrar hisse nahi.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُجَاهِدُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ :" قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، ثُمَّ ارْتَعَدَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : نَحْوَ ذَلِكَ أَوْ فَوْقَ ذَاكَ "
24.en: Narrated by Mujahid ibn Musa, from Ibn Numayr, from Malik ibn Mighwal, from al-Sha'bi, from Alqamah: He said: Abdullah رضي الله عنه said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, then he trembled, then said: Something like that, or above that.
24.hi: Mujahid ibn Musa ne Ibn Numayr se bataya: Humein Malik ibn Mighwal ne bataya, al-Sha'bi se, Alqamah se: Unhone kaha, Abdullah رضي الله عنه ne kaha: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, fir woh kaanp gaye, fir kaha: Kuch aisi hi baat, ya isse zyada.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ  ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  ، قَالَ : صَحِبْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ ، فَلَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِحَدِيثٍ، إِلَّا أَنَّهُ قَالَ : كُنْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَأُتِيَ بِجُمَّارٍ، فَقَالَ :" إِنَّ مِنْ الشَّجَرِ شَجَرًا مِثْلَ الرَّجُلِ الْمُسْلِمِ "، فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَقُولَ : هِيَ النَّخْلَةُ، فَنَظَرْتُ فَإِذَا أَنَا أَصْغَرُ الْقَوْمِ، فَسَكَتُّ، قَالَ عُمَرُ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ : وَدِدْتُ أَنَّكَ قُلْتَ، وَعَلَيَّ كَذَا
24.en: Narrated by Bishr ibn al-Hakam, from Sufyan, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid: He said: I accompanied Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه to Madinah, and I never heard him narrate any hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, except that he said: I was with the Prophet ﷺ and some palm-heart was brought, so he said: Among trees there is a tree like the Muslim man, so I intended to say: It is the palm-tree, but I looked and I was the youngest of the people, so I fell silent, Umar رضي الله عنه said: I wish you had said it, and [I would have given] such-and-such [reward].
24.hi: Bishr ibn al-Hakam ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein Ibn Abi Najih ne bataya, Mujahid se: Unhone kaha, Main Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه ke saath Madinah tak gaya, aur maine unhein Rasulullah ﷺ se koi hadith bayaan karte nahi suna, siwaay iske ke unhone kaha: Main Nabi ﷺ ke saath tha to khajoor ki gudi laayi gayi, to aapne farmaya: Darakhton mein se ek darakht Musalman aadmi jaisa hai, to maine kehna chaaha: Yeh khajoor ka darakht hai, lekin maine dekha ke main log mein sabse chhota tha, to main khamosh ho gaya, Umar رضي الله عنه ne kaha: Kaash tumne kaha hota, aur mujhpar fulaan-fulaan hota.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْهَدَادِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا صَالِحٌ الدَّهَّانُ L3858 ، قَالَ :مَا سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ   يَقُولُ قَطُّ : " قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، إِعْظَامًا وَاتِّقَاءً أَنْ يَكْذِبَ عَلَيْهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Bishr ibn al-Hakam, from Khalid ibn Yazid al-Hadadi, from Salih al-Dahhan: He said: I never heard Jabir ibn Zayd ever say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, out of great reverence and caution against lying about him.
24.hi: Bishr ibn al-Hakam ne Khalid ibn Yazid al-Hadadi se bataya: Humein Salih al-Dahhan ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Jabir ibn Zayd ko kabhi nahi suna kehte: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, is azmat aur is ehtiyaat ki wajah se ke kahin aap par jhoot na laga diya jaaye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا رَوْحٌ  ، عَنْ كَهْمَسِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ  ، قَالَ : جَاءَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ  رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ إِلَى كَعْبٍ يَسْأَلُ عَنْهُ، وَكَعْبٌ فِي الْقَوْمِ، فَقَالَ كَعْبٌ : مَا تُرِيدُ مِنْهُ؟ فَقَالَ : أَمَا إِنِّي لَا أَعْرِفُ لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَحْفَظَ لِحَدِيثِهِ مِنِّي، فَقَالَ كَعْبٌ   :" أَمَا إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَجِدَ طَالِبَ شَيْءٍ إِلَّا سَيَشْبَعُ مِنْهُ يَوْمًا مِنْ الدَّهْرِ، إِلَّا طَالِبَ عِلْمٍ أَوْ طَالِبَ دُنْيَا "، فَقَالَ : أَنْتَ كَعْبٌ؟، قَالَ : نَعَمْ، قَالَ : لِمِثْلِ هَذَا جِئْتُ
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Rawh, from Kahmas ibn al-Hasan, from Abdullah ibn Shaqiq: He said: Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه came to Ka'b asking about him, and Ka'b was among the people, so Ka'b said: What do you want from him? So he said: I do not think any of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ preserves his hadith more than I do, so Ka'b رضي الله عنه said: Indeed, you will never find a seeker of anything who will not be satisfied from it one day, except the seeker of knowledge or the seeker of this world, so he said: Are you Ka'b? He said, Yes, he said: It was for the likes of this that I came.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ne Rawh se bataya: Humein Kahmas ibn al-Hasan ne bataya, Abdullah ibn Shaqiq se: Unhone kaha, Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه Ka'b ke paas aaye unke baare mein poochte hue, aur Ka'b logon mein maujood the, to Ka'b ne kaha: Aap unse kya chaahte hain? To unhone kaha: Mujhe nahi lagta Rasulullah ﷺ ke sahaba mein se koi mujhse zyada unki hadith yaad rakhta ho, to Ka'b رضي الله عنه ne kaha: Sun lo, tumhein kabhi koi aisa talaash karne wala nahi milega jo isse ek din seer na ho, siwaay ilm talaash karne wale ya duniya talaash karne wale ke, to unhone poocha: Kya aap Ka'b hain? Unhone kaha, Haan, unhone kaha: Isi jaisi baat ke liye main aaya tha.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شِبْلٌ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ  ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ  ، قَالَ : قِيلَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَيُّ النَّاسِ أَعْلَمُ؟، قَالَ :" مَنْ جَمَعَ عِلْمَ النَّاسِ إِلَى عِلْمِهِ، وَكُلُّ طَالِبِ عِلْمٍ غَرْثَانُ إِلَى عِلْمٍ "
24.en: Narrated by Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim, from Yahya ibn Abi Bukayr, from Shibl, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Tawus: He said: It was said: O Messenger of Allah, who among people is most knowledgeable? He said: Whoever gathers the knowledge of the people to his own knowledge, and every seeker of knowledge is hungry for more knowledge.
24.hi: Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim ne Yahya ibn Abi Bukayr se bataya: Humein Shibl ne bataya, Amr ibn Dinar se, Tawus se: Unhone kaha, Poocha gaya: Ya Rasulullah, log mein sabse zyada ilm wala kaun hai? Aapne farmaya: Jo logon ke ilm ko apne ilm mein jama kare, aur har ilm talaash karne wala aur ilm ka bhookha rehta hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ ، عَنْ الْخَلِيلِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ ، قَالَ :" كُنْتُ فِي حَلْقَةٍ فِيهَا الْمَشْيَخَةُ وَهُمْ يَتَرَاجَعُونَ، فِيهِمْ عَابِدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، فَقَالَ شَابٌّ فِي نَاحِيَةِ الْقَوْمِ : أَفِيضُوا فِي ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ، بَارَكَ اللَّهُ فِيكُمْ، فَنَظَرَ الْقَوْمُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَى بَعْضٍ، فِي أَيِّ شَيْءٍ رَآنَا؟ ثُمَّ قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ : مَنْ أَمَرَكَ بِهَذَا؟ فَمُرَّ، لَئِنْ عُدْتَ، لَنَفْعَلَنَّ وَلَنَفْعَلَنَّ "
24.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from al-Khalil ibn Murrah, from Mu'awiyah ibn Qurrah: He said: I was in a circle in which there were elders, and they were reviewing [religious matters] with each other, among them was Abid ibn Amr, so a young man on the side of the group said: Delve into the remembrance of Allah, may Allah bless you, so the people looked at each other, wondering: In what way did he see us [as lacking]? Then one of them said: Who commanded you with this? Move along, if you return, we will surely do such-and-such and such-and-such.
24.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne al-Khalil ibn Murrah se bataya: Humein Mu'awiyah ibn Qurrah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Main ek halqe mein tha jismein buzurg log the, aur woh aapas mein [deeni maamlon par] baatchit kar rahe the, unmein Abid ibn Amr bhi the, to giroh ke ek konay mein ek jawaan ladke ne kaha: Allah ke zikr mein lag jao, Allah tumhein barkat de, to log ek-doosre ko dekhne lage, [soch rahe the]: Usne humein kis tarah dekha? Fir unmein se ek ne kaha: Tumhein iska hukum kisne diya? So aage badho, agar tum wapas aaye, to hum zaroor fulaan-fulaan karenge.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ  ، أَنْبَأَنَا قُرَّةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ  ، عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّه   :" نِعْمَ الْمَجْلِسُ مَجْلِسٌ تُنْشَرُ فِيهِ الْحِكْمَةُ، وَتُرْجَى فِيهِ الرَّحْمَةُ "
24.en: Narrated by Yusuf ibn Musa, from Abu Amir, from Qurrah ibn Khalid, from Awn ibn Abdullah: He said: Abdullah said: What a fine gathering is a gathering in which wisdom is spread, and in which mercy is hoped for.
24.hi: Yusuf ibn Musa ne Abu Amir se bataya: Humein Qurrah ibn Khalid ne bataya, Awn ibn Abdullah se: Unhone kaha, Abdullah ne kaha: Kya khoob majlis hai woh majlis jismein hikmat phailaayi jaaye, aur jismein rehmat ki ummeed rakhi jaaye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ جُبْيَرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَشَخَصَ بِبَصَرِهِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ :" هَذَا أَوَانُ يُخْتَلَسُ الْعِلْمُ مِنْ النَّاسِ، حَتَّى لَا يَقْدِرُوا مِنْهُ عَلَى شَيْءٍ، فَقَالَ زِيَادُ بْنُ لَبِيدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، وَكَيْفَ يُخْتَلَسُ مِنَّا وَقَدْ قَرَأْنَا الْقُرْآنَ؟ فَوَاللَّهِ لَنَقْرَأَنَّهُ، وَلَنُقْرِئَنَّهُ نِسَاءَنَا وَأَبْنَاءَنَا، فَقَالَ : ثَكِلَتْكَ أُمُّكَ يَا زِيَادُ، إِنْ كُنْتُ لَأَعُدُّكَ مِنْ فُقَهَاءِ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ ، هَذِهِ التَّوْرَاةُ وَالْإِنْجِيلُ عِنْدَ الْيَهُودِ، وَالنَّصَارَى، فَمَاذَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ؟ "، قَالَ جُبَيْرٌ : فَلَقِيتُ عُبَادَةَ بْنَ الصَّامِتِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ أَلَا تَسْمَعُ مَا يَقُولُ أَخُوكَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ؟ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ بِالَّذِي قَالَ، قَالَ : صَدَقَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ، إِنْ شِئْتَ لَأُحَدِّثَنَّكَ بِأَوَّلِ عِلْمٍ يُرْفَعُ مِنْ النَّاسِ : الْخُشُوعُ يُوشِكُ أَنْ تَدْخُلَ مَسْجِدَ الْجَمَاعَةِ، فَلَا تَرَى فِيهِ رَجُلًا خَاشِعًا
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from Mu'awiyah, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Jubayr ibn Nufayr, from his father Jubayr ibn Nufayr, from Abu al-Darda رضي الله عنه: He said: We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he raised his eyes to the sky, then said: This is the time when knowledge will be snatched away from the people, until they can no longer manage anything of it, so Ziyad ibn Labid al-Ansari said: O Messenger of Allah, and how will it be snatched from us when we have recited the Qur'an? For by Allah, we will surely recite it, and we will surely teach it to our women and our sons, so he said: May your mother be bereaved of you, O Ziyad, I used to count you among the jurists of the people of Madinah, is not this Torah and Gospel with the Jews and the Christians? So what benefit are they to them? Jubayr said: So I met Ubadah ibn al-Samit رضي الله عنه, I said: Do you not hear what your brother Abu al-Darda says? So I informed him of what he said, he said: Abu al-Darda spoke the truth, if you wish, I will indeed narrate to you the first knowledge to be raised away from the people: humility, it is likely that you will enter the mosque of the community and not see in it any humble man.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne Mu'awiyah se bataya: Mujhse Abd al-Rahman ibn Jubayr ibn Nufayr ne bataya, apne walid Jubayr ibn Nufayr se, Abu al-Darda se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath the, to aapne apni nazar aasmaan ki taraf uthaayi, fir farmaya: Yeh woh waqt hai jab ilm logon se cheen liya jaayega, yahan tak ke woh isme se kuch bhi sambhaal nahi paayenge, to Ziyad ibn Labid al-Ansari ne kaha: Ya Rasulullah, aur yeh humse kaise cheena jaayega jabke humne Quran padha hai? Allah ki qasam, hum zaroor isay padhenge, aur hum zaroor isay apni auraton aur apne beton ko sikhaayenge, to aapne farmaya: Teri maa tujhe roye, Ae Ziyad, main tumhein Madinah walon ke fuqaha mein shumaar karta tha, kya yeh Taurat aur Injeel Yahoodiyon, aur Isaiyon ke paas nahi hai? To yeh unhein kya faida deti hai? Jubayr kehte hain: To main Ubadah ibn al-Samit se رضي الله عنه mila, maine kaha: Kya aap nahi sun rahe apne bhai Abu al-Darda kya kehte hain? To maine unhein bataaya jo unhone kaha, unhone kaha: Abu al-Darda ne sach kaha, agar aap chaahein, to main aapko woh pehla ilm bataata hoon jo logon se utha liya jaayega: Khushu' (dil ki tawajjuh), qareeb hai ke tum jama'at ki masjid mein dakhil ho aur usmein koi khaashi' aadmi na dekho.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ جَمِيلٍ الْكِتَانِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَكْحُولٌ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" فَضْلُ الْعَالِمِ عَلَى الْعَابِدِ كَفَضْلِي عَلَى أَدْنَاكُمْ "، ثُمَّ تَلَا هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ # إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى اللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْعُلَمَاءُ سورة فاطر آية 28 #، ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ وَأَهْلَ سَمَاوَاتِهِ وَأَرَضِيهِ، وَالنُّونَ فِي الْبَحْرِ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يُعَلِّمُونَ النَّاسَ الْخَيْرَ "
24.en: Narrated by Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim, from Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Walid ibn Jamil al-Kittani, from Makhul: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: The excellence of the scholar over the worshipper is like my excellence over the least of you, then he recited this verse: 'It is only those who have knowledge among His servants who fear Allah' [Surah Fatir, verse 28], then he said: Indeed Allah, and His angels, and the people of His heavens and His earths, and even the fish in the sea, send blessings upon those who teach the people good.
24.hi: Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim ne Yazid ibn Harun se bataya: Humein al-Walid ibn Jamil al-Kittani ne bataya: Humein Makhul ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Aalim ki afzaliyat ibaadat karne wale par aisi hai jaisi meri afzaliyat tum mein sabse chhote par hai, fir aapne yeh aayat padhi: 'Allah se to uske bandon mein se sirf ilm wale hi darte hain' [Surah Fatir, aayat 28], fir farmaya: Beshak Allah, aur uske farishtay, aur uske aasmaanon aur uski zameenon ke rehne wale, aur samundar ki machhli bhi, un logon par dua bhejte hain jo logon ko bhalaai sikhaate hain.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَمَانٍ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ  ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" لَا يَكُونُ الرَّجُلُ عَالِمًا حَتَّى لَا يَحْسُدَ مَنْ فَوْقَهُ، وَلَا يَحْقِرَ مَنْ دُونَهُ، وَلَا يَبْتَغِيَ بِعِلْمِهِ ثَمَنًا "
24.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Asad Abu Asim, from Yahya ibn Yaman, from Sufyan, from Layth, from a man, from Ibn Umar رضي الله عنه: He said: A man does not become a scholar until he does not envy those above him, nor look down upon those below him, nor seek a price for his knowledge.
24.hi: Ahmad ibn Asad Abu Asim ne Yahya ibn Yaman se bataya: Humein Sufyan ne bataya, Layth se, ek aadmi se, Ibn Umar se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Aadmi tab tak aalim nahi banta jab tak woh apne se oopar walon se hasad na kare, aur apne se neeche walon ko haqeer na samjhe, aur apne ilm ki qeemat na maange.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ ، عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ  ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الْأَعْلَى التَّيْمِيَّ ، يَقُولُ :" مَنْ أُوتِيَ مِنْ الْعِلْمِ مَا لَا يُبْكِيهِ، لَخَلِيقٌ أَنْ لَا يَكُونَ أُوتِيَ عِلْمًا يَنْفَعُهُ، لِأَنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى نَعَتَ الْعُلَمَاءَ، ثُمَّ قَرَأ : # إِنَّ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ يَبْكُونَ سورة الإسراء آية 107 - 109 # "
24.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Sulayman, from Abu Usamah, from Mis'ar: He said: I heard Abd al-A'la al-Taymi say: Whoever is given knowledge that does not make him weep, it is likely that he has not been given knowledge that benefits him, because Allah, exalted is He, described the scholars, then he recited: 'Indeed, those who were given knowledge before it...' up to His saying: 'they weep' [Surah al-Isra, verses 107-109].
24.hi: Sa'id ibn Sulayman ne Abu Usamah se bataya: Humein Mis'ar ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abd al-A'la al-Taymi ko kehte suna: Jise itna ilm diya jaaye ke woh usay rulaaye nahi, to yeh mumkin hai ke usay woh ilm na diya gaya ho jo usay faida de, kyunki Allah Ta'ala ne ulama ka wasf kiya, fir unhone padha: 'Beshak jinhein isse pehle ilm diya gaya' yahan tak ke uska farman: 'woh rote hain' [Surah Al-Isra, aayat 107-109].

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عِصْمَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ حُبَابٍ ، عَنْ مُبَارَكِ بْنِ فَضَالَةَ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ الْعُمَرِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ ، قَالَ :" لَا تَكُونُ عَالِمًا حَتَّى يَكُونَ فِيكَ ثَلَاثُ خِصَالٍ : لَا تَبْغِي عَلَى مَنْ فَوْقَكَ، وَلَا تَحْقِرُ مَنْ دُونَكَ، وَلَا تَأْخُذُ عَلَى عِلْمِكَ دُنْيَا "
24.en: Narrated by Ismah ibn al-Fadl, from Zayd ibn Hubab, from Mubarak ibn Fadalah, from Ubaydullah ibn Umar al-Umari, from Abu Hazim: He said: You are not a scholar until you have three qualities: you do not overreach against those above you, and you do not disdain those below you, and you do not take a worldly price for your knowledge.
24.hi: Ismah ibn al-Fadl ne Zayd ibn Hubab se bataya: Humein Mubarak ibn Fadalah ne bataya, Ubaydullah ibn Umar al-Umari se, Abu Hazim se: Unhone kaha, Tum aalim nahi ho jab tak tum mein teen khaslaten na hon: Tum apne se oopar walon par zulm na karo, aur apne se neeche walon ko haqeer na samjho, aur apne ilm par duniya na lo.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْثَرٌ  ، عَنْ بُرْدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى الدِّمَشْقِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" لَا تَكُونُ عَالِمًا حَتَّى تَكُونَ مُتَعَلِّمًا، وَلَا تَكُونُ بِالْعِلْمِ عَالِمًا حَتَّى تَكُونَ بِهِ عَامِلًا، وَكَفَى بِكَ إِثْمًا أَنْ لَا تَزَالَ مُخَاصِمًا، وَكَفَى بِكَ إِثْمًا أَنْ لَا تَزَالَ مُمَارِيًا، وَكَفَى بِكَ كَاذِبًا أَنْ لَا تَزَالَ مُحَدِّثًا فِي غَيْرِ ذَاتِ اللَّهِ G "
24.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Asad, from Abthar, from Burd ibn Sinan, from Sulayman ibn Musa al-Dimashqi, from Abu al-Darda رضي الله عنه: He said: You are not a scholar until you have been a learner, and you are not a scholar through knowledge until you act by it, and it is enough of a sin for you to be always disputing, and it is enough of a sin for you to be always arguing, and it is enough to make you a liar that you be always talking about matters that are not for Allah's sake, exalted is He.
24.hi: Ahmad ibn Asad ne Abthar se bataya: Humein Burd ibn Sinan ne bataya, Sulayman ibn Musa al-Dimashqi se, Abu al-Darda se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Tum aalim nahi ho sakte jab tak tum seekhne wale na raho, aur tum ilm se aalim nahi ho sakte jab tak tum isper amal na karo, aur tumhare liye itna gunah kaafi hai ke tum hamesha jhagda karte raho, aur tumhare liye itna gunah kaafi hai ke tum hamesha behas karte raho, aur tumhein jhoota banaane ke liye itna kaafi hai ke tum hamesha aisi baatein karte raho jo Allah Ta'ala ke liye na hon.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَرَفَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ أَخِيهِ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ الْمِنْقَرِيِّ ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِلْحَسَنِ  يَوْمًا فِي شَيْءٍ، قَالَهُ : يَا أَبَا سَعِيدٍ، لَيْسَ هَكَذَا يَقُولُ الْفُقَهَاءُ، فَقَالَ :" وَيْحَكَ ! وَرَأَيْتَ أَنْتَ فَقِيهًا قَطُّ، إِنَّمَا الْفَقِيهُ الزَّاهِدُ فِي الدُّنْيَا، الرَّاغِبُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ، الْبَصِيرُ بِأَمْرِ دِينِهِ، الْمُدَاوِمُ عَلَى عِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Hasan ibn Arafah, from al-Mubarak ibn Sa'id, from his brother Sufyan al-Thawri, from Imran al-Minqari: He said: I said to al-Hasan one day about something he had said: O Abu Sa'id, the jurists do not say it like this, so he said: Woe to you! Have you ever seen a jurist? The jurist is only one who renounces this world, desires the Hereafter, has insight into his religion, and continually performs the worship of his Lord.
24.hi: Al-Hasan ibn Arafah ne al-Mubarak ibn Sa'id se bataya: Humein unke bhai Sufyan al-Thawri ne bataya, Imran al-Minqari se: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Hasan se ek din unki kahi hui kisi baat ke baare mein kaha: Ae Abu Sa'id, fuqaha isi tarah nahi kehte, to unhone kaha: Afsos tumpar! Kya tumne kabhi koi faqih dekha hai? Faqih to woh hai jo duniya se dil hataaye, Aakhirat ki khwaahish rakhe, apne deen ki samajh rakhe, aur apne Rab ki ibaadat par lagataar amal kare.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَرَفَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل الْبَجَلِيُّ ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ ،  عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ : قِيلَ لَهُ : مَنْ أَفْقَهُ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ ؟، قَالَ :" أَتْقَاهُمْ لِرَبِّهِ G "
24.en: Narrated by al-Hasan ibn Arafah, from al-Nadr ibn Isma'il al-Bajali, from Mis'ar, from Sa'd ibn Ibrahim: He said: It was said to him: Who is the most understanding among the people of Madinah? He said: Whoever fears his Lord, exalted is He, the most.
24.hi: Al-Hasan ibn Arafah ne al-Nadr ibn Isma'il al-Bajali se bataya: Humein Mis'ar ne bataya, Sa'd ibn Ibrahim se: Unhone kaha, Unse poocha gaya: Madinah walon mein sabse zyada aqal-mand kaun hai? Unhone kaha: Jo apne Rab Ta'ala se sabse zyada dare.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَرَفَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ ، عَنْ لَيْثِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمٍ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ ، قَالَ :" إِنَّمَا الْفَقِيهُ مَنْ يَخَافُ اللَّهَ تَعَاليَ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Hasan ibn Arafah, from al-Husayn ibn Ali, from Layth ibn Abi Sulaym, from Mujahid: He said: The truly understanding person is only one who fears Allah, exalted is He.
24.hi: Al-Hasan ibn Arafah ne al-Husayn ibn Ali se bataya: Humein Layth ibn Abi Sulaym ne bataya, Mujahid se: Unhone kaha, Haqeeqi aqal-mand sirf woh hai jo Allah Ta'ala se dare.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ  ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ الْقُمِّيِّ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي لَيْثُ بْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى هُوَ ابْنُ عَبَّادٍ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ الْفَقِيهَ حَقَّ الْفَقِيهِ، مَنْ لَمْ يُقَنِّطْ النَّاسَ مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ، وَلَمْ يُرَخِّصْ لَهُمْ فِي مَعَاصِي اللَّهِ، وَلَمْ يُؤَمِّنْهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِ اللَّهِ، وَلَمْ يَدَعْ الْقُرْآنَ رَغْبَةً عَنْهُ إِلَى غَيْرِهِ، إِنَّهُ لَا خَيْرَ فِي عِبَادَةٍ لَا عِلْمَ فِيهَا، وَلَا عِلْمٍ لَا فَهْمَ فِيهِ، وَلَا قِرَاءَةٍ لَا تَدَبُّرَ فِيهَا "
24.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Aban, from Ya'qub al-Qummi: He said: Layth ibn Abi Sulaym told me, from Yahya (Ibn Abbad), from Ali ibn Abi Talib رضي الله عنه: he said: The truly understanding person is one who does not make people despair of Allah's mercy, nor gives them ease in disobeying Allah, nor makes them feel secure from Allah's punishment, nor abandons the Qur'an out of preference for something else, indeed there is no good in worship without knowledge, nor in knowledge without understanding, nor in recitation without reflection.
24.hi: Isma'il ibn Aban ne Ya'qub al-Qummi se bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhse Layth ibn Abi Sulaym ne bataya, Yahya se (Ibn Abbad), Ali ibn Abi Talib se رضي الله عنه: unhone kaha, Haqeeqi aqal-mand woh hai jo logon ko Allah ki rehmat se mayoos na kare, aur na hi unhein Allah ki nafarmani mein rukhsat de, aur na hi unhein Allah ke azaab se be-fikar kare, aur na Quran ko chhode kisi aur cheez ki khwaahish mein, beshak koi bhalaai nahi us ibaadat mein jismein ilm na ho, aur na us ilm mein jismein samajh na ho, aur na us qiraat mein jismein gaur-o-fikr na ho.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَرَفَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبَّادٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَلِيٌّ   :" الْفَقِيهُ حَقُّ الْفَقِيهِ الَّذِي لَا يُقَنِّطُ النَّاسَ مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ، وَلَا يُؤَمِّنُهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِ اللَّهِ، وَلَا يُرَخِّصُ لَهُمْ فِي مَعَاصِي اللَّهِ، إِنَّهُ لَا خَيْرَ فِي عِبَادَةٍ لَا عِلْمَ فِيهَا، وَلَا خَيْرَ فِي عِلْمٍ لَا فَهْمَ فِيهِ، وَلَا خَيْرَ فِي قِرَاءَةٍ لَا تَدَبُّرَ فِيهَا "
24.en: Narrated by al-Hasan ibn Arafah, from Isma'il ibn Ibrahim, from Layth, from Yahya ibn Abbad: He said: Ali said: The truly understanding one is the one who does not make people despair of Allah's mercy, nor make them feel secure from Allah's punishment, nor give them ease in disobeying Allah, indeed there is no good in worship without knowledge, and no good in knowledge without understanding, and no good in recitation without reflection.
24.hi: Al-Hasan ibn Arafah ne Isma'il ibn Ibrahim se bataya: Humein Layth ne bataya, Yahya ibn Abbad se: Unhone kaha, Ali (Alayhis Salam) ne kaha: Haqeeqi aqal-mand woh hai jo logon ko Allah ki rehmat se mayoos na kare, aur na hi unhein Allah ke azaab se be-fikar kare, aur na hi unhein Allah ki nafarmani mein rukhsat de, beshak koi bhalaai nahi us ibaadat mein jismein ilm na ho, aur na us ilm mein bhalaai hai jismein samajh na ho, aur na us qiraat mein bhalaai hai jismein gaur-o-fikr na ho.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ حَازِمٍ ، حَدَّثَنِي عَمِّي جَرِيرُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ تُبَيْعًا يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ كَعْبٍ ، قَالَ :" إِنِّي لَأَجِدُ نَعْتَ قَوْمٍ يَتَعَلَّمُونَ لِغَيْرِ الْعَمَلِ، وَيَتَفَقَّهُونَ لِغَيْرِ الْعِبَادَةِ، وَيَطْلُبُونَ الدُّنْيَا بِعَمَلِ الْآخِرَةِ، وَيَلْبَسُونَ جُلُودَ الضَّأْنِ، وَقُلُوبُهُمْ أَمَرُّ مِنْ الصَّبْرِ، فَبِي يَغْتَرُّونَ، أَوْ إِيَّايَ يُخَادِعُونَ؟ فَحَلَفْتُ بِي لَأُتِيحَنَّ لَهُمْ فِتْنَةً تَتْرُكُ الْحَلِيمَ فِيهَا حَيْرَانَ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Yazid ibn Hazim, from his uncle Jarir ibn Zayd: That he heard Tubay' narrating, from Ka'b: he said: I indeed find the description of a people who learn not for the sake of practice, and seek understanding not for the sake of worship, and seek this world through the deeds of the Hereafter, and wear sheep's wool while their hearts are more bitter than the aloe plant, so is it Me they are being deceived about, or is it Me they are trying to deceive? So I have sworn by Myself that I will indeed send upon them a trial that will leave even the forbearing one bewildered in it.
24.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Yazid ibn Hazim ne bataya: Mujhse mere chacha Jarir ibn Zayd ne bataya: ke unhone Tubay' ko riwaayat karte suna, Ka'b se: unhone kaha, Main aise logon ka wasf paata hoon jo amal ke liye nahi seekhte, aur ibaadat ke liye samajh talaash nahi karte, aur Aakhirat ke amal se duniya talaash karte hain, aur bhed ki oon pehnte hain jabke unke dil sabar (kadwe paudhay) se zyada kadwe hain, to kya woh Mujhse dhoke mein hain, ya woh Mujhe dhoka de rahe hain? To Maine apni qasam khaayi hai ke Main unpar zaroor ek aisa fitna bhejunga jo isme sabr karne wale ko bhi hairaan chhod dega.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ الْعَمِّيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيُّ ، عَنْ هَرِمِ بْنِ حَيَّانَ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : "إِيَّاكُمْ وَالْعَالِمَ الْفَاسِقَ، فَبَلَغَ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ  رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ وَأَشْفَقَ مِنْهَا، مَا الْعَالِمُ الْفَاسِقُ؟، قَالَ : فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ هَرِمٌ : يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَاللَّهِ مَا أَرَدْتُ بِهِ إِلَّا الْخَيْرَ : يَكُونُ إِمَامٌ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِالْعِلْمِ، وَيَعْمَلُ بِالْفِسْقِ، فَيُشَبِّهُ عَلَى النَّاسِ، فَيَضِلُّونَ "
24.en: Narrated by Bishr ibn al-Hakam, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Abd al-Samad al-Ammi, from Abu Imran al-Jawni, from Harim ibn Hayyan: That he said: Beware of the sinful scholar, so this reached Umar ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه, so he wrote to him, being alarmed by it: What is the sinful scholar? He said: So Harim wrote to him: O Commander of the Believers, by Allah, I only intended good by it: there being a leader who speaks with knowledge, but acts with sin, so it confuses the people, and they go astray.
24.hi: Bishr ibn al-Hakam ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Abd al-Samad al-Ammi se bataya: Humein Abu Imran al-Jawni ne bataya, Harim ibn Hayyan se: ke unhone kaha: Fasiq aalim se bacho, to yeh baat Umar ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه tak pahunchi, to unhone unhein likha, isse chinta mein padkar: Fasiq aalim kya hai? Unhone bataya: To Harim ne unhein likha: Ae Ameer-ul-Mumineen, Allah ki qasam, maine isse sirf bhalaai chaahi thi: aisa koi peshwa hona jo ilm ki baat kare, lekin fisq (gunah) mein amal kare, to yeh logon ko confuse kar deta hai, to woh gumraah ho jaate hain.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُطَرِّفٍ  ، وَعَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي الْمُهَاجِرِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ  ، قَالَ :" مَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُكْرَمَ دِينُهُ، فَلَا يَدْخُلْ عَلَى السُّلْطَانِ، وَلَا يَخْلُوَنَّ بِالنِّسْوَانِ، وَلَا يُخَاصِمَنَّ أَصْحَابَ الْأَهْوَاءِ "
24.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah, from al-Walid ibn Muslim, from Muhammad ibn Mutarrif, and Abd al-Aziz ibn Isma'il ibn Ubaydullah ibn Abi al-Muhajir, from Abdullah ibn Mas'ud: He said: Whoever wants his religion to be honored, let him not enter upon the ruler, and let him not be alone with women, and let him not dispute with the people of desires [innovators].
24.hi: Sa'id ibn al-Mughirah ne al-Walid ibn Muslim se bataya: Humein Muhammad ibn Mutarrif, aur Abd al-Aziz ibn Isma'il ibn Ubaydullah ibn Abi al-Muhajir ne bataya, Abdullah ibn Mas'ud se: Unhone kaha, Jo chaahta hai ke uska deen izzat wale rahe, woh sultaan ke paas na jaaye, aur auraton ke saath akela na rahe, aur khwaahishaat wale logon se jhagda na kare.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، عَنْ يُونُسَ ، قَالَ : كَتَبَ إِلَيَّ مَيْمُونُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ  :" إِيَّاكَ وَالْخُصُومَةَ وَالْجِدَالَ فِي الدِّينِ، وَلَا تُجَادِلَنَّ عَالِمًا، وَلَا جَاهِلًا، أَمَّا الْعَالِمُ، فَإِنَّهُ يَخْزَنُ عَنْكَ عِلْمَهُ، وَلَا يُبَالِي مَا صَنَعْتَ، وَأَمَّا الْجَاهِلُ، فَإِنَّهُ يُخَشِّنُ بِصَدْرِكَ وَلَا يُطِيعُكَ "
24.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Isma'il ibn Ibrahim, from Yunus: He said: Maymun ibn Mihran wrote to me: Beware of dispute and argument in religion, and do not argue with a scholar, nor an ignorant one, as for the scholar, he will hoard his knowledge from you, and will not care what you do, and as for the ignorant one, he will make your chest tight and will not obey you.
24.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Isma'il ibn Ibrahim se bataya: Humein Yunus ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maymun ibn Mihran ne mujhe likha: Deen mein jhagde aur behas se bacho, aur na kisi aalim se jhagdo, na kisi jaahil se, aalim to apna ilm tumse chhupa lega, aur usay parwaah nahi hogi tum kya karte ho, aur jaahil to tumhare seene ko sakht kar dega aur woh tumhari baat nahi maanega.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام لِابْنِهِ :" دَعْ الْمِرَاءِ، فَإِنَّ نَفْعَهُ قَلِيلٌ، وَهُوَ يُهَيِّجُ الْعَدَاوَةَ بَيْنَ الْإِخْوَانِ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir: He said: Sulayman ibn Dawud, upon him be peace, said to his son: Leave arguing, for its benefit is little, and it stirs up enmity between brothers.
24.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se bataya: Humein Yahya ibn Abi Kathir ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Sulayman ibn Dawud, alayhis-salaam, ne apne bete se kaha: Behas chhod do, kyunki iska faida kam hai, aur yeh bhaiyon ke darmiyan dushmani jagaata hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ أَبِي حَكِيمٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ  ، يَقُولُ :" مَنْ جَعَلَ دِينَهُ غَرَضًا لِلْخُصُومَاتِ، أَكْثَرَ التَّنَقُّلَ "
24.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Abdullah ibn Idris, from Isma'il ibn Abi Hakim: He said: I heard Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz say: Whoever makes his religion a target for disputes, changes his position often.
24.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Abdullah ibn Idris se bataya: Humein Isma'il ibn Abi Hakim ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz ko kehte suna: Jo apne deen ko jhagdon ka nishaana banaaye, woh apni raay baar-baar badalta hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ  ، قَالَ : كَتَبَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ   إِلَى أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ :" أَنَّهُ مَنْ تَعَبَّدَ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ، كَانَ مَا يُفْسِدُ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا يُصْلِحُ، وَمَنْ عَدَّ كَلَامَهُ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ، قَلَّ كَلَامُهُ إِلَّا فِيمَا يَعْنِيهِ، وَمَنْ جَعَلَ دِينَهُ غَرَضًا لِلْخُصُومَاتِ، كَثُرَ تَنَقُّلُهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Marwan ibn Muhammad, from Sa'id ibn Abd al-Aziz: He said: Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz wrote to the people of Madinah: Whoever worships without knowledge, what he corrupts is more than what he sets right, and whoever counts his speech as part of his deeds, speaks little except about what concerns him, and whoever makes his religion a target for disputes, changes his position often.
24.hi: Marwan ibn Muhammad ne Sa'id ibn Abd al-Aziz se bataya: Unhone kaha, Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz ne Madinah walon ko likha: Jo bagair ilm ke ibaadat kare, uska barbaad karna uske theek karne se zyada hoga, aur jo apni baat ko apne amal mein shumaar kare, woh kam bolega siwaay us cheez ke jo usse mutalliq ho, aur jo apne deen ko jhagdon ka nishaana banaaye, uski raay baar-baar badlegi.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بُرْقَانَ ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ ، قَالَ : سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ عَنْ شَيْءٍ مِنْ الْأَهْوَاءِ، فَقَالَ :" عَلَيْكَ بِدِينِ الْأَعْرَابِيِّ، وَالْغُلَامِ فِي الْكُتَّابِ، وَالْهَ عَمَّا سِوَى ذَلِكَ "، قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ : كَثُرَ تَنَقُّلُهُ، أَيْ : يَنْتَقِلُ مِنْ رَأْيٍ إِلَى رَأْيٍ
