24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Harmalah: He said: A man came to Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab to bid him farewell for Hajj or Umrah, so he said to him: Do not leave until you have prayed, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: No one leaves the mosque after the call to prayer except a hypocrite, except a man whom a need took out and he intends to return to the mosque, so he said: My companions are at al-Harrah, he said: So he left, he said: Sa'id kept mentioning him repeatedly until it was reported that he fell from his mount and broke his thigh.
24.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se bataya: Humein Abd al-Rahman ibn Harmalah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Ek aadmi Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab ke paas aaya unhein Hajj ya Umrah ke liye vida'i dete hue, to unhone usse kaha: Jab tak namaz na padh lo, mat jaao, kyunki Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: Adhan ke baad masjid se koi nahi nikalta siwaay munafiq ke, siwaay us aadmi ke jise koi zaroorat le gayi ho aur woh masjid mein wapas aane ka irada rakhta ho, to usne kaha: Mere saathi al-Harrah mein hain, unhone bataya: To woh nikal gaya, unhone bataya: Sa'id baar-baar uska zikr karte rahe yahan tak ke unhein khabar mili ke woh apni sawaari se gir gaya aur uski jaang toot gayi.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ :" لَا تُمِلُّوا النَّاسَ "
24.en: Narrated by Abd al-Samad ibn Abd al-Warith, from Shu'bah, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Abdullah: He said: Do not bore the people.
24.hi: Abd al-Samad ibn Abd al-Warith ne Shu'bah se bataya: Humein Abu Ishaq ne bataya, Abu al-Ahwas se, Abdullah se: Unhone kaha, Logon ko usaa mat karo.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَشْعَثُ  ، عَنْ كُرْدُوسٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ لِلْقُلُوبِ لَنَشَاطًا وَإِقْبَالًا، وَإِنَّ لَهَا تَوْلِيَةً وَإِدْبَارًا، فَحَدِّثُوا النَّاسَ مَا أَقْبَلُوا عَلَيْكُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Ash'ath, from Kurdus, from Abdullah رضي الله عنه: He said: Hearts indeed have enthusiasm and receptiveness, and they have times of turning away and disinterest, so narrate to people as long as they turn towards you.
24.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Ash'ath se bataya: Humein Kurdus ne bataya, Abdullah se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Dilon mein zaroor josh aur khulapan hota hai, aur unmein moda-pan aur be-dhyaani ke bhi lamhe hote hain, so logon ko jab tak woh tumhari taraf mude hon tabhi bataao.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هِلَالٍ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ  يَقُولُ : كَانَ يُقَالُ :" حَدِّثْ الْقَوْمَ مَا أَقْبَلُوا عَلَيْكَ بِوُجُوهِهِمْ، فَإِذَا الْتَفَتُوا، فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّ لَهُمْ حَاجَاتٍ "
24.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Abu Hilal: He said: I heard al-Hasan say: It used to be said: Narrate to the people as long as they turn their faces toward you, but when they turn away, know that they have other needs.
24.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Abu Hilal se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Hasan ko kehte suna: Yeh kaha jaata tha: Logon ko tab tak bataao jab tak woh apne chehre tumhari taraf rakhein, lekin jab woh mud jaayein, to jaan lo ke unki koi aur zaroorat hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا هَمَّامٌ  ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" لَا تَكْتُبُوا عَنِّي شَيْئًا إِلَّا الْقُرْآنَ، فَمَنْ كَتَبَ عَنِّي شَيْئًا غَيْرَ الْقُرْآنِ، فَلْيَمْحُهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Hammam, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from Ata ibn Yasar, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri رضي الله عنه: That the Prophet ﷺ said: Do not write anything from me except the Qur'an, and whoever wrote anything from me besides the Qur'an, let him erase it.
24.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Hammam se bataya: Humein Zayd ibn Aslam ne bataya, Ata ibn Yasar se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se رضي الله عنه: ke Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, Mujhse kuch bhi mat likho siwaay Quran ke, aur jisne mujhse Quran ke ilaawa kuch likha ho, use chaahiye ke woh usay mita de.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ  ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ : أَنَّهُمْاسْتَأْذَنُوا النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي أَنْ يَكْتُبُوا عَنْهُ " فَلَمْ يَأْذَنْ لَهُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu Ma'mar, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from Ata ibn Yasar, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri رضي الله عنه: That they asked the Prophet's ﷺ permission to write from him, but he did not give them permission.
24.hi: Abu Ma'mar ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se bataya: Humein Zayd ibn Aslam ne bataya, Ata ibn Yasar se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se رضي الله عنه: ke unhone Nabi ﷺ se ijaazat maangi ke woh unse likhein, lekin aapne unhein ijaazat nahi di.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ ابْنِ شُبْرُمَةَ ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ :" يَا شِبَاكُ، أَرُدُّ عَلَيْكَ، يَعْنِي : الْحَدِيثَ؟ مَا أَرَدْتُ أَنْ يُرَدَّ عَلَيَّ حَدِيثٌ قَطُّ "
24.en: Narrated by Bishr ibn al-Hakam, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Ibn Shubrumah, from al-Sha'bi: That he used to say: O Shibak, shall I turn it back to you - meaning: the hadith? I never wanted a hadith to be repeated to me, ever.
24.hi: Bishr ibn al-Hakam ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se bataya: Humein Ibn Shubrumah ne bataya, al-Sha'bi se: ke woh kehte the: Ae Shibak, kya main tumhein wapas dun - yaani: hadith? Maine kabhi nahi chaaha ke koi hadith mujhe dobara sunaayi jaaye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ مَهْدِيٍّ  ، يَقُولُ : سَمِعْتُ مَالِكَ بْنَ أَنَسٍ  ، يَقُولُ : جَاءَ الزُّهْرِيُّ بِحَدِيثٍ فَلَقِيتُهُ فِي بَعْضِ الطَّرِيقِ، فَأَخَذْتُ بِلِجَامِهِ، فَقُلْتُ : يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ  ، أَعِدْ عَلَيَّ الْحَدِيثَ الَّذِي حَدَّثْتَنَا بِهِ، قَالَ :" وَتَسْتَعِيدُ الْحَدِيثَ؟، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : وَمَا كُنْتَ تَسْتَعِيدُ الْحَدِيثَ؟، قَالَ : لَا، قُلْتُ : وَلَا تَكْتُبُ؟، قَالَ : لَا "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf: He said: I heard Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi say: I heard Malik ibn Anas say: al-Zuhri brought a hadith, so I met him on some road, and took hold of his rein, and said: O Abu Bakr, repeat to me the hadith you narrated to us, he said: Do you ask for hadith to be repeated? He said: I said: Did you not use to ask for hadith to be repeated? He said, No, I said: And you do not write? He said, No.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi ko kehte suna: Maine Malik ibn Anas ko kehte suna: Al-Zuhri ek hadith le kar aaye, to main unse kisi raaste par mila, aur unki lagaam pakad li, aur kaha: Ae Abu Bakr, mujhe woh hadith dohraaiye jo aapne humein bataayi, unhone kaha: Kya tum hadith dohraane ki darkhwaast karte ho? Unhone kaha: Maine poocha: Kya aap hadith dohraane ki darkhwaast nahi karte the? Unhone kaha, Nahi, maine poocha: Aur aap likhte bhi nahi? Unhone kaha, Nahi.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ ، قَالَ : " كَانَ قَتَادَةُ يَكْرَهُ الْكِتَابَةَ، فَإِذَا سَمِعَ وَقْعَ الْكِتَابِ، أَنْكَرَهُ وَالْتَمَسَهُ بِيَدِهِ "، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ ، قَالَ :" كَانَ الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  يَكْرَهُهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir, from al-Awza'i; a related note also from Abu al-Mughirah: He said: Qatadah used to dislike writing, so when he heard the sound of writing, he would object to it, and search for it with his hand. [Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah: he said: Al-Awza'i also disliked it.]
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir ne al-Awza'i se bataya: Unhone kaha, Qatadah likhna na-pasand karte the, so jab woh likhne ki awaaz sunte, isse aitraaz karte, aur apne haath se isay dhundte. [Abu al-Mughirah ne bataya: Unhone kaha: Al-Awza'i bhi isay na-pasand karte the.]

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ " أَنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ كَانَ يَكْرَهُ الْكِتَابَ "، يَعْنِي : الْعِلْمَ
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Mansur: That Ibrahim used to dislike writing, meaning: knowledge.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein Mansur ne bataya: ke Ibrahim likhna na-pasand karte the, yaani: ilm.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَزْهَرُ ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ ،  عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ ، قَالَ :" لَوْ كُنْتُ مُتَّخِذًا كِتَابًا، لَاتَّخَذْتُ رَسَائِلَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "
24.en: Narrated by Yusuf ibn Musa, from Azhar, from Ibn Awn, from Ibn Sirin: He said: If I were going to keep a book, I would have kept the letters of the Prophet ﷺ.
24.hi: Yusuf ibn Musa ne Azhar se bataya: Humein Ibn Awn ne bataya, Ibn Sirin se: Unhone kaha, Agar main koi kitaab rakhta, to main Nabi ﷺ ke khatoot rakhta.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ ، قَالَ :" رَأَيْتُ حَمَّادًا يَكْتُبُ عِنْدَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ  : أَلَمْ أَنْهَكَ؟، قَالَ : إِنَّمَا هِيَ أَطْرَافٌ "
24.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Aban, from Ibn Idris, from Ibn Awn: He said: I saw Hammad writing in Ibrahim's presence, so Ibrahim said to him: Did I not forbid you? He said: These are only brief notes.
24.hi: Isma'il ibn Aban ne Ibn Idris se bataya: Humein Ibn Awn ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Hammad ko Ibrahim ke saamne likhte dekha, to Ibrahim ne unse kaha: Kya maine tumhein mana nahi kiya tha? Unhone kaha: Yeh to sirf mukhtasar note hain.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ : قَالَ لِي عَبِيدَةُ  :" لَا تُخَلِّدَنَّ عَلَيَّ كِتَابًا "
24.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Aban, from Ibn Idris, from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, from Ibrahim: He said: Abidah said to me: Do not keep a permanent book from me.
24.hi: Isma'il ibn Aban ne Ibn Idris se bataya: Humein Shu'bah ne bataya, al-Hakam se, Ibrahim se: Unhone kaha, Abidah ne mujhse kaha: Mujhse koi permanent kitaab mat rakho.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ ، قَالَ :" مَا كَتَبْتُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ إِلَّا حَدِيثَ الْأَعْمَاقِ، فَلَمَّا حَفِظْتُهُ، مَحَوْتُهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Hisham: He said: I never wrote anything from Muhammad except the hadith of al-A'maq, and when I memorized it, I erased it.
24.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Hisham se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Muhammad se kabhi kuch nahi likha siwaay al-A'maq ki hadith ke, aur jab maine isay yaad kar liya, maine isay mita diya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ ، يَقُولُ :" مَا كَتَبْتُ حَدِيثًا قَطُّ "
24.en: Narrated by Marwan ibn Muhammad: He said: I heard Sa'id ibn Abd al-Aziz say: I never wrote down a hadith, ever.
24.hi: Marwan ibn Muhammad ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Sa'id ibn Abd al-Aziz ko kehte suna: Maine kabhi koi hadith nahi likhi.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةِ ،  عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" مَا كَتَبْتُ شَيْئًا قَطُّ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Imran, from Abu Da'ud, from Shu'bah, from Mughirah, from Ibrahim: He said: I never wrote anything, ever.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Imran ne Abu Da'ud se bataya: Humein Shu'bah ne bataya, Mughirah se, Ibrahim se: Unhone kaha, Maine kabhi kuch nahi likha.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنِ رَجَاءٍ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ عَبِيدَةَ   قِطْعَةَ جِلْدٍ أَكْتُبُ فِيهِ، فَقَالَ : " يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ،لَا تُخَلِّدَنَّ عَنِّي كِتَابًا "، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ الْحَكَمِ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ  ، مِثْلَهُ
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Imran, from Abu Da'ud, from Shu'bah, from Isma'il ibn Raja, from Ibrahim; a similar chain also via Abdullah, from Abu Da'ud, from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, from Ibrahim, from Abidah: He said: I asked Abidah for a piece of skin/parchment to write on, so he said: O Ibrahim, do not keep any permanent book from me. [A similar report is narrated through another chain, from Abdullah, from Abu Da'ud, from Shu'bah, from al-Hakam, from Ibrahim, from Abidah, the same.]
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Imran ne Abu Da'ud se bataya: Humein Shu'bah ne bataya, Isma'il ibn Raja se, Ibrahim se: Unhone kaha, Maine Abidah se chamde ka ek tukda maanga jispar likh sakoon, to unhone kaha: Ae Ibrahim, mujhse koi permanent kitaab mat rakho. [Isi jaisi riwayat Abdullah se, Abu Da'ud se, Shu'bah se, al-Hakam se, Ibrahim se, Abidah se bhi aayi hai.]

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ عَتِيكٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  :" أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُكْتَبَ الْحَدِيثُ فِي الْكَرَارِيسِ، وَيَقُولُ : يُشَبَّهُ بِالْمَصَاحِفِ "، قَالَ يَحْيَى : وَوَجَدْتُ فِي كِتَابِي، عَنْ زِيَادٍ الْكَاتِبِ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ ، " فَاكْتُبْ كَيْفَ شِئْتَ "
24.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hammad, from Abu Awanah, from Sulayman ibn Atik, from Abu Ma'shar, from Ibrahim; with Yahya's note: That he used to dislike hadith being written in notebooks, and would say: It resembles the Mus'hafs. Yahya said: And I found in my book, from Ziyad the scribe, from Abu Ma'shar: Write however you wish.
24.hi: Yahya ibn Hammad ne Abu Awanah se bataya: Humein Sulayman ibn Atik ne bataya, Abu Ma'shar se, Ibrahim se: ke woh hadith ko copy-kitaabon mein likhe jaane ko na-pasand karte the, aur kehte: Yeh Mus'hafon ki tarah lagta hai. Yahya kehte hain: Aur maine apni kitaab mein paaya, Ziyad al-Katib se, Abu Ma'shar se: Jaise chaho likho.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ نُعْمَانَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ L1739 ، أَنَّ عَبِيدَةَ   دَعَا بِكُتُبِهِ فَمَحَاهَا عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ، وَقَالَ :" إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ يَلِيَهَا قَوْمٌ، فَلَا يَضَعُونَهَا مَوَاضِعَهَا "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, and Ubaydullah, from Sufyan, from Nu'man ibn Qays: That Abidah called for his books, and erased them at the time of death, and said: I fear that some people may inherit them, and not place them where they belong.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf, aur Ubaydullah ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein Nu'man ibn Qays ne bataya: ke Abidah ne apni kitaabein mangwaayin aur unhein apni maut ke waqt mita diya, aur kaha: Mujhe dar hai ke kuch log inhein virasat mein paayein, aur inhein wahan na rakhein jahan inhein rakhna chaahiye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، وَزَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ ، " أَنَّهُكَرِهَ أَنْ يُكْتَبَ الْعِلْمُ فِي الْكَرَارِيسِ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, and Zakariya ibn Adi, from Abd al-Wahid ibn Ziyad, from Layth, from Mujahid: That he disliked knowledge being written in notebooks.
24.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, aur Zakariya ibn Adi ne Abd al-Wahid ibn Ziyad se bataya: Humein Layth ne bataya, Mujahid se: ke woh ilm ko copy-kitaabon mein likhe jaane ko na-pasand karte the.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ ، قَالَ :" مَا زَالَ هَذَا الْعِلْمُ عَزِيزًا يَتَلَاقَاهُ الرِّجَالُ حَتَّى وَقَعَ فِي الصُّحُفِ، فَحَمَلَهُ، أَوْ دَخَلَ فِيهِ غَيْرُ أَهْلِهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Abd al-Rahman ibn Salih, from Ibn al-Mubarak, from al-Awza'i: He said: This knowledge continued to be precious, men meeting each other to acquire it, until it fell into written pages, so it was then carried, or those who were not its people entered into it.
24.hi: Abd al-Rahman ibn Salih ne Ibn al-Mubarak se bataya: Humein al-Awza'i ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Yeh ilm hamesha keemti raha, log ise haasil karne ke liye ek-doosre se milte the, yahan tak ke yeh likhe hue safhon mein aa gaya, to iske baad ise uthaaya jaane laga, ya jo iske ehle nahi the woh isme dakhil ho gaye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ يُونُسَ ، قَالَ :" كَانَ الْحَسَنُ يَكْتُبُ وَيُكْتِبُ، وَكَانَ ابْنُ سِيرِينَ   لَا يَكْتُبُ وَلَا يُكْتِبُ "
24.en: Narrated by Yusuf ibn Musa, from Abu Da'ud al-Tayalisi, from Shu'bah, from Yunus: He said: Al-Hasan used to write and have others write for him, but Ibn Sirin neither wrote nor had others write for him.
24.hi: Yusuf ibn Musa ne Abu Da'ud al-Tayalisi se bataya: Humein Shu'bah ne bataya, Yunus se: Unhone kaha, Al-Hasan khud likhte the aur doosron se likhwaate the, lekin Ibn Sirin na khud likhte the na doosron se likhwaate the.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْعَوَّامُ  ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ  ، قَالَ : بَلَغَ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ : أَنَّ عِنْدَ نَاسٍ كِتَابًا يُعْجَبُونَ بِهِ، فَلَمْ يَزَلْ بِهِمْ حَتَّى أَتَوْهُ بِهِ، فَمَحَاهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ :" إِنَّمَا هَلَكَ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ قَبْلَكُمْ : أَنَّهُمْ أَقْبَلُوا عَلَى كُتُبِ عُلَمَائِهِمْ، وَتَرَكُوا كِتَابَ رَبِّهِمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Yazid, from al-Awwam, from Ibrahim al-Taymi: He said: It reached Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه that some people had a book they were greatly pleased with, so he kept after them until they brought it to him, and he erased it, then said: Only the People of the Book before you were destroyed because they turned to the books of their scholars, and abandoned the Book of their Lord.
24.hi: Yazid ne al-Awwam se bataya: Humein Ibrahim al-Taymi ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه tak khabar pahunchi ke kuch logon ke paas ek kitaab hai jismein woh bahut khush hain, to woh unke peechhe pade rahe yahan tak ke woh isay unke paas le aaye, aur unhone isay mita diya, fir kaha: Tumse pehle Ahl-e-Kitaab isliye barbaad hue ke woh apne ulama ki kitaabon ki taraf mud gaye, aur apne Rab ki Kitaab chhod di.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ  قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِعَبِيدَةَ   :" أَكْتُبُ مَا أَسْمَعُ مِنْكَ، قَالَ : لَا، قُلْتُ : فَإِنْ وَجَدْتُ كِتَابًا أَقْرَؤُهُ؟، قَالَ : لَا "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ibn Awn, from Muhammad: He said: I said to Abidah: Shall I write what I hear from you? He said, No, I said: What if I find a book and read it? He said, No.
24.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Ibn Awn ne bataya, Muhammad se: Unhone kaha, Maine Abidah se kaha: Kya main jo aapse sunun woh likh loon? Unhone kaha, Nahi, maine poocha: Aur agar mujhe koi kitaab mil jaaye aur main usay padhun? Unhone kaha, Nahi.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْجُرَيْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِأَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ : أَلَا تُكْتِبُنَا، فَإِنَّا لَا نَحْفَظُ؟، فَقَالَ :" لَا، إِنَّا لَنْ نُكْتِبَكُمْ، وَلَنْ نَجْعَلَهُ قُرْآنًا، وَلَكِنْ احْفَظُوا عَنَّا كَمَا حَفِظْنَا نَحْنُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ "
24.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Jurayri, from Abu Nadrah: He said: I said to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri رضي الله عنه: Will you not have things written down for us, for we do not memorize? So he said: No, we will never have things written down for you, and we will never make it into a Qur'an, but rather memorize from us just as we memorized from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
24.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Jurayri se bataya: Humein Abu Nadrah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se رضي الله عنه kaha: Kya aap humare liye cheezein likhwaayenge, kyunki hum yaad nahi rakh paate? To unhone kaha: Nahi, hum kabhi tumhare liye kuch nahi likhwaayenge, aur hum ise kabhi Quran nahi banaayenge, lekin humse yaad karo jaise humne Rasulullah ﷺ se yaad kiya.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا كَثِيرٍ  ، يَقُولُ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ  ، يَقُولُ :" إِنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ لَا يَكْتُبُ، وَلَا يُكْتِبُ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir, from al-Awza'i: He said: I heard Abu Kathir say: I heard Abu Hurairah say: Indeed Abu Hurairah neither writes nor has others write for him.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir ne al-Awza'i se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Abu Kathir ko kehte suna: Maine Abu Hurairah ko kehte suna: Abu Hurairah na khud likhte hain na doosron se likhwaate hain.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَسَدُ بْنُ مُوسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ  :" أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَكْتُبُ حَدِيثَ أَبِيهِ، فَرَآهُ أَبُو مُوسَى، فَمَحَاهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Asad ibn Musa, from Shu'bah, from Abu Musa, from Humayd ibn Hilal, from Abu Burdah: That he used to write his father's hadith, so Abu Musa saw it, and erased it.
24.hi: Asad ibn Musa ne Shu'bah se bataya: Humein Abu Musa ne bataya, Humayd ibn Hilal se, Abu Burdah se: ke woh apne walid ki hadith likhte the, to Abu Musa ne isay dekha, aur mita diya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ ، حَدَّثَنِي قُرَيْشُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ ، قَالَ : قَالَ لِي ابْنُ عَوْنٍ  :" وَاللَّهِ مَا كَتَبْتُ حَدِيثًا قَطُّ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Walid ibn Shuja', from Quraysh ibn Anas: He said: Ibn Awn said to me: By Allah, I never wrote a hadith, ever.
24.hi: Al-Walid ibn Shuja' ne Quraysh ibn Anas se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ibn Awn ne mujhse kaha: Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi koi hadith nahi likhi.

24.ar: قَالَ : وقَالَ ابْنُ سِيرِينَ  رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ :" لَا وَاللَّهِ مَا كَتَبْتُ حَدِيثًا قَطُّ "، قَالَ ابْنُ عَوْنٍ : قَالَ لِي ابْنُ سِيرِينَ : عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ  رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ أَرَادَنِي مَرْوَانُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ وَهُوَ أَمِيرٌ عَلَى الْمَدِينَةِ أَنْ أُكْتِبَهُ شَيْئًا، قَالَ : فَلَمْ أَفْعَلْ، قَالَ : فَجَعَلَ سِتْرًا بَيْنَ مَجْلِسِهِ وَبَيْنَ بَقِيَّةِ دَارِهِ، قَالَ : فَكَانَ أَصْحَابُهُ يَدْخُلُونَ عَلَيْهِ، وَيَتَحَدَّثُونَ فِي ذَلِكَ الْمَوْضِعِ، فَأَقْبَلَ مَرْوَانُ عَلَى أَصْحَابِهِ، فَقَالَ : مَا أُرَانَا إِلَّا قَدْ خُنَّاهُ، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيَّ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ وَمَا ذَاكَ؟، قَالَ : مَا أُرَانَا إِلَّا قَدْ خُنَّاكَ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : وَمَا ذَاكَ؟، قَالَ : " إِنَّا أَمَرْنَا رَجُلًا يَقْعُدُ خَلْفَ هَذَا السِّتْرِ، فَيَكْتُبُ مَا تُفْتِي هَؤُلَاءِ وَمَا تَقُولُ "
24.en: Narrated with continued chain from Ibn Awn: He said: And Ibn Sirin رضي الله عنه said: No, by Allah, I never wrote a hadith, ever, Ibn Awn said: Ibn Sirin told me: Regarding Zayd ibn Thabit رضي الله عنه, Marwan ibn al-Hakam, while he was governor of Madinah, wanted me to write something for him, he said: So I did not do it, he said: So he put up a curtain between his gathering and the rest of his house, he said: So his companions would come in to him, and talk in that place, so Marwan turned to his companions, and said: I only think we have betrayed him, then he turned to me, he said: I said: What is that? He said: I only think we have betrayed you, he said: I said: What is that? He said: We commanded a man to sit behind this curtain, and write down what these people are giving as rulings and what they say.
24.hi: Ibn Awn se aagey riwaayat mein bataya gaya: Unhone kaha, Aur Ibn Sirin رضي الله عنه ne kaha: Nahi, Allah ki qasam, maine kabhi koi hadith nahi likhi, Ibn Awn kehte hain: Ibn Sirin ne mujhse bataya: Zayd ibn Thabit رضي الله عنه ke baare mein, Marwan ibn al-Hakam ne, jab woh Madinah ke gavarnar the, chaaha ke main unke liye kuch likhun, unhone bataya: To maine aisa nahi kiya, unhone bataya: To unhone apni majlis aur apne baaqi ghar ke darmiyan ek parda laga diya, unhone bataya: To unke sathi unke paas aate, aur us jagah baatein karte, to Marwan apne sathiyon ki taraf mude, aur kaha: Mera khayal hai ke humne unke saath dhoka kiya hai, fir woh meri taraf mude, unhone bataya: Maine poocha: Woh kya hai? Unhone kaha: Mera khayal hai ke humne tumhare saath dhoka kiya hai, unhone bataya: Maine poocha: Woh kya hai? Unhone kaha: Humne ek aadmi ko hukum diya ke woh is parde ke peechhe baithe, aur likhe yeh log kya fatwa dete hain aur kya kehte hain.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ  : إِنَّ سَالِمًا أَتَمُّ مِنْكَ حَدِيثًا؟ قَالَ :" إِنَّ سَالِمًا كَانَ يَكْتُبُ "
24.en: Narrated by Affan, from Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Qattan, from Sufyan, from Mansur: He said: I said to Ibrahim: Salim's hadith is more complete than yours? He said: Salim used to write.
24.hi: Affan ne Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Qattan se bataya: Humein Sufyan ne bataya, Mansur se: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibrahim se kaha: Salim ki hadith aapse zyada mukammal hai? Unhone kaha: Salim likhte the.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَارِثُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْحِمْصِيُّ ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ قَيْسٍ ، قَالَ : وَفَدْتُ مَعَ أَبِي إِلَى يَزِيدَ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ بِحُوَّارَيْنَ حِينَ تُوُفِّيَ مُعَاوِيَةُ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ نُعَزِّيهِ، وَنُهَنِّيهِ بِالْخِلَافَةِ، فَإِذَا رَجُلٌ فِي مَسْجِدِهَا، يَقُولُ :" أَلَا إِنَّ مِنْ أَشْرَاطِ السَّاعَةِ أَنْ تُرْفَعَ الْأَشْرَارُ، ويُوضَعُ الْأَخْيَارُ، أَلَا إِنَّ مِنْ أَشْرَاطِ السَّاعَةِ أَنْ يَظْهَرَ الْقَوْلُ وَيُخْزَنَ الْعَمَلُ، أَلَا إِنَّ مِنْ أَشْرَاطِ السَّاعَةِ أَنْ تُتْلَى الْمَثْنَاةُ، فَلَا يُوجَدُ مَنْ يُغَيِّرُهَا، قِيلَ لَهُ : وَمَا الْمَثْنَاةُ؟، قَالَ : مَا اسْتُكْتِبَ مِنْ كِتَابٍ غَيْرِ الْقُرْآنِ، فَعَلَيْكُمْ بِالْقُرْآنِ فَبِهِ هُدِيتُمْ، وَبِهِ تُجْزَوْنَ، وَعَنْهُ تُسْأَلُونَ "، فَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَنْ الرَّجُلُ، فَحَدَّثْتُ هذَا الْحَدِيثِ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ بِحِمْصَ ، فَقَالَ لِي رَجُلٌ مِنْ الْقَوْمِ : أَوَ مَا تَعْرِفُهُ؟، قُلْتُ : لَا، قَالَ : ذَلِكَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو  رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا
24.en: Narrated by al-Walid ibn Hisham, from al-Harith ibn Yazid al-Himsi, from Amr ibn Qays: He said: I came with a delegation along with my father to Yazid ibn Mu'awiyah at Huwwarin when Mu'awiyah رضي الله عنه died, to console him and congratulate him on the caliphate, and there was a man in its mosque, saying: Listen, among the signs of the Hour is that the wicked will be raised up, and the good will be put down, listen, among the signs of the Hour is that speech will spread while deeds are stored away [unpracticed], listen, among the signs of the Hour is that the mathnah will be recited, and no one will be found to change it, it was said to him: What is the mathnah? He said: Whatever has been written of any book besides the Qur'an, so hold to the Qur'an, for by it you are guided, and by it you are recompensed, and about it you will be questioned, so I did not know who the man was, so I narrated this hadith after that in Hims, so a man among the people said to me: Do you not know him? I said, No, he said: That was Abdullah ibn Amr رضي الله عنهما.
24.hi: Al-Walid ibn Hisham ne al-Harith ibn Yazid al-Himsi se bataya: Humein Amr ibn Qays ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Main apne walid ke saath ek wafd mein Yazid ibn Mu'awiyah ke paas Huwwarin gaya jab Mu'awiyah رضي الله عنه ka intiqaal hua, unhein afsos aur khilaafat par mubaarakbaad dene, to us jagah ki masjid mein ek aadmi tha, kehte hue: Sun lo, Qayamat ki nishaaniyon mein se hai ke bure log bulund kiye jaayenge, aur achhe log neeche kar diye jaayenge, sun lo, Qayamat ki nishaaniyon mein se hai ke baat phailegi aur amal chhupa diya jaayega, sun lo, Qayamat ki nishaaniyon mein se hai ke 'mathnah' padhi jaayegi, aur koi isse badalne wala nahi milega, unse poocha gaya: 'Mathnah' kya hai? Unhone kaha: Quran ke ilaawa kisi bhi kitaab se jo likha gaya ho, so Quran ko pakdo, kyunki isi se tumhein hidayat mili hai, aur isi ka tumhein badla milega, aur isi ke baare mein tumse sawaal hoga, to mujhe nahi maloom tha woh aadmi kaun tha, to maine yeh hadith iske baad Hims mein bayaan ki, to logon mein se ek aadmi ne mujhse kaha: Kya tum unhein nahi pehchaante? Maine kaha, Nahi, unhone kaha: Woh Abdullah ibn Amr the, رضي الله عنهما.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُبَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنٌ  ، عَنْ مُرَّةَ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ  ، قَالَ : جَاءَ أَبُو قُرَّةَ الْكِنْدِيُّ بِكِتَابٍ مِنْ الشَّامِ ، فَحَمَلَهُ، فَدَفَعَهُ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، فَنَظَرَ فِيهِ، فَدَعَا بِطَسْتٍ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِمَاءٍ، فَمَرَسَهُ فِيهِ، وَقَالَ :" إِنَّمَا هَلَكَ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ بِاتِّبَاعِهِمْ الْكُتُبَ وَتَرْكِهِمْ كِتَابَهُمْ "، قَالَ حُصَيْنٌ : فَقَالَ مُرَّةُ : " أَمَا إِنَّهُ لَوْ كَانَ مِنْ الْقُرْآنِ، أَوْ السُّنَّةِ لَمْ يَمْحُهُ، وَلَكِنْ كَانَ مِنْ كُتُبِ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ "
24.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Yunus, from Abu Zubayd, from Husayn, from Murrah al-Hamdani: He said: Abu Qurrah al-Kindi came with a book from Syria, and carried it, and handed it to Abdullah ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه, so he looked at it, then called for a basin, then called for water, and soaked it in it, and said: Only those before you were destroyed by following books and abandoning their [own true] book, Husayn said: So Murrah said: Well, had it been from the Qur'an, or the sunnah, he would not have erased it, but it was from the books of the People of the Book.
24.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Yunus ne Abu Zubayd se bataya: Humein Husayn ne bataya, Murrah al-Hamdani se: Unhone kaha, Abu Qurrah al-Kindi Sham se ek kitaab le kar aaye, aur usay uthaaya, aur usay Abdullah ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه ke haath diya, to unhone isme dekha, fir ek tashtari mangwaayi, fir paani mangwaaya, aur isay usmein bhigo diya, aur kaha: Tumse pehle wale sirf kitaabon ki pairwi aur apni [asli] kitaab chhodne ki wajah se barbaad hue. Husayn kehte hain: To Murrah ne kaha: Achha, agar yeh Quran ya Sunnat se hoti, to woh isay na mitaate, lekin yeh Ahl-e-Kitaab ki kitaabon mein se thi.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ جَعْدَةَ  ، قَالَ : أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِكَتِفٍ فِيهِ كِتَابٌ، فَقَالَ :" كَفَى بِقَوْمٍ ضَلَالًا أَنْ يَرْغَبُوا عَمَّا جَاءَ بِهِ نَبِيُّهُمْ إِلَى مَا جَاءَ بِهِ نَبِيٌّ غَيْرُ نَبِيِّهِمْ، أَوْ كِتَابٌ غَيْرُ كِتَابِهِمْ "، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ G : # أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِهِمْ أَنَّا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ يُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَرَحْمَةً وَذِكْرَى لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ سورة العنكبوت آية 51 #
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Sufyan, from Amr, from Yahya ibn Ja'dah: He said: The Prophet ﷺ was brought a shoulder-blade with writing on it, so he said: It is enough misguidance for a people that they turn away from what their own prophet brought to what a prophet other than their own brought, or a book other than their own, so Allah, exalted is He, revealed: 'And is it not sufficient for them that We revealed to you the Book which is recited to them? Indeed in that is a mercy and a reminder for a people who believe' [Surah al-Ankabut, verse 51].
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein Amr ne bataya, Yahya ibn Ja'dah se: Unhone kaha, Nabi ﷺ ke paas ek kandhe ki haddi laayi gayi jismein likhaawat thi, to aapne farmaya: Kisi qaum ke liye itni gumraahi kaafi hai ke woh apne Nabi jo laaye usse dooriya banaayein aur kisi aur Nabi jo laaye uski taraf, ya kisi aur kitaab ki taraf mudein, to Allah Ta'ala ne nazil kiya: 'Aur kya unhein kaafi nahi ke humne tumpar Kitaab nazil ki jo unpar padhi jaati hai? Beshak isme un logon ke liye rehmat aur yaad-dahaani hai jo imaan laate hain' [Surah Al-Ankabut, aayat 51].

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ الْأَشْعَثِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ : رَأَيْتُ مَعَ رَجُلٍ صَحِيفَةً فِيهَا : سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، فَقُلْتُ لَهً : أَنْسِخْنِيهَا، فَكَأَنَّهُ بَخِلَ بِهَا، ثُمَّ وَعَدَنِي أَنْ يُعْطِيَنِيهَا، فَأَتَيْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، فَقَالَ :" إِنَّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْكِتَابِ بِدْعَةٌ، وَفِتْنَةٌ، وَضَلَالَةٌ، وَإِنَّمَا أَهْلَكَ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ هَذَا وَأَشْبَاهُ هَذَا، إِنَّهُمْ كَتَبُوهَا، فَاسْتَلَذَّتْهَا أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ، وَأُشْرِبَتْهَا قُلُوبُهُمْ، فَأَعْزِمُ عَلَى كُلِّ امْرِئٍ يَعْلَمُ بِمَكَانِ كِتَابٍ إِلَّا دَلَّ عَلَيْهِ، وَأُقْسِمُ بِاللَّهِ، قَالَ شُعْبَةُ : فَأَقْسَمَ بِاللَّهِ؟، قَالَ : أَحْسَبُهُ أَقْسَمَ : لَوْ أَنَّهَا ذُكِرَتْ لَهُ بِدَيْرٍ الْهِنْدِ نَرَاهُ يَعْنِي مَكَانًا بِالْكُوفَةِ بَعِيدًا، لآَتَيْتُهُ وَلَوْ مَشْيًا "
24.en: Narrated by Sahl ibn Hammad, from Shu'bah, from al-Ash'ath, from his father, who was among the companions of Abdullah: He said: I saw with a man a page on which was written: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Allah, and there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the greatest, so I said to him: Copy it for me, so he seemed reluctant, then he promised to give it to me, so I came to Abdullah رضي الله عنه, and there it was in front of him, so he said: What is in this book is an innovation, and a trial, and misguidance, and those before you were destroyed by this and things like this, they wrote it down, and their tongues found delight in it, and their hearts were saturated with it, so I resolve upon every man who knows the location of a book, that he point it out, and I swear by Allah, Shu'bah said: So did he swear by Allah? He said: I think he swore: Had it been mentioned to him at Dayr al-Hind - which we take to mean a place far away in Kufah - I would have come to it even on foot.
24.hi: Sahl ibn Hammad ne Shu'bah se bataya: Humein al-Ash'ath ne bataya, apne walid se, jo Abdullah ke sathiyon mein se the: Unhone kaha, Maine ek aadmi ke paas ek safha dekha jismein likha tha: Subhaanallah, aur Alhamdulillah, aur La ilaaha illallah, aur Allahu Akbar, to maine unse kaha: Isay mere liye copy kar do, to woh kanjoos se dikhe, fir unhone mujhse wa'da kiya ke woh mujhe de denge, to main Abdullah رضي الله عنه ke paas aaya, aur woh unke saamne thi, to unhone kaha: Is kitaab mein jo hai woh bidat, aur fitna, aur gumraahi hai, aur tumse pehle wale isi aur isi jaisi cheezon se barbaad hue, unhone isay likha, to unki zubaanein isse lutf lene lagin, aur unke dilon mein yeh ras basi, so main har us aadmi par ahad karta hoon jo kisi kitaab ki jagah jaanta ho, ke woh isse zaroor bataaye, aur main Allah ki qasam khaata hoon, Shu'bah kehte hain: To kya unhone Allah ki qasam khaayi? Unhone kaha: Mera khayal hai unhone qasam khaayi: Agar yeh Dayr al-Hind mein unse zikr ki jaati - jise hum Kufah mein ek door jagah samajhte hain - to main isse paidal bhi jaata.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ هُوَ ابْنُ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ :" أَنَّ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ كَتَبُوا كِتَابًا، فَتَبِعُوهُ وَتَرَكُوا التَّوْرَاةَ "
24.en: Narrated by Zakariya ibn Adi, from Ubaydullah ibn Amr, from Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr, from Abu Burdah, from Abu Musa رضي الله عنه: That Banu Isra'il wrote a book, and followed it, and abandoned the Torah.
24.hi: Zakariya ibn Adi ne Ubaydullah ibn Amr se bataya: Humein Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr ne bataya, Abu Burdah se, Abu Musa se رضي الله عنه: ke Banu Isra'il ne ek kitaab likhi, aur uski pairwi ki, aur Taurat chhod di.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ  ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، عَنْ عَفَّاقٍ الْمُحَارِبِيِّ L5652 ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، يَقُولُ :" إِنَّ نَاسًا يَسْمَعُونَ كَلَامِي، ثُمَّ يَنْطَلِقُونَ فَيَكْتُبُونَهُ، وَإِنِّي لَا أُحِلُّ لِأَحَدٍ أَنْ يَكْتُبَ إِلَّا كِتَابَ اللَّهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Isra'il, from Uthman ibn Abi al-Mughirah, from Affaq al-Muharibi, from his father: He said: I heard Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه say: Some people hear my speech, then go off and write it down, but I do not permit anyone to write anything except the Book of Allah.
24.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Isra'il se bataya: Humein Uthman ibn Abi al-Mughirah ne bataya, Affaq al-Muharibi se, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه ko kehte suna: Kuch log meri baat sunte hain, fir jaakar isse likh lete hain, lekin main kisi ko kuch bhi likhne ki ijaazat nahi deta siwaay Allah ki Kitaab ke.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ ، عَنْ ابْنِ شُبْرُمَةَ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ ، يَقُولُ :" مَا كَتَبْتُ سَوْدَاءَ فِي بَيْضَاءَ، وَلَا اسْتَعَدْتُ حَدِيثًا مِنْ إِنْسَانٍ "
24.en: Narrated by Malik ibn Isma'il, from Muhammad ibn Fudayl, from Ibn Shubrumah: He said: I heard al-Sha'bi say: I never wrote black on white, nor asked any person to repeat a hadith for me.
24.hi: Malik ibn Isma'il ne Muhammad ibn Fudayl se bataya: Humein Ibn Shubrumah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Sha'bi ko kehte suna: Maine kabhi kaale ko safed par nahi likha, aur na hi kisi insaan se hadith dohraane ki darkhwaast ki.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ  ، عَنْ أَخِيهِ  ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، يَقُولُ :" لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَكْثَرَ حَدِيثًا عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنِّي، إِلَّا مَا كَانَ مِنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يَكْتُبُ، وَلَا أَكْتُبُ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Sufyan, from Amr, from Wahb ibn Munabbih, from his brother, who heard Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه say: No one among the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ narrated more hadith from the Prophet ﷺ than me, except for Abdullah ibn Amr, for he used to write, while I did not write.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein Amr ne bataya, Wahb ibn Munabbih se, apne bhai se, jinhone Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه ko kehte suna: Rasulullah ﷺ ke sahaba mein se koi bhi Nabi ﷺ se mujhse zyada hadith riwaayat nahi karta, siwaay Abdullah ibn Amr ke, kyunki woh likhte the, aur main nahi likhta tha.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى  ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَخْنَسِ  ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مَاهَكَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ أَكْتُبُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَسْمَعُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أُرِيدُ حِفْظَهُ، فَنَهَتْنِي قُرَيْشٌ، وَقَالُوا : تَكْتُبُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَشَرٌ يَتَكَلَّمُ فِي الْغَضَبِ وَالرِّضَاءِ؟ فَأَمْسَكْتُ عَنْ الْكِتَابِ، فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَأَوْمَأَ بِإِصْبَعِهِ إِلَى فِيهِ، وَقَالَ :" اكْتُبْ، فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، مَا خَرَجَ مِنْهُ إِلَّا حَقٌّ "
24.en: Narrated by Musaddad, from Yahya, from Ubaydullah ibn al-Akhnas: He said: al-Walid ibn Abdullah told me, from Yusuf ibn Mahak, from Abdullah ibn Amr: he said: I used to write everything I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, wanting to memorize it, so Quraysh forbade me, and said: You write everything you hear from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ is a human being who speaks in anger and pleasure? So I stopped writing, then I mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he gestured with his finger to his mouth, and said: Write, for by the One in whose hand is my soul, nothing has ever come out of it except the truth.
24.hi: Musaddad ne Yahya se bataya: Humein Ubaydullah ibn al-Akhnas ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhse al-Walid ibn Abdullah ne bataya, Yusuf ibn Mahak se, Abdullah ibn Amr se: Unhone kaha, Main har woh cheez likhta tha jo main Rasulullah ﷺ se sunta, ise yaad rakhna chaahta tha, to Quraysh ne mujhe mana kiya, aur kaha: Tum har woh cheez likhte ho jo tum Rasulullah ﷺ se sunte ho, jabke Rasulullah ﷺ ek insaan hain jo gusse aur khushi mein baat karte hain? To main likhna band kar diya, fir maine yeh baat Rasulullah ﷺ se zikr ki, to aapne apni ungli se apne munh ki taraf ishara kiya, aur farmaya: Likho, kyunki us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, isse kabhi kuch nahi nikla siwaay haq ke.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلَالٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي مُخْبِرٌ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا، أَنَّهُ أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَرْوِيَ مِنْ حَدِيثِكَ، فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَسْتَعِينَ بِكِتَابِ يَدِي مَعَ قَلْبِي إِنْ رَأَيْتَ ذَلِكَ؟، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِنْ كَانَ قَالَهُ :" عِ حَدِيثِي، ثُمَّ اسْتَعِنْ بِيَدِكَ مَعَ قَلْبِكَ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Salih, from al-Layth, from Khalid ibn Yazid, from Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal, from Abd al-Wahid ibn Qays: He said: One who informed me told me, from Abdullah ibn Amr رضي الله عنهما: that he came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and said: O Messenger of Allah, I want to narrate from your hadith, so I want to use writing with my hand along with my heart, if you see fit? So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, if he indeed said it: Remember/be attentive to my hadith, then use your hand along with your heart.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Salih ne al-Layth se bataya: Mujhse Khalid ibn Yazid ne bataya, Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal se, Abd al-Wahid ibn Qays se: Unhone kaha, Mujhe ek khabar dene wale ne bataya, Abdullah ibn Amr se رضي الله عنهما: ke woh Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas aaye, aur kaha: Ya Rasulullah, main aapki hadith riwaayat karna chaahta hoon, so main apne dil ke saath apne haath ki likhaawat ka sahaara lena chaahta hoon agar aap munaasib samjhein? To Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, agar aapne waaqai yeh farmaaya: Meri hadith ko dhyaan se sunho, fir apne dil ke saath apne haath ka sahaara lo.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي قَبِيلٍ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ حَوْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَكْتُبُ إِذْ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : أَيُّ الْمَدِينَتَيْنِ تُفْتَحُ أَوَّلًا : قُسْطَنْطِينِيَّةُ ، أَوْ رُومِيَّةُ ؟، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا، بَلْ مَدِينَةُ هِرَقْلَ أَوَّلًا "
24.en: Narrated by Uthman ibn Muhammad, from Yahya ibn Ishaq, from Yahya ibn Ayyub, from Abu Qabil: He said: I heard Abdullah ibn Amr رضي الله عنه say: While we were around the Messenger of Allah ﷺ writing, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked: Which of the two cities will be conquered first: Constantinople, or Rome? So the Prophet ﷺ said: No, rather the city of Heraclius [Constantinople] first.
24.hi: Uthman ibn Muhammad ne Yahya ibn Ishaq se bataya: Humein Yahya ibn Ayyub ne bataya, Abu Qabil se: Unhone kaha, Maine Abdullah ibn Amr رضي الله عنه ko kehte suna: Jabke hum Rasulullah ﷺ ke aas-paas likh rahe the, Rasulullah ﷺ se poocha gaya: In do shehron mein se pehle kaunsa fatah hoga: Constantinople, ya Rome? To Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: Nahi, balke Heraclius ka shehar pehle.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي ضَمْرَةَ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ،  عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ ، قَالَ : كَتَبَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ  رَحِمَهُ الله إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ :" أَنْ اكْتُبْ إِلَيَّ بِمَا ثَبَتَ عِنْدَكَ مِنْ الْحَدِيثِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَبِحَدِيثِ عَمْرَةَ فَإِنِّي قَدْ خَشِيتُ دُرُوسَ الْعِلْمِ وَذَهَابَهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Ibrahim Abu Ma'mar, from Abu Damrah, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Abdullah ibn Dinar: He said: Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz, may Allah have mercy on him, wrote to Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm: Write to me whatever is established with you of hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and the hadith of Amrah, for I have indeed come to fear the fading and passing away of knowledge.
24.hi: Isma'il ibn Ibrahim Abu Ma'mar ne Abu Damrah se bataya: Humein Yahya ibn Sa'id ne bataya, Abdullah ibn Dinar se: Unhone kaha, Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz, rahimahullah, ne Abu Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Hazm ko likha: Mujhe likho jo bhi tumhare paas Rasulullah ﷺ se hadith saabit ho, aur Amrah ki hadith, kyunki mujhe zaroor ilm ke mit jaane aur khatam ho jaane ka dar hai.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ ، قَالَ : كَتَبَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ  إِلَى أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ :" أَنْ انْظُرُوا حَدِيثَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَاكْتُبُوهُ، فَإِنِّي قَدْ خِفْتُ دُرُوسَ الْعِلْمِ وَذَهَابَ أَهْلِهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Yahya ibn Hassan, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muslim, from Abdullah ibn Dinar: He said: Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz wrote to the people of Madinah: Look into the hadith of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and write it down, for I have indeed come to fear the fading of knowledge and the passing away of its people.
24.hi: Yahya ibn Hassan ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muslim se bataya: Humein Abdullah ibn Dinar ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz ne Madinah walon ko likha: Rasulullah ﷺ ki hadith dekho aur usay likho, kyunki mujhe zaroor ilm ke mit jaane aur uske logon ke khatam ho jaane ka dar hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمَلِيحِ ، قَالَ :" يَعِيبُونَ عَلَيْنَا الْكِتَابَ، وَقَدْ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى : # عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ رَبِّي فِي كِتَابٍ سورة طه آية 52 # "
24.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Abu al-Malih: He said: They criticize us for writing, but Allah, exalted is He, has said: 'Its knowledge is with my Lord in a record' [Surah Ta-Ha, verse 52].
24.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Ayyub ne bataya, Abu al-Malih se: Unhone kaha, Woh humpar likhne ka aib lagaate hain, jabke Allah Ta'ala ne farmaaya: 'Iska ilm mere Rab ke paas ek kitaab mein hai' [Surah Ta-Ha, aayat 52].

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ ، حَدَّثَنَا سَوَادَةُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنَ قُرَّةَ أَبَا إِيَاسٍ ، يَقُولُ : كَانَ يُقَالُ :" مَنْ لَمْ يَكْتُبْ عِلْمَهُ، لَمْ يُعَدَّ عِلْمُهُ عِلْمًا "
24.en: Narrated by Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid, from Sawadah ibn Hayyan: He said: I heard Mu'awiyah ibn Qurrah Abu Iyas say: It used to be said: Whoever does not write down his knowledge, his knowledge is not counted as knowledge.
24.hi: Ubaydullah ibn Abd al-Majid ne Sawadah ibn Hayyan se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Mu'awiyah ibn Qurrah Abu Iyas ko kehte suna: Yeh kaha jaata tha: Jo apna ilm na likhe, uska ilm ilm nahi maana jaata.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى  ، حَدَّثَنِي ثُمَامَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ  : أَنَّ أَنَسًا   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ لِبَنِيهِ : " يَا بَنِيَّقَيِّدُوا هَذَا الْعِلْمَ "
24.en: Narrated by Muslim ibn Ibrahim, from Abdullah ibn al-Muthanna: He said: Thumamah ibn Abdullah ibn Anas told me: that Anas رضي الله عنه used to say to his sons: O my sons, tie down this knowledge [by writing it].
24.hi: Muslim ibn Ibrahim ne Abdullah ibn al-Muthanna se bataya: Mujhse Thumamah ibn Abdullah ibn Anas ne bataya: ke Anas رضي الله عنه apne beton se kaha karte the: Ae mere beto, is ilm ko [likhkar] baandh do.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ ، عَنْ مَهْدِيِّ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ ، عَنْ سَلْمٍ الْعَلَوِيِّ ، قَالَ :" رَأَيْتُ أَبَانَ يَكْتُبُ عِنْدَ أَنَسٍ  رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ فِي سَبُّورَةٍ "
24.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Aban, from Ibn Idris, from Mahdi ibn Maymun, from Salm al-Alawi: He said: I saw Aban writing in Anas's رضي الله عنه presence on a writing tablet.
24.hi: Isma'il ibn Aban ne Ibn Idris se bataya: Humein Mahdi ibn Maymun ne bataya, Salm al-Alawi se: Unhone kaha, Maine Aban ko Anas رضي الله عنه ke saamne ek takhti par likhte dekha.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ  ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ جَابِرٍ  ، أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ الْبَاهِلِيَّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ عَنْ كِتَابِ الْعِلْمِ، فَقَالَ :" لَا بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ "
24.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Isa, from Ibn Wahb, from Mu'awiyah, from al-Hasan ibn Jabir: That he asked Abu Umamah al-Bahili رضي الله عنه about writing down knowledge, so he said: There is no harm in that.
24.hi: Ahmad ibn Isa ne Ibn Wahb se bataya: Humein Mu'awiyah ne bataya, al-Hasan ibn Jabir se: ke unhone Abu Umamah al-Bahili se رضي الله عنه ilm likhne ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: Isme koi harj nahi.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ بْنُ حُدَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ  ، عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ نَهِيكٍ  ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ أَكْتُبُ مَا أَسْمَعُ مِنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، فَلَمَّا أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أُفَارِقَهُ،" أَتَيْتُهُ بِكِتَابِهِ، فَقَرَأْتُهُ عَلَيْهِ، وَقُلْتُ لَهُ : هَذَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْكَ؟، قَالَ : نَعَمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Makhlad ibn Malik, from Mu'adh, from Imran ibn Hudayr, from Abu Mijlaz, from Bashir ibn Nahik: He said: I used to write down what I heard from Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه, so when I intended to part from him, I brought him his book, and read it to him, and said to him: Did I hear this from you? He said, Yes.
24.hi: Makhlad ibn Malik ne Mu'adh se bataya: Humein Imran ibn Hudayr ne bataya, Abu Mijlaz se, Bashir ibn Nahik se: Unhone kaha, Main woh likhta tha jo main Abu Hurairah se رضي الله عنه sunta, to jab maine unse alag hone ka irada kiya, main unki kitaab unke paas laaya, aur unhein padh kar sunaayi, aur unse kaha: Kya maine yeh aapse suna tha? Unhone kaha, Haan.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، أَخْبَرَنَا شَرِيكٌ ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ أَسْمَعُ مِنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، وَابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا" الْحَدِيثَ بِاللَّيْلِ فَأَكْتُبُهُ فِي وَاسِطَةِ الرَّحْلِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Sharik, from Tariq ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr: He said: I used to hear hadith from Ibn Umar, and Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما at night, and write it on the frame of the saddle.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Sa'id ne Sharik se bataya: Humein Tariq ibn Abd al-Rahman ne bataya, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se: Unhone kaha, Main Ibn Umar, aur Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se raat mein hadith sunta aur isay kaathi ke frame par likh leta.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا شَرِيكٌ  ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ  ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، قَالَ :" مَا يُرَغِّبُنِي فِي الْحَيَاةِ إِلَّا الصَّادِقَةُ وَالْوَهْطُ، فَأَمَّا الصَّادِقَةُ، فَصَحِيفَةٌ كَتَبْتُهَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَأَمَّا الْوَهْطُ، فَأَرْضٌ تَصَدَّقَ بِهَا عَمْرُو بْنُ الْعَاصِ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ كَانَ يَقُومُ عَلَيْهَا "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Sharik, from Layth, from Mujahid, from Abdullah ibn Amr: He said: Nothing makes me desire life except al-Sadiqah and al-Wahat, as for al-Sadiqah, it is a page I wrote from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and as for al-Wahat, it is a land that Amr ibn al-As رضي الله عنه gave in charity, which he used to tend.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Sa'id ne Sharik se bataya: Humein Layth ne bataya, Mujahid se, Abdullah ibn Amr se: Unhone kaha, Mujhe zindagi mein koi cheez nahi rijhaati siwaay 'Al-Sadiqah' aur 'Al-Wahat' ke, 'Al-Sadiqah' to woh safha hai jo maine Rasulullah ﷺ se likha, aur 'Al-Wahat' woh zameen hai jo Amr ibn al-As رضي الله عنه ne sadqe mein di, jise woh khud sambhaalte the.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ عَمِّهْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ  ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ   رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ، يَقُولُ :" قَيِّدُوا الْعِلْمَ بِالْكِتَابِ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu Asim, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abd al-Malik ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Sufyan, from his uncle Amr ibn Abi Sufyan: That he heard Umar ibn al-Khattab رضوان الله عليه say: Chain down knowledge by writing.
24.hi: Abu Asim ne Ibn Jurayj se bataya: Mujhe Abd al-Malik ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Sufyan ne bataya, apne chacha Amr ibn Abi Sufyan se: ke unhone Umar ibn al-Khattab رضوان الله عليه ko kehte suna: Ilm ko likhne se baandh do.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ  ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ الثَّقَفِيُّ  ،  عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا أَنَّهُ، قَالَ :" قَيِّدُوا هَذَا الْعِلْمَ بِالْكِتَابِ "
24.en: Narrated by Makhlad ibn Malik, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Jurayj: He said: Abd al-Malik ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Sufyan al-Thaqafi informed me, from Ibn Umar رضي الله عنهما: that he said: Chain down this knowledge by writing.
24.hi: Makhlad ibn Malik ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se bataya: Humein Ibn Jurayj ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Mujhe Abd al-Malik ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Sufyan al-Thaqafi ne bataya, Ibn Umar se رضي الله عنهما: ke unhone kaha: Is ilm ko likhne se baandh do.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ ، يَقُولُ :" كُنْتُ أَسِيرُ مَعَ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ فِي طَرِيقِ مَكَّةَ لَيْلًا، وَكَانَ يُحَدِّثُنِي بِالْحَدِيثِ فَأَكْتُبُهُ فِي وَاسِطَةِ الرَّحْلِ حَتَّى أُصْبِحَ فَأَكْتُبَهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Abd al-Wahid, from Uthman ibn Hakim: He said: I heard Sa'id ibn Jubayr say: I used to travel with Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه on the road to Makkah at night, and he would narrate hadith to me, so I would write it on the frame of the saddle until morning, when I would [properly] write it out.
24.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Abd al-Wahid se bataya: Humein Uthman ibn Hakim ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Sa'id ibn Jubayr ko kehte suna: Main Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه ke saath Makkah ke raaste par raat mein chalta tha, aur woh mujhe hadith bataate, to main isay kaathi ke frame par likh leta yahan tak ke subah hoti to main isay [theek se] likhta.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ الْقُمِّيِّ ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي الْمُغِيرَةِ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ ، قَالَ :" كُنْتُ أَكْتُبُ عِنْدَ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ فِي صَحِيفَةٍ، وَأَكْتُبُ فِي نَعْلَيَّ "
24.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Aban, from Ya'qub al-Qummi, from Ja'far ibn Abi al-Mughirah, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr: He said: I used to write in Ibn Abbas's رضي الله عنه presence on a page, and I would write on my sandals.
24.hi: Isma'il ibn Aban ne Ya'qub al-Qummi se bataya: Humein Ja'far ibn Abi al-Mughirah ne bataya, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se: Unhone kaha, Main Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه ke saamne ek safhe par likhta, aur main apni chappalon par bhi likhta.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْدَلُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْعَنَزِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمُغِيرَةِ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ ، قَالَ :" كُنْتُ أَجْلِسُ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَأَكْتُبُ فِي الصَّحِيفَةِ حَتَّى تَمْتَلِئَ، ثُمَّ أَقْلِبُ نَعْلَيَّ فَأَكْتُبُ فِي ظُهُورِهِمَا "
24.en: Narrated by Malik ibn Isma'il, from Mandal ibn Ali al-Anazi, from Ja'far ibn Abi al-Mughirah, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr: He said: I used to sit with Ibn Abbas, and write on the page until it was full, then I would turn my sandals over and write on their soles.
24.hi: Malik ibn Isma'il ne Mandal ibn Ali al-Anazi se bataya: Mujhse Ja'far ibn Abi al-Mughirah ne bataya, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se: Unhone kaha, Main Ibn Abbas ke paas baithta aur safhe par likhta yahan tak ke woh bhar jaata, fir main apni chappalein ulta karta aur unke talon par likhta.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ ، أَخْبَرَنَا فُضَيْلٌ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدٍ الْمُكْتِبِ ، قَالَ :" رَأَيْتُهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ التَّفْسِيرَ عِنْدَ مُجَاهِدٍ "
24.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Awn, from Fudayl, from Ubayd al-Muktib: He said: I saw them writing down the commentary [tafsir] in the presence of Mujahid.
24.hi: Amr ibn Awn ne Fudayl se bataya: Humein Ubayd al-Muktib ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine unhein Mujahid ke saamne tafseer likhte dekha.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَنَشٍ ، قَالَ :" رَأَيْتُهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ عِنْدَ الْبَرَاءِ بِأَطْرَافِ الْقَصَبِ عَلَى أَكُفِّهِمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Waki', from his father, from Abdullah ibn Hanash: He said: I saw them, in the presence of al-Bara', writing with the tips of reed pens on their palms.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Sa'id ne Waki' se bataya: Humein unke walid ne bataya, Abdullah ibn Hanash se: Unhone kaha, Maine unhein al-Bara' ke saamne, apni hatheliyon par qalam ki nok se likhte dekha.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ إِدْرِيسَ  ، عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ عَنْتَرَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ   بِحَدِيثٍ، فَقُلْتُ : أَكْتُبُهُ عَنْكَ؟، قَالَ :" فَرَخَّصَ لِي وَلَمْ يَكَدْ "
24.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Aban, from Ibn Idris, from Harun ibn Antarah, from his father: He said: Ibn Abbas narrated a hadith to me, so I said: Shall I write it down from you? He said: So he permitted me, but reluctantly.
24.hi: Isma'il ibn Aban ne Ibn Idris se bataya: Humein Harun ibn Antarah ne bataya, apne walid se: Unhone kaha, Ibn Abbas ne mujhe ek hadith bataayi, to maine kaha: Kya main isay aapse likh lun? Unhone bataya: To unhone mujhe ijaazat di lekin be-dili se.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ شَابُورٍ ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي السَّائِبِ ، عَنْ رَجَاءِ بْنِ حَيْوَةَ ، أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُ، قَالَ : كَتَبَ هِشَامُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ إِلَى عَامِلِهِ أَنْ يَسْأَلَنِي عَنْ حَدِيثٍ، قَالَ رَجَاءٌ :" فَكُنْتُ قَدْ نَسِيتُهُ لَوْلَا أَنَّهُ كَانَ عِنْدِي مَكْتُوبًا "
24.en: Narrated by al-Walid ibn Shuja', from Muhammad ibn Shu'ayb ibn Shabur, from al-Walid ibn Sulayman ibn Abi al-Sa'ib, from Raja ibn Haywah: That he narrated to him: he said: Hisham ibn Abd al-Malik wrote to his governor to ask me about a hadith, Raja said: I would have forgotten it, had it not been written down with me.
24.hi: Al-Walid ibn Shuja' ne Muhammad ibn Shu'ayb ibn Shabur se bataya: Humein al-Walid ibn Sulayman ibn Abi al-Sa'ib ne bataya, Raja ibn Haywah se: ke unhone unhein bataaya: Unhone kaha, Hisham ibn Abd al-Malik ne apne karyakarta ko likha ke woh mujhse ek hadith poochhe, Raja kehte hain: Main isay bhool jaata agar yeh mere paas likhi hui na hoti.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ شُعَيْبٍ ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ الْغَازِ ، قَالَ :" كَانَ يُسْأَلُ عَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ  ، وَيُكْتَبُ مَا يُجِيبَ فِيهِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Walid ibn Shuja', from Muhammad ibn Shu'ayb, from Hisham ibn al-Ghaz: He said: Ata ibn Abi Rabah used to be asked, and whatever he answered on the matter would be written down in front of him.
24.hi: Al-Walid ibn Shuja' ne Muhammad ibn Shu'ayb se bataya: Humein Hisham ibn al-Ghaz ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Ata ibn Abi Rabah se poocha jaata, aur woh jo bhi jawaab dete usi maamle mein woh unke saamne likh liya jaata.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ شَابُورٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي السَّائِبِ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى  " أَنَّهُرَأَى نَافِعًا  مَوْلَى ابْنِ عُمَرَ، يُمْلِي عِلْمَهُ، وَيُكْتَبُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Walid ibn Shuja', from Muhammad ibn Shu'ayb ibn Shabur, from al-Walid ibn Sulayman ibn Abi al-Sa'ib, from Sulayman ibn Musa: That he saw Nafi', freed servant of Ibn Umar, dictating his knowledge, and it being written down in front of him.
24.hi: Al-Walid ibn Shuja' ne Muhammad ibn Shu'ayb ibn Shabur se bataya: Humein al-Walid ibn Sulayman ibn Abi al-Sa'ib ne bataya, Sulayman ibn Musa se: ke unhone Nafi', jo Ibn Umar ke azaad kiye hue ghulam the, ko apna ilm dictate karte aur unke saamne likhe jaate dekha.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، قَالَ :" كَانَ سُفْيَانُ  يَكْتُبُ الْحَدِيثَ بِاللَّيْلِ فِي الْحَائِطِ، فَإِذَا أَصْبَحَ نَسَخَهُ ثُمَّ حَكَّهُ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Walid ibn Shuja', from al-Mubarak ibn Sa'id: He said: Sufyan used to write hadith at night on the wall, and when it was morning, he would copy it out, then scrape it off.
24.hi: Al-Walid ibn Shuja' ne al-Mubarak ibn Sa'id se bataya: Unhone kaha, Sufyan raat ko deewaar par hadith likhte, aur jab subah hoti woh isay nakal karte fir isay khurach dete.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غِفَارٍ الْمُثَنَّى بْنُ سَعْيدٍ الطَّائِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عَوْنُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ لِعُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ : حَدَّثَنِي فُلَانٌ   رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَعَرَفَهُ عُمَرُ، قُلْتُ : حَدَّثَنِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" إِنَّ الْحَيَاءَ وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْعِيَّ عِيَّ اللِّسَانِ لَا عِيَّ الْقَلْبِ وَالْفِقْهَ مِنْ الْإِيمَانِ، وَهُنَّ مِمَّا يَزِدْنَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ، وَيُنْقِصْنَ مِنْ الدُّنْيَا، وَمَا يَزِدْنَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ أَكْثَرُ، وَإِنَّ الْبَذَاءَ وَالْجَفَاءَ وَالشُّحَّ مِنْ النِّفَاقِ، وَهُنَّ مِمَّا يَزِدْنَ فِي الدُّنْيَا، وَيُنْقِصْنَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ، وَمَا يُنْقِصْنَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ أَكْثَرُ "، أَخْبَرَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ أَبُو قِلَابَةَ  : خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ  لِصَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ، وَمَعَهُ قِرْطَاسٌ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا لِصَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ، وَهُوَ مَعَهُ، فَقُلْتُ لَهُ : يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، مَا هَذَا الْكِتَابُ؟، قَالَ : " هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَدَّثَنِي بِهِ عَوْنُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، فَأَعْجَبَنِي فَكَتَبْتُهُ "، فَإِذَا فِيهِ هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ
24.en: Narrated by al-Husayn ibn Mansur, from Abu Usamah, from Abu Ghifar al-Muthanna ibn Sa'id al-Ta'i, from Awn ibn Abdullah; a similar note also from al-Husayn ibn Mansur, from Abu Usamah, from Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah: He said: I said to Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz: So-and-so, a man among the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, narrated to me, and Umar recognized him, I said: He narrated to me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Indeed shyness, and chastity, and slowness of speech - meaning slowness of the tongue, not of the heart - and understanding, are all part of faith, and these things increase one's share in the Hereafter, and decrease it in this world, but what they increase in the Hereafter is greater, and indeed obscenity, and harshness, and stinginess are part of hypocrisy, and these things increase one's share in this world, and decrease it in the Hereafter, but what they decrease in the Hereafter is greater. [Narrated by al-Husayn ibn Mansur, from Abu Usamah, from Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah: he said: Abu Qilabah said: Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz came out to us for the Zuhr prayer, with a piece of paper with him, then came out to us for the Asr prayer, with it still with him, so I said to him: O Commander of the Believers, what is this book? He said: This is a hadith that Awn ibn Abdullah narrated to me, and it pleased me, so I wrote it down, and in it was this very hadith.]
24.hi: Al-Husayn ibn Mansur ne Abu Usamah se bataya: Humein Abu Ghifar al-Muthanna ibn Sa'id al-Ta'i ne bataya: Mujhse Awn ibn Abdullah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz se kaha: Fulaan, Rasulullah ﷺ ke sahaba mein se ek aadmi, ne mujhe bataaya, aur Umar unhein pehchaanate the, maine kaha: Unhone mujhe bataaya ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya: Sharm, aur pakizgi, aur dheemi baat (zubaan ki dheemi, dil ki nahi), aur samajh, sab imaan ka hissa hain, aur yeh cheezein Aakhirat mein hissa badhaati hain, aur duniya mein isse ghata deti hain, lekin jo woh Aakhirat mein badhaati hain woh zyada hai, aur be-hayaai, aur sakhti, aur kanjoosi munafiqat ka hissa hain, aur yeh cheezein duniya mein hissa badhaati hain, aur Aakhirat mein isse ghata deti hain, lekin jo woh Aakhirat mein ghataati hain woh zyada hai. [Isi jaisi riwayat al-Husayn ibn Mansur se, Abu Usamah se, Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah se bhi aayi hai: Unhone kaha, Abu Qilabah ne kaha: Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz Zuhr ki namaz ke liye humare paas nikle, unke saath ek kaghaz tha, fir Asr ki namaz ke liye humare paas nikle, woh abhi bhi unke saath tha, to maine unse kaha: Ae Ameer-ul-Mumineen, yeh kitaab kya hai? Unhone kaha: Yeh ek hadith hai jo Awn ibn Abdullah ne mujhe bataayi, aur mujhe pasand aayi, to maine isay likh liya, aur usme yehi hadith thi.]

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مَسْعُودٌ  ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي فَرْوَةَ  ، عَنْ شُرَحْبِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي سَعْدٍ  ، قَالَ : دَعَا الْحَسَنُ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ بَنِيهِ وَبَنِي أَخِيهِ، فَقَالَ : " يَا بَنِيَّ وَبَنِي أَخِي،إِنَّكُمْ صِغَارُ قَوْمٍ يُوشِكُ أَنْ تَكُونُوا كِبَارَ آخَرِينَ، فَتَعَلَّمُوا الْعِلْمَ، فَمَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَرْوِيَهُ، أَوْ قَالَ : يَحْفَظَهُ فَلْيَكْتُبْهُ، وَلْيَضَعْهُ فِي بَيْتِهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Aban, from Mas'ud, from Yunus ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Farwah, from Shurahbil ibn Abi Sa'd: He said: al-Hasan رضي الله عنه called his sons and his brother's sons, and said: O my sons and my brother's sons, you are the young ones of a people who are likely to become the elders of others, so learn knowledge, and whoever among you cannot narrate it, or he said: preserve it, let him write it down, and place it in his house.
24.hi: Isma'il ibn Aban ne Mas'ud se bataya: Humein Yunus ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Farwah ne bataya, Shurahbil ibn Abi Sa'd se: Unhone kaha, Al-Hasan رضي الله عنه ne apne beton aur apne bhai ke beton ko bulaaya, aur kaha: Ae mere beto aur mere bhai ke beto, tum ek qaum ke chhote log ho jo qareeb hai ke doosron ke bade ban jaayein, so ilm seekho, aur tum mein se jo isay riwaayat na kar sake, ya kaha: isay yaad na rakh sake, to use chaahiye ke isay likh le, aur apne ghar mein rakh de.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَاهُ عَاصِمٌ  ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ  ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ سَنَّ سُنَّةً حَسَنَةً عُمِلَ بِهَا بَعْدَهُ، كَانَ لَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يُنْقَصَ مِنْ أَجْرِهِ شَيْءٌ، وَمَنْ سَنَّ سُنَّةً سَيِّئَةً، كَانَ عَلَيْهِ مِثْلُ وِزْرِ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يُنْقَصَ مِنْ أَوْزَارِهِمْ شَيْءٌ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Walid ibn Shuja', from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Asim, from Shaqiq, from Jarir رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Whoever establishes a good precedent that is acted upon after him, has a reward like the reward of whoever acts by it, without anything being diminished from his reward, and whoever establishes an evil precedent, has a burden like the burden of whoever acts by it, without anything being diminished from their burdens.
24.hi: Al-Walid ibn Shuja' ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se bataya: Humein Asim ne bataya, Shaqiq se, Jarir se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Jo koi achhi riwaayat qaayam kare jispar uske baad amal kiya jaaye, usay usi jaisa ajr milega jo koi isper amal kare, bina uske ajr mein kuch kami ke, aur jo koi buri riwaayat qaayam kare, usko usi jaisa gunah hoga jo koi isper amal kare, bina unke gunahon mein kuch kami ke.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ  ، عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ  مَوْلَى الْحُرَقَةِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" مَنْ دَعَا إِلَى هُدًى، كَانَ لَهُ مِنْ الْأَجْرِ مِثْلُ أُجُورِ مَنْ اتَّبَعَهُ، لَا يَنْقُصُ ذَلِكَ مِنْ أُجُورِهِمْ شَيْئًا، وَمَنْ دَعَا إِلَى ضَلَالَةٍ، كَانَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ الْإِثْمِ مِثْلُ آثَامِ مَنْ اتَّبِعَهُ لَا يَنْقُصُ ذَلِكَ مِنْ آثَامِهِمْ شَيْئًا "
24.en: Narrated by al-Walid ibn Shuja', from Isma'il ibn Ja'far, from al-Ala ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Ya'qub, freed servant of al-Huraqah, from his father, from Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Whoever calls to guidance, will have a reward like the rewards of whoever follows him, without any of it diminishing their rewards at all, and whoever calls to misguidance, will have a sin like the sins of whoever follows him, without any of it diminishing their sins at all.
24.hi: Al-Walid ibn Shuja' ne Isma'il ibn Ja'far se bataya: Humein al-Ala ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Ya'qub ne bataya (al-Huraqah ke azaad kiye hue ghulam), apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se رضي الله عنه: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Jo koi hidayat ki taraf bulaaye, usay usi jaisa ajr milega jo unke pairvi karne walon ka ajr hoga, bina unke ajr mein kuch kami ke, aur jo koi gumraahi ki taraf bulaaye, usko usi jaisa gunah hoga jo unke pairvi karne walon ka gunah hoga, bina unke gunahon mein kuch kami ke.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ  ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ يَعْنِي ابْنَ صُبَيْحٍ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ الْعَبْسِيِّ  ، عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " فَحَثَّ النَّاسَ عَلَى الصَّدَقَةِ، فَأَبْطَئُوا حَتَّى بَانَ فِي وَجْهِهِ الْغَضَبُ "، ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ الْأَنْصَارِ جَاءَ بِصُرَّةٍ، فَتَتَابَعَ النَّاسُ حَتَّى رُئِيَ فِي وَجْهِهِ السُّرُورُ، فَقَالَ :" مَنْ سَنَّ سُنَّةً حَسَنَةً، كَانَ لَهُ أَجْرُهُ، وَمِثْلُ أَجْرِ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يُنْقَصَ مِنْ أُجُورِهِمْ شَيْءٌ، وَمَنْ سَنَّ سُنَّةً سَيِّئَةً، كَانَ عَلَيْهِ وِزْرُهُ، وَمِثْلُ وِزْرِ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يُنْقَصَ مِنْ أَوْزَارِهِمْ شَيْءٌ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Walid ibn Shuja', from Abu Mu'awiyah, from al-A'mash, from Muslim (Ibn Subayh), from Abd al-Rahman ibn Hilal al-Absi, from Jarir ibn Abdullah رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a sermon to us, and urged the people toward charity, but they were slow, until anger appeared on his face, then a man from the Ansar came with a bundle, and the people followed suit, until joy was seen on his face, so he said: Whoever establishes a good precedent, has its reward, and a reward like the reward of whoever acts by it, without anything being diminished from their rewards, and whoever establishes an evil precedent, has its burden, and a burden like the burden of whoever acts by it, without anything being diminished from their burdens.
24.hi: Al-Walid ibn Shuja' ne Abu Mu'awiyah se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya, Muslim se (yaani Ibn Subayh), Abd al-Rahman ibn Hilal al-Absi se, Jarir ibn Abdullah se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein khutba diya, aur logon ko sadqe ki taraf ubhaara, lekin woh dheeme rahe, yahan tak ke aapke chehre par gussa zaahir hone laga, fir Ansar mein se ek aadmi ek potli le kar aaya, to log iska pairvi karne lage, yahan tak ke aapke chehre par khushi dikhaayi di, to aapne farmaya: Jo koi achhi riwaayat qaayam kare, usay uska ajr milega, aur usi jaisa ajr jo koi isper amal kare, bina unke ajr mein kuch kami ke, aur jo koi buri riwaayat qaayam kare, usko uska gunah hoga, aur usi jaisa gunah jo koi isper amal kare, bina unke gunahon mein kuch kami ke.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي حَسَّانُ بْنُ عَطِيَّةَ  ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" أَنَا أَعْظَمُكُمْ أَجْرًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، لِأَنَّ لِي أَجْرِي وَمِثْلَ أَجْرِ مَنْ اتَّبَعَنِي "
24.en: Narrated by Abd al-Wahhab ibn Sa'id, from Shu'ayb (Ibn Ishaq), from al-Awza'i, from Hassan ibn Atiyyah: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: I am the greatest of you in reward on the Day of Resurrection, because I have my own reward, and a reward like that of whoever follows me.
24.hi: Abd al-Wahhab ibn Sa'id ne Shu'ayb se bataya (Ibn Ishaq): Humein al-Awza'i ne bataya: Mujhse Hassan ibn Atiyyah ne bataya: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Main Qayamat ke din tum sabse zyada ajr wala hoon, kyunki mera apna ajr hai, aur usi jaisa ajr jo koi meri pairvi kare uska hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ  ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ  ، عَنْ بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ دَعَا إِلَى أَمْرٍ وَلَوْ دَعَا رَجُلٌ رَجُلًا، كَانَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَوْقُوفًا بِهِ، لَازِمًا بِغَارِبِهِ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ : # وَقِفُوهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ مَسْئُولُونَ سورة الصافات آية 24 # "
24.en: Narrated by Malik ibn Isma'il, from Abd al-Salam, from Layth, from Bishr, from Anas رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Whoever calls to a matter, even if just one man calling another man, will be held accountable for it on the Day of Resurrection, tied to his neck, then he recited: 'Stop them, indeed they are to be questioned' [Surah al-Saffat, verse 24].
24.hi: Malik ibn Isma'il ne Abd al-Salam se bataya: Humein Layth ne bataya, Bishr se, Anas se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Jo koi kisi maamle ki taraf bulaaye, chahe ek aadmi doosre aadmi ko hi bulaaye, Qayamat ke din usse iska hisaab liya jaayega, uski gardan se bandha hua, fir aapne padha: 'Unhein roko, unse zaroor poocha jaayega' [Surah As-Saffat, aayat 24].

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" أَرْبَعٌ يُعْطَاهَا الرَّجُلُ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ : ثُلُثُ مَالِهِ إِذَا كَانَ فِيهِ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ لِلَّهِ مُطِيعًا، وَالْوَلَدُ الصَّالِحُ يَدْعُو لَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَوْتِهِ، وَالسُّنَّةُ الْحَسَنَةُ يَسُنُّهَا الرَّجُلُ فَيُعْمَلُ بِهَا بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ، وَالْمِائَةُ إِذَا شَفَعُوا لِلرَّجُلِ شُفِّعُوا فِيهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Asim, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Asim, from al-Sha'bi, from Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه: He said: Four things a man is given after his death: a third of his wealth, if he was obedient to Allah before that, and a righteous child who supplicates for him after his death, and a good precedent that the man established which is acted upon after his death, and the hundred [people], if they intercede for the man, their intercession is accepted regarding him.
24.hi: Amr ibn Asim ne Hammad ibn Salamah se bataya: Humein Asim ne bataya, al-Sha'bi se: ke Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه ne kaha: Chaar cheezein aadmi ko uski maut ke baad di jaati hain: uska tihai maal, agar woh isse pehle Allah ka itaa'atguzaar tha, aur ek neik aulaad jo uski maut ke baad uske liye dua kare, aur ek achhi riwaayat jo aadmi ne qaayam ki ho jispar uski maut ke baad amal kiya jaaye, aur sau [log] jab woh aadmi ke liye sifarish karein, unki sifarish uske liye qabool ki jaati hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَجَّاجِ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ ، قَالَ :" جَهَدْنَا بِإِبْرَاهِيمَ  حَتَّى أَنْ نُجْلِسَهُ إِلَى سَارِيَةٍ، فَأَبَى "
24.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn al-Hajjaj, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from al-A'mash: He said: We tried hard with Ibrahim, even to seat him against a pillar, but he refused.
24.hi: Ahmad ibn al-Hajjaj ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Humne Ibrahim ke saath bahut koshish ki, yahan tak ke unhein ek khambhe ke saath bithaane ki, lekin unhone inkaar kiya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  " أَنَّهُ كَانَيَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَسْتَنِدَ إِلَى السَّارِيَةِ "
24.en: Narrated by Affan, from Abu Awanah, from Mughirah, from Ibrahim: That he used to dislike leaning against a pillar.
24.hi: Affan ne Abu Awanah se bataya: Humein Mughirah ne bataya, Ibrahim se: ke woh khambhe se tekaan lagaana na-pasand karte the.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، قَالَ :" كَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ  لَا يَبْتَدِئُ الْحَدِيثَ حَتَّى يُسْأَلَ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Abu Awanah, from Mughirah: He said: Ibrahim did not initiate hadith until he was asked.
24.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Abu Awanah se bataya: Humein Mughirah ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Ibrahim khud se hadith shuru nahi karte the jab tak unse poocha na jaaye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ ، عَنْ خَيْثَمَةَ ، قَالَ : كَانَ الْحَارِثُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ الْجُعْفِيُّ  وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَكَانُوا مُعْجَبِينَ بِهِ، " فَكَانَيَجْلِسُ إِلَيْهِ الرَّجُلُ وَالرَّجُلَانِ فَيُحَدِّثُهُمَا، فَإِذَا كَثُرُوا، قَامَ وَتَرَكَهُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Sa'id, from Yunus ibn Bukayr, from al-A'mash, from Khaythamah: He said: Al-Harith ibn Qays al-Ju'fi was among the companions of Abdullah, and they were amazed by him, so a man or two men would sit with him and he would narrate hadith to them, but when they became many, he would get up and leave them.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Sa'id ne Yunus ibn Bukayr se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya, Khaythamah se: Unhone kaha, Al-Harith ibn Qays al-Ju'fi Abdullah ke sathiyon mein se the, aur woh unse mutasir the, to ek ya do aadmi unke paas baithte aur woh unhein hadith bataate, lekin jab woh zyada ho jaate, woh uthkar chale jaate aur unhein chhod dete.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ،  عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ ، قَالَ : قِيلَ لَهُ حِينَ مَاتَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ : لَوْ قَعَدْتَ فَعَلَّمْتَ النَّاسَ السُّنَّةَ؟، فَقَالَ :" أَتُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُوطَأَ عَقِبِي؟ "
24.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Yunus, from Abu Shihab, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah: He said: It was said to him, when Abdullah رضي الله عنه died: Had you sat and taught the people the sunnah? So he said: Do you want my footsteps to be trodden [i.e., to be treated like a leader/authority]?
24.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Yunus ne Abu Shihab se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya, Ibrahim se, Alqamah se: Unhone kaha, Jab Abdullah رضي الله عنه ka intiqaal hua, unse kaha gaya: Agar aap baithkar logon ko sunnat sikhaate? To unhone kaha: Kya tum chaahte ho ke mere qadmon ko roonda jaaye [yaani, mujhe peshwa ki tarah maanaa jaaye]?

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ هَارُونَ بْنَ عَنْتَرَةَ  ، عَنْ سُلَيْمِ بْنِ حَنْظَلَةَ  ، قَالَ : أَتَيْنَا أُبَيَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ لِنَتَحَدَّثَ إِلَيْهِ، فَلَمَّا قَامَ قُمْنَا، وَنَحْنُ نَمْشِي خَلْفَهُ، فَرَهَقَنَا عُمَرُ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، فَتَبِعَهُ فَضَرَبَهُ عُمَرُ بِالدِّرَّةِ، قَالَ : فَاتَّقَاهُ بِذِرَاعَيْهِ، فَقَالَ : يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، مَا نَصْنَعُ؟، قَالَ :" أَوَ مَا تَرَى؟ فِتْنَةً لِلْمَتْبُوعِ، مَذَلَّةً لِلتَّابِعِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Ala, from Ibn Idris: He said: I heard Harun ibn Antarah narrating, from Sulaym ibn Hanzalah: he said: We came to Ubayy ibn Ka'b to talk with him, so when he got up, we got up too, and we were walking behind him, so Umar رضي الله عنه caught up to us, and followed him, and Umar struck him with the whip, he said: So he shielded himself with his forearms, and said: O Commander of the Believers, what should we do? He said: Do you not see? It is a trial for the one being followed, and a humiliation for the follower.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Ala ne Ibn Idris se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Harun ibn Antarah ko riwaayat karte suna, Sulaym ibn Hanzalah se: Unhone kaha, Hum Ubayy ibn Ka'b ke paas unse baat karne aaye, to jab woh khade hue, hum bhi khade ho gaye, aur hum unke peechhe chal rahe the, to Umar رضي الله عنه humein mil gaye, aur unke peechhe chale, aur Umar ne unhein kode se maara, unhone kaha: To unhone apne baazuon se apne aap ko bachaaya, aur poocha: Ae Ameer-ul-Mumineen, hum kya karein?
