Unhone kaha: Kya tumhein nazar nahi aata? Yeh un logon ke liye fitna hai jinki pairvi ki jaati hai, aur pairvi karne wale ke liye zillat hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  قَالَ :" كَانُوا يَكْرَهُونَ أَنْ تُوطَأَ أَعْقَابُهُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Jarir, from Mansur, from Ibrahim: He said: They used to dislike having their footsteps trodden [i.e., being followed as if authorities].
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Jarir se bataya: Humein Mansur ne bataya, Ibrahim se: Unhone kaha, Woh apne qadmon ko roonde jaana na-pasand karte the [yaani, unke peechhe peshwa ki tarah chala jaana].

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ ، عَنْ بِسْطَامِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ ، قَالَ : كَانَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِيرِينَ  إِذَا مَشَى مَعَهُ الرَّجُلُ قَامَ، فَقَالَ :" أَلَكَ حَاجَةٌ؟ فَإِنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ حَاجَةٌ، قَضَاهَا، وَإِنْ عَادَ يَمْشِي مَعَهُ قَامَ، فَقَالَ : أَلَكَ حَاجَةٌ؟ "
24.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Bistam ibn Muslim: He said: Muhammad ibn Sirin, when a man walked with him, would stop, and say: Do you have a need? And if he had a need, he would fulfill it, and if he continued walking with him, he would stop again, and say: Do you have a need?
24.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Bistam ibn Muslim se bataya: Unhone kaha, Muhammad ibn Sirin, jab koi aadmi unke saath chalta, woh ruk jaate, aur poochte: Tumhein koi zaroorat hai? Aur agar usay koi zaroorat hoti, woh isay poora karte, aur agar woh phir bhi unke saath chalta rehta, woh phir rukte, aur poochte: Tumhein koi zaroorat hai?

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" إِيَّاكُمْ أَنْ تُوطَأَ أَعْقَابُكُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Hasan ibn Salih, from Abu Hamzah, from Ibrahim: He said: Beware of having your footsteps trodden.
24.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Hasan ibn Salih se bataya: Humein Abu Hamzah ne bataya, Ibrahim se: Unhone kaha, Apne qadmon ko roonde jaane se bacho.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ الْهَيْثَمِ ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ ضَمْرَةَ أَنَّهُ رَأَى أُنَاسًا يَتْبَعُونَ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْر ، قَالَ : فَأُرَاهُ قَالَ : نَهَاهُمْ، وَقَالَ :" إِنَّ صَنِيعَكُمْ هَذَا أَوْ مَشْيَكُمْ هَذَا مَذَلَّةٌ لِلتَّابِعِ، وَفِتْنَةٌ لِلْمَتْبُوعِ "
24.en: Narrated by Makhlad ibn Malik, from Hajjaj ibn Muhammad, from Shu'bah, from al-Haytham, from Asim ibn Damrah: That he saw people following Sa'id ibn Jubayr, he said: So I think he said: He forbade them, and said: This deed of yours, or this walking of yours, is a humiliation for the follower, and a trial for the one being followed.
24.hi: Makhlad ibn Malik ne Hajjaj ibn Muhammad se bataya: Humein Shu'bah ne bataya, al-Haytham se, Asim ibn Damrah se: ke unhone logon ko Sa'id ibn Jubayr ki pairvi karte dekha, unhone kaha: To mera khayal hai unhone kaha: Unhone unhein mana kiya, aur kaha: Tumhara yeh amal, ya tumhara yeh chalna, pairvi karne wale ke liye zillat hai, aur jinki pairvi ki jaati hai unke liye fitna hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْوَدَ ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ ، قَالَ :" شَاوَرْتُ مُحَمَّدًا  فِي بِنَاءٍ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَبْنِيَهُ فِي الْكَلَّاءِ، قَالَ : فَأَشَارَ عَلَيَّ، وَقَالَ : إِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَسَاسَ الْبِنَاءِ فَآذِنِّي حَتَّى أَجِيءَ مَعَكَ، قَالَ : فَأَتَيْتُهُ، قَالَ : فَبَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ نَمْشِي إِذْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَمَشَى مَعَهُ، فَقَامَ، فَقَالَ : أَلَكَ حَاجَةٌ؟، قَالَ : لَا، قَالَ : أَمَّا لَا، فَاذْهَبْ، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيَّ، فَقَالَ : أَنْتَ أَيْضًا فَاذْهَبْ، قَالَ : فَذَهَبْتُ حَتَّى خَالَفْتُ الطَّرِيقَ "
24.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Amir, from Humayd ibn Aswad, from Ibn Awn: He said: I consulted Muhammad about a building I wanted to build at al-Kalla, he said: So he advised me, and said: When you want [to start] the foundation of the building, inform me so I may come with you, he said: So I came to him, he said: So while we were walking, a man came and walked with him, so he stopped, and said: Do you have a need? He said, No, he said: If not, then go, then he turned to me, and said: You too, go, he said: So I went, until I took a different road.
24.hi: Sa'id ibn Amir ne Humayd ibn Aswad se bataya: Humein Ibn Awn ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Muhammad se ek imaarat ke baare mein mashwara kiya jo main al-Kalla mein banaana chaahta tha, unhone kaha: To unhone mujhe salaah di, aur kaha: Jab tum imaarat ki buniyaad [shuru karna] chaaho, mujhe bataana taake main tumhare saath aa sakun, unhone kaha: To main unke paas gaya, unhone kaha: To jabke hum chal rahe the, ek aadmi aaya aur unke saath chalne laga, to woh ruk gaye, aur poocha: Tumhein koi zaroorat hai? Usne kaha, Nahi, unhone kaha: Agar nahi, to jao, fir woh meri taraf mude, aur kaha: Tum bhi, jao, unhone kaha: To main gaya, yahan tak ke maine doosra raasta le liya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَجَّاجِ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ نُسَيْرٍ ، أَنَّ الرَّبِيعَ  كَانَ إِذَا أَتَوْهُ، يَقُولُ :" أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّكُمْ "، يَعْنِي : أَصْحَابَهُ
24.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn al-Hajjaj, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi, from Sufyan, from Nusayr: That al-Rabi', when they came to him, would say: I seek refuge in Allah from your evil, meaning: his companions.
24.hi: Ahmad ibn al-Hajjaj ne Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi se bataya: Humein Sufyan ne bataya, Nusayr se: ke Al-Rabi', jab woh unke paas aate, kehte: Main Allah ki panah maangta hoon tumhari burai se, yaani: apne sathiyon se.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ رَجَاءٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ بِشْرٍ  ، قَالَ : كُنَّا عِنْدَ خَبَّابِ بْنِ الْأَرَتِّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، فَاجْتَمَعَ إِلَيْهِ أَصْحَابُهُ وَهُوَ سَاكِتٌ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ : أَلَا تُحَدِّثُ أَصْحَابَكَ؟، قَالَ :" أَخَافُ أَنْ أَقُولَ لَهُمْ مَا لَا أَفْعَلُ "
24.en: Narrated by Makhlad ibn Malik, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, from al-A'mash, from Raja al-Ansari, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Bishr: He said: We were with Khabbab ibn al-Aratt رضي الله عنه, and his companions gathered around him while he was silent, so it was said to him: Will you not narrate hadith to your companions? So he said: I fear that I will tell them what I myself do not do.
24.hi: Makhlad ibn Malik ne Yahya ibn Sa'id se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya, Raja al-Ansari se, Abd al-Rahman ibn Bishr se: Unhone kaha, Hum Khabbab ibn al-Aratt رضي الله عنه ke paas the, aur unke sathi unke gird jama hue jabke woh khamosh the, to unse kaha gaya: Kya aap apne sathiyon ko hadith nahi bayaan karenge? To unhone kaha: Mujhe dar hai ke main unhein woh bataau jo main khud nahi karta.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ ، قَالَ :" وَدِدْتُ أَنِّي نَجَوْتُ مِنْ عَمَلِي كَفَافًا لَا لِي وَلَا عَلَيَّ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Salih: He said: I heard al-Sha'bi say: I wished I could be saved from my deeds with an even balance, neither for me nor against me.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein Salih ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Sha'bi ko kehte suna: Main chaahta hoon ke main apne amal se barabar bach jaaun, na mere haq mein na mere khilaaf.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ كَانَ يَمْشِي وَنَاسٌ يَطَئُونَ عَقِبَهُ، فَقَالَ :" لَا تَطَئُوا عَقِبِي، فَوَاللَّهِ لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ مَا أُغْلِقُ عَلَيْهِ بَابِي، مَا تَبِعَنِي رَجُلٌ مِنْكُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Ibn Awn, from al-Hasan: That Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه was walking, and people were treading on his heel, so he said: Do not tread on my heel, for by Allah, if you knew what I lock behind my door, none of you would follow me.
24.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Ibn Awn se bataya: Humein al-Hasan ne bataya: ke Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه chal rahe the, aur log unke qadmon par pair rakh rahe the, to unhone kaha: Mere qadmon par pair mat rakho, kyunki Allah ki qasam, agar tum jaante ke main apne darwaze ke peechhe kya band karta hoon, to tum mein se koi bhi mera pairvi na karta.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ ، قَالَ :" فِتْنَةٌ لِلْمَتْبُوعِ، مَذَلَّةٌ لِلتَّابِعِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Humayd, from Jarir, from Mughirah, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr: He said: A trial for the one being followed, a humiliation for the follower.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Humayd ne Jarir se bataya: Humein Mughirah ne bataya, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se: Unhone kaha, Jinki pairvi ki jaati hai unke liye fitna, pairvi karne wale ke liye zillat.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا شِهَابُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ  ، عَنْ أُمَيٍّ  ، قَالَ : مَشَوْا خَلْفَ عَلِيٍّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، فَقَالَ :" عَنِّي خَفْقَ نِعَالِكُمْ، فَإِنَّهَا مُفْسِدَةٌ لِقُلُوبِ نَوْكَى الرِّجَالِ "
24.en: Narrated by Shihab ibn Abbad, from Sufyan, from Umayy: He said: They walked behind Ali رضي الله عنه, so he said: [Keep] away from me the tapping of your sandals, for it corrupts the hearts of foolish men.
24.hi: Shihab ibn Abbad ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein Umayy ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Log Ali (Alayhis Salam) رضي الله عنه ke peechhe chale, to unhone kaha: Mujhse apni chappalon ki tap-tap [door karo], kyunki yeh bewaqoof aadmiyon ke dilon ko bigaad deti hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ حَازِمٍ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ ، يَقُولُ :" إِنَّ خَفْقَ النِّعَالِ حَوْلَ الرِّجَالِ قَلَّ مَا يُلَبِّثُ الْحَمْقَى "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Yazid ibn Hazim: He said: I heard al-Hasan say: The tapping of sandals around men rarely lasts among the foolish.
24.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Yazid ibn Hazim ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine al-Hasan ko kehte suna: Aadmiyon ke gird chappalon ki tap-tap bewaqoofon mein kam hi qaayam rehti hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ الْمُكْتِبُ ، حَدَّثَنَا قَاسِمُ هُوَ ابْنُ مَالِكٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ ، قَالَ :" كَانَ إِذَا جَلَسَ إِلَيْهِ الرَّجُلُ أَوْ الرَّجُلَانِ، قَامَ فَتَنَحَّى "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Hatim al-Muktib, from Qasim (Ibn Malik), from Layth, from Tawus: He said: When a man or two men sat with him, he would get up and move aside.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Hatim al-Muktib ne Qasim se bataya (Ibn Malik): Humein Layth ne bataya, Tawus se: Unhone kaha, Jab ek ya do aadmi unke paas baithte, woh uthkar alag ho jaate.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جُرَيْجٍ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي بَرْزَةَ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" لَا تَزُولُ قَدَمَا عَبْدٍ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حَتَّى يُسْأَلَ عَنْ عُمُرِهِ فِيمَا أَفْنَاهُ، وَعَنْ عِلْمِهِ مَا فَعَلَ بِهِ، وَعَنْ مَالِهِ مِنْ أَيْنَ اكْتَسَبَهُ وَفِيمَا أَنْفَقَهُ، وَعَنْ جِسْمِهِ فِيمَا أَبْلَاهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Aswad ibn Amir, from Abu Bakr, from al-A'mash, from Sa'id ibn Abdullah ibn Jurayj, from Abu Barzah al-Aslami: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: A servant's feet will not move on the Day of Resurrection until he is asked about his life, what he wore it out on, and about his knowledge, what he did with it, and about his wealth, from where he earned it and on what he spent it, and about his body, what he wore it out in.
24.hi: Aswad ibn Amir ne Abu Bakr se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya, Sa'id ibn Abdullah ibn Jurayj se, Abu Barzah al-Aslami se: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Banda ke qadam Qayamat ke din nahi hilenge jab tak usse uski zindagi ke baare mein na poocha jaaye ke usne isay kis mein khatam kiya, aur uske ilm ke baare mein ke usne ismein kya kiya, aur uske maal ke baare mein ke usne kahan se kamaaya aur kahan kharch kiya, aur uske jism ke baare mein ke usne isay kismein ghisaaya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ غَزِيَّةَ  ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ رَاشِدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي فُلَانٌ الْعُرَنِيُّ  ، عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" لَا يَدَعُ اللَّهُ الْعِبَادَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ حَتَّى يَسْأَلَهُمْ عَنْ أَرْبَعٍ : عَمَّا أَفْنَوْا فِيهِ أَعْمَارَهُمْ، وَعَمَّا أَبْلَوْا فِيهِ أَجْسَادَهُمْ، وَعَمَّا كَسَبُوا وفِيمَا أَنْفَقُوا، وَعَمَّا عَمِلُوا فِيمَا عَلِمُوا "
24.en: Narrated by Sa'id ibn Mansur, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Umarah ibn Ghaziyyah, from Yahya ibn Rashid; with an unnamed narrator from him, from Mu'adh ibn Jabal رضي الله عنه: He said: Allah will not leave the servants on the Day of Resurrection, the day the people will stand before the Lord of the worlds, until He asks them about four things: about what they spent their lives on, and about what they wore their bodies out in, and about what they earned and what they spent it on, and about what they did with what they knew.
24.hi: Sa'id ibn Mansur ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se bataya: Humein Umarah ibn Ghaziyyah ne bataya, Yahya ibn Rashid se: Mujhse al-Urani ke ek shakhs ne bataya, Mu'adh ibn Jabal se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Allah bandon ko Qayamat ke din, jis din log Rabb-ul-Aalameen ke saamne khade honge, tab tak nahi chhodega jab tak woh unse chaar cheezon ke baare mein na poochhe: unhone apni zindagi kismein guzaari, aur unhone apne jism kismein ghisaaya, aur unhone kya kamaaya aur kahan kharch kiya, aur unhone jo jaana usme kya kiya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ  ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الصُّنَابِحِيِّ  ، عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" لَا تَزُولُ قَدَمَا عَبْدٍ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حَتَّى يُسْأَلَ عَنْ أَرْبَعٍ : عَنْ عُمُرِهِ فِيمَا أَفْنَاهُ، وَعَنْ جَسَدِهِ فِيمَا أَبْلَاهُ، وَعَنْ مَالِهِ مِنْ أَيْنَ اكْتَسَبَهُ، وَفِيمَا وَضَعَهُ، وَعَنْ عِلْمِهِ مَاذَا عَمِلَ فِيهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Layth, from Adi ibn Adi, from Abu Abdullah al-Sunabihi, from Mu'adh ibn Jabal رضي الله عنه: He said: A servant's feet will not move on the Day of Resurrection until he is asked about four things: about his life, what he wore it out on, and about his body, what he wore it out in, and about his wealth, from where he earned it and on what he spent it, and about his knowledge, what he did with it.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein Layth ne bataya, Adi ibn Adi se, Abu Abdullah al-Sunabihi se, Mu'adh ibn Jabal se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Banda ke qadam Qayamat ke din nahi hilenge jab tak usse chaar cheezon ke baare mein na poocha jaaye: uski zindagi ke baare mein ke usne isay kismein khatam kiya, aur uske jism ke baare mein ke usne isay kismein ghisaaya, aur uske maal ke baare mein ke usne kahan se kamaaya aur kahan kharch kiya, aur uske ilm ke baare mein ke usne isse kya kiya.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ ، قَالَ : قَالَ لِي طَاوُسٌ  :" مَا تَعَلَّمْتَ، فَتَعَلَّمْ لِنَفْسِكَ، فَإِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ ذَهَبَتْ مِنْهُمْ الْأَمَانَةُ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from Layth: He said: Tawus said to me: Whatever you have learned, learn it for your own sake, for trustworthiness has indeed left the people.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein Layth ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Tawus ne mujhse kaha: Jo bhi tumne seekha hai, apne liye seekho, kyunki amaanat log mein se ja chuki hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ :" أَدْرَكْتُ النَّاسَ وَالنَّاسِكُ إِذَا نَسَكَ لَمْ يُعْرَفْ مِنْ قِبَلِ مَنْطِقِهِ، وَلَكِنْ يُعْرَفُ مِنْ قِبَلِ عَمَلِهِ، فَذَلِكَ الْعِلْمُ النَّافِعُ "
24.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Umarah ibn Mihran, from al-Hasan: He said: I found people such that when the devout one practiced devotion, he was not recognized by his talk, but rather was recognized by his deeds, and that is beneficial knowledge.
24.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Umarah ibn Mihran se bataya: Humein al-Hasan ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine aise log paaye ke jab ibaadat-guzaar ibaadat karta, woh apni baaton se nahi pehchaana jaata, balke apne amal se pehchaana jaata, aur yehi faidamand ilm hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، عَنْ حَسَّانَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي كَبْشَةَ  ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ :" بَلِّغُوا عَنِّي وَلَوْ آيَةً، وَحَدِّثُوا عَنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَلَا حَرَجَ، وَمَنْ كَذَبَ عَلَيَّ مُتَعَمِّدًا، فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنْ النَّارِ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from al-Awza'i, from Hassan, from Abu Kabshah: He said: I heard Abdullah ibn Amr رضي الله عنه say: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: Convey from me, even if just one verse, and narrate from Banu Isra'il, and there is no harm, and whoever lies about me deliberately, let him take his seat in the Fire.
24.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne al-Awza'i se bataya: Humein Hassan ne bataya, Abu Kabshah se: Unhone kaha, Maine Abdullah ibn Amr رضي الله عنه ko kehte suna: Maine Rasulullah ﷺ ko farmaate suna, Mujhse pahunchaao, chahe woh ek aayat hi ho, aur Banu Isra'il se riwaayat karo, isme koi harj nahi, aur jo mujhpar jaan-boojh kar jhoot bole, woh apni jagah Jahannam mein banaa le.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْعَوَّامُ بْنُ حَوْشَبٍ أَبُو عِيسَى الشَّيْبَانِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ عَوْفٍ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ " أَنْلَا يَغْلِبُونَا عَلَى ثَلَاثٍ : أَنْ نَأْمُرَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ، وَنَنْهَى عَنْ الْمُنْكَرِ، وَنُعَلِّمَ النَّاسَ السُّنَنَ "
24.en: Narrated by Ali ibn Hujr al-Sa'di, from Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Awwam ibn Hawshab Abu Isa al-Shaybani, from al-Qasim ibn Awf al-Shaybani, from Abu Dharr رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us not to be overpowered on three matters: that we command what is right, and forbid what is wrong, and teach people the sunnahs.
24.hi: Ali ibn Hujr al-Sa'di ne Yazid ibn Harun se bataya: Humein al-Awwam ibn Hawshab Abu Isa al-Shaybani ne bataya: Mujhe al-Qasim ibn Awf al-Shaybani ne bataya, Abu Dharr se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne humein hukum diya ke teen maamlon mein hum kabhi na dabein: ke hum achhaai ka hukum dein, aur burai se rokein, aur logon ko sunnaten sikhaayein.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ  ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ أَبُو أُمَامَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ إِذَا قَعَدْنَا إِلَيْهِ يَجِيئُنَا مِنْ الْحَدِيثِ بِأَمْرٍ عَظِيمٍ، وَيَقُولُ :" لَنَا اسْمَعُوا وَاعْقِلُوا، وَبَلِّغُوا عَنَّا مَا تَسْمَعُونَ "، قَالَ سُلَيْمٌ : " بِمَنْزِلَةِ الَّذِي يُشْهِدُ عَلَى مَا عَلِمَ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Mughirah, from Safwan, from Sulaym ibn Amir: He said: Abu Umamah رضي الله عنه, when we sat with him, would bring us great matters from hadith, and would say: Listen and understand from us, and convey what you hear from us. Sulaym said: In the position of one who bears witness about what he knows.
24.hi: Abu al-Mughirah ne Safwan se bataya: Mujhse Sulaym ibn Amir ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Abu Umamah رضي الله عنه, jab hum unke saath baithte, hadith se badi-badi baatein humare paas laate, aur kehte: Humse suno aur samjho, aur jo tum humse suno usay pahunchaao. Sulaym kehte hain: us shakhs ki tarah jo jaanta hai uski gawaahi deta hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَثِيرٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي  ، قَالَ : أَتَيْتُ أَبَا ذَرٍّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ عِنْدَ الْجَمْرَةِ الْوُسْطَى، وَقَدْ اجْتَمَعَ النَّاسُ عَلَيْهِ يَسْتَفْتُونَهُ، فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَوَقَفَ عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ : أَلَمْ تُنْهَ عَنْ الْفُتْيَا؟ فَرَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ إِلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ :" أَرَقِيبٌ أَنْتَ عَلَيَّ؟ لَوْ وَضَعْتُمْ الصَّمْصَامَةَ عَلَى هَذِهِ وَأَشَارَ إِلَى قَفَاهُ، ثُمَّ ظَنَنْتُ أَنِّي أُنْفِذُ كَلِمَةً سَمِعْتُهَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُجِيزُوا عَلَيَّ لَأَنْفَذْتُهَا "
24.en: Narrated by Abd al-Wahhab ibn Sa'id, from Shu'ayb (Ibn Ishaq), from al-Awza'i, from Abu Kathir, from his father: He said: I came to Abu Dharr رضي الله عنه while he was sitting at the middle Jamrah, and the people had gathered around him seeking his religious rulings, so a man came to him and stood before him, then said: Have you not been forbidden from giving rulings? So he raised his head to him, and said: Are you a watcher over me? If you placed the sharpest sword on this - and he gestured to the back of his neck - and I thought I could relay a word I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ before you carried out [the sentence] on me, I would relay it.
24.hi: Abd al-Wahhab ibn Sa'id ne Shu'ayb se bataya (Ibn Ishaq): Humein al-Awza'i ne bataya: Mujhe Abu Kathir ne bataya: Mujhse mere walid ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Main Abu Dharr رضي الله عنه ke paas aaya jabke woh beech ki Jamrah ke paas baithe hue the, aur log unke gird jama the unse fatwa maangte hue, to unke paas ek aadmi aaya aur unke saamne khada hua, fir kaha: Kya aapko fatwa dene se mana nahi kiya gaya? To unhone apna sar unki taraf uthaaya, aur kaha: Kya tum mujhpar nigraan ho? Agar tum is [gardan] par talwaar rakh do - aur unhone apni gardan ki taraf ishara kiya - aur mujhe lage ke main Rasulullah ﷺ se suni hui koi baat pahunchaa sakta hoon isse pehle ke tum mujhpar [saza] jaari karo, to main isay zaroor pahunchaata.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادٌ هُوَ ابْنُ الْعَوَّامِ  ، عَنْ عَوْفٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ  ، قَالَ : سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا عَنْ شَيْءٍ، فَقَالَ : يَا أَبَا الْعَالِيَةِ، أَتُرِيدُ أَنْ تَكُونَ مُفْتِيًا؟، فَقُلْتُ :" لَا، وَلَكِنْ لَا آمَنُ أَنْ تَذْهَبُوا وَنَبْقَى "، فَقَالَ : " صَدَقَ أَبُو الْعَالِيَةِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abbad (Ibn al-Awwam), from Awf, from Abu al-Aliyah: He said: I asked Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما about something, so he said: O Abu al-Aliyah, do you want to be a mufti [issuer of religious rulings]? So I said: No, but I am not confident that you will pass on and we will remain, so he said: Abu al-Aliyah has spoken the truth.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Abbad se bataya (Ibn al-Awwam): Humein Awf ne bataya, Abu al-Aliyah se: Unhone kaha, Maine Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما se ek cheez ke baare mein poocha, to unhone kaha: Ae Abu al-Aliyah, kya tum mufti banna chaahte ho? To maine kaha: Nahi, lekin mujhe yeh yaqeen nahi ke aap chale jaayenge aur hum reh jaayenge, to unhone kaha: Abu al-Aliyah ne sach kaha.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادٌ ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" كَانَ عَبِيدَةُ  يَأْتِي عَبْدَ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ كُلَّ خَمِيسٍ، فَيَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ غَابَ عَنْهَا، فَكَانَ عَامَّةُ مَا يُحْفَظُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ مِمَّا يَسْأَلُهُ عَبِيدَةُ عَنْهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abbad, from Husayn, from Ibrahim: He said: Abidah used to come to Abdullah رضي الله عنه every Thursday, and ask him about things he had missed, so most of what is preserved from Abdullah is from what Abidah asked him about.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Abbad se bataya: Humein Husayn ne bataya, Ibrahim se: Unhone kaha, Abidah har Jumaeraat ko Abdullah رضي الله عنه ke paas aate, aur unse un cheezon ke baare mein poochte jo unse chhoot gayin, to Abdullah se jo zyada tar yaad rakha gaya hai woh usi mein se hai jo Abidah ne unse poocha.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، حَدَّثَنَا غَسَّانُ هُوَ ابْنُ مُضَرَ ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ عِكْرِمَةَ ، يَقُولُ :" مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَسْأَلُونِي، أَفْلَسْتُمْ؟ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Ghassan (Ibn Mudar), from Sa'id ibn Yazid: He said: I heard Ikrimah say: What is wrong with you that you do not ask me? Have you gone bankrupt?
24.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Ghassan se bataya (Ibn Mudar): Humein Sa'id ibn Yazid ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Ikrimah ko kehte suna: Tumhein kya hua hai ke tum mujhse nahi poochte? Kya tum dewaaliya ho gaye ho?

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ الْمُكْتِبُ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَامِرُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، قَالَ :" الْعِلْمُ خَزَائِنُ، وَتَفْتَحُهَا الْمَسْأَلَةُ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Hatim al-Muktib, from Amir ibn Salih, from Yunus, from Ibn Shihab: He said: Knowledge is treasures, and asking questions is their key.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Hatim al-Muktib ne Amir ibn Salih se bataya: Humein Yunus ne bataya, Ibn Shihab se: Unhone kaha, Ilm khazaane hain, aur sawaal karna unki chaabi hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ   :" مَنْ رَقَّ وَجْهُهُ، رَقَّ عِلْمُهُ "، أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ  ، قَالَ : " مَنْ رَقَّ وَجْهُهُ، رَقَّ عِلْمُهُ "، وَعَنْ ضَمْرَةَ  ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عُمَرَ L2436 ، قَالَ : قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ   : " مَنْ رَقَّ وَجْهُهُ، رَقَّ عِلْمُهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Ibrahim ibn Ishaq, from Jarir; similar reports also via Waki', from his father, from al-Sha'bi, and via Damrah, from Hafs ibn Umar: He said: Ibrahim said: Whoever's face is thin [i.e., timid about asking], his knowledge is thin. [Narrated by Waki', from his father, from al-Sha'bi: he said: Whoever's face is thin, his knowledge is thin. And from Damrah, from Hafs ibn Umar: he said: Umar ibn al-Khattab said: Whoever's face is thin, his knowledge is thin.]
24.hi: Ibrahim ibn Ishaq ne Jarir se bataya: Unhone kaha, Ibrahim ne kaha: Jiska chehra patla hai [yaani, poochne mein sharmeela], uska ilm patla hai. [Waki' ne apne walid se bataya, al-Sha'bi se: Unhone kaha: Jiska chehra patla hai, uska ilm patla hai. Aur Damrah se, Hafs ibn Umar se: Unhone kaha: Umar ibn al-Khattab ne kaha: Jiska chehra patla hai, uska ilm patla hai.]

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ إِسْحَاق ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ ، قَالَ :" لَا يَتَعَلَّمُ مَنْ اسْتَحْيَا وَاسْتَكْبَرَ "
24.en: Narrated by Ibrahim ibn Ishaq, from Jarir, from a man, from Mujahid: He said: Whoever is shy or arrogant, does not learn.
24.hi: Ibrahim ibn Ishaq ne Jarir se bataya: Humein ek aadmi ne bataya, Mujahid se: Unhone kaha, Jo sharmaaye ya takabbur kare, woh nahi seekhta.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَجْمَعُ بَنِيهِ، فَيَقُولُ : " يَا بَنِيَّ ،تَعَلَّمُوا، فَإِنْ تَكُونُوا صِغَارَ قَوْمٍ، فَعَسَى أَنْ تَكُونُوا كِبَارَ آخَرِينَ، وَمَا أَقْبَحَ عَلَى شَيْخٍ يُسْأَلُ لَيْسَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمٌ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf, from Anas ibn Iyad, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father: That he used to gather his sons, and say: O my sons, learn, for if you are the young ones of a people, perhaps you will become the elders of others, and how ugly it is for an elder to be asked and have no knowledge with him.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf ne Anas ibn Iyad se bataya: Humein Hisham ibn Urwah ne bataya, apne walid se: ke woh apne beton ko jama karte, aur kehte: Ae mere beto, seekho, kyunki agar tum kisi qaum ke chhote log ho, to shaayad tum doosron ke bade ban jaao, aur ek buzurg ke liye kitna bura hai ke usse poocha jaaye aur uske paas koi ilm na ho.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ  ، عَنْ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ الْخِرِّيتِ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، قَالَ : كَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ" يَضَعُ فِي رِجْلَيَّ الْكَبْلَ، وَيُعَلِّمُنِي الْقُرْآنَ وَالسُّنَنَ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu al-Nu'man, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from al-Zubayr ibn al-Khirrit, from Ikrimah: He said: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه used to put shackles on my legs, and teach me the Qur'an and the sunnahs.
24.hi: Abu al-Nu'man ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein al-Zubayr ibn al-Khirrit ne bataya, Ikrimah se: Unhone kaha, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه mere paaon mein bediyaan daalte, aur mujhe Quran aur sunnaten sikhaate.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ الضُّرَيْسِ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ ، يَقُولُ :" مَنْ تَرَأَّسَ سَرِيعًا، أَضَرَّ بِكَثِيرٍ مِنْ الْعِلْمِ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَتَرَأَّسْ، طَلَبَ وَطَلَبَ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Humayd, from Yahya ibn al-Durays: He said: I heard Sufyan say: Whoever becomes a leader quickly, damages much knowledge, and whoever does not become a leader, keeps seeking and seeking until he attains [true knowledge].
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Humayd ne Yahya ibn al-Durays se bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Sufyan ko kehte suna: Jo jaldi peshwa ban jaata hai, woh bahut saare ilm ko nuqsaan pahunchaata hai, aur jo peshwa nahi banta, woh talaash karta rehta hai jab tak woh [sahi ilm ko] paa nahi leta.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ خَبَّابٍ  ، عَنْ حُصَيْنِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ  ، عَنْ سَلْمَانَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" عِلْمٌ لَا يُقَالُ بِهِ، كَكَنْزٍ لَا يُنْفَقُ مِنْهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from al-A'mash, from Salih ibn Khabbab, from Husayn ibn Uqbah, from Salman رضي الله عنه: He said: Knowledge that is not spoken is like a treasure that is not spent from.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya, Salih ibn Khabbab se, Husayn ibn Uqbah se, Salman se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Ilm jo bola na jaaye, woh us khazaane jaisa hai jismein se kharch na kiya jaaye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عِيَاضٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَثَلُ عِلْمٍ لَا يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ، كَمَثَلِ كَنْزٍ لَا يُنْفَقُ مِنْهُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah, from Abu Shihab, from Ibrahim, from Abu Iyad, from Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه: He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: The example of knowledge that is not benefited from, is like the example of a treasure that is not spent from in the path of Allah.
24.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ne Abu Shihab se bataya: Mujhse Ibrahim ne bataya, Abu Iyad se, Abu Hurairah se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Us ilm ki misaal jisse faida na uthaaya jaaye, us khazaane jaisi hai jismein se Allah ki raah mein kharch na kiya jaaye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاق  ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ يَسَارٍ  عَمِّهِ، قَالَ : بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ سَلْمَانَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، كَتَبَ إِلَى أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ :" إِنَّ الْعِلْمَ كَالْيَنَابِيعِ يَغْشَاهُنَّ النَّاسُ، فَيَخْتَلِجُهُ هَذَا وَهَذَا، فَيَنْفَعُ اللَّهُ بِهِ غَيْرَ وَاحِدٍ، وَإِنَّ حِكْمَةً لَا يُتَكَلَّمُ بِهَا كَجَسَدٍ لَا رُوحَ فِيهِ، وَإِنَّ عِلْمًا لَا يُخْرَجُ كَكَنْزٍ لَا يُنْفَقُ مِنْهُ، وَإِنَّمَا مَثَلُ الْعَالِمِ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ حَمَلَ سِرَاجًا فِي طَرِيقٍ مُظْلِمٍ يَسْتَضِيءُ بِهِ مَنْ مَرَّ بِهِ، وَكُلٌّ يَدْعُو لَهُ بِالْخَيْرِ "
24.en: Narrated by Ya'la, from Muhammad (Ibn Ishaq), from Musa ibn Yasar, his uncle: He said: It reached me that Salman رضي الله عنه wrote to Abu al-Darda رضي الله عنه: Knowledge is like springs, people cover them, so this one and that one draw water from them, and Allah benefits many through it, and indeed wisdom that is not spoken is like a body with no spirit in it, and indeed knowledge that is not brought out is like a treasure not spent from, and the example of the scholar is only like a man who carries a lamp on a dark road, by which whoever passes by is illuminated, and everyone prays good for him.
24.hi: Ya'la ne Muhammad se bataya (Ibn Ishaq): Humein Musa ibn Yasar ne bataya, jo unke chacha the: Unhone kaha, Mujhe khabar mili ke Salman رضي الله عنه ne Abu al-Darda رضي الله عنه ko likha: Ilm chashmon jaisa hai jinhein log dhaanpte hain, to yeh aur woh unse paani nikaalte hain, aur Allah isse kai logon ko faida deta hai, aur hikmat jo bayaan na ki jaaye, woh ek jism jaisa hai jismein rooh na ho, aur ilm jo baahar na laaya jaaye, woh us khazaane jaisa hai jismein se kharch na kiya jaaye, aur aalim ki misaal sirf us aadmi jaisi hai jo andhere raaste par ek chiraag lekar chalta hai, jisse guzarne wala roshan hota hai, aur har koi uske liye bhalaai ki dua karta hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ أَبِي الْأَسْوَدِ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق الشَّيْبَانِيِّ ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، قَالَ :" يَتْبَعُ الرَّجُلَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ ثَلَاثُ خِلَالٍ : صَدَقَةٌ تَجْرِي بَعْدَهُ، وَصَلَاةُ وَلَدِهِ عَلَيْهِ، وَعِلْمٌ أَفْشَاهُ يُعْمَلُ بِهِ بَعْدَهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn al-Salt, from Mansur ibn Abi al-Aswad, from Abu Ishaq al-Shaybani, from Hammad, from Ibrahim: He said: Three things follow a man after his death: charity that continues after him, and the prayer of his child for him, and knowledge he spread that is acted upon after him.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn al-Salt ne Mansur ibn Abi al-Aswad se bataya: Humein Abu Ishaq al-Shaybani ne bataya, Hammad se, Ibrahim se: Unhone kaha, Aadmi ki maut ke baad teen cheezein uska saath dete rehti hain: sadqa jo uske baad jaari rahe, aur uski aulaad ki uske liye dua, aur ilm jo usne phailaaya jispar uske baad amal kiya jaaye.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، حَدَّثَنِي إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الْمَدَنِيُّ  ، عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" إِذَا مَاتَ الْإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلَّا مِنْ ثَلَاثٍ : عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ، أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ تَجْرِي لَهُ، أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Musa ibn Isma'il, from Isma'il ibn Ja'far al-Madani, from al-Ala ibn Abd al-Rahman, from his father, from Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: When a person dies, his deeds are cut off from him except for three: knowledge that is benefited from, or ongoing charity for him, or a righteous child who supplicates for him.
24.hi: Musa ibn Isma'il ne Isma'il ibn Ja'far al-Madani se bataya: Mujhe al-Ala ibn Abd al-Rahman ne bataya, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se رضي الله عنه, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, Jab insaan mar jaata hai, uska amal usse kat jaata hai siwaay teen ke: aisa ilm jisse faida uthaaya jaaye, ya jaari sadqa jo uske liye ho, ya neik aulaad jo uske liye dua kare.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ يَعِيشَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ  ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ رُسْتُمَ الْمُزَنِيِّ  ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ حِينَ قَدِمَ الْبَصْرَةَ :" بَعَثَنِي إِلَيْكُمْ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ أُعَلِّمُكُمْ كِتَابَ رَبِّكُمْ، وَسُنَّتَكُمْ، وَأُنَظِّفُ طُرُقَكُمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Ubayd ibn Ya'ish, from Yunus, from Salih ibn Rustum al-Muzani, from al-Hasan, from Abu Musa رضي الله عنه: That he said, when he arrived in Basra: Umar ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه sent me to you to teach you the Book of your Lord, and your sunnah, and to clean your roads.
24.hi: Ubayd ibn Ya'ish ne Yunus se bataya: Humein Salih ibn Rustum al-Muzani ne bataya, al-Hasan se, Abu Musa se رضي الله عنه: ke unhone kaha, jab woh Basra pahunche: Umar ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه ne mujhe tumhare paas bheja hai taake main tumhein tumhare Rab ki Kitaab, aur tumhari sunnat sikhaaun, aur tumhare raaste saaf karun.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُعَلَّى  ، حَدَّثَنَا زِيَادُ بْنُ خَيْثَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي دَاوُدَ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَخْبَرَةَ  ، عَنْ سَخْبَرَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ :" مَنْ طَلَبَ الْعِلْمَ، كَانَ كَفَّارَةً لِمَا مَضَى "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Humayd, from Muhammad ibn al-Mu'alla, from Ziyad ibn Khaythamah, from Abu Da'ud, from Abdullah ibn Sakhbarah, from Sakhbarah رضي الله عنه, from the Prophet ﷺ: He said: Whoever seeks knowledge, it becomes an atonement for what has passed.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Humayd ne Muhammad ibn al-Mu'alla se bataya: Humein Ziyad ibn Khaythamah ne bataya, Abu Da'ud se, Abdullah ibn Sakhbarah se, Sakhbarah se رضي الله عنه, Nabi ﷺ se: Aapne farmaya, Jo ilm talaash kare, yeh guzre hue ke liye kaffara ban jaata hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ ، قَالَ :" لَقَدْ أَقَمْتُ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ ثَلَاثًا مَا لِي حَاجَةٌ إِلَّا وَقَدْ فَرَغْتُ مِنْهَا، إِلَّا أَنَّ رَجُلًا كَانُوا يَتَوَقَّعُونَهُ، كَانَ يَرْوِي حَدِيثًا، فَأَقَمْتُ حَتَّى قَدِمَ فَسَأَلْتُهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Isa, from Hammad ibn Zayd, from Ayyub, from Abu Qilabah: He said: I stayed in Madinah for three days, and I had no need left unfulfilled, except that there was a man they were expecting, who used to narrate a hadith, so I stayed until he arrived, and I asked him.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Isa ne Hammad ibn Zayd se bataya: Humein Ayyub ne bataya, Abu Qilabah se: Unhone kaha, Main Madinah mein teen din raha, aur meri koi zaroorat baaqi na thi jo poori na hui ho, siwaay iske ke ek aadmi tha jiska log intezaar kar rahe the, jo ek hadith riwaayat karta tha, to main rukaa yahan tak ke woh aaye aur maine unse poocha.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بنْ مُسِلمٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنَ بِنْ يزيدٍ بْنِ جَابِرٍ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ بُسْرَ بْنَ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ، يَقُولُ :" إِنْ كُنْتُ لَأَرْكَبُ إِلَى مِصْرٍ مِنْ الْأَمْصَارِ فِي الْحَدِيثِ الْوَاحِدِ لِأَسْمَعَهُ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from al-Walid ibn Muslim, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid ibn Jabir: He said: I heard Busr ibn Ubaydullah say: I would indeed travel to one of the cities for a single hadith, just to hear it.
24.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne al-Walid ibn Muslim se bataya: Humein Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid ibn Jabir ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Busr ibn Ubaydullah ko kehte suna: Main zaroor kisi shehar tak jaata tha ek hi hadith ke liye, isse sunne ke liye.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو قَطَنٍ عَمْرُو بْنُ الْهَيْثَمِ ، عَنْ أَبِي خَلْدَةَ ،  عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ ، قَالَ :" كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ الرِّوَايَةَ بِالْبَصْرَةِ عَنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَلَمْ نَرْضَ حَتَّى رَكِبْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ ، فَسَمِعْنَاهَا مِنْ أَفْوَاهِهِمْ "
24.en: Narrated by Amr ibn Zurarah, from Abu Qatan Amr ibn al-Haytham, from Abu Khaldah, from Abu al-Aliyah: He said: We used to hear narrations in Basra from the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, but we were not satisfied until we traveled to Madinah, and heard them from their own mouths.
24.hi: Amr ibn Zurarah ne Abu Qatan Amr ibn al-Haytham se bataya: Humein Abu Khaldah ne bataya, Abu al-Aliyah se: Unhone kaha, Hum Basra mein Rasulullah ﷺ ke sahaba se riwaayaten sunte the, lekin hum razi nahi hue jab tak hum Madinah nahi gaye, aur unhein unke apne munh se suna.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ القُشَيْرِيّ ، قَالَ : قَالَ دَاوُدُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" قُلْ لِصَاحِبِ الْعِلْمِ يَتَّخِذْ عَصًا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ، وَنَعْلَيْنِ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ، وَيَطْلُبْ الْعِلْمَ، حَتَّى تَنْكَسِرَ الْعَصَا وَتَنْخَرِقَ النَّعْلَانِ "
24.en: Narrated by Nu'aym ibn Hammad, from Baqiyyah, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Qushayri: He said: Dawud the Prophet ﷺ said: Tell the seeker of knowledge to take an iron staff, and two iron sandals, and seek knowledge, until the staff breaks and the two sandals wear out.
24.hi: Nu'aym ibn Hammad ne Baqiyyah se bataya: Humein Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Qushayri ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Dawud Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: Ilm talaash karne wale se kaho ke woh lohe ki chhadi, aur lohe ki do chappalein le, aur ilm talaash kare, yahan tak ke chhadi toot jaaye aur donon chappalein phat jaayein.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْأُمَوِيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ  ، عَنْ حُصَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  مِنْ آلِ سَعْدِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ، قَالَ : قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا :" طَلَبْتُ الْعِلْمَ فَلَمْ أَجِدْهُ أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُ فِي الْأَنْصَارِ، فَكُنْتُ آتِي الرَّجُلَ فَأَسْأَلُ عَنْهُ، فَيُقَالُ لِي : نَائِمٌ فَأَتَوَسَّدُ رِدَائِي، ثُمَّ أَضْطَجِعُ حَتَّى يَخْرُجَ إِلَى الظُّهْرِ، فَيَقُولُ : مَتَى كُنْتَ هَا هُنَا يَا ابْنَ عَمِّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ؟، فَأَقُولُ : مُنْذُ زَمَنٍ طَوِيلٍ، فَيَقُولُ : بِئْسَ مَا صَنَعْتَ، هَلَّا أَعْلَمْتَنِي؟، فَأَقُولُ : أَرَدْتُ أَنْ تَخْرُجَ إِلَيَّ وَقَدْ قَضَيْتَ حَاجَتَكَ "
24.en: Narrated by Makhlad ibn Malik, from Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Umawi, from al-Hajjaj, from Husayn ibn Abd al-Rahman, of the family of Sa'd ibn Mu'adh: He said: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما said: I sought knowledge, and did not find more of it than among the Ansar, so I would come to a man and ask about him, and it would be said to me: He is sleeping, so I would put my cloak under my head as a pillow, then lie down until he came out for Zuhr, so he would say: How long have you been here, O cousin of the Messenger of Allah? So I would say: For a long while, so he would say: What a bad thing you have done, why did you not let me know? So I would say: I wanted you to come out to me having already finished your need [i.e., your rest].
24.hi: Makhlad ibn Malik ne Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Umawi se bataya: Humein al-Hajjaj ne bataya, Husayn ibn Abd al-Rahman se, jo Sa'd ibn Mu'adh ke khaandaan se the: Unhone kaha, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنهما ne kaha: Maine ilm talaash kiya, aur mujhe isme Ansar se zyada kahin na mila, to main kisi aadmi ke paas jaata aur unke baare mein poochta, to mujhse kaha jaata: Woh so rahe hain, to main apni chaadar apne sar ke neeche takiye ki tarah rakh leta, fir lait jaata yahan tak ke woh Zuhr ke liye nikalte, to woh kehte: Ae Rasulullah ke chacha zaad, tum kabse yahan ho? To main kehta: Bahut der se, to woh kehte: Tumne bura kiya, tumne mujhe kyun nahi bataaya? To main kehta: Main chahta tha ke aap mere paas nikalein jabke aap apni zaroorat [yaani, aaraam] poori kar chuke hon.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ  ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" وُجِدَ أَكْثَرُ حَدِيثِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عِنْدَ هَذَا الْحَيِّ مِنْ الْأَنْصَارِ، وَاللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُ لَآتِي الرَّجُلَ مِنْهُمْ، فَيُقَالُ : هُوَ نَائِمٌ، فَلَوْ شِئْتُ أَنْ يُوقَظَ لِي، فَأَدَعُهُ حَتَّى يَخْرُجَ لِأَسْتَطِيبَ بِذَلِكَ حَدِيثَهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Yunus, from Abu Bakr, from Muhammad ibn Amr, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه: He said: The most hadith of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was found among this clan of the Ansar, by Allah, I would indeed come to a man among them, and it would be said: He is sleeping, so had I wished to have him woken for me [I could have], but I would leave him until he came out, so that I could enjoy his hadith all the more by doing so.
24.hi: Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Yunus ne Abu Bakr se bataya: Humein Muhammad ibn Amr ne bataya, Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman se, Ibn Abbas se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Rasulullah ﷺ ki sabse zyada hadith is Ansar ke qabeele mein mili, Allah ki qasam, main zaroor unmein se kisi aadmi ke paas jaata, aur kaha jaata: Woh so rahe hain, to agar main chaahta ke unhein mere liye jagaaya jaaye [to woh kar sakte the], lekin main unhein chhod deta yahan tak ke woh khud nikalte, taake main isi tarah unki hadith ka aur zyada mazaa le sakun.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ ،  عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ ، قَالَ :" لَوْ رَفَقْتُ بِابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، لَأَصَبْتُ مِنْهُ عِلْمًا كَثِيرًا "
24.en: Narrated by Abu Ma'mar Isma'il ibn Ibrahim, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salamah: He said: Had I been gentle with Ibn Abbas, I would have obtained much knowledge from him.
24.hi: Abu Ma'mar Isma'il ibn Ibrahim ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se bataya: Humein al-Zuhri ne bataya, Abu Salamah se: Unhone kaha, Agar main Ibn Abbas ke saath narmi se pesh aata, to main unse bahut zyada ilm haasil karta.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ ، عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ ، قَالَ :" كُنْتُ آتِي بَابَ عُرْوَةَ، فَأَجْلِسُ بِالْبَابِ، وَلَوْ شِئْتُ أَنْ أَدْخُلَ لَدَخَلْتُ، وَلَكِنْ إِجْلَالًا لَهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Bishr ibn al-Hakam, from Abd al-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri: He said: I used to come to Urwah's door, and sit at the door, and had I wished to enter, I could have entered, but out of respect for him [I did not].
24.hi: Bishr ibn al-Hakam ne Abd al-Razzaq se bataya: Humein Ma'mar ne bataya, al-Zuhri se: Unhone kaha, Main Urwah ke darwaze par aata, aur darwaze par baith jaata, aur agar main dakhil hona chaahta to dakhil ho sakta tha, lekin unki izzat ki wajah se [nahi hota].

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ  ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ حَكِيمٍ  ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" لَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، قُلْتُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ الْأَنْصَارِ : يَا فُلَانُ، هَلُمَّ فَلْنَسْأَلْ أَصْحَابَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَإِنَّهُمْ الْيَوْمَ كَثِيرٌ، فَقَالَ : وَا عَجَبًا لَكَ يَا ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، أَتَرَى النَّاسَ يَحْتَاجُونَ إِلَيْكَ وَفِي النَّاسِ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَنْ تَرَى؟ فَتَرَكَ ذَلِكَ، وَأَقْبَلْتُ عَلَى الْمَسْأَلَةِ، فَإِنْ كَانَ لَيَبْلُغُنِي الْحَدِيثُ عَنْ الرَّجُلِ فَآتِيهِ، وَهُوَ قَائِلٌ، فَأَتَوَسَّدُ رِدَائِي عَلَى بَابِهِ، فَتَسْفِي الرِّيحُ عَلَى وَجْهِي التُّرَابَ، فَيَخْرُجُ، فَيَرَانِي، فَيَقُولُ : يَا ابْنَ عَمِّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، مَا جَاءَ بِكَ؟ أَلَا أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيَّ فَآتِيَكَ؟، فَأَقُولُ : لَا، أَنَا أَحَقُّ أَنْ آتِيَكَ، فَأَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ الْحَدِيثِ، قَالَ : فَبَقِيَ الرَّجُلُ حَتَّى رَآنِي وَقَدْ اجْتَمَعَ النَّاسُ عَلَيَّ، فَقَالَ : كَانَ هَذَا الْفَتَى أَعْقَلَ مِنِّي "
24.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from Jarir ibn Hazim, from Ya'la ibn Hakim, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه: He said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away, I said to a man from the Ansar: O so-and-so, come, let us ask the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ, for they are many today, so he said: How strange of you, O Ibn Abbas, do you think people need you when among the people are Companions of the Prophet ﷺ whom you can see? So he left it, and I turned to asking, so if a hadith reached me from a man, I would go to him, while he was taking his midday nap, so I would put my cloak under my head as a pillow at his door, and the wind would blow dust onto my face, then he would come out, and see me, and say: O cousin of the Messenger of Allah, what brought you here? Why did you not send for me so I could come to you? So I would say: No, I am more entitled to come to you, and I would ask him about the hadith, he said: So the man remained until he saw me with people gathered around me, so he said: This young man was more sensible than I was.
24.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne Jarir ibn Hazim se bataya: Humein Ya'la ibn Hakim ne bataya, Ikrimah se, Ibn Abbas se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Jab Rasulullah ﷺ ka wisaal hua, maine Ansar mein se ek aadmi se kaha: Ae fulaan, aao, hum Nabi ﷺ ke sahaba se poochein, kyunki woh aaj bahut hain, to unhone kaha: Kitni ajeeb baat hai, Ae Ibn Abbas, kya tum samajhte ho ke logon ko tumhari zaroorat hai jabke log mein Nabi ﷺ ke sahaba maujood hain jo tum dekh sakte ho? To unhone isse chhod diya, aur main sawaal poochne mein lag gaya, so agar mujhe kisi aadmi se hadith ki khabar milti, main unke paas jaata, jabke woh dophar mein aaraam kar rahe hote, to main unke darwaze par apni chaadar apne sar ke neeche takiye ki tarah rakh leta, aur hawa mere chehre par dhool udaati, fir woh nikalte, aur mujhe dekhte, aur kehte: Ae Rasulullah ke chacha zaad, tumhein kya laaya? Tumne mujhe bulwaaya kyun nahi ke main tumhare paas aa jaata? To main kehta: Nahi, main aapke paas aane ka zyada haqdaar hoon, aur main unse hadith ke baare mein poochta, unhone bataya: To woh aadmi zinda rahe yahan tak ke unhone mujhe dekha jabke log mere gird jama the, to unhone kaha: Yeh jawaan mujhse zyada aqal-mand tha.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْجُرَيْرِيُّ  ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ  ، " أَنَّرَجُلًا مَنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَحَلَ إِلَى فَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، وَهُوَ بِمِصْرَ ، فَقَدِمَ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يَمُدُّ لِنَاقَةٍ لَهُ، فَقَالَ : مَرْحَبًا، قَالَ : أَمَا إِنِّي لَمْ آتِكَ زَائِرًا، وَلَكِنْ سَمِعْتُ أَنَا وَأَنْتَ حَدِيثًا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، رَجَوْتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ عِنْدَكَ مِنْهُ عِلْمٌ، قَالَ : كَذَا وَكَذَا "
24.en: Narrated by Yazid ibn Harun, from al-Jurayri, from Abdullah ibn Buraydah: That a man among the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ traveled to Fadalah ibn Ubayd رضي الله عنه, while he was in Egypt, so he arrived while he was stretching out a rope for a she-camel of his, so he said: Welcome, he said: Well, I have not come to you as a visitor, but you and I heard a hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I hoped you might have some knowledge of it, he said: Such-and-such.
24.hi: Yazid ibn Harun ne al-Jurayri se bataya: Humein Abdullah ibn Buraydah ne bataya: ke Nabi ﷺ ke sahaba mein se ek aadmi Fadalah ibn Ubayd رضي الله عنه ke paas safar karke gaya, jabke woh Misr mein the, to woh unke paas pahunche jabke woh apni oontni ke liye rassi tan rahe the, to unhone kaha: Marhaba, unhone kaha: Achha, main aapke paas mehmaan banke nahi aaya, lekin maine aur aapne Rasulullah ﷺ se ek hadith suni thi, mujhe ummeed thi ke aapke paas isme kuch ilm hoga, unhone kaha: Fulaan-fulaan.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْأَعْلَى ،  عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ، أَنَّهُ دَخَلَ السُّوقَ فَسَاوَمَ رَجُلًا بِثَوْبٍ، فَقَالَ :" هُوَ لَكَ بِكَذَا وَكَذَا، وَاللَّهِ لَوْ كَانَ غَيْرَكَ مَا أَعْطَيْتُهُ، فَقَالَ : فَعَلْتُمُوهَا، فَمَا رُئِيَ بَعْدَهَا مُشْتَرِيًا مِنْ السُّوقِ، وَلَا بَائِعًا حَتَّى لَحِقَ بِاللَّهِ G "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Abd al-Salam ibn Harb, from Abd al-A'la, from al-Hasan: That he entered the market and bargained with a man over a garment, so he said: It is yours for such-and-such, by Allah, had you been anyone else, I would not have given it to you, so he said: You have done it! And after that he was never seen buying or selling in the market again until he met Allah, exalted is He.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Sa'id ne Abd al-Salam ibn Harb se bataya: Humein Abd al-A'la ne bataya, al-Hasan se: ke woh bazaar mein dakhil hue aur ek aadmi se ek kapde par bhaav-taav kiya, to unhone kaha: Yeh tumhare liye itna-itna hai, Allah ki qasam, agar tum koi aur hote to main isse tumhein na deta, to unhone kaha: Aapne yeh kar diya! Aur iske baad woh kabhi bazaar mein khareedte ya bechte nahi dekhe gaye yahan tak ke unki Allah Ta'ala se mulaqaat hui.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْهَيْثَمُ بْنُ جَمِيلٍ ، عَنْ حُسَامٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ" لَا يَشْتَرِي مِمَّنْ يَعْرِفُهُ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Haytham ibn Jamil, from Husam, from Abu Ma'shar, from Ibrahim: That he would not buy from someone he knew.
24.hi: Al-Haytham ibn Jamil ne Husam se bataya: Humein Abu Ma'shar ne bataya, Ibrahim se: ke woh us shakhs se nahi khareedte jise woh jaante the.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ الْمُزَنِيِّ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ ، قَالَ : قَسَمَ مُصْعَبُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ مَالًا فِي قُرَّاءِ أَهْلِ الْكُوفَةِ حِينَ دَخَلَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ، فَبَعَثَ إِلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مَعْقِلٍ  بِأَلْفَيْ دِرْهَمٍ، فَقَالَ لَهُ : اسْتَعِنْ بِهَا فِي شَهْرِكَ هَذَا، فَرَدَّهَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَعْقِلٍ وَقَالَ :" لَمْ نَقْرَأْ الْقُرْآنَ لِهَذَا "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Sa'id, from Abd al-Salam, from Abdullah ibn al-Walid al-Muzani, from Ubayd ibn al-Hasan: He said: Mus'ab ibn al-Zubayr distributed wealth among the Qur'an-reciters of the people of Kufah when the month of Ramadan came, so he sent two thousand dirhams to Abd al-Rahman ibn Ma'qil, and said to him: Use this to help you through this month of yours, so Abd al-Rahman ibn Ma'qil returned it, and said: We did not recite the Qur'an for this.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Sa'id ne Abd al-Salam se bataya: Humein Abdullah ibn al-Walid al-Muzani ne bataya, Ubayd ibn al-Hasan se: Unhone kaha, Mus'ab ibn al-Zubayr ne Kufah walon ke Quran padhne walon mein maal taqseem kiya jab Ramzaan ka mahina aaya, to unhone Abd al-Rahman ibn Ma'qil ko do hazaar dirham bheje, aur unse kaha: Isse apne is mahine mein madad lo, to Abd al-Rahman ibn Ma'qil ne isay wapas kar diya, aur kaha: Humne Quran isliye nahi padha.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ  ، حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ  ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ عَلَيْه رضْوَانُ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى، قَالَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلَامٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ :" مَنْ أَرْبَابُ الْعِلْمِ؟ "، قَالَ : " الَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ بِمَا يَعْلَمُونَ، قَالَ : فَمَا يَنْفِي الْعِلْمَ مِنْ صُدُورِ الرِّجَالِ؟، قَالَ : الطَّمَعُ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf, from Anas ibn Iyad, from Ubaydullah ibn Umar: That Umar ibn al-Khattab رضوان الله عليه said to Abdullah ibn Salam رضي الله عنه: Who are the masters of knowledge? He said: Those who act by what they know, he asked: Then what drives knowledge away from the chests of men? He said: Greed.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf ne Anas ibn Iyad se bataya: Mujhse Ubaydullah ibn Umar ne bataya: ke Umar ibn al-Khattab رضوان الله عليه ne Abdullah ibn Salam se رضي الله عنه poocha: Ilm ke maalik kaun hain? Unhone kaha: Woh jo apne ilm par amal karte hain, unhone poocha: Fir kya cheez ilm ko aadmiyon ke seenon se nikaal deti hai? Unhone kaha: Lalach.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ زَيْدٍ ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ ، قَالَ :" مَا أَوَى شَيْءٌ إِلَى شَيْءٍ أَزْيَنَ مِنْ حِلْمٍ إِلَى عِلْمٍ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Zayd, from Ata: He said: Nothing pairs more beautifully with anything than forbearance pairing with knowledge.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se bataya: Humein Zayd ne bataya, Ata se: Unhone kaha, Kisi cheez ka kisi cheez ke saath jodna itna khoobsurat nahi jitna bardaasht ka ilm ke saath jodna.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمٌ الْأَحْوَلُ ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، قَالَ :" زَيْنُ الْعِلْمِ حِلْمُ أَهْلِهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Affan, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Asim al-Ahwal, from Amir al-Sha'bi: He said: The adornment of knowledge is the forbearance of its people.
24.hi: Affan ne Hammad ibn Salamah se bataya: Humein Asim al-Ahwal ne bataya, Amir al-Sha'bi se: Unhone kaha, Ilm ki zeenat uske logon ki bardaasht hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ ، حَدَّثَنَا زَمْعَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ وَهْرَامٍ ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ ، قَالَ :" مَا حُمِلَ الْعِلْمُ فِي مِثْلِ جِرَابِ حِلْمٍ "
24.en: Narrated by Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim, from Abd al-Rahman, from Zam'ah ibn Salih, from Salamah ibn Wahram, from Tawus: He said: Knowledge is not carried in anything better than a sack of forbearance.
24.hi: Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim ne Abd al-Rahman se bataya: Humein Zam'ah ibn Salih ne bataya, Salamah ibn Wahram se, Tawus se: Unhone kaha, Ilm ko kisi cheez mein bardaasht ke thaile jitna behtar tor par nahi le jaaya jaata.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ ، عَنْ ابْنِ شُبْرُمَةَ ،  عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ ، قَالَ :" زَيْنُ الْعِلْمِ حِلْمُ أَهْلِهِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Humayd, from Jarir, from Ibn Shubrumah, from al-Sha'bi: He said: The adornment of knowledge is the forbearance of its people.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Humayd ne Jarir se bataya: Humein Ibn Shubrumah ne bataya, al-Sha'bi se: Unhone kaha, Ilm ki zeenat uske logon ki bardaasht hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُطَرِّفُ بْنُ مَازِنٍ ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ مِقْسَمٍ ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ ، قَالَ :" إِنَّ الْحِكْمَةَ تَسْكُنُ الْقَلْبَ الْوَادِعَ السَّاكِنَ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Mutarrif ibn Mazin, from Ya'la ibn Miqsam, from Wahb ibn Munabbih: He said: Wisdom settles in the tranquil, still heart.
24.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Mutarrif ibn Mazin se bataya: Humein Ya'la ibn Miqsam ne bataya, Wahb ibn Munabbih se: Unhone kaha, Hikmat sukoon wale, shaant dil mein basti hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ  :" شِنْتُمْ الْعِلْمَ وَأَذْهَبْتُمْ نُورَهُ، وَلَوْ أَدْرَكَنِي وَإِيَّاكُمْ عُمَرُ رِضْوَانُ الله عَلَيْهِ لَأَوْجَعَنَا "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad: He said: I heard Sufyan say: Ubaydullah said: You have marred knowledge and taken away its light, and had Umar رضوان الله عليه come upon me and you, he would surely have caused us pain.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Maine Sufyan ko kehte suna: Ubaydullah ne kaha: Tumne ilm ko badsoorat bana diya aur uska noor le liya, aur agar Umar رضوان الله عليه mujhpar aur tumpar nazar daalte, to woh humein zaroor takleef pahunchaate.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا شِهَابُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ  ، عَنْ أُمَيٍّ الْمُرَادِيِّ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ عَلِيٌّ   رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ :" تَعَلَّمُوا الْعِلْمَ، فَإِذَا عَلِمْتُمُوهُ، فَاكْظِمُوا عَلَيْهِ وَلَا تَشُوبُوهُ بِضَحِكٍ، وَلَا بِلَعِبٍ فَتَمُجَّهُ الْقُلُوبُ "
24.en: Narrated by Shihab ibn Abbad, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Umayy al-Muradi: He said: Ali رضوان الله عليه said: Learn knowledge, and when you have learned it, contain yourselves upon it, and do not mix it with laughter, nor with play, or hearts will spit it out.
24.hi: Shihab ibn Abbad ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se bataya: Humein Umayy al-Muradi ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Ali (Alayhis Salam) رضوان الله عليه ne kaha: Ilm seekho, aur jab tum isay seekh lo, to isay apne andar samete rakho aur isay hansi se mat milaao, na khel se, warna dil isay thuk denge.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ  ، عَنْ الْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ غَزْوَانَ  ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ   رَحِمَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ، قَالَ :" مَنْ ضَحِكَ ضَحْكَةً مَجَّ مَجَّةً مِنْ الْعِلْمِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Humayd, from Jarir, from al-Fudayl ibn Ghazwan, from Ali ibn Husayn رحمة الله عليه: He said: Whoever laughs a laugh, spits out a spit of knowledge.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Humayd ne Jarir se bataya: Humein al-Fudayl ibn Ghazwan ne bataya, Ali ibn Husayn (Alayhis Salam) رحمة الله عليه se: Unhone kaha, Jo ek baar hanse, woh ilm ki ek thook thuk deta hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ  ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ  ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ لِكَعْبٍ   :" مَنْ أَرْبَابُ الْعِلْمِ؟، قَالَ : الَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ بِمَا يَعْلَمُونَ، قَالَ : فَمَا أَخْرَجَ الْعِلْمَ مِنْ قُلُوبِ الْعُلَمَاءِ؟، قَالَ : الطَّمَعُ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan: That Umar رضي الله عنه said to Ka'b: Who are the masters of knowledge? He said: Those who act by what they know, he asked: Then what drives knowledge out of the hearts of the scholars? He said: Greed.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se bataya: ke Umar رضي الله عنه ne Ka'b se poocha: Ilm ke maalik kaun hain? Unhone kaha: Woh jo apne ilm par amal karte hain, unhone poocha: Fir kya cheez ilm ko ulama ke dilon se nikaal deti hai? Unhone kaha: Lalach.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ ، قَالَ : كُنْتُ نَازِلًا عَلَى عَمْرِو بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ  فَأَتَاهُ رَسُولُ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ حِينَ حَضَرَهُ رَمَضَانُ بِأَلْفَيْ دِرْهَمٍ، فَقَالَ : إِنَّ الْأَمِيرَ يُقْرِئُكَ السَّلَامَ، وَقَالَ : إِنَّا لَمْ نَدَعْ قَارِئًا شَرِيفًا إِلَّا وَقَدْ وَصَلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنَّا مَعْرُوفٌ، فَاسْتَعِنْ بِهَذَيْنِ عَلَى نَفَقَةِ شَهْرِكَ هَذَا، فَقَالَ : أَقْرِئْ الْأَمِيرَ السَّلَامَ، وَقُلْ لَهُ :" إِنَّا وَاللَّهِ مَا قَرَأْنَا الْقُرْآنَ نُرِيدُ بِهِ الدُّنْيَا وَدِرْهَمَهَا "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Humayd, from Muhammad ibn Bishr, from Abdullah ibn al-Walid, from Umar ibn Ayyub, from Abu Iyas: He said: I was staying with Amr ibn al-Nu'man, so a messenger of Mus'ab ibn al-Zubayr came to him when Ramadan approached, with two thousand dirhams, and said: The governor sends you his greeting of peace, and says: We have not left any noble Qur'an-reciter without kindness reaching him from us, so use these two to help with the expense of this month of yours, so he said: Give my greeting of peace to the governor, and tell him: We, by Allah, did not recite the Qur'an wanting by it this world and its dirhams.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Humayd ne Muhammad ibn Bishr se bataya: Humein Abdullah ibn al-Walid ne bataya, Umar ibn Ayyub se, Abu Iyas se: Unhone kaha, Main Amr ibn al-Nu'man ke paas thehra hua tha, to unke paas Mus'ab ibn al-Zubayr ka ek qaasid aaya jab Ramzaan qareeb aaya, do hazaar dirham lekar, aur kaha: Ameer aapko salaam bhejte hain, aur kehte hain: Humne koi izzat wala Quran padhne wala nahi chhoda jise humse ehsaan na pahuncha ho, so in dono se apne is mahine ke kharche mein madad lo, to unhone kaha: Ameer ko mera salaam pahunchaao, aur unse kaho: Hum, Allah ki qasam, Quran isliye nahi padhte the ke hum isse duniya aur uske dirham chaahte.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَسَدُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ  ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ جَابِرٍ  ، عَنْ الْمِقْدَامِ بْنِ مَعْدِي كَرِبَ الْكِنْدِيِّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ : أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " حَرَّمَ أَشْيَاءَ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ : الْحِمَارَ وَغَيْرَهُ "، ثُمَّ قَالَ :" لَيُوشِكُ ِالرَّجُل مُتَّكِئًا عَلَى أَرِيكَتِهِ، يُحَدَّثُ بِحَدِيثِي فَيَقُولُ : بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ كِتَابُ اللَّهِ، مَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ حَلَالٍ، اسْتَحْلَلْنَاهُ، وَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ حَرَامٍ، حَرَّمْنَاهُ، أَلَا وَإِنَّ مَا حَرَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، هُوَ مِثْلُ مَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى "
24.en: Narrated by Asad ibn Musa, from Mu'awiyah, from al-Hasan ibn Jabir, from al-Miqdam ibn Ma'dikarib al-Kindi رضي الله عنه: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ made unlawful certain things on the day of Khaybar: the domestic donkey and others, then said: It is likely that a man, reclining on his couch, will be told a hadith of mine, and he will say: Between us and you is the Book of Allah, whatever we find lawful in it, we make lawful, and whatever we find unlawful in it, we make unlawful, listen, indeed what the Messenger of Allah has made unlawful, is like what Allah, exalted is He, has made unlawful.
24.hi: Asad ibn Musa ne Mu'awiyah se bataya: Humein al-Hasan ibn Jabir ne bataya, al-Miqdam ibn Ma'dikarib al-Kindi se رضي الله عنه: ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne Khaybar ke din kuch cheezein haraam kin: gharelu gadha aur doosri cheezein, fir farmaya: Qareeb hai ke ek aadmi apne takht par tekaan lagaaye baithe ho, use meri koi hadith bataayi jaaye, to woh kahe: Humare aur tumhare darmiyan Allah ki Kitaab hai, jo hum isme halal paayein, use halal karte hain, aur jo isme haraam paayein, use haraam karte hain, sun lo, jo Rasulullah ne haraam kiya hai, woh Allah Ta'ala ke haraam kiye jaise hi hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاق الْفَزَارِيِّ ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ ، قَالَ :" السُّنَّةُ قَاضِيَةٌ عَلَى الْقُرْآنِ وَلَيْسَ الْقُرْآنُ بِقَاضٍ عَلَى السُّنَّةِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Uyaynah, from Abu Ishaq al-Fazari, from al-Awza'i, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir: He said: The sunnah judges over the Qur'an, and the Qur'an does not judge over the sunnah.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Uyaynah ne Abu Ishaq al-Fazari se bataya: Humein al-Awza'i ne bataya, Yahya ibn Abi Kathir se: Unhone kaha, Sunnat Quran par faisla-kun hai, aur Quran sunnat par faisla-kun nahi hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ  ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ  ، عَنْ حَسَّانَ  ، قَالَ :" كَانَ جِبْرِيلُ يَنْزِلُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالسُّنَّةِ كَمَا يَنْزِلُ عَلَيْهِ بِالْقُرْآنِ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir, from al-Awza'i, from Hassan: He said: Jibril used to descend upon the Prophet ﷺ with the sunnah just as he would descend upon him with the Qur'an.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir ne al-Awza'i se bataya: Humein Hassan ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Jibreel Nabi ﷺ par sunnat lekar utarte the jaise woh unpar Quran lekar utarte the.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ ، عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ ، قَالَ :" السُّنَّةُ سُنَّتَانِ : سُنَّةٌ الْأَخْذُ بِهَا فَرِيضَةٌ، وَتَرْكُهَا كُفْرٌ، وَسُنَّةٌ الْأَخْذُ بِهَا فَضِيلَةٌ، وَتَرْكُهَا إِلَى غَيْرِ حَرَجٍ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Kathir, from al-Awza'i, from Makhul: He said: The sunnah is of two kinds: a sunnah that following it is obligatory, and abandoning it is disbelief, and a sunnah that following it is an excellence, and abandoning it involves no wrong.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Kathir ne al-Awza'i se bataya: Humein Makhul ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Sunnat do tarah ki hai: ek sunnat jispar amal karna farz hai, aur usay chhodna kufr hai, aur ek sunnat jispar amal karna fazeelat hai, aur usay chhodne mein koi harj nahi.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ حَكِيمٍ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ   " أَنَّهُحَدَّثَ يَوْمًا بِحَدِيثٍ عَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ : فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ مَا يُخَالِفُ هَذَا؟، قَالَ : لَا أُرَانِي أُحَدِّثُكَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَتُعَرِّضُ فِيهِ بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ، كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَعْلَمَ بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى مِنْكَ "
24.en: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Harb, from Hammad ibn Salamah, from Ya'la ibn Hakim, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr: That he narrated a hadith one day from the Prophet ﷺ, so a man said: In the Book of Allah is something that contradicts this? He said: I do not see myself narrating to you from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while you counter it with the Book of Allah, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was more knowledgeable of the Book of Allah, exalted is He, than you.
24.hi: Sulayman ibn Harb ne Hammad ibn Salamah se bataya: Humein Ya'la ibn Hakim ne bataya, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se: ke unhone ek din Nabi ﷺ se ek hadith bayaan ki, to ek aadmi ne kaha: Allah ki Kitaab mein aisi cheez hai jo isse mukhtalif hai? Unhone kaha: Mujhe nahi lagta ke main tumhein Rasulullah ﷺ se bayaan karun aur tum ismein Allah ki Kitaab se mukhaalifat karo, Rasulullah ﷺ Allah Ta'ala ki Kitaab ko tumse zyada jaante the.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ  ، عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ أَنَّهُ، قَالَ :" إِذَا حُدِّثْتُمْ بِالْحَدِيثِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَظُنُّوا بِهِ الَّذِي هُوَ أَهْيَأُ، وَالَّذِي هُوَ أَهْدَى، وَالَّذِي هُوَ أَتْقَى "
24.en: Narrated by Nu'aym ibn Hammad, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Ajlan, from Awn ibn Abdullah, from Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه: That he said: When you are told a hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, think of him in the way that is most fitting, and most guided, and most God-fearing.
24.hi: Nu'aym ibn Hammad ne Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad se bataya: Humein Ibn Ajlan ne bataya, Awn ibn Abdullah se, Ibn Mas'ud se رضي الله عنه: ke unhone kaha: Jab tumhein Rasulullah ﷺ se koi hadith bataayi jaaye, to unke baare mein woh khayal karo jo sabse munaasib, aur sabse hidayat wala, aur sabse taqwa wala ho.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ  ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي الْبَخْتَرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيِّ  ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" إِذَا حُدِّثْتُمْ شَيْئًا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَظُنُّوا بِهِ الَّذِي هُوَ أَهْدَى، وَالَّذِي هُوَ أَتْقَى، وَالَّذِي هُوَ أَهْيَأُ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Mis'ar, from Amr ibn Murrah, from Abu al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Sulami, from Ali رضي الله عنه: He said: When you are told something from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, think of him in the way that is most guided, and most God-fearing, and most fitting.
24.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Mis'ar se bataya: Humein Amr ibn Murrah ne bataya, Abu al-Bakhtari se, Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Sulami se, Ali (Alayhis Salam) se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Jab tumhein Rasulullah ﷺ se koi baat bataayi jaaye, to unke baare mein woh khayal karo jo sabse hidayat wala, aur sabse taqwa wala, aur sabse munaasib ho.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ  ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ عُمَرَ  ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ كُلَيْبٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ : كَانَ إِذَا حَدَّثَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :" مَنْ كَذَبَ عَلَيَّ مُتَعَمِّدًا، فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنْ النَّارِ "، فَكَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ إِذَا حَدَّثَ قَالَ : إِذَا سَمِعْتُمُونِي أُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَلَمْ تَجِدُوهُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ، أَوْ حَسَنًا عِنْدَ النَّاسِ، فَاعْلَمُوا أَنِّي قَدْ كَذَبْتُ عَلَيْهِ
24.en: Narrated by Abu Ma'mar Isma'il ibn Ibrahim, from Salih ibn Umar, from Asim ibn Kulayb, from his father, from Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه: He said: When he narrated from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he would say: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Whoever lies about me deliberately, let him take his seat in the Fire, so Ibn Abbas, when he narrated, would say: When you hear me narrating from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and you do not find it in the Book of Allah, or considered good by people, then know that I have lied about him.
24.hi: Abu Ma'mar Isma'il ibn Ibrahim ne Salih ibn Umar se bataya: Humein Asim ibn Kulayb ne bataya, apne walid se, Abu Hurairah se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Jab woh Rasulullah ﷺ se riwaayat karte, kehte: Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya, Jo mujhpar jaan-boojh kar jhoot bole, woh apni jagah Jahannam mein banaa le, to Ibn Abbas, jab woh riwaayat karte, kehte: Jab tum mujhe Rasulullah ﷺ se riwaayat karte suno, aur tumhein yeh Allah ki Kitaab mein na mile, ya log ise achha na samjhein, to jaan lo ke maine aapper jhoot bola hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الْأَحْوَلِ ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ ، قَالَ : " إِنَّأَزْهَدَ النَّاسِ فِي عَالِمٍ أَهْلُهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Imran, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Sulayman al-Ahwal, from Ikrimah: He said: The most detached from a scholar are his own family.
24.hi: Abdullah ibn Imran ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se bataya: Humein Sulayman al-Ahwal ne bataya, Ikrimah se: Unhone kaha, Kisi aalim se sabse zyada be-parwaah uske apne gharwale hote hain.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَسَدُ بْنُ مُوسَى  ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ  ، عَنْ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ  ، وَأَبِي مَسْلَمَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ  ،  عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ :" تَذَاكَرُوا الْحَدِيثَ، فَإِنَّ الْحَدِيثَ يُهَيِّجُ الْحَدِيثَ "
24.en: Narrated by Asad ibn Musa, from Shu'bah, from al-Jurayri, and Abu Maslamah, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri رضي الله عنه: He said: Discuss hadith among yourselves, for hadith stirs up more hadith.
24.hi: Asad ibn Musa ne Shu'bah se bataya: Humein al-Jurayri, aur Abu Maslamah ne bataya, Abu Nadrah se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Hadith par aapas mein baatchit karo, kyunki hadith doosri hadith ko jagaati hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ  ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" تَذَاكَرُوا الْحَدِيثَ، فَإِنَّ الْحَدِيثَ يُهَيِّجُ الْحَدِيثَ "
24.en: Narrated by Abu Nu'aym, from Abu Awanah, from Abu Bishr, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri رضي الله عنه: He said: Discuss hadith among yourselves, for hadith stirs up more hadith.
24.hi: Abu Nu'aym ne Abu Awanah se bataya: Humein Abu Bishr ne bataya, Abu Nadrah se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Hadith par aapas mein baatchit karo, kyunki hadith doosri hadith ko jagaati hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ  ، عَنْ هُشَيْمٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ  ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْريَّ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" تَذَاكَرُوا الْحَدِيثَ، فَإِنَّ الْحَدِيثَ يُهَيِّجُ الْحَدِيثَ "، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ  ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ  ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ  ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ  ، عَن أَبِي سَعِيدٍ  ، وَابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ  ، عَنْ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ  ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ  ، عَن أَبِي سَعِيدٍ  ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مَسْلَمَةَ  يُعْنِي، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ  ، عَن أَبي سَعيدٍ  ، وَفِيهِ كَلَامٌ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ هَذَا
24.en: Narrated by Abu Ma'mar, from Hushaym, from Abu Bishr, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri رضي الله عنه; parallel chains also given: He said: Discuss hadith among yourselves, for hadith stirs up more hadith. [Narrated by Abu Ma'mar, from Abu Mu'awiyah, from al-A'mash, from Abu Bishr, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id, and from Ibn Ulayyah, from al-Jurayri, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id, and narrated by Abu Maslamah, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id, with more discussion than this in it.]
24.hi: Abu Ma'mar ne Hushaym se bataya: Humein Abu Bishr ne bataya, Abu Nadrah se, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Hadith par aapas mein baatchit karo, kyunki hadith doosri hadith ko jagaati hai. [Isi jaisi riwayat Abu Ma'mar se, Abu Mu'awiyah se, al-A'mash se, Abu Bishr se, Abu Nadrah se, Abu Sa'id se, aur Ibn Ulayyah se, al-Jurayri se, Abu Nadrah se, Abu Sa'id se bhi aayi hai, aur Abu Maslamah se, Abu Nadrah se, Abu Sa'id se, jisme isse zyada baatchit hai.]

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو ، قَالَ : قَالَ لِي طَاوُسٌ  :" اذْهَبْ بِنَا نُجَالِسْ النَّاسَ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Sufyan, from Amr: He said: Tawus said to me: Let us go and sit with people.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein Amr ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Tawus ne mujhse kaha: Chalo, hum logon ke saath baithein.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ أَبَانَ  ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْقُمِّيُّ  ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ  ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ :" تَذَاكَرُوا هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ لَا يَنْفَلِتْ مِنْكُمْ، فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِثْلَ الْقُرْآنِ مَجْمُوعٌ مَحْفُوظٌ، وَإِنَّكُمْ إِنْ لَمْ تَذَاكَرُوا هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ يَنْفَلِتْ مِنْكُمْ، وَلَا يَقُولَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ حَدَّثْتُ أَمْسِ فَلَا أُحَدِّثُ الْيَوْمَ، بَلْ حَدِّثْ أَمْسِ، وَلْتُحَدِّثْ الْيَوْمَ، وَلْتُحَدِّثْ غَدًا "
24.en: Narrated by Isma'il ibn Aban, from Ya'qub ibn Abdullah al-Qummi, from Ja'far ibn Abi al-Mughirah, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه: He said: Discuss this hadith so that it does not slip away from you, for it is not, like the Qur'an, collected and preserved, and if you do not discuss this hadith, it will slip away from you, and let none of you say: I narrated yesterday so I will not narrate today, rather, narrate yesterday, and let one narrate today, and let one narrate tomorrow.
24.hi: Isma'il ibn Aban ne Ya'qub ibn Abdullah al-Qummi se bataya: Humein Ja'far ibn Abi al-Mughirah ne bataya, Sa'id ibn Jubayr se, Ibn Abbas se رضي الله عنه: Unhone kaha, Is hadith par baatchit karo taake yeh tumse phisal na jaaye, kyunki yeh Quran ki tarah jama aur mehfooz nahi hai, aur agar tum is hadith par baatchit nahi karoge to yeh tumse phisal jaayegi, aur tum mein se koi na kahe: Maine kal riwaayat ki so main aaj riwaayat nahi karunga, balke, kal bhi riwaayat karo, aur aaj bhi riwaayat karo, aur kal bhi riwaayat karo.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيل  ، حَدَّثَنَا مِنْدَلُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ  ، حَدَّثَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمُغِيرَةِ  ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ  ، قَالَ : قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ   رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ :" رُدُّوا الْحَدِيثَ وَاسْتَذْكِرُوهُ، فَإِنَّهُ إِنْ لَمْ تَذْكُرُوهُ، ذَهَبَ، وَلَا يَقُولَنَّ رَجُلٌ لِحَدِيثٍ قَدْ حَدَّثَهُ قَدْ حَدَّثْتُهُ مَرَّةً، فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ كَانَ سَمِعَهُ يَزْدَادُ بِهِ عِلْمًا، وَيَسْمَعُ مَنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْ "
24.en: Narrated by Malik ibn Isma'il, from Mandal ibn Ali, from Ja'far ibn Abi al-Mughirah, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr: He said: Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه said: Repeat hadith and recall it, for if you do not recall it, it will go away, and let no man say about a hadith he has narrated: I have already narrated it once, for whoever had already heard it increases in knowledge by it, and whoever had not heard it hears it.
24.hi: Malik ibn Isma'il ne Mandal ibn Ali se bataya: Mujhse Ja'far ibn Abi al-Mughirah ne bataya: Mujhse Sa'id ibn Jubayr ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Ibn Abbas رضي الله عنه ne kaha: Hadith dohraao aur usay yaad karo, kyunki agar tum usay yaad nahi karoge, woh chali jaayegi, aur koi aadmi ek hadith ke baare mein jise usne bayaan kiya hai yeh na kahe ke maine isay ek baar bayaan kar diya, kyunki jisne isse pehle suna tha usse isse ilm badhta hai, aur jisne nahi suna woh isay sunta hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى ، قَالَ :" تَذَاكَرُوا، فَإِنَّ إِحْيَاءَ الْحَدِيثِ مُذَاكَرَتُهُ "
24.en: Narrated by al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak, from Abu Awanah, from Yazid ibn Abi Ziyad, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla: He said: Discuss it among yourselves, for reviving hadith is discussing it.
24.hi: Al-Hakam ibn al-Mubarak ne Abu Awanah se bataya: Humein Yazid ibn Abi Ziyad ne bataya, Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla se: Unhone kaha, Aapas mein baatchit karo, kyunki hadith ko zinda rakhna hai isper baatchit karna.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا قَبِيصَةُ ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ ، قَالَا : حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ ، قَالَ :" تَذَاكَرُوا الْحَدِيثَ، فَإِنَّ ذِكْرَهُ حَيَاتُهُ "
24.en: Narrated by Qabisah, and Muhammad ibn Yusuf, from Sufyan, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah: He said: Discuss hadith among yourselves, for its being discussed is its life.
24.hi: Qabisah, aur Muhammad ibn Yusuf ne Sufyan se bataya: Humein al-A'mash ne bataya, Ibrahim se, Alqamah se: Unhone kaha, Hadith par aapas mein baatchit karo, kyunki iska zikr hi iski zindagi hai.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ قُدَامَةَ ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ، قَالَ :" كَانَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ يُحَدِّثُ الْأَعْرَابَ "
24.en: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Qudamah, from Sufyan ibn Uyaynah, from Ziyad ibn Sa'd: He said: Ibn Shihab used to narrate hadith to the Bedouins.
24.hi: Muhammad ibn Qudamah ne Sufyan ibn Uyaynah se bataya: Humein Ziyad ibn Sa'd ne bataya: Unhone kaha, Ibn Shihab Bedouin logon ko hadith bataate the.

24.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، أَنْبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ ، عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ ، قَالَ :" كَانَ إِسْمَاعِيل بْنُ رَجَاءٍ يَجْمَعُ صِبْيَانَ الْكُتَّابِ يُحَدِّثُهُمْ يَتَحَفَّظُ بِذَاكَ "
