And they were, because of it, upon a beacon of a clear path, and the Qur'an was the guide of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was a guide for his Companions, and his Companions were guides for those after them: known men, attributed to their lands, agreed in refuting the people of desires despite the differences among themselves, while the people of desires wandered by their own opinion into different paths, deviating from the intended course, departing from the straight path, so their guides led them astray into misguiding wastelands, and they went further into them, wandering aimlessly in their bewilderment, every time Shaytan introduced for them a new innovation in their misguidance, they moved from it to another, because they did not seek the traces of those who came before, and did not follow the example of the Emigrants, and it has been mentioned about Umar that he said to Ziyad: Do you know what destroys Islam? The slip of a scholar, and the argument of a hypocrite using the Qur'an, and misguiding leaders, fear Allah, and beware of what has newly arisen among your Qur'an-reciters and the people of your mosques of backbiting, and slander, and walking among people with two faces and two tongues, and it has been mentioned that whoever is two-faced in this world, will be two-faced in the Fire, the one given to backbiting meets you, and backbites in your presence someone he thinks you would love to hear backbitten, and then goes against you to your companion, and brings him the same about you, so he attains, with each of you, his own need, and it is hidden from each of you what he brought to the other, his presence with whoever he is present with is the presence of brothers, and his absence from whoever he is absent from is the absence of enemies, whoever among them is present has special favor, and whoever among them is absent has no protection, he causes trial for whoever is present through flattery, and backbites whoever is absent through slander, so O servants of Allah, is there not among the people any rightly-guided one, nor any reformer, to suppress this from his scheming, and turn him away from the honor of his Muslim brother? Rather, he has come to know their desires in what he brings to them, so he has gained power over them, and they have enabled him to get what he wants, so he consumes with his religion along with their religions, so, for Allah's sake, for Allah's sake, defend the honor of those absent among you, and restrain your tongues from them except for good, and give sincere advice to Allah regarding your nation, since you are the bearers of the Book and the sunnah, for the Book does not speak until it is spoken by, and the sunnah is not acted upon until it is acted by, so when will the ignorant learn if the scholar is silent, neither denouncing what has appeared, nor commanding what has been abandoned? Allah has indeed taken a covenant from those given the Book that they will make it clear to the people and not conceal it, fear Allah, for you are in a time in which scrupulousness has grown thin, and humility has become scarce, and knowledge has been carried by those who corrupt it, so they love to be known for carrying it, and dislike to be known for wasting it, so they spoke about it out of desire because of the error they introduced into it, and they twisted words away from the truth they abandoned toward the falsehood they practiced, so their sins are sins for which no forgiveness is sought, and their shortcomings are shortcomings that are not acknowledged, how can the one seeking guidance be guided by a guide if the guide himself is bewildered? They loved this world, but disliked the status of its people, so they shared in the [worldly] living but distanced themselves in speech, and defended themselves in speech from being attributed to their [true] deeds, so they neither disavowed what they denied, nor entered into what they attributed to themselves, because the one who acts by the truth speaks even while silent, and it has been mentioned that Allah, exalted is He, says: I do not accept all of the wise person's speech, but I look at his concern and his desire, so if his concern and his desire are for Me, I make his silence praise and dignity for Me, even if he does not speak, and Allah, exalted is He, said: 'The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah and then did not uphold it is like that of a donkey who carries volumes [of books]' [Surah al-Jumu'ah, verse 5]: meaning books, and He said: 'Take what We have given you with determination' [Surah al-Baqarah, verse 63], he said: [Meaning] acting by what is in it, and do not content yourselves regarding the sunnah with merely claiming it in word without acting by it, for claiming the sunnah without acting by it is a lie in speech along with wasting the deed, and do not find fault with innovations to adorn yourselves by finding fault with them, for the corruption of the people of innovations does not add to your own righteousness, and do not find fault with them out of transgression against their people, for transgression is part of the corruption of your own souls, and it is not fitting for a physician to treat the sick with something that cures them but sickens himself, for if he becomes sick, he becomes occupied with his sickness away from treating them, but rather he should seek health for himself so that he may be strong enough to treat the sick with it, so let your affair, in what you disapprove of among your brothers, be a matter of looking after yourselves, and sincere advice from you to your Lord, and compassion from you toward your brothers, and that you be, along with that, more concerned with your own faults than with the faults of others, and that each of you draw sincere advice from the other, and that whoever offers it to you and accepts it from you should have a special place with you, and Umar ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه indeed said: May Allah have mercy on whoever presents me my faults, you love to speak and have it be tolerated of you, but if something like what you said is said to you, you become angry, you hold against people what you disapprove of in their affairs, yet you commit the like of it yourselves, do you not then wish that it be held against you too? Suspect your own opinion and the opinion of the people of your time, and be firm before you speak, and learn before you act, for a time will come in which truth and falsehood will resemble each other, and what is right will become wrong in it, and what is wrong will become right in it, so how many draw near to Allah by that which distances them, and endear themselves to Him by that which angers Him against them, Allah, exalted is He, said: 'Then is one whose evil deed has been made attractive to him so he considers it good...' [Surah Fatir, verse 8], so you must stop at ambiguities until clear truth becomes manifest to you with evidence, for the one who enters into what he does not know without knowledge is sinful, and whoever looks out for Allah's sake, Allah looks out for him, hold to the Qur'an, and follow it as your imam, and lead by it, and hold to seeking the traces of those who came before in it, and had the rabbis and monks not feared the loss of their positions, and the corruption of their standing, by upholding the Book through their deeds, and clarifying what they had distorted, and not concealing it, but rather, when they opposed the Book with their deeds, they sought to deceive their people about what they had done, out of fear that their positions would be corrupted, and that their corruption would become clear to the people, so they distorted the Book through interpretation, and whatever they could not distort, they concealed, and so they remained silent about their own conduct to preserve their positions, and remained silent about what their people did, currying favor with them, and Allah has indeed taken a covenant from those given the Book that they will make it clear to the people and not conceal it, but rather they colluded regarding it and made it seem trivial to their people.
24.hi: Abd al-Malik ibn Sulayman Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Antaki ne Abbad ibn Abbad al-Khawwas al-Shami Abu Utbah se bataya: Unhone kaha, Amma ba'd, apni aqal ka istemaal karo, aur aqal ek ne'mat hai, kyunki kai aqalmand log aise hain jinke dil un cheezon mein zyada gehraai mein jaane se mashghool ho jaate hain jo unhein nuqsaan pahunchaati hain, us cheez se faida uthaane se door jo unhein zaroorat hai, yahan tak ke woh isse ghaafil ho jaate hain, aur aadmi ki aqal ki fazeelat mein se yeh hai ke woh unn cheezon mein gaur karna chhod de jinme gaur nahi karna chaahiye, taake uski aqal ki ziyaadti usper museebat na ban jaaye, apne se neeche walon se neik amal mein muqaabla chhodne mein - ya woh aadmi jiska dil kisi bidat mein mashghool ho jaaye jismein usne apne deen ko Rasulullah ﷺ ke sahaba ke bajaaye kuch aadmiyon ka taabey banaaya ho, ya apni raay par hi qanaat kar li ho ek aise maamle mein jismein woh sirf isi mein hidayat dekhta ho, aur isse chhodne mein hi gumraahi dekhta ho, dawa karte hue ke usne isay Quran se liya hai jabke woh Quran se alag hone ki taraf bula raha hai, kya usse pehle aur uske sathiyon se pehle Quran ke uthaane wale nahi the jo iske mohkam par amal karte the, aur iske mutashaabih par imaan laate the? Aur woh, isi ki wajah se, seedhi raah ke ek roshan noor par the, aur Quran Rasulullah ﷺ ka rahnuma tha, aur Rasulullah ﷺ apne sahaba ke liye rahnuma the, aur unke sahaba unke baad walon ke liye rahnuma the: maaruf log, apne shehron se mansoob, ittefaaq rakhte the khwaahishaat waalon ke khilaaf, apne aapas ke ikhtilaaf ke bawajood, jabke khwaahishaat waale apni raay se alag-alag raaston mein bhatakte rahe, sahi raaste se hatkar, seedhe raaste se alag hokar, so unke rahnumaon ne unhein gumraah karne wale weeranon mein gumraah kar diya, aur woh isme aur gehre chale gaye, apni hairaani mein bhatakte hue, jab bhi shaytan unke liye unki gumraahi mein koi nayi bidat laata, woh isse ek se doosri taraf jaate, kyunki unhone pehlon ke nishaanaat talaash nahi kiye, aur Muhajireen ki misaal ki pairvi nahi ki, aur Umar ke baare mein zikr kiya gaya hai ke unhone Ziyad se kaha: Kya tumhein maloom hai Islam ko kya barbaad karta hai? Aalim ki lagzish, aur munafiq ka Quran se jhagda, aur gumraah karne wale peshwaain, Allah se daro, aur apne Quran padhne walon aur apni masjidon walon mein jo naya paida hua hai us gheebat, chughli, aur logon ke darmiyan do chehron aur do zubaanon ke saath chalne se bacho, aur zikr kiya gaya hai ke jo duniya mein do-mundha ho, woh Jahannam mein bhi do-mundha hoga, gheebat wala aapse milta hai, aur aapke saamne uski gheebat karta hai jise woh samajhta hai ke aap uski gheebat sunna pasand karenge, fir woh aapke khilaaf aapke saathi ke paas jaata hai, aur usse aapke baare mein wahi laata hai, so woh, tum dono mein se har ek ke paas, apni zaroorat poori kar leta hai, aur tum dono mein se har ek se yeh chhupaa hota hai ke usne doosre ke paas kya laaya, uska haazir hona jiske paas woh haazir ho, bhaaiyon ke haazir hone jaisa hai, aur uska ghair-haazir hona jisse woh ghair-haazir ho, dushmanon ke ghair-haazir hone jaisa hai, unmein se jo haazir ho use tarjeeh milti hai, aur jo ghair-haazir ho use koi hifaazat nahi milti, woh haazir ko tareef se fitne mein daalta hai, aur ghair-haazir ki chughli se gheebat karta hai, so Ae Allah ke bando, kya log mein koi hidayat-yaafta ya sudhaarne wala nahi jo isse iski chaal se roke, aur usse uske Musalman bhai ki izzat se hataaye? Balke, usne unki khwaahishaat ko jaan liya hai jinhein woh unke paas laata hai, so usne unpar qaboo paa liya hai, aur unhone usay uski zaroorat poori karne ka mauka diya hai, so woh apne deen ke saath unke deenon ko bhi khaata hai, so, Allah ke liye, Allah ke liye, apne ghair-haazir logon ki izzat ki hifaazat karo, aur apni zubaanon ko unse rokho siwaay bhalaai ke, aur apni ummat ke baare mein Allah ke liye khair-khwaahi rakho, kyunki tum Kitaab aur sunnat ke uthaane wale ho, kyunki Kitaab tab tak nahi bolti jab tak use bola na jaaye, aur sunnat tab tak amal mein nahi aati jab tak usper amal na kiya jaaye, so jaahil kab seekhega agar aalim khamosh ho, na jo zaahir hua use inkaar kare, na jo chhoda gaya use hukum de? Allah ne unse jinhein Kitaab di gayi thi ahad liya hai ke woh isse logon ke liye wazeh karenge aur ise chhupaayenge nahi, Allah se daro, kyunki tum aise zamane mein ho jismein taqwa patla ho gaya hai, aur khushu' (dil ki tawajjuh) kam ho gaya hai, aur ilm ko uske bigaadne walon ne uthaaya hai, so unhein pasand hai ke woh ise uthaane ke liye jaane jaayein, aur unhein na-pasand hai ke woh ise zaya karne ke liye jaane jaayein, so unhone isme khwaahish se baat ki us ghalti ki wajah se jo unhone isme daali, aur unhone kalimon ko us haq se hataaya jo unhone chhoda, us baatil ki taraf jispar unhone amal kiya, so unke gunah aise gunah hain jinke liye maghfirat nahi maangi jaati, aur unki kami aisi kami hai jise maana nahi jaata, hidayat talaash karne wala kaise hidayat paaye agar rahnuma khud hairaan ho? Unhone duniya se mohabbat ki, lekin uske logon ki haisiyat ko na-pasand kiya, so woh [duniyavi] zindagi mein unke saath shaamil hue lekin baaton mein alag rahe, aur baaton se apne aap ko is se bachaaya ke unke amal ki taraf unhein mansoob kiya jaaye, so na unhone jo inkaar kiya usse alagi zaahir ki, na unhone us cheez mein dakhil hue jo unhone apni taraf mansoob ki, kyunki haq par amal karne wala bolta hai chahe woh khamosh hi kyun na ho, aur zikr kiya gaya hai ke Allah Ta'ala farmaata hai: Main hikmat waale ka har kalaam qabool nahi karta, lekin main uski fikr aur uski khwaahish dekhta hoon, so agar uski fikr aur uski khwaahish mere liye hon, main uski khamoshi ko meri hamd aur waqar bana deta hoon, chahe woh baat na kare, aur Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: 'Un logon ki misaal jinhein Taurat ki zimmedaari di gayi fir unhone isse na uthaaya, gadhe ki misaal jaisi hai jo kitaabein uthaata hai' [Surah Al-Jumu'ah, aayat 5]: yaani kitaabein, aur usne farmaya: 'Jo humne tumhein diya use mazbooti se pakdo' [Surah Al-Baqarah, aayat 63], unhone kaha: [Yaani] isme jo hai uspar amal karna, aur sunnat ke baare mein sirf zubaan se dawa karne par hi qanaat mat karo bina isper amal kiye, kyunki bina amal ke sunnat ka dawa karna baaton mein jhoot hai amal ki barbaadi ke saath, aur bidaton mein aib mat nikaalo apne aap ko unmein aib nikaalkar sajaane ke liye, kyunki bidat waalon ki kharaabi tumhari apni theek-thaak mein izaafa nahi karti, aur unhein unke logon ke khilaaf zulm karke aib mat nikaalo, kyunki zulm tumhari apni jaanon ki kharaabi ka hissa hai, aur vaidya ke liye munaasib nahi ke woh bimaaron ka ilaaj aisi cheez se kare jo unhein theek kare lekin usay khud bimaar kar de, kyunki agar woh bimaar ho jaata hai, to woh apni bimaari mein mashghool ho jaata hai unke ilaaj se door, balke usay apne liye sehat talaash karni chaahiye taake woh isse bimaaron ke ilaaj ke liye taaqatwar ho, so tumhara maamla, jo tum apne bhaaiyon mein na-pasand karte ho, usme apne aap ka khayal rakhna, aur apne Rab ke liye khair-khwaahi karna, aur apne bhaaiyon par reham karna hona chaahiye, aur ke tum, iske saath saath, apni khaamiyon se doosron ki khaamiyon se zyada mutalliq ho, aur ke tum mein se har ek doosre se khair-khwaahi le, aur ke jo tumhein isse pesh kare aur tumse ise qabool kare use tumhare nazdeek khaas jagah mile, aur Umar ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه ne kaha hai: Allah reham kare us par jo mujhe meri khaamiyaan bataaye, tum baat karna pasand karte ho aur chaahte ho ke tumhare liye isse bardaasht kiya jaaye, lekin agar tumhein wahi baat kahi jaaye jo tumne kahi, tum naaraz ho jaate ho, tum logon par unke maamlon mein jo na-pasand karte ho uska bura maanate ho, lekin tum khud isi jaisa karte ho, kya tum nahi chaahte ke tumhare khilaaf bhi aisa hi liya jaaye? Apni raay aur apne zamane ke logon ki raay par shak karo, aur baat karne se pehle sthir raho, aur amal karne se pehle seekho, kyunki aisa waqt aayega jismein haq aur baatil ek jaise lagenge, aur jo achha hai woh isme bura ban jaayega, aur jo bura hai woh isme achha ban jaayega, so kitne hi log Allah ke qareeb aane ki koshish karte hain us cheez se jo unhein door kar deti hai, aur usse mohabbat jataate hain us cheez se jo usay unpar naaraz kar deti hai, Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: 'To kya woh jiske liye uske bure amal ko khoobsurat banaaya gaya to woh isay achha samajhta hai...' [Surah Fatir, aayat 8], so tumhein shubhaat par rukna chaahiye jab tak tumhare liye saaf haq wazeh saboot ke saath zaahir na ho, kyunki jo bagair ilm ke us cheez mein dakhil ho jo woh nahi jaanta, woh gunahgaar hai, aur jo Allah ke liye dekhta hai, Allah uske liye dekhta hai, Quran ko pakdo, aur isi ki pairvi karo apne imam ki tarah, aur isi se rahnumaayi lo, aur ismein pehlon ke nishaan talaash karne ko pakdo, aur agar rabbaani aur sannyaasi apne darjay ke khone aur apni haisiyat ki kharaabi se na darte, apne amal se Kitaab ko qaayam karke, aur usse wazeh karke jo unhone galat baayaan kiya tha, aur ise chhupaaye bagair, lekin jab unhone apne amal se Kitaab ki mukhaalifat ki, unhone apni qaum ko dhoka dene ki koshish ki us baare mein jo unhone kiya, is dar se ke unke darjay kharaab ho jaayein, aur ke unki kharaabi logon ke saamne zaahir ho jaaye, to unhone Kitaab ko tafseer ke zariye galat baayaan kiya, aur jo woh galat baayaan na kar sake, use chhupaaya, so woh apne kartoot ke baare mein khamosh rahe apne darjay bachaane ke liye, aur woh chup rahe jo unki qaum ne kiya, unse khushaamad karte hue, aur Allah ne unse jinhein Kitaab di gayi thi ahad liya hai ke woh isse logon ke liye wazeh karenge aur ise chhupaayenge nahi, balke unhone isme mil-jul kar aur apni qaum ke liye isay mamooli banaakar dikhaaya.
